tulanā--atha nānātve buddhīnāṃ pratiparamāṇu tāvatyo buddhaya iti paramāṇugrahaṇaprasaṅgo'nekapratipattyaprasaṅgaśca parasparamapratipatterabhāvāt ca khalu svasaṃviditānāṃ nānātvapratipattiḥ santānāntarasyāpi pratibhāsaprasaṅgāt...

yadi punaḥ ekānekavikalpaśūnyaṃ tadiṣyate; tarhi pratibhāsā'sūnya meveṣya tām
grāhakābhāva ubhayatrādya nīlādyākāraistadiṣyate; tarhi mecakamaṇidarśanasamaye nīlādyākārāṇāṃ parasparamadarśane santānāntarāṇāmiva abhāvaḥ
teṣāṃ tathā'darśane'pi sattve na paralokādiniṣedhaikānta iti kathumu — tena svarūpavadanyadastīti tadeva sarvamiti tajjānan sarvajñaḥ iti

syānmatam--nyāyonyaṃ tadākārāṇāṃ darśanaṃ nāpyadarśanamiti; tadapi na sūkaṃ svarūpe'pi tathā prasaṅgāt
tasya darśanānneti cet; anyaviviktadarśane ukto doṣaḥ

atha tena anyasya adarśanam; kathaṃ tad anyaviviktatāmātmano'vaiti ? kathaṃ prakṛtipuruṣādīnāmadarśane nīlādestadviviktatāpratītiḥ, kathaṃ vā sukhādeḥ ātmaśūnyatāvittiḥ, yato nairātmyadarśanam ? teṣāṃ darśane susthitamadvaitam ! adarśanādeva tadabhāva iti cet; kimidaṃ tadadarśanam ? darśananivṛttiriti; kathamapratītā sā asti prakṛtyādivat ? nīlādidarśanaṃ tadadarśanamiti cet; kathamanyadarśanam anyādarśanaṃ virodhāt ? anyaviviktarūpatvāccet; prakṛtyādīnāmadarśane keyaṃ tadviviktatā'sya ? anyathā vītādīnāmadarśane'pi nīlasya tadviviktatāpratītiriti kathanna prakṛto doṣaḥ ? nanu ca anīlavyāvṛttirnīlam, anīlābhāve kathaṃ tadvyāvṛttiḥ, evaṃ pītādau vaktavyamiti cet ? tarhi asvasaṃvedanavyāvṛttiḥ svasaṃvedanaṃ tasyā'svasaṃvedanasyābhāve tadapi mābhūt
bhavatu vā, tathāpi mecake nīlādīnāmiva nīlamātre'pi tadvibhāgaḥcintāyāṃ tadavastho doṣaḥ
nanu yata eva citraikajñānavannīlamātramapi na ghaṭate tata eva tadapi paramārthato mābhūt marīcikātoyavat māyāmarīcipratibhāsavadasattve'pyadoṣaḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
atha nīlamātraṃ svabhāgairekamiṣyate; tathā mecakamapi nīlādibhirekamiṣyatām
iṣyata eva citrapratibhāsāpyekaiva buddhirbāhyacitravilakṣaṇatvāt pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3

3 iti vakṣyamāṇatvādatraiva tatkathaṃ sā pramāṇamiti cet ? etaduttaratra nirūpayiṣyate
tatra atiśaye tāvat anyasyāpi jīvāditattvasya niścayaṃ vakṣye siddhestu sātiśayaṃ vakṣye
ko'syāatiśayaḥ sakalaprameyavyavasthāhetutvam, yadvakṣyate--siddhaṃ yanna parāpekṣyam siddhivi॰ 1
tathā prakarṣe; tasyāḥ prakṛṣṭaṃ niścayaṃ viniścayaṃ vakṣye
tathā dvaividhye; dvividhaṃ niścayaṃ tasyā vakṣye pratyakṣaparokṣabhedena kiñcat svataḥ kiñcit parataḥ pramāṇam ityanena vā bhedena, svaparaviṣayadvaividhyena, vyavahitāvyavahitaphaladvaividhyena vā
nanu ca nayādīnāmapi viniścayo'tra pratipādayiṣyate tatkathamucyate siddheḥ pramāṇasya iti cet; na; teṣāṃ śrutabhedena tatraivāntarbhāvāt
laghī॰ ślo॰ 62 na ca pramāṇasya upayogo'pramāṇam; virodhāt, pramāṇanayairadhigamaḥ ta॰ sū॰ 1
pramāṇairadhigamavat tarhi vaktavyamiti cet; na; vikalādeśasyāpi tadbhedatvapratipādanārthaṃ tathāvacanamityadoṣaḥ
tataḥ prameyanirṇayahetutvāt pramāṇanayānāṃ pramāṇatve samāne'pi sakalādeśāt nayanivāryamāṇa pramāṇaśabdaḥ tatraiva pravartate utkalitapuṃskeṣu viśeṣeṣu gośabdavat
pramāṇācca nayasya bhedaikānte pra mā ṇa saṃ gra hā dau pramāṇe iti saṃgrahaḥ pramāṇasaṃ॰ ślo॰ 2 ityabhidhāya punarṇayādipraṇayanamayuktaṃ tenāsaṃgrahāt
tato yathā anyatra pramāṇāt nayādiparigrahaḥ tathā atrāpi, iti sarvaṃ sustham
nanu siddhiḥ adhigatiḥ pramāṇaphalam, tasyā viniścayaṃ nirṇayātmakatvaṃ vakṣye iti vyākhyāne ko doṣaḥ yenedaṃ nāśritamiti cet ? sarvārthāsaṃgrahaḥ
evaṃ hi phalavipratipattinirāsa eva saṃgṛhīto na sarvān prativādinaḥ prati svarūpādivipratipattinirāsaḥ, tataḥ pūrvameva vyākhyānam

nanu śāstravad abhidheyasyāpi prayojanaṃ pṛthageva vaktavyam kākadantavadaprayojanāśaṅkāniṣedhārthaṃ yathā anyatroktam--pramāṇādhīnatvāt prameyavyavasthāyāḥ tadvyutpādanārthamidamucyate iti cet; na; siddhiśabdenaiva tadapyuktam
yasmādayaṃ pramāṇāphalavācinaṃ siddhiśabdamupacārāt pravartayati tasmāduktameva phalam, mukhyādṛte upacārābhāvā diti
sambandhādyanubandhacatuṣṭayasya vyastasamastarūpeṇa carcā ninnalikhitagrantheṣu draṣṭavyā--mādhyamikavṛ॰ pṛ॰ 3
anukteṣu tu pratipattṛbhiḥ niṣprayojanamabhidheyaṃ saṃbhāvyetāsya prakaraṇasya kākadantaparīkṣāyā iva
aśakyānuṣṭhānaṃ vā jvaraharatakṣakacūḍāratnālaṅkāropadeśavat, anabhimataṃ vā prayojanaṃ mātṛvivāhakramopadeśavat
tasmāt prayojanarahitaṃ vākyaṃ tadartho vā na tat prekṣāvatā ārabhyate kartuṃ pratipādayituṃ vā, tadyathā daśadāḍimādivākyam
uktaṃ ca pramāṇādhīno hi prameyādhigamaḥ--pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 340
kṛṣīvalādivat arthasandehāt prekṣāpūrvakāriṇo'pi tadvākyāt pravarttante ityeke
sandehāt pravṛttau kimanyatrāpi pramāṇānveṣaṇena iti pra jñā ka ra gu ptaḥ

tān prati apare prāhuḥ--yadi na tadvacanaṃ pramāṇam; kathaṃ tataḥ śraddhādyutpāde'pi prekṣāvatāṃ pravṛttiḥ ? itarathā yataḥ kutaścit syāt
pramāṇaṃ cet; na tat pratyakṣam, vacanatvāt
tatra tataḥ pravṛttiriti; tatra pratyakṣavat śabdasyāpi pramāṇatvopapattervakṣyamāṇatvādadoṣaḥ
tacca śrotṛpravṛttyarthamiti kaścit nyāyāvatā॰ vā॰ vṛ॰ pṛ॰ 1

athavā, śāstrārthasya saṃgrahavākyametat, asmānnibandhanasthānādatvā ādāya vyākhyāyanta iti

ata eva śāstrārthapratijñāpratipādanaparaḥ ādivākyopanyāsaḥ ityādyapi pratikṣiptam--sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 172
asmāt khalu arthā ādāya ādāya vyākhyāyante
tatra svarūpaniścayaṃ pramāṇasya tāvat darśayannāha--siddhiścet ityādi
nirṇīteḥ kṣaṇikādisiddhiranumā na syāt svayaṃ sarvathā
nirṇītiryadi nirvikalpamakhilaṃ na syāt pramāṇaṃ svataḥ,
tayostarhi kathañcittanvit kadācit pramāṇena phalaṃ kadācit phalena vā pramāṇaṃ vāyadisyate yathā mṛdghaṭayoḥ tathātattve mṛdiyaṃ ghaṭaḥ ghaṭa vā mṛditi
anyeṣāṃ hi darśanaṃ phalāt svaparagrahaṇalakṣaṇād anyadeva acetanaṃ sannikarṣādi pramāṇam iti, tanniṣedhārthaḥ
na pradī pādinā vyabhicāraḥ; tasyāpi pakṣīkaraṇāt
atha avyapadeśyāvyabhicārivyavasāyātmakaghaṭādijñānahetutvāt pramāṇaṃ pradīpādiḥ; tanna yuktam; prāmāṇyavat pradīpādīnāṃ tatajñānahetutvasyāpi paraṃ pratyasiddheḥ

na ghaṭādijñānasya hetuḥ pradīpādiḥ, tatparicchedyatvāt, yad yasya paricchedyaṃ na tat tasya janakaṃ yathā īśvarajñānasya paricchedyaḥ sadasadvargo na tajjanakaḥ, ghaṭajñānaparicchedyaśca pradīpādiḥ, ghaṭena sahaivaikasmin vijñāne tasya pratibhāsanāt

atha īśvarajñānaṃ cenna viṣayeṇa janyate, anyathā tena tatparicchedāyogāt; na tarhi tatsahabhāvināṃ tena grahaṇam akāraṇatvāt, tathā ca sarvaḥ sadasadvargaḥ kasyacid ekapratyakṣaviṣayaḥ anekatvād aṅgulisamūhavat iti vyāhanyate
ajanakānāmapi teṣāṃ tena grahaṇaṃ nānyeṣām iti kiṃkṛto vibhāgaḥ ? nanu ca pradīpāderghaṭajñānaṃ pratyakāraṇatve tadabhāve'pi tat syāditi cet; dṛṣṭatvādadoṣaḥ
dṛṣṭaṃ khalu keṣāñcidvrātiśeṣāṇām añjanādisaṃskṛtalocanānāṃ vā tadabhāve'pi rūpajñānam
na ca yadabhāve'pi yad bhavati tattasya kāryam atiprasaṅgāt
yadi ca pradīpādyabhāve na rūpajñānam; kathaṃ tarhi tamaḥpaṭalāvalokanam ? jñānānutpattireva tamo nānyaditi cet; āstāṃ tāvadetat
yadā sannikarṣaḥ tadā jñānaṃ pramitiḥ, vadā jñānaṃ tadā hānopādānabuddhayaḥ phalam

tasmāt kartṛkarmavyatiriktamavyabhicārādiviśeṣaṇakārthapramājanakaṃ kārakaṃ karaṇamucyate, tadeva ca tṛtīyayā vyapadiśanti dīpena paśyāmi cakṣuṣā nirīkṣe liṅgena budhye śabdena jānāmi manasā niścinomi iti
rūpavattvena hi tamo dravyaṃ syāt, taccānekadravyārabdhaṃ saccākṣuṣaṃ bhavet
na ca dravyāṇi santi, santi ceddivāpyārabheran andhānāmiva nīlimābhimānaḥ nabhasa evetyuktam

smānmatam--yadā dīpādyabhāve'pi rūpajñānaṃ tadā asya anyat kāraṇamastu, yadā tu dīpādibhāve tadā tadeva, anyathā satyasvapne cakṣuṣo'bhāve'pi tajjñānaṃ, dṛṣṭamiti sarvadā tada kāraṇam atīndriya iti, indriya manasī tatkāraṇam laghī॰ sva॰ ślo॰ 54 atīndriyapratyakṣam laghī॰ sva॰ ślo॰ 61 iti ca virudhyate iti; tadapi na sāram; yadi khalu ghaṭādinā saha dṛśyamāno'pi dīpādiḥ tajjñānasya hetuḥ, tarhi ghaṭādirapi pradīpādijñānaheturiti cakṣuriva rūpaprakāśanāt taijasaḥ syāt
yadi punaḥ kevalo'pi pradīpādiḥ samupalabhyate iti na ghaṭādiḥ tajjñānahetuḥ; pradīpādirapi ghaṭādijñānasya heturna syāt tasyāpi kevalasya upalambha ityuktam

yathaiva ca keṣāñcit pradīpādyālokamantareṇa na ghaṭādirūpajñānaṃ tathā keṣāñcinnaktañcarāṇām andhakāramantareṇāpi na tajjñānamiti tadapi taddheturiti taijasaṃ cakṣuḥ rūpādīnāṃ madhye rūpasyaiva prakāśakatvāt pradīpavat
pra॰ vyo॰ pṛ॰ 256 ityasya anena vyabhicāraḥ
atha na andhakāraḥ taddhetuḥ; āloko'pi na bhavediti pradīpavat ityasya nidarśanasya sādhanaśūnyatā
nanu na vedanatvena prāmāṇyaṃ vyāptaṃ yena tadabhāve na bhavet, api tu yathārthajñānajanakatvena
tacca pradīpādiparihāreṇa sannikarṣādāvastīti sa pramāṇamastu iti cet; na; sannikarṣasya jñānaṃ prati hetutvasya niṣetsyamānatvāt
tadapi na pramāṇam; taddhetutve'pi vicetanatvāt ghaṭādivaditi carcitaṃ pra mā ṇa saṃ gra ha bhā ṣye
tataḥ pramāṇe phalopacāraḥ tato bhinnapramāṇaniṣedhavya iti sūktam
tataḥ subhāṣitam--indriyamanasī kāraṇaṃ vijñānasya artho viṣayaḥ
tacca taijasaṃ rūpādiṣu madhye niyabhena rūpavyañjakatvāt
yadyat rūpādiṣu madhye niyamena rūpavyañjakaṃ tattaijasaṃ yathā pradīpam, tathā ca rūpādiṣu madhye niyamena rūpavyañjakaṃ cakṣuḥ tasmāttaijasamiti
taijasatvaṃ tu tasya rūpādiṣu madhye niyamena rūpasyaivābhivyañjakatvāt pradīpavat
upalabhyate anayā vastutattvamiti upalabdhiḥ arthādutpannā tadākārā ca buddhiḥ saiva tanmātram
avisaṃvādaḥ arthatathābhāvaḥ tasya ekaḥ pradhānabhūtaḥ ekasaṃkhyāyukto vā hetuḥ kāraṇaṃ yā nirṇītiḥ yathārtho vikalpaḥ tasyā vinā tāmantareṇa
etaduktaṃ bhavati--tadakiñcitkaraṃ saṃśayakaraṃ viparyayakaraṃ yathārthanirṇayakaraṃ ceti catvāraḥ pakṣāḥ

tataḥ kṣaṇikatvam ādiryasya jñānatvādeḥ sādhanādabhinnasya tattathoktam, tasya siddhiḥ pramāṇam anumā anumānaṃ na syāt tatsādhakaṃ na bhavet, pratyakṣameva syāt nīlādivattasyāpi tata eva pratīteḥ sarvathā sārūpyāt
tatra samāropavyavacchedakaraṇāt syāditi cet; atrāha--sarvathā sarveṇa kṣaṇikādisādhanaprakāreṇa vā anyenāpi samāropavyavacchedaprakāreṇāpi na syāt iti sambandhaḥ
athaitanneṣyate tarhi tadvat sarvacetasām ātmasaṃvedanaṃ savikalpakaṃ bhavet
...nāsti sā kācit cittāvasthā yasyāmātmanaḥ saṃvedanaṃ pratyakṣaṃ na syāt
nanu ca abhyāsadaśāyāṃ bhāvini pravartakaṃ pratyakṣamavikalpakamapi samāropavyavacchedakam, ato'naikāntiko heturiti cet; na; tadā nīlādau svayameva tadabhāvāt
kṣaṇakṣayādau tu sā'styeva kathamanyathā pratyakṣamavisaṃvādi tadā syāditi yatkiñcidetat

nanu bhavatu svarūpe tannirvikalpakam arthe tu vikalpakam, ato bhāvāsiddho heturiti cet; kiṃ punastasya tāttvikaṃ rūpadvayamasti ? tathā cet; tadvat krameṇāpi ekasya rūpadvayasaṃbhavāt na kṣaṇikajñānaṃ nītvādijñānavat samāropa iti kathaṃ tadvyavacchedakaraṇāt tatpramāṇam ? atha kalpitaṃ tatra tasya savikalpakaṃ rūpam; susthitaṃ tarhi bhāgāsiddhatvam, kṛtakatvasyāpyevaṃ bhāgāsiddhatvaprasaṅgāt, vede kalpanayā akṛtakatvasya bhāvāt śabdamātrasya anityatvasādhane
kathaṃ vā tat kalpitaṃ samāropaṃ vyavacchindyāt ? nahi māṇavake agnitvaṃ kalpitaṃ śītaṃ vyavacchinatti
tadvyavacchedo'pi tādṛśa eveti cet; tataḥ tatpramāṇatvamapi tādṛśaṃ prasaktamiti kutaḥ parasya tattvavyavasthā ? pratibhāsādvaitasya tata eva siddhiriti cet; tiṣṭhatu tāvadetat
tato'numānagatasavikalpakasvabhāvāt tadvyavacchedam ityatā sa tāttviko'bhyupagantavya iti sa eva doṣaḥ samāropābhāvalakṣaṇaḥ
bhavatu vā anumānaṃ kīdṛśamapi tathāpi nātaḥ samāropanāśaḥ; tasyā'hetutvopagamāt

atha anumānasannidhānāt pūrvasamāropakṣaṇasya uttarasamāropotpādane asamarthasya bhāvāt pūrvasya svayameva tatkṣaṇasya nāśād uttarasya kāraṇābhāvena anutpādāt evamucyate--anumānena samāropo nāśitaḥ iti pradīpeneva tamaḥ; tarhi kutaściddeśasannidhānāt yathārthasuktyādivikalpe sati pūrvapūrvarajatādisamāropakṣaṇānām uttarottaratatkṣaṇotpādane asamarthānāmudayāt tathā sa pramāṇaṃ kinna syāt yato dve eva pramāṇe syātām ? taduktam--
asyāyamarthaḥ--anumāna darśanānirṇītakṣaṇikādinirṇīteryatastato yadi cet kṣaṇikādisiddhiriti sambandhaḥ
nirvikalpam avikalpakaṃ darśanamakhilaṃ caturvidhamapi na syāt na bhavet pramāṇam svato bauddhasya

atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--yathā dattenānirṇītasya kṣaṇikādinirṇayāt tatra anumānaṃ pramāṇaṃ na darśanaṃ tathā tena anirṇītasya nīlādernirṇayāttatra vikalpa eva tatpṛṣṭhabhāvī pramāṇaṃ syāt na darśanamiti saugatāmām upalabdhimātraṃ cet pramāṇam kṣaṇikādyanumānaṃ na syāt arthanirṇītiḥ nirvikalpamakhilaṃ na bhave ditītaḥ saradataḥ pāśa iti prāptam
nanu yatraiva janayedenāṃ tatraivāsya pramāṇatā iti nīlādikṣaṇikādivikalpānumānajananāt pramāṇamavikalpakamiti dha rmo tta ra- pra jñā ka ra gu ptau; tatrāha--tasyāścet ityādi
tasyāḥ vikalpānumānayornirṇīteścet yadi jananāt pramāṇam avikalpakam iti sambandhaḥ

ata eva yata eva nirṇītijananādavikalpamapi pramāṇaṃ na svataḥ ato'smādeva kāraṇād astu bhavatu svata ātmamaiva nirṇayo vikalpaḥ anumānākhyaḥ, yadbalād darśanasya pramāṇatā varaṃ tasyaiva sāstu iti bhāvaḥ
pratyakṣaṃ sannihitarūpādimātragrāhi vikalpāntareṇaikatvādhyavasāye sati pravartakam--pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 216

athavā anabhyāse dṛśyarūpaliṅgakṣamanumānaṃ prāpye rūpādau abhyāse nirvikalpakamadhyakṣam, na cānyā daśā'sti yasyāṃ vikalpaḥ pramāṇaṃ syāt, sa eva ceṣyate jainaiḥ, tatkathamucyate--vakṣye siddhiviniścayam siddhivi॰ 1
asyāyamarthaḥ--siddhiḥ pramāṇaṃ cet yadi upalabdhimātraṃ pūrvāparākāraśūnyaṃ madhyadarśanamātram upalabdhimātram
kṣaṇikagrahaṇaṃ sādhanādabhinnasādhyalakṣaṇam, ādiśabdena agnyādīnāṃ parigrahaḥ, teṣāṃ siddhiḥ pramāṇam anumānaṃsyāt--notpadyeta svayam ātmanaiva gṛhītagrāhitvena
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā dṛśyaprāpyayorbhedaḥ tathā dṛśyasya darśanasya ca pratyavayavaṃ bhedāt na kasyaciddarśanam ityuktaṃ pra mā ṇa saṃ gra hā la ṅkā re
tathā pakṣādyabhāvānnānumānamiti nābhyāsyoyataḥ tatra pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇam, anumānasyaiva abhyāsopagamāt
saṃvṛtyā syāditi cet atrāha--sarvathā paramārthaprakāreṇeva saṃvṛtiprakāreṇāpi na syāt kasyacidatrabhavasyābhāve saṃvṛtivikalpābhāvāt tatpūrvakatvādasya
kadāmānaṃ syāt ? ityatrāha--vinā nirṇīteḥ sthūlaikasādṛśyadarśanaṃ nirṇītiḥ tāmantareṇa
pakṣahetudṛṣṭāntānāṃ yāthātmyena pratipattiravisaṃvādaḥ, tasya ekahetoḥ pakṣādipratipattervikalpātmakatvāditi bhāvaḥ

bhavatu dṛśyasya sabhedasya grahaṇāt tatra savikalpakaṃ darśanaṃ pramāṇaṃ na pūrvāparako ṭyoriti cet; atrāha--nirṇītiryadi ityādi madhyakṣaṇasya sabhedasya grahaṇāt tatra nirṇītiḥ savikalpakaṃ darśanaṃ yadi pramāṇam; atra dūṣaṇam--avikalpamakhilam abhyāsajamapi na kevalamanyat syād bhavet apramāṇaṃ svato bauddhasya akrameṇaiva krameṇāpi sabhedabhāvaṃbhavād iti bhāvaḥ
nanu ca svarūpe pararūpe vā akrameṇa krameṇavāsvalakṣaṇadarśanamavikalpakam, tatpṛṣṭhabhāvinī tu vikalpabuddhiḥ anumānādivyavahāramāravayati, tadvaśāt tat pramāṇamiti cet; atrāha--tasyāśced ityādi

dvicandrādidarśanamastīti cet; kutastadapramāṇam ? bādhyamānatvāt; na; sarvathā tadayogāditi, jāgraddarśanavad dvicandrādidarśanamapi praṇaṃ na vā kiñciditi vyavacchedyābhāvāt vakṣye siddhiviniścayam ityana- rthakamiti cet; atrāha--siddhiśced ityādi
siddhiḥ pramāṇaṃ ced yadi upalabdhimātram buddhisāmānyam
idamatra tātparyam--avisaṃvādinī buddhiḥ pramāṇaṃ nānyā iti vibhāgamanapekṣya tanmātraṃ yadi pramāṇamiti; atra dūṣaṇamāha--kṣaṇikādisiddhiḥ ityādi
kṣaṇika ādiryasya parābhyupagatatattvasya tattathoktam tasya siddhiḥ tatsambandhanīyaṃ pramāṇamanumānaṃ syāt
ayamabhiprāyaḥ--yadi jñānamātraṃ pramāṇaṃ tarhi nīlādāviva sthūlādāvapi pratyabhijñānādi pramāṇamiti tena bādhitaviṣayatvāt śabdādau kṣaṇikādyanumā na pramāṇam
na ca ekatra parasya anekapramāṇam arthavat, anabhyupagamāt
atha bādhyamānatvānna sthūlādijñānaṃ pramāṇam; tarhi abādhitaṃ jñānaṃ pramāṇayitavyam, na sarvam

abādhitā pratītiḥ avisaṃvādaikahetuḥ nirṇītiryadi pramāṇam nirvikalpaṃ vikalpāt nirṇītibhedānniṣkrānta saṃvedanamātram akhilaṃ niravaśeṣaṃ na syāt pramāṇaṃ svato bauddhasya kintu saṃvedanaviśeṣaḥ syāditi pratijñāhāniḥ tasya

atrāha vaiśeṣikādiḥ--na nirṇītiḥ, api tu taddhetutvāt sannikarṣādiḥ pramāṇamiti cet; atrāha uttaram--tasyā nirṇīteścet jananād anyat pramāṇam ata eva astu svataḥ svayameva nirṇayaḥ--yasya hi bhāvāt paranirapekṣā siddhiḥ tadeva pramāṇaṃ yuktam
nirṇītibhāvācca tathā tatsiddhiḥ, tadabhāve anyabhāve'pi tadabhāvāt, anyathā cakṣuṣo rūpavad rasādisiddhirapi, saṃyuktasamavetasambandhasyāviśeṣāditi manyate

yadi va, ya evamāha pramābhaṅgavādī pra jñā ka ra gu ptaṃ--na pratibhāsādvaitāt paraṃ tattva masti, iti na tatra kiñcit pramāṇam, tadadvaitasya ca svasaṃvedanādhyakṣasiddhatvāt na tatra vipratipattirapratipattirvā yattannirāsārthaṃ pramāṇalakṣaṇapraṇayanam

idamatra cintyate--sarvavikalpātītapratibhāso vā tatra pramāṇaṃ syāt, ghaṭamahaṃ vedmi ityādi pratibhāso vā ? tatra prathamapakṣaṃ dūṣayannāha--siddhiḥ pramāṇaṃ cet yadyekānekatvādibhedaśūnyaṃ pratibhāsamātram upalabdhimātram upalambhanam upalabdhiḥ, saiva tanmātram
yaduktam--pratibhāsaḥ pratibhāsa eveti kathaṃ tatpramāṇam ? iti; atrāha--ghaṭamahaṃ vedmi ityādi pratītiḥ nirṇītiḥ tasyā vinā tāmantareṇa tadabhāvaḥ

bhavatvevaṃ ko doṣa iti cet; atrāha--kṣaṇikādisiddhiḥ kṣaṇika ādiryasya sārūpyasantānāntarādeḥ tasya siddhiḥ pramāṇaṃ parābhyupagatā'numā na syāt svayaṃ saugatasya tadvat puruṣopalabdhiranivāraṇena tayā bādhanāditi manyate
saṃvṛtyā sā pramāṇamiti cet; atrāha--sarvathā paramārthaprakāreṇeva saṃvṛtiprakāreṇāpi na syāt, tadvat nityeśvarādyanumānamapi pramāṇaṃ syāditi nirūpayiṣyate

nirṇītireva tarhi pramāṇamiti cet; atrāha--nirṇītiḥ svaparavyavasāyātmikā buddhiḥ yadi pramāṇam nirvikalpam--ahamiti jñānaṃ grāhakaṃ grāhyo ghaṭādiḥ tadvyavasāyaḥ phalam iti vikalpo bhedaḥ tasmānniṣkrāntam advayavedanaṃ na syāt pramāṇaṃ svataḥ svarūpeṇa
tato yaduktam--pramāṇamavisaṃvādijñānam ityādi vyavahāreṇa pramāṇalakṣaṇamuktam, ajñātārthaprakāśo veti paramārthena, pramāṇāntareṇa ajñātasya advayapratibhāsārthasya ātmavedanasya evamabhidhānāt

nanu ca yadi nīlādiḥ arthatardvibha tadvyatirekeṇa tadgrāhakamasti anupalambhāt, śarīrasukhādeḥ prameyatvena tadagrāhakatvamiti kathaṃ nirṇītiḥ pramāṇamiti cet; na; āttottarasya anantaraṃ ca vakṣyamāṇatvāt
tathā ca pratyayādisvarūpasya svato gatiriti --pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 2
ajñātārthaprakāśo vā--athavedaṃ pramāṇalakṣaṇam, prakāśyate'neneti prakāśaḥ, ajñātasyārthasya prakāśakaṃ jñānaṃ pramāṇam
tathā ca pratyayādisvarūpasya svato gatiriti, uktañca prāmāṇyaṃ vyavahāreṇeti
kā punariyaṃ siddhiḥ pramāṇātmani yā upacārāt pravartata iti cet; atrāha--pramāṇasya ityādi
pratipatturapekṣyaṃ yat pramāṇaṃ na tu pūrvakam || 3
svavṛttiḥ--yathāsvaṃ prameyasya vyavasāyo yatastadeva svataḥ pramāṇam
abhrāntatve'pi sarvathā nirṇayavaśāt prāmāṇyasiddheḥ kathañcit tadātmakatvaṃ tattvabuddherabhyupagantavyam
anadhigatārthādhigantṛ vijñānaṃ pramāṇamityapi kevalamanirṇītārthanirṇītirabhidhīyate, anyathā atiprasaṅgāt
pratipatturuttaraṃ pramāṇaṃ tatsādhanabhāvāt na tu pūrvakam, anumāne'pyevaṃ prasaṅgāt
pramāṇasya karaṇaviśeṣasya yat phalaṃ sākṣād avyavahitaṃ na vyavahitaṃ hānādibuddhilakṣaṇam
nanu tatra ācāryāṇāṃ vipratipattidarśanāt kiṃ tatphalamiti pṛṣṭa iva taddarśayannāha--svārthaviniścayaḥ iti
svaṃ ca vijñānasvarūpam arthaśca ghaṭādiḥ, yadi vā, svo'rthaḥ svagrahaṇayogyo bhāvaḥ tayoḥ tasya vā viniścayo'kiñcitkaratvādivyavacchedena tadgrahaṇam
dvitīyavyākhyānena ghaṭādyarthāgrāhiṇīnāṃ sukhādivittīnāmapi svarūpārthaniścāyakatvena pramāṇatvamuktaṃ veditavyam
nanu na nīlādivyatirekeṇa aparamasti yasya svārthaviniścayaḥ phalaṃ syāt
nīlādireveti cet; na; tasya svaniśca'yepi arthaniścayābhāvāt tato'nyasya arthasyābhāvāt svārthaviniścayaḥ ityanupapannam
'atha dvitīyaṃ vyākhyānamāśritya etadyuktamityucyate; na; tatra vijñaptivādo bhava to'niṣṭaṃ syāt, nīlādeḥ svagrāhakatvena jñānatāpatteḥ

śarīrasukhādi tataḥ param, tasya svarūpavat nīlādāvapi pravṛtterayamadoṣa iti cet; na; śarīrasya nīlādivat prameyatvāt, sukhādeśca nīlādigrāhakatvānabhyupagamāt na svārthetyādi yuktamiti cet; na; ahamahamikayā pratīyamānāyāḥ saṃvitteḥ tato'nyasyāḥ ayatmāye nīlādau kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ sukhādau vā ? yata idaṃ syāt--nīlādi jñānaṃ pratibhāsamānatvāt sukhādivat iti

nanvastu ahampratyayaḥ; sa tu sthūlo'haṃ kṛśo'ham iti śarīrasāmānādhikaraṇyena pratīterna śarīrād bhidyate api tu tadeva, tasya ca nīlādyagrāhakatvamuktamiti cet; na; cārvākamatacarvaṇe carvaṇamasya bhaviṣyati iti kimatraivotsukimana ? bhavatvayaṃ tato bhinnaḥ; tathāpi kathaṃ nīlādergrāhaka iti cet; kathaṃ svarūpasya ? tatra tasya pratibhāsāccet; nīlāderapyata eva grāhako'stu, tathā ca laukikī pratītiḥ--nīlamahaṃ vedmi pītamahaṃ vedmi iti
tato yaduktam--yadi samānakālasya nīlādeḥ grāhakaḥ; nīlādiḥ tasya syāt aviśeṣāt iti; tannirastam

yadi hi samānakālatvādekasya dharmaḥ sarvasya syāt; tarhi citre nīlākāravat nīlatā pītādyākāre'pi syāt pītādyā kāratā vā nīle, tataḥ kathaṃ citraṃ nāma, yataḥ citraṃ citrameva iti bhavet ? pratyakṣabādhā anyatrāpi
na khalu yathā grāhakatā ahampratyaye pratyakṣataḥ pratīyate tathā taṃ pratīyate
yathā vā nīlādergrāhyatā tathā taṃ prati tatpratyayasya sā iti, anyathā'vivādāt saugatameva sakalamiti śāstrapraṇayanamanarthakam
yathā ca na sukhādi vyatirekeṇāparaṃ vijñānaṃ tathā nīlādivyatirekeṇāpi--pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
tulanā--"samakālaścettarhi yathā jñānamarthasya grāhakam evamartho'pi jñānasya grāhakaḥ syāt
syānmatam--na nīlāditatpratyayābhyām anyā grāhyatā grāhakatā ca pratīyate; nanvevaṃ tayoḥ svarūpagrahaṇamapi durlabham, atrāpi na tatsvarūpādanyā grāhyatā grāhakatā vā, na ca tadabhāve tadgrahaṇam
yadi punaḥ svaprakāśarūpatvāt svagrahaṇam; tarhi ahampratyayasya paraprakāśanarūpatvāt paragrahaṇamastu, nīlādeśca paraprakāśyarūpatvāt pareṇa grahaṇam
na vai jainena svabhāvabhūtayogyatāyāḥ anyā grāhyatā grāhakatā vā abhyupagamyate
tathā jñānaṃ svahetūtthaṃ svayaṃ tadgrāhakaṃ matam || laghī॰ ślo॰ 59
etenedamapi pratyakṣaṃ yaduktaṃ pareṇa--yadi nīlādeḥ svabhāvabhūtagṛhītikaraṇāt saṃpratyayo grāhakaḥ; tarhi tena sa eva janitaḥ syāt iti tasya jñānatā jñānakāryatvāt uttarajñānavat
atha arthāntaragṛhītikaraṇāvarthasya na kiñcit kṛtamiti na tena grahaṇam
tathāhi--svarūpasya gṛhītikaraṇād vijñānaṃ ced grāhakam; tattasya janakaṃ syāt na grāhakam, na caitad yuktam, svātmani kriyāvirodhāt
tato bhinnāyaḥ tasyāḥ karaṇā- dadoṣaścet; svarūpasya na kiñcit kṛtamiti kathaṃ tena grahaṇam ? tayā punargṛhītikaraṇe anavasthānam
anyayā cet; ekasya śaktidvayam, tadapi anyena taddvayena vedyate ityanavasthā syāditi cet; idamapi vakṣyamāṇena citraikajñānena suparihāramiti tiṣṭhatu tāvat
nīlādireva janitaḥ, yato hi tasya svabhāvabhūtā gṛhītistena janyate

tulanā--atha gṛhītikaraṇādarthasya jñānaṃ grāhakam, nanu sā arthādarthāntaram anarthāntaraṃ vā tena kriyate ? arthāntaratve arthasya na kiñcitkṛtamiti kathaṃ tenāsya grahaṇam ? tasyeyamiti sambandhāsiddhiśca
anarthāntaratve tu tatkaraṇe artha eva tena kriyate ityasya jñānatā jñānakāryatvāt uttarajñānavat

nanu yaduktam--nīlādergrahaṇe ahampratyayasya yogyatā'sti na tasya tatpratyayagrahaṇe iti; tatredaṃ cintyate--arthagrahaṇakāryadarśanāt tatra yogyatāsti iti gamyate, na tasyāḥ tadgrahaṇam, kāryānumeyatvāttasyāḥ

atha tata eva sā gamyate iti matiḥ; tarhi tato yogyatāsiddhiḥ ataśca tatsiddhiriti anyonyasaṃśraya iti cet; ucyate--yathā sutīkṣṇo'pi asiḥ nātmānaṃ chinatti tathā jñānaṃ na svaṃ paricchinatti svātmanyarthakriyāvirodhāt ityatra yaduktam jñānam ātmānaṃ paricchinatti tathāśaktiḥ nāsiḥ chinatti viparyayāt iti; tatrāpyasya samatvāt
tadyathā svagrahaṇāt tacchaktisiddhiḥ kāryānumeyatvāttasyāḥ na punaḥ tatastadgrahaṇasiddhiḥ
atha svagrahaṇaṃ pratyakṣataḥ siddham, tat kutaḥ iti codye svaśaktitaḥ ityuttaramucyate na punaḥ tasyāḥ tatsiddhiḥ; tadetadanyatra samaṃ na ceti cintyam

bhavatu svarūpavat nīlāderapi tena grahaṇaṃ ko doṣa iti cet ? ayam-- yadavabhāsatetajjñānaṃ yathā sukhādi avabhāsate ca nīlādiḥ ityatra svasya svenaiva avabhāsasya sukhādau jñānatvena vyāptatayā dṛṣṭasya nīlādāvadarśanād asiddho hetuḥ syāditi, itarathā svasaṃvedanātmakatvena tasya jñānāntaratvāt sarvajñajñānavat vādiprativādibhyāmaviṣayīkaraṇāt tau prati āśrayāsiddhatā syāt

arthāntarasyāpi jñānasya mataḥ tasya tābhyāṃ grahaṇaṃ nārthasya sataḥ iti kiṃkṛto vibhāgaḥ ? atha citraikajñānamatamavalambya ahampratyayasya nīlādyākāraikatvamiṣyate yadi; tarhi svabhāvādibhinno'pyahampratyayaḥ kadācid yogyatayā nīlādinā ekatvamupayāti tayaiva tadgrāhakatvamupayāti tayaiva tadgrāhakaḥ syāt
tadanabhyupagame punaridaṃ bhavet śrotriyo na cāṇḍalyā darśanamicchāmi sparśaṃ tvicchāmi iti
tulanā--nanu nīlaṃ kathamātmarūpaṃ prakāśayati ? na hi prakāśyā ghaṭādayaḥ pradīpādinā svaprakāśakāḥ, ātmani kriyā viruddhyate
avedyavedakākārā...svātmani kriyāvirodha iti kutaḥ pramāṇādavagatam ? na hi dṛṣṭāntamātrādarthasya prasiddhiḥ

yadi ghaṭaḥ pradīpena bāhyātmanā prakāśyate, pradīpo'pi tathābhūtenāpareṇeti na paryanuyogaḥ...vastusvabhāva eṣa iti kā vātra kṣatiḥ ? atha svātmani kriyāvirodha iti; ucyate--yadā svarūpantattasya tadā kaiva virodhitā
tathā cenna kiñcidbhavet svena rūpeṇeti sakalamastaṃgataṃ bhavet
chedastu punarviśiṣṭotpādanaṃ na ca tenaiva tasyotpādanam
svaprakāśarūpaṃ tu tasya svarūpaṃ na tenaiva virudhyate...--pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 353--54
atra kecidāhuḥ na cittacaittānāṃ svasaṃvedanaṃ ghaṭate svātmani kāritvavirodhāt
na hi suśikṣito'pi baṭuḥ svaskandhamāroḍhuṃ śaknoti
na hi suprajvalito'pi vahniskandha ātmānaṃ dahati tathā cittacaittamapi kathamātmānaṃ pratyetu ?...atrocyate na karmakartṛbhāvaina vadyavadakatvaṃ jñāne varṇyate
yathā pradīpa ātmānamātmanā prakāśate tathā jñānamapi jaḍapadārthavilakṣaṇaṃ svahetoreva prakāśasvabhāvamupajāyamānaṃ svasaṃvedanaṃ vyavasthāpyate
syānmatam--tatpratyayena nīlādabhinnasya grahaṇe'pi katham arthatā gamyate ? pratibhāsāditi cet; svapnādidṛṣṭānāmapi syāditi tajjñānamapi pramāṇameva
duṣṭakāraṇajanitadarśanaviṣayatvānneti cet; darśanaṃ tattatheti kutaḥ ? arthaviṣayatvāt; anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ--siddhe hi tathādarśane tadviṣayasya anarthatvam, ataḥ tathā darśanamiti
bādhitapratyayagocaratvānnetyapi nottaṃ tasya hi bādhanaṃ nodayakāle svarūpāpahāraḥ; tadā tatpratīteḥ
anyadā tu naśvaratvena svayameva nāsti kena tadbādhanam ? daivaraktā hi kiṃśukāḥ, na tatra naḥ prayāsaḥ
na ca viṣayāpahāraḥ pramāṇadharmaḥ api tu narādhipasya

atha na viṣayasyāpahāro bādhanam, api tu tasya sataḥ pratibhāsajñāpanam; tadapi na sundaram; yato yadyasau asan; kathaṃ pratibhāsaḥ kharaśṛṅgavat ? atha pratibhāsaḥ; kathamasan ? jāgraddṛṣṭo ghaṭādirapi tathaiva syāt
dhiṅ mithyaitad vitarkitaṃ nāyaṃ ghaṭādiḥ kintvanyadetat iti pratyayānutpatterneti cet; nanu marīcikāyāṃ jaladapino jhaṭiti maraṇe deśāntaragamane vānasa pratyayo jāyate iti tajjalaṃ satyaṃ syāt
satyapi ca arthaviśeṣe kvacit sa pratyayo dṛṣṭaḥ
ayamapi pratyayo yadyasadarthaḥ; kathamanyasya asadarthatāṃ jñāpayati, atiprasaṅgāt
kiñca, ayaṃ pratyayaḥ pūrvapratyayasamānaviṣayaścet; na tasya kathañcidapi bādhakaḥ, anyathā sarveṣām ekārthajñānānāmanyonyaṃ bādhyabādhakabhāvebhavet
bhinnaviṣayaścet; sutarāṃ na tasya bādhakaḥ, itarathā ghaṭajñānaṃ paṭajñānasya bādhakamastu

neti pratyayānutpatterneti cet; sa eva pratyayaḥ kuto na jāyate ? ekādhikaraṇatvābhāvāt; rajataśuktikāpratyayoḥ kathamekādhikaraṇatvam, pramāṇābhāvāt ? pūrvottarapratyayābhyāṃ tadapratīteḥ iti kṣaṇabhaṅge carcitametat
visaṃvādidarśanagocaratvāditi cet; na dṛṣṭārthaprāptiḥ avisaṃvādaḥ, sā svapne'pi dṛśyate
atha asau artha eva na bhavati anarthakriyākāritvāt; arthakriyāpi tatra dṛśyate jalādikāryasya snānāderdarśanāt
atha jāgratāt darśanāt sā arthakriyaiva na bhavati; tarhi anyāpi na syāt suptenā'darśanāt
kiñca, yadi arthakriyā asatī; katham ato'nyasya sattvam ? satī svataścet; bhāvo'pi tathaiva sanniti kiṃ tadapekṣaṇena ? anyataścet; anavasthā syāt
bodhamātrasaṃgamo hi svapnetarapratyayasaṃbhavī samāna eva sarvatra--pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 4
na tāvajjñānāntareṇābhāvaḥ svapnajñānasyānyasya vā kenacit kriyate, tatkāle tasya svayameva nāśāt
daivaraktā hi kiṃśukā kena rajyante nāma --prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 75
daivaraktā hi kiṃśukāḥ ka enānadhunā rañjayati
anyena nahi jñānena tasya viṣayāpahāro'sattājñāpanalakṣaṇo bādhaḥ
na ca svaviṣaye pravṛttamanyaviṣayāpahāraṃ racayitumalam, svaviṣaya svaviṣayasya rūpasādhanaṃ hi jñānānāṃ dharmaḥ
pūrveṇa uttarasya uttareṇa ca pūrvasyājñānāt naikādhikaraṇatvapratītiriti bhāvaḥ
jāgratena sā arthakriyā na kriyate ataḥ sā arthakriyaiva na bhavati

jāgraddaśāvat; svapne'pi bahirartho'stu, kiṃ vā svapnadaśāvat anyadāpi samān dubhaya tu sadehaḥ , sarvavikalpātītatā vā yathā syāditi jāgrat-svapnadaśayoḥ aviśeṣacodaneyam ? tatra prathamapakṣe svapnadaśāyāmapi bahirarthasiddheḥ tajjñānamapi pramāṇamiti tallakṣaṇapraṇayanamayuktaṃ vyavacchedyābhāvāditi
asmin mate ko doṣaḥ ? nāparaḥ pramāṇaprameyā'niṣedhāt
parasya mate ko doṣaḥ ? sakalasvamatavilopāt vijñaptimātrādeḥ asiddheḥ
kiñca, svapnādijñānavad īśvarādyanumānādikamapi svapratibhāsinā'rthena arthavaditi tanniṣedhavacanaṃ pra jñā ka ra sya guptavigopakam
atha duṣṭaliṅgādikāraṇajanitatvāt tannirviṣayam; paśyata asya vācyaṃ dhyaṃ svayameva svasvapnādijñāne duṣṭakāraṇārabdhatvaṃ nirākṛtya atra abhyupagacchataḥ
etena idamapi pratyuktam tauna na tadanumānādyarthavat svaparicchinnādanyasya prāpakatvāt iti; svapnādāvapi tathā prasaṅgāt
tanna pra jñā ka ra sya kiñcid anarthajñānam
atha madīyo'yaṃ siddhānta iti na doṣaḥ; na; asya mīmāṃsakasiddhāntasya hi sarvaṃ sālambanaṃ jñānam iti matam
ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ--kvacillaukikaḥ kvacidalaukiko'rtha ālambanam ityeke

sarvatra laukiko ālovā kasmānneti cet ? atha parasya marīcikājalam anyajalavat kasmānna snānādikṛt ? svakāraṇāt tathotpatteriti cet; kiṃ punarasya kāraṇam ? adṛḍhavāsaneti cet; sarvatra ekarūpā vāsanā anyadvā kuto na ? tathā'pratīteriti cet; ata eva tarhi na sarvo laukiko'laukiko vā'rthaḥ

atha jāgratkriyāsamatvāt svapnārthakriyā laukikī, tatkāryartho'pi tathāvidha eveti matiḥ; tarhi yat sat tatsarvaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ yathā ghaṭaḥ, saṃśca śabdaḥ hetubi॰ pṛ॰ 55 iti kṣaṇikatvapratipattyarthakriyāsamatvāt nityeśvarādipratipattirapyarthakriyā iti tatkāraṇakalāpo'pyarthaḥ syāt
yadi punaḥ iyamarthakriyā na bhavati; svapne'pi na syāt
tathā jāgraddaśābhāvinyapi na syāditi cet; kṣaṇikādisiddhirapi na syāditi sarvā'viśeṣacodanā
svapne viparītakhyātiḥ anyadeśādisthasya anyadeśāditayā pratibhāsanāt ityapare
sarvatra saiva kuto neti cet ? na; tathā'pratīteḥ
nahi yathā loke ādityo'nyadeśo'pi prātaḥ parvata sa~llagnatayeva pratibhā tīti pratipadyate, tathā parvato'pyanyadeśastaddeśatayā pratibhātīti pratipadyate iti

yadi punarayaṃ nirbandhaḥ sarvatra saivāstu iti; tarhi yathā anumānasya aspaṣṭaḥ sāmānyākāro bāhye svalakṣaṇa āropāt pratibhāti, anyathā tataḥ tatra pravṛttirna syāt, tathā sarvatra jñāne svasaṃvedanarūpatā anyasya tatra āropitā pratibhāti anyatra aropitā pratibhāti anyatrāpi anyasya ityanavasthā
tulanā--astu tarhi viparītakhyātiḥ pūrvakālameva dṛśyate tatkālatayā...--pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 195
dvitīye'pi svapne bahirarthābhāvamupalabhya anyatra tadabhāvasādhane idamanumānamāśritaṃ syāt— nirālambanāḥ sarvapratyayāḥ pratyayatvāt svapnapratyayavat pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3

tatredaṃ cintyate--pratyayatvaṃ yadi sākalyena svasādhyena vyāptaṃ na; kathamataḥ sādhyasiddhiḥ atiprasaṅgāt ? vyāptaṃ cet; kathamapratītaṃ tattathā ? tatpratītiścet nirālambanā; sa eva doṣaḥ, anyathā anayaiva hetorvyamicāraḥ
atha nānumānaṃ sarvapratyayalaṃba natvaviṣayatvāt pramāṇam api tu samāropavyavacchedāt; bhavedevaṃ yadi anyataḥ pramāṇāt tat pratipannaṃ syāt, na caivamiti nirūpayiṣyate

api ca, yathā saugataḥ svapnanidarśanena na sarvatra bahirarthābhāvaṃ sādhayati tathā anyo'pi yadi grāhyākāranidarśanena saṃvedanābhāvaṃ sādhayet kathaṃ saṃvedanamātrasiddhiḥ yatastatra saugatasya āsthā syāt ?
atha tadapi tathāstu; tathāhi--yadvisadarśana daśāvaseyaṃ na tat paramārthasat yathā kāmalinā upalabdhamindudvayam, visadarśanāvaseyaṃ ca saṃvittyādīti
atrāpi paramārthasattvādanyat, tadabhāvamātraṃ vā sādhyeta ? tatra dvitīyavikalpasya prathamacaturthaṣyavikalpe carcā bhaviṣyati
vibhrame vibhrame teṣāṃ vibhramo'pi na siddhyati

nanunaparamārthataḥ kasyacit kenacid vyāptiriṣyate, nāpi kutaścit kiñcit sādhyate, api tu yathā vyavahāreṇa bahirarthavādinā ekatra agnerdhūmadarśanāt sarvatra sarvadā tata eva sa nānyataḥ, dhūmadarśanācca agniranumīyate tathā prakṛtamanyena anuṣṭhīyata iti cet; uktamatra sarveṣāmarthasiddhiḥ āptamī॰ ślo॰ 81 syāditi
śakyaṃ hi tairapi vaktum--nāsmābhiḥ kenacit kasyacit vyāptiḥ sādhyate, kintu ghaṭādau buddhimatkāraṇatvādinā kāryatvādeḥ sahabhāvadarśanāt, anyatra taddarśanāt sādhyamanumīyate
tathā ca pakṣadharmaḥ hetubi॰ ślo॰ 1 ityādi liṅgalakṣaṇamavācyam nivartyābhāvāt
atha tathā pāramārthikī sādhyasiddhirna syāditi matiḥ; sā anya trāpi samānā
yadi tatra sā na pāramārthikī; kiṃ tarhi pāramārthikam ? saṃvedanādvaitaṃ cet; na; dvayapratibhāsapratipādanāt
vivādāspadaṃ bodhādhārakāraṇaṃ kāryatvāt, yadyat kāryaṃ tattad bodhādhārakāraṇaṃ yathā ghaṭādi...--praśa॰ vyo॰ pṛ॰ 382
tṛtīyavikalpe naikāntena arthaniṣedhaḥ, pākṣikasya tadbhāvasya aniṣedhāt
nahi sthāṇurvā'yaṃ puruṣo vā iti sandehe puruṣo na bhavati iti niścayo'sti, virodhāt
nanu bhavatvevam; tathāpi kiṃ tena apravṛttihetunā ? pravṛttyartha hi bahirartha iṣyate iti cet; kathaṃ bhavataḥ saṃvittimātre pravṛttiḥ ? bahirarthasandehe tatrāpi sandehāt

kathaṃ vā arthe sandehaḥ ? tatpratibhāsasya tadabhāve'pi svapnādau darśanāditi cet; evaṃ tadā tadabhāva eva yukto na sandehaḥ, kathamanyathā kiñcit pratyakṣaṃ svasaṃvedanaṃ nirvikalpasvopa labhya sarvatra tathaiva syāt ? atrāpi sandeha eva yuktaḥ
kuto vā svapne bahirarthābhāvasiddhiḥ ? svayamanabhyupagamāt, bādhyabādhakabhāvaniṣedhavirodhāt
yathaiva hi pareṇa tatra tasya asattvamabhyupagataṃ tathā kṣaṇikatvaprakārāderapi iti sarvatra kṣaṇikatvādāvapi sandehaḥ syāt
atha svapne'pi sandehaḥ; sa kuto jātaḥ ? tadadarśanāditi cet; kathamadarśanam ? darśane atiprasaṅgāt
tasya tadvyabhicārāccet; kiṃ punaridamubhayatra dṛṣṭaṃ yenaivam ? tathā cet; naikāntena arthābhāvaḥ, tannāyamapi vikalpo yuktaḥ
caturthavikalpe'pi yathā bahiḥ sadasattvavikalpātītatā tathā vedane'pi svaparavedanavikalpātītatā syāditi na kiñcit syāt
atha paranirapekṣasvasaṃvedanasya vedanasya pratīternāyaṃ doṣaḥ; kathamadoṣaḥ, yataḥ svasaṃvedane'pi sadasattvavikalpātī tatāyām arthavanna tatsiddhiḥ, itarathā arthāniṣedha
kiñca, anyasmin pakṣe pramāṇamavisaṃvādi jñānam ityādi vyavahāreṇa ajñātārthaprakāśo vā iti paramārthena pramāṇalakṣaṇam pra॰ vārtikāla॰ iti vihanyate, ubhayatrāviśeṣāt

tadayam antarbahiraviśeṣaṃ bruvanneva svasaṃvedanādvaitaṃ vadatīti kathaṃ svasthaḥ ? atha svasaṃvedane paramārthasadiṣyate bahirarthaparihāreṇa; tarhi anyenāpi svapnadṛṣṭaparihāreṇa anyadā dṛṣṭaḥ tathā sanniṣyatāmiti sthitam--arthaviniścayaḥ pramāṇasya phalam iti
bhavatvevaṃ tataḥ kiṃ syāditi cet ? atrāha--pratipattuḥ ityādi
svaṃ ca arthaṃ ca pratipadyate viṣayīkarotīti pratipattā puruṣaḥ tasya apekṣyaṃ tena apekṣyate svaparapratipattau yat jñānaṃ tadeva pramāṇam
nanu naiva pūrvakaṃ tatkāraṇaṃ nirvikalpakadarśanaṃ sannikarṣādi vā, pūrvaśabdasya kāraṇavācitvāt
nahi anyataḥ tatphalaniṣpattau anyat pramāṇam, atiprasaṅgāt
nanu sukhādi nīlādijñānavyaktivyatirekeṇa nāparaḥ pratipattā asti, tat kathamucyate pratipattuḥ iti cet ? na; jīvasiddhiprakaraṇe asya uttaranirūpaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati kimautsukyena ?
tulanā--tasmāt sukhādinīlādivyatiriktamaparamiha jagati saṃvedanaṃ nāstīti sukhādivat svasaṃvedanaṃ nīlādikamapi iti yukta eṣa nirṇayaḥ
kārikāyāḥ pūrvārdhasya sugamatvāt uttarārdhasya sayuktikamarthaṃ darśayannāha— yathāsvam ityādi
asyāyamarthaḥ--prameyasya ghaṭādeḥ vyavasāyo viniścayaḥ nādhigatimātram dṛṣṭe pramāṇāntarāvṛttiprasaṅgāt
yato yadāśritya yasmādvā bhavati ityadhyāhāraḥ tadeva nānyat pramāṇam
pakṣadharmatāniścayaḥ kvacit pratyakṣataḥ ityatra yaduktaṃ dha rmo tta re ṇa--yatraiva janayedenāṃ tatraivāsya pramāṇatā iti tad vyeti, etad evakāreṇa darśayanti
na hi prameyavyavasāyaḥ tadāśritya tato vā bhavati iti, yadvakṣyate atraiva--abhedāt sadṛśasmṛtyām siddhivi॰ 1
bhavatu vā nirvikalpadarśanāt tadvyavasāyaḥ, tathāpi tanna pramāṇamiti darśayannāha--svataḥ iti
svataḥ svātmano na paramparayā vikalpajananāt, uktadoṣāt tasyāśced siddhivi॰ 1
yadi tarhi svato yataḥ prameyavyavasāyaḥ tat pramāṇam, parokṣa-jñānānurapratyakṣa-pradhānapariṇāmajñānataḥ na svataḥ sadeva pramāṇaṃ syāt; ityatrāha--yathāsvam iti
svaśabdo'yaṃ jñānātmavācaka iti, tasya anatikrameṇa yathāsvaṃ svavyavasāyena saha tadvyavasāyo yata ityarthaḥ
tulanā--pakṣadharmaśca yathāsvaṃ pramāṇena niścitaḥ--pra॰ vā॰ sva॰ pṛ॰ 18
tatra pakṣadharmasya sādhyadharmiṇi pratyakṣato'numānato vā prasiddhiḥ--hetubi॰ pṛ॰ 53
parokṣajñānavādino mīmāṃsakāḥ, jñānāntarapratyakṣajñānavādino naiyāyikāḥ, pradhānapariṇāmajñānavādinaḥ sāṃkhyāḥ
anye tu anyatāvatārya etad vyācakṣate--yadi tadvyavasāyo yato bhavati tadeva pramāṇam sarvajñajñānameva pramāṇaṃ syāditi; atrāha--yathāsvam iti
yadyasya jñānasya svagrahaṇayogyaṃ tasya anatikrameṇa iti
tatra pramātuṃ śakyaṃ yogyaṃ svaprameyam ityanena gateḥ
nanu mā bhūt tajjñānaṃ pramāṇam, rasyāt tārānikaramiva caitanyasvabhāve puṃsi prameyasya avabhāsanāt sa eva pramāṇamiti cet; atrāha--jñānam iti
9 tatpramāṇam na pumān tasya pramātṛtvāt nityatvapratiṣedhācca

nanu tadvyavasāyaphalaṃ na jñānaṃ pramāṇam api tu svakāraṇārthākāramiti cet; na; jalādyāropahetormarīcikādidarśanasyāpi pramāṇatāpatteḥ, tato'pi samyagjñānapūrvikā sakalapuruṣārthasiddhiḥ syāditi marīcikādyarthino...diprasarpaṇāditi gānusaraṇamayuktaṃ syāt na caivaṃ tadanusaraṇamayuktam syāt
atha jalādijñānameva nāparaṃ tatsamānakālabhāvi pūrvakālabhāvi vā marīcikādidarśanam; kiṃ punaridaṃ pramādabhāṣitam--no ced bhrāntinimittena pra॰ vā॰ 3
tathā nīlādivikalpāt tratrāk nāpi saha niraṃśadarśanamiti idamapi prapādaprabhāṣitam— manasoryugapadvṛtteḥ pra॰ vā॰ 2
bhavatu taddhetusa ddarśanam, na tu tatpramāṇam apravṛttihetutvāt, anyat pramāṇaṃ viparyāyāditi cet; atrāha--anyata ityādi
svārthaviniścayaphalād yadanyat parastaṃ tato yā pravṛttisatyāṃ viṣayabhūtāyāṃ yo'visaṃvādo'vipratipattiḥ tasya niyamena avaśyaṃbhāvena ayogāt
na hi laukikāḥ pratiparamāṇubhinnaniraṃśadarśanād vayaṃ pravṛttāḥ pravarttāmahe pravartiṣyāmahe iti pratipadyante
nanu tatphalādapi na dṛśyamāne pravṛttiḥ; anubhūyamānatvāt, nāpi bhāvini apratibhāsanāditi cet; na; paśūnāmapi tṛṇādau pravṛttidarśanāt
bhavatu śa darśanāt pravṛttiḥ tathāpi tanna pramāṇam; anyathā marīcikājalajñānamapi syāt
anyato'vikalpadarśanāt pravṛttau satyāṃ yo'visaṃvādaḥ dṛṣṭārthaprāptiḥ tasya niyamena ayogo niraṃśakṣaṇikaparamāṇudarśanāt sthūlaikasthiraprāpteḥ
nanu vyavasāyaphalādapi pravṛttau na dṛṣṭasya prāptirasti tatkāle tadatyayāditi cet; na; citraikajñānavat dṛśyaprāpyayoḥ kathañcidekatvasyāvirodhāditi
na caivaṃ tadanusaraṇamayuktaṃ syāt iti vyarthamatra punarlikhitam
nanu mābhūt kṣaṇikaniraṃśatvādau tadavisaṃvādaḥ, dṛśya-prāpyayoḥ ekatvāropyannīlādau syāditi cet; atrāha--anyata ityādi
anyata iti vyākhyātārtham, pravṛttau iti ca, anantaram avisaṃvādasya yo niyamaḥ sarvatra darśanagocare bhāvaḥ tasyā'yogāt nīlādau yogo na pūrvāparakṣaṇaviveke

vyavahāriṇaṃ prati tatrāpi tadavisaṃvādena abhyāse pratyakṣaṃ bhāvini pramāṇaṃ bhavet, anyathā pratipannavyabhicārasya śaṅkhe pītajñānaṃ prāpye saṃsthāne pramāṇamiti vyarthakamidamanumānaṃ nāma--evaṃ pratibhāso yaḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 5 ityādi
bhavatu tatraivaḥ tadyogaḥ tatraiva pramāṇaṃ syāt nānyatra ityekasya pramāṇetarabhāvaḥ
vyavahārataḥ so'pyastu iti cet; kiṃ punaridaṃ vyavahārādanyatra cintitam--pratyakṣaṃ kalpanāpoḍham pra॰ vā॰ 2
ato'yuktametat— na hyābhyāmarthaṃ paricchidya pravartamāno'rthakriyāyāṃ visaṃvādyate iti
abhyāse bhāvini pravarttakatvāt pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇam iti ca
nanu mā bhūt darśanaṃ sākṣāt pravartakam avisaṃvādakaṃ vā, tathāpi tathāvidhavikalpajananāt tadapi tathāvidhamiti cet; atrāha--taddhetutvam ityādi
2 ityādinā prameyavyavasāyaḥ svato yataḥ tadeva jñānam siddhivi॰ 1
4 ityantena ayamartha uktaḥ, tat kimaneneti cet; na; samādhyantarapratipādanārthatvādadāmaḥ
tathāhi--tasya yathoktasya vikalpasya hetuḥ kāraṇam tasya bhāvaḥ tattvaṃ darśanasya yannat sannikarṣa ādiryasya indriyādeḥ tasyeva tadvat

etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā cakṣuḥśrotramanasām aprāpyakāritvāt tajjñānaṃ prati sannikarṣasya satyasvapnajñānaṃ prati indriyasya akāraṇatvāt na tatra sannikarṣādermānatā api tu jñānasyaiva tathā yat sat tatsarvaṃ kṣaṇikam iti vyāptijñānaṃ prati na darśanasya kāraṇatā tatra tadabhāvāt na tatra tat pramāṇam api tu vikalpa eva
atha darśanamasti; tarhi tataḥ sarvasya darśanāt sarvasya sarvadarśitvamanupāyasiddham, kathamanyathā tasya kṣaṇikatvena vyaptipratipattiḥ--dviṣṭhasambandhapratipattiḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 2

atheyamapi neṣyate; kathamanumā naṃ yato dve pramāṇe syātām ? vyavahāreṇa tadaṅgīkaraṇāt aśeṣaścet; tarhi vyavahāreṇa upagateryathā prāpye bhāvini pramāṇamupagataṃ tathā tatra abhyupagantavyaṃ tadarthā mārgabhāvanā vyarthā, tadbhāvanāyā anumānarūpāyāḥ tasya prāgapi bhāvāt
saṃvṛtivikalpaścet; siddhaṃ sannikarṣādivat tasya taṃ pratyavyāpihetutvam
tato yathā sannikarṣādiparihāreṇa sarvatra darśanāmeva ataḥ pramāṇaṃ tathā ata eva darśanaparihāreṇa vikalpa eva pramāṇam
saṃsthānamātrārthakriyāprasiddhāvanyadeva jñānaṃ pramāṇamanumānaṃ tathāhi pratibhāsa evambhūto yaḥ sa na saṃsthānavarjitaḥ
yena kadācid vyabhicāra upalabdhaḥ sa yathābhiprete visaṃvādād visaṃvādyata eva
yastu vyabhicārasaṃvedī sa vicārya pravartate saṃsthānamātraṃ tāvat prāpyate paratra sandeho viparyayo vā
tato'numānaṃ saṃsthāne saṃśayaḥ paratreti pratyayadvayametat pramāṇamapramāṇaṃ ca
athavā yaduktaṃ pra jñā ka re ṇa--bhāvini pravarttakatvāt sākṣād abhyāse darśanaṃ pramāṇam anabhyāse tatrānumānajananāt iti; tatrāha--taddhetutvaṃ punaḥ ityādi
tasya anumānavikalpasya hetordarśanasya bhāvaḥ tattvaṃ punaḥ iti ubhayatra pakṣāntarasamuccaye sannikarṣāderiva tadvaditi
yathaiva hi indriyārthasannikarṣādiḥ anumānasya na hetuḥ tathā darśanamapi

yadi punaracetanatvāt nendriyādi taddhetuḥ; kathaṃ darśanasya cetanatvam ? svataḥ pratibhāsanāccet; na; śarīrasukhādinīlādivyatirekeṇa pareṇa tatpratibhāsānabhyupagamāt, śarīrādipratibhāsasya vikalpakatvamiti nirūpayiṣyate iti parasya pāśārajjū
atha anyasya abhyupagamācce tanatvam; sukhādeḥ acetanatvaṃ tathā syāt sāṃkhyena tadabhyupagamāt
tattu abhrāntatvāt sarvatra darśanameva pramāṇaṃ na vikalpo viparyayāditi cet; atrāha--abhrāntatve'pi ityādi

asyāyamarthaḥ--taddarśanaṃ sthūlastambhādyākāreṇa abhrāntaṃ cet; dūrasthitaviralakeśeṣu sthūlapratibhāsena vyabhicārāt na tathā pratibhāsād avayavisiddhiḥ ityasya sarvamālambane bhrāntam pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
atha tena bhrāntam; anyasya abhrāntasya abhāvād abhrāntamiti anarthakatvānna vācyam
atha vyavahāreṇa taduktam; viṣayastasya vaktavyaḥ ? jāyatsaṃbhādiḥ iti cet; uktamatra--kalpanāpoḍhatvaṃ durlabhamiti parasya nikaṭe saṅkaṭapraveśaḥ iti sa na labhate tattvavivecanavikaṭāṭavīm
yadi tu tanna tasya tatrābhrāntatvaṃ nāma
abhyupagamya ucyate abhrāntatve'pi, anyataḥ ityanena labdhatāpariṇāmena sambandhād anyasya iti gamyate
tasmin sati kim ? ityatrāha --nirṇayavaśāt prāmāṇyasiddheḥ anyasya pramāṇatvasthiteḥ kāraṇāt tattvātmakatvaṃ nirṇayātmakatvaṃ tattvasiddheḥ abhrāntabuddheḥ pramāṇasya abhyupagantavyam
kathañcit nīlādiprakāreṇa na pratikṣaṇapariṇāmādiprakāreṇa, tatra vyavahāriṇo darśanavyavahārābhāvāt
na di sa yasyan pratikṣaṇapariṇāmādikaṃ paśyāmi iti manyate, tadanumānavaikalyaprāpteḥ, tadvyavahārasamāropayorvirodhāt na tadvyavacchedakaraṇāt tadarthavat
atha vyavahāramullaṅghya tenāpi prakāreṇa tatsiddhiriṣyate gatamidam--prāmāṇyaṃ vyavahāreṇa pra॰ vā॰ 1
na ca paramārthapratibhāsādvaite kṣaṇabhaṅgādisaṃbhavaḥ; sarvavikalpātītatvena tadabhyupagamāt
tato yathā vyavahāreṇa kṣaṇabhaṅgādabhyupagamaḥ tathā tenaiva tatra darśanama pramāṇayitavyamiti sādhūktam--kathañciditi
nanvayamarthaḥ anyataḥ ityādeḥ tṛtīyavyākhyānena darśitaḥ tat kimaneneti cet; na; pūrvaṃ pramāṇamavisaṃvādi pra॰ vā॰ 1
yathaiva keśā davīyasi deśe'saṃsaktā api ghanasanniveśāvabhāsinaḥ paramāṇavo'pi tatheti na virodhaḥ
jāgratstambhādiviṣayatve hi tasya vikalpakatvaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ
nanu sarvapratyayapralaya evāyaṃ pravartate nātra pratīterudayaḥ
nanu yadi tattvasiddhiḥ tadātmakatvaṃ na syāt ko doṣa iti cet ? atrāha--abhyase tyādi
tattvasiddhernirṇayātmakatvaprakārād anyena avikalpakatvaprakāreṇa anyathā tadaphalam anyataḥ ityetadanuvarttamānaṃ vāttamiha saṃpadyate
etadapi kutaḥ ? ityatrāha--asataḥ kharaviṣāṇāde rna viśeṣyeta na bhidyeta yato'nyathā ityanena sambandhaḥ
anyataḥ iti pañcamyantaṃ padaṃ anyat iti prathamāntarūpeṇātra sambaddhyate iti bhāvaḥ
nanu nirṇayātmakatvaṃ nāma svārtha grahaṇātmakatvamiti cet, tadasaṃbhāvyamiti cet; atrāha— akiñcitkara ityādi
na kiñcit karotīti akiñcitkaram svāpādidarśanaṃ siddhaṃ yanna parāpekṣyam siddhivi॰ 1

24 ityādi kārikāvṛttau pratipādayiṣyamāṇaṃ saṃśayaḥ sthāṇurvā puruṣo veti jñānam, viparyayaḥ sthāṇau puruṣa iti tatra vā sthāṇuriti vedanaṃ tau karotīti iti tatkaram, punardvandvaḥ tayoḥ vyavacchedena nirāsena nirṇayātmakatvam nānyathā
nanu tadvyavacchedo nīlādyapekṣāyām avikalpadarśane'pyastīti cet; atrāha--anyathā ityādi
yena prakāreṇa nīlādau tadvyavaccheda iti bhāvaḥ, tataḥ tadātmakatvaṃ tattvasiddheḥ abhyupagantavyam iti sthitam
nanu ca ajñātārthaprakāśo vā pramāṇam pra॰ vā॰ 1
5 iti vacanāt agṛhītagrahaṇād darśanameva pramāṇaṃ na vikalpo viparyayāditi cet; atrāha--anadhigata ityādi

pramāṇāntareṇa aprakāśi to'nadhigataḥ sa cāsau arthaśca tasya adhigantṛ paricchedakaṃ yad vijñānaṃ tat pramāṇam ityapi evamapi na kevalaṃ pūrvaprakāreṇa kevalam anyānapekṣā anirṇītārthasya nirṇītiḥ abhidhīyate
uktaprakārād anyaprakāreṇa anyathā anadhigatārthādhigantṛ darśanameva pramāṇamityabhidhīyate na nirṇayajñānamiti manyate
atiprasaṅgāt nīlādāviva kṣaṇabhaṅgādāvapi darśanasyaiva pramāṇatvāt tadanumānamanarthakaṃ syāditi atiprasaṅgāt anirṇītārthanirṇītiḥ abhidhīyata iti padaghaṭanā
nanvayamarthaḥ dṛṣṭe pramāṇāntarāvṛttiprasadvāt ityetena pratipādayiṣyate tatkimanena ? tasmād anyathā vyākhyāyate--sthirasthūlasvaguṇāvayavātmakaghaṭādinirṇītireva anadhigatārthādhigantrī pratīyate
tad yadi tato'nyad anadhigatārthādhigantṛ pramāṇaṃ kalpyate tarhi tasmādapyanyat tathāvidhaṃ tasmādapyanyat ityanavasthā atiprasaṅgaḥ tasmād anirṇītārthanirṇītiḥ abhidhīyate
tatra pramīyate anena tat pramāṇam, karaṇakārakam, tacca svārthaparicchittikriyāṃ prati sādhakatamameva yuktam
kathaṃbhūtasya ? ityāha— visaṃvādakasya niraṃśānekakṣaṇikaparamāṇudarśane sthūlaikasthiraghaṭādiprāpakatvena vipralambha kasya sādhakatamatvā'nupapatteḥ kāraṇāt tannirṇītirabhidhīyate
tato'yamartho bhavati--adhigatimātraṃ svārthapratipattiṃ prati na sādhakatamaṃ visaṃvādakatvāt indudvayadarśanavaditi na pramāṇam
adhigatimātrasādhanād anyat nīlādau vikalpajñānaṃ kṣaṇikādādanumānaṃ tadantaraṃ tasya apekṣyate yasya gocarasya viṣayasya
kvacit sādhanāntarāpekṣyagocarasya iti pāṭhasūtrāpi sādhanāntaramapekṣyata iti tadapekṣo gocaro yasya tasya sādhakatamatvā'nupapatteḥ tannirṇītiḥ abhidhīyate
tadyathā--adhigatamātraṃ tattvapratipattau na sādhakatamaṃ sādhanāntarāpekṣāgocaratvāt sannikarṣādivat
nanu nirṇīteranadhigatasāmānyārthādhigame'pi anadhigatasvalakṣaṇādhigamābhāvāt anadhigamābhāvāt anadhigatārthādhigantṛ pramāṇam ityanena sā'bhidhīyate
tatra arthaśabdena svalakṣaṇābhidhānāt tato darśanameva abhidhīyata iti cet; atrāha--tad ityādi
tena adhigatimātreṇa anadhigatasya jñānāntareṇa aviṣayīkṛtasya svalakṣaṇasya arthakriyāsama rthārtharūpasya adhigatāvapi paricchittāvapi
na khalu anyena adhigatam anyadvā svalakṣaṇamadhigacchad darśanaṃ pratīyate
tasyāṃ kiṃ prāptam ? ityatrāha--dṛṣṭe darśanena viṣayīkṛte nīlādāviva kṣaṇabhaṅge pramāṇāntarasya anumānasya gṛhītagrāhitvabhayād apravṛttiprasaṅgāt kāraṇāttannirṇītiḥ abhidhīyate
evaṃ hi aniścitanīlakṣīṇakatvayorniścayād vikalpānumānayoḥ apūrvārthatā labhyate iti bhāvaḥ
nanu mā bhūd aniścitakṣaṇabhaṅganiścayāt pramāṇāntaraṃ tatra vṛttimat, api tu kṣaṇike akṣaṇikajñānasamāropavyavacchedakaraṇāt syāditi cet; atrāha--samāna ityādi
samāne sadṛśe atra bhūte darśanena dṛṣṭe yaḥ samāropaḥ viparyayajñānaviśeṣaḥ tasya vyavacchede nirāse saṃvṛtyanumānayoḥ darśanottaravikalpānumānayoḥ na kaścid viśeṣaḥ bhedaḥ

nanu yathā kṣaṇike akṣaṇikatvasamāropo naivaṃ nīle anīlatvasamāropo yattadvyacchedāya samāna ityādyucyate iti cet; ayamatrābhiprāyaḥ--yathā pūrvāparakṣaṇayoḥ tadvyāttāyāsamāropavyavacchedādanumānamarthavat tathā madhyakṣaṇe sthūlaikarūpe sañcitālambanāḥ pañca vijñānakāyāḥ ityanena paramāṇudarśanāropavyavacchedāt saṃvṛtirapi arthavatī syāditi
marīcikāyāṃ toyasamāropavyavacchedādvā tayoḥ viśeṣaṃ darśayannāha paraḥ— sākṣāt ityādi
sākṣād avyavadhānena anubhavād darśanād utpattiḥ nārthātsaṃvṛteḥ iti anubhavānkṛt pravṛttiviṣayānukaraṇāt na tasyā bhinno vyāpāra iti manyate
tataḥ tadutpattau nitarāmarthaviṣayatvasiddheḥ anumiteriva arthapratibandhād ekaviṣayatvañca na virodhi sarvajñetarajñānavat santānavirodhisarvajñotarajñānavat
uttaraṃ vikalpajñānaṃ pramāṇaṃ tasya uttarasya sādhanabhāvāt hetutvāt, natu naiva pūrvakaṃ sannikarṣadarśanādi pramāṇamiti
na kevalaṃ vikalpe kintu anumāne'pi evam uktavat prasaṅgāt tatrāpi sādhanāvabhāsyeva jñānaṃ tatkāraṇaṃ prāpye pramāṇaṃ syāt nānumānam
yaduktaṃ pra jñā ka re ṇa--abhyāse darśanamavikalpakam anyadā anumānaṃ pravarttakatvāt pramāṇam
yadyapi nāma bhāvyartho na pratipannastathāpi tatra pravartanāt pramāṇaṃ yathānumānasyāgrahaṇe'pi na hyanumāne vastusvarūpasvīkāra iti pratipādayiṣyate
na ca cakṣurādikāt pravartate jñānamantareṇa, vikalpamantareṇāpi buddhyā abhyāsāt pravartate
tato heyopādeyaviṣaye dhīreva pūrvikā pravartanāt pramāṇaṃ na vikalpādayaḥ
yatra tu nābhyāsastatra anumānameva na pratyabhijñānādayo'to nātiprasaṅgaḥ
tatra anabhyāse sati abhyāsa iti anabhyāse nirṇīteḥ upayogaṃ darśayannāha--vyavasāyātmana ityādi
vyavasāyātmano dṛṣṭeḥ saṃskāraḥ ityaṃśaḥ nyāyavi॰ vi॰ pra॰ pṛ॰ 493, 521
darśanābhyāsapāṭavaprakaraṇādeḥ dṛṣṭasajātīyasaṃskārasmṛtiprabodhe svabhāvavyavasāyamantareṇa kṣaṇabhaṅgādāvapi liṅgānusaraṇamanupapannaṃ tadaviśeṣānnīlādivat
asyāyamarthaḥ--sukhasādhanasya sukhasaca pūrvaṃ yā dṛṣṭiḥ tasyāḥ saṃskāraḥ smṛtibījam ātmapariṇamo jāyate ityadhyāhāraḥ
nanu dṛṣṭiḥ saṃskāraḥ, tataḥ smṛtirna dṛṣṭiḥ iti cet; na; uttaradṛṣṭeḥ saṃskārasahakāriṇaḥ tadudbhavādadoṣaḥ
nanveko'yaṃ dṛṣṭiśabdaḥ kathamamumarthaṃ pratipādayati ? āvṛttyābhisambandhād ekasyā dṛṣṭeḥ ubhayatra vyāpārād bhedāvagatiḥ
kva punaḥ smṛtiḥ taddhetuśca dṛṣṭiḥ pravartata iti cet ? atrāha— dṛṣṭa iti
tatra uttarā dṛṣṭiḥ tatkāryabhūtā smṛtiḥ pravartate, kathamanyathā ayaṃ mayā dṛṣṭaḥ iti pratītiḥ ? anena pūrvottaradarśanasaṃskārasmṛtīnām ekaviṣayatvaṃ darśayati
tathā dṛṣṭasajātīye dṛṣṭaścāsau uttaravyaktyapekṣayā sajātīyaśca tatra saṃskāraḥ
sā kva ? ityatrāha--sajātīye dṛṣṭena pūrvadarśanaviṣayeṇa sajātīye sadṛśe uttarasvavyaktiviśeṣe
etaduktaṃ bhavati--ekadā jalavyaktiṃ snānādihetumupalabdhavataḥ tatrāhitasaṃskārasya punaḥ tatsadṛśavyaktidarśanāt tatsamāne dṛṣṭe smṛtiḥ iti
anye tu dṛṣṭe saṃskāraḥ dṛṣṭajātīye smṛtiḥ iti vyācakṣate
kiñca, yadi dṛṣṭe saṃskāraḥ, smṛtyāpi tatraiva bhavitavyam anubhūte smṛtiḥ iti vacanāt
kuta etat ? ityatrāha--nānyathā anyena nirvikalpakaprakāreṇa yā dṛṣṭiḥ tasyāḥ na saṃskāraḥ smṛtirvā
nanu ca tasyāḥ saṃskāraḥ smṛtireva iti vaktavyam, kiṃ vāśabdena, tamantareṇa samuccayagateḥ ? na; anuktasamuccayārthatvādadoṣaḥ

tato'yamartho labhyate--pūrvasukhasādhanadarśanāhitasaṃskārasya punastasya tatsamānasya vā darśanād dṛṣṭe smṛtiḥ, tatastadevedaṃ tena sadṛśamiti vā pratyabhijñānam, tato'pi pūrvavad etat sukhasādhanasamartham iti tarkaḥ, asmādapi anumeye pravartamānasya sukhaprāptirbhaviṣyati ityanumānam, tataḥ pravṛttiḥ arthaprāptiriti
ābhimukhyena tadbhedān viniścitya pravartate || siddhivi॰ 1 | 28 iti

nanu ca yaduktaṃ sukhasya tatsādhanasya ca dṛṣṭeḥ saṃskāra iti; tatredaṃ cintyate--idaṃ sukhasādhanam asmād idaṃ sukham iti kutaḥ pratīyate ? na tāvat tatsādhanadarśanāt; tatkāle sukhānuda nutpannaṃ ca niṃtena gṛhyate
atha asmād idamu tpadyate iti ātmā pratipadyate; so'pi yadi sattāmātreṇa,...tavya iti suptamūrcchitādiṣvapi prasaṅgaḥ
atra pratividhīyate--sukhasādhanadarśanasya tadgrahaṇābhimukhyamajahata eva sukhagrahaṇapariṇāmopapatteḥ apratiṣedhaḥ
vakṣyate caitadatraiva dvitīyaprastāve--pūrvapūrvasya svaviṣayagrahaṇānubandhamajahata eva uttarottaraṃ prati sādhakatamatvāt smārtajñānavat
na cedamaprātītikam, asmādbhāvāt me sukhabhāvaḥ iti pratīteḥ
yugapadekamanekākāraṃ vyāpnoti jānātīti vā, na krameṇa iti paramagahanametat ! tataḥ siddhā sukhatatsādhanayorhetuphalabhāvapratītiḥ
krameṇa ekaḥ ātmā nānāparyāyān na vyāpnoti na vā jānāti iti kathanaṃ paramāścaryakaram
yatpunaruktam--pūrvottaradarśanasaṃskārasmṛtīnām ekaviṣayatvaṃ kutaḥ pratīyate iti ? tadapyetena notsṛṣṭam
nanu bhavatvevam, tathāpi pravṛttikāle sukhāpratipattau kathaṃ tatra dṛśyamānasya hetutā pratīyeta yatastava pravṛttiḥ syāt, pratipattau vā na pravṛttiḥ tadaiva sukhaprāpteḥ

atha pravṛttyuttarakālaṃ sukhapratipattiḥ tarhi tatsādhanapratipattau pravṛttiḥ tasyāśca sukhavat pravṛttiḥ syāt pratipattau vā na pravṛttiḥ tadaiva sukhaprāpteḥ atha pravṛttyuttarakālaṃ sukhapratipattiḥ; tarhi tatsādhanapratipattau pravṛttiḥ, tasyāśca sukhapratipattyā tatsādhanapratipattiḥ ityanyonyasamāśrayaḥ
atha sukhasādhanasya pūrvasya tatsadṛśasya vā punardarśanādevaṃ bhavati idaṃ sukhasādhanaṃ tattvāt pūrvasadṛśatvāt pūrvavat iti tataḥ pravṛttiḥ
nanvidamanumānam, taccet sukhaṃ na pratyeti, kathaṃ tat prati kasyacit kāraṇatāmavaiti ? kāyaṃpratipattināntarīyakatvāt kāraṇatāpratipatteḥ
yadi punarna siddhatayā api tu sādhyatayā tat pratyeti; tarhi sādhyatayā asataḥ, tasya ca pratītirityatisāhasam, iti kasyacit sukhasādhanasyāpratipatterna tatra pravṛttiḥ
sukha iti cet; na; tasya darśanetaravikalpadvaye pūrvavat prasaṅgaḥ

tanna kutaścit pravṛttiriti kiṃ vyavasātmanaḥ ityādinā iti cet; atrocyate--dṛśyadarśanena pūrvottarakṣaṇayoradarśane tābhyāṃ tasya kutastṛdyattāpratipattiḥ yataḥ pratyakṣasiddhā kṣaṇikatā syāditi nedaṃ subhāṣitam--yad yathāvabhāsate tattathaiva paramārthasad vyavahārāvatāri yathā nīlaṃ nīlatayā bhāsamānaṃ tathaiva tadvyavahārāvatāri, avabhāsante ca bhāvāḥ kṣaṇikatayā
atha dṛśyadarśanena tayordarśanam; dṛśyasamakālatā tathaiva parābhyupagamāt

tayorapi punaḥ anyābhyāṃ pūrvottarakṣaṇābhyāṃ kradyattāpratipattau anyayorapi tena darśanaṃ punaḥ tayorapi tato'nyābhyāṃ kradyattāpratipattau darśanaṃ tena tayorityekakālatā sakalasantānakṣaṇānāmiti nityatāpratipattivat kṣaṇikatāpratipattāvapi yugapat janmamaraṇāvadhidaśāpratipattiriti tadaiva jāto mṛtaśca syāt
atha dṛśyasya darśanena yathāsvakālaṃ tayordarśanam; sukhasyāpi tathaiva darśanamiti na dṛśye tatsādhane pravṛttivirodhaḥ
rahitatāpratipattiḥ, utṛdira hiṃsāyāmiti raudhādidhātoḥ niṣpannamidaṃ gaṇakāryasyānityatvāt
pūrvasya pūrvasmin kṣaṇe uttarasya ca uttarakṣaṇe

syānmatam--pūrvottarakṣaṇābhyāṃ madhyakṣaṇasya kradyattā svabhāvabhūtā, tataḥ tayoradarśane'pi taddarśanādeva pratīyate; tarhi tasya sukhahetutā tathā kinna pratīyate sukhādarśane'pi ? nahi sāpi tato bhinnā
nanvevaṃ sarvasyāpi bhāvadarśanādeva tatpratīteḥ sukhārthino duḥkhasādhane pravṛttiḥ sukhahetorvā nivṛttiḥ bhrāntyā na syāditi cet; na; kradyattāpratipattāvapi sasamānamiti tadanumānamanarthakam
tathā sati kathaṃ sukhasā dhane pravṛttiriti cet ? kradyattāyāṃ katham ? samāropavyavacchedāt; prakṛte samaḥ samādhiḥ
yathaiva ca ghaṭādau sattvādeḥ kṣaṇikatvena vyāptidarśanādanyatra tataḥ kradyattā anumīyate tathā ākāraviśeṣasya pūrvasukhahetutvena vyāptatayā dṛṣṭasya punaḥ kvacid darśanāt sukhahetutā anumīyatām

nanu uktamatra anumānena sukhāpratipattau kathaṃ taddhetutāpratipattiḥ ? pratipattau na pravṛttiriti cet; idamapyuktam--tena pūrvottarakṣaṇāviṣayīkaraṇe kathaṃ tatsambandhinī kradyattā madhyakṣaṇasya pratīyate yataḥ samāropo nivarteta
etena etadapi nirastaṃ yaduktaṃ pareṇa--yadyapi dṛśyasya sukhādarśane'pi taddhetutā pratīyate tavāpi niścetuṃ na śakyate iti; katham ? kradyattāyāmapi samānatvāt
bhavatu vā tadaniścayaḥ tathāpi ko doṣaḥ ? taddarśanaṃ pravṛttiheturna syāditi

kathaṃ kradyattādarśanamaniścitam anumānahetuḥ, yena yad yathāvabhāsate ityādi sūktam ? etadaniścitam anumānasya kāraṇaṃ na pūrvaṃ pravṛtteriti mahatī prekṣākāritā ! yadi ca, kāryānavadhāraṇakṣaṇe asya kāraṇatānavadhāraṇam; tarhi kathaṃ prāpyānavadhāraṇe dṛśyasya tato vivekāvadhāraṇam, yenātra pakṣatrayamutthāpitam--dṛśyaprāpyayoḥ ekatvādhyavasāyinaṃ prati prāpye pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇam, anyaṃ prati tadābhāsam, avadhāritavivekaṃ prati anumānam iti ? vyavahāreṇa tadutthāpitamiti cet; tenaiva kāryānavadhāraṇe'pi kāraṇatāvadhāraṇamiti kāraṇe pravṛttisaṃbhavādalaṃ bhāvini pravṛttyā, ekānte tadarthena kāraṇatvopavarṇanena vā, vyavahāraviparyayāt

paramārthe'pi citraikajñānādvaitarūpe nīlākāraḥ pītādyākārān anātmasātkurvannapaśyan vā yathā tatsādhāraṇīṃ bodharūpatāmātmasātkaroti paśyati vā tathā kāryānavadhāraṇe'pi kāraṇatāvadhāraṇaṃ kāraṇadarśanena
sarvavikalpātīte'pi tasmin idameva vaktavyam; tathāhi--kāraṇatvādivikalpānāṃ pratipattau kasyacit tadviviktatāvittiḥ
nahi apratipannamaśakasya neha maśakāḥ santi iti nirṇītirasti
tathā cet; susthitaṃ tadadvaitam ! apratipattau cet; prakṛtamanuṣaṅgi
tato yathā kasyacit tadviviktasya darśanāt tadbhāvavya vahāraḥ tathā ākāraviśeṣadarśanāt hetutāvyavahāro'pi sādhyate iti sūktaṃ vyavasāyātmana ityādi
yathā kāraṇatvādivikalpānāmapratipattāvapi tadviviktatāpratipattistathā kāryānavadhāraṇe'pi kāraṇatāvadhāraṇaṃ syāt
nanu yaduktam--nānyathā kṣaṇikādivat iti; tatra yadi nāma nirvikalpadṛṣṭeḥ kṣaṇikādau saṃskārādirna jāyate, tathāpi nīlādau jāyate dṛṣṭatvāt
na ca darśanam ityeva sarvatra svagocare saṃskārādihetuḥ; anyathā vyavasāyātmakamapi tathā iti gṛhītapraghaṭṭakādivismaraṇādi na bhavet
atha tat darśanapāṭavādikamapekṣate; prakṛtamapi tathaiva apekṣate iti tadabhāvānna kṣaṇikādau saṃskārādiḥ, anyatra tu asti viparyayāditi cet; atrottaramāhadarśanetyādi

tacca saṃskārādikārye sāmarthyam, muhurmuhuḥ cetasi parimalanam abhyāsaḥ, tau ādī yasya prakaraṇādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ tasmāt dṛṣṭasajātīyasaṃskārasmṛtiprabodhe dṛṣṭaḥ pūrvadarśanagocaraḥ sa cāsau sajātīyaśca sadṛśaḥ uttaraviśeṣeṇa, upalakṣaṇametat, tataḥ tenaiko'pi dṛṣṭa ityucyate, tatra saṃskāraśca smṛtiśca tayoḥ prabodhe utpāde abhyupagamyamāne
kimantareṇa ? ityatrāha--svabhāvavyavasāyamantareṇa darśanasya svarūpabhūtanirṇayamantareṇa saṃskārasmṛti vacanamapyupalakṣaṇamiti pratyabhijñānādiparigrahaḥ

tatra kiṃ syāt ? ityatrāha--kṣaṇabhaṅgādāvapi ādiśabdena svargaprāpaṇasāmarthyādiparigrahaḥ, na kevalaṃ nīlādau iti apiśabdārthaḥ, liṅgānusaraṇaṃ hetvāśrayaṇam uktamanupapannaṃ pratyakṣata eva tatsiddheriti manyate
kuta etat ? ityatrāha--tadaviśeṣāt tasya danapāṭavādeḥ aviśeṣāt kṣaṇabhaṅgādāvapi
abhyāso'pi muhurmuhuḥ kṣaṇikadarśanasya tadvikalpasya vā vṛttiḥ saugatānāṃ vidyate, tathā arthitvādayo'pi
prayogaścātra--yasminnavikale'pi yanna bhavati tanna tatkāryam, yathā avikale'pi cakrādau abhavan paṭo na tatkāryaḥ, avikale'pi ca darśanapāṭavābhyāsādau na bhavati kṣaṇikādau saṃskārādiḥiti
viparyayaprayogaḥ— yasminnavikale yad bhavati tat tasya kāryam, yathā avikale cakrādau bhavan ghaṭaḥ tasya kāryaḥ, bhavati ca nirṇaye'vikale saṃskārādiḥ iti
nanu darśanapāṭavādeḥ ityastu kimabhyāsagrahaṇamiti cet; ubhayatra ādiśabdasambandhārtham--darśanapāṭavādeḥ abhyāsādeḥ iti
tena ekatra ādiśabdena darśanapratibandhakasya guṇāntarāropasya no ced bhrāntinimittena pra॰ vā॰ 3
yadi vā, sarvatra abhyāsasya prādhānyapradarśanārtham abhyāsagrahaṇam
yaduktaṃ pareṇa--abhyāse pratyakṣam anabhyāse anumānaṃ pramāṇam iti
tatra kṣaṇabhaṅgādāviva nīlādāvapi abhyāsavirahe kutaḥ saṃskārādiḥ yato'numānam ? evaṃ tarhi dṛṣṭasajātīyasaṃskārādiprabodhe iti vaktavyaṃ nārthaḥ smṛtigrahaṇeneti cet; tat kriyate uttarārtham
tatra hi smṛtireva pradhānatayā cintyayiṣyate abhedāt sadṛśasmṛtyām siddhivi॰ 1
tulanā--yeṣāṃ tu punarabhyāsapāṭavādayo niścayasya hetavaḥ santi te mahāmatiśaktayaḥ...--pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 240
na hi dṛṣṭamityeva vikalpena gṛhyate; darśanā'viśeṣāt sarvākāreṣu vikalpodayaprasaṅgāt, api tu kaścideva abhyāsādipratyayāpekṣa ityākāragrahaṇenācaṣṭe
atha matam abhyāsaprakaraṇabuddhipāṭavārthitvebhyo nirvikalpakādapi darśanānnīlādau saṃskāraḥ smaraṇaṃ cotpadyate na punaḥ kṣaṇikādau tadabhāvāt
pāṭavaṃ tīkṣṇatā buddheḥ iti, prakaraṇāt ādiśabdāt pratyāsattitāratamyādergrahaṇam--hetubi॰ ṭīkālo॰ pṛ॰ 271
svārthadṛṣṭismṛtyoḥ svabhāvavyavasāyābhāve kutaḥ saṃkalanājñānaṃ yataḥ saṅketasmṛtyādayaḥ ? nirvikalpakadṛṣṭāvapi sajātīyādhyavasāyādiḥ suptaprabuddhavaccet; na; arthadarśanabhāve'pi tadanuṣaṅgāt
na ca punastasyaivābhidhāne sa eva samarthito nāma atiprasaṅgāt kintu anyasmāddhetoḥ, sa cātra noktaḥ, tasmāt uktārtho'nantaraśloko'yam itya na nta vī ryaḥ
kṣaṇika iti bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ, tataḥ kṣaṇikatvam ekaḥ asahāyaḥ anto dharmo yayoḥ svārthayoḥ tayoḥ saṃvit dṛṣṭiḥ

smṛtiḥ kiṃ kuryāt ? ityatrāha--sāpi smṛtirapi dṛṣṭasaṃkalanādikam dṛṣṭasya pūrvadarśanena viṣayīkṛtasya uttaraparyāyeṇa saha ekatvena sādṛśyena vā samīcīnaṃ kalanaṃ nirṇayanaṃ yena tat saṃkalanaṃ pratyabhijñānam, ādiśabdena tarkādikaṃ gṛhyate tad ādhattām iti
anantavīryo'yaṃ prakṛtaṭīkākārāt ravibhadrapādopajīvino'nantavīryād bhinna eva bhāti
yaduktam--kṣaṇabhaṅgādāvapi liṅgānusaraṇamayuktaṃ tadaviśeṣāt iti; tatrāha--parādarśana ityādi
sadṛśasya pūrveṇa samānajātīyasya aparasya kṣaṇasya yā utpattiḥ utpattiviṣayaṃ darśanam utpattiḥ viṣayiṇi viṣayaśabdopacārāt
na khalu tadutpattireva vipralambhahetuḥ, sarvadā prasaṅgāt
tayā vipralambhaḥ guṇāntarāropaḥ tasmānnāvadhārayati na niścinoti kṣaṇabhaṅgādikam iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
kuta etat ? ityatrāha--sarvathā sarvaprakāreṇa sādṛśyāsaṃbhavāt, pūrvottarakṣaṇayoḥ sārūpyasaṃbhavanāyā api virahāt

tathāhi--pūrvapūrvanityasamāropakṣaṇād uttarottarasamāropakṣaṇo yadi sarvātmanā sadṛśo jāyate tena tarhi pūrvatatkṣaṇavat uttarasyāpi uttaratatkṣaṇotpādanasya sāmarthyam, evamuttarottarasyeti āsaṃsāraṃ na kṣaṇoparamaḥ
nahi anunānena pūrvasmin samarthe uttaraṃ kāryaṃ nivārayituṃ śakyate, tasmin sati avaśyaṃbhāvāt
sadṛśāparotpattivipralabdho vā, sadṛśe hi tadevedamiti buddhiryamaje
tasmāt sadṛśāparabhāvanibandhana evāyaṃ keśakadalīstambādiṣviva ākārasāmyatāmātrāpahṛtahṛdayānāṃ bhrānta eva tattvādhyavasāyo mantavyaḥ...
pṛ॰ 86 sadṛśāparabhāvagrahakṛtaśca arvāgdarśanānāmekatvavibhramo lūnapunarjāteṣviva nakhakeśādiṣviti kinneṣyate
pṛ॰ 120 sadṛśāparamāvatibandhanaṃ caikatayā pratyabhijñānaṃ lūnapunarjāteṣviva keśanakhādiṣu ityatra virodhābhāvāditi
tathā sati caramakṣaṇābhāvaḥ syāditi cet; ayamaparo'sya doṣo'stu
tanna pūrvottaratatsamāropakṣaṇayoḥ tattve naiva uttarakāryajananasāmarthyenāpi sādṛśyam
api ca, yathā pūrvasya uttaraṃ prati kāraṇatvam, evaṃ cet tasyāpi tatprati kāraṇatvam; yuktaṃ sarvātmanā sādṛśyam
atha pūrvasmāt tatsamāropakṣaṇāt kṣaṇakṣayānumānasahāyād aparo'parajanane asamartho'samarthataro'samarthatamo jāyate; tarhi na tatsamāropatvena sādṛśyam uktaprakāreṇa
etaduktaṃ bhavati niraṃśaikānte sadṛśāparotpattyabhāvena vipralambhābhāvāt tadavadhāraṇaṃ syāditi
tayoḥ pūrvottarayoḥ samānasamāropatvenāpi sādṛśyaṃ nāsti ityarthaḥ
nanu mā bhūt pūrvāparayoḥ samānadharmānvayaḥ sādṛśyaṃ vailakṣaṇyānavadhāraṇaṃ tu syāditi cet; atrāha--vailakṣaṇya ityādi
tathāhi— tadanavadhāraṇaṃ prasajyapratiṣedharūpam, paryudāsarūpaṃ vā syāt ? prathamapakṣe tadavadhāraṇābhāvamātramanavadhāraṇaṃ kathaṃ sādṛśyaṃ vipralambhaheturvā ? anyathā kharaśṛṅgādikamapi syāt
dvitīye'pi kiṃ tad vailakṣaṇyāvadhā raṇād anyat yat tadanavadhāraṇaśabdavācyaṃ syāt ? svalakṣaṇamiti cet; ghaṭakapālādau prasaṅgaḥ, tathā ca tato vipralambhāt na tatra saṃskārasmṛtiprabodhaḥ
atha ekatvāvadhāraṇaṃ tadanavadhāraṇam; tarhi sadṛśyād vipralambhaḥ iti kimuktaṃ syāt ekatvāvadhāraṇād ekatvāvadhāraṇaṃ vipralambhaḥ iti
na ca tadeva tasyaiva kāraṇam; virodhāt
tadapi ca ekatvāvadhāraṇaṃ kuto bhavati ? sadṛśāparadarśanāditi cet; na; sarvathā sādṛśyāsaṃbhavāt atiprasaṅgaḥ, anavasthā ca
kiñca, kṣaṇabhaṅgādāvapi liṅgānusaraṇamayuktam iti vadatā tadanavadhāraṇameva coditam; tatra tadanavadhāraṇasuttaraṃ sādhyasamamiti na sādṛśyamidamapi yuktam
tasya vailakṣaṇyasya vikalpo niścayaḥ tasya kāraṇaṃ tasya vyatireko'bhāvaḥ sādṛśyam
na kevalaṃ pūrvaṃ kintu etadapi tādṛgeva pūrvasamānameva, darśanapāṭavābhyāsādeḥ tatkāraṇabhāvāt sarvathā tadvikalpakāraṇavyatirekāsaṃbhavāditi manyate
evam avikalpasya pratibandha-vaikalyavikalasyāpi darśanasya kṣaṇabhaṅgādau saṃskārādyahetutvavat nīlādāvapi tadabhidhāya idānīṃ prakārāntareṇāpi tadabhidhātukāmaḥ prāha--svārtha ityādi
svaṃ ca arthaśca tayoḥ dṛṣṭiśca smṛtiśca tayoḥ svabhāvasya svarūpasya svabhāva eva vā vyavasāyaḥ tasya abhāve

nanu bhavatu dṛṣṭestadabhāvaḥ natu smṛteḥ, tasyāḥ vyavasāyasvabhāvatvāditi cet; na; tasyā api svabhāve vyavasāyābhāve arthe'pi sa durghaṭaḥ evamadhyaṃ ca phakkikāyā ādau svabhāvagrahaṇam, anyathā vyavasāyetyādyucyeta
arthe tatra tasyā vyavasāya iṣyate; dṛṣṭerapi tathaiva syāt
dṛṣṭismṛtyoḥ iti sahavacanaṃ ca tayoḥ tulyadharmatāpratipādanārtham
itaśca parasya nirvikalpikā smṛtiḥ tathāvidhānubhavakāryatvāt uttarānubhavakṣaṇavat
tasmin sati kiṃ jātamiti cet ? atrāha--kutaḥ ityādi
kuto na kutaścit saṃkalanājñānam tadevedaṃ tena sadṛśam iti vā pratyabhijñānaṃ vyavatiṣṭhate, atrāpi uktanyāyasya saṃbhavāt
yato yasmāt saṃkalanājñānāt saṅketasmṛtyādayaḥ ādiśabdena abhilāpayojanādiparigrahaḥ, kāraṇābhāvāt tadabhāvaḥ syāditi manyate

etaduktaṃ bhavati--pūrvaṃ saṅketaviṣayasyārthasya darśanam, punaḥ tasya tajjātīyasya ca darśanāt tasya smṛtiḥ, tato'pi tadevedaṃ tena sadṛśam iti vā saṃkalanam, tato'pi saṅketasmṛtiḥ, tasyāḥ purovartini śabdayojanam, ato'pi ghaṭo'yaṃ paṭo'yam iti vikalpaṃ jñānam, tat sarvaṃ na syāditi
nanu ca yathā meghāt jalaṃ pradīpāt kajjalaṃ vijātīyād bhavati, tathā sarvatra avikalpāddarśanāt vyavahāreṇa svarūpe avikalpakam anyatra viparītaṃ smṛtyādikaṃ syāt
vikalpānniṣkrāntā sā cāsau dṛṣṭiśca tasyāmapi satyāṃ sajātīyāvyavasāyādiḥ ādiśabdena saṃkalanādiparigrahaḥ
pūrvaṃ suptaḥ paścāt prabuddhaḥ santānaḥ sa iva tadvat
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā suptapaścāttaḥ prabuddhāvasthā tathā prakṛtamapi iti
atredaṃ vicāryate--ko'yaṃ supto nāma ? svapnadarśī nidrākrānta iti cet; na tasya prakṛtasamatvā
darśīti cet; tasya yadi nirvikalpaṃ darśanam, ato'pi prabuddhaḥ tathāvidhadarśanavān; na prakṛtasya tadbhavati
na ca pareṇa tasya darśanamiṣyate acetanatvopagamāt
atha cetanārahitaṃ suptamityucyate, na tasmāt prabuddhaḥ, jāgraddaśātaḥ tadabhyupagamāt

kathaṃ parasambandhinidarśanametat pradarśitamiti cet ? na; anyathā vyākhyānāt--supta iva suptaḥ svalakṣaṇāsākṣātkaraṇāt sugatasmānumānadarśaḥ viśeṣaḥ prabuddha iva prabuddhaḥ sarvadarśyavasthābhedaḥ, tato na doṣaḥ, pareṇāpi anumānāt sugatatvopagamāt
arthadarśanabhāve'pi na kevalaṃ tadabhāve tadanuṣaṅgāt sajātīyāvyavasāyādyanuṣaṅgāt
sugatatvaprāptiprākkālabhāvinī śrutamayī cintāmayī ca bhāvanā atra kramaśaḥ parārthānumānasvārthānumānarūpā grāhyā
na bhāvanāmātrata eva yogī bhavati, api tu śrutamayena jñānena arthān gṛhītvā yukticintāmayena vyavasthāpya bhāvayatāṃ tanniṣpattau yadavitathaviṣayaṃ tadeva pramāṇaṃ tadyuktā yoginaḥ
yādṛśo yogināṃ bhāvanākramo viniściye śrutamayetyādinā'bhihitaḥ...--nyāyabi॰ dha॰ pṛ॰ 68
...śrutamayī prajñā hi āptapramāṇajo niścayaḥ, cintāmayī prajñā yuktinidhyānajo niścayaḥ...--abhidha॰ ko॰ 6
tatra indriyārthasannikarṣāpekṣiṇaḥ tatprabodhasya avikalpakalpanāyāṃ pūrvaṃ paścācca darśanamanarthakam
krameṇa yaugapadyena ca sādṛśyaikatvayoḥ vikalpabuddhiḥ sadṛśasmṛtiḥ paramatāpekṣayā ucyate
parasya hi matam--paramāṇava ekārthakriyākāriṇaḥ atatsantānaparāvṛttāḥ svasamānāḥ paramparayā tasyā hetavaḥ, tasyāṃ karttavyāyām abhedād aviśeṣāt
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā anubhavāt niraṃśāt sadṛśasmṛtisaṃbhavaḥ tathā arthādeva tathāvidhāt so'stu iti
na cedamatra codyam--arthadarśanapūrvikā smṛtiḥ sā kathaṃ tadabhāve bhavet ? anyathā sarvatra tadanuṣaṅga iti
katham ? yadi hi darśanagocare svalakṣaṇe jāyate smṛtiḥ tadā tatpūrviketi syāt, na caivaṃ sāmā nyaviṣayatvāt, naivaṃ tasyāḥ evamarthaṃ ca sadṛśasmṛtyām ityuktam
tathāpi tatpūrvikā cet; nīlasmṛtiḥ pītadarśanapūrvikā syāt

atrāha paraḥ--nārthadarśanādeva kevalādupādānāt sajātīyasmṛtiryenā'yaṃ doṣaḥ, api tu pūrvasadṛśasmṛtyāhitavāsanātaḥ uttaratatsmṛtijanma, darśanaṃ tu tadvāsanāprabodhahetutvāt taddhetuḥ ityucyate, ata eva sadṛśākāraḥ tatra na viruddhyate iti; taṃ pratyāha--na kim ityādi
saṃskārāḥ pūrvapūrvavikalpāhitavāsanā viniyamyeran uttarottaraniyatārthasadṛśasmṛtijanane niyatāḥ kriyeran, kiṃ na api tu viniyamyeranneva, pratiṣedhadvayena prakṛtārthagateḥ
sannikarṣaḥ yogyadeśāvasthānam na saṃyogādiḥ tasya niṣetsyamānatvāt, sa vidyate yeṣām arthendriyāṇāṃ te sannikarṣiṇaḥ taiḥ iti
yo yasya saṃskārasya prabodhanapaṭuḥ sannikarṣī tasya anatikrameṇa yathāsvam iti
tanna kvacidarthe darśanasya upayoga iti manyate
pūrvasya kārikādvayasya vyākhyānam kṛtvā sugamatvāt, uttarasya akṣaradvayādhikasya vyākhyānaṃ kurvannāha--vastusvabhāvo'yam ityādi
vastunaḥ padārthasya svabhāvo'yaṃ svarūpamidaṃ yadyasmāttaśca bhāvād vyavasāyo vikalpaḥ smṛtibījam smaraṇanimittaṃ saṃskāram ādadhīta vyavasāyātmano dṛṣṭeḥ siddhivi॰ 1
tanna yuktametat— vastusvabhāvo'yaṃ yadanubhavaḥ paṭīyān smṛtibījamādadhīta
tataḥ kiṃ syāditi cet ? atrāha--tataḥ tasmāt smṛtibījaprabodha prakṛṣṭaḥ saṃśayādirahito bodhaḥ sadṛśasmṛtiḥ syād bhavet
kiṃ tata eva utānyato'pi ? ityatrāha--sahakārikāraṇavaśāt iti
tena smṛtibījena saha karoti sadṛśasmṛtimitisahakāri tacca tatkāraṇaṃ ca indriyārthādi tasya vaśāt
anena paraprasiddhyā sadṛśasmṛteḥ pratyakṣatve nimittaṃ darśayati
tatra tasmin saṃbhave sati kasya tatprabodhasya sadṛśasmṛtiprabodhasya
kathaṃbhūtasya ? indriyārthasannikarṣāpekṣiṇaḥ indriyārthayoḥ sannikarṣamapekṣate ityevaṃśīlasya, kim ? avikalpakalpanāyāṃ pūrvaṃ paścācca darśanamanarthakam iti
nanu bhavatvevaṃ tathāpi sadṛśasmṛterna vaiśadyam, taduktam— na vikalpānuviddhasya spaṣṭārthapratibhāsitā
svapne'pi smaryate smārttaṃ na ca tattādṛgarthadṛg
viśadaṃ ca jñānaṃ bhavatāmadhyakṣamiti cet; atrāha--vaiśadyam ityādi
svapne'pi smaryate smārttaṃ na ca tattādṛgarthadṛg || pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 283 iti
vyavasāyātmanaḥ saṃskāraprabodhasya kāraṇasāmagryā svato vaiśadyamanubhavataḥ ko virodhaḥ ?
vaiśadyaṃ spāṣṭyam ata eva indriyārthasannikarṣāpekṣitvādeva syād bhavet
nanu saṃskārād vāsanā'paranāmnaḥ tatsmṛteḥ saṃbhave nirviṣayā sā bhavet, vaiśadye'pi kāmādyupaplutajñānavaditi cet; atrāha--asaṃskāra ityādi
na saṃskārasya pramoṣaḥ asaṃskārapramoṣaḥ saṃskārasadbhāvaḥ tasmin hi sphuṭam ata eva ityetadatrāpi sambandhanīyam saṃ jñānaṃ samīcīnaṃ saṃśayādirahitam jñānam
etaduktaṃ bhavati— saṃskāramātrabhāvi nirviṣayam, na cedaṃ tathā, arthāderapi kāraṇasya pratipādanāt
dṛśyate hi tathāvidhaṃ samīcīnaṃ svabhyaste kṣaṇabhaṅgādivat jalādau
nanu na vaiśadyaṃ vyavasāyātmanaḥ smṛteḥ kintu darśanasya tatrādhyāropāt na tasyā iti vyapadiśati
vimūḍho laghuvṛttervā tayoraikyaṃ vyavasyati || pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 133
tato'yamartho bhavati--yata eva indriyārthasannikarṣāpekṣī tatprabodhaḥ kimavikalpakalpanayā ? ata eva yasya tāṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ viṣayīkurvatāṃ darśanānāṃ nāpi naivam avaiśadyamiti
idamatra tātparyam--yathā japākusumeṣu raktatvaṃ tathā yadi darśaneṣu vaiśadyaṃ viniścitaṃ syāt tadā anyatra tadadhyāropāt pratibhātīti śakyaṃ vaktuṃ nānyathā atiprasaṅgāditi

vyavasāyātmanaḥ nirṇayasvabhāvasya saṃskāraprabodhasya saṃskārasya vāsanāparābhidhānasya yaḥ prakṛṣṭaḥ samīcīno bodhaḥ cetanāpariṇāmaḥ tasya akṣārthasannikarṣāpekṣayā svato na yācitakamaṇḍananyāyena darśanānāṃ sambandhi vaiśadyam anubhavataḥ svīkurvataḥ ko virodhaḥ na kaścit
nanu svārthayoścet pratyakṣaṃ savikalpakaṃ svābhidhānasaṃsṛṣṭayoreva grāhakaṃ syāt, tadabhidhānayorapi svābhidhānasaṃsṛṣṭayoḥ ityevaṃ yugapadanekābhidhānapratītiprasaṅgaḥ anubhavaviruddhaḥ
prayogaścātra--yat savikalpakaṃ jñānaṃ tadabhidhānasaṃsṛṣṭārthagrāhakaṃ yathā nīlamidamiti jñānam, savikalpakaṃ ca pratyakṣamiti cet; ayuktametat; anaikāntikatvāt hetoriti darśayannāha--sadṛśa ityādi
abhilāpasaṃsargayogyapratibhāsā pratītiḥ kalpaneti viśeṣaṇādadoṣaścet svārthasannikarṣanirbhāsaviśeṣavaikalyavyatirekeṇa na tadviśeṣaṇārthamutprekṣāmahe

sadṛśaḥ sannihitena samānaḥ saṅketasamayabhāvī svaśca arthaśca tasya abhilāpaḥ abhidhānam ādiryasya viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyasambandhalokasthityādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ tasya, nāpi naiva abhilāpinī śabdavatī, parapakṣanikṣiptadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ nyāyasya samānatvāt
ata eva arthābhilāpagrahaṇaṃ yugapad arthābhilāpaḥ abhilāpa pratibhāsapratipādanārtham
anavasthā ca smaryamāṇābhilāpe'pi smṛtasya tasya yojanāt, tatrāpi smṛtasyeti
nā'naikāntikaḥ tasyā avikalpakatvāt abhilāpavatī pratītiḥ kalpanā
tāvataiva anabhilāpitvamātreṇaiva avikalpakatve aṅgīkriyamāṇe tatsmṛteḥ iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
nulyā tucchā nīrūpā dhīḥ buddhiḥ syād bhavet vikalpikā kalpanaiva na syādityarthaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadā tadabhilāpasmṛtiḥ avikalpikā tadā kalpanāpoḍhatvāt pratyakṣaiva syāt--kalpanāpoḍhaṃ pratyakṣam pra॰ samu॰ pṛ॰ 8 iti vacanāt
svalakṣaṇagocaramadhyakṣam, tato na tadviṣayasya abhidhānasya dṛṣṭe yojanamiti nīlamidam ityādi vikalpābhāvaḥ iti pratyakṣalakṣaṇe kalpanāpoḍhapadamanarthakaṃ vyavacchedyābhāvāt
mābhūdayaṃ doṣaḥ iti tatsmṛtiḥ anabhilāpinyapi savikalpikā abhyupagantavyeti sa eva doṣaḥ
etenedamapi nirastaṃ yaduktaṃ pareṇa--na so'sti pratyayaḥ vākyapa॰ 1

kiñcid devadattādikaṃ kenacit daṇḍādinā viśiṣṭaṃ gṛhyamāṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ daṇḍādi viśeṣyaṃ devadattādi tayoḥ sambandhaḥ saṃyogādiḥ ādi- śabdena lokavyavasthādiparigrahaḥ teṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ saṅketakāle pratipattiḥ tadantareṇa na bhavitumarhati kintu tasmin sati bhavati
viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyaṃ ca sambandhaṃ laukikīṃ sthitim
gṛhītvā saṃkalayyaitat tathā pratyeti nānyathā || pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 145 iti
yata evaṃ tataḥ tasmāt pratyakṣaḥ purovarttī tena sadṛśo'rthaḥ saṅketakāladṛṣṭaḥ tasya abhidhānasya vācakasya smṛtiḥ anabhilāpinī abhilāpasaṃsargarahitā abhilāpādiviṣayā siddhā
tasya smaryamāṇasya abhilāpasya yo'nyo'bhilāpaḥ tasya apekṣaṇe aṅgīkriyamāṇe anavasthāprasaṅgād anabhilāpinī siddheti
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadi abhilāpavatī pratītiḥ kalpanā tarhi tadviparītā akalpanā iti svalpā dhīḥ syād vikalpikā iti

abhilapyate yena yo vā asau abhilāpaḥ śabdasāmānyam arthasāmānyaṃ ca, tena arthasya tasya vā śabdena saṃsargo yojanam tasmai yogyaḥ pratibhāso yasyāḥ sā tathoktā pratītiḥ saṃvittiḥ kalpanā ityevaṃ viśeṣaṇāt kāraṇād adoṣaḥ svalpā dhīḥ syāt vikalpikā ityasya doṣasya abhāvaḥ

svaṃ ca arthaśca svasya vā arthaḥ tasya vā sannikarṣa indriyeṇa sambandhaḥ tena janitaḥ sa cāsau nirbhāsaviśeṣaśca niraṃśaparamāṇunirbhāsaḥ tasya vaikalyam abhāvaḥ, paryudāsāpekṣayā sthūlaikapratibhāsa eva tadvaikalyaṃ tadvyatirekeṇa tadapahāya na tadviśeṣaṇārthaṃ viśeṣaṇābhidhānābhidheyam utprekṣāmahe iti kintu tadeva paśyāmaḥ
tataḥ kim tataḥ tasmāt tadviśeṣaṇārthāt kiṃ dūṣaṇamityaparaḥ
svalakṣaṇāni svayamabhimatakṣaṇakṣayaparamāṇulakṣaṇāni paśyato'pi kevalameko hi jñānasanniveśī sthavīyānākāraḥ parisphuṭamavabhāsate
na hi tayā'rthaṃ paricchidya arthakriyāyāṃ visaṃvādyate
tadarthadarśanamupanipatya svataḥ smṛtiṃ janayat nānātmanāntarīyakamākāraṃ puraskartuṃ yuktaṃ tadarthavat
nahi bahirantarvā jātucidasahāyamākāraṃ paśyāmo yathā vyāvarṇyate tathaivānirṇayāt
nānāvayavarūpādyātmana ekasya pariṇāmino ghaṭādeḥ bahiḥ saṃpratīteḥ antaḥ cittaikākārasya ekasya citrasyeva
na ca tadviparītārthaprakāśakaṃ kiñcijjñānamasti yat prakṛtaṃ bhrāntaṃ syāt

tathā sati kathamakṣaṇikatve kramayaugapadyābhyāmarthakriyāvirodhāt tīrādarśiśakuninyāyena tataḥ sattvaṃ nivartamānaṃ kṣaṇikatve avatiṣṭhate iti sataḥ sākalyena kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhiḥ ? tatraiva tābhyāṃ tadvirodhāt
parasparavilakṣaṇāni niraṃśakṣaṇāni svalakṣaṇāni paśyan saugataḥ anyo vā jinaḥ anena sañcitālambanāḥ pañca vijñānakāyāḥ iti parasya siddhānto darśitaḥ
pratyātmavedyaḥ sarveṣāṃ vikalpo nāmasaṃśrayaḥ || pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 123
isyasya ekam ityādinā vakṣyamāṇena pratyakṣeṇa bādhāpradarśanārtham; tathāhi--
tadyathā--sthūlaṃ mahattvopetaṃ ghaṭādikaṃ vyavasyati niścinoti saugato jano vā na sūkṣmaṃ paramāṇurūpam ekaṃ yugapadanekāvayavaguṇasādhāraṇam
nanu vyavasyati tathābhūtaṃ tattu kalpanāmitikalpitatvāt aparisphuṭamiti cet; atrāha--sphuṭam iti
tato nirākṛtametat yaduktaṃ--pra jñā ka re ṇa asthūlā'nekāpekṣayā tat sthūlamekam iti na pāramārthikam
na hi vastusvabhāvāḥ parāpekṣayā bhavanti atiprasaṅgāt
tathaiva tat, na parāpekṣametat, svayaṃ sthūlasyaiva bilvakapitthādeḥ sarṣapāpekṣayā sthūlatāvyavahāraḥ
na hi tathā'pariṇatam anyāpekṣayā tad bhavati atiprasaṅgāt
yat yasmāt vaiśadyaṃ viddhi jānīhi sadṛśasmṛteḥ vyavasāyātmano dṛṣṭeḥ sambandhīti
tathā pariṇatameva tat bhavati na parāpekṣayā tathā'pariṇataṃ tad bhavitumarhati, vyavahāra eva hi parāpekṣayā bhavati na svarūpam
nanu yadi pratyakṣaṃ kalpanāpoḍham pra॰ vā॰ 2

123 ityāderniṣedhārtham ekam ityādi vacanam; tarhi ekaṃ sthūlam ityanena akṣiṇakam ityanena vā tannirākriyata ityubhayavacanamanarthakamiti cet; na; kramā'kramānekāntayoḥ samānabalatāpratipādanārthatvāt tadvacanasya

tathāhi--yathaiva pra jñā ka ra sya madhyakṣaṇadarśanaṃ pūrvottarakṣaṇau draṣṭumasamarthamiti na tayoḥ tena ekatvaṃ hetuphalabhāvamanyaṃ vā sambandhaṃ pratyetumarhati dviṣṭhasaṃbandhasaṃvittiḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 2
tathā madhyakṣaṇasya pūrvasūkṣmaniraṃśaikāṃśagrahaṇe magnaṃ na tad itarabhāvatvākṣituṃ kṣamate iti teṣāmapi saiva vārttā syāt
na ca tadaṃśajñāna sāmānyavat iti sarvaśūnyatāprasaṅgaḥ

sa mā bhūditi stambhajñānamekamabhyupagantavyam, tacca madhyabhāge pravartamānaṃ tadgrahaṇānubandhamajahadeva ūrdhvādhastaryagbhāgeṣu yathā pravartate tathā mṛtpiṇḍe pravartamānaṃ tadgrahaṇānubandhamajahadeva krameṇa śivikā dīni avasyatīti siddham--akṣaṇikaṃ sphuṭaṃ vyavasyati iti
itaranirapekṣaṃ sat svarūpaṃ labhate, iti astitvavihīnamityarthaḥ
athavā sāmānyavat--sāmānyam astitvaṃ tadvat astitvaśāli irtthaḥ
pūrvakārikāyāṃ sadṛśetyādinā parakīyasya hetoḥ anaikāntikatvaṃ darśitam, tāvataiva ityādinā kalpanāpoḍham pra॰ vā॰ 2
123 iti lakṣaṇasya vyavacchedyābhāvaḥ, anena ślokena tadasaṃbhavaḥ iti vibhāgaḥ

svalakṣaṇāni kathambhūtāni ? svayam ātmanā saugatena na jainena naiyāyikādinā vā abhimataḥ aṅgīkṛto yaḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe kṣayaḥ nāsau niranvayo na pariṇāmalakṣaṇaḥ ṣaṭkoṇasthānalakṣaṇo vā, tena upalakṣitā ye paramāṇavaḥ te lakṣaṇaṃ svarūpaṃ yeṣāṃ tāni tathoktāni
tāni kim ? ityatrāha--paśyato'pi vīkṣyamāṇasyāpi saugatasya na kevalamapaśyataḥ kevalam eko hi jñānasanniveśaḥsthavīyān ākāraḥ parisphuṭamavabhāsata iti
nanu tathāvidhāni svalakṣaṇāni paśyataḥ tathāvidha ākāro'vabhāsate iti viruddhametat
nahi nīlaṃ paśyataḥ pītaṃ tathā'vabhāsate iti vacanamaviruddham iti cet; na; arthāparijñānāt
ayaṃ hi asyārthaḥ--sañcitālambanāḥ pañca vijñānakāyāḥ iti parasya rāddhāntaḥ
tatra ca yāvantaḥ paramāṇavo na tāvantyeva tadākārānukārīṇi jñānāni, santānāntaravad bhedāt samūhādipratītivilopāt, ekaṃ teṣāṃ jñānaṃ grāhakamabhyupagantavyam
hi iti yasmādarthe, yasmādevaṃ tadavisaṃvādakaṃ sadṛśasmaraṇamasti ityanena sambandhaḥ
kathambhūto'sau ? ityatrāha--jñānasanniveśo bhedavivakṣayā paramāṇubhirarpitā jñānasya ākārā jñānāni samyak kathañcittādātmyena niveṣṭuṃ śīlaḥ sanniveśī

nanu kārikāyām sthūlaṃ vyavasyati iti vacanāt nātisāyikasya śrutiḥ vṛttau tu sāsti tatkathaṃ vṛttikārikayoḥ sāṅgatyamiti cet ? ayamabhiprāyaḥ--saugatāpekṣayā madhyakṣaṇaḥ sthūlaḥ ekasyānekabhāvavyāpteḥ, sa eva jaināpekṣayā atiśayena sthūlaḥ sāvayavaḥ pūrvottarakṣaṇavyāpteḥ
tataḥ prakṛtya ādau sthūlam iti vyākhyātam

nanu yadi mama svalakṣaṇāni kṣaṇikaparamāṇulakṣaṇāni paśyataḥ tathāvidha ākāro'vabhāsate kathaṃ tathā na jānāni ? kathamanyathā yat sat tatsarvamanekāntātmakam iti vakṣyamāṇakamanumānamarthavat ? itarā kṣaṇakṣaye'pi pakṣe tadanumānamanarthakaṃ na syāditi cet; atrāha--jānāsauṣṭhavapradarśanārthaḥ yadi tubhyaṃ saugatāya rocate diṇḍika rāgaṃ parityajya yadi tatra ruciṃ kuruṣe svayameva

nanu jñānasanniveśī sthavīyānākāro'vabhāsate, kintu tajjñānasya anakṣajatvāt, akṣajaṃ jñānaṃ svārthaparisphuṭam, abhidhānajanatisvargādivikalpapratibhāsā'viśeṣācca na parisphuṭamavabhāsata iti cet; atrāha--prakṛta ityādi

prakṛtā pramāṇasya utpādeḥ adhikṛtā yā sadṛśasmṛtiḥ tasyātivā avyāpṛtākṣasya arthagrahaṇaṃ prati avyāpṛtābhyekṣaṇiyasya yā buddhiḥ vikalpikā tasyām apratibhāsanāt ekasya jñānasanniveśinaḥ sthavīyasatsvākārasya iti tāpariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā prakṛtasadṛśasmṛtau tadākārasya pratibhāsanaṃ tathā yadyavyāpṛtendriyavikalpabuddhau syāt yuktametat, na caivam, ekatra sphuṭatayā anyatra viparyayeṇa pratibhāsanāt
sadṛśaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ yugapatkramabhāvibhāge svākāro yasya tam aśabdaṃ śabdararvamarthaṃ smaratyeva niścinotyeva
atiśayena sthūla iti sthavīyān ityatra atiśayārthasya śrutiḥ vṛttau vartate
ḍiṇḍikarāgam--pareṇokte tasyopari mayā'vaśyamayuktatayā niṣphalamabhidhānīyam ityasthānābhiniveśam--hetubi॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 71
nanu bhavatu prakṛtasadṛśasmṛtau tathāvidhākārasya tathābhāsanam tathāpi sā pramāṇaṃ mābhūd dūrasthitaviralakeśādau tathāvidhākārābhāve'pi tadavabhāsadarśanāditi cet; ityatrāha--tasyāśca ityādi
tasyā eva prakṛtasadṛśasmṛtereva prāmāṇyaṃ yuktam upapannam
na hiḥ yasmāt tayā prakṛtasadṛśasmṛtyā arthaṃ sadṛśākāraṃ vastu paricchidya pravartamānaḥ arthasya kriyāyāṃ prāptau visaṃvādyate dūrasthitaviralakeśādiṣu sthūlaikākāravad vipralambhaṃ nārhati
bhavatu avisaṃvādinīyaṃ tathāpi nāsyāḥ prāmāṇyaṃ darśanadṛṣṭaviṣayatvāt
etadevāha--anadhigatārthādhigantṛtvābhāvād ayuktamiti, darśanena anadhigato'paricchinno yo'rthaḥ tasya adhigantṛtvād ayuktaṃ prāmāṇyamiti; atrottaramāha--atroktam iti
atra pūrvapakṣe uktam uttaram anadhigata siddhivi॰ pṛ॰ 24 ityādi
3 ityādi anyataḥ pravṛttau avisaṃvādaniyamā'yogāt siddhivi॰ vṛ॰ 1
7 ityādi ca anadhigatārthādhigantṛ pramāṇamityapi siddhivi॰ vṛ॰ 1
3 ityādinā ca pratyekapakṣe nirākṛtya samuttaram anadhigatetyādi pramāṇamavisaṃvādijñānāmityādi anyataḥ pravṛttāvavisaṃvādaniyamāyogāt samudāyapakṣe nirākurvannāha--tatsamuccaya ityādi

7 ityetayoḥ samuccayaḥ samudāyaḥ sa eva lakṣaṇaṃ pramāṇasya yasya tasmin pramāṇe aṅgīkriyamāṇe pratyakṣanumānayormadhye anyatarasya pratyakṣasya anumānasya vā apiśabdād dvayorapi prāmāṇyāsaṃbhavāt, tasyāśca prāmāṇyaṃ yuktamiti sambandhaḥ
tathāhi--parasya pratyakṣe ajñātārthaprakāśo'sti na tu avisaṃvādaḥ, tatra svārthayoḥ vipratipattiviṣayatvāt
