anumāne avisaṃvādo'sti na punaḥ ajñātārthaprakāśaḥ, vyāptigrāhakajñānagṛhītagocaratvāt
tasmādanadhigatārthaviṣayaṃ pramāṇamityapi anadhigate svalakṣaṇe iti viśeṣaṇīyam
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt aśābdam śabdānām idaṃ śābdaṃ tatkāryamiti yāvat, na śābdam akṣajamityarthaḥ
avisaṃvādakaṃ svayam adhyavasitārthaprāpakaṃ sadṛśasmaraṇaṃ yugapat kramabhāvibhāgasādhāraṇākārajñānaṃ paraprasiddhyā sadṛśasmaraṇam ucyate asti vidyate
nanu cedaṃ nākṣajaṃ kintu mānasaṃ saṃhṛtasakalavikalpāvasthāyām akṣajasya anyathā darśanāditi cet; atrāha--saṃhṛta ityādi
saṃhṛtāḥ sakalā vikalpā yasyām avasthāyāṃ tasyāmapi na kevalam anyasyāṃ tathaiva uktaprakāreṇaiva pratibhāsanāt svārthayoḥ iti
nanu yadi sā avasthā; kathaṃ tathaiva pratibhāsanam ? taccet; na sā'vasthā, tathāpratibhāsasya vikalpātmakatvāditi cet; satyam, tathāpi tato'nyasya vikalpasya abhāvāt saṃhṛta ityādi vacanam
pareṇa hi yā'sau tadavasthā upavarṇitā saṃhṛtya sarvataścintām pra॰ vā॰ 2

tato nirākṛtametat yaduktaṃ pareṇa--yad upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaṃ yatra nopalabhyate tat tatra nāsti yathā pradeśaviśeṣe ghaṭaḥ, upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptāśca kalpanāḥ saṃhṛtāśeṣavikalpāvasthāyāṃ darśane nopalabhyante iti

tathaiva pratibhāsanaṃ hi kalpanātmakamātmānaṃ pratipadam ātmani viparītakalpanāṃ pratihantīti saṃhṛtāśeṣavikalpāvasthāyāṃ darśanasya kalpanāvirahasiddhau yat sādhanamuktaṃ pareṇa--yā kalpanā yasmin kāle vidyate sā tatkālasambandhinī punaḥ smaryate, yathā godarśanakālasambandhinī aśvakalpanā, na ca saṃhṛtāśeṣavikalpāvasthābhāvinī punaḥ smaryate sā
iti veti na pūrvoktāvasthāyām indriyād gatau || pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 125 iti
darśanam avikalpārthadarśanaṃ kartṛ upanipatya upaḍhaukya svakāryajanmanyavyavahitaṃ bhūtvā na punaḥ saṅketasmṛtijananena
asyāyamarthaḥ--yaḥ avikalpo bodhaḥ prāk svasattāsamaye ajanako buddheḥ sadṛśasmṛteḥ sa upayogāviśeṣataḥ vyāpārāviśeṣataḥ sa paścādapi saṅketasmṛtyuttarakālamapi te saugatasya na syāt janakaḥ
tataḥ kiṃ syāt ? ityatrāha--arthasya avikalpabodhalakṣaṇasya apāye'pi abhāve'pi netradhīḥ akṣajavikalpabuddhiḥ
svataḥ ātmanaiva na vāsanāprabodhadvāreṇa saṃskārā viniyamyeran siddhivi॰ 1
6 iti doṣāt smṛtiṃ smaraṇam janayad utpādayat nānātmanāntarīyakam ātmani tadarthadarśanasvarūpe avidyamānamākāraṃ sāmānyarūpaṃ na puraskartuṃ smṛteḥ agre darśayituṃ yuktam upapannam
tasya darśanasya artho niraṃśasvalakṣaṇaṃ tadarthaḥ sa iva tadvaditi
yathā tadartha upanipatya svato darśayan nānātmanāntarīyakamākāraṃ puraskartuṃ yuktaḥ tathā darśanamapi iti
anyathā arthādeva sāmānyāvabhāsino jñānasya udayād idamayuktaṃ syāt--taddhi arthasāmarthyam ityādi
tathāhi--arthasya sāmarthyena samudbhavāt ityāha--taddhi arthasya sāmarthyenātpadyamānaṃ tadrūpamevānukuryāt
yat punaratroktaṃ pra jñā ka ra gu pte na--nedaṃ svatantraṃ sādhanam api tu prasaṅgasādhanam
tayāhi--bahirarthagrāhakaṃ ced darśanaṃ pareṇeṣyate tasmādutpannaṃ tadākārānukāri ca abhyupagantavyam, anyathā tadayogāditi niraṃśā'rthānukāritvāt nirvikalpakaṃ siddham
iti; tadanena apāstam; yatra hi vyāpyābhyupagamo vyāpakābhyupagamanāntarīyakaḥ pradarśyate tatprasaṅgasādhanam
na caivaṃ nīlādivikalpasya gṛhītagrāhitvam, iti na yuktam ajñātārtha pra॰ vā॰ 1

yadā caivaṃ vyavahārī vadati yathā mama jñānādanutpannaḥ atadākārānukārī vā arthaḥ tasya kāraṇam, tathā arthādanutpannam atadākāraṃ jñānaṃ tasya grāhakam; tadāpi kathaṃ prasaṅgasādhanam ? tataḥ sthitam--tadarthavat iti
tathā ca yathā darśanaṃ tadarthājjāyamānam avikalpakam, tathā taddarśanādutpadyamānaṃ smaraṇamapi iti vikalpavārtāpi gatā, iti na yuktametat--punarvikalpayan kiñcid āsīnme kalpanedṛśī
na cā smṛtau saṃhṛtāśeṣavikalpāvasthāpyasti, kalpanāpi tadā tathaiva anyathā bhavet
atha sāmānyāvabhāsi smaraṇamiṣyate; darśanamapi tathaiṣyatāmiti kathaṃ tadavasthābhāvinī kalpanā na smaryate iti bhāvaḥ
...sādhyasādhanayorvyāpyavyāpakabhāvasiddhau vyāpyābhyupagamo vyāpakābhyupagamanāntarīyakaḥ vyāpakābhāvo vā vyāpyābhāvāvinābhāvī ityetapradarśanaphalam
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt darśanaṃ pratyakṣaṃ na asādhāraṇaikāntagocaram asādhāraṇa ekaḥ asahāyaḥ anto dharmo gocaro yasya tat tathoktam na

vyāpṛtāni jñānajanane praṇihitāni akṣāṇi indriyāṇi yasya tasya kadācit saṃhṛtāśeṣavikalpāvasthāyām anyadaśāyāṃ vā kvacid bahirantarvā tathaiva asādhāraṇagocaraprakāreṇaiva apratīteḥ darśanasya iti padaghaṭanā
hiḥ yasyāt na bahirantarvā jātucit kadācit asahāyaṃ pratyanīkadharmarahitam ākāraṃ vastusvarūpaṃ paśyāmaḥ yathā yena prakāreṇa vyāvarṇyate kathyate paraiḥ ityadhyāhāraḥ
kuta etat ? ityatrāha--tathaivā'nirṇayāt tathaiva varṇitaprakāreṇa anirṇayāt aniścayāt
ghaṭa ādiryasya śarīrādeḥ sa ghaṭādiḥ tasya
kuta etat ? bahiḥ jñānādanyatra deśe saṃpratīteḥ nirṇayāt ekasya na paramāṇusaṃcayarūpasya asahāyamākāraṃ nahi paśyāmaḥ iti sambandhaḥ
evamapi ca avayavaguṇebhyo bhinnasya tasya saṃpratīteḥ naiyāyikādimatasiddhiriti cet; atrāha--nānāvayavarūpādyātmana iti

nānā avayavāśca rūpādayaśca ātmāno yasya sa tathoktaḥ, te calāśca acalāśca āvṛtāśca anāvṛtāśca raktāśca tadviparītāśca naṣṭāścā'naṣṭāśca avayavāḥ nānāvayavāḥ, tadātmanaḥ iti vacanāt calaiḥ pāṇyādibhiḥ calaḥ viparītaiḥ acalaḥ sa ityuktaṃ bhavati
nahi pāṇyādyavayavacalane sa na calati ityatrāpi tathāsaṃpratīteranyat śaraṇamasti

iyameva pratītiḥ, netareti cet; na; ekadeśacalane'pi loke śarīraṃ calati iti vyavahāradarśanāt, tathāhi--yadā kimayaṃ mṛta uta jīvati iti kvacit sandehaḥ, tadā jīvati ayaṃ hastacalane'pi śarīraṃ calayati yataḥ iti vyavahāradarśanāt

avayavakriyāyāḥ avayavini upacārāt tathāvyavahāraḥ, aśvakriyāyāḥ puruṣe upacārāt puruṣo yāti iti vyavahāravaditi cet; tarhi na avayave'pi paramārthataḥ kriyā syāt, tatrāpi parakriyopacārāt tathā vyavahārāt
ekasya caletararūpatvamayuktaṃ virodhāditi cet; na; svarūpeṇa virodhāsiddheḥ
nahi yad yasya svarūpaṃ tat tena virudhyate, sarvabhāveṣu tathātvāpatteḥ
yo'pyāha paraḥ--pāṇyavayave calati na śarīraṃ calati
yaḥ khalu avayavasya aṅgulyādeḥ alpasya kriyāhetuḥ prayatnaḥ nāsau mahataḥ śarīrasya kriyāhetuḥ, na vai yāvān saṃyogaḥ tṛṇamapasārayati tāvākleṣṭamiti
naca aṅgulyavayave calati śarīraṃ calati iti pratyayo'sti
iti; so'pyanena nirastaḥ; na khalu aṅgulyavayave calati tatsamavetamaparamacalaṃ svarūpaṃ paśyāmaḥ, tatra nāṭyākārapratītivirahāt
tathāpi tatkalpane acalāvayaveṣu calamavayavirūpaṃ kalpanīyaṃ syāt

tathāhi--pāṇau kampavati tadāśritaṃ śarīraṃ na kampate, pāde vā kampamāne tadgataṃ śarīraṃ na kampate ityekasya viruddhadharmatāprasaṅgaḥ; tadasaṅgatam; pāṇau kampamāne śarīrakampasyāvaśyambhāvaniyamābhāvāt
yadā pāṇimātraṃ cālayituṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavati tadā tanmātraṃ calati na śarīraṃ kāraṇābhāvāt
yadā tu śarīrasyāpi calanakāraṇaṃ bhavet tadā śarīraṃ calatyeva nāsyācalanamastīti kuto virodhaḥ ?--praśa॰ kanda॰ pṛ॰ 41-42
yatpunaruktaṃ tenaiva--yadi avayavasaṃkarmasamānakālam avayavini karma syād api tarhi aṅgulyavayave calati śarīraṃ calatīti pratyayaḥ syāt
kiṃ kāraṇam ? asati deśavyavadhāne upalabhyādhārasamavetasya karmaṇaḥ pratyakṣatvāt, na caivam aṅgulyavayave calati calati śarīramiti pratyayaḥ
iti; tadapi na yuktam; uktottaratvāt, hastacalane'pi śarīraṃ calayati iti vyavahāradarśanāt iti
kiñca, avayavātmakatve avayavinaḥ avayavasya pāṇyādeḥ ākāśādibhyo vibhāge niyamena vibhāgaḥ, tairvā saṃyoge saṃyogaḥ siddho bhavati na bhede
na hi hastasya kutaścid vibhāge kenacidvā saṃyoge calataḥ acalasya sa yuktaḥ

kuta etat ? kāraṇena viyoginā saṃyoginā vā kāryamavaśyaṃ viyujyate saṃyujyate vā yathā tantvādisaṃyoginā turyādinā paṭādiriti cet; syādetadevaṃ yadi kāryakāraṇayoḥ kathañcidaikyaṃ syāt, itarathā kumbhakārakāraṇenāpi viyoginā saṃyoginā vā kenacit sarvaṃ ghaṭādi tatkāryaṃ viyujyeta saṃyujyeta vā
samavāyikāraṇena iti viśeṣaṇādayamadoṣaḥ, kathamadāḥ kāryakāraṇabhedaikānte samavāyītarakāraṇavibhāgakāraṇābhāvāt
samavāyaḥ tatkāraṇamiti cet; na; tasya niṣedhasyamānatvāt pratyakṣaṃ savikalpakaṃ ca siddhivi॰ 2
aniṣedhe'pi yathā vivakṣitayoḥ kāryakāraṇayoḥ antarāle samavāyaḥ; tathā ghaṭādikumbhakārayorapi

atha sambandhā'viśeṣe'pi kutaścit pratyāsatteḥ kiñcit kasyacit samavāyi kenacit saṃyujyamānena viyujyamānenavā saṃyujyate viyujyate vā kviñcit; tarhi tasyā eva kasyacit kenacit tādātmyasiddheḥ kiṃ samavāyena vibhāgajavibhāgena saṃyogajasaṃyogena ca ? pāṇyādeśca kutaścit kenacid vibhāgāt saṃyogādvā na paraṃ śarīrasya vibhāga saṃyoga vā paśyāmaḥ
tathāpi tatkalpane ekameva na kiñcit syāt
atha pāṇiśarīrayorapi bhedaḥ; kutaḥ ? vibhāgabhedāt; anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ--pāṇiśarīrayoḥ bhedasiddheḥ vibhāgabhedasiddhiḥ, asyāśca prakṛtasiddhiriti

nāpi pāṇyākāśayoḥ pariṇāmaviśeṣavyatirekeṇa parastayorvibhāgo'sti yaḥ śarīrākāśavibhāgakāraṇaṃ syāt, anyathā kāraṇavibhāgāt kāryavibhāgāt, kāryavibhāgasya tadantaraṃ tayorekatābhayāt syāt, tatrāpi tadantaramityanavasthā
svarūpameva tatastasya vibhaktamiti cet; anyatrāpi tadastu
kiñca, yadi ākāśādinā saṃyukte pratīyamāne eva śarīre tataḥ pāṇyādivibhāgapratītiḥ syāt, yuktametat-- pāṇyākāśavibhāgāt śarīrākāśa-vibhāgaḥ tataḥ śarīrākāśasaṃyoganivṛttiḥ
na caivam, tathā kramānupalakṣaṇāt, pāṇyākāśavibhāgakāla eva śarīrākāśavibhāgadarśanāt
nahi kaścit khādinā saṃyukta eva śarīre mama tataḥ pāṇyādikaṃ vibhaktamiti manyate
utpalapatraśatavedhavad āśuvṛtteḥ tadanupalakṣaṇamiti cet; bhavedevaṃ yadi tatpatrāṇāṃ svarūpadeśabhedavat tadvibhāgānāṃ svarūpakālabhedaḥ kutaścit siddhaḥ syāt, na caivam, pratītibādhanāt
kāraṇavibhāgāttāvat kāryāviṣṭe kāraṇe karmotpannaṃ yadā tasya avayavāntarād vibhāgaṃ karoti na tadā ākāśādideśāt, yadā tu ākāśādideśādvibhāgaṃ karoti na tadā avayavāntarāditi sthitiḥ
tato vibhāgācca dravyārambhakasaṃyogavināśaḥ, tasmin vinaṣṭe kāraṇābhāvāt kāryābhāva ityavayavivināśaḥ

tadā kāraṇayorvartamāno vibhāgaḥ kāryavināśaviśiṣṭaṃ kālaṃ svatantraṃ vā avayavamapekṣya sakriyasyaivāvayavasya kāryasaṃyuktādākāśādideśāt vibhāgamārabhate na niṣkriyasya, kāraṇābhāvāduttarasaṃyogānutpattāvanupabhogyatvaprasaṅgaḥ
na tu tadavayavakarma ākāśādideśād vibhāgaṃ karoti tadārambhakālātītatvāt
pradeśāntarasaṃyogaṃ tu karotyeva akṛtasaṃyogasya karmaṇaḥ kālātyayābhāvāt

kāraṇākāraṇavibhāgādapi katham ? yadā haste karmotpannamavayavāntarād vibhāgamakurvad ākāśādideśebhyo vibhāgānārabhya pradeśāntare saṃyogānārabhate tadā te kāraṇākāraṇavibhāgāḥ karma yāṃ diśaṃ prati kāryārambhābhimukhaṃ tāmapekṣya kāryākāryavibhāgānārabhante, tadanantaraṃ kāraṇākāraṇasaṃyogācca kāryākāryasaṃyogāviti
kāraṇasaṃyoginā hyakāraṇena kāryamavaśyaṃ saṃyujyate iti nyāyaḥ--praśa॰ bhā॰ pṛ॰ 485
yatpunaruktaṃ pareṇa--pāṇyākāśayorvibhāgāt tatsaṃyogavināśaḥ iti; tanna sundaram; saṃyoge sati vibhāgānutpādāt tadvirodhini
yathaiva hi saṃyogavirodhini vibhāge samutpanne saṃyogo naśyati tathā vibhāgavirodhini saṃyoge sthite vibhāgo notpadyate
na hi śītavirodhini pāvake sthite śītotpādādiḥ
saṃyoge vinaṣṭe tadutpāda iti cet; kutastarhi tadvināśaḥ ? vibhāgāditi cet; anyonyasaṃśrayaḥ--sati saṃyogavināśe vibhāgotpādaḥ, tasmācca tadvināśa iti
atha dṛśyata eva saṃyoge satyeva vibhāgotpādaḥ, na dṛṣṭe'nupapannaṃ nāma iti cet; na; tathāpratītivirahāt
vibhāgābhāve kutastannāśa iti cet ? tannāśābhāve kuto vibhāgaḥ ? svakāraṇāt karmaṇa iti cet; tāso'pi svakāraṇāt iti brūmo dravyāderiti yadvakṣyate--
sva to'nyato vivarteta kramāddhetu phalātmanā || siddhivi॰ 3 | 21 iti

na ca anyonyāpasaradvastuvyatirekeṇa paraṃ karma, yad vibhāgasya anyasya vā kāraṇaṃ syāt, itarathā utkṣepaṇādikṣayotpattāvapi yadi dravyaṃ svabhāvato na calati na tarhi tasya kutaścid vibhāgaḥ saṃyogo vā deśāntarādinā, aviśeṣeṇa sarvasya prasaṅgāt
atha yasyaiva taditi matiḥ; kasya ? samavāyasambandhaḥ ākāśāderapi
eṣa yaḥ calayati iti pratīyate tasya taditi; na; svayamacalati tatpratītyayogāt bhrāntatāprasaṅgāt
svayaṃ calati cet; tarhi dravyasvarūpaviśeṣa eva kriyā na parā, iti na yuktametat--ekadravyamaguṇaṃ saṃyogavibhāgeṣu kāraṇamanapekṣamiti karmalakṣaṇam
17 iti viphalam kāryavirodhi karma vaiśe॰ sū॰ 1
kāryaṃ virodhi yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ--vaiśe॰ upa॰ pṛ॰ 21
iti; tadapi na prātītikam; nahi pūrvaṃ śarīrarahitasya pāṇeḥ ākāśena saṃyogaḥ, paścāt śarīrasya iti pratītirasti

api ca, yadi gaganādibhyo viyujyamāne pāṇau śarīraṃ viyujyate, taiḥ saṃyujyamāne tasmin tat saṃyujyate vā; tarhitebhyo'viyujyamāneṣu pādādiṣu tadaiva tanna viyujyate iti yugapat tat saṃyuktamanyathā ca syāt
syānmatam--sarvātmanā tad viyuktameva, kintu ākāśādibhiḥ saṃyujyamāneṣu pādādiṣu āśu tatsaṃyoga iti tatsaṃyuktapratipattyaviccheda iti; tanna nirūpitābhidhānam; anyathāpyavirodhāt
na hi ekaṃ calāvayavāpekṣayā calam anyathā acalam, tathā vibhakta-saṃyuktāvayavāpekṣayā saṃyuktaṃ vibhaktaṃ ca viruddham, sacalaikarūpavat
atha etadapi neṣyate; kathaṃ tarhi guṇāśca guṇāntaram vaiśe॰ sū॰ 1
10 ityatra sūtre antaraśabdasya uktaṃ prayojanamidaṃ śobhate--kāryakāraṇaguṇayoḥ kvacit jātyantaratvajñāpanārthatvādadoṣaḥ
katham ? yathā śuklāśuklaiḥ tantubhirārabdhasya paṭasya rūpaṃ kāraṇarūpebhyo jātyantaramiti
kā punaḥ tatra rūpe jātiḥ ? citratvamiti brūmaḥ
viśeṣānavadhāraṇāt, yasvā saurūpa viśeṣaḥ śuklatvādiḥ so'smāt nāvadhāryate iti
citraṃ tadekamiti cet, idaṃ citrataraṃ mahat | pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 200 iti;
kva tarhi vartate iti cet ? ekasmin śabale rūpe vartate iti
tathā ca pratibhāsaḥ--śabalo gauḥ śabalaḥ khalu aśva iti

katham ? yadi hi śuklāśuklaiḥ tantubhirjanite paṭe nīlādīni rūpāṇi bhinnāni bahūni vartante; api tarhi karmāṇi bahūni yugapadekasmin dravye ṇa vartante, sajātīyatve samānendriyagrāhyatve ekadravyatve ca sati avibhudravyavṛttitvāt rūpavat
athaikam; nīlādayaḥ kva vartante ? dravye cet; prakṛto doṣaḥ
tadrūpa iti cet; kena sambandhena ? saṃyogeneti cet; tadrūpanīlādyoḥ dravyatvam
viśeṣaṇībhāveneti cet; rūpādayo'pi dravye tenaiva vartanta iti samavāyābhāvaḥ
tataḥ sthitam--calācalasaṃyuktāsaṃyuktatvapratipādanārtham ekasya nānāvayavātmanaḥ iti vacanam, dṛśoḥ avayavaiḥ adṛśośca dṛśyetarātmakatvapratipādanārthaṃ ca
tulanā--ekadā ekasmin dravye ekameva karma vartate, ekaṃ karma ekatraiva dravye vartate
avibhuni dravye samānendriyagrāhyāṇāṃ viśeṣaguṇānāmasamavāyāditi vyāhanyate--praśa॰ vyo॰ pṛ॰ 220

nanvevam ekatantvavayavagrahaṇe'pi paṭo gṛhyeta, na caivam, bhūyo'vayavendriyasannikarṣasahāyasya ayayavīndriyasannikarṣasya avayavyupalambhakṛttvāditi cet; syādetadevaṃ yadi avayavaavayavinobhedaikāntaḥ, sa tu netīti nirūpitam

evaṃ ca na avayavendriyasannikarṣo'nyaḥ, anyo'vayavīndriyasannikarṣaḥ, yenocyate--bhūyo'vayavendriyasannikarṣasahāyasya avayavīndriyasannikarṣasya avayavyupalambhakatvāt iti; sāhāyyasya bhedanibandhanatvāt

yadi ca, avayavina indriyasannikarṣo'sti; kutastatra jñānaṃ notpadyate ? kathamanyathā samandhakārādau avayavijñānam, nahi tatra bhūyo'vayavendriyasannikarṣo'sti sālokādipradeśavat, itarathā tajjñāne'spaṣṭatā vyavahāro na syāt
athendriyasannikarṣo'pi tasya neṣyate; ekāvayavasyāpi na syāditi tasyāpi na grahaṇam
atha te śe ṣyate tatsannikarṣaḥ; paṭasyāpi syāt kāraṇasaṃyoginā kāryamavaśyaṃ saṃyujyate praśa॰ bhā॰ pṛ॰ 64 iti vacanāt, anyathā vīraṇenāpi na syāt

kiṃca, ekatantvavayavendriyasannikarṣo'pi yadi tadbhūyo'vayavendriyasannikarṣasahāya eva tantūpalambhakaḥ; tarhi tadavayavendriyasannikarṣo'pi tadbhūyo'vayavendriyasannikarṣasahāya eva tadavayavopalambhakaḥ, evaṃ yāvatparamāṇavaḥ
yadi ca ekāvayavendriyasannikarṣāt tatra jñānaṃ na syāt; tarhi jalamagnakariṇaḥ karamātradarśanāt karī tiṣṭhatyatra iti pratītirna syāt, iṣyate ca pareṇa
tataḥ sādhūktam--dṛśyāvayavaiḥ dṛśyātmanaḥ viparītaiḥ viparītātmanaḥ ityasya pradarśanārtham nānāvayavātmanaḥ iti vacanamiti, tathā āvṛtaiḥ āvṛtātmanaḥ viparītairviparītātmana ityasya ca
idaṃ tasya vṛttaṃ yeṣāmindriyasannikarṣād grahaṇamavayavānāṃ taiḥ saha gṛhyate yeṣāmavayavānāṃ vyavadhānādagrahaṇaṃ taiḥ saha na gṛhyate
yāvantaḥ paramāṇurūpā avayavāḥ santi tāvatāṃ sannikarṣaḥ āvaśyakaḥ
ekaṃ calaṃ calairnānyaiḥ naṣṭaṃ naṣṭairna cāparaiḥ
na khalu ekasminnavayave pāṇyādau āvaraṇe satyapi śarīrasya āvaraṇamasti mahattvāt
na hi yāvān āvārakadravyasaṃyogaḥ avayavamāvṛṇoti tāvān avayavinaṃ tasya mahattvāttu punaranya ekāvārakadravyasaṃyogaviśeṣa āvṛṇoti yathā pratiśarādisaṃyogaviśeṣaḥ kuḍyamiti
avayavāvārakaṃ tu dravyam avayavinā saṃyuktaṃ nā''vṛṇoti amahattvāt saṃyogaviśeṣābhāvācca, yathā kaupīnapracchādakamalpaṃ vāsaḥ yathā vā paridhānavāsa iti
samagrāvayavyupalabdhiprasaṅga iti cet; samagrā'samagra itiśabdayoḥ bhedaviṣayatvāt, avayavinastu abhinnatvāt
na khalu avayavī samagro nāpyasamagraḥ, tasya ekatvāt
api bhavān gṛhyamāṇasya avayavinaḥ kimagṛhītaṃ manyate yenāyamakṛtsno gṛhyata ityācaṣṭe ? āvṛto'vayavo na gṛhyata iti cet; na gṛhyatāṃ nāma, avayavī tu gṛhyate tato'nyatvāt

iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ--yeṣāmava yavānām indriyasannikarṣaḥ taiḥ sahopalabhyate, yeṣāṃ punaḥ āvṛtatvānnendriyasannikarṣaḥ taiḥ saha nopalabhyata iti cet; ucyate--śabalaikarūpavad āvṛtā'nāvṛtaikāvayavyupapatternā'yuktametat
na tāvadekasyāvayavino grahaṇāgrahaṇe; avayavāvaraṇe'pi tasya katipayāvayavāvasthānasya grahaṇādeva
na ca bahvavayavāvasthānasya grahaṇe iva tādṛśasthaulyānavabhāsādanavabhāso'vayavina iti sāmpratam; parimāṇabhedo hi sthaulyamavayavidharmaḥ
na ca tasya tādṛśasyānavabhāse avayavī anavabhāsito bhavati, tasya tato'nyatvāt, tasmādindriyasannikarṣamātrādavayavino grahaṇam
indriyeṇārthasya indriyāvayavairarthasya indriyeṇārthāvayavānām indriyāvayavairarthāvayavānāṃ sannikarṣāt parimāṇabhedagrahaṇamiti sāmagrībhedādavayavitatparimāṇabhedayorgrahaṇāgrahaṇe upapadyete
sa hyeko'nekeṣu anāvṛtetarakatipayāvayavagrahaṇena gṛhyate tasya sarvatrābhinnatvāt
-kṛtsnamiti anekasyāśeṣābhidhānam, ekadeśa iti nānātve kasyacidabhidhānam, tāvimau kṛtsnaikadeśaśabdau bhedaviṣayau naikasminnavayavini upapadyete bhedābhāvāditi
yattu bahutarāvayavagrahaṇavat sthūlapratītirna bhavati tad bhūyo'vayavapracayagrahaṇasya parimāṇaprakarṣapratītihetorabhāvāt
yatra tu bhūyasāmavayavānāmāvaraṇam alpatarāvayavagrahaṇaṃ ca tatrāvayavino na grahaṇam, yathā jalanimagnasya śiromātradarśanāt

yatpunaruktam--nahi yāvānāvārakasaṃyogo'vayavamāvṛṇoti tāvān avayavinam iti; tadapi na sūktam; kāraṇasaṃyoginā hi kāryamavaśyaṃ saṃyujyate praśa॰ bhā॰ pṛ॰ 64 iti vacanādavayavavad avayavino'pyāvārakasaṃyogo'sti

tasya cotpattau avayavī samavāyikāraṇamiti sarvātmanā sa tatkāraṇaṃ cet; tat sarvatra tatsaṃyogapratipattiriti kathanna tāvāneva tatsaṃyogaḥ tadāvārako na syāt yenocyate--avayavinaṃ punaḥ anya eva āvārakadravyasaṃyogaviśeṣa āvṛṇoti iti
atha na sarvātmanā kintu ekadeśena; sāṃśatvamavayavinaḥ
nanu coktam--samagrā'samagraśabdayorbhedaviṣayatvād avayavinastu abhinnatvāt tadanupapattiriti; satyamuktam, kintu tadabhinnatvāt iti vadatā tasya ekaṃ svarūpamaṅgīkṛtam
tenaiva cet saṃyogasamavāyikāraṇam; tatra saṃyogaḥ samavetaḥ pratibhātīti na tadrahitaṃ tadrūpamasti iti noktadoṣaparihāraḥ
yaccānyaduktam--api ca bhavān gṛhamāṇasya avayavinaḥ ityādi; tatrāpyucyate--avayavisvarūpaṃ na gṛhyate nāvayavasvarūpam
evaṃ kathañcidavayavā'vayavinostādātmyāt, anyathā āvārakajalādimadhye dṛśyabhāgasya avayavinaḥ stambhādeḥ sandeho na syāt--kimasti kiṃ vā neti, kiyān vā samasti ? iti
yaccānyat--iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ ityādi; tadapyetena nirākṛtam; yathaiva hi āvṛtāvayavā indriyairasannikṛṣṭā nopalabhyante tatsahitaśca avayavī, tathā āvārakasaṃyuktaḥ kevalo'pi nopalabhyate
tataḥ sthitam--āvṛtāvayavāpekṣayā āvṛtātmano'nyāpekṣayā anyathābhūtasya ityasya pratipādanārtham nānāvayavātmanaḥ iti vacanam
tathā naṣṭaiḥ naṣṭātmano'naṣṭairanaṣṭātmanaḥ ityasya ca pratipādanārtham

nanu ca naṣṭā avayavāḥ ta eva ye niṣkriyāvayavebhyo'nye deśāntarādisaṃyogino vicchinnāḥ yathā pādādibhyo hastādayaḥ, naca teṣu śarīrāvayavī vidyate prāktanaḥ pādādiṣu yenocyate--avinaṣṭāvayavāpekṣayā avinaṣṭaḥ iti, anyathā niṣkriyāvayavebhya iva ākāśādibhyaḥ citrapāṇyādivibhāgo na bhavet
taduktam--dravyāśrayyaguṇavān saṃyogavibhāgeṣu akāraṇamanapekṣa iti guṇalakṣaṇam vaiśe॰ 1
16 ityatra sūtre kaiścit tathā kāraṇayoḥ vaṃśadalayoḥ vibhāgo vibhāgamabhinirvartayiṣyan vaṃśavināśamapekṣate

svatantrāvayavavṛttirvibhāgo vibhāgamārabhate na kāryabaddhāvayavavṛttiḥ, etacca yathā subaddhaṃ bhavati tathā agre vakṣyāmaḥ iti, taducyate--kāraṇayorvaṃśadalayoḥ vibhāgāt sakte yasya avayavasya vaṃśadalasya ākāśādibhyo vibhāgaḥ iti cet; syānmataṃ saṃyogau sakriyasya avayavasya vaṃśadalasya ākāśādibhyo vibhāgaḥ sa kriyāja iti na dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhivibhāgārambhakasya karmaṇaḥ

yāni dravyānārambhakasaṃyogavirodhi- vibhāgārambhakāṇi karmāṇi na tāni dravyānārambhakasaṃyogavirodhinaṃ vibhāgamārabhante yathā nṛtyataḥ avayavakarmāṇi, tathehāpi chedanabhedanatakṣaṇakarmaṇāmapi ākāśādibhyo vibhāgajanakatve dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhivibhāgārambhakatvaṃ na syāt

asti ca, tasmādidamucyate--chedanapāṭanatakṣaṇakarmāṇi svāśrayasya ākāśādibhyo na vibhāgamārabhante dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhivibhāgajanakatvāt; yāni punaḥ svāśrayasya ākāśādibhyo vibhāgamārabhante na tāni dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhinaṃ vibhāgamārabhante yathā nṛtyataḥ avayavakarmāṇi iti

ubhayasaṃyogitvād ubhābhyāṃ viyujyate iti cet; syānmataṃ yathā'yaṃ sakriyo'vayavaḥ avayavāntareṇa saṃyujyate tathā ākāśādibhirapi, tasmād yathā avayavāntareṇa saṃyuktatvāt tena viyujyate tathā ākāśādibhirapi saṃyuktatvāt tebhyo'pi viyujyate iti; na; anekāntāt
nāyamekāntaḥ-hastāvayave utpannaṃ karma svāśrayasya sarvasaṃyogibhyo vibhāgamārabhata iti, kiṃ tarhi kutaścideva idam, dṛṣṭatvāt

dṛṣṭaṃ khalu aṅgulikarma aṅgulidravyasya ākāśādibhyo vibhāgamārabhate na avayavāntarād dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhinaṃ vibhāgamārabhata iti tathedamapi pāṭanādyavayavakarma avayavāntarād dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhinaṃ vibhāgamārabhate nākāśādibhyaḥ iti tasmād ubhābhyāṃ viyujyate iti ayuktamuktamiti
kutaḥ punarayaṃ viśeṣa iti cet ? kāraṇaviśeṣāt
tulanā--karmotpannaṃ yadā tasyāvayavasya avayavāntarād dravyārambhakasaṃyogavināśakaṃ vibhāgaṃ karoti na tadā dravyaviruddhād ākāśādideśādvibhāgaṃ karoti
yadā cākāśādideśāt; na tadā avayavāntarāditi sthitiniyamaḥ

syānmatam--hastādyavayavavṛttitvā'viśeṣe'pi sati kānicit karmāṇi svāśrayasya ākāśādibhyo vibhāgamārabhante kānicit punaḥ avayavāntarād dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhinaṃ vibhāgamārabhanta iti kiṃkṛto'yaṃ vibhāgaḥ iti ? kāraṇaviśeṣāt kriyākāraṇaviśeṣādayaṃ viśeṣaḥ

tatra kāryāviṣṭe kāraṇe karma utpannaṃ avayavāntarād vibhāgamārabhate, vibhāgād dravyārambhakasaṃyoganivṛttiḥ, tataḥ kāryadravyaṃ nivartate, tasmin nivṛtte kāraṇayorvartamāno vibhāgaḥ sakriyāvayavasya ākāśādibhyo vibhāgamārabhate praśa॰ bhā॰ pṛ॰ 68 iti

ko hetu riti cet ? syānmataṃ kāryadravyanivṛttau kāraṇayorvartamānād vibhāgāt sakriyāvayavasya ākāśādibhyo vibhāga upajāyate na punaḥ pūrvam ityatra ko heturiti ? kāryadravyavināśasahacaritatvaṃ hetuḥ; yadi sati kāryadravye sakriyāvayavasya ākāśādibhyo vibhāga upajāyeta, naivaṃ tarhi tasya kāryadravyavināśasahacaritatvaṃ na syād aṅgulyākāśavibhāgavaditi cet; atra pratividhīyate--

yattāvaduktam--kāraṇayorvaṃśadalayorvibhāgo vibhāgamabhinirvartayiṣyan vaṃśavināśamapekṣate ityādi; tatra aṅgulyavayave chedakriyātaḥ avayavāntarādvibhāgāt saṃyogavināśe sati yadi avayavinaḥ śarīrasya vināśaḥ tarhi tadavayavachedanakarmādimātrata eva śarīrasya nāśe tadguṇānāṃ nāśāt tadavayavyupalambhavikalatadārambhakapādādyavayavānāmeva upalambhaḥ syāt
na caivam, tacchedanāt prāk paścāt tatsamakālaṃ ca tadevedaṃ śarīram iti pratīteḥ
itarathā chinnāṅgulirapi sa evāyaṃmadīyaḥ putraḥ ityādi vyavahāravilopaprasaṅgaḥ

nanu ca ekāvayavasaṃyogavināśe pūrvadravyanivṛttau punaḥ avasthitasaṃyogebhyo'vayavebhyo anyadravyamupajāyate ato'yamadoṣa iti cet; kośapānaireva kevalamartho'yaṃ pratyeyaḥ, na pratīteḥ, sarvadaikatvapratītyupalambhāt
atha pūrvadravyavināśe dravyāntarotpattireva bādhiketi cet; sā kutaḥ siddhā ? tatpratītervibhramāccet; anyonyasaṃśrayaḥ--siddhāyāṃ dravyāntarotpattau tatpratītervibhramaḥ, tasmācca tatsiddhiriti

yadi ca, sarvadā śarīrasya ekatve pratīyamāne ekāvayavasaṃyogavināśe pūrvadravyanivṛttau punaḥ avasthitasaṃyogebhyo'vayavebhyo'nyadravyamupajāyate itīṣyate; tarhi saha krameṇa ca varaṃ paramāṇava eva abhyupagatāḥ, tathā ca avayavyādisādhanaprayāsād bhavanto mucyeran
madyaṃ pītvaiva ayaṃ viśvāsayogyaḥ yat tatra anyat śarīramutpannamiti
kiṃca, aṅgulyavayave calati āvṛte śarīraṃ na calati nāpyāvriyate tathā pratīteḥ ityabhyupagamya ekāvayavasaṃyogavināśe avayavināśaḥ sarvathā'bhyupagacchan kathaṃ susthaḥ ? tathāpratīteḥ samānatvāt
api ca, yadi nāma ekāvayavasaṃyogavināśaḥ kimāyātaṃ yena tato bhinnasya avayavino vināśaḥ atiprasaṅgāt ? na hyavaśyaṃ kāraṇanāśād utpannaṃ kāryaṃ naśyati atrapariṇāmikāraṇavināśaḥ
na ca saṃyogaḥ pariṇāmikāraṇaṃ parasya anyathā'bhyupagamāt
asamavāyikāraṇavināśādapi tannāśaḥ tathāpratīteriti cet; na, ekāvayavasaṃyogavināśe'pi kāryadravyasya kathañcidavasthānasya pratīteḥ

etena bhedanādibhyaḥ ekāvayavasya avayavāntarād vibhāgena saṃyoganāśāt pūrvāvayavivināśaḥ pratyākhyātaḥ; nahi karṇaikāvayavasya bhedane śarīrasya tantvekāvayavasya pāṭane paṭasya vaṃśasya svaralpattakutakṣaṇe vināśaḥ pratīyate
nanu kāryadravyā'vināśakavaṃśakriyāyāḥ avayavasya ākāśādibhyo vibhāgaḥ asvātantryāt

kasmāditi cet ? kāryadravyavināśasahacaritasya ākāśādibhyo vibhāgasya tadavayave darśanāditi cet; tasya tarhi avayavāntarādvibhāgaḥ kāryadravye avinaṣṭe kiṃ pratīyate ? apratīte eko'sti nāpara iti kiṃ kṛto vibhāgaḥ ?
syānmatam--avayavāttadvibhāgaḥ kāryanāśānyathānupapattyā anumīyamānaḥ pūrvamapyasti nākāśādibhya iti; na; tadavayavāntarādiva ākāśādibhyo'pi tadavibhāge kāryavināśāt
nanu yadi pūrva tadantarānna tadvibhāgaḥ; kathamākāśādibhyaḥ ? kāraṇābhāve kāryānutpa tteriti cet; syādetadevaṃ yadi avayavakarmaṇaḥ tadantarādiva ākāśādibhyaḥ tadvibhāgo na syāt
ekasmāt karmaṇaḥ kathamaneko vibhāga iti cet ? katham ākāśakāladigātmādibhyo yugapat tasya bahavo vibhāgāḥ tairvā saṃyogāḥ, yenedam saṃyogavibhāgānāṃ karma vaiśe॰ sū॰ 1
ekāvayavavṛttikarmaṇaḥ avayavābhyāṃ dvau vibhāgau avayavebhyaḥ bahavo vibhāgāḥ, na ca ākāśādibhyaḥ iti svaruciviracitametat
yatra dravye karmotpannaṃ tena samaṃ yāvaddravyaṃ saṃyuktamāsīt tāvat saṃkhyākān vibhāgān janayitvā tāvataḥ saṃyogānapi punaranyatra janayati...--vaiśe॰ upa॰ 1

yat punaḥ tadavayavasya ākāśādibhyo vibhāgamārabhate na tad dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhinaṃ vibhāgamārabhate yathā nṛtyato'vayavakarma iti; nāyaṃ hetu; asiddhatvāt, saṃyogavināśasyaiva vibhāgatvāditi cintitametat
na ca chedanādeḥ paraṃ prati dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhivibhāgajanakatvaṃ sarvathā siddham avayavināśaprasaṅgāt iti ca

yadi ca nṛtyato'vayavakarma sakriyāvayavasya ākāśādibhyo vibhāgahetuḥ, avayavāntaravibhāgaheturna dṛṣṭaḥ iti chedādirapi tadvat tadahetuḥ prakalpyate; tarhi kāraṇayorvaṃśadalayorvartamāno vibhāgo niṣkriyāvayavasya ākāśādivibhāgaheturna dṛṣṭaḥ iti sakriyasyāpi tathaiva kalpyatām aviśeṣāt

kāryeṇāviṣṭaṃ vyāptamārabdhakāryamiti yāvat tasmin kāraṇe karmotpannaṃ na kāraṇamātre yadā avayavāntarādvibhāgaṃ dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhinaṃ karoti na tadā ākāśādideśāt, yadā tvākāśādideśānna tadā avayavāntarādviśiṣṭaṃ vibhāgamiti sthitiḥ vibhāgajavibhāgacintāyāḥ pratijñātā
ato yatredamupalabhyate tatra dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhivibhāgānutpādakatve nivartamāne tadvyāptam ākāśavibhāgakartṛtvamapi nibartate yathā vahnivyāvṛttau dhūmavyāvṛttiḥ
kiṃca, saṃyogavibhāgānāṃ karma kāraṇaṃ sāmānyam vaiśe॰ sū॰ 1

20 iti vacanāt nṛtyato'vayavakarmāṇi hastādyavayavānām anyo'nyato vibhāgaṃ kinnārabhante ? evaṃ sati tataḥ saṃyogavināśāt nṛtyato'vayavino vināśaḥ syāditi cet; na; ekāvayavasaṃyogavināśe pūrvadravyanivṛttau punaḥ avasthitasaṃyogebhyo'vayavebhyaḥ anyadravyamupajāyate ityabhidhānāt punaḥ pravṛttikarmaviśeṣebhyaḥ saṃyogaviśeṣato'nyad dravyaṃ syāt
evaṃ sati kiṃ labdhamiti cet ? chedanādikarma sakriyāvayavasya ākāśādibhyo vibhāgaṃ nārabhate dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhivibhāgajanakatvāt
yat punaḥ tasya tato vibhāgamārabhate na tat tajjanakaṃ yathā nṛtyato'vayavakarma
tato yathā sakriyāvayavasya avayavāntarāt kriyāto vibhāgaḥ tathā tattvād ākāśādibhyaḥ
naca anaikāntikoyaṃ hetuḥ; tathāhi--aṅgulyākāśavibhāgād hastākāśavibhāgo bhavati na tu kriyājaḥ iti
anekānta iti cet; uktamatra aṅgulicalane hastasyāpi kathañcit calanam, ākāśādibhyaḥ tadvibhāge hastasyāpi tadaiva vibhāgaḥ, anyathā pṛthaksiddhiḥ syāditi
nanu ca yadyayaṃ sakriyasya avayavasya gaganādibhyo vibhāgaḥ kriyājaḥ syāt; tadapi tarhi kriyānantaramutpadyeta, ādyāvayavavibhāgavat, na cotpannaḥ
karmaṇā yasminnavasare vibhāgaḥ karttavyamso'sya naṣṭa iti cet; na satyametat; vibhāge'pyasya samānatvāt
śakyaṃ hi vaktuṃ yadyayaṃ vibhāgāt syāt vibhāgaḥ tadanantaramutpadyeta, na caivam, kṣiavayavavibhāgāt saṃyogavināśaḥ tasmācca dravyavināśaḥ punarvibhāgaḥ ityaṅgīkaraṇāt
karmānantaram avayavāntarākāśādibhyaśca vibhāgaḥ; itarathā na kutaścit tadanantaraṃ bhavet

yatpunaruktam--avayaveṣu karmāṇi tato vibhāgaḥ tebhyaḥ saṃyogavināśaḥ tato dravyavināśaḥ praśa॰ bhā॰ pṛ॰ 46 iti; tadapi na parīkṣākṣamam; avayavebhyo bhinnānāṃ karmaṇāmutpattāvapi tatsvarūpacalanā'bhāvād atiprasaṅgāt
na teṣāṃ tato'pi vibhāgabhāvaḥ, bhāve'pi tata eva na tataḥ tatsaṃ yogavināśaḥ
yadyapyayaṃ bhavet tathāpi saṃyogād bhinna iti saṃyogasya tadavasthasya avasthānānu kāryasya nāsau nāma
karmāṇyutpadyante, tebhyo vibhāgāḥ, vibhāgebhyaḥ saṃyogavināśāḥ, saṃyogavināśebhyaśca kāryadravyaṃ vinaśyati
yad yena nāśyate tat tasya virodhi, na ca saṃyogena nāśyate karma
tato nāśabhāve'pi karmaṇo na kiñcit jāyate

naceyaṃ praṇālikā parasya pratītigocaracāriṇī--pūrvam eṣu karma, tato vibhāgaḥ, tasmāt saṃyogavināśaḥ, tato 'pi dravyavināśaḥ, etasmācca tadāśritarūpādināśaḥ; kintu daṇḍādipātānantaraṃ ghaṭādināśa eva tadgocaracārī
tataḥ sthitam--naṣṭāvayavairnaṣṭaḥ anyaiḥ anaṣṭo'vayavī ityasya jñāpanārthaṃ nānāvayavātmanaḥ iti vacanam
etenedamapi pratyuktam yaduktaṃ--dravyāṇi dravyāntaramārabhante vaiśe॰ sū॰ 1
10 iti; dravyaṃ ca tadantaraṃ ca kāraṇadravyebhyo'nyat kāryadravyam iti; katham ? ekāntena tebhyaḥ tadanyatvaniṣedhāt
yat punaretat--dravye ca dravyāṇi ca tadantaramārabhante te; navaikasya tatoḥ saṃyogaḥ, anekavṛttitvād asya
tadavayavānāṃ saṃyoga iti cet; na tena tantudravyamutpāditam
na ca yeṣvekaṃ dravyaṃ yadaiva avayaveṣu samavetaṃ tadaiva teṣu aparaṃ samavaiti iti cet; na; skandhādapi skandhotpatteḥ apratiṣedhāt, mṛtpiṇḍādeḥ śivakādyutpattidarśanāt
nahi śivakādyutpatteḥ pūrvaṃ tadārambhakāḥ kriyāsaṃyogabhājo bhāgāḥ pratītāḥ
syādetat--śivakādayaḥ saṃyuktāvayavārabdhāḥ kāryadravyatvāt paṭādivat iti; tanna; ekatra tathābhāvadarśanāt sarvatra tadbhāvakalpane loha lekhyaṃ vajraṃ pārthivatvāt kāṣṭhavat ityādyapi syāt
pratyakṣabādhanānneti cet; kiṃ punaḥ śivakādīnām ārambhakā avayavāḥ tataḥ prāk pratyakṣataḥ siddhā yena tadbādhanaṃ na bhavet
kiṃca, tantavaḥ kathaṃ paṭasya janakāḥ ? tadbhāve bhāvād abhāve'bhāvāditi cet; ata eva mṛtpiṇḍo'pi śivakādikāraṇamastu
nanu mṛtpiṇḍavināśe śivakabhāvaḥ, anyathā tatkāle'pi taddarśanaṃ bhavet paṭakāle tantudarśanavaditi cet; na; mṛtpiṇḍasya śivakāraṇāmāt
na ca tantavo'pi prāktanasvabhāvaparikaritatanavaḥ paṭe dṛśyante tadāpi aparāparapaṭotpattiprasaṅgāt
taduktaṃ nyā ya vi ni śca ye--
--bahuṣu pārthiveṣu kāṣṭhapāṣāṇādiṣu lohalekhyatvadarśane'pi pārthiva eva vajre alohalekhyatvadarśane'pi pārthiva eva...--pra॰ vā॰ mano॰ 4

taduktaṃ pareṇa--tantavaḥ paṭamārabhya paṭena pratibandhāt paṭāntaraṃ nārabhante iti; tatredaṃ cintyate; peṭana kāraṇasya svarūpāpahāraḥ, śaktyapahāraḥ, vyāpārāpahāraḥ, kāryadravyotpattiniṣedho vā tadantarajanane pratibandhaḥ syāt ? tatra nādyaḥ pakṣaḥ; kāryakāle'pi kāraṇasattvopagamāt
nityatvādacikitsyasya kastāṃ kṣapayituṃ kṣamaḥ || pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 22 iti
ata eva tṛtīyo'pi na yuktaḥ; śaktaikasvabhāvasya sataḥ avaśyaṃ kāryajanmani vyāpārāt
caturthaḥ punaḥ atyantamasaṃbhavī; prati śaktena kāraṇena kriyamāṇāyāḥ kāryotpatterniṣedhā'yogāt
tataḥ paṭakāle'pi samavāyi-asamavāyi-nimittānāṃ tantu-saṃyogeśvarādīnāṃ sadbhāvāt paṭāntarotpattiḥ syāt
etenedamapi nirastaṃ yaduktaṃ pareṇa--tathā paṭo'pi rūpādīnārabhya rūpādivattvād rūpāntaraṃ nārabhate
katham ? sati samarthe kāraṇe kenacit pratibandhā'yogāt
tastpakṣa pūrvasvabhāvāḥ tantavaḥ paṭe abhyupagantavyā iti pariṇāmasiddhiḥ
tathā ca ekamapi dravyaṃ tadantarārambhakamiti siddham
dravyāṇi dravyāntarāṇi ārabhante ityevaṃ vaktavyam, tena dravyāntaraṃ dravyāntare dravyāntarāṇi yathāsaṃbhavaṃ dravyāṇi ārabhante iti labhyate
yathaiva hi anekaṃ dravyam ekaṃ dravyamārabhamāṇaṃ dṛśyate tathā ekamapi dravyam ekaṃ dravyam dve bahūni dravyāṇi ārabhamāṇamupalabhyate, yathaiko ghaṭo dve bahūni vā kapāladravyāṇi
nanu teṣāṃ vibhāga eva kevalaṃ jāyate na tāni, pūrvameva tadbhāvāt
tataḥ sādhūktam--nānāvayavātmano ghaṭādeḥ bahiḥ saṃpratīteḥ iti, tathā nānārūpādisvabhāvasya
ghaṭāvasthāyāṃ kapālasvīkāre'pi arthakriyāvyāpadeśādayo na santīti bhāvaḥ
atha rūpādeḥ tato bhedāt kathaṃ tadātmana iti yuktamiti ? tanna; pratītivirodhāt
api ca guṇaguṇinorbhedaikānte niyamena ghaṭāderdeśāntaraprāptau rūpādeḥ tatpraptirna syāt
na cātra vibhāgajo vibhāgaḥ saṃyogajo vā saṃyogaḥ; dravyāśrayī aguṇavān guṇaḥ vaiśe॰ sū॰ 1
na ca rūpādeḥ svayaṃ deśāntaraprāptinimittā kriyā samasti; dravyatvaprāpteḥ, kriyāvad guṇavat samavāyikāraṇamiti dravyalakṣaṇam vaiśe॰ sū॰ 1
evamiti cet; tarhi rūpādyātmanāmeva kāraṇadravyāntarārambho na rūpādinirapekṣaṇām, nāpi rūpādirahitaḥ tadārambhaḥ
tatoya eva dravyāṇāṃ dravyāntarārambhaḥ sa eva guṇānāṃ guṇāntarārambhaḥ iti na yuktametat--guṇāśca guṇāntaram vaiśe॰ sū॰ 1
yatpunaretaduktaṃ pareṇa--ghaṭarūpādyutpattau ghaṭaḥ samavāyikāraṇaṃ kapālagatā rūpādayo'samavāyikāraṇam
iti; tadapyetena nirastam; nahi rūpādyutpatteḥ pūrvaṃ ghaṭo rūpādirahitaḥ kutaścin mānāt prasiddho yaḥ samavāyikāraṇaṃ syāt, tadabhāvāt kapālarūpādeḥ asamavāyikāraṇatvañcānupapannam
punarapi kathaṃbhūtasya ? pariṇāminaḥ navapurāṇādivivartāḥ pariṇāmāḥ tadvata iti
nanu nānāvayavavyatirekeṇa nāparaḥ tadātmā ghaṭādiḥ saṃpratīyate, nāpi rūpādivyatirekeṇa; tadgrahaṇopāyā'bhāvāt

tathāhi--cakṣuṣā rūpaṃ śrotreṇa śabdaḥ ghrāṇena gandhaḥ rasanena rasaḥ sparśanena sparśaḥ saṃpratīyate tathāpratīteḥ, na ca aparaṃ guṇirūpaṃ tatra pratibhāsanamavadhāryate, na cendriyāntaraṃ tadgrāhakamasti; tat kasya evaṃ tadātmano ghaṭādeḥ saṃpratīteḥ ityucyatāmiti cet ? atrāha--antaḥ citraikākārasya vā ityādi
ata eva āha--citrasya śabalasya saṃśayādijñānasya arthā'narthaviṣayatayā śabalasya, iva śabdo yathārthaḥ--yathā cittasya īdṛśasya antaḥ, tathā uktaprakārasya ghaṭādeḥ saṃpratīteḥ iti
anye citrasyaiva iti paṭhanti, teṣāṃ kārikopātto'yamartho bhavati na veti cintyametat
10 ityādinā samarthayiṣyamāṇo dṛṣṭānto'tra stavito na sūcitasya pātrasya praveśo nirgnamo vā iti nyāyāt
nanvasti tādṛśasya bahirantarvā pratibhāsaḥ, sa tu bhrāntaḥ
na ca naiva tasmād uktādarthāt yaḥ viparītārthaḥ tasya prakāśakaṃ kiñcit pratyakṣamanumānaṃ vā jñānamasti yasmājjñānāt prakṛtamarthatattvaṃ bhrāntaṃ syāt
pratibhāsamānaviparītārthajñānena hi bādhitaṃ bhrāntam iti vyavahriyate yathā ekacandrajñānena candradvayamiti manyate
nanu yata eva tadviparītārthaprakāśakaṃ na kiñcit jñānamasti ata eva prakṛtamarthatattvaṃ na bhrāntam' ityaparaḥ, tena evaṃvadatā vibhrametaraviveka eva nirastaḥ syāt na kramā'kramā'nekāntaḥ
tadabhyupagame prakṛtamarthatattvaṃ bhrāntamabhyupagantavyam, tacca tadviparītārthaprakāśake jñāne sati, iti kathaṃ na bādhakabhāvaḥ ? na ca tadasti

hiḥ yasmāt tadekānte sa cāsau ekāntaśca tadekāntaḥ tasmin niraṃśakṣaṇikaparamāṇulakṣaṇasvalakṣaṇaikānte svasadasatsamaye sva ātmīyaḥ svasya vā saugatasya satsamayaḥ paramārthasamayaḥ asatsamayo'paramārthasamayaḥ vyavahārasamaya iti yāvat
mṛtpiṇḍāvasthāyām ghaṭasya upamā--upamānam, arthakriyā--jalāharaṇādi, vyapadeśaḥ ghaṭa iti saṃjñā, ādi padena lakṣaṇaguṇādayo na dṛśyante ataḥ tatkāle ghaṭasattvaṃ nāsti
lokasaṃvṛtisatyaṃ ca satyaṃ ca paramārthataḥ || mādhyamika॰ kā॰ 24 | 8 iti
tatra asya saugatakalpitajñānādvaye vastunaḥ kriyā anubhavaḥ tasyāḥ saṃbhavo na iti

tathāhi--tasya satsamayo yathā pūrvottarakṣaṇābhyāṃ madhyakṣaṇasya vivekaikāntaḥ, tathā madhyakṣaṇe'pi stambhādisarvabhāgānām anyo'nyata iti paramārthasañcayamātraṃ tattvamiti; tatra ekaparamāṇuparyavasitaṃ darśanaṃ na paramāṇvantarāṇi īkṣituṃ kṣamate; ekasya anekārthaviṣayatvā'yogāt, madhyakṣaṇadarśanasya pūrvāparakṣaṇaviṣayatvāyogavat samadoṣatvāt
bhavatu tada saṃbhava iti cet; atrāha--tathā sati ityādi

tathā tena svasadasatsamaye ityanena prakāreṇa tadekānte arthakriyāsusaṃbhave sati kathaṃ naiva akṣaṇikatve vastunaḥ kālatrayānuyāyitve kramayaugapadyābhyāṃ krameṇa yaugapadyena vā arthasya kṣaṇikatvalakṣaṇasya kriyā anubhavaḥ tasyāḥ virodhāt
tathāhi--ekadā upalabdhasya punaḥ punaḥ upalambhe krameṇārthakriyā
na ca pūrvopalambhena punaḥ punaḥ tasyaiva upalambha iti pratīyate, tatkāle uttaradarśanānāṃ taddṛśyasya ca abhāvena darśanābhāvāt
nāpi uttaradarśanesāvena pūrvopalabdhaṃ pratīyate iti pratīyate; tatkāle'pi pūrvadarśanadṛśyarūpa yorabhāvāt
pūrveṇa uttareṇa vā darśanena parasya pūrvasya vā grahaṇe sarvagrahaṇamaviśeṣāditi, tasyāḥ virodhaḥ
tatra cānādyanantasvabhāvasya ekakṣaṇe pratibhāsanāt tadeva kṣaṇikatvamiti tasyā virodhaḥ ta smāt sato'nubhūyamānasya sākalyena kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhiḥ
tatraiva tasminneva tadekānte na akṣaṇikatve iti evakārārthaḥ, tatra tadavirodhasya tṛtīyaparicchede pratipādayiṣyamāṇatvāt
tathāhi--na tāvat niraṃśakṣaṇikaparamāṇulakṣaṇasvalakṣaṇārthasya krameṇa kriyā anubhavaḥ; akṣaṇikatvaprasaṅgāt, tasya tallakṣaṇatvāt
nāpi yaugapadyena; yogidarśanaprabhṛtitadanubhavakāryāṇām ekaparamāṇvākāradarśanadeśakālasvabhāvasāṅkaryeṇa tadvadasiddheḥ, anyathā yugapadaśeṣadeśānāṃ darśane'pi na kālasāṅkaryaṃ bhavet

nanu na yathoktaparamāṇulakṣaṇaṃ svalakṣaṇamiṣyate, nāpi yugapadanekānubhavakāri yenāyaṃ doṣaḥ syāt, api tu yathāvabhāsam, yad yathāvabhāsate tat tathaiva paramārthasat ityādi vacanāditi cet; atrāha--tato yatsat ityādi
na yathoktaparamāṇurūpaṃ tattvam, api tu yathāpratibhāsam iti yo'yaṃ parasya abhyupagamaḥ tasmāt yat sat upalambhagocaracāri upalambhaḥ sattā pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
54 iti vacanāt, tat sarvam anekāntātmakaṃ gatyantarābhāvāt tasya
saiva ca na saṃbhavati iti tatpratyākhyānameva jātamiti bhāvaḥ

ataḥ yat dṛśyaṃ bhavati pratyakṣasya na tat prāpyate iti anyad dṛṣṭaṃ prāptañcānyaditi visaṃvādi pratyakṣaṃ syāt ityāśaṅkāyāṃ samāhitam--yat dṛśya-prāpyakṣaṇayoḥ ekatvamāropya yad dṛṣṭaṃ tadeva prāptamiti ekatvādhyavasāyakṛtastatra avisaṃvādaḥ
ataḥ pratyakṣaprāmāṇyasamarthanāya svāsatkālīnārthakriyā kathañcidabhyupagataiva saugatena iti bhāvaḥ
uttarakṣaṇe ca kartuṃ yogyasyābhāvāt arthakriyāyā abhāva eva

yogidarśane te sarve pūrvottarakālavarttinaḥ paramāṇavaḥ pratibhānti ataḥ viṣayakāraṇatāvādināṃ sarveṣāṃ tadanubhavarūpakāryāṇām vartamānaparamāṇukāryabhūtaanubhavena saha ekadeśatā ekakālatā ca syāt, etacca sāṅkaryyamasiddham
evaṃ na syāttadā nityapakṣe'pi yaugapadyena arthakriyāprasādhane kālasāṅkaryyāpattiḥ kathaṃ dīyate ?

athavā, yaduktam--na ca tadviparītārthaprakāśakam ityādi; tatra uktanītyā pratyakṣaṃ yadyapi nāsti tathāpi yat sat tatsarvaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ yathā ghaṭaḥ tathā ca vivādādhikaraṇam ityanumānaṃ syāditi cet; atrāha--nahi ityādi
nahi tadekānte kṣaṇikaikānte svasadasatsamaye sadasad iti bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ
tato'yamarthaḥ--svasattvasamaye svā'sattvasamaye ca arthasya kāryasya kriyā karaṇaṃ tasyāḥ saṃbhavaḥ ekatra anādyanantasantānasya ekakṣaṇaparyavasānam, anyatra kāraṇābhāvena kāryānudaya iti manyate
tulanā--satyeva kāraṇe yadi kāryam; trelokyamekakṣaṇavarti syāt, kāraṇakṣaṇakāla eva sarvasya uttarottarakṣaṇasantānasya bhāvāt, tataḥ santānābhāvāt pakṣāntarāsaṃbhavācca
...yadi punarasatyeva kāraṇe kāryam; tadā kāraṇakṣaṇāt pūrvaṃ paścācca anādiranantaśca kālaḥ kāryasahitaḥ syāt kāraṇābhāvāviśeṣāt
dvitīyaḥ kṣaṇaḥ svasatsamaye arthāt dvitīyakṣaṇe eva tṛtīyamutpādayati ataḥ tṛtīyasya dvitīyakṣaṇe sthitiḥ
evaṃ dvitīyasya svakāraṇa-prathamakṣaṇakāle iti uttarottarakāryāṇāṃ prathamakṣaṇe eva sthityāpattiḥ

nanu ca jāgradvijñānādikaṃ svasattvaśūnye'pi samaye prabodhādikāryaṃ janayati tatkathamucyate svā'satsamaye arthakriyā'saṃbhava iti cet; na; pūrvaṃ tasmin samarthe ajātaṃ punastadabhāve jāyamānaṃ svayameva kathaṃ tatkāryam ? tena janyamānatvāditi cet; kathamasat tat tasya janakaṃkharaviṣāṇavat ? svotpattikāle saditi cet; tadaiva tatkāryamastu tajjananaśakteḥ tadaiva bhāvāt
atha īdṛśī tacchaktiḥ yataḥ kālāntare kāryaṃ tathaiva darśanāt, yathā dṛśyate tathaiva taditi cet; na; nityādapi pūrvaṃ samarthāt punaḥ kāryaṃ na virudhyeta
atha nityāt tathā kāryaṃ jāyamānaṃ na dṛśyate; nityādarśanāt
nahi jāgradvijñānasya anyasya vā kṣaṇikatvaṃ pramāṇaniścitam
bhavatvevaṃ ko doṣa iti cet ? atrāha--tathā sati ityādi
tathā sati tatra arthakriyā'sambhave sati katham akṣaṇikatve kramayaugapadyābhyāmarthakriyāvirodhāt tīrādarśiśakuninyāyena tataḥ sattvaṃ nivartamānaṃ kṣaṇikatve avatiṣṭhate
iti nyāyāt sato'rthakriyākāriṇaḥ sākalyena kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhiḥ ? naiva
kuta etat ? iti cet ? atrāha--tatraiva ityādi
tatraiva tadekānta eva tābhyāṃ kramayaugapadyābhyāṃ tadvirodhāt arthakriyāvirodhāt
nanu ca jāgradvijñānaṃ kṣaṇikamapi sahocchvāsādi--śarīrākārādiviśeṣakāryamupajanayati, krameṇa ca ucchvāsaprabodhādi, tatkathamucyate tatraiva ityādi iti cet; na; uktamatra tatkṣaṇikatvā'niścayāt
api ca, kṣaṇikādakrameṇa kāryasaṃbhave nākramāt kramiṇo bhāvāḥ pra॰ vā॰ 1
avidyamānasya karaṇamiti ko'rthaḥ ? tadanantarabhāvinī tasya sattā
na cānantaryameva tattve nibandhanaṃ vyavahitasyāpi kāraṇatvāt
yat sat tat kṣaṇikameva akṣaṇikatve arthakriyāvirodhāt tallakṣaṇavastutvaṃ hīyate
yadi na sarvaṃ sat kṛtakaṃ vā pratikṣaṇavināśi syāt, akṣaṇikasya kramayaugapadyābhyāmarthakriyā'yogāt arthakriyāsāmarthyalakṣaṇamato nivṛttamityasadeva syāt
yathā kila vahanārūḍhaiḥ vāṇigbhiḥ śakunirmucyate api nāma tīraṃ drakṣyatīti
sa yadā sarvataḥ paryaṭaṃstīraṃ nāsādayati tadā vahanamevāgacchatīti tadvadetadapi draṣṭavyam--hetubi॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 193
yathaiva akrama-nityakāraṇāt krameṇa kāryotpattirviruddhā tathaiva--kramikāraṇāt akrameṇa kāryotpattirapi viruddhaiveti bhāvaḥ

yata evaṃ svalakṣaṇāni svayamabhimatakṣaṇakṣayaparamāṇulakṣaṇāni paśyato'pi eko hi jñānasanniveśī sthavīyān ākāraḥ parisphuṭamavabhāsate tadekānte svasadasatsamaye arthakriyā'saṃbhavaśca tataḥ tasmāt yat sat tat sarvam anekāntātmakam iti
tataḥ ityanuvartate tata uktānnyāyāt tadekāntasya kṣaṇikaikāntasya asattvam avidyamānatvam
kadā ? ityatrāha--upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptau pratyayāntarasākalyaṃ svabhāvaviśeṣaśca upalabdheḥ lakṣaṇaṃ tatprāptau
nanu yadi tadekāntaḥ kvacit kadācit upalambhagocaraḥ kathamekāntena tadabhāvaḥ atiprasaṅgāt ? ekāntena ca tadabhāva iti iṣyate
atha kvacit kadācit sa tathā neṣyate; tarhi asiddho hetuḥ, viśeṣaṇā'siddheriti cet; na; anyathā abhiprāyāt
nedaṃ sādhanaṃ svatantrasādhanābhiprāyeṇa prayuktam, api tu prasaṅgasādhanābhiprāyeṇa
tathā hi--tadekānto dṛśyaścediṣyate, tarhi dṛśyasya sato'nupalambhāt asattvam
prasaṅgasādhane hi pakṣadvayotthāpanaṃ nānyatra yuktam upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptau iti vacanācca prasaṅgasādhanam, adṛśyādarśanasyāpi svayaṃ gamakatvopagamāt
upalambhapratyayāntarasākalyamiti jñānasya ghaṭo'pi janakaḥ anye ca cakṣurādayaḥ, ghaṭād dṛśyādanye hetavaḥ pratyayāntarāṇi teṣāṃ sākalyaṃ sannidhiḥ
...yaḥ svabhāvaḥ satsu anyeṣūpalambhapratyayeṣu san pratyakṣa eva bhavati sa svabhāvaviśeṣaḥ
nanu yaduktam--antaḥ citrakārasyeva ekasya cittasya iti; tadayuktam; tasyāpi tathā'nabhyupagamāt
kiṃ syāt sā citrataikasyāṃ na syāttasyāṃ matāvapi
yadīdaṃ svayamarthebhyo rocate tatra ke vayam || pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 210
iti cet; tatredaṃ cintyate--sautrāntikasya yogācārasya mādhyamikasya vā matamapekṣya idamucyeta ? prathamapakṣe dūṣaṇamāha--pratibhāsaikyaniyama ityādi
nanu yadi sā citratā buddhāvekasyāṃ syāt, tayā ca citramekaṃ dravyaṃ vyavasthāpyeta tadā kiṃ dūṣaṇaṃ syāt ? āha--na syāttasyāṃ matāvapi, na kevalaṃ dravye tasyāṃ matāvapi ekasyāṃ na syāccitratā

kathaṃ tarhi pratītirityāha--yadīdaṃ svayamarthebhyo rocate tatra ke vayam--yadīdam atādrūpye'pi tādrūpyaprathanam arthānāṃ bhāsamānānāṃ nīlādīnāṃ svayam--aparapreraṇayā rocate tatra tathāpratibhāse ke vayamasahamānāḥ api niṣeddhum
avastu ca pratibhāsate ceti vyaktamālīkyam--pra॰ vā॰ mano॰

yadyayamekāntaḥ antarbahirvā viruddhadharmādhyāse naikatvaṃ syāditi kathaṃ bahirarthavibhramacetasāṃ svasaṃvedanam ? kasyacit pramāṇatadābhāsasvabhāvasāṅkarye cittasya kathaṃ pratibhāsabhedādinaikatvaṃ nirākriyeta ? savikalpakanirvikalpayoḥ kathañcidekatve sukhaduḥkhayorapi tathaiva kathanna bhavet ? tadayamekāntamavalambya bahirantarmukhanirbhāsavibhrametaravikalpetaracetaḥsvabhāvamanekāntanāntarīyakaṃ pratipadyamānaḥ taddveṣī tatkārī ceti upekṣāmarhati
atra dvau pratibhāsaśabdau tatra ādyaḥ saṃvedanavācī anyo viṣayākāravācī
tato'yamarthaḥ saṃpadyate--pratibhāsasya saṃvedanasya aikyaniyame niraṃśatvaniyame aṅgīkriyamāṇe dhīḥ buddhiḥ ekaiva na syāt kintu anekā syāt
kuto'nyathā ? ātmanaḥ svarūpapratīteḥ sakāśāt anyathā abhilāpinīm
etaduktaṃ bhavati--ātmanaḥ pratītim sarvacittacaittānām ātmasaṃvedanaṃ pratyakṣaṃ nirvikalpakam nyāyabi॰ 1
10 iti anabhilāpinīṃ pratibhāsapratītiṃ timirāśubhramaṇanauyānasaṃkṣobhādyāhitavibhramām ityabhilāpinīṃ vibhrāṇā dhīḥ ekaiva na syād anekaiva syāditi
tathāhi--bahirarthavibhramacetasām anyaiva svasaṃvedanāt keśoṇḍukādipratītiḥ ekasyā bhrāntetarākāradvayā'yogāt
na ca sā jñānarūpā asti; atiprasaṅgāt
taccetaḥsvasaṃvedanena tajjñāne nāsya vibhramaḥ tadākārānukaraṇāt, nīlākārānukaraṇe nīlatāvat
tadākārasya tato bhede sa eva doṣaḥ anavasthā ca
atadākārānukaraṇe na tena tajjñānam, itarathā nirākāradarśanam
tasyāḥ svasaṃvedanābhyupagame ekasya rūpadvayabhayāt svasaṃvedanāt punarapi tatpratītiranyā'bhyupagantavyā
na ca sā'jñātarūpā'sti iti codye tasminneva uttare sa eva doṣaḥ anavasthā ca
tadevaṃ keśoṇḍukādipratīteḥ anupalambhena asattvāt tannivṛttyartham abhrāntagrahaṇaṃ pratyakṣalakṣaṇe kṛtamanarthakam
vyavahāreṇa tatkāraṇādadoṣa iti cet; tarhi tenaiva sarvacitta nyāyabi॰ 1
bhavatu iti cet; tathā krameṇāpi ekasya sā iti tena kṣaṇabhaṅgasādhanamanavasaram
na caitadiṣyate pareṇa iti sādhūktam--pratibhāsaikyaniyama ityādi
idaṃ ca vyākhyānaṃ śāstrakārasyāpyabhimataṃ na mamaiva, vṛttau yadyayamekānta ityādervakṣyamāṇatvāt
mandaṃ hi bhrābhyamāṇe alātādau na cakrabhrāntirutpadyate, tadartham āśugrahaṇena viśeṣyate bhramaṇam
gacchantyāṃ nāvi sthitasya gacchadvṛkṣādibhrāntirutpadyate iti yānagrahaṇam
nirālambe nabhasi keśākārā uṇḍukākārā ca pratītiḥ
artharūpe bhrāntaṃ svarūpe ca abhrāntamiti dvāvākārau
idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam--pratibhāsaikyaniyame dhīrvikalpikāḥ buddhiḥ, dhīḥ iti sāmānyavacanāt kathamiyaṃ labhyate iti cet ? anantaravakṣyamāṇagacchād anyasyāḥ tadasaṃbhavāt
sā ekaiva na syāt, syāt ityanena vā anāgatena sambandhāt
tena teṣāṃ svasaṃvittiḥ nābhilāpānuṣaṅginī || pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 249 iti
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā āvṛtāt anāvṛtaṃ calād acalaṃ raktād araktaṃ kṛtakād akṛtakaṃ rūpamekāntena anyat tathā anabhilāpinyāḥ svapratīteḥ abhilāpinī pratibhāsapratītirapi anyā iti
na ca sā anupalabdhā asti; atiprasaṅgāt
svata eva tadupalabdhau tasyāḥ svasaṃvedanamavikalpakam, anyathā prakṛtamapi na bhavet
evaṃ cet sa eva doṣaḥ--tataḥ sā bhinnā iti
punarapi svata eva tadupalabdhau prakṛto doṣaḥ
prakṛtasaṃvedanena tadupalabdhau tasya tadātmakatve tasya savikalpakatvaṃ tasyā vā nirvikalpakatvam
atadātmakatve tata utpannena tadākārānukāriṇā vā tena tadupalabdhau tasya savikalpakatvam
kiṃca, vikalpasya buddhisvasaṃvedanāt tasyāḥ pūrvatvaṃ punarapi tasyāḥ svasaṃvedanopagame samānaścarcaḥ, anavasthā
tadanupagame vā arthā'viśeṣāt na sā buddheḥ ākāraḥ syāt
tadevaṃ pratīteḥ anupalambhena asattvāt na kalpanā nāma abhilāpasaṃsargayogyapratibhāsā pratītiḥ kalpanā nyāyabi॰ 1
5 ityasya lakṣaṇasyā'bhāvāt, iti tannivṛttyarthaṃ kalpanāpoḍhapadañca anarthakam
etena nahi imāḥ kalpanā apratisaṃviditā eva udayante vyayante ca yataḥ satyo'pi anupalakṣitāḥ syuḥ
tato yo yena dharmeṇa viśeṣaḥ saṃpratīyate
na sa śakyaḥ tato'nyena tena bhinnā vyavasthitiḥ
katham ? kalpanānāmabhāve tāsāmudayavyayau lakṣaṇaṃ vyāvṛttinibandhanā jātibhedāḥ prakalpyante iti ca śraddhāmātramatopi durlabhamiti nānityatvasattvayoḥ sādhyasādhanabhāvaḥ, abhedāt
saṃvṛteḥ ayaṃ syāditi cet; nanu saṃvṛtiḥ vikalpabuddhireva sā ca nāsti, tata eva cāyam ati viruddhametat
svapnavad bhrānteriti cet; na; tatrāpi yadīyaṃ nirvikalpikā; na tato yuktaḥ
anyathā anyadāpi tata eveti vyāhatametat--sarva evāyam ā॰ dignāgaḥ ityādi
vikalpikā cet; sa eva doṣaḥ--saiva nāsti tata eva cāyam iti viruddhametat
tato'sya doṣasya parihārārthaṃ bahirarthetarayoḥ citretarātmakaṃ savikalpetarātmakaṃ vā ekaṃ jñānaṃ sautrāntikenāpi abhyupagantavyamiti kuto'sya kvacinniraṃśaikāntasiddhiḥ ityabhiprāyaḥ
tato yo yena dharmeṇa viśeṣaḥ saṃpratīyate
na sa śakyaḥ tato'nyena tena bhinnā vyavasthitiḥ || pra॰ vā॰ 3 | 39-41
pṛ॰ 183 saṃvṛtirnāma vikalpavijñānam adhimuktimāha anādivāsanātaḥ pṛ॰ 185 saṃvṛtyāstīti bhrāntajanāpekṣayā astīti pṛ॰ 377--pra॰ vārtikāla॰
tathā ca anumānānumeyavyavahāro'yaṃ sarvo hi buddhiparikalpitaḥ buddhyārūḍhena dharmadharmibhedenetyuktam--ācāryadignāgenāpye taduktamityāha tathā cetyādi— pra॰ vā॰ sva॰, ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 24
yadi ca ayam anantaramucyamānaḥ ekānto'vaśyaṃbhāvaḥ antaḥ cetasi bahirghaṭādau, vā iti samuccayo, viruddhadharmādhyāse sati naikatvaṃ syād bhavet
bahirarthe śuklaśaṅkhādau vibhramaḥ pītādipratītilakṣaṇaḥ yeṣāṃ cetasāṃ vijñānānāṃ tāni tathoktāni teṣāṃ kathaṃ svasaṃvedanaṃ pratyakṣam ? naiva syāditi cintitametat
etena parvatādityādeḥ saṃlagnatādau vibhramacetasāṃ kathaṃ parvatādigrahaṇaṃ pratyakṣamiti draṣṭavyam

kasyacit ityādinā paramatamāśaṅkate--kasyacit--timirāśubhramaṇanauyānasaṃkṣobhādyāhitavibhramasya pramāṇatadābhāsasvabhāvasāṅkarye pramāṇaṃ yaḥ svabhāvaḥ svasaṃvedanalakṣaṇaḥ tadabhāso dvicandrādigrahaṇarūpo yaḥ svabhāvaḥ tayoḥ sāṅkaryye kathañcittādāmye cittasya jñānasya aṅgīkriyamāṇe dūṣaṇamāha--katham ityādi

kena ? ityāha--pratibhāsabheda ādiryasya viruddhadharmādhyāsakāraṇadeśakālārthakriyādibhedasya sa tathoktaḥ tena ekatvaṃ nirākriyeta ? cittasya ityetadatrāpi yojyaṃ madhye karaṇāt, cittasya ātmana ityarthaḥ

etena etadapi nirastaṃ yaduktaṃ vaiśeṣikādinā--ayam iti ūrdhvatāsāmānyaviśiṣṭasya dharmiṇo'vadhāraṇam nirṇayaḥ, sthāṇurvā puruṣo vā iti viśeṣānavadhāraṇaṃ saṃśayaḥ na ekaeva pratyayaḥ ekasya avadhāraṇā'navadhāraṇātmakatvānupapattiḥ iti cet; dṛṣṭatvādapratiṣedhaḥ
dṛṣṭamidam ekaṃ jñānaṃ sāmānyaviśiṣṭavastunaḥ avadhāraṇātmakaṃ sat viśeṣānavadhāraṇātmakamiti
so'pi hi sāmānyaviśiṣṭasya vastuno'vadhāraṇātmakaḥ san viśeṣe viparyayaḥ yathā sthāṇau puruṣaḥ iti pratyaya iti

katham ? yadi saṃśayaviparyayetarasvabhāvamekaṃ jñānamiṣyate; tarhi sāmānyaviśeṣātmakaṃ tathaiva sarvaṃ syāt, anyathā ayamiti sthāṇuriti puruṣa iti ca pratyayāḥ parasparaparihārasthitatanava iti na saṃśayādivyavasthā
anavadhāraṇātmakaśca pratyayaśceti vyāhanyate; na vyāghātaḥ svarūpāvadhāraṇāt
svarūpamasya avadhāryate asti me saṃśayajñānamiti vastusvarūpaṃ tu nānena paricchidyate

ayaṃ hi sāmānyaviśiṣṭadharmyupalambhena dharmaviśeṣānupalambhaviruddhobhayaviśeṣasmaraṇasahakāriṇā janyamāna iti sāmānyaviśiṣṭaṃ dharmiṇamavadhārayan sthāṇurvā puruṣo veti viśeṣamanavadhārayan anavadhāraṇātmakaḥ pratyayaśca syāt
dṛṣṭaṃ hi yatra vilakṣaṇasāmagrī tatra kāryamapi vilakṣaṇameva yathā pratyabhijñānam
vyākhyātā ekenārthena kārikā, dvitīyenedānīṃ vyākhyāyate--savikalpanirvikalpayoḥ cetaḥsvabhāvayoḥ iti manyate
tatra dūṣaṇamāha--sukhaduḥkhayorapi tathaiva tenaiva prakāreṇa kathaṃ na bhaved bhavedeva kathañcidekatvamiti
yaduktaṃ dha rmo tta rā di nā--kalpanāpoḍhamabhrāntaṃ pratyakṣam nyāyabi॰ 1
4 ityatra laukikī bhrāntiḥ keśoṇḍukādipratītirūpā, kalpanā ca jātyādiviśiṣṭagrahaṇātmikā
tadanena carcitam, kasyacit cittasya iti vacanāt
sa hi kasyacit cittasya bhavati na pūrvasya, anyathā kalpanārahitasya bhrāntasya vā saṃbhavāt lakṣaṇamasaṃbhavi syāt pratyakṣasya
yaccoktaṃ tenaiva-- śāstrīyā ca sakalālambanapratītiḥ sarvamālambane bhrāntam iti rāddhāntāt grāhyagrāhakākārapratītaṃsarvaṃ jñānaṃ kalpanā iti ca
kathamidamavagamyate aviśeṣeṇa abhidhānāt ? sā hi sarvavijñānasādhāraṇī, tasyā grahaṇe na kiñcidvijñānaṃ kalpanāpoḍhamabhrāntaṃ vā labhyeta ityabhidhānāt
tad ityayaṃ nipātaḥ saḥ ityasyārthe vartate
tato'yamarthaḥ— so'yaṃ dha rmo tta rā diḥ ekāntaṃ kṣaṇikaniraṃśaparamāṇutattvamātram avalambya
bahiśca antaśca mukhaṃ nirbhāso yasya vibhrametaravikalpetaracetaḥsvabhāvasya sa tathoktaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--bahirmukho vibhramaḥ cetaḥ sarvamālambane bhrāntam pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
196 iti vacanāt, antarmukha itaro'vibhramaḥ cetaḥsvabhāvaḥ, tathā bahirmukho vikalpaḥ tatsvabhāvaḥ grāhya pra॰ vā॰ 3
taṃ kathambhūtam ? ityatrāha--anekāntanāntarīyakaṃ pratipadyamānaḥ tad duṣyate anekāntadveṣī tatkārī ca anekāntakārī ca iti hetoḥ upekṣām avajñām arhati
yathā cirakālīnādhyayanādikhinnasya asthitasya nīlalohitādiguṇaviśiṣṭaḥ keśoṇḍrakākhyaḥ kaścinnayanāgre parisphuṭati
athavā karasaṃmṛditalocanaraśmiṣu yeyaṃ keśapiṇḍāvasthā sa keśoṇḍrakaḥ
yadṛcchāśabdeṣu nāmnā viśiṣṭo'rtha ucyate ḍittha iti
jātyādisaṃsṛṣṭaṃ tu manojñānaṃ kalpanā ityanye kathayanti
yogācāramatena ca tathāgatajñānamadvayaṃ muktvā sarvaṃ jñānaṃ grāhyagrāhakatvena vikalpitaṃ kalpanā
tasmādanāditathābhūtānumānaparamparāpravṛttamanumānamāśritya bahirarthakalpanāyāṃ grāhyagrāhakasaṃvedanakalpanāpravṛtteḥ grāhyādikalpanā, paramārthataḥ saṃvedanamevāvibhāgamiti sthitam
nanu nā'sau taddveṣī tatkārī ca, sarvadā buddhaiḥ ekasyāḥ citrāyāḥ abhinnayogakṣematvenopagamāt, ekāntasya tu bahiḥ
taduktaṃ dha rma kī rtti nā--
pratikṣaṇaṃ viṣayaparicchedalakṣaṇo yogaḥ tadarthakriyānuṣṭhānalakṣaṇaśca kṣemaḥ paripālanarūpaḥ
iti nāmaikabhāvaḥ syāt citrākārasya cetasi || pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 220-21
pra jñā ka ra gu pte nā pyuktam-- "citrakārāpyekaiva buddhiḥ bāhyacitravilakṣaṇatvāt
śakyavivecanaṃ hi bāhyaṃ citram, aśakyavivecanāstu buddheḥ nīlādaya ākārāḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3

bahirantarmukhavibhrametaravikalpāvikalpapramāṇetaratvādi parasparavibhinnaṃ saṃvidaṃ na bhinatti cet avayavinaṃ kathamākṣipet harṣādayo vā kathamātmānaṃ yato nairātmyasiddhiḥ ? ekatrābhinnaviṣaye'pi abhilāpasaṃsargayogyāyogyapratibhāsayoḥ saṃplavapravartanaṃ kathannecchet ? vastunaḥ svabhāvabhedasya vastvabhedakatvāt
antarbahiśca mukhaṃ yasyā sā bhā grāhyagrāhakapratibhāsa ādiryasya pramāṇetaratvādeḥ tat tathoktaṃ tat kartṛ, saṃvidaṃ na bhinatti, tatsadbhāve'pi ekaiva saṃviditi yāvat

idamatra tātparyam--yadi antarbahirmukhābhādi akramatvāt saṃvidaṃ na bhinatti tarhi ekakṣaṇabhāvyaśeṣajñānajātamapi na bhinatti iti ekajñānamaśeṣam ekadā jagat, punarapi tathā punarapi tathaiveti ekasantānamātramapi, iti parasmai parārthānumānam nyāyabi॰ 3
punaḥ dvitīyādikṣaṇabhāvijñānajātamapi parasparaṃ saṃvidaṃ na bhinatti iti ekasantānamātramāpatitamiti bhāvaḥ
etena nānāvijñānasantānavādī yogācāro'pi cintito draṣṭavya iti

syānmatam--nākramatvād antarbahirmukhābhādinā saṃvid aikyamanubhavati yenāyaṃ doṣaḥ syāt, api tu kathañcittādātmyenāvabhāsanāditi; atrottaramāha--na kramādhīnaṃ bhindyādeva sukhādikaṃ kramāyattaṃ sukham ādiryasya duḥkhādeḥ tat tathoktam, tanna bhindyādeva saṃvidam, kramabhāvisukhādyātmikā ekā saṃvit syāt tathābhāsāditi manyate
bahiśca antaśca mukhaṃ yeṣāṃ tāni ca tāni vibhrametaravikalpāvikalpapramāṇetaratvāni ca tathoktāni ādiryasya grāhyādinīlādyākāranikurumbasya tattathoktam
tat kiṃ kuryāt ? ityāha--saṃvidaṃ buddhiṃ na bhinatti ced yadi
etaduktaṃ bhavati--bahirmukho vibhramaḥ sarvamālambane bhrāntam pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
196 iti vacanāt, antarmukha itaro'vibhramaḥ sarvacitta nyāyabi॰ 1
pramāṇetaratve punaḥ bahirmukhe śabdakṣaṇikatvādyapekṣayā candradvitvādyapekṣayā ca, antarmukhe ca saccetanasvargaprāpaṇādisāmarthyāpekṣayā
nanu ca vibhrametarāveva pramāṇetaratve tatkimartham ityadoṣaḥ ?
atra ayamabhiprāyaḥ ?bhinatti ? iti; tadanena nirastam; ekātmaharṣādau sāmyāt

bhavatvevam; tathāpi ko doṣa iti cet ? na kaścit, kevalam yad yathāvabhāsate tattathaiva paramārthasadvyavahārāvatāri yathā nīlaṃ nīlatayā avabhāsamānaṃ tathaiva tadvyavahārāvatāri, pratibhāsante ca kṣaṇikatayā sarve bhāvāḥ ityatra pakṣasya pratyakṣabādhanaṃ hetośca āśrayāsiddhiḥ, yato nairātmyasiddhiḥ naiva nairātmyasiddhiḥ api tu sātmasiddhiriti
sattvacetanatvādyapekṣayā pramāṇatvam, svargaprāpaṇaśaktyādyapekṣayā apramāṇatvam iti grāhyam
97 ityatra yaduktaṃ pareṇa--prāṇādisattvasya kvacit sātmake darśanāt tadabhāve'pi bhāvāśaṅkā'nivṛtteḥ anaikāntikatvam, vijñānasantāna eva bhāvād viruddhatvaṃ ca iti; tannirastamiti darśayati
katham ? yadi uktanyāyena tatra dṛṣṭamapi na dṛṣṭam anyatra dṛṣṭaṃ vocyate; tarhi agnimati dhūmavattvaṃ dṛṣṭam tatrādṛṣṭam anyatra dṛṣṭaṃ vā kalpyatām
tataḥ prāṇādimattvād dharmiṇi jīvaccharīre saṃśaya ātmabhāvābhāvayorityanaikāntikaḥ prāṇādiriti
snehāt sukheṣu tṛṣyati tṛṣṇā doṣaṃ tiraskurute || pra॰ vā॰ 1 | 219 ityādi;
tadapyanena nirastam; yadi hi kramā'kramānekāntacittātmani dṛṣṭe avaśyaṃ snehādiḥ saṃsārasya; na kadācit saugatasya muktiḥ sarvadā tasyaiva darśanāt
nanu akrameṇeva krameṇāpi cittamekaṃ citramastu na bāhyamiti cet; atrāha--avayavinam ityādi

nanu caikatra avayave guṇe vā pravṛttamindriyaṃ nā'vayavāntaraṃ guṇāntaraṃ vekṣituṃ kṣamate, kathamataḥ tatsādhāraṇarūpasya grahaṇam, na ca tadātmakam anyathā vā tadupalabhyate iti cet; atrāha--ekatra ityādi
ekatra abhinne viṣaye'pi grāhye'pi na kevalaṃ citte viṣayiṇi saṃplavapravartanaṃ kathaṃ necchet ? icchedeva saugatādiḥ
kayoḥ ? ityāha--abhilāpasaṃsargayogyam anekaviśeṣasādhāraṇaṃ sāmānyaṃ tadayogyo viśeṣaḥ tayoḥ pratibhāsau tayoḥ, iti cittavad viṣaye'pi sāmānyaviśeṣa- pratibhāsādityabhiprāyaḥ
tathā laukikī pratītiḥ yamahaṃ paśyāmi tameva spṛśāmi, yamahamadrākṣaṃ tameva spṛśāmi iti ca
taduktaṃ nyā ya vi ni śca ye--
evaṃ tarhi abhilāpasaṃsargayogyasvabhāvākrāntam anyat tadviparītasvabhāvākrāntañca anyadvastu syād anyathā kvacidapi tadbhedo na syāditi cet; atrāha--vastuna ityādi

atraivaṃ manyate--dvau bhedau vastunaḥ svabhāvabhūtau yathā jñānasya vibhrametaratvādiḥ, anyaśca yathā jñānāntarasya, sa eva tatra vastunaḥ svabhāvaḥ svarūpayo bhedaḥ tasya vastunaḥ abhedakatvāt kathamākṣipet iti ? tanna sautrāntikamate kiṃ syāt pra॰ vā॰ 2
kiṃ syāt sā citrataikasyāṃ na syāttasyāṃ matāvapi
yadīdaṃ svayamarthebhyo rocate tatra ke vayam
atra svayam avibhāgo'pi buddhyātmā bhāgīva bhāti ityekaṃ darśanam, tadanantarabhāvinī vikalpikā buddhiḥ tamanyathāpratibhāsamapi sabhāgamiva vyavasyati ityaparam
tatra prathamaṃ darśayitvā tāvad dūṣayati--na vidyate bhāgo yasya sa cāsau buddhyātmā ca buddhireva
354 iti ced yadi; dūṣaṇam--akramaḥ sukhādikramarahitaḥ avibhāga buddhyātmā kinna kramavān iva sukhādikramavāniva bhāti iti saṃbuddhau
grāhyagrāhakasaṃvittibhedavat sukhādibhedo'pi na tāttvika iti tatsaṃvedanasya pratyakṣatvadarśanavarṇanamanarthakam
nanu yadyasau kramavān pratibhāti ka ivārthaḥ ? na hi nīlaṃ nīlatayā pratibhāsamānaṃ nīlamiva yuktam

atha tathā na pratibhāti, tathāpi ka ivārthaḥ ? na khalu nīlamapītatayā'vabhāsamānaṃ pītamiva bhavitumarhatīti cet; tarhi yadi grāhyagrāhakasaṃvittibhedavat pratibhāti ka ivārthaḥ ? anyathāpi ka ivārtha iti samānam

kiñca, yadi avibhāgaḥ pramāṇataḥ sa kadācit pratipannaḥ syāt; tadā anyadā savibhāgadarśanāt savibhāga iva iti yukto vyavahāraḥ, ajalasya marīcikācakrasya kvadāciddarśanāt tatra jalamiva iti vyavahāravat
na caivamiti nirūpayiṣyate anantarameva svayamadvayasya dvayanirbhāsapratīteḥ ityanena
dūre yathā vā maruṣu mahāmālyādi dṛśyate
na hi yathā anupaplutacakṣuṣāṃ mṛcchakalādidarśanamanyathā tathā buddhyātma darśanamiti
na ca dṛṣṭāntamātrādabhimatārthaḥ siddhimupagacchati, anyathā sarvaṃ sarvasya sidhyet tadaviśeṣāt
satyaṃ kathaṃ syurākārāḥ tadekatvasya hānitaḥ || pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 358 iti;
dṛśyamānasya nānārūpāvabhāsataḥ satyatāvirahāt, paramārthasya ca darśanavirahānna kiñcit syāt, iti yathādarśanameveyaṃ mānameyaphalasthitiḥ āho yathātattvam iti kuto niścayaḥ ?

syānmatam--na kramabhāvisukhādivyatiriktebhāvābuddhyātmā anubhūyate, kevalaṃ kramajanmasukhādivedanāt, kathaṃ sa kramavāniva bhāti ityucyate ? anyathā kharaviṣāṇaṃ tathā bhāti iti; grāhyākāravyatirikto'pi nā'nubhūyate nīlādikamahaṃ vedmi iti sarvadā pratīteḥ iti samānam

yatpunaretat--pra jñā ka ra gu pta sya pra ti bhā sā dvai ta si ddhi pra ka ra ṇe codyam— yadyasau kramavānavabhāsamāno'pi kramavāniva bhātītyucyate tarhi asan sanniva acetanaścetana iva bhātīti kinnocyate ? iti; tadapi prakṛte bhavati na veti cintyam
dvitīyaṃ dūṣayati darśayitvā--bhāgīva bhāti vuddhyātmā bahirantarmukhādibhiḥ lakṣyate niraṃśadarśanapṛṣṭhabhāvivikalpena niścīyate ced yadi
atra dūṣaṇam--akramaḥ kinna kramavāniva lakṣyate tenaiva vikalpenāvyavasīyate iti ? nyāyasya samānatvāt sarvasya
kiñca, vikalpo'pi tathā taṃ vyavasan grāhyagrāhakasaṃvittibhedavān bhavati na veti cakṣuṣī nimīlya unmīlya vā cintaya tāvat
yadi sa kutaścit tathā bhavati; tadyaści eva buddhyātmā tata eva tathā bhavatu iti kiṃ vikalpakalpanayā ? tatrāpi punastathā kalpane anavasthā
na ca parasya vikalpo nāma ityuktam
kārikāyāḥ sugamatvād vyākhyānamakṛtvā yadyapyabhāgabuddhyātmā bhāgīva kramavāniva vā bhāti lakṣyate vā tathāpi saugatasya puruṣādvaitavādino vā mataṃ sidhyet na jainasya
na hi tathābhāsanāt sa tathaiva bhavati, na khalu jalamiva marīcikācakraṃ jalameva bhavati iti codyaṃ manasi nidhāya dūṣayannāha--tatra sadbhiḥ ityādi
idamatra tātparyam--bhāgīva iti vacanāt tatra buddhyātmani bhāsamānā api grāhyādayo bhāgā na paramārthasantaḥ, asanto'pi na buddhyātmano bhinnā eva
tataḥ te tataḥ kathañcidabhinnā abhyupagantavyā iti

nanvevamapi asadbhiḥ iti vaktavyam nyāyyatvāt kiṃ sadbhiḥ ityanena viparyayāditi cet; satyam; tathāpi yad yathāvabhāsatetattathaiva paramārthasadvyavahārāvatāri yathā nīlaṃ nīlatayāvabhāsamānaṃ tathaiva tadvyavahārāvatāri, avabhāsante ca kṣaṇikatayā sarve bhāvāḥ ityabhidhāya yadi grāhyagrāhakasaṃvittibhāgavattayā bhāsamāno'pi buddhyātmā tathaiva paramārthasanna bhavet; tenaiva hetorvyabhicāraḥ syāt, tasmāt tathaivaparamārthasan iti pra jñā ka ra sya pradarśanārtham sadbhiḥ iti vacanaṃ vyākhyātam iti tātparyārthaḥ
śabdārtho vyākhyāyate--sadbhiḥ vidyamānaiḥ saccetanādivad asadbhiḥ avidyamānaiḥ marīcikātoyādivat ceti samuccaye
kasyacit iti sāmānyavacanaṃ pūrvasya vikalpasya ca buddhyātmanaḥ saṃgrahārtham, ekatvaṃ sidhyet
tathaiva tenaiva prakāreṇa sukhaduḥkhādibhiḥ kramavadbhiḥ sadbhiḥ asadbhirvā kinna akramātmanaḥ siddhiḥ syād ekatvasya iti manyate
ubhayathāpi sadbhirvā ekatvaprakāreṇa asadbhirapi ekatve ekasya vibhrametaratvasiddhiḥ nairātmyasiddherabhāvaḥ
evaṃ parasya aniṣṭasiddhiṃ pradarśya adhunā atraiva pūrvapakṣe iṣṭābhāvaṃ kathayannāha--pratyakṣam ityādi

kalpanāpoḍhasyābhrāntasyāpi vikalpabhrāntisaṃbhave pratyakṣatadābhāsayoḥ kiṃ kāraṇamāśritya bhedaṃ lakṣayediti pratyakṣasya lakṣaṇāntaraṃ śakyaṃ vaktum, candramekaṃ paśyato'pi dvicandrabhrāntiḥ mānasī svayamavibhāgabuddhau kalpanāracitagrāhyagrāhakasaṃvittibhedasaṃvedanavat
avibhāgaṃ bhāgīva sivāniva bhāti cet yadi cittaṃ jñānam
atra dūṣaṇamāha--antaḥ svarūpe tadeva cittaṃ pratyakṣaṃ kalpanāpoḍhaṃ kalpanāpoḍhatvāt tadapi abhrāntatvāt yat pareṇoktaṃ na lakṣyate iti pūrvakārikākriyāpadena sambandhaḥ
niraṃśasya sāṃśatayā avabhāsaṃte vibhramasya sadākārasādhāraṇatayā ca kalpanāyāḥ va kalpanāyā svabhāvādasiddho hetuḥ ityabhiprāyaḥ

nanu ca prathamaṃ darśanam avibhāgameva ātmānaṃ paśyati tadanantarabhāvivikalpastu tatsabhāgamiva vyavasyati tato'yamadoṣa iti cet; atrāha--kiṃ bahiri ti na ityetadatrāpi sambandha nīyaṃ madhye karaṇāt
tato'yamarthaḥ bahiḥ candrādau cittaṃ sarve kinna pratyakṣaṃ kalpanāpoḍham abhrāntaṃ lakṣyate kintu lakṣyata eva
kim na kiñcid vata kāraṇaṃ nimittam āśritya bhedaṃ lakṣayet ? ākasmikaṃ lakṣayed ityarthaḥ
kalpanāpoḍhasya abhrāntasyāpi cittam ityanuvartamānaṃ jāta tāpariṇāmam iha sambadhyate cittasya iti
vikalpabhrāntisaṃbhave ekasya sadasadākārasādhāraṇasya bhāvāt vikalpasya niraṃśasya sāṃśatayā avabhāsabhāvād bhrānteśca saṃbhave sati

etaduktaṃ bhavati--pratyakṣatvasya kalpanāpoḍhā'bhrāntatve vyāpake, te ca svaviruddhakalpanā-bhrāntivyāpta sarvajñānebhyo vyāvartamāne svavyāpyaṃ pratyakṣatvamādāya nivarttete iti na pratyakṣaṃ nāma, tadabhāve na tadābhāsaṃ tadapekṣatvādasya, iti tarhi kalpanāpoḍhabhrāntatvā'bhāve'pi pratyakṣasya lakṣaṇāntarasmāt śakyaṃ vaktuṃ pratipādayitum
candragrahaṇam ekagrahaṇaṃ vā upalakṣaṇaṃ tena saṃkha karituragādiśuklatadveśādigrahaṇaṃ taṃ paśyato'pi cakṣurjñānena sākṣātkurvato'pi na kevalam apaśyataḥ
atrāpi dvicandragrahaṇam upalakṣaṇanimiti svāpādau deśādigrahaṇaṃ tasya bhrāntiḥ anyathāgrahaṇam, sā ca mānasī iti draṣṭavyā
svayam ātmanaḥ avibhāgā niraṃśā yā buddhiḥ tasyāṃ kalpanāracitā grāhya grāhakasaṃvittibhedāḥ teṣāṃ saṃvedanasya iva tadvat iti
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā avimāgabuddhiṃ paśyato'pi grāhyagrāhakasaṃvittibhedasaṃvedanaṃ bhrāntiḥ mānasī tathā prakṛtā'pi iti
pūrvaṃ pratyakṣābhāvāt tadābhāsabhedaṃ na lakṣayet ityuktam, idānīṃ tadābhāsā'bhāvāt pratyakṣamidaṃ na lakṣayet ityucyate
trividhaṃ kalpanājñānaṃ pratyakṣābhaṃ marīcikāyāṃ jalādhyavasāyi bhrāntijñānam saṃvṛttau visaṃvādivyavasāyasāṃvṛtajñānam pūrvadṛṣṭaikatvakalpanāpravṛttaṃ liṅgānumeyādijñānam
kīdṛśam ? āśrayasya indriyasya upaplavaḥ timirādyupaghātaḥ tasmād bhavo yasya tattathā
avikalpakamekaṃ ca pratyakṣābhaṃ caturvidham || pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 288 iti
nanu dvicandrabhrāntiḥ mānasī cet; kimidānīmindriyajñānam ? yad indriyasya bhāvā'bhāvābhyāṃ bhāvā'bhāvavat tattasyeti cet; dvicandrādijñānam ata eva tasya astu
tasya vikāre yad vikāravat tattasyeti cet; etadapi anena notsṛṣṭam
tulanā--yadi tāvat mānasametat dvicandrādijñānamindriyabhāvābhāvānurodhi na syāt
kiñcendriyaṃ ya da kṣāṇāṃ bhāvābhāvānurodhi cet

..."timirajñānaṃ bhramamanicchato'pi kiṃ kīdṛśamaindriyajñānamiṣyate ? yadakṣāṇāṃ bhāvābhāvayoranurodhi svabhāvābhāvābhyāmanuvartakaṃ tadaindriyamiti cet; tata indriyabhāvābhāvānurodhitvaṃ taimirikajñānasyāpi tulyam
indriyavikāreṇa vikriyāvajjñānamaindriyaṃ cet; dvicandrādijñānānāṃ timirādīndriyavikāreṇa vikriyā
saiveyam abhūtārthopadarśanātmikā bhrāntatvanimittamuktā'smābhiḥ kiṃ niṣidhyate ?--pra॰ vā॰ mano॰
tattulyaṃ vikriyāvaccet sā ceyaṃ na kimiṣyate || pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 296
kiñca, dvicandrādibhrāntirmānasī cet; tarhi sarpādibhrāntivat indriya vikṛtāvapi nivarteta, akṣaviplave nivṛtte'pi vā na nivarteta
yathā rajjau sarpādibhrāntiḥ mānasī indriyavikāre satyapi mānasavimarśāt nivartate
api ca, sarpādibhrāntivad etasyāḥ śabdaiḥ tadvācakaiḥ anyasantāne samarpaṇaṃ pūrvadṛṣṭadvicandrādismaraṇāpekṣaṇam aparisphuṭapratibhāsanañca syāt
dṛṣṭasmṛtimapekṣeta na bhāseta parisphuṭam || pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 298
iti cet; tanna; asya prakṛte'pi samānatvāt
tathāhi--grāhyagrāhakasaṃvittibhedasaṃvedanaṃ bhrāntiścet mānasī; kim idānīmindriyajñānam ? indriyabhāvābhāvānurodhi cet; tattulyamitaratrāpi
tathāpi iyaṃ mānasī; tathā dvicandrādibhrāntirapi syāditi manyate
etena etadapi nirastaṃ yaduktaṃ pareṇa--nirālambanāḥ sarve pratyayāḥ pratyayatvāt svapnapratyayavat pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
331 iti; katham ? vādinaṃ prati dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyavikalatvāt
atha prativādinaṃ prati na tasya tadvikalatetyadoṣaḥ; tarhi prativādino'nusaraṇe na avibhāgabuddhyātmasaṃvedanasiddhiḥ
ata eva sarve pratyayā anālabhbanāḥ pratyayatvāt svapnapratyayavaditi pramāṇasya pariśuddhiḥ— pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 359
evam avikalpakamekaṃ ca pratyakṣam pra॰ vā॰ 2
288 ityetat nirākṛtya trividhaṃ kalpanājñānaṃ pratyakṣābham pra॰ vā॰ 2
antaḥ pareṇa anumānādeḥ avikalpakatvamiṣyate iti bahirgrahaṇam, tatrāpi kalpanāpoḍham

pratyakṣavat yadi anumānādi avikalpakam; tadgṛhīte'pi samāropaḥ syāditi tannirāsārthaṃ nirṇayajñānaṃ savikalpakamiva mānasavikalpa iva kutaścid vikalpavaśāt pratibhāti iti nirākṛtametat--bhrāntiḥ saṃvṛtisaṃ jñānam pra॰ samu॰ 1
saṃvṛtisatyaṃ hi svasmin arthāntaramāropya tatsvarūpakalpanāt pratyakṣābhāsam
anumānaṃ tatphalaṃ ca pūrvānubhavakalpanāt na pratyakṣam
dvividho hi arthaḥ pratyakṣaḥ parokṣaśca, tatra yo jñānapratibhāsaṃ svānvayavyatirekāvanukārayati sa pratyakṣo'rthaḥ anyaḥ parokṣaḥ ityetadidānīṃ dūṣayannāha--tanna ityādi
tat tasmāt uktanyāyāt na pratyakṣavyavasthā kalpanāpoḍhasyā'bhrāntasya vikalpabhrāntisaṃbhave na pratyakṣārtho lakṣaṇābhāvāditi manyate
nāpi parokṣaviṣayavyavasthā taimirikaṃ prati parokṣatvena abhimatasya ekacandrādeḥ ānumānikaṃ ca prati pāvakādeḥ svapratyakṣatvāditi bhāvaḥ
tato nirākṛtametat--pramāṇaṃ dvividhaṃ meyadvaividhyāt pra॰ vā॰ 2
pramāṇamavisaṃvādi jñānam itarad apramāṇam tayorvyavasthāne , etadapi kutaḥ ? ityatrāha--tattvetara ityādi
tattvaṃ paramārthādvayaṃ jñānam itaraḥ aparamārtho dvicandrādiḥ tayorvyavasthā'yogāt uktanyāyena tanni ṣedhāt
tanna yogācāramate'pi kiṃ syāt pra॰ vā॰ 2
209 ityādi ca mādhyamikasya darśanamavaśiṣyate, tatrāpi tanna yuktamiti darśayannāha--ātmasaṃvedanam ityādi
na hi bhrānteḥ svasaṃvedanaṃ bhrāntaṃ yuktam, tadapratyakṣatve viṣayavatsvabhāvāsiddhiprasaṅgāt
nāpi tat sarvathā abhrāntameva svayamadvayasyāpi dvayanirbhāsapratīteḥ
yadi punaḥ idaṃ pratyakṣameva timirābhyupahatacakṣuṣāṃ kinna syāt ? tad...
bhrānteḥ antarbahirvibhramasya yadātmanaḥ svarūpasya saṃvedanaṃ grahaṇaṃ tadabhāve arthavat tadasiddheriti manyate
bhāti cakāsti tatsaṃvedanaṃ bhedī citrapataṅgādiḥ tena samānaṃ tadvat
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā citrapataṅgādiḥ ekānekarūpatayā bhāti tathā tatsaṃvedanamapi vibhrametaraikānekarūpatayā iti
kiṃ sarvam ? na, taimiraṃ timiragrahaṇaṃ bhrānti kāraṇopalakṣaṇam, tasmād āgatam dvicandrādijñānamiti yāvat
tat kim ? ityāha--pratyakṣaṃ bhedivat bhāti ca kathañcit pratyakṣamityarthaḥ
tathā ca yaduktaṃ taireva--yadvabhāsate na tat sat yathā dvicandrādi, avabhāsate ca jñānaghaṭādi iti; tannirastam; sarvathā vibhramasya dṛṣṭānte'pi na siddhiriti bhāvaḥ

bhrānternīlādibuddhe smārtha nirālambanāḥ svarūpālambanāḥ pratyayāḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 365 ityabhidhānāt ātmasaṃvedanaṃ svarūpagrahaṇam abhrāntam vibhramākāraśūnyam anyathā sakalavikalpaśūnyatā'siddheriti manyate
atra dūṣaṇam bhrānti tadātmasaṃvedanaṃ pratibhāsate bhedinā citrapataṅgādinā samānamiti

etaduktaṃ bhavati--sarvavikalpātītatvena niraṃśasya grāhyākāraiḥ sāṃśasya iva bhāsanāt kathaṃ tadabhrāntam yataḥ prakṛtamarthatattvaṃ sidhyet ? tathāpi pratyakṣatve dūṣaṇamāha— pratyakṣaṃ tadātmasaṃvedanam taimiraṃ cāndraṃ dvicandrādiviṣayaṃ jñānam kinna pratyakṣam api tu pratyakṣameva
tathā ca yad viśadadarśanāvabhāsi na tat paramārthasat yathā dvicandrādi, tadavabhāsi ca jāgratstambhādi
bhāvā yena nirūpyante tadrūpaṃ nāsti tattvataḥ
yasmādekamanekaṃ ca rūpaṃ teṣāṃ na vidyate
tato nirālambanāḥ sarva eva pratyayāḥ svapnapratyayavaditi ko'rthaḥ ? svarūpālambanāḥ
bhrānteḥ bahirantarvibhramaikāntasya svasya svarūpasya saṃvedanaṃ grahaṇaṃ nahi bhrāntam śakyaṃ yuktamupapannam kintu abhrāntameva yuktam iti anekāntasiddhiḥ
tasya bhrāntisvasaṃvedanasya apratyakṣatve bhrāntatve ityarthaḥ viṣayavat ghaṭādivat svabhāvāsiddhiprasaṅgāt bhrāntisvarūpāsiddhiprasaṅgāt
taduktaṃ nyā ya vi ni śca ye--
vibhrame vibhrame teṣāṃ vibhramo'pi na sidhyati nyāyavi॰ 1 | 54 iti
pakṣāntarasūcakaḥ āpiśabdaḥ sarvathā sarvātmanā tat bhrānteḥ ātmasaṃvedanam abhrāntameva
nāpi na kevalaṃ sarvathā na bhrāntameva
svayam ātmanā saugatopagamād advayasyāpi takaṃ vedanasyāpi sarvavikalpātītasya dvayanirbhāsapratīteḥ saṃvedanagrāhyākāraiḥ ekānekākārapratīteḥ
nanu ca yadi nīlādiśarīrasukhādi grāhyam na tato'paraṃ grāhakaṃ grahaṇaṃ vā pratīyate
atha tad grāhakam; nāparaṃ grāhyaṃ grahaṇaṃ vā iti tadyuktaṃ svayam ityādi iti cet; tanna ahaṃ nīlādikaṃ vedmi iti pratīterapalāpe sarvāpalāpaprasaṅgāt
tulanā— tasmānna nīlādivyatirekeṇa bodho buddhiriti nirūpyate

etena etadapi nirastaṃ taduktaṃ pareṇa--yannimittamasti ayaṃ grāhyākāraḥ ayaṃ grāhakākāraḥ ayaṃ saṃvedanākāra iti vyavasthā, tasya ced bhedaḥ tarhi teṣāmapi bheda eva iti naikaṃ tadātmakaṃ yuktam, anyathā na tadvyavasthā
iti; katham ? evaṃ pratibhāgaṃ vicāraṇe sarvasya paramāṇugamane na santānāntarasiddhiḥ sakalaśūnyatāmātram atrāṇaṃ vā
ata eva ekānekarūpa- vikalpaśūnyapratibhāsamātramapi na yuktam
tataḥ pratibhāsamātramabhyupagacchatā nīlamahaṃ vedmi ityekaṃ jñānamabhyupagantavyamiti sūktam--svayam ityādi
idam advayaṃ dvayanirbhāsavat saṃvedanaṃ yadi punaḥ pratyakṣameva saṃvidapi nāpratyakṣam iti evakārārthaḥ
timirābhyupahatacakṣuṣāṃ kinna syāt ? syādeva saṃvedanaṃ pratyakṣameva candrādiviṣayam
ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ tatra kathañcid iti
tanna mādhyamikadarśane'pi kiṃ syāt pra॰ vā॰ 2
yadīdaṃ svayamarthebhyo rocate tatra ke vayam
antaḥ svalakṣaṇasya paramārthato dvayanirbhāsapratīteḥ bahirekasya sthavīyasaḥ pratibhāsanāt
tadekaṃ sthavīyāṃsaṃ pariṇāminamākāraṃ sakalalokasākṣikamabhrāntaṃ sandarśayantī buddhiḥ anekāntasiddhiḥ svayamekāntaṃ nirākarotīti kinnaścintayā ?
svasvalakṣaṇamarthasvalakṣaṇaṃ ca svaṃ svagrahaṇayogyaṃ vā arthasvalakṣaṇaṃ karmatāpannaṃ jñānaṃ kartṛ pariṇāmi ca uktanyāyena lakṣayet niścinuyāt parābhyupagatapariṇāmaṃ ca ityuktam
tataḥ kiṃ jātam ? ityatrāha--tat kvedam ityādi
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt kva kvacit bahirantarvā idaṃ saugatena ucyamānam kim ? pratyakṣam
4 iti kṛtaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ yasya tat tathoktam, kvacidapi iti
yadi vā, pratyakṣaṃ darśanagrāhyaṃ vastu kṛtalakṣaṇaṃ niścitasvarūpaṃ kva iti vyākhyeyam
kim ? paramārthato na viparyāsāt anyathābhūtasya anyathāgrahaṇāt
bahiḥ ekasya ityanena sañcitālambanāḥ pañca vijñānakāyāḥ iti parasya mataṃ na yuktamiti darśayati
sthavīyasaḥ ityanena niraṃśaparamāṇumātraṃ tattvam iti nirācaṣṭe pratibhāsanāt ityataḥ tasya vikalpaviṣayatvam

tasya antarbahiḥsvalakṣaṇasya ekam anekarūpasādhāraṇaṃ sthavīyāṃsam ata eva pariṇāminam vivakṣitetaraparyāyavantam ākāraṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sakalalokasākṣikam abhrāntaṃ sandarśayantī buddhiḥ anekāntasiddhiḥ anekāntā siddhiḥ nirṇītiḥ yasyā sā tathoktā svayaṃ vā tasya siddhiḥ
svayam ātmanaiva na pareṇa ekāntaṃ nirākaroti, anekāntasiddheḥ ekāntaniṣedhātmakatvāditi manyate
iti hetoḥ kiṃ naḥ asmākam cintayā ekāntaniṣedhārthaparīkṣayeti ?
nanu kathamekāntaṃ sā nirākaroti ekāntaviṣayānumānena bādhitatvāditi cet ? atrāha— jñānam ityādi
yathā antarbahirvā paraparikalpitalakṣaṇaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ pratyakṣalakṣaṇaṃ na puṣṇāti tathaiva sāmānyam
jñānaṃ svagrāhyasya arthasya na liṅgādeḥ balena udbhūtam utpannam adhyakṣam iti yāvat
yathā svalakṣaṇavilakṣaṇaṃ niraṃśakṣaṇikaparamāṇugrahaṇaparāṅmukhaṃ tathā sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyaṃ lakṣyate yasya yena vā tattathoktaṃ jñānam anumānam iti yāvat svalakṣaṇavilakṣaṇam iti sambandhaḥ
tathā ca kutaḥ tena tadbuddhervā iti bhāvaḥ
kutastarhi tattvasiddhiḥ ? ityatrāha--siddhiḥ tattvasya ātmalābhaḥ nirṇītirvā anekāntād anekāntamāśritya tena hetunā vā
yathā yena prakāreṇa antarbahirvā svalakṣaṇaṃ karmatāpannaṃ pratyakṣalakṣaṇam adhyakṣapramāṇaṃ kartṛ na puṣṇāti na gṛhṇāti
kathaṃbhūtaṃ tat ? ityāha--paraparikalpitaṃ saugatakalpitaṃ tathaiva sāmānyaṃ viṣayiṇi viṣayaśabdopacārāt anumānaṃ tat puṣṇāti iti
athavā, anyathā kārikeyamavatāryate--yadi saugatakalpitamavikalpakaṃ darśanaṃ na kvacidasti tarhi idamastu--
bālamūkādivijñānasadṛśaṃ śuddhavastujam || mī॰ ślo॰ pratyakṣa॰ ślo॰ 112

atrāpi prativastūpamālaṅkārāśrayaṇāt yathā jñānaṃ svārthasya niraṃśakṣaṇikaparamāṇurūpasya balena udbhūtam avikalpaṃ darśanam svalakṣaṇavilakṣaṇaṃ svagrāhyaparāṅmukhaṃ tathā sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyaviṣayaṃ svalakṣaṇavilakṣaṇaṃ svaviṣayagrahaṇaparāṅmukham
ubhayatra lakṣyata iti lakṣaṇam iti vyutpatterayamarthaḥ
kuta etat ? ityāha--siddhiḥ nirṇītiḥ svalakṣaṇasya sāmānyasya anekāntād anekāntamāśritya tathekṣaṇāt tathā vā darśanāt
yathā ityādinā kārikārthamāha--yathā antarbahirvā svalakṣaṇaṃ paraparikalpitaṃ saugatakalpitaṃ na pramāṇasiddhaṃ kartṛ pratyakṣalakṣaṇaṃ kalpanāpoḍhamabhrāntam nyāyabi॰ 1
4 ityadhyakṣasvarūpaṃ karmatāpannaṃ na puṣṇāti tatra svarūpāsamarpakatvāt, tathaiva paraparikalpitaṃ sāmānyaṃ tanna puṣṇāti iti
itaśca sāmānyalakṣaṇamanumānādi parasya svalakṣaṇavilakṣaṇamiti darśayannāha--aṅgīkṛtā ityādi

yathā jñānasattāmātreṇa arthānubhave na sarvasya sarvadarśitvaṃ saṃbhavati tathaiva aniścitasvānubhavasattāmātreṇāpi arthaniścaye tanniścaya iti sarvasya sarvaniścaya iti yaḥ svabhāvo niścayena na niścīyate sa kathaṃ tadviṣayaḥ syāt bahirarthavat yataḥ pratyakṣamavikalpakaṃ bhavet ? parataḥ saṃvedane vā anavasthādeḥ

aṅgīkṛtā naiyāyikādinirāsena abhyupagatā saugatena ātmasaṃvittiḥ sarvacittacaittānāṃ svarūpagṛhītiḥ tasyā avikalpopavarṇanaṃ nirvikalpatvādi, anumānādiḥ tasyātmā svarūpaṃ tasya avikalpo nirvikalpakatvaṃ tena arthasya kṣaṇakṣayādeḥ avikalpanād aniścayāt aviṣayīkaraṇāt
tatra yaḥ svabhāvo niścayairna niścīyate sa kathaṃ teṣāṃ viṣayaḥ syāt
ityabhidhānāt iti kathaṃ taiḥ anekāntasiddheḥ buddheḥ bādhanamiti bhāvaḥ

svānubhavaṃ svarūpagrahaṇamantareṇa buddhe dvanisyā rthasya ghaṭādeḥ anubhavo grahaṇaṃ yathā yena jñānasattāmātreṇa arthānubhave santānāntarajñānasattāmātrāpekṣayādi tadanubhave sarvasya sarvadarśitvam iti prakāreṇa na saṃbhavati tathaiva tenaiva aniścitasvānubhavasattāmātreṇa arthaniścaye santānāntarajñānatanmātreṇāpi tanniścaya iti sarvasya sarvaniścaya iti prakāreṇa svaniścayamantareṇa svārthaniścayo na tusaṃbhavati iti sambandhaḥ

tathā ca anumānam--yatra yasya yadaniścitasvarūpaṃ jñānaṃ tatra tasya tadapekṣayā na paramārthato niścitavyavahāraḥ yathā ghaṭādau devadattasya yajñadattajñānāpekṣayā na tathā tadvyavahāraḥ, aniścitasvarūpaṃ ca saugatasya sarvatra sarvavikalpajñānamiti
atha svavikalpasya viṣayīkaraṇam anyasya viparyayaḥ tato'yamadoṣa iti cet; atrāha--yaḥ svabhāvaḥ ityādi
yaḥ svabhāvo yatsvarūpaṃ niścayairna niścīyate sa svabhāvaḥ kathaṃ naiva teṣāṃ niścayānāṃ viṣayaḥ syād bhavet
atra dṛṣṭāntamāha— bahirartha iva tadvat iti
tathā ca prayogaḥ--na svarūpaṃ niścayānāṃ viṣayaḥ taiḥ tadaniścayāt bahirarthavat
syānmatam--svarūpasya darśanaṃ bahirarthasya tato viśeṣa iti; na; aniścitasya kṣaṇikatvavad darśanamiti kutaḥ ? siddhaṃ phalaṃ darśayannāha— yata ityādi
yataḥ tasya tadviṣayatvāt pratyakṣamavikalpaṃ sarvacittacaittānām ātmasaṃvedanaṃ bhavet
yata iti vā ākṣepe, naiva bhavet
atha niścayānāṃ svabhāvaḥ niścayāntarairniścīyata ityadoṣaḥ; tatrāpyāha--parataḥ ityādi
parataḥ anubhavāntarāt niścayāntarācca saṃvedane niścaye vā niścayānām anavasthādeḥ ādiśabdena aviśeṣyaviśeṣaṇasyāviśeṣaḥ saugatavaiśeṣikayoriti
tato yathā vaiśeṣikasya anubhavābhāvena pratyakṣāderabhāvāt pratyakṣānumānāgamabādhitakarmanirdeśānantaraprayukto hetuḥ kālātyayāpadiṣṭaḥ ityayuktam, tathā saugatasya anirākṛtaḥ nyāyabi॰ 3
nanu saugatasya anyasya vā ekāntavādino na kvacit pratyakṣaṃ kṛtalakṣaṇam, tadvā svalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ vā na puṣṇāti
kathambhūtaṃ tarhi tat kīdṛśaṃ vā svalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ vā puṣṇāti iti cet ? atrāha--pratyakṣam ityādi
pratyanīkadharmasādhāraṇasaṃvitsvapramiteḥ asākalyasaṃbhave viṣayasvalakṣaṇe'pi kinna bhavet iti kimāśritya tatrāpramāṇatvam ? prasannākṣabuddheḥ sarvathā saṃvādiniyamāyogāt kinna pramāṇamapi
upaplutākṣāṇāmapi vinaiva liṅgaliṅgisambandhapratipattyā arthaṃ paricchidya pravṛttāvavisaṃvādadarśanāt
atrāyamarthaḥ--yadā kenacit cakṣurādisāmagryanupacaritaṃ pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇamiṣyate tadā tatra prasaṅgasādhanasāmarthyāt jñānatvamāpādyate, tathāvidhapratyakṣapramāṇasya jñānatvena vyāpteḥ
kimarthamiti cet ? tadanabhyupagacchataḥ prasaṅgaviparyayāt, tajjñānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇaṃ yathā syāditi
yadā tu kenacid aviśadaṃ vyāptyādijñānaṃ pratyakṣamiṣyate tadā jñānaṃ viśadaṃ pratyakṣamiti sādhyate vakṣyamāṇapramāṇāntarasadbhāvā'nyathānupapatteḥ
jñānam iti ekavacanaṃ jātyapekṣayā sarvaviśada jñānaparigrahārtham

kuta etat ? ityatrāha--prasannākṣetarādiṣu prasannākṣāḥ puruṣā itare aprasannākṣāḥ, ādiśabdena āsanna-āsannatarādipuruṣaparigrahaḥ, tena yathā yena prakāreṇa yatra viṣaye viśadaṃ tathā tena prakāreṇa tatra viṣaye pratyakṣam iti sambandhaḥ, itaratra tadeva pamākṣamityabhiprāyaḥ
na kevalaṃ pratyakṣam api tu yathā yena prakāreṇa yatra prasannākṣetarādiṣu jñāneṣu madhye yasmin jñāne avisaṃvādo varṇanaṃ tathā tena prakāreṇa tatra jñāne pramāṇatā
anena etat kathayati--sarvaṃ saṃsārijñānaṃ svagocare viśadamaviśadaṃ pramāṇamanyathā ca ityanekāntaḥ, tathā tatsādhyamapi tadeva puṣṇāti iti
atha ko'yamavisaṃvādo nāma ? svārthavyavasāyaḥ nātaḥ paro'visaṃvādaḥ iti vacanāditi cet; svapnādau prasaṅgāt
tatrāpi hi svārthavyavasāyalakṣaṇasya avisaṃvādasya bhāvāt vijñānaṃ pramāṇamiti pramāṇetarapravibhāgavilopaḥ
syānmatam--na tatra svārthau; bādhyamānatvāt, ato na tadvyavasāyalakṣaṇo'visaṃvāda iti
nanu kimidaṃ bādhyamānatvam ? tad yadi pratibhāsakāle jñānāntareṇa bādhakena svarūpāpahāraḥ asattvajñāpanaṃ vā; tarhi aśraddheyam
nahi jñānasya itarasya vā svarūpamapahartuṃ śakyam, pratibhāsamānasya apratibhāsaprasaṅgāt
yadi punastatra mithyā vitarkitametat iti pratyayā'bhāvānnāyaṃ doṣa iti matiḥ, sāpi na yuktā asatye'pi kadācidbhāvāt satye'pyabhāvāt
pratyayasyāpi sadarthatve samāno doṣaḥ; anavasthā ca
atha kālāntare; tadā asataḥ sarvathā ko'pahāraḥ anyadvā
upalabdhasya punaḥpunarupalabdhiḥ phalena vā'bhisambandhaḥ sa iti cet; na; tasya kṣaṇikatvānnāśena tadasaṃbhavāt, svapne bhāvācca
tulanā— ko'yaṃ bādho nāma--pareṇa viṣayābhāvajñāpanaṃ sa yadīṣyate
na tāvajjñānāntareṇābhāvaḥ svapnajñānasyānyasya vā kenacit kriyate tatkāle tasya svayameva nāśāt
anyena na hi jñānena tasya viṣayāpahāro'sattājñāpanalakṣaṇo bādhaḥ...
ghaṭajñāne paṭajñānaṃ bādhakaṃ kinna yuktimat...tasmād yathā jāgratpratyayaḥ svapnapratyayasya bādhakaḥ tathā viparyayo'pi kevalagrahaṇāditi nyāya eṣaḥ
atra pratividhīyate--evaṃ hi sarvapratibhāsā'viśeṣe pramāṇetarapravibhāgā'bhāvād arthavat kutaḥ svasaṃvedanamātrasiddhiḥ, yataḥ pratibhāsādvaitamanyadvā syāt ? pratibhāsātsiddhau; bahirarthasiddhiḥ
ata eva atra svapne'pi tatsiddherhi vibhrametaraviyogaḥ, aparatra bahirarthasiddheḥ asaugataṃ jagat syāt

nanu buddheḥ svasaṃvedanamastu pratibhāsanāt nāntarbahirartho viparyayāt ghaṭādīnāmapi svasaṃvedanātmakatvāditi cet; tarhi yadgrāhyatayā jñānavapuṣi pratibhāti tadasat taimirikakeśādivat, tatra pratibhāti ca tathā jāgradghaṭādikam ityatra vādino'siddho hetuḥ
prativādinaḥ siddha iti cet; na; pramāṇataḥ tatsiddhau dvayorapi siddhaḥ, pramāṇasya kvacit pakṣapātetarayoḥ ayogāt
