abhyupagamāt tatsiddhau na tataḥ kasyacit sādhyasiddhiḥ atiprasaṅgāt, itarathā saugataprasiddhena utpādavināśātmatvena ghaṭavat sukhādau acetanatvaṃ sādhayan sāṃkhyaḥ dha rma kī rtti nā kimiti pratikṣiptaḥ ? prasaṅgasādhanatvādadoṣaḥ, tathāhi— jāgradghaṭādīnāṃ grāhyatvena avabhāsanaṃ cedaṅgīkriyate bahirarthavādinā, tarhi teṣāṃ taimirikopalabdhakeśādivadasattvamabhyupagantavyam, itarathā na kasyacidityekānta iti cet; na; asya prasaṅgasādhanalakṣaṇā'bhāvāt
yatra hi vyāpyābhyupagamo vyāpakābhyupagamanāntarīyakaḥ pradarśyate tat prasaṅgasādhanam

svasaṃvedanaikānte vādiprativādinoḥ svapnādāvapi stambhādīnāṃ grāhyatvena pratibhāsā'siddheḥ kasyā'sattvena vyāptiḥ yadabhyupagama itarābhyupagamanāntarīyakaḥ pradarśyeta ? parasya siddhaṃ sarvametaditi cet; uktamatra pramāṇatastatsiddhau ubhayoḥ siddham, itarathā parasyāpi na siddham iti

yadā ca kaścid guḍaṃ viṣaṃ māraṇātmakaṃ vā abhyupagamya punarmohāt śarkarādikamapi viṣam ityavagacchati, sa kiṃ viduṣaivaṃ vaktavyaḥ--yadi tat viṣam ityabhyupagacchati tarhi tanna khāda yena mriyase, ukto bhakṣayitvā kiṃ mriyate vā ? tataḥ siddhaṃ hetumabhyupagacchatā abhyupagantavya eva bahirarthapratibhāsaḥ ityayuktaṃ viparyayāditi
vyavahāramātramevedaṃ svapnāsvapnabhedo nāma tathā pramāṇāpramāṇabheda iti hi vakṣyate
tulanā--yadi pramāṇataḥ siddhaṃ nānātmasiddhaṃ nāma, parasyeva ātmano'pi vādinaḥ siddhatvāt, pramāṇasiddhasya sarvepāmavipratipattiviṣayatvāt...yat pramāṇamantareṇa siddhaṃ tat parasyāpi na siddham
acetanāḥ sukhādayaḥ iti sādhye utpattimattvamanityatvaṃ vā sāṃkhyasya svayaṃ vādino'siddham
antarā vinā bhavatīti antarīyakaḥ vinābhāvī, na antarīyakaḥ nāntarīyakaḥ avinābhāvītyarthaḥ

api ca, ghaṭādīnāṃ kutaḥ svasaṃvedanātmakatvam ? yadavabhāsate tajjñānaṃ yathā sukhādi, avabhāsante ca ghaṭādayaḥ, jaḍasya pratibhāsā'yogāt ityanumānāditi cet; ucyate--jaḍasya pratibhāsā'yogaḥ tatra pratibhāsābhāvaḥ

tatra yadyayaṃ jaḍaṃ kañcit vipakṣaṃ na pratipadyate; kathaṃ tatra sādhanābhāvamavaiti ? nahi apratipannabhūtalasya atra bhūtale ghaṭo nāsti iti niścayo bhavati, anyathā kvacid deśaviśeṣe pratipattṛpratyakṣe iti ca vāvā na jāghaṭīti

yathā ca jaḍe'pratipanne'pi tatra prakṛtasādhanābhāvaniścayaḥ tathā sarvajñe anupalabdhe'pi tatra vaktṛtvādisādhanābhāvaḥ kathanna niścīyate ? yata idamanumānam--sugataḥ sarvajñaḥ paramavītarāgo vā na bhavati vaktṛtvāt rathyāpuruṣavat' iti
athavā, yadyapi jaḍaṃ kiñcinnopalabhyate tatra tathāpi sādhanābhāvaniścayaḥ tadabhāvāditi

kuta etat ? anupalambhāditi cet; kiṃ punaḥ sarvajñopalambho'sti ? so'yam anupalambhamātrāt sarvajñābhāvamanicchan tata eva jaḍābhāvamicchati iti svecchāvṛttiḥ, sarvajñavat jaḍasyāpi kenacidupalambhā'virodhāt
tato dha rma kī rtti nā yaduktam tadayuktam
tathāhi pratibhāsāttadgatameva nīlamavabhāsate nāparaṃ tataḥ pratibhāsavyatirekeṇa na pramāṇam tato nābhyupagamaḥ
tatrānupalabdhiryathā na pradeśaviśeṣe kvacid ghaṭaḥ = kvaciditi pratipattṛpratyakṣe kvacideva pradeśe iti--nyāyabi॰, ṭī॰ 2
sarvajño vaktā nopalabhyate, ityebamprakārasyānupalambhasya adṛśyātmaviṣayatvena sandehahetutvāt
tasya saṃśayahetutvāt śeṣavattadudāhṛtam || pra॰ vā॰ 3 | 13 iti

pra jñā ka ra gu pta stu tatkārye kāraṇe vā'pratipanne na kāraṇakāryabhāvaniścayaḥ paracaitanye vā'viṣayīkṛte na tasya svadṛṣṭe vṛttiḥ niścīyate iti vadan jaḍe'dṛṣṭe'pi hetvabhāvaṃ pratyeti iti kathamanunmattaḥ ? nanu tasminnapratipanne'pi svato vā parato vā jaḍasya pratibhāsaḥ syāt ityādivicārāt sādhanā'bhāvaḥ pratīyate iti cet; ucyate--yadyayaṃ na pramāṇam, kathamataḥ kvacit kasyacit vidhipratiṣedhayoḥ siddhiḥ atiprasaṅgāt ? pramāṇa tve'pi na pratyakṣam; parāmarśātmakatvād vicārasya, tadviparītatvācca adhyakṣasya

bhavatu vā tathāpi na tat svayamaviṣayīkṛte vipakṣe sādhanābhāvamavaiti tathāvidhe anyathā paralokādau tatsantānābhāvamavaiti iti yaduktaṃ dha rma kī rtti nā vi ni śca ye tadeva tatra nāsti, tata eva tadabhāvasiddhiḥ ityayuktam iti plavate
api ca, yāvān kaścit pratiṣedhaḥ sa sarvo'nupalabdheḥ, apratiṣiddhopalambhasyābhāvāsiddheḥ iti vacanāt, tatra tadabhāvaḥ anupalambhāt pratyeyaḥ

evaṃ cettarhi yadyayaṃ vikāraḥ anumānātmakaḥ svabhāvānupalambhajanita iṣyate; yuktaṃ pratibhāsasya pakṣayorghaṭādisukhādyoḥ upalabdhasya tataḥ kvacijjaḍe vipakṣe abhāvasādhanam, kintu jaḍasya niṣedhyaviviktasya pratipattirabhyupagantavyā tasyā eva tadanupalambhātmakatvāt ghaṭaviviktabhūtalapratipatteḥ ghaṭānupalambhātmakatvavat

atha ca svabhāvaviruddhahetuḥ janitaḥ; tarhi kaḥ tadviruddho hetuḥ ? jaḍatvamiti cet; tadapratipattau kasya tena virodhaḥ pratīyatām ? anyathā adṛśyātmanāmeva teṣāṃ tadviruddhānāṃ ca siddhiḥ asiddhirvā veditavyā anyeṣāṃ virodhakāryakāraṇabhāvābhāvāsiddheḥ nyāyabi॰ 2
yāvān kaścit pratiṣedhaḥ sa sarvo'nupalabdheḥ--pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 520, 638

nanu ca sukhādau pratibhāso jñānatvena vyāptaḥ pratipannaḥ, jñānatvaviruddhaṃ ca jāḍyam, tato'smānnivarttamānaṃ jñānatvaṃ svavyāpyaṃ pratibhāsamādāya nivartata iti vyāpakānu palabdhijanito'yam ityapi vārttam; atiprasaṅgo hi evaṃ syāt

śakyaṃ hi vaktuṃ kvacid rathyāpuruṣe vaktṛtvādeḥ asarvajñatvaṃ vyāpakaṃ pratipannaṃ sarvajñatvena viruddham, ataḥ tannivartamānaṃ svavyāpyaṃ vaktṛtvādikamādāya nivartata iti vakturasarvajñatvasiddhiriti
tato yathā na vaktṛtvādeḥ asarvajñatvena vyāptiḥ tathā na jñānatvena pratibhāsasya
atha jaḍena virodhādasya tena vyāpti; tarhi anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ--siddhe hi jaḍena asya virodhe tena vyāptiḥ, asyāṃ ca siddhāyāṃ tena virodhaḥ sidhyati iti
atha pratipadyate kiñcit jaḍam; tenaiva pratibhāsāt ityasya hetorvyabhicāraḥ

mā vā bhūdayaṃ doṣaḥ, tathāpi ato hetorjāyamānamanumānaṃ svato'rthāntaraṃ sādhyaṃ na ced viṣayīkaroti; kathaṃ tatra pramāṇam atiprasaṅgāt ? bhrāntirapi sambandhataḥ pramā iti cet; nanvatra hetusādhyayoḥ tādātmyalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ hetvanumānayoḥ kāryakāraṇalakṣaṇaḥ, anyasyāsaṃbhavāt

tataḥ kim ? yathaiva yogyatayā hetuḥ anumānaṃ svasamānakālamanyathābhūtaṃ vā janayati tathaiva jñānam arthaṃ tathāvidhaṃ yadi gṛhṇāti ko virodhaḥ sarvasya samatvāt ? athātra kaścit kāryakāraṇabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ anyo vā sambandho neṣyate; tarhi--
atasmiṃstadgraho bhrāntirapi sandhānataḥ pramā--ṣaḍda॰ bṛha॰ pṛ॰ 41
pratibandhāt tadābhāsaśūnyayorapyavañcanam || pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 82 iti plavate

vyavahāreṇa tadabhidhānādadoṣa iti cet; ko'yaṃ vyavahāro nāma ? sambandhā- bhāve'pi tadvikalpa iti cet; kathaṃ taddarśitāt sambandhāt anumānaṃ prekṣakāriṇaḥ kurvantu ? kṛtādvā bhāvataḥ sādhyamanuminvantu ? sarvataḥ īśvarādyanumānāt sarvasya svārthasiddhiprasaṅgāt tatkalpanāyāḥ sarvatrā'viśeṣāt
yathaiva ca sogatena vyavahāranimittamagnyādyanumānaṃ svamatasiddhaye vanvikulamiva kakṣīkriyate tathaiva īśvarādivādināpi saugatānumānam
etena samāropavyavacchedakaraṇāt tattatra pramāṇam iti nirastam; svasamānāsamānakālasamāropavyavacchedakaraṇavad vijñānasya arthagrahaṇaṃ na virudhyeta
iṣṭaṃ tu laiṅgikaṃ jñānaṃ pramāṇam...--tattvasaṃ॰ ślo॰ 1302
yatpunaruktaṃ pareṇa--anumānaṃ sahakārikāraṇaṃ prāṇa pūrvaḥ samāropakṣaṇaḥ svakāryaṃ tatkṣaṇam uttaratatkṣaṇajanane akṣamaṃ janayati
saṃvṛtyā tatastattatheti cet; tata eva jaḍasyāpi pratibhāsābhāvāt pratyakṣataḥ pakṣabādhā kinna syāt ? paramārthataḥ tadvyavacchedakaraṇamapi durlabham

saṃvṛtisiddhena tatkaraṇena anumānaṃ pramāṇaṃ na tayā siddhena ghaṭādināḍya grāhipratyakṣeṇa pakṣabādhanamiti kiṃ kṛto vibhāgaḥ ? atha anumānena asya pratyakṣasya bādhanāt nānena pakṣabādhanam; anenāpyanumānasya bādhanāt na tena tadvyavacchedakaraṇamiti samānam
tatsvato bhinnaṃ bhāvato'nubhavati na jñānāntaraṃ jaḍamarthamiti svecchāviracitadarśanapradarśanamātram
tato nirākṛtametat--yadi bhinnakālo jñānena artho'vagamyate; aviśeṣād ekasya tathāvidhāśeṣārthāvagamaprasaṅgaḥ
atha samakālaḥ; sambandhābhāvāt kiṃ kenāvagamyate ? nīlādinā vā jñānamavagamyeta
gṛhītikaraṇād vijñānaṃ tasya grāhakamiti cet; na; asyāḥ tato'bhede jñānaṃ nīlādiḥ tajjanyatvād uttarajñānavat
bhede jñānaṃ nīlādiḥ gṛhīti ca parasparā'sambaddhaṃ tritayamiti kiṃ kena gṛhyate ? punastayāpi tadantarakaraṇe anavasthā
yadi punastadanumānaṃ pramāṇaṃ neṣyate; kutaḥ prakṛtatattvasiddhiḥ ? pratyakṣāt ityapi nottaram; tato vivādasyānivṛtteḥ

nanu yathā sukhādayo'vidyamānāvedakāḥ pratibhāsamānāḥ pratyakṣasiddhasvasaṃvedanā ucyante tathā ghaṭādaya iti cet; yadyevaṃ labhyeta, kṛtaṃ syāt, tattu na labhyam, ghaṭamahaṃ vedmi, paṭamahaṃ vedmi iti ahamahamikayā pratīyamānapratyayavedyatayā sarvadā teṣām akarāsavāt
tadevaṃ svasaṃvedanavat grāhyākārasyāpi pratibhāsabhāvāt svapnetaragrāhyākārayoriva tayoḥ samānaḥ sarvathā dharmabhāvo'stu
tathāpi svasaṃvedanasyaiva paramārthatve jāgradgrāhyākāra eva paramārthaḥ tathā syāditi svārthavyavasāyo'visaṃvādaḥ nātivyāpakaḥ
ityatra yaduktam--kṣaṇikatvena nāśāt na tasya tatprāptiḥ iti; tat pratibhāsaikyaniyame siddhivi॰ 1
na vidyate bhinno vedako yeṣāṃ te, svasaṃviditā iti yāvat
yaccāpyuktam--dṛṣṭasya prāptiḥ svapne'pyastīti tatrāpi darśanaṃ pramāṇaṃ syāditi; tat grāhyapratibhāse'pi samam
tataḥ sūktam--yathā yatrāvisaṃvādaḥ tathā tatra pramāṇatā iti
sāmānye'numānādi dūrapādapādau avayavijñānamapi viśadaṃ svaviṣayagrahaṇalakṣaṇatvāt, vaiśadyavyavahāraḥ punaḥ viśeṣāvayavāgrahaṇakṛtaḥ' ityeke
dhyāmalitākārasya nīlādyākāravat buddhyākāratvena vastutvāt na tadapekṣayā kiñcid vijñānamaviśadam, bāhyaṃ tu na tasya viṣayaḥ iti na tatra tadaviśadamanyathā vā
etena arthākāratvamasya cintitam; anarthākāratve na tatra jñānaṃ pramāṇaṃ visaṃvādakatvāt ataḥ avisaṃvādaḥ ityevāstu ityapare
atrocyate--viśeṣāvayavāgrahaṇād gṛhīte'pyaspaṣṭatāvyavahāraḥ ityayuktam; na khalu anya syāgrahaṇe anyatra tadvyavahāraḥ, itarathā ghaṭāgrahaṇe gṛhīte paṭe tadvyavahāraḥ syāt
yatpunaretat--dhyāmalitākārasya ityādi; tatra na sāram; sārūpyā'bhāvāt
ahamahamikayā arthagrāhiṇo jñānasya nirākārasya svasaṃvedanādhyakṣasiddhatvāt, na cāsau ākāraḥ tatra pratibhāsād bahiryuktaḥ, tata eva anugatākāro'pi syādityasaugatamaśeṣam
evamapi yathā candrādidvitvādāvasati viśadaṃ jñānaṃ tathā tadākāre'pi iti na kiñcidaviśadaṃ nāmeti cet; tat na candrādau dvitvādivad dharmiṇāpi visadagatra nu dharniṇyaṣya viśadam

na caitāvatā na kasyacid grahaṇam; anumānāt tattvasiddhiprasaṅgāt, tathā ca kuto hetuphalabhāvādyabhāvasiddhiryataḥ pratibhāsādvaitam ? anupalambhāditi cet; kimayaṃ tatpratibaddhaḥ kvacit pratipanno yenaivaṃ syāt ? tathā cet; kathamanumānaṃ pramāṇaṃ neṣṭaṃ syāt ? tadicchati, tattvaviṣayaṃ na iti viruddham
tathā yāvān kaścid dhūmavān pradeśaḥ sa sarvo'pyagnivān ityādi vyāptijñānanivṛttyarthaṃ ca
tathāpi tathā tadabhyupagame na kiñcidaviśadaṃ bhavet
etena akasmād dhūmadarśanād agniratre vi jñānaṃ cintitam
aviśadamapi pratyakṣamiti prajñākaramatam--etaccānumānajñānaṃ kvacidpratyakṣaṃ kvacittu pratyakṣameva akasmād dhūmādagnipratipattau
kutaḥ punaḥ tattajñānaṃ jñānam indriyārthasannikarṣajaṃ jñānatvāt cakṣurādijanitarūpādijñānavaditi cet; na; anumānādijñānena vyabhicārāt
asyāpi pakṣīkaraṇe kutaḥ adhyakṣād bhedaḥ ? pratyakṣā'numānopamānaśabdāḥ pramāṇam nyāyasū॰ 1
atha indriyasya arthena sākṣātsambandhamantareṇa bhāvāt tato'sya bhedaḥ; tathā vyāptijñānasyāpi syāt
nahi tadapi tasya atītānāgatavarttamānārthena tathā sambandhāt jāyate, virodhāt
liṅgādihetutvād bhede dṛṣṭasādharmyāt sādhyasādhanamupamānaṃ pramāṇāntaraṃ syāt, dūrādijñānaṃ ca sarvasmādadhyakṣata iti nirūpayiṣyate
tato vaiśadyādeva tato'sya bheda iti sūktam--viśadameva jñānaṃ pratyakṣam iti
sāmānyalakṣaṇāpratyāsattyā dhūmatvena akhiladhūmānām agnitvena ca nikhilāgnīnāmalaukikārthasannikarṣeṇa jñānasambhavāt
mā vā bhūdasya tannivarttyam, tathāpi indriyārthasannikarṣotpannam nyāyasū॰ 1
4 ityādeḥ parakīyasya pratiṣedhārtham adhyakṣasya viśadam iti viśeṣaṇam
tallakṣaṇe hi sukhādisaṃvedanamadhyakṣaṃ na bhavet tallakṣaṇavirahāt
apa tadapi indriyārthasannikarṣajaṃ tattvāt cakṣurādijanitarūpādijñānavat ityucyate; tanna; tathāpratītivirodhāt

na khalu pūrvamutpannaiḥ sukhādibhiḥ indriyasya sannikarṣe tatsaṃvedanamupajāyate iti pratītirasti, yūnaḥ kāntāsamāgame saṃvedanasya āhlādanākārātmanaḥ tathānubhavāt, svasaṃvedanādhyakṣabādhitaḥ parapakṣaḥ

sadasadvargaḥ kasyacidekajñānālambanam anekatvāt pañcāṅgulavat ityādinā anumitamadhyakṣaṃ paralakṣaṇena kathamanugṛhītam ? indriyārtha sannikarṣajatvāditi cet; kathamaśeṣaṃ sadasadvargaṃ yugapad viṣayīkaroti ? na khalu manasaḥ anyasya cendriyasya yugapat sarvārthasannikarṣo'sti vipratiṣedhāt
sambandhaḥ prāṇabhṛnmātrasya, tataḥ tasyāpi tajjñānaṃ bhavet
viśiṣṭādiṣṭasahakāriniyamakalpanāvi pāpīyasī; bhedaikānte samavāyā'viśeṣataḥ adṛṣṭasyāpi niyamā'siddheḥ
tanna indriyārthasannikarṣajaṃ tajjñānamiti kathanna prakṛto doṣaḥ ? cakṣurjanitaṃ rūpajñānaṃ ca indriyārthasannikarṣamantareṇa bhāvāt iti pratipādayiṣyate paśyatyeva hi sāntaram siddhivi॰ 4
ātmā sarvārthaiḥ saṃyuktaḥ, ātmasaṃyuktaṃ manaḥ indriyāṇi ca ataḥ paramparāsambandhaḥ sarvārthaiḥ syāt
samavāyasya ca vyāpakatvāt sarvātmabhiḥ tatsambandhahetuḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ
indriyavṛttiḥ pratyakṣam iti sāṃkhyaḥ; so'pyanena kṛtottaro draṣṭavyaḥ; svasaṃvedanādau tadasaṃbhavāt
acetanaṃ pratyakṣamanyadvā pramāṇaṃ na iti carcitam
tataḥ sādhūktam— pratyakṣaṃ viśadaṃ jñānam iti
indriyapraṇālikayā bāhyavastūparāgāt sāmānyaviśeṣātmano'rthasya viśeṣāvadhāraṇapradhānā vṛttiḥ pratyakṣam--yogada॰ vyāsabhā॰ pṛ॰ 27
tulanā--śrotrādivṛttiḥ bhrānte'pi na hi nāma na vidyate
na ca jñānaṃ vinā vṛttiḥ śrotrāderupapadyate
ko'nyo na dṛṣṭo bhāgaḥ syād yaḥ pramāṇaiḥ parīkṣyate || pra॰ vā॰ 3 | 42
iti nyāyāt pramitasyā'pramitāma syābhāvāt kathamucyate--yathā yatrā'visaṃvādaḥ tathā tatra pramāṇatā iti cet; atrāha--pratyanīka ityādi

pratyanīkā anyonyaṃ viruddhā ye dharmā vibhrametara-vikalpetara-saṃśayetara-grāhyagrāhakasaṃvittyādayaḥ te kā sādhāraṇī yā saṃvit tasyāḥ svapramiteḥ svaparicchitteḥ asākalyasaṃbhave khaṇḍaśaḥ saṃbhave aṅgīkriyamāṇe
etaduktaṃ bhavati--viruddhadharmādhyāsabhayād ekasya pramitetararūpadvayaṃ neṣyate, sa ca tadadhyāsaḥ anyathāpi jāta iti paraṃ tasyāḥ svapramiteḥ asākalyasaṃbhavo'bhyupeyaḥ tasmin vā iti

tasmāt sāmānye kalpite tadabhāve'pi na saugatasya doṣa iti svalakṣaṇagrahaṇaṃ tatrāpi, na kevalam uktasaṃvidaḥ kinna bhavet iti kim nimittamāśritya nānā visaṃvāda pramāṇatvam timirādijñānasya kathañcit candratvādinā saṃvādāt kinna pramāṇamiti, na kevalamapramāṇameva
yadi ca kathañcid visaṃvādāt tadapramāṇameva; tarhi parasya na kiñcit pramāṇaṃ syāditi darśayannāha--prasanna ityādi

prasannāni nirdoṣāṇi karaṇabhūtāni akṣāṇi yasyāḥ buddheḥ tasyā api na kevalaṃ timirabuddheḥ sarvathā sarveṇa nīlādinā iva kṣaṇakṣayādiprakāreṇa saṃvādiniyamā'yogāt kāraṇāt kinna kathañcit saṃvādāt pramāṇamapi bhavediti
dṛṣṭe darśanena viṣayīkṛte śabdādau dharmiṇi pramāṇāntarasya kṣaṇakṣayādyanumānasya ā samantāt vṛtteḥ tanniyamā'yogaḥ tataḥ tad iti padaghaṭanāt
idamatra tātparyam--yadi darśanaṃ śabdatvādivat nāśādāvapi saṃvādakam, tarhi tadanumānaṃ saṃvṛtivadapramāṇam
atha visaṃvādakam; tatrāstu prakṛtavad apramāṇameveti dharmādyasiddheḥ kutaḥ pramāṇāntaravṛttiḥ ? asti ca, tataḥ prakṛtamiti
atrāha--pra jñā ka ra gu ptaḥ--yata eva dṛṣṭe pramāṇāntaravṛttiḥ ata eva śabdādivat kṣaṇakṣayāderapi darśanam, anyathā darśanasya kṣaṇikatvānumānena tasya vā darśanena bādhanaṃ syāt
iti; tasya viplutākṣaḥ śuklaṃ śaṅkhaṃ pītaṃ paśyan pratipannavyabhicāro yadaivaṃ karoti śuklo'yaṃ śaṅkhatvāt pūrvadṛṣṭaśaṅkhavat iti, tadā taddarśanaṃ śaṅkhatvavat śuklatāmapi paśyet
śakyaṃ hi vaktuṃ yata eva viplutākṣadarśane dṛṣṭe pramāṇāntaraṃ śuklatāviṣayaṃ pravartate tata eva tat śuklatāmavaiti, anyathā taddarśanena pramāṇāntarasya anena vā tasya bādhanaṃ bhavet
atha pītatāmātre tasyānena bādhanamiṣyate; na; sarvātmanā dharmādyasiddhiprasaṅgāt, tathā prakṛte'pi iṣyatāmiti sādhūktam--prasannetyādi

yatpunarāha sa eva--apratipannavyabhicāraḥ taimirikaḥ tajjñānāt pravartamāno visaṃvādyate iti na kathañcidapi tatpratyakṣam, pratipannavyabhicārastu pratibhāso'yam abhimatasaṃsthānavān pūrvadṛṣṭaivaṃpratibhāsavat iti paryālocya pravarttate ityanumānameva tatrāvisaṃvādakam
yena na kadācid vyabhicāra upalabdhaḥ sa yathābhiprete visaṃvādāt visaṃvādyata eva
saṃsthānamātraṃ tāvat prāpyate, paratra saṃdeho viparyayo vā tato'numānaṃ saṃsthāne...--pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 2
mamaivaṃ pratibhāso yaḥ na sa saṃsthānavarjitaḥ
evamanyatra dṛṣṭatvāt anumānaṃ tathā sati || pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 5 iti

upaplutākṣāṇāṃ na kevalaṃ viparītānāṃ vinaiva liṅgaliṅgisambandhapratipattyā liṅgaṃ pratibhāsaviśeṣaḥ liṅgi saṃsthānavattvam tayoḥ sambandhaḥ tādātmyaṃ teṣāṃ pratipattiḥ tāmantareṇa arthaṃ paricchidya pravṛttau satyām avisaṃvādadarśanāt
na khalu viplutākṣaḥ sarve sarvadā mamaivam ityādyanutiṣṭhantaḥ samupalabhyante

tathāpi tadabhyupagame timirajñānā'numānayoḥ vibhramaṃ prati aviśeṣād anumānapratibhāse'pi mamaivaṃ pratibhāsaḥ ityādi kalpanāyām anavasthāprasaṅge nānumāna vyavahārijanānurodhādanumānamavisaṃvādakamicchan tata eva timirajñānaṃ kathañcittathā necchatīti svecchāvṛttiḥ
bhavatu tadapyavisaṃvādakaṃ pramāṇaṃ tu na iti cet; atrāha--tāvatā ca avisaṃvādadarśanādeva prāmāṇyasiddheḥ kāraṇāt kathañcit pramāṇamapi bhavet iti sthitam--yathā yatra ityādi
evaṃ tāvat citrapratibhāsāpyekaiva buddhiḥ bāhyacitravilakṣaṇatvāt pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
220 iti vacanāt citramekaṃ jñānamabhyupagacchataḥ saṃvidaḥ svapramiterasākalyasaṃbhava uktaḥ
dūradūratarādivyāpṛtacakṣuṣāṃ ca vastusattāmātrāvisaṃvādāt tadbhedāpratittau ca tatpramitisādhanaṃ samañjasam
yatpunaranyat-- ārāmaṃ tasya paśyanti na taṃ paśyati kaścana bṛhadā॰ 4

kathaṃbhūtāyāḥ ? vijñātāyāḥ svasaṃvedanādhyakṣagṛhītāyā anyathā tadbhāvāsiddheḥ sambandhī viṣayo grāhyo ghaṭādiḥ tasya sa eva vā nirbhāsa ākāraḥ tasya viveko buddheḥ sakāśād anyatvaṃ tasyā'nupalambho yaḥ tasmāt tataḥ kvacit taimirikopalabdhe candrādau siddho niścito viruddhasya dṛśyacandratvādyākārāpekṣayā pratyanīkasya adṛśyaikatvādeḥ ākārasya saṃbhavaḥ
atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--yadyayaṃ sthavīyān ghaṭādyākārasya nnitaro vā vitteḥ ātmabhūtaḥ; tarhi citraikā sā bhavet, tatra cokto doṣaḥ
athāsannamā tmabhūtaḥ tataḥ sīdyadyā tmano bhedamavaiti kutastadākārā bhrāntiḥ yataḥ yadavabhāsate tat jñānam yathā sukhādi, avabhāsate ca stambhādinīlādikam ityatra āśrayāsiddhirna syāt
nahi pītatārahite śukle śaṅkhe pratibhāsamāne pītatāvibhramo yuktaḥ
atha taṃ nāvaiti; siddhaḥ svapramiterasākalyasaṃbhavaḥ iti

atra ādiśabdena saṃvedanavikalpetarādiparigrahaḥ, sa eva nirbhāsa ākāraḥ sa eva ca viruddho dharmaḥ tasya anabhyupagame'pi na kevalamabhyupagame tasyāḥ vitteḥ viṣayanirbhāsasya ghaṭādyākārasya saṃbandhī yaḥ vivekaḥ sa eva paramārthaḥ tasyāḥ pratītāvapi kathañcit saccetanādirūpeṇa saṃvedanāt anekāntasiddhiḥ
evaṃtāvad dṛśyetaravittinidarśanena saugataprasiddhena viṣayasvalakṣaṇe pramiterasākalyasaṃbhava uktaḥ
idānīṃ taṃ prati lokaprasiddhena dṛśyetarabāhyanidarśanena sa ucyate dūretyādinā
atra ādiśabdena dūrataradūratamaparigrahaḥ, tatra vyāpṛtacakṣuṣāṃ pusāṃ vastuno vṛkṣādeḥ sattaiva tanmātraṃ tasya avisaṃvādāt kāraṇāt tasyā asākalyapramiteḥ sādhanaṃ samañjasaṃ yuktam
kasmin satyapi ? ityatrāha--tasya vastusattāmātrasya ye bhedā viśeṣā vṛkṣādayaḥ teṣāmapratipattāvapi na kevalaṃ pratipattau
edaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā dūradūratarādau pratyakṣeṇa viśeṣāgrahaṇe'pi tatsattāmātragrahaṇaṃ tathā prakṛte'pi dṛśyetaratvaṃ syāditi

yataḥ ityādinā etadeva bhāvayati--yataḥ yasmād yāvadapi yatparimāṇasya pūrvamupalambho mayoktaḥ tatparimāṇasya yathā bhavati nādhikasya, tathā pareṇāpi ucyate yadā tadā yāvat tāvadapi yathā bhavati tathā upalambhaḥ tamantareṇa pramāṇāntarasya anumānasya avṛtteḥ apravṛtteḥ hetoḥ asaṃvyavahāraprasaṅgāt kāraṇāt tatpramitisādhanaṃ samañjasam iti sambandhaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--dūradūratarādau yathā tadbhedā'pratītiḥ tathā ced vastusattāmātrasyāpyapratītiḥ tarhi tatra vyāpṛtacakṣuṣāmandhataiva syāt
na khalu sāmānyaviśeṣāvantareṇa tattvamasti yat tatrāvabhāseta
tathā ca viśeṣamātramidaṃ sattāmātraṃ kenacid viśeṣeṇa tadvattvāt pūrvadṛṣṭatanmātravad iti tadavṛttiḥ, tasyā ca tatra tadapravṛttiḥ, na caivam, pravṛttidarśanāt
nanu bhedavat tanmātrasyāpi na tatra pratītiḥ, abhedādyāt pratītiḥ sā bhrāntā, tata eva pramāṇāntaravṛttiḥ mamaivaṃ pratibhāso yaḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 2
1 ityādi iti cet; uktamatra--tatra vyāpṛtacakṣuṣāṃ vastusattāmātrāvisaṃvādadarśanāt
athavā, saugataṃ prati dṛśyetarabuddhidṛṣṭāntasadbhāvādastu svapramiterviṣayasvalakṣaṇe asākalyasaṃbhavo naiyāyikaṃ prati viparyayāditi cet; atrāha--dūretyādi
tatra vyāpṛtacakṣupām ityanena vastusattāmātraviṣayaṃ pratyakṣaṃ darśayati, vastu dravyādi tasya sattāmātrāvisaṃvādāt tatpramitisādhanam asākalyapramitisādhanaṃ samañjasaṃ yuktam
kasmin satyapi ? ityatrāha--tadbhedāpratipattau ca tasya tanmātrasya bhedo dravyādyādhārapekṣyādhe yatvaviśeṣaḥ tasyāprati pattāvapi
nahi ādhārā'grahaṇe tadapekṣamādheyatvam ātmabhūtamapi pratyetuṃ śakyam
nanu tadbhedavat tanmātrasyāpyapratītiriti cet; atrāha--yata ityādi
sāmānyapratyakṣatve ubhayaviśeṣāṇāṃ tadviparītaviśeṣāṇāṃ vā smṛtau saṃśayādiḥ, tadvyavacchedārthaṃ ca pramāṇāntaraṃ pravarttate
tanmātrā'pratyakṣe tu durlabhametat tato'saṃvyavahāraprasaṅgāt tatpramitisādhanaṃ samañjasam iti
kiñca, ayaṃ sthāṇuḥ puruṣo vā ? puruṣa eva iti vā saṃśayādijñānam ekadharmiṇi arthaviṣayam anyatra viparītamabhyupagacchan dṛśyetararūpamekabhiyauga kathaṃ na svara ceṣṭitaḥ ?
sāmprataṃ saugatādidoṣaṃ puruṣādyadvaitamate'pi samānamityasya pradarśanārthaṃ tadeva darśayati yatpunaḥ ityādinā
kim tadāgamaṃ cetanādibhedādoyaṃ tasya puruṣādeḥ paśyanti draṣṭāraḥ na taṃ puruṣādimadvaitarūpaṃ kaścana teṣāṃ taddṛṣṭṝṇāṃ kaścit paśyati
tatrāpi yat tanmataṃ yat ityanena nirdiṣṭaṃ tatra ityanena parāmṛśyate
na kevalaṃ saugatādimate api tu tatrāpi sarvo'pyuktadoṣaḥ a ka la ṅka de va sya pratyakṣatayā manasi pratibhātīti tam ayam ityanena nirdiśati
tathāhi— yaduktaṃ saugataṃ prati nahi bahirantarvā jātucidasāhāyamākāraṃ paśyāmaḥ yathā vyāvarṇyate tathaivā'nirṇayāt
yatpunaretat ekāntasya upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptau asattvam anyathā syādaprameyatvam siddhivi॰ 1
14 iti vacanāt tadārāmayoḥ kathañcidekatve vibhrametaravikalpetarādīnām ākārāṇāṃ tena ekatvābhyupagamasya avaśyambhāvāt
atha eka eva hi bhūtātmā bra॰ bi॰ 11 ityādeḥ yathā viśuddhamākāśam bṛhadā॰ bhā॰ vā॰ 3
43 ityādeśca śruteḥ avibhāgo'pi brahmā bhāgīva lakṣyata ityucyate; tarhi sadbhirasadbhirvā siddhivi॰ 1
śakyaṃ hi vaktum--yadi sadbhiḥ asadbhirvā cetanetarādyākāraiḥ kasyacid brahmaṇaḥ ekatvaṃ tathaiva bahirantarmukhādibhiḥ tat kinna kasyacid buddhyātmanaḥ sidhyet
yadi punaḥ vidyetarayoḥ ekatvavirodhāt tasmād āgamo bhinna iṣyate; tarhi tadapratyakṣatve idaṃ samānam--tadapratyakṣatve viṣayavat svabhāvāsiddhiprasaṅgāt siddhivi॰ 1
eka eva hi bhūtātmā bhūte bhūte vyavasthitaḥ
tathedamamalaṃ brahma nirvikāramavidyayā kaluṣatvamivāpannaṃ bhedarūpaṃ prapaśyati
yadā tu ārāmaviviktamātmānamasau paśyati; tadā vibhramābhāvaḥ
tadevaṃ samāne prasaṅge buddhibrahmātmanoḥ tyāgābhyupagamāviśeṣeṇa iti manyate
nanu kimu te samānaḥ, yāvatā buddhyabhyupagame kṣaṇayastattanāntara sādhane mahān prayāsaḥ na punaḥ brahmopagame tatra tadabhāvā'bhyupagamāditi cet; atrāha--kevalam ityādi
ayamatrābhiprāyaḥ--tatpratibhāsatayā buddhimekām anabhyupagacchato'pi samayāntarapraveśaḥ parasya iti
kṣaṇakṣayaśca santānāntaraṃ ca, tayoḥ sādhane kriyamāṇe

evaṃ tataḥ kim ityādinā granthena jātiguṇakriyātmikām adhyakṣe kalpanāṃ prasādhya, sāmprataṃ yaduktaṃ pareṇa--na hyarthe śabdāḥ santi tadātmāno vā yena tasmin pratibhāsamāne te'pi pratibhāseran ityatra yad yatra nāsti tasmin avabhāsamāne tannā'vabhāsate yathā rūpe rasaḥ, nāsti ca arthe śabdaḥ iti; tatra parābhyupagamena hetoḥ vyabhicāraṃ darśayannāha--sthūlam ityādi
śabdavat dṛśyamānasvalakṣaṇānāṃ tadanātmatāyāṃ kathaṃ tatra sthavīyānākāro'nvayī avabhāsate rasādivat ? yato'yaṃ śabdayojanārahitamarthaṃ paśyet
sthūlaṃ mahattvopetaṃ ekam anekāvayavaguṇasādhāraṇam ākāram parābhyupagagena asantam avidyamānaṃ svalakṣaṇeṣu
punaḥ iti pakṣāntarasūcakaḥ, teṣāṃ teṣu śabdaḥ kinnāvabhāsate avabhāsata eva asattvā'viśeṣāt
tathā ca paśyannayam aśabdamarthasya paśyati iti durlabham
nanu ca marīcikādau yathā jalādyākāra eva asaṃpratibhāti nanurāgā kāraḥ tathā teṣu sthūlākāra eva pratibhāti na śabdākāraḥ, pratiniyatatvād bhrāntīnām

tathā darśanāditi cet; naitadasti; yataḥ na khalu teṣu kadācit kvacidasataḥ sthūlākārasya pratibhāsadarśanāt sarvatra sarvadā tenaiva pratibhāsitavyam, tathā śabdākārasya tathā prati bhāsadarśanāt tena na pratibhāsitavyam iti niścayo'sti, kasyacid upalaśakalaviśeṣe kadācidasato rajatākārasya pratibhāsadarśane'pi tatraiva paryāyeṇa kanakopayogino'sataḥ kanakākārasya pratibhāsadarśanāt, teṣu śabdākāro'pi pratyabhāt pratibhātyatra pratibhāsyati iti śaṅkā na nivartata iti taddhi arthasāmarthyādupajāyamānam arthasyaiva ākāram anukaroti na śabdādeḥ iti prākṛtametat
anye tu manyante--cakṣurādinā rūpādiparamāṇuṣu nendriyāntaraviṣayasyā sato'pi grahaṇam, adarśanāt

na vai vibhramadaśāyāmapi cakṣuṣi gandhaḥ pratibhāti indriyāntaravaiphalyaṃ vadhirābhāvaśca syāt iti; tanna yuktam; asarvadarśino'darśanamātreṇa tathāniścayā'yogāt, anyathā tata eva sarvarasādīnām ekādhyakṣeṇa grahaṇāsiddherasarvajñaṃ jagat syāt

manokvaviṣayasya sthūlasya anekāvayavaguṇasādhāraṇatvena sāmānyasya ekasyākārasya akṣāntare cakṣurādike'pi pratibhāsābhyupagamāt pareṇa anekāntaḥ ceta nendriyāntaravaiphalyaṃ nirastam; anyathā samānyasya cakṣurādinā grahaṇe anumānavaiyarthyamāpadyeta tasya sāmānyaviṣayatvāt anyat sāmānyaṃ so'numānaviṣayaḥ nyāyabi॰ 1
yatpunaruktam--vadhirā'bhāvaḥ syāt iti; tadapi na doṣāya; kasyacit tatpratibhāsopagamāt, tasyāvādhirye'pi na sarvasya tat so'pi vā vadhiro'stu śravaṇena śabdā'grahaṇāt

nanu pratibhātu śabdo'pi teṣu, naitāvatā śabdakalpanā adhyakṣe, asatā tena tadayogāditi cet; tarhi abhilāpasaṃsargayogyapratibhāsāt kalpanā kvacij jñāne na syāt, so'pi tatra anyatra vā na paramārthasan
athavā, yathā paramāṇurūpatāyāṃ sthūlākāro'san na svarūpeṇa bādhakābhāvāt tathā śabdo'pi ityadoṣaḥ
smārtena śabdānuyojanena, tathā ca sākṣāt svalakṣaṇarūpādarthāt indriyajñānaṃ na syāt
tadapyanena dūṣitam; sthūlākāravat teṣu śabdākārasyāpi asmṛtasya avabhāsāvirodhāt

śabdavat ityādinā kārikāṃ vivṛṇoti--śabdasya iva dṛśyamānāni pratyakṣīkriyamāṇāni yāni svalakṣaṇāni paramāṇulakṣaṇāni teṣāmtadanālatāyām atatsvabhāvatāyām aṅgīkriyamāṇāyām ākārasya sthavīyasaḥ sa kathaṃ tatra ākāraḥ sthavīyān anvayī avabhāsate, naiva

yathā rasādikaṃ parasparamanātmatāyāṃ tatra parasparātmani nāvabhāsate tathā prakṛtamapi iti, tasya ākārasya pratibhāsasaṃbhave svalakṣaṇeṣu śabdaḥ kinnāvabhāsate ? yataḥ yasmād anavabhāsād ayaṃ saugato loko vā śabdayojanārahitamarthaṃ paśyet
yataḥ iti vā ākṣepe, naiva paśyet
tadevaṃ vyavasāyātmake jñāne pramāṇe sati susthitametat--pramāṇasya phalaṃ sākṣāt ityādi
atrāparaḥ prāha--svārthayorabhāvād bhrāntatvādvā kasya kā siddhiḥ yataḥ tasyāḥ kasyacit pramāṇasya bhāvāt tatsūktaṃ syāt iti; taṃ pratyāha--bruvan ityādi

svabhāvanairātmyaṃ sarvathā sarvabhāvānāṃ bruvan pratyakṣamabhrāntaṃ lakṣayan kathamanunmattaḥ ? kutaśca yathādarśanameva mānameyaphalasthitiḥ na punaḥ yathātattvamiti svayamabuddhyeta bodhayati vā pramāṇāderabhāvāt
yathā yathārthāḥ cintyante viśīryante tathā tathā iti mithyājñānānna pratipattumarhati samayāntaravat

kathañcidyāthātmyapratipattimantareṇa yathādarśanameva kṣaṇikabhrāntaikāntacittasantānāntarāṇi svabhāvanairātmyaṃ vetyādi bruvataḥ śauddhodanestāvadayaṃ prajñāparādhaḥ kathamiti savismayaṃ sakaruṇaṃ naścetaḥ

yathādarśanaṃ cittaṃ bahirmukhākāraṃ paramārthaikasaṃvedanaṃ svayamabhyupayataḥ paramātmasiddhireva kinna bhavet ? tattvamakramaṃ sakalavikalpātītaṃ yathādarśanaṃ mithyāvyavasthāmavatarati, tattvamithyāsvabhāvayorekatvamabhyupagantavyam
tasmiṃśca sāmānyaviśeṣātmakatvaṃ bahirantaśca pariṇāmi kinna lakṣyate ? sarvathā anekāntasiddheranivāraṇāt
tulanā--tatra śauddhodanereva kathaṃ prajñāparādhinī babhūveti vathaṃ tāvad bahuvismayamāsmahe
ācāryastasyaiva tāvadidamīdṛśaṃ prajñāskhalitaṃ kathaṃ vṛttamiti savismayānukampaṃ naścetaḥ
kathambhūtam ? pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇapramitaṃ svayaṃ tatpratītau tathāgatasya pratyakṣaikapramāṇātmakatvena pramāṇāntarābhāvāt iti manyate
kuta etaditi cet ? atrāha— abhrāntaṃ vibhramarahitaṃ yataḥ, tathāvidhasyaiva pratyakṣatvāt, itarathā marīcikājalavat kathaṃ pratyakṣaṃ tat ? kiṃ kurvan ? ityāha--bruvan vineyasattvān prati kathayan
vacanamātrāt teṣāṃ tatpratipattyayogāt, pramāṇāntaraṃ vā syāditi bhāvaḥ
atrāpi abhrāntam iti kriyāviśeṣaṇatvena sambandhanīyam, abhrāntaṃ yathā kurvan iti
kathambhūtaḥ ? ityāha--anātmajñaḥ ātmānaṃ svasvarūpam unmattavat na jānāti ityanātmajñaḥ
tathāhi--yadi sarvābhāvaḥ; na tarhi pratyakṣamapi, iti kutastasya tatpratipattiḥ yataḥ taṃ paraṃ prati brūyāt
asyāpi tato vyatireke tadrūpatāvyatireke sambandhā'siddheḥ, na tasya grahaṇam
yadi ca jñānaṃ bhrāntam; kathaṃ pratyakṣam ? tataḥ tasya siddhirvā viṣayavat
abhāvaścet; kathaṃ tābhyām parasya pratipattiriti bhāvaḥ

svabhāva ityādinā kārikārthamāha--svabhāvanairātmyaṃ rūparahitatvam sarvathā pararūpādinā iva svarūpādināpi sarvabhāvānāṃ cetanetaravastūnāṃ bruvan vineyasattvān prati kathayan pratyakṣaṃ tadviṣayam ātmani viśadaṃ jñānam abhrāntaṃ vibhramarahitam lakṣayan kathamanunmattaḥ ? sugataḥ anyo vā unmatta eva
yathādarśanameva--yathāpratibhāsameva mānameyaphalavyavasthitiḥ na punaḥ yathātattvam na tu paramārthā'natikrameṇa ityevam svayam ātmanā avabuddhyeta pāyaṃ bodhayati vā
kuta etat ? ityātrāha--pramāṇāderabhāvāt svāvabodhe adhyakṣasya parāvabodhe anumānasya pramāṇasya ādiśabdena vacanasya abhāvāt
nanu ca na pramāṇabalāt svabhāvanairātmyaṃ yathādarśanameva ityādi vā kaścit pratipadyate pratipādayati vā yenāyaṃ doṣaḥ syāt; api tu vicārāt
yathā yathārthāścintyante viśīryante tathā tathā || pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 209

yathā yathā yena avayavāvayavibāhyetarasatyetarādiprakāreṇa cintyante vicāryante arthā bhāvā tathā tathā viśīryante śūnyā bhavanti ityevaṃ mithyājñānāt na pratipattumarhati, vicārasyāsya pratyakṣānumānatvena pramāṇatvābhāvāt mithyājñānatvamiti bhāvaḥ
nanu ca sarvasya tattvavyavasthāpane ayaṃ vicāra eva paraṃ śaraṇaṃ paramārthataḥ pramāṇāderabhāvāditi cet; atrāha--samayāntaravat iti
yathā ayaṃ sugato'nyo vā teṣvapi mithyājñānāt na kiñcit pratipattumarhati tathā svasamaye'pi iti dṛṣṭāntārthaḥ
pratyakṣatvena anumānatvena vā pramāṇatvābhāve mithyājñānatvameva āpadyeta
adhunā yathādarśanameva ityādyuktvā bhāvataḥ sautrāntikādisamayabhedena kṣaṇakṣayādikaṃ vadataḥ sugatasya prajñāparādhaṃ darśayannāha--kathañcid ityādi
kathañcit kenāpi pratyakṣaprakāreṇa anumānaprakāreṇa vā yāthātmyapratipattiryā tāmantareṇa yathādarśanameva ityādi vacanaṃ bruvataḥ kathayataḥ

bhrāntaikāntavacanam yad viśadadarśanapathāvatāri na tat paramārthasat yathā taimirikopalabdhaṃ keśādi ityasya mādhyamikaviśeṣasya matasaṃgrahārtham cittaṃ ca tatsantānāntarāṇi iti kathanaṃ yogācārasya, teṣāṃ dvandvaḥ tāni iti
na kevalaṃ tānyeva kintu svabhāvanairātmyaṃ vā sakalaśūnyatvaṃ vā bruvataḥ
śauddhodaneḥ sugatasyaiva nānyasya tāvadayaṃ prajñāparādhaḥ kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa jātaḥ ityadhyāhāraḥ iti hetoḥ savismayaṃ sāścaryaṃ sakaruṇaṃsadayaṃ naḥ asmākaṃ cetaḥ
1 ityādi viśeṣaṇasya kāraṇamantareṇaiva sa jāta ityabhiprāyaḥ
santi asyāpi prajñāparādhavato'pi anu paścāt vaktāraḥ taduktaṃ samarthayitāraḥ iti kim anyad anātmajñatāyāḥ saiva iti
nanu ca grāhyākāraṃ svapnetarasādhāraṇam avicāritaramaṇīyamuddiśya yathādarśanameva pra॰ vā॰ 2
tathāha--pra jñā ka ra gu ptaḥ pramāṇamavisaṃvādi jñānam ityādi pramāṇalakṣaṇaṃ vyavahāreṇa pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 2
kathaṃbhūtam ? bahirmukhākāraṃ tena rūpeṇa tattatheti manyate
tathā cāha sa eva ajñātārthaprakāśo vā ityetallakṣaṇaṃ paramārthena pramāṇāntareṇa ajñātasya saṃvedanādvaitasya prakāśanāt pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 2
paramārtho vastubhūtam ekam akhaṇḍam saṃvedanaṃ svasaṃvedanākāro yasya tat tathoktam cittam iti sambandhaḥ
svayam ityādinā abhyupayataḥ abhyupagacchataḥ tathāvidhaṃ cittaṃ saugatasya paramātmasiddhireva paramasya anekāntarūpasya ātmano jīvasya uktanyāyena siddhireva na sandehādi kinna bhavet syādeva
atrāyamarthaḥ--yathā pratibhāsāviśeṣe'pi saṃvedanabahirmukhākārayoḥ paramārthataḥ satyetaravyavasthā tathā tadaviśeṣe'pi svapnetarabahirmukhākārayorapīti nirṇītaprāyametat
prajñākaraguptaḥ tatra pāramārthikapramāṇalakṣaṇametat pūrvaṃ tu sāṃvyavahārikasya--pra॰ vārtikāla॰
syānmatam, sautrāntikādidarśanabhedaḥ saṃvedanagrāhyākārayoḥ satyetarabhedaśca vyavahāreṇa na paramārthataḥ tathāgatenoktaḥ tato'yamadoṣaḥ
lokasaṃvṛtisatyaṃ ca satyaṃ ca paramārthataḥ || mādhya॰ kā॰ pṛ॰ 402 iti
yadi vā, pūrvapakṣārthaṃ tattenoktam, punaḥ pratiṣedhavidhānāt
kathamiti cet ? ucyate--akramatvaṃ sakalavikalpātītatvaṃ yadi tasya bhāvato'sti; kathaṃ sakalavikalpātītam ? tayoreva vikalpatvāt
atha nāsti; tathāpi kathaṃ tadatītam ? tadatītatvaniṣedhe sakalavikalpaprasakteḥ, abhāvaniṣedhasya vidhyātmakatvāt
ekaṃ hi kālatrayānuyāyi nityam, tasya kutaścidanupalambha iti tatra tadakṣā vo'pi

yathaiva hi madhyakṣaṇe kṣīṇakukṣi pratyakṣaṃ na pūrvottarakṣaṇau īkṣituṃ kṣamate tathā nīlāvalokanānnīlaṃ na śuklādikamām , evaṃ nīlamātrāṃśeṣvapi tāvaccintyam yāvat madhyakṣaṇavat pratiparamāṇuniyatasaṃvidāṃ siddhiḥ, tatra ca ekaparamāṇuvedanenānyāsāmupalambhena santānāntarasamatā, tadvedanamapi vivādagocaracārīti kinnāma tattvaṃ yad akramaṃ sakalavikalpātītaṃ bhavet
evam anityaṃ tanna bhavati ityatrāpi cintyam

yathā khalu pūrvottarakṣaṇayoradarśane na sattvaṃ nāpi tābhyāṃ viveko madhyakṣaṇasya kṣaṇikatvaṃ pratyetuṃ śakyaṃ tathā nīlāditadaṃśānāṃ sattvaṃ viveko vā pratyetuṃ kathaṃ śakyo yataḥ sakalavikalpātītaṃ tattvaṃ bhavet
tathāpi tattvakalpane tat mithyāvyavasthāmavatarati iti hetoḥ saṃvedanalakṣaṇo yaḥ tattvasvabhāvaḥ sthirasthūlādi grāhyākāralakṣaṇaśca mithyāsvabhāvaḥ tayorekatvam abhyupagantavyam
kathambhūtam ? pariṇāmi tat kinnalakṣyate ? lakṣyata eva tattvamiti
nanu ghaṭādyākāra eva saṃvedanaṃ na tasmāt tadanyad grāhyākāro vā tatkathaṃ tattvamithyāsvabhāvaikatvamiti cet ? atrāha--sarvathā ityādi
sarvathā sarveṇa tattvamithyāsvabhāvaikatvena ghaṭādyākārasya saṃvedanena anyena ca uktena prakāreṇa anekāntasiddheranivāraṇāt kāraṇasāmānya ityādi lakṣyate iti
evaṃ tāvat siddhiḥ arthaniścayaḥ sākṣāt pramāṇasya phalaṃ prasādhya, adhunā siddhiḥ svaniniścayaḥ tathā tatphalaṃ samarthayamānaḥ prāha--siddham ityādi
pramātṛpramitiprameyapramāṇānāṃ sākalyena prameyatvaṃ sadṛśaṃ rūpam, tatraitāvān viśeṣaḥ svataḥ siddhaṃ pramāṇam
tatpunaḥ yāvatoḥ svabhāvaparabhāvayoḥ sādhanamanyānapekṣaṃ pramātmatvāt na punaḥ svasaṃvinmātraṃ nirṇayarahitam atiprasaṅgāt
sarvacittacaittānāmātmasaṃvedanaṃ pratyakṣaṃ hitāhitaprāptiparihārasamarthamicchatāṃ svāpaprabodhayoḥ ko viśeṣaḥ saṃbhāvyate yataḥ svāpādau samyagjñānapūrvikā sarvapuruṣārthasiddhirna bhavet
na hi svāpādau cittacaitasikānāmabhāvaṃ pratipadyamānān pramāṇamasti
na ca teṣāṃ tadā ātmasaṃvedanaṃ muktvā satāṃ lakṣaṇāntaramasti yataḥ pratyakṣalakṣaṇaṃ tato nivarteta
svāpādisvasaṃvedanasya jāgraccittacaitasikakṣaṇakṣayādisvasaṃvedanasya ca kañcid viśeṣaṃ saṃprekṣāmahe yatastadanupalakṣitamāste
tathā ca svārthaviṣayaṃ pramāṇamiti jāgradvijñānakṣaṇakṣayādisvabhāvasaṃvitteḥ pratyakṣātmano'pi yadyapramāṇatvaṃ na tarhi saṃvitteḥ pratyakṣatā
yadi punaḥ saṃvittistathaiva satyapi pratyakṣaṃ na syāt pramāṇaṃ vā pramāṇalakṣaṇaṃ tato'nyathaiva vyavasthāpanīyaṃ yadativyāpakaṃ na bhavet
tathā ca sarvaṃ svabhāve parabhāve vā kathañcideva pramāṇaṃ na sarvathā

cakṣurādijñānasyāpi sarvathā parataḥ prāmāṇye kutastato'rthaṃ paricchidya pravartamānasya punaravisaṃvādaḥ ? kṣaṇakṣayādau visaṃvāde'pi nīlādau pramāṇatve mṛgatṛṣṇādijñānasyāpi salilādivisaṃvādinaḥ kathañcitpramāṇatvaṃ parīkṣāyāḥ pratiṣṭhāpayituṃ yuktam, anyathā taddarśinaḥ suptatvāviśeṣaprasaṅgāt
yathaiva hi parataḥ pramāṇyaikānte anavasthānādapratipattiḥ tathaiva sarvajñānānāṃ svataḥ svabhāvāniścayaikānte
tataḥ sarvajñānānāṃ svarūpavyavasāyātmakatvaṃ cittacaitasikānāṃ nirvikalpapratyakṣalakṣaṇaṃ nirākarotyeva
tannāyamekāntaḥ saṃvittiḥ sarvā saṃvitsvabhāvāpi satī svarūpaṃ vedayatyeva vedayati bhrānterabhāvaprasaṅgāt, vyavasāyātmakatvādvā svarūpaṃ sarvathā vyavasyati
tathā ca svārthānubhavetarasvabhāvalakṣaṇaṃ svapararūpavyavasāyetarasvabhāvaṃ vā vibhrāṇaṃ vijñānaṃ tadantareṇa na kathañcidupapanīpadyeta
tannāvikalpadarśanaṃ pramāṇaṃ svayamanubhūtasvabhāvasyāpi sarvathā ananubhūtakalpatvāt cetanatve'pi suṣuptādivat
svaviṣayīkṛte vastuni tadantarāpekṣitvāt tadapekṣaṇīyasyaiva prāmāṇyam, tatkāraṇatve'pi sannikarṣādivat mukhyataḥ pramāṇatānupapatteḥ
yataḥ prabhṛti prekṣāpūrvikā puruṣapravṛttiḥ tasya mukhyataḥ pramāṇatvopapattiḥ
svekṣite'nyānapekṣasya avisaṃvādaikabhavanasya vikalpaviṣayasya ca tattvataḥ, yato'yamaskhaladvṛttiḥ hitāhitaprāptiparihārayoḥ saṅkaravyatikaravyatirekeṇa pravarteta
siddhaṃ niścitaṃ yat tat pramāṇaṃ na punaḥ mīmāṃsaka-sāṃkhyakalpitaṃ parokṣaṃ jñānamiti manyate
kva pramāṇam ? ityatrāha--siddhau nirṇītau karttavyāyām nā'dhigatimātre, kṣaṇakṣayādyanumānavaiphalyaprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ
nanu niścayāntareṇa niścitaṃ nirvikalpakaṃ vā savikalpakaṃ vā svasaṃvedanaṃ tat pramāṇam, ataḥ siddhasādhanamiti cet; atrāha--na parāpekṣam iti
tatsiddhau yat parāpekṣaṃ na bhavati api tu svataḥ siddhamiti
kiṃ tat ? ityatrāha-- avikalpamacetanam ca svasaṃvedanaśūnyaṃ ghaṭādiprakhyaṃ yad vijñānam iti
kṣaṇakṣayasya adhigatistu nirvikalpakapratyakṣādeva jātā ataḥ tadeva tatra pramāṇamiti nānumānasya āvaśyakateti bhāvaḥ

pramātā cetanaḥ pariṇāmī vakṣyamāṇo jīvaḥ pramitiḥ svārthaviniścayaḥ ajñānanivṛttiḥ sākṣāt pramāṇasya phalaṃ prameyaṃ ghaṭādivastu teṣāṃ sākalyena anavayavena prameyatvaṃ pramāṇaviṣayatvaṃ sadṛśaṃ rūpaṃ sādhāraṇaḥ svabhāvaḥ pramāṇasya ca nirṇayajñānasya ca anyathā tatsattā'siddhiriti bhāvaḥ
evaṃ tarhi sarveṣāṃ prameyatvāt prameyapadenaiva vacanāt kimarthaṃ pramātrādīnāṃ pṛthagupādānamiti cet ? prameyaśabdasya ghaṭādāveva pravṛttyartham
tato'yamartho labhyate--pramātrādīnāṃ pramātṛtvādivat prameyatvamapyasti, prameyasya tu tadeva iti yaduktaṃ pareṇa--pradīpādayaḥ prameyā api jñānahetutvāt pramāṇamapi iti; tannirastam
pramīyate saṃśayādivyavacchedena mīyate vastutattvaṃ yena tatpramāṇam
na ca pradīpādinā tathā kiñcit mīyate, jñānakalpanāvaiphalyaprasaṅgāt
taddhetutvena tatpramāṇatve ghaṭādirapisvaṃ pramāṇaṃ bhavet tadaviśeṣāt arthavat arthasahakārivyavasāyātmakā'vyapadeśyā'vyabhicārijñānajanane pramāṇam iti vacanāt
prameyādarthāntaraṃ pramāṇam ityapi vacanāt nāyaṃ doṣa iti cet; tarhi tata eva pramātrādīnāṃ pramātṛtvādi durlabham
evamarthaṃ ca teṣāṃ prameyatvaṃ sadṛśaṃ rūpam ityuktam
tato yathā ghaṭādīnāṃ jñānahetutve'pi na pramāṇatvaṃ tathā pradīpāderapi kintu prameyatvameva iti tathā tadupādānamiti

syādetat--siddhaṃ parānapekṣaṃ pramāṇam iti prastute kimarthamaprastutaṃ prameyatvaṃ teṣu prastūyata iti cet ? ucyate--pramātṛprameyābhyāmarthāntaraṃ pramāṇam ityabhidhānāt pramāṇavat pramātṛpramitibhyāmapi tato bhinnābhyāṃ bhavitavyam
na caivam, anupalambhena tadasattvāditi na sūktame tat--catṛsṛṣvevaṃvidhāsu tattvaṃ parisamāpyate yaduta pramātā pramitiḥ prameyaṃ pramāṇamiti nyāyabhā॰ pṛ॰ 1
atha prameyamapi taccatuṣṭayaṃ tatheṣyate; pramātṛprameyābhyāmarthāntaraṃ pramāṇam ityasya vyāghātaḥ, ityasya pratipādanārthaṃ prastūyate
athavā yaduktam--jñānaṃ svato'rthāntareṇaiva jñānena vedyate prameyatvāt ghaṭādivat iti; tatra yathā ghaṭādikaṃ prameyatve sati bhinnenaiva jñānena vedyamānaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tathā pramātrādyapi

tato ghaṭādinidarśanena yadvat prameyatvāt tajjñānaṃ tadantareṇaiva viṣayīkriyate iti sādhyate tadvat tata eva pramātāpi tadantareṇaiva viṣayīkriyate iti sādhyatāmaviśeṣāt, tadantaramapi tadantareṇaivetyanavasthānānna kasyacit pramātuḥ pratipattiḥ ityabhāvaḥ
atha tadaviśeṣe pramātā svayameva ātmānaṃ pramiṇoti; tarhi jñānaṃ jñānāntareṇaiva jñāyate prameyatvāt ityasya tenaiva vyabhicāra ityasya kathanārthaṃ tat pramtūyate
sādhakatamaṃ pramāṇaṃ na tu pramātṛprameye--nyāyavā॰ pṛ॰ 6
jñānāntarasaṃvedyaṃ saṃvedanaṃ vedyatvāt ghaṭādivat--praśa॰ vyo॰ pṛ॰ 529
evamapi pramātṛpramitiprameyapramāṇānāṃ sākalyena prameyatvaṃ sadṛśaṃ rūpam iti vaktavye kimartham pramāṇasya ca iti prathag vacanamiti cet ? svataḥ siddhatvena prameyādasya prādhānyakhyāpanārtham
tatra teṣu pramātrādiṣu madhye pramāṇasya viśeṣaḥ bhedaḥ etāvān adhikaḥ svataḥ siddhaṃ pramāṇam
nanu pramātāpi svataḥ siddha iti cet; satyam; ataeva naivamavadhāraṇīyam pramāṇameva iti, kintu svataḥsiddhameva iti
tato nirastametat--parokṣā hi no buddhiḥ pratyakṣo'rthaḥ, sa hi bahirdeśasambaddhaḥ pratyakṣamanubhūyate, jñāte tvanumānādavagacchati śābarabhā॰ 1
katham ? yena hi sākṣāt prameyaṃ paricchidyate tatpramāṇam, na ca parokṣabuddhyā tathā kiñcit paricchidyate, itarathā santānāntarabuddhyāpi paricchidyate iti sarvadarśitvam
ātmabuddhyā iti nottaram; parokṣāyāṃ tathā niścayavirahāt
na khalu ātmani jñānamasti paratra ca iti śrotriyasya niścayo'sti
syānmatam--mama arthāparokṣatājananāt mayi iti niścaya iti; tadapi na sundaram; yataḥ arthāparokṣatā tajjanitāpi kena pratīyate ? na tāvadarthena; acenatvādasya arthāntaravat
kiṃca, mama sā ityapi kutaḥ ? madīyabuddhijanyatvāditi cet; anyonyasaṃśrayaḥ--siddhe hi tasyā madīyabuddhijanyatve mama sā iti niścīyate, tanniścaye ca tanmadīyabuddhijanyatvaniścayaḥ iti
mama sā iti niścaye'pi na madīyabuddhijanyatvaniścayaḥ, anyasambandhikāraṇajanyānāmapi mama iti niścayadarśanāt anyavyānāt mama viṣāpahārādivat iti
anyena mantraprayoge kṛte yathā anyasya vipāpahāro bhavati, tatrāpi mama iti pratyayo bhavatītyarthaḥ

api ca, tajjñātatvaṃ kva buddhau pratibaddhaṃ pratipannaṃ yena tatastadanumānam ? atha arthapratyakṣatā kādācitkatvāt kasyacit kāryam; kāraṇasya tataḥ tad buddhiḥ iti nāma kriyate iti; kriyatām, yadi cakṣurādivyatiriktaṃ tatkāraṇaṃ vyavasthāpayituṃ śakyeta
idaṃ tu yuktam--cakṣurādivyāpārānantaraṃ tadbhāvāt tadeva tatkāraṇam, cakrādivyāpārānantaraṃ yathā ghaṭasya bhāvāt cakrādi kāraṇam
cakṣurādereva tannāma iti cet; kiṃ punaretadbālabhāṣitam--satsamprayoge yad buddhijanma tat pratyakṣam mī॰ da॰ 1
4 iti ? tanna arthapratyakṣatāyā buddheranumānam, uktanyāyena parabuddherapi tatkāraṇatvestva buddheśca
tasyā sva parokṣatve tadeva codyamanavasthā ca
etena indriyāṇi arthamālocayanti ahaṅkāro'bhimanyate manaḥ saṃkalpayati buddhiradhyavasyati puruṣaścetayate
puruṣasya parokṣatve na tasya buddhiḥ anyadvā, prayuktanyāyasya samānatvāt
evaṃ buddhyahaṅkāramanaścakṣuṣāṃ kramaśo vṛttirdṛṣṭā--cakṣū rūpaṃ paśyati manaḥ saṅkalpayati ahaṅkāro'bhimānayati buddhiradhyavasyati
tarhi jñānāntaragrāhyatvāt siddhaṃ taditi cet; atrāha--svata iti

atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--yathā khalu mīmāṃsakasya parokṣajñānagrāhyo'rtho na siddho bhavatīti jñānāntaraṃ kalpitaṃ tathā parokṣajñānagrāhyaṃ jñānamapi na sidhyatīti tatrāpi tadantaraṃ kalpanīyam, anyathā dvitīyamapi jñānaṃ na kalpanīyaṃ bhavet, tathā ca anavasthānāt svajñānaṃ tadantareṇaiva gṛhyate prameyatvāt ghaṭādivat ityatra dharmihetudṛṣṭāntāsiddhiḥ
atha tajjñānaṃ svataḥsiddhamiṣyate; tarhi dharmyādigrāhakapramāṇabādhitatvāt kālātyayāpadiṣṭo hetuḥ syāt
yatpunaruktaṃ pareṇa--jñāne jñānāntareṇa vedye mama ghaṭādidṛṣṭānto'sti na svavedye jainasya iti; tanna; asya dṛṣṭānta eva nāsti, bhavataḥ punaḥ sakalānumānasāmagryabhāvaḥ
kiñca, bhavato'pi nīlaṃ nīlam ityatra na kaścid dṛṣṭāntaḥ
yathā khalu nīle nīlatayā na lokasya vivādaḥ tathā ahamahamikayā pratīyamāne jñāne svasaṃvedane'pi

yadi punarayaṃ nirbandhaḥ--anumānamantareṇa na tatsiddhiḥ, tadapi na dṛṣṭāntamantareṇa iti; so'pi na, sātmakaṃ jīvaccharīraṃ prāṇādi mattvāt' ityādivat arthajñānaṃ svagrahaṇātmakam arthagrahaṇātmakatvāt, yat punaḥ svagrahaṇātmakaṃ na bhavati tad arthagrahaṇātmakamapi na bhavati yathā arthāntaram ityetāvataiva prayojanaparisamāpteḥ
nanvevamapi kārikāyāṃ vṛttau ca dṛṣṭavacanaṃ spaṣṭārthaṃ karttavyaṃ na siddhavacanamiti cet; tanna; nirvikalpasvasaṃvedanadṛṣṭamapi dṛṣṭam ityāśaṅkā na rnivartteta, na ca tat pramāṇam
jñāpakaṃ hi pramāṇamiṣyate, na ca tadevam, anyathā dāna-hiṃsāviraticetasāṃ svargaprāpaṇasāmarthyaṃ svargādiphalajñāpakaṃ bhavet, na caivamiti pratipādayiṣyate
viṣayadarśanavādinā siddhavacane punaḥ kriyamāṇe siddhaṃ nirṇītam iti gamyate, siddhaḥ pakṣo nirṇītaḥ iti prasiddhidarśanāt
ataḥ tasmād dṛṣṭasya bhāvasya dṛṣṭa evākhilo guṇaḥ
iti nyāyāt dānādicittagrāhiṇā nirvikalpena tatsāmarthyamapi gṛhītam, tathā ca dānādigrāhicittādeva svargādiphalajñaptiḥ syāditi doṣaḥ
anekādhi anena adhigatiḥ tatphalam iti vacanāt tanmātra siddhiḥ ityādi śaṅkā nivarttayati
tathā apra siddhiḥ, sā kim ? ityatrāha--pramitiḥ pramāṇaphalam
sā yataḥ yasmānniṣṭhāt sampadyate samāptiṃ pratipadyate tat vastu pramāṇam
tataḥ tanniṣṭhāt punaḥ iti bhāvanāyām svabhāvaparabhāvayoryāvatoḥ yatparimāṇayoḥ anena chadmasthajñānam aṃśena pramāṇam ityuktaṃ bhavati
tayoḥ kim ? sādhanaṃ sādhakam yāvatoriti vacanāt tāvatoḥ pramāṇam iti gamyate yattadornityaḥ sambandhaḥ iti nyāyāt
pramā pramāṇaṃ tad ātmā svabhāvo yasya tasya bhāvāt tattvāt
etaduktaṃ bhavati--pramāṇaṃ karaṇam, tacca sādhakatamam, na ca siddhiphalaṃ pratyanyāpekṣaṃ tadyuktamiti
nanu mā bhūt naiyāyikādikalpitam anyāpekṣaṃ jñānaṃ pramāṇaṃ saugatavikalpitaṃ tadviparītaṃ syāditi cet; atrāha--na punaḥ ityādi
svasaṃvitteḥ etanmātraṃ nirṇayarahitaṃ svasaṃvedanaṃ tat na punaḥ naiva svabhāvaparabhāvayoḥ pramāṇam iti
nanu kimucyate aviśeṣāt iti, yāvatā viśeṣo'sti iti cet; atrāha--sarvacittacaittānām ityādi
sarvāṇi jāgratsuptamūrcchitādisambandhīni yāni cittāni nīlādijñānāni caittāni sukhādivikalpavedanāni teṣām ātmanaḥ svarūpasya saṃvedanaṃ pratyakṣaṃ kalpanāpoḍhā'bhrāntatvābhyāṃ pramāṇam

1 iti vacanāt hitaṃ sragādi, ahitaṃ viṣādi tayoḥ yāthāsaṃkhyena prāptiśca parihāraśca tayoḥ samartham, icchatāṃ saugatānāṃ svāpo susvapnadarśinyavasthā, prabodhaḥ tasmāt utthitacittadaśā tayoḥ adhikaraṇayoḥ ko viśeṣaḥ na kaścidbhedastasya saṃbhāvyate, sākṣātsampratipatterabhāvā'viśeṣāditi manyate
yataḥ yasmāt viśeṣāt svāpādau ādiśabdena madādiparigrahaḥ samyagjñānapūrvikā sarvapuruṣārthasiddhirna bhavet
yataḥ iti vā ākṣepe, syādeva iti
hitāhitaprāptiparihārārthī sarvaḥ pṛ॰ 28 samyagjñānapūrvakatvaṃ ca hitāhitaprāpti parihārayoruktam
syānmatam--svāpādau teṣāmanupalambhena asattvāt kathamayaṃ doṣaḥ ? ityatrāha--nahi ityādi
hi ryasmāt na svapādau cittacaitasikānām abhāvaṃ pratipadyamānān prati yad darśayati tat pramāṇamasti yāvān kaścit pratiṣedhaḥ sa sarvo'nupalabdhiḥ , sā ca prabodhe'pi asti
ata evoktam--svāpaprabodhayoḥ ko viśeṣaḥ saṃbhāvyeta iti
na ca anaikāntikād hetoḥ sādhyasiddhiḥ atiprasaṅgāditi manyate
kiñca, tadanupalabdhiḥ svasambandhinī, parasambandhinī vā syāt ? svasambandhinī cet; sā upalabdhinivṛttirūpā yadi; kathamatastadabhāvasiddhiḥ ? itarathāpi tannivṛttistadabhāvajñāpikā syāt
jñātā ca sā tajjñāpikā jñāpakatvāt dhūmavat
upalabdhyantarasvabhāvā cet; tatra tadantarabhāve kathaṃ cittacaitasikānāmabhāvaḥ ? tadabhāvo'pi yadi tucchaḥ; samayāntara gamanam
yadi punaḥ jāgratprabodhajñānaṃ tadanupalabdhiḥ; evamapi na tatra tadabhāvasiddhiḥ, anyathā ihalokapratyakṣāt paralokābhāvaḥ sidhyet
parasambandhinī cet; sāpi tadā adṛśyānāṃ teṣāṃ kathamabhāvamavaiti iti, santānāntarāsiddhiprasaṅgāt

atha avasthācatuṣṭayānyathānupapattitaḥ tatra tadabhāvasiddhiḥ; tatredaṃ cintyate--yathā paraparikalpitasya ātmano'siddhau na tena ātmajīvaccharīraṃ sātmakaṃ sidhyati iti, tathā nirvikalpakacittacaitasikānāmabhāvaḥ
tadabhāvosiddhau na tadapekṣe jāgratsuptadaśe sidhyataḥ, tathā tannivṛttyapekṣe mṛtasuṣuptadaśe api
vyavahāriṇaḥ siddhaṃ cet; yadi pramāṇataḥ; prakṛto doṣaḥ
evameva; ityapi vārttam; vṛkṣādau maraṇamapi tathā siddhamastu
yatpunaretat--evaṃ vicāraṇe pratibhāsādvaitamavaśiṣyate iti; tatrāpi citrapratibhāsāpyekaiva buddhiḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
220 ityādi vacanāt citraikajñānarūpeṇa yadi tena paritoṣaḥ; kramabhāvisukhaduḥkhādyātmanāpi paritoṣaḥ kriyatām
atha ekānekavikalpaśūnyena; tatrāpi sakalapratibhāsaśūnyena kriyatām iti carcitam
santu tarhi tatrāpi tāni iti cet; atrāha--na ca ityādi
na ca naiva teṣāṃ cittacaitasikānāṃ tadā svāpādidaśāyām ātmasaṃvedanaṃ muktvā satāṃ vidyamānānāṃ lakṣaṇāntaramasti svasaṃvedanalakṣaṇatvāj jñānasyeti manyate
nanu bhavato'pi na tadā tabhāvo'sti; ātmano'pi nivṛttiprasaṅgāt
satāṃ ca teṣāṃ svaparāvabhāsitvaṃ muktvā na lakṣaṇāntaramasti tataḥ samāno doṣaḥ iti cet; atrāha--svāpādi ityādi

svāpādau svasyaiva saṃvedanaṃ svāpādisvasaṃvedanam tasya jāgratcittacaitasikānāṃ yaḥ kṣaṇakṣayādisvabhāvaḥ, ādiśabdena niraṃśatvasvargādiprāpaṇasāmarthyādiparigrahaḥ tasya yat svasaṃvedanaṃ grahaṇaṃ tasya ca tada kañcid viśeṣamantaraṃ saṃprekṣāmahe, yataḥ tat kṣaṇakṣayādisvabhāvasaṃvedanam anupalakṣitam āste tathā svāpādisvasaṃvedanamapi iti bhāvaḥ
sākṣāt pratyakṣataḥ yā saṃpratipattiḥ nirṇītiḥ tasyā ubhayatra yo bhāvaḥ tasya aviśeṣād anyathā kṣaṇakṣayādibhāvānumānamanarthakam
liṅgāt saṃpratipattiḥ ubhayatra, ekatra sattvādeḥ anyatra vyāpāravyāhārāt ityabhiprāyaḥ
yadi svāpādau jñānaṃ na syāttadā ātmano'bhāvaḥ syāt

yadi punarmatam--pāvakāt dṛṣṭo'pi dhūmaḥ yathā punaḥ dhūmādeva dṛśyate, tathā cittād dṛṣṭo'pi vyāpārādiḥ punaḥ vyāpārādereva dṛkṣyata iti kathaṃ tatastatra svasaṃvedanasiddhiriti ? tatrocyate anyadhiyo gateḥ ityanarthakaṃ bhavet, tadgatyupāyavirahāt
śakyaṃ hi vaktum--pāvakavat nivṛtte'pi janmāntaracetasi ihajanmani sarvadehāntareṣu vyāpārādereva vyāpārādiriti na tadarthaṃ śāstrapraṇayanam
kathaṃ caivaṃvādino jalādyākāraviśeṣadarśanāt bhāvinyāmarthakriyāyāṃ tadarthino niyamena pravṛttiḥ ? kadācit tasyāḥ dṛṣṭo'pi tadākāraviśeṣaḥ punastata eva sa ityāśaṅkā'nivṛtteḥ
tathā rūpāde raso dṛṣṭo'pi rasādeva sa bhavet iti kathamidamanumānam--ekasāmagryadhīnasya pra॰ vā॰ 3
kārikeyaṃ taduktaṃ dharmakīrtinā iti kṛtvā pramāṇaparīkṣāyāṃ pṛ॰ 64 vartate
tadapi prathamanīlārthāt tadākāraṃ punaḥ tata eva āsaṃsāramiti abhrāntagrahaṇamanarthakam
vyavahārī tathā na manyate; kiṃ punarasau svāpādau caitanyābhāvaṃ manyate ? tathā cet; mṛtavat tatrāpi dāhādisāhasamācaret
kuto vā pratibodhe ātmamanaḥsaṃyogāt ? āstāṃ tāvadetat
jāgradvijñānāt; idamapi āstām iti yatkiṃcidekaṃtat kevalaṃ tadviśeṣāsaṃprekṣaṇe svāpādau svasaṃvedanamanupalakṣitaṃ sidhyati api tu idaṃ dūṣaṇāntaraṃ darśayannāha--tathā ca ityādi
tathā tena tadviśeṣāsaṃprekṣaṇaprakāreṇa vā ca śabdaḥ avadhāraṇe tathaiva iti

svaṃ vā arthaśca tāveva viṣayau gocarau tayoḥ pramāṇam ityabhimataṃ jāgraddaśāyāṃ saugatasya yad vijñānaṃ tasya yaḥ kṣaṇakṣayādisvabhāvaḥ tasya yā saṃvittiḥ, agamakatvāt sāpekṣasyāpi vṛtteḥ devadattasya gurubhāryāvad iti
yadi vā, tasya kṣaṇakṣayādergrāhiṇī svabhāvabhūtā saṃvittiḥ iti grāhyam, tasyāḥ pratyakṣātmano'pi visabhāvā api kṣaṇakṣayādyanumānāpramāṇatābhayāt yadyapramāṇatvam iṣyate ityadhyāhāraḥ
na tarhi saṃvitteḥ saṃvitsvarūpasya pratyakṣatā kalpanāpoḍhābhrāntatā pramāṇam
asamarthatvāt samāsābhāva iti cenna; sāpekṣasyāpi samāsadarśanāt iti bhāvaḥ
tataḥ kathaṃ sā pramāṇamiti cet ? atrāha--yadi ityādi

yadi, punaḥ iti vitarke, saṃvittiḥ tathaiva svasaṃvedanaprakāreṇaiva satyapi vidyamāno'pi pratyakṣaṃ na syāt kalpanāpoḍhā'bhrāntasvabhāvā na bhavet pramāṇaṃ vā saṃvādinī vā na syāt, pramāṇalakṣaṇaṃ tataḥ sarvacittacaitasikānāmātmasaṃvedanaṃ pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇam nyāyabi॰ 1
kathaṃbhūtam ? ityatrāha--yat pramāṇalakṣaṇam ativyāpakaṃ na bhavet svāpādisaṃvedane yannāsti ityarthaḥ
pravarttakaṃ pramāṇam pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 151, 22 iti ca vacanaṃ svāpādau kṣaṇakṣayādau vā tadasti iti cet; atrāha--tathā ca ityādi
tathā ca paraparikalpitaprakāreṇa ca sarvaṃ pratyakṣādi pramāṇaṃ svabhāve svasvarūpe parabhāve pararūpe vā kathañcideva saccetanādinīlādirūpeṇaiva na kṣaṇakṣayādirūpeṇa pramāṇam
yena abhyāsadaśāyāṃ bhāvini pravarttakatvāt pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇamiṣṭam, tasyāpi tadrūpādāveva pramāṇaṃ na dṛśyaprāpyaviveke svayaṃ viṣayīkṛte'pi, tayorekatvādhyavasāyo'nyathā na syāt virodhāt
ko'nyo na bhāgo dṛṣṭaḥ syādyaḥ pramāṇaiḥ parīkṣyate

na kevalaṃ sarvacittacaitasikānāmātmasaṃvedanasya, api tu cakṣurādijñānasyāpi ādiśabdena śrotrādijñānaparigrahaḥ sarvathā kṣaṇakṣayādāviva nīlādāvapi parataḥ vikalpāt prāmāṇye aṅgīkriyamāṇe kutaḥ na kutaścit tataḥ cakṣurādijñānāt arthaṃ paricchidya pravartamānasya punaḥ paścād avisaṃvādaḥ
kuta etat ? pravarttanasyaivā'saṃbhavāt tataḥ ityanena sambandhaḥ
kṣaṇakṣayādau ādiśabdena parimaṇḍalādau visaṃvāde'pi cakṣurādijñānasya iti sambandhaḥ
nīlādau pramāṇatve aṅgīkriyamāṇe mṛgatṛṣṇādijñānasyāpi na kevalam anyasya
kathambhūtasya ? salilādivisaṃvādinaḥ śuklādisvabhāvā'visaṃvādāt kathañcit na sarvātmanā pramāṇatvaṃ parīkṣāyāḥ yukteḥ sakāśāt pratiṣṭhāpayituṃ yuktam
syānmatam--mṛgatṛṣṇādijñānamavikalpakamabhrāntaṃ na tatsalilādiviṣayaṃ kathaṃ tasya tatra visaṃvādaḥ, anyathā nīlajñānaṃ pīte visaṃvādi bhavet
yacca salilādijñānaṃ saṃma tanmṛga tṛṣṇādijñānaṃ toyādivibhramasya mānasatvopagamāditi; na; tatra jñānadvayānupalakṣaṇāt
śakyaṃ hi vaktum--candramekaṃ paśyato'pi dvicandrabhrāntiriti ityādi
nanu mṛgatṛṣṇājñānena śuklādisvabhāvāgrahaṇāt kathaṃ tatra tadavisaṃvādo yataḥ kathañcit pramāṇaṃ syāditi cet ? atrāha--anyathā ityādi
anyathā uktābhāvaprakāreṇa taddarśino mṛgatṛṣṇādisaliladarśinaḥ puruṣasya suptatvā'viśeṣaprasaṅgāt kathañcit tasya prāmāṇyaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayituṃ yuktam

dṛśyamānasyāpi śuklādisvabhāvasya adarśanakalpane salilādipratibhāse kaḥ samāśvāsa iti ? dṛṣṭāntadvayasya kiṃ prayojanamiti cet ? ucyate--yadā ekasminnapi vijñāne tasmin salilādipratibhāsaṃ paro'bhyupagacchati na śuklādipratibhāsaṃ tadā uktanyāyena salilādipratibhāsasyāpi nihnavāt suptena asvapnadarśino'viśeṣaprasaṅgāt ityucyate

yadā punaḥ śuklādisvabhāvaviṣayamavikalpaṃ darśanaṃ viśadaṃ salilādigocaraṃ punaḥ savikalpamapi viśadaṃ mānasaṃ jñānamabhyupagacchati, tadā nirvikalpakasya sato'pya nupalakṣaṇād aspaṣṭasalilādijñānasyāsattve'pi bhāvāt anyenā'viśeṣaprasaṅgād ityabhidhīyate
atha svasaṃvedanādhyakṣanirṇayavicāraprastāve na upayogaḥ cakṣurādijñānasya yena tadatra vicāryate iti, svarūpe svasaṃvedanādhyakṣaṃ kathañcideva na sarvathā ityatra nidarśanārtham
ata evoktam--svabhāve vā parabhāve vā ityarthaḥ

sāmprataṃ jñānāntaravedyajñānaikānte yad dūṣaṇaṃ saugatasya prasiddhaṃ tadeva--yatraiva janayedenāṃ tatraivāsya pramāṇatā ityatrāpi pradarśya svataḥ svarūpavyavasāyātmakaṃ sarvaṃ jñānaṃ prasādhayannāha--yathaiva hi ityādi

yathaiva yenaiva hi prakāreṇa parataḥ jñānāntarāt prāmāṇyam ādyasya jñānasya svārthavyavasāyaḥ prāmāṇyaṃ cetasāṃ svārthavyavasāyaḥ iti vacanāt iti evam ekānte yaugakalpite anavasthānāt jñānāntare'pi tadantarāpekṣaṇāt apratipattiḥ svārthayoḥ ityadhyāhāraḥ

tathaiva tenaiva prakāreṇa sarvajñānānāṃ savikalpakanirvikalpakacetasāṃ svataḥ ātmanā svabhāvā'niścayaikānte svabhāvasya svarūpasya aniścayaikānte aṅgīkriyamāṇe anavasthānād anavasthiteḥ apratipattiḥ svārthayoreva gantavyā

etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā ādyaṃ darśanaṃ svabhāve vyavasāyasāmarthyavidhuramutpannamapi anutpannakalpamiti yatraiva janayedenām ityādyuktam, tathā tatsvabhāve samutpannāpi vikalpabuddhiḥ svataḥ svavyavasāyasāmārthya vidhurā iti utpannāpyanutpannakalpā iti tatsvabhāvavyavasāye'pi tadantarānveṣaṇaṃ tatrāpi tadantarānveṣaṇamityanavasthā
tataḥ tasmād anantarād doṣāt sarvajñānānāṃ svarūpavyavasāyātmakatvaṃ avagantavyā ityanena jātanapuṃsakaliṅgapariṇāmena sambandhāt
tat kiṃ karoti ? ityatrāha--nirvikalpeyadinidi nirvikalpaṃ ca tat pratyakṣalakṣaṇaṃ ca tat karmatāpannaṃ nirākarotyeva
syānmatam--svarūpavyavasāyātmakatvā'bhāve kimanupapannaṃ yadarthaṃ tat sādhyate ? ityatra uttaramāha--svasaṃvedanam ityādi
svasya ātmanaḥ saṃvedanaṃ grahaṇam tadantareṇa arthagrahaṇānupa pattivat svarūpavyavasāyam ātmanirṇayamantareṇa viṣayasya svārthalakṣaṇasya vyavasāyānupapattiśca uktā

yata evaṃ svaparaviṣayapramāṇābhimatavijñānasya ityādi suptatvāviśeṣaprasaṅgāt ityantaṃ ca vyavasthitaṃ tasmāt nāyam ekānto vaḥ saṃvittiḥ buddhiḥ sarvā niravaśeṣā sarvajñaśantivadanyāpi svarūpam ātmānaṃ vedayatyeva vedayati tasya kiñcinna vedayati ityevakārārthaḥ
yaduktaṃ dha rmo tta re ṇa--dvividhā bhrāntiḥ--laukikī dvicandrādigrahaṇātmikā
śāstrīyā ca grāhakasaṃvittibhedalakṣaṇātmikā ca tasyā abhāvaprasaṅgāt
tathāhi--saccetanādisvarūpavat tadvibhramavivekamapi yadyātmanaḥ sā vedayati kutaḥ tadbhrāntiḥ ? itarathā nīlajñānasya pīte sā bhavet
etena laukikī bhrāntirnirastā; tasyā grāhyākārābhāve abhāvāt, tannibandhanatvāt
atrāparaḥ prāha--bhrāntarebhāvo na doṣāya saugatasya tadabhyupagamāditi; tanna; yathāpratibhāsaṃ tattvopagame jainadarśanaprasaṅgāt
tathā ca sati bhavataḥ kiṃ siddham ? ityatrāha--vyavasāya ityādi

tato'yamartha--yataḥ parakīyā saṃvittiḥ evaṃvidhā tat tasmād vyavasāyātmakatvāt iti hetoreva vā saṃvittiḥ svarūpaṃ viṣayarūpatvāt sarvathā vyavasyati ityayaṃ naikāntaḥ bhrānterabhāvaprasaṅgāt iti sambandhaḥ

yathaiva hi vaiśeṣikasya saṃvittiḥ vyavasāyātmikā ayam ityevaṃ parāmṛśyamānaṃ dharmiṇaṃ vyavasyati tathaiva yadi tasya sthāṇutvapuruṣatvayoḥ anyataravivekaṃ svabhāvabhūtam, anyathā svabhāvāvyavasthāprasaṅgāt, vyavasyati; kutaḥ saṃśayādivyavasthā atiprasaṅgāt ? evaṃ sarvasya ekāntavādinaḥ ātmanaikavākyatāṃ samarthitāmupasaṃharannāha--tathā ca tena prakāreṇa ca sarvaika vākyabhāve svaṃ ca arthaśca svo vā arthaḥ tayoḥ tasya vā anubhavāśca itaraścā'nanubhavaḥ tāveva svabhāvau lakṣaṇaṃ svarūpaṃ vibhrāṇaṃ dadhānam
etat saugatamuddiśya uktam, svapararūpavyavasāyetarasvabhāvaṃ vā svapararūpayoḥ vyavasāyo nirṇayaḥ itaro'nirṇayaḥ tāveva svabhāvaḥ svarūpaṃ taṃ vā vibhrāṇam
tad anekāntamantareṇa kathaṃ na kathañcid upapanīpadyeta
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt avikalpadarśanaṃ na vidyate vikalpaḥ svapararūpavyavasāyo yasya saugatādikalpitadarśanasya tat tathoktam, na svaparabhāvayoḥ pratyakṣaṃ sat pramāṇam
svayam ātmanā anubhūto gṛhīto yaḥ svabhāvaḥ svarūpam svo vā bhāvo grāhyaḥ padārthātmā, tasyāpi na kevalamanyasya sarvathā kṣaṇikādiprakāreṇeva nīlādiprakāreṇāpi
nanu mā bhūt naiyāyikādidarśanaṃ pratyakṣaṃ sat pramāṇaṃ svagrahaṇasāmarthyavaidhuryeṇa ghaṭādivadacetanatvāt na saugatadarśanaṃ tatsāmarthyabhāvena cetanatvāditi cet; atrāha-- cetanatve'pi ityādi
apiḥ saṃbhāvanāyām, bhāvataḥ tatra cetanatvāsiddheḥ, tasminnapi
nanu bhāvata eva tatra cetanatve kutaḥ kāraṇāducyate--cetanatve'pi ityetaditi cet; atrāha--svaviṣayīkṛta ityādi
svena ātmanā viṣayīkṛte anubhūte vastuni kṣaṇikādinīlādirūpe parakalpitād darśanapramāṇāt anumānaṃ vikalpaśca tadantaraṃ tadapekṣitvāt kāraṇāt cetanatve'pi ityucyate iti
nanu pramitisādhakaṃ pramāṇam, sā ca nīlādau darśanādeva jāteti tatra vikalpaḥ pramāṇameva na bhavati kimucyate tadantaram iti cet; atrāha--tad ityādi
tadapekṣaṇīyasyaiva kṣaṇikatvādau anumānasyaiva nīlādau vikalpasyaiva pramāṇaṃ pramitiṃ prati sādhakatamatvopapatteḥ
atha pramitiṃ prati sādhakatamasya vikalpasya hetutvād darśanamapi tāṃ prati sādhakatamamucyate
taduktam a rca ṭe na--pakṣadharmatāniścayaḥ pratyakṣājjāyate iti pakṣadharmatāniścayaḥ pratyakṣata ityucyate iti
6 ityādivacanāt darśanasya vikalpakāraṇatvaṃ nāsti, ata eva tatkāraṇatve'pi iti, apiśabdaḥ saṃbhāvanāyām
sannikarṣāderiva tadvat mukhyataḥ pramāṇatānupapatteḥ na avikalpadarśanaṃ pramāṇam
upacārataḥ tadupapattiḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--upacārata ityādi
upacārāt sannikarṣādeḥ pramāṇam iti prakāreṇa vyapadeśā'vighātāt
pakṣadharmasya sādhyadharmiṇi pratyakṣato'numānato vā prasiddhiḥ niścaya iti--hetubi॰, ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 39
nanu vyavahāre anyat pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇaṃ nāsti, avikalpadarśanasyaiva mukhyataḥ pramāṇatopapattiḥ iti; atrāha--yataḥ ityādi

tato'yamarthaḥ— yataḥ prabhṛti yasmāt āditaḥ vijñānāt puruṣasya pravṛttiḥ tasya vyavasāyātmanaḥ vijñānasya mukhyataḥ pramāṇatvopapattiḥ nā'vikalpadarśanaṃ pramāṇam iti prabhṛtiśabdena etaddarśayati--pūrvamakasmāt sukhahetoḥ dukhahetorvā darśane tataḥ sukhādyanubhavane ca na puruṣa evamavagacchati idaṃ mesukhasādhanaṃ duḥkhasādhanaṃ vā
yatpunaratredaṃ codyam--sukhādisādhanadarśanakāle na sukhādivedanam, tatkāle ca na tatsādhanavedanam, tat kutaḥ sukhādisādhanayoḥ hetuphalabhāvapratītiriti ? tat pratibhāsaikyaniyame siddhivi॰ 1

tataḥ tadavagamāt tasya saṃskāraḥ, punaḥ kālāntare tasya tajjātīyasya vā darśanāt saṃskāraprabodhe tatra smṛtiḥ, tataḥ tadevedaṃ tatsadṛśam iti vā pratyabhijñā, ato'pi yaditthaṃ tad iyatā kālena sāmagrīviśeṣeṇa vā itthaṃbhūtakāryakāriiti cintā tarkaḥ, tato'pi itthaṃ cedaṃ tasmāt pūrvavat vivakṣitakāryakāri ityanumānam, ataḥ puruṣasya pravṛttiḥ iti
yatpunaretat--pravṛtteḥ phalabhāvena asattvānna kasyacit kutaścit pravṛttiḥ iti; tad yugapadiva ca krameṇāpi citraikajñāna saṃbhavena pratyakṣabādhitamiti
nanu mṛgatṛṣṇādijalajñānādapi puruṣapravṛttirastīti tasyāpi mukhyataḥ pramāṇatvopapattiḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--prekṣāpūrvikā iti
prakṛṣṭā saṃśayādirahite kṣā darśanaṃ pūrvaṃ kāraṇaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathoktā samyagjñānapūrvikā iti yāvat, vibhramasarvavikalpātītatvādyekāntaniṣedhāt
nanu nirvikalpakadarśanādeva tathā puruṣapravṛttiḥ, ataḥ tasyaiva mukhyataḥ pramāṇatopapattiḥ
smaraṇādabhilāṣeṇa vyavahāraḥ pravarttate || pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 24
svekṣite svānubhūte vastuni anyānapekṣasya vyavasāyātmano vijñānasya, ata eva smaraṇādiḥ nānyata iti manyate
syānmatam--bhavatu vyavasāyātmano vijñānād āditaḥ prekṣāpūrvikā puruṣapravṛttiḥ tathāpi na tasya mukhyataḥ pramāṇatopapattiḥ avastusāmānyaviṣayatvena visaṃ vādakatvāt
avisaṃvādasya ekam anyanirapekṣaṃ bhavanaṃ yasmāt tasya vikalpaviṣayasya ca tattvato vastutvāditi bhāvaḥ
atra codyate--vyavasāyātmano nātīte puruṣapravṛttiḥ tasya anubhūtatvāt, na vartamāne anubhūyamānatvāt
nahi sukhādau anubhūyamāne kaścit pravarttate pravṛtteranavasthāprasaṅgāt
nāpi bhāvini; pratyakṣataḥ tadapratipatteḥ na kvacit puruṣapravṛttiriti
ayaṃ codyakāraḥ pra jñā ka ra gu ptaḥ anyo vā pravartteta tathā vicāraṃ kurvannapi na tiṣṭhet

etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadyayaṃ prekṣākārī niyamena pravṛttiviṣayaṃ nāsti iti paśyet na tatra nityavad askhaladvṛttiḥ pravartteta, na caivaṃ suparīkṣaka vicāraṃ kurvannapi na tiṣṭhet kathaṃbhūtaḥ askhaladvṛttiḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati suparīkṣakasyāpi jalādau pravṛttidarśanāt ataḥ tatkārī taddveṣī ceti upekṣāmarhati iti
kva pravartteta iti cet ? atrāha--hita ityādi
nimittayoḥ dvivacanametat, tena hitasya odanādeḥ prāptau prāptinimittam ahitasya viṣādeḥ parihāre parihāranimittam

na caitaccodyam--sukhadukhayorapratipattau na tatkāri hitamahitaṃ vā jñātuṃ śakyata iti; tathā anumānā'pratipattau na liṅgasya taddhetutvaṃ pratīyate iti na tadarthī tatrāpi pravartteta tonudayāt ato' numānānudayāt kutaḥ svayaṃ tattvamavabudhyeta paraṃ vā bodhayet ? svasaṃvedanādhyakṣasya anaṃśasya vivādagocarāpannatvāt
tadayaṃ bhāvyanumānam apratiyannapi liṅgasya taddhetutāmavaiti na punaḥ tathāvidhaṃ sukhādikam apratipannaudanādeḥ taddhetutāmicchatīti svecchāvṛttiḥ
kathaṃ pravarttate iti cet ? atrāha--saṅkara ityādi

yasya prāptiḥ tasya parihāraḥ yasya parihāraḥ tasya prāptiḥ iti saṅkaraḥ, prāptiviṣaye parihāraḥ parihāraviṣaye ca prāptireva vyatikaraḥ, tayoḥ vyatirekeṇa abhāvena yato yasmāt tataḥ yataḥ prabhṛti ityādi sustham
atra aparaḥ saugataḥ prāha--yatraiva janayedenāṃ tatraivāsya pramāṇatā iti dha rmotta ra sya matametat
tacca yayaiva yuktyā asmābhirnirastaṃ tayaiva jainaiḥ iti siddhopasthāyitvaṃ teṣām, darśanaṃ tu vikalpanirapekṣaṃ pramāṇam
yadyapramāṇaṃ vikalpaḥ kathaṃ darśanena apekṣate ? pramāṇatve pramāṇasaṃkhyāvyāghāta iti
viṣamālokya tatra ajña iva pramāṇayati na punaḥ vyavasāyātmakaṃ pramāṇamavisaṃvādakamiti lakṣayati ceti viparītalakṣaṇaprajño devānāṃpriyaḥ
sarvameva darśanamavikalpakaṃ kathaṃ pratyakṣaṃ visaṃvādakaṃ ajñasya viṣadarśanamiva
nanu avikalpakaṃ sukhādinīlādinirbhāsijñānamavisaṃvādakam; na ca tadavisaṃvādakam api tu vikalpakameva vyavasāyātmakatvāt
tadavisaṃvādinaḥ pratyakṣasya nirvikalpakatve kṣaṇakṣayādivat sādhanāntaramapekṣate aniścayāditi
tasmānnāyamavikalpo'nubhavaḥ svalakṣaṇagrāhī yathārthanirbhāsaṃ vyavasāyayituṃ samartho'visaṃvādako nāma
na cāvikalpitena svabhāvena svalakṣaṇavyavasthāpanaṃ yuktamadvaitavaditi bhedābhāvāt

ajñānasya viṣe avyutpattisaṃśaya viparyāsopetasya saṃbandhi yat viṣadarśanaṃ svānubhūte vastuni saṃśayaviparyayakāri akiñcitkaraṃ vā tadiva viṣadarśanavat iti, sarvaṃ caturvidhamapi, yadi vā sarvam anabhyāsajamiva abhyāsajamapi darśanaṃ na pramāṇaṃ syāt bhavet
kathambhūtam ? avikalpakam abhilāpasaṃsargayogyapratibhāsā pratītiḥ kalpanā nyāyabi॰ 1
atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--yadi vikalpanirapekṣaṃ svatantraṃ darśanaṃ pramāṇam; hanta tarhi viṣā'jñasya viṣadarśanaṃ tathāvidhamanivāritamiti tadapi pramāṇaṃ syāt
tathā ca sati sandehādeḥ na kasyacid viṣe pravṛttiḥ iti

yatpunaḥ--yatraiva janayedenām anumānabuddhiṃ tatraivāsya pramāṇatā iti vyākhyānam; tadapyetena nirākṛtam; bhāvimaraṇasaṃbandhiviṣākāraviśeṣaliṅgadarśanasya sajātīya smaraṇasya ca anumānahetoḥ atrāpi kadācid bhāvāt anumānajananādapi pramāṇaṃ syāt
nanu kalpanātmakamapi viṣasya anyasya ca abhyāsadaśāyāṃ darśanaṃ pramāṇaṃ dṛśyate, tataḥ sarvaṃ darśanamapramāṇamiti vadato dṛṣṭabādhanamiti cet; atrāha--avisaṃvādahānitaḥ iti
abhyāsadaśāyāṃ pratiparamāṇuniyataṃ darśanaṃ pramāṇam iti yaḥ avisaṃvādaḥ avipratipattiḥ tasya hānitaḥ sarvaṃ darśanaṃ na pramāṇamiti
yadi vā, dṛṣṭasya paramāṇumātrasya aprāpteḥ taddhānitaḥ iti vyākhyeyam
viṣam ālokya darśanaviṣayīkṛtya tatra pramāṇayati pramāṇamācaṣṭe
ajño vyākhyātaḥ sa iva avyutpannaḥ avyutpattisaṃśayaviparyāsaḥsaugata ityabhiprāyaḥ
kiṃ punarna pramāṇayati ? ityatrāha--na punaḥ ityādi
3 iti evaṃ lakṣayati ca avadhārayati ca iti hetoḥ viparītalakṣaṇaprajño devānāṃpriyaḥ
yat pramāṇaṃ tadavisaṃvādakaṃ na bhavati, yacca avisaṃvādakaṃ tat pramāṇaṃ na vetti iti manyate
mā bhūt tarhi viṣadarśanaṃ pramāṇaṃ vyavasāyātmakaṃ vā jñānamavisaṃvādakamapi tudakamapi tu darśanamiti cet; atrāha--sarvameva ityādi
kena prakāreṇa ? kathaṃ pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇaṃ na kathaṃ cit
punarapi kathambhūtam ? ityatrāha--visaṃvādakaṃ visaṃvādakatvāt iti gamyate yathā sad anityam ityukte sattvāditi
kasya kimiva tattathāvidham ? ityatrāha— ajñasya viṣadarśanamiva iti

tathā ca prayogaḥ--sarvameva avikalpaṃ darśanaṃ na pramāṇaṃ visaṃvādakatvād ajñasya viṣadarśanavat iti yaduktaṃ pareṇa--vivādagocaramavikalpaṃ darśanaṃ pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇam avisaṃvādakatvāt iti; tatra hetorviruddhatāṃ darśayannāha--vyavasāyātmakasyaiva ityādi
nanu yaduktaṃ sarvameva ityādi; tatra asiddho hetuḥ; tathāvidhadarśanasyaiva avisaṃvādabhāvāditi cet; atrāha--tad ityādi
tasya vyavasāyātmano vijñānasya ya itaraḥ anyaḥ tasya visaṃvādāt

nanu avyavasāyātmakaṃ darśanaṃ visaṃvādakam avyavasāyātmakatvena ityucyamāne anityaḥ śabdaḥ śabdatvāt ityādivat pratijñātārthaikadeśā'siddho heturiti cet; āstāṃ tāvadetat, uttaratra asya vicārayiṣyamāṇatvāt
syānmatam--avikalpaṃ darśanaṃ yadyapi kṣaṇakṣayādau visaṃvādakaṃ tathāpi nīlādisukhādau saṃvādakamiti bhāgā'siddho heturiti
na ca naiva tat sukhādinīlādinirbhāsijñānam avisaṃsādakaṃ nirvikalpakam
kiṃ tarhi tat ? ityatrāha--api tu vikalpakameva iti

na cānyasya avisaṃvādakatvadharmaḥ anyasya iti parikalpya bhāgāsiddhatā hetoḥ parikalpayituṃ śakyā, anyathā kvacit śabdādau sāmānyādiprasiddham asattvādikaṃ parikalpya tathā tadapi bhāgā'siddham udbhāvanīyaṃ bhavet
tad vikalpakamiti kuto'vagamyate iti cet ? atrāha--tad iti
tasya sukhādinīlādinirbhāsasya avisaṃvādinaḥ pratyakṣasya nirvikalpakatve aṅgīkriyamāṇe kṣaṇakṣayādinirbhāsavat sādhanāntaramapekṣate pratyakṣam iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
kuta etat ? ityatrāha--aniścayādivat sukhādi svabhāvasya pratyakṣeṇa aniścayāditi
nanu yadi nāma sādhanāntaramapekṣate avikalpakaṃ darśanaṃ naitāvatā visaṃvādakaṃ sādhanāntarānugraheṇa sutarāmavisaṃvādakatvasiddheḥ āgamavat
darśane'pi tathā ca sati svārtha siddhivi॰ 1
23 ityādinā kalpanāyāḥ antaḥsvalakṣaṇasya dvayanirbhāsapratīteḥ siddhivi॰ ityādinā ca vibhramasya vyavasthāpitatvāt darśanaṃ visaṃvādayatyeva
kuta etat ? ityatrāha--yathā darśanamiti darśanā'natikrameṇa yathādarśanam nirṇayasya ayogāt
yadi yathādarśanaṃ nirṇayaḥ syāt tarhi tadanugrahāt tadavisaṃvādakaṃ nitarāṃ bhavediti yuktam, na caivamasti iti manyate

viśeṣākāreṇa sajātīyetaravilakṣaṇākāreṇa cakṣurādibuddhīn arthānāṃ sukhādinīlādīnām anavabhāsanāt kāraṇāt na caitat nirvikalpakamavisaṃvādakam iti saṃbandhaḥ api tu vikalpakameva ityatrāpi tadāha--sāmānya ityādi
sāmānyākāreṇa, ca śabdaḥ viśeṣākāreṇa ityasya samuccayārthaḥ, vyavasāyā'nirṇayāt cakṣurādibuddhau arthānām api tu vikalpakameva iti padaghaṭanā
nanu avikalpakaṃ ca sukhādinīlādinirbhāsijñānam avisaṃvādakam ityasya sādhikāṃ parasya yuktiṃ pradarśya dūṣayannāha--yathāpratipatrabhiprāyam ityādi
pramāṇasya lakṣaṇam avisaṃvādakatvam pramāṇamavisaṃvādi jñānam pra॰ vā॰ 1
kathaṃbhūtaṃ tat ? ityatrāha--yathāpratipatrabhiprāyam dṛśyaprāpyayornaikatvam, anyathā dṛśyameva prāpyameva vā syāt
tathāpi tayorekatvādhyavasāyād yadeva dṛṣṭaṃ tadeva prāptam iti pratipatṝṇām abhiprāyaḥ tasya anatikrameṇa yathāpratipatrabhiprāyam na pāramārthikam ityabhiprāyaḥ

athavā, marīcikājalavat satyābhimatamapi jalaṃ na paramārthasat, tathāpi atra vāsanādārḍhyena ciraṃ pratibhāsānugamena satyametat jalam arthakriyākāritvāt netarad viparyayāt iti teṣāmabhiprāyaḥ, tasya anatikrameṇa yathāpratipatrabhiprāyam

yadi vā, jāgraddaśāvat svapnadaśānāmapi dṛṣṭasya prāptiḥ avisaṃvādo'sti iti tajjñānamapi pramāṇaṃ prasaktam, tathāpi na tayā jātaparitoṣā jantavo jāyante iti na sā arthaprāptiḥ, jāgraddaśāyāṃ tu viparyayād bhavati iti teṣāmabhiprāyaḥ tasya anatikrameṇa yathāpratipatrabhiprāyam iti
nanvevamapi vikalpakamavisaṃvādakaṃ prāptam, tatraivāsya sadbhāvāditi cet atrāha--pramāṇāntarābādhitaviṣayam iti
pramāṇāntareṇa abādhito viṣayo yasya tat tathoktam pramāṇalakṣaṇam iti
tat punaḥ avikalpa eva saṃbhavi na vikalpe, sāmānyādeḥ pramāṇāntareṇa bādhanāditi; tatra dūṣaṇamāha--ayuktam iti
antarbahiśca sarvaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ niraṃśam iti bauddhasya svam atmīyaṃ mataṃ tasya vyāghātāt
na hi kṣaṇikā niraṃśāḥ paramāṇavo dṛṣṭāḥ prāptā veti pratipatṝṇāmabhiprāyo'sti, yataḥ tasya anatikrameṇaṃ tallakṣaṇaṃ yuktaṃ bhavet

yadi ca yathāpratipatrabhiprāyaṃ na pāramārthikaṃ tallakṣaṇaṃ kutaḥ kṣaṇikāḥ sarvasaṃskārāḥ ityādikasya nānyo'nubhāvyo buddhyāsti ityādikasya ca paramārthataḥ siddhiḥ samayāntaravat ? pratibhāsādvaitasya niṣiddhatvāt niṣetsyamānatvācca anantarameva
vāsanādārḍhyametat na tvartha eva sādhayituṃ śakyaḥ
bhūtiryaiṣāṃ kriyā saiva kārakaṃ saiva cocyate
kṣaṇikāḥ sarvasaṃskārāḥ vijñānamātramevedaṃ bho jinaputrāḥ yadidaṃ traidhātukam--sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 731
kathaṃbhūtaḥ ? svalakṣaṇagrāhī yathārthanirbhāsam arthanirbhāsā'natikrameṇa vyavasāyapituṃ vyavasāyaṃ kartuṃ na samarthaḥ avisaṃvādako nāma kintu visaṃvādaka eva
nanu na vyavasāyakaraṇād avisaṃvādakaḥ api tu svalakṣaṇagrahaṇāt
vyavasāyo'pi tadgrahaṇāt nā'paraḥ, jātyādipratibhāsasya indriyajñāne niṣedhāditi cet; atrāha— na ca ityādi
na ca naiva avikalpitena aniścitena svabhāvena svarūpeṇa svalakṣaṇasya vyavasthāpanaṃ yuktam upapannam
puruṣādvaitam iha advaitaṃ gṛhyate na pratibhāsādvaitaṃ tatra bauddhasya vivādābhāvāt, tasya iva tadvaditi
nanu advaita-svalakṣaṇayoḥ apratibhāsetarakṛto viśeṣo'sti ataḥ advaitavat ityayuktamiti cet; atrāha--bhedā'bhāvāt iti
bhedasya viśeṣasya abhāvāt svalakṣaṇasyāpi apratibhāsanāditi manyate

atha matam--tadadvaitaṃ yadi sukhādinīlādipratibhāsātmakaṃ tarhi sākāre saugatadarśane puruṣa iti nāma kṛtaṃ bhavet, anyathā acetanaṃ nāvabhāsate ityasat, sukhādinīlādisattve ca na tadadvaitam, tadasattve prakṛte'pi tadastu iti; tatrottaramāha--vikalpānām ityādi

vikalpānāṃ sukhādinīlādibhedānāṃ bhedaikānte'pi niraṃśasvalakṣaṇaikānte'pi na kevalam advaite niḥsvabhāvatopapatteḥ asattvopapatteḥ, anyathāpratibhāsasya tatrāpi bhāvāditi bhāvaḥ, anyathā anekāntasiddhiḥ ityuktam

idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam--niraṃśasvalakṣaṇadarśanānantarabhāvināṃ vikalpānāṃ yathā sthūlādidūrādibhedā viṣayāḥ tathā niḥkalapuruṣadarśanānantarabhāvināṃ teṣāṃ sukhādinīlādibhedā viṣayāḥ, teṣāṃ ca vikalpānāṃ bhedaikānte'pi niḥsvabhāvatopapatteḥ
svaḥ ātmīyaḥ saugatakalpito bhāvaḥ padārthaḥ tasmānniṣkrāntānāṃ bhāvaḥ tatra tasyā upapatteḥ bhedā'bhāvāditi sambandhaḥ
bhavatvevaṃ tathāpi na tat pratyakṣam; mānasatvena vaiśadyavirahāt, tathā coktam— na vikalpānuviddhasya spaṣṭārthapratibhāsitā
svapne'pi smaryate smārttaṃ na ca tat tādṛgarthadṛg
svapne'pi smaryate smārttaṃ na ca tat tādṛgarthadṛg || pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 283
mānaso hi vikalpo rāgādirūpaḥ pratisaṃkhyānena pratipakṣatattvajñānena nivartyate
na hīdaṃ svārthavyavasāyātmakaṃ mānasaṃ pratyakṣam, gavi sannihite mānasīṃ gobuddhiṃ vinivartya tadā aśvakalpanāyāmapi goreva viniścayāt
tasmādidaṃ spaṣṭaṃ vyavasāyātmakaṃ jñānaṃ svārthasannidhānānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyi pratisaṃkhyānirodhyavisaṃvādakaṃ pramāṇaṃ yuktam
kathaṃbhūtam ? vyavasāyātma nirṇayātmakaṃ mānasaṃ manonimittam na ca naiva matam
pratyakṣaṃ viśadam--indriyāśritaṃ vā yata idaṃ tanna mānasamiti
tathāpi mānasatve asya dvicandradijñānasyāpi mānasatvamiti vyāhatametat--
tathā ca prayogaḥ--etad vivādagocarāpannaṃ jñānaṃ na mānasam, pratisaṃkhyā'nirodhyatvāt, yat punarmānasaṃ na tat pratisaṃkhyā'nirodhyaṃ yathā gavi sannihite gaurayam iti mānaso vikalpaḥ
aśubhādyālambanā rāgādipratipakṣabhūtā prajñā pratisaṃkhyānam--tattvasa॰ pa॰ pṛ॰ 547
tena prajñāviśeṣeṇa prāpyo nirodhaḥ iti pratisaṃkhyānirodhaḥ
kuta etat ? pratyakṣaṃ viśadam akṣāśritaṃ vā yataḥ
gobuddhim gaurayaṃ mahān śuklaḥ dīrghaḥ anyathā vā ityādi parāmarśātmikāṃ mānasīṃ vinivitya tadā tadvivarttanakāle goreva viniścayāt
kasyāṃ satyām ? ityāha--aśvakalpanāyāmapi na kevalaṃ tadakalpanāyām
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadyayaṃ sthirasthūlasādhāraṇākāre goniścayaḥ prakṛtagobuddhivat mānasaḥ; tarhi tadvad aśvakalpanāyāṃ vinivarteta
tatkalpanākāle godarśanaṃ yadi avikalpakam; tarhi kṣaṇakṣayadarśanavat tadvyavahāro na bhavet tadvikalpānutpatteḥ, yugapad vikalpadvayānabhyupagamāt
evakāreṇa punaḥ etat kathayati— darśanamātrāt tathā govyavahāre kṣaṇakṣayādivyavahāro'pi bhaved viśeṣābhāvāt

nanu yadā goviniścayo na tadā aśvavikalpanā, jainasya yugapad upayogadvayā'nutpatteriti cet; mānasaṃ samamupayogadvayaṃ yugapanneṣyate na indriyamānase, kathamanyathā nyā ya vi ni śca ye— sahabhuvo guṇāḥ ityasya--
śaktiḥ kriyānumeyā syāt yūnaḥ kāntāsamāgame || iti nidarśanaṃ syāt ?
etena akṣaṇikajñānalakṣaṇasamāropavyavacchedāt kṣaṇikānumānaṃ pramāṇam iti nirastam; akṣaṇikajñānasya samāropatvā'siddheḥ, aśvakalpanāyāmapi tannivṛttyasiddheḥ iti
saḥ anantaroktaḥ punaḥ iti yuktyantarasūcakaḥ, niścayaḥ govyavasāyaḥ vikalpāntaravad īśvarādivikalpavat yadi mānasaḥ syāt tathā arthasya sannidhiṃ yogyadeśādyavasthitiṃ na apekṣeta
yata evaṃ tasmād idam anantaroktam spaṣṭaṃ viśadaṃ vyavasāyātmakaṃ jñānam
kathaṃbhūtam ? svārthasannidhānānvayavyatire kānuvidhāyi pratisaṃkhyā'nirodhyavisaṃvādakaṃ pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇaṃ yuktam

atha tasya svārthasannidhānānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitvaṃ cet; arthakāryatā, iti la dhī ya stra ye tatpratiṣedho virudhyate iti; tanna; notpattau tadanvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitvam, api tu vyāpāro , arthe sadgrahaṇe vyāpriyate nānyathā iti ācāryābhiprāyāt
na ca indriyavibhramāḥ pratisaṃkhyānena nivartyante candramekam iti bhāvayato'pi dvicandrapratibhāsānivṛtteriti
tathā ca aniścitārthaniścayena avisaṃvādakaṃ jñānaṃ spaṣṭapratibhāsamanyadvā pramāṇaṃ nāparam
tato vyavasāya eva avisaṃvādaniyamo'dhigamaśca niścetavyaḥ tatraiva tadbhāvāt, tadvaśādeva tatpratiṣṭhānāt
sāmānyaviśeṣātmakatattvam avastu viṣayo yasya tat tathoktam
kiṃ tarhi pramāṇam ? na kiñcid ityarthaḥ
avikalpakaṃ darśanam iti cet; atrāha--anyataḥ ityādi
anyataḥ mithyaikāntavādikalpitāt pramāṇād arthasiddhiḥ atyantam asaṃbhavāt
nanu siddhiḥ adhigatimātraṃ tato'pi saṃbhavati iti cet; atrāha--siddheḥ nirṇayātmakatvāt

darśanam arthasākṣātkaraṇaṃ niraṃśādarthāt tadākārātmalābha iti yāvat, tadeva siddhiḥ iti yā saugatasya pratijñā tasyāṃ ca kriyamāṇāyāṃ siddheḥ jñapteḥ anupapatteḥ darśanasya, siddheḥ nirṇayātmakatvam iti
punarapi kathaṃbhūtasya ? sādhanāntarapratīkṣasya sādhanāntare pratīkṣā yasya iti
anena darśanā'bhāvāt na tatsiddhiḥ ityuktaṃ bhavati
yatpunaretat--adhigatistatphalam iti; tad arthato nirākṛtam, śabdato nirākurvannāha--adhigatiḥ ityapi na kevalamanyā api tu adhigatirityapi yā siddhiḥ parasya sāpi nirṇītireva
tataḥ kiṃ jātam ? ityāha--tathā ca ityādi
tathā ca tena ca prakāreṇa aniścitasya arthasya yo niścayaḥ na darśanamātram, tena avisaṃvādakaṃ jñānaṃ spaṣṭapratibhāsam anyadvā'spaṣṭapratibhāsaṃ pramāṇaṃ nāparam iti yuktaṃ paśyāmaḥ
yata evaṃ tato vyavasāya eva nirṇaye eva avisaṃvādaniyamaḥ adhigamaḥ svārthagrahaṇaṃ ca niścetavyaḥ
kuta etat ? ityatrāha--tatraiva vyavasāya eva antayoḥ avisaṃvādaniyama-adhigamayoḥ bhāvāt
etadapi kutaḥ ? ityatrāha— tadvaśādeva vyavasāyādeva tatpratiṣṭhānāt tayoḥ pratiṣṭhānāt
evaṃ vyavasāyātmakamavisaṃvādijñānaṃ pramāṇaṃ vyavasthāpya sāmprataṃ tataḥ pravṛttikramaṃ darśayati anāgatamarthaṃ ca sūtrayati--akṣajñānaiḥ ityādinā
taiḥ svaviṣayagrahaṇam avagrahādyātmikā matiḥ bahubahuvidhakṣiprāniḥsṛtānuktadhruvāṇāṃ setaraprakārāṇām
nahi saṃvitteḥ bahubahuvidhaprabhṛtyākṛtayaḥ svayamasaṃviditā evodayante vyayante vā yataḥ satyo'pyanupalakṣitāḥ syuḥ kalpanāvat tathetarākṛtayaḥ
svalakṣaṇasāmānyalakṣaṇaikānte punaḥ saṃvedanākṛtīḥ na paśyāmaḥ tathaivāpaśyantaḥ kathamātmānameva vipralabhāmahe

manyate mananaṃ vā iti matiḥ, smaraṇaṃ smṛtiḥ, saṃjñānaṃ saṃjñā, cintanaṃ cintā, abhinibodhanamabhinibodha iti tathāmananti ta ttvā rtha sū tra kā rāḥ— matiḥ smṛtiḥ saṃjñācintābhinibodha ityanarthāntaram ta॰ sū॰ 1
matismṛtyādayaḥ śabdayojanāmantareṇa na bhavantītyekānto na yatastatrāntarbhāvyeran
tadekānte punaḥ na kvacit syuḥ tannāmasmṛterayogāt anavasthānādeḥ

ato nibandhanasthānād vākyāntarāṇi upaplavante--akṣajñānaiḥ tadbhedān viniścitya pravartate ityekaṃ vākyam, anusmṛtya tadbhedān pravartate iti dvitīyam, pratyabhijñāya tadbhedān pravartate iti tṛtīyam, cintayan vitarkayan tadbhedān pravartate iti caturtham, ābhimukhyena tadbhedān viniścatya pravartate iti pañcamam, cintayannābhimukhyena tadbhedānviniścitya pravartate iti ṣaṣṭhaṃ samuditam
tatra akṣāṇi cakṣurādīni indriyāṇi teṣāṃ kāryabhūtaiḥ jñānaiḥ tadbhedān hitāhitārthaviśeṣān viniścitya pravartate puruṣaḥ
nahi tasyāṃ pravarttamāno niyamena sajātīyānusmaraṇādikamapekṣate janaḥ tathā'pratīteḥ amumevārthamāśritya abhyāse bhāvini pravarttakatvāt pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇam iti
tatsarvaṃ yuktam, idaṃ tu ayuktam pra jñā ka ra gu pte noktam— bhāvini iti; dāhādikāraṇe pāvakādau lokasya pravṛttidarśanāt

dāhādyadarśane kathaṃ tat tatkāraṇam iti pratīyate iti cet ? abhyāsāt kinna jāyate ? svayaṃ ca vyavahāramāśritya tato'pratipannamapi pratyakṣeṇa bhāvi pratipannamicchan tameva āśritya varttamānaṃ tatkāraṇaṃ pratyakṣamicchantaṃ na sahate iti prākṛtabuddhiḥ
yatrātyantābhyāsādavikalpayato'pi pravartanaṃ tatra pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇam--pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 218
tasmād vyavahāramātraprasiddhānumānāśrayeṇa prasiddhaṃ sambandhamāśritya tadetadarthakriyāsādhanamiti darśanena spṛśyādisādhanasya pratipattau pravartate
paścādabhyāsānumānamantareṇāpi pratibhāsamātrādeva vṛttiriti pratyakṣamapi pravartakatvāt pramāṇam
athavā, yaduktam--gavi sannihite gobuddhiṃ vinivarttya tadā aśvakalpanāyāmapi goreva viniściyāt iti; tatra pravṛttau idaṃ vākyam, tatra anusmṛtyādervirodhāt
pratyabhijñāya tadbhedān tu pravartate ityetat punaḥ tadevedaṃ tena sadṛśam iti vā anusandhānamātreṇa pravṛttau
ābhimukhyena tadbhedān viniścitya pravartate ityetat akasmād dhūmadarśanāt pāvako'tra iti pravṛttau
cintayan ābhimukhyena tadbhedān viniścitya pravartate ityetat anityaḥ śabdaḥ śrāvaṇatvāt ityādyanumānāt pravṛttau
samuditaṃ tu vākyam vahniratra, dhūmāt, yatra yatra dhūmaḥ tatra tatra vahniḥ yathā mahānasādau, dhūmaścātra ityevamādyanumānāt pravṛttau
tatra akṣajñānaiḥ pūrvamanayoḥ sambandhe gṛhīte sati punastaireva kvacit dhūme viṣayīkṛte pūrvasaṃskāraprabodhaḥ, tataḥ smṛtiḥ, tasyāḥ pratyabhijñā, punaḥ tarkaḥ, ato'numānaṃ tataḥ pravṛttiriti
taiḥ sparśanādibhiḥ kāraṇabhūtaiḥ svaviṣayāṇāṃ sparśādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ tadgrāhakaṃ yajjanyate jñānam
bahu ca yugapat samānajātīyānāṃ bahūnāṃ grahaṇam, bahuvidhaṃ ca bhinnajātīyānām, kṣipraṃ ca jhaṭiti, aniḥsṛtaṃ ca ālokādyanapema anuktaṃ ca pānakādau guḍādirasaviśeṣasya akathitaṃ ca
kathaṃbhūtānām ? setaraprakārāṇām saha itaraprakāraiḥ abahvādibhiḥ vartamānānām
tathā ca sati kiṃ siddham ? ityatrāha--ata eva ityādi
yata eva taiḥ svaviṣayāṇāṃ grahaṇamevaṃvidham, ata eva anekāntasiddhiḥ
nanu āgamādeva kevalāt sarvametat siddhaṃ nānyataḥ anupalakṣaṇāt, tato bhavata āgamikatvamiti cet; atrāha--nahi ityādi

nahi saṃvitteḥ indriyamateḥ sambandhinyaḥ bahubahuvidhaprabhṛtyākṛtayaḥ svayam ātmanā asaṃviditā eva ajñātā eva udayanta utpadyante vyayante vinaśyanti vā yato yasmād asaṃviditodayavyayāt satyo'pi anupalakṣitāḥ syuḥ
yathā nahi imāḥ kalpanāḥ ityādi vacanāt īśvarādikalpanā nā'nupalakṣitāḥ udayante vyayante ca tathā prakṛtā api iti
tathā tenaiva prakāreṇa itarākṛtayaḥ abahvādyākṛtayaḥ na satyo'pi anupalakṣitā udayante vyayante vā iti
tarhi tathaiva svalakṣaṇasaṃvedanākṛtayaḥ sāmānyasaṃvedanākṛtaya eva vā svayaṃ svasaṃviditā eva udayante vyayante ceti cet; atrāha--svalakṣaṇa ityādi
svalakṣaṇaṃ ca sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ ca te eva ekāntau tayoḥ saṃvedanākṛtīḥ punaḥ na paśyāmaḥ
tathāpi tāḥ satyaḥ kalpyatāmiti cet; atrāha--tathaiva ityādi
tathaiva paraparikalpitaprakāreṇaiva apaśyattata kathaṃ kalpanayā svalakṣaṇasāmānyalakṣaṇaikānte saṃvedanākṛtikalpanayā ātmānameva vipralabhāmahe vañcayāmaḥ
tadāha--na cemāḥ kalpanā apratisaṃviditā evodayante vyayante ceti
tatta got evam uktaprakāreṇa paramārthataḥ siddhiḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ niṣpattiḥ pratipattirvā anekāntād anekāntamāśritya
ta ttvā rtha sū tra kā reṇa sahātmanaḥ ekavākyatāṃ darśayannāha--tathā ityādi
tathā uktaprakāreṇa āmananti ta ttvā rtha sū tra kā rāḥ
katham ? ityāha--matiḥ smṛtiḥ saṃjñā cintābhinibodha ityanarthāntaram ta॰ sū॰ 1

tato'yamartho jāyate--matiḥ pravartikā iti, smṛtiḥ pravartikā iti, saṃjñā pravartikā iti, cintā pravartikā iti, abhinibodhaḥ pravartakaḥ, cintābhinibodhaḥ pravartakaḥ, matiḥ smṛtiḥ saṃjñā cintā'bhinibodhaḥ pravartakaḥ iti ca
mananaṃ matiḥ smaraṇaṃ smṛtiḥ saṃjñānaṃ saṃjñā cintanaṃ cintā ābhimukhyena niyataṃ bodhanamabhinibodha iti--ta॰ vā॰ 1
nanu ca etanmatyādikamanyonyaṃ bhinnamabhinnaṃ vā ? ubhayathāpi svalakṣaṇa ityādi virudhyate iti cet; atrāha--anarthāntaram iti
