uktaṃ ca la ghī ya stra ye--pramāṇaphalayoḥ kramabhāve'pi tādātmyaṃ pratyeyam laghī॰ sva॰ ślo॰ 6 iti
athavā, yadāvagrahaviṣayīkṛtam īhā pratyeti, īhitam avāyo'vaiti, avāyānubhūtaṃ dhāraṇā, evam uttaratrāpi yojyam, tadevamāha anarthāntaram iti, kathañcidabhinnaviṣaya matyādikam ityarthaḥ
antyavākyāpekṣayā anarthāntaram— abhinnapravṛttiprayojanam iti vā vyākhyeyam

nanu matyādikaṃ sarvam abhidhānapurassarameva svārthaṃ pratyeti iti śabdaśruta evāntarbhāvo'sya, tathā ca taccintane evāsya cintā bhaviṣyati iti pṛthagiha cintanamanarthakamiti cet; atrāha— śabdayojanam ityādi
matismṛtyādayaḥ śabdayojanamantareṇa te na bhavanti kintu tadyojane sati bhavanti ityevam ekānto na, yata ekāntāt tatra antarbhāvyeran ityarthaḥ
yata iti vā ākṣepe, naiva saṃkīryeran
sa cāsau ekāntaśca tasmin aṅgīkriyamāṇe punaḥ na kvacid bahirantarvā syuḥ matismṛtyādayaḥ
yasya nāmnā yojanāt mṛtismṛtyādayaḥ tat tannāma ityucyate, tasya smṛterayogāt
etaduktaṃ bhavati--na yatra yatra svārthaḥ tatra tatra tannāma, yataḥ tadyojanāt niyamena matismṛtyādayaḥ syuḥ api tu saṅketasya yojanāt, tatsmṛtereva ca ayogāt prakṛtamiti
kuta etat ? ityatrāha--anavasthānādeḥ anavasthānamādiryasya anyonyasaṃśrayasya sa tathoktaḥ tasmāt
tathāhi--prathamā nāmasmṛtiḥ tadviṣayābhidhānasmṛteḥ, sāpi tadviṣayanāmasmṛteḥ ityanavasthā
sannihite ca vastuni matyādinā nirṇīte nāmaviśeṣe smṛtiḥ, tasyāśca satyādiḥ ityanyo'nyasamāśrayaḥ
ata eva apratipattiḥ pratipatterabhāvaḥ, andhamūkaṃ jagat syāditi manyate
evaṃ tāvat pramāṇasya phalaṃ sākṣāt siddhiḥ svārthavi niścayaḥ siddhivi॰ 1
tannairātmyamapītareṇa na vivekātmā na sā yujyate || 28
kathambhūtāyāḥ ? ityāha— sthūlaikacitrākṛteḥ sthūlā ekā citrā śabalā ākṛtiḥ ākāro yasyāḥ sā tathoktaḥ tasyāḥ sañcitālambanāḥ pañca vijñānakāyāḥ iti rāddhāntāt
kena ? buddhena itara kena ? di gnā gā di nā
kathaṃ pralapatā ? aślīlameva asambaddhameva yathā bhavati ākulaṃ ca
apiśabdaḥ bhinnaprakramaḥ atra draṣṭavyaḥ ca śabdārthaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā nīlākṛteḥ saṃvitteḥ nīlaṃ pratyakṣaṃ na pītādi, sārūpyakalpanāvaiphalyabhayāt tathā sthūlaikacitrākṛteḥ tasyāḥ pratyakṣo viṣayo'pi tathāvidha eva kalpanīyo na paramāṇavaḥ iti
yatpunaratroktaṃ pra jñā ka ra gu pte na--tathāvidhāyāḥ tathāvidhaviṣayasiddhiḥ dūrasthitaviralakeśeṣu atadātmasu tathāvidhāyāḥ tasyāḥ darśanāt

iti; tatra na tarhi paramāṇavaḥ tasyāḥ pratyakṣaḥ santo viṣayāḥ kintu anumeyāḥ, itarathā dūrasthitaviralakeśā api aneka saṃvitterviṣayāḥ tathā iti na bhrāntaṃ nāma kiñcit, yannirāsārtham abhrāntagrahaṇaṃ kriyamāṇamarthavat syāt

atha tatkeśānāṃ viralanānanukaraṇe'pi kṛṣṇatāmātrānukaraṇavat paramāṇūnāmanyonyavivekānanukaraṇe'pi nīlatāmātrānukaraṇāt te pratyakṣā iti; tarhi ekasya gṛhītetararūpatayā anekāntasiddhiḥ aiti syādvādavidveṣiṇā alam alam iti
na tattvataḥ tasyāḥ te pratyakṣaṃ kṣāḥ kintu vyavahāreṇeti cet; uktamatra nīlākārasaṃvitteḥ nīlavat tasyā api sthūlaikacitrārthapratyakṣatāprasaṅgāditi
yathaiva keśā davīyasi deśe asaṃsaktā api ghanasanniveśāvabhāsinaḥ paramāṇavo'pi tatheti na virodhaḥ
kiṃca, saṃvittivad ekasya sthūlaikacitrākāro'pi na virudhyate iti, evamarthaṃ ca sthūlaikacitrākṛteḥ iti vacanam
tarhi pratiparamāṇubhedāt saṃvittirapi tathāvidhā mā bhūt
kiṃ syāt sā citrataikasyāṃ na syāttasyāṃ matāvapi
na kevalaṃ bahirartho'pitu sā'pi saṃvittirapi vivekātmā na na yujyate yujyetaiva, pratiṣedhadvayena prakṛtārthagateḥ, itarathā uktanyāyena sakalaśūnyatā syāditi manyate
yata evaṃ tasmāt nairātmyaṃ sakalaśūnyatvaṃ bahirantarvā iti evaṃ pralapatā ityādinā sambandhaḥ
iti śrī ra vi bha dra pādopajīvi-a na nta vī rya viracitāyāṃ si ddhi vi ni śca ya ṭī kā yāṃ pratyakṣasiddhiḥ prathamaḥ prastāvaḥ
27 ityādinā uktamartham itaragranthena samarthayitukāmaḥ tadādau saṃgrahavṛttatrayaṃ svārtha ityādikamāha--
asyā'yamarthaḥ--svaṃ ca arthaśca tayoḥ grāhako'vagrahaḥ svārthā'vagrahaḥ svārthāvagrahaśca ni pūrvād iṇaḥ kti śati bhavati, anyasyā'prakṛtatvāt, pratyāsatteśca avagraheṇa nītam avagatam iti gamyate
tatra bhedavacanasānnidhyāt dvividhaṃ sāmānyam iti ca, tasya bhedo viśeṣo viṣayaḥ yasyā ākāṅkṣāyā īhāyāḥ sā tathoktā, tāvātmānau svabhāvau yasyāḥ sā tadātmikeyaṃ matiḥ
kiṃ karoti ? ityatrāha--saṃskāratāṃ yāti dhāraṇātmikā bhavati
kiṃ kṛtvā ? ityatrāha--bhedāvāyamupetya upaḍhaukya nirṇayamayaṃ tadātmikā bhūtā ityarthaḥ
ataḥ asyāḥ mateḥ param anyad aspaṣṭajñānaṃ śrutam śrutamaspaṣṭatarkaṇam ta॰ ślo॰ pṛ॰ 237 iti vacanāt
ataḥ ityetad anenāpi sambadhyate--tato mateḥ smṛtiḥ, tayā smṛtyā kāraṇabhūtayā pratyabhijñānatā tadevedaṃ tena sadṛśam iti vā pratyabhijñāvatā puruṣeṇa ūhaviṣayād hetoḥ liṅgād anumā kalpyā
abhi samantād arthasya sāmānyarūpeṇeva viśeṣarūpeṇāpi niścito bodho grahaṇam tatra niyuktā na punaḥ sāmānyāpohamātragrahaṇa iti manyate
athavā, pūrvajñānāpekṣayā kathañcidatinavasya apūrvasyārthasya grahaṇam abhinibodhaḥ tatra niyuktā matipūrvaṃ śrutam ta॰ sū॰ 1
mateḥ smṛtiḥ, tataḥ pratyabhijñā, ata ūhaḥ, asmād aśābdānumā śrutam ityuktaṃ bhavati
ato'pi paraṃ śābdayojitaṃ jñānaṃ śrutam iti
yathā bauddhānām anumānaṃ sāmānyaviṣayaṃ na tathā
syānmatam--darśanam, ataśca bhedaniścaya iti kiṃ tadantarāle ākāṅkṣayā iti ? tatrottaramāha--vaiśadyam ityādi
pratyakṣaṃ na tato'nanvayadhiyāṃ kā vāsanānāṃ kathā || 2

vaiśadyaṃ svalakṣaṇasākṣātkaraṇaṃ yadi bhedaniścayakaram avāyaṃ karotīti cet; dṛṣṭedarśanasya saṃbandhi tadvaiśadyam ekāntato'vaśyaṃ bhāvataḥ sarvasmāt sajī sajātīyādvijātīyāyācca parataḥ anyasyād vastunaḥ sakāśāt karotu
kim ? viparītāropavicchedanaṃ viparītasya guṇāntarasya āropavit samāropajñānaṃ tasyāḥ chedanaṃ vināśaḥ tadaviśeṣāt
nāyaṃ doṣaḥ, sarvatra darśanapāṭavāderabhāvāt iti parasya ākūtaṃ kṛtottaramiti mattvā tatpakṣāntaramāśaṅkate saṃkalpa ityādi

kalpanaṃ kalpaḥ vyavasāyaḥ, samīcīnaḥ kalpaḥ yathāvasthitabhedaniścayaḥ tasmāyāhitā vyavasthāpitā, tena vā, vāsanā tasyāḥ pariṇatiḥ svakāryotpādanasāmarthyaparipākaḥ sā citrā śabalā dṛṣṭārthavaiśadyāviśeṣe'pi kvacideva aṃśe bhedaniścayahetuḥ sā na sarvatra
na vikalpotpattiḥ, ataḥ samāropavyavacchedāya anumānaṃ saphalamiti
kramaṇaṃ kāminī bhakṣyā iti sā vikalpanāḥ
īhanam īhā, pratyakṣasya tataḥ tatpariṇateḥ citratāyāḥ sakāśād astu pratyakṣam īhātmakaṃ bhavatu
etaduktaṃ bhavati--na upādānajñānād anyā vāsanā, tatpariṇateḥ citratvena jñānapariṇatireva citrā ityuktaṃ bhavati
na ca avagraha jñānādanyat pūrvam avāyajñānāt pratīyate tataḥ sā avagṛhītaviśeṣākāṅkṣāpariṇatisvabhāvā astu iti
na ca parasya vāsanā iti darśayannāha--ananvaya ityādi
anvayāt niṣkrāntadhiyāṃ saugatānām kā na kācid vāsanānāṃ kathā iti nirūpayiṣyate kāryakāraṇatā nāsti siddhivi॰ 4

nanu pūrvaparyāyapravṛttamadhyakṣaṃ nottaraparyāye vṛttimat, nāpi uttaraparyāyaviṣayaṃ pūrvaparyāyavītvaṃkṣamam, ata eva nānumānamapi, tatkuto'vagrahādyātmakatvaṃ kasyacit pratīyate ? na caikasya anekātmakatvam virodhāditi cet; atrāha--pratyakṣam ityādi
vicitro nānāprakāro viṣayo nīlādiḥ, tadākāra iva ākāro yasya ekasya abhinnasaṃvedanasya tat tathoktam, yasyāpi yaugasya nirākāraṃ taṃ prati vicitraviṣayākāreṣu ekasaṃvedanam iti vyākhyeyam
tathā ca yaugasya prayogaḥ--kṣaṇikā buddhiḥ asmadādipratyakṣatve sati vibhudravyaviśeṣaguṇatvāt śabdavat iti

tad anyathā aṅgīkurvataḥ saugatasya na kiñcit sidhyediti manyamāna evaṃ pṛcchati, yaugasyāpi prativiṣayaṃ vijñānabhedamabhyupagacchataḥ sadasadvargaḥ kasyacid ekajñānālambanam anekatvāt pañcāṅgulavat ityatra sādhyadṛṣṭāntavirodhaḥ iti ca
sukhaduḥkhamohagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇam, tena sarvātītānāgatavarttamānaparyāyā gṛhyante, te ca te vividhākārāśca teṣvekaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ tadekaḥ sa cāsau jīvaśca
yadi vā, sukhaduḥkhamohā vividhākārāḥ svabhāvabhūtā dharmā yasya sa tathoktaḥ, sa cāsau ekajīvaśca na kiṃ tattvam ? api tu tattvameva
yathaiva hi yugapat saṃvedanaṃ citramātmānaṃ pratyakṣayati, nāpi tena virudhyate; tathaiva krameṇa jīvaḥ tathā pratyakṣayati tena vā na virudhyata iti bhāvaḥ
tulanā--anityaḥ śabdaḥ guṇatve sati asmadādīndriyaviṣayatvāt buddhivat
nanu saugataṃ sākārajñānavādinaṃ prati atattve tadaniṣṭaṃ na yaugaṃ nirākārajñānavādinaṃ prati
sa hi nirākāreṇa ekajñānena anekamarthaṃ viṣayīkarotīti cet; na; ekena svabhāvena tadviṣayīkaraṇe kutaḥ arthabhedaḥ ? itarathā ekasvabhāvāt kāraṇāt kāryabhedaḥ syāt

nanu ekasmin santāne sukhe utpadyamāne anubhūyamāne vā na duḥkhamohādaya utpadyante anubhūyante vā, vinaśyati, tato bhinnayogakṣematvāt rāmā'rjunādivat teṣāṃ bheda eva iti saugataḥ; etadeva darśayannāha--yoga ityādi
yogaḥ utpādaḥ kṣemovināśaḥ saṃvedanaṃ vā, tayoḥ bhedā'bhedenānu prakṛte sukhādau iti cet; atrottaramāha--santāna ityādi

idamatra tātparyam-- ekasantānavyapadeśabhājāṃ bhede sādhye sukhādīnāṃ bhinnayogakṣematvāt, yat anyad--bhinnaṃ citraṃ jñānaṃ tad vipakṣaḥ, tasya ca hetuviparyayeṇa abhinnayogakṣemena anavayavena vyāptau, tato nivartamāno bhinnayogakṣemalakṣaṇo hetuḥ tadbhedaṃ sādhayet nānyathā, hetuviparyayasyāpi sādhyaviparyayeṇa vyāptau citramekaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ jñānaṃ prasidhyati abhinnayogakṣematvena
tathā ca sati santānānāṃ bhedo nānātvaṃ kutaḥ ? na kutaścinmānāt
sukhe vinaśyati sati vā na duḥkhamohādayo vinaśyanti
atra aparaḥ pratibhāsādvaitavādī āha--santānābhāvāt kasya kena abhedaḥ codyate iti cet ? tanniṣedhakapramāṇā'bhāvāt
anupalabdhiḥ pramāṇamiti cet; na; sukhaduḥkhayoḥ anyo'nyamapravedanādabhāvaḥ, anyathā anaikāntiko hetuḥ
satāmapi santānānāmabhinnayogakṣematvādabhedaḥ iti na taiḥ vyabhicāraḥ pakṣīkaraṇāditi kecit; tadapi na yuktam; vyabhicāraviṣayasya pakṣīkaraṇādavyabhicāre na kaściddhetuḥ vyabhicārī syāt
svayaṃ ca pakṣīkṛtaiḥ tarkvādibhiḥ kāryatvādeḥ vyabhicāramudbhāvayan tathā nigadatīti yatkiñcidetat
tato yathā citraikapratibhāsādakrameṇa citramekaṃ jñānam, tathā krameṇāpi iti sthita svārtha ityādi
urvīparvatatarutanvādikaṃ buddhimaddhetukaṃ kāryatvāt iti īśvarānumāne pakṣīkṛtaiḥ tarvādibhiḥ vyabhicāra udbhāvyate yat--te kāryāḥ na ca buddhimaddhetukāḥ
pratyakṣaṃ svārthaṃ sāmānyenāvagṛhṇātu punarādātuṃ viśeṣeṇa tadākāreṇa avaiti yathā avāyastena saṃskāramādhatte
akṣabuddhau svāvayavasvabhāvaṃ sthavīyāṃsamekamākāraṃ pratibhāsamānaṃ pūrvāparānvayi parisphuṭamaskhaladvṛtti saṃpaśyāmaḥ

pratisaṃkhyānena apratyākhyeyatvācca parasparavilakṣaṇānāṃ svalakṣaṇānāṃ spaṣṭanirbhāsānvayaikasvabhāvābhāve akṣajñānaṃ savikalpaṃ siddham, anyathā pararūpaṃ svarūpeṇa tadeva kathaṃ saṃvṛṇuyāt ? yato bahiḥ sadṛśātmanā sphuṭamavabhāseta
athāyaṃ paramārthasad asādhāraṇānāṃ kathamekāntena saṃbhavaḥ tatpratyakṣavirodhāt
yadi kutaścit pratyāsatteḥ bahiriva antaḥparamāṇavaḥ saṃcitāstathā pratyavabhāseranniti; parasparamasaṃplavāt santānāntaravat sthūlaikānvayākārapratītirna syāt

tadvibhrame bahirantaśca kiñcit kutaścidaprasiddham idantayā nedantayā ca tattvaṃ vyavasthāpayatīti suvyavasthitaṃ tattvam ! nacaitanmantavyam--avagṛhītasāmānyasya viśeṣākāṅkṣaṇaṃ mānasamiti; tadiṣyata eva, tadabhāve akṣajñānasya niyamena avagṛhītasadṛśākārasmṛterayogāt
na hi sannihitaviṣayabalodbhūtaṃ tadākārasvabhāvaniyatamasādhāraṇaikāntātmaviṣayaṃ niyamena abhimatasajātīyasmaraṇakāraṇaṃ yuktam, samayānabhijñasyeva kāryasmṛti sāmarthyam
yadi punarantarvāsanāprabodhavicitratā, tarhi tataḥ svayamavagṛhītasamānākārārthaviśeṣākāṅkṣālakṣaṇaṃ parisphuṭaṃ pratyakṣaṃ kinnānumanyata eva sannihitārthopayogāt yataḥ nirvikalpaikāntasiddhiḥ
tad yuktaṃ cakṣurādijñānamapi sattvadravyatvasaṃsthānavarṇādisāmānyaviśeṣān vyāpakavyāpyasvabhāvaṃ pratipadyamānaṃ svayamīhitaṃ vyāpakagrahaṇapūrvakaṃ prāyaḥ paricchinatti
na vai cakṣurādijñānam īhā, api tu tatsamanantarajanmanā tadarthānantaragrāhiṇā mānasapratyakṣeṇa janito vikalpaḥ
tataḥ smṛtirīheti cet; kiṃ punaḥ mānasapratyakṣavikalpanayā labdham ?
akṣadhīḥ indriyabuddhiḥ ādau āditaḥ svārtham svam arthaśca abhedena sāmānyākāreṇa avagṛhṇāti viśeṣeṇa viśeṣākāreṇa avaiti niścinoti svārtham iti sambandhaḥ
kiṃ punaḥ sā karoti ? dhārayati svārthasaṃskāramādhatte
kuta etat ? anyathā dhāraṇā'bhāvaprakāreṇa asmṛteḥ smṛterabhāvāt
yadi vā, sāmānyā'vagrahābhāvaprakāreṇa anyathā smṛterabhedena smṛterabhāvaprasaṅgāt
nahi svalakṣaṇāt bhavān sāmānye smṛtiryukta anyathā nīlānubhavāt pīte sā bhavet
atha syāt--viśeṣāgrahaṇe kathaṃ sāmānyā'vagrahaḥ ? vyāpyāpratītau vyāpakāpratipatteriti; tanna; citraikajñāne nīlākāreṇa pītādyākārānanukaraṇe'pi tadvyāpakajñānamātrānukaraṇavadadoṣaḥ
kiṃ kurvat punaḥ tat kiṃ karoti ? ityatrāha--punaḥ ityādi
punaḥ paścād viśeṣeṇa tadākāreṇa svārthamādānupraiva viśeṣākāreṇaiva avaiti niścinoti
yathā yena prakāreṇa avāyaḥ svārthayoḥ tena saṃskāramādhatte
kuta etat sāmānyena avagṛhyāditi cet ? atrāha--abhimata ityādi

abhimatāni bauddhaiḥ aṅgīkṛtāni svalakṣaṇāni niraṃśaparamāṇulakṣaṇāni teṣāṃ kathañcit kenāpi deśādibhedaprakāreṇa asādhāraṇatve'pi vilakṣaṇatve'pi sadṛśātmanaiva nīlādikasamānasvabhāvena na asādhāraṇasvabhāvena iti evakārārthaḥ, pratibhāsanāt prakṛtamiti
etattu abhyupagamya uktaṃ na paramārthataḥ idamasti, ityāha--svāvayavasvabhāvam ityādi
svāvayavān dravyāntarāvayavān tato nirākṛtametat--sarvasyobhayarūpatve pra॰ vā॰ 3
181 ityādi, svabhāvaḥ svarūpaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ
etattu viśeṣaṇamapi sādhanatvena pratyeyam--yataḥ sthavīyāṃsam tataḥ svāvayavasvabhāvamiti
na khalu nirava yava-avayavikalpanaikānte paramāṇuvat parasparamavayavināṃ mahattvādibhedo'sti yataḥ sthūlasthūlatarādivyavahāraḥ tatra ghaṭeta
tadārambhakāvayavabahutvādyapekṣaḥ sarvo'yaṃ vyavahāra iti cet; atrāhaekam iti
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yo'sau sthavīyān ākāraḥ sa ekaḥ pratīyate, avayavabahutvādyapekṣe tu tadvyavahāre tatra sa iti pratīyate na tu sthavīyān iti, sthavīyastvasyāvayaveṣūpi parasyāsaṃbhavāt
anena dharmakīrtinā sarvadravyāṇāṃ sarvātmakatvaṃ kalpayitvā codito dadhi khādeti kimuṣṭraṃ nābhidhāvati iti dūṣaṇaṃ dattam, tannirākṛtam
atrāha paraḥ--satyam tathāvidhamākāraṃ bhavantaḥ saṃpaśyanti, tattu kṣaṇikam anyathā darśanā'śakteḥ, ityatrāha--pūrvāpara ityādi
pūrvāparau pariṇāmā vandhetu śīlaṃ pratibhāsamānam akṣabuddhau saṃpaśyāmaḥ iti
anena yad yathā'vabhāsate tat tathaiva paramārthasad vyavahāramavatarati ityādiprayoge hetorasiddhatāṃ darśayati
nanu dūrasthitaviralakeśādiṣu iva tamākāramekamasantaṃ bhavantaḥ saṃpaśyanti iti cet; atrāha--askhaladvṛtti yathā bhavati tathā taṃ paśyāmo bādhakā'bhāvāditi manyate
nākṣabuddhau kintu vikalpabuddhau pratibhāsamānaṃ saṃpaśyāma iti nigadantaṃ pratyāha--parisphuṭam ityādi
anyathā akṣabuddhau pratibhāsanābhāvaprakāreṇa parisphuṭaṃ yathā bhavati tathā nāvabhāseta
evaṃ pratibhāsabalena akṣajñāne sāmānyākāreṇa svārthapratibhāsaṃ vyavasthāpitamapi pādaprasārikayā anicchantaṃ prati dūṣaṇāntaramāha--svalakṣaṇānām ityādi
kathaṃbhūtānām ? parasparavilakṣaṇānām spaṣṭanirbhāsānvayaikasvabhāvā'bhāve spaṣṭo nirbhāso yasya sa cāsau anvayaikasvabhāvaśca tasya abhāve aṅgīkriyamāṇe dūṣaṇam akṣa ityādi

ayamatrābhiprāyaḥ--tatsvabhāvaḥ pratibhāsamāno'pi taimirikakeśādivad yadyakṣasaṃvitterviṣaya ityādi; tatra uttaram--atha sannapi na bahiḥ tarhi gatyantarābhāvāt jñānasya sa iti akṣajñānaṃ savikalpaṃ sabhedaṃ siddham anyathā savikalpakatvābhāvaprakāreṇa pararūpaṃ bahiḥsvalakṣaṇarūpaṃ svarūpeṇa spaṣṭanirbhāsānvayaikasvabhāvena tadeva akṣajñānameva kathaṃ saṃvṛṇuyāt ? naiva
yataḥ saṃvaraṇāt sadṛśātmanā samānasvabhāvena avabhāseta parisphuṭaṃ viśadaṃ yathā bhavati bahiḥ tadeveti
anye tu spaṣṭanirbhāsānvayaikasvabhāve iti paṭhanti; teṣām kathamanyathā ityādi virodhaḥ
nahi tena tadeva saṃvriyate anyathā paṭaḥ svātmanā saṃvriyeta
bhavatu tarhi akṣajñānavad bahirapi tatsvabhāvaḥ nyāyabalāyātasya parihartumaśakyatvāditi cet; atrāha--athāyam ityādi
athāyam anantaranirdiṣṭa ākāraḥ paramārthena sad vidyamāno antariva bahirapi iti bhāvaḥ
tarhi bahirantaśca paramāṇava eva avinirbhāgavṛttyutpattyā saṃcitāḥ pratibhānti taduktam--
atrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ--pararūpaṃ svarūpeṇa yayā saṃvriyate dhiyā
anye tu iti padena asya vyākhyāntaraṃ sūcayati ṭīkākāraḥ
yathā yathā'rthāścintyante vivicyante tathā tathā || pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 209
iti cet; etadeva āśaṅkya dūṣayannāha--kutaścid ityādi
kutaścit kasyāścid avinirbhāgavṛttyutpattilakṣaṇāyāḥ pratyāsatteḥ bahiḥ paramāṇava iva tadvat
yadi punaḥ antaḥ paramāṇavaḥ saṃcitāḥ puñjībhūtāḥ tathā spaṣṭanirbhāsānvayaikasvabhāvaprakāreṇa pratyavabhāseran iti paramatāśaṅkā
parasparam anyonyam asaṃplavāt, ekasya jñānaparamāṇoḥ tadantareṣu teṣāṃ vā tatra svabhāvasya vyāpārasya vā yaḥ saṃplavo gamanaṃ tasya abhāvāt
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā teṣāṃ nānyaḥsvabhāvasaṃkīrṇatā nāpi viṣayīkaraṇaṃ saṃplavaḥ tathā antaḥparamāṇūnāmiti
sthūlaikasya advayopalakṣitākārasya pratītiḥ sa sthūlaikānvayākārapratītiḥ sā na syāt
santānāntaravad iti nidarśanaṃ madhye karaṇādanenāpi sambandhanīyam
tato yathā trailokyasantānāntaragṛhītārthāpekṣayā na tatpratītiḥ tathā dārṣṭāntikapratītirapi na syāt
yastu anupalambhāt santānāntarābhāvāt nidarśanamasiddhamiti manyate, sa katham ekajñānaparamāṇunā vedyamānam anyadabhyupagacchet yataḥ citrādvaitaṃ bhavet
etena sakala vikalpātītaṃ tattvaṃ cintitam; nīlapratibhāsam upalabhyamānaṃ sukhādipratibhāsaṃ santamabhyupagacchan santānāntaraniṣedhaṃ nigadati yatkiñcidetat
atrāha paraḥ--astīyaṃ pratītirbhrāntā iti, taduktaṃ pra jñā ka ra gu pte na--māyāmarīciprabhṛtipratibhāsavadasattve'pi adoṣaḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
kiṃ jātam ? ityatrāha--kiñcit sukhādikaṃ nīlādikaṃ ca tat kutaścit pratyakṣādanumānādvā aprasiddham anirṇītam

kena prakāreṇa ? idaṃtayā kṣaṇikajñānānanyavedyavibhramasarvavikalpātītatayā nedaṃtayā na tadviparītarūpatayā ceti tad itthaṃbhūtaṃ tattvaṃ vyavasthāpayati saugataḥ ityevaṃ suvyavasthitaṃ tattvam ityupahasanametat, vibhramāt kasyacit asiddhera ti prasaṅgāt iti manyate
idānīm īhājñāne vipratipattiṃ nirākurvannāha--nanu tasmin sati tat mānasamanyadveti vicāraḥ pravartate, dharmavicārasya dharmisattānibandhanatvāt
ataḥ tatsattaiva sadhyeti cet; naitadasti; tatsattvasya svasaṃvedanādhyakṣasiddhatvāt
siddhe hi sāmānye dharmiṇi tadviśeṣānādātumīhamānasya pratīteḥ, tadyogyopāyopādānāt nirīhasya tadayogāditi manyate
evamarthaṃ cedamuktamatraiva nahi saṃvittaḥ bahubahuvidhaprabhṛtyākṛtayaḥ siddhivi॰ 1
na ca naiva etanmantavyam avagṛhītasya avagraheṇa viṣayīkṛtasya sāmānyasya viśeṣākāṅkṣaṇaṃ mānasaṃ manonimittam, na indriyanimittam iti mānasaṃ tad iṣyata eva kintu tadeva na bhavati iti evakārārthaḥ
tadākāṅkṣaṇaṃ mānasam ityukte avagrahajñānamapi tatpariṇāmi tad ityuktaṃ bhavati, yathā mārdo ghaṭaḥ ityukte mṛtpiṇḍo'pi tadupādānaṃ mārda ityuktaṃ bhavati

kasya ? akṣajñānasya niraṃśasvalakṣaṇaviṣaye akṣajñāne abhyupagamyamāna ityarthaḥ, niyamena avaśyaṃbhāvena avagṛhītaḥ avagraheṇa viṣayīkṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ yaḥ sadṛśākāraḥ athavā idānīm avagṛhītena sadṛśākāraḥ pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ tasya smṛterayogāt na caitanmantavyam iti
etadapi kutaḥ ? ityatrāha— na hi ityādi
hiḥ iti yasmādarthe, yasmāt na sannihito yo viṣayaḥ tasya balena udbhūtam utpannamapi akṣajñānam iti vibhaktipariṇāmena saṃbandhaḥ
tasya sannihitaviṣayasya ākāram anukaroti ityevaṃśīlo yaḥ svabhāvaḥ svasvarūpaṃ tatra niyatam svapne'pi svarūpād anyanna paśyati ityarthaḥ

sarvato vilakṣaṇo'sādhāraṇaḥ ekaḥ asahāyaḥ antaḥ dharmo yasya ātmanaḥ sva bhāvasya sa viṣayo yasya tat, kaṃ niyamena abhimatasajātīyasmaraṇakāraṇaṃ yuktaṃ pūrveṇa paraḥ pareṇa vā pūrvaḥ kṣaṇaḥ sajātīya iti smaraṇam abhimatasajātīyasmaraṇam tasya kāraṇaṃ yuktam
nahi asādhāraṇaikāntātmaviṣayānubhavāt tathāvidhaṃ bahiḥsmaraṇaṃ yuktaṃ nīlānubhavāt pītasmaraṇavat
tathā ca sāmānyādivyavahāraḥ parasya durghaṭa iti manyate

samayetyādinā dṛṣṭānte tadeva samarthayate--ayamudāttaḥ ayamanyaḥ ityādikaḥ saṅketaḥ samayaḥ tadanabhijñasya gopālāderiva śāstravyākhyākaraṇādi-svarādibhedaḥ kāryam ucyate tatra smṛtisāmarthyamayuktam
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā udāttādisamayāgrahaṇe na tatra gopālādeḥ smṛtiḥ tathā sadṛśākārā'grahaṇe'pi na tatra smṛtiriti
nanu nākṣajñānam asādhāraṇaikāntaviṣayam tatsmṛtikāraṇam iti sambandhaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā nīlānubhavājjāyamānā vāsanā nīle smṛtikāraṇaṃ na pīte tathā tadakṣajñānavāsanāpi asādhāraṇaviṣayasmṛtikāraṇaṃ na tat smṛtikāraṇamiti

idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam--yata eva akṣajñānamuktaprakāraṃ tata eva na kevalaṃ tatsmṛtiḥ, api tu vāsanāpi na bhavet notpadyeta tata iti na sādhāraṇaikānta viṣayā akṣa jñānavāsanā tatkāraṇam api tu pūrvasajātīyasmṛtivāsanā
ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ--tadakṣajñānaprabodhitā satī tatkāraṇam, tatprabodhaśca nīlādāveva na kṣaṇakṣayādau iti cet; atrāha--yadi punaḥ ityādi

abhilāpasaṃsargayogyapratibhāsapratītikalpanāhitavāsanā antarvāsanā tasyāḥ prabodhaḥ darśanāduttarasajātīyasmaraṇajananapariṇatiḥ tasya vicitratā--nīlādāveva na kṣaṇakṣayādau tatprabodha iti, yadi punaḥ iṣyate ityadhyāhāraḥ; tarhi tataḥ tadvicitratāyāḥ pratyakṣaṃ kinnā'numanyate ? anumanyata eva
kathaṃbhūtam ? ityatrāha--svayam ātmanā avagṛhītaḥ viṣayīkṛto yaḥ samānākāro'rthaḥ tasya viśeṣā ye teṣu ākāṅkṣaṇaṃ tadgrahaṇābhimukhyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ svarūpaṃ yasya tat tathoktam
etaduktaṃ bhavati--tatkalpanā tataḥ kiṃ syāt ityādinā pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇam ityuktam, tadāhitavāsanā'parasajātīyavikalpa eva tatprabodhavicitratā kasyacideva viśeṣasya nirṇayākāṅkṣā iti
yataḥ iti vā ākṣepe, naiva tatsiddhiriti
na caitanmantavyam ityādinā vaiśadyam ityādi vṛttamapi vyākhyātam
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt yuktam upapannam
kiṃ tat ? ityāha--cakṣurādijñānamapi na kevalaṃ mānasaṃ krameṇa paricchinatti jānāti iti
yadā pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ sāmānyam tadā uttare viśeṣā iti tadviśeṣān ityucyate
vyāpakena vyāpyaḥ svabhāvo yasya viśeṣasya sa tathoktaḥ taṃ pratipadyamānaṃ niścinvat
kiṃ sarvadā evaṃ paricchinatti iti cet ? atrāha--prāyaḥ bāhulyena, kadācit naivam iti pratipādayiṣyate varṇasaṃsthānasāmānyam siddhivi॰ 2
yatpunaratroktam--yadi cakṣurādijñānaṃ svayamakramarūpaṃ kathaṃ tatkrameṇa paricchinatti virodhāt ? atha kramarūpaṃ tarhi svakramamapi pareṇa paricchinatti tamapi pareṇa svakrameṇa ityanavasthitiḥ
tadetat pūrvapūrvasya svagrahaṇānubandhamajahataḥ eva uttarottaraṃ prati sādhakatamatvāt siddhivi॰ 2
navai naiva cakṣurādijñānaṃ cakṣurādīnāṃ kāryaṃ yajjñānam tat īhā apitu kintu tatsamanantarajanmanā tasmāt cakṣurādijñānāt samanantarād upādānāt janma yasya tat tathoktaṃ tena
kathaṃbhūtena ? tadarthānantaragrāhiṇā tasya cakṣurādijñānasya yo'rthaḥ tasya anantaraḥ tajjñāna sahakāryarthakṣaṇaḥ tadgrāhiṇā
taduktam--indriyajñānena samanantarapratyayena svaviṣayānantaraviṣayasahakāriṇā janitaṃ mānasaṃ pratyakṣam

tataḥ tasmāt kāraṇāt smṛtiḥ na pratyakṣam īhā iti anubhavakāryasya tadviṣayasya jñānasya gatyantarā'bhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ, iti evaṃ cet; atra pṛcchati ācāryaḥ--kiṃ punaḥ mānasapratyakṣavikalpakalpanayā labdham ? mānasaṃ pratyakṣameva vikalpo bhedaḥ tasya kalpanayā kiṃ prāptaṃ saugatena ? tatpratyakṣaṃ cakṣurādivyāpārakāle anyadā vā na pratibhāti kevalaṃ kalpanāśilpikalpitam ityetat kalpanayā iti

atrāha śā nta bha draḥ--tatkalpanayā bahirarthe mānasaṃ smaraṇaṃ labdham, na hi tat cakṣurādi jñādyuktaṃ bhinnasantānatvāt, anyathā devadattānubhūte yajñadattasya smaraṇaṃ bhavet, mānasāt tatpratyakṣāt tatsmaraṇaṃ na virudhyate
śāntabhadrastvāha--yadyapi pratyakṣataḥ tasmād bhedo na lakṣyate kāryato lakṣyata eva
kāryaṃ hi nīlādivikalparūpaṃ smaraṇāparavyapadeśaṃ na kāraṇamantareṇa kādācitkatvāt
na cākṣajñānameva tasya kāraṇaṃ santānabhedāt prasiddhasantānāntaratajjñānavat

iha śāntabhadreṇa sautrāntikānāṃ mataṃ darśayatā pūrvaṃ cakṣū rūpe cakṣurvijñānaṃ tatastenendriyavijñānena sahajakṣaṇasahakāriṇā tṛtīyasmin kṣaṇe mānasapratyakṣaṃ janyate iti vyākhyātam...iha pūrvaiḥ cakṣurādivijñānenānubhūtatvānna vikalpābhāva iti cāśaṅkyābhihitam--devadattenāpi dṛṣṭe yajñadattasyāpi vikalpaprasaṅgaḥ...--nyāyabi॰ dha॰ pṛ॰ 61-62
mano'kṣajñānānāṃ santānanānātve'pi yato'nanyasattvavyavasthā parasparaṃ samanantarapratyayatā ca, tata evendriyārthe manasaḥ smṛtiḥ syāt
pratyakṣāt, kathaṃbhūtāt ? mānasādṛte tadantareṇa bahiḥ smṛtirna, kutaḥ sakāśāt ? akṣadhiyaḥ cakṣurādijñānāt
yathā devadattānna yajñadatte smṛtiḥ tathā prakṛtadhiyaḥ ced yadi matam
idamatra tātparyam--indriyamānasapratyakṣayoḥ abhinnaḥ, bhinno vā santānaḥ syāt ? abhinnaścet; tat mānasaṃ pratyakṣaṃ samanantaram upādānam asya smṛtikāryasya kim ? naiva
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathaiva indriyajñānāt santānāntarāt na mānasaṃ smaraṇam, tathaiva tadabhinnasantānānna mānasapratyakṣādapi iti
yo hi jātyaśvo na gardabhāt, saḥ tatputrādapi na bhavati
bhinnaścet; tad akṣajñānaṃ samanantaram upādānam asya mānasādhyakṣasya kim ? naiva, smṛtivat tadapi tato na bhavati
yatpunaruktaṃ pra jñā ka re ṇa--na smṛtiliṅgataḥ tadadhyakṣasya vyavasthā kinna pratītitaḥ, niścayātmakāt nīlādipratīteḥ tadadhyakṣarūpatvāt

iti; tadapyetena nirastam; indriyajñānasya tadupādānasya tadvat nirṇayātmakatve tata eva sakalārthasiddheḥ, tasyaiva pratīteḥ tadindriyajñānaṃ samanantaramasya kim ? anirṇayātmakatve tadanirṇayātmakam indriyajñānaṃ samanantaram asya nirṇayātmano mānasādhyakṣasya kim ? akṣārthayogādeva tasaṃbhavādāt tatsaṃbhavāt
kiṃca, yadi tat kṣaṇikaniraṃśaparamāṇuviṣayaṃ na tatra pramāṇāntaravṛttiḥ, nirṇīte samāropā'bhāvāt
yadi ca tat madhyakṣaṇasya pūrvāparakṣaṇāpekṣaṃ kāryakāraṇatvamātmabhūtaṃ na niścinoti; sarvā'grahaṇam, anyathā gṛhītetararūpamekaṃ syāt
tathā pūrvāparāvasthānirṇaye'pi svayamavasthāt nirṇayādvāpyāpratipattiḥ iti ca
atha tadgrahaṇe; tarhi tayorapi kāryakāraṇabhāvanirṇayaḥ aparatadgrahaṇe, iti pūrvāparakoṭyosmādyantayorviṣayīkaraṇamavaśyaṃbhāvi, tathā tasya parataḥ sarvasmād vivekaniścaye sarvaṃ vaktavyam
dvayasvarūpagrahaṇe sati sambandhavedanam || pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 1 | 2 iti
tato yaduktaṃ pareṇa--madhyakṣaṇadarśanenāgatakṣaṇadarśane tadvattattvāt sarvā'tītānāgatakṣaṇadarśanam iti; tannirastam; anyatrāpi samānatvāt
atha kvacit kāryakāraṇabhāva eva neṣyate; naivam; indriyajñānā'bhāvāt tatprabhavaṃ mānasādhyakṣaṃ na syāt
śeṣamatra pra mā ṇa saṃ gra ha bhā ṣyā t pratyeyam

mano'kṣajñānānāṃ mānasendriyapratyakṣāṇāṃ santānanānātve'pi na kevalaṃ tadanānātve yato yasyāḥ pratyāsatteḥ ananyasattvavyavasthā ekaprāṇivyavasthā parasparam anyonyaṃ mano'kṣasaṃvidāṃ samanantarapratyayatā ca upādānakāraṇatā ca

nanu akṣasaṃvida eva manaḥsaṃvidāṃ samanantarakāraṇaṃ na punaḥ etāḥ tāsām; tatkathamucyate--parasparam ityādi iti cet; naivaṃ śakyaṃ vaktum, yathaiva hi pāvakādeva dhūmo na tasmāt pāvako jāyamānaḥ pratīyate iti pāvaka eva dhūmasya kāraṇaṃ na dhūmaḥ pāvakasya iti niścayaḥ, tathaiva yadi indriyajñānādeva mānasaṃ pratyakṣaṃ na tasmādindriyajñānaṃ jāyamānaṃ pratīyate yuktametat--indriyajñānameva tatkāraṇaṃ na tattasyeti
yāvatā kalpanayā indriyajñānaṃ tatkāraṇaṃ tayaiva ca tadapi kasyacidindriyajñānasya kāraṇamastu, tasyāḥ sarvatra niraṅkuśatvāt
tato yathā indriyajñānajanitaṃ jñānaṃ mānasaṃ pratyakṣaṃ tathā tajjanitaṃ pratyakṣāntaraṃ syādityabhiprāyaḥ
tata eva tasyā eva pratyāsatteḥ indriyārthe cakṣurādiviṣaye manasaḥ mano'dhyakṣāt smṛtiḥ īhā syāt bhavet nānyataḥ kāraṇāditi bhāvaḥ
tataḥ kiṃ jainena prāptam ? ityāha--tad ityādi
tat tasmād uktanyāyād alaṃ paryāptaṃ bahirmānasapratyakṣeṇa kalpitena
kathaṃbhūtena ? antargaḍunā smṛtyakṣajñānayoḥ ghāṭālalāṭayoriva antarālagaḍulavad vartamānena akiñcitkareṇa ? indriyajñānādeva prakṛtārthasiddheriti bhāvaḥ
tatra indriyārthasannikarṣaḥ samayaniyamena antarvāsanāprabodhaṃ yathārhaṃ spaṣṭayatīti teṣāṃ tatsamānam
tatasteṣāmarthapratibhāsaḥ anupalakṣaṇe'pi bhidyeta na punarīhā nirākriyeta liṅgaliṅgisambandhasmṛtivitarkavat tadanyathānupapatteḥ atarkasmṛteḥ vyāptiḥ na sidhyet apratipatteḥ
avagrahādīnām uttarottaraṃ jñānaṃ vikalpaḥ tena āhitā vāsanā tadvāsanā tasyāḥ spaṣṭo kinvāda prabodhaḥ unmīlanam
sa kutaḥ ? ityāha--akṣārthasannidheḥ indriyārthasaṃprayogāt na mānasapratyakṣāderiti manyate
vyāpakaṃ ca vyāpyaśca tau ca tau sāmānya viśeṣau ca vyāpakaṃ sāmānyam vyāpyo viśeṣaḥ tatsvabhāvau arthātmānau gocarau yasya sa tathoktaḥ
vitarkaṇaṃ vitarkaḥ viśeṣākāṅkṣaṇavitarkapariṇāmam anu paścād gatam tacca tad vyāpakasāmānyagrahaṇaṃ ca tat pūrvaṃ kāraṇaṃ paramparayā yasya tattathoktam kiṃ ta dityāha--vyāpyaviśeṣāvāyajñānam
nanu pratyakṣaprastāve kimarthamaprastutānāṃ manovikalpānāmupādānamiti cet ? dṛṣṭāntārtham
yathā manovikalpānāṃ vitarkā'nugatavyāpakasāmānyagrahaṇapūrvaṃ vyāpyaviśeṣāvāyajñānaṃ tathā akṣavikalpānāmiti
na cāsiddho dṛṣṭāntaḥ; pūrvaṃ manasā sāmānyavyavasāyaḥ, tadanantaraṃ tadviśeṣākāṅkṣaṇam, ataśca puruṣaḥ sthāṇuḥ iti vā viśeṣāvāyajñānam, saugatasyāpi prasiddhametaditi

nanu yadi nāma manovikalpānāṃ vitarkānugatavyāpakasāmānyagrahaṇapūrvaṃ vyāpyaviśeṣāvāyajñānaṃ kimāyātaṃ yena akṣavikalpānāṃ tat syāt ? na hi ekasya dharmo niyamena anyasyāpi, anyathā arkasya kaṭu kimā guḍasya syāditi cet; atrāha--tatra ityādi

tatra dṛṣṭāntetararūpe tadvikalpānāṃ sahanirdeśaḥ indriyārthayoḥ sannikarṣaḥ yogyadeśādisannidhiḥ samayasya avagrahādikālasya niyamena avyabhicāreṇa antarvāsanāprabodham antarvāsanā manovikalpavāsanā tasyāḥ prabodham unmīlanaṃ spaṣṭayati viśadaṃ karoti iti hetoḥ teṣāṃ tatsamānam iti
etaduktaṃ bhavati--manovikalpā eva na tatsannikarṣāt spaṣṭībhavanti tataḥ dṛṣṭāntetarabhāvo na virudhyate iti
nanu mānasā vikalpāḥ spaṣṭākāravidhurāḥ, tat kutaḥ spaṣṭībhavanti iti cet ? atrāha— yathārham ityādi
yathārham yathāyogyaṃ sāmagrībhedaṃ prāpya spaṣṭayati iti
upasaṃharannāha--tataḥ tasmāt arthapratibhāsā teṣāṃ vikalpānāṃ spaṣṭetararūpatayā bhidyeta na punaḥ īhā nirākriyeta anupalakṣaṇe'pi na kevalam upalakṣaṇe ca
liṅgaliṅginoḥ sambandhaḥ avinābhāvaḥ tasya yā smṛtiḥ tadrūpo yo vitarkaḥ tasye va tadanupalakṣaṇam
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā gṛhītavyāptikasya puṃso dhūmadarśanānantaraṃ dhūmaketupratipattau antarāle vidyamānasyāpi sambandhavitarkasya anupalakṣaṇam, tathā īhāyāmapi iti
tathā ca vipakṣe'pi anupalakṣyamāṇatvāt ityasya sādhanasya sadbhāvāt īhā tato na nirākriyeta iti bhāvaḥ iti kecidācakṣate

teṣāṃ dhūmadarśanānantaraṃ pāvakapratipattau anupalakṣitasambandhasmṛtisadbhāve bhrūṇe'pi yadakasmād dhūmadarśanād agniratra iti jñānaṃ tadde ve na bauddhaṃ prati pramāṇāntaram ityuktaṃ kathanna virudhyeta ? yadā anupalakṣyamāṇāt tatsmṛtiṃ necchati tadā taduktaṃ nānyadeti cet; tadāpi paraprasiddhasya prakṛtahetuvyabhicāraviṣayasya abhāvāt parasya tat pramāṇāntaraṃ syāt, bhavet punaḥ īhā hīyate iti samānā'niṣṭāpattiḥ
tasmādanyathā vyākhyāyate--liṅgaliṅgisambandhasmṛtiḥ paraprasiddhyā ūha eva ucyate, tasyā vitarkaḥ viśeṣākāṅkṣā tena tulyaṃ varttata iti tadvat
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā mīmāṃsakena liṅgiliṅgisāmānyasambandhasmṛtimicchatā anupalakṣyamāṇe'pi tadvirtakanā saugatena niṣidhyate api tu iṣyate eva tathā prakṛtā īhā'pi iti
na vidyate tarkitaṃ viśeṣākāṅkṣaṇaṃ yasyāḥ sā cāsau smṛtiśca tasyāḥ sakāśāt vyāptiḥ anavayavena liṅgaliṅginoḥ sambandho na sidhyet
nahi dhūmasya sāmānyasya agnisāmānyena vyāptigrahaṇe sā gṛhītā nāma
nanu vyāpyā'pratipattau na vyāpakapratipattiriti kathamucyate--vitarkānugata ityādi
atha vyāpyapratipattau vyāpakapratipattiḥ; tarhi vyāpakasāmānyavat vyāpyaviśeṣasyāpi avagraheṇāvagrahaṇāt kim īhādinā ? saṃśayādyabhāvaḥ tasmāt iti cet; atrāha--varṇa ityādi

yathaiva hi vyaktivyatirekasāmānyadarśinastadanupalakṣaṇamayuktaṃ taddarśanabalād bhinneṣu dravyādiṣu abhinnapratyayayotpatteḥ, tathaiva svalakṣaṇadarśinastadanupalakṣaṇaṃ taddarśanabalāttadanyavyavacchedavikalpotpatteḥ

tadanubhavehitavyapohamātmasātkurvan kathamanupalakṣako nāma ? svalakṣaṇadarśinaḥ svalakṣaṇopalakṣaṇavikalpamantareṇāpi tadanyāpohakalpanāyāṃ jātidarśino'pi tadupalakṣaṇavikalpamantareṇāpi kutaścit bhinneṣu samavāyiṣu pratyayaḥ kathaṃ virudhyeta ? kāraṇaśakteracintyatvāt itaratrāpi etadevottaraṃ viśeṣābhāvāt
varṇaśca śuklādiḥ saṃsthānaṃ ca ūrdhvādiḥ ādiśabdena karmādiparigrahaḥ, teṣāṃ sāmānyaṃ sadṛśaḥ pariṇāmaḥ dūrasthasya bhāvasya avagṛhyate avagraheṇa viṣayīkriyate
tathāhi--dūrasthavalākādiviśeṣaṇaśuklarūpāgrahaṇe'pi tadrūpasāmānyagrahaṇam puruṣādiviśeṣaṇa-ūrdhvādyadarśanaṃ dūre, tathā karmaṇyapi yojyam
tasya sāmānyasya viśeṣāḥ teṣu īhā ākāṅkṣā tayā saha
tarhi tadīhāto niyamena viśeṣāvāyabhāvāt saṃśayādyabhāva iti cet; atrāha--avāya ityādi
avāya eva tasyā vā kāraṇabhūtā śaktiḥ tasyāḥ abhāve'pi na kevalaṃ bhāve jātucit kadācit na sarvadā

nanu dūrasthasya na tatsāmānyamavagṛhyate kintu svalakṣaṇameva, kevalam ataddhetuphalavyapohasāmānyaniścayotpatteḥ tatsāmānyamavagṛhyata iti vyavahārī manyate iti paraḥ, tannirākaraṇadvāreṇa kārikārthaṃ samarthayamāna āha-- yathaiva hi ityādi

yathaiva hi yenaiva hi prakāreṇa vyaktibhyo vyatireko bhedo yasya tacca tatsāmānyaṃ ca taddraṣṭuṃ śīlasya vaiśeṣikādeḥ taddarśinaḥ tasya sāmānyasya anupalakṣaṇam aniścayanam ayuktam anupapannam, kintu upalakṣaṇameva yuktam
tasya sāmānyasya darśanaṃ tasya balaṃ sāmarthyaṃ tasmāt bhinneṣu deśādibhedavatsu
dravyamādiḥ yeṣāṃ guṇādīnāṃ te tathoktāḥ teṣu, abhinnaḥ pratyayagrahaṇamupalakṣaṇaṃ tena abhidhānotpattiḥ ityapi gṛhyate
etaduktaṃ bhavati— viśeṣāḥ dravyādayaḥ viśeṣaṇaṃ sattādisāmānyam, na ca tadanupalakṣitaṃ teṣu viśiṣṭapratyayahetuḥ itarathā daṇḍānupalakṣaṇe'pi kvacid daṇḍī iti pratyayaḥ syāt

na caivam, nā'gṛhītaviśeṣaṇā viśeṣye buddhiḥ iti vacanāt iti, tathaiva tenaiva prakāreṇa svalakṣaṇadarśinaḥ svalakṣaṇaṃ paśyati ityevaṃśīlasya saugatasya tadanupalakṣaṇam svalakṣaṇānupalakṣaṇam ayuktam iti sambandhaḥ

tasya svalakṣaṇasya yat darśanaṃ tadbalāt tadanyavyavacchedavikalpotpatteḥ tasya vivakṣitakhaṇḍādisvalakṣaṇasya anye vijātīyāḥ karkādayaḥ teṣāṃ tebhyo vā vyavacchedo vyāvṛttiḥ tasya vikalpo niścayaḥ tasya utpatteḥ
nanu yadi nāma tadbalāt tadvikalpotpattiḥ tathāpi na svalakṣaṇopalakṣaṇaṃ niyamābhāvāditi cet; atrāha--tad ityādi

tasya svalakṣaṇasya anubhavo darśanam tena īhita ākāṅkṣito yo vyapoho vijātīyavyāvṛttiḥ, athavā vyapohaviṣayatvād vikalpo vyapohaḥ, tam ātmasātkurvan saugataḥ katham anupalakṣako nāma aniścāyako nāma kintu upalakṣaka eva
na khalu devadattasyānupalakṣaṇe tasya yajñadattād vyapohaḥ siddhaḥ śakyaḥ pratyetum, tatpratītau na tadupalakṣaṇam

atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--yadā'yaṃ saugataḥ anubhūtasvalakṣaṇasya upalakṣako bhavati tadā dūrasthasya varṇasaṃsthānādisāmānyasya vikalpato'pi grahaṇābhāvāt tadgrahaṇanibandhanaḥ kimiyaṃ valākā ahosvit patākā, valākāyāṃ patākākaireti , tathā sthāṇurvā puruṣo vā, puruṣe sthāṇureva iti saṃśayaḥ viparyayo vā na bhavet
na caivam, tato dūrasthasya tatsāmānyaṃ prathamamavagṛhyate iti

svalakṣaṇadarśinaḥ tathāgatasya svalakṣaṇasya upalakṣaṇaṃ niścayanaṃ yena yasmin vā sa tathoktaḥ sa cāsau vikalpaḥ tamantareṇāpi tasya vivakṣitasvalakṣaṇasya anyo vijātīyaḥ tasya apoho vyāvṛttiḥ tadviṣayo vikalpaḥ tathā ucyate tasya kalpanāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ jātidarśino'pi vaiśeṣikādeḥ tadupalakṣaṇavikalpamantareṇāpi sāmānyopalakṣaṇaniścayamantareṇāpi kutaścit kasyāścid yogyatāyāḥ samavāyiṣu gotvādisāmānyasambandhavatsu nānyeṣu, kathambhūteṣu ? bhinneṣu pratyayaḥ kathaṃ virudhyeta
kathamanupalakṣitaṃ sāmānyaṃ tatpratyayaheturiti cet ? atrāha--kāraṇa ityādi
nanu dṛṣṭe vastuni codye kāraṇaśakteracintyatvāt ityettaduttaraṃ nānyatra atiprasaṅgāt
yatkiñcidātmābhimataṃ divāya pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 35 ityādi
na ca sāmānyaṃ kvacid dṛṣṭamiti cet; atrāha--itaratrāpi iti
na kevalaṃ jātivādipakṣe api tu itaratrāpi svalakṣaṇavādipakṣe'pi kāraṇaśakteracintyatvāt ityetadevottaramiti manyate

atha mataṃ svasāmānyalakṣaṇayoḥ darśanādarśanakṛtaviśeṣasadbhāvāt kathamaviśeṣacodanamiti cet ? atrāha--viśeṣā'bhāvāt iti ? jātivat svalakṣaṇasyāpi darśanā'bhāvāt, bhavato dvayorapi sattvamasattvaṃ vā iti manyate
tanna darśanajanmanā vikalpenaiva sāmānyaṃ gṛhyata iti yuktam
vastusvabhāvairiha vācyamitthaṃ tathottare syād vijayī samastaḥ
bhavatu vā, tathāpi svamatasiddhiṃ darśayannāha--asataḥ ityādi
dūrasthasya arthadarśanaṃ yadi asataḥ svaviṣayamapohantīṃ kimapyastīti vikalpabuddhiṃ janayet tathā dūrasthadṛṣṭirapi punaḥ aśeṣavastusvabhāvānupalambhe'pi sanmātragrāhiṇī saṃbhā vyeta
na vai kevalamāsannārthadarśī samaviṣamākāradarśanaviśeṣāneva nopalakṣayati, kiṃ tarhi sattādivikalpaviśeṣānapi kramasyopalakṣayitumaśakteḥ
paśyannayamasādhāraṇameva paśyati iti pratijñāya kośapānaṃ vidheyam
tatra candrādyadarśanaṃ kalpayan na kevalaṃ rūpādisvalakṣaṇānyeva dṛṣṭe tatpratibhāsavaikalyānnopalabhate api tu svayamantaḥsvalakṣaṇaṃ ca yathāśrutamapratibhāsānāt
tato bahirantaśca kṛtam ! tasmādayaṃ kiñcit kenacit sadṛśapariṇāmaviśiṣṭaṃ paśyet, tadviśiṣṭaṃ pratīhamāno nāvaśyaṃ viśeṣamavaiti smaranniva
tena sarvasmād anabhimatād iti gṛhyate, sad iti upalakṣaṇam sarvasyā'bhimatasya
yathā yena yogyatāprakāreṇa anakṣavikalpadhīḥ mānasī vikalpabuddhiriti

anakṣaviśeṣaṇaṃ svamatāpekṣayā na saugatāpekṣayā, tasya hi sarvā vikalpadhīḥ anakṣaiva iti tadviśeṣaṇamanarthakam, tathā tena prakāreṇa spaṣṭākṣadhīḥ pratyakṣabuddhiḥ asataḥ sad vyavacchindyāt iti sambandhaḥ
iti śabdo'tra draṣṭavyaḥ, ityevam anumanyatām abhyupagamyatām
na indriyajanyā, api tu mānasī nirvikalpajanyā vā
dūrasthasya puruṣasya yadarthadarśanaṃ kartṛ yadi vikalpabuddhiṃ janayet
kutaḥ ? asataḥ kharaviṣāṇādeḥ kevalāt nānyato na sato vyapohantīm
kena prakāreṇa ? ityatrāha— kimapi asti iti evaṃ tathā tena prakāreṇa dūrasthadṛṣṭirapi na kevalam anakṣavikalpadhīḥ saṃbhāvyeta
atha matam--anarthaviṣayatvād anakṣavikalpadhīḥ tathā yuktā nendriyabuddhiḥ viparyayāditi cet; na; tasyā api vastuviṣayatvasya pratipādayiṣyamāṇatvāt
nanu dūrārthadarśane avagrahādyabhāvo mā bhūt tadupalakṣaṇāt, āsannārthadarśane tat syād viparyayāditi cet; atrāha--navai kevalam ityādi

vai śabdaḥ śiraḥkaṃppa, na kevalamāsannamarthaṃ paśyati ityevaṃ śī laḥ samaśca viṣamaśca tau ca tau ākārau ca sadṛśetarapariṇāmākārau tayordarśanam grahaṇaṃ tasya viśeṣā avagrahādayaḥ tāneva nopalakṣayati, kiṃ tarhi ? sattādivikalpaviśeṣānapi sattā ādiryeṣāṃ śabdatvādīnāṃ teṣāṃ vikalpā vyavasāyāḥ ta eva viśeṣāḥ tānapi nopalakṣayati

etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā kvacit sattvajñeyatvādivikalpān kramabhāvina upalabhya punaḥ āsannārthadarśī yugapad vyavasāye'pi krameṇaiva tatpravṛttiriti vyavasthāpayati yugapadanekavyāvṛttivikalpā'saṃbhavāt tathā dūre samaviṣamākāradarśanaviśeṣān krameṇa jāyamānānupalabhya āsanne'pi tathā tān vyavasthāpayati, dṛṣṭena adṛṣṭasiddheranivāraṇāditi
atha matam--āsannārthadarśī yadi taddarśanaviśeṣān paśyati kimiti tathaiva nāvadhārayati iti ? tatrāha--kramasya upalakṣayitumaśakteḥ iti
āsannārthadarśino ye taddarśanaviśeṣāḥ teṣām sattādivikalpavat kramasya upalakṣayitumaśakteḥ iti
syānmatam--āsannārthadarśī kṣaṇikaniraṃśaparamāṇusvalakṣaṇameva paśyati iti taddarśanaviśeṣān asattvānnopalakṣayati na sata eva tatkathamucyate--sama iti ? atrāha--paśyannayam ityādi
paśyannayaṃ saugato loko vā asādhāraṇameva nānyat paśyati ityetat pratijñāya kośapānaṃ vidheyam anyataḥ tatpratipatterasaṃbhavāditi bhāvaḥ

upahatāni kāmalādinā dūṣitāni indriyāṇi yeṣāṃ taiḥ candrādeḥ ādiśabdena vartulatvāderdarśane'pi na kevalam adarśane, tathā tatra upahatendriyeṣu ādyaṃ candrādidarśanābhāvaṃ kalpayan saugatādiḥ, kutaḥ kalpayan ? ityatrāha--tad ityādi
tasya candraderviśeṣaḥ ekatvādiḥ tasya anupalabdhiḥ tadanupalabdhau candrādyadarśanam, ekasya gṛhītetararūpadvayā'yogāditi manyate
na kevalaṃ rūpādisvalakṣaṇānyeva niraṃśakṣaṇikarūpādiparamāṇūneva nopalabhate, kuta etat ? dṛṣṭeḥ
rūpādidarśanasya tatpratibhāsavaikalyāt paraparikalpitasvalakṣaṇapratibhāsavirahāt, upahatendriyairiva anupahatairapi bahirarthā'darśanam iti manyate
mābhūt tasya darśanaṃ tathāpi vijñānavādino na kiñcit tasyatīti cet; atrāha--api tu ityādi
api tu kintu svayam ātmanā antaḥsvalakṣaṇaṃ ca jñāna svalakṣaṇamapi nopalabhate iti
yathāśrutaṃ yathābhyupagama ma apratibhāsanād antaḥ svalakṣaṇasya iti sambandhaḥ
tarhi bahiriva anyatrāpi vicārasāmyāt śakalaśūnyatā astu iti cet; atrāha--svabhāva ityādi
jñānajñeyayoḥ svabhāvasya svarūpasya nairātmyaṃ nīrūpatvaṃ tasya kalpanām āviśan saugataḥ ātmānam ahrīkayati
tato bahirantaśca kṛtam ! apratibhāse'pi yathā sāmānyāvabhāsanaṃ tathā tadviśeṣānupalambhe'pi candrādidarśanam upahatendriyairiti kathanna dṛṣṭiḥ sanmātragrāhiṇī saṃbhāvyata iti manyate

yata evaṃ tasmāt ayaṃ vyavahārī kiñcit puruṣādikaṃ kenacit sthāṇvādinā saha yaḥ sadṛśapariṇāmaḥ tena viśiṣṭaṃ paśyet, tadviśiṣṭaṃ tatpariṇāmabhedaṃ tatprati īhamāno'pi nā'vaśyaṃ viśeṣamavaiti na viśeṣo' vāyībhavati
yathā kathañcit smaran kenacit sadṛśapariṇāmena tadviśeṣaṃ pratīhamāno'pi nāvaśyaṃ tadviśeṣaṃ smarati tathā prakṛtamapi iti
yadi nāvaśyaṃ viśeṣamavaiti kiṃ tarhi tat syāt ? ityatrāha--samadṛṣṭeḥ ityādi
vyāpakaṃ svabhāvaṃ paśyan viśeṣaṃ prati punastadantaramīhamāno vyavahārī nāvaśyamavaiti sāmagrīvaikalyasaṃbhavāt
samadṛṣṭeḥ avagrahād viśeṣākāṅkṣā viśeṣehā, tasyāḥ kim ? ityāha--āreketi
viśeṣehā ityetajjāta kā vibhakti pariṇāmamiha saṃbadhyate
svaśabdena īhā gṛhyate, svasya arthaḥ tadākāṅkṣito viśeṣaḥ tasyā'viniścaye sati ārekā na viniścaye, kadācit tataḥ tadviniścayo'pi jāyata ityabhiprāyaḥ
na kevalaṃ tata ārekaiva kintu viparyayo'pi iti darśayannāha--atasmiṃstadgraho bhrāntirapi iti
bhrāntirapi viparyayo'pi na kevalam ārekā'vāyāveva tato jāyete iti
tatsvarūpaṃ darśayitumāha--atasmiṃstadgrahaḥ sthāṇau puruṣādigrahaḥ abāhye bāhyagrahavat
yathaiva ca ekena jñānena anyo'nyabhinnanīlādyākārāṇāṃ vyāptiḥ tathā svato bhinnānāṃ gṛhītiriti niveditam
nivedayiṣyataitadavibhrame ṣyate caitat-- avibhrame' saugataṃ jagat ityādinā
sarvavikalpātītatve sa eva doṣaḥ kathañcit kutaścidapratipatteḥ
kathambhūtā sā ? ityatrāha--spaṣṭāvabhāsinī iti viśadā iti
anena sadṛśadarśanaprabhavā sarvāpi bhrāntiḥ mānasī iti mataṃ nirastam; tasyāḥ spaṣṭāvabhāsitvā'yogāt
pratīyate ca tatprabhavā'pi marīcikādau jalādibhrāntiḥ tathāvabhāsinī
tulanā— mānasaṃ tadapītyeke teṣāṃ grantho virudhyate
vyāpakasvabhāvaṃ nā'vyāpakasvabhāvaṃ sādṛśyaikatvapariṇāmasvabhāvaṃ paśyan viśeṣaṃ tadbhidaṃ prati punaḥ tadantaramīhamāno vyavahārī nāvaśyaṃ niyamena avaiti niścinoti viśeṣam iti sambandhaḥ
viśeṣe avāyasya yā sāmagrī deśasannidhānādilakṣaṇā tasyā vikalpa saṃbhavāt
saṃśayādīnāṃ svarūpaṃ pradarśya īhāta utpattiṃ darśayannāha--tattva ityādi
vyāpakasvabhāvam iti vacanāt vyāpyo'pi svabhāvaḥ, ākṣiptastasya tannāntarīyakatvāt

sa cānekaḥ tataḥ sūsyata vyāpakasvabhāve dṛśyamāne tattvasvabhāvo vivakṣitavyāpyasvabhāvaḥ itaraśca svabhāvo'vivakṣitavyāpyasvabhāvaḥ tayorna vidyate avasthā avasthitiryasyā sā tathoktā ubhayatra dolāyamānā ityarthaḥ
sāmānyaviśeṣātmakatattvapratītirapi saṃśītiḥ ityeke; tannirāsārtha evakāraḥ, tasyāḥ tattvetarasvabhāvāvasthārūpatvāt
anyathā anyena tattvasvabhāve itarasvabhāvaprakāreṇa, itarasvabhāve tattvasvabhāvaprakāreṇa pratipattiḥ punaḥ visaṃvādo viparyayaḥ
sarvaṃ niravaśeṣaṃ ca idaṃ saṃśītyādikam īhā'vinābhāvi
nanu yadi nāma samadṛṣṭiḥ kimāyātaṃ yena ato viśeṣeṣu īhātaśca ārekā syāt
nahi anyatra dṛṣṭeḥ anyatra sā yuktā, anyathā ghaṭadṛṣṭeḥ paṭe bhavet
kiṃca, sāmānyadṛṣṭau viśeṣo yadyupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptiḥ sannopalabhyate tarhi tadabhāva eva na tatra īhā ārekā vā
atha anyathā a dṛśyānupalabdhereva saṃśītiḥ iti kiṃ samadṛṣṭeḥ ityanena ? na hi svargādau taddṛṣṭeḥ saṃśītiḥ iti cet; atrāha--sāmānya ityādi
vyāpakasvabhāvaṃ paśyan ityanuvṛtteḥ yeṣāṃ viśeṣāṇām īhā ārekā ca teṣāṃ vyāpakasvabhāvaṃ sāmānyam iha gṛhyate tasya pratyakṣād darśanāt
anena na hyanyasya darśane anyasya sā yuktā, anyathā ghaṭadarśane paṭe sā bhavet iti; tannirastam
na khalu yathā tatsāmānyaṃ vivakṣitaviśeṣasvabhāvaṃ tathā paṭaḥ paṭasvabhāva iti
anena yaduktam--sāmānyā'dṛṣṭau viśeṣāṇāṃ dṛśyātmanāmadṛṣṭau abhāvaḥ syāt
iti; tannirastam; tadā ācāryeṇa taddṛśyātmatānabhyupagamāt, anyathā īhamānasya iti na brūyāt
ko hi nāma dṛśyaṃ paśyanneva ādātumīhate

yatpunaruktam--evaṃ sati adṛśyānupalabdhireva saṃśayāt kiṃ sāmānyapratyakṣāt ityanena iti; tadapyetena nirastam; tattvetarasvabhāvavyāpakabhavedarśanādeva anaikāntikahetudarśanādi ca tatra niyamena sandeho yukto na adṛśyadarśanādeva
yaccoktam--sāmānyapratyakṣamantareṇāpi kvacit saṃśayaḥ iti tadapi na sūktam; tatrāpi śabdādanyato vā sāmānyāpratipattau tadabhāvāt samavāyādarśinaḥ śāstrārthasandehaḥ anyathā
viśeṣā'pratyakṣāt tasya sāmānyasya ye viśeṣāḥ teṣām apratyakṣāt adarśanāt, idamapyupalakṣaṇam tadagrahaṇasya
viśeṣasmṛteḥ viśeṣayoḥ smaraṇāt sandehopapatteḥ kāraṇāt sarvaṃ cedam īhāvinābhāvi iti sambandhaḥ
tulanā--dṛśyate kānyakubjādiṣu sāmānyapratyakṣatāmantareṇāpi prathamatarameva smaraṇāt saṃśayaḥ
nanu yadīyaṃ bhrāntiḥ tatsmaraṇapūrvikā, na tarhi spaṣṭāvabhāsinī anumānavat, ato'yuktamuktam--bhrāntirapi spaṣṭāvabhāsinī iti cet; na; jalādibhrāntyā vyabhicārāt
vyabhicāraḥ, taddhi smaraṇapūrvakamapi pratyakṣaṃ spaṣṭāvabhāsi ca
nanu saṃśayādiḥ smṛtiviśeṣaḥ, sa ca avikalpānubhavāt vastusvabhāvata iti kiṃ tatra īhayeti ? etadevāha--nirvikalpa ityādinā
taddṛṣṭāveva dṛṣṭeṣu vyavahārapravṛttau saṃvittibalāt sajātīyasmṛtyabhilāṣāderiti kiṃ grāhyākārakalpanayā ? kevalamavabodhamātraṃ bhāvasvabhāvato prakṛtasmṛtihetuḥ pratīyeta
kalpayitvāpi viṣayākāraṃ sa viśeṣo mṛgyaḥ yena prativiṣayaṃ bhidyeta anyathā atiprasaṅgāt
yata utpannaṃ jñānaṃ yajjātīyasmṛtihetutayā vyavahārayati tattasya netarasyeti kuto'tiprasaṅgaḥ, sadarthākārasma svayamanupalakṣitasya smṛtau abhāvānatiśāyanāt
tāvataiva sarvavyavahāraprasiddhestathaivāstu iti cet; svayamabhipretabhrāntimātrāsiddheḥ sarvathā'sambaddhapralāpamātram, avidyāta eva vidyāsiddheranivāraṇāt aniṣṭānuṣaṅgāt
bhrāntimātrāt paramārthato'siddhasvabhāvāt pratītiviparyāsena bhāvān idantayā nedantayā vā vyavasthāpayitukāmaḥ saugataḥ ekāntena avikalpa evetyalamatiprasaṅgena
nirvikalpadṛṣṭeḥ avikalpānubhavād vastusvabhāvataḥ bhāvasvābhāvyādeva nānyataḥ iti evakārārthaḥ
sajātīyasmṛtau sāmānyaviṣayavikalpabuddhau aṅgīkriyamāṇāyām dūṣaṇamidamiti darśayannāha--nirākāra ityādi
nirākārāvabodhena arthasārūpyarahitadarśanena hetutya kinna sajātīyasmṛtiḥ sarvo'pi sāmānyavikalpo jāyate ityadhyāhāryam, jāyata eva
kutaḥ ? vastusvabhāvataḥ bhāvaśakteriti, yena kāraṇena grāhyākāro'rthākāro'trāvabodhe kalpyate
sa cārthākārarahitaḥ sedānīṃ tadvatī katham || pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 374 iti
yathaiva hi nirākārādanubhavāt kathaṃ sā tadvatī ākāravatī; tathā sāmānyākārarahitāttataḥ tadākāravatī kathamiti samānam
vastusvabhāvataḥ ityapi nottaram; anyathā nirākārāvabodhāt tata eva tadvatī iti yatkiñcidetat
nirvikalpikā dṛṣṭiḥ taddṛṣṭiḥ tasyāṃ satyāṃ punaḥ ye dṛṣṭāḥ teṣu vyavahāraḥrapravṛttau aṅgīkriyamāṇāyām

saṃvitterbalaṃ sāmarthyam tasmād yā sajātīyasmṛtiḥ tasyā abhilāṣa ādiśabdena dveṣaparigrahaḥ tasmāt iti kiṃ darśanasya grāhyākārakalpanayā sārūpyakalpanayā kevalaṃ grāhyākāraśūnyamavabodhamātraṃ bhāvasvabhāvato vastuśakteḥ prakṛtasmṛtihetuḥ sajātīyasmaraṇakāraṇaṃ pratīyeta
tatra sākārasmṛterdarśanaṃ sākāraṃ sidhyati iti manyate
āha ca--taddṛṣṭāveva...smaraṇādabhilāṣeṇa vyavahāraḥ pravartate--sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 498
punaścoktaṃ dṛṣṭeṣu saṃvitsāmarthyabhāvinaṃ smaraṇādityādi--pra॰ vā॰ sva॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 6
nanu mā bhūt sākārasmṛterdarśanasya sākāratāsiddhiḥ, tasyā anyathā siddhiḥ, pratikarmavyavasthāyāḥ tat syāt iti
tasmāt prameyādhigateḥ pramāṇaṃ meyarūpatā || pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 305 iti | cet;

na kevalam akalpayitvā kintu kalpayitvāpi viṣayākāraṃ darśanasya viṣayasārūpyaṃ viśeṣaḥ atiśayaḥ mṛgyaḥ saḥ avabodho yena viśeṣeṇa prativiṣayaṃ bhidyeta, anyathā anyena tadviśeṣānveṣaṇābhāvaprakāreṇa atiprasaṅgāt
tadākārāt pratikarmavyavasthāyām kiñcinnīlajñānaṃ sakalasya nīlasya, sadākāraṃ vā jñānaṃ sataḥ syāt iti atiprasaṅgaḥ, tasmād viśeṣo mṛgyaḥ iti pratikarmavyavasthāpi anyathā siddheti bhāvaḥ
nanu bhavato'pi avabodhasya nirākārasya sarvatrāviśeṣādatiprasaṅgaḥ samāna iti cet; atrāha--tenaiva ityādi
tenaiva yogyatāviśeṣeṇaiva saṃvedanaṃ samīcīnaṃ pratiniyatārthavedanaṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt iti kuto'tiprasaṅgaḥ iti gatvā sambandhaḥ
sāṃprataṃ naiyāyiko bhūtvā sūriḥ atiprasaṅgaṃ pariharannāha--yata ityādi
yataḥ yasmāt sthūlatvādidharmopetādarthād utpannaṃ jñānaṃ tasyārthasya tat na itarasya ajanakasyārthasya iti hetoḥ kuto'tiprasaṅgaḥ itarathā anagneḥ dhūmaḥ syāt
syānmatam--yata utpannaṃ tasya tat ityucyamāne indriyādeḥ syāditi; tatrāha— yajjātīya ityādi
yatsamānaḥ yajjātīyaḥ tasya smṛtihetutayā vyavahārayati— vyavahāre pravṛttaṃ janaṃ karoti tasya tat netarasya iti kuto'tiprasaṅgaḥ ? na cendriyādiḥ sajātīyasmṛtihetutayā vyavahārayati iti
nanu padārthāntaraṃ jñānaṃ svayamanubhavātmakaṃ bhavati tadā tena artho jñāto bhavati, tatra ca tatsmṛtiheturnānyathā, na caitat naiyāyikasyeti cet; atrāha--tarthe tyādi
sati pratiniyato nīlādiḥ arthaḥ tasya ākāra iva ākāro yasya jñānasya tat tathoktaṃ tasya anupalakṣitasya aniścitasya svayam ātmanā abhāvena śaśaśṛṅgādinā'natiśāyanāt
tasyāṃ kriyamāṇāyām atiśayābhāvāt yata utpannam ityādi sambandhaḥ

etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadi nirvikalpakaṃ darśanaṃ tadatiśayarahitamapi smṛtikāraṇaṃ naiyāyikakalpitaṃ cinna syāt iti; tarhi viplave arthābhāve'pi tadākāradarśanāt sasākāro jñānasya pratibhāsamānasya gatyantarābhāvāt
anarthākāraśaṅkā syādapyarthavati cetasi | pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 371 iti cet;

viplave vibhramadaśāyāṃ yat sākāradarśanam avikalpakaṃ jñānamevamarthaṃ ca darśanagrahaṇam, anyathā jñānagrahaṇaṃ nyāyyam tasmāt tena hetunā tadvā āśritya, tad ityayaṃ nipātaḥ tasya ityasyārthe draṣṭavyaḥ
tasya grāhyākārasya anyatra jāgraddaśājñāne kalpanāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyām atiprasaṅgāt
yataḥ kutaścidasiddhāt nidarśanāt yasya kasyacidarthasya siddhiprasaṅgāditi naivaṃ saṃvedanam ityādinā sambandhaḥ
viplave'pi sākāradarśanamasiddham nirākāreṇa darśanena tatra kutaścid bhrānteḥ ghaṭāderasata eva bahiriva grahaṇāt ityabhiprāyaḥ
taduktaṃ nyā ya vi ni śca ye--na caitad bahireva, kiṃ tarhi bahirbahiriva pratibhāsate
kuta etat ? bhrānte ḥ, tadanyatra samānam iti
tāvataiva asataḥ pratibhāsanamātreṇaiva sarvasya pramāṇetarādirūpasya vyavahārasya mithyāvikalparacitasya prāmāṇyaṃ vyavahāreṇa pra॰ vā॰ 1
7 ityādi vacanāt prasiddheḥ kāraṇāt tathaivāstu tenaiva nirākāreṇa jñānena asadeva ghaṭādikaṃ gṛhyate iti prakāreṇaiva astu sarvam ityadhyāhāraḥ iti evaṃ cet; atrāha ācāryaḥ--svayam ityādi
svayam ātmanā yadabhipretam aṅgīkṛtaṃ bhrāntimātraṃ saugatena tasya asiddheḥ tadapratipatteḥ kāraṇāt
sarvathā sarveṇa prakāreṇa asambandhasya asambaddhaṃ vā pralāpamātram iti evaṃ nirṇītametat prathamaprastāve
idamatra tātparyam--yathā vibhramādevaṃ vibhramasiddhiḥ tathā vā vidyāta eva pratyakṣādilakṣaṇāyā vidyāyā brahmaṇo yā siddhiḥ tasyā anivāraṇād asaṃbaddhapralāpamātram iti
nanu bhavatu tatsiddhiḥ, tathāpi ghaṭādivat pratibhāsamānasya tasya vibhramasiddheḥ siddhaṃ naḥ samīhitamiti cet; atrāha--aniṣṭānuṣaṅgāt
saugatasya iṣṭam--anekaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ sarvathā bhrāntaṃ jñānam, aniṣṭam--ekamakṣaṇikaṃ vyāpakamabhrāntaṃ brahmatattvam, asya anuṣaṅgāt tanmātram iti sambandhaḥ
yathā khalu bhrāntiḥ bhrānteḥ pratīyamānāpi na bhrāntiḥ tathā brahmatattvamapi iti manyate
tarhi bhrantirapi na kutaścit pratīyate iti cet; atrāha--bhrāntimātrāt ityādi

kathaṃbhūtāt ? paramārthataḥ tattvato'siddhasvabhāvāt aniścitarūpāt pratītiviparyāsena svapnādidaśāviparyāsena svapnādidaśāyāṃ bhrāntaṃ jñānaṃ na jāgraddaśāyām iti yeyaṃ pratītiḥ laukikī prasiddhiḥ tasyāḥ svapnādivad anyadā vibhrāntaṃ jñānam anyadeva vā svapnādāvapi abhrāntam iti yo viparyayaḥ tena bhāvān navetararūpānarthānaivattayā svābhimatasvabhāvatayā nedantayā na parābhimatasvabhāvatayā vā śabdaḥ pūrvasamuccayārthaḥ vyavasthāpayitukāmaḥ saugataḥ ekāntena avaśyaṃbhāvena avikalpa eva parāmarśaśūnya eva
yadi vā īṣadasiddhonmeṣo'yam ityevam alaṃ paryāptam atiprasaṅgena
nirvikalpadarśanāt sajātīyasmṛtau na kevalamanubhavasya grāhyākāravaikalyam api tu tasyāpi iti darśayannāha--sarvataḥ ityādi
vastusvabhāvata eva samanantarapratyayo'vagrahādimatiḥ svayam indriyārthasannikarṣaviśiṣṭaḥ smṛtyādivyavahārahetuḥ, sāmagrīviśeṣāt vāsanāprabodhavaiśadyasaṃbhavāt svapnādivat
tadayaṃ spaṣṭāvitathasvagrāhyaviśeṣānvayapratibhāsavāsanāprabodhaśca sākṣāt darśananimitto bhavan anekāntatattvaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati
sarvataḥ sajātīyād vijātīyācca sarveṇa nīlādiprakāreṇa iva sadādiprakāreṇāpi sarvaṃ svaviṣayābhimatamaśeṣaṃ vilakṣaṇaṃ vyāvṛttarūpam alakṣayan aniścinvan
kau'sau ? bodhātmā nirvikalpo bodhaḥ smṛteḥ smaraṇasya hetuḥ ced yadi sannikarṣaḥ indriyārthasaṃprayogaḥ tathā tena vastusvabhāvaprakāreṇa na kiṃ smṛtihetuḥ ? syādeva
tathā ca anubhavavaikalyaṃ tathā tadalakṣayaḥ nāsya tataḥ cetanatvakṛto viśeṣa iti manyate

kārikāyāḥ sugamatvād vyākhyānamakṛtvā prakṛtamarthamupasaṃharannāha--vastusvabhāvata eva na sārūpyādeḥ iti evakārārthaḥ, samanantarapratyayaḥ--samaḥ jñānatvena anantaraḥ upādānatvena pratyayaḥ avagrahādimatiḥ bodhaḥ, kathambhūtaḥ ? ityatrāha--svayam ityādi
svayam ātmanā na sāṃkhyasya iva pāramparyeṇa indriyārthasannikarṣaviśiṣṭaḥ svavyāpāre notpattau iti cintitam
tataḥ tadaviśiṣṭomānasādhyakṣapratyayaparityāgaḥ smṛtyādivyavahārahetuḥ smṛtiḥ ādiryasya pratyabhijñānādeḥ sa eva tena vā vyavahārasya hetuḥ
syānmatam--avagrahādipratyayaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣātmavastuviṣayatvena savikalpaka iti vaiśadyavirahāt kathaṃ tadviśiṣṭa iti ? tatrāha--sāmagrī ityādi
sāmagryā indriyārthasannikarṣādilakṣaṇāyāḥ viśeṣāt hetoḥ vāsanāprabodhavaiśadyasaṃbhavāt tadviśiṣṭa iti sambandhaḥ
syādetat--vāsanānimittatvena pratyayasya svapnādivad bhrāntatā syāt iti; tatrāha--tadayam ityādi

tat tasmāt indriyārthasannikarṣādisāmagrīviśeṣād ayam avagrahādipratyayābhidhānaḥ avitatho'bhrāntaḥ spaṣṭo viśadaḥ svasya grāhyo viśaṣānvayau bhedābhedau tayoḥ pratibhāsaḥ yasmin sa cāsau vāsanāprabodhaśca punaḥ asya avitatha ityādinā yasaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadyapi arthapratyayo vāsanāto jāyate tathāpi na bhrāntaḥ sāmagrīviśeṣādutpatteḥ svapnādau asaṃbhavina iti
nanu pūrvadarśanāhitavāsanāprabodhaḥ paradarśanāt nendriyārthasannikarṣāditi cet; atrāha--sākṣāt ityādi
sākṣād avyavadhānena darśananimitto bhavatu tatprabodhaḥ anekāntatattvaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati anekāntadarśanād aparasya darśanasya tannimittasya abhāvāditi bhāvaḥ
na paśyāmaḥ kvacit kiñcit sāmānyaṃ vā svalakṣaṇam
yathoktaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ vā na kvacit kadācit paśyāmaḥ pratyakṣe vaṇaṃsaṃsthādivicitramanvayinamupalakṣayāmaḥ
svaparapratibodhaṃ pratyakṣaṃ kathañcidapramāṇayan pramāṇāntaraṃ kathamavatiṣṭheta ? svataḥ siddhasya kasyacidanyathānupapattivitarkāt parokṣārthapratipattiranumānaṃ na punaranupapannam
pratyakṣasya ātmani paratra vā kathañcit paramārthasiddhau kathaṃ tanmithyaikāntaṃ anyānapekṣyaṃ sādhayet yato'yaṃ yathādarśanameva mānameyaphalasthitiḥ kriyate na punaryathātattvamiti brūyāt
yathehitaṃ pramāṇātītaṃ paramātmatattvamanyathā vā kathayataḥ parasyāpi na vaktraṃ vakrībhavati yataḥ svalakṣaṇānyeva yathālakṣaṇaṃ sidhyeyuḥ
na paśyāmaḥ kvacid bahirantarvā kiñcit paramaparaṃ vā vyaktibhyo bhinnaṃ tadrahitaṃ vā sāmānyaṃ vāśabdo bhinnaprakramaḥ svalakṣaṇam ityasya anantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ
ivārtho vā, sāmānyamiva svalakṣaṇaṃ na paśyāmaḥ
kiṃ tarhi paśyatha ? ityatrāha--jātya ntaraṃ tu anekāntaṃ punaḥ paśyāmaḥ
na kevalamadhyakṛmeva naikāntajātaṃ paritoṣam, api tu sarvaliṅgamapi iti darśayannāha--tata ityādi
tataḥ tasmāttyāyad tasmānnyāyād anekāntasya hetavaḥ sarve'pi sambandhinaḥ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ
yathā yena prakāreṇa saugatena svalakṣaṇaṃ naiyāyikādinā sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ ca uktaṃ kadācid vyavahāradaśāyāṃ paramārthadaśāyāṃ vā kvacit na paśyāmaḥ ? kuta etat ? ityatrāha--pratyakṣa ityādi
varṇo nīlādiḥ saṃsthānaṃ vartulatvādi ādiśabdaḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate tena ekatra rasādeḥ anyatra nava-purāṇādibhedasya parigrahaḥ tena vicitraṃ śabalam
vanādivatpratyayavat bhrāntaṃ tadupalakṣaṇamiti cet; atrāha--svapara ityādi
svaparayoḥ pratibodhaḥ grahaṇaṃ yena yasmin vā tattathoktam

kathañcit kenāpi pratyakṣaprakāreṇa anumānaprakāreṇa vā apramāṇayan apramāṇaṃ kurvan kathayan vā pramāṇāntaram asmāt pratyakṣapramāṇāt anyad avikalpadarśanam anumānaṃ ca tadantaraṃ kathaṃ naiva avatiṣṭheta pratiṣṭhāpayet saugataḥ
nanu uktanyāyāt yadyapi darśanaṃ nāvatiṣṭheta anumānaṃ savikalpakamātiṣṭheta iti cet; atrāha--svata ityādi

svato na sādhānāntarāt kasyacit kāryasya itarasya vā liṅgasya siddhasya niścitasya yaḥ anyathānupapattivitarkaḥ tasmāt parokṣārthapratipattiḥ anumānaṃ ta punaḥ anumānamanupapannam pratyakṣasya ātmani svasvarūpe paratra vā dharmādau kathañcit sadādirūpeṇa na kṣaṇabhaṅgaprakāreṇa paramārthami kriyamāṇāyām anyānapekṣyāmantareṇa, carcitametat--siddhaṃ yanna parāpekṣyam siddhivi॰ 1
kathaṃ naiva tanmithyaikāntaṃ pratyakṣavibhramaikāntaṃ sādhayet ? nahi svayamanupapannam anyad vyavasthāpayati atiprasaṅgāt yataḥ tatsādhanādayaṃ saugataḥ--
vat iti nirarthakaṃ bhāti, vanādipratyayo yathā bhrāntaḥ kevalaṃ samūhālambanaḥ vṛkṣādivyatirekeṇa vanasya svatantrasyābhāvāt
na punaryathātattvamā kriyate iti evaṃ brūyāt iti
yadi punaḥ avicāritaramaṇīyaṃ tena vyavahāraprasiddhyarthaṃ tadāśrīyate tarhi mayāpi tathaiveti na doṣa iti cet; atrāha--yathehitam ityādi

īhitasya svecchāviṣayīkṛtasya anatikrameṇa yathehitam pramāṇātītam apramāṇam paramātmatattvaṃ brahmatattvam anyathā vā pradhānādiprakāreṇa vā kathayato vacanamātreṇa pratipādayataḥ parasyāpi puruṣādyadvaitavādino'pi
na kevalaṃ saugatasya na vaktraṃ vakrībhavati
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā'pramāṇakaṃ vibhramamātraṃ paraprasiddhādapramāṇāt anumānāt saugatasya sidhyati paramārthataḥ tathā parasyāpi vyavahāriprasiddhavacanādeḥ puruṣādyadvaitādi sidhyati
na khalu vyavahārī vacanenāpi vinā jīvituṃ kṣaṇamate iti nivedayiṣyate
yato vaktrasya vakrībhāvāt svalakṣaṇānyeva nānyat yathālakṣaṇaṃ sidhyeyuḥ
yataḥ iti vā ākṣepe naiva sidhyeyuriti
etena bhrāntetaravivekaikāntaṃ kathaṃ sādhayet iti pratyeyam
atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--yathā vibhrametarākāraśūnyaṃ svasaṃvedanamātraṃ pratibhāsāt sidhyati tathā pramāṇātītamanyathā vā sapramāṇaṃ vā puruṣāditattvaṃ sidhyati
taccaritraika jñānaprasādād avagrahādyātmakamekaṃ prasādhya adhunā anyathā sādhayannāha--phalānumeya ityādi

svārthalakṣaṇapratyakṣaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ svaphalānumeyasāmarthyātmakaṃ yadyekaṃ syāt sannihitārthasāmānyaviśeṣāvagrahehārthātmakamekaṃ kathanna bhavet ? yato viśeṣadarśanādeva tadviparītatattvāropavyavacchedasmṛtiḥ kalpyeta
śaktiśaktimatorbhede sambandhāsiddheḥ, abhedaikānte vyaktivyaktyā vyaktiḥ parokṣaiva śaktivat prasajyeta
saṃvṛteraparādho'yam yadimāṃ saṃvṛṇoti pārimaṇḍalyādivaditi śakteḥ saṃvṛtiriyaṃ śaktimasaṃvṛṇvantī tadanekāntatvaṃ prasādhayati
tadayaṃ samāropaḥ pratyakṣe kṣaṇikapārimaṇḍalyādau bhavan ekāntakalpanāmastaṃ gamayati
svaśabdena ekāntavādī gṛhyate tasyāyerthāyā svasaṃvidaḥ tāsāṃ sambandhi yat pratyakṣaṃ pratyakṣaparicchedyam
phalena anumeyā 123 ka 1 śaktiḥ ātmā svabhāvo yasya tattathoktaṃ saha vā yugapadiva tatpratyakṣaṃ krameṇaikaṃ kiṃ na syādeva
bhedasya viśeṣasya īhā tadgrāhyo'rthaparyāyaḥ tathocyate jñānaparyāyaviśeṣaśca, saiva ātmā svabhāvaḥ tena, ca śabdād avagrahāvāyādyātmanā kinna syāt ityarthaḥ pratipādyaḥ

tasya arthareva lakṣaṇam arthasvarūpaṃ yat pratyakṣaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ svasvarūpaṃ yat pratyakṣaṃ pratyakṣapramāṇapramitaṃ tat svaphalānumeyasāmarthyātmakaṃ svam ātmīyaṃ yat phalaṃ tena anumeyaṃ yat sāmarthyam tadātmakam
ātmaśabdena sāmarthyasya tadvato bhedaikāntaṃ nirasyati, tatra tadayogāt
na khalu tato bhinnaṃ sāmarthyaṃ yuktam, bhāvasya tanniṣṭhatvād anyathā sarvaṃ sarvasya tat syāt, samavāyasya niṣedhāt sarvatrā'viśeṣācca
kuta etat ? citratvād bhāvaśaktīnamiti cet; kiṃ punaḥ tadvataḥ tasya ca anyāḥ pṛthagbhūtāḥ śaktayaḥ santi yenaivam ? tathā cet sa eva doṣaḥ anavasthā vā
apṛthagbhūtāścet; tathā ādyaṃ sāmarthyam iti sādhūktam--tadātmakamiti
nityatvāt vyāpakatvādekatvācca sarvaṃ prati samānaḥ samavāya iti bhāvaḥ
nanu phalānumeyasāmarthyātmakam ityevāstu kiṃ svaśabdena lokavattareṇāpi tadarthagateḥ
na khalu loko dhūmādagniṃ pratipadyamānamevaṃ vadati pāvako'tra svadhūmāt iti cet; ucyate--123 kha 1 anyamataniṣedhārthatvādadoṣaḥ
anekaśaktyātmakasya bhāvasya anekaṃ phalaṃ tasmād ekaśaktyātmakabhavānumānam ityanyeṣāṃ darśanam; tanniṣedhārthaṃ svavacanamiti
sannihito'rtho ghaṭādiḥ tasya sāmānyaviśeṣau tāvevāgrahetayorthātayorthaṃ tadātmakamekaṃ kathanna bhavet ? syādeva
yataḥ tadabhavanāt viśeṣadarśanādeva darśanam āśrityaiva kalpyeta
teṣu viśeṣeṣu viparītasyaiva tattvasya āropaḥ tasya vyavacchedasmṛtiḥ kṣaṇikatvānumā naiva kalpyeta, yata ityasya ākṣepārthatvāt, tadviparītajñānasya samāropatvāsiddheriti bhāvaḥ
parasparam anyonyaṃ virodho yayoḥ pratyakṣānumeyayoḥ svabhāvayoḥ ekatvasya tādātmyasya siddhau sahakramābhyāṃ vicitravivartaparamārthaikasvabhāvabhāvapratipatterapratiṣedhāt
no ced bhrāntinimittena pra॰ vā॰ 3 | 43 ityādi

nanu śakti-śaktimatorbhedaikāntaniṣedhe abheda eva iti na pakṣāntarasaṃbhava iti na yuktaṃ phalānumeya ityādi iti cet; atrāha--śaktiśaktimatoḥ bhede naiyāyikopagate yā 123 ka 2 sambandhāsiddhiḥ tasyāḥ sakāśāt yaḥ saugatena tayoḥ abhedaikānto'bhyupagataḥ tasmin sati vyaktiḥ cetanasya itarasya vā vyaktyā buddhyā viṣayīkriyamāṇe svabhāve vyaktiḥ parokṣaiva adṛśyaiva śaktivat prasajyeta
tataḥ hetunā yaḥ samagreṇa pra॰ vā॰ 3
atra paramatamāśaṅkate--śakteḥ pratyakṣatve'pi saṃvṛteḥ viparītakalpanāyām ayamaparādho doṣaḥ yad yasmād imāṃ śaktiṃ saṃvṛṇoti pārimaṇḍalyādivat
atra ādiśabdena kṣaṇikatvādiparigrahaḥ iti evaṃ cet; atrāha--śakteḥ ityādi
śaktiḥ saṃvṛtiḥ saṃvaraṇam iyaṃ pareṇa ucyamānā
kiṃ karoti ? ityāha--tasya anantarasya anekāntatvaṃ prasādhayati
tadevaṃ niścitetaratvena gṛhītetaraṃ rūpaṃ syāt ityarthaḥ
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt ayaṃ samāropaḥ viparītāropaḥ pratyakṣe darśanagocare kṣaṇikapārimaṇḍalyādau bhavan nīlābhāvante kāntakalpanām astaṃgamayati, anekāntasiddheriti manyate
nanu syādayaṃdoṣo yadi samāropavivekavat niścitaṃ gṛhītamanpaśyannalaivam anyathāpyadoṣāt iti cet; atrāha--pratyakṣasya ityādi

123 kha 2 pratyakṣasya nīlādau na kṣaṇikatvādau samāropasya anīlādyāropasya viveko yasmin yena vā tasyaiva nānyasya vyavasāyātmakatvād vyavasitasyaiva pratyakṣatvāt ityahiprapāttām astaṃgamayati iti stambandhaḥ
nanu pratyakṣād vyavasāyodbhavaḥ, tatra kathaṃ tattadātmakamiti cet; atrāha--dṛṣṭeḥ ityādi
itaraśca na dṛṣṭeravikalpikāyāḥ vikalpa iti darśayannāha— svalakṣaṇa ityādi
vyavasāyo vikalpaḥ saṃjāyate, na tu svayaṃ tanniścayātmakam
evamavagrahamīhāṃ ca vyavasthāpya avāyaṃ vyavasthāpayannāha--tatsvārtha ityādi
na hyanyataḥ svārthamavyavacchindat pratyakṣaṃ paricchinatti, nāpi kathañcidaparicchindadeva vyavacchinatti sarvathā arthasvabhāvāsiddhiprasaṅgāt
na ca tato vikalpasaṃbhavaḥ tato varṇasaṃsthānādivikalpo'pi mā bhūta
kathamevaṃ na suptāyitam, kathañcātyantamasadṛśātmakaṃ pūrvāparaparāmarśaśūnyamalakṣyaṃ nimamena sadṛśavikalpaṃ vandhyāsutadarśanamiva yojayet ? yato vikalpānāṃ kutaścidavisaṃvādaḥ sambandhāsiddheḥ
tad iti nipātaḥ sa ityasya arthe draṣṭavyaḥ
evakāro bhinnaprakramaḥ anyāpoha ityasyā'nantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ, tato'nyo vijātīyaḥ apohyate svaviṣayād bhinno vyavasthāpyate yena vyavasāyena so'nyāpoha eva svārthā'vāyo jainābhimataḥ
yadi vā, yathānyāsameva evakāro'stu tadavāya eva anyāpoho nānya ityarthaḥ
kathaṃcana kenāpi svayam upādānatvaprakāreṇa vikalpavāsanāprabodhaprakāreṇa vā
avikalpakadṛṣṭeḥ avikalpadarśanāt syāt bhavet na vikalpamano yataḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadi tadavāya eva anyāpohaḥ ayameva vā tadavāyo na bhavet kintu anya eva darśanajanito mānaso vikalpaḥ; tarhi tadabhāva eva syāt iti
tathāhi--yadi taddṛṣṭiḥ kadācid upalambhagocaracāriṇī yuktametat--yato vikalpamanaḥ iti, nānyathā atiprasaṅgāt
yasmāt nānyato'vivakṣitāt svārthaṃ svam arthaśca avyavacchindat tato bhinnamaviṣayīkurvat pratyakṣaṃ paricchinatti viṣayīkaroti svārthaṃ nāma kintu vyavacchindadeva
anena svārthāvāya eva anyāpoha iti vyākhyātam
nāpi svārthaṃ kathañcit saccetananīlādiprakāreṇa aparicchindadeva vyavacchinatti anena anyāpoha eva tadavāya iti darśitam
sarveṇa anyato vyavacchindatā tatparicchinnatya nena kathañcit pana cchindat vyavacchinatti nāma ityanena vā prakāreṇa arthasvabhāvā'siddhiprasaṅgāt
anyavyavacchedavikalpāt niṣkrāntena gṛhītasya agṛhīta kalpanayā hetubhūtayā vikalpabuddheḥ anyavyavacchedavikalpasya nirviṣayatvācca
svārthavyavasāyajananāt nirvikalpakameva arthasvabhāvagrāhakamiti cet; atrāha--naca ityādi naca tato vikalpasaṃbhavaḥ
nanu mābhūt kṣaṇikādiviṣayattatastatrannīlādiviṣayaṃ ttasyāt iti cet; atrāha--tato varṇa ityādi
tato nirvikalpakadarśanāt na kevalaṃ kṣaṇikatvādivikalpaḥ kintu varṇasaṃsthānādivikalpo'pi mā bhūt, ekasya svaviṣaye tajjanaketararūpāsaṃbhavāditi bhāvaḥ
idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam--tato mānasatajjñānayogād varṇena liṅgena saṃsthānādivikalpaḥ tadanumānamapi mā bhūt, darśanamātraviṣayīkṛtasya liṅgasya tadakāraṇatvāt
nīle vikalpajanakatvaṃ kṣaṇikāṃśe tadajanakatvamiti rūpadvayāsambhavāditi bhāvaḥ
mamaivaṃ pratibhāso yaḥ na sa saṃsthānavarjitaḥ | pra॰ vārtikāla 2 | 1 ityādi
evam anantaraprakāreṇa sati doṣe kathaṃ na suptāyitam ? atraiva dūṣaṇāntaramāha--katham ityādi

kathaṃ ca atyantaṃ sarvātmanā asadṛśātmakaṃ vilakṣaṇaṃ kāraṇaviṣayasvabhāvādinā vikalpadarśanam iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ sadṛśavikalpaṃ niyamena avaśyaṃbhāvena yojayet anyathā nīlajñānaṃ pītavikalpaṃ yojayet aviśeṣāt
kathambhūtaṃ tat ? ityāha--pūrvāparaparāmarśaśūnyaṃ pūrvaḥ kāraṇakṣaṇaḥ aparaḥ kāryakṣaṇaḥ tayoḥ parāmarśo viṣayīkaraṇam tena śūnyam
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadā taddarśanaṃ pūrvāparayorna pravarttate tadā tadgataṃ sādṛśyaṃ na viṣayīkaroti tatkathaṃ tatra smṛtihetuḥ ? ananubhūte tadayogāt
itarathā varttamāne vṛttimadindriyaṃ tatra darśanakāraṇaṃ syāt iti na yuktametat--
tadāśritaṃ kathaṃ jñānaṃ vartetātītabhāvini || pra॰ vārtikāla 3 | 126 iti
atha pūrvasmaraṇasahāyamaparadarśanaṃ tadvikalpena yojayet, evamapi pūrvamātrasmṛtiḥ syāt nāparasadṛśe sādṛśyā'nanubhavāt
tathāpi tatkalpane parimalasmaraṇasahāyaṃ cakṣuḥ gandhe jñānamupajanayet

yadi punaḥ pūrvāparadarśanābhyāṃ tadabhedena vyavasthitaṃ sādṛśyaṃ pratipannameva kevalaṃ pūrvasmaraṇasahāyāduttaradarśanāt tatra vikalpaḥ syāditi cet; tarhi taddarśanābhyāṃ tadabhedena vyavasthitamekatvaṃ pratipannameva kevalaṃ pūrvasmaraṇasahāyādaparadarśanāt tatra ekatvajñānaṃ syāt
tanna parasya sadṛśavikalpaṃ tad yojayediti sthitam
niraṃśaparamāṇurūpatayā santānāntaravadabhāvena sandehena vā anadhyavaśeyaṃyamane bandhyāsutadarśanamiva tatra kathaṃ yojayediti darśayati
yato yojanād vikalpānām ayagavināmanyathā vyavasāyināṃ kutaścit paramparayā svalakṣaṇādutpatteḥ avisaṃvādaḥ
kuta iti cet ? atrāha— sambandhā'siddheḥ iti
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadi parasya svalakṣaṇāt taddarśanādvā vikalpānāmutpattiḥ syāt tadā tatra sambandhasiddheḥ avisaṃvādaḥ syāt
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt na asādhāraṇaikānte pramāṇaprameyaphalavyavasthā
3 ityanena pramāṇasya akramarūpaṃ phalaṃ pratipādya adhunā svapakṣe kramarūpaṃ darśayannāha--vyāpaka ityādi

paśyannayamasādhāraṇameva paśyati darśanāt iti paramasamañjasaṃ sthūlākārasya tatra pratibhāsāt, tadvyatirekeṇa svalakṣaṇāni parisphuṭaṃ tatra pratibhāsanta iti racitaṃ śilāplavaṃ kaḥ śraddadhīta ? nahi sañcitāḥ paramāṇavaḥ pārimaṇḍalyaṃ kṣaṇikatvaṃ vā jahati yato'nyathā pratibhāseran
tadetatsāmānyaṃ vyāpakamavagṛhya viśeṣaṃ pratīhamānaṃ tathā'vayat dhārayati iti yuktā pramāṇaphalavyavasthitiḥ
pūrvapūrvasya svaviṣayagrahaṇānubandhamajahata eva uttarottaraṃ prati sādhakatamatvāt smārtajñānavat
yathādarśanameva sarvatra mānādivyavasthā na yathātattvamityekānte kutastattvapratipattiḥ ? pramāṇāntarasyāpyasiddheḥ
vyāpakaṃ sāmānyaṃ tasya avagrahaśca vyāpto viśeṣaḥ tasya samīhā avāyo dhāraṇāśca
nanu svalakṣaṇamātrasya sarvatra darśanāt ayuktametad--vyāpaketyādi iti cet; atrāha— paśyannayam ityādi
paśyannayaṃ saugataḥ jano vā asādhāraṇameva na sādhāraṇaṃ paśyati
kuta etat ? darśanāt asādhāraṇasya avalokanāt ityevaṃ paramasamajjasam
nāstyeva tatra tasya pratibhāsaḥ svalakṣaṇapratibhāsāditi cet; atrāha— tadvyatirekeṇa ityādi

tadvyatirekeṇa yathoktasthūlākāravyatirekeṇa svalakṣaṇāni parisphuṭaṃ yathā bhavanti tathā tatra akṣabuddhau pratibhāsante ityevaṃ racitaṃ śilāplavaṃ kaḥ śraddhadhīta ? yathoktākārasya tatra pratibhāse'pi eteṣāṃ pratibhāsakalpane kāṣṭhaplave śilāplavakalpanā syāditi manyate
atha tānyeva sañcitāni tathāvabhāsante; tatrāha--nahi ityādi
hiḥ yasmāt na paramāṇavaḥ cetanetarāṇavaḥ saṃtā santaḥ pārimaṇḍalyam asarvagataniraṃśatvaṃ jahati kṣaṇikatvaṃ vā sāṃśā'kṣaṇikatvaprasaṅgāditi manyate
yataḥ tattyāgād anyathā anyena parimaṇḍalakṣaṇikatvaprakārāddinena sāṃśā'kṣaṇikatvaprakāreṇa pratibhāseran
yata iti vā ākṣepe, naiva pratibhāseran
tathāpi tathāvabhāsane na kiñcidvijñānamabhrāntaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt etat pratīyamānaṃ pratyakṣam avagṛhya
kim ? ityāha--sāmānyaṃ dvividhamapi, kathambhūtam ? vyāpakaṃ svasakalaviśeṣasvabhāvam, anyasya vyāpakatvābhāvāt
kiṃ kurvat kiṃ karoti ? ityatrāha--viśeṣaṃ tadvyāpyabhedaṃ prati īhamānaṃ tathā īhitaviśeṣaprakāreṇa avayat niścinvat dhārayati dhāraṇībhavati iti evaṃ yuktaṃ pramāṇaphalavyavasthitiḥ

atrāha--naiyāyikādiḥ--viśeṣaṇasya sāmānyasya vyāpakasya yadā jñānaṃ pramāṇaṃ tadā viśeṣasya viśeṣyasya jñānaṃ phalam, asya ca pramāṇatve saṃskāraḥ phalam ityabhidhānāt madīya eva mate tadvyavasthitiḥ; tatrāha--atraiva iti
parīkṣyamāṇe asminneva anekānte tattve tadvyavasthitiriti sambandhaḥ, anyatra sāmānyādivyavasthā'bhāvāditi bhāvaḥ
yadā sannikarṣaḥ tadā jñānaṃ pramitiḥ, yadā jñānaṃ tadā hānopādānopekṣābuddhayaḥ phalam...--nyāyabhā॰ 1

tatra sāmānyaviśeṣeṣu svarūpālocanamātraṃ pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇam...pramitiḥ dravyādiviṣayaṃ jñānam...athavā sarveṣu padārtheṣu catuṣṭayasannikarṣādavitathamavyapadeśyaṃ yajjñānamutpadyate tatpratyakṣaṃ pramāṇaṃ...pramitiḥ guṇadoṣamādhyasthyadarśanamiti
yadā nirvikalpakaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣajñānaṃ pramāṇaṃ tadā dravyādiviṣayaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ jñānaṃ pramitirityarthaḥ

yadā nirvikalpakaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣajñānamapi pramārūpamarthapratītirūpatvāt tadā tadutpattāvavibhaktamālocanamātraṃ pratyakṣaṃ...viśeṣyajñānaṃ viśeṣaṇajñānasya phalaṃ viśeṣaṇajñānaṃ na jñānāntaraphalaṃ...yadā nirvikalpakaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣajñānaṃ phalaṃ tadā indriyārthasannikarṣaḥ pramāṇam, yadā viśeṣyajñānaṃ phalaṃ tadā sāmānyaviśeṣālocanaṃ pramāṇamityuktaṃ tāvat...samprati hānādibuddhīnāṃ phalatve viśeṣyajñānaṃ pramāṇamityāha...--praśa॰ kanda॰ pṛ॰ 199
niścayaṃ tu phalaṃ tatra nāsāvālocito yadā
nanu ca madhyakṣaṇekṣaṇakṣīṇam adhyakṣaṃ na pūrvottarakṣaṇau īkṣituṃ kṣamate
nāpi pūrvāparaparyāyālokanaṃ madhyakṣaṇamālocate, khaṇḍe vṛttimat na muṇḍādau vartate tatkutaḥ tadādhārasya sāmānyasya tasya tadvyāpakasyeti cet ? atrāha--pūrvapūrvasya
pūrvapūrvaṃ yadvijñānaṃ tasya tasya uttaramuttaraṃ ca pratītiḥ yajjñānaṃ tatprati sādhakatamatvāt avyavadhānena janakatvāt pūrvapūrvasya uttarottarajñānapariṇāmāditi bhāvaḥ
kathambhūtasya ? svaviṣayagrahaṇānubandhamajahata eva svaviṣayaṃ gṛhṇadeva viṣayāntaragrahaṇākāreṇa pariṇamate
smṛtireva smārttaṃ jñānaṃ tasya iva tadvat iti
etacca parasya suprasiddham, anyathā kathaṃ kālpanikamapi sāmānyādivyavahāramāracayet
nanu sarvatra tadvyavasthā yathādarśanameva na paramārthata iti cet; atrāha--yathā ityādi
sarvatra antarbahiśca mahi vā itaramatavat jainamate'pi yathādarśanameva mānādivyavasthā na yathātattvam ityevam ekānte aṅgīkriyamāṇe kuto na kutaścit tattvasya yathādarśanameva pra॰ vā॰ 2
357 ityādi svarūpasya kṣaṇakṣayādisvarūpasya vā pratipattiḥ ? etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadi tatra yathādarśanameva tadvyavasthā bahirarthavanna tatsiddhiḥ
nanu mā bhūt pratyakṣataḥ tatpratipattiḥ vicārāt syāditi cet; atrāha--pramāṇāntarasyāpi ityādi
idamatra tātparyam--yāvān kaścidvicāraḥ sa sarvo'pi yadi apramāṇam; na tato bahirarthavat prakṛtatattvasiddhiḥ
atha pramāṇam, na pratyakṣam; vicārātmakatvāt kalpanāpoḍhatvād bhrāntatvācca pratyakṣasya
anumānaṃ cet; tarhi pramāṇāntarasyāpi anumānasyāpyasiddhiḥ kutaḥ tattvapratipattiḥ ? kutaḥ tadasiddhiḥ ? ityatrāha--pratyakṣasvabhāvatvāt iti
pratyakṣasya avikalpasya svabhāvaḥ kṣaṇikaniraṃśaparamāṇurūpatā iva svabhāvo yasya tasya bhāvāt tattvāt
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā avikalpadarśanaṃ na lakṣyaṃ tathā anumāna mapi
na ca tasya rūpadvayaṃ yena kathañcillakṣyaṃ syāt, ekāntahāniprasaṅgāt
athavā pratyakṣasya svaparabhāvayoḥ vibhramaḥ svabhāvaḥ sarvavikalpātītatā vā sa iva svabhāvo yasya tasya bhāvāt tattvāt iti
tato yathā pratyakṣānna svaparayoḥ siddhiḥ tathā anumānādapi iti
yathā vā, na vibhramādi vyavasthā tathā adhyakṣānumānavyavasthāpīti bhāvaḥ
sarveṇa paramārthaprakāreṇeva vyavahāraprakāreṇāpi sarvathā siddhiḥ asiddheḥ iti vikalpābhāve atyantavyavahārāpahārāt mithyaikānte tadagrahāditi
evaṃ parasya pratītyabhāvena pramāṇāntarā'siddhiruktā, sāmprataṃ kāraṇābhāvena sā ucyate iti darśayitumāha--nibodha ityādi
svaviṣayaviśeṣanirbhāsaṃ pratyakṣamātmānaṃ kathañcinna lakṣayatīti viruddham, yathāsamayaṃ pratipatteḥ
viśeṣaṃ lakṣayato nirākāṅkṣatvāt kathañcidaprayatamānasya kutaḥ smṛtiryataḥ samāropavyavacchedavikalpaḥ
yadi punaḥ anubhūtaṃ sarvathā na lakṣayet kutaḥ samāropavyavacchedaprayatnaḥ supuptavat
viśeṣaṃ paśyato lakṣayato vā samānākārasmṛtirayuktaiva tayorasambandhāt
tattvadarśinastadviparītasmṛtyutpādanaprayatnānupapatteḥ taddarśanabalotpatteḥ tattve pravartanācca nānarthikā anumānavaditi cet; tasyāstarhi prāmāṇyaṃ yuktaṃ tadabhāve saṃvādāyogāt
nibodho bodho hetuḥ kāraṇam anyasya pramāṇāntarasya iti avikalpanā vommayasya kalpanā

kiṃ kurvan ? alakṣayan aniścinvan, sarvataḥ sajātīyād anyato'rthāntarād vilakṣaṇaṃ vyāvṛttaṃ parakalpitaṃ vastu dharmmāde siddheḥ, aniścitasya asya anumānahetutve svāpādau prasaṅga iti coktam, taduttarakālabhāvivikalpāpekṣa taddhetuḥ iti cet; atrāha--sadṛśasmṛtyā iti
sadṛśasmṛtyā sadṛśavikalpena kāraṇena sa tasya hetuḥ ityapi avikalpanā vikalpapramāṇāntaratāpatteḥ
yadvakṣyati atraiva vṛttau tasyāḥ tarhi ityādi
sa tarhi tallakṣayan tasya heturiti cet; atrāha--anīhaḥ ityādi
anīhaḥ sattvādivat kṣaṇikatvādirūpeṇāpi lakṣite vastuni alakṣitā sā sambhavātti rākāṅkṣaḥ tasya hetuḥ ityapi vi kalpanā niścite pramāṇāntaravaiphalyāditi manyate
vilakṣaṇe lakṣite ca sadṛśasmṛterabhāvāt tayā hetuḥ iti avikalpanā iti
nanu syādayaṃ doṣo yadi tatsarvathā na sarvaṃ lakṣayet
svo bodhātmā viṣayo'rthaḥ, yadi svāveva viśeṣau bhedau sarvato vyāvṛttatvāt, tayornirbhāsaḥ tadākāratā sa vidyate yasya tattathoktaṃ jñānam

kathaṃbhūtam ? pratyakṣam avikalpadarśanam ātmānaṃ svasvarūpam, upalakṣaṇametat--tena viṣayasvarūpaṃ ca, kathañcit sattvādirūpeṇa na kṣapati ityevaṃ viruddham ekasya lakṣitetarasvabhāve anekāntaprasaṅgāditi manyate
sarvathā tarhi lakṣayati iti cet; atrāha--yathāsamayam ityādi
samayasya saugatakalpitaṃ tasya anatikrameṇa yathāsamayaṃ pratipatteḥ tattvasya, lakṣayatīti viruddham
kuta etat ? ityatrāha— viśeṣaṃ lakṣayato nirākāṅkṣatvāt
tathāpi tadvṛttiḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--kathañcit ityādi
nīlādiprakāreṇeva kṣaṇikatvādiprakāreṇāpi aprayatamānasya vastu sādhayitumanīhamānasya kutaḥ kāraṇāt smṛtirdṛṣṭāntasmaraṇaṃ yataḥ smṛteḥ samāropavyavaccheda vikalpaḥ tadvyavacchedakamanumānam
tena pratyakṣeṇa lakṣitasya samārope aṅgīkriyamāṇe atiprasaṅgāt anumānalakṣitasyāpi syāt
bhavatu ko doṣaḥ iti cet; atrāha--kim akiñcitkara ityādi
tarhi sarvathā na lakṣayatīti cet; atrāha--yadi punaḥ ityādi
anubhūtaṃ anubhavaviṣayīkṛtaṃ sarvathā kṣaṇikatvādinā iva nīlatvādināpi yadi na lakṣayet, pratyakṣam iti sambandhaḥ
kutaḥ samāropavyavacchedaprayatnaḥ samāropavyavacchedo'numānaṃ tatra prayatnaḥ kutaḥ ? suṣuptasya iva tadvat iti
syānmatam--uttaravikalpajananāt pratyakṣaṃ tallakṣayati ityucyate tato'yamadoṣaḥ iti; tatrāha--viśeṣam ityādi
viśeṣaṇaṃ paśyato darśanasya lokasya vā samānākārasmṛtirayuktaiva
kathaṃbhūtasya ? lakṣayato vā viśeṣamiti lakṣaṇokṛtavikāre'pi punaḥ lakṣayataḥ iti vacanaṃ doṣāntarapratipādanārtham
kutaḥ sā na yuktā ? ityāha--tayoḥ viśeṣadarśanasamānākārasmṛtyoḥ asambandhāt tādātmyatadutpattisambandhavirahāt
yadyapi viśeṣarūpeṇa lakṣaṇīkṛta eva vicāraḥ pravartate
atha matam--mā bhūd visadṛśayoḥ tādātmyalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ, pāvakadhūmayoriva tadutpatti lakṣaṇaḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--atiprasaṅgo hi evaṃ syāt nīlānubhavasya pītasmṛtiḥ syāt visadṛśatvāviśeṣāt
tadvat tatsmṛtirapi tadgrāhikā iti cet; atrāha--vikalpabuddheḥ atadviṣayatvāt arthakiyāsamarthā'viṣayatvāt kāraṇāt anarthikā iti
bhavatu atadviṣayā tathāpi tatsattayaiva naḥ prayojanamiti cet; atrāha--tattva ityādi
tattvadarśinaḥ saugatasya anyasya vā arthakriyārthinaḥ tasya tattvasya yā viparītā samānākārasmṛtiḥ tasyā utpādane yaḥ prayatnaḥ tasya anupapatteḥ anarthikā iti
nahi nīladarśinaḥ tatkriyārthinaḥ pītasmṛtikaraṇe prayatna upapadyate

tasya tattvasya darśanaṃ tasya balaṃ sāmarthyaṃ tena utpatteḥ tatratve pravartanātva na anarthikā anumānavat iti cet; atrāha--tasyāḥ samānākārasmṛteḥ tarhi prāmāṇyaṃ yuktam upapannam, na dṛṣṭeḥ prāmāṇyaṃ yuktam iti
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt ayaṃ saugataḥ viśeṣadarśanāt sāmānyasmṛtivyavahāraṃ pravarttayan avikalpa eva parāmarśaśūnya eva
tannāsya pramāṇāntarasya siddhiriti kutaḥ tattvapratipattiriti sthitam
bhavatu tarhi yathātattvameva mānādivyavasthā, sā ca saugatamata eva; ityatrāha--
vikalpabuddheḥ na kevalamavastunirbhāsaḥ kintu visaṃvādo'pi sāmānyapratipatteḥ viśeṣadarśanāt
punaranumānāt kṣaṇabhaṅgādiṣu vyavahartra bhiprāyavaśāt prāmāṇyāprāmāṇyavyavasthāyāṃ vikalpāvikalpayoḥ pramāṇetaravyavasthā prasajyate
kathamarthanirbhāsa iti cet; sthūlasyaikasya pratibhāsanāt vastuno tadviparītalakṣaṇatvāt

vikalpe anumāne anyasmin vā anarthanirbhāse vastusāmānyākāre visaṃvādini vigatā'vipratipattiprapañce yadivāvyabhicāriṇi satyavikalpake kṣaṇikaniraṃśaikaparamāṇuniṣṭhe darśane pratyakṣaṃ kiṃ na kiñcid vikalpajñānam anyadvā, yadi vā svasaṃvedanam anyadvā, yata idaṃ sūktaṃ syāt--kalpanāpoḍhaṃ jñānaṃ pratyakṣam pramāṇasamu॰ pṛ॰ 8 iti, tadābhāsaṃ kim ? na kiñcit, pratyakṣāpekṣyasyāsya tadabhāve abhāvāditi tadvyavacchedārthamabhrāntagrahaṇamayuktam
paśya hi bahiriva antaḥ paramāṇumātraṃ tattvaṃ na tasya dvicandrādidarśanamapi
pratyakṣa pramāṇād yad anumānaṃ tadantaram tadeva vā kiṃ yata idaṃ śobheta--trirūpāt liṅgād nyāyabi॰ 2
pramāṇāntarābhāsaṃ vā kim ? tat sūktam--hetvābhāsāḥ tato'pare hetubi॰ ślo॰ 1 ityādi
sāmānyasya pratipattiḥ yasyāṃ sā tathoktā tasyā vikalpabuddheḥ pravṛttena viśeṣāṇāṃ darśanāt śaṅkhe pītapratipatteḥ pravṛttena śukladarśanādiva
nanu viśeṣeṣu tadvisaṃvāde'pi na tatsādhyāyāṃ sa iti cet; atrāha--artham ityādi
arthaṃ pāvakādikaṃ paricchidya anayā vikalpabuddhyā pravartamānaḥ jano'rthakriyāyāṃ dāhādilakṣaṇāyāṃ visaṃvādyate viśeṣadarśanāt sāmānyapratipatteḥ ityetadatrāpi sambadhyate

etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathāvidhamarthaṃ paricchidya pravarttate janaḥ tathāvidhārthasādhyā'rthakriyāprāptau tatra tadavisaṃvādo nānyathā, itarathā pītajñānāt pravarttamānasya śuklaśaṅkhārthakiyāprāptau tatra jñānamavisaṃvādi syāditi

anumānavikalpabuddhyā na visaṃvādyate iti cet; atrāha--punaḥ ityādi--punaḥ liṅgabuddhyanantaram anumānādarthaṃ paricchidya pravarttamāno visaṃvādyate, kva ? kṣaṇabhaṅgādiṣu viśeṣadarśanāt sāmānyapratipatteḥ
nanu vyākhyātāraḥ khalvevaṃ vivecayanti na vyavaharttāraḥ
te hi dṛśyavikalpyāvarthau ekīkṛtya yatheṣṭaṃ pravarttante, tadabhiprāyavaśāt tadavañcanamuktam pra॰ vā॰ sva॰ 1

vyavahartṝṇām vyavahāriṇām yadeva asmābhiḥ liṅgabuddheḥ liṅgibuddhervā pratipannam tadeva prāpyate iti yo'bhiprāyaḥ tadvaśāt kṣaṇikavikalpānāṃ prāmāṇyavyavasthāyāṃ nityādivikalpānāṃ vā'pramāṇavyavasthāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ vikalpāvikalpayoḥ pramāṇetaravyavasthā prasajyeta

darśanottarakālabhāvī nīlādiniścayaḥ iha vikalpa ityucyate nā'numānam, atra parasya vivādā'bhāvāt, tasya pramāṇatvavyavasthā--yadeva tena paricchannaṃ tadeva prāpyate iti, tadabhiprāyavaśād avikalpasya apramāṇatvavyavasthā prasajyeta anena arthaṃ paricchidya pravarttamānā vayaṃ tatprāptinattaititannetitattada bhiprāyaḥ
etena darśanadṛṣṭaviṣayatvamapi vikalpasya nirastam; tathā tadabhiprāyābhāvāt
vastuvikalpasya tadvya vastheti cet; atrāha--vastutaḥ paramārthataḥ
punaḥ iti pakṣāntaradyotane, vikalpabuddheḥ anumānavikalpabuddherapi anyasyāḥ svayaṃ pareṇa tattvopagamāt visaṃvādo'pi vañcanaṃ na kevalamavastunirbhāsa eva
tathā ca itaravikalpavad anumānavikalpo'pi pramāṇaṃ na bhavediti manyate
astu tarhi sarvā vikalpabuddhirapramāṇaṃ visaṃvādāt avastunirbhāsācca, avikalpabuddhistu pramāṇaṃ viparyayāditi cet; atrāha--tathaiva ityādi
avikalpabuddheḥ bauddhena svalakṣaṇaviṣayatvopagamāt kvarthaṃ tadavastuviṣayatvamiti manvānaḥ paraḥ pṛcchati kathamanarthanirbhāsaḥ iti ? atrottaramāha--sthūlasyaikasya pratibhāsanāt ityādi
idameva vastulakṣaṇamiti cet; atrāha— vastunaḥ ityādi
vastunaḥ arthakriyākāriṇo bhāvasya tasmād uktāllakṣaṇād viparītam anyathābhūtam advayarūpaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ paśya tasya bhāvāt tattvāt
paraprasiddhyā idamuktam, tata eva avastunirbhāsādeva visaṃvādo'pi na kevalam avastunirbhāsa eva avikalpabuddheḥ iti sambandhaḥ
tathā ca pramāṇamavisaṃvādi jñānam pra॰ vā॰ 1
nanu vyavahāramāśritya pramāṇamavisaṃvādi jñānam ityuktam vyavahāreṇa pra॰ vā॰ 1

na ca janāḥ tadavastunirbhāse'pi saṃvādabhājaḥ pratīyante, tadavastunirbhāsa eva vastvadhyāropeṇa pravṛttau tatparitoṣadarśanāt, tatparitoṣaśca avisaṃvāda iti saugataṃ matam, tat kasyeva tasyā visaṃvāda iti cet; atrāha-- vikalpavad iti
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā vikalpasya avastusāmānyanirbhāsino visaṃvādaḥ tataḥ pravṛttau jātaparitoṣe'pi vyavahāriṇi tathā avikalpabuddherapi
itarathā tadvat vikalpasyāpi prāmāṇyasiddhiḥ pramāṇasaṃkhyāniyamaḥ svalakṣaṇaikāntaśca niravasaraḥ syāt

etenedamapi nirastaṃ yaduktam a rca ṭe na--vyavahartrabhiprāyavaśād vikalpasya gṛhītagrahaṇāt prāmāṇyamuktaṃ, na bhāvataḥ, tatra tadabhāvāt, paramārthataḥ punaḥ avastunirbhāsāt iti; katham ? avikalpabuddherapi asya samānatvāt

tulanā--yadyapi tenānadhigataṃ sāmānyamadhigamyata iti varṇyate tathāpi tadarthakriyāsādhanaṃ na bhavatīti tadadhigantā taimirikādijñānaprakhyo vidhivikalpo na pramāṇam...jātestu arthakriyāsādhanatvābhāvādanadhigatāyā adhigame'pi keśādijñānasyeva na prāmāṇyam
adhunā yogācārasya mataṃ dūṣayituṃ darśayati--yathā ityādi
satyaṃ kathaṃ syurākārā nirbhāsā yato bahiḥ || 18
yathākathañcit yena kenacit sāmānyādiprakāreṇa vikalpasya avikalpasya vā avabhāsinaḥ
kathaṃbhūtam ? satyam avitatham niraṃśaṃ tasyaiva satyatvāt
tato'yamarthaḥ--satyāḥ avitathāḥ katham ? kathañcit su bhaveyuḥ ākārāḥ nirbhāsā yataḥ satyākārebhyo bahiḥ

bahirarthaśūnyā vijñaptireva tanmātraṃ tatrāpi na kevalaṃ bahirarthe sarvaṃ niravaśeṣam anantaraṃ bahirarthadūṣaṇaṃ samānam tato bahirarthavat mādhyasthyabaddhaparikareṇa prāmāṇikajanena tadapi pariharaṇīyamiti manyate
200 iti vadatā tanmātramapi citramekaṃ nābhyupagantavyaṃ kintu niraṃśamekam, tathā ca citrapratibhāsāpi ekaiva buddhiḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
