tacca na nīlādisukhādiśarīravyatiriktam, parasya anabhyupagamāt, anyathā na nīlādisukhādiśarīravyatiriktaṃ jaḍārthagrāhakamasti iti pra jñā ka ra gu pta sya vacanaṃ na subhāṣitaṃ syāt
apratibhāsanācca, anya thā brahmapratibhāso'pi kathaṃ nirākriyeta ? tato nīlādisukhādiśarīrasvabhāvaṃ tadityabhyupagantavyam
tasya ca svatattvam ātmasvabhāva kṣaṇikaniraṃśaparamāṇuparimāṇaṃ muktvā vihāya anyathaiva sthirasthūlasādhāraṇātmanā pratibhāsanāt
uktaṃ ca atraiva--paśyan svalakṣaṇānyekaṃ sthūlam siddhivi॰ 1
itarathā yaduktaṃ pra jñā ka re ṇa--tadetannūnamāyātam pra॰ vā॰ 2
210 ityādinā paramāṇupratibhāsaṃ vyavasthāpayato atisūkṣmekṣikayā vicārayato'pi sthūlaikapratibhāso nati varttate ityāśaṅkya māyāmarīciprabhṛtipratibhāsavad asattve'pyadoṣaḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
...citraṃ nīlapītādyātmakaṃ tat pataṅgādikamekamiti cet; idam citramekam yaducyate tat tataḥ citrapataṅgādapi citrataram āścaryataram
nīlādisukhādikamantareṇāparasya jñānākārasyānupalakṣaṇātpṛ॰ 345yathā ca na sukhādivyatirekeṇāparaṃ vijñānaṃ tathā nīlādivyatirekeṇāpi
nīlānna vyatirekeṇa viṣayijñānamīkṣyate pṛ॰ 406 na hi sitāsitādivyatirekeṇāparā grāhakāditā pratibhāsamānopalabhyate

yatpunaruktaṃ tenaiva--yadavabhāsate tajjñānaṃ yathā sukhādi, avabhāsate ca nīlā dikam iti; tadanena nirastam; niraṃśaparamāṇusvabhāvasya nīlādeḥ sādhyadharmitve sukhādeśca dṛṣṭāntatve sādhyadharmiprabhṛti sarvamasiddham apratibhāsanāt
citraikarūpasya tattve sarvaṃ siddhaṃ viparyayāt, idaṃ tvasiddham--tajjñānam iti, tatra tadasaṃbhavād anabhyupagamāt, parasya citraikajñānasiddheḥ
tama nyatra niraṃśe vastuni jñānatvaṃ sādhyo dharmo varttate anyatra sādhyadharmī dṛṣṭāntadharmī ca yatra sādhyadharmo varttate iti na kiñcidetat
nanu ca nīlāderyadyapi sthūlādirūpeṇa svatattvaṃ muktvā avabhāsanaṃ tathāpi na svasaṃvedanarūpatayā, ataḥ tayā tasya satyasatya vā na prakṛtarūpeṇeti cet; atrāha— yathākathañcit ityādi
kiṃ kṛttvā ? ātmarūpaṃ muktvā advayasvabhāvaṃ vihāya
kathamavabhāsinaḥ ? yathākathañcid yena kenacit sthūlādigrāhyādiprakāreṇa, satyākāro citsvasaṃvedanarūpatayā na sthūlādirūpatayā syāt bhavet
kṣāntaḥ svasvarūpe tathā santi vibhrametararūpatayā citramekaṃ jñānaṃ syāditi manyate
bhavatvevaṃ ko doṣa iti cet; atrāha--bahiḥ bāhyaṃ vastunaḥ kiṃ syādeva satyākāraṃ vibhramekam
athavā tasya jñānasya satyākāraḥ kathañcinnīlādirūpatayā na sthūlādirūpatayā na kiñcit syādeva
tathā ca sautrāntiko vijayate na yogācāraḥ, tasya kathañcit jāgraddaśāsambandhitayā na svapnādyavasthāsambandhitayā
tato nirākṛtato nirākṛtametat--nirālambanāḥ sarve pratyayāḥ pratyayatvāt svapnapratyayavat
katham ? jñānasya sthūlādyākāravat pratibhāsanāt svasaṃvedanākārasyāpi satyatāvirahaprasaṅgāt bahirarthavat na tadākārasiddhiḥ syāditi
nīlādayo hi svapnapratibhāsavadasatyāḥ pū॰ 185 grāhyatā pratibhāsādanyā nāsti pṛ॰ 196
paramārthataḥ saṃvedanamevāvibhāgamiti sthitam pṛ॰ 398 grāhyagrāhakabhāvo hi naivāsti paramārthataḥ
kārikāyāḥ sugamatvād vyākhyānamakṛtvā ka rṇa ka matapraveśārtha pūrvoktamupasaṃharannāha— yathā ityādi

yathā yena prakāreṇa buddhervitathapratibhāsanāt hetunā tataḥ tadvā āśritya sautrāntikasya artharūpam arthasya acetanasya ghaṭāde rūpam anekakṣaṇikaniraṃśaparamāṇulakṣaṇaṃ na sidhyati tathā yogācārasyāpi svarūpaṃ ca tato buddherna sidhyati
kuta etat ? ityatrāha--aviśeṣāt viśeṣābhāvāt vastusvabhāvaparihāreṇa pratibhāsasya ubhayatra samatvāt
yathā vā tena bahiḥ sthūlaikākāro neṣyate tathā yogācāreṇāpi antaḥ
athavā, yathā buddhervitathapratibhāsanāt svapnādidaśāyām artharūpaṃ na sidhyati aviśeṣeṇa naiyāyikādeḥ tathā svarūpaṃ ca svasaṃvedanaṃ ca buddherna sidhyati aviśeṣeṇa yogācārasya
kuta etat ? ityatrāha--aviśeṣāt viśeṣābhāvāt arthajñānapakṣayoḥ, ekatra svapnādiḥ anyatra grāhyākāro dṛṣṭānta iti manyate
ka lla ka stu āha--svarūpamantareṇa ityādi
buddheḥ yatsvarūpamātrā sākṣātkaraṇalakṣaṇaṃ tadantareṇa vibhramasya bhrāntākārasya yaḥ pratibhāsaḥ tasya asaṃbhavāt, svataḥ tasya pratibhāse vibhramā'yogāditi manyate
tathā prayogaḥ— asti buddheḥ svarūpaṃ vibhramapratibhāsā'nyathānupapatteḥ
nanvevam artharūpamantareṇāpi tatpratibhāsāsaṃbhavāt tatastatsiddhiḥ kasmānneti cet; atrāha--viṣaya ityādi
viṣayasya ghaṭāderabhāve'pi na kevalaṃ bhāve bahulaṃ tathā viṣayagrāhakatvena upalabdherbuddheḥ sarvatra sarvadā tathā seti manyate
asamānam ityevaṃ cet; atra dūṣaṇamāha--anyathā ityādi
kathañcidasiddhātmano buddheḥ kathamasādhāraṇaṃ rūpamanumīyate ? yataḥ saṃbhāvyaṃ syāt

svatastaccidrūpasiddhau saṃbhāvitāsādhāraṇātmanaḥ sākalyena yat sattatsarvaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣātmakamiti vyāptisiddhau kathaṃ dravyasya paramārthasyāpi bahirarthasya pratyakṣapratipattirapahnūyeta ? na hi agṛhītavastusāmānyaṃ cidrūpamātraṃ pratyakṣaṃ kartumavagāhate yatastena cetanaikāntasiddhirviśiṣyeta

idamatra tātparyam--kathañcid buddheḥ pratyakṣatve yathākathañcid ityādi dūṣaṇamuktam iti sarvathā tadapratyakṣatvamaṅgīkarttavyam, tasmiṃśca sati na vibhramapratibhāsasaṃbhavaḥ, pareṇāpi tathābhyupagamāt
tathā ca anyathā anyena buddhisvarūpābhāvaprakāreṇa anupapannatvam asiddhasya aniścitasya vibhramapratibhāsasya na sidhyati
nahi asiddhasya bandhyāsutasya tadabhāva prakāreṇa anupapannam iti vaktuṃ śakyam
anena anyathānupapannatvaṃ hetulakṣaṇaṃ tadvattve siddhamiti darśayati
tarhi saccetanādirūpeṇa pratyakṣā buddhiḥ nāpareṇeti cet; atrāha--citsāmānya ityādi
nanvetat bahirna kim ityanena dūṣaṇamuktam, tat kimarthaṃ punarucyate iti cet; na; tena buddhervibhramākārasya kathañcidabhede idamuktam, anena ekāntena bhede iti vibhāgāt
cideva tasyā vā sāmānyam tasya vidā vedanena buddhisvabhāvabhūtavibhramākāravivekagrahaṇavimukhacinmātragrahaṇena ityarthaḥ
yuktam upapannaṃ svagrahaṇayogyo yo'rthaḥ tasya sāmānyam īkṣitum
anena buddheḥ kathañcit pratyakṣatvamekasyārthasvabhāvasya pra॰ vā॰ 3
ko'nyo na dṛṣṭo bhāgaḥ syādyaḥ pramāṇaiḥ parīkṣyate

kathañcid vibhramākāravivekādiprakāreṇāpi asiddhātmanaḥ sarvathā agṛhītarūpāyā buddheḥ katham asādhāraṇam acetanādiva vibhramādapi vyāvṛttaṃ yadadvayaṃ svasvaṃvedanarūpaṃ tadvibhramapratibhāsānyathānupapattyā anumīyeta na kathañcit
yato'numīyamānatvāt saṃbhāvyaṃ syāt asādhāraṇaṃ rūpam iti sambandhaḥ
syānmatam--tasyāḥ saccetanādi rūpaṃ svataḥ siddham; ityāha--svataḥ ityādi
svato nānyataḥ tasyāḥ cideva rūpaṃ tasya siddhau aṅgīkriyamāṇāyāṃ buddheḥ iti sambandhaḥ
saṃbhāvitaḥ anumeyaḥ asādhāraṇaḥ ātmā yasyāḥ sā tathoktā tasyāṃ kim ? ityatrāha— sākalyena ityādi
sākalyena bahirantaśca yat sat tatsarvaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣātmakam ityevaṃ vyāptisiddhau kathaṃ pratyakṣeṇa pratyakṣāḥ vā pratipattiḥ pratyakṣapratipattiḥ apahnūyeta ? naiva
punarapi kathaṃbhūtasya ? ityāha--dravyetyādi paramārthasya iti paryantam
nanu yadi nāma na buddhiḥ pratyakṣasaṃbhāvitātmā, bahirarthasya kimāyātaṃ, yena so'pi tathā syāditi cet; atrāha--na hi agṛhīta ityādi
kim ? ityāha— cidrūpamātram citsvasaṃvedanalakṣaṇa rūpaṃ yasya bhāvasya sa tathoktaḥ sa eva tanmātraṃ karma jñānasāmānyamiti yāvat
kathaṃbhūtam ? ityāha--agṛhītavastusāmānyam agṛhītaṃ bāhyavā sāmānyaṃ yena tattathoktam

etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā vyāpakasya cidrūpamātrasya anupalabdhau tadvyāpyasya saṃbhāvitāsādhāraṇarūpasya vibhramākāravivekalakṣaṇasya anupalabdhiḥ tathā prakṛtamapi iti yaduktaṃ pra jñā ka re ṇa— atītānāgatāvasthānāmagrahaṇe'pi tadavasthātā gṛhyate ityatra kathaṃ vyāpyā'pratipattau tadvyāpakapratipattiḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 1
44 iti; tadanena nirastam; vibhramākāravivekāpratipattāvapi tadvyāpakacidrūpamātrapratipattivad viśeṣā'grahaṇe'pi tadvyāpakasāmānyapratipattisaṃbhavāt

nanu bahi ḥ vyāpakopalabdhāvapi viśeṣāṇāṃ yadyadarśanaṃ kathaṃ tasya te iti pratipattiḥ ? punastatra darśanāditi cet; punastatra darśanaṃ kutaḥ siddham ? na tāvat pūrvapratyakṣāt; tasya paścādbhāvāt tatrā'pravṛtteḥ
ubhayakālabhāvi ca tadekaṃ kramabhāvicakṣurādivyāpāracarcitaṃ na cāru carcanamarhati
tadgrahaṇopāyāsaṃbhavācca ātmasattāmātrasyā'viśeṣāt, na tataḥ tatsiddham pratyakṣaparyāyasya kṛtottaratvāt
athāvasthānāmagrahaṇe na pūrvāparavyāptipratītiḥ; avasthā'grahaṇe'vasthātṛpratītiḥ kathaṃ bhavet
kramabhāvyubhayavyāpinaḥ ekasya siddhau tathābhūtasyātmano'pi siddhiḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ
etena anumānamapi cintitam; tatra tadabhāve'syābhāvāditi cet; atrāha--cidrūpam ityādi
kutaścidapi svayamavyāvṛttaṃ sāmānyaṃ paśyanneva ātmā gṛhītuṃ prayatamānaḥ acetanavyavacchinnaṃ caitanyaṃ dravyaṃ krameṇa gṛhṇīyāt
tataḥ pratyakṣa ātmā svayamavipratiṣiddhaḥ yathāsāmarthyamantargṛhṇāti tathā ca bahirityavagantavyam
kathañcidapratyakṣatve kuto vastu saṃbhāvayet liṅgāderasiddheḥ gāḍhanidrākrāntavat
kutaḥ ? sarvataḥ sajātīyād vijātīyācca satsāmānyaṃ tasyaiva tathāvidhatvāditi manyate

paśyataḥ vikalpadarśanena viṣayīkurvataḥ saugatasya tadviśeṣaḥ tasya citsambandhinaḥ tatsāmānyasya viśeṣaḥ caitanyādilakṣaṇaḥ vṛttau vakṣyamāṇo bhedaḥ yathā yena prakāreṇa vedyo grāhyaḥ paramārthataḥ iti tanmadhyekaraṇāt ubhayatra sambandhanīyam
tathā tena prakāreṇa bahiḥ bahirarthe upeyatāṃ satsāmānyaṃ paśyato'rthasya tathā viśeṣo vedyaḥ nidarśanam anantaranītyā prasādhitaṃ na punaḥ prasādhyate
kutaścid ityādinā kārikārthamāha--kutaścidapi na kevalam ekasmāt svayam ātmanā avyāvṛttaṃ, kim ? sāmānyaṃ paśyanneva
kiṃ kartum ? ityāha--gṛhītuṃ caitanyam iti sambandhaḥ
nanu ātmano niṣedhāt kathametaditi cet; atrāha--svayam ityādi
svayam ātmanā avipratiṣiddho'nirākṛtaḥ prathamaprastāve'tra ca cintitametat
tarhi tasyāviśeṣāt sarvaṃ sarvadā savatra gṛhṇīyāditi cet; atrāha--yathā ityādi
yathā yenā vyāpakagrahaṇapūrvavyāpyagrahaṇaprakāreṇa, yadi vā yathā śaktigrahaṇaprakāreṇa antargṛhṇāti tathā ca tainaiva prakāreṇa bahiḥ gṛhṇāti ityevam avagantavyam
tathā ca yaduktaṃ pra jñā ka re ṇa--yadavabhāsate tajjñānaṃ yathā sukhādi, avabhāsate ca nīlādikam, jaḍasya pratibhāsā'yogāt iti; tadanena nirastam; jñānavat jaḍasyāpi pratibhāsāvighātāt
ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ--jñānasya svataḥ itarasya parataḥ iti

na ca tadapahnavo yuktaḥ, stambhādikamahaṃ vedmi iti pratyayāt tatpratīteḥ, anyathā nīlādau kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ ? kathaṃ sa tasya grāhakaḥ ityapi na codyam; svarūpasya kathaṃ grāhakaḥ ityapi codyaprasaṅgāt
svarūpavat pararūpasyāpi grāhakaḥ pratīyate iti na viśeṣaḥ
śeṣaṃ punaratra parasya bhāṣitam--kāryakāraṇabhāvam anumāna-samāropa-vyavacchedya-vyavacchedakabhāvaṃ citraikajñānādvaitam anyadvā vijñaptimātre'pi nirākaroti iti nirūpayiṣyate
anu mānena samāropasya vyavacchedaḥ kriyate iti tayoḥ vyavacchedyavyavacchedakabhāvaḥ
yatpunaretat--nīlādi jñānaṃ cakṣurādivyāpārānantaram upalabhyamānatvāt tadgrāhakābhimatajñānavat iti; tatra tanna nīlaṃ tadvyāpārānantaram upalabhyamānatvāt śaṅkhavat ityasyāpi prasaṅgaḥ

kiñca, cakṣurāderbahirarthatve darśanābhāvena na tadvyāpārānantaraṃ tadupalambha iti hetorasiddhiḥ dṛṣṭāntasya ca sādhanavikalatā, anyasya cakṣurāderliṅgasya vā vyāpārānantaraṃ tadupalambhabhāve vā prakṛtahetorvyabhicāraḥ, jñānatve tadvyāpārānantaraṃ nīladyupalambhe'pi na parasya tajjñā nasya upalambha iti dṛṣṭāntā'siddhiḥ
atha arthavādinaḥ tat siddhamiti na doṣaḥ; tad yadi pramāṇataḥ siddham; saugatasyāpi siddham, pramāṇasya kvacit pakṣapātābhāvāt
tathā ca na nīlādeḥ paraṃ grāhakam ityasya vyāghātaḥ
yadi punaḥ apramāṇataḥ; tarhi na nidarśanam; apramāṇasiddhasya tadayogāt hetuvat, itarathā cākṣuṣatvādikamapi hetuḥ syāditi yatkiñcidetat
yatpunaretat--jāgratstambhādi jñānam vāsanākāryatvāt kāmaśokādyupaplutadṛṣṭakāminyādivat iti; tadapi na sāram; yataḥ tasya paraṃ prati tatkāryatvāsiddheḥ
evamapi na bahirarthasya sāmānyaviśeṣātmakasya pratibhāsanaṃ tasya vā saṃbhavo niṣedhāditi cet; atrāha--pratyakṣa ityādi
pratyakṣo yaḥ sāmānyarūpaḥ svabhāvabhedaḥ vastuna ātmabhūto viśeṣaḥ saṃbhāvyaḥ, yacca parokṣā asādhāraṇalakṣaṇaḥ svabhāvabhedaḥ tayoḥ ekaḥ sādhāraṇa ātmā svabhāvo yasya sa tathoktaḥ tasya
kasya ? prameyasya bahirgrāhyasya pratiṣeddhuṃ nirākartumaśakyatvāt anyathā tathā vitterapi niṣedhaḥ syāditi manyate
tarhi bahirantarvā asādhāraṇarūpeṇeva sādhāraṇenāpi rūpeṇa apratyakṣatā'stviti cet; atrāha— kathañcid iti
apratyakṣatve vastunaḥ pratyakṣatvābhāve kuto liṅgāderna kutaścit saṃbhāvayed vastu anumānena viṣayīkuryāt liṅgāderasiddheḥ kathañcidasādhāraṇavad gāḍhanidrākrānta iva tadvaditi
sarvaṃ cetanetarasāmānyena vastusattvaṃ paśyanneva acetanaṃ cetanād vyavacchindan paricchinatti janaḥ
punastameva anyato'cetanād vyavacchindan tadvarṇasaṃsthānādiviśeṣān kramaśaḥ kālādibhedena paricchinatti nānyathā
antaraṅgasya pratipattāvayameva kramaḥ— svaparacaitanyasāmānyamacetanādviviktaṃ paricchidya punaḥ parasmād vyavacchidya krameṇa viśeṣān paricchinatti niṣkala svabhāvānavadhāraṇāt
go॰ jī॰ gā॰ 481 ityabhidhānāt tad vaiśeṣikādikalpitaṃ gṛhṇīyāt; ityatrāha— rūpaṃ svabhāvam

kutaḥ ? anyasmāt vijātīyādacetanāt avagraharūpaḥ san vivecayet, punaḥ sarvato viviktaṃ sajātīyād vijātīyācca ākāṅkṣādipariṇāmātmā punaśca kālādibhedakṛt kālādibhiḥ bhedyasya tattathoktam rūpam iti sambandhaḥ, kālādiviśiṣṭaṃ tad vivecayet
jaṃ sāmaṇṇaṃ gahaṇaṃ bhāvāṇaṃ ṇeva kaṭṭumāyāraṃ
iyam aparāparāyojātikā satsat iti yadrūpaṃ sarvabhāvānāṃ sādhāraṇaṃ tad vivecayet, punaḥ pudgaletatsvabhāvaṃ tad vivecayet
kathambhūtam ? sarvasyā vivikta vitteḥ sakāśāt anyasmād vitteḥ arthāntarāt pudgalāntarāditi yāvat sarvato niravaśeṣāt
punarapi kālādinā bhedaṃ kurvāṇā vivecayet iti
tat sat dvividhaṃ pudgalātmakam pudgalabhinnajīvādirūpaṃ ca ityādirūpeṇa
sarvaṃ cetarasāmānyena tatsādhāraṇatvena vastunaḥ sattvaṃ paśyanneva acetanaṃ pudgalaṃ paricchinatti janaḥ ātmā vā
kutaḥ ? cetanāt, punarapi tameva anyataḥ acetanād arthāntarataḥ pudgalāntarāt vyavacchindan tasya pudgalasya varṇasaṃsthānādiviśeṣān kramaśaḥ paricchinatti
katham ? kālādibhedena ādiśabdena kṣetrādiparigrahaḥ nānyathā nā'pareṇa prakāreṇa
nanu pratyakṣato'numānato vā kālasyā'grahe kathaṃ tadbhedena paricchinattīti cet; na sadetat; vyavahārakālasya pratpara mārthakālasya tarkaviṣayatvāt
antaraṅgasya caitanyasya pratipattau ayameva nānyaḥ kramaḥ
tato'yamarthaḥ--tatsāmānyena tatpaśyanneva svaparacaitanyasāmānyam acetanādviviktaṃ paricchidya punaḥ parasmād ātmāntarād ātmānaṃ vyavacchidya krameṇa viśeṣān avagrahādīn svabhāvān paricchinatti iti
tadvibhramaikānte bahirarthapratipattivat santānāntarapratipattirapi saugatasya durlabheti darśayannāha kārikām--buddhipūrvām ityādikām
uktaṃ ca--buddhipūrvāṃ...manyate buddhisadbhāvaḥ sā na yeṣu na teṣu dhīḥ
svayaṃ vyāpāravyāhāranirbhāsavijñānasyaiva sākṣāt cikīrṣāvivakṣāprabhavaniyamaḥ saṃbhāvyeta iti kalpane pramāṇābhāvāt
buddhipūrvā kriyaiva vyāpāravyāhārātmikā parokṣabuddherheturiti svalpamuktam, ākāraviśeṣasyāpi hetoravipratiṣedhāt
suṣuptādau tayorabhāve'pi kathamayaṃ svabhāvaviprakarṣiṇām indriyāyunirodhamanupalabdhervijānīyāt ? yataḥ sthāvareṣu tannirodhalakṣaṇasya maraṇasya asaṃbhavamācakṣīta
yadi punarāyurnirodhameva maraṇaṃ kiṃ syādyatastad vijñānādinirodhena viśiṣyate ? na jāne ahamapi īdṛśam
tadayaṃ svavedanamadvayaṃ paricchinnavyavadhānamalakṣayan paracittamatyantaparokṣaṃ kutaścit paricchinatti vyavacchinattīti ca niṣpramāṇikaivāsya pravṛttiḥ
anyatra paradehe tadgrahāt buddhipūrvakriyāgrahāt jñāyate buddhiranyatra iti padaghaṭanā
kaiḥ ? abhrāntaiḥ puruṣaiḥ kvacit tamātre buddhisāmānye na vibhramaiḥ na nānāvibhramairjñāyate talliṅgasya vāhārāderarthavadasitibhāsavahārādi pratibhāsasyāpi nirālambanatvāditi manyate
syānmatam--jāgraddaśāyāṃ vyāpārādinirbhāsaḥ sākṣāt cikīrṣādeḥ, anyatra pāramparyeṇa tato'yamadoṣa iti; tatrottaramāha--svayam ityādi
svayam ātmanā vyāpāraḥ kāyasya ceṣṭā vyāhāro vacanasva tayornirbhāso yasmin vijñāne tat tathoktaṃ tasyaiva cikīrṣāvivakṣāprabhavaniyamaḥ sambhāvyeta

yastu pra jñā ka raḥ svapnāntikaśarīravādī svapnadaśāyāmapi vyāhārādinirbhāsajñānasyāpi sākṣāt cikīrṣādiprabhavaniyamamabhyupagacchati; tatra tasya bahirnirbhāsajñānasyāpi sākṣāt bahirarthatattvaprabhavaniyamasiddhervijñaptimātravādo nirālambaḥ syāt

yatpunaruktaṃ tenaiva--santānāntarasyānabhyupagamāt tadasiddhirna doṣāya iti; tadapi na satyam; yato yogācāraṃ pratyasya doṣasyābhidhānāt pratibhāsādvaitavādinaṃ prati viparyayāt--tasya hi nnityavat svapratibhāsasyāpi vicāryamāṇasya ghaṭanāyogāt sarvā'bhāva eva doṣaḥ iti kiṃ taddūṣaṇābhidhāneneti
buddhipūrvā buddhiḥ kāryabhūtā kriyaiva, kathambhūtā ? vyāpāravyāhārātmikā parokṣabuddheḥ dehāntarabuddheḥ hetuḥ liṅgam ityevaṃ svalpamuktam pakṣīkṛte sarvatrāsyāasaṃbhava iti bhāvaḥ
atha maṃḍādautavaḥ sa ca acetanatvād vipakṣa eva na pakṣa iti; tatrottaramāha--ākāraviśeṣasyāpi ityādi
na kevaktaṃ tatkriyāyāeva, kasyacit lokaprasiddhasya anumeyabuddhisahacarasya dharmāntaradharmasyādiḥ sambandhinaḥ caitanyasya hetoḥ liṅgasya avipratiṣedhāt
etaduktaṃ bhavati--tatra caitanyābhāve sa vipakṣaḥ syāt
kiṃca, tatkriyātaḥ paradehe caitanyarahitaṃ tadvipakṣaḥ, na vāsya tatra caitanyābhāvagrāhakamastīti darśayannāha--suṣuptādau ityādi

svabhāvaviprakarṣiṇāṃ pakṣasapakṣābhyām anyasya iti vaktavye indriyāyugrahaṇam uttaradūṣaṇaditsayā, kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa na kenacid ayaṃ saugataḥ nirodham abhāvaṃ vijānīyāt yataḥ kaścid vipakṣaḥ syāt
nanu tatkāryasya vyāhārāderadarśanāt nirodhaṃ vijānīyāditi cet; atrāha--suṣuptādau

nanu tasyāḥ kriyāyāḥ abhāve'pi tadabhāve'pi iti vaktavye kimartham--tayoḥ iti vacanam ? asandehārtham, itarathā ākāraviśeṣasya abhāve'pi tadabhāve'pi ityapi matiḥ syā bhāvāt kathaṃ teṣāṃ taṃ vijānīyāt iti sambandhaḥ
evaṃ manyate pratibaddhasāmarthyasya kāryā'bhāvādabhāvāvagatiḥ, na caivaṃ caitanyamiti
pra jñā ka ra stvāha--tatrāpi caitanyasyābhāve anyathā avasthācatuṣṭayābhāvaḥ iti; na sa yuktakārī; prabodhā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt, vinaṣṭāt kāraṇāt kāryānutpatteriti nivedayiṣyate atraiva anantaraprastāve
teṣāṃ nirodhamajānato yadaparaṃ prāptaṃ taddarśayannāha--yataḥ ityādi
yato yasmāt nirodhavijñānāt sthāvareṣu tarvādiṣu tannirodhalakṣaṇasya asaṃbhavaṃ maraṇasya ācakṣīta
yata iti vā ākṣepe naiva ācakṣīta
yadi punaḥ āyurnirodhameva maraṇam; kiṃ syāt kiṃ dūṣaṇaṃ bhavet yato dūṣaṇāt tanmaraṇaṃ vijñānādinirodhena ādiśabdena indriyanirodhena viśiṣyate iti ? atra ācāryo dūṣaṇamapaśyan āha--na ityādi
na jāne'hamapi na kevalam anyo na jānāti īdṛśaṃ pareṇa yādṛśamuktam
yata evaṃ tat tasmād ayaṃ saugataḥ svavedanamadvayam alakṣayan
yadi vā paricchinnaṃ pramāṇenānavagatam svaparagrahaṇe vyavadhānahetutvād vyavadhānam āvaraṇakāraṇaṃ karma yasyeti vyākhyeyam, svasaṃvedanaikāntopagamāditi manyate

kathaṃbhūtam ? atyantaparokṣaṃ kutaścid vyāpārādeḥ buddhipūrvakāt paricchinatti svayaṃ viṣayīkaroti vyavacchinatti ca kutaścid vṛkṣādeḥ vyāhārāditatkāryābhāvādvā ityevaṃ niḥpramāṇikaiva asya bauddhasya pravṛttiḥ sātmakaṃ jīvaccharīraṃ prāṇādimattvāt ityasmādanya nyāyasyābhedāditi manyate
nanu yaduktam--kathañcidasiddhātmano buddheḥ ityādi; tadayuktam; saccetanādirūpeṇāpi tasyāḥ pratyakṣatvāditi cet; atrāha--svataśca ityādi
svataścetsarvathā siddhiḥ buddheḥ kiṃ tatra hetunā

yathaiva hyavitarkayataḥ samāropavyavacchedaḥ na savikalpapratyakṣamantareṇa saṃbhavati tathaiva pratyakṣavikalpe ca punaḥ samāropavyavacchedasmṛtiḥ na kañcidarthaṃ puṣṇāti svataḥ samāropānutpādāt, kṛtasya karaṇābhāvāt, anyathā kṛtasya svataḥ siddhau pramāṇāntarānarthakyāsaṃbhavau pratipattavyau
svataḥ paranirapekṣā siddhiḥ jñaptiḥ ced yadi buddheḥ sarvathā sadādirūpeṇeva rūpāntareṇāpi kiṃ na kiñcit tatra buddhau hetunā liṅgena nīlādyākāreṇeva sarvākāraiḥ tasyāḥ pratyakṣasiddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ
tathā ca yadavabhāsate tajjñānaṃ yathā sukhādi

yad yathā'vabhāsate tattathaiva paramārthasad vyavahārāvatāri yathā nīlaṃ nīlatayā'vabhāsamānaṃ tathaiva tadavatāri, ava bhāsante ca kṣaṇikatayā sarve bhāvaḥ ityādi pra jñā ka ra sya vijñānaikāntavādino na kañcidarthaṃ puṣṇāti samāropavyavacchedasya nirākariṣyamāṇatvādanantaram
svataścet sarvathā'siddhiḥ buddheḥ kiṃ tatra hetunā dharmādyasiddhau hetorapravṛttiriti bhāvaḥ
sautrāntikaṃ prati pratipāditaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ samānaṃ yogācārasyāpīti manvāna ācāryaḥ tadeva dṛṣṭāntīkṛtya tathaiva ityādinā kārikāṃ vivṛṇoti
yathaiva hi yenaiva hi prakāreṇa sautrāntikamya na saṃbhavati
kim ? ityāha--samāropavyavacchedaḥ, samāropavyavacchedahetutvād anumānaṃ tadvyaccheda ityucyate
kiṃ kurvataḥ ? avitarkayataḥ dharmādikana niścinvataḥ, na ca aniścitaṃ tadanumānāya prabhavati, śeṣamatra cintitam
tarhi savikalpakapratyakṣemati sa bhavati ityāha--pratyakṣa ityādi
pratyakṣasya vikalpe vā bhede ca vyavasāyamakeva pratyakṣe matiḥ punaḥ samāropavyavacchedasmṛtiḥ kṣaṇikādyanumānaṃ na kañcidarthaṃ puṣṇāti kṣaṇikatvādeḥ pratyakṣato nirṇayāditi bhāvaḥ
svayaṃ samāropānutpādāt, niścaye tadayogāt, niścayāropamanasoḥ bādhyabādhakabhāvātaḥ pra॰ vā॰ 1
50 iti vacanāt na kañcidarthaṃ puṣṇāti iti manyate
anyathā anena kṛtasya buddheḥ svataḥ siddhau nirṇītau pramāṇāntarasya anumānasya ānarthakyam, asiddhā ca saṃbhavaḥ tadānarthakyā'saṃbhavau pratipattavyau
svataḥ asiddhau anumānasya asaṃbhava iti bhāvaḥ
evaṃ saugatasya avikalpakamadhyakṣaṃ nirākṛtya vaiśeṣikasya savikalpakaṃ tannirākartumāha— pratyakṣam ityādi
na hi bhinneṣu dravyādiṣvanuvṛttijñānaṃ yuktaṃ sadṛśapratītirvā
na caikavastusambandhamantareṇa bhinneṣu dravyādiṣu samānapratyayo na bhavati sāmānyānāṃ svataḥ sattvajñeyatvādipratīterabhāvaprasaṅgāt
keṣāñcit svataḥ sattvaṃ netareṣāmityasyāpi niṣpramāṇikā pravṛttiḥ, anyathā sāmānyasamavāyānavasthānuṣaṅgāt sāmānyatadvatostādātmyaṃ yuktam
samavāyasya samavāyāntarābhāve'pi vṛttau kiṃ punaritareṣāṃ tathaiva vṛttirna syāt
na ca iha viṣāṇādiṣu gauḥ śākhādiṣu vṛkṣaḥ iti pratītiḥ syāt
sāmānyasamavāyayorvyāpitve'pi kvacideva samīhitapratyayahetutvaṃ nānyatreti vaicitryasaṃbhave dravyameva citraṃ bhavitumarhati
niraṃśaniṣkriyātmanaḥ sāmānyasya samavāyasya ca svaviśeṣavyāpitvaṃ kathaṃ svasthaḥ prasthāpayet dravyādyādhārabhedāt svarūpahāneḥ

sāmānyena samavāyināṃ samavāyavatāṃ dravyaguṇakarmaṇām, yadi vā, sāmānyānāṃ samavāyināṃ ca dravya-guṇa-karma-antyaviśeṣāṇāṃ samavāyasambandhavatām, sāmarthyāt samavāyasyāpi tad ityuktaṃ bhavati--nā'gṛhītaviśeṣāṇāṃ viśeṣye buddhiḥ iti vacanāt

sattāsāmānyena dravyaguṇakarmaṇām, taiśca tasya, dravyatvaguṇatvakarmatvasāmānyena dravyādīnāṃ pratyekam, taiḥ tasya ca, dravyeṇa guṇakarmaṇām, taiḥ tasya, avayavināṃ , tai rvā tasya kathañcittādātmyena vyāptayaḥ anusyūyataḥ tāsāṃ dhiyo gṛhītayo na syuḥ, atra asmin pratyakṣe savikalpe sati aṅgīkriyamāṇe vā
tato'yamarthaḥ— ekasya ekasya asahāyasya asahāyasya svatantrasya vā sāmānyasya dravyasya guṇasya karmaṇo'nyasya vā viniścayāt
tataḥ tadabhāvaprāpteḥ parasya pramāṇavirodha iti manyate
athavā, sāmānyānāṃ sattvādīnāṃ yā anusyūtidhiyaḥ idaṃ sāmānyam, idaṃ sāmānyam iti buddhayaḥ, bahuvacanāt tathābhidhānāni ca yāni tāḥ tāni ca na syuḥ iti
samavāyināṃ ca yā anusyūtidhiyaḥ tāśca na syuḥ, bahuvacanaṃ pūrvavad vyākhyeyam
ekasya asahāyasya dravyasya guṇasya karmaṇaḥ samavāyasya anyasya ca viniścayāt
teṣu kim ? ityādi anuvṛttijñānaṃ sad dravyaṃ san guṇaḥ sat karma ityādyanugamajñānaṃ yuktam upapannam sadṛśapratītirvā anena ayaṃ samānaḥ iti buddhirvā nahi yuktā iti sambandhaḥ
yat parasya yuktaṃ tadāha--kintarhi kinna teṣāṃ dravyādīnām ekena asādhāraṇena sāmānyādinā sambandhaḥ samavāyaḥ tasya pratītireva yujyate nānyānubhūtānāmika sūtrasambandhapratītivat
yadi vā, te ca, ekaṃ ca sāmānyādi sambandhaśca samavāyaḥ teṣāṃ pratītireva parasparavilakṣaṇānāṃ yujyate

nanu samavāyasya atisūkṣmatvena anupalakṣaṇād bhrāntyā tadanuvṛttijñānamiti cet; atrāha--bhrānterabhāvāt anuvṛttijñānavibhramā'yogāt jātitadvatām avayava-avayavināṃ guṇa-guṇināṃ kriyā-tadvatāṃ sambandhasya ca bhedena nirṇaye vibhramā'bhāvāt
na vai khalu ghaṭa paṭayorbhinnayoḥ nirṇayeekasya anyatarānuvṛttipratītiriti manyate
nanu yaduktam--dravyādiṣu bhinneṣu anuvṛttijñānaṃ sāmānyanibandhanaṃ na bhavati iti; tadayuktam; anumānabādhanāt pratijñāyāḥ
tacca anumānam--dravyādiṣu bhinneṣu abhinnaṃ jñānaṃ tato bhinnaviśeṣaṇanibandhanaṃ tatpratyayaviśiṣṭapratyayatvāt puruṣe daṇḍītipratyayavat iti cet; atrāha— nacaika ityādi
na ca naiva ekena vastunā sāmānyena yaḥ sambandhaḥ tamantareṇa bhinneṣu dravyādiṣu samānapratyayo na bhavatyeva api tu bhavatyeva, pratiṣedhadvayena prakṛtārthagateḥ
sāmānyānāṃ sattvādijātīnāṃ svataḥ anyasambandharahitānām ātmanaiva sattvajñeyatvādi ādiśabdena padārthatvaparigrahaḥ, tasya pratīterabhāvaprasaṅgāt
asti ca tatpratītiḥ, tato'naikāntiko heturiti manyate
dravyaguṇakarmasu satsaditi pratyayo viśeṣyavyatiriktānugatanimittanibandhanaḥ bhinneṣu anugatapratyayāt kambalādiṣu nīladravyasambandhāt nīlaṃ nīlamiti jñānavat
...evaṃ daṇḍīti jñāne daṇḍo nimittam...--praśa॰ vyo॰ pṛ॰ 687
etena sāmānyaṃ sāmānyam iti pratītiḥ cintitā
nanu kimucyate--tadabhāvaprasaṅgāt iti, yāvatā svata eva teṣāṃ tatra sāmarthyam, tata eva seti cet; atrāha--svataḥ ityādi

keṣāñcit sāmānya-samavāya-antyaviśeṣāṇāṃ sattvaṃ vidyamānatvam, anyathā pradhānādivat kutastadvyavasthā, nā'parasattāsambandhamantareṇa anusyūtipratyayahetutvaṃ netareṣāṃ dravyādīnām ityevam asyāpi vaiśeṣikasyāpi na kevalaṃ saugatasyaiva niṣpramāṇikā pravṛttiḥ

atra kaścidāha--sāmānyādau sattvajñeyatvā vaṃsatisabhiṣyati kuto yogināmapi tataḥ pradhānādiviparyayeṇa sāmānyādisiddhiḥ ? kathaṃ ca sā tatropacaritā ? bhinnasattādivastusambandhamantareṇa utpatteḥ; dravyādau sā tathā syāt, atrāpi tadabhāvād apratīteḥ
taduktam--na paśyāmaḥ kvacit kiñcit sāmānyaṃ vā siddhivi॰ 2
yadi punastatra tadupacārāt atra sā bhinnaviśeṣaṇanimittā anyathā tadayogāditi matiḥ; sāpi na yuktā; atra upacārāt tatra mukhyā ityasyāpi prāpteḥ
na ca svayaṃkalpitāt mukhyopacāravibhāgāt tattvasiddhiḥ; atiprasaṅgāditi

aparastvāha--sāmānyaṃ sāmānyam ityanusyūtipratyayasya samavāyahetutvāt svataḥ ityādyayuktamiti; tanna; idamihetipratyayasya tannimittatvāt, itarathā ghaṭo'yaṃ ghaṭo'yam ityāderapi pratyayasya tannimittatvasiddheḥ kiṃ sāmānyena ? api ca, kimidaṃ sāmānyaṃ nāma iti praśne kimuttaraṃ vaktavyam ? ekam anekavṛtti tat iti cet; avayavidravya-saṃyoga-dvitvādisaṃkhyādau prasaṅgaḥ
anuvṛttivijñānanimittamiti cet; samavāyaḥ sāmānyaṃ prasaktam iti na sāmānyaṃ sāmānyam iti jñānaṃ tannimittamiti sādhūktam--svataḥ ityādi
bhavatu tarhi sāmānyādīnāmapi anyataḥ sattvamanusyūtipratyayahetutvaṃ ceti cet; atrāha--anyathā ityādi
anyena svataḥ tatapratyayahetutvābhāvaprakāreṇa anyataḥ tadbhāvaprakāreṇa sāmānyānāṃ samavāyasya ca anavasthā'nuṣaṅgāt asyāpi niṣpramāṇikā vṛttiḥ iti sambandhaḥ
tathāhi--dravyādivat yadi sāmānyānāmapi aparasāmānyasambandhāt sattvaṃ tatpratyayahetutvaṃ vā; tarhi tatsambandhāttasyāpi aparasatsambandhāt tasyāpyaparasatsambandhādityanavasthā
samavāyasyāpi anyataḥ tattve; anyasya samavāyasya cānyaḥ samavāya iti samavāyānavasthā
atha matam--sāmānyasamavāyānavasthā atha matam--sāmānyasamavāyānāmapi sattāsambandhe; dravyādivadaparasāmānyasambandhaḥ syāt, na caivamiti
ayamapi parasyaiva doṣo'stu na jainasya, tena kvacidanyatastattvānabhyupagamāt
sāmānyatadvatoḥ jātitadvatoḥ tādātmyaṃ kathañcidekatvaṃ yuktam upapannaṃ yata iti
evaṃ tāvad dravyādibhyo bhinnaṃ sāmānyaṃ nirākṛtya sāṃprataṃ tatsambandhaṃ nirākurvannāha— samavāyasya ityādi
nanu so'pi samavāyānavasthānuṣaṅgāt ityanena nirastaḥ; satyam; tathāpi parato jātyādīnāṃ tattve niraste idānīmanyathāpi nirākriyata iti viśeṣaḥ
atra parasya anekaṃ darśanam--svata eva samavāyiṣu samavāyo varttate ityekam

tadetad darśanatrayaṃ cetasi vyavasyāpya prathame tāvad dūṣaṇaṃ yojayati--samavāyasya samavāyāntarābhāve'pi svata eva iti yāvat, vṛttau samavāyiṣu varttate aṅgīkriyamāṇe kiṃ punaḥ itareṣāṃ dravyādīnāṃ tathaiva yenaiva prakāreṇa samavāyasya tenaiva vṛttirna syāt ? syādeva
na ca iha viṣāṇādiṣu gauḥ śākhādiṣu vṛkṣaḥ ityevaṃ pratītirbuddhiḥ syād bhavet, samavāyasya kāryatvena sambandhinī iti sambandhaḥ

evaṃ manyate iha viṣāṇādiṣu gauḥ śākhādiṣu vṛkṣaḥ iti buddheḥ samavāyaḥ sādhyate tatkāryabhūtāyāḥ, yadā tu samavāyaḥ svata eva kvacid vartate taha samavāyo varttate iti buddhirna samavāyanimittā yathā tathā prakṛtāpi iti, anena taddhetorvyabhicāra uktaḥ

dvitīye samavāyasya samavāyāntarābhāve apiśabdād anyasya viśeṣaṇībhāvasambandhasya bhāve vṛttau kiṃ punaḥ itareṣāṃ dravyādīnāṃ tathaiva samavāyād vṛttirnasyāt ? syādeva, iti samavāyataddravyādīnāmapi kvacid vṛttau viśeṣaṇībhāvasambandha iti manyate
ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ iha samavāyo varttate ityasyāḥ pratīteḥ yathā viśeṣaṇībhāvaḥ kāraṇārathā anyasyā api iti
athavā, viśeṣaṇībhāvaḥ sambandho yadi sambandhāntaraṃ svasambandhiṣu vartate; taha ni vasthānāt nacetyādi dūṣaṇam
atha svataḥ; samavāyo'pi tathaiva vartate iti samavāyasya ityādi tadavastham
yadi punaḥ, na te samavāye tathā prasaṅgaḥ iti kutaḥ tataḥ ihedam iti pratītiḥ ? tṛtīye'pi samavāyasya tadantarābhāve, apiśabdo bhinnaprakramaḥ vṛttau ityasya anantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ
tato'yamarthaḥ--vṛttāvapi, api śabdācca vṛttau kiṃ punaḥ samavāyena iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
kuta etat ? atrāha--itareṣāṃ dravyā dīnāṃ tathaiva vṛttirna syāt
na khalu idamanuvarttate ityetat tadasambandhād yujyate; yataḥ kutaścit tadanuṣaṅgāt
sambandhāt syāt iti cet; kutaḥ sambandhaḥ samavāyaḥ, sambandhāsambandhād gaganādivat ? dūṣaṇāntaramāha--na ceha ityādi
atrāyamarthaḥ— yata eva na dravyādīnāṃ kvacid vṛttiḥ ata eva tatpratītirapi na syāditi, anyathā īśvarādereva syāt
kathaṃ vā kasyacit pratyakṣaḥ samavāyaḥ indriyārthasannikarṣābhāvāt ? sarvathāpi tatpratyakṣatve alaṃ cakṣuṣo'rthena sannikarṣasādhanena ?
avibhāgino vṛttyātmakasya samavāyasya nānyā vṛttirasti tasmāt svātmavṛttiḥ
4 tasmād vinā sambandhāntaraṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāva eṣitavya iti siddham--nyāyavā॰ tā॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 111
tulanā--ityayuktaḥ sa sambandho na yuktaḥ samavānibhiḥ
nahi svasambindhibhiḥ asambaddhaḥ kaścit sambandho bhavitumarhati
vṛttyabhāve'pi tatpratītau īśvarakālādereva sā pratītirbhavatu iti doṣaḥ
anena yaduktaṃ pareṇa--sarvasya sāmānyasya sarvagatatve samavāyasya ca gotvādipratyayasāṅkaryamiti dadhi khādeti coditaḥ uṣṭramapi dhāvet pra॰ vā॰ 3
183 ityatra codye pratyuttaram--sambandhasyāpiviśeṣe'pi na sambandhinaḥ saḥ, nahi kuṇḍabadarayoḥ saṃyogo yathā kuṇḍebadare cavarttate tathā badaramapi iti tad dūṣayannāha-- sāmānya ityādi

idamatra tātparyam--sarvasarvagate sāmānye idaṃ pratyuttaram, vyaktisarvagate vā ? prathamapakṣe sāmānyasamavāyayorvyāpitve'pi kvacideva dravyatvasya pṛthivyādiṣu eva guṇatvasya rūpādiṣveva karmatvasya gamanādiṣveva samīhitapratyayahetutvaṃ dravyādipratītinimittatvaṃ nānyatra ityevaṃ vaicitryasya tayoḥ samarthetarasvabhāvabhedena śabalatvasya saṃbhave aṅgīkriyamāṇe dravyameva sāmānyaviśeṣātmakaṃ citraṃ bhavitumarhati

evaṃ manyate tayorvyāpitvapakṣe nedaṃ pratyuttaram— sambandhasyā'viśeṣe'pi taṃ sambandhinaḥ saḥ iti; sambandhavat sambandhino'pi sāmānyasyāviśeṣāt, idaṃ tu yuktam--tadaviśeṣesvā tmabhūtakāryajananaśaktiviśeṣaḥ iti
dvitīye pakṣe svaviśeṣavyāpitvaṃ deśādibhinnānekasvākāravyāpitvaṃ niraṃśaniṣkriyātmanaḥ sāmānyasya samavāyasya ca kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa svasthaḥ piśācādyanupahataḥ prasthāpayet
nanu tathāvidhasyāpi sarvātmanā svāvāreṣu vṛtteḥ tattasya sa prasthāpayediti cet; atrāha--dravya ityādi
dravyādiṣu pratyādhāraṃ tasya bhedāt svarūpahāneḥ kathaṃ prasthāpayet iti ? yata evaṃ tat tasmāt etat prastutaprastāvavyavasthāpyamānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ dravyaparyāyātmakameva
yadi vā, etat vicāryamāṇaṃ vastu pratyakṣaṃ tatparicchedyaṃ dravyaparyāyātmakameva yuktam iti
aviśeṣaḥ, yena dadhyākhyaḥ sambandhī uṣṭrarūpaḥ syāt
kvacideva samīhitapratyayahetutayā sāmarthyamanyatra tu asāmarthyamiti svabhāvabhedena

yadyapi aparicchinnadeśāni sāmānyāni bhavanti tathāpyupalakṣaṇaniyamāt kāraṇasāmagrīniyamācca svaviṣayasarvagatāni pṛ॰ 314 yathā kuṇḍadadhnoḥ saṃyogaikatve bhavatyāśrayāśrayibhāvaniyamaḥ tathā dravyatvādīnāmapi samavāyaikatve'pi vyaṅgyavyañjakaśaktibhedād ādhārādheyaniyamaḥ
anyathānupapannatvam ityādikam, anyacca svalakṣaṇādarśanam, vaiśeṣikasyāpi bhāgino varttananiṣedhaṃ ca darśayannāha—pratyakṣam ityādi
antam api śabdo bhinnaprakramaḥ pratyakṣam ityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ
pratyakṣamapi dravyaṃ ghaṭādi parokṣaṃ dṛśyetarātmakaṃ yataḥ tato guṇaparyāyātmakam iti
kuta etat ? ityatrāha--svataḥ svarūpeṇa siddhasya niścitasya dravyasya anumiteḥ anumeyatvād anyathā sarvo hetuḥ āśrayāsiddhaḥ syāt
nanu yadi tatsiddhaṃ kathamanumeyamiti cet ? atrāha--phalopajananaśaktyādyātmanā
nahi vyaktivat śaktirapi tasya pratyakṣā; tadanumānavaiphalyaprasaṅgāt, tathā vyavahārābhāvācca
yadi punaḥ saugatasyeva naiyāyikasyāpi avikalpaṃ darśanaṃ tato'yamadoṣaḥ iti; tadapi nottaram; saugatena sahāyasmai jalāñjalerdānāt
nāpi śaktivad vyaktirapi parokṣā; sarvasya āndhyaprāpteḥ pramāṇavirodhāt
evamapi vyaktiśaktyorabhede na tato guṇaparyāyātmakaṃ taditi cet; na pratyakṣetaraikāntaḥ syāt
bhedāditi cet; kathaṃ dravyasya śaktiḥ iti vyapadeśaḥ atiprasaṅgāt ? tatra samavāyāt; na; asya niṣedhāt
ihetipratyayahetuḥ samavāyasya śaktiḥ yadi tato bhinnā; kathaṃ tasya iti vyapadiśyatāṃ samavāyāntarābhāvāt ? carcitametaditi yatkiñcidetat
abhede sati vyaktiḥ pratyakṣā śaktiḥ parokṣeti dvayātmakatā na syāditi bhāvaḥ
pratyekaṃ dvibahuṣu kāryaṃ svāṃśaiḥ sarvātmanā na tat || 29
sāmānyādi ekāntena viviktaṃ bhinnam ? kutaḥ ? arthasamavāyādeḥ arthāt dravyādeḥ samavāyād ādiśabdād antyaviśeṣāt
yathā tasya sāmānyādi tato viviktamadṛśyam hi yasmāt tasmād asat tathā asyāpi iti

tathā ca prayogaḥ--yad yadrūpatayā kālatraye'pi na pratīyate na tat tadrūpatayā sat yathā ātmādi pudgalarūpatayā kālatraye'pi apratīyamānam, tadrūpatayā asattvena pratīyate ca ekāntena arthasamavāyādeḥ viviktaṃ sāmānyādi iti
kathambhūteṣu ? dvibahuṣu dvayoḥ paramāṇvādidravyayoḥ kāryadravyādi varttata iti dvigrahaṇaṃ svaṃśaiḥ svaikadeśaiḥ sarvātmanā sarvasvabhāvena na varttate ityupaskāraḥ
iti ra vi bha dra pādopajīvya na nta vī rya viracitāyāṃ si ddhi vi ni śca ya ṭī kā yāṃ savikalpakasiddhiḥ dvitīyaḥ prastāvaḥ

evaṃ prastāvadvayena savikalpamadhyakṣaṃ pramāṇaṃ prasādhya adhunā smaraṇapratyabhijñānohānāṃ prāmāṇyamavisaṃvādināṃ vyavasthāpayitukāmaḥ tatsvarūpāvisaṃvādanibandhanaṃ prastutaprastāvadvayārthaṃ smarannāha prastāvādau samyag ityādi vṛttam
samyak sāmānyasaṃvit vyabhicarati na vai satsvabhāvaṃ parasmāt,
arthaḥ--saugatānusāreṇa smaraṇādisaṃvit sāmānyasaṃvit ityuktam, tatra tasyā eva sāmānyasaṃvittvāt
samyag avisaṃvādinī satī vā kācit ityapekṣam

atra yukti vyabhicarati ityādikāmāha--cittaṃ jñānaṃ vyabhicarati jahāti navai naiva satsvabhāvata arthātmanoḥ vidyamānaṃ svarūpam, kvacit plutau laukikaśāstrīyavibhrame yadi vibhrametararūpamekaṃ jñānaṃ cedityarthaḥ
tadeva nirṇetuṃ niścetuṃ svam ātmānam, upalakṣaṇametat tena paraṃ ca gṛhyate, analamasamartham
kutaḥ ? parasmād anyasmāt sajātīyād vijātīyācca apagatam iti vacanāt, anyathā taṃ nirṇetuṃ samarthamiti gamyate, yadi svaviṣaye nirṇayajananetarasvabhāvavadityarthaḥ
tadeva ca yadi siddhasādhyaikarūpaṃ siddhaṃ niścitaṃ sadādisādhyaṃ phalānumeyaṃ svargādiprāpaṇādikam ekaṃ rūpaṃ yasya tattathoktaṃ dṛśyetararūpamekaṃ cediti manyate
yaḥ punarmanyate dha rmo tta raḥ--sthavīyān eko grāhyākāro mithyā vicāryamāṇasya ayogāt, tato vyatiriktaṃ niraṃśaṃ saṃvinmātraṃ paramārthasat
saṃbhāvyaḥ arthākāravirahaḥ ālokyaḥ sadādibhedo yasya tattathoktaṃ cittamekaṃ yadi iti
yovi manyate pra jñā ka ra guptaḥ--na nīlādisukhādiśarīravyatiriktaṃ saṃvedanamasti anupalambhāt pra॰ vārtikāla॰ tadeva citramekaṃ jñānam citrapratibhāsā'pi pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
nīlādirgrāhyādṛśyākāraiḥ citrā sadalā bhā pratītiryasya tattathoktam, citramekaṃ yadi tadapi na virahitam kintu sahitam
kaiḥ ? paryāyaiḥ kramapariṇāmaiḥ ekam abhinnam uktanyāyena īyuḥ saugatāḥ avagaccheyuḥ yadi ityanenaitaddarśayati
tato nirākṛtametat yaduktaṃ pareṇa--anubhūte smaraṇam ityetannānubhavena jñāyate tena smaraṇā'viṣayīkaraṇe, nānena anubhavasyāparicchedāt
tad idam iti smaraṇapratyakṣe lekhaka vyatirekeṇa nāparaṃ pratyabhijñānam, tadabhāve na tarko'pi iti kathamuktam pratipattyā bādhanāt ? kiṃ kārayat tattathā yadi ? ityāha--bahiḥ ityādi
yathaiva hi tadekaṃ citrāha mātmānaṃ bibhartti tathaiva tathāvidhaṃ bahirgamayati
tathā ca yaduktaṃ pareṇa--smaraṇaviṣayasya kṣaṇikatvena nāśāt pratyabhijñāgocarasya abhāvāt na pravṛttau prāptiryataḥ tadavisaṃvādaḥ iti; tadanena nirastam
tataḥ sthitam--yadi tathāvidhaṃ cittaṃ tarhi samyak sāmānyasaṃviditi
tulanā— nanu anubhūte jāyamānamityetat kena pratīyatām ? na tāvadanubhavena tatkāle smṛterevāsattvāt
na cānubhavakāle arthasya anubhūtatā'sti, tadā tasyānubhūyamānatvāt
athānubhūte smṛtirityetat smṛtireva pratipadyate; na; anayā atītānubhavārthayoraviṣayīkaraṇe tathā pratītyayogāt
tasmāt sa evāyamiti pratyayadvayametat--pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 22
yadatītaṃ na tad grāhyaṃ yadā grāhyaṃ na tattathā
na syādyadi tadekatvaṃ kiṃ tato'rthakriyā na sā...--pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 593
tadevaṃ smaraṇādeḥ avisaṃvāde siddhe yadaparaṃ siddhaṃ taddarśayannāha--pramāṇam ityādi
savikalpe'nadhigatārthavyavasāyābhāvādayuktamiti cet; na; prayojanaviśeṣāt, kvacit sadṛśākārabhedaviśeṣāṇāmuttarottaraparyāyaviśeṣasādhyārthakriyāvāñchāyāṃ tathaiva prāmāṇyāvirodhāt
nanu nāvisaṃvāda eva pramāṇalakṣaṇaṃ yenaivaṃ syāt, api tu ajñātārthaprakāśo'pi
smṛtau tadabhāvāt na pramāṇaṃ seti; tadāha--gṛhītagrahaṇāt
gṛhītasya darśanena viṣayīkṛtasya grahaṇāt smṛtyā viṣayīkaraṇāt kāraṇāt no na cet yadi smṛtiḥ pramāṇam
pramāṇasya hi prayojanaṃ phalam--ajñānanivṛttiḥ pravṛttiśca, tasya bhedāt, pratyakṣaprayojanāt smṛtiprayojanasya viśeṣāt
tataḥ yathaiva hi prāk pravṛttam ātmano'jñānam adhyakṣaṃ nivarttayati punaḥ svagocare pravarttayati janaṃ tathā smṛtirapi viśeṣā'bhāvāt
nanu yaduktam--smṛtiḥ pramāṇam avisaṃvādāt pratyakṣavat iti; tanna sāram; dṛṣṭānte arthasārūpyāt prāmāṇyasiddheḥ smṛtau tadabhāvāditi cet; atrāha--pratyakṣasyāpi ityādi
na kevalamanyasya kintu pratyakṣasyāpi prāmāṇyam avisaṃvādāt na punaḥ arthākārānukāritayā
bhavatu avisaṃvādāt tasya taditi cet; atrāha--sa punaḥ ityādi
saḥ avisaṃvādaḥ punaḥ anubhūtasya arthasya smṛteḥ yadi syād bhavet prāmāṇyaṃ lakṣayati tatsmṛteḥ iti
savikalpe savikalpakapratyakṣapakṣe smṛteḥ anadhigatārthavyavasāyābhāvād ayuktaṃ prāmāṇyam
anena etaddarśayati— paraḥ--yathā mama aniścitārthaniścayāt samāropavyavacchedādvā anubhūtārthamanityatvādyanumānam, naivaṃ smṛtirviparyayāt niścite tadayogāt iti evaṃ cet; atrāha--na ityādi
atra pareṇa saha ekavākyatāmātmano darśayannāha--kvacid ityādi

kvacit sūbhrādau sadṛśākārāṇāṃ pratyakṣāṇāṃ ye bhedā dhārāvābhiviśeṣāḥ teṣām uttarottaraparyāyaviśeṣasādhyārthakriyāvāñchāyāṃ tathaiva prayojanaviśeṣaprakāreṇaiva prāmāṇyā'virodhāt prayojanaviśeṣāt smṛteḥ prāmāṇyaṃ yuktamiti

kuta etat ? ityatrāha--kālādibhedena ādiśabdāt kṣetrādiparigrahaḥ, anyathā anyena prayojanaviśeṣābhāvaprakāreṇa anadhigatārthādhigaterapi agṛhītārthagrahaṇādapi na kevalam anyataḥ tadviśeṣāṇāṃ pramāṇatā'nabhyupagamāt saugatena yathā jalaprāptyekārthakriyāvāñchāyām avāntaradarśanaviśeṣāṇām, itarathā jalādhyavasāyakāraṇaṃ marīcikādarśanaṃ tadvat pramāṇaṃ bhavet
yadi punarayaṃ nirbandhaḥ gṛhītagrahaṇānna smṛtiḥ pramāṇaṃ tarhi tata eva tadvat sakalamanumānamapi pramāṇaṃ na syāditi darśayannāha--sākalyena ādito vyāptiḥ ityādi
yāvān kaścid dhūmavān pradeśaḥ sa sarvo'pi agnimāniti vyāptāvasiddhāyām anumeyapratipattyanupapatteḥ
sāmānyaviṣayā vyāptiḥ tadviśiṣṭānumiteḥ iti cet; pūrvānubhūtasmṛterapi tathāvidhaviśeṣānirākaraṇāt yatkiñcidetat
sākalyena sāmastyena āditaḥ ādau sakalānumānapravṛtteḥ pūrvaṃ siddhā niścitā vyāptiḥ avinābhāvaḥ cet
anumeyasmṛtiḥ anumānaṃ na syāt pramāṇaṃ sākalyena ityetadatrāpi sambandhanīyam

yāvān ityādinā kārikārthamāha--yāvān kaścid dhūmavān pradeśaḥ, upalakṣaṇametat dhānu kālo'pi gṛhyate sa pradeśādiḥ sarvo'pi na kevalaṃ kaścideva agnimān ityevaṃ vyāptau asiddhāyāṃ satyāṃ anumeyasya aprasiddhasya yā pratipattiḥ tasyā anupapatteḥ anumāna smṛtyantarād aliṅgajāt smaraṇāt na viśeṣyeta na bhidyeta

etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā ananubhūte na smṛtyantaram atiprasaṅgāt tathā vyāpyatvenāniścitāt liṅgāt vyāpakatvenāniścitasyānumeyasya pratipattirapi na yuktā, anyathā bhūmigṛhavardhitasya akasmād dhūmadarśanād agnipratipattiḥ syāt
tavaivaṃ vyāpakatvenāgṛhītasya tataḥ pratipattisaṃbhāvanā, anumānasya smṛtiviśeṣatvāt ata evoktam--smṛtyantarāt iti, tataḥ tadasattvena na viśeṣyeta iti manyate
tathā yāvān kaścidbhāvaḥ sa sarvaḥ kṣaṇika eva ityevaṃ tasyamasiddhāyāṃ sarvaṃ vācyam
tasyāṃ siddhāyāṃ ko doṣa iti cet ? atrāha--siddhau iti
siddhau niścaye evaṃ vyāpteḥ iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ, anumānaṃ smṛtyantarāt na viśeṣyeta
sādhyaṃ śakyamabhipretamaprasiddhamanumeyam iti, tasya yā pratipattiḥ tasyāḥ anupapatteḥ vyāptijñānena tasya niścaye tadayogāt
tathā ca trirūpālliṅgād yadanumeye jñānaṃ tadanumānam nyāyabi॰ 2
3 iti vacanamātram; siddhasādhyaviṣayatvena tasya pramāṇābhāsateti manyate

anumānagrahaṇamapi upalakṣaṇam, tena uttarapradeśādipratyakṣamapi tato na viśeṣyeta vyāptijñānena pradeśāderapi grahaṇāt, itarathā sa sarvo'pi agnimān iti pratipatterayogāt, vyāpyāpratipattau vyāpakāpratipattivat ādhārāpratipattau ādheyapratipattirapi nāsti, evamarthaṃ ca pradeśagrahaṇam, anyathā yāvān kaścid dhūmaḥ iti brūyāt
na ca bhāvakṣaṇikatvavyatirekeṇa aparaṃ yatta jñānenāgṛhītam uttarādhyakṣeṇa gṛhyate
nāpyanumānamiṣyate iti pra jñā ka ra gu ptaḥ kathaṃ dve eva pramāṇe pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
62 ityuktam ? vyavahāreṇeti cet; tenaiva tarhi yathā vyāptijñānena gṛhīte anumānaṃ pramāṇaṃ tathā pratyakṣānubhūte smṛteḥ iti dve eva pramāṇe pra॰ vārtikāla॰ iti mithyāvacaḥ
vyavahāre ca pramāṇamantareṇa vyāptisiddhau kimanyatrāpi tadanveṣaṇena iti sa eva doṣo mithyā tadvaca iti
yāvān kaścid bhāvaḥ sa sarvaḥ kṣaṇikaḥ iti prayoge
astu pramāṇasyāpi vilopaḥ advaitopagamāt iti prajñākaraguptaḥ, tatrāha--
tasya tato'viśeṣe kiṃ jātam ? ityāha--tata ityādi
kayoḥ ? ityāha--liṅgaliṅgijñānayoḥ liṅgajñāne vyāptijñāne pramāṇavyavasthā liṅgijñāne anumānajñāne itaravyavasthā syāt
atha liṅgajñānaviṣayād anyatra liṅgajñānasya vṛttiriṣyate tato'yamadoṣaḥ; tatrāha--svayam ityādi
svayam ātmanā anubhūtāt vyāptijñānena viṣayīkṛtāt vyatireko liṅgijñānavijñānaviṣayasya bhede aṅgīkriyamāṇe punaḥ anavayavena sākalyena vyāptisiddherayogāt sā vyatikīryeta iti sambandhaḥ
tadanubhūte tadvaiphalyam, anyatra tadapravṛttiḥ iti manyate

sāmānya ityādi a rca ṭa mataṃ dūṣayituṃ śaṅkate--deśādiviśeṣaṇarahitena agninā tathābhūtasya dhūmasya vyāptisiddhiḥ sāmānyaviṣayā vyāptiḥ ityucyate, viśeṣeṇa pakṣadharmatābalād deśādiviśeṣeṇa tadbhedena viśiṣṭasya taiḥ anumiteḥ iti cet; atrottaramāha--pūrvānubhūta ityādi
pūrvaṃ yadanubhūtaṃ tasya yā smṛtiḥ tasyā api na kevalam anumitereva tathāvidhasya anumitau kalpitasya viśeṣasya a nirākaraṇāt kāraṇāt yatkiñcidetat na kiñcidetadityarthaḥ
tathāhi--deśādi viśeṣaṇarahitasya anubhūtasya tatsahitasya punaḥ smaraṇe na bādhakaṃ paśyāmaḥ

kathaṃ tathānanubhūtasya tathā smaraṇam atiprasaṅgāditi cet ? kathaṃ tathāvidhasya vyāptijñānenāviṣayīkṛtasya anumitiḥ atiprasaṅgāt iti samānātmatva pakṣadharmatāgrahaṇasya prakṛte kṣayopaśamasya balamiti na viśeṣaḥ
dṛśyate hi kenacid viśeṣeṇa rahitasya vyākhyātuḥ praghaṭṭakasya grahaṇe'pi punaḥ smartṛviśeṣāt tadviśiṣṭasya smaraṇam
tannirastam; pūrvānubhūtasmaraṇe'pi asya anumānavad bhāvāt saptamapramāṇaprasaṅgāt
adhunā naiyāyiko bhūtvā sūriḥ sāmānyaviṣayā vyāptiḥ viśeṣeṇa anumitiḥ iti vadantaṃ pramāṇāntaramanyadāpādayitumāha--tadevam ityādi
gosadṛśo gavayaḥ iti vākyāt saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhamavagatavataḥ asyeyaṃ saṃjñeti viśeṣaṇapratipattiḥ punaranumānaṃ nātiśete yataḥ pramāṇamanumānaṃ nāparam
tat ityayaṃ nipātaḥ tasmin ityasyārthe draṣṭavyaḥ
tasmin parokṣe evam uktaprakāreṇa sati nyāye gauriva gavayaḥ iti vākyam upamāvākyaṃ tena āhito yaḥ saṃskāraḥ tasmāttatra jñānajo jñānahetuśca saṃskāraḥ iti vacanāt
kathaṃ tadvākyāt sa iti cet ? pāramparyeṇa tataḥ tasya bhāvāt tataḥ sa ityucyate ityadoṣaḥ

tathāhi--tadvākyāt pratipattiriti tadviṣayaṃ jñānam, punaḥ tatsahakāriṇā manasā yāvān kaścit padārthaḥ gosadṛśaḥ sa sarvo gavayaśabdavācyaḥ iti sāmānyena vācyavācakasambandhaviṣayamānasamadhyakṣaṃ janyate, tataḥ saṃskāraḥ iti smṛtiḥ smaraṇaṃ jāyate ityadhyāhāraḥ
tau ca tau saṃjñāsaṃjñinau ca gavayaśabda ga viśeṣau tayoḥ sambandhe vācyavācakalakṣaṇe

idamatra tātparyam--yathā sāmānyaviṣayāyāṃ vyāptau viśeṣeṇa anumānaṃ jāyamānamapūrvārthaṃ tathā mānasapratyakṣeṇa sāmānyena saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhe pratipante punaḥ tasya sarvasya smaraṇād vane gavayadarśanād viśeṣeṇa tatpratipattiḥ apūrvārthāstu
yatpunaratroktam--sāmānyasya viśeṣaniṣṭhatvāt, tatprati pattau viśeṣapratipattiḥ iti; tadasāram; anyatra samatvāt

gosadṛśo gavayaḥ ityevaṃ vākyāt tadvijñānāt sahakāriṇaḥ saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandham avagatavataḥ jñātavataḥ sāmānyena punaḥ kālāntareṇa gavayadarśanād asya pratīyamānasya iyaṃ gavayaḥ iti saṃjñā ityevaṃ viśeṣeṇa pratipattiḥ vyāptidarśinaḥ sāmānyena iti sambandhaḥ
yataḥ atiśāyanāt pramāṇam anumānaṃ nā'param upamānaṃ na pramāṇaṃ syāt
yataḥ iti vā ākṣepe, yato nāparaṃ syāt ? syādeva, upamānaṃ pramāṇamabhyupagacchet
saugatasya itarasya vā pramāṇāntaraṃ darśayituṃ matamāśaṅkate--yadi ityādinā

tadvākyāhitasaṃskārasya agoṣu svayaṃ tannāmāsambandhamarthāpattyā upagamyate yathā sāmānyena liṅgaliṅgisambandhapratipattiḥ pramāṇāntaraṃ tatheyamapi pratyabhijñānaṃ pramāṇāntaram, na gavayo'yaṃ tādṛśopalabdheḥ
athavā, ekaviṣāṇi khaṅgaḥ saptaparṇo viṣamacchada ityāhitasaṃskārāṇāṃ punastatpratyakṣadarśināmabhijñānaṃ kinnāma pramāṇaṃ syāt ?
upamānādanyat pramāṇaṃ pramāṇāntaraṃ syāt anyatra gavayād anyeṣu mahiṣyādiṣu gavaya iti saṃjñā tatsaṃjñā tasyāḥ asaṃbhavasmṛtiḥ
gosadṛśo gavayaḥ iti vākyaṃ tadvākyaṃ tena uktavidhinā āhitaḥ saṃskāro yasya tasya pratipattivataḥ

nanu gauriva gavayaḥ iti vākyapratipattisahakāriṇā manasā bhavatu gosadṛśeṣu sāmānyena tatsaṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhapratipattiḥ tadvisadṛśeṣu kena tannāmā'saṃbandhapratipattiḥ iti cet ? atrāha— arthāpattyā iti

yato gosadṛśo gavayaḥ, tato'rthāt tadvilakṣaṇo na gavayaḥ itivākyapratipattiḥ arthāpattiḥ tayā ttyatenaivatante taddarśayati--yathā sāmānyena liṅgaliṅginoḥ saṃjñāsaṃjñinoḥ sambandhasya pratipattiḥ pramāṇāntaram anumānādeḥ tathā iyamapi iti
ayaṃ govisadṛśo dṛśyamāno na gavayaḥ na gavayaśabdavācya iti
ayam ityanena sāmānyārthāpatteḥ anumānavadasya viśeṣaṃ darśayati
yadi asya paro vaidharmyopamāne antarbhāvaṃ brūyāt tarhi jaino'pi asya upamānasya ca asādṛśyetarapratyabhijñāne iti nānayoḥ tataḥ pramāṇāntaratvaṃ pratyakṣādiva āgamāderapi tadbhāvāditi
adhunā asya kārikākhaṇḍasya anyārtho vyākhyāyate--anyatroktād anyasmin viṣaye tatsaṃjñāsaṃbhavasmṛtiḥ tasya anyasya saṃjñā nāma tasyāḥ saṃbhavasmṛtiḥ pramāṇāntarameva

ekaviṣāṇī khaṅgaḥ saptaparṇo viṣamacchadaḥ ityevam āhitasaṃskārāṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ punaḥ paścāt tatpratyakṣadarśināṃ tatkhaṅgādikaṃ pratyakṣeṇa draṣṭuṃ śīlānām abhijñānam--ayaṃ sa khaṅgādiśabdavācyo'rthaḥ iti pratyabhijñānaṃ kinnāma pramāṇaṃ syāt sādharmyopamāne vaidharmyopamāne vā asya anantarbhāvāt tallakṣaṇatvādasyānyannāma karttavyamiti manyate

strādīnām dvandvaḥ, punaḥ asya ādiśabdena bahubrīhiḥ, asyāpi lakṣaṇaśabdena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, asya ca śravaṇena, tasmāt punaḥ tathā śravaṇaprakāreṇa darśinaḥ stryādi didarśanavataḥ samabhijñānaṃ kinnāma pramāṇam iti sambandhaḥ
saṃkhyaikatvādilakṣaṇā ādiryeṣāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvaparavākyadūrāsannādīnāṃ te tathoktāḥ teṣāṃ pratipattiśca pramāṇāntaram iti sambandhaḥ
ātmano 'rthasannikarṣajatvāt mānasaṃ pratyakṣaṃ sukhādipratipattivat sā ityeke
atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ— yathā ātmamanaścakṣurādyartha sannikarṣāj jāyamānaṃ jñānaṃ cakṣurādipratyakṣamucyate nānyat, tathā ātmamano'rthasannikarṣāt mānasam ityucyatāṃ na prakṛtam
yadi punaḥ tadapi jñānatvāt cakṣurādijanitarūpādijñānavat indriyārthasannikarṣajam; tarhi anumānādinā vyabhicāraḥ
taddhetuliṅgāderapyapekṣaṇānna doṣa iti cet; anyatra pūrvāparanirīkṣaṇasya apekṣaṇānna doṣa iti na samānamiti
pratyabhijñānaṃ hi nāma ādyapratyakṣanirodhe dvitīyadarśane prāgāhitasaṃskārābhivyaktau smṛtipūrvaṃ tṛtīyaṃ darśanam
evaṃ pūrvajñānaviśeṣitasya stambhāderviśeṣaṇamatītakṣaṇaviṣaya iti mānasī pratyabhijñā
atra ādiśabdena kāraṇādiparigrahaḥ, teṣu saha pṛthag vā dṛṣṭeṣu sopāneṣu pṛthageva dṛṣṭeṣu kāraṇādiṣu saṃkhyādipratipattirbhavantī uktanyāyena pratyakṣādeḥ atiricyeta, tataḥ pṛthak pramāṇaṃ bhavet
pūrvāparayorbhāvaḥ ādiryasya sthūletaratvādeḥ tasya yā smṛtiḥ tadapekṣaiva nānyathā iti evakārārthaḥ
tathāhi--pūrvadarśanāhitasaṃskārasya aparadarśane sati tataḥ pūrvasmaraṇe ca tasmād ayamekaḥ tena dvitīyaḥ ityādi pratipattiḥ, evaṃ kāraṇabhāvādau yojyam
nāma abhidhānam ādiryeṣāṃ jātiguṇādīnāṃ te tathoktāḥ teṣāṃ yojanājñānam keṣāṃ vat ? ityāha--paśyatām abhidheyābhidhānādikam upalabhamānānām
abhidhānābhidheyaviśeṣaṇādīnāṃ pūrvāparapramāṇavyaktayaḥ tadavinābhāvi yat śabdādiyojanājñānaṃ tat sarvaṃ niravaśeṣam upamānamiva pramāṇāntaram
kiṃ punaḥ āpādyānyetānyeva pramāṇāni āhosvit parāṇyapi santi iti kaścit ? santi iti darśayantamāha--arthāpattiḥ ityādi

deśakālādiniyataṃ paśyataḥ śṛṇvato vā punaḥ idamitthameva nānyatheti vidhipratiṣedhalakṣaṇaṃ vikalpadvayaṃ kathañcana smārtameveti saṃkīryeta na vā ? saṃbhavapratyayasvabhāvamavadhāraṇaparaṃ smārtameva
pramāṇaṣaṭkavijñāto yaccāluḥ sādhyābhāve niyamenābhavan yatra adṛṣṭamarthaṃ kalpayet sā arthāpattiḥ
adṛṣṭaṃ kalpayedarthaṃ sārthāpattirudāhṛtā || mī॰ ślo॰ arthā॰ ślo॰ 1 iti
aṭavyāṃ gavayadarśanāt nagare gavi yā smṛtiḥ ityanena gṛhyate, anyasyāḥ pramāṇāntaratvena aviśeṣeṇa prasādhitatvāt
yāvān kaścid dhūmavān pradeśaḥ sa sarvo'pyagnimān ityādi pratipattiḥ cintā
atha iyam adṛṣṭaśrutapūrvā iti kiṃ svarūpā sā iti pṛṣṭa iva tatsvarūpaṃ darśayitumāha--meya ityādi
meyo'numeyaḥ agnyādiḥ vipakṣaḥ tasmād anyo yo anagnyādivipakṣaḥ tasmāddhetoḥ apohanaṃ vyāvṛttiḥ tasya ūhanaṃ vitarkaṇam
athavā, meyo dhūmādihetuḥ tasya anyasmād anagnyādeḥ apohanam tana miti kecit; tadyuktamanyatheti vā cintyam; sūtra eva tadavayavavyākhyāne prayojanābhāvāt, vṛttyaviśeṣaprasaṅgāt atiprasaṅgācca

tasmād anyathā vyākhyāyate--meyaḥ pratyakṣādipramāṇaparicchedyaḥ svapararūpābhyāṃ bhāvā'bhāvātmako ghaṭādiḥ tasya ūhanam dīrgho'yam anyathā vā ityādi rūpeṇa darśanānantaraṃ mānasavikalpena cintanam, tatraiva anyasya paṭādeḥ apohanaṃ vyāvṛttiḥ, tasya tadiha nāsti iti ūhanaṃ vitarkaṇam

etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā tadatra nāsti iti ūhanadarśanād abhāvākhyaṃ pramāṇamiṣyate tathā itthamidam ityūhanadarśanād bhāvākhyamapi aparaṃ tadiṣyatām, bhāvāṃśavad abhāvāṃśasyāpi pratyākṣādereva anyathā grahaṇād abhāvākhyamapi tannābhyupagantavyamiti, tadetat sarvam upamānavaditi sambandhaḥ
ṭīkātaḥ sūtrasya bhedo na syāditi bhāvaḥ
atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ— yathā svadeśādinā sattvaṃ bhāvasya pratyakṣataḥ pratīyate tathā paradeśādinā asattvamapi
bhāvāṃśenaiva sambandhaḥ yogyatvādindriyasya hi || mī॰ ślo॰ abhāva॰ ślo॰ 18 iti
yathaiva hi tato bhāvāṃśasya pratīteḥ tatra tad yogyaṃ tathā abhāvāṃśasyāpi iti, atrāpi tadyogyamastu aviśeṣāt
yatpunaretat--abhāvaḥ svasamānajātīyapramāṇavedyaḥ prameyatvāt bhāvavat iti; tadapyanena nirastam; pratyakṣabādhanāt pratijñāyāḥ
tathā śṛṇvato vā śabdāt pratipadyamānasya vā deśakālādiniyatam
anena pūrvasya hetoḥ vyabhicāraṃ darśayati agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāmaḥ kṛ॰ ya॰ kāṭhaka॰ 6
7 iti vākyāt svabhāvād abhimatasattvavad anabhimatāsattvasyāpi pratīteḥ, kimanyathā taduccāraṇeneti ? tasya kim ? ityāha--punaḥ ityādi
punaḥ darśanaśravaṇād ūrdhvaṃ vikalpadvayaṃ jāyate ityupaskāraḥ
kathaṃbhūtam ? ityāha— vidhipratiṣedhalakṣaṇaṃ vidhipratiṣedhayoḥ bhāvābhāvayoḥ lakṣaṇaṃ niścayanaṃ yasya yasmin vā tattathoktam
idaṃ dṛśyamānaṃ ca ittham anena svadeśādi prakāreṇaiva nānyathā paradeśādiprakāreṇa naiva
smṛtiśabdaḥ pūrvo'nuvartate ityeva varttate ityevaṃ saṃkīryeta na vā ? yadi saṃkīryeta; tarhi vidhilakṣaṇavikalpavat pratiṣedhalakṣaṇavikalpo'pi na smṛteḥ pramāṇāntaraṃ syāt
atha na saṃkīryate; pratiṣedhalakṣaṇavikalpavat vidhilakṣaṇavikalpo'pi pramāṇāntaraṃ syāditi manyate
tanna ku mā ri laḥ pramāṇaṣaṭkavādī
bauddhādikalpitasya khādet śvamāṃsam ityādyaniṣṭārthasya nivṛttirapi tataḥ pratīyate iti bhāvaḥ
yo'pi pra bhā ka ro manyate--nā'bhāvaḥ pramāṇāntaraṃ pratyakṣādipramāṇapañcakaśeṣatvādasya iti taṃ pratyāha--saṃbhava ityādi
kathaṃbhūtam ? ityāha--saṃbhavaḥ sādhyabhāve bhāvaḥ niyamena tadabhāve abhāvaḥ, dṛśyamānasya śrūyamāṇasya vā deśakālādiniyatasya tayoḥ pratyayaḥ pratītiḥ anyathānupapattigraha iti yāvat
sa eva sva ātmīyaḥ kāraṇatvena bhāvo yasya tattathoktam
anena yathā anumānasya sādhyābhāvāsaṃbhavaniyamanirṇayalakṣaṇo hetuḥ kāraṇaṃ tathā arthāpatterapi iti darśayati
punarapi kathaṃbhūtam ? ityāha--avadhāraṇaparaṃ jīvādiḥ sattvādibhyaḥ pari ṇāmyeva nānyathā ityavadhāraṇapradhānam

tat kim ? ityāha--saṃkīryeta na vā saṃkīryeta ? katham ? ityāha--kathaṃcana, anumānaprakāreṇa arthāpattiprakāreṇa caikībhavedvā na vā ? yadi saṃkīryeta; tarhi yathā ku mā ri la sya pramāṇaṣaṭkavārttā vārttaiva tathā prakārasya pramāṇapañcakakathā kṛtvaiva

atha na saṃkīryeta; trirūpaliṅgajanitādanumānānumānadvatta yathā sādharmyadṛṣṭāntarahitāyā arthāpatteḥ bhedaḥ tathā tasyāḥ pakṣadharmatvavarjitāyā iti sa eva doṣaḥ tayoḥ pramāṇasaṃkhyāvyāghāta iti manyate
nanvanumānaṃ smaraṇajam, dṛṣṭāntasmaraṇabhāve bhāvāt, naivamarthāpattirviparyayāt tatastayorbheda iti cet; atrāha--smārttameva iti
evakāreṇa etatkathayati--yadi anumānotthāpako'rtho dṛṣṭāntasmaraṇamantareṇa anumānaṃ notthāpayitumalam, tarhi arthāpattyutthāpako'pi tathaivā'stu
atha vipakṣe sadbhāvabādhakapramāṇabalādeva artho'rthāpattimupajanayati, tathā anumānamapi iti nirūpayiṣyate
yadi punaḥ arthāpattau dṛṣṭāntasyā'satona smaraṇam, anumāne sato'pi; akiñcitkarasya kiṃ smaraṇena iti samānaḥ tadabhāvaḥ
athāyaṃ nirbandho liṅgaṃ dṛṣṭāntamantareṇa sādhyāvinābhāvi jñātuṃ na śakyate iti; tathā arthāpattyutthāpako'pyarthaḥ, iti sūktam--smārttameva iti
apramīyamāṇatvameva hi nāstitvaṃ nāparaṃ na cāpramīthamāṇataiva prameyaṃ yasmāttadarthāsaṃsṛṣṭānubhavayuktataiva ātmanaḥ tasyārthasyāpramīyamāṇatā
sā cāvasthā ātmanaḥ svasaṃviditaiva, ataḥ prameyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate
tasmād bhāvagrāhakapramāṇānanuvṛttireva abhāvāvagamaṃ prasūte pṛ॰ 119 abhāvasya tu svarūpāvagatirnāsti iti na pramāṇābhāvādanyaḥ prameyābhāvaḥ
pramāṇābhāvo'pi ca svarūpāntarānavagamādeva na bhāvāntarapramiterbhidyate, bhāvāntarapramitiśca svayaṃ prakāśarūpā na prameyatāmanubhavatīti prameyamabhāvākhyasya pramāṇasya nopapadyate
nanu yaduktaṃ smṛtiḥ upamānavaditi na doṣāya abhyupagamāditi cet; atrāha--gavismṛtiḥ ityādi
gavi smṛtiḥ pramāṇaṃ syāt gavayaṃ paśyataḥ katham
upamāvākyād yathā kvāpi sādṛśyapratipattistathā kasyacit kenacid vailakṣaṇyapratipattiḥ arthāpatteḥ

taduttarapratyakṣāt pūrvasmṛtiraviśeṣeṇa pramāṇamastu prayojanavaśāt prasiddhasādharmyātsādhyasādhanamupamānam, saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhapratipattiśca upamānārtha iti kiṃ parisaṃkhyānena ? kṛtena akṛtavīkṣaṇasya sarvasyaiva bhavati upamānam
udāharaṇasādharmyavaidharmyābhyāṃ saha pṛthagvā sa eva tatra sādhanam
atrāpi upamānasādharmyānumānayorabhedaḥ syād viśeṣādarśanāditi viparītalakṣaṇaprajño jaḍātmā
kasyacit kathañcit svataḥ siddhimantareṇa uttarasyāvṛtteḥ cintopamānavat
goralābhe gavayena tatkāryaṃ karttavyam iti śrutvā kaścit kañcid āṭavyaṃ pṛcchati kathaṃbhūto gavayo bhavati ? sa taṃ pratyāha--gauriva gavayaḥ iti

sa pṛṣṭvā evaṃ śrutvā nagare gāmupalabhya punaḥ aṭavīṃ paryaṭan, yadvātatra gavayamupalabhya gāṃ smarati tadā sā gavi gavayasādṛśyaviśiṣṭe smṛtiḥ pramāṇaṃ mīmāṃsakasya upamānākhyaṃ mānaṃ syād bhavet, gavayaṃ paśyataḥ puṃsaḥ
cecchabdo'tra draṣṭavyaḥ, kātvā vā tadartho vyākhyātavyaḥ
kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa na pramāṇam api tu pramāṇameva
anyatra kvacit mahiṣyādau smṛtiḥ iti sambandhaḥ
tasmād gavayād visadṛśarūpeṇa lakṣyate iti tadvilakṣyaḥ tasminnapi na kevalaṃ tatsadṛśe gavi iti
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā sādṛśyaviśiṣṭe gavi tadviśiṣṭe vā sādṛśye, gograhaṇamupalakṣaṇam, smṛtiḥ pramāṇāntaraṃ tathā vailakṣaṇyaviśiṣṭe mahiṣyādau tadviśiṣṭe vā vailakṣaṇye iti
nanu gosadṛśālambhanādi yathā sadṛśasmṛteḥ prayojanaṃ naivaṃ vailakṣaṇyasmṛteriti cet; atrāha--prayojanavaśāt iti
gosadṛśasya yāgādau ālambhanaṃ kriyate iti sadṛśasmṛteḥ vaidikaṃ prayojanaṃ vidyate iti bhāvaḥ
gauriva gavayaḥ iti vākyād yathā kvāpi gavi sādṛśyapratipattiḥ tathā kasyacit mahiṣyādeḥ kenacid gavādinā vailakṣaṇyapratipattiḥ
kutaḥ ? arthāpatteḥ, yata evaṃ tat tasmāt uttarapratyakṣāt gavayapratyakṣāt pūrvasya gavādeḥ smṛtiḥ pramāṇamastu aviśeṣeṇa, sadṛśasmṛtivad visadṛśasmṛtirapi pramāṇaṃ bhavatu
nanu yaduktam--cintopamānavat iti; tatra sākalyena liṅgaliṅgisambandhabuddhiryadi cintateyasyāḥ sākṣāt paramparayā mano'rthasannikarṣādutpattermānasapratyakṣatvena pramāṇatā iti siddhasādhanam
athavā yaduktam--pramāṇāntaram ityādi; tadapi tādṛgeva; vaidharmyopamānatvādasya, śeṣaṃ mānasamadhyakṣam iti naiyāyikādayaḥ
prasiddhena gavādinā prasiddhaṃ vā yat sādharmyaṃ tasmāt sādhyasya saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhajñānasya sādhanam pramātṛprameyābhyāmanyaḥ kāraṇakalāpaḥ upamānam pramāṇam
upamānārtha upamānaphalam ityevaṃ ca śabdaḥ pūrvasamuccaye kiṃ parisaṃkhyānena parigaṇanena, na kiñcit
kṛtena niścitena akṛtasya parokṣasya yad vīkṣaṇaṃ jñānaṃ tasya sarvasyaiva niravaśeṣasyaiva bhavati upamānam, upamānādaparaṃ parokṣaṃ pramāṇaṃ mā bhūd iti manyate

etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā viśadendriyārthasannikarṣajajñānasādharmyāt sākṣāt paramparayā tatsannikarṣajaṃ viśadamaviśadaṃ vā pratyaksamucyate tathā prasiddhasādharmyāt sādhyasādhanopamānasādharmyāt kṛtenākṛtajñānam upamānamastu avāntaraviśeṣasya sarvatra bhāvāditi
dhūmamagnisahacaritamindriyeṇopalabhya anagneśca jalādervyāvartamānamanupalambhena jñātvā manasā niścinoti dhūmo'gniṃ na vyabhicaratiti
evaṃ sati upamānā'numānayoḥ abhedaprasaṅgaḥ; bhedaśca tayorloke prasiddha iti manyate
tathāstu iti vadantamācāryaṃ pratyāha--sa eva tatra ityādi
udāharaṇaṃ nidarśanaṃ tena yat sādharmyaṃ kṛtakatvādi samānadharmeṇa sadṛśatvam vaidharmyaṃ taddharmā'bhāvena visadṛśatvaṃ pakṣasya tābhyām iti

saha ityanena anvayavyatirekavat pūrvavaccheṣavatsāmānyato'dṛṣṭam ityanumānaṃ darśayati pṛthagvā ityanena kevalānvayi pūrvavaccheṣavad iti kevalavyatireki pūrvavatsāmānyato'dṛṣṭam iti ca upamānalakṣaṇamuktamiti nocyate
na kevalaṃ pūrva vyāptijñānasya mānasādhyakṣatvakalpane kiṃ caitrāpi upamānasādharmyānumānayorabhedaḥ syāt prasiddhasādharmyāt sādhyasādhanam nyāyasū॰ 1
tathā ca paraḥ paramārthataḥ tayorbhedaṃ kathayati lakṣaṇaṃ ca samānaṃ brūte iti viparītalakṣaṇaprajño jaḍātmā iti
satyaṃ nidarśanamātrametat tena vaidharmyobhayopamānānumānayorabhedaḥ syāditi ca draṣṭavyam
evaṃ svayam ācāryeṇa naiyāyike niraste saugatāḥ prāhuḥ--tato'numānameva ityādi
asyāyamarthaḥ--yasmāt kṛtena akṛtavīkṣaṇaṃ sarvam iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
atrāha paraḥ--prasiddhasādharmyādanyato vā sādhyā vinābhāvinaḥ sādhyasādhanamanumānamastu paraṃ tu upamānādikaṃ syāditi cet; atrāha saugataḥ--sarvathā ityādi
sarveṇa prasiddhasādharmyaprakāreṇa anyena vā sarvatha avinābhāvasambandhapratipatteḥ vinā tamantareṇa prāmāṇyānupapatteḥ anumānameva astu iti sambandhaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadi prasiddhasādharmyasya anyasya vā avinābhāvasambandhapratipattirasti; siddhamasmatsamīhitam
anyathā tato jāyamānaṃ na kiñcitpramāṇam atiprasaṅgāditi
nanu yathā pratyakṣasya avinābhāvasambandhapratipattervinā prāmāṇyaṃ tathā upamānādeḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--pratyakṣe'pi ityādi
na kevalamanyatra api tu pratyakṣe'pi samānaḥ sadṛśaḥ prasaṅgaḥ prasaktiḥ avinābhāva ityādikasya
tadapi hi vastupratibandhāt tatra pramāṇaṃ nānyathā
avinābhāvagrahaṇaṃ binā yat jñānaṃ sādṛśyād bhavati tad bhavatu upamānamityabhiprāyaḥ
atrāha cārvākaḥ--anumāne tarhi avinābhāvasambandhapratipatterabhāvāt prāmāṇyaṃ na syāditi; tatrāha--tathaiva ityādi
tathā tena pratyakṣaprakāreṇa anumāne'pi na kevalam anyatra samānaḥ prasaṅgaḥ iti padaghaṭanā
asti ca tatrāpi sā iti manyate
evaṃ svamataṃ vyavasthāpya saugatāḥ kadācidevaṃ brūyuḥ--asmākaṃ kathaṃ cino pamānavad iti
kasyacit dhūmādeḥ kathañcit kenāpi prakāreṇa svataḥ nasādhanāntareṇa jñānāpekṣāmantareṇa siddhiḥ nirṇītiḥtāmantareṇa uttarasya adhyakṣad anumānasyā'vṛtteḥ cintopamānavat iti
atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--asyāḥ siddheḥ sadbhāve tataḥ anumānameva astu ityayuktaṃ pratyākhyānam
pratyakṣānumānayoranyataratra tadantarbhāvāt na doṣa iti cet; atrāha--bhūtā ityādi
bhūtā bhavyāḥ sarve santo bhāvāḥ kṣaṇakṣayāḥ
iti vyāptau pramāṇaṃ te na pratyakṣaṃ na laiṅgikam || 8
parokṣasya sambandhāttadavinābhāvino'nyataḥ siddhiranumānameveti; atra sambandho naiva pratyakṣo bhavitumarhati yato'numānavyavasthā syāt
na hi kasyacit sākalyena vyāptijñānaṃ kvacit kadācit pratyakṣaṃ sannihitaviṣayabalotpatteravicārakatvāt
yadi tadbalotpannaṃ vikalpajñānaṃ na bhavet anumānaṃ ca na syāt
anadhigataliṅgaliṅgisvalakṣaṇādhyavasāye'pi yadi na pramāṇāntaraṃ pratyakṣamapi na syāt
yat sat tatsarvaṃ kṣaṇikameveti pratyakṣasiddhau śabdakṣaṇikatvameva kimanumeyam ?
kṣaṇikṣayā ityevaṃ vyāptau vyāptiviṣaye pramāṇaṃ te saugatasya na pratyakṣaṃ na laiṅgikam nānumānam
teṣāṃ vyāpteragrahe nānumānaṃ nāma, ityayuktamidam--pratyakṣamanumānaṃ ceti dve eva pramāṇe
vyavahāreṇa tadabhidhānādadoṣa iti cet; vyavahāreṇa tat na paramārthataḥ iti kuto'vaseyam ? vicārāditi na yuktam; asya apramāṇatve nātastadavaseyam atiprasaṅgāt

na ca tat svarūpādanyatra vṛttimat iti kutastataḥ anyat pratyakṣam anumānaṃ ca vyavahāreṇa iti pratipattiḥ ? nahi nīlajñānaṃ pītādikam idaṃtayā nedaṃtayā vā vyavasthāpayitumalam, jñānāntarakalpanāvaiphalyaprāpteḥ

atha anyat pratyakṣādikam asat; asataśca sattvena anyathā vā kalpanaṃ nānyato vyavahārāt iti cet; kutastadasattvasiddhiḥ ? anupalambhāt ityanuttaram; svayameva ataḥ pareṇaanumānavyavasthānāt pratiṣedhācca kasyacit iti vacanāditi
asya vyavahāreṇa prāmāṇye kutaḥ antaḥ paramārthato'nyābhāvasiddhiḥ yataḥ svasaṃvedanādhyakṣādvaitameva iti yuktam
nāpyata eva tadabhāvaḥ sidhyati; tatra asya avyāpārāt, itarathā sukhādīnāṃ parasparamanulambhāt sarvābhāvaḥ syāt
nirvikalpakasya hi pratyakṣatvamabhyupagabhyate, vicārasya ca vikalparūpatvāditi bhāvaḥ
etena yaduktaṃ pra jñā ka re ṇa--pratibhāsādvaitādanyasya abhāvāt kathamucyate bhūtā ityādi iti; tannirastam
asyāḥ grahaṇam upalakṣaṇam, tena anyasyāmapi, tanna tasya pramāṇam ityanumānocchedaḥ
parokṣasya indriyaviṣayasya sambandhāt tadavinābhāvino'nyataḥ tato'nyasmāt siddhiḥ anumānameva na pramāṇāntaram
atra parapakṣe saṃbandho liṅgaliṅginoḥ avinābhāvo naiva pratyakṣo bhavitumarhati yato yasmāt tatpratyakṣabhavanārhatvāt anumānavyavasthā syāt
yata iti vā ākṣepe, naiva syāt
54 iti vacanāt pratyakṣabhavanārhatvābhāvena sarvaṃcastadabhāve nānumānaṃ kāraṇābhāve kāryānutpatteriti

hi yasmāt na kasyacit saugatasya naiyāyikādervā sākalyena sāmastyena vyāptijñānaṃ liṅgaliṅgisambandhagrahaṇaṃ pratyakṣaṃ kvacid vyavahāre paramārthe vā deśe vā kadācit saṃsāridaśāyāṃ yogidaśāyāṃ vā kāle vā bhavitumarhati
kenacid dharmeṇa na tāvadvaiśadyena; tatra tadabhāvāt, tathā avyavahārāt
tathāpi tatra tadaṅgīkaraṇe na kiñcidaviśadaṃ jñānaṃ bhavet
nāpi cakṣurādyakṣaprabhavatvena; tatra tadavyāpārāt, anyathā pratyakṣasaṃkhyāniyamavyāghātaḥ
abhyāsajatveneti cet; atredaṃ cintyate--vikalpamātraṃ vā abhyāsaparikaragocarīkṛtaṃ tat syāt, anumānaṃ vā ? prathamavikalpe na tatpramāṇam, kāmādyupaplutadṛṣṭivat

dvitīye vyāptijñānādanukṛtānvayavyatirekaṃ kāraṇam nā'kāraṇaṃ viṣayaḥ ityasya pramāṇato'rthapratipattyā pravṛttisāmarthyād arthavat pramāṇam nyāyabhā॰ pṛ॰ 1 arthasahakārivyavasāyādiviśeṣaṇajñānakaṃ pramātṛprameyābhyāmarthāntaraṃ pramāṇam ityasya ca vacanāt svaviṣayakāryeṇa tena bhavitavyam, iti na svasamānasamayabhuvo grahaṇam tasya tadakāraṇatvāt
yacca kāraṇaṃ tadapi taddeśādisannihitameva na sarvaṃ vivakṣitam, anyathā svānyakāryadeśādau tena tatkarttavyamiti nirūpayiṣyate anantarameva
tataḥ sūktam--sannihitetyādi sannihitaḥ tatkālānantarakālo yo viṣayaḥ tasya balena utpatteḥ kāraṇāt pratyakṣasya, tajñānaṃ na pratyakṣaṃ bhavitumarhatīti
avikalpakatvā'svagrahaṇātmakatvābhyāṃ sannihitasyāpi viṣayasya avyavasthāpakatvāt tanna tad bhavitumarhatīti
tadvyāptijñānaṃ tarhi anumānaṃ syāditi cet; atrāha--tadbalād ityādi
na kevalaṃ tajjñānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ na bhavitu marhatī tkaṃ kintvanumānaṃ ca tadapi na syāt
yadi ced vikalpajñānamūka jñānaṃ na bhavet
kathambhūtam ? tadbalotpannaṃ pratyakṣasāmarthyotpannam ūho matinibandhanaḥ iti vacanāt
asti tat, kevalaṃ pramāṇaṃ na bhavati, pramāṇamapi liṃgika meva iti cet; atrāha--anadhigata ityādi
anadhigataṃ pratyakṣādinā aviṣayīkṛtaṃ liṅgaliṅgisvalakṣaṇaṃ yat tasyādhyavasāye'pi na kevalam anadhyavasāye yadi na pramāṇāntaram
tathāhi--yadi na pramāṇaṃ pratyakṣamapi na syāt tasyāpi tallakṣaṇāntarābhāvāt
yadi na tadantaraṃ kintu anumānamenameva, anumānaṃ na syāt anavasthānāditi manyate
nanu mābhūd anumānaṃ tathāpi na saugatasya kācit kṣatiḥ svayaṃ tadabhāvopagamāt
tattvābhyupagatasya pratibhāsādvaitasya pratyakṣataḥ siddhiriti cet; atrāha--tatpratyakṣa ityādi
te ca te saugatakalpite paramārthasaṃvṛtirūpe pratyakṣamanumāne ca tābhyām, kathambhūtābhyām ? ityāha— avikalpita ityādi

nārthādhigatirnāma vyavahāre arthasya vyaptilakṣaṇasya paramārthe tadadvaitalakṣaṇasya adhigatirna, pratyakṣasya sakalavikalpavikalasya paraṃ prati asiddheḥ, anumānasya ca sāṃvṛtasya tattvā'sādhakatvāditi manyate
nanu yaduktam--mā'numā--anumānena nārthādhigatiḥ nāma iti; tatsiddhasādhanam; tena tadadhigateranabhyupagamāt
samāropavyavacchedakaraṇāt tat pramāṇamiṣyata iti cet; atrāha--samāropa ityādi
na kevalam arthādhigateḥ api tu tadvyavacchedasyāpyabhāvāt
yadā punaranumānena samāropavyavacchedaḥ kṛto na bhavatīti tadarthamanyat pravartate
yastu manyate pra jñā ka ra gu ptaḥ--yogijñānaṃ vyāptijñānam iti
yat sat arthakriyākāri tatsarvaṃ kṣaṇikameva nityaṃ na bhavati ityevaṃ pratyakṣasiddhau śabdakṣaṇikatvameva kimanumeyaṃ kintu sarvam anumeyaṃ syāt iti na kiñcit pratyakṣapramāṇaprameyaṃ bhavet
atha sukhādi-nīlādi tatprameyamiṣyate, tathā kṣaṇikatvamapi astu tadaviśeṣāditi na kiñcidanumeyam
na ca yogijñānaviṣayīkṛte samāropyebhyāsadaśācadyataḥ tadvyavacchedakaraṇādanumeyaṃ syāt, samārope vā na pratyakṣataḥ tadvyāptisiddhiḥ
na vā niścitaliṅgavat sā anumānakaraṇamiti manyate
tulanā--anye tu vyāptigrahaṇakāle pratipatturyogina ivāśeṣaviṣayaṃ parijñānamastīti bruvate

evaṃ tāvat sāmānyena parasya sākalyena vyāptigrahaṇesaṃbhavīti pratipādyaṃ yaduktam a rca ṭe na--sarvasya kṣaṇikatvena sākalyavyāptigrahaṇaṃ nādhyakṣataḥ, api tu akṣaṇikāt sarvataḥ sattvaṃ vyāvarttamānaṃ tīrādarśiśakuninyāyena gatyantarā'bhāvāt kṣaṇike vyavasthitiṃ kurvat tena vyāptamiti niścīyate, tataḥ tadvyāvṛttiśca tadvyāpikāyā arthakriyāyāḥ vyāvṛtteḥ, asyāśca vyāpakayoḥ kramayaugapadyayoḥ
naiva pratyakṣataḥ kāryavirahādvā sarvaśaktiviraho'kṣaṇikatve ucyate kintu tadvyāpakavirahāt

tataḥ kāryakriyāśaktivyāpakayostayorakṣaṇikatve virodhānnivṛttestadvyāptāyāḥ kāryakriyāśakterapi nivṛttiriti sarvaśaktivirahalakṣaṇamasattvamakṣaṇikatve vyāpakānupalabdhirākarṣati viruddhayorekatrāyogāt
tato nivṛttaṃ sattvaṃ kṣaṇikeṣvevāvatiṣṭhamānaṃ tadātmatāmanubhavatīti yat sat tat kṣaṇikameva ityanvayavyatirekarūpāyā vyāpteḥ siddhiḥniścayo bhavati
yathā kila vahanārūḍhairvaṇigbhiḥ śakunirmucyate api nāma tīraṃ drakṣyatīti
sa yadā sarvataḥ paryaṭaṃ stīraṃ nāsādayati tadā vahanamevāgacchati tadvadetadapi draṣṭavyam
yataścāvaśyābhyupagamanīyo'yaṃ pakṣaḥ tasmānna kiñcidamayā avidyamānapratiṣṭhānayā diśaḥ pratipattyā prayojanam
kramākramayoḥ vyāpakayoranyatareṇa kṣaṇike arthakriyāyāḥ pratyakṣapravṛttireva vipakṣe bādhakapramāṇavṛttiḥ
sā punaḥ kṣaṇakṣayānupalakṣaṇāt kathaṃ pratyakṣā ? pratyakṣāpi kathaṃ tatsambandhinī
kṣaṇikasyārthakriyāsiddhimantareṇa sattā vyāvartamānā kathañcitkṣaṇike sattāṃ sādhayet vipakṣānatiśāyanāt
tadayaṃ kṣaṇike arthakriyāmeva kutaścit sādhayitumarhati anyathā vipakṣavyāvṛttyasiddheḥ
kāraṇasya kṣaṇikasya sattaivārthakriyā pratyakṣeti cet; tathā'kṣaṇikasya aviśeṣāt, pratītivattvaviśeṣaḥ itaratrāpi
kāraṇāccet; kiṃ kena vyāptam ? tataḥ svabhāvānupalabdhireva vipakṣe bādhakaṃ pramāṇam
sā punaḥ kṣaṇikopalabdhirasiddhaiva vipratipatteḥ anyathā sādhanavaiyarthyāt
sarvataḥ kudasyāt kālāntarasthāyinaśca yadi vā dṛśyābhimatād anyataśca akṣaṇikāt cet sattāṃ nivarttayet
kathambhūtām ? vyāpyāṃ svavyāpyām ityavagantavyam, yathā mātari varttitavyam ityatra svasyām iti
tatra dūṣaṇam sā arthakriyā svāhimeta kṣaṇike vastuni
kena pramāṇena prakāreṇa vā sidhyati, na kenacit
etaduktaṃ bhavati--akṣaṇike vyāpakayoḥ kramā'kramayoranupalambhaḥ kṣaṇike'pi iti tatrāpi tadabhāvo na vā kvaciditi
anyatareṇa krameṇa akrameṇa vā kṣaṇike niranvayanaśvare vastuni yā arthakriyā tasyāḥ pratyakṣapravṛttiḥ adhyakṣotpattiravā vipakṣe akṣaṇike
yadā hi śabdaḥ kṣaṇikaḥ sattvāt sādhyate tadā anyaḥ sarvaḥ kṣaṇikaḥ sapakṣo bhavati akṣaṇiko vipakṣa iti bādhakapramāṇavṛttiḥ arthakriyāyāḥ iti gatena sambandhaḥ

anvayapratipattireva vyatirekapratipattiḥ; kathamanyathā niścitānvayavacanādeva sāmarthyād vyatirekagateḥ tadvacanaṃ nigrahasthānam ukta śobheta ? sātmake ca kvacit prāṇāderadarśane'pi kutaścit nirātmakānnivṛttiḥ syāditi manyate
punaḥ iti vitarke kṣaṇakṣayānupalakṣaṇāt kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa pratyakṣā ? tasyā api kṣaṇikaikānte kṣaṇikatvena anupalakṣaṇāditi manyate
mā sidhat tatsambandhinī sā; ko doṣa iti cet ? atrāha--kṣaṇikasya ityādi
kṣaṇikasya arthakriyāyāḥ yā siddhiḥ nirṇītiḥ tāmantareṇa kṣaṇikāt sattā arthakriyā vyāvarttamānā kathañcitkṣaṇike sattām arthakriyāṃ sādhayet

yata evaṃ tasmād ayaṃ saugataḥ kṣaṇike arthakriyāmeva kutaścit pramāṇāt sādhayitum arhati, anyathā tatra tatsādhanābhāvaprakāreṇa vipakṣavyāvṛtterasiddhiḥ vipakṣāda kṣaṇikād arthakriyāyāḥ yā vyāvṛttiḥ tasyā asiddheḥ iti
kā iti yogavibhāgāt kā-saḥ tātparaḥ taparaḥ iti yathā
kathambhūtasya ? kṣaṇikasya sattaiva svarūpasattvameva arthakriyā, taduktam--bhūtiryeṣāṃ kriyā saiva
kathaṃbhūtā sā ? ityāha--pratyakṣā iti evaṃ ced yadi
uttaramāha ācāryaḥ--tathā tena prakāreṇa akṣaṇikasya kāraṇasya sattaiva arthakriyā pratyakṣā iti na tataḥ sādhyo vyāvarttate iti manyate
anvayavyatirekavacanayorvā sādharmyavati vaidharmyavati ca sādhanaprayoga ekasyaivābhidhānena siddherbhāvāt dvitīyasyāsāmarthyamiti tasyāpyasādhanāṅgasyābhidhānaṃ nigrahasthānaṃ vyarthābhidhānādeva
kṣaṇikāḥ sarvasaṃskārāḥ asthirāṇāṃ kutaḥ kriyā ? bhūtiryaiṣāṃ kriyā saiva kārakaṃ saiva cocyate

ananne kasya kālatrayānuyāyitvam akṣaṇikasattvam, na ca tat pratyakṣataḥ pratyetuṃ śakyaṃ tatra tadasāmarthyāt, tasya pūrvāparakoṭivicchinnatvaṃ kṣaṇikasattvam, tacca tataḥ pratyetuṃ śakyaṃ tato'syābhāvāt kathamuktamiti cet ? atrāha--aviśeṣāt asya viśeṣasyābhāvāditi
yathaiva hi ekasya kālatrayānuyāyisattvaṃ draṣṭumaśakyaṃ tathā bāhyasyetarasya vā paramāṇoḥ kṣaṇamātrasattvam
nanu na paramāṇoḥ pūrvāparayattā kṣaṇikatvamucyate, api tu dṛśyasya sthūlasya, tato'yaṃ viśeṣa iti cet; atrāha--pratītītyādi

atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--asmin pakṣe yathā yugapadekasya sthūlasya ekānekātmakatvaṃ tathā krameṇāpi iti, kṣaṇakṣayapakṣe pratītivālakṣaṇo viśeṣaḥ akṣaṇikapakṣād bhedaḥ itarathā kṣaṇikapakṣe pratītyanugrahaṇalakṣaṇo'nya ekṣā tatānyathā cintitam anyathā parasya kāryaṃ pravṛttam
tadutpattiḥ sā syāt iti paramatamāśaṅkate--kāraṇāt ityādi
nanvetad āśaṅkitaṃ parihṛtaṃ ca kāraṇasya kṣaṇikasya ityādinā; satyam; tathāpi dūṣaṇāntarapratipādanārthaṃ tatpunaḥ āśaṅkyate, tadevāha--kiṃ tena ityādi
kiṃ sattvaṃ nānārtha kriyālakṣaṇena vyāpakena vyāptam ? na kenaciditi
eva manyate— yadā sattaiva arthakriyā; tathā'bhedānna tayoḥ kalpito'pi vyāpyavyāpakabhāvaḥ
tathā sati yad dūṣaṇaṃ tadāha--tata ityādi
tata uktanyāyāt svabhāvasya sattāsvarūpasya anupalabdhireva uktā na vyāpakā'nupalabdhiḥ vipakṣe sattābādhakaṃ pramāṇam iti evakārārthaḥ
anena anupalabdhiviśeṣāparijñānam a rca ṭa sya darśayati
saivāstu kodoṣaḥ iti cet; atrāha— sā punaḥ ityādi
sā pareṇa ucyamānā punaḥ iti vitarke kṣaṇikopalabdhiḥ kṣaṇikasattā viṣaye viṣayiśabdopacārādevamucyate
athavā upalabhyate iti upalabdhiḥ iti vyutpatteḥ
kuta etat ? ityatrāha--vipratipatteḥ viruddhā akṣaṇikasya pratipattiḥ vipratipattiḥ tasyāḥ
asyānabhyupagame dūṣaṇamāha--anyathā anyena vipratipattyabhāvaprakāreṇa sādhanasya kṣaṇikatvānumānasya vaiyarthyāt sā asiddhaiva iti
idamatra tātparyam--anupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptāyāḥ sattāyāḥ na tāvat svabhāvānupalabdhiḥ vipakṣe'bhāvasādhanaṃ svayamanabhyupagamāt
nāpyupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptāyāḥ; nityavat kṣaṇike'pi tadadarśane gatyanta rābhāvena tadupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptatā'siddheriti
upalabdhirhi jñānātmikā viṣayiṇī tasyāḥ viṣayabhūtāyāṃ sattāyāmupacāraḥ kriyate
nanu yaduktam--anyatrāpi samānam iti; na samānam; akṣaṇikāt kramā'kramābhyāṃ kāryotpatteḥ virodhāt; tatpariharannāha--pūrvamityādi

yasmin satyeva yadbhāvaḥ tatkāryamitarat kāraṇamiti kṣaṇikatve na saṃbhavatyeva sahotpattiprasaṅgāt kutaḥ santānavṛttiḥ ? tataḥ prāk tatkaraṇasāmarthye anutpannaṃ tadabhāva eva bhāvi tatkāryamiti mṛtvāpi aṅgīkarttavyam
tadetat kāraṇaṃ kāryotpattau tatkālaṃ vā tiṣṭhatu mā vā bhūt prāk tatkaraṇasamarthaṃ paścānna karotyeva
na vai paścāt karoti abhāvāt, tat svayaṃ paścāt bhavati, ityatrāpi pratiniyatakālamapekṣyam, yato yathāsvaṃ krameṇa kāryaṃ bhavati
pūrvaṃ svasattākāla iti yāvat śaktāt samarthāt
kutaḥ ? naśvarāt kṣaṇikāt kāryaṃ jāyate ityadhyāhāraḥ
kiṃ avinaśvarād akṣaṇikāt prāk śaktāt kāryaṃ paścānna jāyate ? tathotpādanasvabhāvasya aviśeṣāt
nanvevaṃ kāryakāle'pi kāraṇasaṃbhava iti kutaḥ kāryabhāva iti cet; atrāha--kāryotpattirvirudhyeta navai naiva kāraṇasattayā kintu tadabhāvena
tatra anvayaḥ kāraṇabhāve bhāvaḥ, vyatirekaḥ tadabhāve abhāvaḥ iti tannirākṛtya kārikārthaṃ darśayitukāma āha— yasmin ityādi
yasmin satyeva nā'sati yadbhāvaḥ tasya kāryam itarat pūrvaṃ kāraṇam ityevaṃ kṣaṇikatve bhāvānām aṅgīkriyamāṇe na saṃbhavatyeva
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadi sat kāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ janayati tarhi svotpattisamaye janayati, tadaiva tasya sattvāt
tathā tatkārye viśva kāryaṃ svotpattisamaya ityekakālīnatā sakalasantānasya iti

tataḥ tasmād anantaradoṣāt prāk svotpattisamaye tatkaraṇasāmarthye tasya vivakṣitasya kāryasya karaṇaṃ niṣpādanam tatra sāmarthyaṃ tasmin sati anutpannaṃ kāryaṃ tadabhāva eva kāraṇābhāve eva bhāvi tatkāraṇābhāva eva bhavat tasya vinaṣṭasya kāryam ityevaṃ mṛttvā saṭitvāpi aṅgīkarttavyam
ayamatrābhiprāyaḥ— yathā prāk samarthāt naśvarāt paścāt jāyamānaṃ kāryaṃ tasya iti vyapadiśyate tathā anaśvarādapi iti na tatredaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ dha rma kī rtti nā kīrttitaṃ tatkīrttimāvahati
nanvevaṃ tayoḥ aviśeṣa eva darśitaḥ iti cet; atrāha--parapakṣa ityādi
parapakṣe akṣaṇikavādipakṣe punaḥ etāvāneva adhiko viśeṣaḥ kṣaṇikapakṣād bhedakaḥ
nanvevaṃ kāryotpattirna syāt kāraṇasattayā tadvirodhāditi cet; atrāha--na ca ityādi
kiṃ tarhi kāraṇābhāvena tadutpattirvirudhyeta, anyathā nirhetukatvamiti manyate

prakṛtopasaṃhāramāha--yata evaṃ tat tasmāt etadupalabhyamānaṃ pitrādi kāraṇaṃ kāryotpattau kriyamāṇāyāṃ tannimittaṃ vā tiṣṭhatu tatkālaṃ vā avasthitiṃ karotu mā vā'bhūt pūrvameva vā nīrūpatāṃ vrajan prāk tatkaraṇasamarthaṃ paścānna karoti evaṃ kintu prāgeva karoti
tadbhāve bhāvaḥ tadabhāve'bhāvaśca pratyakṣānupalambhasādhanaśca kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ--hetubi॰ pṛ॰ 54
bhāve bhāvini tadbhāvaḥ bhāva eva ca bhāvitā
kāryakāraṇabhāvaprasādhanaṃ bhāvābhāvaprasādhanapramāṇābhyāṃ yathā idamasmin sati bhavati satsvapi tadanyeṣu samartheṣu taddhetuṣu tadabhāve na bhavatīti
asmin sati idaṃ bhavatyasyotpādādidamutpadyate ityetadeva hetulakṣaṇaṃ bhagavatoktam --pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 67, 68, 27
anvayo nāma sarvatra satyeva sādhye hetorbhāvo vyāptyā
cāsati sādhye hetorabhāvo vyatirekaḥ--hetubi॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 224
na caivākṣaṇikasya kvacit kadācit śaktirasti kramayaugapadyābhyāṃ kāryakriyāśaktivirahāt...
nanu saugatasya kṣaṇādūrdhvaṃ na tiṣṭhanti bhāvāḥ tatkimarthamidamucyate--tiṣṭhantu iti ? dṛṣṭārthaṃ
yathā avatiṣṭhamānaṃ prācyamarthaṃ tadaiva sakalaṃ karotu ityucyate tathā tadviparītamapi ucyatāmaviśeṣāt
para āha--navai naiva paścāt karoti svayamabhāvāt paścāt iti
kiṃ tarhi ? tatkāryaṃ paścād bhavati svayam ityetad atrāpyapekṣyam, ityetatkāraṇāt pratiniyatakālaṃ kriyāviśeṣaṇametat
yathāsvaṃ krameṇa svayam ityanuvartate, kāryaṃ bhavati iti
tato nirākṛtametat--nā'kramāt kramiṇo bhāvāḥ pra॰ vā॰ 1
nanu yathā naśvarāt tatkāryaṃ paścājjāyamānamapina sakalamekadaiva jāyate tathā nityādapi jāyate iti na yuktam--pratiniyatakālam ityādi iti cet; atrāha--yad yad ityādi
kāraṇaṃ kāryabhedena na bhinnaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ yathā || 11
yathā kṣaṇikaṃ pradīpādi kāraṇaṃ svabhāvanānātvamantareṇa svabhāvadeśādibhinnamanekaṃ kramabhāvi tailadaśānanadāhādi kāryaṃ karoti tathā'kṣaṇikaṃ kālabhedabhinnam kārya...
yadanantaraṃ yannotpannaṃ na tattatkāryam akṣepakāritvāt kāraṇasyetyayuktaṃ deśavyavadhāne'pi tathā prasaṅgāt
yat sajātīyaṃ vijātīyaṃ ca yadā kāryam utpitsu tasya tadā yadutpādanaṃ sattā sambandhinaḥ karaṇaṃ tadātmakam
taduktam--kramādbhavantī dhīśceyaṃ kramaṃ tasyāpi saṃśati pra॰ vā॰ 1
45 iti cet; atrāha--kāryabhedena na bhinnaṃ kāraṇam iti padaghaṭanā

dṛṣṭāntaṃ vyācaṣṭe--kṣaṇikaṃ pradīpādi kāraṇaṃ svabhāvanānātvamantareṇa svabhāvadeśādibhinnam, atra ādiśabdena cirantara bauddhāpekṣayā sāmarthyaparigrahaḥ idānīntanāpekṣayā kālaparigrahaḥ, tasya hi vallī dāhād ekasmāt kramabhāvi tasya rpākorthāde kāryaṃ jāyate anekaṃ tailadaśānanadāhādikaṃ kāryaṃ yathā karoti
dṛṣṭāntaṃ vyākhyāya dārṣṭāntike yojayati--tathā kālabhedabhinnam anekaṃ kāryaṃ karoti iti akṣaṇikaṃ svabhāvanānātvamantareṇa ityetadatrāpi anuvarttanīyam
yat tasya anantaraṃ yad vastu notpannam api tu paścāt kālāntare na tat tasya kāryam, kuta etat ? akṣepakāritvāt kāraṇasya

kutaḥ ? ityāha--deśavyavadhāne'pi na kevalaṃ kāla vyavadhāne tat tathā prasaṅgāt; tathāhi— yasya anantaradeśe yannotpannaṃ na tat tasya kāryam apekṣyakāritvāt kāraṇasya iti na yogijñānaṃ trailokyakāryamiti sarvajñābhāvaḥ, itarathā sarvārthadeśena tena bhavitavyamiti prāptam
atha deśavyavadhāne'pi jātaṃ tasya ityucyate na kālavyavadhāne; tadāha--kālasyaiva ityādinā
taduttaraṃ vā tatkāryaṃ na ca jātestadatyaye || 12
vyavahitasya kāryotpattau vyāvṛttyaviśeṣāt upayogo na viśeṣyeta, nivṛtteḥ niḥsvabhāvatvāt
bhāvasyaiva kathañcid viśeṣoṣapatteḥ citranirbhāsakṣaṇikajñānavat tato'nena pūrvasyābhāve bhavatā aniṣṭe'pi bhavitavyam abhāvasya sarvatrāviśeṣāt
tulanā--satyabhavataḥ svayameva niyamena paścādbhavataḥ tatkāryatvaṃ viruddham, kālāntare'pi kinna syāttadabhāvāviśeṣāt samanantaravat
atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--dha rmo tta rā dī nāṃ pūrvamanantaraṃ kāraṇam, uttaraṃ kāryam, viparītam akāryakāraṇam, tatra yadanantaraṃ taiḥ kāraṇamabhyupagantavyam, tat kāraṇaṃ na bhavati ityakāraṇam
kutaḥ ? aprāptaḥ kāryakālo yena tasya bhāvād aprāptakāryakālatvāt
yathā raṇḍāgarbhaṃ prati pariṇetā kālena vyavahito'kāraṇam tathā prakṛtamapi iti
dvitīyaṃ prayogamāha--tacca uttaram anantaraṃ vā kāryaṃ tasya kāryaṃ na bhavati
kuta etat ? ityatrāha--jāterutpatte ḥ tadatyaye kāraṇābhimatātyaye
atrāpi yathā vyavahitam iti nidarśanaṃ yojyam
yathā bhāvikālavyavahitaṃ vidhavāgarbhakāryaṃ vinaṣṭasya pariṇeturna bhavati tathā prakṛtamapi iti
kārikāyāḥ sugamatvād vyākhyānamakṛtvā yaduktaṃ pareṇa--aprāptakālatvāviśeṣe'pi pūrvaḥ anantarameva kāraṇaṃ na vyavahitaṃ vicitratvād bhāvaśakteḥ
nahi prāptakālamapi sarvaṃ kāraṇamiti sandigdhavipakṣavyāvṛttiko hetuḥ
vyavahitasya ciravinaṣṭasya anantaranaṣṭasya ca kāryotpattau kriyamāṇāyāṃ vyāvṛtteḥ nivṛtteḥ aviśeṣāt upayogaḥ vyāpāro na viśiṣyeta
tathā ca anantaravad vyavahitamapi kāraṇaṃ syāt vicitratvād bhāvaśakteḥ atrāpi na daṇḍadhāritam iti pra jñā ka ra gu pta syai va mataṃ na dha rmo tta rā dī nā m iti manyate
nanu yadi nivṛtteḥ niḥsvabhāvatvānna viśeṣaḥ, kasya tarhi viśeṣaḥ ? ityāha--bhāvasyaiva nā'bhāvasya kathañcit kenāpi samarthetarādiprakāreṇa viśeṣasya bhedasya upapatteḥ upayogo na viśiṣyata iti
atrāha kaścit--vyavahitamapi kiñcit kāraṇaṃ jāgrajjñānādiḥ prabodhādeḥ, tasya ca svakāle bhāvatvād viśeṣopattiḥ iti sādhyavikalo dṛṣṭānta iti tatrāha--citra ityādi
citro nirbhāso yasya tattathoktaṃ tacca tatkṣaṇikajñānaṃ ca tasya iva tadvat iti

etaduktaṃ bhavati--yat tad vyavahitasyāpi kāraṇatve jāgradvijñānaṃ dṛṣṭāntīkṛtam, tacca niraṃśaikaparamāṇuparyavasitasvabhāvam; tarhi na tat vādinaḥ prativādino vā pramāṇataḥ siddhamiti kathaṃ nidarśanaṃ puruṣavat ? atha citrapratibhāsāpi ekaiva buddhiḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
220 ityādi vacanāt citramekam; na tat saugatasya darśanamanusarati kintu jainasya akrameṇa iva krameṇāpi ātmano dṛśyetarasvabhāvenāpi citratvaprasādhanāt
kena ? uttareṇa kāryeṇa kathambhūtena ? pūrvasya kāraṇasya abhāve eva na bhāve bhavatā jāyamānena
kiṃkattathyam ? ityāha--aniṣṭe'pi na kevalam iṣṭe anantarakāle bhavitavyamiti
iti pūrvābhāvasya tatkāraṇasya sarvatra kāle aviśeṣāt
na cā'vikale kāraṇe kāryānutpādo yukta iti manyate
nanu sarvadā tadaviśeṣe'pi kāryaṃ pratiniyatakālaṃ jāyate iti cet; atrāha--anyathā ityādi
aniṣṭakālotpattyabhāvaprakāreṇa anyathā svata eva ātmanaiva niyatakālaṃ yat svātantryaṃ nirhetukatvaṃ sūcayat dustaraṃ kāryalakṣaṇam parāyattatvam ativartteta bhāvā'bhāvayoḥ anāyattatvāt
syānmatam, pūrvasyābhāvo yadyapi iṣṭakālavad aniṣṭe'pi kāle samasti tathāpi abhimatābhāvakāla eva bhavati kāryamiti; tatrāha--abhāvasya ca ityādi
anyasmād abhāvād bhidyamāno'bhāvaḥ kathañcidbhāvaḥtasya tato bhedā'yogāt ityabhiprāyaḥ
nahiyasmād ānantaryaṃ kāryotpatteḥ prāg anantaram abhāvasya bhāva ānantaryamabhāvaṃ viśeṣayati anyasmādabhāvād vyavacchinatti, tucchābhāvasya viśeṣayitumaśakteḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadā pūrvasya kathañciduttarākāreṇa gamanam abhāvaḥ, tadā'sau kenacid bandhyāsutādyabhāvacchidyetavaṃ vyavacchedyetanānyadā iti
yadi vā, kāryotpatteḥ prāg anantarakāraṇasya bhāva ānantaryaṃ tadabhāvaṃ viśeṣayati
nahi pūrvamanantara syābhāvo na sarvasya iti

yaduktaṃ sānta bhadre ṇa--nirudhyamānaṃ kāraṇaṃ niruddham iti; tadasāram; yato nirudhyamānaṃ yadi svotpattisamaye; hetuphalayoḥ samakālatā, anyadā tu tadeva nāsti iti kiṃ nirudhyamānaṃ nāma ? anyathā artha ityādi doṣaḥ
tataḥ sthitam--yathā prāk samarthe nitye kāraṇe ajātaṃ kāryaṃ paścāt svayameva niyatakālaṃ jāyamānaṃ na tasya kāryaṃ tathā kṣaṇike'pi svasattākāle samatve'nupajātaṃ punastathā jāyamānaṃ na tasya iti
nanu ca yad yadā kāryam utpitsu tattadotpādanātmakaṃ kāraṇaṃ nityaṃ yadi kramavatsahakārikāraṇamapekṣyate tadeva anityatvam, tatkṛtamupakāramātmasātkurvato gatyantarābhāvāt
sāmagrīvaśāt kāryabhede'pi yathā'kṣepakāriṇāṃ kṣaṇikānāṃ svabhāvabhedo na bhavati anādheyāpraheyātiśayatvāt tathaiva kālāntarasthāyināṃ kramotpitsukāryāviśeṣe'pi svabhāvabhedo mā bhūt
kimbhūtasya ? sthirasya nityasya ātmā svarūpaṃ na bhidyeta
