ato'yamartho jāyate— sahakāribhiḥ kṛtvā phalānāṃ vividhātmanāmutpattau na upādānopakārotpattau hetoḥ ātmā na bhidyata iti
yadi punarayaṃ nirbandhaḥ sahakāriṇa upādānasya upakāraṃ kurvanta eva prakṛtaphalāni janayanti iti

tatredaṃ cintyate--upakāramupādānasya aparamupakāramupakalpayantaḥ prakṛtamupakāraṃ janayanti, anupakalpayanto vā ? prathamapakṣe--aparopakārakaraṇe'pi tadupādānopakārakaraṇamityanavasthāyām, aparāparopakārakaraṇa eva upayuktaśaktīnāṃ sahakāriṇāṃ prakṛtakāryajanmani vyāpāraṃ na syāt

dvitīyapakṣe--upakāropādānasya upakāramakurvanta eva upakāraṃ kurvanti sahakāriṇo na kāryopādānasya tamakurvataḥ kāryamiti kiṃ kṛto vibhāgaḥ ? asyaiva samarthanārthaṃ saugataprasiddhaṃ dṛṣṭāntamāha--kṣaṇikasya ca iti
tadayamartha ukto bhavati--yathā kṣaṇikasya upādānakāraṇasya sahakāribhiḥ ātmā na bhidyeta taireva phalānāṃ vividhātmanāmutpattau tathā prakṛtasyāpi iti
na hi tasyāpi niraṃśasya svahetoḥ utpannasya arthaiḥ kiñcit kriyate bhedaprāpteḥ iti
sāmagrīvaśāt kāryabhede'pi phalanānātve'pi kṣaṇikānāṃ svabhāvasya svarūpasya bhedo yathā na bhavati
kathambhūtānāṃ teṣām ? ityāha— akṣepakāriṇām iti avilambyakāriṇām ityarthaḥ
niraṃśatvena teṣu atiśayasya kena api ādhāna prahāṇābhāvāditi manyate
tathaiva tenaiva prakāreṇa kālāntarasthāyināṃ nityānāṃ kramotpitsu kāryaviśeṣe'pi svabhāvabhedo mā bhūt sāmagrīvaśād ityetadatrāpi sambandhanīyam
tadvaśāditīde bhinnaṃ kāryameva jāyate na teṣām atiśayādhānaprahāṇam iti manyate
kutastarhi krameṇa kāryamiti cet ? atrāha--kāryakāla ityādi
tatsahakāriṇaḥ tanniṣpattau upādānaṃ kimarthaṃ gṛhyate tatrā'samarthatvāt ? anyathā prāgapi tataḥ kāryaṃ sahakāriṇaḥ samarthāḥ janayanti nopādānam iti kiṃ kṛto vibhāgaḥ ?
teṣāmeva vā tadanvayavyatirekānuvidhānāt na nityavyāpinaḥ sannidhāne'pi atiprasaṅgāt iti cet; atrāha--nityaiśca ityādi

yathākāryakālaṃ svabhāvataḥ kartari svakāraṇāttathotpanneṣu tatkaraṇasamartheṣu punarāgantukeṣu parasparaupakāriṣu tatkaraṇasamarthe'nyatamasmin sati na vai apare nivarteran pratyekaṃ tatkaraṇasvabhāvatvāt kṣaṇikavat
kāryakāraṇayoḥ sahāvasthāne dadhikṣīrādiṣu sahopalambhena abhedādiprasaṅgaḥ iti cet; saṃvido vibhrametarasvabhāvayoḥ sahabhāve'pi sahopalambhāderabhāvāt
caśabdo bhinnaprakramaḥ ivārthaḥ akālikaiḥ ityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ
kiṃbhūtaiḥ ? ityāha— anyo'nyasahakāribhiḥ ekakārye parasparasahāyaiḥ ityarthaḥ
yadi vā, kvacit kārye ekasya upādānatve anyeṣāṃ tatsāmagrīpatitānāṃ sahakāritvam, teṣām upādānatve tasya sahakāritvamityanyo'nyasahakāriṇaḥ taiḥ iti
teṣu artheṣu ekatra ekasmin upādāne sahakāriṇi vā kāraṇe samarthe vyāpriyamāṇe vā anye sahakāriṇaḥ upādānapadārthā hetavo na nivartteran kintu sarve'pi tān kurvanti tatkaraṇaikasvabhāvatvāt
yathā akālikaiḥ kṣaṇikaiḥ anyo'nyasahakāribhiḥ janyeṣvarthe ṣu ekatra anye na nivartteran hetavaḥ tathā prakṛte'pi iti
kāryakālā'natikrameṇa yathākāryakālam kattari kasmiṃścit janake sati
pūrvaṃ samarthe tasmin satyapi punaḥ paścāt āgantukeṣu
tasmin sati kiṃ jātam ? ityāha--tat ityādi
tatkaraṇasamarthe anyatamasmin upādānakāraṇe sahakāriṇi vā sati navai naiva apare nivartteran
yathā kṣaṇike tatkaraṇasamarthe anyatamasmin apare na nivartteran tathā nitye'pi iti

yatpunaratroktaṃ pareṇa--kṣaṇikasya svahetoḥ sa svabhāvaḥ yaḥ sahakārikāraṇāpekṣaḥ kāryajanakaḥ, sa na nityasya, tadabhāvāt, ākasmikatve aniyamaprasaṅgaḥ iti; tadasāram; kāryāṇāṃ nityānāṃ tadanivāraṇāt
evamarthaḥ nokṛṃ tathaiva kālāntarasthāyinām ityādi, anyathā kūṭasthānām ityādi brūyāt
kūṭasthapakṣe'pi ayaṃ na doṣaḥ nityatvāt tatsvabhāvasya, anityo hi svabhāvaḥ svayamutpadyamāno'niyataḥ syāt iti yuktam

tat tasmād evam uktaprakāreṇa kṣaṇiketaraikāntau kṣaṇikā'kṣaṇikaikāntau nānyo'nyaṃ parasparam atiśayāte bhedaṃ labhete ? kṣaṇikavad akṣaṇike'pi arthakriyāsaṃbhavena vyāpakānupalabdhiḥ, sattvena vyāptisiddhiḥ
athavā, akṣaṇikavat kṣaṇike'pi tadasambandhe na tasya tadvyāptisiddhiḥ iti manyate
yatra upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaṃ yat nopalabhyate tatra tannāsti yathā pradeśaviśeṣe ghaṭaḥ, nopalabhyate ca tathāvidhaṃ kāraṇaṃ kārye iti svabhāvānupalabdhiḥ
tatra tadupalambhe vā sarvasya sarvatropalambha iti prāptam
na caivam, tataḥ pradeśaviśeṣe ghaṭavat kāraṇe kāryasya tatra ca kāraṇasya anupalabdhiḥ dṛśyasya abhāva iti kṣaṇikatāsiddheḥ na yuktam--tadevam ityādi, ityabhiprāyavato matamāśaṅkate kārya ityādi
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā sataḥ kāraṇasya kārye avasthānaṃ tathā kāryasya kāraṇe iti
tataḥ kiṃ syāt ? ityāha--dadhikṣīrādiṣu sahopalambhena kāryakāraṇayoḥ iti sambandhaḥ, abhedādiprasaṅgaḥ

asyāyamarthaḥ--yadi kāryaṃ dadhyādi pūrvaṃ kāraṇena kṣīrādinā, kāraṇaṃ kṣīrādi kāryeṇa dadhyādinā punaḥ sahopalabhyate tadā asya idaṃ kāraṇam, idamasya kāryam iti yo bhedaḥ tasya abhāvo abhedaḥ, yadi vā, yadā jaina-sāṃkhyayoḥ kāraṇe kāryaṃ tatra kāraṇaṃ tādātmyena varttate tadā kāryakāraṇayoḥ sahāvasthāne ekatvena avasthāne sati kadācit kṣīrādiṣu
kena kim ? ityāha--sahopalambhena ekatvopalambhena abhedaḥ kāryameva kāraṇameva vā syāt, ādiśabdena varttamānatvādivyapadeśādiparigrahaḥ, tasya prasaṅgaḥ
saṃvidaḥ taimirādijñānasya yo vibhramasvabhāvo dvicandrādyapekṣayā timirāśubhramaṇa nyāyabi॰ 1
6 ityādi vacanāt yaśca itarasvabhāvaḥ svarūpāpekṣayā'vibhramasvabhāvaḥ sarvacittacaittānām nyāyabi॰ 1
athavā, saṃvido nikhilakalpanājñānasya yo vibhramaḥ svabhāvo abhilāpasaṃsarga nyāyabi॰ 1
5 ityādivacanāt yaśca itarasvabhāvaḥ sa ca kathitaḥ, tayoḥ sahabhāve'pi na kevalam asahabhāve
sahopalambhaḥ sahadarśanam ādiryasya abhedādeḥ tasya abhāvāt
na vai dvicandrādijñānasya pratibhāsasamaye eva tatsvabhāvopalambho'sti vipratipattyabhāvena tataḥ kasyacit kadācidapi kvacit pravṛttāttyabhāvaprasaṅgāt
etat sautrāntikaṃ prati pūrvoktasya vyabhicārapradarśanārthaṃ vyākhyānam
tayoḥ sahabhāve'pi kathañcidekatvam, bhāve'pi sarvathaikatvopalambhāderabhāvādacodyametat iti vyākhyeyam

sattvamarthakriyayā vyāptam, sā ca kramayaugapadyābhyām, te ca nityānnivartamāne svavyāpyāmarthakriyāmādāya nivartete, sā ca svavyāpyaṃ sattvam iti vyāpakānupalabdhibalāt sattvasya kṣaṇikatvena vyāptiḥ sādhyate
yadā akṣaṇike'pi arthakriyā siddhā tadā na sattvakṣaṇikatvayoḥ vyāptiḥ siddheti bhāvaḥ
sāmprataṃ yogācaraṃ prati vyākhyānaṃ kriyate--saṃvido yo vibhramasvabhāvo grāhyagrāhakasaṃvedanatrayasvabhāvaḥ yaśca itarasvabhāvo'dvayasaṃvitsvabhāvaḥ
na hi śukle śaṅkhe pītatopalambhe śuklasvabhāvopalambhaḥ
tato na yuktam--avibhāgo'pi buddhyātmā pra॰ vā॰ 2
grāhyagrāhakavaidhuryyāt svayaṃ saiva prakāśate || pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 327 iti ca
vadātmanaḥ puruṣavat svapne'pyadarśanāt tato bhrāntimātre vyavatiṣṭheta
itarasvabhāvādarśane'pi gateyaṃ vibhramavārtā iti nirabhidheyametat--avedyavedakākārā pra॰ vā॰ 2

pra jñā ka raḥ pūrvamavibhāgabuddhyātmano darśanaṃ punaḥ tatpṛṣṭhabhāvinā vikalpena sa grāhyagrāhakasamvittibhedavāniva lakṣyate iti vacanaṃ nahi nirvikalpakena kiñcit lakṣyate nāma, iti saḥ dha rma kī rtteḥ abhiprāyamajñāttvaiva manyate, tathā tadabhiprāyā'bhāvāt, anyathā mantrādyupaplutākṣāṇām pra॰ vā॰ 2
nahi nāma savibhrame akṣavibhramo nidarśanam, īśvarādivibhramasya tajjātīyasya bhāvāt
na cāsya dvicandrādibhrāntirapi indriyajā iti sidhyati
śakyaṃ hi vaktum--prathamam ekendudarśanam, punastasya vikalpena dvitvādhyavasāya iti
tathā ca tasyā indriyajatvaṃ sādhayato dha rma kī rtteḥ akīrtiḥ āyātā
etena naiyāyikādirapi jainaṃ prati kāryakāraṇayoḥ ityādi vadan nivārito draṣṭavyaḥ

tathāhi--saṃvidaḥ saṃśayaviparyayajñānasya yaḥ sthāṇurvā puruṣo vā'yam iti, puruṣe sthāṇau vā sthāṇuriti puruṣaḥ iti vā vibhramasvabhāvaḥ, yaśca ayam iti dharmimātre itarasvabhāvo'vibhramasvabhāvaḥ tayoḥ
bhavatu aviruddhamekaṃ jñānamiti cet; atrāha--vijñapteḥ ityādi
tad anantaroktam anyatrāpi arthe'pi samānaṃ kalpayan kena vāryate
na hi vinaśvaraṃ tadbhāve hetumapekṣate svahetoreva vinaśvarāṇāṃ bhāvāt
yathaiva hi bhāvasya vināśahetuḥ svabhāvabhūtasya vināśaṃ na karoti kṛtasya karaṇābhāvāt
nāpi parabhūtaṃ karoti, tasya karaṇe'pi prāgiva tadavasthasya tathopalambhādiprasaṅgāt
sannapi tādātmānamakhaṇḍayan tadavasthameva sthagayati yato na dṛśyeta
tadayaṃ vināśahetuḥ tadatatkriyāvikalaḥ kathamapekṣyaḥ yataḥ kādācitko vināśaḥ syāt ?
prāgasata ātmalābhaḥ utpādaḥ, sataḥ punarabhāvo bhaṅgaḥ pūrvasya dvitīyādikṣaṇe, avasthānaṃ sthitiḥ iti eteṣāṃ svabhāvāt svarūpeṇa hetubhūtena anubandhitā avinābhāvitā
teṣām utpādasthitibhaṅgānāṃ ye hetavaḥ teṣām asāmarthyāt, utpādasthitibhaṅgeṣu iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
ataḥ asmāt nyāyāt tattvaṃ jīvādisvarūpaṃ trayātmakam utpādasthitibhaṅgātmakam
yathaiva yenaiva prakāreṇa, hiḥ iti vitarke bhāvasya ghaṭādervināśahetuḥ mudgarādiḥ svabhāvabhūva syātma bhūtaṃ bhāvasya ityetadatrāpi sambandhanīyam, vināśam abhāvaṃ na karoti
kṛtasya svakāraṇāt niṣpannasya bhāvasya karaṇābhāvād bhāvasya svabhāvabhūtavināśakaraṇābhāva eva kṛtaḥ syāt, tasya ca svahetoḥ utpatterna karaṇamiti manyate
parabhūtam arthāntarabhūtaṃ nāpi karoti tasya parabhūtasya vināśasya karaṇe'pi na karaṇe prāgiva tadavasthasya pūrvāvasthā'vicalitasya bhāvasya tathā pūrvavad upalambhādiprasaṅgāt
sambandhasya pāratantryasya asiddheḥ kāraṇād asya ghaṭādervināśa ityevaṃ vyapadeśo'pi, abhidhānamapi na kevalam anantara eva doṣa iti apiśabdaḥ, mā bhūt
svabhāvata eva bhāvā naśvarāḥ, naiṣāṃ svahetubhyo niṣpannānāmanyato vināśotpattiḥ tasyāsāmarthyāt
na hi vināśaheturbhāvasya svabhāvameva karoti tasya svahetubhyo nirvṛtteḥ
nāpi vināśahetunā abhāvaḥ kriyate abhāvasya vidhinānyatayopagame vyatirekāvyatirekavikalpanātikramāt
bhāvapratiṣedhakaraṇe na tasya kiṃcit bhavati na bhavatyeva kevalamiti
evaṃ ca kartā na bhavatītyakartturahetutvamiti na vināśahetuḥ kaścit
yadi svabhāvato naśvaraḥ na kiñcinnāśakāraṇaiḥ, tatsvabhāvatayaiva svayaṃ nāśāt
yo hi yatsvabhāvaḥ sa svahetorevotpadyamānastādṛśo bhavati na punastadbhāve hetvantaramapekṣate
nanu kimucyate sambandhāsiddhiḥ iti, yāvatā viśeṣaṇībhāvo bhāvābhāvayoḥ sambandhaḥ siddha iti cet; na; atra anavasthiteḥ pratipādanāt
mābhūt tayoḥ sambandho vyapadeśo vā tathāpi na doṣaḥ, sambandharahitasya abhyupagamāt ityeke; tadapi na sundaram; sākṣāt paramparayā vā tasya indriyeṇa asambandho na; agrahaṇaprasaṅgāt
syānmatam--abhāvena tasya sthaganāt tathopalambhādyabhāvādayuktasya ktaṃtasya karaṇe'pi ityādi
naca naiva vyatirikto ghaṭādeḥ arthāntarabhūto vināśo nāma
asyāyamarthaḥ--sannapi tadātmānaṃ tasya dṛśyasya ghaṭādeḥ ātmānaṃ svabhāvam akhaṇḍayan avināśayan tadavasthameva tadātmānaṃ sthagayati, na ca yataḥ sthaganāt na dṛśyeta
satā hi svaviṣayajñānajananayogyena avaśyaṃ tatkarttavyamiti manyate
yata evaṃ tat tasmād ayaṃ loke pratīyamāno vināśahetuḥ mudgarādiḥ
tadatatkriyāvikalo ghaṭasvabhāvāsvabhāvavināśakaraṇavikalaḥ kathaṃ naiva apekṣyo vināśakārye ityupacārayato apeṇāt kādācitko bhāvasya vināśaḥ syāt
yata iti vā ākṣepe, naiva syāt, nityaḥ syāt ityarthaḥ
tataḥ svabhāvanaśvaro'rthaḥ siddhaḥ, tathaiva bhāvasya utpādaheturakiñcitkaraḥ kṛtasya utpādane prayojanābhāvāt

prāgabhāvaṃ bhāvīkurvannutpādahetuścet; prāgbhāvamabhāvīkurvan vināśahetuḥ kinnānumanyate ? yadi punarbhāvasya pradhvaṃsābhāvo'pi svata eva abhāvāntaravat svahetoreva abhāvatvāt, tathaiva bhāvasya sthitirapi

yathā ca svayamanutpitsoḥ utpādahetuḥ sthāsnoḥ sthitiheturiti utpādasthitiheturiti utpādasthitibhaṅgān pratyanapekṣatvaṃ bhāvasya siddhaṃ tatsvabhāvāpekṣaṇāt, kāṃścid dravyakṣetrakālasvabhāvaviśeṣān parihṛtya anyatra bhavan utpādo vināśo vā tadapekṣastaddhetuśca yujyeta pratīteravirodhāt

vināśaḥ yadyabhāvaḥ prasajyapratiṣedharūpā bhāvanivṛttiḥ yadi tarhi abhāvaṃ mudgarādiḥ karoti ityevaṃ bhāvaṃ na karoti iti hetoḥ kriyāpratiṣedhāt ghaṭādeḥ karaṇanirākaraṇāt akiñcitkaratvaṃ vināśahetoḥ, kriyāpratiṣedharūpatvāt prasajyapratiṣedhasya iti tat tasmāt kena apekṣyeta na kenacit kvacit kārye ityarthaḥ
atha kriyāniṣedho'yaṃ bhāvaṃ naiva karoti hi
yata evaṃ tataḥ svabhāvato naśvaro'rthaḥ siddhaḥ
tathā ca prayogaḥ--yo yaṃ prati anyānapekṣaḥ sa tatsvabhāvaniyataḥ yathā antyā kāraṇasāmagrī svakāryotpādanaṃ prati anapekṣā tatsvabhāvaniyatā, vināśaṃ prati anyānapekṣaśca bhāvaḥ iti
evaṃ dṛṣṭāntaṃ vyākhyāya dārṣṭāntikaṃ vivṛṇvannāha--tathaiva ityādi
tathaiva tenaiva prakāreṇa bhāvasya ghaṭādeḥ utpādahetuḥ akiñcitkaraḥ
kuta etaditi cet ? atrāha--kṛtasya utpādana ityādi
idamatra tātparyam— yathā vināśo'bhāva iti bhāvavato bhedavicāramarhati tathā utpādo'pi tadaviśeṣāditi
tathāhi— yadi sata eva svabhāvabhūta utpādaḥ kriyate; tarhi sa eva kriyate iti kṛtasya utpādane prayojanābhāvāt hetusvabhāvavaditi
na khalu sato ghaṭasya arthāntarabhūto'pi saḥ kriyamāṇaḥ kañcana arthaṃ puṣṇāti
syānmatam--asya vikalpadvayasya nirālambanatvāt nātaḥ prakṛtasiddhiriti cet; atrāha— tata eva ityādi
tata eva anantaravikalpabhedādeva nānyato'bhāvasyāpi na kevalamutpādasya svabhāvataḥ siddhatvād utpādahetuḥ akiñcitkaraḥ iti sambandhaḥ
asya vikalpadvayasya nirālambanatve saugatasya iṣṭā'siddhiriti manyate
atha ko'yaṃ prāgabhāvo nāma ? utpatteḥ pūrvamabhāva iti cet; sa mṛtpiṇḍādanyaḥ, sa eva vā syāt ? prathamapakṣe naiyāyikādeḥ tanmataṃ na saugatasyeti tanmatānabhijñānāt
na ca tucchamabhāvaṃ kaścid bhāvīkaroti bandhyāsutāderapi tatkaraṇaprasaṅgāt, bhāvopādānakalpanāvaiphalyaprasaṅgācca
dvitīye'pi pakṣe mṛtpiṇḍa eva prāgabhāvaḥ, taṃ bhāvīkurvan ityuktam, tasya pūrvameva sataḥ tadayogāt
atha taṃ ghaṭābhāvātmakaṃ bhāvīkurvan ityayamartho vivakṣitaḥ, so'pi na yuktaḥ, tato ghaṭasya bhinnasya bhāvāt vyapadeśādibhedāt

tatrāpi cintyate--kimidaṃ prāgbhāvamiti ? yadi vināśāt pūrvakālabhāvī ghaṭaḥ prāgabhāvaḥ tamiti; tarhi bauddhasya na kaścit tuccho vināśa iti kasya tataḥ prāg anyadā vā bhāvaḥ ? na khalu bandhyāsutāt prāk kiñcid bhavati
tata eva tam abhāvīkurvan ityayuktam; abhāvasya tato vyatirekāvyatirekayoryathoktadoṣāt
atha tam abhāvīkurvan kapālīkurvan ityucyate; tadasāram; tasyaiva kapālabhāvayogāt, ghaṭanāśe kapālabhāvāyogāt, tato yatkiñcidetaditi

atra pratividhīyate--yathaiva hi saugatasya prāgabhāvaḥ pradhvaṃsābhāvaśca tuccho nāsti tathaiva karaṇāt, ekāntena bhinnaṃ kāryamapi nāsti kintu upādānameva upādeyo bhavati iti pratipāditam vijñapteḥ siddhivi॰ 3

tataḥ prāgabhāvaṃ ghaṭaviviktamṛtpiṇḍākāraṃ dravyaṃ bhāvīkurvan ghaṭīkurvan ghaṭaparyāyopetaṃ janayan utpādahetuḥ upādānam, sahakārikāraṇakāraṇakalāpa iti cet; prāgbhāvaṃ ghaṭasattvam abhāvīkurvan svaparyāyakapālaviviktaṃ kurvan vināśahetuḥ kinnānumanyate ? ayamevācāryasya abhiprāyaḥ
yadi punaḥ ityādināpūrvapakṣān yadi punaḥ ityādinā tu aparapakṣaṃ darśayati
yadi iti parābhiprāyasūcane, punaḥ iti vitarke, bhāvasya ghaṭādeḥ pradhvaṃsābhāvo'pi na kevalaṃ prāgabhāvaḥ svata eva svasmādeva naśvarasvabhāvāt nānyato mudgarādeḥ
atra nidarśanamāha--abhāvāntaravat itaretarātyantābhāvavat, so'pi svabhāvaḥ, kutaḥ ? ityāha--svahetoreva
pradhvaṃsaḥ kapālātmanā bhāvaḥ svata eva abhāvatvāt itaretarābhāvavat; atra dūṣaṇamāha--tathaiva ityādi
tathaiva tenaiva prakāreṇa bhāvasya sthitiḥ parāparakṣaṇeṣu avasthānamapi na kevalaṃ pradhvaṃsa eva svata eva syāt iti
śakyaṃ hi vaktuṃ bhāvasya sthitiḥ svata eva bhāvadharmatvāt pradhvaṃsavat
na cātra dharmyasiddhiḥ; pūrvasya uttarakṣaṇe vivekavad avivekatvāt syāpi prasiddheḥ, tathā coktaṃ nyā ya vi ni śca ye--
tathaiva sthitiṃ pratyanapekṣaṃ sthāsnu taddhetorakiñcitkaratvāt, tadvyatiriktāvyatiriktākaraṇādityādi sarvaṃ samānam
abhedajñānataḥ siddhā niraṃśe na kenacit || nyāyavi॰ ślo॰ 114
ata eva na svarūpāsiddho hetuḥ pratyakṣādibādhito vā pakṣaḥ
anena pūrvasya hetorviruddhatvamitthaṃ kathayati--tatra yaduktaṃ prāgbhāvam ityādi; tadayuktam; yato naśvaraṃ cet tamabhāvīkurvan vināśahetuḥ kiṃ tena ? svayameva nāśāt
nahi anaśvaraṃ taṃ kaścid abhāvīkarttuṃ samartha iti cet; atrāha--yathā ca ityādi
yathā iti vacanād anuktamapi tathā iti gamyate
tathā svayam ātmano'pi anutpitsośca punaḥ utpādahetuḥ akiñcitkaraḥ iti sambandhaḥ
prathamasya svayam utpatteranyasya śaśaviṣāṇavat kāraṇasannidhāne'pi anutpatteriti bhāvaḥ
anenaiva taddarśayati--utpādasthitibhaṅgān prati anapekṣatvaṃ bhāvasya siddhaṃ tatsvabhāvāpekṣaṇāt iti tadvināśe'pi
yadi punaḥ taṃ prati nāpekṣaṃ tatsvabhāvasya sarvadā sannidhānāt ityucyate tathā pratīteḥ; taditaratra samānamiti
samatvāt parapakṣe'pi yadvā syāt kalpitaḥ svayam
nanu ca utpādasya ahetukatve nityaṃ sattvamasattvaṃ vā
apekṣāto hi bhāvānāṃ kādācitkatvasaṃbhavāt || pra॰ vā॰ 3 | 34
kāṃścid vivakṣitān dravyakṣetrakālasvabhāvaviśeṣān viśeṣaśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ dravyādibhiḥ sambandhanīyam, parihṛtya
kā ? anyatra abhimatakālādau bhavan jāyamānaḥ vāśabdo bhinna prakrama ivārthaḥ utpāda ityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ
tata utpāda iva vināśaḥ tadapekṣo anyadravyāpekṣaḥ taddhetuḥ dravyādihetuko yujyeta
vināśavad utpādo'pi svata eva iti svabhāvavādinaṃ prati kāṃścid ityādeḥ upanyāsāt
evaṃ satyapi dṛṣṭānte vyāptigrahaṇābhāvāt kṣaṇakṣayādau sarvahetūnāṃ gamakatvaṃ pratipādya saṃprati dṛṣṭāntābhāvāttatpratipādayannāha--jīvaccharīra ityādi
yadi vā, yaduktam a rca ṭe na--sattvādeḥ anvayābhāve'pi vyāpakānupalabdheḥ vipakṣavyatirekād gamakatvam iti; tatra kṛtaṃ niṣedha upasaṃharannāha--jīvaccharīra ityādi
tadanayā bādhakapramāṇapravṛttyā sādhyadharmasya vastunaḥ sādhanadharmasvabhāvatā sidhyati
pakṣavipakṣābhyāṃ sarvasya saṃgrahāt yathā jīvaccharīre prāṇādirananvayaḥ tathā kṣaṇikatve'pi sattvakṛtakatvādiriti
na hi kṣaṇikatvetarābhyāṃ tṛtīyā rāśirasti yatra heturvartate śabde'pi tathā'niścayāt
aparāparatālvādicakṣurāditailādivyāpārasāphalyācchabdādīnāmaparāparasvabhāvasiddheḥ kṣaṇikatvaviniścayaḥ, tata eva anityatāmātraṃ sādhyaṃ kvacit siddham, tatraiva tadvyāpārasya sāphalyāt
na hi sātmakanirātmakābhyāmanyo rāśirasti yatrāyaṃ prāṇādirvarteta
jīvaccharīre sātmakatve sādhye prāṇādiḥ hetuḥ yathā yena prakāreṇa ahetuḥ
tathā sarvaḥ śuddhāśuddhasvabhāvaḥ sattvādiḥ niranvayādahetuḥ kṣaṇike kvacit kasmiṃścit śabdādau sādhye kṣaṇikatve vā kvacit sādhye
athavā, jīvaccharīre sātmakatve sādhye prāṇādiḥ hetuḥ niranvayād anvayābhāvaṃ prāpya yo'sau uktaḥ sa yathā yena vyatirekābhāvaprakāreṇa sattvādirahetuḥ

jīvaccharīraṃ sarvaṃ pakṣaḥ, ghaṭādiḥ vipakṣaḥ, tābhyāṃ sarvasya cetanetarajātasya saṃgrahāt yathā jīvaccharīraprāṇādiḥ ananvayaḥ sādharmyadṛṣṭāntarahitaḥ tathā kṣaṇikatve sādhye, apiśabdo bhinnaprakramaḥ sattvakṛtakatvādiḥ ityasya anantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ
hi yasmāt na vyāptisādhane sattvādeḥ kṣaṇiketaratvābhyām avinābhāvasiddhau tṛtīyā rāśirasti sapakṣābhidhānā pratiratra tadrāsau hetuḥ sattvādiḥ varteta
śabdādiḥ tṛtīyā rāśirasti iti cet; atrāha--śabda ityādi
apiśabdāt na kevalaṃ vivādagocare vastuni iti tathā kṣaṇikatvaprakāreṇa aniścayāt sattvādeḥ iti
na ca tathā'niścitasattvaṃ vastu nidarśanam, itarathā sādhyamapi syādaviśeṣāt
yadā punaḥ śabda eva kṣaṇikaḥ sādhyaḥ tadā śabdasya buddhyādibhiḥ saha upādānaṃ tena teṣāṃ samānatāpratipādanārtham
atrāparaḥ prāha--aparāparatālvādi-cakṣurādi-tailādivyāpārasāphalyāt śabdādīnām aparāparasvabhāvasiddhiḥ kṣaṇikatvaviniścayaḥ; tadasāramiti darśayannāha--tata eva ityādi
yata eva aparaḥ tadvyāpāraḥ aparāparaśabdādisvabhāvamantareṇa anupapanno vaiphalyāt, tata eva anityatāmātraṃ pariṇāminityatvaṃ sādhyaṃ kvacit saugatasya tatraiva tadvyāpārasya uktavidhinā sāphalyāt
etaduktaṃ bhavati--tato nyāyāt śabdādau pariṇāmā'nityatvaṃ siddhaṃ tannidarśanamucyate nānyatra siddhasādhanāt, tathā ca dṛṣṭāntābhāvāttadasādhyamuktam
etaccoktamiti kimaneneti cet; na; anyathā abhiprāyāt

yaduktaṃ pra jñā ka re ṇa--kṣaṇikatve sādhye na dṛṣṭāntābhāvo nīlādeḥ sarvasya, tatra yadyavabhāsate tattathaiva paramārthasad vyavahārāvatāri yathā nīlaṃ nīlatayā'vabhāsanaṃ tathaiva tadavatāri, sarvamavabhāsate ca kṣaṇikatayā
iti; tatra pakṣasya pratyakṣabādhanaṃ hetośca asiddhatvamanena kathyate
athavā, kṣaṇikatvāt nīlāderavyatireke tadvat tasyāpi svabhāvaviprakarṣa iti dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyasādhanobhayavaikalyam
tatra tadanabhyupagame kva hetoḥ upasaṃhāra iti pradarśyate

syānmatam--saugatasya dānādicetāṃsyeva puṇyapāpavyapadeśabhāñji, teṣāṃ ca svasaṃvedanādhyakṣaviṣayatvāt na svabhāvaviprakarṣa iti sādhanavikalatā dṛṣṭāntasyeti; tadaśikṣitābhidhānam; yataḥ tataḥ kālāntare phalā'siddheḥ, tadanyābhyupagamasya avaśyaṃbhāvāt
atha matam--svabhāvaviprakarṣe'pi puṇyapāpayoḥ sarvairapi vādibhiḥ sādhanāt, sādhyavikalatā dṛṣṭāntasyeti; tadanupapannam; prakramā'parijñānāt
sāmprataṃ hetorviruddhatvāt na tat sādhyam; ityāha--aniṣṭasiddheḥ
yad yadbhāvaṃ prati anyānyapekṣaṃ tattadbhāvaniyataṃ yathā antyā kāraṇasāmagrī svakāryajananaṃ prati iti parasya coditacodyametat
tathā cet; bhāvaḥ kālāntarasthānotpādaṃ pratyanapekṣaṇāt tadbhāvaniyataḥ sidhyet nānyathā
sato'rthasya punaḥ uttarakālaṃ sthitau kimapekṣaṇīyaṃ syāt yataḥ kādācitkī sthitiḥ syāt, tathā punarutpitsorutpattau na kiñcidapekṣaṇīyamiti samānam
yadi punaḥ bhāvaḥ sthāsnurutpitsurvā na bhavet na kadācidapi tiṣṭhedutpadyeta vā khapuṣpavat

aniṣṭasya pariṇāmā'nityatvasya siddheḥ tatraiva sarvahetūnāṃ darśanānna tatsādhyamiti vaiphalyācca sādhanasya iti śeṣaḥ, yadarthaṃ tatprayuktaṃ tasya asādhanāt aniṣṭasiddhiṃ samarthayate pārārthyam ityādinā
cakṣurādīnāṃ saṃbandhi saṃhatatvaṃ kartṛ prasādhayet yathā yena tatraiva darśanaprakāreṇa
kimbhūtam ? aniṣṭam teṣāmeva sāṃkhyena saṃhataṃ tat sādhayitum iṣṭaṃ saṃhataṃ prasādhayet
evaṃ paraprasiddhaṃ nidarśanaṃ pratipādya dārṣṭāntikaṃ pratipādayati tathā sattvaṃ śuddhetararūpam aniṣṭaṃ prasādhayet iti sambandhaḥ
vipakṣa eva pariṇāma eva nirṇayāt kṛtakatvasya iti
nanu yadyapi kṛtakatvasya tatraiva nirṇayaḥ tathāpi na tena tadvyāptiḥ anumānena tadviparītavyāptiprasādhanāditi paraḥ

nanu pūrvam utpādasthitibhaṅgānām ityādinā sarvametaduktam, iti kimarthaṃ punarapi ucyate iti cet ? satyamuktam, kintu pūrvaṃ vināśe ayamiva svatantro hetuḥ, adhunā anena kṛtakatvādeḥ nāśitvena avinābhāvaḥ sādhyata iti vibhāgaḥ
yadvā vipakṣa eva nirṇayāt ityasya hetobhaktenaiva paragrathanāsiddha tāmudbhānaiva tāṃ pariharati parasya coditacodyametat iti nipānārtha
yadvastu yasya bhāvo yadbhāvaḥ taṃ prati anapekṣaṃ tadvastu tadbhāvaniyataṃ dvitīyena tacchabdena yaduktaṃ tasya parāmarśaḥ
antyā cāsau kāraṇasāmagrī ca iti tatsāmagrī svakāryajananaṃ prati anapekṣā satī tadbhāvaniyataiva svakāryajanana bhāvaniyataiva
bhāva ityetadupalakṣaṇaṃ tena kṛtaka ityetadapi gṛhyate
kālāntarasthāna ca utpādaśca tau prati anapekṣaṇāt tadbhāvaniyataḥ kālāntarasthānotpādabhāvaniyataḥ sidhyet
asyā'nabhyupagame dūṣaṇamāha--nānyathā ato hetorvinaśvarābhāvaḥ sidhyet vyabhicāritvāt hetoriti manyate
etadanena darśayati--yathā kṣaṇikatve sattvādirviruddhaḥ vipakṣa eva niścayāt, tathā anyena tasya avinābhāvasādhako'pyanapekṣaṇāditi hetuḥ tatraiva viniścayāviśeṣāditi
syānmatam--kālāntarasthānotpādau prati anapekṣaṇāt ityasiddham; tadbhāvaniyatatve tau prati sāpekṣatvād bhāvasya iti
sato vidyamānasya arthakriyākāriṇo bhāvasya punaḥ iti vitarke uttarakālam utpatteḥ sthitau kimapekṣaṇīyaṃ syāt na kiñcidityarthaḥ

sato'rthasya svabhāvabhūtāyā anyasyā vā kenacit karaṇe vināśe ca doṣāt, evamarthaṃ ca sato'rthasya ityuktam, yataḥ apekṣaṇīyāt kādācitkī sthitiḥ syāt tathā tenaiva prakāreṇa punaḥ utpitsorbhāvasya utpattau na kiñcidapekṣaṇīyam yato'pekṣaṇīyāt kādācittvo tpattiḥ syāditi
nanvasya apekṣaṇīyasyābhāve'pi sthāsnu-utpitsu-svabhāvāpekṣaṇāt, asya ca sarvadā'sannidhānādasiddho hetuḥ iti cet; atrāha--yadi punaḥ ityādi
bhāvo jīvādiḥ sthāsnuḥ utpitsu vati bhavet na kadācidapi tiṣṭhed utpadyeta vā khapuṣpavat iti
tiṣṭhati utpadyate ca tataḥ tatsvabhāva iti
nanu tadbhāvaṃ prati anapekṣatvaṃ naśvaratvameva sādhayati pratyakṣādibādhā'bhāvāt na sthityutpattisvabhāvaṃ viparyayāditi cet; atrāha--nahi ityādi
hiḥ yasmāt tadbhāvaṃ prati anapekṣatvaṃ naśvaratvameva nānyat sādhayati iti na samajjasam upapannam
āpādyasādhye'pi aviśeṣād viśeṣābhāvāt; tatrāpi pratyakṣādibādhā'bhāvāditi manyate
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt ime pratyakṣataḥ pratīyamānā arthā jīvādayaḥ svarasata eva sva bhāvata eva uttarībhavantaḥ pūrvākāraparityāgā'jahadvṛttottarākāraṃ gacchantaḥ ātmasātkurvanti iti yuktam
katham ? ityāha--yathāyogamiti utpādavināśasahakārikāraṇasaṃbandho yogaḥ tasya anatikrameṇa
paraspareṇa sahakāriṇā upādānasya anena sahakāriṇa upakāro yasmin yena iti vā vigrahaḥ
tadanena utpādaṃ pratīvapināsaṃ pratyapi bhāvasya kṛtakasya vā sāpekṣatvād bhāvasya vinābhāvasāvināsāvinābhāva sādhane tadbhāvaṃ pratyanapekṣatvamasiddhamityuktam bhavati
nanu yaduktam--tahiye arthāḥ svarasata eva uttarībhavantaḥ iti; tadayuktam; kasyacit pūrvasya kutaścid vināśe paraḥ anya eva jāyate iti cet; atrāha--nanu ityādi
nanu naiva niranvayanivṛttau atyantamabhāve kasya kāraṇasya kāraṇākāraṇāhitā kāryotpattiḥ aniyamaprasaṅgāditi manyate
pūrvākāraparityāgaḥ uttarākārasvīkāraśca parasparam ajahadvṛttaḥ--dhrauvyatvaṃ svīkurvanneva saṃjāyate iti bhāvaḥ
vināśaṃ pratyanyānapekṣaṇāditi hetuḥ asiddhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

yadi sarvaṃ sat utpādasthityātmakaṃ sarvadā na syāt sakṛdapi tathā mā bhūt kharaviṣāṇavat, tathā tat pūrvottarapariṇāmātmanā satataṃ vivartamānaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ trilakṣaṇaṃ hetuphalavyavasthāmātmani vikalpayan paratra kāryakāraṇavyapadeśabhāg bhavatīti samajjasam, pratyanīkasvabhāvāvinābhāvāt
avidyamānā ādinidhanam anādinidhanaṃ, sāditve kāryānupādānakāraṇābhāve sadapi sahakārikāraṇam akiñcitkaram
na caivaṃ śakyaṃ vaktuṃ kadācidanupādānā kāryotpattiḥ anyadā anyatheti; tathā'darśanāt
kathañcaivaṃ vādināṃ kāryadarśanād upādānakāraṇānumānam ? sarvatrā''śaṅkā'nivṛtterati tadvyavahārocchedaḥ
nirūpayiṣyate caitat jī va si ddhau
na caitat codyam--rūpādivyatirekeṇa kiṃ tat iti ? pratibhāsaikyaniyama siddhivi॰ 1
punarapi kathambhūtaṃ taditi āhosvit tadityāha--utpitsu sthāsnu naśvaram ityādi

nanu ca pradhānaṃ mahadādiphalātmanā vivarttate na taddhetvātmanā mūlaprakṛtiravikṛtiḥ sāṃkhyakā॰ 3 iti vacanāditi cet; na; mahadādipariṇāmajananasvabhāvasya akādācitkatve tadanuparatiriti kapilo'nyo vā mutko na ma kathaṃ yadi punaḥ kapilādinā saṃsargābhāvāttaduparati riti matiḥ; sāpi na yuktā; avikale kāraṇe kāryasya avaśyaṃbhāvāt
atha tatsaṃsarga eva sa svabhāvo na pūrvam; hanta katham mūlaprakṛtiḥ ? sāṃkhyakā॰ 3 iti yuktam hetuphalātmanā iti
na pradhānam anyahetutaḥ samudbhūtaṃ tasya nityatvāditi
ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ--kadācit kasyacidabhivyaktiḥ anabhivyaktisvāha ca sarvaṃ sarvatra vidyate iti kaścit; taṃ pratyāha--kramād iti
kramam āśritya ityarthaḥ, itarathā savyetaragoviṣāṇavat na hetuphalavyapadeśaḥ
vivartate tadātmanā kintu svata eveti puruṣādyadvaitavādinaḥ puruṣa evedam ṛk॰ 10
yad utpadyate tat parataḥ, naśvaraḥ, svātmani kriyāvirodhāt, utpattisamaye svamayabhāvācca
tathā parata eva vina svataḥ, sarvadā vināśaprasaṅgāt iti kecit; tān prati āha--svataḥ anyataḥ iti
svataḥ tathā vivarttanasvabhāvavaidhuryye parato'pi na vivartteta kharaśṛṅgavat, gaganaccaiyamarthaṃ ca utpitsu ityādyuktam
puruṣa evedaṃ yad bhūtaṃ yacca bhavyam
dravyam utpitsu ityādi samarthayate yadi ityādinā
yadi cet sa vidyamānaṃ sarvaṃ sarvadā utpādātmakaṃ na syāt sakṛdapi tathotpādātmakatvaprakāreṇa mā bhūt, bhavati ca, tato manyāmahe sarvadā utpādātmakamiti
nanu yadi nāma ca kadācid duṣātmakaṃ vastu tasya kimāyātaṃ yena sarvadā tat tadātmakaṃ syāditi cet; na tarhi idānīṃ kadācit sa kṣaṇikamupalabhya sarvadā tattathā ityanumānam
tathā sthityātmakaṃ sarvadā yadi na syāt; sakṛdapi tathā mābhūt

tataḥ sarvadā tadātmakamiti nirākṛtametat yaduktaṃ pra jñā ka re ṇa--dadha dattādeḥ upalambhadaśāyāṃ bhavat kālāntarasthāyitā tathāpratītirnānyadā viparyayāt iti; katham ? adṛṣṭasya jñānādeḥ abhimatasvābhāvā'siddhiprasaṅgāt
pṛthagasya upādānaṃ dṛṣṭāntārthaṃ paraṃ prati asya siddhatvāt, naiyāyikādikaṃ prati etat sādhyārtham pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭā ntārthamiti vibhāgaḥ
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt pūrvottarapariṇāmātmanā satataṃ vivarttamānaṃ kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇaṃprati pratikṣaṇaṃ trīṇi utpādasthitibhaṅgāḥ lakṣaṇāni yasya tat trilakṣaṇam sat sarvam iti sambandhaḥ
tat kiṃ kurvat kiṃ karoti ? ityatrāha--hetuphala ityādi
hetuphalayorvyavasthā pūrvaḥ pūrvo hetuḥ paraṃ paraṃ phalam iti laukikī sthitiḥ tām iti
tadanena yaduktaṃ kenacit pūrvaṃ kāryam uttaraṃ kāraṇam iti; tannirastam; śuci naraśiraḥkapālaṃ prāṇyaṅgatvāt nyāyapra॰ pṛ॰ 2 ityādivat prasiddhibādhanāditi
yadi vā, hetuphalameva viśiṣṭā nānāprakārā yā avasthā daśā tām iti
svarūpameva janyaṃ janakaṃ ca iti, tadanena nirastam
katham ? vikalpayan janyajanakatāpratīteḥ ātmani svasvarūpeṇa kalpanāyām tatastadvyavasthāyāḥ kālpanikatvaṃ kalpayan avikalpa ityuktaṃ bhavati
nahi pūrvottarapariṇāmarahitaṃ kiñcit kvacit pratyakṣabuddhau pratibhāti ityuktam
nahi sa kaścit kṣaṇo vidyate yasmāt agrimakṣaṇotpattirna bhavati iti caramakṣaṇasya abhāva eva
yadi upalabdhasyaiva tatsvabhāvatā vyavasthāpyate tadā adṛṣṭasya--anupalabdhasya
abhimato yaḥ pratibhāsarūpaḥ svabhāvaḥ tasya asiddhiḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ
yathā ca kāraṇasya pūrvaṃ bhāvaṃ vinā na bhavati kāryaṃ tathā avaśyaṃbhāvi kāraṇaṃ kāryasya parabhāvaṃ vinā neti samānaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvanibandhanamiti dvayorapi parasparaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ
lokaviruddho yathā śuci naraśiraḥkapālaṃ prāṇyaṅgatvāt śaṅkhaśuktivat--nyāyapra॰ pṛ॰ 2
athavā, avasthātuḥ ekāntena avasthā bhinnāḥ iti matam ayuktamiti kathitaṃ bhavati
bhavati paratra sahakāritvena upakārake santānāntare sati kāryavyapadeśabhāg, upakārye kāraṇavyapadeśabhāg bhavati iti samañjasam
kutaḥ punaḥ sat sarvaṃ tathāvidham ? ityatrāha--pratyanīka ityādi
utpādasya pratyanīkasvabhāvaḥ sthitiḥ tadavinābhāvād vastusvabhāvasya utpādasya
upakāryam upakārakaṃ ca, ata eva kāraṇakāryātmakam
kuta etadapi iti cet ? atrāha--dravyād ityādi
guṇinaḥ kathañcidabhinnāḥ rūpādayaḥ sukhādayo vā sakṛtpratītāḥ krameṇa...tathā...

dravyāt ityanena guṇaparyāyaikāntaṃ niṣedhati, abhinnāśca ityanena teṣāṃ tadvatorbhedaikāntam, vyāvṛttāśca ityanena sāṃkhyamatam, parasparaṃ vā bhinnā vyāvṛttāśca ityanenāpi, svasmād ityanena sarvasyobhayarūpatve pra॰ vā॰ 3
guṇāḥ sahabhāvino jīvasya jñānādayaḥ, pudgalasya rūpādayaḥ, paryāyāḥ kramabhāvinaḥ sukhaduḥkhādayaḥ, śivakādayaśca lakṣyante pratyakṣapramāṇena niścīyante
yuktyā yanna ghaṭāmupaiti tadahaṃ dṛṣṭvāpi na śraddadhe iti vadantaṃ prati nidarśanamāha— dhīvikalpā'vikalpavad iti
yathā dhiyaḥ sakāśāt vikalpau ākārau bhinnau abhinnaiva lakṣyete tathā prakṛtāḥ svadravyād iti niṣṭhuravicāracaturasya anena svamatatyāgaṃ darśayati
naiyāyikādikaṃ prati nidarśanaṃ noktaṃ pratītibalena tena dravyādivyavasthopagamāt
athavā, dhiyaḥ sambandhinau vikalpau svaiḥ vibhrametara-saṃśayetara-dṛśyetara-grāhyetara-nīletarākāraiḥ bhedābhedau tābhyāṃ tulyaṃ varttata iti tadvat
guṇinaḥ sakāśāt kathañcit tat sarvātmanā abhinnā rūpādayaḥ sukhādayo vā sakṛd ekadā pratītāḥ parīkṣitapramāṇapramitāḥ
tadanabhyupagacchato'pi hatād āgacchati iti darśayannāha--tathā ityādi
atrāpi krameṇa ityādi saṃyojya vyākhyā karttavyā
nanu asti sthūlasya ekasya nānāvayavaguṇaparyāyātmano buddhau pratibhāsanam, sa naiko'vayavī guṇī vā yuktaḥ vicārāyogāt
yat pareṇa yathoktaprameyadūṣaṇam uktam iti śeṣaḥ
punaḥ iti yuktyantarasūcane, etannivedyamānaṃ sthūlasya sūkṣmanāntarīyakatvāt paramāṇūnām ityuktam
te ca saṃyogāpekṣā eva taṃ janayanti nānyathā atiprasaṅgāt iti saṃyoge iti sa ca ekadeśena sarvātmanā vā syād gatyantarābhāvāt iti manasi nidhāya prathamapakṣe dūṣaṇamāha--digvibhāgena ityādi
diśaḥ prācyādayaḥ tadvibhāgena saṃyoge aṅgīkriyamāṇe ṣaḍaṃśatāpatteḥ teṣāmevaparamāṇutaiva na syāt sāṃśatvāt ghaṭādivat iti manyate
dvitīyapakṣe tadāha--niraṃśatve paramāṇūnām aṅgīkriyamāṇe parasparānupraveśāt kāraṇāt na pracayabhedaḥ skandha bhedaḥ iti śabdaḥ pūrvapakṣasamāptau
no cet piṇḍo'ṇumātraḥ syāt na ca te buddhigocarāḥ
atra pūrvapakṣe uttaram ucyate iti śeṣaḥ
antarā vinā na bhavatīti nāntarīyakam avinābhāvītyarthaḥ
no cet piṇḍo'ṇumātraḥ syāt na ca te buddhigocarāḥ || nyāyavi॰ 1 | 86 iti
vijñaptimātre'pi jñānasya svahetuphalamadhyavartinaḥ sāṃśatve anantakṣaṇaprasaṅgāt tāvataiva parisamāptatvāttadanyakalpanānarthakyam
anupraveśe punaḥ ekakṣaṇavarti niṣparyāyaṃ jagat syāt
yadi punaḥ kathañcinniraṃśatve'pi tathā paramāṇūnāmanupraveśābhāvāt pracayabhedaḥ syāt
yathā citkṣaṇamadhyasthaḥ cidrūpau kāraṇakāryabhūtau yau kṣaṇau tayormadhyam antaraṃ tatra tiṣṭhati iti tatsthaḥ
ko'sau ? ityāha--kṣaṇo bhāgaḥ pūrvasya kāryabhūtaḥ uttarasya kāraṇabhūtaḥ, so'pi cidrūpa eva anyasya tadabhāvāt
sa kiṃ karoti ? ityāha--na jahāti na parityajati

kim ? ityāha--niraṃśatām niraṃśasya sarvātmanā ekadeśena iti vikalpā'yogāt kevalaṃ tatra tiṣṭhati iti nyāyāt, tathā aṇurapi paramāṇurapi na kevalaṃ citkṣaṇa eva madhyastho na jahāti niraṃśatām iti sambandhaḥ
tataḥ kiṃ siddham ? ityāha--tataḥ pracayavardhanaṃ tasmānnyāyāt kālapracayavat deśapracayasyāpi vardhanam, syāt ityadhyāhāraḥ

etaduktaṃ bhavati--vitkṣaṇa madhyasthaḥ kṣaṇaḥ pūrvottarakṣaṇābhyāṃ sāntaraḥ, nirantaro vā ? na tāvadādyo vikalpaḥ; cirantanasaugatānāṃ tathā'bhyupagamābhāvāt, nairantaryaviśiṣṭānāmeva kṣaṇānām upādānopādeyabhāvābhyupagamāt
yeṣāmapi pra jñā ka ra gu ptā dī nāṃ tathābhyupagamaḥ teṣām asaṃsṛṣṭā kṣaṇā eva svakāryaṃ kurvanti na paramāṇava iti kiṃ kṛto vibhāgaḥ ? atiprasaṅgo'trāpi durvāraḥ
tanna paramāṇūnāṃ kāryārambhe saṃyogamupakalpya tannibandhanaṃ doṣacintanaṃ nyāyyam
jāgaraṇaprabodhacetasoḥ upādānopādeyabhūtayoḥ vyavadhāne nityavat kāryakāraṇabhāvaniṣedhāt na susthitaṃ tanmatam
vyavadhānaṃ ca tayoḥ nābhāvena nāpi kālena; tadanabhyupagamāt
ata eva na sajātīyavijñānaiḥ; svāpādidaśāyāṃ tadanabhyupagamāt
bhavatu vā tairvyavadhānam, tathāpi teṣāmanyonyaṃ taccetobhyāṃ ca punarapi sāntaratve tadeva codyaṃ tadeva uttaramityanavasthāḥ pratyekaṃ gaganatalavisarpiṇyo yojyāḥ
evamarthaṃ ca kṣaṇo vitkṣaṇamadhyasthaḥ iti sāmānyenoktam

anye tu manyante sarvacetasāṃ parasparaṃ na sāntaṃratvaṃ nāpi viparyayaḥ, tatkathaṃ kṣaṇo vitkṣaṇa ityādi doṣa iti; tena tatpratītipṛthuvatra nihataprajñāmūrttayaḥ kinnāma idaṃtayā nedaṃtayā vyavasthāpayantīti yatkiñcidetat
sakṛd vijñānasyaikasya citratāpratītirna nairantaryādipratītiḥ iti paramagahanametat
sarvātmanā ekadeśena vā saṃyogaḥ iti saṃyoganibandhanam
svāpāt prāgvarti jāgraccetaḥ svāpānantaramutthitasya prabodhacetaḥ, tayoḥ mithaḥ kāraṇakāryabhāvaḥ svāpāvasthāyāṃ jñānābhāvavādinaḥ prajñākaramate'sti
aparastu āha--pratīyamānameva jñānaṃ na pūrvaṃ nāpi paramiti kathamucyate kṣaṇo vitkṣaṇamadhyasthaḥ iti; so'pi na yuktakārī, vicārāyogāt
nīlādayaśca citratvāt naikaṃ yugapat nīlādicitratvaṃ pratyeti
na pūrvaṃ kāraṇam, nāpi param kāryam
kṣaṇo vā kṣaṇamadhyasthaḥ iti ca pāṭho'sti

tatrāyamarthaḥ--acetano nīlādirūpaḥ cetanaśca tadbuddhisvabhāvaḥ cetana eva iti kṣaṇo vā kṣaṇa iva kṣaṇayoḥ acetanayoḥ cetanayoḥ tayoreva vā kāraṇākāryabhūtayoḥ madhyastho na jahāti niraṃśatām aṇurapi iti
vijñaptimātre'pi antarjñeyavādimate'pi na kevalaṃ sautrāntikamata iti apiśabdārthaḥ
jñānasya atrāpi apiśabdo lupto draṣṭavyaḥ, tena ajñānasyāpi
kathaṃbhūtasya ? svahetuphalamadhyavarttinaḥ svasya svo vā yo hetuḥ yacca phalam tayormadhye vartituṃ śīlamasyeti tadvarttinaḥ, ṣaṭparamāṇumadhyavarttinaḥ
paramāṇorapi ca sāṃśatve aṅgīkriyamāṇe natatkṣaṇa prasaṅgāt kāraṇāt tāvataiva tasyānantakṣaṇaprasaṅgamātreṇaiva parisamāptatvād anādyanantasantānaprayojanasya iti manyate
tadanyakalpanānarthakyam tebhyaḥ anantakṣaṇebhyaḥ ye anye kṣaṇāḥ teṣāṃ kalpanānarthakyam
tathāhi--tanmadhyavartinaḥ kṣaṇasya svāṃśamadhyavartitve'pi tadaparāṃśakalpanā, punarapi tasmin sati tadanyakalpaneti paraṃ sāntaratvecintane sa eva prasaṅgaścintyaḥ
sahabhāvināṃ svasantānāntarakṣaṇānām etat saṃbhavati na veti vicāracaturasradhiyo vicārayantu
yadi saṃbhavati; kimarthaṃ paramāṇava eva upadrūyante ? niraṃśatve dūṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha--anupraveśa ityādi
tasya tadvartinaḥ pūrvatra uttaratra vā tayorvā tatrānupraveśe aṅgīkriyamāṇe punaḥ iti pakṣāntarasūcane
pra jñā ka ra sya tathābhyupagamaṃ kurvato'pi uktam--yugapaccitrapratipattivat krameṇāpi tatpratipatteraniṣedhāt pratyakṣavirodhaḥ iti
yadi punaḥ ityādinā paramatamāśaṅkate--yadi punaḥ kathañcit kenāpi prakāreṇa niraṃśatve'pi iṣyate ityadhyāhāraḥ
tathā tena prakāreṇa paramāṇūnāṃ ghaṭārambhakācetanasūkṣmabhāgānāṃ pracayabhedo racanāviśeṣaḥ syāt iti gatena sambandhaḥ
evaṃ sati yat siddhaṃ taddarśayannāha--tathā sati ityādi
paramāṇavaḥ pārimaṇḍalyaṃ bhittvā sthūlamekaṃ svabhāvaṃ svayamupagatāḥ samupalakṣyante tathāpariṇāmāt
evaṃ sati pārimaṇḍalyaṃ ca niraṃśatvaṃ ca nānātvaṃ ca adṛśyatā ca atyaktāḥ pārimaṇḍalyanānātvā'dṛśyatā yaiḥ te tathoktāḥ, te ca te aṇavaśca
te kiṃ kurvanti ? ityāha— tad ityādi
tatpratyanīkaṃ pārimaṇḍalyanānātvādṛśyatāpratyanīkaṃ sāṃśamekaṃ dṛśyam iti yāvat

atyaktapārimaṇḍalyapadena ghaṭavat tatparāvayavānāmapi sāṃśatve anavasthā syāditi kalpanaṃ nirasyati, atyaktanānātvadhvaninā avayavino niraṃśatvam, atyaktādṛśyatāvacanena dṛṣṭe pramāṇāntarāvṛttim, aṇavaḥ ityanena prakṛtiḥ kāraṇam, puruṣaḥ kāraṇam ityetat, tatpratyanīkamityataḥ paramāṇubhyaḥ paramāṇava eva nirantarā dṛśyā jāyante iti, ātmānam ityanena vaiśeṣikādimatam añjasā ityanena kalpitatvam iti
tathāhi--parimaṇḍalāni paramāṇumanāṃsi, teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ pārimaṇḍalyaṃ tatparimāṇameva
nanu kutaḥ paramāṇavaḥ siddhā yenaivaṃ syāt ? natāvat pratyakṣataḥ; tatra tatpratibhāsavirahāt svayamanabhyupagamāt
tanna yuktam--atra pratyakṣānupalambhasādhanaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ hetubi॰ pṛ॰ 54 iti
tata eva nānumānato'pi; pratyakṣābhāve tanmūlasya tasya anavatārāt
nāpi indriyavat kāryavyatirekataḥ tatsiddhiḥ; satsu anyeṣu kāraṇeṣu tadabhāve niyatena anupajāyamānasya kasyacit kāryasyā'bhāvāt, sthūlādeva mṛtpiṇḍāt tathāvidhaghaṭotpattidarśanāt
yadīndriyaṃ na syāt tarhi rūpādijñānaṃ na syāditivat yadi paramāṇavo na syuḥ tarhi ghaṭādikāryaṃ kutaḥ syāditi
yatpunaretat--yatsthūlaṃ tad alpaparimāṇakāraṇārabdhaṃ yathā paṭaḥ, sthūlaṃ ca aṣṭāṇukādi kāryam, tat svalpaparimāṇakāraṇamiti paramāṇusiddhiḥ iti; tadasāram; yataḥ sūkṣmamapekṣya sthūlamiti bhavati
na ca aṣṭāṇukāt paraṃ rūpaṃ siddhamasti yadapekṣya aṣṭāṇukaṃ sthūlaṃ syāt
ata eva tatsiddhiriti cet; asyāpi kutaḥ ? tata iti cet; anyonyasaṃśrayaḥ--siddhe hi tataḥ parasmin tadrūpe tataḥ tatsthūlatāsiddhiḥ, asyāśca tatsiddhiriti
tathā kāryādalpaparimāṇaṃ samavāyikāraṇaṃ tasyāpyanyadalpaparimāṇamityādyaṃ kāryaṃ niratiśayaparamāṇuparimāṇairārabdhamiti jñāyate

yaccānyat--yat sthūlaṃ tadbhidyamānaṃ ghādi dṛṣṭam, sthūlaṃ ca aṣṭāṇukam, tataḥ tadapi bhidyate tāvad abhidyamānabhedaparyantamiti tatsiddhiḥ iti; tadapi vilakṣābhidhānam; yataḥ aṣṭā ṇukasya bhedanataḥ paraṃ na kiñcid bhavatyeva pramāṇābhāvāt
prayogaḥ--parimāṇasya apakarṣaḥ kvacit paramakāṣṭhāvān atiśayavattvāt tatprakarṣavat
na ca sādhyaśūnyo dṛṣṭāntaḥ, itarathā sarvajñādyabhāvaḥ pramāṇabādhito bhavet
yathā vijñānasya utkarṣātiśayadarśanāt parākāṣṭhāsiddhirbhavati yathā vā parimāṇasya atimahāparimāṇarūpatā ca prasādhyate tathaiva
tathā ghaṭādikāraṇakāraṇeṣu alpatarādibhāvaḥ kvacidviśrāntaḥ taratamaśabdavācyatvāt mahāparimāṇavat
yatpunaruktaṃ pareṇa--tadapakarṣakāṣṭhāyāṃ bhāvaḥ kimāste, āhosvit sarvathā naśyati iti na niścayo'sti iti; tadasāram; sarvathā tadvināśābhāvāt yuktibādhanāt
paramāṇavaḥ samupalakṣyante iti sambandhaḥ, viśadābādhitarūpeṇa samīcīnena lakṣyante ityasya pradarśanārtham--samaḥ abhidhānam
svayaṃ svagrāhakajñānasāmīpyam upagatā na ākārasamarpaṇena ityasya kathanārtham upasya, niścīyante na avikalpadarśanena dṛśyante ityasya ca lakṣyante ityasya
kiṃ kurvāṇāḥ kim ? ityāha— sthūlamekaṃ pratyakṣamātmānam ityanuvarttate
hiḥ yasmāt na tathā tena anantaraprakāreṇa apariṇataṃ tat tadanantaraṃ vastu bhavati
prakṛtanigamanavyājena upamānādīnāṃ svābhyupagatajñāne antarbhāvaṃ kurvannāha--tadetad ityādi

tadetat upamānādi matijñānaprabhedalakṣaṇam avagrahādimatismṛtisaṃjñācintābhinibodhātmakaṃ dravyaparyāyaviṣayaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣaviṣayaṃ ca prāgabhilāpasaṃsargāt pramāṇamavisaṃvādāt tadviparītamapi tatprabhedalakṣaṇam
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt etad anantaraṃ nirūpyamāṇaṃ upamānādi jñānam iti sambandhaḥ
matijñānasya prabhedaḥ prapañcaḥ sa eva lakṣaṇaṃ svarūpaṃ yasya tattathoktaṃ matijñānaviśeṣa iti yāvat
kuta etat ? ityatrāha--avagraha ityādi avagraha ādiryasyāḥ sā cāsau matiḥ samāsaḥ, sā ca smṛtiśca saṃjñā ca cintā ca abhinibodhaśca te ātmāno yasya tattathoktam
etacca tatprabhedaviśeṣaṇamapi sādhanaṃ draṣṭavyam, tataḥ tajjñānaṃ tadātmakatvāt matiprabhedalakṣaṇam iti

nanu upamādīnādīnāṃ tatrāntarbhāvo nirūpayitumārabdhaḥ tatkimartham avagrahādimatismṛtigrahaṇamiti cet ? satyam; tathāpi prasiddhasaṃjñādijñānotpattikramasya upamānādau pradarśanārthaṃ tadgrahaṇamityadoṣaḥ

tathāhi--yathaiva pūrvaparyāyā'vagrahādyāhitasaṃskārasya paraparyāyāvagrahāt pūrvaparyāyasmṛtau prasiddhasaṃjñācintā'bhinibodhāḥ tathaiva gavayasadṛśagavādyavagrahādyāhitasaṃskārasya punargavayādyavagrahād gosmaraṇe sati tena sadṛśo'yam iti jñānaṃ jāyate iti saṃjñāto na bhidyate

nanu ca avagrahādimatismṛtiprabhavasya jñānasya saṃjñātmakatve sarvato vyāvṛttasya ghaṭasya avagrahāt saṃskāre punaḥ tathāvidhasya bhūtalāderavagrahād avagṛhītaghaṭasmaraṇād iha sa ghaṭo nāsti iti jñānaṃ saṃjñā bhavet, na caivam, sādṛśyaikatvapratyavamarśasyaiva tattvopagamāt pratyabhijñā dvidhā nyāyavi॰ 2
yasya abhāvaḥ kriyate saḥ pratiyogī tam
mī॰ ślo॰ abhāvapa॰ ślo॰ 27 iti cet;
50 ityādi tu vacanam ekatvavat sādṛśye pratyabhijñātvapratipādanārthaṃ na parigaṇanārtham, itarathā matismṛti-- ta॰ sū॰ 1
syānmatam, ghaṭabhūtalayoḥ anyonyavivekasya tatpratyakṣābhyāṃ gogavayayoḥ sādṛśyavat pratītau punaḥ tatpratyavamarśaḥ pratyabhijñānaṃ bhavet, na caivaṃ mānasanāstitājñānādeva tatpratīteḥ
mī॰ ślo॰ abhāvapa॰ ślo॰ 18 iti cet;
tanna yuktam; bhāvāṃśavad itarasyāpi pratyakṣa eva
pratiyoginaḥ sarvānyasaṃsṛṣṭasya smaraṇe na kvacit pratiṣedhaḥ, abhyupagamabādhanāt
tadasaṃsṛṣṭasya smaraṇaṃ tathā pūrvamanubhave, anyathā ati prasaṅgaḥ
tathā avagrahādimatismṛtisaṃjñābhyo jāyamānaṃ jñānaṃ cintātmakatvāt tatprabhedalakṣaṇaṃ na yogipratyakṣam, tasya tadvirodhāt
ghaṭaviviktabhūtalasmaraṇād ghaṭasya bhūtalāsaṃsṛṣṭatāpratipattiḥ, ghaṭasya bhūtalāsaṃsṛṣṭatāpratipattau ca ghaṭaviviktabhūtalasmaraṇamiti
etena mānasaṃ pratyakṣaṃ tat iti nirastam
tadvat cintāprabhavatvād arthāpattirapi prasiddhā anumānavat tatprabhedalakṣaṇam abhinibodhātmakatvāt
syānmatam--ekatvapratyavamarśaḥ pratyabhijñānam, na sādṛśyādipratyavamarśasya tatprabhedalakṣaṇe antarbhāva iti cet; atrāha--dravya ityādi
asyāyamarthaḥ--yasmāt tadetad vijñānaṃ pareṇa ucyamānaṃ dravyaparyāyaviṣayaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣaviṣayaṃ ca tasmāt yathoktaṃ
sāmānyaṃ hi sādṛśyameva tadviṣayaṃ ca jñānaṃ pareṇāpi pratyabhijñānamiṣyate iti manyate
kiṃ sarvaṃ tanna lakṣaṇaṃ na ityāha--prāg abhilāpasaṃsargāt iti
gavayādiśabdayojanāt prāk yajjāyate upamāṇādijñānaṃ tat na punaḥ so'yaṃ gavayaśabdavācyaḥ ityādi jñānam iti bhāvaḥ
na kevalaṃ tat tallakṣaṇameva kintupramāṇamapi iti darśayannāha--pramāṇam

tasmād uktād upamānādeḥ viparītaṃ goriva gavayaḥ ityādyāgamāhitasaṃskārasya śākhādimān vṛkṣaḥ kṣīrāmbhaḥpravivecanatuṇḍo haṃsaḥ ityādyāgamāhitasaṃskārasya ca naiyāyikādyupamānādijñānaṃ tadapi dravyādiviṣayaṃ sat tatprabhedalakṣaṇaṃ pramāṇaṃ vādāditi sambandhaḥ
mithyā avagrahādimatismṛtisaṃjñācintābhinibodhātmakaṃ jñānam iti ajñānam apramāṇam pramāṇaṃ na bhavati matyajñānatvāt iti draṣṭavyam
ekāntasya viṣayasya sambandhi darśanā'nu mānādikam ādi śabdena āgamaparigrahaṃ tadyaveti

yadi vā, anyathā pūrvapakṣayitvā etad jñātavyam, tadyathā pūrvaprastāvadvaye yadavagrahādidhāraṇāparyantaṃ jñānaṃ cintitam, yacca pramāṇam avisaṃvādismṛtiḥ ityādinā smaraṇam asmin, caturthaprastāve pratyabhijñānaṃ nirūpayiṣyamāṇam, tatraiva leśataḥ kramaprāptaprastāvavaśena bhūtābhavyāḥ ityādinā pūrvaṃ cintitaṃ tarka jñānam, ṣaṣṭhe cintayiṣyamāṇam anumānaṃ ca, pañcasu jñāneṣu kva antarbhāvyatāmiti ? tatrāha--tadetad ityādi
nanu ca pūrvam atra anyatra ca smaraṇādi sarvaṃ śrutam ityuktam, tatkathanna virodha iti cet ? na virodhaḥ, mukhyaśrutasādharmyād upacāreṇa tathābhidhānāt
sarvaṃ tarhi tadātmakaṃ jñānaṃ tallakṣaṇaṃ prasaktam; ityāha--tadviparītam ityādi
tat tasmāt dravyādiviṣayāt tadātmakājjñānād viparītaṃ vilakṣaṇaṃ jñānam ityanuvartate matyajñānaṃ matijñānaṃ naṃbhavati
kutaḥ ? apramāṇaṃ yataḥ dravyādiviṣayaṃ na bhavati ityabhiprāyaḥ
kvacitpustake--pramāṇamekamadhyakṣamagauṇamapare viduḥ ityādi sakalaṃ cū rṇi pra ka ra ṇa masti, tat kaiścinna vyākhyātaṃ, vadgalaṃ paunaruktyasya aprastutābhidhānasya ca tatra bhāvāt
nanu yaduktam--matijñānaprabhedalakṣaṇaṃ jñānaṃ pramāṇam avisaṃvādakatvāt iti; tadayuktam; kvacid avisaṃvādābhāvāt
tathāhi--na dṛṣṭasya punaḥ prāptiḥ asti, bhavatu vā sā svapne'pyasti
yadi punarasau na tatprāptiḥ, katham anyā ? viśeṣā'bhāvāt
atha arthadarśanam avisaṃvādo na tatprāptiḥ; idamapi tādṛgeva, viplave'pi asya bhāvāt
atha arthatadvyavasthā vipakṣavat; tatpratītiśca pratyakṣataḥ anumānato vā gatyantarābhāvāt ? paraparyanuyogo'pi nāto yuktaḥ asambaddhapralāpitvaprasaṅgāt
bhavatu tata eva sā iti cet; dravyate --
jñānī pratyakṣādijñānavān, yena pratyakṣādijñānena atiśete vijayate, anyena tadatiśāyanā'yogāt jñānena iti labhyate
kathaṃbhūtam ? ityāha--itaram ajñāninaṃ vibhramānye kāntatattve viparyāsānadhyavasāyopapannaṃ naiyāyikādikam
sa yena tam ati śete tat tat ityanena parāmṛśyate, tatpramāṇam, anyathā kutastataḥ sveṣṭasiddhiḥ bahirarthavaditi manyate
samantāt sarvato heyaṃ yattattvaṃ satyetarapravibhāgalakṣaṇaṃ yacca upādeyaṃ vibhramādyakāntarūpaṃ tayoḥ siddhau tatsiddhinimittam
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadi na kiñcit pramāṇam kutaḥ abhimata siddhiḥ ? tadasti cet; sākalyena pramābhaṅgavidhānavirodhaḥ iti
aparastu āha--na kiñcid vijñānaṃ pramāṇam nāpyapramāṇaṃ sakalavikalpātītatvāt tattvasya, tasya ca svasaṃvedanādhyakṣapramāṇataḥ siddheḥ, nāpi pramābhaṅgavidhānavirodhaḥ bahiḥ tadvidhānāt iti
na punaḥ naiva anubhavaḥ pramāṇam iti sambandhaḥ
kva ? ityāha— heyopādeyasiddhau heyaṃ sakalavikalpatattvaṃ upādeyaṃ tadrahitaṃ saṃvedanamātram, tatsiddhau iti
na vidyate satyetarādivikalpo bhedo yasya sa tathoktaḥ
abhūtam ajātaṃ kutaścit kāraṇāt brahmādi tattvaṃ nityaṃ tatsamānaḥ

kathamabhūtakalpa iti cet ? ucyate--yathaikasya anekātmatābhayāt nīlādisukhādibhyo vyatiricyamānaśarīraṃ sarvavikalpātītaṃ kenacid vrahyatattvamiṣyate tathā tata eva saṃvedanatattvaṃ tathāvidhaṃ niraṃśaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ saugatena abhyupagantavyam, tadvadeva
tacca na svaparavyavasthāhetuḥ iti na pramāṇamiti
tasmānna paramārthataḥ kiñcidastītyastu yathā tathā saṃvṛtyā etāvatāpi pramāṇāpramāṇavyavasthitirna kācit kṣatiḥ
abhipreta eva bhavatpakṣo'smākamiti na vastutattvamatikramya vartituṃ śakyam
nanu na mayā pareṇa vā'dṛṣṭameva tadabhyupagamyate yenāyaṃ doṣaḥ syāt, api tu yathāpratibhāsamiti cet; atrāha--pratyakṣa ityādi

pratyakṣaṃ avagrahādidhāraṇāparyantam, asyaiva prakṛtatvāt smṛtiśca abhijñā ca, svaṃ ca paraśca svaparau tau viṣayau yasya sa tathoktaḥ, sa cāsau tarkaśca sa ca anumā ca tā ātmāno yasyāḥ sā tathoktā matiḥ syād bhavet pramāṇam iti sambandhaḥ
anena etat kathayati--yadi yathāpratibhāsaṃ saṃvedanaṃ pramāṇamiṣyate; tarhi yathoktā matiḥ pramāṇayitavyā tasyā ekatra darśanādiprāptiparyantavyavahāropayogitvena pratibhāsanāt
atha atisūkṣmaparīkṣayā vyavatiṣṭhamānaṃ tad brahma na kiñcid vyasyāt parasya gatyantarābhāvāt iti

nanu svaparaśabdena kimarthaṃ tarka eva viśeṣyate nānyat pratyakṣādikam, tadapi tathāvidhameva jainasyeti cet; satyam; yastathā necchati taṃ prati tasya tathāvidhaprasādhanāya tarko dṛṣṭāntīkartuṃ tathā viśeṣyate
yathā tarkaḥ svaparaviṣayaḥ tataḥ sākalyavyāptiṃ sādhyasādhanayoḥ pareṇa icchatā abhyupagamyate tathā pratyakṣādikamabhyupagantavyamiti nirākṛtametat--nānyo'nubhāvyo buddhyā'sti pra॰ vā॰ 3
cintā tarko'cintyātmikā acintyaḥ kathamevaṃ viveyam ityavicāryaḥ ātmā svabhāvo yasyāḥ sā tathoktā iyaṃ pratyanumātṛ pratyakṣapramāṇaparicchedyā
kuto'nyam ? ityāha--viṣayāt pratyakṣādi gocarāt anyaṃ parokṣamityarthaḥ
kva ? ityatrāha--anyatra svadeśād anyadeśe, upalakṣaṇametat tena anyadā ca iti gṛhyate
kimarthaṃ kalayati ? ityāha--siddhau nirṇītau anyasya anyatra siddhinimittamityarthaḥ
asyā'nabhyupagame sākalyena hetoḥ sādhyena vyāpterasiddheḥ--yadavabhāsate tat jñānaṃ yathā sukhādi ityādyanumānaṃ pratihataprasaraṃ bhavet
na ca svāṃśamātrāvalambinā jaḍasya pratibhāsāyogāt ityādinā vicāreṇa tatsiddhiḥ, anyathā nīlajñānāt pītādisiddhiḥ syādityalaṃ prasaṅgena
athavā, savikalpakapratyakṣapakṣe smṛtergṛhītagrāhakatve'pi na prayojanaviśeṣāt ityādinā prāmāṇyaṃ vyavasthāpya saṃprati parapakṣoktaṃ tasya gṛhītagrāhitvaṃ nirākurvannāha--jñānī ityādi
kim ? ityāha--itaram acetanaṃ ghaṭādikam, yena svabhāvena tato bhidyata ityarthaḥ
nanu svagrahaṇavimukhyena arthagrahaṇātmanā dharmeṇa tam atiśete sa iti, so'pi dharmaḥ pramāṇaṃ syāditi cet; atrāha--bhavabhṛtam iti
ca śabdo'tra draṣṭavyaḥ, bhavabhṛtaṃ ca maheśvarapoṣakaṃ naiyāyikādikaṃ tat pramāṇaṃ svaparavyavasāyajñānaṃ pramāṇamityarthaḥ
avikalpānubhavena mataṃ vijayate ataḥ sa pramāṇam, ityatrāha--na punaḥ ityādi
abhūtakalpaḥ abhūto'jātaḥ kharaviṣāṇādiḥ īṣadasiddhaḥ, abhūtakalpaḥ avikalpo'nubhavaḥ na pramāṇam nārthaparicchedakaḥ
prayogaḥ— avikalpo'nubhavaḥ na kasyacid grāhakaḥ, asattvāt, gaganakusumavat iti
ataḥ kathaṃ tadgṛhītaṃ kiñcid vijñānaṃ gṛhīti, nānyathā so'pi anyagṛhītaṃ gṛhṇāti iti syāt tadanyavat
avikalpānubhavasyāpi nānubhavaḥ; tadanubhavasya apramāṇatve na kiñcit pramāṇaṃ bhavet
cintā parakīyā iyaṃ gṛhītagrāhijñānaṃ sarvaṃ pramāṇam ityevaṃ rūpā'cintyātmikā'cintyasvabhāvā mānatrāṇarahitātāyāḥ bhartṛtrāṇahīnāyāḥ kulayoṣita iva tadrūpatvāt
anyatra anyasyāḥ siddhau gṛhītau, anyatra iti vacanāt sūrermanasi kācid vivakṣitā siddhirvarttate iti gamyate
anyatra ityasya saṃbandhiśabdāt tato vivakṣitasiddhiviṣayād anyaṃ viṣayāntaram ekāntena kalayati adhyavasyati yataḥ, na caivamasti iti manyate
deśādibhedena ekatrārthe anekasiddhisaṃbhavāt, na ca sā pramāṇaṃ tato'pravṛttiprasaṅgāt
kṣaṇikatvādarthasya naivaṃ cet; na; atra pramāṇābhāvāt

pūrvottarayoḥ madhye tasya ca tatra anupalabdhiḥ pramāṇamiti cet; na; asyāḥ kṣaṇikaniraṃśaparamāṇutattvaikānte sarvathā'siddheḥ yugapat svāvayavātmakaghaṭāditattvasamaye'pi nitarāṃ tatra pratyakṣādyātmikāyāḥ mateḥ pramāṇatvāt
yardi vā, anyathā pūrvapakṣayitvā idaṃ vṛttaṃ vyākhyātavyam
nanu pratyakṣameva ekaṃ pramāṇam tatkimarthaṃ tadanantaraṃ smaraṇādi pramāṇatrayamatra cintyate iti cet; atrāha--jñānī ityādi
jñānī parīkṣāvān svayaṃ cārvāko yena anumānajñānena atiśete
kam ? ityāha— bhavabhṛtam bhavaḥ saṃsāraḥ taṃ bibhartti ṣuṣṇāti samarthayata iti bhavabhṛt jainādiḥ tam, itaravat niṣedhakam svaśiṣyādikam atiśete tato viśeṣaṃ labhate
samantāt sākalyena heyasya paralokadevatāviśeṣadharmā'dharmapramāṇāntarādeḥ upādeyasya bhūtacatuṣṭayaparacaitanya-mukhyapratyakṣapramāṇādeḥ siddhau nirṇītinimittam
nanu pratyakṣānubhavādeva tatsiddhiḥ iti sa eva pramāṇamiti cet; atrāha--na punaḥ ityādi
na punaḥ naiva anubhavaḥ pratyakṣajñānaṃ pramāṇaṃ heyopādeyasiddhau ityanuvarttate
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni svayam acetanāni na heyopādeyasiddhau pramāṇam, anyathā jñānakalpanamanarthakaṃ syāt, tathā anubhavo'pi tadupādānatayā svayamacetano na tatra pramāṇam
na khalu acetanopādānaṃ cetanaṃ yuktam, itarathā acetanāt mṛtpiṇḍāt cetano ghaṭaḥ syāt
tathā ca prayogaḥ--yadacetanopādānaṃ na tat cetanaṃ yathā ghaṭādi, acetanatopādānaṃ ca parasya jñānamiti
nanu tadupādānatve'pi tasya cidrūpatayā pratīteḥ pratyakṣabādhitaḥ pakṣaḥ iti cet; mṛta eva vijñānāt tasya tathātvapratīti gastyattāvadetat caturthaparicchede nirūpayiṣyāmāṇatvāt
yadi vā bhūtāni kalpyante vyavasthāpyante viṣayīkriyante yena sa bhūtakalpa iti vyākhyeyam
na ca tasya tatsiddhau sāmarthyaṃ paralokādeḥ atadviṣayatvāt
nāpi yad yadviṣayaṃ na bhavati tattasya niṣedhakaṃ vyavasthāpakaṃ vā atiprasaṅgāt
nanu bhavatu anumānaṃ pramāṇam, tathāpi prakṛte ka upayoga iti cet ? atrāha--pratyakṣa ityādi
atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--anumānaṃ pramāṇamicchatā pūrvaṃ liṅgaliṅginoḥ sambandhadarśanam, punaḥ kvacit prāyo liṅgadarśanam, sambandhasmṛtiḥ, pratyabhijñānam, tarkaḥ, punaḥ anumānamityabhyupagantavyam

nanu ca pratyakṣeṇa liṅgaliṅginoḥ sākalyena sambandhapratipattau pratipattuḥ sarvajñatvam, tenaiva anumānena pratipattau anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ, tadantareṇa anavasthā, tatkathaṃ sambandhapratipattiḥ yato'numānamiti cet; atrāha--cintā ityādi
cintā ityanvarthasaṃjñākaraṇāt tarkasya mānasavikalpatvopavarṇanam, pratyakṣatvaniṣedhe tena sākalyavyāptiṃ pratipadyamānasya jainasya sarvajñatvaṃ nā'niṣṭāya abhyupagamāt iti darśayati anena
he jina, yadā sāmānyamanuṣyo'pi sattvasāmānyena sarvaṃ vastujātaṃ jānan sarvajño bhavati tadā akhilajñānavān yadi sarvajño bhavet kimatra citram
acintyātmikā ityanena ca viṣayotpattisārūpyayoḥ liṅgāśritatvasya ca abhāve'pi yogyatayā svaviṣayaparicchedānna tatpakṣabhāvī doṣaḥ
iyam ityanenāpi tasyāḥ pratyātma svasaṃvedanādhyakṣavedyatayā niṣedhane pratyakṣabādhanam
sā kiṃ karoti ? ityāha--kalayati sākalyena avadhārayati
kim ? anyaṃ sādhanaṃ sādhyāt tasya anyatvāt
sādhanāt anyat sādhyaṃ tatra anumānanimittamiti yāvat
yathā mātari varttitavyam, pitari śuśrūṣitavyam ityukte svasyāṃ svasmin iti gamyate tathā viṣayāt ityukte'pi svaviṣayād anyathānupapannatvalakṣaṇāt iti gamyate iti
iti ra vi bha dra pādakañjabhramara a na nta vī rya viracitāyāṃ si ddhi vi ni śca ya ṭī kā yāṃ pramāṇāntarasiddhiḥ tṛtīyaḥ prastāvaḥ
evaṃ tāvat pramāṇasya sākṣāt siddhiḥ svārthaviniścayaḥ ityapekṣya smaraṇaṃ pramāṇāntaraṃ saprapañcaṃ cintitam

sāmpratam--pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ pramāṇaṃ syāt phalaṃ syāduttarottaram laghī॰ ślo॰ 7 ityabhisamīkṣya tadeva pratyakṣāphalajananāt cintayituṃ pratyabhijñānaṃ ca ātmasiddhipurassaraṃ tarkajananāt prajñāvādau vijñātān ityādi --
paśyatyeva hi sāntaraṃ pṛthutaraṃ raśmeḥ kuto niḥsṛtiḥ || 1
tulanā--sāntaragrahaṇaṃ na syāt prāptau jñānādhikasya ca
manyate budhyate arthān iti manaḥ ātmā
sa kiṃ karoti ? ityāha--budhyate jānāti, na niranvayajñānasantānaḥ prakṛtipariṇāmo vyavasāyaḥ pṛthivyādirvā iti manyate
na cedamatra mantavyam sukhādivyatirekeṇa nātmā asti tatkathamasau budhyate ? sukhādeḥ ātmatve'vipratisāra iti kutaḥ ? pratyakṣaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ vicitraviṣayākāraikasaṃvedanam siddhivi॰ 2

tato yaduktaṃ kenacit--yena vedyate tattato na bhidyate yathā tasyaiva vedakasya svarūpam, vedyate ca ātmanā nīlādikam iti; tadanena nirastam; pakṣasya pratyakṣabādhanāt, vedakasya ahamahamikayā anyatra anyatra ca ghaṭāderdarśanāt, itarathā kokilakulaṃ dhavalaṃ pakṣitvād balākāvat ityapi syāt
atha katham ātmā tato bhinnaḥ atadāyattastātvetti ? tathādarśanāt, kathamanyathā arthastathāvidhaḥ tajjanakaḥ ? yogyatā anyatrāpi na vāryate
tatra vidūṣaṇasamudācāro'kuśalaṃ karmādhyācarati tatra tatraiva ca vipratisārabahulo bhavati

etena yaduktaṃ sāṃkhyena--indriyāṇi arthamālocayanti, ahaṅkāro'bhimanyate, manaḥ saṃkalpayati, buddhiḥ adhyavasyati puruṣaścetayate iti; tannirastam; buddhyākāravad viṣaya syeva sākṣād vedanasadbhāvāt
kaścāyaṃ niyamaḥ--buddhiḥ tadanuramantareṇa dṛśyate na viṣaya iti
nanu yadi sattāmātreṇa sa tānu budhyate; tarhi tadaviśeṣāt sarvaḥ sarvadarśī syāditi cet; atrāha— abhijñayā iti pratyabhijñānena
evaṃ buddhyahaṅkāramanaścakṣuṣāṃ kramaśo vṛttirdṛṣṭā— cakṣū rūpaṃ paśyati, manaḥ saṃkalpayati, ahaṅkāro'bhimānayati, buddhiradhyavasyati

syānmatam--tadevedam iti jñānamabhijñā; tatra tad iti smaraṇollekhaḥ, idam iti ca varttamānollekhaḥ, na cāparaṃ jñānamasti yat pratyabhijñābhidhānaṃ syāditi; tadasāram; yataḥ pratiparamāṇuniyatasya vedanasya pūrvameva niṣedhāt
pratyakṣasya smaraṇasya vā ullekhaḥ, kharaviṣāṇollekhaḥ, yugapat citraikasaṃvedanābhyupagamaḥ, pūrvāpara paryāyagrahaṇollekhadvayamullikhantīṃ pratyabhijñāmekāṃ samarthayate
tathā ca prayogaḥ--yena jñānena ātmā viṣayān budhyate tat pramāṇam, yathā ghaṭādijñānam, budhyate ca sa pratyabhijñānena viṣayān iti
atha mataṃ yadyasau gatāḥ tayā budhyate, tarhi adṛṣṭapūrvasyāpi bhāvasya pūrvāparaparyāyaikatvaṃ prathamadarśana eva tayā sa budhyeta iti; tadapi na yuktam; ityāha--vijñātān iti

kaiḥ ? ityatrāha--aśeṣakaraṇaiḥ sannihite bījapūrakādau yāni rūparasagandhasparśaviṣayāṇi aśeṣāni samastāni karaṇāni cakṣurādīni, jñānāni vā kārye kāraṇopacārāt, yadi vā pūrvaṃ yāni vṛttāni yāni ca paścāt pravarttante tānyaśeṣakaraṇāni taiḥ iti
nanvevaṃ vijñātavijñānād abhijñā pramāṇaṃ na syāditi cet; atrāha--na kiṃ te ityādi
na kiṃ tam ūhitam yad avagrahādi tasya gocaro viṣaya itaro vidhiḥ svabhāvaḥ, svakāraṇairvidhīyate iti vidhiḥ iti vyutpatteḥ taṃ nītvā viṣayān iti varttate

tathāhi--cakṣuṣā bījapūrādeḥ ekasya sthavīyaso rūpātmakasya grahaṇe'pi na sodyākasya grahaṇam, rasavādino'pi tasya rasādyātmakasya vedane'pi na rūpātmakasya vedanam, tathā pūrvadarśanena pūrvaparyāyaviśiṣṭasya avasāye'pi nottaraparyāyaviśiṣṭasya avasāyaḥ, nāpi aparaparyāyāvagraheṇa pūrvadaśāviśiṣṭasya avagraha iti, pratyabhijñayā tu ubhayāvasthāviśiṣṭo budhyate iti naikāntena gṛhītagrāhitvamiti bhāvaḥ
nanu yadi pūrveṇa uttareṇa vā darśanena kasyacid ekatvaṃ pratipannaṃ syāt yuktaṃ pratyabhijñayā tasya grahaṇaṃ darśanānusāritvādasyāḥ
mā bhūt, pratyabhijñā ca tadviṣayā syāditi cet; uktamatra--pūrvadarśanābhāve'pi syāt
āśusmaraṇe satīti cet; paṭadarśanasmaraṇāt ghaṭe tadekatvapratyabhijñānaṃ bhavet
tadekatvādarśanānneti cet; tata eva anyatrāpi mā bhūd aviśeṣāditi cet; atrāha--abhinanava iti
abhi navaṃ pūrvaparyāyaparihāreṇa aparaṃ yanti iti abhimataḥ nipātatvādayamasyārtha uktaḥ
pūrvatvaṃ kālāntarasthāna vatto viṣayān vijñātān viṣayān aśeṣakaraṇaiḥ iti sambandhaḥ
na cāyamekāntaḥ aparāparadaśādarśane tadvātrayaṃ dṛśyate iti, kathamanyathā madhyakṣaṇasya darśanena pūrvāparakṣaṇādarśane tato vivekapratipattiḥ ? śeṣamatra pūrvamatrāpi cintitam
syādetad yati vijñātān viṣayān aśeṣakaraṇaiḥ ātmā abhijñayā budhyate tarhi sarvān ājanmanaḥ sarvaḥtā tayā budhyate iti cet; atrāha--smṛtvā iti
smaraṇena vijñātān pūrvaviṣayān kṛtyottara viṣayaiḥ vijñānaiḥ ekatvena dhyasā budhyate na sarvāniti manyate
asyāyamarthaḥ— abhijñayā karaṇabhūtayā kṛttvā tarkam ūhaṃ nītvā viṣayān tarkagrāhyān tān kṛttvetyarthaḥ
tān viṣayān nītvā taṃ tadgrāhakamāpādya ityarthaḥ
tarkitaḥ pratyakṣapramāṇena niścito gocaraḥ tasmāt itaro'nyaḥ deśādyantarabhāvī bhāvaḥ tatra vidhiḥ vidhānam utpattiryasya sa tathoktaḥ tamiti
sa kiṃ karoti ? ityāha--budhyate abhitaḥ samantād viṣayān tarkeṇa iti vibhaktipariṇāmena saṃbandhaḥ

nanu smaraṇādiviṣayasya tatkāle'bhāvāt kathaṃ tena grahaṇam ? grāhakasamānasamayo hi viṣayaḥ tena gṛhyata iti yuktam, anyathā cakṣurādijñānamapi sarvātītādigrāhakaṃ syāditi cet; atrāha--śrotrādi ityādi
idaṃ vākyaṃ yathātathāśabdāvantareṇāpi prativastūpamālaṅkāravaśena vyāhṛtaṃ yathātathāśabdaṃ vyākhyeyam

śrotram ādiḥ yasya ghrāṇādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ yathā samupetameva svasannikṛṣṭameva nā'sannikṛṣṭaṃ viṣayīkurvīta viṣayam iti vacanapariṇāmena sambandhaḥ, cakṣuḥ navai naiva samupetameva viṣayīkurvīta tadasamupetameva viṣayaṃ viṣayīkurvan pratīyata iti manyate
yathā cakṣurādijñānaṃ svakālaviśeṣaṇaṃ vastu viṣayīkurvīta smaraṇādikaṃ tu bhinnakālaviśeṣaṇamapi iti, sarvatra tathāpratīteraviśeṣāt

etenedamapi nirastaṃ yaduktaṃ pra jñā ka re ṇa--smaraṇādikam atītādau pravarttamānaṃ nirviṣayaṃ tatkāle viṣayābhāvāt iti; tannirastam; cakṣurjñānamapi tathā nirviṣayaṃ syāt, taddeśe tadviṣayābhāvāt iti
atītegrahaṇe tasya rūpābhāve na sā smṛtiḥ
idānīṃ smaraṇaṃ jātaṃ kathaṃ jānāti pūrvatām
nanu saugatasya cakṣuriva śrotramapi na vai samupetameva viṣayīkurvīta cakṣuḥśrotramanasām aprāpyakāritvam iti rāddhāntāt kimucyate śrotrādi ityādi
dūre śabdaḥ nikaṭe śabdaḥ iti pratītiśca cakṣuriva śrotramaprāpyakāri iti cet; āstāṃ tāvadetat, āgamaprastāve asya nirūpayiṣyamāṇatvāt
atrāha vaiśeṣikaḥ--śrotrādivat bāhyendriyatvāt cakṣurapi samupetameva viṣayīkaroti, tat kimarthamuktam cakṣurna vai iti; taṃ pratyāha--paśyatyeva hi ityādi
hi yasmādarthaḥ, yat paśyatyeva īkṣata eva na na paśyati iti evakārārthaḥ, cakṣuḥ ityanuvarttate
nanu manaḥ paśyati na cakṣuḥ anyathā tatparikalpanamanarthakam iti cet; na; ātmānaṃ viṣayaṃ paśyantaṃ cakṣuḥ saha karoti iti tat paśyati ityucyata ityadoṣāt
saha antareṇa deśena nadyādinā dravyeṇa kācātpaṭalādinā varttamānaṃ ghaṭādikaṃ viṣayam iti vacanapariṇāmena sambandhaḥ

etaduktaṃ bhavati--cakṣuriti yadi golakasya lokavyavahārataḥ abhidhānamāśrīyate; tarhi tasya deśādivyavahitena ghaṭādinā pratyakṣataḥ tato'tyantabhinnena pratīyamānena sannikarṣasādhane pratyakṣabādhitakarmanirdeśānantaraprayuktatvena bāhyendriyatvāt iti kālātyayāpadiṣṭo hetuḥ syāt, yathā aśrāvaṇaḥ śabdaḥ sattvāt iti
prāptārthaprakāśakaṃ cakṣuḥ vyavahitārthāprakāśakatvāt pradīpavat bāhyendriyatvāt tvagindriyavat
sarṣapādeḥ sūkṣmāt pṛthu cakṣuḥ tasmāt atiśayena pṛthu parvatādikaṃ pṛthutaraṃ tat paśyati iti sambandhaḥ

atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--pūrvoktena vidhinā deśādinā deśādivyavahitena parvatādinā pramāṇabādhitatvānna cakṣuṣastena sannikarṣo'sti, tathāpi pādaprasārikatayā yadi iṣyate tarhi yataḥ parvatādipradeśasya pṛthuno jalabudbudasannibhena cakṣuṣā sambandhaḥ, tāvata eva tena grahaṇaṃ syāt na yojanādiparimāṇasya pṛthutarasya
na khalu hastena andhasya hastihastamātrasannikarṣe saṃpūrṇahastipratipattirasti
tato manyāmahe asannikṛṣṭaṃ paśyati cakṣuḥ iti
nanu na golakaviśeṣaḥ cakṣuḥ yenāyaṃ doṣaḥ syāt, api tu raśmayaḥ, teṣāṃ ca arthasannikṛṣṭānāṃ tatprakāśanasādhanāt
asmiṃśca pakṣe pṛthutaraṃ tat paśyati iti na vihanyate, mūle sūkṣmāṇāṃ pradīpādiraśmivat agre sthūlānāṃ bhāvāditi cet; atrāha--raśmeḥ ityādi
raśmiḥ iti jātivyapekṣayaikavacanam, vyaktyapekṣāyāṃ tu raśmīnāṃ cakṣuṣa iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
kutaḥ ? na kutaścit pramāṇāt niḥsṛtiḥpratipattiḥ gatyarthasya saraterjñānārthatvāt
nanu idamasti--raśmivaccakṣuḥ svaraśmisambaddhaṃ sarvatra svārthaṃ prakāśayati, taijasatvāt, pradīpavat iti cet; kuto'sya taijasatvam ? uṣṇasparśatvāt; na; tadviśeṣasya tatrā'bhāvāt
bhāsurarūpavattvāt; kimidaṃ rūpasya bhāsuratvam ? ujjvalatvamiti cet; na; asya nimittaṃ nistriṃśādau bhāvāt
kapiśatve sati iti cet; na; tasya varanārīlocaneṣu dugdhadhavaleṣu abhāvāt, kanakavacca kanakaketakīkusumadaleṣu bhāvāt
tayormahadaṇvorgrahaṇaṃ cakṣūraśmerarthasya ca sannikarṣaviśeṣād bhavati yathā pradīparaśmerarthasya ceti
tulanā--kṛṣṇasāraṃ raśmivat dravyatve sati rūpopalabdhau niyatasya sādhanāṅgasya nimittatvāt
athavā, raśmivaccakṣuḥ dravyatve sati niyatatve ca sati sphaṭikādivyavahitārthaprakāśakatvāt pradīpavat
sū॰ dṛśyante hi naktaṃ nayanaraśmayo naktañcarāṇāṃ vṛṣadaṃśaprabhṛtīnām, tena śeṣasyānumānam

apareṣāṃ darśanam--cakṣuḥ taijasaṃ rūpādīnāṃ madhye rūpasyaiva prakāśakatvāt pradīpavat iti; teṣāṃ sarve ghaṭādayaḥ prasiddhāḥ pāvakavat sattvāt taijasāḥ kinna syuḥ ? atha uṣṇabhāsurasparśarūpaviviktaghaṭādigrāhiṇā adhyakṣeṇa pakṣasya bādhanāt naivam; prakṛte'pi samānametat

kiṃca, na taijasaṃ cakṣuḥ atyāsannā'prakāśakatvāt, yat punaḥ taijasaṃ tad atyāsannasyāpi prakāśakaṃ yathā pradīpādiḥ iti vyati rekī hetuḥ atra kinna vijṛmbhate ? na cāyaṃ parasya agamakaḥ; anyathā sātmakaṃ jīvaccharīraṃ prāṇādimattvāt iti na subhāṣitam
yadi prāpyakāri syāt tvagindriyavat spṛṣṭamañjanaṃ gṛhṇīyāt
yadi vā, tamaḥprakāśakatvāt; yat punaḥ taijasaṃ na tat tamaḥprakāśakaṃ yathā pradīpādi iti grāhyam
tamo nirodhi vīkṣyante tamasā nāvṛtaṃ param

pradīpādyālokābhāve'pi ca kvacid rūpajñānasya udayadarśanāt kathaṃ tadālokasya niyamena rūpaprakāśakatvam, yataḥ sādhanavikalo dṛṣṭānto na bhavet ? tadevaṃ nāyanaraśmīnāmasiddheḥ teṣāṃ cakṣuḥśabdavācyatvena dharmitve bāhyendriyatvāt iti āśrayasvarūpāsiddho heturiti yatkiñcidetat
idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam--raśmeḥ cakṣūraśmīnāṃ kutaḥ kāraṇāt niḥsṛtiḥ nirgamanaṃ svādhiṣṭhānāt
nahi akāraṇam adṛṣṭaṃ sattayā kalpanamarhati, atiprasaṅgāt
tatra yadi golakavat tadraśmīnāmapi arthasambandho na syāt kutastatprakāśanam ? asti ca
tathāhi--yathā mana ātmanā saṃyuktam, so'pi ākāśena, tadapi sarvabhāvaiḥ iti sambandhasambandhāt tadarthaprakāśakam
na khalu tasya tadraśmīnāñca svārthena saṃyogaḥ paraiḥ abhyupagamyate
tathā cakṣuḥ manasā, tadapi ātmanā saṃyuktam, so'pi ākāśena, tadapi sarvabhāvaiḥ iti sambandhasambandhāt tadarthaprakāśakam
na khalu tasya tadraśmīnāṃ svārthena saṃyogaḥ paraiḥ abhyupagamyate
tathā, cakṣuḥ manasā tadapi ātmanā so'pi viṣayaiḥ saṃyukta iti sambandhāt cakṣurapi tatprakāśakamityalaṃ raśminirgamanakalpanayā
na ca indriyatvā'viśeṣe'pi manaḥ tathā prakāśa ṣepirakṣuḥ iti na viśeṣaṃ paśyāmaḥ
evaṃ śākhācandramasoryugapadgrahaṇamupapannaṃ bhavati, anyathā krameṇa gacchatāṃ raśmīnāṃ pūrvaṃ śākhayā saṃyoga iti tasyā eva grahaṇaṃ punaḥ candramasā iti tasya grahaṇamiti kramapratipattiḥ syāt
tulanā--karaṇaṃ vāsyādi prāpyakāri dṛṣṭaṃ tathā cendriyāṇi tasmāt prāpyakārīṇi
atyabhyāse ca dūre ca rūpaṃ vyaktaṃ na tatra kim
yadi cakṣuḥ prāpyakāritvāt viṣayadeśaṃ gacchet tadā unmiṣitamātreṇa na candratārakādīnarthān gṛhṇīyāt

utpalapatraśatavedhavat śākhācandramasorgrahaṇasya āśubhāvāt yaugapadyapratipattibhrama ityanye; tanna; mūrttasya asarvagatasya sūcīdravyasya tatpatraiḥ bhinnadeśaiḥ krameṇa sambandhāt yukto yugapattvavibhramaḥ nānyatra tadviparīte, itarathā evam ekajñānavārttā nirmūlā syād varākī
yatpunaretat-śākhācandramasostulyakālagrahaṇamiti; tadapi na; anabhyupagamāt ko hi svasthātmā śākhācandramasoḥ tulyakālagrahaṇaṃ pratipadyate
yadi matam--anyatrāpi tathāvidhasya raśmerbhinnadeśābhyāṃ śākhācandramobhyām saṃyogaḥ krameṇa iti; syādetadevaṃ yadi sūcīdravyavat kutaścid raśmigamanapratipattiḥ syāt, na sā asti ityuktam
tathāhi--krameṇa raśmigamanasiddhau tadvibhramasiddhiḥ tadvibhramasiddhau ca krameṇa raśmigamanasiddhiḥ iti
nanu yasya sakalajñeyagrahaṇasvabhāvaṃ jñānaṃ tatsvabhāvaśca ātmā kathaṃ tasya sa kasyacidapyarthasya svayaṃ grāhako yataḥ akṣāpekṣasya arthe kramagrahaḥ syāt sarvajñavat
āvaraṇasadbhāvāt svayamagrāhaka iti cet; kutaḥ tatsiddhiḥ ? na pratyakṣataḥ; tatra tadapratibhāsanāt
deśādīnām āvaraṇatve sarvajñābhāvaḥ, teṣāṃ sarvadā bhāvāt
anyasya anumānato na pratipattiḥ; tadarthāpaka liṅgābhāvāt

atha sarvaviṣayaprakāśanasvabhāvasya tadaprakāśanāt tatsiddhiḥ; tatsvabhāvatā kutastasya siddhā ? tadāvaraṇāpāye sarvaprakāśanasvabhāvatvāt; anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ--siddhe hi sarvaprakāśanasvabhāve sati āvaraṇasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau tatkṣaye tatprakāśanasvabhāvasiddhiḥ iti cet; atrāha--mithyājñānam ityādi
matyajñānabhedā avagrahādayaḥ pramāṇābhāsā mithyāgrahaṇātmakāḥ, pramāṇasya avipratisāralakṣaṇatvāt
svataḥ pramāṇabhūtasya ātmanaḥ parato viparyāsopapatteḥ mattamūrcchitādivat
yadi punaḥ svata eva jñātā na syāt kutaḥ parato'cetanavat

parasya anyātiśayakalpanāyāmātmanaḥ kinna kalpyate ? jñasvabhāvasya aprāpyakāriṇaḥ pratibandhābhāve trikālagocaramaśepaṃ dravyaṃ kathañcijjānato na kaścidvirodhaḥ, ātmanaḥ svaviṣaye vaiśadyamanubhavataḥ parokṣapratyakṣavat
svalakṣaṇadarśanāhitasantānavikalpavāsanāprakṛtiḥ saṃvṛtiḥ vastumātrādhyavasāyāt vyavahāramāracayatīti cet; na; kṣaṇikaikānte arthakriyāvirodhanirṇayāt
asyāyamarthaḥ--yat tasmin mithyājñānam apramāṇaṃ visaṃvādāt vañcanāt prasiddhaṃ hi loke prakṛtyādiviṣayaṃ tat dharmi
jīvasya svaviṣaye pravṛttiniṣedhakaṃ jñānāvaraṇīyādi karma āvaraṇaṃ tasya udbhūtiḥ svakāryakaraṇābhimukhyaṃ tasyāḥ, bhavati iti śeṣaḥ
doṣaḥ anyathāgrahaṇaṃ sa eva hetuḥ liṅgaṃ tasmāt
viṣam ādiryasya surādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ tasmādiva tadvaditi
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā viṣādeḥ upajāyamānaṃ bhūbhramaṇādiviṣayaṃ viṣādyāvaraṇodbhūteḥ bhavati tathā prakṛtyādiviṣayamapi, tadadṛṣṭāvaraṇodbhūteḥ iti

prayogaḥ--vivādagocarāpannaṃ mithyājñānam āvaraṇodbhūterbhavati, mithyājñānatvāt mithyājñānasya upalakṣaṇārthatvāt tena ajñānatvād aspaṣṭatvāditi ca gṛhyate, viṣādijanitatathāvidhajñānavat, evamarthaṃ ca viṣādigrahaṇam, tadupayoge tatriyānanivṛtteḥ iti
atrāha sautrāntikādiḥ--mithyājñānāt prāk tadādhārasya svaviṣayaprakāśanasvabhāvasya bhāve kasyacid āvaraṇakalpanā śreyasī; na ca so'sti pramāṇābhāvāt
mithyājñānamapi nirādhāraṃ jāyate ādeśāḥ citravaitasikā iti vacanāt
tatastasyāpi āvaraṇakalpanā kīdṛśī ? tatra bhāvāntarādarśanāditi pakṣasya pratyakṣabādho dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyavaikalya miti; taṃ pratyāha--jñātuḥ iti
yaḥ prāk śaṅkhaṃ śuklatayā jñātavān, saṃprati jānāti pītatayā, punarjñāsyati śuklatayā sa jñātā ityucyate
sa ca pratyakṣaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ vicitraviṣayākāraikasaṃvedanam siddhivi॰ 2
3 ityādinā leśataḥ pradarśitaḥ, prapañcataḥ punaratraiva pradarśayiṣyate
taduktaṃ nyā ya vi ni śca ye--
vaiśeṣikastvāha--jñānotpatteḥ prāk ātmā vidyate, sa tu tadā jñānābhāvādeva viṣayaṃ santamapi na viṣayīkaroti nāvaraṇāditi; daivaraktāḥ kiṃśukāḥ iti na tatra naḥ prayāsaḥ āvaraṇasādhane
tatra kevalaṃ dharmādisāmagrītaḥ samīcīnajñānam, anyasyāḥ bhithyājñānamiti vibhāga iti
svātmarūpeṇa na arthāntarajñānasambandhena jñātuḥ iti vṛttau pratipādayiṣyate
vibhramaikāntavādī prāha--bhavatu kaścit svayaṃ jñātā, sa ca svabhāvata eva viparītārthagrāhī nāvaraṇāditi; tata uttaraṃ paṭhanti--sato'vitathasya yathāvasthitasvārthagrahaṇasvabhāvasya ityarthaḥ
svataḥ ityetadatrāpi sambandhanīyam, kathamanyathā vibhramaikāntasyāpi pratipattiḥ

paraḥ punarevaṃ manyate--svatastasya mithyādarśanātmakatvam anyato yathārthadarśanātmakatvamiti; sa viṣāt ityanena nirastaḥ; viṣādyupayogānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitayā dṛśyamānasya mithyādarśanasya anyataḥ kalpane dhūmo'pi agniprabhavo na syāt

svataśca mithyātvena sarvasaṃvidāṃ kutaḥ svasaṃvedanaparamārtha siddhiḥ ? nahi tatra pūrvasaṃvedanādanyasya vyāpāraḥ cakṣurāderviṣayapratiniyamaḥ vipayāt tadākāratā ālokāt spaṣṭatā vijñānād vijñānasya vidrūpatā
nāpi svasaṃvedanaparamārthā'siddhau saugatāḥ sukhamāsituṃ kālakalāleśamapi samarthāḥ, kasyacid vidhiniṣedhāyogāt

nanvevaṃ cedidamanumānaṃ tarhi mithyājñānamapramāṇam ityevāstu, kiṃ visaṃvādāt ityanena iti cet ? ucyate--vivādāspadībhūtaṃ mithyājñānam adṛṣṭāvaraṇam iti sādhayantaṃ prati yadā kaścid bravīti kasyacin mithyājñānasya abhāvāt sādhyadṛṣṭāntadharmiṇorasiddhiḥ iti; tadā taṃ prati taddharmiṇaḥ sādhanārtham visaṃvādāt ityucyate

yataḥ abhyupagacchatāpi pra jñā ka re ṇa pratibhāsādvaitam idam ato jāyate, idamasmād dūraṃ nikaṭam ityādi vikalpabuddhīnāṃ nirviṣayatvā'paranāmā visaṃvādo'bhyupagantavyaḥ kathamanyathā pratibhāsādvaitam ? tathā ca kathaṃ dharmyasiddhiḥ ? tathāpi mithyājñānaṃ visaṃvādāt ityastu kim apramāṇapadena iti cet ? na; anumānena āvaraṇasattā sādhyate bhavatā, tacca mithyā tatkutaḥ tato bhāvataḥ tatsiddhiḥ iti vadantaṃ prati evamabhidhānāt
atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--anumānaṃ cet mithyātvapekṣyate; tarhi visaṃvādādapramāṇaṃ syāt, pramāṇaṃ ceṣyate, tanna mithyā iti

nanu syādedat pramāṇaṃ yadi visaṃvādakaṃ syāt, yāvatā mithyātve'pi maṇiprabhāmaṇijñānavat sādhya pratibandhādavisaṃvādakamiti cet; nanu tanmaṇijñānam avisaṃvāde'pi yadi na pramāṇam; kvathamanumānaṃ tallakṣaṇavyabhicārāt ? pramāṇaṃ cet; pratyakṣam, anumānaṃ vā ? anyatra maṇyadhyavasāyaḥ anyatra maṇiprāpteḥ nādhyakṣam, itarathā marīcikānicaye jalādhyavasāyaḥ kūpādau jalaprāptau adhyakṣaṃ syāt

bhavati jātaparitoṣasya iti codavadet yadi maṇibhrāntiḥ indriyajñānam, na caivam, rūpasādharmyadarśanāpekṣaṇāt, akṣavikāramantareṇa bhāvāt, vāvakaiḥ santānāntareṇa samarpaṇāt, pratisaṃkhyānena bādhanāt, mānasī tu yuktā yukta rajatabhrāntivat
bhavatu mānasī neratasya pramāṇamiti cet; pratyakṣād anyasyāṃ tadanurodhāt pratyakṣatve darśanapṛṣṭhabhāvino vikalpasya vyavahāriṇaṃ prati smṛtitvavarṇanamayuktam
na khalu vyavahārī darśanād vikalpamanyamicchati manasoryugapadvṛtteḥ pra॰ vā॰ 2

astu nāma tamaḥ tadanyatra maṇiprāpteḥ dhūmādagnivat, pūrvaṃ ca tatprabhāvyavasāyaḥ syāt, vṛkṣādhyavasāye śiṃśapādhyavasāyavat, na caivam, avicāraikamajātaparitoṣaṃ vyavahāriṇaṃ prati tadaprāmāṇyavarṇanāt

etena kāryaliṅgatvaṃ tayornirastam; tadadhyavasāyāt prāg agnivyavasāyavat prabhādhyavasāyena bhavitavyamiti kutastatra maṇyadhyavasāyaḥ ? nahi dhūmaṃ niścinvataḥ pāvakasya anyasya vā adhyavasāyo dṛṣṭaḥ
tatra maṇivyavasāyasya anumānatve maṇipradīpaprabhayoḥ pra॰ vā॰ 2
yastarhi avadhāritaviśeṣaḥ evamanumānaṃ karoti— prabhāvānayaṃ gṛhapradeśaviśeṣaḥ maṇisahitaprabhāviśeṣatvāt anyatropalabdhaivaṃvidhatatpradeśavat
kuñcikāvivaraprabhāviśeṣo vāyaṃ maṇisaṃsthānavān tadviśeṣatvāt pūrvopalabdhatadviśeṣavat iti, tatra kā vārttā ? anumānameva taditi brūmaḥ
ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ--yadyetat mithyājñānamapramāṇaṃ kathamanyasya tathāvidhasya anumānasya prāmāṇye dṛṣṭāntaḥ syāt ? na khalu sādhyameva dṛṣṭāntībhavati atiprasaṅgāt
tataḥ sthitam--anumānaṃ cet mithyājñānam apramāṇaṃ syāt, arthādutpattau taimirikajñānavat ityasya pradarśanārtham apramāṇagrahaṇamiti

tathāhi--yaduktam anantaraprastāve tadetad dravyaparyāyasāmānyaviśeṣaviṣayam ityādi pramāṇam avisaṃvādāt ityantam; tatra tajjñānasya vedama svabhāve ātmani samavāyāt sa eva tāṃstathā budhyata iti naiyāyikādiḥ
śarīre samavāyāt śarīraṃ na manaḥ iti cārvākāḥ
tajjñānaṃ svataḥ pramāṇaṃ na parataḥ iti mīmāṃsakāḥ
na hi svato'satī śaktiḥ kartumanyena pāryate
jñātuḥ avagrahādimatismṛti saṃjñācintābhinibodhātmakaṃ prāgabhilāpasaṃsargāt matijñānaprabhedalakṣaṇaṃ jñānam iti sambandhaḥ
na śarīrasya pradhānasya vā; tasya jñātṛtvāyogāditi nirūpayiṣyate acetanatvāt ghaṭādivat iti
kuto jñātuḥ ? ityāha--svataḥ svasvābhāvyāt, nārthāntarajñānasambandhāditi ca
anena svakārye pravṛttilakṣaṇe svagrahaṇāpekṣaṇāt parataḥ tat ityuktaṃ bhavati
svato jñātuḥ sakāśāt iti kā vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ, utpatteḥ iti śeṣaḥ, pramāṇam iti ghaṭanāt
anenāpi kāraṇaguṇatastadudbhavāt parataḥ tad iti; manyate
atra dṛṣṭāntamāha--pramāṇaṃ mithyājñānaṃ visaṃvādāt āvaraṇodbhūteśca yathā parataḥ iti śeṣaḥ, āvaraṇād udbhūtiḥ āvaraṇodbhūtiḥ iṇo
śeṣam uktavat a na nta kī rtti kṛ teḥ sva taḥ prā mā ṇya bha ṅgā d avaseyametat
yadi vā, doṣahetoḥ ityādi anyathāvatārya adhunā vyākhyāyate--kuto nu khalu āvaraṇodbhūtiḥ ? yadi svataḥ; mithyājñānamapi tata eva astu
parataścet; sa vaktavyaḥ, na ca so'sti, apramāṇatvāt
nahi bījamiva aṅkuram āvaraṇaṃ janayan kaścidupalabhyate anumīyate vā liṅgābhāvāt
rāgādiḥ upalabhyate; satyam; kintu tadanantarameva āvaraṇaṃ jāyamānaṃ nopalabhyate anumīyate vā
bhavatu vā sakāraṇamāvaraṇam, tathāpi tena mūrtena amūrtasya ātmanaḥ pāṃśurāśinā iva ākāśasya na sambandha iti; atrāha--doṣahetoḥ ityādi
doṣo rāgādiḥ sa eva hetuḥ kāraṇaṃ tasmāt āvaraṇodbhūteḥ yadvā sa heturyasyāḥ tasyā iti
tathāhi--mithyājñānādanumitā āvaraṇodbhūtiḥ jñātṛrāgādipūrvikā tadupaghātahetutvād viṣādivat iti
vakṣyati ca--manodhyakṣāyakarmanirāśravaiḥ śubhairaśubhaiśca yathāsvaṃ puṇyapāpabandho jīvānām siddhivi॰ prastā॰ 4 ityādi
yaduktam--amūrttasya kathaṃ mūrttena sambandha iti ? tadapyanena nirastam; tatsambandhahetordoṣasya amūrtte'pi bhāvāt
etadapi vakṣyati--malairnisargād badhyeta siddhivi॰ prastā॰ 4 ityādinā
doṣasya hetoḥ viṣayāderiva tadvad iti vā vyākhyeyam
kārikāṃ vivṛṇvannāha--matyādi matyajñānabhedā matyajñānaviśeṣāḥ, upalakṣaṇametat tena śrutājñānādibhedā gṛhyante
te kim ? ityāha--pramāṇābhāsāḥ pramāṇaṃ na bhavanti ityarthaḥ
nanu anumānajñānam anyathāsthitaṃ svalakṣaṇam anyathā gṛhṇadapi pramāṇaṃ tato nedamapramāṇalakṣaṇaṃ vyabhicārāditi cet; atrāha--pramāṇasya ityādi
pramāṇasyāpi pratisāro yathāvasthitārthanirṇayo lakṣaṇaṃ yasya tasya bhāvāt tattvāt

etaduktaṃ bhavati--pramāṇatvaṃ yathārthanirṇayena vyāptaṃ sarvaprāṇabhṛtāṃ siddham, mithyaikāntādipravāde'pi tadviṣayasyaiva paramārthato jñānasya pramāṇatvopavarṇanāt parairapi, tato yathārthe nivartamāne tadapi nivarttate yathā vṛkṣatve nivartamāne śiṃśapātvam, anyathā sarvasya pramāṇamiti na kaścit svapakṣasiddhivikalaḥ syāditi
śeṣamatra cintitam, cintayiṣyate cānakasya kathambhūtasya kuto bhavanti ? ityāha--svataḥ ityādi
svataḥ ātmano jīvasya na nirādhāro nāpi śarīrasya pradhānasya vā
atrāpi ātmanaḥ ityapekṣyam, ātmanaḥ parataḥ mūrttakarmaṇaḥ sakāśāt yā viparyāsopapattiḥ anyathāsvabhāvāpādanaṃ tasyāḥ
yathā mattādeḥ parato viṣādeḥ viparyāsopapatteḥ mithyā'vagrahādayaḥ tathā anyasyāpi iti nidarśanārthaḥ
etena idamapi pratyuktaṃ yaduktaṃ pareṇa-- karmaṇā ātmasvarūpā'khaṇḍane tadavasthaṃ jainasya sarvasya sarvadarśitvam, khaṇḍane ātmā'nityatvam
āvaraṇaṃ ca prakāśyaprakāśakayoḥ antarāle varttamānaṃ ghaṭapradīpayoriva prāvaraṇam prakāśyasyaiva prakāśanaṃ pratibadhnāti na prakāśakasya
nahi antaryavanikayā dīpasya ātmaprakāśanaṃ pratihanyate iti ātmanaḥ tasmin satyapisarvathā svarūpaprakāśanaṃ syāt
iti; kathañcit ātmasvarūpakhaṇḍanasya abhimatatvāt, ātmanaḥ parato viparyāsopapattivarṇanāt, anyathā ko'syārthaḥ syāt, kathañcidanityatvasya va sarvathā anyatrāpi tadasaṃbhavāt
dṛśyate hi kiṭṭikālikādinā kaluṣitavapuṣām anyadīnāṃ svarūpe'pi citraprakāśanam--
yadi cet, punaḥ iti vitarke pakṣāntarasūcane vā, svata eva svasvabhāvata eva svakāraṇādeva yo jñātā yathārthagrāhī na syāt na bhaved ātmā iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
tatra ko doṣaḥ ? ityāha— parataḥ ityādi
svarūpāt svahetorvā paraṃ jñānaṃ tataḥ, kuto naiva syāt jñātā iti sambandhaḥ
ghaṭādiḥ acetanaḥ tena tulyaṃ varttate iti tadvat iti
prayogaśca--yo jñānasvabhāvarahito nāsau jñātā yathā ghaṭādiḥ, jñānasvabhāvarahitaśca parasya ātmā iti
nanu kimidamacetanamiti ? cetanā'samavāyikāraṇam; tatsamavāyikāraṇaṃ tarhi cetanaṃ prasaktamiti ātmāpi cetana iti katham ajñātā, cetanasyaiva tadvyapadeśādityabhyupagamavirodhaḥ
na ca cetanāsvabhāvo na tatsamavāyikāraṇam; arūpādisvabhāvasyāpi ghaṭāde rūpādisamavāyikāraṇatvopapatteḥ

atha cetanāyāḥ anyadacetanam syāt; na ca tadasti, pramāṇā'bhāvāditi dṛṣṭāntamātramaśeṣamiti na sādhyadharmisaṃbhavaḥ, tadbhāve vā tata evāsiddheḥ kimetena anumānena ? ata eva tatsiddhau anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ--tathā hato tasya ātmatattvasiddhau anye ghaṭādayo dṛṣṭāntībhavanti, tataśca tatsiddhiḥ iti
yadi punaḥ acetanatvāviśeṣe'pi ātmana āśrayatvaṃ ghaṭādestat acetanavat iti sāmānyavacanena labhyate iti cet; na; ubhayathāpyadoṣāt

tathāhi--astu tāvaccetanā'samavāyikāraṇam acetanaṃ ghaṭādi, cetanaṃ ca tatsamavāyikāraṇam, tathāpi na ityupagamamāhāniḥ , cetanāpariṇāmakāraṇasyaiva samavāyikāraṇatvāt nānyasya, anyathā cakṣurāderapi tatkāraṇatvaprasaṅgāt
tatra tasyāḥ asamavāyānneti cet; atha ko'yaṃ tatra samavāyaḥ ? tasmin sati ātmalābha iti cet; prasaṅgaḥ pūrvavadbhavet
tasmin sati tadātmana udbhava iti cet; na kiñcit parihṛtam
tadādheyatvam ityapi vārttam; bhūtale kalaśādeḥ samavāyaprasaṅgāt
ayutasiddhasya iti cet; kimidamayutasiddhasya iti ? apṛthaksiddhasyeti cet; na; apṛthaksiddhatvaṃ yadi kāraṇādekāntenābhinnasiddhatvam; sāṃkhyadarśanam
syānmatam— kāraṇābhinnadeśakālaprabhavatvam; ākāśādi samavāyikāraṇaṃ kinna syāt ? nahi taddeśādiparihāreṇa cetanāsaṃbhavaḥ tadasarvagatatvaprasaṅgāt
buddhyātmapradeśasya cakṣurādyabhinnadeśāditve buddherapi tadbhavati na veti cintyatām
tataḥ cetanaiva cetanāsamavāyikāraṇam, tadakāraṇamacetanam iti sthitam

yatpunaruktam--arūpādisvabhāvā ghaṭādayo rūpādisamavāyikāraṇamiti; tadapyanena nirastam; nanu ghaṭādivat ātmano'pi atatsvabhāvasya cetanāsamavāyikāraṇatve sādhyadṛṣṭāntayoraviśeṣa iti cet; āstāṃ tāvadetat, anantaraṃ nirūpaṇāt

bhavatu vā cetanāyā anyadacetanam, tathāpi na sarvasya dṛṣṭāntā'viśeṣaḥ, acetanatve'pi ātmanaḥ sādhyadharmitvena upādānāt, anyad acetanaṃ dṛṣṭāntībhavati, yathā piṇḍo'yaṃ sāsnādimān govat ityukte anyo gauḥ dṛṣṭāntībhavati

idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam--yadi punaḥ svata eva svanaiva rūpeṇa jñātā arthagrahaṇapariṇāmī na syād ātmā parato'samavāyi-nimittakāraṇāt kutaḥ syāt ? naiva nahi tathāpariṇāmasvabhāvarahitasya kasyacid anyaḥ tathāpariṇāmaḥ acetanavat pṛthivyādivat iti, lokāyatāpekṣayā ghaṭādivat iti

nanu yaduktam--'ātmanaḥ cetanasyābhede tadvat cakṣurādirapi tatsamavāyikāraṇaṃ syāt, bhedasya samavāyasya vā'viśeṣāditi; tanna yuktam; bhedā'viśeṣe'pi kasyacideva kasyāścit pratyāsatteḥ kāryaṃ prati tatkāraṇatvopapatteḥ, citratvād bhāvaśaktīnāmiti cet; atrāha--parasya ityādi
parasya jñātuḥ anyasya kāraṇasya atiśayasya sāmarthyasya kalpanāyāṃ svata eva ityanuvarttate, anyathā anavasthā syāditi manyate
ātmanaḥ kinna kalpayet svata eva grahaṇātiśayaṃ naiyāyikaḥ, kalpayedeva nyāyasya samānatvāditi manyate

athavā, anyathā pūrvapakṣayitvā idaṃ vyākhyeyam--'nātmā svataḥ parato vā jñātā tasya jñānasambandhā'bhāvāt, api tu pradhānaṃ jñātṛ viparyayāt, tatastasyaiva mithyājñānagrahādayaḥ parato viparyāsopapatteḥ pariṇāmitvāt, nātmano viparyayāt iti sāṃkhyaḥ; taṃ pratyāha--parasya ityādi
parasya ātmano'nyasya pradhānasya atiśayakalpanāyāṃ yathārthetarajñānasāmarthyakalpanāyām ātmanaḥ puruṣasya tamatiśayaṃ kinna kalpyate, yataḥ sāṃkhyapradhānavad ātmano'pi pariṇāmā'virodhāditi manyate
nanu bhavatu svato jñātā ātmā sāvaraṇaśca tathāpi āvaraṇābhāve akṣavyāpārasamakālameva bhāvato'rthaṃ viṣayīkarotu tanmātra eva tatsāmarthyāt
tadyathā--pradīpaḥ anāvaraṇe'pi svayogyameva prakāśayati na sarvam iti pra jñā ka raḥ; tatrāha--jñasvabhāvasya ityādi
jānāti iti jñaḥ svabhāvo yasya jñasvabhāvasya ātmanaḥ jānato na kaścid virodhaḥ
anena rūpādyavayavātmana ekasya sthavīyasaḥ tena grahaṇāditi manyate
vartamānakālaviśeṣaṇaṃ tattasya jānato na virodha iti cet; atrāha--trikālagocaram
trayaḥ kālo gocaro yasya tat tathoktaṃ trikālāvayavirūpamityarthaḥ
evamapi khaṇḍaśo jānata ityāha— aśeṣaṃ sarvam

tathāhi— pūrvaṃ cakṣurādinā navatvaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasya ghaṭasya grahaṇam, punaḥ tasyaiva tena purāṇaviśiṣṭasya, tadanantaraṃ pūrvaparyāyaviśiṣṭasya smaraṇāt, pratyabhijñānāt pūrvāparaparyāyayoḥ tāṃ yāvaḥ , tarkeṇa janmādimaraṇaparyantaṃ paryāyāṇām ekatvāvinābhāvināṃ darśanasmaraṇābhijñānajanmanā sākalyena sāmānyataḥ svasādhyā'vinābhāve teṣāṃ gṛhīte sati, dravyasya anantatā anumānataḥ pratīyate iti
eke anumānajanmanā mānasapratyakṣetva katham iti cintyam
yasya jñānasya svaviṣaye pravartamānasya yat pratibandhakaṃ karma tasya abhāve sati
nanu jñānasvabhāvasya pratibandharahitasyāpi abhinnadeśakālā'rthagrahaṇamātmanaḥ; anyathā atiprasaṅga iti cet; atrāha--aprāpyakāriṇaḥ
prāptuṃ grāhakasamānadeśakālaṃ kartuṃ śakyaṃ prāptaṃ yanna tathā bhavati tadaprāpyaṃ kartuṃ gṛhītuṃ śīlasya aprāpyakāriṇaḥ, deśavat kālabhinnasyāpi grahaṇe virodhā'bhāvāditi manyate
yastu manyate svarūpādanyatra na jñānasya pravṛttiḥ tatkathamucyate aprāpyakāriṇa iti ? sa dṛṣṭavyo bhavati--kathaṃ svarūpe vṛttiḥ ? tatra varttamānasya darśanāditi cet; taditaratra samānam
atrāha mīmāṃsakaḥ--tadaśeṣaṃ jānataḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ pramāṇairna kaścid virodhaḥ iti
yathopavarṇitasya ātmanaḥ svaviṣayaṃ sat sarvam anyathā vyāptyapratipattiḥ, tatra vaiśadyamanubhavato na kaścid virodhaḥ pratibandhābhāve ityanuvarttate
nanu pratyakṣaparokṣavat iti vaktavyam nyāyyatvāditi cet; na; paramatāpekṣayā evamabhidhānāt
