tathā hi--yaduktaṃ pra jñā ka re ṇa--kathamekatra kramavittayo'vagamyante yato'śeṣaṃ dravyaṃ kathaṃvijñānato na kaścid virodha iti syāt iti taduddiśya parokṣaṃ sādhāraṇaspaṣṭākāraviṣayamānādivikalpajñānaṃ tacca tatpratyakṣaṃ ca svarūpāpekṣayā tena tulyaṃ varttate iti tadvad iti vyākhyeyam
yathā ekaṃ yugapad ākāradvayasādhāraṇamavagamyate tathā krameṇa anekavittisādhāraṇamiti manyate
cakārābhāve vi sat pratyakṣamucyate tasya iva tadvat iti vyākhyeyam
yadi ṣaḍbhiḥ pramāṇaiḥ syāt sarvajñaḥ kena vāryate
ekena tu pramāṇena sarvajño yena kalpyate
nūnaṃ sa cakṣuṣā sarvān rasādīn pratipadyate
pakṣe pramāṇābādhaṃ dṛṣṭānte sādhyaṃ darśayannāha saugataḥ--nāsmākam ityādi

nāsmākaṃ saugatānām āvaraṇaṃ ca jñānāvaraṇīyādikarma, kṣayaśca upaśamaśca anyasya aprakṛtatvāt aśruteḥ, svāvaraṇasyaiva kṣaya upaśamaśca gṛhyate teṣāṃ ca sā buddhiḥ nāvaraṇavaśāt mithyābuddhiḥ yena matyajñānabhedāt ityādi śobheta
nāpi tatkṣayopaśamavaśād yathārthabuddhiḥ yato jñasvabhāvasya ityādi ca
kutaḥ tarhi sā ? ityatrāha--api tu, kintu svakāraṇaśakteḥ mithyābuddheḥ kāraṇaṃ kadācit kaluṣitaṃ locanādi timirāśubhramaṇa nyāyabi॰ 1
6 ityādi vacanāt, yathārthabuddheḥ tadeva viparītam, tasya śaktiḥ yathoktajñānajananasāmarthyam tasyā buddhiḥ iti sambandhaḥ
mandaṃ hi bhrāmyamāṇe alātādau na cakrabhrāntirutpadyate tadarthamāśugrahaṇena viśeṣyate bhramaṇam
gacchantyāṃ nāvi sthitasya gacchadvṛkṣādibhrāntirutpadyata iti yānagrahaṇam
nanu yathā kāmalādyupaliptāccakṣurādeḥ indriyajā bhrāntiḥ tathā karmā''varaṇopaliptātmanaḥ sā mānasī vikalpabhrāntiriti; atrāha--svalakṣaṇa ityādi
svalakṣaṇadarśanena āhite sthāpite santāne yā vikalpavāsanā vikalpakāraṇabhūtā vāsanā
yadi vā, taddarśanāhitā svakāryajananaṃ pratyabhimukhīkṛtā pūrvapūrvavikalpajanitā vāsanā tasyāḥ prakṛteḥ svabhāvāt nāvaraṇodbhūteḥ saṃvṛtiḥ svataḥ udbhūtā tattvasaṃvaraṇāt sāmānyāditikalpabuddhiḥ
sā kiṃ karoti ? ityāha--vyavahāraṃ mithyetararūpam āracayati

nanu mattamūrcchitādeḥ indriyajā mānasī bhrāntiḥ viṣādimūrttyasavasaṃya kaluṣitaprāktanānmanaso dṛṣṭāpi yadṛṣṭatathāvidhabhāvasaṃparkamanaḥpūrvikā kalpyate; tarhi kṣityādeḥ bījasahakṛtāyā dṛṣṭo'pi aṅkuraḥ khalavilādivyavahite bīje aṅkuro dṛśyamānaḥ kṣityādereva kinna kalpyate ? tathā, yadyathā yathā madirādipratibandhanivṛttiḥ tathā jñāneṣu mithyātvanivṛttirdṛṣṭāpi yadyanyathā syāt; na tarhi kāraṇanivṛttiprayuktā kāryanivṛttiriti na kvacid vyavatiṣṭheta ityabhiprāyavatā mithyājñānam ityādi vadatā etat parihṛtaṃ yadyapi tathāpi bhaṅgyantareṇa pariharannāha--na ityādi
kutaḥ ? ityāha--kṣaṇikaikānte arthasya kāryasya kriyā karaṇaṃ tadvirodhasya nirṇayād anantarātītaprastāve iti śeṣaḥ
satyāṃ ca kāryakāraṇatāyāṃ kutaḥ kvacit santānaniyamaḥ ? sarvatra sarvepāmānantaryā viśeṣāt
tadvirodhanirṇayāt kāryakāraṇatā kāryatā kāraṇatā vā naiva
mā bhūt sā, tathāpi kim ? ityāha--santatiḥ santānaḥ kutaḥ cittānām iti sambandhaḥ
bhavatu vā tatra teṣāṃ kāraṇatā tathāpi doṣaḥ, ityāha--vāsyavāsakatā pūrvacittaṃ tasya vāsakatā, uttaracittasya vāsyatā kutaḥ naiva
kutaḥ ? bhedāt nānātvāt ekasantānatvena abhimatacittānām iti ghaṭanā
satyāmapi kāryakāraṇatāyāṃ kvacit lakṣaṇaikānte kuto na kutaścit santānaniyamaḥ— ayam ekaḥ santānaḥ, ete ca nānāsantānāḥ iti vibhāgaḥ; tadekānte ityanusambandhaḥ
nanu yeṣāṃ kṣaṇānām ānantaryeṇa pūrvāparabhāvaḥ teṣāmekasantānatvam anyeṣāṃ viparyaya iti cet; atrāha--sarvatra sarveṣām ityādi
sarveṣāṃ bhinnaikasantānapātināṃ kṣaṇānām ānantaryā'viśeṣāt sarvatra bahirantarvā
yadvā, sarvatra kāryakāraṇābhimatānām sarveṣāṃ tadaviśeṣāt iti pratyeyam

atrāparaḥ prāha--nānantaryāt santānaniyamaḥ, anyathāpi tadbhāvāt, jāgatprabodhacetasoriveti; tasya samānaṃ kālaṃścaye jāgraccetāṃsi kasyacit prabodhasya ekasantānāni kuto na bhavanti ? deśādi deśasya bhedasya sarvatrāviśeṣāt
ekasya anekopādānābhāvāt na iti cet; kathamekasmād devadattajāgradvijñānāt prabodhajñānapañcakaṃ kadācit bhavati
teṣāṃ tadvijñānāt pūrvajñānopādānatve naikasāmagyadhīnaḥ bhāvānāṃ sahabhāvaḥ iti niḥsārametat--ekasāmagryadhīnasya pra॰ vā॰ 3
tadbhāve'pi na jñāyate kiṃ kasya tatropādānamiti

rūpajñānaṃ rūpajñānasya, evamanyatrāpi yojyamiti cet; ādyaṃ saugataṃ jñānamanupādānaṃ prasaktam, pūrvaṃ tathāvidhasya tadupādānasyābhāvāt, anyathā kutaḥ sopāyaṃ sugatatvam ? anumānasya vikalpena bhinnasantānatve tu pratyakṣaṃ prati upādānatvam, anyathā vikalpasya tad iti abhedāt sadṛśasmṛtyām siddhivi॰ 1
ato yathā ekamanekasya upādānam tathā anekamekasya, itarathā jāgradvijñānapañcakāt naikaṃ kadācid iti anyeṣāmānarthakyam
sahakāritvānneti cet; tarhi viṣādimūrcchitādipratibodhaṃ prati vainateyādidhyānādikamapāthakam
bhinnakālānāmekatra sahakāritve anumīyamānarūpasamānakālyarasaḥ pūrvarūpāderupajanane sahakārīti sāmagryekadeśaḥ sāmagryā liṅgamiti prasaktam
yadi pūrvamapi saugataṃ sarvajñajñānamasti tadā kutaḥ upāyāt sarvajñatvaṃ jāyate iti syāt ?
kiñca, ekatra bhinnakālānekopādānasahakārijñānavyāpārasaṃbhave na jñāyate bhedaikānte santatiniyama iti tadavastho doṣaḥ
na ca teṣāṃ sajātīye upayoge anyatra upayoga iti cintitam
tatra prabodhabhinnakāle upayogo vā tathaikasya kramabhāvini kārye vyāpāra iti nā'kramāt kramiṇo bhāvāḥ pra॰ vā॰ 1

anye tvāhuḥ--na anantaraṃ nāpi bhinnakālamupādānam, api tu sadṛśam, ato'yaṃ niyama iti; teṣāṃ śāntacetasaḥ kutaścid āviṣṭaprabodhabhāve kathaṃ sa iti nirūpyatām ? putrasya pitṛcittadharmānuvṛttau saṃbhavet, niyamābhāvaḥ anyatrāpi
bhavatu vā tanniyamaḥ, tathāpi doṣaḥ ityāha--satyapi ityādi
pūrvacittasya vāsakatā aparasya vāsyatā na bhavatyeva
atha keyaṃ pratyāsattiḥ yasyāḥ tvayā atrābhāvo'bhidhīyate ? hetuphalabhāva iti cet; sā astyeva iti hetorasiddhiḥ, satyapi ityādi vacanāt
deśādinaikaṭyam; tarhi tadabhāve'pi upādānopādeyabhāvavad vāsyavāsakabhāvo'pi na viruddhyata iti sandigdhavipakṣavyāvṛttiko hetuḥ
yadi punaḥ tadabhāve anupādānetarabhāvo'pi neṣyate; satyapi ityabhyupagamavirodhaḥ ityukto doṣaḥ
yadi punaḥ yogyatā; kutastadabhāvo bhedaikānte ? vāsyavāsakatvena abhimatayoḥ deśādibhedāt; uktamatrāpi janyajanakabhāvayogyatābhāvāt, iyamapi yogyatā na virudhyata iti
dṛṣṭatvācca, dṛṣṭaṃ khalu jāgraccittaṃ śāstrādiparijñānaṃparikaraṃ deśādivyavahite prabodhacetasi vā nirūpāṃ vāsanāmādadhānam
yāpi tatparikaracetastvacittakaiḥ anubhūyate taddaśābhāvabhayāt yatastatra vāsanā kalpyate iti tathā kalpaṃsādi kusumaṃ kusthamādiraktaṃ kālādivyavahite phalajāyi
yatpunaretat nidarśanam--santānāntaravat iti; tadapi na sūktam; vaiṣamyāt, hetuphalabhāvasya niyatatvāt

anyatrāpi asya codyasya samatvāditi; tanna; anyathā'bhiprāyāt; tathāhi--rājñā rājaputrāṇāmiva bhede'pi yathākathañcidastu laukikaḥ santānaniyamaḥ, vāsyavāsakabhāvaḥ punaḥ kathañcit kāraṇānurūpakāryabhāvaḥ

na hi yathā pitari mṛte'pi kālāntare tatsantānaṃ ca gṛhṇanti putrādayaḥ, dṛśyate adyāpi rājyasthitena rājña janito'pi svarājye punaḥ niveśitaḥ tatsantānavyapadeśabhāk, tathā tadākāram; anyathā ciramṛte'pi bharttari vidhavāyāḥ cirabhāvini vā kanyāyātpradākāramapatyaṃ bhavet
pituḥ ākāraṃ na hi tatsantānatvena gṛhṇanti
yatpunaretaduktam--mṛte'pi jāgraccetasi tadanurūpaṃ prabodhajñānamiti; tadapi na sāram; siddhaṃ yanna parāpekṣyam siddhivi॰ 1

api ca, adarśanamātreṇa svāpādau ātmābhāvasiddhau ghaṭādāvapi syāditi na nirākulametat adṛśyānupalambhādātmano ghaṭādiṣu abhāvā'pratisiddhau ghaṭādīnāṃ nairātmyā'siddheḥ nirātmakebhyo ghaṭādibhyaḥ prāṇādeḥ anivṛttiḥ itinādṛśyānupalambha nādabhāvāsiddhiḥ, api tu pratipatrabhiprāyaviṣayād avasthācatuṣṭayādiveti cet,tarhi sātmakā'nātmakāvasthābhedāt tadviṣayāt ghaṭādīnāṃ nairātmyaṃ kena vāryate ? yathā casupto devadattaḥ suṣupto mṛto jīvati iti vyavahārabhedaḥ, tathā kāraṇāt kāryāt svabhāvād anyataśca sādhyasiddhivyavahārabhedo'sti, sa kinnā'bhyupagamyate ? kāraṇānyayojyaṃbhivāradarśanāt sarvadhānāsvāse dṛśyādarśanasya vyabhicāradarśane svāpādau kinnāma sattvāśaṅkā syāt, yataḥ jāgraccetasa eva prabodho niścīyeta ? na ca vyavahāraḥ caitanyavirahiṇīṃ svāpādidaśāṃ manyate, tadvatyapi jīvadvyavahārapravarttanāt
teṣāṃ ca tatra tadabhāvamananādabhāve na kvacit kṣaṇabhaṅgadarśanaṃ sidhyet
taiḥ anupalakṣitaṃ tadasti na svāpādicaitanyam iti kiṃ kṛto vibhāgaḥ ?
nirātmakeṣu ghaṭādiṣu dṛṣṭādṛṣṭeṣu prāṇādyadarśanāt tannivṛttyā ātmagateḥ
yatpunaruktam--kārpāsādikusume lākṣādirāgāt phale tadrāgavāsanā iti; tadapyatisāhasam; rañjitapuṣpasya vyavahitaphalakāraṇatve avāntarabījāṅkurādivaiphalyam
kathañcaivam anantaro'rthaḥ jñānaṃ svākāraṃ janayati iti niyamaḥ, yatastadarthināṃ niyatadeśādau vṛttiḥ ? tataḥ sthitam--kṣaṇikaikānte vāsyavāsakatā na bhavati iti
yata evaṃ tato vikalpa eva na bhavet kāraṇābhāvāditi manyate
nanvasya sarvasya abhāvo na bauddhān prati pratibhāsādvaitavādino bādhate abhīṣṭatvāt
na ca pakṣa eva vipakṣaḥ atiprasaṅgāditi cet; atrāha--anyato'pi ityādi
sarvato'nyasyād vyāvṛttaṃ cittaṃ bahirantarmukhabhrāntābhrāntasvabhāvānvayi tatkṣaṇasthitidharmakaṃ parikalpya ātmānameva svaguṇaparyāyātmakaṃ svataḥ saṃvedananiṣṭhitaṃ pratikṣipatītyayuktam

atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--citramekaṃ jñānaṃ tadadvaitam, niraṃśānekajñānamātram, sarvavikalpātītaṃ vibhramamātraṃ vā yatredamuktam māyāmarīciprabhṛtipratibhāsavad asattve'pi adoṣaḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 286 iti ? tatra prathamapakṣe--anyataḥ sajātīyāt vijātīyācca vi nivṛttā apasṛtā dhīḥ buddhiḥ svabhāvān ātmabhūtān ākārān anuvartate vyāpnoti
kān tān ? ityāha--pratyakṣādīn pratyakṣo'bhrānta ādiryeṣāṃ bhrāntanīlādīnāṃ te tathoktāniti
anena ekatra viruddhadharmadhyāsasaṃbhave anekameva na kiñcit syāditi sarvasya sarvatropayogādiprasaṅgaḥ ityādi nirastamiti darśayati

tathā tena ekasya anekasvabhāvabhūtākāratādātmyapratibhāsaprakāreṇa, sahotpattivināśasaṃvedanaprakāreṇa sahabhuvāṃ sarveṣāṃ kṣaṇānāmekatvaprasaṅgena ekasantānāpatteḥ ātmā puruṣaḥ ekaḥ svabhāvo'nuvarttate iti sambandhaḥ
nahi tadapi svākāratādātmyābhāsād anyathā uktadoṣād aparam
tulanā--na caikasya viruddhau svabhāvau saṃbhavataḥ, viruddhadharmādhyāsena tasyaikatvahāniprasaṅgāt
nanu pratibhāsādvaite vivakṣitadhīvyatiriktasyā'bhāvāt kathamucyate--anyato vinivṛttā dhīḥ iti
sato'pi adarśane kutaḥ kasya kena vinivṛttiḥ pratīyate ? na ca ananyavedyeṣu vedaneṣu kenacid anyavedanamiti cet; uktamatra anyabhāvagrāhakapramāṇābhāvaḥ
yathā ca sukhenā'saṃvedanād duḥkhābhāvaḥ tathā tena sukhabhāvasyā'vedanādabhāva iti na kiñcit syāt
sukhena aviṣayīkriyamāṇaṃ duḥkhamasti na jñānāntarāṇi iti paśyata parasya sudhiṣo duśceṣṭitam
yatpunaruktam--sato'pyaviṣayīkṛtā na kasyacid vinivṛttipratipattiḥ iti; tadapi parasya svavavāya śūlatakṣā svapratibhāsamātrasyāpyasiddheḥ, jñānena tadviparītadharmā'niṣedhāt tadadarśanopagamāt
yadi punaḥ, nirapekṣasukhādivedanameva tadviparītadharmaniṣedhanam; aviṣayīkṛtādapi tarhi vinivṛttiḥ pratīyate ityāyātam
api ca, ayaṃ svayameva sarvavikalpān pratipadyamāno'pi tadatītaṃ tattvaṃ pratipadyate vadati ca nā'viṣayīkṛtād vinivṛttisiddhiḥ iti tatkārī taddveṣī ceti upekṣāmarhati
yaccānyaduktam-- ananyavedyeṣu vedaneṣu na cānyavedanam; tadapi na sundaram; pratibhāsādvaitā'siddhiprasaṅgāt sarvasaṃvidāṃ nirālambanatvā'siddheḥ
sarvato vijātīyāt upādānopādeyābhimatāt kṣaṇād anyasmāt svato bhinnād vyāvṛttam apasṛtaṃ cittaṃ jñānaṃ parikalpya

kathambhūtam ? ityāha--bahirantarmukhabhrāntāt tatsvabhāvāccapi bahiśca antaśca mukhamavabhāsanaṃ yayoḥ tau tathoktau tau ca tau bhrāntā'bhrāntasvabhāvau tau anvetuṃ śīlam, tadanvayo vā asyāstīti tadanvayi bahirmukhābhrāntasvabhāvānvayi
yadi vā, bahirantarmukhau yau svabhāvau bhrāntau ca yau svabhāvau tān anvetuṃ śīlamiti grāhyam
tathāhi--parasya sarvaṃ vikalpajñānaṃ svarūpe abhrāntam, sarvacittacaittānām nyāyabi॰ 1
10 ityādi vacanāt, bahiḥ artharūpe bhrāntam bhrāntirapi sambandhataḥ pramā ityādi vacanāt

na caitat sarvato'nyasyād vyāvṛttam ityanenaiva kathitamiti kiṃ punarucyate, yad visavaṃto vyāvṛttaṃ tatkṣaṇasthitidharmakameva, anyathā na kaṃ sarvato vyāvṛttamiti cet; satyam; tathāpi yaḥ pūrvāparakṣaṇavyāvṛttaṃ necchati taṃ prati tatsādhanārthamidaṃ tatkṣaṇa ityādi
tathāhi--yasmāt kṣaṇasthitidharmakaṃ naśvarasvabhāvaṃ tasmāt nāśaṃ prati anapekṣaṇāt pratikṣaṇaṃ nāśaniyatamiti
yadi vā, pūrveṇa sahabhāvinaḥ sarvasmād vyāvṛttamuktam, etena pūrvāparābhyām iti viśeṣaḥ
kim ? ityāha--ātmānameva jīvameva na taccittameva iti evakārārthaḥ
svataḥ ātmanaiva saṃvedananiṣṭhitam iti hetoḥ ayuktam anupapannam parasya sarvamiti
sāṃpratam uttaraṃ vikalpatrayaṃ dūṣayitukāma āha--abhrāntam ityādi
buddhiḥ sītvā saditvā ca ātmānaṃ pratikṣaṇam || 5
cetano'yamitīkṣamāṇaḥ parasmāt sarvataḥ parāvṛttaḥ pratikṣaṇamātmānaṃ nātyantāya vai jahāti svaguṇaparyāyānvayalakṣaṇatvāt tadvastunaḥ
abhrāntaṃ jāgraddaśāyāṃ svarūpe'pi vā, bhrāntaṃ svapnāvasthāyāṃ grāhyākāre ca ātmānaṃ svabhāvaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇaṃ prati amuñcatī svīkurvāṇā daddhiḥ buddhiḥ sarvasya pratītiviśeṣaḥ
ca śabdaḥ apiśabdārthaḥ bhinnaprakramaḥ muñcatyātmacetanām ityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ
na ityapi nipātānāmanekārthatvāt nani tyasya arthe, ākṣepe
tato'yamarthaḥ--buddhiḥ nanu ātmacetanāmapi na kevalaṃ guṇinamavayati taṃ pariṇāminaṃ muñcati jahāti, sakalaśūnyatā syāditi manyate
kiṃ kṛttvā ? ityāha— saditvā iti sūkṣmaparīkṣayā sthūlādyekasvabhāvāpi kathita phalavat niraṃśā'nekaparamāṇudaśāyāṃ gaṃdhā
punarapi kiṃ kṛtvā ? sītvā tādṛkṣasā'nandane bahiḥ paramāṇuvat mṛtā ityarthaḥ
tathā ca sarvadātve jagati jāte pratibhāsamātrasyāpi pratyastamayāt kimāśrayo'yaṃ kāraṇādīnāṃ pratiṣedhaṃ brūyāditi manyate
antyavikalpamāśritya idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam--bhrāntamātmānam amuñcatī, itarathā māyāmarīciprabhṛtipratibhāsavadasattve'pyadoṣaḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
bhrāntamātmānamamuñcantī bahirantaśca viruddhadharmādhyāsino vicārākṣamasya svabhāvasyāpi tatra pratibhāsanāt pratikṣaṇaṃ buddhiḥ iti ubhayatra saṃbadhyate
kiṃ karoti ? ityāha--na muñcatyātmacetanām ātmāparanāmikāṃ pūrvāparaparyāyāṃ nayatī cetanāṃ na jahāti ityarthaḥ
kiṃ kṛtvā ? ityāha--sītvā saditvācca iti laukikī vacanapravṛttiriyam
yadi vā, tamātmānaṃ pratikṣaṇamamuñcatī buddhiḥ svabhāvāt pratikṣaṇavilakṣaṇād anuvarttate iti gatayā kārikayā sambandhaḥ
nanu na bhrāntaṃ nāpi abhrāntamātmānaṃ buddhiḥ bibharti tasmāntam bhāvāt sarvavikalpātītatvāttattvasyeti cet; atrāha--sīrtta ityādi
ātmacetanāṃ svaprakāśaṃ na muñcantī anyathā sthūlādigrāhyarūpavat tatparityāge bahirarthasattvavad bhrāntetaraviveko'pi na sidhyediti ajñānārthako'sau iti pāramārthikaṃ pramāṇalakṣaṇam iti plavate

cetanaḥ svaparagrahaṇasvabhāvaḥ ātmā ekaḥ iti gatena sambandhataḥ naiyāyikādiparikalpitaḥ ayam iti svasaṃvedanādhyakṣeṇa īkṣamānaḥ ahami kayā na puruṣādvaitavādisāṃkhyakalpitaḥ, tatra nityam āgamagamyatvena ayam ityullekhābhāvāt
natu āgamavat tatra svasaṃvedanādhyakṣamapi vyāpriyate tato'yamadoṣa iti cet; atrāha--parā ityādi
parāvṛttaḥ apasṛtaḥ parasmād ātmāntarād ghaṭādeśca tathāpratīteḥ
madīya ātmā tathā iti sāṃkhyaḥ; tatrāha--sarvataḥ sarveṇa svarūpeṇa iva deśādināpi parāvṛttaḥ
yadi vā, sarvasmāt sarvataḥ naivaṃ sāṃkhyātmā sarvathā sarvaṃ sarvatra vidyate ityasya virodhāt
pratikṣaṇanāśikṣaṇasantānātmā itthambhūta iti saugataḥ; tatrāha--pratikṣaṇam ityādi
kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇaṃ prati ātmānaṃ svarūpaṃ jahadapi nātyantāya nātyantam ityasyārthe'vaṃta pratirūpako'yaṃ nipāto varttate, jahāti kintu kathañcit

sve ātmīyā ye guṇā ye ca paryāyā na dravyāntarasambandhinaḥ teṣu anvayaḥ anugamanam tasya lakṣaṇaṃ grahaṇaṃ sa eva vālakṣaṇaṃ svarūpaṃ yasya tattathoktam tasya bhāvāt tadvastunaḥ cetanasya itarasya vā bhāvasya
api ca, vastuna iti sāmānyavacanaṃ dṛṣṭānte na parābhyupetopalabdhiḥ ityasya pradarśanārtham
tadvyatirekeṇa anantaravarṇita vastuvyatirekeṇa bhāvasya brahmaṇa iva niraṃśavijñāna, santānasyāpi anupapatteḥ pramāṇābhāvāditi manyate

tataḥ kiṃ jātam ? ityāha--kuto na kaścit sahetuḥ sakāraṇo aheturvā akāraṇo vā apinā yo yadbhāvaṃ pratyanyānapekṣaḥ sa tatsvabhāvaniyataḥ yathā antyā kāraṇa sāmagrī svasvakāryotpādanaṃ prati anapekṣayā satī laa bhāvaniyatā, vināśaṃ prati anapekṣaśca bhāvaḥ iti durbhāṣitaṃ sādhyādyantyadharmyasiddhiḥ
tulanā--ye yadbhāvaṃ pratyanapekṣāste tadbhāvaniyatāḥ, yathā samanantaraphalā sāmagrī svakāryotpādane niyatā, vināśaṃ pratyanapekṣāśca sarve janminaḥ kṛtakā bhāvā iti svabhāvahetuḥ
punarapi parasya sahetuke vināśe doṣamupadarśayannāha--hetumattve ityādi
vināśo yadi bhāvasvabhāvo na bhavet tasya kiṃ kurvāṇo hetuḥ syāt ? na tāvadutpādayati; pūrvāvadhiparicchinnavastusattāsambandhalakṣaṇatvādutpatteḥ
tasya kathañcit kenāpi kāryatve bhāvasvabhāvānatikrānteḥ bhāvaḥ syāt, tallakṣaṇatvād vastunaḥ
tathā anutpattidharmakam anādheyāpraheyātiśayātmakaṃ tathā svavināśahetubhāvānna vinaśyatīti
vināśahetuḥ prāga sato vināśasya svabhāvaṃ karoti na sattāsambandhamiti cet; kaḥ punarbhāvānāmanyonyābhāvaprāgabhāvakarttā ? yatastatsvabhāvasthitiḥ
na hi atītena vartamānasya tadvattā atiprasaṅgāt

atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--ekāntavādikalpitasya vastunaḥ pramāṇābhāvena asattvānna tasya heturvā vināśa ityukti laukikasya arthasya pareṇa sa vināśaḥ kalpanīyaḥ, tatrāpi pūrvottarākāraparihārāvāptilakṣaṇavikārasya vināśotpattivyapadeśe ubhayatrāpi jainamatasiddhiḥ ityuktamanantaraprastāve ahetuvināśapakṣe utpādasthitibhaṅgānām siddhivi॰ 3
17 ityādinā, sahetuvināśapakṣe'pi anādinidhanaṃ dravyamutpitsu khāsuśa naśvaram
tataḥ tadbhayāt tena nāśotpādavata utpāda ekāntena bhinnaḥ abhyupagantavyaḥ

evaṃ ca vināśasya bhāvādekāntena bhinnasya pradhvaṃsasya hetumattve sakāraṇatve abhyupagamyamāne nāśāt pradhvaṃsāt vināśasya ityanuvarttate bhāvo ghaṭādiḥ punarbhavet svopalambhārthakriyākārī pūrvavat paścādapi syādityarthaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--paravyāpārājjāyamāno nāśaḥ anyo vā kṛtako bhavati, apekṣitaparavyāpāro hi bhāvaḥkṛtakaḥ nyāyabi॰ 3
kutaścid bhavato'syāpi bhāvavyapadeśāvirodhāt, kṛtakaśca ghaṭādivadavaśyaṃ naśyati iti
nanu yasya kṛtakaḥ svakāraṇānnaśvaro jāyate bhavatu tasyā'yaṃ doṣo nāsmākam, anaśvarakṛtako'pi hi bhāvaḥ vināśakāraṇasannipātād vinaśyati na svabhāvataḥ
na ca nāśasya nāśakaṃ kāraṇamasti ityeke; tatrāha--nānyathaikāntikā ityādi
vināśasya nāśābhāvaprakāreṇa anyathā naikāntikāḥ avyabhi cāriṇo na sarve niravaśeṣāḥ anaikāntikāḥ syuḥ ityarthaḥ
ke ? ityāha--hetumannāśahetavaḥ sakāraṇapradhvaṃsasya hetavaḥ liṅgāni kṛtakatvādīni
yathaiva hi vināśakṛtakatve'pi na tannāśahetavaḥ avaśyaṃbhāvinaḥ tathā ghaṭādivināśahetavo'pi
atra anyeṣāṃ darśanam--vināśasya vināśe'pi bhāvasya na prādurbhāvaḥ, nahi devadattasya hantari hate devadattasya prādurbhāva iti; tanna sāram; vaiṣamyād dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayoḥ
nahi yathā bhāvasya pradhvaṃsabhāvaḥ tathā devadattasya hantā'pi, tena ātmano'nyasya devadatte'bhāvasya vidhānāt
asya nāśe bhavatyeva tasya prādurbhāvaḥ, itarathā tadabhāvavaiphalyam, tasmin sati jīvato'pi devadattasya adarśanaprasaṅgaḥ
pradhvaṃsarūpeṇa pariṇatiḥ tathā hantuḥ devatattavināśarūpeṇa pariṇatiḥ
anye tu bruvate--ghaṭasya pradhvaṃsavat tatpradhvaṃso'pi upalabdhiṃ pratibadhnāti iti tadadarśanamiti; tadapi na sūktam; atiprasaṅgāt
tathāhi--yadi anyāmāvo'nyasya upa labdhipratighātakṛt; tarhi paṭābhāvaḥ sakalasya upalabdhipratibandhakārī syāt pratyāsatti viprakarṣābhāvāt
adyā bhāvenāpi bhāvasya viśeṣaṇībhāvasya asya vā sambandhasya paraṃ pratyasiddhatvāt, anavasthānāt sambandhāntarābhāvāt
yadi punaḥ, viśeṣaṇībhāvaḥ aparasambandharahito'pi kasyaciducyate; tarhi samavāyādyabhāve'pi guṇādiḥ kasyaciducyatāmaviśeṣāt
indriyeṇā'sambaddhasya ca tasya grahaṇe kimatra kimanyatra indriyasya viṣayeṇa sambandhakalpanena ?
pradhvaṃsarūpasya kapālasya nāśe'pi ghaṭasya darśanaṃ na bhavati
kiñca, pradhvaṃsanāśavat prāgabhāvanāśo'pi ghaṭopalabdhiṃ pratibadhnāti iti na punaḥ ghaṭotpattiḥ syāt
atha ghaṭabhāvena tattvāśayasyu tiraskārāt nāsau tadupalabdhipratibandhakaḥ; kimasau tadbhāvaḥ pradhvaṃsakāle nāsti yena taskāraiko na bhavet
anāditvāt prāgabhāvasya gaganādivanna nāśa ityeke; teṣāṃ prāgiva ghaṭotpattikāle dṛśyaḥ san upalabhyate iti tadāpi ghaṭo nādyāpi utpadyate iti pratītiḥ syāt pūrvavat
atha ghaṭabhāvena tiraskārāt sato'pi tārānikarasyeva bhāsvatā tasyā'nupalambhanam; nityasya svaviṣayavijñānotpādanayogyasyasamagretarakāraṇasya tiraskārāyogāt
tadevam anupalabdhikāraṇeṣu dūratvādiṣu asatsvapi anupalabhyamāno'pi yadi prāgabhāvo ghaṭakāle'sti śabdaḥ tālvādivyāpārāt pūrvamūrdhvaṃ ca tathā asti iti tasya ākāśakāryaguṇatvakalpanamayuktam
nanu yathā nityavyāpinaḥ sato dṛśyasyāpi gotvādeḥ kenacit tiraskārastathā atrāpi syāditi cet; na; tatrāpi samatvād doṣasya
yadi punaretanmatam--tadabhāvena tasya dṛśyatākhaṇḍanāttiraskāra iti; tarhi prāgabhāvasyāpi nāśo'bhyupagataḥ syāt
api ca, pradhvaṃsasyāpi tadabhāvaḥ tiraskārako'stu bhāvatiraskārakatvāt prāgabhāvavat
atra kecit codayanti--yadi bhāvād bhinnaṃ vināśamuddiśya idaṃ dūṣaṇamucyate sūriṇā, tarhi bhāvasya tatkāle'pi tadavasthasyaiva bhāvāt kimarthamucyate--vināśasya nāśādbhāvaḥ punarbhavet iti
atha punarbhavet iti pūrvavad darśanādiviṣayo bhavet iti vyākhyāyate; tadapi na sundaram; tadāpi tataḥ tadviṣayatāniṣedhāt

tathāhi--hetumattve vināśasya abhyupagamamyamāne nāśāt tato vināśāt sakāśād bhāvo ghaṭādiḥ punaḥ iti avadhāraṇārthaḥ, anyathetyasya anantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ, anyathaiva anyena evakāreṇa ekāntena bhinna ityarthaḥ bhavet sādhadi iti śeṣaḥ
na ityayaṃ bhinnaprakramaḥ aikā ntika itpūrvamanaṃ draṣṭavyaḥ
tato'yamarthaḥ--hetumato nāśasya pareṇa ye hetavaḥ yāni kāraṇāni pratipāditāni te na aikāntikā nāvaśyakābhyupagamanārhāḥ tatkṛtanāśe satyapi tathaiva ghaṭādeḥ upalambhāditi manyate

yadyevam anena paryāptamiti pūrvadūṣaṇamanarthakamiti cet; na; hetoḥ vināśaṃ tena ca bhāvasya tirodhānamabhyupagacchanti ye teṣāṃ vināśo yadi ityādikasya kādācitkamakāryam ityasya ca vṛttigranthasya bhedo na syāt
anyena arthena kārikāṃ vivṛṇvannāha--vināśo yadi ityādi
vināśaḥ pradhvaṃso yadi bhāvaḥ svabhāvo na bhavet uttarapariṇāmātmako na syād api tu bhāvād bhinnaḥ syādityarthaḥ
tasya vināśasya kiṃ kurvāṇo hetuḥ na kiñcitkurvāṇaḥ kāraṇaṃ syāt mudgarādiḥ
athavā, tasya bhāvasya kiṃ kurvāṇo vināśaḥ syāt, vināśasya ca kiṃ kurvāṇo hetuḥ syāditi yojyam
tathāhi--yadā bhāvād bhinna eva vināśaḥ tadā nāsau tasya kiñcitkaroti iti vyapadiśyate upakārāpekṣatvāt arthāntarayoḥ vāstavasambandhasya, anyathā atiprasaṅgāt
yogyatāsambandhe'pi avinābhāva eva rūparasādivat na punarbhāvanivṛttiḥ
saiva tasya tena kriyate iti cet; yadi svabhāvabhūtā; prathamo'pi vināśaḥ tathaivāstu ityalaṃ bhedaikāntakalpanayā
vināśena ca vināśakaraṇāt tasyaiva so'stu pāvakasyeva dhūmaḥ
tathā vadhinā ta eva tatsambandhānnaṣṭa iti syānna bhāvaḥ
bhāvasambandhinaḥ karaṇādadoṣaścet; uktamatra, tena tasya upakārā'karaṇāt tatsambandhinaḥ iti ghaṭanāyogāt
bhāvenāpyasau kriyate tatastatsambandhīti cet; ubhayoḥ syāt, tava bhāvaḥ svavināśahetuḥ, sarvadā prasaṅgāt, nityasya apekṣāyogāt
viśeṣaṇībhāvasambandhasya tatraiva bhāvāt tatsambandhī ityapi vārttam; bhedaikānte tatsambandhasyāvinamayi tumaśakteḥ
tannivṛttikaraṇād bhāvasya vināśaḥ upalambhapratibandhakaraṇāt syāditi cet; uktamatra tadavasthasya tadayogāditi
yogino na ca yuktāḥ syuḥ kathaṃ sarvārthavedanaiḥ
sarvajñatvaṃ tathā caivaṃ varṇyate yaiḥ svabhaktitaḥ
te yadā taiḥ samīkṣyante tadā kṣīṇā pratikṣīṇāṃ
sāṃkhyasya yoginaḥ sarve ciraṃ jīvaṃ sāmpratam
yoginaḥ evaṃ cakāraḥ kākavadbhuvi vā nuḥ
kairika taistā saṃtīnāḥ kaṃ yāntu saṃśrayam
bata vadata vināśe naiva cānyena yogaḥ
sata iha satataṃ tat tannirodho na vārttā || iti
tat sthitam--vināśo yadi bhāvasvabhāvo na bhavet tasya kiṃ kurvāṇasya syād vināśaḥ iti
nanu yaduktam--tasya vināśasya hetuḥ kiṃ kurvāṇaḥ syāt iti; tatra utpatteḥ kurvāṇaḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--pūrva ityādi
tāvacchabdo vitarke na kramārthau anyasya prayojanasyāvacanāt notpādayati na janayati hetuḥ mudgarādiḥ vināśam iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha--pūrvāvadhiḥ prāgabhāvaḥ tena paricchinnaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ yadvastu ghaṭādiḥ tasya sattayā sambandhaḥ samavāyaḥ sa eva lakṣaṇaṃ yasya tasya bhāvāt tattvāt
na ca prāgastato vināśasya sattayā sambandhaḥ; anabhyupagamāt parasya tripadārthasatkarī sattā iti vacanāt
nāpi pradhvaṃsasya pareṇa dravyādiṣvanta ta ta vi iṣyata iti manyate
saditi yato dravyaguṇakarmasu sā sattā--vaiśe॰ sū॰ 1
nanvevam atyalpamidamucyate--sa hetuḥ vināśaṃ na tāvad utpādayati iti, yāvatā ghaṭāderhetuḥ tamavi notpādayati
tathāhi--na tāvad ghaṭādeḥ prāgasataḥ taddhetuḥ ātmalābhalakṣaṇāmutpattimupajanayati; tadanyotpattikalpanānarthakyaprasaṅgāt
na ca kutaścidajñātasya bandhyāsutasyeva sattayā anyena vā sambandhaḥ, yataḥ kiñcit kenacidutpāditaṃ bhavet
jātasyeti cet; yada labdhātmalābhasya; tarhi ukto doṣaḥ--kimanyayā utpattyā ? kathamanyathā śaśaśṛṅgāderbheda iti cet; ayamaparaḥ parasya doṣo'stu
nanu na vināśasyādyasya vā prāgasataḥ sattāsambandhalakṣaṇā utpattiḥ hetunā kriyate yatrāyaṃ syāt, api tu svarūpameva kriyatāmiti cet; atrāha--tasya ityādi

tasya vināśasya kathañcit kenāpi sattāsambandhakaraṇalakṣaṇena svarūpalakṣaṇena vā prakāreṇa kāryatve hetubhājatṛtve bhāvasvabhāvānatikrānterbhāvarūpānatikramāt na tāvadutpāda yati iti sambandho bhāvaḥ syāditi manyate
tathāpi sa kuto bhāvaḥ syāditi cet ? atrāha— tallakṣaṇatvād vastunaḥ iti
paramatāpekṣayā sa sattāsambandho lakṣaṇaṃ yasya tasya bhāvāt tattvād vastunaḥ sadvargasyeti vyākhyeyam

svamatāpekṣayā tu saḥ prāgasato hetorātmalābho lakṣaṇaṃ yasya tasya bhāvāt tattvāt vastuno bhāvasya iti, svaprāgabhāvād anyathā pradhvaṃso na viśiṣyeta avāntarajātisambandhavirahāt, itarathā dravyādivat sattāsambandhaḥ
yadi punaḥ kvacittadavirahe'pi tatsambandho neṣyate; tarhi kathaṃ tatsambandhavirahe'pi dravyādīnāmeva avāntarajātiyogo na jātyādīnāmiti vibhāgaḥ syāt
etena anyasyāpi viśeṣakasya dharmasya saṃbhavo nirasta iti manyate
atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ— anantaranyāyena prāgasan punaḥ kutaścit jāyamāno vināśaḥ kāryam, ata eva vastuvyavasthā mitaṃ tat
idānīṃ vināśalakṣaṇaṃ vastu kādācitkaṃ deśakāladravyādiniyataṃ sadakāryam iti prakriyāvyāvarṇanamātraścāṣṭaṣaṣṭhi ghaṭitakṛtāntapadārthaprapañcakathanamātram
tathāhi--yadi vināśa vastu prāgasat kutaścit jāyate kathamakāryam ghaṭādivat ? athā'kāryam; gaganādivat kathaṃ kādācitkaṃ kādācitkañca akāryaṃ ceti parasparaviruddhametat
tadyathā tatkādācitkaṃ prāgasat punarlabdhātmalābhakaṃ kuḍyādivat kathamanutpattidharmakam avidyamānotpattidharmakam ? tathātmalāmasyaiva utpattirūpatvasyacid arthāntarasattāsambandhaniṣedhāt
athā'nutpattidharmakam ākāśavad bandhyāstandhayavat; kathaṃ kādācitkam iti virodhaḥ ? tasmāt kādācitkatvād utpattidharmakamiti bhāvaḥ
tathā, kādācitkam anādheyā'praheyā'tiśayātmakam ajanyāvināśasāmarthyasvabhāvam iti prakriyāvyāvarṇanamātram
tathā ca kutaścid ātmānaṃ tallabhate cetyadivat durupapādamanādheyā'praheyātiśayātmakatvam, anyata ātmalābhasyaiva ādheyapraheyātiśayātmakatvāt

yadi punaḥ gaganādivat anādheyā'praheyātmakam; kathaṃ kādācitkam ? atha jātasya punaḥ atiśaya āvānupānetuṃ vāmaśakyata iti tattadātmakamucyate; tadasatya kādācitkatve arthakriyākāritve vā tatra ādheyapraheyātiśayātmakatvaṃ ghaṭādivat punaranumiteḥ pratipadyamānaḥ kena vāryate ?
tathaiva kādācitkamavinaśvaram iti prakriyāvyāvarṇanamātraṃ virodhāt, sarvasya kādā citkasya vinaśvaratvena pratītiḥ ghaṭādivat iti

tathā kādācitkaṃ svavināśahetubhāvāt svaśabdena vināśa vastu parāmṛśyate tasya vināśaḥ svo vināśasya ātmīyo vā vināśaḥ tasya hetoḥ kāraṇasya abhāvāt na vinaśyati iti prakriyāvyāvarṇanamātraṃ virodhāt iti svamatavyādhātāt
yo hi kādācitkatve jagato'pi vināśakāraṇamabhyupagacchati tasya prakṛte kā'kṣamā ? tathā vināśe vā pradhvaṃse vā vināśavastunaḥ iti sambandhaḥ
vā śabdaḥ abhyupagamasūcakaḥ pakṣāntarasūcako vā, vinaṣṭasya pradhvaṃsaviśeṣaṇavataḥ sattāsambandhino ghaṭādeḥ
yadi vā, sato vināśād bhinnasya svato vidyamānasya anutpattiḥ punaraprādurbhāvaḥ
ādityālokābhāvalakṣaṇe tamasi punaḥ pradīpādibhāvena prahate'pi punaḥ tadālokonmajjanam
yadi vināśavināśe'pi prādurbhāvaḥ; na tarhi vināśavināśaḥ tadbhāvaḥ, tallakṣaṇatvādasya, kathamanyathā nairātmyaniṣedhe sātmakatvasiddhiḥ
tato yadi vināśavināśaḥ; kathanna bhāvaprādurbhāvaḥ ? na cet; kathaṃ tannāśaḥ ?
yatpunaruktam--utpattihetubhāvāditi; tadasāram; yato ghaṭotpattau avayavasaṃyogaḥ kāraṇam, tasyāpi kriyā , ataḥ kriyāvināśavināśe tatprādurbhāvaḥ, tataḥ saṃyogaḥ tato'pi ghaṭaḥ
yadi vā, vibhāgena saṃyogavināśaḥ kṛta iti sahetukaḥ tasyāpi kutaścinnāśe saṃyogonmajjanam
athavā, ghaṭād bhinnasya nāśasya bhāve na tasya kiñciditi nāśanāśe niṣpratidvandvinaḥ kevalamupalambho bhavati tamonāśa iva iti kiṃ hetunā ?
yatpunaruktam--ālokābhāve tamasi nāśite'pi na dinakarālokaprādurbhāva iti; tadapi na suparīkṣitābhidhānam; tatrāpi codyasya samatvāt
na ālokābhāvamātraṃ tamaḥ, sālokāpavarake bahalālokapradeśāt praviṣṭasya tamaḥpratibhāsāt
vijñānābhāve cātra tamasi sarvatra tadabhāva etadastu nādityālokābhāvaḥ
jñāna bhāvaḥ tamaḥ; abhāve na jñānaprādurbhāvaḥ
na khalu ci tadabhāva eva mataḥ ; itarathā āloko'pi tamo'bhāvo bhavet
na kevalaṃ vināśasya kintu ghaṭāderapi hetumarthe kādācitkatve ca sati evaṃ vināśavat prasaṅgāt kāraṇāt prakriyāvarṇanamātram iti sambandhaḥ
svasāmagryā janma yasya bhāvasya abhāvasya vā tasya

tadvināśakāraṇasya yat tadvināśakāraṇaṃ pareṇa abhyupagataṃ tat tacchabdena parāmṛśyate, tacca tadvināśakāraṇaṃ ca iti tasya, avaśyaṃbhāvaniyamā'bhāvāt kāraṇāt na kaścit kṛtakatvādiḥ anityatvasādhano hetuḥ avyabhicārī syādityarthaḥ
yaduktam--na prāgasato vināśasya sattāsambandhalakṣaṇā utpattiḥ kenacit kriyate api tu svarūpameva; tatrāha saugataḥ--vināśahetuḥ ityādi
vināśasya hetuḥ kāraṇaṃ parābhyupagataḥ prāgasataḥ svotpatteḥ pūrvamasato'vidyamānasya vināśasya svabhāvaṃ svarūpaṃ karoti na sattāsambandham ityevaṃ ced yadi

kaḥ na kaścit punaḥ iti akṣamāyām, bhāvānāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ yaḥ anyo'nyābhāvaḥ, atyantābhāvasya etadviśeṣatvāt pṛthaganabhidhānam, yaśca prāgabhāvaḥ tasya karttā, yataḥ kartuḥ tatsvabhāvasthitiḥ ? yata iti vā ākṣepe, naiva tatsthitiḥ
tathā ca prayogaḥ--yaḥabhāvaḥ sa sa nirhetukaḥ yathā prāgabhāvādiḥ, abhāvaśca vināśa iti
nanu yadi nāma prāgabhāvāderahetutvaṃ naitāvatā vināśasya tat, anyathā gaganāderahetutvāt ghaṭādīnāmapi tadbhavet
pratyakṣabādhanamubhayatra samānamiti cet; atrāha--asti vā ityādi
asti vidyate vā kaścid deśādikṛto viśeṣaḥ bhedaḥ prāgabhāvādervināśasya ? nāsti ityarthaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati— yathā prāgabhāvādayaḥ kāraṇānvayavyatirekānanuvidhāyinaḥ akṛtakāḥ tathā vināśo'pi
nahi mahati daṇḍādisannipāte mahān anyathāvidhe anyathā vināśaḥ; vinivṛttimātrasya sarvatra aviśeṣāditi
na ca bhāvataḥ prāgabhāvādayaḥ santi; ityāha--paraspara ityādi
parasparam anyonyaṃ svabhāvaśca deśaśca kālaśca teṣāṃ parihāraḥ tena pariṇatim ātmalābham abhāvaṃ vidmaḥ bhāvānām iti sambandhaḥ
tulanā--na hi vināśaheturbhāvasya svabhāvameva karoti; tasya svahetubhyo nirvṛtteḥ
evaṃ saugatenāpi naiyāyikaṃ vimukhatāṃ nītvā adhunā saugataṃ svayaṃ tāṃ nayannāha--tathā ca ityādi
tathā ca tena ca tatparaṇatyabhāvavedanaprakāreṇa hetumattvaṃ sakāraṇatvaṃ viruddhapramāṇabādhitam
kasya ? ityāha--kṣaṇikasya bhāvasya iti vacanapariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
idamatra tātparyam--naiyāyikasya hetumato'pi vināśasya vināśamanabhyupagacchataḥ anityatvahetavo vyabhicāriṇaḥ, prāgabhāvādikamahetumabhyupagacchato vināśo vinihetuḥ tadabhāvo vā
bauddhasya punaḥ kṣaṇikatvamabhyupacchataḥ kṛtakatvādayaḥ asiddhā eva iti nāsau paramatiśete iti
kutastasya na hetutvam ? ityāha--na hyatīta ityādi
hi yasmād atītena kāryotpatteḥ prāgeva naṣṭena bhāvena varttamānasya tadvattā hetumattā na atiprasaṅgāt sarveṇa atītena sarvasya tadvattāprasaṅgāt
nanvevaṃ naiyāyikasyeva saugatasyāpi matābhāve sakalaśūnyataiva syāditi cet; atrāha— samakṣam ityādi
samakṣaṃ pratyakṣaṃ guṇaśca paryāyāśca svabhāvā ātmāno yasya dravyasya tasya sādhanam bahirantaśca guṇaparyāyātmakadravyapratyakṣatvāt ityarthaḥ
syānmatam--asti pratyakṣabuddhau yasya pratibhāsaḥ, sa tu bhrāntaḥ bādhyamānatvād dvicandrādipratibhāsavaditi cet; atrāha--vipakṣa ityādi
vipakṣe bhāvādyekānte arthakriyāyāḥ darśanādilakṣaṇāyā ayogāt vyāvṛttam apasṛtam
kutaḥ ? vibhramātmanaḥ bhrāntasvabhāvāt samakṣam iti sambandhaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā ekacandradarśanabhāvād dvicandradarśanaṃ bhrāntaṃ tathā ekāntadarśanādibhāve anantarasamakṣaṃ bhrāntaṃ syāt
kārikārthasya naikadhā rājapathīkṛtatvāt prakṛtamupasaṃha rannāha--iti sthitametat ityādi
nanu cetanā'cetanayoḥ amūrttamūrttayoḥ jīvakarmaṇoḥ sambandhābhāvena ekasya gamane sthāne vā nānyasya niyamena gamanaṃ sthānaṃ vā gavāśvavat
sambandhe'pi tadutpattilakṣaṇe sa eva doṣaḥ ghaṭakulālavat
tādātmyalakṣaṇe tu nāyaṃ doṣaḥ kṛtakatva-śabdavat, atrāpi anyataradeva syāt kalpito vā bheda iti cet; atrāha--cetanā ityādi
jīva eva syāt karma eva vā
parasparavilakṣaṇāvapi cetanācetanau bandhaṃ pratyekatvaṃ pratipadyete hemaśyāmikādivat
na ca mūrtāmūrtayoḥ saṃyogo viruddhaḥ pañcaskandhakadambakābhāvaprasaṅgāt ātmamanaḥsannikarṣādeśca

cetana ātmā acetanaḥ karmapadārthaḥ tau cetanācetanau, upalakṣaṇametat tena amūrttamūrttau etau pratyakṣānumānapratīyamānau bandhaṃ saṃyogaviśeṣam prati apekṣakatām sahacarādikāryasamānatādātmyaṃ bhinnadravyayoḥ tadvirodhāt
kutastādātmyaṃ na gatau ? ityāha--bhinnau paradravyāntarabhūtau yataḥ
kena ? ityāha--lakṣaṇataḥ svalakṣaṇena ādyādipāṭhāntaḥ, tallakṣaṇameva āśritya
tathāhi--jñānadarśanopayogo jīvasyaiva lakṣaṇam, acetane rūpādyātmakatvaṃ pudgalasyaiva iti
kathaṃ bhinnau ? ityāha--atyantaṃ kālatraye'pi parasparaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃkrāntyabhāvamanena darśayati
ekena ādiśabdena māṇikyādeḥ apareṇa kiṭṭādeḥ parigrahaḥ tāviva tadvaditi
parasparam anyonyaṃ vilakṣaṇāvapi visadṛśalakṣaṇāvapi cetanā'cetanau jīvakarmapudgalau bandhaṃ prati ekatvaṃ pratipadyete hemaśyāmikādivad ādiśabdaḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate
nanumūrttā' mūrttayostayoḥ saṃyogaviśeṣalakṣaṇaḥ kathaṃ bandho yenaivaṃ syāditi cet ? atrāha--na ca ityādi
na ca naiva mūrtā'mūrtayoḥ karmātmanoḥ viruddhaḥ saṃyogaḥ
nanu viṣādivat ityanena parihṛtaṃ yata ityadoṣaḥ
pañcaskandhā rūpādayaḥ teṣāṃ kadambakasya samūhasya abhāvaprasaṅgāt kāraṇāt na ca mūrttā'mūrttayorviruddhaḥ saṃyogaḥ iti padaghaṭanā
tathāhi--kvacit śarīre rūpaskandho mūrttaḥ, amūrttā vedanādayaḥ, tatsamūharūpaparāpararūpatayā upajāyamānasya saṃsāravyapadeśāt
mūrttettarayośca saṃyogavirodhaḥ anyatra rūpam anyatra vedanādayaḥ sahyavindhyavaditi na śarīre sukhādyanubhavanamiti prāptam
nanu tatkadambakaṃ yadi saṃyogaḥ; tarhi tadabhāvo na saugatasya doṣāya abhyupagamāditi cet; nairantaryasya tenāpyupagamāt
tato yathā pañcaskandhānāṃ mūrttetararūpāṇāmapi nairantaryalakṣaṇaḥ saṃyogaḥ tathā jīvakarmaṇoriti
ātmanaḥ sannikarṣa ātmamanasoḥ saṃyogaḥ, ātmā manasā yujyate nyāma॰ pṛ॰ 74 iti vacanāt ādiḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ tasya ca abhāvaprasaṅgāt na ca tayoḥ saṃyogo viruddhaḥ
ye nirantarotpanne vastunī te eva saṃyuktaśabdavācye...
astu yathārthagrahaṇasvabhāvasya ātmano mithyājñānādanumito bandhaḥ, sa tu kena hetunā ? ityatrāha--śubhā'śubhaiḥ ityādi
manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ śubhairaśubhaiścāsravaiḥ yathāsvaṃ puṇyapāpabandho jīvānāmityatra na kaścid vipratipattumarhati kintu sarveṣāmavigīto'yamiti
kiṃbhūtaḥ ? cetanaḥ svaparagrahaṇasvabhāvaḥ na vaiśeṣikakalpitaḥ tasya bandhaphalābhāvāt
na ca sarvadā acetanasya tad yuktaṃ virodhāt
bhinnasya utpattāvapi na tasya kiñcid atiprasaṅgāt, samavāyaniṣedhāt
kaiḥ ? ityāha--acetanaiḥ karmapudgalaiḥ na saugatakalpitaiḥ cetanarūpaiḥ karmabhiḥ cetanā karma abhidha॰ ko॰ 4
kutaḥ syāḥ karmatva virodhāt, ātmasvabhā vatvāccetanāyāḥ

viparītā cetanā karmeti cet; tasyāḥ kuto bhāvaḥ ? vāsanātaścet; na; tanniṣedhāt anantarameva, tasyāśca tattva-tadvedanakāla eva narakādiprāpaṇasāmarthyavedanāt, sarvasyāpi hiṃsādicetanādibhyaḥ aparopadeśāt nivṛttiḥ syāt tattvaveditā yogināmiva
na khalu kaścit sacetano dustaṭīpātamatitayā na kaṃ jānanneva ācarate duḥkhabhīruḥ
na ca niṣkaladarśane cetanāniścaye'pi tatsāmarthyāniścayakalpanamiti suvicāritametat
tatsāmarthyāgrahaṇe ca tadvato'pyagrahaṇamiti na acetanakarmapakṣād viśeṣaḥ
nanu badhyante sau taiḥ, sa tu naśvaram api tu maheśvarapreritaiḥ
tayāhi--yaḥ cetanena badhyate sa dhīmatā preritena badhyate, yathā cauro nigaḍādinā, badhyate ca ātmā tathāvidhasteneti, yo'sau tatprerakaḥ sa maheśvara iti cet; atrāha--svayam iti
yo hi cetanaḥ taiḥ badhyate sa eva ātmavandhanāya teṣāṃ prerakaḥ kiṃ tatra īśvareṇa anyena manyata vā
na cedamatra codyam--arvāgdarśī tāni apaśyan kathaṃ teṣāṃ preraka iti; svapnādau adṛṣṭāttānāmapi svakaracaraṇādīnāṃ prerakatvadarśanān
yasya ca īśvarajñānamekaṃ nityamanātmavedakam, tasya īśvaraḥ tāni paśyati ityatiśraddheyam
anityaṃ cet; tattarhi tasya adṛṣṭapūrvakam, anyathā yato'bhyudayaniḥśreyasasiddhiḥ sa dharmaḥ vaiśe॰ sū॰ 1
tasya ca adṛṣṭasambandho yadi anyena dhīmatā kṛtaḥ; anavasthā
īśvaraprerito gacchet śvabhraṃ vā svargameva vā
atha matam--yadi cetanaḥ taiḥ svayaṃ manyate muktātmāno'pi badhyeran viśeṣābhāvāditi cet; atrāha--āsravaiḥ iti
āsravanti samāgacchanti saṃsāriṇāṃ jīvānāṃ karmāṇi yaiḥ yebhyo vā te āsravā rāgādayaḥ taiḥ karaṇabhūtaiḥ kṛtvā
na kevalam etaireva api tu manovākkāyakarmabhiśca manovacanaśarīravyāpāraiśca

yadyevaśabdaḥ rāgādivad eteṣvapi pravartate nimittasāmyāt tatkimarthaṃ tacchabdena rāgādaya ucyante iti cet ? satyam, manaḥprabhṛtīnāṃ svaśabdenāvidhānāt, tacchabdena teṣāmeva abhidhānam yathā doṣāvaraṇayorhāniḥ āptamī॰ ślo॰ 4 ityatra doṣaśabdena āvaraṇayorapyabhidhāne'pi āvaraṇayoḥ pṛthagabhidhānāt doṣā rāgādaya ucyante
yadi vā, āsravaiḥ manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ iti samānādhikaraṇyena sambandhaḥ karaṇīyaḥ
tatra ca laukikanyāyāpekṣayā manaḥkarmabhiḥ ityanena mānasā vyāpārā rāgādayo'pi gṛhyante, tataḥ siddhā na tairbaddhyante nirāsrayatvātteṣāmiti manyate

anena sarveṇa etat kathayati--vivādagocarāpannaṃ kāryaṃ buddhimatkāraṇaṃ tattvāt ghaṭādivat ityatra yadi cetanena ātmanā sāsraveṇa ātmano'caitanairbandhaḥ svayaṃ kriyate, iti sa eva kriyate iti sa eva dhīmān tatkāraṇaṃ sādhyate; tarhi siddhasādhanam
nanu badhyamāno'sau āsravaiḥ kṛttvā acetanaiḥ svayam, tathāpi ātmīyairiva parakīyairapi badhyate iti mīmāṃsakaḥ
sa hi putrādisambandhibhiḥ taiḥ ciramṛtānāmapi pitrādīnām baddhatvamabhyupagacchati, saugato vā anyakarmabhiḥ anyasya; taṃ prati āha--svaiḥ iti
svaiḥ ātmīyaiḥ āsravaiḥ na parakīyaiḥ, avyavasthāpatteḥ

na khalu putrasya surādarśanābhilāṣādayaḥ pitaram atyantaśrotriyaṃ surayā yojayanti jīvantapi kimaṅga punaḥ mṛtān ? anyathā kṛtānekayogo'pi pitā putradoṣāt narakaṃ vrajediti na kaścit prekṣākārī niyamena sukṛtakārī syāt
kadācit putraṃ doṣakāriṇamāśaṅkamānaḥ putro vā na jananīyaḥ
nahi vairiṇaḥ svavadhamāśaṅkamāna eva tam ātmanaḥ sannihitamupanayati

yadi punaḥ kasyacit kaścit putraḥ śrutakārī dṛṣṭa iti svayaṃ putrajanane pravṛttiḥ--anyo'pi tādṛśo bhaviṣyati, kadācidarthasandeho hi kṛṣīvalādivat pravṛtteḥ aṅgamiti; tadasāmpratam; yataḥ kasyacidapakāryapi tādṛkṣo bhaviṣyati ityanarthasaṃjñānivṛtteḥ
yadvā, svaiḥ acetanairbadhyate; anyathā ṭhakapāpaiḥ sarvo'pi badhyeta
yadi asau anyasmai dadāti, tadā so'pi badhyate

tathāhi--saugataḥ janmayopārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ tena tvāḥ sarve sarve sattvāḥ sukhino bhavantu iti sarvo'pi vadatīti cet; vatinaitā tasya puṇyena anye sukhino nāma, itarathāmatiryadaiva pāpo bhaṇati madīyena atipāpena sarve yogino duḥkhitā bhavantu tadā'sau sakalasaṃsāraduḥkharahito yoginastu tatsahitāḥ syuḥ iti

yasmai taddīyate sa yadicchati, tatarhi sarvameva tatta yoginaḥ tadicchanti iti cet; na yuktametat; yato yadaiva mriyamāṇāya ciraṃjīvinam icchati, varṣaśatāyuḥ svāyuḥ dadāti, taddātuḥ tadaiva maraṇam anyasya cirajīvinastam bhavet
kṣaṇikatvāt, anyena kriyate anyaśca badhyate iti bhāvaḥ
tvāḥ sarve iti vyarthamatra dvirlikhitaṃ bhāti
puṇyahetubhiḥ śubhaiḥ apuṇyahetubhiḥ aśubhaiḥ manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ āsravaiḥ iti
nanu ca ya eva puṇyahetavaḥ ta eva pāpahetavaḥ śubhācaraṇavato'pi apāyadarśanāt, tathā ya eva pāpahetavaḥ ta eva puṇyahetavo'pi hiṃsādyanuṣṭhānaratasyāpi abhyudayadarśanāt
evaṃ ca hetusaṅkare kathaṃ prekṣākāriṇā dharmādyupāyācaraṇamiti cet; atrāha--yathāsvam iti
yāni svāni ye vā yathāsvam iti
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yasya śubhasya aśubhasya vā cetanasya yāni manovākkāyakarmāṇi svāni kāraṇatvena pratyāsannāni ye vā āsravāḥ teṣāmanatikrameṇa cetano'caitanairbadhyate iti
na khalu śubhasya acetanasya kāraṇāni aśubhasya sutā bhavitumarhanti, anyathā śālyaṅkurakāraṇāni yavāṅkurasya syuḥ

yastu śubhācāravato'pi apāyo dṛśyate nāsau tadācārāt tajjanyānādvākarmaṇaḥ, api tu pūrvakṛtaduṣkarmaṇaḥ, itarathā tadācāraphalasya tadaiva niṣpannatvānna kaścid bhāvinā mantradevatāviśeṣārādhanādiphalena tadvān syāt

yadi ca kadācit śubhādvā'nantaramapāyadarśanāt sa eva tasya tatkāraṇasya vā kāraṇam; hanta saviṣaṃ divyamāhāraṃ bhuñjānasya mṛtyuḥ tadāhārakṛtaḥ ! yadi punaḥ prāyaśaḥ tadāhārāt sa na dṛṣṭaḥ, kintu viṣād dṛṣṭaḥ iti tadeva tatkāraṇaṃ kalpyate nāhāraḥ; evaṃ prakṛteti kalpanāyām kiṃ virudhyeta yataḥ sā na kriyeta ? apāyasya vajjalaṃ viruddhācaraṇādeva darśanāt
nanu syādetadevaṃ yadi śubhāvaṇet puṇyaṃ kutaścit siddhaṃ syāditi cet; āstāṃ tāvadetat vṛttau vakṣyati
etena hiṃsādyanuṣṭhānāt kadācid hiraṇyādilābhopalambhāt tadanuṣṭhānaṃ dharmasādhanam iti nirastam; tallābhasya pūrvakṛtasukṛtādeva bhāvāt
idaṃ tu syāt--itthaṃ tena karma kṛtaṃ yattadanuṣṭhānasahitaṃ phalaṃ dadāti
tata eva ca tadbhāve gurubhāryābhigamanādeḥ tat syāt
etena idamapi prayuktam--parasya anukūleṣu anukūlābhimānajanito'bhilāṣaḥ abhilaṣituḥ arthābhimukhakriyākāraṇaṃ janayati tattadātmano'nukūleṣu tajjanitābhilāṣavat
iti; katham ? gurubhāryānukūleṣu parapuruṣādigamanādiṣu putrādeḥ tadanukūlābhilāṣasyāpi dharmahetutvaprasaṅgāt
guroḥ pratikūlatvānneti cet; mṛte vā gurau syāt
yadi pratikūle ca tapasi bhatura nukūlābhilāṣo'pi puṇyaheturna syāt

mīmāṃsakastvāha--keva hiṃsādyanuṣṭhānaṃ mantrasahitam, yathā viṣaṃ kevalaṃ mṛtyave na mantrādisahitam, tato'bhyudayasya vyādhiśamanasya bhāvāditi; tadayuktam; svecchāmātrād arthā'siddheḥ, atiprasaṅgācca
vedasya pramāṇatvasya niṣetsyamānatvāt na tato'sya vibhāgasya pratipattiḥ, khārpaṭikāgamādapi tatpratītiprasaṅgācca
yadi vā, śubhā'śubhaiḥ puṇyāpuṇyairacetanaiḥ badhyate iti sambandhanīyam
tarhi aviśeṣeṇa cetanaṃ taiḥ badhyata iti cet; atrāha--yathāsvam iti
yasya cetanasya yaḥ svaḥ mandatīvrādirūpaḥ krodhādisvabhāvastasya anatikrameṇa iti
athavā āsravaiḥ ityatra ca śabdo draṣṭavyaḥ
nanu kārikāyāṃ śubhā'śubhaiḥ iti samasto nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ, atra kimarthaṃ vyastaḥ kriyate iti cet ? saṅkarādiparihārārthaḥ
ye śubhāḥ te śubhā eva, ye ca svasya te svasyaiva nānyasya' iti pratipādanārthaḥ tathānirdeśaḥ

tā kārikāyāṃ sāmānyato jīva ityuktam, atra vyaktyapekṣaṃ jīvānām iti vacanaṃ jīvabahutvapratipādanārtham, itarathā atrāpi jīvasya ityekavacanaprayoge mandamateḥ āśaṅkā syāt--ācāryamate eka eva jīvaḥ iti
na ca tadbandhaḥ tasya tatkāraṇābhāvāt sattāmātrā pramāṇabhācca
śarīraparimāṇasya cetanāpariṇāmasya anādyanidhanasya karturbhoktuḥ ātmanaḥ pratipādanārthaṃ jīvagrahaṇam
asyaiva grahaṇam asyaiva tadvācyatvena prasiddheḥ, ātmādiśabdānāṃ tu parāpekṣayā anyatrāpi pravṛtteḥ
nanvatra paravipratipattinirāsārthaṃ pramāṇaṃ vaktavyamiti cet; atrāha--atra ityādi
syānmatam--pramāṇena viṣayīkṛte prameye na kaścid vipratipattumarhati
na vai khalu ātasāditailādisaṃparke ghaṭādeḥ pāṃśurāśisambandha iva manovākkāyakarmabhirāsravaiḥ śubhairaśubhaiśca puṇyapāpabandho jīvānāṃ pratyakṣataḥ pratīyate; vipratipatterabhāvaprasaṅgāt
na ca tatkarmāsravāḥ liṅgam; kāraṇāt kāryānumānam iti prāpteḥ
na caivam, vyabhicārāt, nāvaśyaṃ kāraṇāni kāryavanti bhavanti pra॰ vā॰ sva॰ 1
na ca te anyatra anyadā tatkāraṇatvena ātasatailādivat pratītaṃ yatastebhyo bandho'numīyeta mālavakātasatailasaṃparkādiva udaramalabandhaḥ

āgamena viṣayīkṛta iti cet; kathanna tatra kaścid vipratipattumarhati ? tadviṣayīkaraṇādeva vipratipattīnāmatīndriyārthe prakṛtiḥ kāraṇaṃ puruṣaḥ kāraṇam ityādau darśanāt, anyathā āgamenāpi tadaviṣayīkaraṇe nirālambā vipratipattayo na pravartteran
yadeva ca vipratipattikāraṇaṃ tata eva tannivṛttiriti na hetuphalavyavasthā
atha tatkarmāsravebhyaḥ puṇyabandho jīvānām ityādi vākyaṃ pramāṇam, arhadvākyatvāt, pariṇāmighaṭādipratipādakatadvākyavat' iti; tadapi na sundaram; atra tadvākyatvā'siddheḥ
yadi punaḥ tadapi tadvākyam anekāntātmakatattvaviṣayatvāt prasiddhānyatadviṣayavākyavat iti; tadapi tādṛgeva; tadviṣayatve parāpapratītatvāvirodhāt
nahi etannāmakamatīndriyaṃ saptamadravyaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ pariṇāmīti vikalavido vadato vaktraṃ vakrībhavati

apare manyante--na prayāsasādhyo'yamarthaḥ kintu sarveṣāmavigīto'yam, sarveṣāṃ vādināṃ vigānarahito'yamiti na kaścit sacetano vipratipattimapi pramāṇāṅkuśarahitāḥ svamatasamarthanamadavahalāvalepāpannā gajā iva pravarttamānā vipratipattāraḥ kena vāryante
dṛśyante hi cārvākādayaḥ atraiva vivadamānāḥ, na ca te tattvapratipattiṃ prati upekṣaṇīyāḥ samadarśibhiḥ parahitāvadhānadīkṣāvadbhiḥ a ka la ṅkaiḥ
nāpi teṣāṃ vipratipattaya evameva nivarttante api tu pramāṇāt, atastadeva tān prati vaktavyaṃ kimanena atra na kaścit ityādinā
mīmāṃsako'pi śvetaṃ chagamālabheta svargakāmaḥ iti vacanāt dravyādīnāmeva puṇyatvamicchati, brāhmaṇo na hantavyaḥ ityādi vacanācca brahmavadhādīnāmeva pāpatvam, na tābhyāṃ paraṃ puṇyapāpabandha iti
na māṃsabhakṣaṇe doṣaḥ na madye na ca maithune
dānahiṃsāviraticetasāṃ svargaprāpaṇasāmarthyāt, teṣāṃ pratyakṣatve'pi na pratyakṣatvam iti sūrervacanād idamevam ityavasīyate
saṃskārāḥ pūrvavatsattvo badhyate na na mucyate
sāṃkhyasya tu matam--taiḥ prakṛtipariṇāmaviśeṣo jāyate, tataḥ tasyā eva tadbandho na puruṣāṇāṃ śuddhātmanāmiti
atra pratividhīyate--puṇyapāpabandho jīvānām ityatra na kaścid vipratipattumarhati iti vadato'yamabhiprāyaḥ--sarvādvaitaniṣedhāt jīvabahutvasiddheḥ jīvānām ityatra na kaścid vipratipattumarhati

kathaṃ tatpratiṣedha iti cet ? uktamatra, tathāpi ucyate kiñcit--vijñānalakṣaṇasya anyasya vā advaitasya adṛṣṭasya kalpane tathāvidhānāṃ pariṇāmināmanyathābhūtānāṃ vā santānāntarāṇāṃ tathākalpanāyāṃ tasyāḥ puruṣādhīnatayā anivāryatvāt kathamadvaitam ? dṛṣṭasya kalpane; anyato darśane asya siddhaḥ paramārthato grāhyābhāva iti kathamadvaitam ? itarathā grāhyabhedavat na tatastatsiddhiḥ
svato darśanaṃ ve jñāne etat pratīyatām
nahi apramāṇakaṃ svadarśanamanyadvā kyadhyava sthām arhati, atiprasaṅgāt

atha matam--nīlādyātmakameva tadadvaitam, anyasyāpratibhāsenāsattvāt, nīlādeśca svapratibhāsātmakatvaṃ sukhādivat pratibhāsamānasya sato'nyagrāhakādarśanāditi; tanna yuktam; yataḥ pratibhāsavaśena tattvavyavasthāyāṃ nīlamahaṃ vedmi, pītamahaṃ vedmi iti ahamahamikayā jñānasvarūpavat tato bhinnaṃ nīlādikaṃ pratiyat pratīyate iti tathaiva syāt, anyathā na kasyacidvedakamiti svagrahaṇamiti dūrotsāritam
anekasvabhāvena; anavasthā, tasyāpi punaḥ anyasvabhāvāntareṇa grahaṇāt
na ca grahaṇasvabhāvasya jñānasya agṛhītaḥ svabhāvaḥ; virodhāt iti
katham ? yasmād ekameva svabhāvamapi svaparo pratiyat pratīyate tasmāt tau pratyeti
nāpi tayoraikyaṃ tadapratīteḥ, itarathā nīlajñānaṃ yena svabhāvena pītād vyāvartate tenaiva raktād vyāvṛttau tayoraikyamiti mahatī citrādvaitatā ! svabhāvāntarakalpane tadavasthā anavasthā
bhavet vā tadanekasvabhāvaṃ tadgrāhakam tathāpi nānavasthā, tadvato grahaṇe'pi svabhāvabhūtāyā api yogyatāyāḥ grahaṇaniyamā'yogāt
kevalaṃ kāryadarśanāt tadātmikā anumīyate vyavahāro nedānīṃ pravarttyate
tadvato grahaṇe tadgrahaṇe'pi nānavasthā; tatsvabhāvātmakasya tathaiva pratibhāsanāt

asyānabhyupagame kutastadadvaitamiti kathaṃ jīvanānātvanirākaraṇamapramāṇakaṃ yuktam ? bhāve vā tasya prāgabhāvapradhvaṃsābhāvā'nabhyupagame na puruṣādvaitād bheda iti susthitā citrādvaitatā ! tadabhyupagame vā kathaṃ prakṛtavikalpadvayanivṛttiḥ ? tathāhi--yena svabhāvena prāk paścācca tadasat tenaiva svakāle sat, svabhāvāntareṇa vā ? prathamapakṣe pūrvaṃ paścācca bhāvaḥ svakāle'pi bhāvāt, kāryakāraṇabhāvapratiṣedho vā pūrvottarakṣaṇaviśeṣayoreva tadbhāvavyapadeśāt
tadabhāvasya vijñaptimātre'pi upagamādadoṣa iti cet; kathamadoṣaḥ, yāvatā yenaiva svabhāvena kutaścit jāyate madhyakṣaṇaḥ tenaiva cedaparasya kāraṇam; pūrvāparayoraikyam

pūrvottarakṣaṇānabhyupagame ca yathā akṣaṇikasya akrameṇa svakāryakāriṇo yugapat sakalaṃ svaviṣayaṃ vijñānamutpādya uparatasya dvitīyādikṣaṇādarśanābhāvāt śūnyatā tathā kṣaṇamātrāvalambino vijñānasya bhavet na veti sudhiyaḥ cintayantu ? tadā ca śūnyatāyāmapi yadi na parasya aniṣṭaṃ kiñcidāpadyate sarvadā saivāstu
kiñca, svayaṃ saiva prakāśate pra॰ vā॰ 2
327 ityetadapi evaṃ sati ayuktaṃ syāt, svagrahaṇayogyatāmantareṇa jaḍārthavat tadayogāt
sāpi svagrāhyatā yogyatāmapekṣate, tatra ca prakṛtavikalpadvayavṛttiḥ avaśyaṃbhāvinī yathoktadoṣāt
tanna pratyakṣasiddhaṃ svaparāvabhāsakatvaṃ cetasāṃ nirvikalpāt nirākartuṃ yuktam atiprasaṅgāt
nanu na samakālasya parasya prakāśikā buddhiḥ apratibandhāt, svatantrayoḥ ubhayoḥ pratibhāsanāt, para eva vā nīlādiḥ tatprakāśakaḥ syāt
atha nīlādau karmatā pratīyate tataḥ sa etayā prakāśyate na tena buddhirviparyayāditi; tatra yato nīlāvya tirekeṇa karmatādarśanam
tatsvarūpameva karmateti cet; na; buddhāvapi tasya bhāvāt
yadi punaḥ gṛhītikaraṇād buddhireva tasya grāhikā; tarhi sā yadi tato bhinnā kriyate gṛhītiḥ buddhiḥ nīlam iti tritayaṃ svatantramābhāti na kiñcit kasyacid grāhakam
gṛhītyāpi bhinnasya tadantarasya karaṇe sa eva doṣo'navasthā ca, tenāpi tadantarasya karaṇāt
tadgṛhītau ca anubaddhaprasaṅgaḥ, anavasthā ca tatrāpi aparāparagṛhītyapekṣaṇāt
abhinnā cet; nīlādireva tayā kriyate iti prāptam; tacca na yuktam; anyata eva tasya bhāvāt, kṛtasya karaṇāyogāt
tayā ca kriyamāṇo nīlādiḥ uttarajñānavaśatāmeva syāt na arthaḥ
grahaṇe vā kathaṃ na prakṛto doṣaḥ anavasthā cakrakaṃ bhavet
abhinnāyāḥ tatrāpi gṛhīteḥ karaṇe punaḥ punastasyaiva pravṛtteḥ
yaḥ doṣaprasaṅgaḥ arthapakṣe asti tasya anubaddhatvamatrāpi syāt
etena bhinnakālasyāpi tayā grahaṇaṃ svāritam; aviśeṣāt, sarvātītānāgatagrahaṇaprasaṅgācca
tanna bhinnasya kenacit kasyacid grahaṇamiti na jīvavat kuḍyamiti cet; na; uktamatra, avikalpena pratyakṣa pratīyamānasya buddhinīlādyorvedyavedakabhāvasya nirākarttumaśakteriti
na ca buddhivat nīlādeḥ pratibhāsanam aparādhīnaṃ paraṃ prati prasiddham, anyathā nīlamahaṃ vedmi iti svapne'pi na syād aviṣaye tadavṛtteḥ
nahi nīladarśī pītamahaṃ vedmi iti kadācid vyavaharati
na cetanasya jīvasya siddhirnāpi kuḍyasya acetanasyeti bhāvaḥ
svādhīnam, na parādhīnam aparādhīnam iti vyutpatteḥ
yatpunaruktam--nīlameva śabdaḥ kuto na grāhakam iti; tadapi tathā supratītyā parihṛtam
parasyāpi nīlākāraṃ jñānam ātmavat pītākārajñānasya grāhakaṃ tadvad ātmano vā agrāhakaṃ na syāt
ātmano grāhakatvena anyasya agrāhakatvena pratīteriti cet; ahamahamikayā buddheḥ pratīyamānāyāḥ svaparagrāhakatvena nīlādeśca tadgrāhyatvena pratītiriti samaḥ samādhiḥ
yatpunaretat--na nīlādisvarūpavyatirekeṇa grāhyatā pratibhāti, svarūpaṃ ca yathā buddhyapekṣayā nīlasya tathā tadapekṣayā buddherapi iti; tadapi na sāram; yataḥ sarvabhāvānāmanyo'nyaṃ svarūpabhedāt
nahi ekasya svarūpaṃ anyasya; sarvasya ekatvaprasaṅgāt
tathā ca buddhergrāhyaṃ grāhakaṃ ca svarūpam nīlādeḥ, grāhyameva, tathāpratīteriti
itarathā yayā yogyatayā nīlākāram ātmasātkaroti nīlajñānaṃ tayā pītajñānaṃ tamātmasātkuryāt
ata eva na dhiyā tasya gṛhītiḥ kācit kriyate, api tu svarūpameva gṛhyate, yathā kāraṇena kāryasya svarūpaṃ janyate
kathañcaivaṃvādinām ātmano'pi buddhirgrāhikā ? gṛhītikaraṇāt; prasaṅgaḥ pūrvavat
atha na tasya sā grāhikā kintu svayaṃ prakāśate; na; svayam ātmānaṃ gṛhṇāti iti nāmamātrabhedāt, nīlaṃ vā na gṛhṇāti kintu prakāśayati ityapi syāt
yaccāpyuktam--na samasamayasya itarasya vā grāhikā iti; tat sarvagam; tathāhi--jñānam ātmani nīlādyākāraṃ vitsamakālam itaraṃ vā vibhartti iti sarvaṃ vācyam

nanu ca nīlamahaṃ vedmi iti pratītiḥ svapne'pi; tataḥ kim ? tatreva jāgraddaśāyāmapi nīlādipratibhāsaḥ asadarthaḥ sidhyati iti cet; na; ekatra tathābhāvena sarvatra tathābhāvaniyamāsiddheḥ, itarathā svavedane'pi tathābhāvasiddheḥ bahirarthavat tadapi tyāgāṅgaṃ tato bahirarthādiva sādhanādiprayojanāsiddheḥ, itarathā asatpratibhāsatvāviśeṣe'pi tadaṅgīkaraṇāt ardhavaisasa nyāyo'nuṣṭhitaḥ syāt
tato yathā pratibhāsāviśeṣe'pi bahirarthapratibhāso'sadartha iṣyate saugatena, na svavedanapratibhāsaḥ, tathā pareṇa svapnārthapratibhāso'sadartha iṣyate na jāgratpratibhāsaḥ

nanu yathā jāgratpratibhāsādeḥ stambhādeḥ paramārthasattvaṃ tataḥ svapne'pi tattasya bhavediti bhāve ko doṣo bahirarthavādinaḥ ? pramāṇatadābhāsapraṇayanamanarthakamiti cet; saugatasyāpi sarvamālambane, na svarūpe bhrāntam pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 280 iti kimevamanarthakaṃ na syāt ? api ca, svapnetarayoḥ tataḥ paramārthasiddhau mama pramāṇatadābhāsapraṇayanaṃ vaikatrasya , saugatasya punaḥ sakalaṃ darśanaṃ vijñaptimātrā'siddheḥ ityaho tasya paradūṣaṇakauśalam !
yathā kaścidyavanaḥ kukkuṭīmāṃsabhojanakāmaḥ tatsantatikāmaśca tadgrīvādikaṃ chittvā bhuṅkte, udaraṃ ca santānārthaṃ sthāpayatīti yathā na saṃbhavati tathā prakṛte'pi
...kukkuṭādereko deśaḥ prasavāya kalpate pacyate deśāntaramityardhavaiśasam...--bṛhadā॰ vā॰ ṭī॰ 1
apareṣāṃ darśanam--svapnavad anyadāpi satyetarapravibhāgaviyoga iti; teṣāmapi na vijñaptimātraṃ prasidhyati, jñapteriva sakalavikalpātītasyāpi siddheḥ darśanāntarānuṣaṅgāt
kiṃ tena tādṛśā siddheneti cet ? kiṃ jñaptyā ? na ca asminnekānte na kasyacit sakalavikalpātītatā kṣaṇikaikānto vā sidhyatītyuktaprāyam
bhedavad abhedasyāpi bahirantaśca pratīteḥ kuṇḍalādiṣu sarpavat
na ceyaṃ pratītiḥ kalpitarūpā; saḥ iti pratītollekhaḥ ayam iti varttamāna iti vikalpayato'pi anivṛtteḥ, aśvaṃ vikalpayato'pi gobuddhivat
na tadekānte pareṇa bādha iṣyate yato nirviṣayatvaṃ syāt svapnajñāne'pi tathānuṣaṅgena tadekāntahāneḥ
kuta iyaṃ pratītiriti cet ? bhedapratītivat cakṣurādeḥ iti
kevalaṃ pūrvottaraparyāya smaraṇadarśanābhyāṃ sa evāyam iti pratyavamarśo'nyo janyate, yataḥ aparapariṇāmeṣu tiṣṭhataḥ pūrvaparyāyasthitā vyavasīyate
na ca indriyajñānameva saviṣayam; sarvasya svapratibhāsinā viṣayeṇa saviṣayatvāt
etena kāryakāraṇabhāvapratītirapi nirūpitā; idamasmājjātam iti avigānena pratīteḥ

yatpunaretat--yad viśadadarśanamārgāvatāri na tat paramārthasat yathā svapnopalabdhaṃ mataṅgajādikam, viśadadarśanamārgāvatāri ca jāgraddaśādarśanadṛṣṭastambhādikam iti; tatrāpi dṛṣṭānte kutaḥ paramārthasattvābhāvaḥ prāptaḥ yatastena viśadadarśanamārgāvatāritvasya anyasya vā hetoḥ vyāptiḥ sidhyet ? apratipannena sātmakatveneva prāṇādeḥ ātmanā iva saṃhṛtatvādeḥ kasyacid vyāptyasiddheḥ
pratipanne iti cet; yadi viśadadarśanāt paramārthasat; kathaṃ hetuḥ avyabhicārī, anena vyabhicārāt ? aparamārthasan cet; bahirarthavat na tatsiddhiriti sa eva doṣaḥ— na tena kasyacid vyāptiḥ iti
etena anumānādapi tatpratipannatā pratyuktā; tatrāpi aparanidarśanānveṣaṇe anavasthā
jāgraddṛṣṭastambhādi nidarśanamiti cet; anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ--siddhehi svapnadṛṣṭamataṅgajādeḥ paramārthasattvābhāve tato jāgraddaśopalabdhastambhādeśca tatsiddhiḥ, ataśca tatsiddhiḥ iti

yadi punaḥ pratipādyena svapnadṛṣṭasya ghaṭādeḥ paramārthasattvābhāve'pi upagamāt tena hetoḥ vyāptisiddheḥ, na hetoḥ niranvayadoṣaḥ, dṛṣṭāntasya vā sādhyavikalatā sandigdhadharmatā vā; tathā sati sāṃkhyo'pi acetanāḥ sukhādayaḥ anityotpattimattvāt ghaṭādivat iti vadan kimiti dha rma kī rtti nā sva grahaṇaṃ vyācakṣāṇena akāraṇameva nirastaḥ ? pratipādyena saugatena lokena vā tatra anityotpattimattvādeḥ aṅgīkaraṇāt

pratipādyavaśena ca dṛṣṭānte sādhyasiddhiḥ na punaḥ sādhyadharmiṇi hetoḥ iti ko'yaṃ niyogaḥ ? yadi vā pratipādyecchāmātrasiddhaṃ sādhyamādāya dṛṣṭānte tena hetoḥ vyāptiriṣyate; tarhi asvecchā mātrasiddhamādāya sā kinneṣyate ? apramāṇabhūtayoḥ svaparecchayoraviśeṣāt
tathābhyupagame ko doṣa iti cet; na kaścit; kevalaṃ sādhyavat sādhanasyāpi svecchākalpitasya abhimatasādhyena vyāptibhāvāt svadṛṣṭārthaprakāśakaṃ parārthamanumānam ityatra arthagrahaṇamanarthakam
tanna svaparecchāmātrasiddhena sādhyena hetorvyāptisiddhiriti kathanna niranvayādidoṣa iti cet ? ata eva, pakṣīkṛte'pi tadabhāvasiddheḥ hetoḥ ānarthakyam

atha jāgratpratyayo bādhaka iṣyate, yatastasmin sati paramārthasanna bhavati svapnaghaṭādikam, api tu tathā asadapi sattvena mithyā vitarkitamiti vyavahārapravṛtteriti cet; na; pareṇa tasya tadbādhakatvā'nabhyupagamāt
bhavatu vā kathañcit tare tadabhāvo naitāvatā sarvatra tatsiddhiḥ, vipakṣe sadbhāvabādhakapramāṇābhāve sandigdhavipakṣavyāvṛttikatvena anaikāntikatvāt
nahi paramārthasaddarśanamārgāvatāritvaṃ kena vijñānaṃ taścid bādhyamānaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ sarvajñe vaktṛtvādivat; tathā sataḥ kasyacittadadarśanāt
tathāpi tatra tadabhāvasādhane na vaktṛtvādīnāṃ gamakatvamiti mīmāṃsakaṃ prati vidveṣo nirnibandhanaḥ
darśane vā hetorvyabhicāraḥ kathaṃ parihṛtaḥ syāt ? sutapava na virodho'pi sākṣāt tatra tadbhāvaṃ bādhate, adṛṣṭena hetoḥ virodhadvayāsiddheḥ
tatra parārthānumānaṃ tu svadṛṣṭārthaprakāśanam--pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 467

nanu paramārthasattvavirodhī tadabhāvaḥ, tena vyāpto hetuḥ, ataḥ paramparāpāyā virodha iti cet; yadi kvacit tayoḥ sahabhāvadarśanāt tena tadvyāptiḥ, kāryatvasya buddhimatkāraṇatvena vyāptiḥ, kvacit sahabhāvadarśanasya atrāpi bhāvāt
bhavatu vā vipakṣāt kathañcidasya vyāvṛttiḥ, tathāpi viśadadarśanagamyatve'pi paramārthasattve hetoḥ vyabhicārāparihāraḥ
yathā kāryatvahetoḥ vipakṣe bādhakaṃ durlabham tathā anyatrāpi viśadadarśanagamyatve'pi hetau durlabham

nanu na bauddhena kvacit kiñcit sādhyate niṣidhyate vā tatkutaḥ, kevalaṃ yo vyavahārī pratibhāsādinā jāgratstambhādīnāṃ paramārthatvaṃ sādhayati śatena svapnādau tadvyabhicāreṇa tadabhyupagatena nirānta yate, tena tatra paramārthasattvābhāvābhyupagamāt ityeke
tatra kiṃ puruṣābhyupagamādapramāṇakāt sādhanaṃ vyabhicāri bhavati ? tathā cet; sattvādi sarvamanaikāntikaṃ tadvat syāt, pratipādyena anityaghaṭādivat nitye gaganādau tadaṅgīkaraṇāt
yadi ca pratibhāsādiḥ anaikāntikaḥ tataḥ kiṃ bahirarthaparamārthasiddhiḥ ? na hi sandigdhavyabhicāriṇaḥ sādhanāt sādhyasiddhirasandigdhā upajāyate atiprasaṅgāt

sandigdhe'rthe sati ko doṣaḥ ? kiṃ tena vyavahārānupayoginā samāśritena iti ? kiṃ punastattvam, yat tatparihāreṇa samāśrayaṇīyaṃ syāt ? svasaṃvedanamātramiti cet; nanu ca pratibhāsādinā tadapi sidhyati, sa ca abhyupagamena vyabhicārīkṛta iti na kiñcidetat
athātra viśeṣo'bhyupagamyate pareṇa; anyatrāpi so'bhyupagamyate iti
na ca anyasya vyabhicāre anyasya vyabhicāraḥ atiprasaṅgāt

nanvevaṃ bahirarthasādhanaṃ prakṛti cet; ucyate--yathā bahirarthagrahaṇānubandhamajahata eva jñānasya svagrahaṇavyāpāraḥ, svagrahaṇānubandhaṃ cā'jahato deśabhinnārthagrahaṇavyāpāraḥ, tathā kāraṇagrahaṇānubandhamajahata eva kālabhinnakāryagrahaṇasiddheḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ pāramārthikaḥ sidhyati, tatsiddheśca yathā kvacid dhūmadarśanādagneḥ siddhiḥ tathā kvacid vāgupalambhāt caitanyasiddhiḥ iti yaduktam--vāgbuddhyoḥ pramāṇābhāvena kāryakāraṇabhāvā'siddherna vāco buddhyanumānam iti; tannirastam

tattve kadā buddhervāco darśane'pi na sarvatra sarvadā tata eva, sālūkāt sālūkasya darśane'pi punaḥ gomayādapi taddarśanena vyabhicārāśaṅkā'nivṛtteḥ tatrāpi, taṃ kathaṃ vāco buddhyanumānam ityeke; te cārvākādapi pāpīyāṃsaḥ; svayameva yādṛśād yādṛśamupalabdham, anyadāpi tādṛśādeva tādṛśabhāvam abhyupagamya punaḥ anyathābhidhānāt
kathaṃ caivaṃ vādināṃ sarvaṃ jñānaṃ svāgrāhimā punaḥ paragrāhyatā iti sidhyati yato mīmāṃsakādinivṛttiḥ syāt
nahi pratyakṣamiyato vyāpārān kartuṃ samartham, aviṣaye svayamavṛtteḥ, eka vākya dvaitaniṣedhāt
atha yat svagrāhi na bhavati taj jñānameva na bhavati
nanvekatra tathādarśane sarvatra tathābhāvaḥ kathaṃbhūtasya vṛkṣasya svabhāvasya ekadā darśane'pi svabhāvātikramā'nivṛtteḥ
evaṃ satyapi jñānaṃ svasvabhāvaṃ kadācanāpi na jahāti, kāryaṃ tu kāraṇaṃ jahāti iti pracaṇḍanṛpaticeṣṭitam ! tataḥ sādhūktam--jīvānām ityatra na kaścid viprattipattumarhati iti
kathaṃ caivaṃ vādināṃ sarva jñānam ekaṃ ca sidhyati tadadvaitaniṣedhāt iti sambandhaḥ

tadyathā, teṣāṃ yathāvasthitasvaparaprakāśanasvabhāvatvenā prakṛtyāśubhāmurīṇam āmaṃtuke mithyājñānaṃ viṣādibhyaḥ samupalabhya āgantukaṃ sukhādikamapi tathāvidhakāraṇaprabhavam ityanu mātumarhantu parīkṣakāḥ itarathā dhūmādeḥ agnyādi kathamanumīyate ? etāvāṃstu viśeṣaḥ— yato mithyājñānādikaṃ vivādāspadībhūtaṃ bhavati tat pāpam ityākhyāyate, yataḥ sukhādikaṃ tat puṇyam iti
tathā ca prayogaḥ teṣām--āgantukavivādagocarāpannaṃ sukhādikaṃ tatsaṃyuktaviṣādikāraṇasamāna kāraṇaprabhavam āgantuke sati tatpariṇāmatvāt prasiddhamithyājñānavat
idamapi tu subhāṣitam--puṇyapāpabandho jīvānām ityatra na kaścid vipratipattumarhati iti
tathaiva teṣāṃ tadbandhaḥ manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ āsravaiḥ śubhāśubhaiḥ ityatra na kaścid vipratipattumarhati iti

tathāhi--viṣādau svaparātmanoḥ ahite hitabuddhiḥ mithyājñānataḥ, tatastatra aviratiḥ ata lakṣaṇā, tato'pi pramāṇe hitetaraviṣayaṃ manaso'praṇidhānam, tasmācca lobhaḥ tadādātuṃ manovākkāyavyāpāraḥ, tatastadānam ātmanastena saṃyogaḥ, tena punaḥ aparaṃ mithyājñānam, evaṃ paratrāpi vaktavyam
tathā tatraiva mithyājñānāt krodhādayaḥ tadvyāpāraḥ tadupādānaṃ mithyātma nādikamiti vyākhyātavyam
tadvad viśiṣṭauṣadhādau samyagjñānādeḥ tadupādāne sukhādikaṃ vyākhyātavyam
tadevaṃ siddhāyāṃ vyāptau puṇyapāpabandho'numito'to bhavati ityanumīyate, ājñādi mithyājñānādikaṃ ca tatkāraṇamityapi
na ca kāraṇāt kāryānumānamayuktam, anyathā dṛśyānupalabdhiḥ asadvyavahārasādhanam anirūpitameva syāt, tasyāḥ tatkāraṇatvopagamāt
yogyatānumāne'pi pratibandhavaikalyasaṃbhavāśaṅkayā kathaṃ niḥśaṅkaṃ tadanumānaṃ tandulādeḥ odanādyanumānavat
mithyātvopacitāt sa eva samalaḥ kālādilabdhau kvacit
eṣo'haṃ mama karma śarma harate tadbandhanānyāsravaiḥ,
tanuktovādibhya eva hīnasaṃsthānasaṃkrāntitvaṃ tebhyo'nyadadṛṣṭaṃ tatkāraṇaṃ jāyate atadarśanāt iti
prāṇino yasya te na staḥ na sa janmādhigacchati || pra॰ vā॰ 1 | 83 iti
punaḥ teṣāṃ puṇyapāpabandhāt paścāt kālāntara ityarthaḥ
jīvakarmaṇoḥ saṃyogaviśeṣaḥ na samavāyaḥ cetane samavāyavirodhāt bandhaḥ tasya santatiḥ āphalāvāpteḥ santānena samavasthānam
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadi krodhādibhyaḥ ātmasambandhasantatyā prāptaphalakālaṃ kiñcinna syāt kuto janmāntare phalavikalpaḥ ? krodhādeśca janmakāla eva vilayāt
na tataḥ kṣaṇikaikānte santānaniṣedhāt sa yuktaḥ
etena śvetaṃ chāgamālabheta svargakāmaḥ iti vacanāt na manovākkāyakarmabhyaḥ phalavikalpaḥ iti nirastam; dravyādīnām iṣṭikālādāveva vināśāt
tatpravāhaṃsthitau varaṃ tebhyaḥ samutpannakarmaṇāṃ tatsthitirastu virodhā'bhāvāt, na dravyādīnāṃ viparyayāt, aihikaphalakāle'pi tatsantaterapratipatteriti
tasyāṃ satyām kathaṃ kutaḥ sa syāt ? ityatrāha— yathāsvam ityādi
yasya karmaṇo sa udayaḥ phalopajananasāmarthyaparipākaḥ yathākālam, udīraṇam apakvaparipācanaṃ tasya anatikrameṇa yathāsvam iti
tayordhvasā sāmarthyāt svasyāt atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--yadi svena svabhāvena prathamamutpannaṃ śubhamaśubhaṃ vā karma tenaiva kālāntare sthitamapi phalaṃ janayet, tadutpattisamaya eva tatsyāt
syānmatam--itthaṃbhūta eva asau svabhāvaḥ yat kālāntare kāryam
dṛśyate hi mantratantrādīnāṃ svadeśe samarthānāṃ deśāntare kāryakaraṇamiti; tanna yuktam; tatkāryāṇāṃ kālāntare'pi sahabhāvaprasaṅgāt
tathā ca asya utpadyate idaṃ karma iti yogino'pi na buddhiḥ
na ca parasya akāraṇaṃ viṣayaḥ arthavat arthasahakāri pramāṇam iti vacanāt
yoginaḥ akāraṇamapi viṣayaḥ ityapi vārttam; anyasyāpi tathāsaṃbhāvanāprasaṅgāt yasya yāvatī mātrā pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 223 itu nyāyāt

nanu īśvarajñānaṃ nityamapi arthagrāhakam, tathā nityamastu, anyathā anīśvarayogino jñānaṃ kathamarthagrāhakam ? tatkāryatvāt; kathamekasmād ekasvabhāvāt karmaṇaḥ anyato vā kramabhāvi kāryadvayam ? tathā svabhāvāditi cet; sa svabhāvaḥ kāraṇasya, kāryasya vā bhavet ? na tāvat kāraṇasya; ekasvabhāvatvāt
nahi ya eva pūrvakārye sa eva anyatra tadvyāpāro yuktaḥ, kāryakālabhedā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt
nāpyutpannasya; anyo'nyasaṃśrayāt--utpannasya tatsvabhāvatā, tasyāṃ ca tathotpattiḥ iti
nanu yathā ekasmād ekasvabhāvācca yugapad deśabhinnaṃ kāryaṃ tathā krameṇa kālabhinnamiti cet; bhavatu saugatasya na jainasya, tasya sarvadā kāraṇasvabhāvabhedādeva kāryabhedabhāvāt
atrāparaḥ prāha--yathā ekasvabhāvena kāraṇam ātmani nānāsāmarthyaṃ bibhartti, tathā tenaiva nānākāryaṃ kuryāditi, itarathā anavasthā iti; tanna; jainasya samayā'parijñānāt
na khalu jainasya kiñcit kenacit svabhāvena tatsāmarthyaṃ bibhartti iti matam, api tu svakāraṇāt tadātmakamutpadyate saṃśayetarasvabhāvajñānavaditi
yathā saṃśayajñānaṃ sthāṇvādāvarthe saṃśayarūpamapi svarūpe asaṃśayātmakaṃ bhavati tathā
tadetena yaduktaṃ kenacit--rūpādivad dharmā'dharmasaṃskārāṇām ādhāravyāpakatvam iti; tannirastam; sarvatra sarvadā tatkāryodayaprasaṅgāt, mokṣābhāvaprasaṅgāt dharmādyabhāvarūpatvāttasya
tatra tadabhāve nādhāravyāpakatvaṃ teṣām; mokṣe tadrahitasya ātmano bhāvāt

kathaṃ vā tatra tadabhāvo'vasīyate ? tatkāryaśarīrādyabhāvāt; kiṃ punaḥ kāryā'bhāvāt kāraṇābhāvagatiḥ ityekāntaḥ ? tathā cet; kathaṃ sarvatra dharmādigatiḥ yataḥ sarvagatātmavyāpakatvaṃ sarvatra tatkāryābhāvāt
adarśanāt satkāryābhāvāt tatra tatkāryābhāvo na dharmādyabhāvāt iti nottaram; mokṣe'pi tathā prasaṅgāt

kiṃ ca, ātmamanaḥsaṃyogaḥ svādhārāvyāpako'pi cet sarvatra sarvadā ātmani dharmādikaṃ janayati; dharmādiḥ tathā svādhārā'vyāpako'pi sarvatra kāryaṃ karoti iti kiṃ tadvyāpakatvakalpanayā ? iti yatkiñcidetat
nanu na sarvatra sarvaṃ tatkāryaṃ kālādisāmagrīvaikalyāt tadbhāve tu bhavatyeveti cet; atrāha--kālādi ityādi
kāla ādiryeṣāṃ te deśadravyaviśeṣādīnāṃ te tathoktāḥ teṣāṃ sāmagrī taḥ te eva viśiṣṭapariṇāmopetā na punaḥ tebhyo'nyaiva, tasyā eva kāryodayaḥ prasaṅgāt
tasyāḥ sannidhau sannidhāne aṅgīkriyamāṇe udaya-udīraṇavaśāt phalavikalpaḥ syāt
yadi vā, tatsannidhau phalavikalpaḥ syāt, tasmin satyeva bhāvāt, karmasu teṣu satsvapi pūrvamabhāvāt iti vyākhyeyam

punaḥ bandhasantatau phalavikalpaḥ syāt ityanena dṛśyādeva sevādeḥ tadvikalpana nirākaroti samānasevādīnāmapi kasyacid acirād aparasya cirāt phalam anyasya cirādapi phalaṃ na iti phalavikalpasya darśanāt
na ca samāne kāraṇe phalavaicitryam; atatphalatvaprasaṅgāt
etena dṛśyabhūtaviśeṣāt tatsaṃbhavo'pāstaḥ; parisrāvyasphaṭikabhājane vyavasthāpitādapi jalāt nānājantujanmopalambhāt
tadviśeṣo kadācit kvacideva bhavannātmanaḥ kāraṇaniyamaṃ sūcayati
mūṣikā'larkaśabdayoḥ kṛtadvandvayoḥ viṣaśabdena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ tasya punaḥ vikāraśabdena
yadi vā, mūṣikālarkaviṣāṇāṃ kṛtadvandvānāṃ vikāraśabdena tatsamāso'bhidheyaḥ, tadvikāreṇa tulyaṃ varttate iti tadvat iti
sukhaduḥkhādilakṣaṇaḥ ityatra ādiśabdena vivakṣitaṃ mithyādarśanajñānaphalaṃ nirūpituṃ kārikāmupanyasyati udayodīraṇa ityādinā
jīve tāvannāstikyam anyatra jīvābhimānaśca, mithyādṛṣṭeḥ dvaividhyānatikramāt vipratipattirapratipattirveti
nanu ca ādiśabdena upadarśitopadarśanārthaṃ punaḥ kārikā ucyamānā punaruktatāmāvahet, atiprasaṅgaśca iṣṭāniṣṭaśarīrādiphalopadarśanārthayorapi tathāvacanaprāpteḥ iti cet; na; anyathā tadupanyāsāt

tathāhi--mithyājñānādeḥ aviratiḥ, tataḥ pramādaḥ, asmāt krodhādayaḥ, tebhyaḥ āsravaḥ, tataḥ karmabandhaḥ, punaḥ bandhasantatau phalavikalpaḥ syāt iti sūreḥ abhiprāyaḥ, eṣo'haṃ mama karma śarma harate yaśa॰ u॰ pṛ॰ 246 ityādi vacanāt
tatra prathamaṃ mithyātvādikaṃ yadi akāraṇamanyakāraṇaṃ vā sarvaṃ tathaiva syāditi; atrāha--udayodīraṇa ityādi
atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--tadapi mithyātvādikam anyasmāt karmodayodīraṇavaśād anāditvāt tatprabandhasya bījāṅkuraprabandhavat iti
yadvā, tatra ādiśabdena iṣṭasthānasaṃkramaṇādiparigrahaḥ, na mithyādarśanādeḥ tatra vivādasya mithyājñānaṃ visaṃvādādapramāṇam siddhivi॰ 4
tadeva atra punarapi dṛṣṭāntārthamupadarśayitum udayodīraṇa ityādikāṃ kārikāmāha

idamatra tātparyam--yathā mūṣikālarkaviṣādi svakālādisāmagrī sattavā sattve phalavat tathā udayodīraṇavaśāt mithyātvaṃ kiñcid upalabhya āgantukam akṣaṇikatvādimithyātvaṃ tādṛśādeva kāraṇādiṣyate tathā āgantukasukhādivikalpo'pi iti
kiṃ syāt ? ityāha--mithyādṛṣṭidhiyau mithyāruci-mithyājñāne syātām iti śeṣaḥ
kiṃ sarvadā iti cet; atrāha--karma ityādi

yadā kāścit karmaprakṛtayaḥ kṣayopaśamavatyo bhavanti tadā ātmano viṣayagrahaṇābhimukhyam, anyathā mattamūrcchitavat tadayogāt, tadāpi kāsāñcid udayādibhāve mithyārucyādikamiti, yathā viṣādyupayoge mūrcchitasya
akāsāvid dviṃṣṭakalānāṃ kutaścit kṣayopaśame kāsāñcicca udayodīraṇe prāthamikaprabodhe sa vibhrabha iti manyate
jīvādi ityādinā kārikāṃ vivṛṇvan prathamaṃ nirdiṣṭāṃ mithyādṛṣṭiṃ vivṛṇoti--mithyādarśanam
ādiśabdena ajīvādiparigrahaḥ, sa eva tattvārthaḥ pramāṇopapannatvāt tatra aśraddhānam aruciḥ
tāvat śabdaḥ kramavācī jīve ātmani nāstikyaṃ nāstikasya bhāvo mithyādarśanam iti sambandhaḥ
tatraiva aparaṃ darśayati anyatra cetanāpariṇāmaśūnye svayaṃ kalpite dharmiṇi sarvagatatvādidharmoparakte jīvābhimānaśca mithyādarśanam ityanuvartate, atasmin tadabhimānasya tadrūpatvāt
kiṃ punaḥ dvividhameva tat pradarśyate ? ityāha--mithyādṛṣṭeḥ ityādi
mithyā dṛṣṭiḥ ruciryasya tasya dvadhyā natikramāt
tasya jīve viruddhā viparītā vā pratipattiḥ vipratipattiḥ apratipattiḥ pratipattyabhāvo yataḥ vā śabdo vikalpārthaḥ iti śabdaḥ mithyārucisamāptyarthaḥ

nanu kiṃ jīvo'stu na vā iti, tathā cetanapariṇāmasvabhāvaḥ anyo vā iti saṃśayapakṣo'pi tṛtīyo'sti sa kasmānnehocyate iti cet ? na; tasya apratipattiśabdena uktatvāt, tathā vā pratipattyabhāvarūpatvāt saṃśayasya iti
kathaṃbhūtasya mithyādṛṣṭestadbhavaḥ ? ityāha— kṣāyopaśamikabhāvasyāpi karmaṇāṃ yaḥ kṣayaśca upaśamaśca kṣayopaśamaḥ tatra bhavo bhāvo yasya tasyāpi mithyādṛṣṭeḥ
tadapi śabdaḥ tasyaiva ityavadhāraṇe, vacchatā rahitasya tadabhāvāt
tacchabdena jīvaḥ parāmṛśyate, tasya jīvasya ghātikarmāṇi yāni tat karmasāmānyavacane'pi darśanopaghātadvāreṇa tadupaghātakāni prakramād gṛhyante, teṣām udayodīraṇavaśāt iti
na kevalaṃ mithyādarśanameva tasya ato bhavati api tu mithyājñānamapi iti darśayannāha--matya ityādi
matyajñānam mithyā'vagrahādijñānam ādiryasya śrutā'jñānādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ sa eva pariṇatiḥ
nanu ca jīvavadanyatrāpi nāstikyasaṃbhave jīve tāvat iti kramavācī śabdaḥ prayujyate
na cānyatra taditi cet; atrāha--tatra ityādi

vijñaptimātraṃ paramārthasat; yathādarśanaṃ prajñaptisattvāt bhrāntasyāpi nānaikatva saṃbhavāt grāhya grāhakasaṃvitti bhedāvabhāsanāt saṃbhāvitaikarūpasya svato'siddheḥ parataśca svabhāvanairātmyaṃ sarvabhāvānāṃ pramāṇābhāve na pratipattumarhati śūnyavādī, bhāve ca
tadayamātmānaṃ mithyābhiniveśena anarthagarte praveśyamāno'pi na cetayate
pramāṇābhāvena pratyakṣamekaṃ nāparaṃ prameyatattvaṃ veti na tathā pratipattumarhati
pramāṇāntarapratiṣedhe pratyakṣalakṣaṇānupapatteḥ kiṃ kena vidadhyāt pratiṣedhayedvā yataḥ cāturbhautikameva jagat syāt
yadi nāma svasaṃvedanāpekṣayā bahirantaścopaplutamiti sūktamevaitat, nirākṛtaparadarśanagamanāt
vibhramaikāntamupetya svasaṃvedane'pi apalāpopalabdheḥ anyathā vipratiṣedhāt caturbhūtavyavasthāmapi lakṣaṇabhedāt kathayitumarhati
na ca caturbhūtavyavasthākathanaṃ yuktam parokṣāṇāmapi lakṣaṇāt sākalyena tattvāpratipatteranyathānupapatteḥ

tatrakṣāyopaśamikabhāvasyāpi tadghātikarmodayodīraṇavaśāt mithyā darśanamityevaṃ vyavasthite sati mate vā nāstikyaṃ nāstikasya bhāvaḥ karma vā dvedhā dviprakāraṃ bāhyādhyātmikaviṣayabhedena, yadi vā, jīvā'jīvagocaranānātvena vijñaptimātrasya bhāvāt, athavā jāgratsvapnaviṣayabhedena vā bhedagocaratvena ca, yadi vā anumānādipramāṇatatprameyaviṣayabhedena tadvivite
yadi vā, jīve yannāstikyaṃ tasya bhedaṃ darśayannāha--tatra ityādi
athavā, tatra tayoḥ nāstikya-anyatrajīvābhimānayormadhye nāstikyaṃ taddvedhā iti vyākhyeyam
tat kim ? ityāha— prajñāsat saṃvṛtisat ityarthaḥ

nanu prajñāpti śabdo na kvacit saṃvṛtiparyāyatayā rūḍhaḥ tata evaṃ vaktavyaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ saṃvṛtisat iti, evaṃ hi spaṣṭo nirdeśo bhavati tattvasaṃvaraṇāt saṃvṛtiḥ mithyāvikalpabuddhiḥ iti sarvatra prasiddheḥ tayā sat iti
nāpi evaṃvacane kārikā mada iti cet; tanna; paramatabhedapradarśanārthatvāt tathāvacanasya
tathāhi--dṛṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ cetanabhvā mithyeti matam māyāmarīciprabhṛti pratibhāsavadasattve'pi adoṣaḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
kutaḥ ? ityāha--prajñaptisat iti hetoḥ, pragatā jñaptiḥ yasya tat tathoktaṃ prajñaptisat sattvaṃ yasya sarvasya tadapi tathoktam
nahi kasyacit paramārthasattvagrāhakaṃ mānamasti, upalambhādeḥ svapne'pi bhāvāditi
tathādṛṣṭam upalambhagocaracāri prakṛṣṭā'dvayajñaptirūpeṇa sad vidyamānaṃ sarvaṃ sukhādinīlādi na jīvā'jīvarūpeṇa
yad upalabhyate ca nīlādi kam iti vacanāt
aparaṃ darśanam tathā ca anyādṛṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ prajñaptisat vyavahāreṇa sat prāmāṇyaṃ vyavahāreṇa pra॰ vā॰ 1
praśithilā avicāritaramaṇīyā jñaptiḥ asya iti vyutpatteḥ iti
paramapi nāstikyaṃ darśayati adṛṣṭam anupalabdhaṃ kṣaṇikaparamāṇurūpavedanaṃ puruṣavat sakalaśūnyatvaṃ vā paramārthasat iti
tathā tena prakāreṇa dṛṣṭaṃ darśanaṃ pratyakṣam iti yāvat
dṛṣṭameva iti avadhāraṇīyam, tena na adṛṣṭaṃ darśanādanyat anumānādikamapi gṛhyate
tattvaviṣayatvāt tattvaṃ viṣayiṇi viṣayopacārāt yathā upalambhaḥ sattā pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
yadi vā, dṛṣṭameva darśanaviṣayīkṛtamiva na anumānādiviṣayīkṛtam ātmāditattvaṃ paramārthasat iti grāhyam iti evam ātmavidviṣāṃ nairātmyavādināṃ saugatalaukāyatānām nāstikyaṃ dvedhā iti sambandhaḥ
kumbhastambhau ādī yasya cetanetaravastunaḥ tat tathoktam, tacca tat dṛṣṭaṃ ca darśanaviṣayīkṛtam ityarthaḥ
nanu ca kumbhādi iti vaktavye kimarthaṃ stambhavacanamiti vaktuṃ bhavati ? stambhasya tadvadvā kumbhasya upalambhapratipādanārtham, ekasyāpi tadapalāpe dvayorapi sa bhavet
yathaiva hi kumbhadarśanena stambho na dṛśyate tathā stambhadarśanena kumbho'pi
ekasya tadātmakatve tadgrahaṇe vā krameṇāpi tasya tadavirodhi iti kathaṃ nairātmyaṃ kṣaṇikatvaṃ vā iti tatpratipādane siddhaṃ bhavati
kumbhādi iti punarucyamāne matāntaradṛṣṭam ādiśabdena puruṣādi gṛhyate iti āśaṅkyeta
atra yad viśadadarśana ityādi sādhanaṃ draṣṭavyam
saṃsthānam dīrghatvādikam ādiḥ yasya dravyasāmānyādeḥ tasya svalakṣaṇeṣu bahirantaḥparamāṇulakṣaṇeṣu abhāvāt
guṇini guṇānām avayaveṣu avayavinaḥ viśeṣeṣu jāteḥ samavāyena varttanaṃ vṛttiḥ tasyāḥ vikalpaḥ kim ekadeśena uta sarvātmanā, krameṇa yaugapadyena vā iti bhedavittana tena tasmin vā anavasthā
'ekadeśena varttane tatrāpi aparabhinnadeśakalpanam, tatrāpi aparamiti deśāvyavasthitiḥ, sarvātmanā guṇaguṇinoḥ anyataradeva syāt, evamanyatra guṇinoḥ anyatarat evamanyatrāpi vaktavyam
tathā sati guṇādayaḥ tadvantaśca iti yā vyavahilambanādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ sa cāsau doṣaśca tasya anuvṛtteḥ sakāśāt kumbhastambhādi dṛṣṭaṃ prajñaptisad iti sambandhaḥ
nanu mā bhūt saṃsthānādiḥ ādhāravyatiriktā yathoktadoṣāt, svayameva tu svalakṣaṇaṃ kumbhādisthūlādirūpaṃ syāditi jainaḥ; tatrāha--sthūlasya abhāvād iti
sthūlasya mahattvopetasya, upalakṣaṇametat, tena dīrghāderabhāvāt svalakṣaṇasya iti vacanavibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
tasya hi kāraṇaṃ bahvavayavasaṃyogaḥ, sa ca sarvātmanā ekadeśena vā avayavānāṃ durupapādaḥ
apekṣākṛtatvādvā, sthūlādikamapekṣya sūkṣmādikam, sūkṣmādikaṃ cāpekṣya sthūlādikamātmānaṃ labhate
anena abhedavādo darśitaḥ iti vibhāgaḥ, tadabhāvāt kumbhādikaṃ prajñaptisad iti ghaṭanā
paramāṇavastarhi paramārthasanto bhavantu iti cet; atrāha--parimaṇḍala ityādi
parimaṇḍalaṃ sūkṣmaniraṃśatvam ādiḥ yasya kṣaṇabhaṅgādeḥ tasya apratibhāsanāt svalakṣaṇeṣu iti tat tatsat iti
yathoktaviśeṣaśūnyaṃ nīlādimātraṃ paramārthasat iti cet; atrāha--tadvyatirekiṇa ityādi
tasmāt sthūlakumbhāderdṛṣṭād vyatiriktasya nīlādeḥ asaṃbhavāt apratibhāsanāt iti anantarokto hetuḥ atra draṣṭavyaḥ
tato'yamarthaḥ--yathā apratibhāsanāt parimaṇḍalāderabhāvaḥ tathā tadvyatirekiṇo nīlāderapi iti na yuktametat--yad yathāvabhāsate tat tathaiva paramārthasad yathā nīlaṃ nīlatayā'vabhāsamānam
tathāpi tatkalpanāyāṃ parimaṇḍalāderapi sā kena vāryata iti tanniṣedhavacanaṃ pūrvāparabādhitaṃ tadvyatirekiṇaḥ ityanena etad darśayati

yadi sthūlādisvabhāvāvyatirekiṇo nīlādeḥ tathāvabhāsanena paramārthasattvamiṣyate, sarvasya kṣaṇikatvasya sādhane tathāvabhāsanahetunā; nahi sthūlādipratibhāsanavad akṣaṇikatva pratibhāsasyāpi kāraṇā'bhāvādasiddho heturiti
yadi punaḥ nīlādeḥ tadavyatirekiṇo'pi paramārthasattvaṃ na tasya ityucyate; vyabhicārī hetuḥ syāditi
tato nīlādeḥ tadvyatirekiṇo'saṃbhavāt kumbhādikaṃ tathāsad iti
saṃprati prajñaptiśabdasya aparamapyarthaṃ darśayannāha--vijñapti mātram ityādi
viśiṣṭā jñaptireva tanmātram kumbhastambhādi dṛṣṭam iti sambandhaḥ yadavabhāsate tajjñānam ityādyabhidhānāt
tacca kiṃ bhūtam ? ityāha--paramārthasad, vijñaptimātrasya paramārthasattvena upagamāt
pra jñā ka re ṇā pyuktam--ajñātārthaprakāśo vā ityetat pāramārthikaṃ pramāṇalakṣaṇam pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 2

atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--yathādarśanaṃ vā vijñaptimātraṃ kalpeta, anyathā vā ? prathamapakṣe yathādarśanaṃ darśanā'natikrameṇa prajñaptisattvāt bahirarthavad avicāritasad vijñaptimātraṃ na paramārthasad iti manyate
atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--pareṇa citrapratibhāsāpi ekaiva buddhiḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
220 ityādi vadatā nānaikatve'pi tasyāḥ paramārthasattvamaṅgīkṛtaṃ sarvathā nairātmyaṃ nirūpayato nānaikātmanaḥ tadvat saṃviditātmanaḥ pariṇāmino'pi ātmanaḥ paramārthasattvam
tadevaṃ bhrāntasyāpi pariṇāmina ātmanaḥ, na kevalam abhrāntasya vijñaptimātrasya iti apiśabdārthaḥ
evaṃ manyate--yasya nānaikatvasaṃbhavo na tasyābhrāntatvaṃ yathā pariṇāmina ātmanaḥ, nānaikatvasaṃbhavaśca vijñaptimātrasya iti
yadi punaḥ tadātmano'pi tadvat paramārthasattvaṃ paro manyate ko doṣaḥ syāt ? na kaścit, te guṇa eva tu syāt
nānaikatvasya vipakṣasaṃkramanivāraṇāt asaugataṃ jagat syāditi cet; na jāne ahamapi īdṛśam
nanu bhavatu bhrāntasya nānaikatvasaṃbhavaḥ nā'bhrāntasya tanmātrasyeti cet; atrāha-- grāhya grāhakasaṃvitti ityādi
grāhyādiśabdānāṃ kṛtadvandvānāṃ bhedaśabdena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ tena avabhāsanāt tanmātrasya iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ

dvitīyapakṣe--saṃbhāvitaikarūpasya--saṃbhāvitam astīti manasā avatāri punaṃ na punaḥ pratyakṣādinā pramāṇena niścitam ekatra sahāyam, athavā santānāntaraniṣedhena ekasaṃkhyāyuktaṃ rūpaṃ svabhāvo yasya tasya svataḥ svasaṃvedanādhyakṣato asiddheḥ apratipatteḥ
na hi asūkṣikayā kālabhedamiva deśabhedamapi cintayato nīlādisvabhāvam anyathābhūtaṃ vā paramāṇurūpaṃ vedanamābhāti
yadi vā svato'siddheḥ aniṣpatteḥ anutpatteḥ ityarthaḥ
nahi kasyacit svata utpattiḥ, ahetukatvena sarvatra sarvadā bhāvaprasaṅgāt, nīlādi pītādinā bhavet
tathāpi tanniṃyame arthākāryatve'pi jñānasya tanniyamaḥ syādityalaṃ tadutpattisārūpyakalpanena
etena nityasyaikarūpasya sahakāryapekṣasya tatkṛtopakārānapekṣasya kramato'pi kāryakaraṇe svabhāvaniyamo vyākhyātaḥ
tasya parato'pyasiddheḥ iti darśayannāha--parataśca anyato'pyasiddheḥ apratipatteḥ
tathāhi— saṃbhāvitaikarūpasya cakṣuṣi gandhasya, evaṃ paratrāpi, na pratibhānamasti nīlādisukhādivyatiriktava vādāspadatvāt
tatra tatpratibhāsanabhāve'pi paramārthato grāhyagrāhakabhāvā'bhāvena nānyo'nubhāvyo buddhyāsti pra॰ 2
327 ityādi, nirālambanāḥpratyayāḥ pra॰ vārtikāla pṛ॰ 387 ityādi yadavabhāsate tajjñānam ityādi ca virudhyate, jñānasyeva jaḍasyāpi parataḥ pratibhāsā'virodhāt
kiñca parasyāpi tadrūpasya parataḥ siddhiḥ, tasyāpi parataḥ ityanavasthā
atadrūpatve kiṃ tasya nirbhāgaṃdhakalpanayā iti manyate

nanu tasya svapratibhāsarahitasya parataḥ siddhau vijñaptirūpataiva hīyate svapratibhāsalakṣaṇatvāttasyāḥ, tatkathaṃ parānabhyupagamo dūṣyata iti cet ? satyam; tathāpi yo aniścitasvasaṃvedanarūpāṃ grāhyādibhrāntyanthānupapattyā tāṃ vyavasthāpayanti tān prati idamucyate, advayaṃyānamuttamam ityāgamādvā
idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam--parataśca svataḥ anyataḥ kāraṇādapi asiddheḥ anutpatteḥ
tadyathā— samakālāt paratastadutpattau; tadapi parasya kāraṇam aviśeṣāt, tathā ca sati anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ
athāpi kiñcideva kāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ vā; tathā kiñcideva kasyacideva grāhakaṃ grāhyam iti tathā ca nirākṛtametat--nīlādirapi jñānasya grāhakaḥ syāt iti
yathā ca tasya pareṇa janyate svarūpaṃ nāparotpattiḥ kriyate, tathā jaṃta tasya nīlādeḥ svarūpaṃ gṛhyate na gṛhītiḥ kriyate
tasmādetadapi nirastam--jñānena arthasya tadrūpāyā gṛhīteḥ karaṇe ekatra arthasya karaṇam anyatra anavasthā iti
api ca janyavijñānakāle'sataḥ parasmādutpattau bandhyāsutādapi utpattiḥ syāt bhedābhāvāt
atha tasya tatkāle'sattve'pi svakāle sattvaṃ na bandhyāsutasya tato'yamadoṣaḥ; nanu tasya kāryakāle'sattvavat svakāle sattvaṃ yadi na kutaścit pratīyate; tarhi vacanamātrametanna samādhānamarhati
pratīyate cet; kathaṃ grāhyagrāhakabhāvanivṛttiḥ ? tanna kiñcidetat
atha pareṇa yataḥ kasyacidutpattyanabhyupagamāt kimarthametaducyate iti matiḥ; tasya aniṣṭasiddhipratipādanārtham
yadā hi tadrūpasya sataḥ svataḥ parato vā notpattiḥ ata eva na vināśaḥ, tato nityatvam iti sarvasya kṣaṇikatvapratijñāvyāghātaḥ
jñānavādināṃ punaḥ kālā'bhāvād ekasya kālatrayānuyāyitvam, ekakṣaṇānuvṛttiḥ kṣaṇikatvam iti apasiddhāntaḥ
yaducyate pratibhāsādvaitavādinā yadi samakālaṃ jñānaṃ nīlādergrāhakam, tadā nīlādirapi kuto na jñānasya grāhaka iti ?
tataḥ kim ? ityāha--svabhāvena svarūpeṇa nairātmyaṃ svarūpatucchatā sarvabhāvānāṃ tadasiddheḥ iti padaghaṭanā
evaṃ śūnyavādinā vijñaptivādinaṃ ghātayitvā adhunā śūnyavādinaṃ svayameva nihanti pramāṇa ityādinā
pramāṇasya pratyakṣādeḥ abhāvena karaṇabhūtenana pratipattumarhati śūnyavādī svabhāvanairātmyam iti sambandhaḥ
yasya hi sarvaṃ śūnyaṃ tasya pramāṇābhāvo'pi
tena tatpratipattau tasyāpi anena tadabhāvena pratipattiḥ tasyāpyanyenetyanavastheti manyate

yadi vā, tadabhāvena tatpratipattau kimanyatrāpi pramāṇānveṣaṇena iti ? atha cetraika nīlādisukhādipratibhāsena sakalaśūnyatāvyavasthākāriṇaḥ pramāṇasya bādhanāt tadabhāve na pratipattumarhati--pramāṇābhāve sati na pratipattumarhati svabhāvanairātmyam iti vā vyākhyānam
atrāha pra jñā ka ra gu ptaḥ-- pratibhāsa eva kāryakāraṇabhāvādivikalpaśūnyatvāt paryudāsāpekṣayā śūnyatā yathā kevalaṃ bhūtalaṃ ghaṭaśūnyatā
tatra ca svasaṃvedanādhyakṣa-pramāṇabhāvāt kathamucyate tadabhāve na tat pratipattumarhati
tat tasmād bhāvād ayaṃ pra jñā ka rā diḥ na cetayate
kim ? ityāha--anarthagarttaṃ svayam anarthatvena abhyupagamād anarthaḥ pariṇāmādiḥ tena upalakṣitaṃ tadrūpasvā garttamiva garttam tatpraviṣṭo yugasahasrairapi tato nātmānamuddharati
kena ? ityāha--mithyābhiniveśena mithyā asatyaḥ abhiniveśaḥ nairātmyādyāgrahaḥ tasya yasmin citraikapratibhāse sa tathoktaḥ tena, svayam ātmanā
yadvā, ātmā na svattaceta anarthagarttaṃ sakalaśūnyatāgarttaṃ praveśyamāno'pi nātmānaṃ cetayate
kutaḥ punaḥ ayamapi nātmānaṃ na cetayate iti cet ? ucyate--pramāṇābhāve na tadabhāve sati vā tathā pratipattuṃ vā arhati yataḥ
kim ? ityāha--pratyakṣamekam pramāṇam iti śeṣaḥ, nāparam anumānādikam ityetat
kimetadeva tathā pratipattumarhati nāparamapi ? ityāha--prameyatattvaṃ vā
etacca kutaḥ tadabhāve na tatpratipattumarhati ? ityāha--pramāṇāntara ityādi
