pratyakṣapramāṇād anyad anumānādi tadantaraṃ tasya pratiṣedhe nirāse sati pratyakṣalakṣaṇānupapatteḥ
pratyakṣasya hi lakṣaṇaṃ vaiśadyaṃ sāviplavam, tacca aśeṣatadvyaktiniṣṭhaṃ na pramāṇāntaramantareṇa pratipattuṃ śakyaṃ pratyakṣasya niyatagocaratvāt
akṛtalakṣaṇatvācca na tataḥ tatpratipattiḥ, tadabhāve na pratipattum arhati iti sambandhaḥ
idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam--pramāṇāntaraniṣedhe karttavye pratyakṣalakṣaṇagrahaṇaṃ tanniṣedhasya tasyānupapatteḥ
nahi sarvathā pramāṇāntaraṃ nāsti iti pratyakṣam iyato vyāpārān karttuṃ samartham nāparamiti tadabhāve na pratipattumarhati
atra ta ttvo pa pla va kṛ d āha--cārvākaiścāru carcitaṃ--svayam evaṃ lakṣaṇataḥ tadanupapattiḥ teṣāṃ na doṣāya, pratyakṣopagamastu vyavahāreṇa iti; tatrāha--kiṃ kena ? ityādi
tadanupapatteḥ kāraṇāt kiṃ pratyakṣādilakṣaṇasya parakīyasya ativyāptyādikam, kena ? na kenacit vidadhyāt kuryāt cārvākaḥ
na hi pramāṇamantareṇa tadapi kartuṃ śakyaṃ yataḥ paraparyanuyogaparāṇi bṛ haspa teḥ sūtrāṇi iti sūktaṃ syāt
kiṃ tat ativyāptyādikaṃ kena pratiṣedhayedvā yato yasmāt kasyacid vidhānāt pratiṣedhācca jagat syāt
kiṃ bhūtam ? ityāha--cāturbhautikameva caturbhiḥ pṛthivyādibhiḥ upaśrutatvāt bhūtairivegṛhāte dvata iti
yadi vā, kiṃ pṛthivyādikaṃ jīvādikaṃ ca kena vidadhyāt pratiṣedhayedvā pramāṇābhāve ubhayoḥ abhyupagamaḥ pratiṣedho vā syāt iti manyate
etadevāha--yato yasmād vidhānāt pratiṣedhācca cāturbhautikameva jagat syāt caturbhūtanirmitameva syāt

etaduktaṃ bhavati--pramāṇābhāvena ātmādivad bhūtaparityāge sakalaśūnyatāpatteḥ, bhūtavad ātmādiparigrahe vyavahārāviśeṣāt kutaḥ cāturbhautikameva viparyayabhāvāt ? tannāyaṃ saugatam atiśete iti tadayam ityādikam ādarśayati-tatra hi pratyakṣamanyadvā pramāṇaṃ pratiṣidhyate--tadupalambhāderbādhakābhāvasya anyasya vā tallakṣaṇasya svapne'pi bhāvāt

aduṣṭakāraṇārabdhatvasya jñātumaśakteḥ atīndriyasyendriyasya duṣṭatvasya itarasya vā pratyakṣato'jñānāt jñā ne'pi pūrvacodyā'nivṛttiḥ, punastatrāpi aduṣṭakāraṇārabdhatvakalpane tadeva codyam tadeva uttaram ityanavasthā
jñānaprāmāṇyāt tadavagame anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ--tathāhi siddhe tatprāmāṇye tato'duṣṭakāraṇārabdhatvasiddhiḥ, tasyāḥ tatprāmāṇyasiddhiḥ iti
tanna bahiḥ kiñcit pramāṇam, kasyacid vidhānaṃ pratiṣedhanaṃ tu svasaṃvedanapratyakṣabalāt iti kasyacit ebhaito'pi
nāsti tatphalaṃ vā svargādi...uktaṃ ca paramārthavidbhirapi--laukiko mārgo'nusartavyaḥ a...
nanu yadyupaplutastattvānāṃ kimāyā...athātastattvaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ pṛthivyaptejovāyuriti tattvāni, tatsamudāye śarīrendriyaviṣayasaṃjñā ityādi ? na; anyārthatvāt
kiṃ punaratra pratibimbyate ? pṛthivyādīni tattvāni loke prasiddhāni, tānyapi vicāryamāṇāni na vyavatiṣṭhante kiṃ punaranyāni
pṛ॰ 1 tadevamupapluteṣveva tattveṣu avicāritaramaṇīyāḥ sarve vyavahārā ghaṭanta iti
api ca ta ttvo pa pla va karaṇāt ja ya rā śiḥ saugatamatamavalambya brūyāt; tatrāha— svasaṃvedana ityādi
svena svasya vā vedanaṃ grahaṇaṃ tasya upekṣayā abhyupagamena yadi nāma ityarucau
tathā sati bahiḥ upaplutam, antaśca anyathā, iti saugatamatameva nirastaprasaraṃ ta cārvākam iti pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇam ityevamuktam
tatra upahāsaparaṃ vacanamāha--sūktamevaitat asūkte'pi sūktam ityabhidhānāt, nirākṛtaparadarśanagamanāt sakalasvadarśanatyāgāt sūktaleśo'pi nāsti iti evakāreṇa darśayati
kasmāt asūktam yasmād upahāsyametaditi kadācit saugataḥ tatpakṣapātamudvahan brūyād ityāha--svasaṃvedana ityādi
tato'yamarthaḥ-- na kevalaṃ bahiḥ apitu svasaṃvedane'pi aprastāpo palabdheḥ pralāpasya nihnavasya upalabdheḥ darśanāt sūktamevaitat iti sambandhaḥ
bahiriva tatrāpi vibhramasya nirūpitatvāditi nedaṃ punarnirūpyate

nanu satyaṃ tatrāpi apalāpopalabdhirasti bahujanmajātmani jagati tatrāpi vivādavṛtteranivāraṇāt, sa tu upalabhyamāno'pi apalāpo yuktyā vyavacchidyasye ti tasya apalāpasya vyavacchedasyāpi tadupalabdhiḥ iti sambandhaḥ
tadabhāvaḥ kuta iti cet ? atrāha--anyathā ityādi
anyathā anyena virodhā'bhāvaprakāreṇa vipratiṣedhād anyo'nyavirodhāt tasya tadupalabdheḥ ityapekṣam
tathāhi--yadi pratyakṣa-apalāpayoḥ virodhaḥ; tarhi svasaṃvedanabhāve tadbhāve vā svasaṃvedanasya vārttāpi durlabhā
pratyakṣaṃ ca samānakālamanyadvā na tadvirodhi; arthagrahaṇavat doṣāt
virodho'pi mithyaikānte anidaṃte kathamiva satupya vagamyate ? nāpi anumānato'nabhyupagamāt iti manyate
idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam--na tāvat svasaṃvedanāt tadvyavacchedaḥ; tena tasya virodhā'bhāvāt, anyathā anyena anumānena tadvyavacchedaprakāreṇa vipratiṣedhāt tasya tadupalabdheḥ iti

tadyathā— yadi anumānena tadvyavacchedaḥ; kathaṃ svasaṃvedanapratyakṣameva pramāṇam ? tacca kathaṃ tena tadvyavacchedaḥ ? vyavahāreṇa anumānopagamādadoṣa iti cet; atha ko'yaṃ vyavahāro nāma ? asatyapi anumāne pramāṇe janasya tadastitvavikalpaḥ sa iti cet; na; atra pramāṇābhāvāt
na svasaṃvedanapratyakṣam; tatra mithyaikāntamanabhyupetya apalāpopalabdheḥ, na ca svayamanavasthitam anyavyavasthānibandhanam atiprasaṅgāt
nāpyanumānam; tadeva nāsti tata eva tadvyavasthānamityatisāhasam
saṃvṛtisiddhena tena tadvyavasthāpi tādṛgeva; yādṛśo yakṣaḥ tādṛśo baliḥ iti nyāyāt
anyastvāha--svasaṃvedane vibhramaikāntābhyupagamaḥ pramāṇānna yuktaḥ; vibhramāt tadasiddheḥ
tanna yuktam--svasaṃvidita ityādi iti cet; na; atra bahirarthasiddheranivāraṇāt doṣo mā bhūt paramatagamanamiti
tarhi bahirapi pṛthivyādimātre pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇamiṣyate; tatrāha--caturbhūta ityādi
caturṇāṃ pṛthivyādīnāṃ bhūtānāṃ vyavasthā saṅkaravyatikaravyatirekeṇa sthitiḥ, tā eva tāmapi lakṣaṇabhedāt dhāraṇeraṇadravanānātvāt kathayitumarhati iti
tathā paro mithyābhiniveśena svayam anarthagartam ātmānaṃ jānaṃdha jīvaṃ praveśyamāno'pi na cetayate iti sambandhaḥ
tathāhi--yathā dhāraṇādisvabhāvabhedāt kālatraye'pi parasparaṃ bhinnā bhūmyādayaḥ tathā tebhyaḥ cetanāmūrttatvarūpabhedāt sahadarśananiyame'pi bhinnaśca ātmā iti
dhāraṇaṃ pṛthivyāḥ īraṇaṃ vāyoḥ dravatvaṃ jalasya uṣṇatā ca agneḥ lakṣaṇam

nanu yathā pūrvamuktam pratipattumarhati iti, evamatrāpi vaktavyam, kimarthamuktam— kathayitumarhati iti cet ? ucyate--kathayati paraṃ pratipādayati, sa ca pratipanna caitanyaḥ pratipādanīyaḥ, anyathā pāṣāṇādayaḥ pratipādanīyāḥ syuḥ
acetanatvānneti cet; pratipādyābhimate'pi caitanyaṃ kutaḥ pratipannam ? adhyakṣata iti cet; na; tasya tatra apravṛtteḥ
nahi paraḥ parasukhaduḥkhādikaṃ pratyakṣayitumarhati, anyathā sarvajñaniṣedhaḥ

caitanyamātraṃ pratyakṣayati, kathamanyathā śarīradarśanāt jīvati iti pratītiḥ syāt, nahi viśeṣaṇā'grahaṇe tadviśiṣṭaviśeṣyapratītiḥ daṇḍāgrahaṇe daṇḍyagrahaṇavad iti cet; na; caitanyasya sukhādyavyatirekāt
na ca sukhādyagrahe'pi tadavyatiriktacaitanyagraho yuktaḥ, anyathā piṇḍādyagrahaṇe'pi mṛddravyagrahaḥ syāt
nanu yathā bhavadīyamate pratikṣaṇapariṇāmā'grahe'pi dravyagrahaṇam, dūre vā viśeṣāgrahaṇe'pi sanmātragrahaṇaṃ tathā atrāpi syāditi cet; na; tatpariṇāmasya prākṛtapuruṣāvedyatvāt
tadviśeṣāṇām atidūratādagrahaṇaṃ naivaṃ sukhādayo'pi viparyayāt, teṣāṃ svasaṃvedanaikasvabhāvatvamiti cet; kuta etat ? indriyeṇā'grahaṇāt
dūratvād indriyeṇa parasya sukhādyapratyakṣatve pratyo ranyo'nyaṃ saṃśleṣe sukhādyanubhavanaṃ bhavet
jīvati ayam ityayaṃ tu pratyayaḥ śarīrākāraviśeṣādarśanāt dhūmavattvadarśanāt kvacit pradeśe agnipratyayavat iti anumānatvena pramāṇāntaraniṣedhasya ityasya pradarśanārthamiti
yadi punaḥ tadvyavasthā na tadbhedāt kathayitumarhati iti; tatrāha--anyathā
tattvātta danyena tatprasaṅgāt iti vā vācyam
tadbhedādeva tarhi kathayitumarhati iti cet; atrāha--na ca ityādi
na ca naivaṃ caturbhūtavyavasthākathanāhaṃtvaṃ tathā lakṣaṇabhedaprakāreṇa pratyakṣeṇa karaṇabhūtena yuktam upapannam
kutaḥ ? ityāha--parokṣāṇāmapi na kevalaṃ pratyakṣāṇāmeva bhūmyādīnām lakṣaṇāt dhāraṇādisvabhāvānāṃ jñānāt
yadi vā, pratyakṣeṇa lakṣaṇabhedena tadvyavasthākathanakāle parokṣaṇāt punaḥ tathā lakṣaṇayuktānāṃ darśanāt
nahi dhūmo deśāntarādau dhūmadhvajapūrvakatvena upalabhyamānaḥ pūrvapratyakṣeṇa tathā kṛtavyavastha iti bhaṇituṃ śakyate parokṣāṇāmapi tadrūpeṇāṅganāditi
etadapi kutaḥ ? ityāha--sākalyena sāmastyena tattvānāṃ pṛthivyādīnāṃ pratipatteḥ nirṇayasya anyathā parokṣāṇāmapi lakṣaṇābhāvaprakāreṇa anupapannāḥ teṣāmapi lakṣaṇāt iti sambandhaḥ
sākalyena tattvasya pṛthivyādisvarūpasya idaṃtayā nedaṃtayā vā pratipatteḥ anyathā punaḥ punaḥ tathaiva teṣāṃ darśanābhāvaprakāreṇa anupapatteḥ iti
tathā sati dharmādharmasvabhāvāḥ paralokānuyāyicaitanyasvabhāvā viśiṣṭasukhajñānādisvabhāvā vā na bhūmyādaya iti durārādhyā pratipattiḥ

athavā sākalyena ityādi vākyam uttarakārikayā sambaddhya vyākhyātavyam--sākalyena anavayavena tattvasya pṛthivyādeḥ tṛptyādi kāryakāraṇasvabhāvasya yā pratipattiḥ tasyāḥ anyathā anyena ādhyātmikajñānābhāvaprakāreṇa anupapatteḥ sakāśād ādhyātmikajñānaṃ yad asti iti śeṣaḥ
pṛthivyādisvabhāvabhedaṃ pratipadya vijñaptisvabhāvabhedam, harṣa viṣādādyanekākāram antaḥsamakṣaṃ pratikṣipatīti kathaṃ prekṣāvān ? api ca bhūtapratyakṣaṃ yadi tattvāntaram parisaṃkhyā virudhyeta

tathāhi--kutaścit pṛthivyādiviśeṣāt bubhukṣādipīḍāpāye ekadā pratipanne yad evaṃvidhaṃ tad iyatā kālādinā itthambhūtaprāṇiviśeṣasya tadapāyakāraṇam iti siddhāyāṃ vyāptau punaḥ tasya tādṛśasya vā darśanāt sambandhasmṛtau pratyabhijñāne cintāyāṃ dṛśyamānasya tatkāraṇasvabhāvapratipattau pravṛttiriti prāyikametat
na caitat pṛthivyāderyuktam, pūrvajñānasya uttarajñānākārapariṇāmadarśanāt gṛtpiṇḍasya sthāsapariṇāmavat
na vai khalu pṛthivyādyasaṃbhaviguṇaparyāyopacitatayā pratyakṣaṃ tattvaṃ pṛthivyādibhyo bhinnam anyadvā iti vicāramarhati, teṣāmapi parasparaṃ tatprasaṅgāt
nanu asya ādhyātmikajñānādā ttatparihāreṇaiva parihṛtaṃ tat kimarthaṃ pṛthagetaducyate ? satyam; tathāpi pūrvaṃ sāmānyena ayaṃ viśeṣeṇa ucyate iti vibhāgaḥ
atra parasya anekaṃ darśanam--bhūtasvabhāvaḥ tad ityekam
tebhyo bhinnamatattvaṃ marīcikājalavat iti anyat tattvam iti param
tatra anekaṃ vākyam--bhūtaṃ pṛthivyādi bhūtarūpaṃ cet yadi bhūtagocaraṃ jñānaṃ pratyakṣam āstāṃ paryāptam tenetyaḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha--abhūtaṃ syāt yataḥ abhūtasvabhāvaṃ bhavet
nahi sarvabhūtāni cetanārūpāṇi saṃvidrate jagataḥ prāṇimayatvaprasaṅgāt
kvacit tadāvirbhāvatirobhāvakalpanāpi pāpīyasī sāṃkhyāviśeṣāt, bhūtavyavasthā bhūtarūpaiva syāditi
tathā abhūtam īṣadbhūtarūpaṃ pariṇāmamasya kathañcit pariṇāmirūpatvāt cet yadi tadapi āstām abhūtaṃ syāt yataḥ kathañcidapi bhūtarūpaṃ na bhavet acetanasya cetanapariṇāmavirodhāt
tathā abhūtaṃ bhūtād anyat ced asvataṃ marīcikājalavadasat syāt
bhūtaṃ paramārthaṃ tacced astu pañcamaṃ tattvam iti śeṣaḥ
tathā idamaparam--abhūtaṃ bhūtebhyo vyaktāt kāraṇāt kāryasya anyatvāta paṭatantuvat cet; tathāpi bhūtaṃ ced bhūtarūpaṃ yadi, tatkāryatvena tatraiva antarbhāvāt pṛthivyāṃ paṭavaditi
abhūtaṃ syāt bhūtarahitaṃ sarvaṃ syāt bhūtānāmanyo'nyaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvena antarbhāvād bhūtavyavasthā na syāt
yadi punaḥ kāṣṭhāderantarbhūtapāvakādeḥ pāvakādisamudbhava iti na doṣaḥ; tatrāha--astu pañcamaṃ tattvaṃ pṛthivyādeḥ antarbhūtacetaso bhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ
na punaḥ pārthivāt kāṣṭhāderagniḥ jalādvā pārthivaṃ muktāphalādikam

pṛthivyādeḥ svabhāvabhedaṃ svarūpanānātvaṃ pratipattyā abhyupagamya vijñaptisvabhāvabhedaṃ buddhīnāṃ santānabhinnānāṃ rūpanānātvaṃ vijñaptigrahaṇaṃ sāṃkhyavaiśeṣika-ātmaniṣedhārtham svabhāvabhedagrahaṇaṃ sakalādvaitabādhārtham

samakṣaṃ svasaṃvedanapratyakṣaviṣayaṃ pratikṣipati nirākaroti iti hetoḥ kathaṃ prekṣāvān ? api ca ityādinā atraiva dūṣaṇāntaramāha--bhūtapratyakṣaṃ pṛthivyādigocaram indriyajñānam yadi taraṃ pṛthivyādibhyo'nyatve sati yadi dravyāntaram; parisaṃkhyā catvāryeva tattvāni iti parigaṇanaṃ virudhyeta

idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam--tattvaṃ ca pṛthivyādikāryatvena antaraṃ ca bhinnam iti cet; atrāha--saṃvitteḥ svaparagrahaṇalakṣaṇāyāḥ bhūtapratyakṣarūpacetanāyāḥ teṣu bhūteṣu tatsvabhāvatayā antarbhāvakalpanāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ tattvam ekameva syāt taccāturvidhyaṃ hīyeta parasparā'ntarbhāvāt
atha pṛthivyādīnāṃ parasparaviviktānāṃ pratibhāsanāt naivam; tarhi saṃvittivibhaktānāṃ tathaiva pratibhāsanāt, anyathā prāṇimayaṃ jagat syāditi prakṛtamapi mā bhūditi manyate
yadi punaḥ tatsvabhāvatayā na tatrāntarbhāvaḥ api tu tatpariṇāmatayā tatrāha--syāt paryāya ityādi

pudgaladravyaṃ sūkṣmaṃ kharādivivartamāsādya pṛthivyādivyapadeśabhāk punaranyathā bahulaṃ pariṇāmi lakṣyate, yathā candrakāntamaṇiḥ pṛthivīsvabhāvo dravati candrarameḥ, śukraśoṇitaṃ bhasmamṛttikādiparyantaṃ rūpādipariṇāmaṃ yāti, tathaiva muktāphalādi
na punaḥ cetanaścaitanyaṃ vihāya viparivartate acetanaścetano bhavan sa~llakṣyate
tadayamubhayaṃ cetanetaratattvamekīkurvan pudgaladravyalakṣaṇaṃ pṛthivyādibhedena caturdhā vyavasthāpayan kathaṃ svastho viparyastabuddhirdevānāṃ priyaḥ ? pratyakṣasyātīvalaṅghanāt
ihajanmani tāvat prāṇināmādyantacittāni cittāntaropādānopādeyabhūtāni cittatvāt yathā madhyacittam
anena pathikāgneḥ jvālāntarapūrvakatvaṃ pratyagnivat iti vyabhicāracodanaṃ pratyuktam, teja kāraṇapūrvakatvasya tatra virodhāt
sataścetanasya citsvabhāvena pariṇamataḥ kāraṇāntarānapekṣatvāt svayamakṣepeṇa vivartopapatteḥ anaimittikatvā dacetanavat
yadi punaḥ antyakṣaṇasya nottarībhavanaśaktiḥ; avastutvaṃ svopādānaprabandhābhāvaṃ sādhayet arthakriyālakṣaṇatvādvastunaḥ
sāmagrījanmanāṃ visadṛśakāryāṇāṃ kādācitkatvaṃ na tu uttarībhavanasya
tadetat ante kṣayadarśanamasiddham, madhye sthitidarśanamapi sthitiṃ prasādhayedavyabhicārāt
yadi cetanaḥ acetanākāreṇa vivarteta svāpaprabodhavat pretyabhāvasiddheḥ kathannānavadyam--apara...
jalabudbudavajjīvāḥ madaśaktivad vijñānamiti paraḥ arke kaṭukimānaṃ dṛṣṭvā guḍe yojayati

vijñapteryadi svālakṣaṇyādiviśeṣe'pi madaśaktyādidṛṣṭāntena sattvotpattikṛtakatvādeḥ bhūtasvabhāvatvam; tata eva paro'pi bhūtānāmapi buddhicaitanyavivartānatikramaṃ sukhādisvasaṃvedanavat sādhayediti viruddhāvyabhicārīti mithyābhiniveśāt pramāṇaprameyavyavasthāmatilaṅghayet

tulanā--jalabudbudavajjīvāḥ yathaiva hi samudrādau niyāmakādṛṣṭarahitāḥ padārthasāmarthyavaśāt vaicitryavyapadeśabhājo budbudāḥ prādurbhavanti tathā sukhaduḥkhavaicitryabhājo jīvāḥ..."--nyāyakumu॰ pṛ॰ 342
idamatra tātparyam--saṃvitteḥ bhūtapariṇāmatvena tatrāntarbhāve aniṣṭaṃ kiñcit sidhyati iṣṭaṃ ca na sidhyati
asyārthaṃ svayameva vṛttau vakṣyati tanneha ucyate
tataḥ pṛthivyādau salilādeḥ antarbhāva iti bhāvaḥ

yena anvayavyatirekānuvidhāna prakāreṇa pṛthivyādeḥ paryāyaḥ salilādiḥ tathā navai naiva cetano'vagrahādiḥ acetanasya cetanasvabhāvarahitasya pṛthivyādeḥ acetanaḥ pṛthivyādiḥ cetanasya vā paryāya iti sambandhaḥ
avagrahād īhāyāḥ tato'vāyasya ato dhāraṇāyāḥ smṛteḥ pratyabhijñāyā asyāḥ tarkasya anumānasyotpattidarśanāt

syānmatam--yadi cetanasya nācetanaḥ tasya vā cetanaḥ; kathaṃ jāgraddaśātaḥ svāpadaśā, tasyaśca prabodhadaśā yatastadā avagrahādisaṃbhava iti ? tatra keṣāñcitparihāraḥ--taddaśāyāmavikalpakaṃ darśanamasti tataḥ prabodhaḥ
nāntyaḥ tāvat parihāraḥ saṃbhavati; jñānād vyatiriktasya ātmano'nyasya vā bhūtā'viśeṣāt
yadyapi kāryabhūtānāṃ kṣaṇikatvamiti na smaraṇapratyabhijñānādisaṃbhavataḥ tadāpi tatkāraṇabhūtebhyaḥ tatsaṃbhavo nityatvātteṣām
yadyapi tadrūpādayaḥ nāsmatsadṛśānāṃ pratyakṣāḥ tathāpi buddhā dayaḥ tadāśritatve'pi pratyakṣāḥ, yathā ākāśaparamamahattvādyapratyakṣatve'pi tadāśritaḥ śabdaḥ pratyakṣaḥ
yastu manyate buddheḥ śarīrāśritatve tasya kṣaṇikatvād deśāntarādau pratyabhijñānaṃ na syāditi; syādetadevaṃ yadi kāryasaṃyoginā kāraṇaṃ na saṃyujyeta, na caivam, paṭasaṃyoginā tantusaṃyogadarśanāt
nāpi madhyamadhyamaśarīrasya prabodhakāraṇatvāt ; tadbhāve bhāvād abhāve abhāvāt
tathāpi tat tasya cet kāraṇam; tarhi vidhavāyā garbhaḥ ciramṛtād bharttuḥ na sannihitāt parapuruṣāt, iti na sā nigrāhyā syāt
yadi matam--prabodhasya śarīrakāraṇatve jāgraccittānukaraṇavirodha iti; tadapi suparihāram; yataḥ kāraṇakāraṇasyāpi anukāraṇasaṃbhavāt tadavirodhaḥ
tathāhi--taccetasaḥ śarīraṃ prāṇādivat, tataḥ punaraparaṃ śarīraṃ prāṇāderiva prāṇādiḥ tāvad antā daśā, tataḥ punaḥ tadanurūpaprabodhaḥ pitranurūpaputravat iti
tadyathā pituḥ śukrādipātaḥ punaḥ tatpariṇāmaviśeṣāt pitranurūpamapatyaśarīram

yadi vā, śarīraṃ bodhopādānakāraṇam, taccittaṃ sahakārikāraṇam, parasya ca sahakārikāraṇānurūpaṃ kāryam, anyathā kathamarthānurūpaṃ jñānam ? bhinnakālaṃ kathaṃ sahakāri ityapi nottaram; sarpādidaṣṭamūrcchitasya pūrvāmūrcchitaḥ cittaṃ prati bhinnakālatāsyāpi mantrādeḥ sahakāritvasya parairabhyupagamāt
prathamaḥ punaḥ aparyālocita eva; svāpādau hi kṣaṇikasaṃvedanopagame jāgaraṇāt tasya viśeṣo vācyaḥ yatastatra pratyakṣasiddhaṃ kṣaṇakṣayādikaṃ tatpravṛttyādikāraṇaṃ maraṇavad iti na syāt
samāropaḥ iti cet; na; tatra tadabhāvāt
itarathā tadupalakṣaṇe na gāḍhanidrā daśā nāma
tadanupalakṣaṇaṃ tu nahi imāḥ kalpanāḥ pra॰ vā॰ sva॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 127 ityādi pratihanti
yadi punaḥ niścayā'bhāvo viśeṣaḥ; so'pi na yuktaḥ; tadabhāva eva astu
kathamanubhūtaṃ kṣaṇakṣayādikamananubhūtaṃ yatastatra tadvyavahāro na syāt ? nirvikalpānubhūtamananubhūtakalpamiti cet; na tarhi svāpādeḥ saṃhṛtāśeṣavikalpadaśā bhidyata iti tatreva anyatrāpi--
apratisaṃvaditā evodayante vyayante vā yataḥ satyo'pyanupalakṣitāḥ syuḥ iti śeṣaḥ
tatra nīlādivikalpasadbhāve'pi tatastatra saṃvedanā'pravedanāt, cetanasya cetanaḥ tasya vā acetanaḥ paryāyaḥ iti na yuktametat--navai cetano'cetanasya ityādi iti cet; atra pratividhīyate--
yadi svāpe saṃvittiranupalakṣiteti prabodho'hetukaḥ, tarhi meghādiḥ anupabdhopādānaḥ tathaiva ahetuḥ iti sarve kādācitkamapi tathaiva śaṅkyeta
atha anyahetukaḥ; tanmeghādirapi anyajātikāraṇa iti na caturbhūtavyavasthā
arthaṃ pṛthivyādereva tadutpattidarśanāt; adṛṣṭamapi jalapaṭalādeḥ sajātīyaṃ kāraṇamanumīyatām
etenedamapi pratyuktam--yathā avikalpāt svāpāt savikalpaprabodhasaṃbhavaḥ tathā acetanāt cetanasaṃbhavaḥ iti; katham ? anyatrāpi prasaṅgāt
śakyaṃ hi vaktuṃ yathā sūkṣmapṛthivyādibhūtebhyaḥ sthūlatadbhūtabhāvaḥ tathā jalādeḥ bhūmyādibhāvasyā iti syāt
nanu yathā ātmavat pṛthivyādayo bhinnajātīyāḥ parasparaṃ kathaṃ tadvadevapṛthivyādeḥ salilādiparyāya iti cet; atrāha--pudgaladravyam ityādi
kiṃ syāt ? ityāha--pṛthivyādivyapadeśabhāk syāt iti śeṣaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--na pṛthivyādayo bhinnajātīyā ekadravyaparyāyatvāt mṛtpiṇḍādivat iti
nanu pratīyamānapṛthivyādibhyaḥ kimanyat tadvyapadeśabhāgiti cet; na; sthūlasya sūkṣmapūrvakatvasyāpi avyabhicārāt paṭavat iti tantusiddheḥ

evamapi bhavatu pṛthivyāḥ svayaṃ rūparasagandhasparśavatyāḥ tathāvidhakāraṇānumānam, na jalā'nalā'nilebhyaḥ gandharasarūpavirahitebhyo yathāsaṃbhavaṃ kintu tadanurūpaṃ kāraṇāntaramanumīyate cet; na; tatrāpi sparśavattve sati gandhādyanumānā'nirākaraṇāt
punaḥ paścād anyathā anyena pṛthivyādivilakṣaṇaprakāreṇa bahulaṃ pariṇāmi lakṣyate pudgaladravyamiti
yathā ityayamudāharaṇapradarśane, candrakāntamaṇiḥ kharatvena pṛthivīsvabhāvo dvayaviti jalībhavati
na tanmaṇiḥ dravati upalambhād api tu tatsaṃsaktā jalātmakāḥ candraraśmayaḥ ityeke

teṣāṃ taddrutau ko doṣaḥ ? adarśanamiti cet; na; gandhadravyasya sarvadā sarvadikṣu bhāgānāṃ gamane'pi tāvata eva upalambhāt, tadraśmeścāpyadarśanaṃ kinna syāt ? tadaparāparotpattiḥ na tanmaṇeḥ iti kiṃ kṛto vibhāgaḥ ? śukraśoṇitaṃ dravarūpaṃ kalalārbudādikrameṇa stryādipariṇāmaṃ yāti
bhasmamṛttikayoḥ kṛtadvandvayoḥ ādiśabdena bahubrīhiḥ, atra ādiśabdena piṇḍādiparigrahaḥ, punaḥ asya paryantaśabdena sa eva vidheyaḥ
tathaiva tenaiva viśiṣṭauṣadhādiprayogaprakāreṇa muktāphalādi, ādiśabdena himādi parigṛhyate dravati iti anuvarttate
yadi vā, pudgaladravyaṃ snehavivarttamāsādya muktāphalādikaṃ pariṇāmaṃ yāti iti sambandhaḥ
pratikṣaṇaṃ aparāparacandraśmaya utpadyante cet; maṇirapi aparāpara evotpanno'stu
tarhi tadvat puruṣacetanaḥ tathā pariṇamate na pudgaladravyamiti; atrāha--na punaḥ naiva cetano brahmātmā caitanyaṃ svaparāvabhāsitvaṃ vihāya viparivarttate pṛthivyādirūpeṇa pariṇamate
etaduktaṃ bhavati--pudgaladravyaṃ yathā pṛthivyādirūpeṇa viparivarttate tatra tadrūpādyanvayadarśanāt, tathā yadi puruṣaḥ tadrūpeṇa viparivarttitā ; caitanyānvayaḥ tatra pratīyeta
acetanastarhi cetanarūpeṇa pariṇamata iti cet; atrāha--acetanaḥ pṛthivyādiḥ punaḥ cetano bhavan sa~llakṣyate
na punaḥ ityanuvarttate, sa llakṣyata iti
anenaitad darśayati— yadi acetanaḥ pariṇāmī cetanaḥ tatpariṇāmaḥ tatra tadrūpānvayaḥ sa lakṣyate
na ca tadasti rūpādirahitasya antaḥcetanasya parisphuraṇāt
na ca tatra rūpādīnāmanāvirbhāvakalpanā śreyasī; bhūtānāmanyo'nyātmani lakṣaṇānāvirbhāvakalpane na lakṣaṇabhedena tadvyavasthākathanama yuktaṃ syāt
yata evaṃ tat tasmād ayaṃ vāvākasvatvaṃ pudgaladravyalakṣaṇam ekasaṃkhyopapannam caturdhā caturbhiḥ prakāraiḥ vyavasthāpayan
kena ? ityāha— pṛthivyādibhedena kathaṃ svasthaḥ bhūtagṛhīta ityarthaḥ
yathā candramasamekaṃ dvitvena vyavasthāpayan tathāvidhabuddhiḥ tathā ayamapi yataḥ
nanu paracetovṛttīnāṃ duranvayatvāt tathāvidhabuddhirayamiti kuto jñāyate iti cet; atrāha— devānāṃpriya ityādi
nahi asau sattāmātreṇa tanmayaḥ atiprasaṅgāt, api tu pramāṇatrāṇarahitatvopadeśāt sukhasaṃvardhitamatīnāṃ teṣāṃ pramāṇaviṣaye apraveśāt, tato'sau tathābuddhiḥ avagamyate
tathāvidhatattvopadeśo'pi tasya kuto'vagamyate iti cet ? atrāha--pratyakṣasya ityādi
pratyakṣasya pramāṇasya prameyasya vā atīva laṅghanād anyathaiva pratipādanāt
kiṃ punarayametadeva kurvan asvasthaḥ ? na; ityāha--cetanetaratattvam ekīkurvan
tadevaṃ madhyāvasthāyāṃ cetana eva cetanībhavati iti sākalyena vipakṣe'nantarabādhakopadarśanena siddhāyāṃ vyāptau yatsiddhaṃ taddarśayannāha--prāṇinām ihajanmani ityādi
prāṇā daśa āgamapaṭhitā vidyante yeṣāṃ te prāṇinaḥ teṣām

etena sarvasambandhinām ādyantacittānāṃ dharmitvena upādīyamānānāṃ pramāṇādisattvena anumānasiddhatvaṃ darśayati, itarathā pratyakṣeṇa teṣāmagrahaṇād anumānasya vā'vacane hetoḥ āśrayāsiddhiḥ āśaṅkyeta
na ca ātmana eva taccitte tathā sādhayitumatrābhipreta cittāni iti bahunirdeśāt
tataḥ sūktam--prāṇinām iti vacanaṃ sarvasattvādyantacittān mānaparicchedyatvajñāpanārthamiti

evamapi teṣāmanādyanantabhūtānām ādyantacittāsaṃbhava iti āśrayāsiddho hetuḥ; yasmāddhi na pūrvacittamasti tad ādiḥ, yasmācca northa tad antyam, na caitat jīvānādyanibaṃdhana tve yuktamiti cet; atrāha— ihajanmani asmin janmani
yadi vā, cittāntarasya upādānopādeyabhūtāni iti grāhyam
tathā hi ādicittāni pūrvabhavamaraṇāntyacittāntarasyopādeyabhūtāni, antyacittāni bhāvibhavādyacittāntarasya upādānabhūtāni

evamapi evaṃ vaktavyam cittopādānopādeyabhūtāni iti vaktavyaṃ kimantaraśabdena bhedasya upādānopādeyabhūtavacanādeva siddheḥ anyathā tadayogāt, ekātmavaditi cet; na; sākhyaṃ prati siddhasādhyatāparihārārtham evaṃvacanāt
sāṃkhyo hi sarvatra kāryakāraṇayorabhedaikāntavādī cittopādānopādeyabhūtāni iti vacane siddhasādhyatā manyeta
tatkutaḥ tāni tathābhūtāni ? ityāha— cittatvāt, viśeṣasya sādhyatvāt sāmānyasya sādhanatvāt na pratijñārthaikadeśā'siddho hetuḥ ityeke
viśeṣayoḥ sāmānyayorvā evaṃ sādhyasādhanabhāve'pi nāyaṃ doṣaḥ ityapare
anyathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ śabdatvāt ityādāvapi syāt
paṃca vi iṃdiyapāṇā maṇavacikāyesu tiṇṇi balapāṇā
nanu pratyayaviśeṣo dharmī sāmānyaṃ sādhyamiti na pratijñārthaikadeśatā
nanu jainasya lohalekhyaṃ vajraṃ pārthivatvāt kāṣṭhavat ityādāviva na dṛṣṭāntamātrād hetuḥ gamakaḥ, api tu anyathānupapatteḥ, sa ca atra, ataḥ āha--atra ityādi
atra hetoḥ punaḥ iti sauṣṭhave, anyathā sādhyābhāvaprakāreṇa anupapattiḥ aghaṭanā asti
eva nipātena manāgapi tadupapattiḥ nāsti iti vadati
jātaivādauvā antyatasya pūrvam atītajanmanyaśca stanādipānādikatrasya smṛteranubandhāt avicchedāt
etaduktaṃ bhavati--maraṇāntyacittasya tattvaṃ yadi uttarajanmādiprabodhāvinābhāvi na bhavet, tarhi tatra tadāhitasaṃkāravaidhurye jātasya smṛtyanubandhaḥ na syāt
mānnapi puruṣamātreṇa anyena kathamavagamyate paracetovṛttīnāṃ duranvayatvāditi cet; atrāha--bhayādi ityādi
bhayam ādiryasya abhilāṣādeḥ tasya pratipatteḥ mukhavikārādinā niściteḥ, anyathā kutaścit paracetovṛttiviśeṣe pratipattyabhāvamutprekṣāmahe
na caivam, ato vatkuvikārādeḥ bhayādipratipattiḥ tataḥ tadanubandhapratipattiriti
etena jātasya pūrvābhyastasmṛtyanubandhāt ityasya hetoḥ svarūpāsiddhirapi pratyuktā
nanu madhyacetasi cittatvaṃ yadyapi cittāntaropādeyatvasahitaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tathāpi ādyantacetasi tattathā na yuktam, anyathā pratyagnerjvālāpūrvakatvadarśanāt pathikāgnerapi pūrvaṃ katvaṃ tattvādanumīyeta
vyabhicārāśaṅkā anyatrāpi iti cet; atrāha--pathikāgneḥ ityādi
anena ityayaṃ śabdaḥ ante karaṇāt pratyagnivat ityasya anantaraṃ yathāsthānaṃ ca draṣṭavyaḥ

tato'yamarthaḥ— pathikāgneḥ pathikasambandhinaḥ pāvakasya, pathikasya anavasthāyitvena tatsaṃbandhitvasya parokṣatājñāpanārtham, athavā jvālāntarapūrvakatvetaratvasaṃbhavajñāpanārthaṃ pathikagrahaṇam tasya hi agniḥ uta yadyapi saṃbhavati
jvālāntarapūrvakatvaṃ sādhyam, atra hetuḥ pathikāgnitvāt iti draṣṭavyaḥ

kaścit pathikaḥ śītārto araṇinirmathanād anyato vā prajvālitāgniḥ niḥśīto bhūtāt kvāpi gataḥ, punastatraiva aparaḥ paṇḍitamānā samāgatya tato'gneḥ pratyagniṃ prajvālya anumānaṃ karoti pathikāgniḥ jvālāntarapūrvakaḥ tattvāt pratyagnivat
na caivam, ataḥ anena bhavadīyānumānasya vyabhicāra iti yad vyabhicāracodanaṃ tadanena anantaragranthena pratyuktam prakṛte hetulakṣaṇabhāvād anyatra viparyayāt
tejasaḥ kāraṇaṃ pudgaladravyam anantaravarṇitam tatpūrvakatvasya tatra pathikāgnau avirodhāt
virodhābhāvānna jvālāntarapūrvakatvamasya, nanu cetane abhihitanītyā tatpūrvakatvasya avirodha iti manyate
atha sarvatra sarvadā santu tadādicittāni iṣṭasādhyāni nanu maraṇāntyacittāni pramāṇābhāvāt
tarhi arvāgbhāgadarśipratyakṣam iyato vyāpārān karttuṃ samartham sannihitaviṣayabalotpatteḥ
cittatvasya bhāvāliṃgātā vo asiddha iti cet; na; tat kāryam, kāraṇam, anubhayaṃ vā syāt ? tatra upa— deyābhimatāt prāgeva bhāvāt na kāryam
snānādeḥ prāgapi bhavan jalādistatkāryam ityeke; teṣāṃ prāpyamarthakriyājātaṃ kiṃ kurvāṇaṃ jalādeḥ kāraṇam ? akiñcitkarasya tadayogād atiprasaṅgāt

sattām iti cet; nanu ca anutpannamasat kharaviṣāṇasamaṃ kathaṃ kasyacit tāmupajanayati ? svakāle sattvādadoṣaḥ; kāryotpatteḥ prāgapi tadā tatsattve pūrvabhāvitvameva kāraṇasya arthādāpatitaṃ nānāgatatvam
paścāt sattve prāgeva utpanne kārye tadakiñcitkaratvaṃ kṛtasya karaṇā'yogāt
sato vidyamānasya cetanasya antyadaśāyām iti prakramād etallabhyate

anena etat kathayati--madhye cetanasya anyasya vā sattvaṃ bhinnakāryakāritveneva uttarasvapariṇāmakāritvena vyāptaṃ pratipannam, tadidānīṃ yadi tadabhāve'pi syāt niḥsvabhāvatvamiti kutaḥ kasyacit tattvamanyadvā ? anyathā sarvasya vyāpyasya svavyāpakābhāve'pi bhāvāśaṅkayā ananumānaṃ jagat syāditi
yasmāt kāraṇāt utpadyate asau cetanaḥ tasmād anyat kāraṇaṃ tadantaram, tatra na vidyate apekṣā yasya tadvā na apekṣyate iti tasya bhāvā'bhāvāt atra punaḥ anyathānupapattiḥ astyeva ityanena sambandhaḥ
nanu tadanapekṣatve'pi tadrūpeṇa pariṇāmo na bhaviṣyati ? ityāha--svayam ityādi
svayam ātmanā akṣepeṇa jhaṭiti vivartasya upapatteḥ
tu sa tanasya ityādi anabhyupagacchato dūṣaṇamāha--yadi ityādi
punaḥ iti pakṣāntaradyotane, antyakṣaṇasya maraṇacittasya nottarībhavanaśaktiḥ nottarapariṇāmasāmarthyam, avastutvam antyakṣaṇasya
sva ityanena ante kṣaṇaḥ parāmṛśyate tasya upādānaprabandhasya abhāvaṃ sādhayet
237 arthasya kāryasya kriyā karaṇaṃ tallakṣaṇatvād vastunaḥ
tatsāmarthyaṃ tallakṣaṇam, tacca sahakārivaikalyāt kāryākāriṇo'pi tatkṣaṇasya asti iti cet; atrāha— samartham ityādi
samartham antyakṣaṇajātam iti na karoti ca ityevaṃ viruddham
tathāhi— yadi samartham; kathaṃ na karoti ? na karoti cet; kathaṃ samartham ? anyathā nityaṃ samarthamapi sahakārivaikalyāt sarvadā na kuryāditi manyate
nārthakriyā nāpi tatsāmarthyaṃ tallakṣaṇam, api tu sattāsambandha iti kasmānnāśaṅkitamiti cet; avyāpakatvāt, sāmānyādau abhāvāt, pratiṣiddhatvācca
tarhi taduttarībhavanaśaktyabhāve'pi vijātīyakaraṇaśakterna tadavastutvam ityāśaṅkanīyamiti cet; na; cārthākasya tathā matābhāvād bhūtasamucchedānabhyupagamāt
dravyādīnāṃ trayāṇāmapi sattāsambandhaḥ...--praśa॰ bhā॰, vyo॰ pṛ॰ 121

nanu yathā cetanasya saṃsāre avagrahādayo na tata ūrdhvaṃ tathā maraṇāt pūrvaṃ so'pi na paścāditi cet; atrāha--sāmagryā janma yeṣām visadṛśakāryāṇāṃ keṣāṃ kādācitkatvaṃ suvarṇe kaṭakādīnāmiva syāt na puna ca uttarībhavanasya kādācitkatvam
na ca antyacittāni cittāntaropādeyabhūtāni iti sādhayataḥ pratyakṣabādhā pakṣasya yathā aśrāvaṇaḥ śabdaḥ iti sādhayataḥ
antye kṣayadarśanāditi cet; atrāha--tat tasmād uktanyāyāt etat pareṇa ucyamānam ante maraṇād ūrdhvaṃ yaccetanasya pareṇa kṣayadarśanam upagatam tad asiddham aniścitam, tatra tatkṣayā'siddheḥ
na ca tadadarśanaṃ pakṣabādhanāya alam, anyathā śabde nityatvā'darśanamapi tadbādhakaṃ syāditi manyate
ataśca tadasiddham ityāha--madhye janmana ūrdhvaṃ maraṇāt prāk yat sthitidarśanaṃ tadapi na kevalam ukto nyāyaḥ sthitiṃ prasādhyet antye iti sambandhaḥ
tathāhi— yadi ante sthāṃturna bhavet bhāvo madhye'pi na bhaved aviśeṣāditi saugataṃ matam
yo jāto na ca vidhvasto naśyet paścāt sahetava || iti
uddhṛto'yam...jātireva...naśyet paścāt sa kena vā--ṣaḍda॰ vṛha॰ pṛ॰ 12
atha madhye sthitiḥ, tarhi tatra yattasya rūpaṃ tadevāpi iti paścāt sthitiḥ kena vāryate
atha madhye sthāsnurapi punaḥ kṣarādi vipāyipratyayopanipāte naśyati iti matiḥ; sāpi na yuktā; yataḥ tathāvidhasya gaganādivat tadayogāt sato'tyantavināśā'saṃbhavāt ityuktatvācca
saugatamatānusārī bhūtvā kadācit cārvāko madhye sthiteranupalabdhiṃ madhye sthiteradarśanasya asiddheśca kāraṇāt, na kevalam avyabhicārāt madhye sthitidarśanam ityādinā sambandhaḥ
nanu prasādhayatu madhye sthitidarśanam ante sthitiṃ cetanasya, tāṃ tu acetanarūpeṇa, tato viruddho hetuḥ iti cet; atrāha--yadi ityādi
cetanaḥ san acetanākāreṇa vivartteta punaḥ cetanākāreṇa vivartteta yadi svāpaprabodhavat svāpaprabodhayoriva pretyabhāvasiddheḥ mṛttvā punarbhavanasiddheḥ kathaṃ na kathañcid anavadyaṃ syāt
etadabhyupagamya dūṣaṇamuktam, yāvatā paramārthato naitadasti iti
na punaḥ cetanaḥ caitanyaṃ vihāya ityādinā uktaṃ smārayannāha--cetanetarayoḥ ityādi
cetano jīvaḥ itaro'cetanaḥ pṛthivyādiḥ tayoḥ saṅkaraśca ekatra prasaktiḥ vyatikaraśca parasparaviṣayagamanaṃ tayoḥ pratipattiḥ ayuktaiva
yadi vā, svasmāt samānajātīyād bhāvāt niṣpannayoḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha--dṛṣṭasya tayorbhedasya hāneḥ sarvasya prakṣayasya sā nāsatāṃ darśayati--nīlādisukhādipratyakṣasyāpi tadanuṣaṅgāt
adṛṣṭasya pratyakṣeṇa aviṣayīkṛtasya tayoḥ saṅkarādeḥ kalpanācca iti
anenāpi parasya pramāṇāntara prasaṅgaṃ darśayati tadabhāve tadayogāt
nanu bhavatu adṛṣṭakalpanam apramāṇakaṃ tu na syāt, vyavahāreṇa tadabhedasādhakasya anumānasyopagamāt
tacca anumānam--cetano bhūtapariṇāmaḥ tatsvabhāvo vā sattvādibhyo jalabudbudavat madaśaktivacca iti
jalasya budbudaiḥ samānaṃ varttate iti tadvat
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā sattvādisanto budbudā jalātmakāḥ tatraiva bhavanti vinaśyanti ca tathā jīvāḥ pṛthivyādiṣu iti madasya jātikayā mantryā tulyaṃ vartate iti tadvat
idamatra tātparyam--yathā bhatīkivodiniḥ madaśaktiḥ ātmabhūtā abhivyajyate, tatraiva punaḥ sā tirobhavati tathā bhūtaiḥ vijñānam
atrottaramāha--ityeva paraḥ kevalam arkasā kaṭukimānaṃ dṛṣṭvā guḍādāvapi yojayati--kaṭuko guḍādiḥ sattvādibhyo guḍāditi
tadanena yathā atra pakṣasya pratyakṣabādhanaṃ tathā prakṛte'pi iti darśayati
vijñapteḥ pariṇāmicetanāyāḥ, yadi sādhayet iti sambandhaḥ
atra ādiśabdena paryāyādiviśeṣo gṛhyate, tatpratibandhābhāvaṃ darśayati tasya
dūṣaṇamāha--tata eva sattvotpattikṛtakatvādeḥ sādhayati iti sambandhaḥ
buddhiśca pradhānasya ādyaḥ pariṇāmo mahadākhyaḥ caitanyaṃ tu puruṣaḥ tayoḥ vivarttaḥ pariṇāmaḥ tasya anatikramam
sukhādi svasaṃvedanaṃ ca tayoriva tadvat iti
kaḥ ? ityāha--paro'pi sāṃkhyaḥ--tasmādapi ṣoḍaśakāt pañcabhyaḥ pañca bhūtāni sāṃkhyakā॰ 21 iti vacanāt

2 ityādyabhidhānāt, na kevalaṃ cārvāka eva iti apiśabdaḥ iti hetoḥ viruddhā'vyabhicārī sattvotpattikṛtakatvādiḥ iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ, viruddhaṃ sādhyaṃ na vyabhicarati evaṃśīlaḥ caitanyabhūtapariṇāmavat teṣāmapi anyapariṇāmaprasādhanāt
yadi vā, viruddhena sādhyena avyabhicārī tadavinābhāvī viruddha iti yāvat

tathāhi--vijñapteḥ sattvādi madhyāvasthāyām anantaroktanyāyād vipakṣasadbhāvabādhanāt cetanopādeyatvāvyabhicāri pratiṣṭhāpitaṃ yathā ca antarvyāptau asiddhāyāṃ bahirvyāpterakiñcitkaratvaṃ tathā na siddhāyāmapi iti
yadvakṣyati--pra mā ṇa saṃ gra he--bhaviṣyati ātmā sattvāt pramāṇasaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 104 tatra ca na acidrūpeṇa; aniṣṭāpatteḥ sādhanavaiphalyācca
nāpi cidrūpeṇa; tatsādhane pṛthivyādāvapi sadbhāve na tadvyabhicārī viśiṣṭasya hetutvāt
bhūtānāmapi iti, ayamapiśabdo bhinnakramaḥ viruddhā'vyabhicārī ityasya anantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ
tato'yamartho na kevalaṃ viruddhā'vyabhicārī kintu vyabhicāryapi

iti ityādinā upasaṃhāramāha--ityevam anantaraprakāreṇa mithyābhiniveśād asatyā''grahāt pramāṇaprameyavyavasthām atilaṅghayet pramāṇasya pramāṇatvasya, bhāvapradhānatvāt nirdeśasya, vyavasthā viśada eva abhrānta eva jñāne sthitiḥ tām atilaṅghayet atīva pralayaṃ nayet

tathāhi— bhūtebhyo'tyantamabhinnaṃ caitanyaṃ bhinnaṃ paśyat pratyakṣaṃ yadi pramāṇam; dvicandrādijñānaṃ kathaṃ na bhavet yato laukikī pratyakṣatadābhāsavyavasthāmanusaran laukāyatikaḥ syāt ? atha apramāṇam; dvicandrādijñānavat sarvamaviśeṣeṇa bhaved bhūtebhyo'bhinnasya svarūpasya tato bhinnasya sarveṇa grahaṇāt
nahi kiñcidvijñānam ātmānaṃ rūpādyātmakaṃ pratyeti sārūpyaniṣedhāt
tathāpi tasya tathā pratītikalpane sarvasya sarvadarśitvakalpane 'laukāyatikaṃ jagat syāt
kiṃ ca, tadātmakatvena sarvasya jñānasya avabhāsane cārvākacarvitā sarvavipratipattiḥ iti kiṃ śāstrapraṇayanena ? nahi nīlādikaṃ paśyantaṃ prati tadupadeśaḥ arthavān

bhrāntivyavacchedārthaṃ taditi cet; na; bhrāntibuddherapi tadātmakatvena avabhāsane tadavastho doṣaḥ, tataḥ tato'bhinnasya svarūpasya bhinnasya grahaṇāt kinnāmābhrāntaṃ yat pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇaṃ syāt ? bhūtātmamātre abhrāntamiti cet; syādetadevaṃ yadi tanmātrasya kutaścitsattvaṃ pratīyeta, darśanasya tadadarśanena vyabhicārād, atrāpi bādhakasya durlabhatvāt
yadi tarhi tad bhūtebhyo bhinnamavabhāsate tathaiva sat ityeke
tathāpi tasya tato'bhede na kasyacit kutaścid bheda iti na pratyakṣapramāṇavyavasthā tatprameyavyavasthā vā ityapare

aparasya tu darśanam--satyam; tadbhūtebhyaḥ kāraṇatvena abhimatebhyo bhinnaṃ tathā'vabhāsanāt, kāryasya kāraṇāt bhedācca, tathāpi yathā pārthivatantubhyaḥ paṭo jāyamāno bhinno'pi pārthiva eva tathā caitanyaṃ bhūtātmakaśarīrād bhūtātmakam iti; tadasatyam; yato nahi yathā rūpāditvena tantupaṭayoḥ sādharmyaṃ tathā bhūtacetanayoḥ, arūpāditvāt cetanasya

nānumānam, anyathā pratyakṣameva pramāṇaṃ nāparam iti pramāṇavyavasthāmatilaṅghayati sattvādeḥ pṛthivīdṛṣṭāntena cetate rūpādimattvasādhane tata eva bhūtānāṃ pratyekaṃ tatsādhanāt prameyavyavasthām atilaṅghayati
jīve tāvat nāstikyaṃ mithyādarśanam iti vyākhyātam, saṃprati anyatra jīvābhimānaśca ityetad vyākhyātukāma āha-- tathā ca ityādi
tadvihāya punaravikāriṇa eva prayatnādṛṣṭasamavāyāt kartṛtvaṃ punaḥ sukhaduḥkhādisamavāyāt bhoktṛtvamiti bandhyāsūnorvikramādiguṇasampadvaktumupakramate
tathā paro jīvasya tattvaṃ caitanyasukhaduḥkhādipariṇāmakartṛtvabhoktṛtvalakṣaṇaṃ cetanaḥ puruṣaḥ svayaṃ svabhāvataḥ akarttā darśanāt bhokteti vibhajate
tathā tenaiva prakāreṇa guṇaiḥ prayatnā'dṛṣṭādilakṣaṇaiḥ karaṇaiḥ kṛtvā ātmā karttā

kiṃbhūto'pi ? ityāha--avikāryapi anādheyā'praheyātiśayo'pi ityevaṃ matam mithyā taprā guṇairbuddhyādibhiḥ arthāntaraiḥ ātmā avikāryapi sukhādyanubhavarūpatayā gaganavadapariṇato'pi bhoktā iti mithyā yuktivirodhāt
evaṃ vaiśeṣikādeḥ anyatra jīvābhimānaṃ pradarśya sāṃkhyasya darśayannāha— bhoktā ityādi
tatrāyamarthaḥ--guṇaiḥ sattvarajastamobhiḥ kāraṇabhūtaiḥ arthāntaraiḥ pradhānāśritaiḥ ātmā puruṣaḥ bhoktā tadupadarśitānāmarthānām anubhavitā avikāryapi tatsākṣātkaraṇapariṇāmarahito'pi iti mithyā
na ca samānadarśanānāṃ kasyacid dṛśyaṃdya yadya dṛṣyaṃ dṛṣṭamiti
tathā bhoktāpi sannakarttā iti mithyā, bhoktuḥ akartṛtvavirodhāt, sakalaśaktivirahalakṣaṇatvād akartṛtvasya
adhunā tayoḥ sādhāraṇaṃ mithyātvaṃ darśayannāha--vyāpaka ityādi
vyāpakasya ātmano'deśakalpanā niraṃśatvakalpanā mithyā tayoḥ virodhāt iti nirūpayiṣyate
atra ādiśabdena niraṃśatvādiparigrahaḥ, so'pi mithyā ekatra pramāṇābhāvād anyatra dehā'vyāpakatvaprasaṅgāt

svataḥ ityādinā kārikārthamāha--svata ātmanā pravartamānasyaiva pūrvākāraparihārā'jahadvṛttamuttaraṃ pariṇāmam anubhavata evānekarūpasya paropakārasaṃbhavāt pareṣām ātmano bhinnānāṃ buddhyādīnām upakāro janam athavā paraiḥ sahakāribhiḥ upakāraḥ atiśayo vā taktasya saṃbhavāt kāraṇāt tadvihāya tat svataḥ pravarttamānaṃ va'tustrutyatrkā punaravikāriṇa eva kūṭasthanityasyaiva ātmano jīvasya prayatnā'dṛṣṭasamavāyāt sakāśāt kartṛtvaṃ punaḥ paścāt prayatnā'dṛṣṭākṛṣṭeṣṭapadārthaprāptyanantaraṃ sukhaduḥkhādisamavāyād bhoktṛtvam ityevaṃ vyāsūno rvikramādiguṇasampadaṃ vaktum upakramate naiyāyikaḥ

etaduktaṃ bhavati— yathā bandhyāsutasya paropakārā'saṃbhavāt na vikramādiguṇasaṃpatkīrttanaṃ nyāyyaṃ tathā avikāriṇaḥ paropakārā'saṃbhavāt prayatnā'dṛṣṭayorabhāvāt na tatsamavāyāt kartṛtvaṃ nyāyyam, tadabhāvāt tatkutaḥ ? sukhaduḥkhādivijñānā'bhāvāt tatsamavāyād bhoktṛtvamapi tādṛgeva iti
pareṇa hi prayatnaviśeṣād adṛṣṭaḥ, tasmācca prayatnaviśeṣa iti iṣyate
dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikabhāvā'bhāvapradarśanārthaṃ vā--tena hi prayatnasya dṛṣṭāntatvam adṛṣṭasya dārṣṭāntikatvam iṣyate

tadyathā--prayatnasamānadharmeṇa hi devadattaguṇena tadupakārakāḥ paśvādayaḥ samākṛṣṭāḥ kāryatve sati tadupakārakatvāt grāsādivat iti; tatra prayatnasya avikāriguṇatvaniṣedhe kuta eva adṛṣṭasya tadguṇatvam iti ?
devadattaviśeṣaguṇapreritabhūtakāryāḥ tadupagṛhītāśca śarīrādayaḥ kāryatve sati tadupabhogasādhanatvāt gṛhavaditi
nanu mā bhūd bandhyāsūnoḥ atyantamasato vikramādiguṇasamyagavyāvarṇanam ātmanastu avikāriṇo'pi sattvāt kartṛtvādivyāvarṇanamupapannamiti cet; atrāha--vastu ityādi
tallakṣaṇaṃ vastuno vihāya punaḥ avikāriṇa eva vastulakṣaṇapariṇāmarahitasyaiva avastuna eva ityarthaḥ, lakṣaṇanivṛttyā lakṣyanivṛtteravaśyaṃbhāvāt
evaṃ naiyāyikamataṃ nirākṛtya kāpilamataṃ nirākurvannāha--tathā ityādi
tathā tena prakāreṇa paraḥ sāṃkhyaḥ jīvasya ātmanaḥ tattvaṃ svarūpaṃ caitanyasukhaduḥkhādipariṇāma karttṛtvabhoktṛtvalakṣaṇaṃ vibhajate vilabhate
kiṃ gaje va katham ? ityāha--pratipanna ityādi
pratipannaḥ kathañcidabhedena ātmasātkṛtaḥ kāryasya uttarottarasya mahadādeḥ kāraṇasya pūrvapūrvasya ātma svabhāvo yena tasya
pratipanna ityādinā pradhānavad yadi puruṣasyāpi pratipannakāryakāraṇātmatā ko doṣaḥ syād yena tasya avikāritvaṃ kalpyate ? na ca doṣamantareṇa tattyāgaḥ aprekṣākāritāpatteḥ
syāt pratyakṣādi vā vā doṣo yadi avikāryasyā pratīyete darśayati sukha ityādinā kṛtottaratvam
nanu syādevaṃ yadi cetanāḥ sukhādayaḥ siddhāḥ syuḥ, na caivamiti cet; kathaṃ puruṣaḥ cetanaḥ ? abhyupagamāt, so'yam anyasya sukhādāvapi
yadi punaḥ svayam ātmano grahaṇāt sa cetanaḥ; sukhādirapi syāt
nahi tasyāpi para eva sākṣātkārī kaścit
puruṣa iti cet; tasyāpi tathā anyakalpane anavasthitiḥ
acetanapradhānapariṇāmatvāt pṛthivyādivad asvagrahaṇātmakāḥ sukhādayaḥ; pratyakṣeṇa pakṣabādhanaṃ śabdā'śrāvaṇatvavat
kathaṃ vā tatpariṇāmāḥ te ityapi cintyam
utpattyanyatvādeḥ ghaṭādivadacetanāḥ sukhādaya ityeke; tatra sattvāt tadvat puruṣo'pyacetanaḥ syāt
tatra yathā sattvā'viśeṣe'pi kiñcit cetanam, aparam anyathā, tathā utpattyādya viśeṣe'pi syāt
atra anye hetoḥ asiddhatāmudbhāvayanti; tanna; anyathābhāvasya utpattyādivyapadeśāt, tasya sāṃkhyairapi aṅgīkaraṇāt anyasya tadvyapadeśārhasya pramāṇataḥ saugatasyāpi asiddheḥ
cetanaḥ puruṣaḥ svayam ātmanā akarttā kevalaṃ pradhānakartṛtvāropād upacāreṇa karttā ityucyate iti svayam ityanena darśayati, svabhāvataḥ svarūpataḥ na upacārataḥ
darśanād darśitaviṣayasya sākṣātkaraṇād bhoktā ityevaṃ jīvasya tattvaṃ vibhajate
evaṃ manyate bhoktṛtvavat kartṛtvamapi buddhipūrva cetanasyaiva yuktaṃ netarasya; anyathā tata eva sakalapuruṣārthasiddheḥ puruṣakalpanā kamarthaṃ puṣṇāti
sati sukhādeḥ ātmatvenāgrahaṇe acetanapradhānapariṇāmasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca anātmagrahaṇasiddhiriti
svata ityādinaiva vyāpako deśa kalpanā mithyā iti ca vyākhyātam
tathāhi--svata ātmanā pravarttamānasyaiva yugapat sarvaśarīrāvayavān svāvayavaiḥ vyāpnuvataḥ parasya śarīropakāro dhāraṇādiḥ tasya saṃbhavānna niśrā deśasya saugatakalpitāvibhāgacittavad iti
etacca cū rṇau laghvāde jīvasiddhau śāstrakṛtā cintitam avadhāryam
pariṇāmaḥ saha krameṇa vā anyathābhāvo bhāvalakṣaṇam
nanu yathā caramakṣaṇaḥ anarthakriyākāryapi parārthakriyākārisāmyāt san tathā ātmāpi syāt; tanna yuktaṃ tadvihāya ityādi iti sāṃkhya-yaugāḥ; tatrāha--antya ityādi
nityasyātmanaḥ antyabuddhikṣaṇasya ca svayamakiñcitkarasyānarthakriyākāriṇaḥ kutaścitkārakādisādharmyād vastutve punaḥ akārakatvādeva vyaktamavastutvam avastusādharmyāt
anta ścāsau cittakṣaṇaśca sa iva ātmā puruṣo'kārakaḥ kāryamakurvan bhāvo vastu syād bhavet
kutaḥ ? kārako yataḥ, anyena kārakeṇa samānadharmā yataḥ
atra dūṣaṇamāha--abhāvasvacchaḥ syāt ātmā iti sambandhaḥ
tataḥ tadvat antyacittakṣaṇād abhāvena nīrūpatvena aviśeṣato viśeṣā'bhāvāt, jainān prati sādhyasamo dṛṣṭānta iti manyate
nityasya avikāriṇa ātmanaḥ antyabuddhikṣaṇasya saugatakalpitasya ca iti samuccaye
svayaṃ na kiñcitkarasya anarthakriyākāriṇaḥ kutaścid vastutve aṅgīkriyamāṇe
nanu jñeyatvaṃ svaviṣayajñānajanakatvam, ataḥ taccet tasyāsti; svayam akiñcitkarasya iti virudhyate
vastutvādisādharmyācca vastutvasādhane tadeva sādhanaṃ sādhyaṃ ca prasaktam
tatra jñeyatvādibhāve va yadvakṣyati--avastusādharmyāt iti; tadapi na saṅgatam, kharaśṛṅgādinā sādharmyābhāvāditi cet; na; anyathā'bhiprāyāt

tadyathā, yathāhi--pareṇa antyacittakṣaṇasya ātmano vā svayamakiñcitkarasyāpi vastutvaṃ sādhyate kārikābhimatavat kenacid ubhayatra vidyamānena dharmeṇa, tadā hetorasya asiddhatodbhāvanārthamāha--punaḥ ityādi
punaḥ asya prayogasya anantaram akāraṇa tvādeva kārakasādharmyā'bhāvādeva na hetvantarāt iti evakārārthaḥ
na hi svayamakiñcitkarasya kenāpi dharmeṇa kārakasādṛśyaṃ sadapi jñātuṃ śakyam, taddharmajñānopāyā'saṃbhavāt
tataḥ kim ? ityāha--vyaktaṃ yathā bhavati tathā avastutvam vastutvasādhanābhāvaḥ prakṛtasya iti
idaṃ tu niścitaṃ syād ityāha--avastu ityādi
avastunā kharaviṣāṇena sādharmyād akiñcitkaratvasādṛśyāt vyaktamavastutvaṃ niḥsvabhāvatvam
yadā paro'kiñcitkarasyāsya vastutvasādhane kalpitaṃ kārakasādharmyamicchati tadā akārakatvādeva ityādi pratipramāṇamucyate
antyacittakṣaṇasya akiñcitkarasya avastusādharmyādi vastutve sādhye akārakatvādeva ityasya hetoḥ paropagatena nyāyena sādhyāvyabhicāraṃ darśayannāha--sattām ityādi
sā punaḥ kramayaugapadyābhyāṃ vastusattāṃ vyāpnuyāt antyacittakṣaṇāt nityādvā svayaṃ vyāvartamānā tatsattāṃ nivartayet
sā ca...kathamavyabhicārī sattvādihetuḥ yataḥ kṣaṇikameva paramārthasat sidhyet
kā'sau arthakriyā ? ityāha--kāryasattaiva tatkā raṇasāmarthyam, asya nirūpayiṣyamāṇatvāt
sā'pi arthakriyā kramākramābhyāṃ vyāptā, ced ityanuvarttate, vyāpnoti ityasya kṛtapratyayapariṇāmasya atra sambandhaḥ
kūṭasthād acalāt nityāt svanivṛttau sattāṃ nivarttayed arthakriyā cet
athavā kramā'kramau svanivṛttau nivarttayataḥ iti vacanapariṇāmena sambandhaḥ arthakriyām iti tā vibhaktipariṇāmena
nahi antyacittakṣaṇasya akārakatvādeva avastusādharmyād vyaktamavastutvam iti ghaṭanā
vyāpnoti iti kriyā kṛdantapratyayāntā vyāptā iti rūpaṃ prāptā atra sambandhyate
atra tu arthakriyām iti dvitīyāntaṃ sambadhyate

nanu antyacittakṣaṇo yadyapi sajātīyaṃ kāryaṃ na karoti, na cāpi vijātīyasya viṣayavijñānādeḥ karaṇāt nā'siddho madīyo hetuḥ, bhavadīya eva akārakatvādeva ityasiddha iti cet; etaccodyaparihārapurassaraṃ na paramātarī iti gamyate
tasya sattā svottarapariṇāmasadbhāvaḥ tasyā vyatirekaḥ abhāvaḥ tena ttāma ntareṇa ityarthaḥ
nārthakriyāṃ vijātīyakaraṇaṃ prekṣāmahe api tu tayā sahaiva prekṣāmahe

evaṃ manyate yathā śiśapāyāḥ kvacid vṛkṣasvabhāvatāmupalabhya deśāntarādāvapi tatsvabhāvatā, anyathā niḥsvabhāvatāpatteḥ, vvavasthāpyate, tathā tata eva bhāvasya bahulaṃ sajātīyetarakāryajananasāmarthyasvabhāvavādarśanāt sarvadā sā kinna vyavasthāpyate viśeṣābhāvāt ? itarathā sarvānumānocchedaḥ
nanu bhavatu tatsvabhāvatā, tathāpi sajātīyaṃ na kariṣyati iti cet; viruddhametat samarthaṃ na karoti ca iti nityavat
atha kāryattayā bhāvasattā vyāptā tato vijātīyakāryāsadbhāve'pi sā na virudhyate

yadi vandhaḥ sajātīyākaraṇe'pi vijātīyakaraṇam iti; tathā vijātīyā'karaṇe'pi sajātīyakaraṇaśaṅkayā bhāvyamiti na nirārekā sugatasya itarasya vā sarvajñatā nāma ? kathañcaivaṃvādināṃ sāmagrī janikā ? yataḥ ekasāmagryadhīnasya pra॰ vā॰ 3
sarve'rthāḥ sajātīyameva uttarakṣaṇaṃ kurvantu na sarvajñacittaṃ vijātīyamiti bhāvaḥ
tatra hi sajātīyamuttarakṣaṇaṃ janayitvaiva vijātīyaṃ kṣaṇaṃ prati sahakāribhāvakalpanenaiva nirvāhaḥ
bhavatu evaṃ tataḥ kim ? ityatrāha--sā anantaroktā punaḥ arthakriyā vastusattāṃ ced vyāpnuyāt
tataḥ kim ? ityāha— vyāvarttamānā arthakriyā antyacittakṣaṇāt nityādvā tayoḥ sattāṃ nivarttayet
kuta etat ? ityatrāha--svayam ātmanā, avyāpakasya vyāvṛttau satyāṃ vyāvṛtteḥ aniyamād avaśyaṃbhāvā'bhāvād avyāpyasya iti śeṣaḥ
syānmatam--vyāvarttatām antyacittakṣaṇād arthakriyā tathāpi sattā na nivarttate apratibandhāt iti cet; atrāha--sā ca ityādi
katham avyabhicārī na kathañcit hetuḥ sattvādiḥ anarthakriyākāriṇi nitye'pi tadbhāvā'nivāraṇāditi manyate
nanu na kāryasattayā vastusattā vyāptā yataḥ tannivṛttau sā'pi nivartteta api tu tajjananasāmarthyena, tacca sahakāri 244 vaikalyāt caramakṣaṇasya asti iti nā'sattvamiti cet; atrāha--sāmagrī ityādi
sāmagrī kāraṇaṃ naikaṃ śaktānāṃ śaktimān yadi
sāmagrīṃ prāpya nityo'rthaḥ karotyevaṃ na kiṃ punaḥ || 19
nārthakriyā nivartamānā vastusattāṃ nivartayati, tatsāmarthyaṃ punarantyakṣaṇasyāsti, na karoti sāmagrīvaikalyāt
samarthasādṛśyādityayuktam; nityasyāpi sarvadā sāmarthye'pi sāmagrīsākalyavaikalyābhyāṃ kāryakaraṇākaraṇaprasaṅgāt
viśeṣataḥ punaḥ nityo'rthaḥ saṃbhavasāmagrīsannidhiḥ karotyapi na punarantyakṣaṇaḥ sarvathā'bhāvāt
śaktānāṃ guṇakāryotpattiṃ prati samarthānāṃ sahakāri-upādānahetūnāṃ yā sāmagrī samagratā meva kāraṇaṃ kāryajanikā ityarthaḥ, na teṣāṃ madhye ekāṃ kāraṇam iti
caramaśca kṣaṇa eka iti paro manyate
śaktimān sadā samarthaḥ sāmagrīṃ prāpya nityo'rthaḥ ātmā anyo vā karoti evaṃ na kiṃ punaḥ

etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā kṣaṇikaṃ vastu caramadaśāyāṃ samarthamapi sāmagrīvikalpāt kāryāṇi na sampādayati anyadā tu viparyayāt saṃpādayati tathā akṣaṇamapi sarvadā samarthamapi sāmagrīvelāyāṃ karoti nānyadā iti
na arthakriyā kāryasattā nivarttamānā vastusattāṃ nivarttayati tasyāḥ tenavyāpteḥ iti bhāvaḥ
tatsāmarthyam punaḥ iti sauṣṭhave antyakṣaṇasya asti
kāryaṃ kasmānna karoti iti cet ? āha--sāmagrīvaikalyāt sahakāripratyayavaidhuryyāt
kāryākaraṇe'pi asti iti kuto'vagamyate iti cet ? āha--samartham ityādi
yena kāryaṃ kṛtaṃ tad iha samarthaṃ gṛhyate, anyasya sādhyasamatvāt, tena tatsādṛśyāt kasyacid ākārasya ubhayatra sadbhāvāt
vivecayanti hi laukikāḥ kṛtamaraṇakāryeṇa sādṛśyād viśeṣeṇā paramapi tatsamarthamiti
kutaḥ ? ityāha— nityasyāpi na kevalaṃ kṣaṇikasya sāmagrīsākalyā bhyāṃ kāryakaraṇā'karaṇaprasaṅgāt
viśeṣaḥ tatkṣaṇād atiśayena, punaḥ iti atiśayabhāvanāyām nityo'rthaḥ karoti api, na kevalaṃ na karoti
saṃbhavāt sāmagrīsannidhiḥ asye ti saṃbhavachenaitadṛbdena etaddarśayati
yadyapi sahakāriṇā tasya na kiñcit kriyate, tathāpyasau tasya saṃbhavati sahabhūya kāryakaraṇāt kṣaṇikapakṣavaditi
nanu tathā antyakṣaṇo'pi karoti iti na tasmādasya viśeṣa iti cet; atrāha--na punaḥ naiva antyakṣaṇaḥ karoti api iti sambandhaḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha--sarvathā sāmastyaprakāreṇa na punaḥ kāryakāle a bhāvāt
na ca asan kāryajanmani vyāpriyate, itarathā ciramṛtādapi sākṣāt śarīre praṇādiprasava ityāśaṅkāyāṃ cittakṣaṇasantānātmanāpi na sātmakatvaṃ jīvaccharīre syāt
yadi punaḥ sva kāle sat kāryakṛdiṣyate; tadapi na sundaram; yataḥ pūrvaṃ tatsamarthe'pi paścāt kāryabhāve na nityārthaniṣedhaḥ, tathā grāhyagrāhakabhāvasyāpi anivāraṇāt
tadanena tasya paratrāpi na vyāpāra iti tadapi gatam yat piñjane lagnam iti parasya darśitaṃ bhavati
nanu caramaḥ anyo vā kṣaṇasthāyī bhāvaḥ kāryaṃ kurvan upalabhyate, na punaḥ nityo'rthaḥ tatkathaṃ tasmādasya viśeṣa iti cet ? atrāha--sahakāriṇa ityādi
visadṛśakāryajanmani yaḥ sahakārī tasya sannivāva sannidhau ca svataḥ svarūpeṇa kathañcit na sarvātmanā pravṛttireva uttarākāreṇa gamanameva bhāvalakṣaṇaṃ vasturūpaṃ tathaiva darśanāt iti manyate
tadevam antyacittakṣaṇasya avastutve sādhite sādhūktam--antyacittakṣaṇo vātmā ityādi
syānmatam--akarttā nirguṇaḥ śuddho bhoktā sannātmāgame yathā te tasyaiva niṣedhe śāstravirodhaḥ, na ca śāstramanena nyāyena vācyāte bhinnaviṣayatvāt
tadavastubhūtāpariṇāmyātmapratipādakaśāstram āgamaḥ na yukteḥ anantaroktāyāḥ bādhane nirākaraṇe samartham api tu saiva tadbādhane samarthā, atīndriye'pi tasyā apratihataprasaratvāt
yadi vā, tathāvivātmapratipattiṃ vidavacchāstraṃ tadbādhane samarthaṃ na sattāmātreṇa atiprasaṅgāt
tatpratipattiśca na pradhāne acetane ghaṭādivat karoti

nāpi puṃsi tadvikāraśūnye parokṣe ca sā satyapi kamarthaṃ puṣṇāti ? svasaṃvidite punaḥ pratiprāṇi sarveṣām ātmanā svasaṃvedanādhyakṣasiddhatvāt kiṃ śāstraṃ kariṣyati ? na cā'vikāriṇi bhrāntiḥ, yā tena apanīyate
etena puruṣādvaitaniṣedhe'pi na śāstraṃ tadbādhanasamarthamiti nirūpitam

nanu yadi kathañcit pravṛttireva bhāvalakṣaṇam sā pradhāne asti iti tadvastu, tato netaravat sāṅkhyaḥ ekāntena dūṣitaḥ syāt, tatra ca bhedānāṃ parimāṇādeḥ sādhanasya bhāvāt na tadabhāvāśaṅkāpi yukteti cet; atrāha--asti pradhānam ityatra ityādi
bhedānāmekakāraṇapūrvakatve sādhye vaiśvarūpyakāraṇabhāvāt viruddhā eva nityādivat, viśvarūpādikāraṇānāṃ pariṇāma eva saṃbhavāt
na vai kāraṇasāmānyavacane'pi cicchakteḥ sahakārikāraṇam apariṇāmitvāt
asti pradhānamityatra sādhye bhedānāṃ mahadādīnām anvayaḥ anugamanam ādiḥ yeṣāṃ parimāṇādīnāṃ te anvayādayaḥ pareṇa ucyamānā hetavaḥ
kathambhūtāḥ ? ityāha--anyathā sādhyābhāvaprakāreṇaiva upapadyeran manāgapi tadbhāvaprakāreṇa nopapadyeran tato nā'naikāntikāḥ kintu viruddhā eva ityevakārārthaḥ
atra dṛṣṭāntamāha--ekānte nityakṣaṇikaikānte sādhye bhāvadharmavat bhāvaḥ sattvam, upalakṣaṇametat, tena kṛtakatvādiparigrahaḥ, sa eva dharmaḥ parāśritatvāt tena tulyaṃ varttate iti tadvat
svayam asti sarvajñaḥ iti dharmiṇaḥ sattāprasādhanāt tatsādhanadoṣo nodbhāvitaḥ svamatasiddhyanukūlatvādi ti viruddhataiva āviṣkṛtā
ekam advitīyaṃ yat kāraṇaṃ pradhānākhyaṃ tatpūrvakatve tannimittatve sādhye

nanu kārikāyām asti pradhānam iti anyat sādhyaṃ nirdiṣṭam, vṛttau tu bhedānām ekakāraṇapūrvakatvam anyaditi kathaṃ vṛttisūtrayoḥ sāṅgatyam ? sūtrānurūpayā ca vṛttyā bhavitavyamiti cet; atra kecit parihāramāhuḥ--pradhānadharmiṇaḥ sattāsādhane bhāvā'bhāvobhayadharmāṇām asiddha-viruddha-anaikāntikamiti doṣadarśanāt, evaṃsādhyāntarakaraṇe'pi viruddhatādoṣa iti pratipādanārthamevaṃ vacanamiti; taiḥ ekakāraṇapūrvakatve ityatra apiśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ, na kevalam asti pradhānam ityatra api tu tatpūrvakatve'pi viruddhā eva iti arthapratipattiryathā syāditi tathā sūtre'pi asti pradhānam ityetad upalakṣaṇatvena vyākhyeyam, kathamanyathā tadasāṅgatyaparihāraḥ ?
bhāvasādhane asiddhaḥ, abhāve viruddhaḥ ubhayadharme ca anaikāntikaḥ
dharmo viruddho'bhāvasya sā sattā sādhyate katham
idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam--ekakāraṇam iti pradhānasya aparamatvarthakamabhidhānam, tacca tat mahadādibhyaḥ pūrvaṃ bhāvāt pūrvakaṃ ceti tasya bhāve tattattve sādhye iti
pūrvavyākhyāne bhedānām ityetat pūrvavad uttaratrāpi sambadhyate
asmin uttaratraiva bhedānāṃ mahadādīnāṃ vaiśvarūpyakāraṇabhāvāt nanu viruddhā eva iti
kutaḥ ? ityāha— pariṇāma eva saṃbhavād iti
svaguṇaparyāyairna paraguṇaparyāyaiḥ bhāvaḥ pariṇāmaḥ tatraiva saṃbhavāt vaiśvarūpyakāryakāraṇatva pādī nām iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
rūpam ādi rasādeḥ asau rūpādiḥ, viśvo niravaśeṣo pādaḥ na naiyāyikamatavad vikalo rūpādiryeṣāṃ pudgaladravyābhimatakāraṇānām rūparasagandhasparśavantaḥ pudgalāḥ ta॰ sū॰ 5
23 iti vacanāt, teṣāṃ viśvarūpādikāraṇānāṃ pariṇāma eva saṃbhavāt ityanuvarttate
na vidyate paramaṃ dvitīyaṃ yasya tasya bhāvastattvam aparamatvam, tad artho yasyeti aparamatvārthakam, ekameva pradhānaṃ na dvitīyamityarthaḥ
yathā naiyāyikamate agnau rasagandhau jale gandhaḥ vāyau ca rūparasagandhā na svīkriyante na tathā atra vikalatvam
iti vacanāt yathā bhūtāni rūpādimanti tathā tatkāraṇāni pañca tanmātrābhimatāni, evaṃ tāvadvaktavyam--yāvat prakṛtiḥ, vijātīyāt kāryānutpatteḥ iti
kāraṇānām ityanena pradhānasya pudgalāparanāmno viśeṣāpekṣayā bahutvaṃ darśayati
tadapi kutaḥ etat ? ityatrāha--svayame kasya ityādi
svayaṃ sāṃkhyena viśvaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ rūpādi yasya pṛthivyādikāryasya tat tathoktaṃ tasya anabhyupagamāt
ekaḥ cetanālakṣaṇo na rūpādilakṣaṇaḥ svabhāvo yasya tasya iti
evaṃ manyate--yathā puruṣasya rūpādiradihatasya na rūpādimatkāryaṃ tathā anyasyā pātaravā puruṣasyaiva taditi kiṃ tattvāntarakalpanayeti
idamatra tātparyam--yathā tasya deśakālasvabhāvabhinnam anekaṃ rūpādimad upādeyamayuktaṃ tathā ekasya pradhānasya iti
itaśca viśvarūpādikaraṇānāṃ tatraiva saṃbhava iti darśayannāha--vikārāṇām ityādi
teṣāṃ vikārāṇāṃ yaḥ svo bhāvaḥ svarūpaṃ tadanurūpasya vikārāntarasya utpattiḥ yā tasyāḥ avipratiṣedhāt kāraṇāt tatraiva teṣāṃ saṃbhavāt iti sambandhaḥ
ṣoḍaśakaśca vikāro na prakṛtiḥ na vikṛtiḥ puruṣaḥ

nanu mūlakāraṇābhāve kutaḥ tadvikārā iti cet ? anyebhyo vikārebhyaḥ te'pi anyebhyaḥ iti anādi vipratiṣedhāt kāraṇāt tatraiva teṣāṃ saṃbhavāditi sambandha viṣayaṃ tatparamparā iti na sāṃkhyaṃ pratipatti darśanamuktam--nityakṣaṇikaikānta satko tpattyādiri ti; tanna yuktam, tasya tadasiddheḥ
sa hi sattvādeḥ nityaikānte sādhye nityapuruṣavat pariṇāmini mahadādau sattvasya bhāvād vyabhicāramicchati, kṛtakatvādeḥ tatra bhāve'pi prakṛtipuruṣayorabhāvād bhāgāsiddhatvam
kṣaṇikatve punaḥ sarvasya kṣaṇikatve sādhye nitye puruṣe sattvasya bhāvāt tadeva vyabhicāritvam, kṛtakatvādeḥ tathaiva bhāgāsiddhatvaṃ na viruddhatvam
atha pradhānasyaiva tadubhayaṃ sādhyate; bhavet kṛtakatvāderviruddhatvaṃ pariṇāminyeva pradhānādau bhāvāt, na sattvasya nitye'pi puruṣe tasya bhāvāt
atha puruṣo'pi pariṇāmī iti naite doṣāḥ, tatrāha--na vai ityādi
na vai naiva kāraṇasāmānyavacane'pi pariṇāmikāraṇam iha gṛhyate
nahi ātmā cicchakteḥ sahakārikāraṇam; tasyāḥ tato'vyatirekāt
kutaḥ ? ityāha— apariṇāmitvāt, pariṇāma rahitatvād ātmanaḥ iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
tanna nityakṣaṇikaikānte sādhye sattvādirviruddhaḥ api tu yathokta iti kāpilo manyate
nanu iti bhāvanāyām, evam uktaprakāreṇa sati tadakāraṇatve iti śeṣo bhāvaḥ prasajyeta ātmanaḥ iti sambandhaḥ
na caivam, ataḥ tasya sattvamicchatā pariṇāmitvamabhyupagantavyamiti kathaṃ nidarśanā'siddhiriti bhāvaḥ
bhavatu tarhi tacchakteḥ kāraṇam ātmeti cet; atrāha--buddhya ityādi
buddhyadhyavasite cicchaktiḥ puṃsaḥ svata eva cet
cetanasya vaiśvarūpyādeḥ pariṇāmaḥ siddhaḥ, sukhādivyatirekeṇa caitanyavṛtteranupalabdheḥ
tataḥ darśanaśaktiḥ kāryanirapekṣā buddhyadhyavasāyavat yataḥ buddhyadhyavasitamarthaṃ puruṣaścetayate
ubhayayoḥ vaiśyarūpyādeḥ saṃbhavāt kutaḥ apariṇāminī cicchaktiḥ buddhivivartamanuvidhatte ?

buddhyadhyavasiteindriyāṇi artham ālocayanti ityādikayā praṇālikayā gṛhītākāravastūni puṃsaḥ cicchaktiḥ taddarśanasāmarthyaṃ svata eva na parataḥ vṛttayaḥ ityanena labdhaikavacanapariṇāmena sambandhād vṛttiḥ pariṇāmaḥ, tathā syuḥ ityanenāpi jātaikavacanapariṇāmena sambandhāt syāt iti bhavati
jñānam ādiryeṣāṃ sukhādīnāṃ te tathoktāḥ kathaṃ na syuḥ syureva cetanasyaiva puruṣasyaiva vṛttayaḥ pariṇāmāḥ
evaṃ manyante yathā jñānādibhedānāṃ vaiśvarūpyādayo naikakāraṇapūrvakā itarathā śarīrādivat puruṣāṇāmapi pariṇāmināṃ kiñcid aparamekaṃ kāraṇaṃ syāt iti va sāṃkhyadarśanam tathā ghaṭādibhedānāmapi iti
indriyāṇi arthamālocayanti buddhiravadhārayati manaḥ saṃkalpate ātmā cetayate iti
evaṃ buddhyahaṅkāramanaścakṣuṣāṃ kramaśo vṛttirdṛṣṭā--cakṣū rūpaṃ paśyati manaḥ saṃkalpayati ahaṅkāro'bhimānayati buddhiradhyavasyati
etadapi kutaḥ ? ityāha--sukhādivyatirekeṇa caitanyavṛtteḥ caitanyapariṇāmasya anupalabdheḥ, sukhādyātmakatvena tattadvṛtteḥ upalabdheśca iti bhāvaḥ
prakṛtamupasaṃharannāha--tataḥ anantarāt nyāyāt na darśanaśakte bhūtāna ityāha--kārya ityādi
buddheḥ adhyavasāyaḥ svaparanirṇayaḥ sa iva tadvat
yathā tadadhyavasāyo na kāryatvanirapekṣaḥ tathā tacchaktirapi, yataḥ tacchakteḥ kāryatvanirapekṣatvād buddhyadhyavasitamartha nityaḥ pumān, cetayati paśyati
yata iti vā ākṣepe, tadabhāvāt naiva cetayate
tanna yuktam--na prakṛtirna vikṛtiḥ puruṣaḥ sāṃkhyakā॰ 22 iti
nanu yadi nāma buddhyadhyavasāyaḥ kāryatvanirapekṣe nāsti tacchakteḥ kimāyātaṃ yena sāpi tasya ? nahi ekasya dharmo'viśeṣeṇa anyasya iti cet; atrāha--vaiśva ityādi
kasya sambandhinaḥ ? ityāha--ubhayayoḥ caitanyaśakti-buddhyadhyavasāyayoḥ bhedānāmapi iti buddhyadhyavasitamarthaṃ nitya ścetayate

iti ca bruvāṇena buddhivat puruṣo'pi viṣayākāro'bhyupagantavyaḥ, anyathā buddhipratibandhabāhyamartham anākāro'pi paśyet iti kiṃ buddhikalpanayā ? atheṣyate so'pi tadākāraḥ; tatrāha--kutaḥ na kutaścinnyāyāt buddhivivarttaḥ buddheḥ arthākāraṃ pariṇāmam anuvidhatte anukaroti
idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam--kutaḥ kāraṇāt sā apariṇāminī api iti, apiśabdo'tra draṣṭavyaḥ
tadvivarttam anuvidhatte yadi svataḥ arthamapi tata eva anuvidhatte iti anantatadvivarttena arthe tadantarānavasthā syāditi manyate
tathā idamaparam--cicchakti rapariṇāminī sadaikarūpā buddhervivarttaṃ yugapat kramabhāvyanekanīlādisukhādipratibimbapariṇāmaṃ kutaḥ anuvidhatte ? naikatvena tatsamā nānaiva bhaved virodhāt
tathāhi--yadi sarvadā ekarūpā; tarhi na buddhivivarttānukāriṇī
na ca viṣayanānātvavad viṣayiṇaḥ tadgrahaṇaśaktinānātvamantareṇa tadgrahaṇaṃ yuktam, ekaikasvabhāvasya anekakāryakaraṇavat
tadevaṃ jñānādayaścet tasyaiva vṛttayaḥ iti prasādhite yallabdhaṃ taddarśayannāha-- jñānam ityādi
jñānaṃ jīvasya vā mithyā anekaṃ vetyanātmakam || 21
vṛttiracetanasya jñānaṃ cetanasyopalabdhiriti svayaṃkḷptāṃ bhedakalpanāṃ prāha viśeṣānupalabdheḥ atiprasaṅgācca
tathā paro dravyasya svataścaitanyavikalasya vyatirekiṇaṃ guṇamāha sambandhāt
tathā punaścaitanyasya mūrtasya itarasya jñānamanātmakamiti ca mithyādarśanāni
jñānādigrahaṇam upalakṣaṇaṃ sukhādeḥ, tena jñānādikaṃ vṛttiḥ ajīvasya acetanasya pradhānasya
kiṃbhūtasya ? mūrttasya rūpādimata iti yajjñānaṃ tat mithyā yathoktanyāyavacanāt
vakṣyamāṇako vā śabda ivārthaḥ atrāpi sambandhanīyaḥ
mūrttasya ityetad viśeṣaṇam asaṃbhavāt, pareṇa tathāvidhasyāpi ātmanaḥ amūrttatvena upagamāt, atra nābhisambadhyate, jñānaṃ vṛttiḥ iti
na vidyate ātmā yasya tad anātmakam jñānam iti jñānaṃ yathā mithyā tathā jīvasya vyatirekiṇo jñānaṃ vṛttiḥ iti jñānaṃ mithyā iti
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā anyātmakaṃ jñānam anāśrayaṃ na kasyacid guṇaḥ tathā vyatirekiṇo'pi na guṇaḥ syād atiprasaṅgāt
atha ātmana eva guṇaḥ tatra samavāyāt; na; samavāyasya aviśeṣe tadaviśeṣāt, pramāṇabhāvena asattvācca
tata utpatteḥ tasya tadguṇatve; uttarottaraṃ jñānaṃ pūrvapūrvasya kṣaṇikajñānasya guṇa iti tato'nyasya guṇinaḥ sādhanamanavasarameva

yathaiva ca kṣaṇikasya svasattāsamaye kāryaṃ kurvataḥ kāraṇatvaṃ durupapādam, hetuphalayoḥ sahabhāvāpatteḥ, tathā a kṣaṇikasyāpi kāryakālaviśeṣaṇāt tadrūpāt pūrvottaratadrūpayoḥ sarvathā a vyatireke, tāvanmātratvāttasya iti
yathaiva vā svasattāsamaye tasya tatkurvataḥ tad durupapādam kāryakāle svayamabhāvāt tathā itarasyāpi pūrvakālaviśeṣaṇād rūpād uttarasya sarvathā abhedāt, itarathā ekameva na kiñcit syāt
kiñca, na parātmano yugapadanekadeśakālavyāptiḥ, niraṃśatvād anātmakacittavad iti
kim ? jñānam, cetanasya puruṣasya upalabdhiḥ darśanaṃ vṛttiḥ ityevaṃ svayam ātmanā na pramāṇena prakḷptām aparicitāṃ bhedakalpanāṃ prāha sāṃkhyaḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha— viśeṣasya jñānopalabdhyoḥ bhedasya anupalabdheḥ
nanu ayamanaikāntiko hetuḥ ayogolaka-pāvakayoḥ viśeṣānupalambhe'pi bhedāditi cet; atrāha--atiprasaṅgāt puruṣacaitanyayorapi bhedaprasaṅgāt
śakyaṃ vaktuṃ puṃsaḥ anyadeva caitanyam, saṃsargād ayogolakavahnibhedābhāvavadabhedādhyavasāyaḥ
atiprasaṅgādeva svayaṃ prakḷptāṃ bhedakalpanāṃ prāha iti
na ca pariṇāmavādinaṃ prati dṛṣṭāntaḥ siddho'sti; ayogolakasya tathāpariṇāmāt
yena svamavāṣikā prakāreṇa sāṃkhyo buddhicaitanyayorbhedamāha tathā paro yaugo dravyasya iti
sāmānyavacane'pi prastāvād ātmanaḥ iti gamyate svataḥ svarūpeṇa caitanyavikalasya acetanasya vyatirekiṇam arthāntarabhūtaṃ guṇamāha
kutaḥ ? ityāha-- sambandhāt samavāyāt, tathā ca buddhivat caitanyamapi na puruṣasya rūpam, iti na yuktametat— caitanyaṃ puruṣasya svarūpam yogabhā॰ 1
sa āha--kimucyate tathā iti; yāvatā pramāṇabalena ahaṃ sarvametat kathayāmi iti
tatrāha--vidyamāne'pi satyapi sambandhi dravyacaitanyayoḥ atyantabhinnayoḥ samavāyarūpe, apiśabdaḥ saṃbhāvanāyām bhāvataḥ pramāṇābhāvena tadabhāvāt
bahirantaśca jātyantarapratibhāse iha avayave avayavī ityādi pratyayābhāve dharmiṇo virahāt tadviṣayānumānāvṛtteḥ iti
katham ajñe cetanaḥ sattātmā cetano nāma ? naiva
kuto na syāt ? ityāha--atiprasaṅgāt gaganādirapi tataḥ cetanaḥ syāditi buddhyāderviśeṣaguṇatvaṃ navadravyāṇi iti ca dravyasaṃkhyā vihanyate, tatsambandhasya sarvagatatvena tatrāpyaviśeṣāt
atha sambandhasya aviśeṣe sambandhinorviśeṣa iṣyate; na; sambandhavaiphalyaprasaṅgāt
yayaiva pratyāsattyā tadaviśeṣe'pi tadviśeṣeṣṭiḥ tayaiva asya ayam iti vyapadeśaniyamabhāvāt
kiṃca, yadi ātmanyeva caitanyamupalabhyeta; yuktametat, na caivaṃ tadātmano'nupalabdhiḥ
tathāpi tatra tatkalpane anyatrāpi tadastu aviśeṣāditi

yadi vā, arthaśabdo'yaṃ ghaṭādiviṣayavācī, tasmādanyaḥ tadvat svato bhinnajñānagrāhyatvaṃ gataḥ tadantaraṃ viṣayāntaraṃ tasmāt svayam ajñaḥ san kathaṃ cetano nāma ? kutaḥ ? ityāha--atiprasaṅgāt prayatnādisambandhe'pi cetanaḥ syāt
atha arthagrahaṇātmakatvāj jñānasya, tatsambandhādeva cetanaḥ netarasambandhāt tasya viparyayarūpatvāt; tasya svagrahaṇābhāve arthagrahaṇamapi durlabhaṃ ghaṭādivadityuktaprāyamiti
atiprasaṅgaṃ punarapi sāṃkhyasya darśayannāha--tathā punaḥ ityādi
tathā tena sāṃkhyakalpanāprakāreṇa punaḥ sāṃkhyādikalpanāyāḥ paścāt caitanyasya mūrttasya pṛthivyādicatuṣṭayasya jñānam anena pau raṃnda raṃ mataṃ darśitam
athavā puruṣa eva idaṃ sarvam ṛk॰ 10
yadi vā, svadarśanam, atra mūrttasya iti na sambandhanīyaṃ jainacetanasya amūrttatbhaṃ kādācitkamatra anupayogīti na vaktavyam
itarasya acetanasya vā bhūmyādeḥ mūrttasya, anena a vi ddha ka rṇa sya samayo darśitaḥ
jñānagrahaṇe anuvarttamāne punaḥ jñānagrahaṇaṃ tadvyavahitamiti sannihitasambandhārtham anātmakam ātmaśūnyaṃ jñānam ityetadatrāpi sambandhanīyam
ca iti samuccaye iti ca evaṃ sati mithyādarśanāni ekāntavādisaṃbandhanīti śeṣaḥ
uktānāmapi yaugādimatānāṃ kāpilamatānantaraṃ punaḥ pradarśanaṃ tatra atiprasaṅgapratipādanārtham
nanu yaduktamatraiva prastāve prathamakārikāyām mithyājñānaṃ svataḥ sato jñātuḥ āvaraṇodbhūteḥ ityādi; tadayuktam; amūrttasya ātmano muktasyeva mūrttena āvaraṇābhimatena sambandhā'bhāvāt
jīvasya mūrtiṃ kalpayitvāpi karmabandhanimittaṃ svadoṣāntaraṃ kalpitavyaṃ māṇikyādivat
tataḥ punaramūrtasya cetanasya naisargikā mithyādarśanādayo bandhahetavaḥ
kathaṃ na kathañcit punaḥ amūrttasya karmaṇā mūrttena sambandhaḥ
nanu mūrttena ityatra na śrūyate tat kathaṃ labhyamiti cet ? amūrttasya iti vacanāt
yadi karmā'pi amūrttaṃ syāt tadvacanamanarthakaṃ syāt, amūrttayoḥ sambandhā'virodhāt
na ca mūrttā'mūrttayoḥ viruddhaḥ saṃyoga iti; ataḥ prastutatvādvā
nanvetat parasparavilakṣaṇāvapi ityādinā granthena pratipāditam, śubhaiḥ ityādinā ca tadbandhakāraṇam, tat kimarthaṃ punarapyucyate iti cet ? tasyaiva prakārāntareṇa samarthanārtham

tathāhi--manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ ityādi na kaścid vipratipattumarhati iti paryantavacane'pi pañcaskandhavat ityādikamullaṅghaghya kaścid vadati mūrttā eva hemādayaḥ mūrtaiḥ śyāmādikābhiḥ sambandhya mānā dṛṣṭā iti mūrttireva bandhakāraṇam, atmani tadabhāvānna tadbandhaḥ iti; taṃ prati ucyate--malaiḥ ityādi
na caivam, anyathāpi tasya darśanāditi manyate
svasya svo vā doṣaḥ duṣṭākaraprabhavatvādilakṣaṇaḥ tena tato badhyeta māṇikyādiḥ iti vā anuvarttate
evamanvayaḥ--sadoṣo māṇikyādiḥ sambadhyate maṇaiḥ netaraḥ, tathaiva tasya svābhāvyāt tathā darśanāditi
luptaḥ api śabdaḥ atra draṣṭavyaḥ tato jīvo'pi na kevale māṇikyādireva
malaiḥ karmabhiḥ nisargāt svabhāvataḥ svadoṣataḥ ātmīyena mithyātvādidoṣeṇa
jīvasya mūrttiṃ kalpayitvāpi karmabandhanimittaṃ svadoṣāntaraṃ bhāvakarmalakṣaṇaṃ kalpitavyam māṇikyāderiva tadvad iti
tataḥ tasmānnyāyāt punaḥ amūrttasya naisargikā bandhahetavaḥ
nanu kimamūrttasya mūrttena karmaṇā sambandhakalpanayā, yāvatā a mūrttenāpi tena tadguṇādisamavāye na kaścid doṣaḥ
taduktam--ātmaviśeṣaguṇaḥ kartṛphaladāyī kāryavirodhī saṃyogajo'dṛṣṭo dharmo'pi vyākhyātaḥ iti cet; atrāha--jātyā ityādi
dharmaḥ puruṣaguṇaḥ kartuḥ priyahitamokṣahetuḥ atīndriyo'ntyasukhasaṃvijñānavirodhī puruṣāntaḥkaraṇasaṃyogaviśuddhābhisandhijaḥ...--praśa॰ bhā॰ pṛ॰ 138
jātyā vyatiriktayā'rthāḥ syuranyā jātiḥ svataḥ satī
jātyā iti sāmānyavacane'pi syuḥ iti vacanāt sattā parigṛhyate
kiṃ tayā ? ityāha--artho dravyaguṇakarmāṇi dravyaguṇakarmasu arthaḥ vaiśe॰ sū॰ 8
nahi svayamatadrūpam anyena tad bhavati, anyathā rūpādinā rādanā dikaṃ tadvat syāt
tathāvidhayā jātyā arthānāṃ samavāyasambandho'pi atraiva vṛtte nirākariṣyate
kiñca, jātirapi yadyasatī; kathaṃ tayā kiñcidasat sat syāt ? nahi--bandhyāsuto gaganakusumamālayā sannāma
svato yadi; tatrāha paraḥ— arthebhyaḥ anyā jātiḥ sattāsāmānyaṃ svata ātmanā syāt satī bhavet kim ityanena syāt ityanena vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ
arthā api tathaiva svayaṃ syuḥ iti manyate
tadanena dravyaguṇayoḥ abhāvāt ātmaviśeṣaguṇo dharmādiḥ iti nirastam, guṇakarmaṇorabhāvāt ātmamanaḥsaṃyogajaḥ iti ca
athavā, devadattaṃ prati upasarpatāṃ paśvādīnāṃ parābhyupagamena karmā'bhāvāt tato dharmādyanumānamanupapannamiti darśayati
devadattaviśeṣaguṇapreritabhūtakāryyāḥ tadupagṛhītāśca śarīrādayaḥ kāryatve sati tadupabhogasādhanatvāt gṛhavaditi...--praśa॰ kiraṇā॰ pṛ॰ 149
bhavantu vā yathākathañcit parasya arthāḥ, tathāpi doṣaṃ darśayannāha--arthāntaraiḥ dravyādatyantaṃ bhinnaiḥ dravyaṃ pṛthivyādi syād bhaved dhavalaṃ saṅkhyeyādi gantrādikam
guṇaiḥ rūpādibhiḥ karmabhiḥ gamanādibhiḥ yāthāsaṅkhyena guṇaiḥ dhavala saṅkhyeyādi karmabhiḥ gantrādikam
kim ityetad atrāpi sambandhanīyam, anyathā ātmādikamapi syāt aviśeṣāt
kārakāṇi kartrādīni guṇino dravyāṇi sarvairguṇairvā vinā syuḥ ityanena gatena sambandhaḥ, parasparānāpannā eva syuḥ iti manyate

nanu nāyaṃ doṣaḥ jātitadvatorguṇaguṇinoḥ karmatadvatoḥ bhede'pi sa samavāyavṛttyā jātyādīnāṃ tadvati varttanāditi cet; atrāha--samavāyena samavāya eva ca avṛtti kim ? naiva vṛttiḥ, kutsitā vā vṛttiḥ iti, yataḥ samavāyasya samavāyiṣu vṛttau iha samavāyo varttate iti pratyayaḥ sambandhāntaranibandhanaḥ syāt, punarapi tadantaranibandhana ityanavasthā, anyathā tantuṣu paṭaḥ ityādipratyayo'pyanenaiva vyabhicārāt na samavāyasādhakaḥ syāt
teṣu tadavṛttau vā na kasyacit sambandho'parāyattatvād ākāśavat
ata eva ihapratyayakartṛtvamapi tasya tadvadeva duranvayam, itarathā saṃyoge'pi prasaṅgaḥ asambandhe'pi ityevaṃ yuktibādhitaṃ saṃkīrtyate vaiśeṣikaiḥ
anena kāryavirodhī kartṛphaladāyī iti ca nirastaṃ boddhavyam
adṛṣṭe hi svakāryaṃ kṛtvā vinaśyatīti bhāvaḥ

iti ra vi bha dra pādapaṅkajabhramara-a na nta vī rya viracitāyāṃ si ddhi vi ni śca ya ṭī kā yāṃ jīvasiddhiḥ caturtha prastāvaḥ
evam anantaraprastāvadvayena aśabdayojanaṃ smaraṇādi śrutaṃ vyākhyātam

yaduktamaḥ śabdaiḥ paramanyadyojitaṃ śrutam iti; tat saṃprati vyākhyātum avasaraprāptam, tacca parārthamiti, parapratipādanāya ca tatprayoge nyāyavādinamapi kecidekāntavādino vacanādyupālambhacchalena parājayena yojayantaḥ samupalabhyante tanniṣedhārthaṃ vādanyāyaprastāvaṃ prastuvan tadādau saṃgrahavṛttamāha— pakṣasthāpanayā ityādi
anyadvā pralapan pareṇa sa samaḥ svārthāsādhane || 1
pakṣo va kṣyamāṇalakṣaṇaḥ tasya sthāpanā samarthanaṃ tathā vādī prativādī vā nigṛhṇāti vijayate
kam ? ityāha--nirasto viṣayaḥ pakṣo yasya sa tathoktaḥ taṃ vādinaṃ prativādinam
vādī anyathā kuvot bhijñāti ityāha--na ityādi
svākūtaśabdena svapakṣaḥ parāmṛśyate tasya utsa tyāgaḥ kriyāviśeṣaṇametat, svākūtojjhā yathā bhavati tathā na nigṛhṇāti
kaiḥ kṛttvā ? ityāha-- asādhanāṅgam na sādhanāṅgam asādhanāṅgama tasya vacanam, athavā na sādhanāṅgavacanam
na doṣo'doṣaḥ tasya uktiḥ, yadi vā na doṣoktiḥ adoṣoktiḥ vidyamānasyāpi doṣasya anuccāraṇam, asādhanāṅgavacanaṃ vādoktiśca tayoḥ saṃkīrttanāni prakāśanāni tairiti
kaṃ taiḥ na nigṛhṇāti ? ityāha— svārthaṃ sādhitavantam
nanvayamarthaḥ svākūtojjham ityanena uktaḥ kimarthaṃ punarucyate ? satyam uktaḥ, tathāpi pūrvamanāśritapakṣo na nigṛhṇāti ityasya pratipādanārtham
taduktam--yato vādinā ubhayaṃ karttavyaṃ svapakṣasādhanaṃ parapakṣadūṣaṇaṃ ca iti
jācaṃ punaḥ āśritapakṣo'pi nirastaviṣayo na nigṛhṇāti asyeti viśeṣaḥ
idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam--svākūto jñānaṃ nigṛhṇāti, na ca svārthaṃ sādhitavantaṃ tatsaṃkīrtanaiḥ astaviṣayaḥ asiddhamahāmahīprāntaritaviṣayaḥ
vijigīṣuṇā ubhayaṃ karttavyaṃ svaparapakṣasādhanadūṣaṇam --aṣṭaśa॰, aṣṭasaha॰ pṛ॰ 87
asiddhaścāsau mahāmahīpaḥ mahābhūpālaḥ tena antaritaḥ ākrāntaḥ viṣayaḥ pakṣaḥ yasya asiddhapakṣa iti yāvat
nanu yadyapi svārthaṃ sādhitavantaṃ na nigṛhṇāti tarhi tūṣṇīṃbhavantaṃ nigṛhṇāti iti cet; atrāha--tūṣṇīṃbhavantam ityādi

atrādimatiprāyaḥ tūṣṇīṃbhavantaṃ kiṃ paraḥ svapakṣaṃ sādhayan nigṛhṇāti, kiṃ vā tvayā sādhanābhidhāne adhikāriṇāpi na kiñciduktam maunameva anuṣṭhitam ityaddhā svārthasiddhyanupayogi bruvan, svayaṃ tūṣṇīṃbhavan vā ? tatra prathamapakṣe uktam--pakṣasthāpanayā ityādi
dvitīya āha--tūṣṇīṃ bhavantam na iti sambandhaḥ
bruvan tūṣṇīṃbhāvam udbhāvayan, anyadvā asambaddham pralapan vā puruṣaḥ
kiṃbhūtaḥ ? pareṇa nigrāhyeṇa sama eva pūrva evakāro'tra draṣṭavyaḥ
yathaiva hi tūṣṇīṃbhavataḥ sādhanānabhidhāne na svārthasiddhiḥ tathā tadudbhāvayato'pi anyadvā bruvataḥ
tṛtīye'pyāha--sodhye tyāhadi bruvato'nyaḥ itaraḥ tūṣṇīṃbhūtaḥ, so'pi tūṣṇīṃbhavantaṃ na nigṛhṇāti
nanu vāde nigṛhṇāti ityuktam, tat ko vādaḥ ? ityatrāha--samarthavacanam ityādi
vādinaḥ tattvapratipādanasāmarthyamantareṇa yathaivonmārgaśodhanena mārgaprabhāvanā na saṃbhavati evaṃ pariṣadvalasya yathārhaṃ satyadoṣanivedanasāmarthye'sati
svayamevoddhṛtya nyāyavādinamapi vyāpāravyāhārābhyāṃ pratikṣipatāṃ darśanāt svayamauddhatyapracchādanārtham
chalajātinigrahasthānānāṃ bhedo lakṣaṇaṃ ca neha pratanyate
tataścaturaṅga eva jalpaḥ vacanasyāpi sāṃkaryyaṃ tadanyataratattvetaranirṇayāvasānameva, na punaḥ vaktrabhiprāyasūcanam
ke ? ityāha--budhāḥ vidvāṃsaḥ sa ma nta bha dra svā mi prabhṛtayaḥ

yadi tarhi teṣāṃ jalpalakṣaṇaparijñānaṃ kimiti nyāyāntaravad vādanyāyo na nirdiṣṭaḥ; tadanirdeśe ca kutaḥ tatparijñānaṃ teṣāmavagamyatām ? vacanaliṅgā hi vaktṛcetoviśeṣā asarvavidāmiti cet; ka evamāha--sa tairna nirdiṣṭaḥ iti ? yāvatā--
anvarthasaṃjñaḥ sumatiḥ munistvaṃ svayaṃ mataṃ yena suyuktinītam
ityādinā bhagavato nyāyena pratipādyajanapratibodhanaṃ stuvadbhiḥ sarvatra tadeva abhyupagatamiti jñāyate
yo hi svayamayuktamakurvan paraṃ yuktakāriṇam abhinandati sa loke abhimatayuktakāriṇaṃ tva iti avagamyate
kathaṃ punaḥ tenamestasya tassutam iti cet ? ucyate--sumatiḥ muniḥtvam anvarthasaṃjñaḥ anugatārthā'bhidhānavān
kena kāraṇena ? ityāha--yena kāraṇena tvayā iti adhyāhāraḥ, svayaṃ mataṃ svapakṣaḥ suyuktā abādhitayuktyā pramāṇātmikayā na tacchalādyātmikayā nītam arthijanaṃ prāpitaṃ sa yuktyā prabodhita ityarthaḥ
tataḥ pakṣasthāpanayā ityādi vādinā ubhayaṃ karttavyam ityabhidadhānena uktaṃ na veti parīkṣakāḥ cintayantu
yadi yuktam; kimiti taiḥ vādanyāyo noktaḥ ? teṣāmeva ca sūtrakṛtāṃ bhagavatāṃ prākṛtajanāvedyābhiprāyaḥ sūriṇā a ka la ṅke na vā rtti ka kā re ṇa saprapañcaḥ prakaṭīkriyate
athavā prastutagranthagatamūlaślokā api vārtikaśabdena ucyante, tatkartrā
atha ko vādaḥ iti praśne kimarthaṃ jalpaṃ viduḥ iti uttaramucyate vādajalpayoḥ bhedāt
praśnānurūpeṇa ca uttareṇa bhavitavyam anyathā svātpṛṣṭhaḥ ko'pi dārām ācaṣṭe iti syāt
atha tayorabhedaḥ; evamapi prakṛtānurūpaṃ vaktavyam vādaṃ viduḥ iti
ata eva vitaṇḍāpi na kathāntaram, jalpasya vādādabhede kathaṃ vitaṇḍā tadviśeṣaḥ tato bhidyeta
yadi vā vādaṃ viduḥ vāde ityetad anuvarttamānaṃ vibhaktipariṇāmena iha sambadhyate, tanna jalpād anyo vāda iti manyate
athavā kathambhūtaṃ jalpaṃ vādaṃ viduḥ ? ityāha--samarthavacanam iti
yadi vā, samarthaṃ vacanamasmin jalpe tam iti
kiṃ punaḥ vacana samartham ? yena svayamabhipreto'rthaḥ sādhyarūpaḥ sādhanarūpaḥ viruddhadūṣaṇatallakṣaṇaśca paraṃ prati pratipādyate vacanena tatsamartham iti ucyate
vacanaṃ ca yathā arthapratipādakaṃ tathā nirūpayiṣyate
tadanena trirūpaliṅgavākyameva pañcāvayavameva vākyaṃ vāda iti ekāntaṃ nirākaroti
tatra yāvatā vacanena tatpratipattiḥ tāvat samartham iti kiṃ niyamena ? tena chalajātinigrahasthānasādhanopālambho jalpaḥ nyāyasū॰ 1
nahi te svayaṃ prayuktāḥ svapakṣaṃ sādhayanti sādhanavaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt, paratra ca udbhāvitāḥ parapakṣaṃ nirākurvasya virodhāt
tatprayoge'pi samyaksādhanavādinaḥ sādhyasiddherapratibandhāt paravyāmohanārtham ekavṛttam anuṣṭeyam asārthā varaṇam
ubhayatra asiddhānaikāntikodbhāvanamapi tādṛgeva, tarthe tasmin jalpe vitaṇḍābhāvaḥ

3 iti; tatra pratipakṣasthāpanāhīnaḥ svapakṣasamarthanarahitaścet; na samarthavacana iti kuto jalpaḥ yato vitaṇḍā syāt ? atha vaitaṇḍikaḥ parapakṣadūṣaṇāya avaśyaṃ yatate tatastaddūṣaṇavacanaṃ samarthavacanam ityucyate; tadapi na sāram; yataḥ svapakṣasiddhyabhāve parapakṣā'niṣedhāt
yathāha--vitaṇḍā ātmatiraskāraḥ iti cet; ayaṃ parasyaiva doṣo'stu
yatra vijigīṣuḥ vijigīṣuṇā saha lābhapūjākhyātikāmaḥ jayaparājayārthaṃ pravartate sā vijigīṣukathā
yadi mataṃ samarthavacanasya jalpatve vyākhyānādiṣu atiprasaṅga iti; tatrāha--caturaṅgam iti
yadi vā, kathaṃ jalpa eva vādaḥ tayorviṣayabhedād, vijigīṣuviṣayaḥ jalpo na vādaḥ asya śiṣṭādiviṣayatvāt iti; tatrāha--caturaṅgam iti
tatra vādo nāma yat paraspareṇa saha śāstrapūrvaṃ vigṛhya kathayati
sa vādo dvividhaḥ saṃgraheṇa jalpo vitaṇḍā ca
yatra vītarāgo vītarāgeṇaiva saha tattvanirṇayārthaṃ sādhanopālambhau karoti sā vītarāgakathā vādasaṃjñayā ucyate
vādo nāma vītarāgayoḥ pakṣapratipakṣaparigrahapūrvakaḥ pramāṇatarkapūrvakasādhanopālambhaprayoge kriyamāṇe ekapakṣanirṇayāvasāno vākyasamūhaḥ
dvitīye tu vyākhyāne aṅgaśabdo avayavavācī saṃbhavati, caturaṅga samarthaṃvacanaṃ jalpaṃ vādaṃ viduḥ iti
vādiprativādivacanāt na vyākhyānādiṣu samarthavacanaṃ jalpa iti darśayati tatra tadabhāvāt
sabhā sabhāpativacanāt tasya vijigīṣuviṣayatām anyathā vyākhyānādivat tatparigrahavaiphalyam
etāvadeva ca vādasyāpi nigrahavato rūpamiti kathaṃ tayoḥ viṣayabheda iti ?
etena ekasya vādiprativādibhedakalpane'pi na tadvacanaṃ jalpa ityuktaṃ bhavati
yadi tadvacanaṃ jalpaḥ tadanavasānam tanniyamakāraṇasya asādhanādiḥ avacanāditi cet; atrāha— pakṣanirṇayaparyantam iti
pakṣasya vivādagocarārthasya nirṇayaḥ vipratipattiparihāreṇa avasthānaṃ paryanto yasya sa tathoktaḥ tam iti na vādiprativādiguṇadoṣasaṃkīrtanaparyantamiti bhāvaḥ

nanu yadi vādisambandhipakṣanirṇayaparyantam iti gṛhyate jalpāpravṛttiḥ, pūrvameva tannirṇaya bhāvāt, svaniścayavad anyasya niścayotpādanāya taddhetuprayogāt, itarathā gopālavat kutastasya jalpe vikāraḥ
etena prāśnikatannirṇayaparyantamiti cintitam siddhāntadvayavedinaḥ iti vacanāt nirjñātobhayapakṣāṇāmeva prāśnikatvāt
pārthivaḥ punaḥ pārthiva iva na sarvaḥ svayaṃ tannirṇayavān tannirṇayaparyantam iti ca duravagāham
nāpi prativāditannirṇayaparyantam ityupapannam; svadurāgamāhitadṛḍhavibhramasya prativādinaḥ pratipadya mānasyāpi tannirṇayayogāt

tanna yuktaṃ pakṣanirṇayaparyantam iti cet; na sundarametat; yataḥ sādhyāvinābhāvisādhanaprayogopanyāsād apahāya prarūḍhamapi vyāmohaṃ prativādinaḥ parapakṣaṃ pratiyantaḥ pratīyante abhimānino'pi, āturā iva paramauṣadham

ye'pi ca kecinna pratiyanti khalamatayaḥ tadapekṣayā tadupanyāsajanitaḥ satyanirṇayo jñātobhayakṛtāntānām anyavacanāt pratipattiḥ jāyate, itarathā janmanasi vādītaraguṇadoṣapratipattiviśvavaidhuryāt kuto nikaṣopalambhasamā natvaṃ yatastadapekṣā syāditi
kiṃ punarasya phalam ? ityāha--phalaṃ jalpasya ityanuvarttate

nanu tattvasya ātmādeḥ adhyavasāyaḥ kutaścit svayaṃ nirṇayaḥ tasya dasyubhyaḥ saugatādibhyaḥ saṃrakṣaṇaṃ tatphalamastu tattvādhyavasāyasaṃrakṣaṇārthaṃ jalpavitaṇḍe bījaprarohasaṃrakṣaṇārthaṃ kaṇṭakaśākhāvaraṇavat nyāyasū॰ 4
50 iti vacanāditi cet; yadi pramāṇataḥ tatsarakṣaṇam; anukūlamācarasi pramāṇaviṣaye pravṛtteḥ, tata eva tatprakāśanasya avaśyaṃbhāvāt
dasyavo'pi yadi pramāṇataḥ tannirākurvanti na chalādicacanādapramāṇakāt tasya trāṇaṃ prāśnikāḥ pakṣapātarahitāḥ tattvavedino manyate
yadi sapramāṇakāt; svata eva tadrakṣitam, kiṃ tatra chalādiprayāsena ? daivaraktā hi hiṃsakāḥ kiṃśukāḥ kena rajyante nāma
nanu ca vādinā prativādī sabhyāśca pratipādanīyāḥ na sabhāpatiḥ sukumāraprajñaḥ, tataḥ kiṃ tena iti tryaṅgaṃ jalpaṃ viduḥ ityevāstu iti cet atrāha--vādi ityādi

vādinaḥ prativādiprāśnikayoḥ tattvapratipādanasāmarthyam upalakṣaṇametat tena prativādiprāśnikayoḥ tattvapratipādanasāmarthyam ityapi gṛhyate tadantareṇa yathaiva yenaiva pratipādyapratītyoḥ abhāvaprakāreṇa unmārgasya ekāntasya śodhanena apasāraṇena mārgaprabhāvanā na saṃbhavati vakṣyamāṇavidhinā

evaṃ pariṣadvalasya rājñaḥ yathārhaṃ yathāyogyaṃ satye, rājñe vādiprativādinaṃ doṣanivedane sati tena evaṃ tvayā sthātavyam, tvayā evaṃ sabhyaiśca yathāvṛttameva asmi nivedanīyam ityalaṅgha nīyamājñāpanaṃ karttavyam, tatra sāmarthye'sati punarna syāt tacchodhanena tatprabhāvanā iti
nyāyavādinamapi nyāyaṃ vadati ityevaṃśīlaguṇamapi vādinaṃ prativādinaṃ pratikṣipatāṃ darśanāt
kimartham ? ityāha--svayam ātmanā vā addhatya pracchādanārtham
nanu sabhyāḥ tannivārakāḥ, tān ullaṅghayantaṃ kṣipatāṃ darśanāt iti manyate
nyāyaśāstrameva tarhi niyāmakamiti cet; atrāha--chala ityādi
19 eṣāṃ bhedo lakṣaṇaṃ ca neha pratanyate vistarabhayād anyatraiva tada draṣṭavyam iti kecit taiḥ sādhanam upālambhaśca yasmin sa tathoktaḥ
ko'sau ? ityāha--jalpa ityevam vādāt pṛthageva jalpasya kaiścit naiyā yikādibhiḥ lakṣaṇāt, tābhyāṃ taṃ pratipakṣipatāṃ darśanād iti sambandhaḥ

tathāhi--āḍhyo'yaṃ navakambalavattvat ityukte sa prativādī udbhāvayati mā asya nava kambalāḥ kintu ekaḥ ityasiddho heturiti; tatredaṃ cintyate--kiṃ samyak sādhanaprayoge puraḥ sa e tadudbhāvane prativādinaḥ parājayaḥ, viparīte vā ? tatrādyapakṣe svapakṣasiddhyaiva vādī prativādinaṃ vijayate kimanyena ? yadi punaḥ dvirbaddhaṃ subaddhaṃ bhavati iti tadudbhāvanenāpi; tadasatyam; yuktyā nigṛhīte tadvaiphalyāt, viṣopayogamṛte sattomahi tadvyāpādanāya svalpacapeṭādikaṃ yuñjate
kathañcaivaṃ hetvantaraṃ nigrahasthānaṃ na dūṣaṇāntarodbhāvanam iti vibhāgaḥ, yato vādino yugapat jayaparājayau na syātām ? tasmāt navakambalatvādi tihetvarthasya vivakṣitatvāt nāyamasiddho hetuḥ

prakaraṇādi bhiśca anekārtheṣu śabdeṣu niyatārthasaṃpratyayaḥ karttavyaḥ, anyathā sarvaśabdānāmanekārthatvāt sarvo'pi evaṃ hetvādiḥ duṣṭaḥ syāt nāstyatra sītasyaso dhūmaketoḥ--śikhinaḥ ityādi prayo ge'pi tadudbhāvanasaṃbhavāditi
evamasau nivāraṇīyo na tāvatā nigrahaṇīyaḥ, samīcīnasādhanaprayogavaiphalyam anyathā syāditi
kiṃ punarevaṃvādinā tadudbhāvanaṃ na karttavyam ? na nigrahabuddhyā prakṛtadoṣāt api tu nivāraṇabuddhyā iti brūmaḥ
anudbhāvane ko doṣaḥ ? na kaścit, yadi hetuṃ samarthayate

nigrahaḥ ityapare; tadasāmpratam; yataḥ prativādiprayuktachalānudbhāvanaṃ vādinaḥ parājayādhikaraṇaṃ yadi sa eva mayā prayuktaṃ chalaṃ kṛpayā nodbhāvitamiti paryanuyojyopekṣaṇāt nigṛhīto'si iti vyavasthāpayet; tarhi tasyaiva tadudbhāvane svayaṃ svadoṣodbhāvanāt
asti vā svabhāvatadudbhāvanāvasthayoḥ viśeṣaḥ ? dṛśyante hi svayam udbhāvitenāpi doṣeṇa nigṛhyamāṇāḥ cauraprabhṛtayaḥ
ko hi svaṃ kaupīnaṃ vivṛṇuyāt iti vacanāt svayaṃ tadudbhāvanāyogācca
atha sabhyāḥ; te tarhi yathā tadanudbhāvanaṃ tasya parājayaṃ vyavasthāpayati tathā samīcīnasādhanavacanaṃ jayamapi vyavasthāpayantu
saha jayetarau syātāmiti cet; jālpikasyaiva ayaṃ doṣo'paro'stu
atha tadanudbhāvanadoṣaiḥ na sādhanasamīcīnatā syāt, sa doṣo'pi mā bhūt; aho madhyasthāḥ prāśnikāḥ yadalpadoṣeṇa mahāguṇamapi sādhanamasamīcīnaṃ manyante, na punaḥ tadguṇena alpadoṣam adoṣam iti
tanna ādyapakṣe samīcīnasādhanaprayogapurassare chalodbhāvane vādī paraṃ vijayata iti
tulanā--tattvarakṣaṇārthaṃ sadbhirupahartta vyameva chalādi vijigīṣubhiriti cet; nakhacapeṭaśastraprahārādīpanādibhirapi iti vaktavyam
tatrāyaṃ chalavādī vakturabhiprāyādavivakṣita manyārtham--nava kambalā asyeti tāvadabhihitaṃ bhavatā iti kalpayati
kalpayitvā cāsaṃbhavena pratiṣedhati eko'sya kambalaḥ kuto nava kambalāḥ iti ? tadidaṃ sāmānyaśabde vāci chalaṃ vākchalamiti
agneḥ ityasyārthe śikhinaḥ iti prayoge kriyamāṇe kaścit śikhiśabdaṃ mayūrārthakaṃ mattvā dūṣayet
tulanā--etacca kasya parājaya ityanuyuktayā pariṣadā vacanīyam, na khalu nigrahaṃ prāptaḥ svakaupīnaṃ vivṛṇuyāditi
nāpi dvitīye, dvayoḥ samatvāt kasya vijayaḥ ? aparasyāpi parājayo vā syāt ? yathaiva prativādinaḥ chalaprayogo doṣaḥ tathā vādinaḥ sādhanābhāsaprayogaḥ
vadi prativādī tadudbhāvayet tathaiva, anyathā sa eva parājayavān syāt yadi vādī jayavān na cet, tayoḥ parasparāpekṣatvāt
bhavati iti cet; tatra prativādinaḥ paryanuyojyopekṣaṇamanudbhāvyate; tarhi so'pi vā no doṣamanudbhāvya jayati iti punarapi sakṛt jayetarau
yadi udbhāvya; vādī eva jīyate ityuktaṃ svadoṣa prakāśanāt
atha prāśnikāḥ vādidoṣānudbhāvanaṃ prativādino nigrahaṃ kalpayanti; te eva vādinaḥ sādhanābhāsavacanena prativādinaḥ chalavacanena iti tadavasthā yugapad dvayorjayetaravyavasthā

atha tayoḥ parasparadoṣodbhāvanaṃ pratīkṣya jayetaravyavasthāṃ te viracayanti; tadanudbhāvane kā vārttā ? tayoḥ sāmyena vyavasthāpanamiti cet; kuta etat ? anyatarasyāpi pakṣā'siddheriti cet; tadudbhāvane'pi tadeva astu viśeṣā'bhāvāt, anyo'nyadoṣodbhāvanaviśeṣabhāve'pi prakṛtatattvā'parisamāpteḥ

kiñca, sādhanābhāvavādinā parasyachale samudbhāvite kiṃ tasya tadvādinā naṣṭā yena jayaṃ vyavasthāpayanti ? tadudbhāvanena tirodhānānuṣṭhā iti cet; tadudbhāvanamapi sādhanadoṣesa tirodhānānnaṣṭamiva kinna syāt ? evametat, sa doṣo yadi prativādinodbhāyotān bhāvane kiṃ syāt prativādinaḥ ? sato'pi doṣasyā'nudbhāvanaṃ nigraha iti cet; tasya taddayāṃ prasaktam tanna vā, anyataraṃ doṣamudbhāvya vādino jayamicchataḥ aṃśena paryanuyojyopekṣaṇaprasaktiḥ
nanu yadā chalavādī doṣamudbhāvayati tadā kā gatiḥ ? sakṛjjayetaraprāptiḥ
yadi vādī chalamudbhāvayediti cet; tathā vādino'pi tatprāptiprakāśane'pi tasya doṣadvayamāyātam, chalāprakāśaṃ sādhanābhāsavacanaṃ ca
etena pūrvapakṣavādī chalaṃ vadan pareṇa jīyate iti mataṃ cintitam, prakṛtavikalpadvaye tathaiva doṣāt
