nanu chalaṃ trividham--vākchalam, sāmānyachalam, upacārachalaṃ ceti
tatra ādyasya vyākhyānam--svatram aviśeṣābhihite'rthe vakturabhiprāyād arthāntarakalpanā vākchalam nyāyasū॰ 1

12 asyāyamarthaḥ--aviśeṣeṇa pratyagra-saṃkhyāviśeṣavācisāmānyaśabdena abhihite'rthe navakambalatvāt iti hetoḥ vakturabhiprāyāt tadā ukta pratyagrakambalāptadi arthāntarasya navasaṃkhyopetārthasya kalpanā vākchalam
yathā hi eṣaḥ navakambalatvāt ityukte kuto'sya ekakambalasya nava kambalāḥ iti vacanam
23 saṃbhavataḥ śrūyamāṇasya arthasya atisāmānyayogāt anaikāntikasāmānyayogād asadbhūtārthakalpanā tasya anekasya sāmānyasya ahetoḥ hetutvakalpanā tayā vacana vyākhyātaḥ sa no chalam
yathā brāhmaṇo'yaṃ vidyācaraṇasampannaḥ ityukte kaścidāha--saṃbhavati brāhmaṇe vidyācaraṇasampad iti tatstutiḥ
tatrāparaḥ prāha--yadi brāhmaṇatvaṃ tatsampado hetuḥ jñāpakaḥ kārako vā'sya; brāto'pi dvijaḥ tatsampannaḥ syāditi
yathā mañcāḥ krośanti ityukte na mañcāḥ krośanti kintu tadgatāḥ puruṣāḥ iti
tadetat trividhamapi chalaṃ chalamātram na nigrahāya uktavat
kā punariyaṃ jātiḥ ? sādharmyavaidharmyābhyāṃ pratyavasthānaṃ jātiḥ nyāyasū॰ 1
18 tatra pratyavasthānaṃ jātiḥ iti jāteḥ sāmānyalakṣaṇam
prakṣaṇaṃ pratyavasthānam pratyavasthānamātraṃ pratiṣedhābhāsa ityeke; tadasatyam; pratyavasthānaśabdasya uttarasāmānyavacanasya tadābhāse asatyarthādau vṛttivirodhāt

yatpunaratrodāharaṇamuktam--anityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtakatvāt ghaṭādivat ityukte vaiśeṣikeṇa; kaścidāha--yathā ghaṭe'nityatve sati kṛtakatvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tathā ākāśaguṇatvābhāve'pi, tata idamapi prasaktam--na ākāśaguṇaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtakatvāt ghaṭavat iti; pratyavasthānamātrametat; katham ? aprastutākāratvānāguṇatvabādhanepi atinya tvābādhanāt
tanna vaiśeṣikasya subhāṣitam āgamabādhane sarvatra āgamaḥ pratijñā nyāyabhā॰ 1
na ca vibhāgena tadāgamatvam; anyatrāpi anāśvāsāpatteḥ
anena pūrvahetorvyāpterakhaṇḍanāt tanmātram ityapare; teṣāmakhaṇḍitaprāptikā prakṛtasādhanasamarthāt prā ktanādeva hetoḥ jayetaravyavasthānāt nedaṃ nigrahasthānam, itarathā tadvaiphalyam
kathaṃ vā anena tadvyāpteḥ akhaṇḍanam, yāvatā ghaṭādau ākāśaguṇatvābhāvasahacaritasya kṛtakatvasya vacane'pi yadi tetena tadvyāptiḥ anityatvenāpi na syāt ityevaṃ tatra prativādinaḥ abhiprāyāt

yatpunaruktam--ākāśā'pratipattau aprasiddhaviśeṣaṇaḥ pakṣaḥ, śabdaguṇāt tatpratipattau na tatpratiṣedha iti ākāśaguṇatvābhāvena na kṛtakatvasya vyāptiḥ iti na pūrvasamānatā iti; tanna yuktam; yataḥ ākāśasya pratipattāvapi na śabdāt pratipattiḥ iti nirūpayiṣyate, tato yatkiñcidetat
sādharmyeṇokte hetau pratyavasthānaṃ darśayati bhāṣyakāraḥ--udāharaṇasādharmyāt sādhyasādhanaṃ hetuḥ nyāyasū॰ 1
35 iti, asya udāharaṇavaidharmyeṇa pratyavasthānaṃ jātiḥ iti śeṣaḥ
tatra udāharaṇam--kriyāvān ātmā kriyāhetuguṇayogatvāt loṣṭavat iti
atrāha paraḥ--yadi kriyāvaddravyasādharmyāt kriyāhetuguṇasambandhāt tathā ātmā sādhyate; tarhi tadravyadabhu tvād akriyatvamasyāstu viśeṣābhāvāditi
tadyathā--niṣkriya ātmā vibhutvād ākāśavat iti, atra pratyavasthānam--sakriya ātmā kriyāhetuguṇayogitvāt loṣṭavat aviśeṣāt iti
vaidharmyeṇokte hetau pratyavasthānaṃ darśayati sa eva udāharaṇavaidharmyāt sādhyasādhanaṃ hetuḥ ityasya udāharaṇasādharmyeṇa pratyavasthānaṃ jātiḥ iti śeṣaḥ

yathā na cetanāyatanaṃ tṛṇādayaḥ prāṇādirahitatvāt, yat punaḥ cetanāyatanaṃ tat prāṇādimad dṛṣṭaṃ yathā jīvaccharīram ityatra yadi jīvaccharīravaidharmyādacetanatvaṃ tarhi tatsādharmyāt mūrttatvāt tṛṇādīnāṃ cetanatvamastu viśeṣahetvabhāvāt iti
upalakṣaṇametat, tena udāharaṇavaidharmyāt sādhyasādhanaṃ hetuḥ ityasya udāharaṇavaidharmyeṇāpi pratyavasthānaṃ jātiḥ iti

tatrodāharaṇam--anityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtakatvāt, yadanityaṃ na bhavati na tat kṛtakaṃ yathā ākāśam ityukte para āha--yadi nityavaidharyāt kṛtakatvād anityaḥ śabdaḥ tarhi anityavaidharmyād asparśavattvāt nityo'stu
sādharmyeṇopasaṃhāre sādhyadharmaviparyayopapatteḥ sādharmyeṇaiva pratyavasthānamaviśiṣyamāṇaṃ sthāpanāhetutaḥ sādharmyasamaḥ pratipedhaḥ
dravyaṃ loṣṭaḥ kriyāhetuguṇayuktaḥ kriyāvān tathā cātmā tasmāt kriyāvāniti
evamupasaṃhṛte paraḥ sādharmyeṇaiva pratyavatiṣṭhate niṣkriya ātmā vibhuno dravyasya niṣkriyatvāt
vibhu ca ākāśaṃ niṣkriyaṃ ca, tathā cātmā, tasmānniṣkriyaḥ iti
na cāsti viśeṣahetuḥ kriyāvatsādharmyāt kriyāvatā bhavitavyaṃ na punarakriyasādharmyānniṣkriyeṇeti viśeṣahetvabhāvāt sādharmyasamaḥ pratiṣedho bhavati
kriyāvad dravyamavibhu dṛṣṭaṃ yathā loṣṭaḥ, na ca tathātmā tasmānniṣkriyaḥ iti
vaidharmyeṇa pratyavasthānaṃ niṣkriyaṃ dravyamākāśaṃ kriyāhetuguṇarahitaṃ dṛṣṭam, na tathā ātmā tasmānniṣkriya iti
na cāsti viśeṣahetuḥ kriyāvadvaidharmyāt niṣkriyeṇa bhavitavyaṃ na punarakriyavaidharmyāt kriyāvateti viśeṣahetvabhāvāt vaidharmyasamaḥ
atha vaidharmyasamaḥ--kriyāhetuguṇayukto loṣṭaḥ paricchinno dṛṣṭaḥ, na ca tathātmā tasmānna loṣṭavat kriyāvāniti
na cāsti viśeṣahetuḥ kriyāvatsādharmyāt kriyāvatā bhavitavyaṃ na punaḥ kriyāvadvaidharmyādakriyeṇeti viśeṣahetvabhāvād vaidharmyasamaḥ
tatra kiṃ tasya sādharmyam ? ityāha--vacanasyāpi ityādi
vacanasyāpi na kevalam adhyakṣaliṅgayoreva sāmarthyam asti iti vākyaśeṣaḥ
tacchabdena vādiprativādinoḥ tattve prakṛte parāmṛśyetite iti tadanyatarasya vāditvam tattvasya itarasya vā yo nirṇayaḥ sa eva avasānaṃ paryantaṃ yasya tat tathoktaṃ na itarakalpitam iti evakārārthaḥ
vaktrabhiprāya sūtameva tat tasyeti cet; tatrāha--na punaḥ naiva vaktrabhiprāyasūcanam
sādhanaṃ ca dūṣaṇaṃ ca tadābhāsaśca sādhanadūṣaṇamātraṃ teṣāṃ vyavasthā abhidhānavikalpātmikā sthitiḥ tasyā vastuvatva pratibandhāt
asyā'yamarthaḥ--vastu paramārthasat yat sādhanāditattvaṃ tatra pratibandhād āyattatvāt
etaduktaṃ bhavati--sādhanādivikalpaḥ tadviṣayaḥ, anyathā tataḥ tatsiddheḥ tadvyavahārocchedaḥ, avikalpaniṣedhāt
aniṣedhe'pi na tato'pi, itarathā akiñcitkarāderapi tatsiddheḥ kṛtakaḥ śabdaḥ anityatvāt ghaṭādivat ityapisyāt
tadvikalpaprabhavāśca nitarāṃ tadviṣayāḥ, iti nirākṛtametat--vikalpayonayaḥ śabdāḥ ityādi
vaktuḥ sādhanādivādinaḥ abhiprāyaḥ sādhanādivikalpaḥ sūcyate abhilapyate yena tatsūcanam abhidhānaṃ tayoḥ samāhāralakṣaṇo dvandvaḥ tasya sarvatra sādhanādisadbhāvavat tadabhāve'pi aviśeṣāt

etadapi kutaḥ ? ityāha--pratibandhābhāvāt sādhanādibhiḥ saha vaktrabhiprāyasūcanasya tādātmya-tadutpattilakṣaṇā'vinābhāvā bhāvā t kāraṇāt kathaṃ śabdaiḥ upalakṣaṇametat, tena vikalpaiḥ svārthasya sādhanādilakṣaṇasya pratipādanamiti cet; atra parasya svavacanavirodhaṃ darśayituṃ kārikāṃ nopaneyam ityādikāmāha--
śabdāḥ kathaṃ kasyacit sādhanamiti bruvan kathamavadheyavacanaḥ ? tatkṛtāṃ tattvasiddhimupajīvatīti sādhanāṅgavacanād bhūtadoṣodbhāvanādvā
śaktasya sūcanaṃ hetuvacanaṃ svayamaśaktamapi, sādhyoktiḥ punaḥ pāramparyeṇa nālamiti paraḥ prākṛtaśaktiḥ
tulanā--tatkṛtāṃ vastusiddhimupajīvati na tadvācyatāṃ ceti svadṛṣṭirāgamātramanavasthānuṣaṅgāt
kvacit śabdādidharmiṇi kiñcid asiddham anityatvādikaṃ nopaneyaṃ nopaḍhaukanīyam
kayā ? vācā anityatvaśabdena, sādhanānarthakyam anyatheti manyate
tata eva kutaścit śabdādeḥ kiñcit nityatvādikaṃ nāpanīyate na nirākriyate vācā na nityaḥ iti cacanena
taduktaṃ vi ni śca ye--te tarhi kvacit kiñcid upanayato'panayato vā kathaṃ kasyacit sādhanam iti
kiṃ tarhi tayā kriyate ? ityāha--vācā'ṅgaṃ liṅgaṃ sūcyate ca parārthaṃ tu anumānaṃ svadṛṣṭārthaprakāśanam pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 4
1 iti vacanād ityevaṃ yo vaktā sa katham anākulaḥ ākula eva pūrvāparaviruddhā'bhidhānāt
vācā iti upalakṣaṇam, tena vikalpenāpi sūcyate ca iti vā upalakṣaṇam, tena vyavasīyate ca
svena dṛṣṭaṃ svadṛṣṭaṃ vādiprativādibhyāṃ pratipādyapratipādakābhyāṃ svadṛṣṭasyetyarthaḥ
śabdāḥ kathaṃ na kathañcit kasyacit sādhanam ityevaṃ bruvan saugataḥ kathamavadheyavacanaḥ ? kutaḥ ? ityāha--tatkṛtāṃ śabdakṛtāṃ tattvasya siddhiṃ nirṇītim upajīvati iti hetoḥ

etadapi kutaḥ ityāha--siddhiḥ sādhanaṃ tasya aṅgaṃ nimittam trirūpaṃ liṅgam; sādhyate anena iti vā sādhanam, asyāṃ pakṣadharmatvādeḥ avayavaḥ tasya vacanāt pratipādanāt śabdaiḥ iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
idamatra tātparyam--sādhanadūṣaṇavacanena tadapratipādane sādhanāṅgasya avacanād doṣasya ca anudbhāvanād anarthakavacanācca nigrahaprāptiḥ tadvaktuḥ

syānmatam-- na tataḥ kiñcit kaścit pratipādaprati pratipadyatevā kevalaṃ taimirikadvayavad bhrāntyā śabdata idaṃ mayā ayaṃ pratipāditaḥ ahaṃ ca pratipannaḥ iti vaktuḥ pratipattuśca buddhiḥ jāyate iti; tanna sāram; yataḥ kathamevaṃ svayaṃ jānanneva śābdavyavahāram anubādheta saṃyogyādivyavahāravat ? yathaivāyaṃ saṃyogyādiliṅgaṃ pratibandhābhāvena savyabhicāramupalabhya parihṛtavān tathā śabdaṃ pariharet
atha tatparityāge kṣaṇamapi jīvituṃ na śakyate iti tatpāmaḥ tata eva bhaviṣyacchakaṭādyanumāne kṛttikādyudayaparityāgo'pi mā bhūt
tathā ca adya ādityodayāt śva āditya udetā iti nānumānaṃ vyabhicārasaṃbhavāt iti plavate
yadi punaḥ vyavahārī tathāvidhādapi śabdāt liṅgādikaṃ pratipadyate iti tadarthā tadaṅgīkaraṇam; ata eva saṃyogyādyaṅgīkaraṇamastu
tadayam apratibaddhādapi śabdāt liṅgaṃ pratipādayati na tathāvidhālliṅgāt liṅginamiti prākṛtaśaktiḥ

taimiriko'pi vijñātataimirajñānamithyātvo na tato vyavahāramāracayati, itarathā vibhramajñāne pra jñā ka ra sya pakṣatrayasthāpanamayuktaṃ syāt--pratipannavyabhicāro na tataḥ pravarttate api tu anumānāt, anyasya jātavipralambhasya tarasyata pramāṇam iti
tulanā--anena etadapi nirākṛtam--advaite kathaṃ parapratibodhanāya pravartate iti
ayaṃ paro'haṃ na paraḥ iti svasaṃvedanamevaitad udayamāsādayati
nātra paramārthato vibhāgaḥ--ahaṃ praśnayitā paraḥ kathayati
dvayorapi svākāroparaktapratyayasaṃvedanamevaitat na tu vibhāgaḥ svapnapratyayavat unmattapratyayapralāpavacca
unmattastarhi vādī kathaṃ tato'dvaitapratītirapi ? nanu sarvapratyayapralaya evāyaṃ pravartate nātra pratīterudayaḥ
kiṃ tarhi prativādinā'nyena vā karttavyam ? kiṃ kriyamāṇaṃ kiñcid dṛśyate ? --pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 293
śva āditya udeteti grahaṇaṃ vā bhaviṣyati
tathāhi--pratibhāsa evaṃ bhūto yaḥ sa na saṃsthānavarjitaḥ
yena na kadācid vyabhicāra upalabdhaḥ sa yathābhiprete visaṃvādāt visaṃvādyata eva
yastu vyabhicārasaṃvedī sa vicārya pravartate--saṃsthānamātraṃ tāvat prāpyate paratra saṃdeho viparyayo vā, tato'numānaṃ saṃsthāne saṃśayaḥ paratreti pratyayadvayametat pramāṇamapramāṇaṃ ca

nanu tasya śabdādapi vastupratipattiṃ tataḥ tatprāptiṃ manyamānasya tat jñānaṃ pramāṇaṃ syāt, ayamasyaiva doṣo'stu, ato liṅgādivat śabdādapi anena vyavahāraṃ kurvatā tadvat tasya vastutattvapratibandho'bhyupagantavya iti sthitam
bhavatvetat, tathāpi śabdo liṅgaṃ gamayati na sādhyamiti cet ; atrāha--śaktasya sūcanam ityādi
kimbhūtam ? ityāha--aśaktamapi sādhyajñāpane'samarthamapi svayam ātmanā iti

sādhyaṃvacanaṃ kiṃbhūtam ? ityāha--sādhyoktiḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti pratijñāvacanam punaḥ na kevalaṃ sādhanāt sādhyasiddheḥ sākṣād api tu vacanavat pāramparyeṇāpi nā'laṃ sādhyapratipādane na samarthā sādhyapratipādanād ityevaṃ paraḥ prākṛtaśaktiḥ prākṛtā prākṛte vā śaktiḥ asya, śaktavat sādhyapratipādanasaṃbhavāditi manyate
na tu liṅgasyeva sādhyasyāpi pratipādane vacanasya sāmarthye tata eva sādhyasiddheḥ hetuvaiphalyamiti cet; atrāha--samyagvicāritā ityādi

sarva evāyamanumānānumeyavyavahāro vikalpārūḍhena dharmadharminyāyena na bahiḥ sadasattvamepakṣate iti cet; kathamarthādeva liṅgādarthagatiḥ ? kathañca dharmadharmitayā bheda eva buddhiparikalpito nārtho'pi, vikalpānāmavastusaṃsparśābhyupagamāt
vastvāśrayatvādvastuviṣayatve kathaṃ sādhyāvinābhāvihetumantareṇānupapannaṃ hetuvacanaṃ tattvaviṣayaṃ na bhavet ?
samyak sādhyāvinābhāvisādhanopanyāsena vicāritāḥ parīkṣitāḥ tattvagocaraṃ nayantaḥ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ
yadi vā, vākyāni vikalpāśca iti grāhyam
yathā uktavidhinā samyag vicāritā vikalpāḥ tattvagocarāḥ tathā vākyānyapi, rūpādiśabdā nirviṣaya vikalpayonitvāt pradhānādiśabdavat ityatra hetoḥ asiddhatodbhāvanārthaṃ vā

sarveṇa anena etaduktaṃ bhavati--śabdo'nitya iti pratipādyamānā api svasamayāvaṣṭambhād anarthakānyaśabdasādharmyādvā na pratipadyante tānuddiśya hetūpanyāsa iti; tarhi hetoreva sādhyasiddheḥ kiṃ sādhyanirdeśeneti cet ? atrāha--prāyaḥ ityādi
prāyo bāhulyena kṣaṇikatvādirūpeṇa na śabdādisvabhāvena yacchabdādi sādhyam anumeyam tadajñeyam aparicchedyam
teṣāṃ jñānaṃ sarvamavikalpam, vikalpasyāpi svarūpavad bahirapi etteḥ ekasya rūpadvayavirodhāt
kiṃ kurvadbhiḥ ? ityāha— paśyadbhiḥ indriyāṇi tatra vyāpārayadbhiḥ, indriyagrāhyaṃ na bhavedityarthaḥ
ekasya vikalpasya svarūpe nirvikalpakatvaṃ bahirarthe ca vikalpakatvamiti rūpadvayaṃ na saṃbhavati virodhādityarthaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā hetoḥ sidhyati sādhye tatpratītyarthaṃ vaktravigrahamāvahati tathā cakṣurādivyāpāro'pi dṛṣṭuḥ aviśeṣāt
ko hi viśeṣo yena indriyamanarthakaṃ doṣāya, api tu vacanameva
yadi punaḥ liṅgād gamyamāne'pyarthe nendriyavyāpārā skirataṃ buddhyutpattāvapi nāparāparasya tasya vaiphalyaṃ syāt
atha dharmimātre tatsāphalyānnāyaṃ doṣaḥ; kṣaṇikatvādidharme syāt
ekatra guṇaḥ sarvatra guṇaṃ karoti na doṣo doṣamiti cintyametat
tato'smāddoṣād bibhyatā pratijñāvacanamiva indriyamapi tatra pariharaṇīyam
kārikāyā uttarārdhasya vyākhyānamakṛtvā sugamatvāt pūrvārdhaṃ samarthayituṃ pūrvapakṣayannāha--sarva eva ityādi
sarva eva kāryahetoḥ svabhāvahetorvā ayaṃ pratīyamānaḥ anumānānumeyavyavahāro liṅgaliṅgivyavahāro vikalpārūḍhena vikalpāvabhāsinā
kena ? ityāha--dharmaḥ sattvādiḥ dharmī śabdādiḥ tayoḥ nyāyaḥ sarve bhāvāḥ svabhāvena pra॰ vā॰ 3
tarhi tadvikalpasya vastvāśrayatvāt tadvyavahāraḥ pāramārthikaḥ iti cet ? atrāha--na bahirapekṣate tadvyavahāraḥ
sattvamasattvaṃ ca dharmadharmiṇoḥ; ityapekṣate, vikalpasya nirviṣayatvāditi manyate

tatra dūṣaṇamāha--kathaṃ na kathaṃcit arthādeva vastubhūtādeva liṅgāt sattvadhūmādeḥ na kalpitāt pakṣasapakṣā'nyataratvādeḥ iti evakārārthasya agnyādeḥ gatiḥ pratipattiḥ ? iṣyate ca pareṇa artho hi arthaṃ gamayati iti vacanāt
kathaṃ tataḥ sā na syāditi cet ? ucyate--yadā hi dharmadharmivikalpo nirviṣayaḥ tadā dharmī śabdaḥ taddharmāḥ sattvādayaḥ pakṣasapakṣānyataratvādernātiricyante iti
tathā cānumānānumeyavyavahāro'yaṃ sarvo hi buddhiparikalpato buddhyārūḍhena dharmadharmibhedeneti uktam--pra॰ vā॰ svavṛ॰ 1
ācāryadignāgenāpyetaduktamityāha--tathā cetyādi...--pra॰ vā॰ svavṛ॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 24
nanu uktamatra dharmadharmitayā bheda eva buddhiparikalpito nārtho'pi iti cet; atrāha--kathaṃ ca ityādi
dharmadharmiṇorbhāvaḥ tattā tayā yo bhedaḥ sa eva buddhiparikalpito nārthepyarthopi liṅgaliṅgi lakṣaṇo na kevalaṃ tattayā bheda eva kathaṃ vā na buddhiparikalpitaḥ kintu tatkalpita eva

idamatra tātparyam--uktavidhinā na antarbahirvā niraṃśo'rthaḥ saṃbhavati sāṃśa ca vikalpaviṣayatvāt, vikalpānāṃ ca saugataiḥ avastusaṃsparśā'bhyupagamāt vikalpo'vastunirbhāso visaṃvādādupaplavaḥ iti vacanāt, na artho'pi buddhiparikalpitaḥ iti sambandhaḥ
paśyatu pra jñā ka ra sya sarvavikalpātītaṃ pratibhāsamātraṃ tattvam iti matam
tasya sattvādayaḥ artharūpatayāpi vikalpitā bhavanti naveti cintyametat

yadi bhavanti; katham artho hi arthaṃ gamayati iti dha rma kī rtti vacanam asau gacchet ? bhavantu tarhi vastuviṣayāḥ te iti cet; atrāha--vastu bahirantaśca sāṃśo bhāvaḥ āśrayaḥ kāraṇam avalambyaṃ yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ bhāvāt tattvāt
vastuviṣayatve aṅgīkriyamāṇe vikalpānām ityanuvarttate, kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa tattvaviṣaya na bhavet
vicāryamāṇaṃ hi sakalameva viśīryate nādvaitādaparaṃ tattvamasti--pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 31
evaṃ tāvat liṅgaliṅgivikalpānāṃ keṣāñcid bahirarthaviṣayatvapratipādanena tajjanmano'bhidhānasyāpi tadviṣayatvaṃ pratipāditam
saṃprati vivakṣāprabhavatvena tasya tadviṣayatvaṃ pareṇa yaduktaṃ tatpūrvapakṣayitvā nirākurvannāha--vivakṣā ityādi
vaktrabhiprāyamātraṃ vākyaṃ sūcayatītyaviśeṣeṇākṣipan pāramparyeṇāpi na tatastattvaṃ pratipadyeta
na ca vaktrabhiprāyamekāntena sūcayanti śrutiduṣṭādeḥ anyata eva prasiddheḥ
tathā anekārtheṣu kenārtho'yaṃ vivecitaḥ yena vaktrabhiprāya evārthaḥ
śabdaiḥ kvacit visaṃvādāt svayamanāśvāse kiṃ śabdavikalpavyabhicāracodanayā svalpakalpanayā, jñānameva kinna pratikṣipet ?
vivakṣaiva prabhavaḥ kāraṇaṃ yasya prabhavati asmāt iti vyutpatteḥ, vivakṣāyā vā prabhavo yasya, tataḥ prabhavati iti vā yat tathoktam
kva ? ityāha--svārthe sva ātmīyo vādino heturūpo'rthaḥ tasmin, iti kākvā artho'tra draṣṭavyaḥ
kena ? liṅgena vivakṣā vikalpārūḍhā iti manyate
anyasya tena sūcanasya paraiḥ anabhyupagamāt kathaṃ na kathañcit tattvasya vyavasthitiḥ iṣṭasya kṣaṇakṣayādeḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yat tena vikalpārūḍhaṃ liṅgaṃ sūcitaṃ na tasya tattve pratibandhaḥ, yasya ca tatra pratibandho na tattena sūcitam
na ca anyasya sūcane anyatra pratipattiḥ pravṛttirvā, anyathā svaśabdena aśvavacane gavi sā bhavet
atha tadārūḍheṇa prayojanā'siddheḥ anyatra sā bhavet; tanna; atiprasaṅgāt
yadi punaḥ tattvatastena sūcane'pi bhrāntyā trirūpaṃ liṅgaṃ sūcitamiti pratipattiḥ; sāpi na yuktā; aviṣaye bhrānterapi pratipatterayogāt, itarathā tataḥ aśvaśabdāt gavi pratipattiḥ syāt
asādṛśyānneti cet; kiṃ punaḥ vikalpākāra-arthasvabhāvayoḥ sādṛśyamasti ? tathā cet; pratyakṣavad vikalpānāmarthaviṣayatvaṃ kena vāryate ? pratyakṣasyāpi sarvathā tadabhāvāt
yastu manyate--tadabhāve'pi āntaropaplavavaśāt tathāpratipattiḥ iti; sāpi na tattvadṛṣṭiḥ; yataḥ yad yatkāryaṃ tat tadeva gamayati pratibandhāt, yathā dhūmaḥ agnim, vivakṣākāryaṃ ca vākyam
tathā yat yatkāryaṃ na bhavati tad bhrāntyāpi tanna gamayati yathā sa eva dhūmaḥ apāvakam, akāryaṃ ca vākyam arthasya iti

yadi punaḥ tathāpi tayā tat tatra buddhiṃ janayati kutaścit pratyāsatteḥ; tata eva tarhi paramārthataḥ kiñcidakāraṇe jñānaṃ kariṣyati, tadvijñānaṃ ca tatra pramāṇaṃ syāt avisaṃvādābhimāninaḥ yathā kuñcikāvivaramaṇijñānaṃ maṇau

syānmatam, na vākyaṃ kathañcidapi arthe jñānaṃ janayati vivakṣāyā anyatra, kevalaṃ vikalpāntaramevaṃ jāyate ato vākyādarthaḥ pratīya te iti; na; tathā kramapratīterabhāvāt pūrvaṃ vākyād vivakṣāvikalpaḥ punaḥ arthavikalpa iti
tataḥ sthitam--tat sūcitena liṅgena kathaṃ tattvavyavasthitiḥ iti
idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam--vivakṣāprabhavamapi iti api śabdo'tra draṣṭavyaḥ
vākyaṃ svārthena svābhidheyavastunā pratibadhyate katham iti praśne tatsūcitena liṅgena tattvavyavasthitiryataḥ ityuttaram

kārikāṃ vivṛṇvannāha--vaktrabhiprāyamātraṃ bhavadbhiḥ arthaṃ vākyaṃ sūcayati ityevam aviśeṣeṇa ākṣipan kroḍīkurvan saugataḥ pāramparyeṇāpi na kevalaṃ sante to vākyāt tattvaṃ sādhyaṃ vastu na pratipadyeta
atha vākyāt liṅgam, ataḥ tattvam iti; parārthānumānaṃ syāditi manyate

dvitīyaṃ kārikāvyākhyānaṃ vyatirekamukheṇa anenaiva darśitam, vaktrabhiprāyasūcakatvaṃ vākyasyābhyupagamya dūṣaṇamuktam, idānīm ekāntena tadapi nāstīti darśayannāha--naca naiva vaktrabhiprāyam ekāntena avaśyambhāvena sūcayanti sūcyata ityuta ityāha--śruti ityādi
yatrāpi śrutirdṛṣṭyā deḥ iti pāṭhaḥ, tatra ādiśabdena kalpanāduṣṭādiparigrahaḥ
pakṣo dharmī avayave samudāyopacārāt, tasya dharmaḥ tadaṃśena tasya pakṣasya aṃśena sādhyadharmeṇa na tadekadeśena pakṣaśabdena samudāyāvacanāt vyāpto vyāptiyogāt
vyāptiśca vyāpakagatā tatra yatrāsau sādhanadharmo bhāva eva nābhāve
kim ? ityāha--punaḥ iti vitarke hetureva manāgapi a heturna bhavati ityevakārārthaḥ
kati prakāraḥ ? ityatrāha--sa hi sa hetuḥ khalu tridhā
vyāptirhi vyāpakasya tatra bhāva eva, vyāpyasya vā tatraiva bhāvaḥ
atra codyate--yadi pakṣadharmaḥ; katham asiddhaḥ ? svayam āśrayasya ca sandehe asiddho vā'siddha ucyate
tathā yadi tadaṃśena vyāptaḥ; kathaṃ viruddho'naikāntiko vā ? tadaṃśavyāptivacanena anvayavyatirekayorabhidhānena tannirāsāt
sa hi vipakṣe san asan sapakṣe viruddhaḥ, ubhayatra san saṃbhāvyamāno vā anaikāntikaḥ, na cāsya tadaṃ śavyāptiriti; na; parāpekṣayā evamabhidhānāt

paro hi sattvādīnāṃ pakṣadharmatvaṃ tadaṃśavyāptiṃ ca abhyupagacchati kuto'nekāntavādinastasya pramāṇatā ? te na kvacit sattvādisaṃbhavaḥ iti asiddha ucyate, anekānta eva vā asya tavodvirāddhaḥ kalpitasya kṣaṇikaikāntavad akṣaṇikaikānte'pi vyabhicārī iti, yadvakṣyati--
asiddhaḥ si ddha se na sya viruddho de va na ndi naḥ
dve dhā sa ma nta bha dra sya heturekāntasādhane || siddhivi॰ pari॰ 6 iti
tataḥ paraparikalpitāt kāryādeḥ apare kāryādayo maraṇādau sādhye ariṣṭādayaḥ hetvābhāsā na hetavaḥ bhavanti ityadhyāhāraḥ
dvitīyaṃ vyākhyānamāha--tataḥ pare saṃ yogyādayo hetvābhāsā bhavanti iti
asyāyamarthaḥ--vinā bhāvya mantareṇa abhāvya niyamaḥ sādhyābhāve abhāvaniyamaḥ, punaḥ asya na jñāyoge sādhyābhāve'pi bhāva ityuktaṃ bhavati, tasmād iti
tataḥ ki jātam ? ityāha--svayam ātmanā ādinā anabhimatasyāpi na kevalam abhimatasyaiva vastunaḥ arthasya pratipatteḥ śabdebhyaḥ iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
na ca vaktrabhiprāyam ekāntena sūcayanti śabdā ityapekṣam
nanu yadyapyevaṃ bhāvanā vyākhyāyate--yathā pyayamasya artho na bhavati kintu vaktrabhiprāyo'rthaḥ iti cet; atrāha--tattva ityādi
tathā tena uktaprakāreṇa anekārtheṣu śabdeṣu satsu kena puruṣeṇa pramāṇena vā artho'yaṃ nirdiśyamāno vivecitaḥ pṛthakkṛtaḥ yena vitetranena vaktrabhiprāya eva nānyaḥ syādarthaḥ na kenacit ityarthaḥ
atha kadācid arthābhāve'pi vṛtteḥ anarthakāḥ śabdāḥ ? ityatrāha--kvacit na sarvatra visaṃvādāt vañcanāt
kaiḥ ? ityāha--śabdaiḥ saṃvāde'pi vahulaṃ śabdaiḥ ityapekṣam svayam ātmanā bauddhena anāśvāse kriyamāṇe kiṃ svalpakalpanayā
kiṃbhūtayā ? ityāha--śabdānāṃ vikalpānāṃ vyabhicārasya codanaṃ yasyāṃ tayā
tarhi kiṃ kuryāt paraḥ ? ityāha--jñānameva vikalpānām anantaraṃ nirdeśāt jñānaśabdena darśanam iha gṛhyate, tadeva, na śabdavikalpānām, tatpratikṣepeṇaiva tatpratikṣepaṇāt tanmūlatvātteṣāmiti manyate
kinna pratikṣipet ? bahiḥ pratikṣipedeva tasya svapnādau arthābhāve'pi darśanāt ityeke
yena svasaṃvedanena jñānaṃ jñānam iti bhavati tat jñānam ityucyate, tadeva kinna pratikṣipet ? dvayanirbhāsavat tatrāpi anāśvāsāt
śaktasya sūcikā sākṣāt kācana sarvā na kalpanā || 6
tattvapratipattiṃ prati vākyaviśeṣaiḥ anumānavṛttau vyavahartāro'tiśerate nānyathā
kim ? ityāha--sādhyopalabdheḥ sādhyasya kṣaṇakṣayasya svasaṃvadenā'nanyavedyādeḥ yā upalabdhiḥ dṛṣṭiḥ sākṣātkaraṇaṃ tasyāḥ pratyakṣaṃ caturvidham avikalpadarśanaṃ nā'lam na samartham
katham ? ityāha--pāramparyeṇa api śabdo'tra vyākhyeyo bhinnaprakramanyāyāt
na kevalaṃ sākṣād api tu pāramparyeṇāpi
tathāhi--na tāvat sākṣāt, paramārthābhāve'pi tatpravṛtteḥ upaplavadaśāyām
tathā sati yadavabhāsate na tat paramārthasat yathā taimirikopalabhyamānaṃ keśoṃdrakādi, avabhāsate ca jñānasya svasaṃvedanādi
na caitanmantavyam--keśoṇḍukādeḥ jñānātmakatve tatsattvāt sādhyavikalo dṛṣṭānta iti; sārūpyaniṣedhāt, grāhyagrāhakākārabhedapratīteḥ anyena anyagrahaṇāvirodhāt jananavat

taddhi trirūpaliṅgajamiṣyate tadabhāvamabhyupagacchan katham yadavabhāsate tajjñānaṃ yathā sukhādi avabhāsate ca nīlādikam ityādyanumānaṃ vadet ? asya sāṃvṛtatve kutaḥ ato nīlādeḥ bhāvato jñānatvasiddhiḥ atiprasaṅgāt ? atha yādṛśo yakṣaḥ tādṛśo baliḥ iti vacanāt sāpi tatastathā neṣyate; vastutaḥ kiṃ nīlādikamastu ? jñānam iti cet; kutaḥ pramāṇāt ? ata eveti cet; hanta hato'si, prakṛtavirodhāt
yadi cedamanumānaṃ paramparayāpi na tatra pratibaddham, kathamasya tadavyabhicāraḥ ? tathāpi tadbhāvo
yathā balistathā yakṣa iti kiṃ kena saṅgatam
pratibandhāt tadābhāsaśūnyayorapyavañcanam || pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 82 iti plavate
yadi punaḥ paramparayā tatkāryatvenopagamānnāyaṃ doṣaḥ; tathā sati sarvamanumānam avyabhicāram ata eva syāditi na tadābhāso nāma
tato'sya tatra pratibandhā'bhāve na avyabhicāra iti nātastatsiddhiḥ
pratyakṣata iti cet; na; tasya tāvati vyāpāre sāmarthyābhāvāt
na hi idaṃ sarvaṃ nīlādi jñānam iti pratyetumarhati, anena anyagrahaṇaprasaṅgāt
na ca sarvaṃ nīlādi bhavadīyajñānād bahirbhūtam iti yuktirasti; atra tato'nyasyāpi anivāraṇāt
bhavadīyānupalambhamātrasya tadabhāvasādhane sādharmyāt , itarathā sukhena duḥkhasya anupalambhādabhāvaḥ syāt
nanu na madīyamadhyakṣam aśeṣasya nīlādeḥ jñānātmakatvamavaiti kintu svayaṃ viṣayīkṛtasya iti cet; na; tatra vivādāt
tathāhi--tvatpratyakṣaṃ nīlādikamātmabhūtaṃ pratyeti iti kaḥ pratyeti ? tadeveti cet; anyasya pratyakṣaṃ tat svato bhinnaṃ pratyeti
tathā va tattathā pratipadyamānamātmānaṃ pratyeti tadeveti na vijñaptimātrasiddhiḥ
sa kathamidaṃ parasmai nivedayati ? kathaṃ kena prakṣeṇa tvadīyapratyakṣasya parapratipattyahetutvāt, jñānāntaravaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt
anyajñānasya adhipatipratyayo bhavatīti cet; tarhi tasya kenacit pratyāsattiviprakarṣābhāvāt sarvasya bhavediti na vivādo nāma bhavet
kathaṃ caivaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvo na bhavet, yataḥ tadvat pareṇa parasya grahaṇaṃ viruddhatā nyayāpi ca pratyakṣaṃ tathā parapratipattihetuḥ tathaiva syāt
mama neti cet; bhavadīyamanyasya na iti samānam

yatpunaretat--vivakṣitapratyakṣāt nīlāderabhedāt svātmabhūtameva tat tatpratyeti iti tasya tato'bhedaḥ, kutastena grahaṇam ? tadyathā--yad yena gṛhyate tat tena svātmabhūtaṃ gṛhyate yathā svarūpam, gṛhyate ca nīlādikam iti
parābhāvānna sa pratipādyata iti cet; tadetad anyatrāpi samānam
śakyaṃ hi anyenāpi vaktum ahaṃ tāvat nīlādikaṃ svato bhinnaṃ paśyāmi, na cānyaḥ pratipattā asti yo mayā pratipādyate, māṃ prati codya svā karoti, pratipakṣāt naḥ svārthasiddhiḥ
yatpunaretat--kathaṃ svato bhinnaṃ tat tatpratyeti iti ? abhinnaṃ kathaṃ pratyeti ? tathādarśanāt; anyatra samānam
tato bahirbhūtasya paramārthasattve ca na vijñaptimātraṃ pratyakṣalakṣaṇe vā abhrāntagrahaṇam arthavaditi
tataḥ tadabhyupagacchatā bahiḥ taimirikakeśādeḥ asattvamabhyupagantavyamiti na sādhyaśūnyo dṛṣṭāntaḥ
nanu pratyakṣe saccetanādeḥ pratibhāsane kathaṃ na tadupalabdhiḥ ? tatsamarthamiti cet; na; paramārthopalabdhiḥ vivakṣitatvāt
ata eva tadviṣayānumānajanakatvena pāramparyeṇa; sarvathā bhrāntyā tadanutpatteriti manyate
nanu grāhyākāravat svarūpe'pi vibhrame vibhramo'pi na sidhyati
śaktasya liṅgasya sūcikā jñāpikā kācana kalpanā na sarvā, na sat
sākṣāt tatsūcane samarthā tadviṣayā iti yāvat
yadi vā, kārye kāraṇasya tatra vā kāryasyopacārāt kalpanāśabdena śabda ucyate
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā pratibhāsāviśeṣe svarūpaparihāreṇa anyatra bhrāntaṃ tathā śakta sūcakaśabdavikalpaparihāreṇa pradhānādiśabdādibhrāntatvamiti
paramārthaḥ svalakṣaṇaṃ tasmin ekaḥ pradhānabhūtaḥ tānaḥ tādātmyādipratibandho yāsāṃ tāsāṃ bhāve tattve aṅgīkriyamāṇe
tasyāṃ kiṃ syāt ? ityatrāha--syāt bhavet pravṛttiḥ varttanam

kiṃbhūteṣu ? samayāntarabhediṣu bahiḥ parasparaviviktatanavaḥ kṣaṇikā niraṃśāḥ paramāṇavo darśanaviṣayā antaśca advayaṃ vedanam iti darśanam iha samayaḥ ityucyate, nānyaḥ aprastāvāt, tato'nyaḥ tadantaram tadbhettuṃ saugatasamayād anyatvena vyavasthāpanaśīleṣu, sthirasthūlasādhāraṇādisvabhāveṣu samastavo ktinyāyāt

tato manyāmahe--bahirantaśca buddhīnāmaviśeṣeṇa paramārthaikatānatvaṃ nāstīti śabdānāṃ nirviṣayatvaṃ vyavasthāpayitukāmasya buddhīnāṃ tadājātaṃ ataḥ adhikārthinyāḥ patitaṃ tadapi ca yat pijjane lagnam
bahirantaśca kasyacit pramāṇābhāvāt tadabhāvasādhanaṃ tva siddhasādhanamiti manyamānasya pra jñā ka ra sya mataṃ pūrvapakṣeṇaiva dūṣayitvā kārikādvayasya tātparyaṃ kathayannāha--pramāṇābhāva ityādi
asyāyamarthaḥ yaduktam--jñānameva kiṃ na pratikṣipet iti
tatra tatpratikṣepe pramāṇapratikṣepo jñānātmakatvāt pramāṇasya, asya vā bhāve pratikṣepāsiddhiḥ jñānasya anyasya vā nirāsā'siddhiḥ
taduktaṃ nyāya vi ni śca ye--pramāṇamātmasātkurvan nyāyavi॰ 1
ityevaṃ cet; atrāha--vākyapratikṣepe'pi vākyasya saviṣayatvanirāse'pi na kevalaṃ jñānasya samānaṃ sadṛśam
tattvasya kṣaṇa kṣayādeḥ pratipattiṃ prati anumānasya vṛttau pravṛttau
nanu ca tatpratipattireva anumānaṃ tatkathamidamucyate iti cet ? na; upacāreṇa anumānaśabdena liṅgābhidhānāt
tasyāṃ kim ? ityāha--vyavaharttuṃ vyākhyātāro'pi tiserate nānyathā nā'pareṇa prakāreṇa
idamatra tātparyam--sarvaṃ vākyaṃ bahirarthaśūnyam iti pratipādayato na tatra pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇam
yadi punaḥ yadyatrāpratibaddhaṃ na tattatra yathārthapratītijanakaṃ yathā dhūmo'pāvake, bahirarthā'pratibaddhaṃ ca sarvaṃ vākyam ityanumānaṃ tatra pramāṇam
asya vākyasya liṅgapratipādane pratijñā svavacanavirodhinī, tadapratipādane kutaḥ parasya liṅgapratītiḥ iti
agnyādeḥ kāṣṭhādijanmano'pi maṇyāderdarśane tatkāryasya vyabhicāre'pi yathā gamakatvaṃ tathā śabdasya kvacid vyabhicāre'pi
tena kāṣṭhādaya eva viśiṣṭāḥ sāmagrīśabdena ucyante nānyā tebhyaḥ sā iti darśayati
kiṃca, asyā eva kāryaniṣpatteḥ kāṣṭhādikam anarthakaṃ syāt
na cānyata utpannaṃ kāryamanyasya yuktam atiprasaṅgāt
atha tatsambandhinyā janakatve tasyāḥ tadapi janakaṃ tatsambandhanāka
asya sarvagatatve kutaḥ kasyacideva sā iti cintyam
yadi punaḥ samavāyasambandhāviśeṣe'pi tatsambandhiviśeṣa iṣyate; iṣyatāṃ bhinnā sāmagrī tu na sidhyati
yayaiva pratyāsattyā samavāyāviśeṣe'pi kecideva kāñcideva sāmagrīṃ bibhrati tayaiva te tatkāryaṃ kurvantu tayā kim ? samavāyaniṣedhācca na tatsambandhinī
kāryatvāditi cet; tāṃ tarhi kāṣṭhādayo'svarūpeṇa janayanti kārye kaḥ pradveṣaḥ yataḥ tat te na janayanti ? aparayā sāmagryeti cet; sa eva doṣaḥ, anavasthā ceti
nahi agnivad dhūmasyāpi vijātīyābhāve kāryaṃ liṅgaṃ saṃbhavati
tatsaṃbhave'pi kāryaṃ liṅgam suvivecitaṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ na vyabhicarati iti nyāyāt na śabdaḥ
kiṃbhūtaḥ ? ityāha--yataḥ śabdāt tattvaṃ liṅgalakṣaṇam anyadvā pratipadyate saugataḥ
tathāhi--yo'rthe sati bhavati śabdaḥ so'nyaḥ, yaśca tadabhāve so'pi anyaḥ
suvivecitaṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ na vyabhicarati ityetat na saugatakākakulacarvitam
na caitat codyam--ya eva ghaṭaśabdo ghaṭe sati dṛśyate sa eva tadabhāve, tatkathaṃ liṅgamiti; tadekatvā'siddheḥ, ubhayorapi deśādibhedāt iti
syānmatam--kāṣṭhādijanmanā pāvakena maṇyādijanyasya tasya na sādṛśyaṃ kāraṇavaisādṛśyāt, na tādṛśāt
tādṛśānyādṛśavyadvi jāyamānaṃ tādṛ śannamadhā tādṛśānyādṛśavyavasthaiva na syāditi
yathaiva ca ghaṭaśabdaṃ samānaṃ sarvatra jano manyate tathā kāṣṭhamaṇijanitaṃ vahnim, sadṛśavyavahāradarśanāt
yastu manyate—indhanāt pāvako jāyate, tadindhanaṃ kāṣṭhavat maṇirapi, tatra tādṛśādeva tādṛśodbhava iti
tatra kimidamindhanam ? pāvakajananayogyaṃ vastu iti cet; tarhi dhūmo'pi tajjananayogyāt śakramūrdhāderbhavan tādṛśāt tādṛśaḥ syāt
na caitāvatā śakramūrdhādiḥ agnirbhavati, itarathā kāṣṭhaṃ maṇiḥ syādaviśeṣāt
anyeṣāṃ tu darśanam--vaktari śabdaḥ deśāntarādau arthaḥ tatkathaṃ sa liṅgam
na hi mahān sadhūmo mahodadhidahanasya liṅgam
kathaṃ tarhi parṇakādyā deśāntarādi tallī dāhasya kathaṃ vā anyatra prasuptasya anyatra prabodhasthānāntarādicetaso yataḥ pra jñā ka ra sya nirupādānaḥ prabodho na bhavet
svayaṃ ca jalacandrādeḥ candrāderanumānamicchati, yadi daṃ darśanamavatiṣṭhata tato yatkiñcidetat
nanu yadi kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ vyabhicarati mā bhūt tatastadanumānamiti cet; etadevāha--sāmagrībhyaḥ vicitrābhyaḥ kāṣṭhādibhyo'gnisaṃbhave sati kāryaliṅgaṃ talliṅgameva na bhavati
yataḥ śabdāt tattvam abhimataṃ vastu pratipadyate saugataḥ cārvāko vā sa śabdaḥ kim ? ayamatrā'bhiprāyaḥ--uktadoṣādanumānaṃ tyajannapi na śabdaṃ tyaktumarhati mūkatāprāpteḥ
tadaparityāge kama yadyapramāṇaṃ na tataḥ tattvaṃ pratipadyeta, anyathā kathaṃ prekṣāvān kimarthaṃ vā anyatra pramāṇānveṣaṇam ? pramāṇaṃ cet; siddhaṃ naḥ samīhitam

nanu śabdāt tattvapratipatterabhāvādasiddho heturiti cet; atrāha--svārthānumāne'pi ityādi na kevalaṃ parārthānumāne api tu svārthānumāne'pi prayogadarśanam anyathā anyena tattvaprayogadarśanam anyathā anyena tattvapratipattyabhāvaprakāreṇa ayuktameva tatprayojanābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ
idaṃ vā anyathā ayuktameva iti darśayannāha--tattva ityādi
śabdena vaktrabhiprāyasūcanāṅgīkaraṇe vādī nigṛhyate tattvataḥ sādhanāṅgāvacanāt, tathā prativādyapi bhūtadoṣamaprakāśayan
tattvaṃ pramāṇato'pratipādayataḥ asādhanāṅgavacanaṃ bhūtadoṣaṃ samudbhāvayati prativādīti yugapannigrahaprāptiḥ jayanāt
kasyacittūṣṇīṃ bhāve tāvatā parasya jayābhāvāt kaḥ kena nigṛhyate ? sādhanadūṣaṇatadābhāsānāmanyatarasya tathodbhāvyamāne tūṣṇīṃbhāvasyāpi yugapatsaṃbhavāt
tattvasya tu rūpaheturūpasya, yadi vā sādhyarūpasya pratyāyanād saugato jayati prativādinam ityadhyāhāraḥ
na kevalaṃ vādyeva api tu prativādyapi sa eva jayati vādinam iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
kiṃ kṛtvā ? ityāha--bhūtadoṣaṃ pāramārthikāsiddhādidoṣamudbhāvyeta anyathā ayuktameva ityanuvarttate, anyathā pratipattyabhāvaprakāreṇa tattvapratyāyana-bhūtadoṣodbhāvanayoḥ atyantamasaṃbhavāt
tathāhi--yathā saugate samīcīnasādhanavati paraḥ tadviparītaḥ parājayavān tathā saugato'pi syāt, sato'pi tatsādhanasya tenā'vacanāt
tathā, yathā sadoṣasādhanavādī vaiśeṣikādiḥ nigrahavān prativādī bauddho'pi tathaiva, tena doṣasya sato'pi anudbhāvanāt
yadi śabdo hetuḥ tata eva sādhyasiddheḥ, punaḥ kṛtakatvādyupādāne hetvantaraṃ nāma nigrahasthānaṃ syāt
etena śābdaṃ pramāṇāntaraṃ va ityetadapi nirūpitamiti; atrāha--tattva ityādi
nanvetat samyag vicāritā ityādinā śakyaparihṛtam, kimarthaṃ punarā ha ? dūṣaṇāntarapratipādanārtham ityadoṣaḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha--tattvasya jīvādeḥ samīcīnasādhanapratijñādivacanena pratyāyanāt pratipādyepi saugato vādinaṃ jayati
tathāhi--yadaiva vādī svābhimataṃ yuktitaḥ pratipādya paraṃ vijayate, tadaiva paro'narthakapratijñādivacanamudbhāvya, tatra caikadā saṃbhavaḥ
ekasmādeva sādhyasiddhau dvitīyahetūpādāne hetvantaraṃ nāma nigrahasthānaṃ bhavati
vaktrabhiprāyasya sūcanaṃ śabdena kāryaliṅgena yajjñāpanaṃ tasya aṅgīkaraṇe vādī saugato nigṛhyate naiyāyikādinā
yadi vā, sādhanameva aṅgaṃ sādhyapratipatteḥ nimittam
athavā, siddhiḥ sādhanaṃ tasya aṅgaṃ kāraṇaṃ tasya, avacanād vādinā iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
nahi anyasūcakena tattvato'nyaḥ sūcito nāma atiprasaṅgāt
tathā tena prakāreṇa prativādyapi saugato nigṛhyate ityanuvarttate
tattvaṃ pramāṇataḥ a pratipādayataḥ saugatasya pratijñādi asādhanāṅgavacanam bhūtadoṣaṃ samudbhāvayati ? kākvā vyākhyeyametat
kutaḥ ? ityāha--jayanāt yugapad ityanuvarttate, bhūtadoṣāt parājayavat tattvapratyāyanāt jayo'pi vādino'vaśyaṃbhāvī iti manyate
upasaṃhāramāha--yata evaṃ tat tasmāt na kasyacit jayo nāma
kutaḥ ? ityāha--mārgasya samyagdarśanādeḥ prabhāvanā prakāśanaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ yasya tasya bhāvāt tattvāt
yata evaṃ tasmāt nirākṛtapakṣatvameva nirākṛtaḥ pakṣo yasya tasya bhāvaḥ tattvameva nānyat pratijñādikaṃ nigrahasthānaṃ vādinaḥ prativādino vā
tattu asamyaksādhanavādini jaine saugatasya pratijñādivacanamudbhāvayato'pi astīti sa eva nigṛhyate iti bhāvaḥ

1 ityatra naiyāyikādinā avayavanyūnatā-viparyāsa-ādhikyaṃ nigrahasthānam iti; para āha atya la midamucyate--nirākṛtapakṣatvameva nigrahasthānam iti; yāvatā tūṣṇīṃbhāvo'pi taditi cet; atrāha--kasyacit vādinaḥ prativādino vā tūṣṇīmbhāve sati tāvatā tūṣṇīmbhāvamātreṇa parasya prativādino vādino vā jayābhāvāt kaḥ kena nigṛhyate
na kevalaṃ sādhanā'sādhanāṅgapratijñādivacanodbhāvanayoḥ yugapat saṃbhavaḥ kintu tūṣṇīmbhāvasyāpi yugapat saṃbhavāt
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadi vādinaḥ tūṣṇīmbhāvāt parājayaḥ tasyāpi kadācit tadbhāvāt vādinaḥ saṃbhavediti sakṛjjayetarau syātām iti
anena ca hīnamanyatamenāpyavayavena nyūnam, hetūdāharaṇādhikamadhikam iti nyūnādhikayorudbhāvanamanujñāyate
siddhāntāviruddhagrahaṇenāpi siddhāntamabhyupetya tadvirodhī viruddhaḥ iti viruddhākhyahetvābhāsodbhāvanamanujñātamityevaṃ vāde trīṇi nigrahasthānānyudbhāvanīyāni

anye vadanti--viruddha eva hetvābhāso vāde codyate nānaikāntikādiriti kathametad yujyate ? nigrahasthānebhyaḥ pṛthagupadiṣṭāḥ hetvābhāsā vāde codanīyā bhaviṣyanti iti bhāṣyakāravacanāt pramāṇapadena ca tanmūlāvayavākṣepāt pramāṇābhāsamūlanirāse sati sakalahetvābhāsodbhāvanamapi tatra siddhamiti
siddhāntāviruddhagrahaṇena siddhāntamabhyupetyāniyamāt kathāprasaṅgo'pasiddhānta ityapasiddhāntākhyanigrahasthānāni vāde udbhāvyanta iti
nanu kasyacit tūṣṇīmbhāvamātreṇa na parasya tayo yenāyaṃ doṣaḥ syāt, api tu tathodbhāvayataḥ, na ca dvayoḥ tūṣṇīmbhāve tadastīti cet; atrāha--sādhana ityādi
sādhane ye dūṣaṇaṃ ca asiddhatvādi, tad ityanena sādhanadūṣaṇaṃ parāmṛśyate tadiva ābhāsata iti tadābhāsam ca tattvato asiddhādeḥ tathā bhāvena udbhāvyamāna tayośca yugapat saṃbhavāt iti sambandhaḥ

evaṃ manyate vādinā asiddhādīnāṃ sādhanadoṣāṇām anyenya tasmit prayukte tannodbhāvayati paraḥ kintu anyameva yadā; tadā kasya jayaḥ parājayo vā ? na kasyacit, anyathā dbayorapi sakṛt syāt, samataiva tu nyāyyā
ka evaṃ vyavasthāpayati ? sabhā iti cet; kutaḥ ? dvayorapi tattvasiddherabhāvāt, ekasya duṣṭasādhanavacanād anyasya anyadoṣaprakāśanāt
saiva tarhi tūṣṇīmbhāvamātraprakāśane'pi, kasyacidiṣṭasiddherabhāvāt anyathā sādhanopayogābhāvaṃ tayoḥ samatāṃ vyavasthāpayitumarhati
yadi punaḥ vādinaḥ taddoṣaprakāśanād itaro jayavān ityucyate; tiṣṭhatu tāvadetat asādhanāṅga ityādi kārikayā nirūpayiṣyamāṇatvāt
yadā parasya anyadoṣodbhāvanamudbhāvyate tadā vādī jayati ityeke; tat kena udbhāvyate ? vādineti cet; sakṛjjayetarau, parasyeva ātmano'pi doṣasya tenaiva prakāśanāt
etena sabhayā iti nirastam; sā hi yathā vādino'pi santaṃ doṣaṃ nopalakṣyate amadhyasthatāprasaṅgāditi

asādhanāṅgasya anuccāraṇaṃ tūṣṇīmbhāvaḥ adoṣodbhāvanaṃ doṣasya sato'pi aprakāśanam upekṣaṇaṃ dvayoḥ yathāsaṅkhena vādiprativādinoḥ nigrahasthānam iṣṭaṃ cet yadi kiṃ na kiñcit sādhyaiḥ sādhanaiśca jñātaiḥ ityadhyāhāraḥ
idamatra tātparyam--tatparijñānaṃ yadi svārthameva; parapratipādanā'saṃbhavāt, kutaḥ kasyacit kva kāruṇikatvaṃ yataḥ śiṣyopādhyāyavyavasthā
pratipādakābhāve vā kathaṃ kasyacit tatparijñānam ityapi cintyam
svata iti cet; sarvasya syāditi śāstrapraṇayanamanarthakam
parārtham apai ti cet; kimarthaṃ tūṣṇīmbhūtaḥ kaścit nigṛhyate ? sa tāvat pratipādanīyo yāvat tattvaṃ pratipadyate anyathā kimarthatṛrevā bhidhīyate--tāvad abhidhānīyaṃ yāvat pratipādyaḥ pratipadyate
kathaṃ paropanyastamajāna n taiḥ punaḥ punaḥ pratipādyate na punaḥ svasādhanam iti ko'yaṃ niyogaḥ--anyaḥ sarvaḥ pratipādyate na vādī prativādī veti ca
dasyutvāt iti cet; kathaṃ dasyutā ? samayāntarāveśāt; tata eva pratipādyate tadāveśaparityāgena pratipādakasamaye samāveśo yathā syāt
dṛśyante hi samayāntarānuṣaṅgiṇo'pi tatra viśeṣapratipādanavaśād anyamārgānusāriṇo bhavantaḥ
kecit na sarve iti cet; na tarhi kaścit pratipādyaḥ, nahi anyo'pi pratipādyamāno'bhīṣṭasamaya eva vartate, tatrāpravarttanasya kasyacit samayāntare pravarttanasya ca darśanāt

kathamevaṃ śiṣṭādiḥ dasyurna bhavet vādapravṛttikāle tatsamāveśāt, itarathā tatra pravṛttiḥ kutaḥ ? sarvadā neti cet; anyayopi sarvadā sa iti kuto niścayaḥ ? etena codyakṛt śiṣyo'pi dasyuḥ syāditi vijñeyam
atha nigrahabuddhyā pravṛtterdasyutā; uktamatra śiṣṭādeḥ syāt
kiñca, tūṣṇamāsīno yadi vādī dasyutvānna pratibodhyate, kevalaṃ na gṛhyate; tarhi vādinā'pi anena paro'ta eva na samīcīnasādhanāt pratibodhanīyaḥ, taṃ prati maunaṃ vidhātavyaṃ yatkiñcidvā bhāṣaṇīyam
evaṃ sati sa eva nigṛhīti cet; tatra ṭhakaprayogaḥ karttavyaḥ yato'sau vimukho bhavati, tatparijñānāya ca ṭhakāḥ sevanīyāḥ vādaṃ cikīrṣubhiḥ, na sādhanaparijñānārthaṃ tattvavādinaḥ
tatastatprayogāt nirmukhībhūta evaṃ vaktavyaḥ paryanuyojyo'pi ahamupekṣitastvayā tato nigṛhīto'si iti
tayā asādhutā syāditi cet; na; dasyunigrahe tadayogāt, anyatra samatvāt
idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam--sādhanāṅgaṃ yanna bhavati tasya vacanam, doṣo yo na bhavati tasya udbhāvanaṃ dvayornigrahasthānam iṣṭaṃ cet kiṃ punaḥ sādhyasādhanaiḥ iti
tathāhi--pratijñādivacanam asiddhādivacanaṃ ca bhūtadoṣamudbhāvya vādini nigṛhīte punaḥ punaḥ svapakṣasādhanāya prativādinaḥ prayāso nigrahasthānaṃ syāt
tathā'bhūtadoṣodbhāvanamudbhāvya prativādini vādinā nirjite punaḥ tasya svapakṣasādhanaṃ tādṛśameveti
paraḥ punaretat pariharati--naiva kaścit nigrahottarakālaṃ svapakṣasiddhaye yatate prayojanābhāvāt, vādinā ubhayaṃ karttavyam svapakṣasādhanaṃ parapakṣadūṣaṇam iti tu vādipravṛttiniyamārtham

vādinā hi na yatkiñcana bhāṣaṇīyam api tu svaparapakṣayoḥ sādhanadūṣaṇe, vādinā iti vacanāt, itarathā tasya nigrahaḥ syāditi; tanna sāram; yataḥ nāsādhanāṅgaṃ viruddhasādhanamatra gṛhyate, tasya pakṣasādhanaṃkatvena sādhanāṅgatvāt, tato nigrahasyābhimatatvāt, tasmāt nirākṛtapakṣatvameva nigrahasthānam iti vacanāt, api tu asiddhānaikāntikapratijñāditadvacanam asādhanāṅgavacanaṃ vādino nigrahasthānam
vādanyā॰ pṛ॰ 66 kuta etat ? tataḥ tatpakṣāsiddheriti cet; kiṃ punaḥ parasya pakṣasiddhirasti yato'sau vijayī ? na ca tajjayamantareṇa itarasya nigraho nāma, parasparāpekṣatvāt jayaparājayayoḥ
na svapakṣasiddhyā paro vādinamabhibhavati kintu tadvacanadoṣamātrāt
bhavatyeva tataḥ parapakṣasiddhiriti cet; na; itaradoṣamātrāt tadayogāt, anyathā sādhyasya yāni sādhanāni tadavinābhāvīni taiḥ kim ? kathaṃ caivaṃ vādino asiddhādiḥ viruddhād viśiṣyeta ?
sādhanasya siddheryannāṅgam asiddho viruddho'naikāntiko vā hetvābhāsaḥ tasyāpi vacanaṃ vādino nigrahasthānam asamarthopādānāt
tataḥ sthitam--asādhanāṅgasya vacanaṃ vādino nigrahasthānam iṣṭaṃ cet kiṃ punaḥ sādhyasādhanaiḥ iti
tathā adoṣasya udbhāvanaṃ prativādino nigrahasthānaṃ cintyam
yadā hi vādinā akalaṅkasādhane upanyaste paro'doṣodoṣamudbhāvayati; tadā tata eva cedasau nigṛhyeta kiṃ sādhyasādhanaiḥ sādhyasya siddhaye yāni sādhanāni upanyastāni taiḥ na kiñcit
paranigrahāya tadupanyāsaḥ sa ca anyata eva jāta iti manyate
nanu tadabhāve adoṣodbhāvanameva na jñāyate; tasya anyathāpi parijñānāt
kiṃca, samyaksādhanaprayoge yadā paro doṣaṃ nodbhāvayati tadā kuto'sau nigṛhyate ? tatprayogāditi cet; tata eva adoṣodbhāvane'pi nigṛhyatām
nahi tatprayogaḥ tadā tatprayogo bhavati, anyathā adoṣodbhāvanamapi duranvayam
athābhyata eva nigrahe kiṃ tataḥ tena ? ta eva tadbhāve kimanyataḥ tena iti samānam
ata eva āha--kiṃ punaḥ sādhyasādhanaiḥ iti
asyāyamarthaḥ--adoṣodbhāvanaṃ parasya nigrahasthānamiṣṭaṃ cet; kiṃ punaḥ sādhyasādhanaiḥ tat ? iṣṭam ityanuvarttate
syānmatam--adoṣodbhāvanaṃ sadapi ced vādī nigrahaṃ nodbhāvayate; tarhi paryanuyojyopekṣaṇāt sa eva nigṛhyate nirākṛtapakṣatvāt
tadubhayasya nigraha sthānamiṣṭamiti cet; āstāṃ tāvadetat vādino'nekahetūktau siddhivi॰ pari॰ 5 ityādinā nirūpayiṣyamāṇatvāt
aparaḥ prāha--na sādhusādhanaprayoge adoṣodbhāvanaṃ nigrahasthānamiṣṭam, api tu tadviparītaprayoge iti; tatrāha--kiṃ punaḥ sādhyasādhanaiḥ iti
tātparyamidamatra--vādinā hetvābhāse prayukte prativādinā ca adoṣe samudbhāvite na vādī prativādinaṃ nigṛhṇāti; sadoṣacetanasya jayābhāvāt, na tamantareṇa itarasya nigraho nāma
tathā sati prativādyapi vādinaṃ nigṛhṇīyāditi yugapat jayetarau syātām, tataḥ tayoḥ samataiva yuktā
tathāpi prativādina eva sthāpayantaḥ kathaṃ prāśnikā madhyasthā yato vāde apekṣante ? sādhyaṃ sādhyate yeṣu taiḥ sādhyasādhanaiḥ sabhyaiḥ kim iti

nanu syāt samatā yadi vādī prativādinaḥ adoṣodbhāvanaṃ nāvirbhāvayet, āvirbhāvane tu mataṃ na yatīti cet; tatredaṃ cintyate--svadoṣaṃ prakāśya, anyathā vā tadāvirbhāvayediti ? tatra na tāvadantyaḥ pakṣaḥ; svadoṣā'prakāśane mayā prayukto doṣaḥ anena nodbhāvito'pi kṛtya iti jñātumaśakteḥ
nāpi ādyaḥ; svayaṃ svadoṣaprakāśanāt tasyaiva nigrahaprāptiḥ ityuktatvāt
yadi punaḥ paratra bhūtadoṣaprakāśanāt jayaḥ svātmani bhūtadoṣovirbhāvanād viparyayo'pi syāt
atha bhūtadoṣodbhāvanaguṇena tiraskārāt nāsau doṣaḥ; tena asya tiraskārāt kathamayaṃ guṇaḥ ?

kiñca, yadi anyātmadoṣaprakāśanāt svadoṣāḥ svātmani doṣātmatāṃ jahati; tarhi asiddhādīnāṃ hetvābhāsānāmanyatamaṃ tadābhāsaṃ svayamevoccārya nivvaraṃ vaktavyam--mayā asiddho'nyo vā hetuḥ prayukto'pi kriyā nodbhāvita iti
tayā ca sasa māha-- vādinaḥ ityādi

vādinaḥ pūrvapakṣavataḥ tūṣṇīṃbhāvād asādhanāṅgavacanāt svaparapakṣayoḥ sādhanāṅgaṃ yanna bhavati pratijñādyadisiddhā di, tasya vacanāt, na punaḥ na sādhanāṅgavacanād asādhanāṅgavacanāt iti vyākhyānam, asya tūṣṇīṃbhāvāt ityanena gatatvāt
nigrahasthānaṃ paryante yasya jalpasya vādasya tasya parisamāptau satyām
athavā tasyaiva sādhanasya yannāṅgaṃ pratijñopanayanigamanādi tasya asādhanāṅgasya sādhanavākye upādānaṃ vādino nigrahasthānaṃ vyarthābhidhānāt

athavā siddhiḥ sādhanaṃ tadaṅgaṃ dharmo yasyārthasya vivādāśrayasya vādaprastāvahetoḥ sa sādhanāṅgaḥ tadvyatirekeṇāparasyāpyajijñāsitasya viśeṣasya śāstrāśrayavyājādibhiḥ prakṣepo moṣaṇaṃ ca paravyāmohanānubhāṣaṇaśaktivighātādihetoḥ, tadapyasādhanāṅgavacanaṃ vādino nigrahasthānamaprastutābhidhānāt
nanu vādivat prativādino'pi tūṣṇīṃbhāve yatkiñcanabhāṣaṇabhāve vā dvayoḥ samatvānna tatparisamāptiriti cet; atrāha--bhūta ityādi
tanna subhāṣitam-- vijigīṣuṇobhayaṃ karttavyaṃ svapakṣasādhanaṃ parapakṣadūṣaṇaṃ ca iti
bhūtadoṣaṃ tūṣṇīṃmbhāvādiparamārthadoṣam udbhāvya kathamudbhāvya ? ityāha--jitavān iti
yadi vā, tamu dbhāvya vādī jitavān yataḥ tataḥ punaḥ paścād vitarke ca punaḥ iti...svapakṣasiddhipratipatamātaḥ prativādī nigṛhyate
kutaḥ ? ityāha--tāvataiva bhūtadoṣodbhāvanamātreṇaiva prasyā vādinigraharūpasya parisamāpteḥ iti
anyathā tadaparisamāptiprajñākareṇa kathaṃ vādī nigṛhyate na kathañcit
tathāhi--tāṃ prati tatprayatnaḥ vādino nigrahārthaḥ, pratibodhanārthaḥ, satā pratibodhanārthaḥ, evameva vāditi catvāraḥ pakṣaḥ
tatra ādye pakṣe tadvaiphalyam; anyata eva tannigrahāt, tūṣṇīmbhāvāderapi ṭhakaprayogādbhāvāt
na hi parapratipādanāya kṛtāvāsanā doṣamātreṇa parāna nigraheṇa yojayanti śiṣyāṇi ca siddhāntadvayavedinaṃ prāśnikāḥ
caturthe tu vaktuḥ asambaddhābhidhāyitvam, sākṣisamakṣam ātmotkarṣajñāpanārthaṃ tāṃ prati yatate prativādī na tatparisamāptau nitarām ālokṣāthā jñāpitaḥ syāditi saiva kriyatām
atha tataḥ tatparisamāptau na kaścit svapakṣasiddhiṃ prati yatate iti; atrāha--tanna ityādi
kim ? ityāha--vijigīṣuṇā vādinā prativādinā vā ubhayaṃ karttavyam svapakṣasādhanaṃ parapakṣadūṣaṇam iti
tathāhi--prativādinā vijigīṣuṇā na tāvat tatkarttavyam api tu tena vādī yataḥ kutaścit nirmukhaḥ piśāco vā vidhātavyaḥ
yadi śābdo hetuḥ śābdaṃ pramāṇaṃ vā; anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti vacanādeva sādhyasiddheḥ kiṃ kṛtakatvādinā, tatsiddhau tadvacanaṃ nigrahasthānamiti

sākalyena vyāptahetuvacanāt punaḥ pakṣadharmatvavacanaṃ pratijñopanayavacanena samānaṃ bhavedvā na veti tathāgatarāgaṃ parityajya cakṣuṣī nimīlya samunmīlya vā cintaya tāvat tattathā sādharmyavaidharmyayoḥ sahavacanena sādhanavākyaṃ samānaṃ bhavedvā na vā ? yadi samānamiti kiṃ pratijñādivacanaireva ? sādhanasāmarthyaparijñānamubhayatra samānam
sākalyena a navayavena avinābhāve siddhe niścite sati
tata eva hetoḥ sakāśāt prasidhyati sati sādhya sattvādivādī va ādi śabdena upanayādiparigrahaḥ
pakṣadharmatvavādī sattvādi vādīva vat sadṛśaḥ sattvādivādī syāt ityarthaḥ
nahi anityaḥ śabdaḥ ityasmāt san kṛtako vā śabdaḥ ityādeḥ viśeṣaṃ paśyāmaḥ
api śabdāt yat sat kṛtakaṃ vā tadanityaṃ yathā ghaṭaḥ, san kṛtakaśca śabdaḥ ityādivākyavādī gṛhyate
hi upanayatigamana yugapat sādharmyavaidharmyaprayogavādino na viśiṣyate iti pravṛttau nirūpayiṣyate
sākalyena vyāptasya hetoḥ yat sat kṛtakaṃ vā tadanityaṃ yathā ghaṭaḥ ityādi yadvacanaṃ tasmāt punaḥ paścāt pakṣadharmatvavacanaṃ samānam sadṛśam

bhavedvā naveti tathāgatarāgaṃ sugatāgraham athavā tathā tena pratijñādivacanaṃ nigrahasthānam, pakṣadharmatvavacanam iti prakāreṇa āgatarāgaṃ parityajya cakṣuṣī nimīlya samunmīlya vā cintaya tā vat tattathā sādharmya vaidharmyayoḥ saha yugapat yat sat tadanityaṃ yathā ghaṭaḥ, saṃśca śabdaḥ, yadi nityaṃ na bhavati tat sadapi na bhavati yathā ākāśaṃ tathā ca śabdaḥ iti yad vacanaṃ tena samānam yat sat tat sarvamanityam ghaṭavat, saṃśca śabdaḥ ityādi sādhanavākyaṃ bhavedvā na vā ityādi sarvaṃvaktavyam
athavā tasyaiva sādhanasya yannāṅgaṃ pratijñopanayanigamanādi, tasyāsādhanāṅgasya sādhanavākye upādānaṃ vādino nigrahasthānaṃ vyarthābhidhānādeva
nanu anityaḥ śabdaḥ ityanena pratijñāvacanena saṃśca śabdaḥ iti pakṣadharmatvavacanaṃ samānaṃ bhāvyam, sādhyasyaiva nirdeśāt
yathaiva hi vipratipannaṃ prati śabdasya anityatvaṃ sādhyam, tathā sattvādikamapi anyathā tadvacanānarthakyaṃ syāt
anityaḥ śabdaḥ, kṛtakatvāt, yat kṛtakaṃ tadanityaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yathā ghaṭaḥ, kṛtakaśca śabdaḥ iti upanayavacanena ca
yathaiva hi śabdo'nityaḥ kṛtakatvāt ityanena ukta eva arthaḥ kṛtakaśca śabdaḥ ityanenocyate tathā yatkṛtakaṃ tadanityam ityanenoktameva kṛtakaśca śabdaḥ ityanenāpi ucyate
etena tasmādanityaḥ ityanena nigamanavacanena tatsamānamiti cintitam
yathā khalu hetusāmarthyena ukta eva artho nigamanena abhidhīyate tathā vyāptivākyena uktaḥ pakṣadharmatvavacanena

yathā vai khalu niścite'nvaye ukte vyatirekasya, avyatirekānvaya sya arthāpattyā gatiḥ tathā vipakṣasadbhāvabādhakapramāṇabalāt sākalyena vyāptasya avagatasya hetoḥ vacanāt pakṣadharmatvaṃ sapakṣe sattvam arthāpattyā avagamyate iti trirūpasādhanavākyaṃ kvopayujyata iti cet; atrāha--yadasamānam iti kiṃ pratijñādivacanairiva pratijñādivacanaireva kim iti, nigṛhyeta iti padaghaṭanā
nahi tadvacanaiḥ hetorvyāptiḥ khaṇḍyate tatparijñānaṃ vā yatastatpratibandhaḥ syāt
nanu parārthamanumānaṃ na hetudoṣādeva duṣṭam api tu vādidoṣādapi, asti ca doṣaḥ pratijñādivacanarahitasyāpi sādhanasya sādhyasiddhau yatsāmarthyaṃ tadaparijñānam, anyathā na tatprayogaṃ kuryāt
ko hi dhīmān anarthake jñānaṃ neva ātmānaṃ kleśayati iti cet; atrāha--sādhana ityādi
sādhanasya sattvādeḥ sāmarthyasya parijñānam ubhayatra pratijñādivacane pakṣadharmatvādivacane ca uktavidhinā samānam
tataḥ sattvādivādīva pakṣadharmatvādivādī ca pakṣadharmatvādivādyapi nigṛhyeta iti manyate
kiṃ ca, yadi parārthe anumāne sādhanasādharmyāparijñānaṃ doṣaḥ iti vādī nigṛhyeta tarhi saugatasya idamaparaṃ nigrahasthānaṃ syāditi darśayannāha--sattvādeva ityādi
kevalasyāpi bhāvasya vināśasādhanasāmarthyāt punaḥ utpatteḥ kṛtakatvādveti upādhiviśiṣṭopādānāt nigrahasthānam svaparavyāpārāpekṣabhāvalakṣaṇatvātteṣām
na hi yenāvaśyaṃ nigrahasthānaṃ tena śiṣyā vyutpādanīyāḥ
na hi śuddhasyāpi sādhanatve punarupādhyapekṣaṇaṃ yuktam

sattvād vidyamānatvād bhinnābhinnopādhirahitāt iti evakārārthaḥ kṣaṇasthāne kvacid dharmiṇi kṣaṇakṣaye siddhe niścite sati utpattyādau utpattiḥ ādiryasya kṛtakatvādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ, tasmin prayukte ityadhyāhāraḥ nigṛhyate vādī iti śeṣaḥ

nanu utpattiśabdena prāgasataḥ ātmalābhalakṣaṇaṃ sattvamucyate, kṛtakaśabdenāpi tadetā pekṣitaparavyāpārabhāvam, evaṃ prayatnānantarīyakatvādāvapi vaktavyam, tato yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ sattvāt ityukte na nigrahaḥ tathā utpatteḥ kṛtakatvāt prayatnānantarīyakatvād ityukte'pi na sa yuktaḥ
na hi śabdāntareṇa tadeva ucyamānaṃ nigrahāya jāyate anyathā dhūmo'pi tena ucyamāno jāyeta iti cet; atrāha--dharma ityādi
dharmeṇa prāgasattva-paravyāpārādirūpeṇa bhinnābhinnaviśeṣaṇena adhikasyoktitaḥ ukte sattvasya utpattyādinā iti ubhayatra vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yacchuddhasattvaṃ sattvaśabdenocyate tadeva utpattyādiśabdena yadyucyeta; na doṣo'yaṃ syāt
tadvacane ca sattvaṃ śuddhāśuddhabhedena bhinnā'bhinnaviśeṣaṇabhedena ca śiṣyavyutpādanārthaṃ sattvakṛtakatvādiśabdaiḥ abhidhīyate iti plavate
tulanā--yathā yat sat tat sarvaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ yathā ghaṭādayaḥ, saṃśca śabdaḥ
yat sat tatsarvamanityaṃ yathā ghaṭādiriti śuddhasya svabhāvahetoḥ prayogaḥ

kiṃca, kṛtakatvādiśabdeṣu saṅketamātrāśrayaṇaṃ na vyutpatteḥ kathamevaṃ sati prayatnānantarīyakatvasya sapakṣaikadeśavyāpakatvam, tasmin vā sādhye anityatvasya anaikāntikatvaṃ śuddhe sattve tadayogāt ? anena viśiṣṭaṃ taducyate notpattyādinā iti kiṃ kṛto vibhāgaḥ ?
nanu bhavatu dharmādidhikasya sattvasya abhidhānam utpattyādinā tathāpi kathaṃ tatra nigṛhyeta iti cet; atrāha--tad ityādi
tacchabdena sattvaṃ parāmṛśyate tasya sāmarthyaṃ kevalasya sādhanaśaktiḥ tasyānabhijñayā aparijñānena
evaṃ manyate yadi--śuddhasya sattvasya sādhanasāmarthyaṃ kiṃ viśeṣaṇananonye yattadupādā naṃ na nigrahasthānamiti
anye punarāhuḥ--notpattyādeḥ kvacit kṣaṇikatvaṃ sādhyate paramārthatastadabhāvāt, api tu tathāvabhāsanāt yathāvabhāsate ityādi vacanāt
tadeva ca sattvam upalambhaḥ sattā pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
54 iti vacanāt, tenāyamadoṣa iti; teṣāmapi idamevottaram
tadyathā sattvādeḥ kṣaṇikatvena avabhāsādeva sarvavastūnāṃ kṣaṇasthāne siddhe niścite aṅgīkriyamāṇe nigṛhyeta saugataḥ
nahi ekāntakṣaṇikatāvabhāsanaṃ sarvabhāvānāṃ dharmiṇāṃ dharmaḥ pratyakṣato'numānato vā siddhaḥ
na khalu cakṣurādibuddhau kṣaṇikatvena avabhāsamānā bhāvā bhāsanta iti niścayo'sti kuṇḍalādiparyāyānuyāyinaḥ sarpādayaḥ tatrāvabhāsante iti nirṇayāt
tatra anavasthodbhāvanam a rca ṭa sya svapakṣaghātīva lakṣyate
hetutrirūpatvaniścaye'pi tatsaṃbhavāt abhilāpyetarākāradvayasya tatropagamāt, itarathā nirvikalpakaikānte dharmadharmibhāvābhāvānna he tu bi ndo ra pi kalpanayāpi vyavasthā
ekāntena vibhinne ca te syātāṃ vastunī sa ca
niścayo hi artharūpe vikalpako'pi san svarūpe avikalpako bhavati

nanu pūrvaparyāyapratyakṣasya nottaraparyāye, tatpratyakṣasya pūrvaparyāye vṛttiriti kathaṃ tena tadanuyāyitvaṃ kasyacit pratīyate iti cet; tarhi svarūpamātraparyavasitaṃ tat kathamanyeṣāṃ grāhakaṃ yataḥ tat kṣaṇikatvāvabhāsanaṃ pratipadyeta, dharmapratipatteḥ dharmipratipattināntarīyakatvāt iti kathaṃ siddho hetuḥ ? ata eva nā'numānam; tadabhāve tadabhāvāt

yadi punaḥ saṃvṛtisiddhaṃ sarvaṃ kṣaṇikatvāvabhāsanamabhyupagamya hetoḥ siddhiḥ prārthyate; paro'pi saṃvṛtisiddham ekasya trikālānuyāyitvāvabhāsanamabhyupagamya asiddhaṃ tattathaiva vyavasthāpayedaviśeṣāt
atha svayam upalabhyamānādbhāvāt kṣaṇikatvāvabhāsanadharmānupalabhya sarve'pi taddharmakā vyavasthāpyante; atrāpi tadavasthaṃ codyam--kena tathā vyavasthāpyante ? nādhyakṣeṇa anumānena vā; uktadoṣāt
saṃvṛtyā tadvyavasthāpane tataḥ kṣaṇikatvamapi saṃvṛtisiddhaṃ syāditi na pāramārthikabhāvasvabhāvaniścaya iti mahatī saugatasya bhāvasvabhāvanirūpaṇakuśalatā !

kiṃvā svayam upalabhyamāneṣu bhāveṣu kṣaṇikatvam ? aparāparakoṭivicchinnateti cet; koṭigrahaṇapūrvakamadhyakṣaṃ yadi kasyacit tadvicchinnatvaṃ gṛhṇīyāt, na tarhi anugamagrahaṇaṃ dūṣitaṃ syāt, vicchinnatvavat tadviparyayasya anyagrahaṇasaṃbhavāt
anyathā cet; tathaiva anuyāyitvaṃ gṛhṇīyāt ityuktam
bhavatu vā kutaścit tatsiddhiḥ tathāpi hetusiddhita eva sādhyasiddheḥ anumānamanarthakam
taccenniścitam; kimaniścitaṃ yadanumānasādhyam ? tadvyavahāra iti cet; na; asya niścayātmakatvāt

kathaṃ caivaṃvādinaḥ savikalpapratyakṣagṛhīte vyavahārāya mā numānaṃ pravartteta ? kathaṃ vā bhāveṣu kṣaṇikatvamanicchantaḥ tathāvabhāsanamicchanti ? paramārthataḥ bhāvadharmapratipatterbhāvapratipattiṃnāntarīyakatvāt
kṣaṇikabhāvadharmaśca tathāvabhāsanam, anyathā ko hi bhāvadharmamicchan bhāvaṃ necchet pra॰ vā॰ svavṛ॰ 2
193 ityādi subhāṣitaṃ ? katham ? yathā ca kṣaṇikatvamanicchanto dṛśyante tathā tathāvabhāsanamapi
tataḥ sthitam--hetusiddhāveva siddhiḥ sādhyasya anumānamapārthakam nigrahasthānam
etadevāha--adhikoktitaḥ hetuniścayād adhikasya anumānasya uktito nigṛhyeta iti
yadi vā, kṣaṇikāḥ sarve bhāvāḥ tathāvabhāsanāt, yadi punaḥ tathāvabhāsamānā api tathā na syuḥ ni rūpatā syāt saṃvinniṣṭhatvāt prameyavyavasthiteḥ iti
etāvataiva cet prakṛtaṃ sidhyet nīlādivad ityane
na hi puruṣādvaitavādinaṃ prati dṛṣṭānte'pi paramārthasādhane upāyāntaramasti anavasthāpatteḥ
na ca taṃ prati kṣaṇikatvaṃ sādhyaṃ vivādā'viśeṣāt

yadi vā, ayamekāntaḥ--yad yathāvabhāsate tat tathaiva paramārthasat; tarhi stambhādayaḥ sthūlaikanānātvasvabhāvatayā pratibhāsamānāḥ tathaiva santa iti māyāmarīciprabhṛtipratibhāsatve'pi adoṣaḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
akramavat krameṇāpi sāṃśayitaika vastusaṃbhave ca kathaṃ pratijñāhetvoḥ saṃbhavaḥ ? tatpratibhāsaniṣedhe ca sarvaniṣedhanamiti nānumānotthānaṃ dharmā dyasiddheḥ
asamanta ścet taireva hetuḥ anaikāntika iti tadvacanāt nigṛhyeta
tadāha--dharmādhikoktitaḥ dharmaścāsau adhikaśca iti kāmacāreṇa viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvamiti adhikasya viśeṣyatvam
tathā sattvādeva kṣaṇasthānavad utpattyādau siddhe aṅgīkriyamāṇe saugato viruddhāvyabhicārihetuvacanāt nigṛhyeta
tasya hetusādhakasya pramāṇasya sādhye yat sāmarthyam, athavā tasya hetordṛṣṭāntarahitasya yat tat, yadi vā svahetoriva parahetorapi, tasyānabhijñayā
yadvā tasya hetorabhāvena tatsāmarthyasya vā anabhijñāyate
api śabdo bhinnaprakramaḥ, kevalasyāpi na kevalaṃ dhūmādeḥ kevalasya vināśaḥ sādhanaṃ sādharmyāt kāraṇāt punaḥ iti parāmarśe
upādhinā prāgasataḥ ityādinā viśiṣṭasya upādānā'prayogāt bhāvasya ityanuvarttate
nanu yathā kevalo bhāvaḥ sattvaśabdena ucyate, tadvad utpattyādiśabdairiti; atrāha— svapara ityādi
svaparayoḥ vyāpārayoḥ apekṣā yasya tau vā apekṣate iti tadapekṣaḥ sa cāsau bhāvaśca iti tallakṣaṇatvāt teṣām utpattyādīnām
svavyapārāpekṣabhāvalakṣaṇā utpattiḥ prāgasata ātmalābha utpattiḥ iti vacanāt abhinnaviśeṣaṇo bhāva evamuktaḥ
paravyāpārāpekṣabhāvalakṣaṇāḥ kṛtakatvādayaḥ apekṣitaparavyāpārohi bhāvaḥ kṛtakaḥ nyāyabi॰ 3
śuddhasya sāmarthyeti siddha vyutpādanārthaṃ tadviśiṣṭopādānamiti cet; atrāha--nahi ityādi
evaṃ manyate--yena prayukte avaśyaṃ nigrahasthānam na tena śiṣyāḥ tadanugrahāpravṛtteḥ vyutpādanīyā iti

idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam--kevalasya sajātīyavijātīyaviviktaniraṃśakṣaṇasya yo bhāvaḥ sattā viṣayiṇi viṣayopacārāt, vastuno vā upalambho vā tasyāpi na kevalam anyasya yat pareṇa vināśasādhanasāmarthyamabhyupagatam, yad upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaṃ yatra nopalabhyate tattatra nāsti yathā kvacitpradeśe tathāvidho ghaṭaḥ, upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptau ca pūrvāparakṣaṇau madhyakṣaṇe, sā vā tatra nopalabhyate ca
yadi vā yad yathāvabhāsate ityādi prayogāpekṣaḥ; tasmāt tasya nigrahasthānam

etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā pra jñā ka ra sya niraṃśādvaitavādinaḥ na kiñcit prāgasat utpadyate apekṣitaparavyāpāraṃ kṛtakaṃ vā, tathāpi taddhetu vadato nigrahasthānam tathā na tasya kasyacid bhāva upalambho vā svabhāvaviruddhasthūlaikasthirapratibhāsena bādhanāt, tathā tasyaiva tatsāmarthyāt punaḥ paścād upādhinā sapakṣasattvena viśiṣṭopādāna nigrahasthāna
yadi vā, pakṣadharmatvaṃ sapakṣe sattvam asapakṣe'sattvam upādhiḥ tadviśiṣṭahetoḥ upādānād iti grāhyam
tathā sva svavādī tayoḥ vyāpārau sādhanaprayogau tadapekṣo yo bhāvaḥ tallakṣaṇatvāt rūpatvācca teṣām, pra jñā ka ra gu pta ma prayuktavināśahetūnām nigra hasthānam iti sambandhaḥ
śakyaṃ vaktuṃ yad yatra yathā upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptam upalabhyate tat tattvataḥ tathā vidyate yathā citrajñānaṃ svākāreṣu, kathañcidupalabhyate ca tathāvidho bhāvaḥ svaparyāyeṣu kramabhāviṣu
tathā nirbādhabodhe yad yathāvabhāsate tat tathā paramārthasat svasaṃvedanavat, pratibhāsate ca sarvam utpādavyayadhrauvyātmakatvena
yathā yo yaṃ pratyanapekṣam ityādikamapi vācyam

nahi śuddhasyāpi hetudṛṣṭāntarahitasyāpi bhāvasya ityanuvarttate sādhanatve hetuhīnasya pratyakṣatvena, sādhyasādhakatvadṛṣṭāntarahitasya laṃgaṃdhe punaḥ upādhiḥ pakṣadharmatvāra pekṣaṇaṃ yasmin liṅge tattathoktam, upādhiḥ sapakṣasattvasya apekṣaṇaṃ yuktaṃ samartham upapannaṃ vā
sa tatsvabhāvaniyataḥ, yathā antyā kāraṇasāmagrī svakāryotpādane
punarapi tatraiva pūrvapakṣe dūṣaṇāntaraṃ darśayannāha--sarvanāmnā ityādi
sarvanāmnā vinā vākyaṃ taddhitena vinā padam

tulanā--sattvamātreṇa naśvaratvasiddhau utpattimattvakṛtakatvādivacanamatiriktaviśeṣaṇopādānāt kṛtakatvaprayatnānantarīyakādiṣu ca kapratyayātirekādasādhanāṅgavacanaṃ parājayāya prabhavet...--aṣṭaśa॰ aṣṭasa॰ pṛ॰ 86

kathaṃ kṛtakatvāditi hetuḥ kvacidvadataḥ svārthikasya kapratyayasya vacanam, yatkṛtakaṃ tadanityaṃ dṛṣṭamiti vyāptiṃ pradarśayate yattad vacanamadhikaṃ nāma nigrahasthānaṃ na syāt, tena vināpi tadarthapratipatteḥ
sarvatra vṛttipadaprayogādeva cārthāpratipattau saṃbhāvyamānāyāṃ vākyasya vacanaṃ kamarthaṃ puṣṇāti yenādhikaṃ na syāt...--ta॰ ślo॰ pṛ॰ 291
yattatpadaṃ ca doṣaḥ syāt pratītārthātayā sthiteḥ
kṛtaṃ sarvamanityaṃ hi dṛṣṭaṃ yadvad ghaṭādikam
sarvanāmnā vinā vākyaṃ taddhitena vinā padam
yat sat utpattimat kṛtakaṃ prayatnānantarīyakaṃ ceti vākyaṃ sadutpannamityādi saṃkṣeptavyaṃ sadanityamiti vā
tato varaṃ vināśī śabda iti prakṛtaṃ pratijñātum
saugatena liṅgapratipādakaṃ yad vākyam iṣyate tat saṃkṣeptavyam
tatraiva vākye yat padaṃ tadapi saṃkṣeptavyam iti sambandhaḥ
samāna evaḥ padasya padāntareṇa pratyayasya pratyakṣā yasyārthaḥ sa tathoktaḥ tena nigrahasthānaṃ tatra nīruṇā sogatena nā'pareṇa
taddhitīyo yaḥ svārthe kaḥ ityādi pratyayaḥ tena vinā
kṛtakam ityatra kṛtam ityeva prayoktavyamiti bhāvaḥ
kārikāṃ vivṛṇoti--yat sadutpattimat kṛtakaṃ prayatnānantarīyakaṃ ca ityādi
yadi ca iti śabdaḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate--yat sat tadanityaṃ yathā ghaṭaḥ saṃśca śabdaḥ ityevaṃ vākyam, evaṃ sarvatra yojyam
sadanityam iti, utpannam anityam iti, evaṃ sarvatra yojyam
nanu sarvanāmnā vinā vākyaṃ saṃkṣeptavyam ityuktam na dṛṣṭāntena vinā iti, tat kiṃ dṛṣṭānto bhaṇanīyaḥ ? ityatrāha--sada ityādi

vā iti pūrvahetusamuccaye, tataḥ sadanityam utpannamanityam kṛta ka manityam yannityamanityam ityevaṃ vipakṣehetusadbhāvabādhakapramāṇabalena vyāptau siddhāyāṃ niścitāyāṃ ca dṛṣṭāntasya akiñcitkaratvāt tathā tat saṃkṣeptavyam iti sambandhaḥ
tathā saṃkṣepe ko doṣaḥ; ityatrāha--tathā ca tenaiva anantaroktaprakāreṇa pratijñaiveyaṃ sadanityam ityādirūpā vyāptiḥ syāt
nahi śabdo'nityaḥ, sadanityam ityavasthayoḥ viśeṣo'sti, heturatra na kaścit syādityevakārārthaḥ
yadi punaḥ sadeva anityatvaṃ gamayet tarhi tasya sarvadā bhāvāt sarvadā tataḥ sādhyapratīteḥ vivādābhāvaḥ

bhavatu pratijñaiva tatra ko doṣaḥ ? ityatrāha--tataḥ tasmād uktāt nyāyād varaṃ vināśī śabdaḥ ityevaṃ prakṛtaṃ prastāvagocarāpannaṃ pratijñātuṃ yat prakṛtaṃ pratiyateta śirastāḍaṃ krandato'pi pratijñāyā anivṛtteriti manyate
nanu hetoḥ sādhyasiddhau kiṃ pratijñayā ? tasmin siddhau kiṃ hetunā iti cet ? atrāha— vi nāśī ityādi
yadi ca , uktanyāyena dṛṣṭāntasya akiñcitkaratve siddhe sati śabdatvāderasādhāraṇasya vacanaṃ hetoḥ na nigrahasthānamiti sadṛṣṭāntaṃ darśayannāha--vināśī ityādi
vināśī bhāva iti vā hetunaiva prasidhyati
antarvyāptyā hetoḥ sādhyapratyāyane śaktāvaśaktau ca bahirvyāpterudbhāvanaṃ vyartham
pakṣīkṛta eva sādhanasya sādhyena vyāptirantarvyāptiḥ anyatra tu bahirvyāptiḥ
yathā anekāntātmakaṃ vastu sattvasya tathaivopapatteḥ, agnimānayaṃ deśo dhūmavattvāt, ya evaṃ sa evaṃ yathā pākasthānam
tato yathā sattvaṃ śabdasya nityatve nopapadyate tathā śabdatvam
vā śabdaḥ ivārthaḥ, nipātānāmanekārthatvāt, vināśī bhāva ityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ
tato'yamarthaḥ--bhāvaḥ san sarvo vināśī sad anityam iti vacanāt, yathā hetunaiva na sadanityam iti pratijñāmātreṇa prasidhyati tathā dhvaniḥ śabdo vināśī iti hetunaiva prasidhyati
evaṃ manyate yathā sadanityam ityuktvā hetuṃ vadato na doṣaḥ tathā śabdo'nityaḥ ityuktvāpi iti
nanu na mayā sarvaṃ sad anityatvena vyāptaṃ hetoḥ sādhyate kintu pratyakṣataḥ

pratyakṣaṃ hi tada nityameva pratīyate iti cet; atrāha--antarvyāptau asiddhāyāṃ vivādasthāne sādhyena sādhanasya vyāptiḥ, tasyāṃ vipakṣe bādhakabalena asiddhāyāṃ satyām, dṛṣṭānte vyāptiḥ bahirvyāptiḥ asādhanaṃ sādhyasya iti śeṣaḥ
tato'ntarvyāptisiddhimicchatā sādhyavatyavat parokṣā sāpi hetoreva sādhyeti bhāvaḥ
dvitīyapātanikāyāṃ kārikāvyākhyānam--vināśī śabdaḥ iti yat pratijñātam, tat prasidhyati
kena ? ityāha--dhvaniḥ iti bhāvapradhāno'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ, iti śabdasya anantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ dhvanitvaṃ śabdatvam iti yo hetuḥ tenaiva, na hetvantareṇa
vā śabdaḥ pūrvatra draṣṭavyaḥ, itiśabdo'trāpi yojyaḥ
tato yathā bhāvaḥ vināśī bhāvaḥ ityanenaiva hetunā prasidhyati tathā prakṛtamapi iti

idamatra tātparyam--anityaḥ śabdaḥ ityatra dharmiśabdena aśabdavyāvṛtteḥ uktatvāt punaḥ śabdatvād iti yathā bhaṇituṃ na labhyate tathā sadanityam ityatra sacchabdena asadvyāvṛtteḥ kathanāt sattvāt ityapi
nanu yat sat tatsarvam anityam ityetena sarvasya asato vyāvṛtteḥ uktatvāt saṃśca śabdaḥ ityapi tādṛśameva
vipakṣe hetoḥ sadbhāvabādhakaṃ yat pramāṇaṃ tasya yā vyāvṛttiḥ tasyāṃ satyāṃ hetusāmarthyaṃ liṅgasya svaliṅgijñāpanaśaktiḥ

sā kutaḥ ? ityāha--anyathā anyena sādhyābhāvaprakāreṇa yā anupapattiḥ liṅgasya aghaṭanā tasyā eva na pakṣadharmatvasapakṣasattvābhyām iti evakārārthaḥ, tato yathā vipakṣe bādhakapramāṇavṛttyā hetusāmarthye darśite'pi dṛṣṭāntādikamantareṇa tadapratipannavantaṃ prati dṛṣṭāntavacanaṃ tathā pratijñāvacanamantareṇāpi tadapratipatti jñā vacanamiti manyate
tato vipakṣabādhakapramāṇavṛttinyāyād yathā sattvaṃ śabdasya anyasya vā nityatve sati nopapadyate tathaiva śabdatvam iti śabdavat śabdatva mapi hetuḥ iti bhāvaḥ
nanu pakṣa eva sādhanasya sādhyena vyāptiḥ antarvyāptiḥ, sā ca dviṣṭhasambandhasaṃvittiḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 1
1 ityādi vacanāt sādhye pratipanne pratīyeta nānyathā
asmādeva; iti cet; anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ--siddhe ataḥ sādhye asya antarvyāptisiddhiḥ, asyāñca sādhyasiddhiḥ
tataḥ sākalyavyāptiḥ śreyasī iti cet; atrāha--sākalyena ityādi
pakṣe sapakṣe ca sarvatra sādhyasādhanayoḥ vyāptiḥ sakalavyāptiḥ
bahirvyāptimātraṃ na sādhanam, sākalyavyāptiḥ sādhyasiddhimākṣipatyeva, tataḥ śreyān sādhyanirdeśaḥ
tato'ntarvyāptireva śreyasī, tadabhāve sākalyena vyāptisādhane bahirdṛṣṭāntābhāvāt na kaścit hetuḥ syāt
tadbhāvahetubhāvayoravācyatvād kiṃ viduṣaḥ prati tādātmyatadutpattipradarśanena dṛṣṭāntena ? yaduktasyāsamarthane sādhanasya nigrahasthānaṃ syāt
sādhyadharmiṇi atra ca sādhyena sādhanasya vyāptiḥ sākalyena vyāptiḥ kathaṃ na kathañcid bhavet antarvyāptyā vinā tayā syād iti yāvat
bahiriva sādhyadharmiṇyapi vyāpteḥrvāditarathā prādeśityu vyāptiḥ syāt
tayaiva bhavatu seti cet; tatpratipattau kathamātmadoṣam ātmani pariharet ? atha pakṣe sā na pratīyate api tu sapakṣe; na tarhi tatpratipattiḥ sākalyavyāptipratipatteḥ atadrūpatvāt
yadi punastatra tatpratipaśepattirne ṣyate; kathamevam atiprasaṅgo na bhavet
vajrasya lohalekhyatvasādhane pratyakṣavirodhāt tanmātraṃ na sādhanam
yatra tu na tadvirodhaḥ tatra sādhanameva iti paraḥ; na; tādātmyapratibaṃdhyabhyavepi tadvirodhasaṃbhave anyatra kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ ? lakṣaṇayukte bādhāsaṃbhave tallakṣaṇameva dūṣitaṃ syāt
tatpratibandhabhāvaḥ punaḥ kāṣṭhādau ya ta eva pārthivatvaṃ tata eva lohalekhyatvadarśanāt
tata eva tasya sadbhāve nityaṃ tadabhāva prasaṅgo nāśavat iti cet; na; yogyatāyā nityamavirodhāt
kāṣṭhādeḥ pārthivasya lohalekhyatve'pi na sarvasya tadbhāvo viparyaye bādhakābhāvāditi cet; tarhi sakalavyāptiḥ abhyupagatā syāt
tatheti cet; atrāha--sākalyena vyāptiḥ sādhyasiddhim ākṣipatyeva, tadabhāve tatpratipatterayogāt iti manyate
tulanā--lakṣaṇayukte bādhāsaṃbhave tallakṣaṇameva dūṣitaṃ syāditi sarvatrānāśvāsaḥ

yata evaṃ tataḥ tasmāt śreyān sādhyanirdeśaḥ pratijñāvacanam, anyathānupapannatvopetahetunirdeśe tadanirdeśaḥ praśasyaḥ, tato'pi tannirdeśo bālabuddhya nugrahārthatvāt praśasyatara iti śreyān ityucyate
yadi vā, tasmāt sākalyena vyāptiḥ tadgṛhītiḥ viṣayiṇi viṣayopacārāt sādhyasiddhim ākṣipatyeva tataḥ śreyān sādhyanirdeśaḥ
evaṃ manyate--sākalyavyāptyākṣiptasyāpi sādhyasya punaḥ hetoḥ sādhanaṃ tathā pratijñāvacanenāpi iti śabdatvasādhananirdeśasya praśasyamasamarthanāha māha--krama ityādi
nanvetad vipakṣe ityādinā samarthitam kiṃ punaḥ samarthyate ? na asya anyathāvatārāt
tathāhi--sākalyena vyāptiḥ sādhyasiddhim ākṣipatyeva, yadi sakalavyāpakapratipattināntarīyakā sakalavyāpyasya tadavinābhāvasambandhapratipattiḥ
na caivam, kintu vipakṣe bādhakapramāṇapūrvikā iti cet; atrāha--krametyādi
tataḥ kiṃ jātam ? ityāha--yata evaṃ tato'ntarvyāptiḥ eva na bahirvyāptiḥ sākalyavyāptirvā śreyasī iti

itaśca saiva śreyasī; ityāha--tadabhāve vipakṣe bādhakapramāṇavṛttyabhāve sākalyena anavayavena sattvādeḥ anyasya yā vyāptisādhane vyāptisiddhau kriyamāṇāyāṃ bahirdṛṣṭāntābhāvāt na kasyacit svabhāvaḥ kāryaṃ vā hetuḥ syāt
yaduktaṃ pareṇa--lakṣaṇakāle dharmī prayogakāle dharmadharmisamudāyaḥ vyāptigrahaṇakāle sādhanadharmaḥ pakṣaḥ
iti; tadanena nirastam; na hi yāvān kaścid bhāvaḥ dhūmo vā sa sarvo'pi vināśa-dahanābhyāṃ vyāptaḥ iti; atrāha--nya pakṣa kalpanā phalavatī
nanu sākalyena vyāptisādhane bahirdṛṣṭāntābhāvāt mābhūt tadanveṣaṇam vipakṣe bādhakavṛtteḥ tatsiddheśca, prayogasamaye tu tadbhā vādanveṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti; atrāha--tadbhāva ityādi
kān prati ? ityāha— viduṣaḥ prati vipakṣe hetusadbhāvabādhakapramāṇapravṛttipravijṛmbhitahetusāmarthyaparijñānavataḥ prati
etaduktaṃ bhavati--tādātmyatadutpattī dṛṣṭānte na pradarśyaṃte sādhanasya te cedanyato jñāyete kiṃ tena ? yaduktam--
khyāpyete viduṣāṃ vācyo hetureva hi kevalaḥ || pra॰ vā॰ 3 | 27 iti
kiṃbhūtena dṛṣṭāntena kim ? ityatrāha--yaduktasya yena dṛṣṭāntena asamarthane
kiṃbhūtasya ? uktasya uccaritasya nigrahasthānaṃ syāt tena dṛṣṭāntena kim iti sambandhaḥ
idamaparamasya vyākhyānaṃ yat pareṇoktam--aviduṣaḥ prati dṛṣṭāntenoktasya svaśabdena pratipāditasya sādhanasyāsamarthane nigrahasthānaṃ syāt
tatra pūrvapakṣe sādhanasya doṣavattvāt nigrahasthānaṃ syāt ityeva yuktam saiva nirdoṣatā dṛṣṭāntena prakāśyate iti; na; tasyā anyathāpi prakāśanāt ityuktaprāyam
pūrvake tu vyākhyāne tatra ityādi dūṣaṇāntaram ūhyam
yathā yena prakāreṇa vādinā ukto doṣaḥ tena udbhāvanāyāṃ prativādinaḥ sāmarthyaṃ tasmāt prativādino nigrahasthānaṃ yuktam anyathā doṣasya sato'pyaprakāśanāt prativādī nigṛhyeta
idaṃ vyākhyānaṃ cintyam, doṣabadvena sādhanasya, vādinigrahādhikāre anyānadhikārāt

tathāhi--vādinā doṣa iti sādhane prayukte'pi yadā prāśnikāḥ tasya nigrahaṃ vyavasthāpayanti prativādinaḥ tadudbhāvanamapekṣya, tadā sa tam, anyaṃ do dbhāvayet, na kiñcidvā udbhāvayet iti trayaḥ pakṣāḥ
tatra prathamapakṣe yathā prayukte'pi doṣe tatprakāśanāpekṣā tathā tatra prakāśite'pi tatparihārāpekṣā punaḥ tatsamarthanāpekṣā ityanavasthā
yadi punaḥ bhūtadoṣodbhāvanāmātreṇa prativādinaḥ te jayaṃ vyavasthāpayati ; tarhi vādino'pi taddoṣaprayogamātreṇa parājayaṃ vyavasthāpayeyuḥ alaṃ dvitīyopanyāsāpekṣaṇena
atha tāvanmātreṇa parasya tathodbhāvanāsāmarthyaṃ na jñāyate iti tadupanyāsāpekṣaṇam; tarhi tadupanyāsamātreṇa itarasya tatparihārasāmarthyamapi na jñāyata iti tṛtīyopanyāsāpekṣaṇaṃ haṭhādāpatati
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt na tatsarvam anityam iti vyāptivacanaṃ pratijñām atiśete

atrāha paraḥ--yaduktam sākalyena vyāptisādhane nahidṛṣṭānto bhāvāt iti; sāram vivādagocarasya bhāvasya kṣaṇikatvena vyāptisādhane anyasya dṛṣṭāntabhāvāditi; tatrottaramāha--na kṣaṇādūrdhvamasthānam ityādi
arthakriyāyāḥ kuto vipakṣād vyāvṛttiḥ kṣaṇikapakṣe pratyakṣatānupapatteḥ
tanna ādhikyadoṣamudbhāvya paramārthavādinaṃ paro vijayate iti ghaṭāmupaḍhaukate
parimāṇotpradantara vyatikramakālaḥ kṣaṇaḥ tata ūrdhvaṃ bhāvasya yadava sthānaṃ vināśaḥ tatpratyakṣaṇāt na prasidhyati
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadi kṣaṇiko bhāvaḥ kvacit pratyakṣasiddhaḥ syāt tannidarśanena anyo'pi tathā syāt

syānmatam--pūrvāparakoṭivicchinnasya madhyakṣaṇasya tadviviktayorvā tatkoṭyoḥ pratyakṣeṇa upalambhāḥ , anyathā ekakṣaṇa mānaṃ prasajyeta, tatra kevalaṃ dṛśyānupalabdheḥ abhāvavyavahāraḥ sādhyate iti; tatrāha--tatra ityādi
etuduktaṃ bhavati--tatra ekānte yadi upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaṃ kiñcid bhavati tasya anupalambhābhāvaḥ tadvyavahāro vā prasidhyet, na caitadasti ityuktaprāyam
tallakṣaṇaprāptaṃ tasya anupalambhāt tatra abhāvaḥ sidhyet
sa tu naikāntena, akrameṇeva krameṇāpi ekasya anekarūpasaṃbhavāditi ca, tattasya kasyacidbhāvasya kṣaṇakṣayadarśanāt sarvasya tena vyāptisiddhiriti sthitam
yatpunaruktam a rca ṭe na--sattvasya vipakṣād vyāvṛtteḥ kṣaṇikatvena vyāptisiddhiḥ na bahirdṛṣṭāntabalena, dṛṣṭāntavacanaṃ tu kāryahetvapekṣayā svabhāvaviśeṣāpekṣayā ca
kuto na kutaścit pramāṇāt vipakṣād akṣaṇikābhimatād vyāvṛttiḥ
tayā hi sattvaṃ vyāptam, sā tato vyāvarttamānā tadādāya nivartteta; saiva tu tato na nivarttate
yadā hi kṣaṇikapakṣe kramayaugapadyābhyāṃ pratyakṣā arthakriyā bhavati tadā kutaścit tayoḥ nivṛttau sā vinivarttate
yadā tu akṣaṇikavad itaratrāpi na pratyakṣā, tadā kutaḥ sā tata eva vyāvartteta iti bhāvaḥ
yathā yatsat tatkṣaṇikameva, akṣaṇikatve arthakriyāvirodhāt tatlakṣaṇavastutvaṃ hīyate
yata evaṃ parasya sadanityam ityādi saṃkṣepakaraṇaṃ prasaktam tat tasmāt na ādhikyādidoṣam udbhāvya paramārthavādinaṃ paraḥ prativādī vijayate ityetad ghaṭāmupaḍhaukata iti
yadi punaḥ ādhikyādidoṣamudbhāvya paramārthavādinaṃ paro vijayate, nahīdam aparaṃ dūṣaṇam iti darśayannāha--sādhyokti ḥ sādhanam ityādi

na hi...etāvatā prakṛtārthaparisamāptau kiṃ sattvakṛtakatvādinā ? nanveta tadapyuktam--nāsamarthitameva sādhanamiṣyate nigraha prāpteḥ śabdatvaṃ sādhanameva sādhyavyāpakasvabhāvatvāt sākalyena anityatvasādhane sattvādivat tadekalakṣaṇopapatteḥ, anyathā dṛṣṭānte satyapyagamakatvāt
vacanam uktiḥ anityatvaviśiṣṭā sādhyā cāsau uktiśca anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti
kutaḥ ? ityāha--śabdasya a vi nivṛttau apariṇāme a saṃbhavāt kāraṇāt sādhyoktiḥ sādhanam iti
tataḥ kiṃ jātam ? ityāha--na bhāvaḥ kṛtakatvaṃ vā sādhanam ityanuvarttate, śabdā'nityatvasya ra va saṃbhāvi vacanād anyata eva siddheḥ

yadi punaḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ ityuktvā sattvāt kṛtakatvādvā iti brūyāt; tarhi uktasya śabdatvasya svayamasamarthasya tatsāmarthyāparijñānena sattvādikamucyamānaṃ hetvantaratayā nigrahasthānaṃ syāditi manyate
nanu yadi śabdo hetuḥ; tasya sadā bhāvāt tataḥ sadā sādhyapratīteḥ na kadācit kasyacit nāma nityatve vivādaḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--asādhanam ityādi
bhāvaḥ kṛtakatvaṃ vā etad iha anuvarttate
tato'yamarthaḥ--bhāva iva kṛtakatvamiva śabdaḥ sādhanaṃ nāsamarthitam api tu samarthitameva
samarthanaṃ ca tasya na sadā iti kutaḥ tataḥ sarvadā vya pratītiḥ, itarathā anyatrāpi samānametat
etāvatā śabdasya pariṇāmamantareṇa asaṃbhavamātreṇa prakṛtārthaparisamāptau śabdapariṇāmasiddhiniṣpattau kiṃ sattvakṛtakatvādinā prayuktena ityadhyāhāraḥ
nanu sarvasya sarvadā bhāvād arthapratīterna vivāda iti cet; atrāha--nanu ityādi
na ca sarvadā tatsamarthanam, yatastathaiva sādhyapratītiriti bhāvaḥ
nanu dṛṣṭāntena tatsamarthana ca so'tra iti cet; atrāha--śabdatvaṃ śrāvaṇatvaṃ vā sādhanameva asādhanaṃ na bhavati
sādhyaścāsau vyāpakaśca saḥ svabhāvo yasya tasya bhāvāt tattvāt
kveva kimite tyāha sākalyena anityatvasādhane sattvādivat
etadapi kutaḥ ? ityāha--tasya ekaṃ yallakṣaṇaṃ tasya upapatteḥ, anyathā ekalakṣaṇopapattyabhāvaprakāreṇa dṛṣṭānte satyapi agamakatvāt
yathā prayatnānantarīyakaḥ anityatvād ghaṭavat atra sādhyasādhanayoḥ tādātmyaṃ siddham, anyathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ prayatnānantarīyakatvāt ityādi na syāt
nahi idaṃ sādhyaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ tādātmyaṃ jahāti
yaduktam a rca ṭe na--prayatnānantarīyakatvasvabhāvam anityaṃ sādhanameva tanmātram hetubi॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 74 iti; na; sarvānaikāntikavilopaprasaṅgāt
yadi prayatnānantarīyakatvamantareṇāpi kṛtakatvasya bhāvādatatsvabhāvatvam; anityatve'pyayameva vṛttāntaḥ

tataśca tādātmyavirahāt prayatnānantarīyakatvasyānityatvenānvayo na syāt, tannivṛttau vā nivṛttiriti kathaṃ tatastat pratīyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; prayatnānantarīyakapadārthasvabhāvasyaiva anityatvasya tena sādhanāt
punarapi ādhikyādidoṣodbhāvanāt paramārthavādiparājaye dūṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha--sa vā manuktvā ityādi
sa tāmanuktvā vā'nuktaṃ sādhanaṃ cet samarthyate
pakṣamanuktvā sādhanaṃ bruvan svayaṃ pakṣīkaroti, punaḥ samarthanāt
sādhanaṃ yadi anuktvā samarthayet kiṃ yatkṛtakam ityādinā ? parasya sādhanamapratyuccārya dūṣaṇasaṃbhave kathamanuktaṃ na samarthyate ? tadubhayatrāviśeṣāt
saṃvāsa nityaḥ sa tām anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti pratijñāmanuktvā tadvacane nigrahaprāptiḥ anarthakābhidhānādvā vaṃvet kim ? ityāha--sādhanaṃ sattvādiliṅgam
atradūṣaṇam--samarthyate asiddhaviruddhānaikāntikatvamalavikalaṃ kriyate kinna, kinnakārayoḥ vyavahitayoḥ abhisambandhaḥ
nanvevaṃ sādhanāṅgasyābandhanā nigrahasthānam; uktasya samarthane pratijñāvacanaṃ svayamabhyupagataṃ nigrahasthānam ityubhayathā yāptārajjaḥ
syādetat, uktaṃ sādhanaṃ kimiva samarthyate ? ityāha--sādhyavat śabdānityatvavad iti

anuktasya samarthane ko doṣaḥ iti cet ? ucyate--sādhyavat tatra vipratipattau sādhanāntarāt samarthitāt samarthanam, tasyāpi anuktasyaiva samarthanaṃ tadantarāt tasyāpi anuktasyaiva tadantarāt ityanavasthānāt sādhanaprayogo'navasaraḥ
kiṃ ca, vādinā ubhayaṃ karttavyam— svapakṣasādhanaṃ parapakṣadūṣaṇaṃ ca
tava pratipakṣaḥ tadā dūṣito bhavati yadā pratijñādinigamanaparyantaṃ sādhanavākyaṃ dūṣayati
tacca uccārya yadi saugato vādī dūṣayati; kathaṃ pratijñāprayogo nigrahadāyī na bhavet ? iti darśayannāha--dūṣyam ityādi
dūṣyam nirākaraṇamanyadīpaṃ sādhanam ityanuvarttate, pakṣādīnām upalakṣaṇabhūtam
pratyuccārya pūrvapakṣayitvā dūṣyate nirākriyate kim ityanena sambandhaḥ
śāstre vādakāle vā pūrvapakṣo na karttavyaḥ anyathā pratijñāvacanamavaśyaṃbhāvīti manyate
etena naiyāyikādeḥ vādinaḥ saugataḥ prativādī sādhanaṃ pratyuccārya dūṣayan nirasto veditavyaḥ
yadi punaḥ niyamena tadapratyuccārya dūṣyate; tatrāha--dūṣyaṃ ca ityādi
yathā sādhanamapratyuccārya dūṣyate tathā anuktaṃ kinna samarthyate ?
śabdo'nityaḥ iti pakṣam anuktvā sādhanaṃ bruvan saugataḥ pakṣīkaroti svayam ucyamānaṃ sādhanaṃ sādhyaṃ karoti
kutaḥ ? ityatrāha— punaḥ tadvacanottarakālam samarthanād asiddhādidoṣavikalatayā vyavasthāpanāt sādhanasya iti vibhaktipariṇāmena padaghaṭanā
anuktaṃ tat samarthyate ityatrāha--sādhanaṃ yadi samarthayet anuktvā pakṣavat
dūṣaṇasaṃbhave dūṣaṇodbhāvanaṃsaṃbhave sādhanasya iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
katham sādhanamayuktaṃ yuktyā na samarthyate samarthyetaiva
tasya evaṃvacanasya ubhayatra sādhanasya dūṣaṇā samarthane vā viśeṣāditi

tataḥ kiṃ parasya jātam ? ityatrāha--tadanyataroktau tayoḥ sādhana-tatsamarthanayoḥ anyatarasya sādhanasyaiva samarthanarahitasya samarthanasyaiva vā sādhanarahitasya uktau satyāṃ yat pareṇa nigrahasthānam uktam ekatra uktasya sādhanasya asamarthanam anyatra sādhanāṅgasya avacanam tadayuktam ubhayavacane'pi tadaviśeṣāt iti manyate
yaduktaṃ pareṇa--śabdaḥ pramāṇāntaraṃ ca ityatra yadi śabdo liṅgaṃ tata eva tarhi sakalasamīhitasiddheḥ anyahetūpādānāt vādino nigrahasthānam iti; tatrāha--vādino'nekahetūktau ityādi
vādino jainādeḥ nigṛhītiḥ kailetyaruvā viṣyate saugatena
kasmin ? ityāha--anekahetūktau ekatra sādhye anekasya jñāpakasya uktau satyāṃ prakāśitaprakāśanavat, ekena hetunā gate'rthe anyavaiphalyāditi manyate paraḥ

tatredaṃ cintyate--vādinā ubhayaṃ karttavyaṃ svapakṣasādhanaṃ parapakṣadūṣaṇamiti saugato vādī svahetumekamabhidhāya parapakṣe anekānte virodhavaiyadhikaraṇyānavasthā'bhāvādidoṣamanekaṃ vadan nigṛhyate, ekasmādeva doṣāt paraparājaye anyavaiphalyam
tarhi tena sarvatra ekameva dūṣaṇaṃ vaktavyamiti niyamena kārtsnyena parapakṣo dūṣitaḥ syāt
atha dvirbaddhaṃ subaddham iti vacanād anekadūṣaṇavacane'pi na nigṛhīti terata eva anekahetuvacane'pi na syāt
etadeva darśayannāha— nānekadūṣaṇasyoktau vādino nagṛhītiḥ ityanuvarttate
yadi vā, vādinaḥ anekahetūktau nigṛhītiḥ iti vacanāt prativādī tadudbhāvane jayavān vaktavya itarathā tadayogāt
tatra ca vādino'nekadoṣasaṃbhavaḥ, anekasya vacanaṃ sena doṣo vacana parasya sarvasyāvacane anekahetuvacanavat prasaṅgaḥ
kārikāṃ vyācaṣṭe--sādhanasya pratipakṣasādhanasya vādinā upanyastasya ca ekadoṣamudbhāvya śeṣasya sato'pi doṣasya anudbhāvanāt prativādinaḥ sakṛjjayaparājayau syātām
punaḥ anekadoṣodbhāvane kathamanekasādhanaṃ vā nama atiśayīta prativādī iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
pratijñādivacanopālambhacchalena nyāyavādinamapi nigrahaṇena saṃyojya ātmānaṃ manyamānaṃ paramupahasannāha--pakṣam ityādi

svapakṣasthāpanāhīno'pi prativādī tattvaṃ sādhayantaṃ siddherapratibandhakaṃ doṣaṃ vitaṇḍayodbhāvayan jayatīti phalguprāyam, samarthayoreva vivādāt kathamanyataro vaitaṇḍikaḥ saṃbhāvyeta ? na vai tadanyataro vaitaṇḍikaḥ sādhanaṃ pratyucārya dūṣayataḥ prativādinaḥ pratyavasthānāt, svayaṃ kathañciduttaramabhidhāyeti vā, tathā tayorvaitaṇḍikatve paripūrṇo vādanyāyaḥ syāt !
pakṣam svābhipretamarthaṃ sādhyāvinābhāvisādhanena sādhayan na nigṛhṇīyāt
api śabdaḥ bhinnaprakramaḥ vaitaṇḍika ityasya anantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ, vaitaṇḍiko'pi svapakṣasthāpanāhīno'pi sa pratipakṣasthāpanāhīno jalpo vitaṇḍā
3 iti vacanāt, pratipakṣo hastipratihastinyāyena svapakṣa ucyate ced yadi tatra doṣo vādanyāyo mahānayam vādanyāyo na bhavati kintu vitaṇḍā syāt
kiṃ kurvan sa taṃ nigṛhṇīyāt ? ityatrāha--doṣamudbhāvayan, pakṣaṃ sādhitavantam iti vacanāt pakṣasiddhyapratibandhakamudbhāvayanniti gamyate
uttarapakṣavādī vaitaṇḍikaḥ prathamavādiprasādhyamānapakṣāpekṣayā hastipratihastinyāyena pratipakṣa ityucyate tamasāvabhyupagacchatyeva na tatra sādhanamupadiśati parapakṣamevākṣipannāste
kam ? ityāha--tattvaṃ sādhayantaṃ vaitaṇḍikasya iyameva gatiḥ yat yathākathañcit jayati iti cet; atrāha--samarthayoḥ ityādi
samarthayoreva samyaksādhanadūṣaṇavacane śaktayoreva nā'samarthayoḥ vādiprativādinoḥ vivādāt samarthasyāsamarthana tasya vā samarthena saha vivādāsaṃbhavāt pracaṇḍabhūpatere va klīveneti
katham anyataro vādī prativādī vā vaitaṇḍikaḥ saṃbhāvyeta tasya tadviparītatvāt
syānmatam--vādinā samyaksādhane prayukte prativādī bhūtadoṣamapaśyan yadi pratijñādivacanaṃ siddherapratibandhakamapi santaṃ nodbhāvayet tasya aikāntikaḥ parājayaḥ syāt
yadā vādī tathaiva pariharati tadā parājayaḥ
aparihāre anyathāparihāre vā vādyeva parājīyate aikāntikaparājayādvaraṃ sandehaḥ iti prativādī vaitaṇḍiko bhūtvā pratijñādivacanamudbhāvayati
tathā vādyapi tasmin udbhāvite tathā yadi uttaraṃ na vadati tarhi tasya aikāntikaḥ parājayaḥ syāt, uttaramātre tu ukte sandehaḥ

yadā paraḥ tathaiva dūṣayet jayavān syāt adūṣaṇe anyathādūṣaṇe vā parājayavān iti aikāntikaparājayavān iti, aikāntikaparājayād varaṃ sandehaḥ iti vādyapi vaitaṇḍiko bhūtvā uttaramātraṃ dadātīti nāthonaro vaitaṇḍikaḥ api tu dvāvapi vaitaṇḍikāviti
na vai naiva tadanyataro vādiprativādinoḥ anyataraḥ vaitaṇḍikaḥ kintu dvau api vaitaṇḍikau iti bhāvaḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha--pratyuccāyyante dya , anyathā ananubhāṣaṇaṃ nigrahasthānaṃ syāt
kim ? ityāha--sādhanaṃ vādi hecchaṃ tatkiṃ kurvataḥ ? dūṣayataḥ pratijñādivacanopālambhacchalena nirākurvataḥ
tasya kim ? ityāha-- prati vasthānāt nirākaraṇāt
katham ? ityāha— kathañcit yatkiñcid uttaramabhidhāya iti śabdaḥ pūrvapakṣasamāptau, vā iti parābhiprāyadyotane
atra dūṣaṇamāha--tathā tena uktaprakāreṇa tayorvādiprativādinorvaitaṇḍikatve abhyupagamyamāne vādanyāyaḥ paripūripūrṇatyāt upahasanaparametat
tathāpi aikāntikaparājayādvaraṃ sandeha iti yuktaṃ tatprayogakaraṇena sphuṭāṭopakaraṇam

kiñca, idamasiddhaṃ dravyo yadi pratijñādivacanāt samīcīnasādhanavādyapi vādī nigrahārhaḥ kathamasau jetā tadvacanarahitasādhanavacanena iti cet ? etat pūrvārdhena pradarśya uttarārdhena ca dūṣayannāha--kārikāṃ jalpāka ida kā
vādinaḥ...sādhananāṅgavacanāt prativādino nigrahasthānaprāpteḥ tathānupapatteriti phalguprāyamiti; sādhanapratyuccāraṇavat doṣāntarokti-anuktiprabhṛtibhiḥ doṣavatsādhanavādināpi punarnigṛhyeta

kasyacid vipratipattau apratipattau vā parasya svapakṣasiddhimantareṇa jayābhāvāt kaḥ kena nigṛhyate ? yatpunaḥ iṣṭasya arthasiddhiḥ sādhanaṃ ca tadaṅgaṃ pakṣadharmatvāditrilakṣaṇāstrayo hetavo gamakāḥ tadavinābhāvaniyamāt; tatra pakṣadharmatvakāryatvapūrvatvādilakṣaṇam asādhanam, anyathānupapattimaniścinvānaḥ sādhyasādhanayostādātmyatadutpattī kathaṃ pratipadyeta ? tatpratipattau kiṃ sambandhāntareṇa antargaḍunā ?
kathaye tyāha--anadhikoktyā na vidyate adhikā upalakṣaṇametat tena nyūnamapi yasyāṃ sā tathoktā tayā iti
tarhi vādino jaya eva prativādinaḥ parājaya iti kasyāmavasthāyāṃ doṣaḥ syāt ? tadudbhāvanaṃ vā prativādinaḥ parājayaḥ syāt
