atrāpi idaṃ cintyate kiṃ sato'pi svadoṣāṇāmanudbhāvanāt, samīcīnasādhanavacanādvā vādī jayati ? tatra antye pakṣe uktaṃ jalpādi virudhyeta iti, sa eva parasya parājaya iti
prathamapakṣe'pi sa eva vādī svayaṃ sa doṣamudbhāvya jayati tarhi tasya parājaya ityuktam
yadi punaḥ prāśnikaprakāśitāt tadanudbhāvanāt; te tarhi yathā doṣasya anudbhāvanaṃ parasya parājayaṃ vyavasthāpayanti tathā vādino'pi vacanamiti yatkiñcidetat
tat tasmin pakṣe ca prativādinaḥ paroktaḥ parājayaḥ

prativādino nigrahasthānaprāpteḥ tathā paroktaprakāreṇa anupapatteḥ phalguprāyam iti sādhanapratyuccāraṇavad doṣāntaroktiśca anuktiśca prabhṛti yeṣām adoṣodbhāvanādīnāṃ taiḥ iti vādijayādeva tannigrahasthānaprāpteriti manyate
taireva tatprāptiḥ nātaḥ iti cet; atrāha--doṣavatsādhanavādināpi na kevalam anyena punaḥ evaṃ sati nigṛhyeta prativādī iti sambandhaḥ
tad ityayaṃ nipātaḥ tena ityasya arthe varttate
tena pakṣasthāpanayā ityādinā etena idānīṃ cetasi pratyakṣatayā pratibhāsamānena
etena ityucyamāne anantare saṃpratipattiḥ syāt, tena ityucyamāne ciravyavahite, tasmāt tadetena ityucyate
teṣāṃ prapañcaḥ sa neha pradarśyate granthagauravabhayāt ka thā tra ya bha ṅgā d avagantavyaḥ

kathaṃ pratyukta ityuktaḥ ? ityādi kasyacid vādino prativādino vā vipratipattau anyathā vyavasthitasya paramārgasya anyathāgrahaṇe apratipattau tadgrahaṇābhya veca parasya prativādino vā svapakṣasiddhimantareṇa jayābhāvāt kāraṇāt kaḥ kena nigṛhyate na kaścit kenacit ? jayaparājayayoḥ anyo'nyāpekṣatvāditi
tadevaṃ vādiprativādiprāśnika ityādinā caturaṅga eva ityanena caturaṅgaṃ vidurbudhāḥ iti vyākhyātam

vacanasyāpi ityādinā svārthānumāne'pi prayogapradarśanam anyathā'yuktameva ityanena ca samarthaṃ ca tadvacanaṃ ca iti samarthavacanam ityetacca, tattvapratyāyanāt ityādinā mārgaprabhāvanālakṣaṇatvāt iti paryantena punaḥ pakṣanirṇayaparyantena punaḥ pakṣanirṇayaparyantaṃ phalaṃ mārgaprabhāvanā iti ca
saṃprati samarthasya sādhya sicco śaktasya vacanaṃ jalpaṃ viduḥ ityetad vyavasthāpayitukāmaḥ paramataṃ dūṣayitumupanyasyati yatpunaḥ ityādi
kiṃ tat ? ityāha--iṣṭasya vādino'bhimatasya arthasiddhiḥ sādhanam anumeyapratītiḥ iti yāvat, sādhyate anena iti sādhanaṃ liṅgam ityarthaḥ
tadaṅgam tasya sādhanasya liṅgasya aṅgam avayavaḥ
kiṃ tat ? ityāha--pūrvapakṣadharmatvādi, ādiśabdena sapakṣe sapakṣe sattvamasattvaṃ vā pakṣe gṛhyate, tasya vā siddhiḥ
upa sādhanasya aṅgaṃ nimittaṃ ke ? ityāha--trilakṣaṇāḥ trayaḥ pakṣadharmatvādayo lakṣaṇaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ
yadi vā, pakṣadharmatvādīni trīṇi lakṣaṇāni yeṣām iti grāhyam

iṣṭasyārtha siddhiḥ sādhanaṃ tasya nirvarttakamaṅgaṃ tasya vacanaṃ tasyāṅgasyānuccāraṇaṃ vādino nigrahādhikaraṇam--tacca sādhanāṅgamiha niścitatrairūpyaṃ liṅgamucyate, tasya sādhanāṅgasya vacanaṃ trirūpaliṅgakhyānam, tasya sādhanāṅgasyāvacanamanuccāraṇamanabhidhānam...--vādanyā॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 3
trairūpyaṃ punarliṅgasyānumeye sattvameva sapakṣe eva sattvam asapakṣe cāsattvameva niścitam
sādhanādibhyaḥ pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ pūrvam abhidhānāt, sa yasyāsti tat tadvaditi
pakṣād uktād uddharitaḥ śeṣaḥ sapakṣo yasyāsti tattadvat
kevalavyatirekiṇo liṅgasya pakṣadharmatvam, ādiśabdena sāmānyato dṛṣṭaṃ ceti gṛhyate
tena pūrvavat sāmānyato dṛṣṭaṃ ca nyāyasū॰ 1
sāmānyena ca śabdād viśeṣaṇenaiva adṛṣṭaṃ vipakṣe ityarthaḥ
ādiśabdena śeṣavat sāmānyato dṛṣṭaṃ ca iti gṛhyate
ataḥ tṛtīyamapi sūtram anugṛhītam--pūrvavaccheṣavat sāmānyatodṛṣṭaṃ ca nyāyasū॰ 1
tasyāḥ siddheḥ aṅgaṃ nimittaṃ tadaṅgaṃ trayo hetavaḥ kevalānvayakevalavyatireka-anvaya vyatirekiṇaḥ
yadi vā, pakṣadharmatvādīni trīṇi lakṣaṇāni yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ
tatpūrvakaṃ trividhamanumānaṃ pūrvaccheṣavat sāmānyato dṛṣṭaṃ ca iti
uccāraṇāpekṣayā, hetoḥ pūrvaṃ pakṣaḥ samuccāryate ityarthaḥ
tulanā athavā trividhamiti pūrvaccheṣavatsāmānyato dṛṣṭaṃ ceti
pūrvaṃ sādhyaṃ tadvyāptyā yasyāstīti tat pūrvavat
tatrānvayavyatirekī vivakṣitatajjātīyopapattau vipakṣāvṛttiḥ yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣavattve sati asmadādibāhyakaraṇapratyakṣatvāt ghaṭavaditi
vyatirekī vivakṣitavyāpakatve sati sapakṣābhāve sati vipakṣāvṛttiḥ yathā nedaṃ jīvaccharīraṃ nirātmakam aprāṇādimattvaprasaṅgāditi
evaṃ ca pūrvavat kāryāt pūrvaṃ jāyamānatvāt pūrvaṃ kāraṇam asya asti iti
śeṣavad iti śeṣaṃ kāryam asti iti śeṣavad iti
sāmānyena akāryakāraṇatvena sāmānyatodṛṣṭaṃ rasādīni sūtratrayam anusṛtaṃ bhavati
teṣu pakṣadharmatvādiṣu triṣu hetuṣu vā avinābhāvasya niyamād iti
tatra tasmin pūrvapakṣe pakṣadharmatvaṃ ca kāryatvaṃ pūrvatvaṃ pūrvatvaṃ ca tadādiryasya tat tathoktaṃ tallakṣaṇaṃ yasya tadapi tathoktam
pūrvavaditi yatra kāraṇena kāryamanumīyate yathā meghonnatyā bhaviṣyati vṛṣṭiriti
śeṣavat tad yatra kāryeṇa kāraṇamanumīyate pūrvodakaviparītamudakaṃ nadyāḥ pūrṇatvaṃ śīghratvaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā srotaso'numīyate bhūtā vṛṣṭiriti
sāmānyatodṛṣṭaṃ vrajyāpūrvakamanyatra dṛṣṭasya anyatra darśanamiti tathā cādityasya
tatra prathamaṃ tāvat dvividhaṃ vītamavītaṃ ca
anvayamukhena pravarttamānaṃ vidhāyakaṃ vītam, vyatirekamukhena pravartamānaṃ niṣedhakamavītam
tatrāvītaṃ śeṣavat...vītaṃ dvedhā pūrvavat sāmānyato dṛṣṭaṃ ca
nanu bhavatu ta i hitatvaṃ tathāpi pakṣadharmatva-kāryatvādilakṣaṇaṃ sādhanameva tādātmyatadutpattipratibandhāditi cet; atrāha--sādhya ityādi
tayoḥ tādātmyaṃ ca sādhyarūpatā tadutpattiśca sādhyād ātmalābhaḥ te tādātmyatadutpattī kathaṃ na kathaṃcit pratipadyeta saugataḥ
kiṃ kurvan ? anyathā sādhyābhāvaprakāreṇa anupapattimaghaṭāṃ hetoḥ satīmasatīṃ vā aniścinvānaḥ
nahi yad yadabhāve'pi bhavati tat tatsvabhāvaṃ tatkāryaṃ vā manīṣiṇo manyante

pūrvatvādikāryatvādilakṣaṇam asādhanam iti niścinoti nāma iti cet; atrāha--tatpratipattau tasyā anyathānupapatteḥ pratipattau niścaye aṅgīkriyamāṇe yāḥ kiṃ sambandhāntareṇa tādātmyādilakṣaṇena ? kiṃbhūtena ? antargaḍunā anarthakena
syānmatam--sambandhāntaramantareṇa sāpi na satī niścīyate vā tatkathaṃ tasya antaraṃ gataḥ neti cet; atrāha--ekalakṣaṇasiddhiḥ ityādi
ekaṃ pradhānam anyathānupapannatvaṃ yat sādhanalakṣaṇaṃ tasya siddhiḥ nirṇītiḥ sākalyena katham ityādinā kṛtā iti adhyāhāraḥ
evaṃ tāvat pūrvatvakāryatvādilakṣaṇaṃ saugatakalpitam anyathānupapattirahitatvādasādhanam iti pratipādya nayāyikaṃ prati pūrvatvādilakṣaṇaṃ tadrahitatvādasādhanam iti pratipādayannāha--tathā ityādi
tathā tena anantaraprakāreṇa yojanīyam asādhanam ityetat
tathāhi--pūrvavaccheṣavat pakṣasapakṣavat, na sādhanam anyathānupapattirahitatvāt tadanyavat
itarathā vivādāspadaṃ sarvamanityaṃ sattvāt dīpādivat ityapi syāt pūrvavaccheṣavad ityasya lakṣaṇasya bhāvāt

atha anityatvābhāve'pi sattvasya ātmādau bhāvāt nedaṃ sādhanam; kiṃ tarhi syāt ? yat tadabhāve niyamena na bhavati; anyathānupapattiriyam, iti antargaḍunā kiṃ pūrvavad ityādinā ? tathā pūrvavatsāmānyatodṛṣṭaṃ vipakṣa ; ityetadapi tadrahitaṃ na sādhanam, anyathā svasaṃvedanaṃ ghaṭādijñānam ātmaviśeṣaguṇatvāt, yaḥ punaḥ svasaṃvedano na bhavati sa tadviśeṣaguṇo na bhavati iti yathā rūpādiḥ ityapi syāt, pūrvavattvasya vipakṣe sāmānyato viśeṣato vā'darśanasya ca bhāvāt
atha mataṃ svasaṃvedanābhāve'pi prayatnādau tadviśeṣaguṇatvasya bhāvāt nedaṃ sādhanamiti; kiṃ tarhi syāt ? yat tadabhāve niyamena na bhavati; uktamatra anyathānupapattisamarthanamiti

tathā pūrvavaccheṣavat sāmānyato'dṛṣṭam iti vacanamayuktam; kathamanyathā pakvānyetāni phalāni evaṃrasāni ca ekaśākhāprabhavatvād upayuktaphalavat, yāni punaḥ evaṃvidhāni na bhavanti tāni ekaśākhāprabhavāṇi na bhavanti yathā avivakṣitaphalāni ityevamādyapi yuktaṃ na bhavet

bādhitaviṣayatvāt neti cet; nanu lakṣaṇayukte bādhāsaṃbhave tallakṣaṇameva dūṣitaṃ syāt pra॰ vā॰ svavṛ॰ pṛ॰ 66 iti kathamanyatra samāśvāso yataḥ pūrvavattvādi sādhanaṃ syāt ? abādhitatvasyāpi tallakṣaṇāt

nā'sya lakṣaṇayogaḥ iti cet; kimidaṃ bādhitatattvam sādhyābhāve'pi sādhyadharmiṇi darśanam; abādhitatvaṃ tadabhāve niyamenā'darśanam iti anyathānupapannatvam--abādhitatvam iti nānayoḥ avasthayoḥ viśeṣaḥ
kiñca, abādhitaviṣayatvaṃ kiṃ bādhakasyādarśanāt, uta pūrvavaccheṣavat sāmānyato'dṛṣṭam ityetasmāt, āhosvit vipakṣe bādhakapramāṇaditi trayaḥ pakṣāḥ
tatra ādye pakṣe vyabhicāraḥ, sato'pi bādhakasya kutaścidadarśanasaṃbhavāt, punaḥ paryāyeṇa darśanāt, adṛṣṭadoṣeṣu śāstreṣu parīkṣayā punaḥ doṣadarśana
kṣaṇacayānyo yā vītarāgatvena abhimato rāgādimān puruṣavat
puruṣo hi rāgādīnāṃ kāraṇamiṣyate buddhyādīnāṃ kāryāṇāṃ tadviśeṣaguṇatvopagamāt
vītarāgatvenopagato na tatkāraṇam; na tarhi saṃsāriṇo mokṣaḥ syāt, iti tadarthamanuṣṭhānamanarthakam
na caitanmantavyam--sāmagrī rāgādikāraṇaṃ na kevalaḥ puruṣaḥ, tasyāḥ tadanumāne siddhasādhanam, puruṣād vyabhicāra iti; nityasya apekṣāniṣedhāt tasyāḥ tatkāraṇatvānupapatteḥ
yadi punastasya tatkṛto'vasthāviśeṣaḥ tadavyabhicārī iti; tata eva tadanumānam ekalakṣaṇaśāsanam
yataḥ sāmagrī rāgādikāraṇam ataḥ kevalapuruṣāt tadutpādo na bhavati
yaccānyat--śeṣavat kāryavad iti; tadapyasundaram; yādṛśa eva ghaṭādeḥ saṃsthānaviśeṣaḥ cakracīvaranāradaṇḍāderbhavati tādṛśasyaiva pākajotpattau tadabhāve'pi svayamabhyupagamāt
evaṃ ca sati cakrādivat upalabdhimadabhāve'pi kvacittatsaṃbhavāśaṅkāyāṃ kathamataḥ parvatādau buddhimatkāraṇānumānaṃ niḥśaṅkam
atha yathā cakrādyabhāve'pi taddarśanaṃ tathā buddhimadabhāve yadi kadācit syāt ko virodhaḥ ? virodhe vā tata eva gamakatvopagateḥ kiṃ śeṣavat ityanena
yat punaranyat-- sāmānyataḥ sāmānyena akāryakāraṇatvena dṛṣṭaṃ rūpādau rasādikam; tadapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam; yataḥ kutaḥ kutaścit yasya kasyacit pratipattiprasaṅgāt
atha ekasmin dravye tatastadanumānam, ato'yamadoṣaḥ; tarhi rasād rūpavat kvacit phale buddhyāderanumānaṃ sahabhāvasya kadāciddarśanaṃ
tatra tasya samavāyācceti cet; ekārthasamavāyaḥ tarhi gamakatve nibandhanam
bhavatu ko doṣa iti cet; na; tataḥ tadvat karmaṇo'numitiḥ syāt tadaviśeṣāt

tathāpi rūpādereva tatsaṃbhave kimekārthasamavāyena ? yadi ca rūparasādeḥ kvacit sahabhāvadarśanād anyatra rasād rūpagatiḥ; tarhi sparśavattvādeḥ tatra darśanāt sparśāt jalādau gandhādipratipattirastu
atha anumīyamānajalādisajātīye gandhādyadarśanāt naivam; ata eva sarvatra tadanumānam
nacāyamekāntaḥ tatsajātīye eva dṛṣṭasambandhaliṅginaṃ gamayati tat, anyathāpyavirodhāt, itarathā kathanna paramatasiddhiriti yatkiñcidetat
sāmānyatodṛṣṭaṃ tu yadakāryakāraṇabhūtālliṅgāt tādṛśasyaiva liṅgino'numānaṃ yathā kapitthādau rūpeṇa rasānumānam
nanu sākalyena sādhyābhāve sādhanābhāvasya pratyakṣataḥ pratipattau pratipattuḥ sarvajñatvam
na ca mānāntaramiti cet; atrāha--sattarkeṇohyate rūpam ityādi

sannikṛṣṭaṃ viprakṛṣṭaṃ vārthaṃ sākalyenedantayā nedantayā vā vyavasthāpayitukāmasya anyathābhāvaviṣayastarkaḥ paraṃ śaraṇaṃ nāparam, sarva viṣayatvāt tataḥ śabdavikalpayostattvasādhanamalaṅghyaśāsanaṃ pracaṇḍabhūpatervā
tarkeṇa sarvatra svavedanābhāve jñānatvānupapattilakṣaṇāntarābhāvād iti aspaṣṭohavikalpenana darśanādinā ūhyate vitarkyate yad rūpaṃ svabhāvaḥ
kiṃbhūtasya ? pratyakṣasya pratyakṣagrahaṇayogyasya sattvadhūmādeḥ itarasya vā tadagrahaṇayogyasya vā
yathā anantajñānasya anantasukhasādhane tasya vā bubhukṣādyabhāve sādhane tatraiva vā anantavīryasya
e na ca asmadādyapekṣayā uktam; anyasya aśeṣaṃ pratyakṣameva
kiṃ tadrūpam ? ityāha--anyathānupapannatvam sādhyābhāve niyamena sādhanasya aghaṭanam
etaduktaṃ bhavati--na pratyakṣeṇa anumānena vā niścitaṃ rūpam ekaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ hetoḥ yataḥ pratipattuḥ sarvajñatvamanavasthā vā, kintu manovikalpena
jina prakṛtimānuṣo'pi kimutākhilajñānavān || pātrake॰ ślo॰ 19 iti
nanu tarko nāsti anupalambhāt kharaviṣāṇavat, kathaṃ tena asatā kiñcidūhyate ? sato'pi vā ānarthakyam, tadarthasyānyataḥ siddhiḥ teti cet; atrāha--sannikṛṣṭam ityādi

sannikṛṣṭaṃ puruṣamātradarśanayogyaṃ viprakṛṣṭaṃ vā tadviparītam arthaṃ sattva-dhūmādikam sākalyena deśakālāntaravyāptyā idaṃtayā anityādi-agnisvabhāvakāryatayā nedaṃtayā vā nityaanagnisvabhāvakāryatayā anavasthāpayitukāmasya lokasya tarkaḥ paraṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ śaraṇam
kiṃbhūtaḥ ? anyathā sādhyābhāva abhāvaḥ sa viṣayo yasya sa tathoktaḥ
idamuktaṃ bhavati— anabhimataparihāreṇa abhimataṃ tattvam anavayavena vyavasthāpayitumicchatā anumānameṣṭavyam
tadapyabhyupagacchatā liṅgaṃ sādhyāvinābhāvaniyamaikalakṣaṇam taścaya sa ca tarkāt nānyataḥ iti tarkamabhyupagamya niṣedhato dviṣṭakāmiteti
yatpunaruktam--svatopi vānarthakyaṃ tadanyasya anyataḥ siddheriti; tatrāha--nāparam iti tarkādanyadaparam adhyakṣādi kṛtavicāraṃ na śaraṇam ityanuvarttate
kutaḥ sa eva śaraṇam ? ityāha--sarva ityādi
yata evaṃ tataḥ śabdavikalpayoḥ śabdavikalpābhyāṃ tattvasādhanam alaṅghyaśāsanam pracaṇḍabhūpateryadalaṅghyaṃ śāsanam ājñāpanaṃ vā tadiva iti
nanu tarkavikalpaprastāve kimarthamaprastutaśabdagrahaṇamiti cet ? ucyate--vacanasyāpi ityādyabhidhānādasyāpi prastāvāt
nanu tayorarthe pratibandhadvayasyābhāvāt kathaṃ tadviṣayatvamiti cet ? atrāha--yogya ityādi
yogyaḥ śabdo vikalpo vā sarvaḥ sarvatra cetsvataḥ
yadyevaṃ śāstrakāreṇa kathamanyatra pratipāditam--yogyaḥ śabdo...--nyāyavi॰ vi॰ dvi॰ pṛ॰ 321
yogyaḥ samarthaḥ pratyakṣavat tayostatra yogyatāsambandho nānyaḥ iti tanniṣedhe'pi na doṣa iti bhāvaḥ
tanna yuktam--tayoḥ niyamārthayogyatāyāṃ dhūmādivat puruṣecchāvaśādarthāntare vṛttirna syāt iti; tatrāpi tadyogyatvāt
yugapat tataḥ sarvārthapratipattiḥ iti cet; na; ekatra apareṇa kṣayopaśamasya anyatra saṅketasya aniyatasyāpekṣaṇāt
svayaṃ yogyasya kiṃ tena ? ityapi vārtam; ayogyasya nitarāṃ kiṃ tena ? na hi sikatāḥ pīḍanamapekṣya tailopādānamiti
mithyātvaṃ svārthasyānyathā viṣayīkaraṇam śabdasya vikalpasya ca iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha--parataḥ kasyacit karmaṇaḥ, anyasya mithyājñānāt
vāñchanto vā na vaktāraḥ śāstrāṇāṃ mandabuddhayaḥ
kiṃ sye ti ki tyāha--cakṣurādidhiyām iva iti
prasara midaṃ cittaṃ prakṛtyā pra॰ vā॰ 1
210 iti vacanāt āsāṃ svārthe sato yogyānāṃ parataḥ timirādeḥ yathānvat tathā prakṛtasyāpi iti
nanu śabdaḥ svārthe yogyo jñānakāryajananādavasīyate, tacca saṅketād iti
kutastadavasāya iti cet ? atrāha--śabdānāṃ pūrvaṃ jātyapekṣayā ekavacanam, atra vyaktyapekṣayā bahuvacanam
svataḥ svarūpataḥ tattvaṃ pratipādanayogyatve na cet śabdaḥ parābhiprāyadyotane
prayatnairapi samayakaraṇairapi na śakyate kartuṃ tadyogyatvam
bahuvacane, na kevalam ekena dvābhyāṃ vā api tu bahubhirapi iti darśayati
tathāhi--yo yatra svato'yogyaḥ sa tatra prayatnairapi tathā na bhavati yathā sikatādiḥ taile, svato'yogyāśca parasya śabdāḥ tattvapratipādane iti
śakyate ca tatkartuṃ prayatnaiḥ, tatastaiḥ svato yogyāḥ, rūpādipratipattiviśeṣasya rūpādiśabdānvayadarśanāt
ata evoktam--viśeṣaṃ kurute hetuḥ visrasā pariṇāminām
tadanena etat nirastam; kāryadarśanād yogyatā anuyīyate,yogyatātaḥ kāryam iti anyo'nyasaṃśrayāt iti
katham ? yogyatātaḥ tatra kāryapratipatteranabhyupagamāt, tatkāryasya pratyakṣatvāt

kevalaṃ tatkārye kiṃ tādātmyādipratibandhāt uta anyata iti vicāro yogyatāta iti brūmaḥ, tasyā vicārasahatvādi ti syāt, tadbhāve kutaḥ tattvasya svalakṣaṇasya vyavasthitiḥ vyavasthānam ? kutaścidanyasya tadvyavasthāhetoḥ abhāvāditi manyate
avikalpakapratyakṣāditi cet; atrāha--pratyakṣasya savikalpa sya bauddhaṃ prati vipakṣatvād avikalpakasya iti gamyate
sādhyo'prasiddhaḥ sādhyamaprasiddham nyāyavi॰ ślo॰ 172 iti vacanāt, viṣayo niraṃśakṣaṇikajñānarūpādilakṣaṇo yasya, anyasya vikalpaviṣayatvāt tattathoktaṃ tasyā sya bhāvāt tathā tatkutaḥ tadvyavasthā
yadi vā, sādhyaṃ ca tadadvayaṃ buddhyātmanaḥ puruṣavad aprasiddhatvāt viṣayasya svaparāvyavasthāpakatvena jaḍaghaṭāviśeṣāt tasya bhāvāt tattvāditi grāhyam
syānmatam--tattvataḥ savikalpasya itarasya vā kvacit pramāṇena iṣṭam atastadabhāvo nādvaitavādino doṣāya, tattvāvyavasthā vā
yattu iṣṭaṃ tad vyavahāreṇa prāmāṇyaṃ vyavahāreṇa pra॰ vā॰ 1
6 ityabhidhānāt iti vacanāt iti; tatrāha--tattva ityādi

nirviṣayaṃ mithyājñānam adhyakṣamanumānaṃ ca sthūlaikākāragocaraṃ vyavahāreṇa pramāṇīkṛtya tattvaṃ vyāvarṇayitumicchati pratibandhādivikalpasya sarvasyaiva asamīkṣita tattvārthena atiśayābhāvāt paramārthāvatārāya lokapratītiṃ na pramāṇaṃ samāśrayati
tadapramāṇasya kutaścit paramārthasādhanatve anyatrāpi pramāṇānveṣaṇaṃ kaimarthakyaṃ pratipadyate ? sākalyena tattvāvatārāya pratibandhaḥ...
vaktrabhiprāyasūcakaiḥ śabdaiḥ paraṃ tattvasādhanaṃ pratipipādayiṣati sādhanaiḥ kiṃ punastattvaṃ na sādhayet yatastena vādī nigṛhyate
na ca pratyakṣabuddhiḥ svalakṣaṇaṃ yathālakṣaṇaṃ prasādhayati, sthūlasyaikasya anekāvayavarūpādisādhāraṇasya atadrūpaparāvṛttavastumātrasya ca tatra pratibhāsanāt
tadasādhāraṇasya saṃvedanābhyupagame vikalpasyāpi tadaṅgīkaraṇamaśakyaniṣedham ? tathā sati saṃvedanādvaitāya sādhanādivyavahārāya ca datto jalāñjaliḥ

asyāyamarthaḥ--niraṃśāḥ kṣaṇikā jñānajñeyaparamāṇavaḥ tathāvidhā bahirarthaśūnyā vijñānasantatayaḥ sarvāḥ sarvathā bhrāntāḥ, sarvavikalpātītaṃ pratibhāsamātraṃ sūkalaśūnyatitvaṃ tattvam iti darśanabhedaḥ tasya vittiḥ yāthātmyena grahaṇaṃ tayā vinā tāmantareṇa vikalpānām atattvaviṣayatvād vetti jānāti saugataḥ
upalakṣaṇametat tena vijñānasantatimātram bhrāntimātram sakalavikalpavikalapratibhāsamātram śūnyamātram, anena parasya pūrvāparābhyupagamavirodhaṃ darśayati
tathāhi--yadi jagattattvaṃ tathāvidhaṃ vetti kathaṃ tattvavittiḥ paramārthato nāsti yataḥ prāmāṇyaṃ vyavahāreṇa pra॰ vā॰ 1
6 iti brūyāt ? atha nāsti; kathaṃ vidyāt taditi ? saṃprati ttveva va virodhavat ityādinā vakti kathayati
pūrvasyānantaramasya vacanam jagataḥ kṣaṇakṣayapratipattimabhyupagamayati idaṃ dūṣaṇamiti pratipādanārthaṃ nānyathā
kiṃbhūtam ? ityāha--vāgagocaram vāco gocaro yo na bhavati tam iti, svayameva vacanāgocaraṃ hetuṃ vadati tatpratipādanārthaṃ ca vākyam upanyasyati iti svavacanavirodha iti manyate
nanu vyavahāreṇa tattvavittira si hetuśca vāggocaro na tattvataḥ iti cet; atrāha— sādhayet kiṃ na kiñcit

paramārthataḥ sādhanāni yāni na bhavanti taiḥ iti, svayamasādhanebhyo vyavahāriṇā sādhanatvenopagatebhyaḥ anyasya tattvasiddhau saugatena upagatebhyo vitya tvādibhyaḥ sukhādau sāṃkhyasya tattvato'cetanatvasiddhiḥ syāditi manyate
yatpunaratroktam--yādṛśo yakṣaḥ tādṛśo baliḥ yādṛśāni sādhanāni tādṛśameva tat sādhyam iti; tadanena nirastam; paramārthasādhanābhāve yādṛśatādṛśapratipatterayogāditi
yathā balistathā yakṣa iti kiṃ kena saṃgatam

viṣayānniṣkrāntam nirastaviṣayaṃ vā mithyājñānam anumānam adhyakṣaṃ ca sthūlaikākāragocaraṃ vyavahāreṇa pramāṇīkṛtya svayamapramāṇaṃ pramāṇayatā bhya tattvaṃ vyāvarṇayituṃ vyavasthāpayitum icchati saugataḥ
na ca tadvyavasthā, marīcikājalajñānāt satyajalavyavasthāvaditi manyate
syodatat--mābhūt pratyakṣāt tadā kāragocarāt tadvyavasthā anumānāt syāt paramparayā tatpratibaddhāt bhrāntirapi sambandhataḥ pramā iti vacanāditi; tatrāha--pratibandhādi ityādi
liṅgaliṅginoḥ avinābhāvaḥ pratibandhaḥ ādiryasya pakṣadharmatvādeḥ tasya yo vikalpaḥ tadgrāhī niścayaḥ, avikalpasya tatrāpravṛtteḥ svayamaviṣaye tadayogāt
nahi idamato jātam, ayamasya svabhāvo asya dharmo vā iti vyāpāro tatsāmarthyam; kāraṇādiparamāṇudarśanavyāpārasya paraṃ pratyasiddheḥ
evamuktaṃ bhavati--pratibandhādivikalpasya mithyātve anumānasya vastuni pāramparyeṇāpi na pratibandhaḥ iti na yuktam liṅgaliṅgidhiyorevam pra॰ vā॰ 2

yadi punaretanmatam--na paramāṇudarśanam agnidhūmayoḥ vṛkṣaśiṃśapayoḥ, dhūmaparvatasya adarśanam, api tu sthūlaikatvadarśanameva lokasya tatraiva pramāṇādivyavahārāt iti, tadapramāṇaṃ pramāṇaṃ vā bhavataḥ syāt ? prathamapakṣe doṣamāha--loka ityādi
lokapratītiṃ sthūlaikākārasaṃvittima kiṃbhūtā na pramāṇaṃ samāśrayati
vādhanamaṇāva krameṇāpi ekasya anekākārasiddheḥ savikalpakaṃ pramāṇaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ
paramārthāvatārāya tāmapramāṇaṃ samāśrayataḥ ko doṣaḥ ? ityatrāha--tadapramāṇasya ityādi

vā cāsau lokapratītiḥ apramāṇaṃ ca tadapramāṇaṃ tasya paramārthasādhanatve abhyupagamyamāne kutaścit tata eva lokavyavahāramithyādeḥ anyatrāpi nityatrāpi nityatvādāvapi pramāṇānveṣaṇaṃ kamarthakyaṃ pratipadyate pramāṇamantareṇa anyasyāpi siddheriti
tattvāvatārāya ātmeśvarāditattvapraveśārtham apramāṇaṃ sārthakam jīvaccharīram ityādi, vimatyadhikaraṇabhāvāpannaṃ tanvādi buddhimatkāraṇam ityādi vā anumānam

agniratra ityanumānāt kathamagnisiddhiriti ? tathā pareṇāpyucyate—tato mithyājñānād ātmādya siddhau kathaṃ kṣaṇakṣayādisiddhiriti nanu yathā lokataḥ kṣaṇakṣayādau sattvādipratibandhasiddhiḥ naivam ātmādau prāṇādimattvādeḥ iti cet; uktamatra--pratibandhetyādi
evaṃ sati dhūmaparvatayoḥ adarśanaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ
tattvasya kṣaṇakṣayādeḥ sambandhi sādhanaṃ liṅgaṃ pratipipādayiṣati paraṃ prati
kiṃ punaḥ tattvaṃ na sādhayet ? sādhayedeva
kaiḥ ? ityāha--asādhanai sādhyā pratibaddhaiḥ prāṇādimattvādibhiḥ yato 'sādhanaiḥ tattvasādhanaṃ tena nigṛhyeta vādī
yata iti vā ākṣepe naiva iti
nanu anumānānumeyayorabhāvāt santi ca kramāt tasya hetutvādiprabhedavikalasya bhāvāt tasya svasaṃvedanādhyakṣataḥ siddheḥ nāyaṃ doṣaḥ ityaparaḥ
syānmatam--etat pratibandhādi ityādinā uktamiti kimarthaṃ punarucyate iti cet ? satyamuktam, tathāpi--
lokasaṃvṛtisatyaṃ ca satyaṃ ca paramārthataḥ || mādhyamikakā॰ 24 | 8

iti vacanāt lokasaṃvṛtisatyāpekṣayā taduktam, pratibhāsādvaitaparamārthasatyāpekṣayā idamucyate--na ca naiva pratyakṣabuddhiḥ svasaṃvedanādhyakṣaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ svasvarūpaṃ prasādhayati saṃśayādirahitaṃ vyavasthāpayati
kiṃ manāgapi na ? ityāha--yathālakṣaṇaṃ yat tasya pareṇa grāhyagrāhakākārasaṃvittirahitatayā avibhāgalakṣaṇamucyate tadanatikrameṇa

tātparyamidamatra--nīlādeḥ śarīrasukhādinīlādivyatiriktasya grāhakasyābhāvāt, avabhāsamānasya svataḥ jñānātmakatvamiti paraḥ, tasya sthūlaikasya anekāvayavarūpādisādhāraṇasya kevalaṃ tatra pratyakṣabuddhau pratibhāsanāt
tasyānmathāva bhāsante tathā tadadvayaṃ niraṃśaṃ bhāve'pi kramavad bhāsata iti
mantrādyupaplutākṣāṇāṃ yathā mṛcchakalādayaḥḥ pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 355 ityādi
dūre yathā vā maruṣu mahānalpo'pi bhāsate | pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 356 ityādi
tatrāha--atadrūpaparāvṛttavastumātraṃ ca tasya sthūlaikasya tatra pratibhāsanāt
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadā paraparikalpita tattvaṃ tadavabhāsāt pūrvaṃ paścādvā pramāṇataḥ siddhaṃ bhavati yathā gajādipratibhāsāt mūcha lādayaḥ tadā tattathā pratibhāsata iti yuktam
na caivam, ābodhimārga ghahārāt tasyaiva pratibhāsanāt
tathāpi tasyaiva pratibhāsopagamo na kiñcit svarūpeṇa pratigataṃ syāt, kadācittatrāpi anyasya tathāvabhāsakalpanāditi
nanu asthūlāpekṣayā sthūlam anekāpekṣayā ca ekaḥ kalpyate
na ca apekṣayā pāramārthikā dharmā bhavanti; atiprasaṅgāt
na sthūlasyaikasya pratyakṣabuddhau pratibhāsanam api tu vikalpe, tatra jñānaparamāṇvabhāsanamiti cet; atrāha--tadasādhāraṇa ityādi
tasya parakīyasya asādhāraṇasya sarvato vyāvṛttasya saṃvedanābhyupagame
kim ? ityāha--vikalpasyāpi na kevalamadhyakṣasya tada ṅgīkaraṇaṃ svaparāsādhāraṇasaṃvedanāṅgīkaraṇam aśakyaniṣedham aṅgīkaraṇasya icchāto'viśeṣāt
sa tathā sati saṃvedanādvaitāya sādhanādivyavahārāya ca datto jalāñjaliḥ tasya kalpitasāmānyagocaratvāditi
atha matam--vikalpāt tatpratibhāsābhāvānna tadaṅgīkaraṇamiti; tatrāha--pratītya ityādi
vikalpā'vikalpayoḥ yo'yam asādhāraṇa pratītyabhāvaḥ tasya aviśeṣāt
evaṃ sati pratyakṣabuddhau asādhāraṇapratītyabhāve yadavabhāsate tajjñānam ityādau yad yathāvabhāsate ityādau ca dharmiprabhṛti sarvamasiddham
tatra tatpratītyabhyupagame vikalpe'pi svaparayoḥ tathāvidhayoḥ pratītiriti
śloko'yam apohasiddhau pṛ॰ 6 yacchāstram iti kṛtvā samuddhṛtaḥ
tatkathamucyate--vaktyaṃ vāggocaraṃ hetum iti yogyaḥ śabdaḥ vikalpo vā sarvaḥ sarvatra iti veti cet; atrāha--naca ityādi
kāsām ? buddhīnām ekaviṣayatvena viruddham ekaviṣayatve'pi tanmātrasya saṃbhavāt, viśiṣṭastu tadbhedaḥ tenna viruddhyate iti mātraśabdena darśayati

cakṣurādijñānamekatra pratibhāsabhedamanubhavad yadīṣyate; pratyakṣādīnāṃ sāmagrībhedāt pratibhāsabhede'pi ekaviṣayatvaṃ kathanna syāt ? vikalpasya atasmiṃstadgrahānnirviṣayatvaṃ vadan hatastvam asādhanāṅgavacanāt
yathādarśanaṃ ca tattvam; anyathā tattvānupapattyā anekāntasiddhiḥ
dūrāsannaśabdau bhāvapradhānau, tena dūratvam āsannatvam ādiryāsām

ādiśabdena dūrataratvaāsannataratvādiparigrahaḥ, athavā mandalocanatvādiparigrahaḥ, tā tathokteḥ sāmagryo yāmāṃ tā api tathā tāśca tāḥ pratyakṣāśca punarapi tā ekārtha saṃvidaśca tāsāṃ pratibhāso yathā yena viśadetaraprakāreṇa bhinnaḥ pratyakṣetarayoḥ indriyaśabdajñānayoḥ tathā pratibhāso bhinnaḥ ityanuvarttate
cakṣurādiryasya ghrāṇādeḥ tasya jñānam ekatra grāhye pratibhāsabhedaṃ viśadetaranirbhāsātiśayam anubhavad yadīṣyate saugatena
tato nirākṛtametat— yau bhinnapratibhāsau pratyayau na bhāvaika viṣayau yathā rūparasapratyayau, bhinnapratibhāsau ca śābda-indriyapratyayau
tathā yau ekaviṣayau tau na bhinnapratibhāsau yathā sannihite nīle puruṣadvayasya tatpratyayau, ekaviṣayau na parasya prakṛta avyayau
iti; katham ? ekaviṣayatve'pi mandetaracakṣuṣoḥ pratyayapratibhāsātiśayopagamena vyabhicārāt

yastvāha--pra jñā ka raḥ tadviṣayasya paraṃ prati asiddheḥ tatrāpi aviśadanirbhāsasya ekaviṣayatvābhāvād anyatvā tadabhāvāt sāmagrībhedāt tadbhāvo'khaṇḍaikaviṣayatve'pi cakṣurādibuddhīnāṃ rūpādipratibhāsabhedaḥ sāmagrīviśeṣāt iti syāt iti; sa na prekṣāvān; yataḥ aviśadanirbhāsino vijñānād dvaṃdva saugatānāmarthe pravṛttyabhāvaprasaṅgaḥ
nahi nirviṣayatāṃ jānanneva jātasya ta naḥ prekṣākārī pravarttate, sarvatra pramāṇaparīkṣābhāvaprasaṅgāt
1 ityādyanumānād aviśadanirbhāsāt tatra te pravarttante na indriyagrāmād iti mahatī kāhalatā ! punarapi anumāne anavasthā
atha svalakṣaṇaviṣayatvād viśadetarendriyajñānayoḥ ekaviṣayatvamastu na pratyakṣaparokṣayoḥ, avastusāmānyaviṣayatvāt parokṣasyeti; tadevāha--vikalpa ityādi
atasminna svalakṣaṇe tadgrahāt svalakṣaṇa grahāt nirviṣayatvam ityevaṃ vedan sa hato nirākṛtastvaṃ pūrvameveti
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadā a vastusatsāmānyaviṣayo vikalpaḥ tadā tatprabhavaṃ vacanamapi tadviṣayamiti na paramārthasādhanāṅgaviṣayamiti tadavacanāt nigṛhīteḥ arhanna hatastvam iti
vikalpasya paramparayā svalakṣaṇapratibandhāt tatprabhavasya vacanasyāpi tatra sa iti cet; atrāha--sambandhasya parasparāvinābhāvasya ekāntena niyamena atattvarūpatvāt atattvaṃ tadavasturūpatvāt
paraparikalpitasvalakṣaṇasya kutaścidasiddheḥ kathaṃ tatra sākṣādanyathā vā kasyacit tattvataḥ pratibandho bhavet ? tadasiddho kiṃ tattvamiti cet ? atrāha--tattvam ityādi
darśanānatikrameṇa yathādarśanaṃ ca sthūlādeḥ iti bhāvaḥ
anyathā anyena ane kāntasiddherabhāvaprakāreṇa tattvasya yā anupapattiḥ tayā anekāntasiddhiḥ
atra paraḥ pṛcchati sūrim katham ityādinā ? saṃpṛṣṭa āha--tallakṣaṇa ityādi
tasya hetoḥ lakṣaṇasiddhiḥ anantaraṃ vakṣyamāṇaprastāvaḥ tatra, anyasya pakṣadharmatvādeḥ anapekṣaṇaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ iti
pratibhāsa evambhūto yaḥ sa na saṃsthānavarjitaḥ
tadevaṃ jalpasvarūpaṃ nirūpya adhunā sadasi tadupanyāsaprayojanaṃ darśayannāha--syādvādena ityādi
kiṃbhūtena ? samastavastuviṣayeṇa samastena saṃpūrṇena vastuviṣayeṇa tāddhikena vastu viṣayo yasya
teṣu satsu kim ? ityāha--ekamukhīkṛtā anyakathābhyo vinivarttya praśastajalpaniyatā kṛtā ca ityāha--semukhī
kim ? cāritram vādiprativādipakṣayoḥ mādhyasthyam, anupamamupamam dvādbhaditi heturliṅgaṃ viniścīyate
nanu pāvakāderapi hetuḥ viniścetavyaḥ; satyam; tathāpi pradhāne kṛto yatnaḥ anyatrāpi bhavati

hetuvad anumeyajñane'pi vivādabhāvāt tadapi viniścīyatām; ityatrāha--syādvādena anekāntaśāsanena samastavasuviṣayiṇā unmiṣitamapi anekāntamantareṇa na saṃbhavati iti vacanad ekāntavādeṣu saugatādisamayeṣu abhidhvasteṣu ekamukhīkṛtā anekāntābhimukhīkṛta śeṣaṃ pūrvavat
tat hetuvat tadvākye'pi vivādavṛtteḥ tadapi parairiva bhavadbhirapi kinna viniścīyate iti cet ? na; asya anantaraṃ vicāritatvāt
mārgaprabhāvanāyāḥ kiṃ phalamiti vā śaṅkyate syādvādena ityādi
naiyāyikī pramāṇaprameyanyāyaniyuktā śemuṣī samyagjñānam iti yāvat
āsādayantī jhaṭityadvā anantacatuṣṭayasya anantajñānādeḥ mahato hetuḥ kāraṇam tatpaleti viniścīyate
iti ra vi bha dra pādopajīvi a na nta vī rya mu ni viracitāyāṃ si ddhi vi ni śca ya ṭī kā yāṃ jalpasiddhiḥ pañcamaḥ prastāvaḥ
atha svaireva vipaścidbhiḥ hetoḥ viniścitatvāt iha punarapi kimarthaṃ viniścīyate iti cet; atrāha--he ya ityādi
śapati krośati sādhuśāsina iti vyaktaṃ vivekṣyāmahe || 1
bāla iva svabhādhva svabhāvato vaimukhyāt paraḥ saugatādiḥ bālaḥ anena sahajaṃ mohamasya darśayati
kiṃbhūtaḥ ? ityāha--heyam pakṣadharmatvādikam ādeyam anyathānupapannatvaṃ tayoḥ viveko vivecanam mithaḥ pṛthakkaraṇam tatra kāhalaścāsau khalaśca sa kāhalaḥ kāhalakātaḥ tadvivekakleśabhīruḥ
khalaḥ śataḥ tadvivekam anyena pratipādyamāno'pi svāyam apratipadyamānaḥpūrvaḥ tena prāyeṇa bāhulyena pralabdho vañcitaścāsau ākulaśca ityanena ābhisaṃskārikaṃ darśayanti
sa kim ? ityāha--nālaṃ śaktaḥ alam atyarthaṃ manāk samartha ityarthaḥ avinābhāvaniyamād hetubi॰ ślo॰ 1 iti vacanāt
kim ? ityāha--padam adhikārāt hetuṃ padyate gamyate anena anumeyo'rthaḥ iti vyutpatteḥ
nanu sadopaṃ tat, atastadaparijñānamadoṣāya iti cet; atrāha--amalālīḍham amalaiḥ gaṇadharaprabhṛtibhiḥ ālīḍham āsvāditam
kasya tat ? ityatrāha--svā mi naḥ pā tra ke śa ri ṇa ityeke
kuta etat ? tena tadviṣaya tri la kṣa ṇa ka da rtha na m uttarabhāṣyaṃ yataḥ kṛtamiti cet; nanvevaṃ sī ma ndha ra bha ṭṭā ra ka sya aśeṣārthasākṣātkāriṇaḥ tīrthakarasya syāt

tulanā--nedaṃ svabuddhikalpitam api tu parāgamasiddhamityupadarśayitukāmo bhāvatsīmandharasvāmitārthaṃkaradevasamavasaraṇāt gaṇadharadevaprasādādāsāditaṃ devyā padmāvatyā yadānīya pātrakesarisvāmine samarpitamanyathānupapattivārtikaṃ tadāha--anyathānupapannatvaṃ...--nyāyavi॰ vi॰ dvi॰ pṛ॰ 177
anyathā'sambhavo jñāto yatra tatra trayeṇa kim
kathamidamavagamyate iti cet ? pā tra ke śa ri ṇā tri la kṣa ṇa ka dartha naṃ kṛtamiti kathamavagamyate iti samānam ? ācāryaprasiddheḥ ityapi samānamubhayatra
tasya tatkṛtatve pramāṇamāṇye tatprasiddhau kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ ? tadarthaṃ karaṇāt tasyeti cet; tarhi sarvaṃ śāstraṃ tadavibhidheyaṃ ca ata eva śiṣyāṇāmeva na tatkṛtam iti vyapadiśyeta
pā tra ke sa ri ṇo'pi vā na bhavet; tenāpi anyārthaṃ tatkaraṇāt tenāpyanyārthamiti na kasyacit syāt
anena tadviṣayaprabandhakāraṇāt pā tra ke sa ri ṇaḥ tad iti cintitam; mūlasūtrakāreṇa kasyacid vyapadeśābhāvaprasaṅgāt
tasmāt sākalyena sākṣātkṛtya upadiśata eva ayaṃ bhagavataḥ tīrthakarasya hetuḥ iti niścīyate
nanu tenāpi tadaṅgīkriyate sādhyābhāve niyamena sādhanābhāvasyopagamāt, tat kimucyate bālaṃ praboddhumiti ? atrāha--svīkurvan bālaḥ padam iti ca anuvarttate
kaiḥ ? ityāha--vitathaikāntaiḥ pakṣadharma eva sapakṣe sanneva ityādayo pi tathā mṛṣā ekāntāḥ taiḥ iti
nirmalaṃ samalaṃ vidhāya pratipadyamānaḥ tatpratipadyate dvicandradarśī va candramasamiti manyate
na kevalaṃ tat malinīkaroti kintu krośatyapi
svāminaḥ ityetat jñāta vibhaktivacanapariṇāmam iha saṃbadhyate
tatkhalavipralabdhākula eva tān śapati nānyaḥ iti hetoḥ vyaktaṃ viśadaṃ yathā bhavati tat padaṃ tathā vivekṣyāmahe
kiṃ tasya padaṃ kena vācyaṃ vyaktaṃ kariṣyate iti ? atrāha--pakṣa ityādi
parārthānumāne punaḥ jijñāpayiṣitaviśeṣaḥ svaniścayavadanyeṣāṃ niścayotpādanāya pakṣaparigrahāt
satyāñca parasya jijñāsāyāṃ tatpratipādayiṣoḥ pakṣavyapadeśo vaktrabhiprāyasyaiva pratyāsatteḥ parārthavyapadeśavat
tādṛśapakṣasya nirupacaritasya dharmaḥ tadaṃśena ca vyāptaḥ
nirupacaritasva tadaṃśaḥ taddhamastadekadeśa iti, pakṣaśabdena samudāyavacanāt
nahi tatra taddharmaḥ sādhayitumiṣṭaḥ tathā ca sarvaḥ sarvadharmā syāt icchāyā niraṅkuśatvāt
tadanirākṛtau sādhayitumiṣṭaḥ taddharmaḥ iti sandehaḥ syāt, anyathā hetuvacanānarthakyāt
sandigdhadharmaṇaḥ pakṣadharmatve kathaṃ tatropacaritapakṣavyapadeśaḥ sandigdhaṃ dharmamicchan hetorasiddhimāśaṅkyeta ? yato'yaṃ upacāramāśrayet
yadi punaḥ upacaritapakṣasya dharmiṇaḥ asandigdhena vyāpto hetuḥ; śabdasya nityatve kṛtakatvādirapi sattvaprameyatvādinā vyāpto hetuḥ syāt na taddharmiṇā

na ca svayamekadeśopacāravṛtteḥ punaḥ sarvanāmnā parāmṛśya samudāyaśabdasya samudāyavṛttirayuktā, yataḥ pakṣaśabdena samudāyasyāvacanāt dharmiṇa eva vacanāt tadaṃśavat taddharmo na tadekadeśaḥ iti sūktaṃ syāt yathā grāmasya tadekadeśasthito'hamadrākṣamiti
tadetat mukhyaśabdārthalaṅghanaṃ gaṅgāsnānabhayāt karkaṭībhakṣaṇanyāyamanusarati tatraiva doṣāt
vyāptirvyāpakasya tatra bhāva eva vyāpyasya vā tatraiva bhāvaḥ; tatra anyathānupapattireva nānyat rūpam

na cet; kiṃ kasya vyāpyaṃ vyāpakaṃ ca ? kāraṇaṃ kāryasya svabhāvo bhāvasya cet; kṣaṇikakāraṇasya kāryakālamaprāpnuvataḥ kathaṃ vyāptirnāma ? tatsvabhāvayośca bhedaikānte kiṃ kena vyāpyate ? vyavahartrabhiprāyavaśāt tattvamasamīkṣya tādātmyatadutpattivyavasthāyāṃ sa pramāṇāntaraṃ prasajyeta avisaṃvādakatvāt
tadetasmin pratibandhaniyame kathaṃ candrāderarvāgbhāgadarśanāt parabhāgo'numīyeta ? nānayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ sahaiva bhāvāt
na ca tādātmyam; lakṣaṇabhedāt alam anyathānupapatteranavadyamanumānam
kiṃ punaranyathopapadyate ? na vai bhāvāḥ paryanuyogamarhanti ? tādātmye kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ vṛkṣasvabhāvā śiṃśapā, dhūmo'gnikāryamatiprasaṅgāt atrāpi tadevottaram
tadā hi vakturabhiprāyavaśānna tadekadeśaḥ tadaṃśaḥ pakṣaśabdena samudāyāvacanāt
tasya vyāptirhi vyāpakasya tatra bhāva eva
anena heto rūpaṃ tadgrāhakaṃ pramāṇam, tadanabhyupagame tadā satāṃ ca darśayati
dharmo'pi, api śabdāt pakṣadharmo'pi ayaṃ śabde sattvādiḥ śakaṭodaye kṛttikodayaḥ pratyakṣapratīyamāno hetutāṃ gamakatvevetiṃ tathā tadaṃśena vyāpto'pi
tadevodāharaṇam--anityaḥ śabdaḥ sattvāt ghaṭavat śrāvaṇatvādvā iti
kiṃ sarvo'pi sa tathāvidhaḥ tāmeti ? na; ityāha--lakṣyate niścīyate
asyānabhyupagame doṣamāha--na cedam anyathānupapanno na hetutāmeti, anyathā sa śyāmaḥ tatputratvāt ityādirapi āgacchet
tathā paramārthato'nyathānupapanno'pi na cet tarkeṇa anyathānupapanno'yam iti na lakṣyate hetutām eti itarathā kvacid dhūmadarśanāt nālikeradvīpādāgatasya agnipratipattiḥ syāt
athavā tarkeṇa lakṣyate ced anyathānupapanno'yaṃ nanu hetutāmeti kintu etyeveti
svārthaṃ yad anumānaṃ tatra dharmī pakṣaḥ
parasmai padārthaṃ yad anumānaṃ tatra punaḥ iti pakṣāntarasūcane jijñāpayiṣitaviśeṣo dharmī pakṣaḥ ityanuvartate

tasya niścayaḥ anumeyapratipattiḥ tena tulyaṃ varttate iti tadvad anyeṣāṃ pratipādyānām niścayotpādanāya anumeyapratītijananāya pakṣaparigrahāt pratipādakasya kāraṇāt jijñāpayiṣitaviśeṣaḥ sa ityucyate
yatra hi paraṃ prati asiddho dharmaḥ pratipādayitumiṣṭo bhavati sa eva tathocyate

nanu svaniścayavadanyeṣāṃ niścayotpādanāya pakṣaparigrahe'pi yadi pratipādyābhimatasya tatra dharmajijñāsā nāsti kathamasau jijñāpayiṣitaviśeṣaḥ ? tatra viśeṣaṃ jñātum icchantaṃ pratipādayitumiṣṭaviśeṣaḥ jijñāpayiṣitaviśeṣa ityucyate iti cet; atrāha--satyāṃ ca ityādi
satyāmeva parasya pratipādyasya jijñāsāyāṃ jijñāpayiṣitaviśeṣo dharmī pakṣa ucyate

nanu tatra tasya yadi jijñāsā syāttarhi yathā svārthe anumāne tadvata eva pakṣavyapadeśaḥ tathā parārthe'pi parasya tadvataḥ tadvyapadeśa iti tadguṇadoṣābhyāṃ parasyaiva sambandho na pratipādakasyeti cet; atrāha--vaktrabhiprāyasyaiva ityādi
tato'yamarthaḥ--satyāmapi parasya jijñāsāyāṃ tat apratītārthaṃ pratipādayiṣoḥ pratipādakasya ityarthaḥ
pakṣeṇa vyapadeśaḥ pakṣavyapadeśaḥ tasya sa pakṣa iti yāvat netarasya
kutaḥ ? ityatrāha--vaktuḥ pratipādakasya yo'bhiprāyaḥ tadapratītārthapratipādanābhisandhiḥ tasyaiva na itarābhiprāyasya pratyāsatteḥ kāraṇāt
tathāhi--prathamaṃ parasya tattvabubhutsā tadanantaraṃ tannivedanaṃ punaḥ pratipādakasya tatpratipādanābhiprāyaḥ pakṣaparigrahaśca iti pakṣaparigrahaṃ prati vaktrabhiprāyasya pratyāsattiḥ
evaṃ pakṣasya lakṣaṇaṃ pratipādya prayogaṃ darśayannāha--tādṛśasya uktarūpasya pakṣasya dharmaḥ tadāśritatvāt
atra pūrvāparāvadharaṇaniyamacintā na kṛtā ubhayatrāpi doṣābhāvasya nirūpayiṣyamāṇatvāt
vyāpyagatā tatraiva tatra bhāvaḥ, vyāpakagatā tatra bhāva eva vyāpakasya iti
kena ? ityāha--tade daṃśena tacchabdena pakṣaḥ parāmṛśyate
yadyapi ca śābdyā vṛttyā pakṣasya dharmaviśeṣaṇatayā aprādhānyaṃ tathāpi ārthanyāyānusāri tasya prādhānyaṃ tadāśritatvād dharmasya iti
vyāptirhi vyāpakasya tatra bhāva eva, vyāpyasya vā tatraiva bhāvaḥ
vyāpake sādhye satyeva, na tu vyāpakābhāve
sadbhāva eva na tu kadācidapyabhāva iti
etena anvayo vyatireko vā pakṣadharmaśca yathāsvaṃ pramāṇena niścita uktaḥ
nanu yadi dharmaḥ; na tadveśaḥ tadavayavaḥ
ata eva dha rma kī rti nā uktam--taddharmo na tadekadeśaḥ hetubi॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 17 iti cet; naitatsāram; dharmaikadeśayoḥ bhedābhāvābhiprāyeṇa evaṃ vacanāt

bhedā'bhedātmake hi jñeye bhedāḥ kadācid dharmaśabdena kadācid aṃśaśabdena kadācid ekadeśaśabdena bhedaśabdena paryāyaśabdena anena bodhyante , tadātmake jñeya iti dravyaparyāyātmā'rthaḥ iti vastubhūtāṃdharmādhiṣṭhānaṃ bhāvaḥ ityādi vyavahāradarśanāt
kīrttiḥ punaḥ ko'nyo na dṛṣṭo bhāgaḥ syāt pra॰ vā॰ 3
44 iti dṛṣṭa eva akhilo guṇaḥ pra॰ vā॰ 3
42 iti dharmadharmitayā pra॰ vā॰ svavṛ॰ pṛ॰ 24 iti ca vadanneva dharmaikadeśayoḥ bhedaṃ svavacanaviruddhaṃ vadantīti darśayitumidamuktam--taddharmaḥ tadekadeśa iti
samudāyapakṣaikadeśasya upacaritapradeśasya dharmiṇa ekadeśa iti cet; atrāha--pakṣaśabdena samudāyavacanāt
sa avayavaḥ taddharmapadena na vaktuṃ śakyate ityarthaḥ
pakṣaśabdena dharmimātravacanāt na tadaṃśaḥ tasya eka deśābhāvāditi
evaṃ tāvat parapratipādye sati mukhye kiṃ gauṇakalpanayā iti vā rti ka-he tu bi ndu śā stre upacaritaṃ paropacaritaṃ paropadarśitaṃ pakṣaṃ dūṣayitum upadarśayannāha--pakṣo dharmī ityādi
pakṣo dharmī ityevam upacāre dharmadharmisamudāyaṃ vā avinābhāvataḥ pakṣadharmasya tadekadeśe dharmiṇi ekadeśābhāvena paramārthato'dhyārope aṅgīkriyamāṇe
sa sādhyo dharmo yasya tasya bhāvaḥ taddharmatā sāpi na siddhā iti
apiśabdāt na kevalaṃ tadekadeśatā na sidhyati
yathaiva hi niraṃśasya dharmiṇo na ekadeśasaṃbhavaḥ svayaṃ samudāyaprasaṅgāt tathā na taddharmasyāpi saṃbhavaḥ, dharmadharmirūpasamudāyaprāpteranivāraṇāt
kathamanyathā prayogakāle dharmadharmisamudāyaḥ pakṣaḥ ityucyate iti manyate
tatra hetulakṣaṇe niścetavye dharmī anumeyaḥ, anyatra tu sādhyapratipattikāle samudāyo'numeyaḥ
nanu dharmadekade kathamucyate na kevalaṃ tadekadeśatā api tu taddharmatā na sidhyediti; satyam; naivaṃ vaktavyaṃ parāpekṣayā tūktam
satyam ekadeśavat tatra vastuno dharmo'pi na saṃbhavati, sādhayituṃ tatreṣṭi iti cet; atrāha--nahi ityādi
natra khalu tatra niraṃśe dharmiṇi sādhayitum iṣṭaḥ taddharmaḥ tasya dharmiṇo dharmaḥ
nahi puruṣecchāvaśād bhāvo'nyathā bhavati, tadekadeśatā anyathā astu iti manyate
tathā tena tatra sādhayitum iṣṭaḥ taddharmaḥ ityanena ca prakāreṇa sarvo nīlādiḥ arthaḥ sarvadharmā sarvaḥ pītatvādiko dharmo yasya iti sa taddharmā syāt iti
nanu yathā śabde nityatvaṃ sādhayituṃ jano vāñchati naivaṃ nīlādau pītatvādikam, ato'yamadoṣaḥ iti cet; niraṅkuśatvāt nivārakābhāvāt
kasyāḥ ? ityāha--icchāyāḥ kākakokilakulādikaṃ pītaṃ sattvāt kanakavat iti sādhayato nivārakābhāvāt

nanu pakṣabādhakaṃ tasyāḥ, yatra tu tannāsti tatra sādhayitum iṣṭaḥ taddharmaḥ iti cet; atrāha— tadanirākṛtau tasya sādhayitum iṣṭasya dharmasya pratyakṣādinā'nirākṛtau anirākaraṇe sādhayitum iṣṭaḥ taddharmaḥ ityaṅgīkriyamāṇāyāṃ sandehaḥ syāt tadanirākṛtau iti sambandhaḥ
evaṃ manyate--anityaḥ śabdaḥ sattvāt ghaṭavat ityādāvapi tadicchākāla eva nahi tadanirākṛtiḥ avasīyate, anavasitatve na lakṣaṇamiti
tadasandehe dūṣaṇamāha--anyathā anyena tadanirākṛtasandehaprakāreṇa hetuvacanānarthakyāt hetoḥ sandehaḥ syāt iti padaghaṭanāt
tathāhi--tatra dharmiṇi sādhyaviniścayāt tadanirākṛtiniścaye na sandehanivṛttiḥ hetūpanyāsācca prāgeva tadviniścaye kiṃ teneti ?

syānmatam--na sādhyaviniścayāt tatsandehavinivṛttiḥ, viniścayo'pi ta tatra pratibaddhaliṅgadarśanāditi; tanna sāram; yata evaṃ vai paramārthataḥ taddharmaḥ, itarathā na tatpratibaddhaliṅgasya tatra darśanam
na ca niraṃśe tadupapannam, na punaḥ sādhayitum iṣṭa eva taddharmaḥ
na vai sadhūmaḥ pradeśaḥ syā gnimanicchantaṃ pratya nyathā bhavatīchannaṃ prati sāgnirbhavati iti nyāyo'sti
na ca niraṃśaṃ nāma kiṃvā na nirūpitaṃ nirūpayiṣyate cātraiva
syādetat na tatra bādhito niścito vā api tu sandigdhaḥ taddharmaḥ iti cet; atrāha— tatra dharmiṇi upacaritapakṣaḥvyapadeśa sandigdhaṃ dharmamicchan katham asiddham āśaṅkyeta
kiṃ bhūtasya ? ityāha--sandigdhadharmaṇaḥ, sandigdhaḥ sādhyo'nityatvādidharmo yasya tasya iti

etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā sandigdhena taddharmeṇa hetoḥ vyāptiriṣyate tathā sandigdhasiddhadharmadharmisamudāyaḥ pakṣa iṣyatām iti na yuktametat--yadi hetuprayogāt pūrvaṃ samudāyasiddhiḥ kiṃ hetunā ? tadasiddhau hetoḥ taddharmatā'siddhiḥ iti
tulanā--pakṣadharma ityatra hetulakṣaṇe'pi kriyamāṇe yadi samudāyaḥ pakṣo gṛhyate yo'numānaviṣayaḥ tadā sarvo heturasiddhaḥ, siddhau vā anumānavaiyarthyamityāha pakṣo dharmīti
kiṃbhūtāmasiddhiṃ katham asiddhiṃ kathamāśaṅketa ? ityatrāha--yato yasmāt tadasiddhiśaṅkanād ayaṃ kī rtiḥ upacāram āśrayeta pakṣo dharmā vayave samudāyopavād hetubi॰ pṛ॰ 52 ityanena iti
yata iti vā ākṣepe naiva tamāśrayeta
ko hi anunmattaḥ sandigdhena dharmeṇa hetorvyāptimicchati na punaḥ samudāyamiti
nanu mayā yathā sandigdhena samudāyo neṣyate dharmeṇa tathā vyāptirapi hetorneṣyate, kintu asandigdhena iti cet; atrāha--yadi ityādi
nanu etad āśaṅkya anyathā hetuvacanānarthakyāt ityanena parihṛtaṃ kimarthaṃ punaḥ āśaṅkyate iti cet ? adhikadūṣaṇapratipādanārtham iti
ādau yo yadi iti parābhiprāyasya, punaḥ iti pakṣāntarasya dyotakaḥ
kasya ? dharmiṇaḥ na samudāyasya asandigdhena niścitena, dharmeṇa ityanuvarttate vyāpto hetuḥ iṣyate ityadhyāhāraḥ
atra dūṣaṇam-- śabdasya nityatve akṛtakatve sādhye kṛtakatvādiḥ ādiśabdena utpattyādiparigrahaḥ hetuḥ syāt, viruddho na syāditi manyate
na hi sattvādikamantareṇa kṛtakatvādirasti, iti tena vyāpta ucyate
atha ya eva sādhayitumiṣyate tenaiva vyāpto hetuḥ nānyena, so'sandigdho na bhavati; hetuvacanānarthakyaprasaṅgāt ityuktam

syānmatam--dṛṣṭānte so'sandigdhaḥ na pakṣe, tatra tu sādhayitumiṣṭatvāt, setsyati iti vā tasya ityucyate iti; tanna sāram; yato hetoḥ punaḥ samudāya siddhe sa tasya bhaviṣyati iti prāgapi tasyaivocyatām na dharmimātrasya
yathā kaścit kañcit pacantamupalabhya anyaṃ pṛcchati kasya ayaṃ pakṣā iti ? sa pṛṣṭa āha--odanasya iti
tato manyāmahe--yasmin odane jāte asya iti vyapadeśabhāk sa bhaviṣyati tena pūrvaṃ vyapadiśyata iti dharmiṇi pakṣopacārā'narthakyam
na ca naiva samudāyavṛttiḥ ayuktā samudāye varttanaṃ nā'yuktam
kiṃbhūtasya ? svayam ātmanā ekasmin deśe samudāyaikabhāge dharmiṇi upacāreṇa vṛttiḥ varttanaṃ yasya tasya tadvṛtteḥ
punarapi kiṃbhūtasya ? ityāha--punaḥ paścāt sarvanāmnā tadaṃśena ityatra tacchabdena parāmṛśya
yato yasmāt tadvṛtteḥ ayuktatvāt tadaṃśaḥ taddharmo na tadekadeśaḥ, kutaḥ pakṣaśabdena samudāyasyāvacanāt dharmiṇa eva vacanāt ityevaṃ sūktaṃ naiva syāt iti
evaṃ manyate--samudāyaśabdasya upacārāt tadekadeśavṛttasyāpi yadā samudāyavṛttirna virudhyate tadā tasyaiva tacchabdena parāmarśaḥ--tadaṃśaḥ tadekadeśaḥ iti na virudhyate iti
grāmasya tadekadeśasya na sarvasya, anyathā tadekadeśasthito'ham adrākṣam ityasyānupapattiḥ
anena grāmaśabdasya upacāreṇa tadekadeśe vṛttim āha
tacchabdena atra mukhyasya samudāyarūpasya grāmasya parāmarśaḥ na tadanekadeśasya, pāṭakāntaravyavasthitasya evaṃ prayogāt tasya ekadeśe tiṣṭhati iti tatsthaḥ
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt etat pareṇa kriyamāṇam
tathāhi--aṃśaśabdasya mukhyo loko rthaḥ bhāgaḥ, pakṣaśabdasya dharmadharmisamudāyaḥ tasya atilaṅghanaṃ atikramaṇam
tat kiṃ karoti ? ityāha--gaṅgāsnānabhayāt yaḥ karkaṭībhakṣaṇanyāyaḥ tam anusarati
nanu tadbhayāt karkaṭītakṣaṇe vadhabandhādiko doṣo'sti na tallaṅghane tatkathamucyate--tannyāyamanusarati iti cet ? atrāha--tatraiva ityādi
tatra ullaṅghane doṣāt na tallaṅghana iti evakārārthaḥ
tataḥ sthitam--jijñāsita ityādi, na punaḥ pakṣo dharmī ityādi
evaṃ pakṣadharmaḥ tadaṃśena ityetad dvayaṃ vyākhyāya vyāptaḥ ityetad vyācaṣṭe— vyāptiḥ ityādinā

sā ca vyāpyavyāpakobhayāśriteti vyāptiḥ vyāpakasya sambandhinī yatra asau vyāpyo dharmo dharmiṇi varttate tatra, na punaḥ dharma eva tatra anyadharmā'bhāvāt, bhāva eva vyāpyasya vyāptiḥ ityanuvarttate, vā śabdaḥ samuccaye yatraiva dharmiṇi vyāpako dharmo vidyate tatraiva nānyatra bhāvaḥ
kimevaṃ sati jātam ? ityatrāha--tatra tasyāṃ vyāptau aṅgīkriyamāṇāyām anyathā sādhyābhāvaprakāreṇa hetoḥ anupapattireva nānyad rūpam uktam ityadhyāhāraḥ
anena pakṣadharmaḥ tadaṃśena vyāptaḥ hetutāmeti, anyathānupapanno'yaṃ cet tarkeṇa lakṣyate iti samarthitam
anyathānupapattiryadi na kiṃ sādhyam kasya vyāpyaṃ sādhanaṃ vyāpakaṃ cit

kasyacit sādhyābhimatā bhāve'pi anyasya bhāvāditi manyate iti pṛṣṭamiva ātmānaṃ manyamānaḥ paraḥ prāha--kāraṇaṃ pāvakādikaṃ kāryasya dhūmādeḥ svabhāvo vṛkṣatvādiḥ bhāvasya śiṃśapātvādeḥ vyāpakam ityanuvarttate
yadi kāraṇaṃ kāryasya svabhāvo bhāvasya niyamena vyāpaka iṣyate tarhi tadabhāve avaśyaṃ tanna bhavati iti anyathānupapattireva samarthitā
sā ca anekānta eva saṃbhavatīti kṣaṇikasya ityanena darśayati
kṣaṇikasya utpattisamayānantaraṃ niranvayanāśinaḥ kāraṇasya parābhiprāyeṇa idamuktam, tattvataḥ tanna kāraṇam
kiṃbhūtasya ? kāryakālam aprāpnuvataḥ kāryotpatteḥ prāgeva nastasya kathaṃ na kaṃ ñcid vyāptirnāma
kāraṇasya hi vyāpakasya vyāptiḥ, yatra kāryaṃ tatra bhāva vaca
na ca prāgeva naṣṭasya sa labhyate
evaṃ hi kāryamahetukaṃ tadabhāve bhavat kena vāryate ? śeṣamatroktamiti bhāvaḥ
svabhāvahetuṃ dūṣayannāha--bhāvasvabhāvayośca sattvakṣaṇikatvayośca abhedaikānte aṅgīkriyamāṇe kiṃ kena vyāpyate vyāpyavyāpakadvayavirahāt
vyāpakaṃ tadatanniṣṭhaṃ vyāpyaṃ tanniṣṭhameva vā | iti
paraṃ vyāpyaṃ vyāpakaniṣṭhameva, na kadācidapi vyāpakābhāve bhavati
yatpunaretat--nityā kalpitena anityatvena asattvavyāvṛttyā kalpitaṃ sattvaṃ vyāpyeta iti; tadapi tadekānte durlabham; vikalpābhāve tatkalpanasya atyantamasaṃbhavāt
tadbhāve vā abhilāpyetarākārayoḥ kathañcid viruddhayoḥ ekatra saṃbhavād a po ha vā rtikā ya niravaśeṣāya datto jalāñjaliḥ
atrāha pra jñā ka ra gu ptaḥ-- kāraṇaṃ na kāryasya svabhāvo vā bhāvasya nāvyāpakaḥ pramāṇābhāvena tayorabhāvāt
yattu kāryādeḥ kāraṇādikaṃ prati hetutvamucyate, tad vyavahartuḥ abhiprāyavaśāt prāmāṇyaṃ vyavahāreṇa pra॰ vā॰ 1

6 iti vacanāt iti; taṃ pratyāha--vyavaharturabhiprāyavaśāt vyavaharttāraḥ śāstrasaṃkārarahitā lokā na tatsaṃskāravanto naiyāyikādayaḥ teṣāmanyathābhiprāyāt, teṣāṃ vyavahartṝṇām paramārthayoḥ hetuphalayoḥ bhāvasvabhāvayorabhāve'pi sarvatra agnereva dhūmaḥ vṛkṣa eva śiṃśapā ityabhiprāyaḥ tadvat sā tādātmyatadutpattivyavasthāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyām
athavā tattvaṃ pratibhāsādvaitaṃ samīkṣyate, tatsamīkṣaṇe tadavya vasthāyogāt
tasyāṃ kim ? ityāha--sa tadabhiprāyaḥ pramāṇāntaraṃ pratyakṣānumānābhyām anyat pramāṇaṃ prasajyeta
tatra tadantarbhāve vā pratyakṣavaśāt tadvyavasthā iti sāṃvṛtatvamanupapannamasya

kiṃca na ananukṛtānvayavyatirekaṃ kāraṇam nā'kāraṇaṃ viṣayaḥ iti vacanāt anumānaṃ tadvyavasthāyāḥ kāryaṃ sad vyavasthāpakam; tacca tatkāryaṃ tadabhiprāyāt, sa ca anumānam, tatrāpi tadeva codyaṃ tadeva uttaram, anavasthā ca
nanu saḥ pramāṇameva na bhavati tallakṣaṇābhāvāt kathaṃ tadantaramiti cet ? atrāha— avisaṃvādakatvāt tadvyavasthā'vyabhicāritvāt
apisaṃvādakaṃ ca jñānaṃ pramāṇamavisaṃvādijñānam pra॰ vā॰ 1
asiddho'yaṃ heturiti cet; atrāha--visaṃvādakatve avisaṃvādakatvābhāve tadabhiprāyasya abhyupagamyamāne tadāśrayaṇaṃ tasya tadabhiprāyasya aṅgīkaraṇam aprekṣākāritvaṃ bauddhasya
tathāhi--yad visaṃvādaṃ tad vyavahāre'pi nābhimatavyavasthopayogi yathā marīcikājalajñānam, visaṃvādī ca tadabhiprāyaḥ
yad yadvyavasthopayogi na bhavati na tat tadarthinā upagamyate yathā jalārthinā tadeva jñānam, tadvyavasthānupayogī ca tadabhiprāyaḥ
tadevaṃ tadabhiprāsya avisaṃvādakatve parasya pramāṇāntaramāpatati, anyathā tadanāśrayaṇāt tannibandhanavyavahāravilopa iti sthitam
ayamapi na doṣaḥ abhyupagamāditi cet; āstāṃ tāvadetat
tasmin paramatagate etasmin ucyamāne pratibandhaniyame tādātmyādirūpe aṅgīkriyamāṇe katham arvāgbhāgadarśanāt parabhāgo'numīyeta
katham ? ityāha--nānayoḥ arthāt sāgāvarabhāga yoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ

kiṃ punaḥ ityādi paramatamāśaṅkate--kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam anyathā parabhāgābhāvaprakāreṇa upapadyate arvāgbhāga iti cet ? asyottaram--navai naivāḥ paryanuyogam arhanti kimevaṃ bhavanto bhavati iti ? kevalaṃ yathā tai bādhabodha pratibhānti tathaiva aṅgīkarttavyāḥ prajñālocanaiḥ
pādaprasārikā evaṃ syāditi cet; atrāha--tādātmya ityādi
tādātmye kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ vṛkṣasvabhāvo śiṃśapā dhūmaḥ agnikāryam ityevaṃ prasaṅgāt; atrāpi tadevottaram--navai bhāvāḥ paryanuyogamarhanti iti
bhavatu tarhi arvāgbhāgo'nyathā'nupapattereva parabhāgasya heturiti cet; atrāha--parabhāga ityādi

tadarvāgbhāgasya parabhāgāvinābhāvasvabhāvaṃ kalpayatā dhūmasyāpi pāvakāvinābhāvasvabhāvādeva tatra gamakatvaṃ pratipattuṃ yuktaṃ kiṃ tadutpattyā ? tasyāṃ ca sarvatha gamyagamakabhāvaḥ sarvathā janyajanakabhāvāt
kiṃ kuryāt ? ityatrāha--svabhāvaṃ kāryahetuṃ ca tatra anyathānupapattau antarbhāvayet na kim ? antarbhāvayedeva

tasya candrādayo arvāgbhāgaḥ tasya parabhāgāvinābhāvasvabhāva tadavyabhicārisvarūpaṃ kalpayatā na kevalamasyaiva api tu dhūmasyāpi pāvakāvinābhāvasvabhāvāde va tatra pāvake gamakatvaṃ pratipattuṃ yuktam iti
tataḥ kim ? ityāha--kiṃ na kiñcit tasmāt pāvakāt utpattyā dhūmasya iti sambandhaḥ
atha tadutpattyaiva dhūmasya tatra gamakatvam; ityatrāha--sā ca tadutpattāveva gamakatve abhyupagamyamānāyāṃ sarvathā sarveṇa prakāreṇa gamyagamakabhāvaḥ pāvakadhūmayoḥ syāt ityadhyāhāraḥ
yathā pāvako dāhapākādikāriṇā sāmānyaprakāreṇa gamyaḥ tathā sajātīyavijātīyavyāvṛttāsādhāraṇena deśakālākāraniyatenāpi syāt iti pratyakṣavat svalakṣaṇaviṣayatā anumiteḥ iti nāto viśeṣaḥ
avaiśadyād viśeṣaḥ; ityapi vārttam; viśeṣaviṣayatve tadayogāt, parasya tathābhyupagamābhāvāt
kathamevaṃ sati viṣayasaṃplavāt prameyadvaividhyāt pramāṇadvaividhyamiti cet; ayamaparo'sya doṣo'stu

yatpunaretaduktam-- tadavinābhāva dhūmaviśeṣāvasāya iṣyate eva sarvathā gamyo'gniḥ kuṅkumacandanāgurujanitadhūmāvadhāraṇe tataḥ tatpratipattidarśanāt iti; tadanena nirastam; tatrāpi kuṅkumādisāmānyadharmānumiteḥ, itarathā antyaviśeṣaviṣayatvād anumiteḥ tatastatra sandehaḥ kutaḥ ? viśeṣānumāne anvayābhāvaśca cintyaḥ

tathā dhūmaḥ sarvathā gamaka iti viśeṣadharmeṇa ca kaṇṭhākṣavikārakāriṇā sāmānyadharmeṇāpi sattvādinā syāditi dhūme saṃśayādibhāve'pi sattvādiviniścayaṃ tato'gnipratipattirastu, tataḥ sandigdhādyasiddhatākīrttanamasāramiti manyate
syānmatam--pāvakasya sāmānyadharmā eva janakāḥ, tataḥ taireva gamyaḥ, dhūmasya viśeṣadharmā eva janyā iti taireva gamaka iti cet; atrāha--sarvathā sarvaprakāreṇa janyajanakabhāvāt

bahuvacanaṃ sarvathā arthaparigrahārtham, aṃśena avayavena janyajanakabhāvaḥ prasajyeta yathā pāvakaḥ sāmānyadharmaiḥ na viśeṣadharmairjanako dhūmo viśeṣadharmairna sāmānyadharmaiḥ janyaḥ tathā sarve bhāvā iti
tatra grāhyagrāhakabhāvo'pi tannibandhano jñānaiva iti na yuktametat--ekasyārthasvabhāvasya pra॰ vā॰ 3
ko'nyo na dṛṣṭo bhāgaḥ syāt yaḥ pramāṇaiḥ parīkṣyate
yadi mataṃ sarvathā janyajanakabhāvaḥ sarvathā gamyagamakabhāvaśca iṣyate, evaṃ tajjanyaviśeṣāvasāya iti; tatrāha--tajjanyaviśeṣa ityādi
tādātmyāviśeṣe'pi vyāpyasyaiva gamakatvaṃ kathayan ekalakṣaṇameva samarthayate pakṣadharmatvādyanapekṣaṇāt
sa dhūmagato'vāntaro bhedo'yaṃ janyo yasya sa tathoktaḥ, sa cāsau viśeṣaśca pāvakagato bhedaḥ
kaḥ ? na kaścidabhimataḥ svayaṃ saugatena gamyaḥ iti sambandhaḥ
kiṃbhūtaḥ ? ityāha--paro vidyamānaḥ paro viśeṣo yasmād ityaparo'sādhāraṇa ityarthaḥ
kiṃ sarvathā nābhimataḥ ? ityatrāha--anyatra anyathā'nupapatteḥ anyathānupapattimantareṇa tasyāstu abhimata eva, nidarśanamantareṇa tadgamyatvopagamāt
idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam--tena agninā janyate iti tajjanyaḥ sa cāsau dhūmatvaviśeṣaṇaḥ sattvādiḥ dhūmagato viśeṣaśca tadviśeṣaḥ ko'paro'nyaḥ abhimataḥ svayaṃ saugatena
tathāhi--dhūme dharmiṇi dhūmatvavat sattvāderapi pāvakakāryatvā'viśeṣe'pi dhūmatvameva tadanyathānupapattyā gamakaṃ netaraditi nirastā tadutpattiḥ
vyāpyasyaiva sattvāderna vyāpakasya anityatvādeḥ gamakatvaṃ kathayan para ekalakṣaṇameva samarthayate pakṣadharmatvādyapekṣaṇāyā ādiśabdena tadaṃśavyāptigrahaṇam
nanu sādharmyavaidharmyadṛṣṭāntayoranyatarābhāve na hetuḥ iti cet; atrāha--tad ityādi

tasyāḥ antarvyāpteḥ siddhiśca jñaptiḥ ātmalābho vā asiddhiśca viparyayaḥ tayoḥ satyoḥ bahirvyāpteḥ pakṣādanyatra vyāptiḥ bahirvyāptiḥ, tayoḥ sakāśād asādhanāt sādhanā bhāvāt, tām āśritya na kiñcit sādhanaṃ bhavatīti
athavā, tasyāḥ asādhanatvāt iti sā na sādhanam iti yāvat
pakṣe anyatra ca vyāptiḥ sakalavyāptiḥ tasyā ubhayadoṣānatikramāt tadeva samarthayata iti 308
tathāhi--nāntareṇa antarvyāptim sakalavyāptiḥ, sa cet siddhā kutaścit; kimapareṇa ? na cet; kā sakalavyāptiḥ ? tathā vinā bahirvyāptyāpi na sā yuktā, tāttarayā
satyam, arvāgbhāgadarśanāt candrādeḥ parabhāgo'numīyate, sa tu nānyathānupapatterapi tu ekasāmagryadhīnatayā iti; etatkadarthayannāha--cittabhrānti ityādi
upalakṣaṇametat tena vikalpasaṃśayaviparyāsādīnāṃ grahaṇam, svasaṃvittiśca svasaṃvedanādhyakṣam
cittasya jñānasya bhrāntisvasaṃvittī tayoḥ tādātmyaṃ ced vilakṣaṇaiḥ visadṛśaiḥ dṛṣṭaiḥ indriyagocaraiḥ bhāvyam bhavitavyam
keṣāṃ kaiḥ ityāha--naśvarāṇām pratikṣaṇabhaṅgurāṇām anaśvaraiḥ sthitaiḥ
kiṃ sarvaiḥ ? na ityāha--svaiḥ ātmīyaiḥ na buddhyantaragataiḥ
yadyapi ca bhrāntigraheṇana viparyāsa uktaḥ tathāpi dvayoḥ upādānaṃ bāhyetaravibhramapratipādanārtham
evaṃ sati kiṃ labdham ? ityāha--tathā ca ityādi

pratyanīkasvabhāvatādātmyamanyathānupapattyā kvacit siddhamupayan ekāntabhinnaviṣayaṃ pratītiviruddhamavikalpaṃ nirviṣayaṃ cānumānaṃ parikalpya tatastattvasiddhiṃ vyavasthāpayatīti kimataḥ paramayuktam anyathānupapatteratikramāt
tato'paraḥ sahabhāvināṃ rūpādipara bhāgādīnām rasārvāgbhāgādibhiḥ prakḷptaḥ pratibandhaniyamaśca svamataghātī, upayuktarasānumeyopādānaśaktitaḥ rūpasiddhau pratītiṃ svaliṅgasaṃkhyāñca laṅghayet
upayuktādrasāt rūpādyutpattau sahakāritvaṃ tadupādānasvabhāvaṃ pratipannavān, punaḥ tatkāryaṃ rūpādikaṃ pratyeti
svopādānasya śaktipravṛttyā vinā na rasotpattiḥ saiva rūpādikāraṇamiti atītaikakālānāṃ gatirnānāgatānāṃ vyabhicārāt iti ko'yaṃ pratipattikramaḥ tathaiva vyavahārābhāvāt
sahabhāvinaśca rasāt pāramparyeṇa rūpādyanumānaṃ na kevalaṃ pratītiprasiddhimuparuṇaddhi kintu anumīyamānaṃ pratibandhaniyamaṃ ca
kiṃbhūtā sā ? ityatrāha--tādātmyamatī vi śabdo'tra draṣṭavyaḥ
punarapi kiṃbhūtaiḥ ? suparīkṣitaiḥ kathaṃ suparīkṣakaiḥ ? ityāha--anyathānupapannaiḥ iti
na kaivalaṃ taiḥ teṣāmeva tat kintu cākṣuṣāṇām, upalakṣaṇametat sattvaṃ ndriyāṇām
kiṃbhūtaiḥ ? svaptāvaiḥ api śabdaḥ cākṣuṣāṇām ityatra pati tavyaḥ
yathā loke pratīyate ityanena ca pratītisiddhañcānekāntaṃ darśayati
prakṛte ko'sya upayoga iti cet ? atrāha--skandho'rvāgbhāgetyādi
kiṃbhūtaḥ ? arvāgādīnāṃ dvandvaḥ, punaḥ bhāgaśabdena karmadhārayaḥ, te ātmāno yasya sa cāsau ekaśca tadātmaiko yathā loke pratīyate
tatra skandhe kenacid arvāgbhāgena kaścid bhāgo madhyādiḥ anumeyaḥ syāt
yathā kathañcittādātmyāt rasād rūpādiranumeyaḥ, naikasāmagryadhīnatvena tatrāṃ tatra kenacid bhāgena kaścid bhāgo'numīyate iti nidarśanārthaḥ
kārikātrayaṃ sugamatvād avyākhyāya nidarśanaṃ samarthayitukāmaḥ āha pratyanīka ityādi pratyādi

pratyanīkau anyo'nyaviruddhau yau svabhāvau vikalpā'vikalpau bhrānti-pratyakṣau viparyayapratyakṣesaṃśayapratyakṣau tayoḥ tādātmyam ekatvam kvacid vijñānādau siddhaṃ pramāṇaniścitam upapannam abhyupagacchan
anyathā anyena tādātmyābhāvaprakāreṇa tayoḥ svabhāvayoḥ yā anupapattiḥ tayā iti
tathāhi--nirvikalpasvabhāvād vikalpasvabhāvādvi bhedaikānte kutaḥ tadvedanaṃ yataḥ tatkalpanam ? ajñātakalpane atiprasaṅgāt
tathā ca abhilāpasaṃsargayogyapratibhāsā pratītiḥ kalpanā nyāyabi॰ 1
5 yavi kalpanayāpi na labhyata iti dūraṃ saṃvṛtivārtā
svata iti cet; tarhi vikalpasvabhāvo'vikalpa iti tadavasthāprasaṅgaḥ sarvacittacaitasikānām nyāya bi॰ 1
10 ityādi katham ? anyathā tatrāpi aparatatsvabhāvakalpanam uktadoṣam anavasthāmanvākarṣati
yadi punaḥ avikalpasvabhāvād anyena anyavedanam iti nirākāradarśanam, asataśca tatastasya vedanamiti svaparayoḥ pratyanīkayoḥ tādātmyam; atrāpi bhedaikānte ma prakṛtamanuvarttata iti cakrakam
tadupayan vyavasthāpayati iti kimataḥ paramayuktam ? idameva ayuktamiti
kiṃbhūtaṃ kiṃbhūtvā kutaḥ kiṃ vyavasthāpayati ? ityatrāha--avikalpaṃ parikalpya
nahi ekaikaparamāṇuparyavasitavapuḥ adhyakṣaṃ pratītyārūḍhaṃ lakṣyate dṛśyānupalabdhiḥ abhāvaprasaṅgāt ekajñānasaṃsargipadārthadvayābhāvāt
kathamevaṃ vibhramato'pi sthūladīrghādipratītiḥ, yataḥ parvatādivyavasthā iti cet ? ayamaparo doṣo'stu
yadi punaḥ anekaparamāṇuviṣayaṃ sākāramekaṃ darśanam; kiṃ syāt ? uktamatra pratyanīka ityādi
kvacit pratyanīkasvabhāvayoḥ pramāṇasiddhatādātmyopagame nityatvānityatva-kṛtakatva-sattvādīnāṃ pratyanīkasvabhāvanām śabde tādātmyasiddheḥ pratītiviruddhaṃ nirviṣayaṃ taditi manyate
tato'vikalpāt pratyakṣāt tadviruddhāt nirviṣayāccaanumānāt tattvasiddhim iti
yataḥ anyathānupapatteḥ kvacit pratyanīkasvabhāvayoḥ tādātmyamabhyupaiti saugataḥ, tasyā eva tataḥ tattvasiddhiṃ vyavasthāpayato'tikramāt, tato na kvacit tayoḥ tādātmyamiti, idameva ayuktamiti bhāvaḥ

idamatra tātparyam--rasādikṣaṇikaparamāṇūnāṃ vivekaikānte vikalpābhāvāt kuto nirviṣayamapyanumānam, yataḥ tattvavyavasthā ? tadasti cet; vikalpāvikalpapratyanīkasvabhāvayoḥ kvacit tādātmyaṃ siddham, rasādīnāmapi tadasti iti na dṛṣṭāntāsiddhiḥ

yastu manyate--arvāgbhāgāt saṃyoginaḥ parabhāgagaḥ rasād ekārthasamavāyino rūpādiḥ anumīyate, na tādātmyād anyato veti; so'pyanena nirastaḥ; śakyaṃ hi vaktuṃ pratyanīkasvabhāvayoḥ sāmarthyetarayoḥ anyayorvā tādātmyam anyathānupapattyā kvacit tādātmyādau siddham upayan vaiśeṣikādiḥ pratītiviruddham ekāntabhinnasvabhāvadravyaguṇakarmākṣaṇakṣayapradhvaṃsa mavikalpaṃ niraṃśaikārtham niyataṃ parikalpya tatpūrvakatvena nirviṣayam anumānaṃ ceti

nanu yadyapi arvāgbhāga-parabhāgayoḥ rūpādirasādyoḥ tādātmyaṃ tathāpi na tadanyathānupapattyā gamyagamakabhāvaḥ, api tu pūrvaviśiṣṭakāraṇasya anumānena, tata eva tādātmyasyāpi bhāvāditi cet; atrāha--tato'paraḥ ityādi
tataḥ tādātmyā'nyathānupapatteḥ aparaḥ anyaḥ svayam ātmanā saugatena na lokena pramāṇena vā prakḷpto racitaḥ
ca śabdo na kevalaṃ pratyakṣādikaṃ prastāvād arvāgbhāgaparabhāgayoḥ rūpādirasādyoḥ iti gamyate
yadi vā, tataḥ sākṣāt tādātmyatadutpattipratibandhād aparo'nya ekasāmagryadhīnatālakṣaṇa iti vyākhyeyam
kutaḥ sa prakḷptaḥ ? ityāha— sahabhāvinām anumānaprasaṅgāt

upayuktena āsvāditena rasena anumeyā yā upādānasya upayuktatatsahabhāvirasarūpapariṇāmikāraṇasya śaktiḥ sāmarthyaṃ rasasya rasotpattau upādānaśaktiḥ rūpotpattau sahakāriśaktiḥ rūpasyāpi rūpotpattau upādānaśaktiḥ anyatra sahakāriśaktiḥ tataḥ rūpasiddhau rūpānumitau kriyamāṇāyāṃ pratītiṃ lokaprasiddhiṃ laṅghayet saugataḥ
nahi pūrvam upayuktād rasāt sāmagrīviśeṣānumānam tato rūpānumānam iti loke paramparāpratītirasti; tatra upayuktarasādeva rūpānumitipratīteḥ
tathāpi tatkalpane śakyaṃ hi boddhum svabhāvaheturbhāvam ityādinā dūṣaṇaṃ nirūpayiṣyate
atha pratītilaṅghane kathaṃ sa svamataghātī iti cet ? uktamatra dūṣaṇaṃ nirūpayiṣyate iti
upayuktasya rasasya tatsahabhāvino rūpasya ca pariṇāmikāraṇasya uttararasātmakatvena uttararūpātmakatvena ca svayaṃ pariṇāminaḥ
kiñca lokānumānasya mananaṃ yacca kīrttitaṃ kī rtti nā tanva kiṃ tasya pratītivilaṃghamenataḥ tatsiddhau dūṣaṇāntaramāha-- svaliṅgasaṃkhyāṃ kāryasvabhāvānupalabdhigocarāṃ ca laṅghayet
evaṃ kāraṇaliṅgopagamāt rasād upayuktād ityādinā kārikāṃ vivṛṇoti--rasāt
kiṃ bhūtāt ? upayuktāt pratipannavān saugato loko vā
tasya upayuktarasasya yad upādānaṃ tatsvabhāvam, punaḥ paścāt tatkāryam tasya tatra tatsvabhāvasya sahakāritvasya kāryam
śakteḥ pravṛttiḥ kārye vyāpāraḥ tayā vinā na rasotpattiḥ upayukta-rasātmalābhaḥ
kasya tayā vinā ? ityāha--svopādānasya upayuktarasopādānasya kintu tatpravṛttyā tadutpattiḥ
tataḥ kim ? ityāha--saiva tasya śaktipravṛttireva rūpādikāraṇam iti hetoḥ atītaikakālānāṃ gatiḥ pratītiḥ nānāgatānām
pūrvam upayuktarasāt tadupādānarasasya rūpasahakāriṇaḥ pratipattiḥ punaḥ tato rūpasya iti pratipattikramo'yaṃ pareṇa ucyamānaḥ kaḥ kutsita ityarthaḥ
yadvā, atītaikakālānāṃ gatiḥ nānāgatānām iti pratipatteḥ kramaḥ paripāṭiḥ nyāyānatilaṅghanam ko'yam
tathaiva atītaikakālānāṃ gatirnānāgatānām pra॰ vā॰ svavṛ॰ 1
12 ityanenaiva prakāreṇa vyavahārābhāvād anyathāpi vyavahārāt saugatasya iti draṣṭavyam
svayameva upayuktarasānumitarasādinā tadapekṣayā nā nāgatasya rūpāderavyabhicāragateḥ ityupagamāt
dūṣaṇāntaramāha--tathā ca tenaiva paraparikalpitaprakāreṇa kāraṇāt kāryānumānam

pūrvarūpaṃ hi svasajātīyaṃ uttararūpamutpādyaiva uttararasotpādakasāmagryāmanupraviśati iti āsvādyamānarasāt sāmagryanumānaṃ yadyapi kāryāt kāraṇānumānaṃ tathapi ekasāmagryantargatapūrvarūpāt uttararūpānumānaṃ kāraṇāt kāryānumānameva iti bhāvaḥ

yastu manyate--bhāvi kāraṇam iti; asmin darśane kāryāt kāraṇānumānam, na kāraṇāt kāryānumānam iti; sa kī rteḥ anantaravacanaṃ kṛtyati; tasyāpi upayuktarasena pūrvarasapratipattiḥ kāraṇāt kāryānumānaṃ syāt
evamanena pratītiṃ svaliṅgasaṃkhyāṃ ca laṅghayet iti vyākhyātam
tat kiṃ karoti ? ityāha--na kevalaṃ pratītiprasiddhim uparuṇaddhi nirākaroti
anena kṛtanāśo darśitaḥ, kintu pratibandhasya tādātmyatadutpattilakṣaṇasya niyamaṃ ca viruṇaddhi
katham ? anumīyamānam rūpeṇa saha prāktanarasādeḥ tādātmyādyabhāve'pi pratibandhāntarād gamakatvavarṇanāt

syānmatam--na tayā paramārthataḥ pūrvam uttarasya uttaraṃ vā pūrvasya kāraṇaṃ liṅgaṃ ca iṣyate yenāyam anyo'nyasaṃśrayādidoṣaḥ syāt, api tu vyavahāriṇā kevalaṃ tanmatānusāriṇā anumīyate, tadeva anūdyate

tatrāparaḥ prāha--sa tarhi sākṣād rasād rūpapratipattiṃ kurvan kimiti pratikṣiptaḥ ? tatpratibandhābhāvāditi cet; pūrvottarayoḥ kaḥ pratibandhaḥ ? tadutpattiriti cet; pramāṇataḥ siddhā, kimucyate vyavahāriṇeti ? pramāṇasiddhasyobhayorapi abhyupagamārhatvāt, anyathā tparataḥ prāmāṇikatvādvo yena
na ca apramāṇābhyupagamasiddherdbavaisa sa nyāyo nyāyānusāriṇāṃ yuktaḥ
tadapi astu iti cet; atrāha--sahabhāvinaśca ityādi
sahabhāvina eva rasāt samakālarūpādyanumānaṃ na kevalaṃ pāramparyeṇa yā prīti saugatābhyupagatā tāmuparuṇaddhi kintu pratibandhaniyamaṃ ca uparuṇaddhi ityanuvarttate

tadevaṃ dṛṣṭānte nirākulīkṛte para āha--yaduktam--bhrāntipratyakṣayoḥ tādātmyena bhavitavyam iti; tanna sāram; pratyakṣād ātmasaṃvedanarūpād bhrānteḥ citrākāranirbhāsarūpāyāḥ viruddhadharmādhyāsena bhedāditi cet; atrāha--svaṃ svaṃ khaṇḍaśaśced ityādi
svaṃ khaṇḍaśaścetsaṃvittiḥ bahirvedyaṃ na kiṃ tathā
svam ātmānaṃ khaṇḍaśaḥ saccetanādirūpeṇa na vibhramākāravivekarūpeṇa satā'pi bhrānterabhāvaprasaṅgāt saṃvittiḥ viṣayīkaroti vittiḥ buddhiśced yadi
tatra dūṣaṇam bahirvedyaṃ ghaṭādi kinna khaṇḍaśaḥ saṃvittiḥ iti padaghaṭanā
kathaṃ khaṇḍaśaḥ syāt tatsaṃvittiḥ ? ityatrāha--sāmagrī ityādi
yato yasmāt khaṇḍaśaḥ saṃvedanād bhidyaren bhinnāḥ syuḥ parasparam

pūrvārdhasya sugamatvād vyākhyānamakṛtvā paramardhaṃ vyācaṣṭe--pudgalasya rūpādimayaghaṭādeḥ ekasyaiva svaguṇaparyāyasādhāraṇātmana eva na parakalpitarūpādi-paramārthaikāntabhinnaavayava-avayavirūpasya rūpādijñānapratibhāsabhedaḥ kevalaṃ na svarūpabheda ityarthaḥ
rūpādayaḥ eva ekāntabhinnāḥ paramārthā iti bauddhakalpitam, avayava-avayavinau ekāntabhinnāviti yaugaiḥ parikalpitam
nanu ca grāhyākārād bhinnaṃ jñānamāśritya kārikā prakṛttā tatkathamidamucyate iti cet; na; ekasya dṛśyetarasaṃbhavavad bāhyākārasaṃbhavāvirodhābhiprāyeṇa evamabhidhānāt
yadi matam--na jñānasya grāhyādyākārād bhedo nāpi paramārthataḥ tattadātmakam tadākārasya bhrāntasya tataḥ tattvānyatvābhyānirvacanīyatvāt
tasya grāhyādinirbhāsabhedavato jñānasya bhrāntikalpanāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ ubhayākārānatikramāt svapararūpāpekṣayā avibhrametarākārānatilaṅghanāt tadavasthaṃ codyam kathamekam anekātmakam iti ?
atha pararūpavat svarūpe'pi tadbhrāntamiṣyate; tatrāha--yathāsvam ityādi
pratyakṣānumānayoḥ svabhāvavibhramāt anekāntamantareṇa pratyakṣasyāpi svārthasaṃvedanānupapatteḥ suvyavasthitaṃ tattvam !
kiṃ sarvathā ? na ityāha--yathāsvaṃ sarvacittacaittānām ātmasaṃvedanaṃ pratyakṣam nyāyabi॰ 1
10 avikalpakaṃ buddheḥ svarūpam prabhāsvaramidaṃ cittaṃ prakṛtyā pra॰ vā॰ 1
kutaḥ ? ityāha--svākāravibhramāt buddheḥ sva ātmīya ākāraḥ svaprakāśatā svayameva prakāśate pra॰ vā॰ 2
kena pramāṇena ? na kenacit, svayaṃ bhrāntāt pratyakṣāt tadasiddheḥ bahirarthavat

evaṃ manyate--tat svasaṃvedanapratyakṣaṃ nīlamahaṃ vedmi iti grāhyagrāhakasaṃvedanasvabhāvam, tato'nyadvā syāt ? prathamapakṣe anekāntamantareṇa na kevalamanumānasya api tu pratyakṣasyāpi svārthasaṃvedanānupapatteḥ suvyavasthitaṃ tattvam svayameva svasya vā arthaḥ iti
dvitīye sukhanīlādau kā vārttā ? bhrāntatvamiti cet; anyasya tadviparītasya adarśanenā'sattvāt
darśane'pi tadvadeva, tataḥ tadeva codyam pratyakṣānumānayoḥ svabhāvavibhramāt suvyavasthitaṃ tattvam iti
syānmatam--tad vibhramavivekanirmatatayā yadyathātmānaṃ na darśayati tathāpi taccetanadayā darśayati itarasya vibhramābhāva iti; tatrāha--suvyakta ityādi
tau ced bhrāntau kimabhrāntaṃ yat pratyakṣaṃ syāt ? tau hi tadātmānau tadvyatirekeṇa ekāntasyānupalabdheḥ
kathañcidupalabdhau satyāñca tadvivekānupalabdhau upalabdhasyāpi saṃvṛtau cetaḥsvalakṣaṇasya sakṛd vyaktetarasvabhāvau vyāpnuvataḥ krameṇa hetuphalavyāptau kaḥ pratibandhaḥ ?
vyaktaḥ pratyakṣaḥ saṃvideta bodhasvabhāvaḥ saṃvṛtaḥ tadviparīto vedyavedakākāraviveka ityeke svaṃ khaṇḍaśaḥ cet saṃvetti ityādi nānārthametad ityapare
tasmāt saccetanādirūpeṇa iva vibhramavivekarūpeṇāpi buddhiḥ cakāsti kevalaṃ taduttarakālabhāvinī vikalpabuddhiḥ tatrāsantaṃ grāhyādyāvaraṇapaṭaṃ parikalpa tadvivekaṃ saṃvṛṇoti netarad rūpam
svau va to vyaktasaṃvṛtātmānau ca vyāpnoti tadātmakaṃ bhavati ekaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ buddhivastu yadi ityanena parābhyupagamaṃ darśayati

grāhyādyākāravivekaṃ nirmalaṃ vijñānaṃ tāvat na saṃbhavati iti na buddhatyā dinā pratipādayan tadabhyupagamya ceyaṃ kārikā kṛtā iti ca kathañcid ityādinā vyaktetara ityādinā kārikāṃ vivṛṇvannāha--na buddheḥ ityādi
na buddheḥ grāhyagrāhakākārau bhrāntāveva manovikalpabhrāntiracitāveva na tāttvikau iti evakārārthaḥ

kutaḥ ? ityatrāha--svayaṃ saugatasya yo'yam sarvamavibhāgaṃ jñānam iti ekāntaḥ tasya hāneḥ vikalpe to bhāvataḥ syātām, kathamanyathā avibhāgo'pi buddhyātmā, grāhyagrāhakasaṃvittibhedavāniva vikalpena lakṣyate
354 iti subhāṣitaṃ tasya syāt, tadekānte vikalpabhāvāt
so'pi tadantareṇa na; ityapi vārttam; tatrāpi tathākalpane anavasthānāt
vikalpo vastu tasva dvā nānyaditi kiṃ kṛto'yaṃ vibhāga iti manyate
tatraiva dūṣaṇāntaramāha--tau vedinau grāhyagrāhakākārau cet yadi bhrāntau niraṃśabuddhau vikalpāropitau kim abhrāntam tadākārarahitam na kiñcit yad abhrāntaṃ pratyakṣaṃ syāt
idamatra tātparyam--yadi avibhāgo buddhyātmā kadācit pratipannaḥ syāt tad vikalpena tau tatra āropitau iti, nānyathā
nahi śuktikā'siddhau tatra rajatāropasiddhiḥ, rajatatvavad rajate vikalpe ca tau yadi siddhau bhavataḥ
nanu pratibhāsi sarvadā tadātmā'vibhāgaḥ, tau ca vikalpārūḍhau iti cet; atrāha--tau grāhyagrāhakākārau hi khalu tasya buddhyātmanaḥ ātmānau svabhāvau
kutaḥ ? ityāha— tadvyatirekeṇa tadākāravyatirekeṇa ekāntasya eko grāhyādirahitoścetanaiva anto dharmo yasya tasya anupalabdheḥ
śabdādirūpeṇa na vivakṣitarūpeṇa upalabdhau saṃśayādivyavacchedena nirṇītau satyāṃ ca tadvivekānupalabdhau tasya vibhramasya vivekasya anupalabdhau upalabdhasyāpi saṃvṛtau satyāṃ ca ityanu varttate
kasya ? cetaḥsvalakṣaṇasya krameṇa svahetuphalavyāptau kaḥ pratibandhaḥ ?

nanu phale vṛttimad vijñānaṃ na hetau vṛttimat svakāle tadabhāvāt, ata eva hetau vṛttimat na phale, tatkathaṃ cetaḥsvalakṣaṇasya svahetuphalavyāptipratipattiḥ yataḥ tatra kaḥ pratibandhaḥ iti syāditi cet; atrāha--saṃvṛṇotyeva ityādi
yāvatā buddheḥ khaṇḍaśaḥ svārthasaṃvedanaṃ bhavat sākalyena tāvadāndhyavijṛmbhaṇam
kena ? ityatrāha--sāmānyena pūrvāparaikatvena svārthayoḥ ityetad atrāpyapekṣaṃ bhedaikāntavirodhisāmānyātmakahetuphalagrāhiṇī iti yāvat
nanvevaṃ bhavatā kalpyate, nanvevaṃ sā pratibhāsate iti cet; atrāha--avabhāseta ityādi
tato'yamarthaḥ--yathā yena prakāreṇa loke pratīyate vittiḥ tathāvabhāseta
saṃvṛtaviśeṣā ca sāmānyena svārthayoḥ loke pratīyate ataḥ tathaivāvabhāsate
na ca heto vṛttasya jñānasya phalagrahaṇābhimukhyaṃ viruddham, anyathā svātmani vṛttasya paratra vṛttirviruddhā bhavediti sarvasya kṣaṇikatāpisādhanamanavasaram
etāvā~stu viśeṣaḥ ekatra deśasya anyatra kālasya bheda iti
nanu hetuphalasāmānyānāṃ pratibhāsate anyo'nyaviviktaṃ vastutrayamāpatitaṃ naikaṃ tadātmakam, itarathā nānaikaṃ syājjagat iti cet; atrāha--pratyāsanna ityādi
pratyāpodyatayā yathā tathā'vabhāsalakṣaṇayā, svahetoḥ tathotpattilakṣaṇayā aśakyavivecanarūpayā vā aikyaṃ tādātmyaṃ syāt
tathāhi--yadeva patiśaṅkhajñānam arthakriyāsthitivirahāt bhrāntaṃ tadeva svarūpe abhrāntaṃ saṃsthānamātre vā 'viparyayāt
na ca tatra jñānāntarasya avisaṃvādakalpanā, tata eva taddarśanāt, anyathā anyato'pi na bhavet, tato'pi anyata eva kalpanādityavyavasthānāt
yathaiva hi śaṅkhe pītajñānasya pītasambandhārtha kriyāvirahaḥ tathā saṃsthāne sādhāraṇāspaṣṭānumānākārārthakriyā'bhāvaḥ anyathā sāmānyavastu
vyavahārī naivaṃ manyate iti cet; pītajñāne saṃsthānapratibhāse sama
vyavahāre tadaikyamiti cet; tatraiva kṣaṇabhaṅgādikhaṇḍanam, parastu paramārtho'pi cintitaḥ
tadaikye kim ? ityāha--tayā pratyāsattyā svahetuphalayoḥ aikyam
hetuḥ pūrvaparyāyaḥ phalamuttaraparyāyaḥ tayośca anvitaṃ sāmānyaṃ dravyamiti vastutrayam
kvacid bahirantarvā yadvā vibhrame anyatra vā vyavahāre paramārthe vā ekāntasaṃbhave ekāntasya aśeṣaparavādimatasya pramāṇabalāt saṃbhave sati pratītiḥ ayaṃ iyaṃ kriyeta
samasti tatsaṃbhavaḥ tatastadapalāpa iti; atrāha--yāvatā ityādi
svārthayoḥ saṃvedanaṃ grahaṇaṃ buddheḥ khaṇḍaśaḥ svasaṃvedanam sa yadi rūpeṇa na vibhrama- vivekasvarūpeṇa iti dha rmo tta rā diḥ
tathā jñānarūpeṇa na uttarārthakriyāsambandhinā svabhāvena dviṣṭhasambandhasaṃvittiḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 2
itarathā sādhanajñānapratītikāle eva pramāṇatāyāḥ pratīteḥ tatparīkṣaṇaṃ bālavilasitam
yadi punaḥ tatsandhitā tadvadgrahaṇāt, gṛhītopi arthakriyā darśanena na niścīyate; na tarhigṛhītā
tadanusārī ca bhavān, paramārthataḥ kārye kāraṇabhāvobhāve'pi tadicchayā tadaṅgīkaraṇāt,
iha ca rūpādau vastuni dṛśyamāne āntaraḥ sukhādyākārastulyakālaṃ saṃvedyate
na ca gṛhyamāṇākāro nīlādiḥ sātarūpo vedyate iti śakyaṃ vaktum; yato nīlādiḥ sātarūpeṇānubhūyate iti na niścīyate
tadgrahe sāṃvṛtatve tu tadgraho'stu vikalpataḥ || iti
tathā arthavedanamapi nīlāditayā na jātayā iti sautrāntikaḥ
dravyādeḥ tadrūpeṇa na sakala tajanyekalaṃnaka śaktirūpeṇa, tatra avivādaprasaṅgāt, śakteḥ tato bhedaikānte'pi uktam, iti vaiśeṣikādiḥ
tāvadvāntyaviccaṃbhaṇaṃ tattvaparīkṣāyām madhyasthaṃ yadi cetaḥ, tadvijñabhaṇe tu neti
tādātmyaṃ tu kathañcit syāt tato hi na tulāntayoḥ
sthālyādau liṅgamīdṛk cet sarvaṃ kāryaṃ na kiṃ punaḥ || 15
tulāntayornāmonnāmayorekatarasya darśanādanyatarasyānumānam, vṛkṣādeḥ chāyādyanumānaṃ kāryaliṅgaṃ saṃbhāvayan svabhāvahetumuparuṇaddhi
śakyaṃ hi vaktum--bhāvaḥ sat kṛtakaṃ vā vastu janayan anaśvaramevaṃ janayati
ataḥ svakāraṇasvabhāvānumānāt kāraṇātmanaḥ pratipattiriti duḥkhaṃ vatāyaṃ tapasvī, tasya svorastāḍaṃ krandrato'pi lokānivṛtteḥ
tulanā--na hi vṛkṣādiḥ chāyādeḥ svabhāvaḥ kāryaṃ vā
na hi jalacandrādeḥ candrādiḥ svabhāvaḥ kāryaṃ vā
sthālyādau ādiśabdena jale candrādigrahaṇam, sati dravyameghādau anumīyate ityupaskāraḥ
atha pūrvam, etacca pūrvasāmagrīkāryamiti, ataḥ saivā'numīyate; ityatrāha--īdṛg ityādi
kāryam idṛg liṅgaṃ ced yadi iti kiṃ punarna kāryam sattvādikamapi kāryameva syāditi

tulāntayoḥ yau nāmonnāmau tayoḥ ekatarasya nāmasya unnāmasya vā darśanād anyatarasya unnāmasya nāmasya vā anumānam tathā vṛkṣādeḥ sakāpā dyanumānam athavā vṛkṣāḥ sambandhi chāyādinā anumānam kāryaliṅgaṃ saṃbhavaṃ bhavan saugataḥ svabhāvahetum uparuṇaddhi nirākaroti, kāryaṃ hetuṃ taṃ brūyāt
śakyaṃ hi vaktum bhāvaṃ sat tat kṛtakaṃ vā apekṣitaparavyāpāraṃ vā vastu janayatuyan svaramevāṃ anaśvarameva nityarūpameva janayati ghaṭādau tathā darśanāt iti manyate

tataḥ kim ? ityāha— ya taḥ kāraṇād ato vā liṅgāt svakāraṇasvabhāvānumānād bhāvasya kṛtakasya vā yat kāraṇaṃ tasya yaḥ svabhāvo naśvaraśca kāryajananarūpaḥ tasya anumānāt kāraṇātmanaḥ kṛtakasya vā pratipattiḥ iti na sākṣāt tatkālabhāvinā tā na śvaratvamanumīyata iti bhāvaḥ

atha yadā ataḥ svakāraṇasvabhāvānumitiḥ tadā kāryaṃ sattvādi, yadā tu svabhāvabhūtaṃ naśvaratvaṃ tadā svabhāva iti cet; tarhi yadā rasādeḥ svabhāvānumānaṃ tadā kāryatvaṃ yadā tu samānakālarūpādyanumānaṃ tadā liṅgāntaratvam
prakṛte tādātmyasambandho nātreti cet; atrāpi yogyatā iti samānam

yathaiva vā arthāntarayoḥ akāryakāraṇayoḥ kvacit kadācit sahadarśanebhāve'pi punaḥ ekābhāve'pi tadadarśanāt sarvatrānāśvāsaḥ tathā anarthāntarayorapi kvacittādātmyadarśane'pi tadanyathādarśanāt, yathā vṛkṣatvābhāve'pi cūtatvasya iti sarvatra anāśvāsaḥ

na cāyaṃ pakṣaḥ kṣamo bhavatā tadaṅgīkaraṇāt, saugatasya kathaṃ kṣamaḥ tenāpi ayamaṅgīkṛtaḥ ? prāgadvaitāvatārāt lokāt tādātmyādipratibandhasiddhivat sahabhāvināṃ rūpādīnām ayathānupapattipratibandhasiddhirapi astu viśeṣābhāvāde vāha--duḥkham ityādinā
duḥkhaṃ yathā bhavati tathā jīvati ityanusandhiḥ, vata iti viṣāde
kutaḥ ? ityāha--tasya saugatasya sapādo darasi ra stānaṃ kriyāviśeṣaṇametat
krandato'pi rudato'pi lokasya anivṛtteḥ anyathānupapattyā pravṛttād vyavahārāt iti sambandhaḥ
apekṣitaparavyāpāro hi bhāvaḥ svabhāvaniṣpattau kṛtaka iti
pratibandhaparisaṃkhyāyām udeṣyati śakaṭaṃ kṛttikodayāditi kiṃ pramāṇam ? na cātra kaścid vyabhicāro'sti
tādātmyena kutaścit atītaikakālānāṃ gatirnānāgatānāṃ vyabhicārāt pra॰ vā॰ svavṛ॰ pṛ॰ 49 iti vyāptimeva pratikṣipan na kevalamanumānamudrāṃ bhinatti kintu samastapramāṇaprameyavyavasthāmapi
śva āditya udeteti grahaṇaṃ vā bhaviṣyati
tadetat bhaviṣyadviṣayamavisaṃvādakaṃ jñānaṃ pratibandhasaṃkhyāṃ pramāṇasaṃkhyāṃ ca pratiruṇaddhi
yathaiva anyathānupapatteḥ nāmonnānayoḥ ekataradarśanād anyatarānumānaṃ vṛkṣādeḥ chāyādyanumānaṃ tathaiva tenaiva prakāreṇa anumā bhavet iti sambandhaḥ

kutaḥ kva ? ityāha--jyotiṣāṃ madhye uditādyo tiṣaḥ kṛttikādeḥ hetoḥ liṅgād udeṣyati jyotiṣi śakaṭādau iti bhavan śeṣyate saugataiḥ iti cet; atrāha--kuto naiva bhavet ? atītaikakālānāṃ gatiḥ pra॰ vā॰ svavṛ॰ pṛ॰ 49 pratipattiḥ no cet; na yadi bhaviṣyatāṃ vyabhicārāditi vyabahārānusāriṇo'pi tadvyavahāravilopaḥ
na kṛttikodayāt bhaviṣyacchakaṭādyanumānam api tu dvayoḥ kāraṇabhūtayoḥ sāmagryā ityeke
teṣāṃ tayoḥ yaugapadyam, itarathā rasādīnāmapi tu na syāditi nirarthakam--atītaikakālānāṃ gatiḥ pra॰ vā॰ svavṛ॰ iti
kiñca, ekasāmagryadhīnatve'pi dayorayaugapadye mānasādhyakṣaviṣaya indriyajñānasahakārīna syāt
indriyajñānaviṣayasya anantaro viṣayaḥ indriyajñānasya sahakārī bhavan manovijñānamutpādayati, tanna syāditi bhāvaḥ
nanu kathañcit sāmagrīsvabhāvānumāne'pi na bhāviśakaṭodayātmānam atītaikakālānāṃ gatiḥ pra॰ vā॰ svavṛ॰ ityasya virodhā ve vidaṃ sa eva jānāti ya evaṃ vadanti
sādhyapi kāraṇam, kṛttikodayāt śakaṭodayasya karaṇasya anu mānam ityapare
teṣāṃ svagranthe śva āditya udetā adya tadva indriyāt ityanumānaniṣedhaṃkathā pramāṇānām ayuktam
ubhayoḥ anabhyupagame kathamanābhāvi nivṛttiḥ aikāntikī syāt ? pūrvabhāvitve ca kāryasya sugatasya sugatatvā proktanīyā dasāsarvā kāryabhūtā uttarā kāraṇarūpā tataḥ tadarthaṃ pravṛtteḥ

tathā ca atra bhagavato hetuphalasaṃpattyā pramāṇabhūtatvaṃna stotrābhidhānam, tatra hetuḥ āśayaprayogasampat sāṃvyavahārikapramāṇāpekṣayā, āśayo jagaddhitaiṣitā, prayogo jagachannāchāsṛtvaṃ phalaṃ svapayat svārthaṃsaṃpat sugatatvena pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 1

1 ityādi sarvamayuktam; saṃvyavahārāpekṣayaivaṃ vyākhyāne agniḥ kāraṇaṃ dāhādyarthakriyā tatphalam ityanabhyāse agnikāraṇaliṅgadarśanāt tatphale pravṛttiḥ iti prasaktam, tathāpi tatkriyāyā eva kāraṇatve vallīdāhaḥ phalaparṇakaughaḥ kāraṇam, ataḥ taddāhānumānaṃ kāraṇāt kāryānumānam

kathamevaṃ sugatatvaṃ tāyitvaṃ va hetuḥ āśayaprayogaḥ tatphalaṃ na syāditi tadavasthaḥ pūrvo vyāghātaḥ syāditi cet; kuta etat ? sugatatvābhāve āśraya prayogasaṃpado'pya bhāvāt, tadabhāve na sugatatvam

saṃvyavahārāśrayāt sarvatra hetuphalabhāvam anyośrayadoṣaiṣṭamadhyabhī ṣṭamicchati na punaḥ akāraṇabhūtāt kṛttikodayād anyathānupapannāt taddoṣaparivarjitāt śakaṭodayānumānamiti satyaṃ paroguptaprajñeḥ
tulanā--tena yaducyate bhaṭṭena--yaḥ savitrudayo bhāvī na tenādyodayo'nvitaḥ
yaccādyodayāt śvaḥ sūryodayādyanumānaṃ na tadanumānaṃ niyāmakaliṅgābhāvāt, adya gardabhadarśanāt śvaḥ sūryodayānumānavat
śva āditya udeteti grahaṇaṃ vā bhaviṣyati--laghī॰ ślo॰ 14
atra ca bhagavato hetuphalasampattyā pramāṇabhūtatvena stotrābhidhānaṃ prakaraṇādau prasādajananārtham
tatra heturāśayaprayogasampat, āśayo jagaddhitaiṣitā, prayogo jagacchāsanāt śāstṛtvam, phalaṃ svārthasampat
apunarāvṛttyartha sunaṣṭajvaravat, niḥśeṣārthaṃ supūrṇaghaṭavat...--pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ ja॰ 1
pratibandhasya avinābhāvasya parisaṃkhyāyāṃ tādātmyatadutpattirūpa eva nānyaḥ pratibandha iti parigaṇane kriyamāṇe udeṣyati śakaṭaṃ kṛttikodayāt iti kiṃ pramāṇam ? iti pṛcchati
yadvā parasya kiṃ naiva pramāṇam iti vyākhyeyam
vyabhicārānna pramāṇamiti cet atrāha-- na cātra ityādi
deśakālākāraviparyayagrahaṇalakṣaṇānāṃ vyabhicārāṇāṃ madhye naiko'pyasti iti kaścid grahaṇam
nanu tadanyathānupapattiḥ kuto'vagamyate ? vivakṣitaśakaṭodayābhāve adarśanāditi cet; tanna; sarvadarśino'darśanaṃ sarvatra arthābhāvaṃ gamayati, nānyasya vyabhicārāt
ekadā tadā dṛṣṭānāṃ sakaṣāyadhātrīphalānāṃ punaranyathāpi darśanāt

nā'yaṃ saugatapakṣe doṣaḥ tadavagamanimittasya tādātmyādipratibandhasya bhāvāditi cet; naitatsāram; yato yathaiva bahulaṃ śiṃśapāyāḥ vṛkṣasvabhāvadarśanāt tadavinābhūtaṃ sarvatra sarvadā vṛkṣasvabhāvasya iti gamyate anyathā sakṛdapi tatsvabhāvā na bhavet, tathā kṛttikodayaḥ bahulaṃ śakṭodayāvinābhāvisvabhāvaḥ pratīyamānaḥ sarvatra sarvadā tatsvabhāvaḥ, anyathā sakṛtadapisva tatsvabhāvatā'yogāditi gamyate
atra adṛṣṭavyabhicārāśaṅkā na śiṃśapāyāmiti kiṃkṛto vivekaḥ ? yathā ca vṛkṣābhāve'pi tadbhāvo niḥsvabhāvatā tasyāḥ tathā kṛttikodayasya tadavinābhāvisvabhāvavirahe tadavasthaiva niḥsvabhāvatā
na cedamatra codyam— tatsvabhāvatā tasya kutaḥ iti; śiṃśapāyāmapi tulyatvāt
deśāntare kālāntare dravyāntarasambandhe ca madhurāṇāmapi darśanāt
yenairva saugate brūte no cet liṅgāntaraṃ na vit
evaṃ manyate--asya anumāne antarbhāvāttu dve pramāṇe iti pramāṇasaṃkhyā pratibandhaparisaṃkhyāghātinīva dvividha eva pratibandha iti tatparisaṃkhyā pramāṇa parisaṃkhyāghātinī lakṣyate
kutaḥ ? ityatrāha--jyotiṣāṃ grahādīnāṃ yau anāgatodayāstamayau tau ādī yasya tatphalasya tasya jñānam uktapratibandhād anumānamanicchataḥ pramāṇāntaraprasaṅgāt
kutaḥ ? vyabhicārāt, ityevaṃ na kevalam anumānamudrāṃ bhinatti

tathāhi— tatpratibandhaniyamasamaye buddheḥ nā'kāraṇam artho viṣayaḥ, na ca sākalyavyāptiviṣayāyāḥ tasyāḥ sarvam atītaṃ varttamānamanāgataṃ ca kāraṇam; anantarātītasyaiva sarvatra kāraṇatvopagamāt, itarathā tat svānyakāryadeśādisaṅgatāṃ kuryāditi
nāsmākaṃ pratibhāsādvaitavādināṃ tanmudrābhedo doṣāya sūtvād ityapare
kintu api tu samastapramāṇaprameyavyavasthāmapi bhinatti ityanuvarttate
anumānābhāve tadayogāt, itarathā pramāṇetarasāmānyasthiteḥ ityādikamanarthakam anyat sarvam
yadā hi pramāṇapramāṇābhāsayoḥ sāmānyā sthitirbhavati tadā idaṃ pramāṇam idañcāpramāṇamiti vibhāgaḥ avisaṃvādihetumūlakena anumānenaiva bhavati
śloko'yaṃ dharmakītirapyetadāha iti kṛtvā uddhṛtaḥ pramāṇamīmāṃsāyām pṛ॰ 8 uddhṛtaśca pramāṇapa॰ pṛ॰ 64 prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 180 syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 261 ityādiṣu
tadvyavasthābhede'pi pratyakṣaḥ pramāṇaprameyavyavasthābheda iti cet; atrāha--pratyakṣa
viśada...kālāntara...tathā saṃvittiṃ grāhyagrāhakavikalpavibhramātmikāṃ saṃpaśyāmo na punarekāntam
na ca svasaṃvedanavyaktibhiḥ svayamalakṣitābhiḥ tacchakyamiti tātparyam
yuktametat--yadi sākalyena caturvidhapratyakṣalakṣaṇamucyeta, na caivam tadabhāvāt, viparyayāt svasaṃvedanasyaivocyate tat pratyakṣasiddhamiti cet; atrāha--pratyakṣam ityādi
kiṃbhūtam ? ityāha--sugatasya sambandhi yad ekāntena asādhāraṇatvena ekena asahāyena antena dharminā upalakṣitaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ tena vilakṣaṇaṃ visadṛśaṃ na tadākāraṃ tato vimukhaṃ vā
anumiteḥ tatsiddhiriti cet; atrāha--mithyā visaṃvādinī anumā
kutaḥ ? ityatrāha--asadarthā nirviṣayā niṣprayojanā vā, pratibhāsādvaitasya svataḥsiddherabhyupagamāt
yadvā asannartho hetulakṣaṇapramāśca bhāvena yasyā iti
tataḥ kim ? ityāha--svalakṣaṇaṃ parakīyaṃ mukhyalakṣaṇam, anena svalakṣaṇaśabdaniruktaṃ karoti
kutaḥ punaḥ pratyakṣaṃ tadvilakṣaṇam ? ityatrāha--viśada ityādi
yathaiva ca yugapad ekasya sthavīyaso grahaṇasaṃbhavaḥ tathā kālāntarasthāyino'pīti; atrāha--kālāntara ityādi
pūvottarānugabhāge mukta evāsi sarvathā || iti manyate
yadi punaḥ tato bhinnaṃ tadadvaitam; tatrāha--yathāsaṃvittim ityādi
tathā saṃvittiṃ saṃpaśyāmaḥ grāhyagrāhakāveva vikalpau bhedau tābhyāṃ vibhramātmikām
evaṃ manyate--yadi stambhādivyatiricya mānaśarīraṃ tadadvaitam stambhādi kiṃ bhaviṣyati ? bhaviṣyati cet; svato'syāvabhāsanota va yogāt, svasaṃvedanavibhramaprāpteḥ
ekāntamapi saṃpaśyanti bhavanta iti cet; atrāha--na punaḥ ityādi
tadevaṃ bahirantaśca anekānte siddhe yat prāptaṃ taddarśayannāha--svabhāvo vyavahāro'pi ityādi
tatra viṣayapratipattau apratipannaviṣayiṇo darśanāt na yuktā
tadayaṃ bahirantaścānekāntaṃ paśyanneva tattvadṛṣṭiparāṅmukhaḥ samayāvaṣṭambhādanyato vā tarkaprayogaistadvyavahāramavatāryate
tato na kevalam alaṃbhaḥ api tu svabhāvo'pi anekāntopalambho'pi hetuḥ liṅgam
kva ? ityatrāha--vyavahāre, prakramād anekāntasya iti gamyate
nanu tadupalambhādeva sākṣād anekāntasiddheḥ kuto'sau hetuḥ ? ityatrāha--tattve anekāntasvarūpe pravarttanād antarbhūtaṇijartho yā draṣṭavyaḥ
tasmin anekānte mithyā yo'bhiniveśaḥ ekāntābhiniveśaḥ tadvatāṃ tannirāsārtham ityarthaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā svabhāvaheturapi anupalambhaḥ sādhyābhedād bhinne ucyate tathā'rya svabhāvopalambho'pi kāryavyāpyasvabhāvābhyāṃ bhinna iti trīṇyeva liṅgāni nyāyabi॰ 2
11 iti vyāhanyate, iti pra jñāka ra prayuktasya hetoḥ pakṣasya ca svayaṃ tena darśito bādhaḥ
bodhye niraṃśaikāntasādhane kathaṃ tatra sa hetuḥ itya thā tat tadviruddha ityādi
tacchabdena anekāntaṃparāmṛśyate, tadviruddha ityanena vā anekāntaḥviruddho nityādyekāntaḥ tau ādī yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ

tatra ādyena ādiśabdena anekāntakāraṇakāryasahacā rādīnāṃ grahaṇāt, dvitīyena ekāntakāraṇādīnām, teṣāṃ yathāsaṃkhyena śabdaśca jñānaṃ ca tayoḥ tarkeṇa vipakṣe sadbhāvabādhakohetuprayogataḥ prayogeṇa tatpratipādakavākyoccāraṇena
udāraprapañcastu nehokto grantha gauravāt, pra mā ṇa saṃ gra hā t jñeyaḥ paṇḍitairmānasābhiḥ
svabhāvopalambhaḥ, svabhāva eva anekāntabhāvasvarūpameyā upalabhyate iti upalambhaḥ svabhāvaścāsau upalambhaśca iti vyutpatteḥ
