yadi vā, tadupalambhe na svabhāvaḥ satviti vyavasthāpyata iti viṣayīśabdasya viṣaya upacāro pavṛtteḥ tadupalambhasvabhāva ityucyate
tataḥ kiṃ kriyate ? ityāha--tataḥ svabhāvād vyavahāro'nekāntaviṣayaḥ saditi jñānādiḥ sādhyaḥ
nanu svabhāvopalambhe so'pi siddha eveti kathaṃ sādhya iti cet ? atrāha--tatra ityādi

tatra anekānte viṣayasya tadupalambhasya pratipattau satyāṃ apratipanno viṣayī yena tasya saugatādeḥ darśanāt tadupalambharūpo'nupalambho'vikalpaḥ tataḥ tatpratipattāvapi viṣayiṇo'pratipattiḥ yuktā, na bhavato'nekāntopalambhasya vyavasāyarūpatvāt
na ca ataḥ paro vyavahāraḥ yastataḥ sādhyaḥ iti cet; uktamatra tatra ityādi
na ca bhūtaladarśanamavikalpakam ityuktaṃ prathamaparicchede iti yatkiñcidetat
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt etat kim ityatrāha--kāryetyādi
anupalambhaḥ, punaḥ iti pakṣāntaradyotane vyatirekatadvyavahārasādhano bhāvābhāvavyavahārayoḥ sādhana iti svabhāvopalambhaḥ ityādirapi vyavahāraṇo vā sādhanatvāditi manyate
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt ayam ekāntavādī saugatādiḥ anekāntaṃ paśyanneva
sa kim ? ityāha— tattvasya anekānta-jīvāderyā dṛṣṭiḥ tasyāḥ parāṅmukho vimukhaḥ tattvaṃ paśyannapi na paśyāmi iti manyate iti bhāvaḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha--samayāvaṣṭambhāt svāgamāgrahagrahāveśāt anyato vā pūrvaka narmma
sa kiṃ kriyate ? ityādi yamo'rthanyavahāramavatāpi ta kaiḥ ? ityāha--tarkaprayogaiḥ tarkamūlaiḥ sādhanavākyaiḥ tā darśayannāha--sattva ityādi
adhunā tadviruddhādyajñānatarkaprayoga iti vyākhyātu māha--svabhāva ityādi
svabhāvo'nekāntasvarūpaṃ tadviruddho nityādyekāntaḥ upalakṣyate, upalakṣaṇametat tena natkuryādi parigrahaḥ
tasyā anupalabdheḥ tathaiva tenaiva prakāreṇa bhāvaḥ anekāntātmaka iva iti sambandhaḥ
asiddho hetuḥ iti cet; atrāha--bahirapi ekāntānupalabdheḥ iti

nanu tadanupalabdhiśca syāt nāpi bhāvo'nekāntātmako virodhābhāvāt iti sandigdha vipakṣavyāvṛttiko heturiti cet, atrāha--anyathā anyena bhāvasya anekāntātmakatvābhāvaprakāreṇa anupapatteḥ tatra tadanupalabdhiriti
tathāhi--tadanupalabdhiḥ upalabdhinivṛttim anyopalabdhiḥ vā ? prathamapakṣo'nabhyupagamād dattottaraḥ, pramāṇā'sattvena asattvāt
tatrāha --bahirarthavibhramaikāntavādī bahirvibhramaikāntopalabdhiḥ tatra asiddho heturiti; tanmatamāśaṅkya dūṣayannāha--pratyakṣaika ityādi
svalakṣaṇānāṃ dṛśyaikasthirasthūlasvabhāvavirodhāt vyatireke vṛtti vikalpānavasthādidoṣaprasaṅgāt bahirarthanirākṛtau vijñapterapi sarvaṃ samānam
vedyavedakabhrāntisaṃvedanavikalpāvikalpādīnāṃ parasparaṃ sarvathā tādātmyāsaṃbhavāt na kiñcit bhrāntaṃ jñānaṃ syāt
na ca bhāvānāṃ sākalyena nairātmyaṃ pratipattuṃ yuktam pramāṇābhāvāt
ekaśca sthiraśca sthūlaśca ekasthirasthūlāḥ te ca te svabhāvāśca punareteṣāṃ karmadhārayaḥ kāryaḥ taiḥ, nā bhāvyam
kutaḥ ? ityāha--ekāntabhrāntasvabhāvād ekāntena avaśyaṃbhāvena bhrānto yaḥ svabhāvaḥ teṣāmeva, tataḥ tasmāt tena hetunā
bhāvapradhāno vā nirdeśaḥ, ekāntena bhrāntaḥ svabhāvo yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ bhāvāt tattvāt iti draṣṭaṃ
tathāhi--naite svabhāvāḥ santaḥ sadbhiḥ abhyupagantavyā ekāntabhrāntasvabhāvatvāt svapnadṛṣṭarājādisvabhāvavat
ekāntabhrāntasvabhāvatvaṃ ca grāhyasamānādhikaraṇatayā avabhāsanāt, ekatra virodhādvā dūrasthitaviralakeśī tatsvabhāvavat
idamatra tātparyam--ekasthirasthūlasvabhāvānāṃ vilakṣaṇānām ekāntabhrāntasvabhāvopagame tadāvedakaṃ pramāṇamanveṣyam, itarathā arthavattadasiddheḥ
tatra tatpratibhāsanaṃ ca anyathā tena tadvibhramā'grahaṇāt, paracittārthagrahaṇe tadekārthāgrahaṇavat

tadanveṣaṇe ca yata eva asanta ḥ tatra tatsvabhāvāḥ pratibhānti tata eva tadapramāṇam, yata eva ca teṣām ekāntena vibhramasvabhāvavedakam ata eva apramāṇam, īṣat pramāṇam apramā ādiryeṣāṃ vikalpādisvabhāvānāṃ tairapi na bhāvyam
etaduktaṃ bhavati--pramāṇetarasvabhāvayoḥ aikyam ekāntena bhrāntasvabhāvaṃ tattvād avayavarūpādyaikyavat pūrvāparabhāgaikyasthiratvavat bahvavayavasaṃsargaikatvapariṇāmasthaulyavadvā
tathā ca na kevalaṃ bahiḥ svapnā'svapnavibhāgo durlabhaḥ kintu jñānayādo jñānārthavibhāgo'pi

tatra yaduktaṃ dvitīyaḥ punaḥ anekāntamantareṇa neti niścitamiti yaduktam--yadyanekakṣaṇikasūkṣmasvabhāvavad ekasthirasthūlasvabhāvā api pratyakṣasiddhā ekatra syuḥ, na caivaṃ vicārāyogāt, kevalam ane kalpitā tatta eva bhrāntāḥ iti cet; etadevopadarśya dūṣayannāha--pratyakṣaika ityādi
api śabdaḥ atra draṣṭavyaḥ, na bhāvyam iti
na vidyate pramā ādiśabdena hetuphalabhāvādiḥ yeṣāṃ taiḥ iti
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā ekādisvabhāvā viśadatayā avabhāsamānā api kalpitā iṣyante tathā vilakṣaṇāśca viśeṣābhāvādiṣyatām
tatra hetvantaramāha--vyatireke svalakṣaṇebhyaḥ tatsvabhāvasya bhede aṅgīkriyamāṇe vṛttivikalpa-anavasthādidoṣaprasaṅgāt
ekadeśena vṛttiḥ sarvātmanā vā ityādayo vṛttivikalpāḥ

nanu tatsvabhāvavirodhāt taddoṣaprasaṅgācca tatsvabhāvasyaiva bahirnirākṛtirastu na svalakṣaṇānāvat katham aviśeṣeṇocyate bahirarthanirākṛtau iti ? evaṃ manyate--yathoktahetudvayena tatsvabhāvasya dṛśyasyāpi nirākṛtau anyatra kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ ? evamarthaṃ ca pūrvaphakkikāyāṃ dṛśyagrahaṇam, atatsvabhāvalakṣaṇānām anupalambhācca
na kevalaṃ bahirarthaśca sarvam uktamanuktaṃ ca dūṣaṇaṃ samānaṃ sādhāraṇam
tathā ca nirūpita nirūpyate ca vedya ityādinā
vedyaśca stambhādigrāhyākāraḥ vedakaśca tadgrahaṇayogyo jñānākāraḥ tāveva bhrāntiḥ sā ca saṃvedanaṃ ca ādī yeṣāṃ vikalpyāvikalpyā dīnāṃ teṣām
yadvā vedyaśabdena nīlādaya ākārā ucyante, vedakaśabdena tadākāraṃ tadgrāhakaṃ jñānam
bhrāntiśabdena grāhyagrāhakasaṃvedanabhedo buddheḥ gṛhyate mantrādyupaplutākṣāṇām pra॰ vā॰ 2
354 ityādeśca vacanāt saṃvedanadhvaninā advayaṃ vedanam, eteṣāṃ kṛtadvandvānām ādiśabdena vikalpādigrāhiṇāṃ bahuvrīhiḥ kāryaḥ teṣām
sarvathā sarvaprakāreṇa tādātmyasya aikyasya vā anena asaṃbhavāt kāraṇāt na kiñcid bhrāntaṃ jñānaṃ syāt
ayamabhiprāyaḥ--vedyavedakabhrāntisaṃvedanayoḥ ekāntena aikye saṃvedanameva bhrāntimātrameva vā pramāṇakaṃ syāt
yadi vā, vedyavedakayoḥ sarvathā tādātmye anyataradeva syāt iti na citramekaṃ jñānam, tathā nīlamātre'pi, parīkṣāyāṃ nāpyacitram iti na kiñcit citramacitraṃ vā jñānaṃ syāt iti vyākhyeyam
tathā bhrāntisaṃvedanayo tathā tattve anyataradeveti na kiñcid grāhyamanyad bhrāntam

tarhi teṣāṃ vyatireka iti cet; atrāha--vyatireke tadbhede saṃbandha ityanuvarttate, santānāntarāṇāmiva tadvat teṣām anyo'nyasaṃbandhāsiddheḥ kāraṇāt na kiñcijjñānaṃ syāt, iti riktā vācoyuktiḥ--svarūpasya svato gatiḥ pra॰ vā॰ 1
6 iti na kiñcid bhrāntaṃ syāt iti
tarhi bahiriva anyatrāpi tattvasya vicāryamāṇasyā'yogāt sākalyena śūnyatā
209 ityādi iti cet; atrāha--na ca naiva pratipattuṃ yuktam
katham ? ityāha--sākalyena sāmastyena pararūpeṇa iva svarūpeṇāpi
kutaḥ ? ityāha--pramāṇābhāvāt tannairātmya iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
tasya nairātmyasya tasmin vā yat pramāṇaṃ tasya upagamavirodhāt
tathāhi--yadi sākalyena bhāvānāṃ nairātmyaṃ na tat pramāṇaṃ vicārasyāpyayogāt
syānmatam--na kaścit sakalapratibhāsavaikalyaṃ nairātmyamāha--māyāmarīciprabhṛtipratibhāsavadasattve'pi adoṣaḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
211 iti vacanāt, stambhādipratibhāsamātrasya bhrāntasya bhāvād vibhrametararahitasyāveti; tatrāha--mithyaikānta ityādi
citrapataṅganirbhāsādernaikayogakṣematvaṃ pratibhāsasya svabhāvabhedaṃ na nirākaroti santānaikatvaprasaṅgāt, bahirapi svabhāvabhedādeva svalakṣaṇānāmekasvabhāvānabhyupagāt

mithyā iti bhāvapradhāno'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ tena mithyātvam ekānto yasyā dhiyaḥ tayā tattvaṃ svarūpaṃ tasyā eva dhiyo mithyaikāntatvaṃ veda vetti saugata iti kṛtāntaviṣamagraham vibhramād vibhramāsiddheḥ ityuktatvāt
tathā paramapi parasya tadagrahaṃ darśayannāha--anartha ityādi

na vidyate artho bahiḥ grāhyo yasyāḥ sāmarthyaṃ svarūpālambanā ityarthaḥ, na sthirā asthirā kṣaṇikā ityarthaḥ, anarthā ca sā'sthirā ca, sā ca sā dhīśca tasyāḥ citraṃ citratvaṃ bhāvapradhānatvāt nirdeśasya, tena vā santatiḥ tasyāḥ tattvam ekatvaṃ veda
etaduktaṃ bhavati--hetuphalādīnāmabhāvaṃ vadatā sarūpo'sau vaktavyaḥ, anyatra pramāṇaniṣedhāt, so'pi citraikapratibhāsātmakaḥ, anyathā sakalaśūnyam ityuktam
tatpratibhāso'pi pūrvāparakṣaṇaikatvanāntarīyaka iti bahiḥ ghaṭādau na tattvaṃ veda ayamapi siddhāntaviṣamagrahaḥ ubhayatrāviśeṣāditi
anarthāsthiradhīcitrasantateḥ tattvaṃ veda bahirna ityetad vyatirekamukhena vyākhyātukāma āha--citra ityādi

citrapataṅgasya nirbhāsaḥ tadākāraṃ jñānam ādiryasya citrāstaraṇādinirbhāsasya pratyakṣetarādinirbhāsasya vā sa tathoktaḥ, tatra naikākayogakṣematvaṃ yogaḥ utpādaḥ kṣemaḥ utpannasya saṃrakṣaṇam anubhavan yasya, asthirajñānapakṣe saṃrakṣaṇasyābhāvāt
athavā kṣemo vināśaḥ, tatra tacchabdasya saṅketāt dviṣṭebhradrikāśabdavat, ekam abhinnaṃ yogakṣemaṃ yasya tasya bhāvaḥ tattvaṃ pratibhāsasya citrapataṅgabuddheḥ svabhāvabhedaṃ na nirākaroti

yadā hi ekaṃ jñānamutpadyate vedyate vā tadā santānāntarajñānānyapi; anyathaikajñānasantānamātraṃ jagat, tathā ca sati sugatajñānasantānānta para-miti yaduktaṃ kenacit --svasaṃvedanameva ekaṃ pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇam nāparam, prapañcastu vineyajanānurodhāt ityādi; tatsarvaṃ plavate; vineyajanābhāvāt
tasmād ekajñānodayakāle anyajñānodayo'bhyupagantavya iti santānānām ekayogakṣematvaṃ svabhāvabhedaṃ nirākuryāditi punarapi nānantaradoṣaḥparihāraḥ
na caivam, ataḥ tat svabhāvabhedanirākaraṇe akiñcitkarapiti manyate
nanu tripadaṃga nirbhāsādau pratibhāsasya yadyapi ekayogakṣematvaṃ svabhāvabhedaṃ na nirākaroti tathāpi ekatvaṃ syāditi cet; atrāha--bahirapi ityādi
na kevalam antaḥ kintu bahirapi svabhāvabhedādeva nānyataḥ svalakṣaṇānāṃ rūpādiparamāṇūnām ekasvabhāvā'nabhyupagamāt pareṇa, iti kāraṇāt tasyāstaṃ tasya nirākaroti iti
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā svabhāvabhedāt naikatvaṃ bahiḥparamāṇūnāṃ tathā antarapi iti
kiṃ syāt sā citraikasyāṃ na syātpra॰ vā॰ 2
210 ityādi vacanādadoṣo'yamiti cet; atrāha--a siddha ityādi
yadīdaṃ svayamarthebhyo rocate tatra ke vayam iti śeṣaḥ
asiddhaḥ si ddha se na sya viruddho de va na ndi naḥ
dvedhā sa ma nta bha dra sya heturekāntasādhane || 21

anaikāntikatvaṃ punaḥ sattvādeḥ kṣaṇakṣayādisādhane asamīkṣitatattvārthaiḥ lokapratītiṃ pramāṇamāśritya tathā heturubhayatra vartate svapakṣavipakṣayoḥ, prāgeva tatkaraṇasamarthāt kāraṇāt punaḥ svakālaniyatakāryotpattyaviśeṣeṇa saṃbhavāt
na ca svakāraṇasattayā kāryotpattirvirudhyeta yato'kṣaṇika eva doṣaḥ syāt nirṇīta...tatsūktametat
svalakṣaṇaikāntasya sādhane siddhau aṅgīkriyamāṇāyāṃ sarvo hetuḥ si ddha se na sya bhagavataḥ asiddhaḥ

kathamiti cet ? ucyate--bahirivetisūkṣmaparīkṣayā antarapi sakalaṃ pratibhāsavikalamiti kiṃ sādhanajñānaṃ yato bhāvinaḥ prāpyasya anumānādabhyāse tatra pravṛttiḥ syāt ? kiṃ vā pūrvāparaviviktamadhyadarśanaṃ yasmād yad yathā'vabhāsa ityādi kṣaṇabhaṅgasādhanamavatiṣṭheta ? kiṃ vā nīlādyavabhāsanaṃ yena yadavabhāsate tajjñānam ityādi sidhyet ? etena sattvādayo'pi cintitāḥ
abhāvaikāntavat bhāvaikānte'pi tasya sarvo hetuḥ asiddhaḥ, anupalambhena tadabhāvāt sarvasaṅkarācca
parasparā'nātmakabhāvā'bhāvaikāntasādhane tu parasya na anantarapakṣād viśeṣaḥ, sarvasya sarvātmakatvaṃ prāgabhāvādyabhāvāditi
na caivaṃ vādinaḥ prāgabhāvādīnāmanyo'nyam anyato vā bhedaḥ sidhyati, anavasthābhayād aparaprāgabhāvādyabhāvāt
tataḥ sūktam--ekāntasādhane heturasiddhaḥ si ddha se na sya iti
kaścit svayūthyaḥ atrāha--si ddha se ne na kvacittasya asiddhasyā'vacanādayuktametaditi; tena kadācidetat śrutam ?
saṃkhā vi asavvāe tesiṃ savvevi te savvā
sāṃkhyā api asadvāde teṣāṃ sarve'pi te satyāḥ
athāto rūpāt citramekaṃ jñānamiṣyate; tatrāha--viruddho de va na ndi naḥ hetuḥ ekāntasādhane, krameṇeva akrameṇāpi citraikavirodhāt
tathā ca kathañcideva kṣaṇikatvena avabhāsanāt tatastathaiva bhāvānāṃ kṣaṇikatvasiddhiḥ

nanu yasya vaiśeṣikādeḥ nirākārajñānavādino naikaṃ jñānaṃ nīlādinirbhāsaiḥ citraṃ taṃ prati kena dṛṣṭāntena sarvasya anekāntātmakatvaṃ sidhyati yena tadīyaikāntasādhane viruddho hetuḥ syāditi cet; na; tasyāpi pratiprāṇi trikālaviṣayānekavyāpyavyāpakapadārthagrahaṇānekaśaktyātmakaikamānasajñānasadbhāvāt
itarathā kuto liṅgaliṅginoḥ sākalyena vyāptigraho yato'numānam ? na ca yaiva tasya atītagrahaṇe aśvatā saiva varttamānādigrahaṇonmukhatā; grāhyaikatvaprāpteḥ
nahi cakṣurādijñāneṣu yaiva rasagrahaṇonmukhatā saiva rūpādigrahonmukhatā; jñānabhedavaiyarthyāpatteḥ
sambandhābhāvena samavāyaniṣedhāt tasya tā iti vyapadeśavilopāt
kathañca anekaṃ kasya citraṃ jñānam ? tataḥ sthitam--viruddho ityādi
1 śabdārthasambandhānāṃ siddhiḥ niṣpattiḥ ātmasattājñaptirvā anekāntāt nānyataḥ iti
aparastvāha--na mayā pratibhāsādvaitavādinā paramārthataḥ kvacid hetuḥ iṣyate, yastu iṣyate sa vyavahāreṇa prāmāṇyaṃ vyavahāreṇa pra॰ vā॰ 1
4 ityabhidhānāditi; taṃ pratyāha— dvedhā sa ma nta bha dra sya hetuḥ ekāntasādhane iti
pakṣavad vipakṣe'pi varttate iti dvedhā anaikāntika iti yāvat
tathāhi--sattvam arthakriyākāritvam, akṣaṇikavat kṣaṇike'pi svasadasatsamaye bhāvato'saṃbhavi; kalpanayā punaḥ ubhayatrāpi na vāryata ityuktam
etena upalambhaḥ sattvam pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 231 iti nirūpitam
yathaiva hi ekasya kālatrayānuyāyitvaṃ nityatvaṃ na kutaścit pratyetuṃ śakyaṃ tathā ekaparamāṇuparyavasitaṃ kṣaṇikatvamiti ca

tathāpi tatpratipattyabhyupagame sarvasya trikālagocarā'śeṣāvasthānuyāyidravyadarśanaṃ kinna abhyupagabhyate ? yata idaṃ syāt--yad yathāvabhāsate tat tathaiva paramārthasat yathā sukhaṃ tattvenāvabhāsamānaṃ tathaiva paramārthasat, avabhāsante ca bhāvā anityatvena iti
tathā vyavahārā vā 'nyatrāpi sarvasya sarvadarśitvam ityapi nottaram; ekaikaparamāṇuniyatakṣaṇikatvadarśane'pi sarvasya sugatatvāt
nahi tathādarśino bhāvataḥ saugataiḥ anyaḥ sugata iṣyate
saṃsārītaravyavasthā'bhāva iti cet; sugatetarābhāvo'pi tathā na kim ? paramārthato yathā'syābhāvaḥ tathā anyasyāpi
vyavahāreṇa ubhayorapi siddhiḥ na vā kasyacit
yatpunaretat--prathamakṣaṇadarśanasamaye atītā'nāgatadaśādarśane tadaiva utpannamṛtapratītiḥ syāditi; tadapi na sundaram; ubhayatrāpi sa matvāt
yo hi pūrvāparaviviktamekaṃ paramāṇuṃ paśyati sa nitarāṃ tadaiva utpannamṛtam ātmānaṃ paśyati iti na kasyacit kvacit pravṛttiḥ nivṛttirvā kutaściditi prāptam
tadabhyupagame sakalakālakālīnadaśāsthitānsa darśino'pi sadabhyupagamaḥ kena vāryate ? atha madhyakṣaṇa eva utpanno mṛtaśca syāditi matiḥ; sāpi na yuktā; yathāsamayameva tadgrahaṇāt
asyā'nabhyupagame anyatra kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ ? tato'kṣaṇikavat kṣaṇikasyāpi na tattvato darśanam
kalpanayā tu dvayorapi, iti sādhūktam--dvedhā sa ma nta bha drasya iti
kva punaranena bhagavatā ekāntavādihetūnāmanaikāntikatvamucyata iti cet; na;
tapasvinaste kiṃ kuryurapātraṃ tvanmataśriyaḥ || bṛhatsva॰ ślo॰ 99
tava arajinasya bhagavato matabhāsannaṃ tasya śrīḥ sarvapadārthavyāpi-anekāntābhidheyam, tasyāḥ, ekāntavādinaḥ iti yāvat
te kiṃ kuryuḥ ? naiva kiñcit, svaparapakṣasiddhiniṣedhau naiva kuryuḥ ityarthaḥ
parasya saugatāpekṣayā nityavādinaḥ tadapekṣayā saugatasya, skhalitaṃ kramayaugapadyābhyām arthakriyā'sāmarthyaṃ tatonnidrā taddraṣṭāraḥ
svadoṣebhanimīlinaḥ svadoṣān paśyanto'pi apaśyanta iva varttante
sattvam arthakriyākāritvam upalambham anyadvā ādiryasya ekāntavādisambandhinikhilahetoḥ sa tathoktaḥ tasya
kiṃbhūtasya ? vastudharmasya asiddhatvam ekāntavastuna eva kasyacidabhāvāt taddharmo'pi tādṛśa eveti manyate
nanu nityaikānte tadabhāve'pi kṣaṇikatve tadbhāvāt nā'siddhatvamiti cet; atrāha--sākalyena sāmastyena kṣaṇiketaraikāntayoḥ asiddheḥ sattvādeḥ iti
syānmatam--ekāntavādiparikalpitatattvasamīkṣāyāṃ tadasiddhirastu, yathādarśanaṃ tadaṅgīkaraṇe ayamadoṣa iti; tatrāha--anyathā'nupapatteḥ ityādi
etadapi kutaḥ ? ityāha--anyathā anekāntābhāvaprakāreṇa anupapatteḥ yathādarśanaṃ sattvādeḥ iti
kaiḥ ? ityāha--asamīkṣitatattvārthaiḥ asamīkṣito viparītāropanirāsena na samyag īkṣitaḥ tattvārthaḥ pratibhāsādvaitalakṣaṇo yaiḥ taiḥ, pṛthagjanaiḥ ityarthaḥ
taduktaṃ kaiścit--pramāṇamavisaṃvādijñānam ityādi pramāṇalakṣaṇaṃ saṃvyavahārāpekṣayā pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 1
tadā tena parikalpitaprakāreṇa arthakriyālakṣaṇo hetuḥ ubhayatra pakṣavad vipakṣe'pi vartate yataḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha— prāgeva kāryotpatteḥ pūrvameva tatkaraṇasamarthāt kāryotpādanaśaktāt kāraṇāt punaḥ uttarakālaṃ svakālaniyatakāryotpatteḥ aviśeṣeṇa viśeṣābhāvena saṃbhavāt
tato yaduktaṃ kenacit--yadi nityo maheśvaro bhāvīni sarva kāryāṇi kartuṃ prāgeva śaktaḥ tāni yugapat kuryāt prāgeva, punaḥ tato'pi prāgeva punaḥ tato'pi prāgeva iti na kāryotpattikālavyavasthā

iti; tannirastam; katham ? cetanālakṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ karma cet svakāryotpattau vaicitryaṃ svasattāsamaye karttuṃ śaktam; tadaiva kuryāt, tasyāpi cetanālakṣaṇasya karmaṇo yat sarvam anyadvā kāryaṃ svasattāsamaye karotu tasyāpi kāraṇaṃ svaṃ phalaṃ tadā janayati iti kṣaṇikapakṣe'pi kāryotpattikālavyavasthā durghaṭā, iti na yuktam--
te ete kāryahetutvenābhimatāḥ sthitvāpravṛttyādayo naite samyagghetavaḥ
na ca siddhaḥ pakṣo bhavatīti...--pra॰ vārtikāla॰

yadi punaḥ prāgeva samarthādapi kṣaṇikāt kāraṇāt kālāntare kāryotpattiḥ prārthyate, kathamanyathā suptasya cirotthitasya pūrvā'bhyāsād vikalpā iti; tathā nityādapi prārthyatām, iti na yuktam--nityādutpattiviśleṣāt pra॰ vā॰ 1

nanu pūrvaṃ samarthamapi nityaṃ paścāt svakāryaṃ karotu, tathāpi tenaiva kāryotpatteḥ, ūrdhvaṃ tasya sthāne punarapi tadeva karttavyamiti kāryasyoparamaḥ kathamiti cet ? uktamatra--punaḥ svakālaniyatakāryotpatteḥ saṃbhavāditi punaḥ punaḥ tasyaiva karaṇe na svakālaniyatakāryotpattisaṃbhavaḥ
kṣaṇikapakṣe'pi sarvaṃ samānam; tathāhi--yena svabhāvena pradīpaḥ pramātari jñānamupajanayati tenaiva ced anyatra kajjalam; tatra tajjñānamapi janayet pramātari vā kajjalam iti
nanu kāryakālaṃ prāpnuvataḥ kāraṇasya tattvaṃ viruddhyata iti cet; atrāha--nacetyādi
virodhe kāraṇasattayā virudhyate yathā agnisattayā śītotpattiḥ iti
svākāraṇagrahaṇaṃ kuto na virudhyate iti cet ? virodhadvayasyāpyabhāvāt
nahi tadutpatteḥ tatsattayā sahānavasthānalakṣaṇo virodhaḥ; avikalakāraṇāyāḥ kasyāścid bhavatyāḥ tadanyatarasyāḥ sannidhāne niyamena nivṛttyadarśanāt, paṭotpattisamaye'pi tatkāraṇatantudarśanāt
na cedamatra codyam--pūrvāparaikatā kena pratīyate iti ? kṛtottaratvāt
kiṃbhūtaḥ sa nāsti ? ityāha--yato virodhād akṣaṇika eva na kṣaṇike doṣaḥ syād arthakriyābhāvalakṣaṇaḥ

yatpunaruktam a rca ṭe na--sattvam arthakriyayā vyāptam, sā'pi kramayaugapadyābhyāṃ prakārāntarābhāvāt tatkaraṇasya, te ca akṣaṇikānnivartamāne tāmarthakriyāmādāya nivarttete, sāpi sattvamiti tīrādarśiśakuninyāyena kṣaṇikatvam avalambate sarvaṃ pakṣāntarābhāvāt, tatkathaṃ kṣaṇikatve tadaikāntikam
iti; tadetat pakṣāntare'pi samānamiti darśayannāha— syāt sattā ityādi

tataḥ kāryakiyāśaktivyāpakayoḥ tayorakṣaṇikatve virodhānnivṛttestadvyāptāyāḥ kāryakriyāśakterapi nivṛttiriti sarvaśaktivirahalakṣaṇamasattvamakṣaṇikatve vyāpakānupalabdhirākarṣati viruddhayorekatrāyogāt
tato nivṛttaṃ sattvaṃ kṣaṇikeṣvevāvatiṣṭhamānaṃ tadātmatāmanubhavatīti yat sat tat kṣaṇikameveti anvayavyatirekarūpāyāḥ vyāpterniścayo bhavati pṛ॰ 146, 47 tasmāt tīrādarśineva ityādi
yathā kila bahanārūḍhairvaṇigbhiḥ śakunirmucyate api nāma tīraṃ drakṣyatīti
sa yadā sarvataḥ paryaṭa~ stīraṃ nāsādayati tadā vahanameva āgacchati tadvadetadapi draṣṭavyam
yat sat tatsarvaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ vipakṣe kramayaugapadyābhyāmarthakriyāvirodhāt
tallakṣaṇā sattā tato nivartamānā pakṣaṃ santaṃ tathābhūtaṃ prasādhayati
vipakṣavyāvṛttyā pakṣe pratyakṣavṛttiḥ, pakṣe pratyakṣavṛttyā ca vipakṣādvyāvṛttiriti parasparāśrayaṃ cakrakam, yataḥ tadvyavasthaiva na syāt
nanvakṣaṇike arthakriyāyāḥ satyaṃ pratyakṣamasti ? anyathā kiṃ tatrānumānena ? vipratipattistatra anyathā'rthakriyānupapattiprayogāt nirākriyate
kutaḥ ? ityāha--vipakṣe kṣaṇike arthakriyāyāḥ kramayaugapadyābhyāṃ vyāptāyāḥ sattvasya vyāpikāyāḥ agrahāt kutaścidapratipatteḥ
śakyamanenāpyevaṃ vaktum--kṣaṇikāt sattvaṃ svavyāpakanivṛttyā vyāvarttamānaṃ gatyantarābhāvād akṣaṇike vyavatiṣṭhate iti

syānmatam--vipakṣe kṣaṇike tvaṃkriyāḥ vyāpārānupalabdherabhāvaḥ sidhyed yadi sā akṣaṇikāt nivartteta, anyathā anaikāntikī kathaṃ tatra tadabhāvaṃ sādhayet ? tataḥ tannivṛttiśca kramayaugapadyābhyām akṣaṇike arthakriyādarśane
na ca tatra tad iti; tatrāha--vyāpaka ityādi

vyāpakayoḥ kramayaugapadyayoḥ yā'nupalabdhi rakṣaṇikāsattvasādhanāyopanyastā tasyāḥ vyatirekaḥ kṣaṇikād vipakṣād vyāvṛttiḥ prasiddhā, nitye pratibhātasya krametarābhyām arthakriyākāritvasya vyavasthāpitatvāditi manyate
cet śabdaḥ avadhāraṇārthaḥ, nipātānām anekārthatvāt arthakriyāgrahād ityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ
bhavatu tarhi sattā'kṣaṇike hetuḥ tathāpi jainasya prakṛtaṃ hīdhate iti cet; atrāha--syād ityādi gatārthametat
vyāpakānupalabdheśced yadi vyatirekaḥ prasidhyati, sa tu na prasidhyati iti manyate
evaṃ tarhi kṣaṇike hetuḥ syād vastudharmasya gatyantarābhāvāt, kathamanaikāntikatvamiti cet; atrāha--syād ityādi
kārikām yat sat tat sarvam ityādinā vyācaṣṭe
yat sad arthakriyākāri tat sarvaṃ sat kṣaṇikam, vāśabda ivārthaḥ kṣaṇikam ityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ
nidarśanamatra nom a rca ṭe na tadantareṇa asya gamakatvopavarṇanāt
vipakṣaḥ akṣaṇikāpekṣayā kṣaṇikaḥ, tatra kramayaugapadyābhyāṃ krameṇa yaugapadyena ca arthakriyāvirodhāt
tathāhi--na tāvattatra krameṇa arthasya karaṇam; ekaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ tenaiva parasya karaṇaṃ krameṇa tatkaraṇam, na ca nityavadi caṃ tasyāpi niraṃśaikasvabhāvasya tat saṃbhavati
etena jāgraccetasaḥ samanantaracirabhāviprāṇādiprabodhakāryadvayaṃ tistaṃ yaduktaṃ pra jñā ka re ṇa--
jāgraccittaṃ hi anantaraṃ prāṇādi janayati suṣuptyanantaraṃ prabodhaṃ ca utpādayati
kāryaṃ vā sarvathā tena jñāpyate'rthakriyodayaḥ || pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 1 | 5 iti;

tatredaṃ cintyate--yadi kāraṇam; kathamato'bhyāse pravṛttiḥ punaḥ arthakriyodayaḥ iti kramabhāvikāryadvayam ? yadi punaḥ pravṛttiḥ tato neṣyate kathamuktam--abhyāse bhāvini pravarttakatvāt pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇam iti ? anabhyāse'pi pūrvam ato'numānaṃ punaḥ tadudayaḥ iti ca
nāpyakrameṇa; ekena yugapadanekasya karaṇaṃ tathoktaṃ bhavet, taccanityasya kālabhinnamiva itarasya ekasvabhāvatve deśabhinnamapi na saṃbhavati ityuktam
mābhūt kṣaṇike'rthe kācidarthakriyā ko doṣa iti cet; atrāha--tallakṣaṇā arthakriyālakṣaṇā sattā tataḥ kṣaṇikānnivattamānā pakṣaṃ sādhyaṃ santaṃ tathābhūtam akṣaṇikaṃ prasādhayati iti yuktam
atra a rca ṭa matamāśaṅkate dūṣayituṃ yadi ityādi
vyāpakayoḥ kramā'kramayoḥ anupalabdhiḥ vyatirekaḥ akṣaṇikād vyāvṛttiḥ yadi nirṇīyeta tadā pakṣaṃ santaṃ sādhayati iti yuktam, nacaivamiti manyate
kayā nītyā ? hra svapakṣe akṣaṇike pratyakṣavṛttya tatra kramā'kramayoḥ, pratyakṣavṛttyā tadanupalabdhirbādhyate nānyathā
atha yata eva akṣaṇikāpekṣayā yo vipakṣaḥ kṣaṇikaḥ tasmād vyāvṛttirbādhakasya ata eva svāpakṣa pratyakṣavṛttiḥ iti cet; atrāha--vipakṣa ityādi

vipakṣād vyāvṛttiḥ yā vyāpakasya tayā pakṣe kṣaṇike pratyakṣavṛttiḥ tatra vyāpakadarśanaṃ pakṣe pratyakṣavṛttyā ca vivakṣāvṛttiḥ ityevaṃ parasparāśrayaṃ cakramiva āvarttate cakrakam yata evaṃ tayorvyavasthaiva vyavasthitirna kasyacit syāt
nanu iti sauṣṭhave akṣaṇike yā arthakriyā kramā'kramābhyāṃ yadarthakaraṇaṃ tasyāḥ pratyakṣamasti grāhakam ityupaskāraḥ

tathāhi--paśyannayam indriyaiḥ kālatrayānuyāyinamarthaṃ paśyati anyathā kṣaṇasthāyinamapi na paśyet kiṃ tarhi tatra anumānena ? nahi pratyakṣānumānamarthaṃ tad iti cet; atrāha--vipratipattistatra gṛṇike saugatānāṃ akṣaṇikāropalakṣaṇā nirākriyate
kutaḥ ? ityāha--anyathā kṣaṇikatvābhāvaprakāreṇa yā arthakriyāyā anupapattiḥ tatprayogāt tatpratipādakavākyoccāraṇāditi
idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam--yat sat tatsarvaṃ kṣaṇikam iti saugataḥ, akṣaṇikam iti nityavādī, sattvād iti gamyate
ubhayatra anena etat kathayati--yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ pakṣasapakṣānyataratvāt iti kalpitaḥ tathā sad iti raṇyakāta iti
nanu kṣaṇike pratyakṣavṛttirasti na tato na parasparāśrayamiti cet; atrāha--cakrakaṃ punaḥ punaruktasya pravṛtteḥ iti
yena latsādhanedaṃ mado matyā dityabhiprāyamān paraḥ pṛcchati--nanu akṣaṇike paraṇāmabhinyevastutya rthakriyāyāḥ sabandhi pratyayakṣa sakhi naivāsti
hetūpanyāsaḥ tarhi tatra anarthaka iti cet; atrāha— vipratipattiḥ ityādi
syānmatam--ekasya anekasvabhāvavirodhāt tatrāpi na taditi cet; atrāha--svabhāve ityādi
svasaṃvedanaṃ pratyakṣamekasvabhāvamantareṇa bhrāntītarādisvabhāvāḥ niḥsvabhāvāḥ syuḥ skandhāntara...svabhāvabhedasya bhedakatve kiṃ pratītiviparyāsakalpanayā ?
bhāvo jñānalakṣaṇo'nyo vā candrādiḥ, svabhāve svarūpe sati

kiṃbhūte ? avibhrame vibhramavivekanirmale saccetanādhāvalyādilakṣaṇo bhrāntaḥ savibhramo grāhyādyākāradvitvādinā, tathā savikalpe abhilāpasaṃsargayogyapratibhāse svabhāve ityanuvartate vikalpaḥ kalpanārahito bhāvaḥ iti padaghaṭanā
yadvā savikalpe sabhede nīlādinirbhāsavatya kulpo bhinnaḥ
tathā saṃśaye sthāṇuḥ puruṣaḥ iti svabhāve asaṃśayo vidyamānasaṃśayo'yam ityullekharūpeṇa bhāvo bhavatīti kākvā vyākhyeyam
atra siddhāntaḥ nitye svabhāve anityo nitya nubudhyate jñāyate bhāvaḥ
yadi vā, anitye nitya iti vaiśeṣikādirapi ekāntena nityetarasvabhāvayoḥ bhedaṃ kalpayan etena nirastaḥ; tasyāpi arthāvadhāraṇānavadhāraṇātmakasya saṃśayā pratyasyanāvo virodhāt
dravyam uktalakṣaṇaṃ dharmi nityaṃ kālāntarasthāyi iti tatsādhyaṃ pariṇāminityatvam atra sādhyam anyasyā'niṣṭeḥ
upalakṣaṇametat tena anityaṃ dravyaṃ nityasvabhāvānupapatteḥ iti ca draṣṭavyam
nanu rūpādivyatirekeṇa anyasya dravyasyāpratibhāsena asattvād āśrayāsiddho heturiti cet; atrāha--bhrāntītyādi
bhrāntyādīnāṃ kṛtadvandvānām ādiśabdena bahuvrīhiḥ, punaḥ svabhāvāḥ ityanena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ te niḥsvabhāvāḥ syuḥ
punarapi kiṃbhūtam ? svasaṃvedanam, etacca antaḥpratyakṣamapi viśeṣaṇam avyabhicārādatra yuktam
evaṃ manyate--yathā rūpādīnām anekāntena parasparabhedaḥ tathā vibhrametarādīnāṃ sa yadi syāt tatprasaṅgo durnivāryaḥ
na ca tathā tattvavyavastheti niḥsvabhāvāḥ syuḥ iti bhāvaḥ
bhavatu tarhi vibhrametarādinirbhāsaiḥ eko bhāvaḥ iti cet; atrāha--svabhāvabhedasya ityādi
bhāvasya yaḥ svabhāvabhedaḥ tasya bhedakatve aṅgīkriyamāṇe kiṃ na kiñcit pratīteḥ bahirantaśca ekānekarūpāyāḥ viparyāsakalpanayā iti siddhaṃ dravyam
tato yaduktaṃ kenacit svarūpasya svato gatiḥ pra॰ vā॰ 1
6 iti, tatra yadi ekānekarūpasya; siddhaṃ naḥ samīhitam
atha anyathābhūtasya niḥsvabhāvāḥ sarvebhāvāḥ iti, bāliśagītametat ajñātārthaprakāśo vā iti pāramārthikaṃ pramāṇalakṣaṇam iti pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 30
svabhāvanairātmyaṃ na doṣāya iṣṭatvāt ityaparaḥ; taṃ pratyāha--yena bhāva ityādi
bahirantaśca dharmanairātmyaṃ pramāṇataḥ pratipattuṃ nārhatyeva vipratiṣedhāt
kaḥ ? ityāha--abhāvaḥ sakalavyāvṛttiḥ tajjñānaṃ cet na tattvato vidyate ityadhyāhāraḥ
staṃ vā rthaśca tayoḥ siddhiḥ ātmalābho jñānajñeyasiddhiḥ iti yāvat
yadi vā, yadā saugataḥ abhyupagatā'bhāvajñānenāpi varjito bhavati tadā bandhyāsutavat jainābhyupagatasvārthayoḥ siddhiṃ jñaptiṃ prati na kiñcid bādhakaṃ brūyāt
vaditvā kathanna svavacanavirodhī, iti svārthayoḥ jñaptirna bādhyeta lokasiddhā
tatra pramāṇaṃ tattvato na bhavati prāmāṇyaṃ vyavahāreṇa pra॰ vā॰ 1
6 iti vacanāditi cet; atrāha--yena abhāvaḥ prameyaḥ tadvijñānaṃ pramāṇaṃ cet na tattvataḥ paramārthataḥ kintu saṃvṛtirūpavyavahārataḥ
idamatra tātparyam--atha pramāṇād abhāvapratipatteḥ bhāvapratipattirapi syāt iti
yadvā apramāṇasiddho nābhāvaḥ pāramārthikaḥ iti tadavastho bhāva iti
tatra hetumāha--viruddhānupalambhato viruddhasya atyantābhāvasya anupalambhataḥ apratipatteḥ
vahirantaśca dharmanairātmyaṃ sakalaśūnyatvaṃ pramāṇataḥ pratipattuṃ bauddho nārhatyeva
apramāṇāttarhi tatpratipattumarhati iti cet; atrāha--paramārthato nairātmyapratipatterabhāvāt
tataḥ kiṃ jātam ? ityāha— bhāvopalabdhiḥ bhavatyeva anekāntasiddhiḥ
atha ekāntabhāvopalabdhenaiva naivam; atrārtha svabhāva ityādi
yaduktaṃ bhāvopalabdhiriti; tatrāsti tāvannīlādeḥ upalabdhiḥ, sā tu bhāvasya iti kutaḥ ? tasya tattvasādhanābhāvāt
upalabdhireva tatsādhu keti cet; na; svapne'pi tasyāstaṃ tattvam iti na satyetarapravibhāgaḥ pāramārthikaḥ
na ca tasyāḥ kvacit bādhakasadbhāvetarakṛto viśeṣaḥ; sākalyena bādhakābhāvavyavasthānāt
sā arthakriyā na bhavatīti cet; kathamanyā ? pratibhāsāt; anyatra samānam
kiṃca, arthakriyāpi tadantarāt ced bhāvarūpā; anavasthā tatrāpi tadantarāpekṣaṇāt
paritoṣahetutvāt; svapne'pi ata eva sā tathāstu aviśeṣāt
bhāvajanyatvāt arthakriyāyā bhāvarūpatā, arthakriyāyāśca bhāvasya bhāvarūpateti

svasaṃvitteḥ bhrāntayā arthasaṃvittyā tādātmyaṃ pratiyataḥ kathamekatra kṛtakākṛtakayoḥ sthūlasūkṣmayorvā virodhaḥ ? tatra mithyābuddhyā antarjñeyaṃ sākalyena paramārthato bhrāntamanyathā vā pratiyataḥ bahirarthena ko'parādhaḥ kṛtaḥ yataḥ pratikṣipet ? tadvidhipratiṣedhatattvapratipatteḥ mithyaikānte virodhāviśeṣāt
tadayaṃ tato'ntarbahiśca tattvamekāntabhrāntayā mithyātvaṃ ca vyavasthāpayitukāmaḥ kṣaṇiketarapakṣavidhipratiṣedhavādinaṃ na vijayate sādhanaprayogapratiṣedhāt

asyāyamarthaḥ--jñānāni ca giraśca jñānagiraḥ, girāṃ grahaṇaṃ bahirarthopalakṣaṇārtham, tattvāni ca tāḥ jñānagiraśca tāsāṃ tattvajñānagirāṃ tattvajñānānāṃ tattvārthānāṃ ca dūṣakastvam aṅga yataḥ saugataḥ, tato vidūṣaka upasahanakārī bahirarthavastvabhimatajñānatattvadūṣaṇāt

tathāhi--yathā pratibhāsāt jāgraddaśāyāṃ stambhādīnāṃ paramārthasattve svapnāvasthāyāṃ tatsyāt ityucyate tathā tata eva jñānānāṃ paramārthasattve bahiḥ stambhādīnāmapi tad iti na jñānaikāntavādāvatāra iti 330 vyāhatam--advayaṃ nāga muttamam iti

yathā vā prāti bhāsādhyāsitatanavo'pi svapnaghaṭādayo na paramārthasantaḥ tathā'nye'pi iti kathyate tathā pratibhāsavanto'pi jāgradghaṭādayo'santaḥitijñāneṣu kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ iti bahirarthavat tatparityāgo nyāyyaḥ
bahirarthavad vijñānasyāpi na paramārthasattvam iti cet; atrāha--mithyā ityādi

arthasya ābhā pratibhāso yeṣāṃ tāni arthābhāni, na sthirāṇi asthirāṇi kṣaṇikāni ityarthaḥ, arthābhāni ca tāni asthirāṇi ca punaḥ tāni ca tāni jñānāni ca, mithyā ca tāni jñānāni ca teṣāṃ citrā nānākārāḥ santānāḥ teṣāṃ sādhakastvam aṅga yataḥ tato dūṣakaḥ tvaṃ vidūṣakaḥ vibhramaikānte tatsādhakatvāyogāt
kiṃbhūtayā ? bhrāntayā svapnavadasadarthaviṣayābhrāntayā, tādātmyaṃ tau bhrāntau ātmānau yasyāḥ tasyā bhāvaḥ tādātmyaṃ pratiyataḥ saugatasya

etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā arthasaṃvittiḥ yāthātmyasaṃvittiḥ bhrāntā'bhrāntā vā tathā sva saṃvittirapi yadi bhrāntā anyathā vā syāt, ekāntena tatra arthasaṃvittyā bhrāntayā tasyāḥ tādātmyaṃ pratiyataḥ kathamekatra bāhye vastuni kṛtakākṛtakayoḥ sthūlasūkṣmayorvā dharmayoḥ virodhaḥ ? svasaṃvittivat tatsaṃvitterapi abhrāntatvād iti manyate

idaṃ vyākhyānaṃ kasmānna bhavati--svasaṃvitteḥ arthasaṃvittyā bāhyanirbhāsena bhrāntena abhrā ntena vā tādātmyam ekatvaṃ pratiyataḥ kathamekatra tayorvirodho viruddhadharmādhyāsasya jñāne'pyanivāraṇāt iti ? svabhāve'vibhrame bhrāntaḥ siddhivi॰ 6

arthasaṃvittyā bhrāntayā saha tasyāḥ tādātmyaṃ bhrāntatvaṃ pratiyataḥ tatra tasyāṃ svasaṃvittau mithyābuddhyā bhrāntayā dhiyā antarjñeyaṃ jñānasvarūpaṃ bhrāntam anyathā vā pratiyataḥ sākalyena anavayavena paramārthato na vyavahāreṇa ko'parodho na kaściddoṣo bahirarthena kṛtaḥ yato'parādhāt pratikṣipet saugataḥ bahirartham iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
evaṃ manyate--mithyābuddhyā antarjñeyaṃ sākalyena paramārthato bhrāntam anyathā vā yathā paraḥ pratipadyate tathā santaṃ bahirarthaṃ pratipadyatām aviśeṣāt
syānmatam--yadi tayā bahirarthaṃ pratipadyate; kathaṃ sā mithyā ? tathā cet; na tayā kiñcit pratyeti
tathā pratyeti mithyā ca sā iti viruddhamiti; tatrāha--tad ityādi
tayoḥ antarjñeya-bahirarthayoḥ yau vidhipratiṣedhau antarjñeyasya bahirarthasya ca yo vidhipratiṣedhau ityarthaḥ, tayoryā tattvapratipattiḥ yāthātmyasaṃvittiḥ tasyā mithyaikānte virodhāviśeṣāt
ayamabhiprāyaḥ--yathā tadekānte kasyacid vidheḥ tattvataḥ pratipattirnāsti tathā pratiṣedhasyāpi iti tanniṣedhābhāve na tadekāntasiddhiriti
yata evaṃ tat tasmād ayaṃ saugataḥ vyavasthāpayitukāmaḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha--tato buddhiṃ sattvaṃ vyavasthāpakāt nyāyāt
ca iti bhinnaprakrama ivārtho antaḥ ityasyā nantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ
tathāhi--svapnā'svapnayoraviśeṣaṃ pratipādya bahirarthaṃ nirākurvatāpi buddhiḥ paramārtharūpā abhyupagantavyā, paramārthasāṃvyavahārikapramāṇalakṣaṇapraṇayanāt
tadabhyupagame nyāyo bahirapi na rājadaṇḍavārita iti bhāvaḥ
kṣaṇikaśca itaraśca akṣaṇikaḥ, tayoḥ tāveva vā pakṣai tayoryāthāsaṃkhyena vidhipratiṣedhau vadati ityevaṃ śīlastadvādī taṃ na vijayate
yathā kṣaṇikapakṣavidhivādī svanyāyena kṣaṇikapakṣaṃ vidadhāti, tanniṣedhavādī taddoṣeṇa kṣaṇikapakṣaṃ niṣedhati, tathā ayamapi iti
tarhi bahiriva svarūpavibhrāntā buddhiriti cet; atrāha— mithyātvaṃ ca
tadayam antarbahiḥ ityanuvarttate, svayam ātmanā vyavasthāpayitukāmaḥ, kayā ? ekāntabhrāntyā
ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ--yathā kṣaṇikavādī kalpanayā svapakṣaṃ sādhayan vipakṣaṃ na jahāti vipakṣaṃ vā niṣedhan nityagrāhakapramāṇapratividhānena svapakṣaṃ tiraskaroti tathā'yamapi iti
na traktaṃ vidhinā kṣaṇiketarapakṣavidhipratiṣedhavādino na tattvasādhanamasti, asya tu vidyate iti kathamucyate na tadvādinaṃ vijayate iti cet ? atrāha--sādhana ityādi

idamatra tātparyam--vijñaptimātraṃ paramārthasad bahirarthaḥ punaḥ tadviparīta iti darśane vijñaptivad anyasyāpi pratyakṣataḥ siddhe tanmātrasādhane pakṣasya pratyakṣabādhanamiti na tatra hetūpanyāsa ḥ taduktam--na tasya hetubhistrāṇam utpanne ca yo hataḥ iti
sādhanasya tanmātraliṅgasya prayogo vacanaṃ tasya pratiṣedhāt nirākaraṇāt, nirākṛte tadanupayogāt
bahirarthavat tanmātrasyāpi na paramārthasattvam iti mate sādhanamapi tathāvidhameva
tataḥ sādhanaprayogapratiṣedhāt asataḥ prayogavaiphalyāt iti manyate
yadi vā, tatprayogasya pratiṣedhāt, bhrāntimātre tadvacanasya svayameva nirākaraṇāt tadayaṃ tadvādinaṃ na vijayate iti

atra aparaḥ prāha--na citpratibhāsamānasya citpratiṣedha ucyate yenā'yaṃ doṣaḥ syāt api tu paramārthasattvāropa eva vivādagocare ghaṭādau nirākriyate taimirikakeśādinidarśanena iti; so'pi anena nirastaḥ
tathāhi--taimirikakeśādau paramārthasadbhāvaḥ kutaścit paramārthato yadi siddhaḥ; tarhi tenaiva tadvyavacchedahetoḥ vyabhicāraḥ iti sādhanaprayogapratiṣedhāt savyabhicārāt sādhanasya aprayogāt
no cet; na tarhi tatra kasyacit sādhanasya tena vyāptiriti sādhyavikalo dṛṣṭāntaḥ

ama vyavahāriṇā tatra tadabhāva iṣyate tena tadvyāptiḥ; tarhi saugatena jñāneṣu svasaṃvedane paramārthasattayopagatena upalambhasya vyāpteḥ yadupalabhyate tat paramārthasad yathā svasaṃvedanam upalabhyate ca jāgratsvapnadaśāyāṃ bahirarthaḥ iti bahirarthasatyaikāntavādī atha syāt na tena svasaṃvedanaṃ paramārthasad iṣyate; vyavahāriṇāpi tatra tadabhāvo neṣyate itisamānam

kathaṃ tasya satyetara pravibhāga iti cet; itarasya kathaṃ paramārthasaṃvyavahāra pramāṇalakṣaṇābhedaḥ ? kathaṃ vā tadaparamārthasattve bahirarthād viśeṣyā yena bahirarthaḥ tyajyate na taditi ? so'yaṃ svasaṃvedanakṛtāṃ sarvavikalpābhāvasiddhimupajīvati na tatparamārthasattvam icchati itarathā parasaṃvedanasya aparamārthasattve'pi tato bahirarthasiddhiḥ syāt
etena paropagatena sādhyena dṛṣṭāntena hetorvyāptiḥ iti nirastam

kiṃca, vyavahāriṇā tatra pramāṇamantareṇa yadi nāma tadabhāvo'bhyupagato naitāvatā sarvatra tadabhāva iti kvacid bahirarthe'pi paramārthasattvāśaṅkā'nivṛtteḥ kathaṃ matimataṃ saugatamata eva matiḥ ? anyathā kvacit puruṣe sa sarvajñatvābhāvastena upagataḥ iti sarvatra tadābhāvaḥ tathā ca mīmāṃsakapakṣe parasya pradveṣo nirnibandhanaṃ
nanu jñānavad yadi artho'pyupalabhyeta yuktametat ubhayoraviśeṣeṇa sattvamasattvaṃ vā yāvatā jñānameva upalabhyate, nīlādeḥ sahopalambhaniyamena tadrūpatvāditi cet; atrāha--sahopalambha ityādi
sahopalambhaniyamādabhedaikāntasādhane bhrāntipratyakṣayoranyatarasyābhāvāt na kvacid bhrāntijñānaṃ syāt tadekāntena bhrāntiviviktapratyakṣasvabhāvopapatteḥ suṣuptavat
sakṛdekārthopanibaddhadṛṣṭīnāṃ parajñānānupalambhe'pi tadarthadarśanāt kuto niyamaḥ ? tadekakṣaṇavartināṃ sahopalambhaniyamāt svayaṃ vedanenotpatteḥ sakalaṃ jagadekasantānaṃ prasajyeta
yadi punarekajñānopalambhaniyamo hetuḥ; asiddhaḥ anaikāntikaśca, nīlasya sakṛdanekena jñānena upalambhasaṃbhavāt, bahūnāmapi dravyāṇāmekajñānopalambhāpratiṣedhāt
yadi punarasahānupalambha iti; ko viśeṣaḥ ? prasajyapratiṣedhamātramasādhyasādhanam śaśaviṣāṇa-kharaviṣāṇayoriva, arthādarthagatilakṣaṇāt
nīlatadviṣayayoḥ nīlanīlajñānayoḥ yaḥ sahopalambhaniyamo yaugapadyopalambhaniyamaḥ pareṇa tadabhedabhāvanāya upanyastaḥ tasmālliṅgāt syāt bhede bhedo nānātvaṃ nīlataddhiyoḥ iti āvṛttyā sambandhaḥ
tanniyamasya tarkato bhedaniṣṭhatvāt, tataḥ tatsiddherviruddho'yamabhedasādhana iti manyate
na khalu nīlasyaiva upalambhe nīlapītayoḥ sahopalambha iti yuktam
viṣayasya hi nīlādeḥ dhiyā saha sakṛdeva saṃvedanaṃ dhiyā saha na pṛthak...--pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
dharmyatra nīlākārataddhiyau tayorabhinnatvaṃ sādhyadharmaḥ yathoktaḥ sahopalambhaniyamo hetuḥ
nanu candradvayasya abhede'pi tanniyamaḥ tatkathamasya bhedena vyāptiriti cet ? uktamatra sahopalambho na syāt tadanyaravat iti
sahaśabdasya yaugapadyārtham uktvā tadarthāntaraṃ parikalpitamāśaṅkya dūṣayannāha--asahānupalambhaśced iti

asyāyamarthaḥ--sahānupalambhaḥ paryudāsavṛttyā pṛthagupalambhaḥ, tasya nañā prasajyapratiṣedhavācinā, na paryudāsavācinā uktārthaprasaṅgāt, abhisambandhe pṛthagupalambhābhāvaḥ asahānupalambhaḥ sahopalambhaḥ
atra dūṣaṇam asiddho hetuḥ asminnarthe sahopalambhalakṣaṇaḥ
tathāhi--pramātari ahamahamikayā jñānaṃ pratīyate anyatra ghaṭādikaṃ samānakāle'pi
asya ca nirviṣayatve ananumānam, tatkāle sambandhā'grahaṇāt
ariṣṭādiliṅgād bhāvino maraṇāderanumāne kālapṛthaktvena anumānānumeyayoḥ pratibhāsanaṃ siddhameva
tulanā--tatra bhadantaśubhaguptastvāha--viruddho'yaṃ hetuḥ, yasmāt sahaśabdaśca loke'nyo nnaivānyena vinā kvacit
punaḥ sa evāha--yadi sahaśabda ekārthaḥ tadā heturasiddhaḥ
yadā ca sattvaṃ prāṇabhṛtāṃ sarve cittakṣaṇāḥ sarvajñenāvasīyante tadā kathamekenaivopalambhaḥ siddhaḥ syāt
atha sahaśabda ekakālavivakṣayā; tadā buddhajñeyacittena cittacaittaiśca sarvathā anaikāntikatā hetoḥ

yathā kila buddhasya bhagavato yadvijñeyaṃ santānāntaracittaṃ tasya buddhajñānasya ca sahopalambhaniyame'pyastyeva ca nānātvam, tathā cittacaittānāṃ satyapi sahopalamme naikatvamityato'naikāntiko heturiti
...syādetat yadyapi vipakṣe sattvaṃ na niścitaṃ sandigdhaṃ tu, tataścānaikāntiko hetuḥ sandigdhavipakṣavyāvṛttikatvāt
atha svarūpānnānyatra jñānavṛttiḥ tenāyamadoṣaḥ; uktamatra anyatrāpi tadvṛttidarśanāt
kiṃca, nīlataddhiyorabheda syātmānenā'viṣayīkaraṇe kiṃ sahopalambhaniyamopanyāsena ? samāropavyavacchedo'pi cintito'smabhiranyatra
dharmisādhyadharmānumā nānām abhedo abhinna- vedane siddhaṃ pṛthagupalambhanam
sahaśabdasya ekārthavācitvāt ekasya jñānasyaiva upalambhaniyamaḥ sahopalambhaniyamaḥ iti etena nirastam; ubhayorupalambhāt
yadi vā, syād iti nipāto'yam, ataḥ śeṣahetvādidoṣaparigrahaḥ
sahopalambhaniyamāt yaugapadyopalambhaniyamād abhedaikāntasādhane aṅgīkriyamāṇe nīlataddhiyoḥ iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ
bhrāntiśabdena bhrāntirapi sambandhataḥ pramā iti vacanāt nīlatadvijñānayoḥ abhedaikāntānumānasya anumeye vibhramo gṛhyate
10 ityabhidhānāt, tasya ātmavedanam tayoranyatarasya bhrānteḥ pratyakṣatya vā abhāvāt na kvacit tadabhede'nyatra vā bhrāntijñānaṃ mithyānumānaṃ syād bhavet, tato lābhamicchato mūlocchedaḥ
tanniyamād yo'sau bhrāntipratyakṣayoḥ tadekānto bhedaikāntaḥ tena hetunā bhrāntyā sādhāraṇā'spaṣṭanirbhāsena vivikto vikalaḥ pratyakṣasya svalāvedanādhyakṣasya yaḥ svabhāvaḥ tasya upapatteḥ kāraṇāt
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadā bhrāntiḥ pratyakṣādabhinnā bhavati tadā tadeva sā
yad yasmādabhinnaṃ tat tadeva bhavati yathā pratyakṣasvarūpam, abhinnā ca bhrāntistata iti
pratyakṣaviviktabhrānteḥ prasaṅgāt kāraṇāt, tadabhāvāt na kvacid bhrāntijñānaṃ syāt
evaṃ manyate--bhrānteḥ pratyakṣasyābhede saiva tad iti sādhāraṇaviśadākāramātraṃ svasaṃvedanarahitaṃ pramāṇatrāṇaśca nyaṃ prasaktam
tato'numānābhyupagamād bhrāntipratyakṣayoḥ bheda eva tanniyamasadbhāvād viruddho hetuḥ iti bhāvaḥ
anena vyatirekamukhena sahopalambhaniyamāt syādbhedo nīlataddhiyoḥ iti vyākhyānam
kva ? ityatrāha--bahirantaśca nīlasya bahiḥ taddhiyo'ntaḥ, caśabdād anyadā smaryamāṇānumeyārthayoḥ anyadā smaraṇānumānayoḥ iti darśayati
kuto na kutaścit mānāt sahopalambhaniyamaḥ siddho hetuḥ ityarthaḥ

prakārāntareṇa tadasiddhatāṃ darśayannāha--sakṛd ekahelayā ekasminnarthe narttakyādau upanibaddhā vyāpṛtā dṛṣṭiryeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ puruṣāḥ teṣāṃ parajñānānupalambhe'pi na kevalaṃ puruṣaviśeṣāṇāmupalambhe tadarthadarśanāt teṣāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ jñānānāṃ ca arthasya darśanāt kuto niyamaḥ sahopalambhasya ?
nanu tajjñānānupalambhe kathamayaṃ tadartha iti jñāyate ? dviṣṭhasambandhasaṃvittiḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 2

atha puruṣāṇāṃ tatra pravṛttidarśanāt tajjñānaviṣayīkṛto'sau arthaḥ iti paricchidyate; evaṃ tarhi ya eva kenacidupalabhyate sa eva pareṇāpi iti anumānādavagamyate tathā ca dvayoḥ samānapravṛttidarśanāt samānārthadarśanaṃ sidhyet

sāmānyaviṣaya tvādanumānasya naikārthadarśanam, anyathā sadṛśaromāñcakañcukitatvadarśanāt ekasukhapratipattiḥ syād iti cet; tadasat; yataḥ paśavo'pi svadarśanābhilaṣitāṃ paśuyoṣitam anyairabhilaṣitāṃ pratipadyamānāḥ taiḥ sārddhaṃ bu ddhyamānā dṛśyante
yādṛśyasmābhirabhilaṣitā tādṛśī anyaiḥ iti pratipattau tadayogāt

kutaste tathā pratipadyante iti cet; kāryaviśeṣā vadhāraṇād iti siddhaḥ kathamanyathā tadviśeṣāvadhāraṇe iṣyata eva sarvathā gamyagamakabhāvaḥ iti vacanaṃ śobheta ? na cāyamekāntaḥ dṛṣṭāntasādharmyāt sāmānyameva anumeyam iti, viduṣā vācyo hetureva hi kevalaḥ pra॰ vā॰ 3
mā vā bhūt--yamarthaṃ paśyatyayaṃ tameva anyo'pi iti niścitā pratītiḥ, tathāpi pareṇa taddarśananiṣedhābhāvāt tanniyamasya sandigdhā'siddhatā
atha narthakya nyadarśanavikalā pratītiniyata iti tadbādhanam; tarhi khalavilāntargatabījād aṅkuraṃ tadviviktaṃ pratīyate iti na tatra tadvyāpāraḥ
tato yathā kārye adṛṣṭasyāpi kāraṇasya vyāpāraḥ tathā prameye anyajñānasya saṃbhāvyeta
vyavahāreṇa tadaṅgīkaraṇaṃ, tenaiva tanniyamasya sandigdhāsiddhatāmanvākarṣati iti yatkiñcidetat
syānmatam--yajjñānasyākāro'sau tena vedyate nānyena; tanna; yataḥ tadākāratā tasyāḥ kutaḥ siddhā ? tanniyamāditi cet; anyo'nyāśrayāt --siddhe tadākāratve tanniyamaḥ sidhyati, tataḥ tadākāratvam
sidhyatu vā kutaścit tadākāratvam, tathāpi sugatena tadvedane tadavastho'pi doṣaḥ
tatastadvijñānāvedane'pi pṛthagjatena tadarthavedanāt kathaṃ sugataḥ sarvajña sta tadatāt kathaṃ sugataḥ sarvajñaste tadavedane ?
grāhyaṃ na tasya grahaṇaṃ na tena jñānāntaragrāhyaḥtayāpi śūnyaḥ
tathāpi ca jñānamayaḥ prakāśaḥ pratyakṣapakṣasya tathāvivāsīd
iti vacanāt nā'śeṣajñātā tasya sarvajñatā api tu svarūpajñatā, tasyāpyetanna sundaram; itarasmāttadaviśeṣāt pramāṇabhūtāya pramāṇasamu॰ ślo॰ 1 ityādeḥ ānarthakyaprasaṅgāt
pramāṇasiddhyai svakṛtiprakīrṇanāt nibadhyate viprasṛtaṃ samuccitam iti śeṣaḥ
yadi ca sa tathāvidho na kutaścit pratipannaḥ; kathamasti yena tathā stūyate ? tadidamāyātam--yathā īśvare nitye'pyapramāṇatā tathā sugate'pi pramāṇaśūnyatā
atha pratipannaḥ; tarhi bhavatā sugato'pi jñāyate na tena paraṃ kiñciditi mūḍhatā
...miti kathaṃ na prakṛto doṣaḥ ? tatḥ sthitaṃ kuto niyamaḥ iti
tena vivakṣitanīlajñānena ekasmin kṣaṇe varttituṃ śīlānām ekakṣaṇabhāvisantānāntarajñānānām ityarthaḥ
tadapi kutaḥ ? ityāha--svayam ātmano vā vedanenotpatteḥ
na caivam, ato vyabhicārī hetuḥ iti bhāvaḥ
sa ma nta bha dra sya tu matam--yayoḥ...

...sahopalambha ityādinā tadabhede ca na grāhyagrāhakatayā tanniyama iti ca grāhakābhimatāt grāhyasya bhede na tenāsya grahaṇam ananyavedyaniyamād api tu svayameva tadapi pratibhāti, tathāpi sahopalambhaniyamāt tayorabhede tadeketyādyuktam
tadetadittham anye pariharanti--nīlataddhiyorabhede naikatvam api tu jñānatvena sadṛśatvam, yathā jñānaṃ jñānaṃ tathā nīlamapi sahopalambhaniyamāttathā...

...dasti iti na taiḥ vyabhicāro hetoḥ vipakṣe'gamanāditi; te na yuktakāriṇaḥ; yato yadi yaj jñānena saha upalabhyate tadapi jñānaṃ tarhi nīlajñānaikakṣaṇavarttināṃ jñānāntarāṇāṃ sahopalambhaniyamāt nīlatvamāpadyeta
punaḥ tatkāryasyāpi jñānasya nīlatve tadavastho doṣaḥ punarapi tadavastha iti nīlamātraṃ jagat
tena nīlajñānena ekakṣaṇavarttināṃ svayam ātmano vena notpatteḥ kāraṇāt anena sahavṛttivad vedanamapi sahaiva darśayati--sahopalambhaniyamāt sakala jagad ekasantānaṃ sadṛśasantānaṃ prasajyeta
na caivaṃ paresti stato vyabhicārī hetuḥ
tatra na tanniyamamātrāt nīlaṃ jñānamiti gamyate api tu jñānavat svayaṃ pratibhāsanāt

na ca niyatanīlajñānavat sarvajñajñānaṃ nīlatayā cakāsti yenātiprasaṅgaḥ syāditi cet; tarhi nīlaṃ jñānaṃ svayaṃ prakāśanāt tajjñānavat ityevāstu kiṃ vyabhicāriṇā tanniyamena ? tadevāstu iti cet; na; parata eva tatpratibhāsapratipādanāt

parasya tu darśanaṃ vivaika jñāna dvaitābhyupagamāt sakalaṃ jagad ekajñānamiṣyate na punaḥ ekasantānaṃ tadabhāvāt iti na tena tadvyabhicāra iti; tanna sūktam; nīlamātradarśino'pi sakalajagadapekṣacitratvapratītiprasaṅgāt anyathā nānaikam ityuktaṃ bhavet yugapadiva krameṇāpi ca tatprasaṅgāt
evaṃ yaugapadyārthaṃ sahaśabdaṃ nirūpya nipātānāmanekārthatvāt ekārthaṃ nirūpayannāha--yadi ityādi

yadīti parābhyupagamasūcakaḥ, punariti pakṣāntarasya, ekajñānopalambhaniyamaḥ ekasya jñāno palambho nārthasya iti tanniyamaḥ, ekena jñānenopalambho nīlasya na tadantareṇa iti vā tanniyamo hetuḥ sahopalambhaniyamo yadītyarthaḥ
ādye pakṣe dūṣaṇamāha--asiddho hetuḥ ityanena sambandhaḥ, arthasyāpyupalambhāt
kasyacinnarttakyādigatasya sakṛcchabdena sahiti vyākhyātam, anekena jñānena upalambha saṃbhavāditi
anena tatpakṣīkaraṇaṃ niṣedhati, nahi jīvādīnām ekajñāno pakṣīkaraṇamātreṇa ekatvaṃ pramāṇabādhanāt
paryāyāṇām ityucyamāne teṣāṃ dravyāpekṣayā ekatvāt syādapi pakṣīkaraṇam
ekajñānopalambhaḥ ekena jñānena upalambhasya darśanasya apratiṣedhāt niṣedhābhāvāt
sahopalambhaniyamād iti hetuḥ sa yadi punaḥ asahānupalambha iti syāt; tatra dūṣaṇaṃ ko viśeṣa iti pūrvoktādarthāt na kaścidasya bhedaḥ
tathāhi--paryudāsavṛttyā sahānupalambhaḥ pṛthagupalambhaḥ asya najāti sambandhe tadvṛttyā sahopalambha iti prāptiḥ
athātra prasajyapratiṣedho'pekṣā tarhi sādhyamapi tathāvidhamastu anyathā sambandhā'siddheḥ
prasajyapratiṣedhamātramasādhyasādhanam sādhyaṃ na bhavati sādhanaṃ ca na bhavati ityarthaḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha--arthād dhūmādeḥ sakāśād arthasya agnyāderyā gatiḥ pratipattiḥ tasyā lakṣaṇād darśanāt
athavā arthasambandhi yallakṣaṇam--artho hyarthaṃ mayatā iti śāstraṃ tadāśrityeti
āha ukta bhavatā--nīlākārasya jñānasyaikasya upalambho nārthasya tanniyama nyatra asiddho hetuḥ arthasyāpyupalambhāt iti; tanna yuktam; arthasya svasadasatsamayabhāvina ḥ kenacidagrahaṇāt
na caikasya ubhayatra vyāpāro virodhāt iti cet; atrāha--vijñānasya ityādi
jñānakālīnasya arthasya jñānaṃ prati kāraṇatvābhāvāt sahabhāvinoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvābhāvāt
jñānakāle'vidyamānasya grāhyatve sakalātītānāgatasya grahaṇaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ
bhrāntaikāntavad iti nidarśanaṃ sāvapi tu bhrāntaikānte tyu panyasya dūṣayati--viplutākṣā ityādina
vipratipattiviṣayāpannajñānānāṃ nirviṣayatāsādhane sarvajñānānāṃ svayamaviṣayīkṛtānāṃ nirviṣayatāsiddheḥ syādvādalaṅghane iṣṭavighātakṛt viruddhaḥ bahirarthāviśeṣāt svasaṃvedanaṃ ca na sidhyet
tadabhrāntaikānte sahopalambhavirodhāt saha pṛthagvā dvicandranirbhāsavat nīlataddhiyoranupalabdhereva bhedābhedayorabhāvasādhane vyatirekasiddhirvirudhyeta

viplutāni akṣāṇi yasyāḥ sā tathoktā buddhiḥ kāmalādyupahatendriyakeśoṇu kādibuddhiriti yathā yena grāhyagrāhakādipravṛttaprakāreṇa anyena vā ci tathā prati bhāsinī asadarthapratibhāsavatī tathā tena prakāreṇa sarvatra svapararūpayoḥ athavā jāgratsvapnayoḥ yā buddhiḥ vitathapratibhāsinī kinna vitathapratibhāsinyeva pratiṣedhadvayena prakṛtārthagateḥ
etatat dūṣayati iti evaṃ jaḍāḥ prajñāhīnāḥ saugatāḥ saṃprapedire jñātavantaḥ
nirālambe nabhasi keśākārā uṇḍukākārā--maśakādyākārā yā buddhiḥ

tātparyamatra— anenānumānena vipratipattiviṣayāpannajñānānāṃ nirviṣayatā sādhyeta, saviṣayatāsamāropavyavacchedo vā kriyeta gatyantarābhāvāt iti ? tatra ādye pakṣe anena dharmiṇāṃ jñānānāmaparicchede na taddharmasya nirviṣayatvasya paricchedo devadattāgrahaṇe tacchyāmatvavat
tadāha--sarvajñānānāṃ vivādāspadībhūtavedanānāṃ svayam ātmānumānena aviṣayīkṛtānām nirviṣayatā'siddhiḥ kāraṇād iṣṭavighātakṛt vādina iccheṣṭaṃ tasya khaṇḍanakṛt, ataśca hetvābhāsaḥ
kinnāmeha viruddhaḥ kiñcitkaratvaviparītena akiñcitkaratvenāruddhaḥ kroḍīkṛto viruddhaḥ
teṣām anena paricchede; sidhyati viṣayatā kintu tadvadanyeṣāmapi pratibhāsinā'rthena viṣayatvasiddhiḥ, itarathā asyāpi na syāt iti tadavasthamakiñcitkaratvam
iṣṭa vi ghātakṛt iṣṭaṃ saugatasya jāgratsvapnapratyayānāṃ nirviṣayatvam tasya vighātakṛt viruddho hetvābhāsaḥ
tathāhi--atadvyāptaḥ tadvyāptivibhramoṣito viruddha iti manīṣiṇo manyante
prakṛtānumāne ca grāhyagrāhakasaṃvedanākāratvam anyadvā viṣayatvena vyāptaṃ siddham
tata evaṃ vaktavyam--jāgratsvapnapratyayāḥ saviṣava grāhyagrāhakasaṃvedanākāratvād anyato vā parakīyahetoḥ prakṛtānumānavad iti
svapnajñānasya saviṣayatvasādhane prasiddhibādhādidoṣa iti cet; jāgradvijñānasya nirviṣayatvasādhane'pi samānaḥ
kiñcidvijñānaṃ saviṣayaṃ kiñcid viparītam tadapi kathañcit iti syādvādaḥ tasya laṅghane parityāge sati

evaṃ manyate--yadā yathā bauddhena paraprasiddhamithyāsvapnajñānanidarśanena sarvajñānasya mithyātvaṃ sādhyate tathā pareṇāpi bauddhaprasiddhasatyānumānanidarśanena sarvajñānasya satyatā, tadā viruddhaḥ
tadā tu syādvādamavalambya svapnajñānasya mithyātve'pi prakṛtānumānavat tadākāratve'pi kiñccidvijñānaṃ sālambanaṃ syāt iti sādhayati paraḥ, tadā'naikāntiko hetvābhāsa iti
yadi punaḥ samāropavyavacchedaḥ kriyate; tatrāpyucyate--nirviṣayeṣu saviṣayatāvikalpaḥ samāropaḥ
tadanumānāt prāk tatra pramāṇāntarāpravṛttau kathaṃ nirviṣayatāsiddhiryataḥ tadvikalpaḥ samāropaḥ, tadvyavacchedakaraṇācca anumānamarthavadbhavet

etadevāha--sarvajñānānāṃ svapnetarapratyayānāṃ svayaṃ saugatena, anyena tadviṣayīkaraṇe'pi tasya tannirviṣayatā'siddheriti bhāvaḥ, aviṣayīkṛtānām, kasmin sati ? ityāha--syādvādalaṅghane svarūpavat pararūpe'pi ekasya jñānasya grahaṇaśaktisadbhāvaḥ syādvādaḥ tasya laṅghane svarūpamātraparyavasitajñānapakṣa ityarthaḥ nirviṣayatāsiddheḥ kāraṇāt iṣṭavighātakṛtaṃ svayam ityanuvarttate svayamiṣṭo vādinā samāropaḥ tasya vyāghāto'bhāvaḥ tasya tatkaraṇam
tataḥ kim ? ityāha--viruddhaḥ pūrvavad akiñcitkaro hetvābhāsaḥ
atha svayaṃ teṣāṃ viṣayīkṛtānāmeva sarvametadicchet; tatrāha--sarva ityādi
ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ yena pratyakṣeṇa sarvajñānaṃnirviṣayatāṃ pratipadyate tena viruddho'naikāntikaśca hetvābhāsaḥ pūrvavad yojyaḥ
prakṛtānumānena saviṣayatāsamāropavyavacchedaḥ kriyate asmin vikalpe dūṣaṇamāha
nanu tadapi pratyakṣamānaṃ ca nirviṣayameva tenāyamadoṣa iti cet; atrāha--bahirarthāviśeṣāt ityādi
svayaṃ bauddhasya na kevalaṃ bahirarthāviśeṣāt santānāntare svahetuphalasiddhiḥ na bhavati api tu kintu svasaṃvedanaṃ ca na sidhyet
tathā ca kuto vibhramo'nyo vā sidhyediti bhāvaḥ
tato yathā bahirarthaviśeṣe'pi svasaṃvedanasyaiva sattvam na bahirarthasya tathā svapnetarapratibhāsāviśeṣe'pi jāgradghaṭādereva tat iti kathaṃ nā'siddho hetuḥ
atrāha pra jñā ka raḥ--jāgradghaṭādivat svapnaghaṭāderapi sattvam
svarūpasākṣātkaraṇe satyatetyādi durghaṭam || pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 2 | 37 iti;
atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--satyavādītiṃ durghaṭam iti ko'rthaḥ ? yadi sarvamasatyam, satyāsatyavibhāgaśūnyaṃ vā; tatroktaṃ bahirarthāviśeṣādityādi
atha satyam; tatredamucyate--sahopalambhavirodhādviruddho hetvābhāsaḥ, dvicandrādāvapi sahopalambhasya bheda eva bhāvāditi bhāvaḥ
athavā yaduktam--bahirarthāviśeṣāt svasaṃvedanaṃ ca na sidhyet iti tatra svasaṃvedana naṃ pratibhāsāt sidhyati, bahirarthaḥ viparyayāt iti paraḥ; tatrāha--tadabhrāntaikānta ityādi
atra dvaitaṃ niraṃśaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ tatsvasaṃvedanam, citramekaṃ vā ? tatra dvitīye pakṣe--tatra ityādi vakṣyamāṇaṃ dūṣaṇamiti

prathame dūṣaṇam--tad ityanena svasaṃvedanaṃ parāmṛśyate tasya abhrānto ya ekaḥ asahāyaḥ sarvvatodharmadharmittasu pagamyamāne sahopalambhavirodhāt nīlarūpasya ekasya jñānasyaiva, ekenaiva ekasyaiva vā upalambhasya virodhādabhāvāt, bahirantarvā asahāyasya upalambhaniṣedhena, kāraṇāt saha yaugapadyena pṛthag vā kālādibhedaina, veti samuccaye, nīlataddhiyoḥ yenamu nupalabdhiradarśanam tasyā eva na sahopalambhāt ityevakārārthaḥ, bhedā'bhedayoḥ bhedasya abhedasya vā'bhāvasādhane nīlataddhiyoḥ aṅgīkriyamāṇe tu
yathā dvicandranirbhāsayoranyo'nyaṃ na bhedo nāpyabhedaḥ, tayoḥ vastuniṣṭhatvāt, tannirbhāsayoravastutvāt tathā prakṛtayorapi iti

tatra dūṣaṇamāha--anupalabdheḥ bhedābhedayorabhāvasādhane hetutvena upanyastāyāḥ vyatirekasiddhiḥ vipakṣād bhāvarūpād vyatirekasya vyāvṛtteḥ siddhiḥ nirṇītirvirudhyeta niraṃśasvasaṃvedanabhāve'pi tasyā bhāvāt
na cā'niścitavyatireko hetuḥ gamaka iti manyate
nanu na tad ekāntaabhrāntarūpam iṣyate kintu svarūpe abhrānta grāhyākāre anyathā iti cet; atrāha--nanvamityādi
buddheḥ svopalambhe arthopalambhe ca yāthāsaṃkhyena tattvāgrahaikānte mithyāgrahaikānte vā abhyupagamyamāne sahopalambhaniyamaḥ kva ? na kvacit
niraṃśasaṃvedanānubhavābhāvena arthopalambhasyāpi durghaṭatvāt apratyakṣopalambhasya nārthadṛṣṭiḥ prasidhyati iti manyate
na ca naiva anekāntamantareṇa ekānte ityarthaḥ
nīlataddhiyoḥ sahopalambhaniyamaḥ, tayoḥ upalambhasyaiva abhāvāditi bhāvaḥ
tadupalambhe'pi tamantareṇa svayam antarjñeyatattvasya na ca iti padaghaṭanā bahirantasyāpyasattvāt
antarbahiśca bhavatvanekānta iti cet; atrāha--anekāntā jñārnāyoḥ ekānekātmakatve aṅgīkriyamāṇe kathañcit na sarvathā
evaṃ manyate--tatra bahirantarvā bhedā'bhedayoḥ tanniyame'pi nekāntenaikatvaṃ tathā nīlataddhiyorapi
yadi ca upalambhā'viśeṣe'pi svopalambhe tattvagrahaikāntaḥ arthopalambhe mithyāgrahaikānta ityanekānte kathañcit jāgraddaśāyāṃ svapnadaśāyāṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavat
athavā, svarūpe vibhrāntaṃ jñānam arthepītyanekānte bahirarthatattvaṃ kathañcit pratyakṣaparokṣātmakaṃ yathā pramāṇaṃ vyavasthitameva
anena tanniyamasya bhāgāsiddhatāṃ darśayati--cetanānīlatārūpeṇa tadbhāve'pi kṣaṇakṣayādyātmanā abhāvāt
nanu buddhermithyākāro na svākāraḥ kintu parākāraḥ, tato'yamadoṣa iti cet; atrāha— svapratyakṣa ityādi
svabhāvanānātvaṃ yadi bhāvasya bhedakaṃ na bhavet kiṃ paravyāvṛtteḥ kāryakāraṇasantānakarmaphalasambandhaprabhṛtitadarthasmaraṇādyanekachidrāśakyapidhānānarthanibandhanayā niranvayakalpanayā ?

ato bhede'pi tādātmyāvabhāso bhrāntyā, anyathā anekānta ityuktam iti svapratyakṣaṃ ca cetanādirūpeṇa parokṣaśca sukhādivirodhavadākāravivekaḥ tau ca tāvātmānau ca svau pratyakṣaparokṣātmānau yasya tattathoktaṃ tacca tajjñānaṃ ca tasya siddhau aṅgīkriyamāṇāyāṃ na sidhyati kiṃ sidhyatyeva
evaṃ manyate--yasmād vijñānamekaṃ pratyakṣaparokṣātmakaṃ tasmāt pratyakṣaparokṣātmaikaḥ sidhyati
yasmācca jñānatadvivekayorabhedena pakṣīkṛtayorapi tanniyamo'vidyamānatvena bhāgāsiddhaḥ tasmādarthaḥ sidhyati iti

svabhāvetyādinā kārikārthamāha--pratyakṣaparokṣarūpeṇa yat svabhāvanānātvaṃ jñānasya tadbhāvasya tasyaiva bhedakaṃ nānātvāpādakaṃ yadi na bhavet parasmāt sajātīyād vijātīyācca yā vyāvṛttirbhāvasya tasyāḥ sakāśāt kiṃ niranvayakalpanayā ? kiṃbhūtayā ? ityāha--kāryetyādi
kāryaṃ ca kāraṇaṃ ca santānaśca karma ca vāsanārūpaṃ cetanā karma abhidha॰ ko॰ 4

1 iti vacanāt, phalaṃ ca dehāntarasaṃcārādi, tayoḥ sambandhaśca tadutpattiḥ, punaḥ eteṣāṃ prabhṛtiśabdena bahuvrīhiḥ, tadarthaḥ smaraṇādiḥ tasya anekam anantaroktaṃ chidraṃ dūṣaṇam tasyāśakyaṃ pidhānam uttaraṃ tadevānarthanircavvo yasyāṃ tayā iti

nanu nārthavad buddheḥ svarūpaṃ bhrāntam, nāpi svapararūpayoḥ abhrāntetarasvabhāvaṃ svagrāhyākārasvabhāvaṃ svagrāhyākāravivekāpekṣayā dṛśo tarasvabhāvaṃ vā yenāya doṣaḥ syāt, api tu sukhādinīlādiśarīrākārameva tanniyamāt iti cet; etad buddhajñāna-tadvedyābhyāṃ vyabhicārayannāha--
tanniyame'pi tayorbhede anyathā anekāntaṃ sādhayan pratyakṣetyādi
na kevalaṃ santānakṣaṇānāṃ tanniyamādekasantānatvamapi tu santānāntarāṇām
buddhaścet santānināṃ santānāntarāṇāṃ ca boddhā, tadekopalambhāt santatirna bhavettadekatāpatteḥ
saṃvitteḥ punarananyavedyaniyame kathaṃ mithyāvikalpamantareṇa svaparasantānavikalpamātropadeśaḥ ? tanmithyāvikalpānāmanekāntātmakatvam
nanvetat pūrvamuktam asmābhiḥ na śāstrakṛtā iti
pratyakṣaḥ madhyarūpo madhyasvabhāvo'rvāgbhāgo yasya sa tathoktaḥ sacā sāvarthaśca tasmātmanaḥ svarūpasya parokṣatā
buddhajñānaṃ hi sakalārthaiḥ samam upalabhyate na ca taiḥ saha tasya ekatvamiti sahopalambho'nekāntaḥ vyabhicārītyarthaḥ

asyā'yamarthaḥ--yadā sugata ātmasantānatatsantānātītānādyanantakṣaṇān anyasantānatatkṣaṇāṃśca paśyati vā, na vā ? prathamapakṣe na kevalaṃ santānakṣaṇānāṃ sahopalambhaniyamād yena jñānena te upalabhyante tena saha tanniyamād ekasantānatvaṃ eko'bhinnaḥ kathañcidanyo'nyasantānaḥ santānaṃ yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ tattvam, apitu santānāntarāṇām ekasantānatvaṃ sugatajñānena saha syāt ityadhyāhāraḥ buddhaśced yadi boddhā santānināṃ santānāntarāṇāṃ ca
atha yathādeśakālāṃ teṣāmasau boddhā; anaikāntiko hetuḥ iti bhāvaḥ
atha etaddoṣadvayabhayād ekāntena na sahaikatvamiṣyate teṣām; tatrāha--tadeka ityādi
tasya buddhasya vivakṣitaṃ yadekam atanasajñānaṃ tena upalambhāt kāraṇāt santānināṃ santānāntarāṇāṃ ca santatirna bhavet
kutaḥ ? ityatrāha--tadekatāpatteḥ tena upalambhakena nai katāpatteḥ teṣāmiti
atha svarūpamātraparyavasānāt na buddhasteṣāṃ boddhā; tatrāha— punarityādi
punaḥ ato doṣāt paścāt saṃvitterjñānasya buddhasya iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
svaśca paraśca tāveva santānau tayorvikalpaḥ kṣaṇakṣayādibhedaḥ sa eva tanmātraśabdena bahirarthābhāvamāha, tasyopadeśaḥ kathaṃ na kathañcit buddhasya
yo yanna paśyati na sa tadaviparītam upadiśati parebhyaḥ yathā rathyāpuruṣaḥ śāstrārtham, na paśyati ca buddhaḥ tadvikalpamātramiti kāraṇānupalabdhiḥ
tanna yuktam--atra bhagavāneva dharmādau pramāṇabhūtatvena sādhyate pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 1 iti bhāvaḥ
atra bhagavato hetuphalasampattyā pramāṇabhūtatvena stotrābhidhānaṃ śāstrādau śāstrārthatvāt, bhagavāneva hi pramāṇabhūto'smin prasādhyate
6 iti vacanāt svarūpabhāparvya vasiteṣu jñāneṣu na buddhetarapratibhāgo bhāvato'sti
tanmātropadeśaḥ punaḥ tato'nyasya vicāryamāṇasyā'yogāt iti; tatrāha--mithyetyādi
kākākṣagolakanyāyena kathaṃ śabda ubhayata saṃbadhyate tato buddhasyetarasya vā mithyāvikalpamantareṇa tadupadeśaḥ kathaṃ saṃbhavati nirvikalpena tadvicārāyogāt iti bhāvaḥ
astyeva tadvikalpa iti cet; atrāha— tanmithyetyādi
nanu ca vikalpānām ityukte'pi mithyātvaṃ labhyate tadrūpatvātteṣām tanmithyetivacanamanarthakamiti cet; ucyate--sugatasya kecidaliṅgajaṃ vikalpajñānamicchanti
antarbhāve vā tada tasyāpi savikalpaṃ pratyakṣaṃ syāt gṛhītagrahaṇāt
tat pramāṇaṃ na bhavati kathaṃ tadantaramiti cet; tasya nirvikalpavat savikalpasyāpi santānavṛttisaṃbhave tadgṛhītagrahaṇāt avikalpamapramāṇamastu tannadya tārtham ityasya pratipādakamiti
anekāntātmakatvaṃ bhrāntetarātmakatvam bhavatvevaṃ ko doṣa iti cet ? atrāha--katham ityādi
upalabhyaṃ madhyasvarūpaṃ yasya vastunaḥ tat kathaṃ na vartteta ? varttetaiva
evaṃ kramā'nekāntaṃ pratipādya skandhe'kramānekāntaṃ kathayannāha--dṛśya ityādi
yata evaṃ tattasmāt na bahirantarvā tattvaṃ pratipattumarhati
yathāyaṃ tathā bhavānapi tattvamanekāntaṃ na pratipattumarhati iti cet; atrāha--pratyakṣeṇāpi ityādi
nanu pratyakṣaṃ varttamānakṣaṇamātragrahaṇamanartha na pūrvāparakoṭivīkṣaṇapaddha tiprasaṅgāt
tathā tadatra arvāgbhāgadarśanaṃ magnaṃ na parabhāgādi vīkṣate ato na tattadekatvaṃ pratyeti
ata eva nānumānaṃ tattakvaryavad dṛśyetarātmakatvaṃ kasyacit pratipadyate iti cet; atrāha--paśyan ityādi
paśyan jīvaḥ sa evaikaḥ sattāmātraṃ vikalpayan
matiḥ smṛtiḥ saṃjñā cintābhinibodha ityanarthāntaramta॰ sū॰ 1
13 iti matyādīnāṃ tādātmyalakṣaṇaṃ sambandhamāha sū tra kā raḥ
jīva ātmā abhinibudhyate pūrvāparayoḥ abhi samantād ekatvaṃ jānāti
nanu jñānātmako' sau jñānānāṃ ca ekāntena bhedāt so'pi bhinna iti cet; atrāha--eka iti
anyathā ekatvābhāvaprakāreṇa yā jīva tarasyesya vā uktavidhinā anupapattiḥ tayā
sa yadi sattāmātreṇa abhinibudhyate sarvasya sarvadarśitvamiti cet; atrāha--paśyan sattāmātraṃ cetanetarasādhāraṇaṃ darśanena viṣayīkurvan
na ca sattāyāḥ paraṃ sāmānyam; yato'navasthā syāt
atha nikaṭe sāmānyagrahaṇamantareṇāpi viśeṣavyavasāyaḥ tato vyabhicāraḥ; na; tatrāvagrahādibhedasya sato'pyanupalakṣaṇāt

nanvevamapi sattāmātramastu grahaṇāt, na viśeṣo viparyayāt iti cet; atrāha--vikalpayan tadeva sattāsāmānyaṃ cetanetaratvādiviśeṣabhinnam avagrahādidhāraṇāparyantajñānena vikalpayan vyavasyan pūrvaṃ paścācca tathā smṛtvā pratyabhijñāya cintayan abhinibudhyate iti
idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam--upalabhyamadhyarūpasya pūrvāparakoṭyoḥ adṛśyātmānaṃ dṛśyārvāgbhāgasya parokṣaṃ parabhāgasya rasasparśādikam abhinibudhyate anuminoti
kārikāṃ vivṛṇvannātmanaḥ tatra kā re ṇaikavākyatāṃ darśayati--matirityādinā
anarthāntaraṃ padaṃ vyācaṣṭe--matyādīnāṃ tādātmyalakṣaṇaṃ kathaścidekatvasvarūpaṃ sambandhamāha anarthāntaram ityanena sū tra kā ro na paryāyapadatvam, pratītivirodhāditi

teṣu matyādiṣu anyatamasyāpi na kevalaṃ sarveṣām atādātmyaikānte bhedaikānte sati arthasya ghaṭādeḥ anumeyasya vā vahnyādeḥ pratipatteḥ adhyakṣabuddheḥ, sarvato vyāpṛtasya paramāṇumātrasya darśanābhāvāt, anupapatteḥ santānāntaravat
yathā santānāntaraṃ parasya adṛśyaṃ tathā paramāṇavaḥ sarvasya
tathāpi dṛśyatvakalpane santānāntare kaḥ pradveṣaḥ yataḥ tadanumeyatvaṃ tadabhāvaṃ vā'darśanāt kaścid ācakṣīta ? pratipatteḥ anumānabuddhervā anupapatteḥ santānāntare iva tadvad iti
yathaiva anyasya dhūmadarśanād aparasya tadadarśino'smaraṇāt, aparatatsmaraṇāt puruṣāntarasyā'pratyabhijñānāt, itarasya tarkābhāvāt na santānāntare anumānam, tathā prakṛte'pi

yadi punaḥ kutaścit pratyāsatteḥ ekasantāne, nānyatra, pūrvapūrvadarśanādeḥ uttarasmaraṇādivṛtteḥ ayamadoṣaḥ kalpyate; tanna; yataḥ tatrā hetuphalabhāvaniyame'pi upādānetarakāraṇavibhāgābhāvaprasaṅgāt
yaddhi yadrūpatayā pariṇamate tat tasya upādānam
nāpi tad rūpāntaraṃ santānakāraṇakāraṇam upādānakāraṇamiti cet; ko'yaṃ santāno nāma ? hetuphalapravāha iti cet; na; sugatetarayoḥ ekasantānatvaprasaṅgāt
sugataśced itarasya duṣṭā ; tatkāryatayā eva bhavitumarhati
sadṛśaḥ tatpravāhaḥ saḥ; ityapi nottaram; hetuphalāvasthayoḥ sugataikasantānāpatteḥ
yadā sugataḥ itarajanacittaṃ jānāti tadā itarajanacittaṃ sugatacittasya kāraṇaṃ bhavati, atastayoḥ ekasantānatāpattiḥ

atha upādānopādeyakṣaṇaprabandha iṣyate taccaitadeva bubhutsitam--bhedaikānte kimupādānam itaradvā iti ? yadi punaḥ ekasmin santāne pūrvam upādānaṃ param itarat; tarhi siddhe santāne sati upādānetarasiddhiḥ, tasyāḥ svasantānasiddhiḥ ityanyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ
atha yadvikāreṇa yad vikriyate tadupādānam itarad upādeyam; keyaṃ yadvikāreṇa yadvikriyā nāma ? śāstrādinā saṃskṛtacittāt tādṛśacittotpattiḥ; tato yogijñānā tayuṣaṃ tādṛśaṃ kinna bhavati yenaivam
kiṃ ca, śāstrādinā prathamasaṃskriyamāṇaṃ cittaṃ pūrvasmāt tadasaṃskṛtādeva tato jāyate iti na yuktam--yadvikāreṇa ityādi
tasyāpi tena saṃskāra ityapi nottaram; anavasthāprasaṅgāt
nanu suptasya svapnadarśino jāgradvijñānaṃ prabodharūpeṇāpariṇamamāṇamapi tadupādānam, ato vyabhicāraḥ; uktamatra paricchede
kutaśca tattasyopādānam ? tadrūpaprabodhadarśanāt; sugatajñānamapi tadrūpaṃ tvayā iṣyata eva tathā ca tajjñānamupādānam buddhajñānamupādeyam iti prasaktam
deśabhedānneti cet; anyatra suptasya anyatra prabodhe na syāt
atha suptasya śarīravat cittasyāpyatuṭyatsantānatayā deśāntaragamanamiṣyate; kālāntaragamanaparīṣyatām aviśeṣāt
evaṃ tāvat asiddhaḥ si ddha se na sya ityādinā mithyaikānte hetvabhāvaṃ pradarśya adhunā ekalakṣaṇavirahe sarvatra tadabhāvaṃ darśayannāha--ekalakṣaṇetyādi
anyathānupapattinirṇīto hetuḥ gamaka iti hetvābhāsā nirākṛtāḥ
ekalakṣaṇasāmarthyāt anyathānupapannatvamāhātmyād hetvābhāsāḥ hetupratirūpakā nivarttitāḥ hetusāmarthyāt pṛthakkṛtāḥ
viruddhādīnāṃ dvandvaṃ kṛttvā ādiśabdena bahuvrīhiḥ karttavyaḥ
anyathā sādhyābhāve niyamena yā anupapattiḥ tayā nirṇītaḥ padārtho hetuḥ gamakaḥ ityevaṃ sāmarthyād hetvābhāsā viruddhādayo nirākṛtā hetutvena
paraḥ pṛcchati katham iti ? sūrirāha--anyathaiva sādhyābhāvaprakāreṇaiva sādhyāntara eva upapattyā viruddhaḥ
tathā ca sādhyabhāvaprakāreṇa ca anyathā ca sādhyābhāvaprakāreṇa ca upapattyā anaikāntiko vyabhicārī
tadajñāne tasya hetoḥ sato'pi saṃśayādinā'jñāne anirṇaye punarajñātaḥ asiddhaḥ ityanuvarttate
yadi vā, tasya hetulakṣaṇasya pakṣe anyatra vā'jñāne punarajñāto'kiñcitkaraḥ
atrodāharaṇaṃ kim ? ityatrāha--tathaiva yathaiva asiddhaḥ siddhasenasya ityādau uktamudāharaṇaṃ pratipattavyam

nanu naikalakṣaṇavirahād viruddhādirnirākṛtaḥ kintu pakṣadharmatvādivirahāditi cet; atrāha--nahyekalakṣaṇābhāve trilakṣaṇaṃ trīṇi pakṣadharmatvādīni lakṣaṇāni yasya tattathoktaṃ vastu gamakaṃ liṅgam api tu tat tadbhāva eva

evaṃ manyate--yadi trilakṣaṇaṃ vyāptaṃ gamakatvaṃ tarhi syādetat tadabhāve na syāt iti, yāvataiva lakṣaṇavyāptaṃ tadabhāve eva na bhavet iti kiṃ trilakṣaṇena ? kiṃ tat trilakṣaṇaṃ liṅgamiti cet; atrāha--anupalabdhiḥ ityādi
kuta etat ? tadabhāve tadgamakam ityetat kuta iti paraḥ
paraḥ pṛcchati kathamiti kena prakāreṇa niścetumaśakyā iti ?
nahi upalambhapratyayāntarasākalyaṃ tadviraho vā svayamupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaṃ yataḥ tadanyo'nyābhāvarūpeṇa nirṇayaḥ syāt
dṛśyasya lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ prāptaṃ yakābhyāṃ te tathokte na bhavataḥ
dṛśyārthalakṣaṇe adṛśyārthalakṣaṇasya, tatra vā dṛśpravyathārtha lakṣaṇasyābhāvaḥ parasparabhāvaḥ tena svasvabhāvavyavasthitiḥ tallakṣaṇayorvyavasthiti hetutvāt
svena rūpeṇa vyavasthito nirṇītaḥ dṛśyo'tra lakṣaṇasya itaratra tasya ca prakṛta eva abhāvo na saṅkaravyatikarau ityarthaḥ
atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--yadā dṛśyārthalakṣaṇamavasitaṃ bhavati tadā lakṣaṇaprāptiḥ kvacidavagamyate, anupalambhācca tayā syā bhāvaḥ, na caivam iti
tacca ṭāde ravastutvabhayānnārthāntaram iti tasyāvabhāse avabhāsate ekasyārthasvabhāvasya pra॰ vā॰ 3
kathanna dṛśyalakṣaṇaṃ pratyayāntarāṇāṃ ghaṭādisahacāriṇāṃ sākalyaṃ namaskārā dīnāṃ na tebhyo vyatiricyata iti dṛśyalakṣaṇaparihāreṇa prāptatve tādṛśameva
so'pi paryudāsavṛttyā uktabhāvasvabhāva iti na yuktam na dṛśyalakṣaṇaprāpte ityādi
bhavatu vā dṛśyārthalakṣaṇaṃ na dṛśyārthalakṣaṇaprāptamaṃtyebhaḥ tathāpi tasya itaratra tādātmyaniṣedho na virudhyate iti
ko'nyo na dṛṣṭo bhāgaḥ syādyaḥ pramāṇaiḥ parīkṣyate
atra pratividhīyate--svabhāvaviśeṣaḥ pratyayāntarasākalyaṃ ca viṣayasya pratyayāntarāṇāṃ ca rūpādijñānakāryajananayogyatā
sā ca na dṛśyalakṣaṇaprāptā, kāraṇaśakteḥ asmādṛśāṃ nityaṃ kāryānumeyatvāt
anyathā kāraṇadarśino na kārye sandehaḥ iti na paralokānumānam arthavat
na ca tāvanmātrāpekṣaṃ tadvacanam, anyatrāpi tadaviśeṣāt
atha virodhāt dṛśyārthalakṣaṇe adṛśyārthalakṣaṇābhāvaḥ; tadapi na; dṛśyātmanāmeva pareṇa virodhopagamāt
yadi punaḥ kāryānumeyāyāṃ yogyatāyām itarābhāvasiddhiḥ prārthyate, tadapi prārthanamātramiti pratipādayiṣyate adṛśyasya ityādinā
paralokagāmino jīvasya pratyakṣatve tadyogyatāyā api sākṣātkaraṇaṃ yato jātam
tatra pakṣadvayam--upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptiḥ upalambhapratyayāntarasākalyaṃ svabhāvaviśeṣaśca darśanaviṣayatā vā

prathamapakṣe tatra upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptānupalabdhiḥ abhāvahetuḥ hetubi॰ pṛ॰ 64 iti granthe upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptiḥ upalabdheḥ buddheḥ lakṣaṇaṃ kārasmin sati sā lakṣyate tatprāptiḥ upalambhasya pratyayāntarāṇi ghaṭapratyayāpekṣayā indriyādīni teṣāṃ sākalyaṃ tajjananayogyadaśāprāptiḥ svabhāvaviśeṣaśca ghaṭasya svabhāvaviśeṣaḥ tatra yogyatā
na hi naiva upalambhapratyayāntarāṇāṃ sākalyam, upalakṣaṇametat tena svabhāvaviśeṣo'pi gṛhyate
kalpaṃ vā tadviraho vā svayamupalabdheḥ lakṣaṇaprāptaṃ yataḥ tatprāptatvāt tayoḥ sākalyavaikalyayoḥ anyo'nyābhāvarūpeṇa nirṇayaḥ syāt

atītasya vartamānasya pratipattṛpratyakṣasya nivṛttiryadi paryudāsātmikā; nāvṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapā bhaviṣyati dhūmo'nagnijanmā vetyajānan kathaṃ vyāptijñaḥ ? punastatrānumānaṃ kuryāt ? tannāyamekāntaḥ--upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptasyānupalabdhirabhāvasādhanīti
ca śabdād anupalabdheśca vyatireko na sidhyati sādhyābhāve sādhanābhāvo na sivyati
dṛśyasyā rthalakṣaṇayoḥ dṛśyalakṣaṇaprāptatvābhāve dṛśyārthalakṣaṇasya itaralakṣaṇavidhurasya anirṇayāt na dṛśyārthalakṣaṇaṃ kāraṇe kārye bhāve svabhāve vā sidhyati
tathā ca kāraṇa-bhāvayoḥ kvacinnivṛttyasiddheḥ kutaḥ tannivṛttipūrvikā kāryasvabhāvanivṛttiḥ iti manyate
mā bhūd vyatirekasiddhiḥ, anvayamātreṇa kāryādergamakatvamiti cet; atrāha--trikālaviṣayam ityādi
tā tparyamidamatra--vyatirekāsiddhāvanvayo'pi na sidhyati, pareṇa parasparam avinābhāvopagamādanayoḥ
tathā ca tannibandhanatādātmyādi pratibandho'pi na sidhyati
kevalam asya sādhyasādhanayoranavayaveda darśanaṃ pratibandhasādhakam, tacca nāstīti
tataḥ kim ? ityāha--tataḥ tasmād uktanyāyād aikāntikam avyabhicāritvaṃ kāryādīnāṃ madhye na kasyacid hetoḥ syāt
evaṃ parasya upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptyabhāvaṃ tasmiṃśca sati dūṣaṇaṃ yat tadapi pratipādya, idānīm anupalabdhiṃ vyatirekaprasādhikāṃ dūṣayituṃ pṛcchati--nivṛttiḥ paryudāsātmi kā yadi
kasya nivṛttiḥ ? ityāha--pratitva pratyakṣasya yo vṛkṣasyābhāve śiṃśapātvasya vahnerabhāve dhūma tvasya abhāvaṃ pratipadyate tatpratyakṣasya na puruṣaviśeṣapratyakṣasya
śiṃśapā na bhaviṣyati itevamajānaṃ avṛkṣo vṛkṣo yo na tathā dhūmo na bhaviṣyatītyevamajānan
kiṃbhūtaḥ ? anagnijanmā na vidyate agnerjanma yasyeti
kathaṃ vyāptijñe na kathañcit saugataḥ, vyāptijñatvasya sākalyena anvayavyatirekajñātārūpatvāt
punaḥ paścāt tatra vṛkṣe agnau vā anumānaṃ kuryāt kathamati sambandhaḥ
upalakṣaṇametat, tena tadviparītasya vā anupalabdheḥ abhāvasādhanīti nāyamekāntaḥ
bhāvino'dṛśyasya kālādeḥ, adṛśyena śiṃśapātvādinā vṛkṣatvādyabhāvena prasādhanāt iti bhāvaḥ

nanvetat he tu bi ndau coditaṃ prarahṛta na deśāntarādau kāraṇāderabhāvena kāryādyabhāvaḥ sādhyate kintu tatra tadabhāva346 syā'nirṇayāt, kevalaṃ vṛkṣābhavaścat na śiṃśapayā bhavitavyam, niḥsvabhāvatāpatteḥ, agnerabhāve na dhūmena nirhetukatvaṃ syāditi prasaṅgasādhanamucyate iti cet; uktamatra anvayavyatirekā'nirṇaye pratibandhā'nirṇayānnaivamiti
kathaṃ ca śiṃśapā vṛkṣasvabhāvā yena tadabhāve na syāt ? tathā darśanāt; yadi sarvatra; pratipattuḥ sarvajñatvam
kvaciccet; anityasya prayatnānantarīyakasvabhāvatā ghaṭādau tathā darśanāt
atha vanakusumādau anyathāpi darśanāt tasya na tatsvabhāvatā; śiṃśapā vṛkṣābhāve na bhaviṣyati iti tathaiva na pramāṇam
tadabhāve abhāvāt tasyāḥ tatsvabhāvatā; anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ--siddhe tatsvabhāve tadabhā vāttasyā abhāvaḥ sidhyati, tataḥ tatsvabhāvatā iti na kiñcidetat

yadi kāraṇāvyāpakau tadanyabhāvasiddhyā anupalabdhyā siddhasadvyavahārau anyasyābhāvamabhāvavyavahāraṃ ca sādhayataḥ, sā ca tayorupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptāvevāsadvyavahārasya sādhiketi kathaṃ tayoḥ kāraṇavyāpakānupalabdhyoḥ parokṣe'rthe prayogaḥ ? naiva prayogaḥ pramāṇatayā liṅgasyāniścayāt
kevalaṃ kāraṇavyāpakayorhi siddhasambandhayoryadyabhāvaḥ parasyāpyavaśyaṃ niyamenābhāva ityetasya darśanārthamete kvacit prayujyete iti

kāraṇavyāpakayorhi kāryakāraṇabhāvaprasādhakena pūrvoktena pramāṇena vyāpyavyāpakabhāvasādhakena ca tadutpattilakṣaṇe tādātmyalakṣaṇe ca sambandhe sādhite siddhasambandhayoryadyabhāvaḥ yatra yatra abhāvaḥ syāt parasyāpi kāryasya vyāpyasya vā avaśyaṃ niyamenābhāvaḥ, anyathā ahetukatvaprasaṅgācca...

nanu bhavatu dṛśyādṛśyārthalakṣaṇe na dṛśyalakṣaṇaprāpte iti, tathāpi cakṣurunmīlanādisannidhau rūpādijñānakāryadarśanāt kvacid dṛśyārthalakṣaṇe viviktaṃ pratīyate, tadadarśanādadṛśyārthalakṣaṇam itaraviviktamiti cet; atrāha--adṛśyasyetyādi
yathaiva darśanābhāvakāraṇāsaṃbhave dṛśyābhāvo'nupalabdheḥ sidhyati tathaiva anumānābhāvakāraṇāsaṃbhave anumeyasya paracittādeḥ bhavatyabhāvasiddhiḥ anyathā niścetanaparaśarīrapratipatteranupapatteḥ
tadayaṃ bhūtacaitanyavādinamapi dhārṣṭyādvijayate sarvathā anumānocchedaprasaṅgāt, dṛṣṭārthāpalāpāt kvacid vyavasthityabhāvāt parapakṣākṣepamātrāgrahāt svapakṣapratikṣepācca
yadi punarayaṃ nirbandhaḥ viprakarṣiṇāmabhāvāsiddhestadā kṛtakatvadhūmādervināśānalābhyāṃ vyāpterasiddherna kaścid hetuḥ
kim ? ityāha--kathaṃ nā'bhāvaḥ pratīyate ? pratīyata eva
anumāyā abhāvo'sattvaṃ tasya kāraṇam anumātrādyabhāvaḥ tasyāsaṃbhave tadasadbhāve sati
syānmatam--yadi sarvadā sādhyamadṛśyaṃ kathaṃ tatra kiñcit pratibaddhaṃ sidhyati ? kiṃca, na kāryādyabhāvena niyameyā bhāvaḥ, anyathā dhūmaśiṃśapayorabhāvo agnivṛkṣayoḥ tathābhāvaḥ syāt
na caivamiti cet; atrāha--dṛśyasya anupalambhavad iti
dṛśyasya dṛśyārthalakṣaṇopetasya, upalabhyate iti upalambhaḥ dṛśya ityarthaḥ, upalabhyate'nena iti vā, na upalambho'nupalambhaḥ tena iva tadvat iti
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā darśanābhāvakāraṇāsaṃbhave draṣṭā disaṃbhave darśanābhāvena dṛśyalakṣaṇaprāptasyāpi, dṛśyalakṣaṇe'bhāva upalambhasya, adṛśye'bhāvo grāhya tathā prakṛtasyāpīti
yatpunaruktam--adṛśye kathaṃ kasyacit pratibandhaḥ iti; tadayuktam; dṛśyalakṣaṇaśakteradṛśyatve kathaṃ tatra darśanapratibandha iti cintyam
yaccānyat--na dhūmābhāvāt dhūmadhvajābhāva iti; tadapi suparihāram; yataḥ darśanasya ghaṭādikāryasyābhāve kathaṃ kvacid ghaṭābhāvasiddhiḥ ? śakyaṃ hi vaktum--nāvaśyaṃ kāraṇāni kāryavanti bhavanti iti
apratibaddhasāmarthyasya bhavatyeva tatsiddhiḥ ityapi nottaram; sāmarthyasya adṛśyatvāt pratibaddhasāmarthyetaravibhāgānavadhāraṇāt
na ca kāraṇānyavaśyaṃ kāryavanti bhavanti--nyāyabi॰ ṭī॰ 2
kiṃ ca, pratibaddhasāmarthyasya samarthyasya sato'pi sarvasya sarvatrā'bhāvā'viniścayād bhāvaśaṅkayā na kenacit pravartitavyaṃ nivartitavyaṃ vā kutaścid ityetadāpatitam
darśanasyā'bhāvo'nutpattiḥ tasya kāraṇaṃ pratyayāntaravaikalyaṃ tasyāsaṃbhave pratyayāntarasākalya ityarthaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--pratyayāntarasākalye'pi yadā bhūtalaghaṭe darśanaṃ notpadyate tadā tadabhāvaḥ pratīyate dṛśyā bhā siddhimupadarśya darśanakāraṇasaṃbhavamupadarśayatā tadevāṅgīkṛtam iti
anumānābhāvasya kāraṇam anumātṛpakṣadṛṣṭāntādīnāmabhāvaḥ, tasyāsaṃbhave teṣāṃ saṃbhavaḥ ityarthaḥ
kutastatsaṃbhave tasya bhavatyabhāvasiddhiḥ iti cet ? atra hetuḥ anupalabdheḥ ityanuvarttanīyaḥ anumānopalabdherabhāvāt
nanvanumānam anumeyakāryam; ato'syābhāve kathaṃ tadabhāva iti cet ? atrāha--anyathā ityādi
anyathā anyena anupalabdhiḥ tatsaṃbhave tadabhāvāsiddhiprakāreṇa niścetanaparaśarīrapratipatteranupapatteḥ bhavatyabhāvasiddhiḥ anumeyasya iti

syānmatam--cetanākāryasya vyāpārādhyā hārādeḥ adarśanāt paravapuṣi cetanāvirahasiddhiḥ, na ca kāryābhāvāt kāraṇābhāva, pratibaddhasāmarthyasya kāraṇāntaravaikalyasya vā śaṅkā'nivṛtteḥ, tato niścetanaparaśarīrapratipatteranupapatteḥ iti siddhaṃ sādhyata iti cet; atrāha--tadayam ityādi
so'yaṃ saugato bhūtacaitanyavādinaṃ yat kālatraye'pi nābhūtaṃ tadbhūtam, tadā satvai tadvādinaṃ sāṃkhya dhārṣṭāna vijayate
yathā asau sarvaṃ sarvatrādṛṣṭamabhyugapacchati tathāyamapi paraśarīre pratibaddhasāmarthyacaitanyavat svajñāne pratibaddhasāmarthyasya sarvatra sarvasya bhāvopagamāt
yadi vā, bhūtānyeva caitanyaṃ tadvādinamapi iti grāhyam
yathā, tena bhūteṣu anudbhūtamapi caitanyamiṣyate tathā'nena sarvaṃ sarvatra iti
nanu saugatasya anumānamasti na tasya tatkathaṃ dhārṣṭyenaiva vijayate iti cet ? atrāha--anumānocchedaprasaṅgāt
pāvakāderdhūmādi jāyate vṛkṣādisvabhāvaḥ śiṃśapādiriti dṛṣṭo'rthaḥ, saugatena tasyāpi na kevalam anyasya īśvarādeḥ apalāpāt
yathaiva hi mutatra śarīre adṛṣṭakāryasvabhāvamapi caitanyaṃ saditi śaṅkyate apratibaddhasāmarthyasyaiva kāraṇasya kāryābhāvo'bhāvaṃ gamayati
iti vacanāt, tathaiva agnivṛkṣādeḥ pūrvaṃ paścādvā adṛṣṭajñānakāryadhūmaśiṃśapādisattā śaṅkyata iti na pratibandhasiddhiriti manyate
jīvaccharīre ātmanaḥ ghaṭādau tasmād ātmanivṛttau prāṇinivṛttiḥ iti parasya jainādeḥ pakṣaḥ tasyākṣepo nirāsaḥ
tathāhi— parātmanaḥ pūrvāparasvabhāvānugatacetanālakṣaṇasya na ghaṭādau dṛśyatārahitasya pratyakṣeṇā'nupalambhādabhāvaḥ, atiprasaṅgāt
nāpi kāryādarśanāt mṛtaśarīravad atastatra tadabhāvasiddhiḥ, na tata ātmanivṛttipūrvikā prāṇādinivṛttiḥ
sa eva tanmātraṃ tatrābhiniveśād āgrahāt svapakṣapratikṣepād agninivṛttau kuḍyādeḥ dhūmanivṛttiḥ kāryahetoḥ vipakṣād vyatirekaḥ iti sva ātmīyaḥ saugatasya yastasya pratikṣepaḥ pratihatiḥ
tadyathā mṛtābhimataśarīre pratibaddhasāmarthyaṃ svakāryamakurvadapi caitanyaṃ ghaṭādau vā yathā saṃbhāvyate tathā kuḍyādau agniḥ saṃbhāvyate iti nāgninivṛttipūrvikā tato dhūmanivṛttiḥ iti tasmāt
tulanā--kāraṇāni ca nāvaśyaṃ kāryavanti bhavantīti kāryādarśanādapratibaddhasāmarthyānāmevābhāvaḥ sādhyaḥ natvanyeṣām
evaṃbhūtā dhūmaśiṃśapādayaḥ, ye svaviṣayakaṃ jñānamapi notpādayanti
ācāryīyamabhiprāyamajānan paraḥ pṛcchati katham iti ? taṃ prati uttaram adṛśya ityādi

svalakṣaṇaṃ parasparaviviktakṣaṇikaparamāṇulakṣaṇaṃ svarūpaṃ pararūpaṃ vā sajātīya vijātīyavyāvṛttaṃ svasva bhāvavyavasthiteḥ paśyataḥ katham anupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaniraṃśārthasvabhāvāsiddhau tadvyāvṛttasya bhāvasya darśanam ? tadabhāve sākalyena dṛśyādṛśyasvabhāvavivekasiddheratinidrāyitaṃ jagat syāt
na ca na dṛśyalakṣaṇaprāpte ityādinā uktametaditi cet; upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptiḥ pratyayāntarasākalyaṃ svabhāvaviśeṣaśca ityatra taduktam, idaṃ tu darśanaviṣayatā tallakṣaṇaprāptiḥ ityatra ucyate
kim ? ityāha--piśāco nāhamasmi na bhavāmi iti
upalakṣaṇametat, tena cetano'cetano na bhavati, acetanaścetano na bhavati iti na ca lakṣayet
kiṃbhūtaḥ ? ityāha--dṛśyā'dṛśyayorna vidyate viveke bhede dhīryasya sa tathoktaḥ, guḍagorasakārī iti yāvat
svalakṣaṇaṃ paraspara vikrikṣaṇi paramāṇulakṣaṇam svarūpam ātmasvabhāvaṃ pararūpam arthasvabhāvaṃ vā
kathaṃ na kathañcit tadvivṛttasya sajātīyavijātīyāvyāvṛttasya svabhāvasya darśanam
anupalabdhilakṣaṇaṃ prāpto darśanāgocaro niraṃśo yo arthastasya svabhāvāsiddhau satyām
tanna yuktam-- sarva bhāvāḥ pra॰ vā॰ 3
na sa śakyastato'nyena tena bhinnā vyavasthitiḥ

mābhūt taddarśanaṃ ko doṣa iti cet; atrāha--tadabhāve taddarśanābhāve sākalyena anavayavena dṛśyādṛśyasvabhāvavivekā'siddheḥ sukhādinīlādayo dṛśyasvabhāva īśvarādayo'dṛśyasvabhāvā iti yo viveko vibhāgaḥ tasya asiddheḥ kāraṇāt atinidrāyitaṃ jagat syāt
syānmatam--na kvacit mayā paramāṇava iṣyante yathāvyāhāraṃ tattvopagamāt tenāyamadoṣa iti; tatrāha--pratyakṣam ityādi
yathaikaṃ paśyan tadarthāntarasvabhāvābhāvaṃ niyamena paśyati tathā upalabdhi lakṣaṇaprāptasya anyathā asaṅkīrṇasvabhāvopalabdheranupapatteḥ
dadhyādau na pravartteta bauddhaḥ tadbhuktaye janaḥ
dadhyādike tathā bhukte na bhuktaṃ kāñjikādikam
ityasau vettu no vetti na bhuktā saugatī tanuḥ || iti
vyādhibhūtagrahendriyādīnāmekānte nivāryamāṇe pravṛttinivṛttyoḥ kutaḥ siddhiryataḥ pratyayāntarasākalyaṃ vaikalyamanyadvā pravarteta mantrauṣadhādiśakteśca dṛśya lakṣaṇānupapatteḥ
pratyakṣaṃ karttṛ viśvato viśvamāśritya yad vyavasthitam
tat kiṃ kuryāt ? ityatrāha— svalakṣaṇaṃ paśyan
kiṃbhūtam ? anyataḥ sajātīyavijātīyād vyāvṛttaṃ cet yadi; katham adṛśyā'rthasvabhāvābhāvadṛg na tat adṛśyārthasvabhāvasya abhāvadṛg kathaṃ na ? bhavatyeva
anyathā anyato vyāvṛttaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ tat kathaṃ paśyet
yathā yena vyāri janānurodhaprakāreṇa ekaṃ bhūtalādi paśyan saugataḥ upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptāt tadarthāntarasvabhāvābhāvaṃ paśyati niyamena avaśyaṃbhāvena tathā tena prakāreṇa
na hyasau davyādikaṃ svalakṣaṇaprāpto rajñādete revābhāvaṃ paśyati na punaradṛśya vo visattva samūhasya
dadhyādau na pravartteta bauddhaḥ tadbhuktaye janaḥ
dadhyādike tathā bhukte na bhuktaṃ kāñjikādikam
ityasau vettu no vetti na bhuktā saugatī tanuḥ || iti
vyādhibhūtagrahendriyādīnām ekānte'smin vivāryamāṇe pravṛttinivṛttyoḥ sadbhāvā'sadbhāvayoḥ kutaḥ siddhiḥ ? na kutaścit, yataḥ siddheḥ pratyayāntarāṇāṃ sākalyaṃ vaikalyam anyadvā pratipadyeta
punarapi tadantaramāha--mantrauṣadhādiśakteśca pravṛttinivṛttyoḥ kutaḥ siddhiḥ ityādinā sambandhaḥ
nāyaṃ doṣaḥ tasyāḥ dṛśyatvāt iti cet; atrāha--dṛśyetyādi
na cāyam ekāntaḥ dṛśyasya ātmaśaktiḥ dṛśyaiva iti, kṣaṇabhaṅgena vyabhicāritatvāt ityalamatiprasaṅgena dūṣaṇaparamparāyā
nanu vyavahāre adṛśyānupalabdhiḥ saṃśayahetuḥ uktā, tatra cāyaṃ doṣo'stu na punaḥ pratibhāsādvaite, tatra adṛśyasyāpi paraciṃtāderniṣedhāditi cet; atrāha--svabhāva ityādi
saṃvidāṃ tattvamanaṃśamadṛśyaṃ kathamasti ? kathaṃ ca na ? svabhāva viprakarṣāt
idamatra tātparyam--niraṃśaikaparamāṇurūpaṃ tat saṃvedanaṃ citram, ekaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe sattvāntaravadanupalabdheḥ tadabhāva iti kṣaṇikatvaṃ kutaḥ siddham ? na kutaścit
saṃvidāṃ tattvaṃ svarūpam anaṃśamadṛśyamanupalabhyam ato na asti iti manyate
kathaṃ ca na iti parasya praśnaḥ
ata eva svabhāvaviprakarṣādeva svaparabhāvābhyāṃ vyāvṛttirna sidhyet
nanu mithyāgrāhyākāradarśanāt tadastītyanumīyate tatkathamuktaṃ nāsti iti cet ? atrāha--kuto bahirarthopalabdhiḥ apratyakṣopalabdheḥ sakāśāt apratyakṣopalabdheḥ saṃbhāvyeta saṃvidāṃ tattvam iti
dūṣaṇāntaramāha--na ca naiva sattānupamānamitaṃ bauddhaiḥ sattāyāṃ hi sādhyāyāṃ sarvo hetuḥ trayīṃ hoṣyairjagatāṃ nāpi va rttase pra॰ vā॰ svavṛ॰ 1
193 iti vacanāt yuktaṃ vā na ca sattānumānam iti hetorabhāvāditi bhāvaḥ
atrāpi yataḥ sattānupamā nāt saṃbhāvyeta iti vyākhyeyam
sattāsādhye bhāvadharmo heturasiddhaḥ, abhāvadharmo viruddhaḥ, ubhayadharmaśca anaikāntika iti
kutaḥ kā kva ca bhāvaḥ syātkvābhāvavyavahārakṛt || 39
bahirantarvā saṃśayasyāpi siddherayogāt kiṃ kena vyavasthāpyeta ? tadayaṃ bhūtacatuṣṭayavādinaḥ pāpīyān
ekānte kvacid dṛśyasvabhāva upalabhyasvabhāvo naiva antarbahiḥ
kutaḥ kiṃ jātam ? ityāha--kutaḥ pramāṇāt, kā upalabdhiḥ, kva bhāvaḥ sattā upalabdhinibandhanatvāttasyāḥ
tadabhāve'bhāvāditi kva abhāvavyavahārakṛt saugataḥ, tadvyavahāranibandhanasya anyopalambhasyā'bhāvāt
saṃśayastarhi syāditi cet; atrāha--saṃśayasyāpi na kevalamanyasya siddheḥ pratipatterayogāt, tasyāpi jñānatvāt niraṃśatvena anyasamānatvāt
astu sakalaśūnyatvaṃ tadapi bauddhābhimatameveti cet; atrāha--kiṃ śūnyatve kena pramāṇena vyavasthāpyeta na kiñcit kenacit
yata evaṃ tat tasmādayaṃ saugataḥ bhūtacatuṣṭayavādinaḥ pāpīyān tena pratyakṣapratītasya ātmana eva niṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ anena sarvasya iti manyate
mā bhūt sakalapratibhāsavaikalyamātramapramāṇakaṃ śūnyatvam, api tu pratibhāsa eva ekānekatvādidharmaśūnyaḥ tathaiva ca sāṃvṛtaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ iti pra jñā ka raḥ; tatrāha— pratyakṣatvam ityādi
pratyakṣānumānayoḥ sākalyena avastuviṣayatvāt, kāryasvabhāvahetvoravasturūpatvāt kutastataḥ kiñcit sidhyet
na caitat niraṃśaṃ tattvaṃ sāṃvyavahārikaṃ pramāṇaṃ pratipattuṃ yuktaṃ pratītiviparyāsāt, tadekānte'nupapatteḥ
pratyakṣatvaṃ tadviṣayatvaṃ vā'bhāvānāṃ vanyā sutādīnāṃ kāryakāraṇatā hetuphalabhāvaḥ ityapi teṣāmeva prasajyeta na vastūnām
kutaḥ ? ityāha--niraṃśasya tattvasya sarvavikalpātītasaṃvedanasya anyasya vā anupalambhanāt
pratyakṣasya vacanavadavastusthūlākāraviṣayatvāt, anumānasya tathāvidhasāmānyagocaratvāt, sākalyena anavayavena
nanvanumānasya avastuviṣayatve'pi vastusādhanatvaṃ tatra pratibandhāditi cet; atrāha— kārya ityādi
etaduktatvaṃ bhavati--yadi kāryasvabhāvayoḥ paramārthataḥ tattvam; tarhi tayoḥ sādhye pratibandhāt tajjāti tasyānumānasyāpi saṃbhavet
na caivam iti kutaḥ kāraṇāt tataḥ tābhyāṃ kāryasvabhāvahetubhyāṃ kiñcit parābhimataṃ sidhyet na kutaścit
