atha vyavahāriṇā abhyāsānabhyāsayoḥ yathā tābhyāmeva tidveṣa yābhyāṃ bhāvivastusiddhiḥ upāyāntarābhāvāt tathā mamāpi niraṃśatvasiddhiḥ iti; tatrāha--na caitad ityādi
na ca naiva iti niraṃśaṃ tattvaṃ karttṛ pratipattum āśrayituṃ yuktaṃ śaktam
yathā pūrvaṃ paścācca sāṃvyavahāriko pratīti-tadviparyāsena tattvopagamāt, pratītyanusāreṇa ca tadvyavasthā; tarhi niraṃśasya anupalabdheḥ upalabhyamānasya ca vicārāsahatvāt ceti
vibhramā'siddheḥ iti cet; atrottaram-antarvṛttena tādātmya ityādinā darśayati
guṇīti guṇasamudāyaḥ ekāntaḥ kva nu saṃbhavet
tādātmyaṃ sādhyasādhanayoḥ dṛśya-prāpyayoḥ kathañcidekatvamādiryasya hetuphalabhāvaikatvānekatvādināḥ tattathoktaṃ pratīmaḥ
ke ? ityāha--ekalakṣaṇavido vayaṃ jaināḥ kasmāt ? ityāha--tarkāt vicārāt
nanu pūrvaparyāyaparyavasitajñānānantaraparyāyavṛttimat tat kathaṃ tādātmyādikaṃ pratīmaḥ ityucyate iti cet; atrāha--sahetyādi
sahavidāṃ rūparasādiguṇagrahaṇānām kramavidāṃ mṛtpiṇḍaśivakachatrakādiparyāyagrahaṇānām ekamabhinnaṃ svasaṃvedanaṃ svam ātmā'yam saṃvedanaṃ ātmāparanāmakaṃ tarkāt pratīmo yataḥ iti
yathaiva saṃvedanaṃ tataḥ pratīmaḥ iti tathā sambandhāt saṃyogāt
keṣām ? samudāyinām avayavāsahatāṃ hastapādādīnāṃ yaḥ samudāyi śarīravyapadeśabhāk so'pi tattvamekatvaṃ pratīyate iti vibhaktivacanapariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
yathā paramāṇusanniveśamātraṃ tathaiva guṇānāṃ rūpādīnāṃ samudāyaḥ tattvaṃ pratīyate
iti hetoḥ ekāntaḥ kva nu saṃbhavet ? na kvacit
yad yasmād ekāntasaṃbhavād idaṃ pratīyamānaṃ svalakṣyātmalakṣaṇam anekāntarūpatvamu llaṅghyamaparaiḥ jainaiḥ
iti si ddhi vi ni śca ya ṭī kā yām a na nta vī rya viracitāyāṃ hetulakṣaṇasiddhiḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ prastāvaḥ
pratyakṣādivat śabdo'pi arthaprasādhakaḥ, tatra ca avipratipatteḥ tadvyutpādanārthamāha— śāstram ityādi
śāstraṃ mahadarvā ntaravākyātmakaṃ vacanam, kevalasya varṇasya padasya ca vyavahārānupayogāt
tat kim ? upādeyam āśrayapraṇīyaṃ pramāṇīkaṃ karttavyam ityarthaḥ
karttari tā kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti pāṇini॰ sū॰ 2
śakyaṃ parīkṣaṇaṃ yasmin liṅgādau na kevalam atyantaparokṣa eva viṣaye
syāt iti karaṇam uccāraṇaṃ yasya tat syātkāraṃ tacca tatra śrutaṃ ca śabdaḥ tadeva satyam avitathaṃ lāñchanaṃ yasya tattathoktam
kutaḥ ? ityāha--satāṃ vidyamānānāṃ jīvādīnāṃ śāsanaṃ pratipādakam
athavā satām arhatāṃ jñāpakam tatkāryatvena yataḥ
itthambhūtatvamasya sandigdhamiti cet ? atrāha--kālakovidārekā saṃśītiḥ atra satāṃ śāsane
kṛdyoge kartari karmaṇi ca ṣaṣṭhī syāt--si॰ kau 2
nanvatraikāntavādiprayuktā doṣāḥ santi tatkathamupādeyamiti cet ? atrāha--ekāntetyādi
viṣayiṇyekāntavādini viṣayasya ekāntasya upacārāt ekāntadhāccyaiḥ tadvādivyāmohaiḥ alaṃ paryāptamātreti sambandhaḥ, taddoṣāṇāṃ nirākaraṇāditi manyate
mithyaikāntakalaṅkita visaṃvādaka buddhīkṣya jñātvā śāstram ityādi atrāpi sambadhyate
kaiḥ ? ityatrāha--tarkāgamaiḥ, tarkeṇa tasyaiva dṛṣṭe'pi yuktetaravivaraṇāt nyāyārād āgamaiśca taravākyaiḥ iti
nanu sāṃvyavahārikapratyakṣānumānābhyāmeva sakalārthasiddheḥ kimarthaṃśāstramupādeyamiti cet ? atrāha--śrutam ityādi

karaṇaṃ puruṣasya aikāntikātyantikānādiduḥkhanivṛtterupāyatayā guṇapuruṣāntarabhedatattvaṃ yathā yathā śṛṇoti gṛhṇāti saṃdhārayati vijānāti vitarkayati abhiniviśate tathā tathā cetano'pariṇāmī puruṣaḥ etaddarśitaṃ nirvedaṃ paśyan kaivalyamanubhavan mokṣamupaiti
na cāryapuruṣaḥ autsukyanivṛtteḥ vaśyati iti kecit

tadupāyopeyatattvamamṛṣyanto naiyāyikāḥ kathaṃ cidvṛttiḥ acetanasya karaṇasya atiprasaṅgāt ? kathaṃ vā'cetanasyopalabdhiḥ ? kathaṃ karaṇamanyakaraṇaṃ vinā paśyet ? kathaṃ cetanasyāpyakartturupalabdhiḥ ? dṛśyadarśanasvabhāvayoḥ vyāpakayoḥ vā tadavasthayoḥ kathaṃ vā saṃyogaḥ ? iti ātmāditattvajñānāt mithyājñānanivṛttau doṣānutpatteḥ pravṛttyasaṃbhavāt janmanivṛttau aśeṣaguṇarahitasyātmanaḥ svātmanyavasthānaṃ mokṣamāhuḥ naiyāyikāḥ

so'yamātmātmīyagrahaḥ saṃsārahetutaḥ ayoniśo manaskāro yataḥ kathaṃ mokṣāya ? nityasya vastutvameva na saṃbhāvyam iti catuḥsatyabhāvanopāyaṃ sakalasantānocchedarūpaṃ nirvāṇaṃ bruvāṇāḥ saugatāḥ pratyavasthāpyeran
kathaṃ catuḥsatyapratipādakavacanajanitamithyājñānasya arthāviṣayatvāt tataḥ tattvapratipattiḥ ? kathamatattvabhāvanāprakarṣaparyantajaṃ tattvajñānaṃ nirvāṇaṃ ca

nairātmyetarapakṣayoḥ mithyaikāntāviśeṣe asti vā kaścidviśeṣaḥ ? pratyakṣahetutadābhāsavikalpasambandhabhāvābhāvayośca, mithyāviṣayatāviśeṣāt, yathālakṣaṇaṃ svalakṣaṇavilakṣaṇajātyantara lakṣaṇāt kutastattvapratipattiḥ ? sādhanavacanasyāpi tattvānabhidhānopagamāt, tataḥ kīdṛśī sugatasya tattvadeśanā ?
itthamekāntamatyantataḥ tāpatrayasyābhāvāt uparamādanutpatteḥ kaivalyaṃ mokṣa ityarthaḥ, tamāpnoti
yathāha--imesaṃ kho bhikkhave catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ abhisambuddhatto tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddhotti vuccatīti saṃ॰ 5
ata eva tāni satyatayā manyanta iti teṣāṃ satyāni
ta eva hetubhūtāstṛṣṇāsahāyāḥ samudayākhyaṃ satyaṃ dvitīyam
śreyo mokṣaḥ tasya panthā mārgaḥ, tanmārgasya samyagdarśanādeḥ upadeśāt śreyaḥpathaḥ
keṣām ? ityāha--puṃsām ātmanāṃ na kṣaṇikacittasantatīnāṃ tadabhāvāt

jñānād ekāntena bhinnānāṃ syāditi cet; atrāha--boddhṛṇām svaparasvabhāvavedakānām anyeṣāṃ sadapi śrutamanupayogi, ghaṭādīnāmiva tasya śravaṇe arthāvadhāraṇe tadanuṣṭhāne tatphale mokṣe ca sati na teṣāṃ tadupayogi
na ca jñānāt bhinnātmanāṃ tadasti gaganādīnāmevaditinātmta kalpanaṃ phalavat
athātmanāṃ jñānaṃ bandho na gaganādīnāṃ tato'yamadoṣaḥ; kathamadoṣo yataḥ samavāyasambandhaniṣedhāt, sato'pi sarvatrā'viśeṣāt
na ca bhinnasya ātmano darśane iha jñānam ātmani iti pratyayo'sti yena samavāyo'tra syāt, anyathā kharaśṛṅge jñānam ityapi syāt

atha jñānaṃ dravyāśritaṃ guṇatvād rūpādivat, guṇatadvatośca bhedaḥ anyathā tadayogāditi matiḥ; sāpi na yuktā; va tataḥ sāpi jñānādirūpādibhyo bhinnasya ādhārasya darśane satyeva syāt, na ca tadasti ityuktaṃ purastāt
tathāpi taddarśanakalpane tato'pyanyasya tadādhārasya tato'pyanyasya tadādhārasya darśanakalpanamityanavasthā syāt

tarhi nānādi rūpādimātramāpannamiti nātma nāpi ghaṭādiskandha iti śākyaśāsanaṃ samastamiti cet; na; pūrvāparībhūtaikajñānasya ātmatvaprasāvanā tatha rūpādiviśeṣāṇāṃ kathañcidekatvamupagatānāṃ ghaṭādiskandhasthāpanāt
tathāvidhajñānasya aparadravyāśritatvasādhane tapakṣa sādhana hetuśca asiddhaḥ, tasya guṇatvā'siddheḥ dravyāśraya guṇavān saṃyogavibhāgeṣvakāraṇam anapekṣaḥ guṇaḥ vaiśe॰ sū॰ 1
na cāsya dravyāśrayitvam; pūrvāparajñānabhedena vā'sya sambandhāt dravyaguṇayoraviśeṣaḥ
atha pūrvottarasvabhāvayoḥ guṇatvaṃ tadāśritatvaṃ ca ucyate; atra parihāraḥ--
jñānādbhinnastathā na syādātmā sta thā matiḥ
evamapi caitanye puruṣasya svaṃ rūpamapiti yogabhā॰ 1
9 iti vacanāt sāṃkhyapuruṣāṇāṃ tatsyāt iti cet atrāha--pariṇāminām iti
nanu sāṅkhyasya puruṣa istāro voddha punaḥ pradhānaṃ bodhapariṇāmāt, tatkathamevamāśaṅkitamiti cet ? na; bodhadarśanayoravyatirekāt
syānmatam--nityaṃ śrutaṃ teṣāṃ śreyaḥpathopāyaṃ syāditi cet; atrāha--sopāyopeyatattvārtham iti
upāyo hetuḥ saṃsārasya mithyātvādiḥ mokṣasya samyagdarśanādiḥ upeyaṃ phalaṃ saṃsāro mokṣaśca, saha upāyena varttata iti sopāyam tacca tad upeyaṃ ca tadeva tattvam artho viṣayo yasya tattathoktam
na ca nityaṃ vedaśrutam evaṃvidhimiti nivedayiṣyate
pi ṭaka tra yākhyaṃ teṣāṃ tatpatha iti cet; atrāha--na vaktrākūtasṭava nam iti
sāṃkhya naiyāyikena naiyāyikaṃ saugatena taṃ ca svayaṃ nirākurvan, vyātirekamukhena kārikāṃ vyācaṣṭe--karaṇam ityādinā

tatra sāṃkhyamataṃ tāvaddarśayati--karaṇaṃ śrotrādi yathā yathā śṛṇoti gṛhṇāti śrutaṃ śāstrārthamavagacchati saṃdhārayati kālāntarasmaraṇadhāraṇaviṣayatāṃ nayati vijānāti tadarthapariṇataṃ bhavati vitarkayati yuktamidam idaṃ vānyathā iti vijayate abhiniviśate yukte ruciṃ karoti
guṇāḥ sattvādayaḥ puruṣāḥ pumāṃsaḥ teṣām antaraṃ bhedaḥ sa eva tattvaṃ taditi
punarapi kiṃbhūtaḥ ? apariṇāmī sat paśyan kiṃ karoti ? ityāha--mokṣamupaiti
nanu muktasyāpi punaḥ saṃsāraḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--punaḥ paścāt taraṇaṃ na darśayati ātmānam ityadhyāhāraḥ
kim ? upāyopeyatattvam mṛṣyato asahamānāḥ naiyāyikā mokṣam āhuḥ iti sambandhaḥ
vā athavā kathaṃ kena pratyakṣānumānaprakāreṇa upalabdhiḥ pratipattiḥ acetanasya parakalpitasya na kenacit tatra tadabhāvāt kathaṃ karaṇam ityāyuktam

nanu yadi tanna syāt kathaṃ taddarśitaṃ puruṣaḥ paśyediti cet ? atrocyate--karaṇaṃ kathaṃ paśyet anyakaraṇaṃ vinā ? anyathā arthamapi tathaiva paśyediti kiṃ kṛtaṃ karaṇakalpanayā ? tatrāpi tadantarakalpane anavasthā
tathāpi tatkalpanāyāṃ doṣamāha--atiprasaṅgāt, anyasyāpi tathā kalpanā syāt iti
yatpunaruktam--paśyan ityādi; tatrāha--kathaṃ cetanasyāpyakartturupalabdhiḥ atiprasaṅgāt iti
akartuḥ puruṣasya akarttā'guṇaḥ śuddhaḥ puruṣaḥ kapiladarśane
iti vacanāt katham upalabdhiḥ arthasākṣātkaraṇaṃ cetanasya darśasvā bhāvasya
nahi arthasannidhānāt prāk taddarśane 'vyāpṛtaṃ rūpa yahataḥ punaḥ taddarśanaṃ yuktam pūrvaṃ na yuktaṃ pūrvavat
parityāge katha nna kartṛtvaṃ karaṇakriyayeva darśanakriyayāpi śliṣṭakartṛtvāt
atha sarvadā udāsīnaḥ puruṣo darpaṇasaṃsthānāyo yo yadā sannihito'rtho bhavati taṃ tadā paśyati iti; tadāyuktam; audāsīnyāparityāge tadayogāditi
dṛśyadarśanasvabhāvayoḥ prakṛtipuruṣayoḥ vyāpakayoḥ kathaṃ saṃyogo vā nacedvā śabdo prasaṅgasamuccayārthaḥ
nanu kadācittayoḥ avasthāntarāvāptiḥ tato'yamadoṣa iti cet; atrāha--tadavasthayoḥ kūṭasthayoḥ ityarthaḥ
nanu pradhānasya pariṇāmitvāt tadavasthayoḥ ityayuktamiti cet; na; puruṣasyāpi tadvat pariṇāmitvāpatteraviśeṣāditi manyate
saṃprati naiyāyikamataṃ darśayati saugatena dūṣayitum ātmā ityādi

ātmādi pradhānaṃ yasya padārthasamūhasya sa eva tattvaṃ tajjñānāt mithyājñānanivṛttau satyāṃ doṣānutpatteḥ doṣā rāgādayaḥ teṣāmanutpatteḥ pravṛtterasaṃbhavāt rāgādikāryadharmādharmayorasaṃbhavāt janmanivṛttau aśeṣaguṇarahitasya ātmanaḥ svātmanyavasthānaṃ mokṣamāhuḥ naiyāyikāḥ
kaḥ ? ityāha ātmātmīyagrahaḥ kathaṃ mokṣāya ? kuta iti cet ? āha--saṃsārahetutaḥ
na ca saṃsārakāraṇameva mokṣakāraṇaṃ yuktam atiprasaṅgāt
etadapi kutaḥ ? ityāha--ayoniśo manaskāro yataḥ nirviṣayo vikalpo yataḥ iti manyate
ayoniśo manaskāraḥ bhrāntaḥ nirṇayaḥ--abhidha॰ ko॰ ṭī॰ 5
anayoḥ saṃpratibaddhāḥ sarve doṣāḥ prajāyante || pra॰ vā॰ 1 | 221 ityādi
duḥkhasatyādiduḥkhasamudāyani rodhamārgasaṃjñakāni catuḥsatyāni teṣāṃ bhāvanopāyo heturyasya sa tathoktaḥ taṃ bruvāṇāḥ saugatāḥ

catuḥsatyapratipādakavacanajanitaṃ tadviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ mithyājñānam tasya artha viṣayatvāt arthāpratibandhāt sākṣāt tasmādanutpattiḥ śabdasya ca taireva tatpratibandhānabhyupagamāt tataḥ kathaṃ na kathañcit tattvasya catuḥsatyalakṣaṇasya pratipattiḥ
tathāpi yadeva tataḥ pratīyate tadeva bhāvayatāṃ muktiḥ syāt iti cet; atrāha--katham ityādi

katham atattvasya śabdārthasya bhāvanāyāḥ tasyāḥ praṣa paryantaḥ prakarṣāvasānaṃ tasmājjātaṃ tajjaṃ tattvajñānaṃ catuḥsatyajñānaṃ nirvāṇaṃ ca iti pūrvadūṣaṇasamuccaye kāmaśokādyupaplutajñānamiva atattvajñānameva syāditi
anyasyāpyaparijñāne saṃbhavedapi tasya tat || pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 2 | 31 iti

nityātmādipratipādakaśāstrārthajñānasyeva catuḥsatyapratipādakaśāstrasyāpi mithyaikāntāviśeṣaḥ tasmin sati nairātmyetarapakṣayoḥ nairātmyam ātmarahitatvam itarat sātmakatvaṃ tayoḥ pakṣau tayoḥ pratijñetarayoḥ asti vā kaścidviśeṣaḥ ? na kaścidasti ityarthaḥ
tato yathā ātmā bhāvanāto muktiḥ tathā nairātmyabhāvanāto'pi iti manyate

nanu kimucyate tayorna kaścidviśeṣa iti, yāvaganairātmyapakṣādikayāvatā tarātnya pakṣādikamasti netarapakṣa tataḥ śrutādarthamavagamya punaḥ pratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ vicārya bhāvayatāṃ nairātmyavādināmeva muktiriti cet; atrāha--pratyakṣetyādi

pratyakṣaṃ ca hetuśca liṅgaṃ tadābhāsau ca pratyakṣahetutadābhāsau ta eva vikalpā bhedāḥ teṣāṃ sambandho arthāvinābhāvastasya bhāvābhāvau pratyakṣahetuvikalpayoḥ arthasambandhābhāvaḥ pratyakṣa hetutvābhāsavikalpayoḥ sambandhābhāvaḥ, tayośca nairātmyetarapakṣayoḥ asti vā kaścidviśeṣaḥ iti sambandhaḥ
mithyā kalpito viṣayo gocara stayo rbhāvaḥ tattā tasyā aviśeṣāt
lakṣaṇānatikrameṇa yathālakṣaṇaṃ tacca taścalaṇaṃ ca nairātmyetaravādikalpitaṃ vastu tasmād vilakṣaṇaṃ visadṛśaṃ jātyantaraṃ tasya iti lakṣaṇāt
kutaścit pramāṇāt tattvasya pratipattiḥ sugatasyetarasya vā
sādhanavacanasyāpi trirūpaliṅgavacanasyāpi yat sat tat sarvamanityam vādanyā॰ pṛ॰ 6 ityevamādikasya na kevalam agnihotraṃ juhuyāt maitrā॰ 6
jñānavati satyapi tadvacanāt tattvāpratipatteḥ, vakturabhiprāyamātrāyapratipattiḥ punaranyavacanādapi
sugatasannidhānāt svayameva janasya tattvapratipattiḥ, kuḍyādibhyo vā deśanāḥ
iti kecit; tadayuktam; yataḥ tatsannidhānāttasya tattvapratipattiḥ adhyakṣarūpā, vikalparūpā vā syāt ? prathamapakṣe tatsannidhānopāyā janmināṃ sarvajñateti prasaktam
catuḥ satyajñasya sarvajñatvam iti parasya matam
heyaṃ duḥkhasatyam, upādeyaṃ nirodhasatyam, tayoḥ abhyupāyaḥ samudaya--mārgasatye
yaḥ pramāṇamasavisto na tu sarvasya vedakaḥ
dūraṃ paśyatu vā mā vā tattvamiṣṭaṃ tu paśyatu
dvitīyapakṣe--vikalpamātrarūpā, anumānarūpā vā syāt ? atrāpi prathamavikalpe ukto doṣaḥ kathamatattvabhāvanā ityādi
yadi punastasyāḥ paramārthaviṣayatvamiṣyate, vyāhatametat--dve eva pramāṇe pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
liṅgasya ca svayaṃ pratipattau tataḥ sādhyapratītirapi svayameva iti kiṃ tatsannidhānena ? nahi dhūmād agniṃ pratipadyamānaṃ prati tadupayogi

atha sādhyavalliṅgajñānaṃ tata eva; taccet pratyakṣam; atīndriyatvā'viśeṣe'pi liṅge pratyakṣaṃ tato na sādhye iti kiṃ kṛto vibhāgaḥ ? yadi vikalpamātram; kathamato liṅgapratipattiḥ yato'numāna rūpatvam, anumānatve prakṛtamanuvarttata ityanavasthā
yatpunaruktam--kuḍyādibhyo'pi deśanāḥ iti; tatra jñānamātreṇāpi varjitebhyaḥ tebhyo deśanāsaṃbhave kathamidaṃ sūktam--
atha anya eva te śabdā ye vikalpābhāve'pi bhavanti; tarhi anyadeva taccittaṃ yattā yattadabhāve'pi syāditi paralokasiddhiḥ
kathaṃ caivaṃ sati vyāhārādeḥ paraśarīre caitanyapratītiḥ ? kathaṃ ca na syāt ? kiṃ kuḍyādikavat kasyacit sannidhānāt dha rma kī rttyā da yo vadanti uta svayameva iti śaṅkā'nivṛtteḥ
kiṃca, taddeśanābhyo yadi na kasyacittattvapratītiḥ kiṃ tābhiḥ ? asti cet; siddhaḥ śabdaḥ arthavācakaḥ
tadvad anyo'pi tatsannidhānāttayā iti cet; anyasannidhānād anyā api, bhāvaniyamābhāvāt śaktīnāmiti
iti; tatrāpi kuḍyādipratibaddhajanmānaḥ tāḥ kuḍyādikaṃ gamayeyuḥ, tacca tatsannidhānamiti dūre tattvapratipattiḥ vyavahitā vā syāt
nanu sugatasyāpi vikalpo'sti tato dharmādenā iti cet; atrāha--sopāyopeya ityādi
so'yaṃ paramārthāsaṃsparśibhiḥ vikalpaistattvaṃ niścinvan tattvānabhidhānaiḥ vācakairvikalpaviṣayaṃ niścāyayati iti kaimaṃ vyāghātabhāramudvoḍhuṃ samarthaḥ anyatraikāntavinaśvarāt
buddhaḥ sugataḥ niścitya vikalpaviṣayatāṃ nītvā avikalpenā'niścayāt
anena etaddarśayati buddhasya śuddhanirvikalpabodhasadbhāve na tato vacanapravṛttiriti tatkalpanamanarthakam
etena idamapi nirastaṃ yaduktaṃ gā dga la kī rtti nā--
ye kalpayanti kavayaḥ sugatasya vācaste kalpanāmapi muniḥ parikalpayanti
tasyāmabāhyatayā cakāsti doṣaṃ tataḥ stutipadairnigadanti te'rthāt || iti
katham ? tadvacanābhāve kiṃ tena anarthakena arthā poṣitena ? śeṣaṃ cintitamanantaram
athā dvaitamalasveda muktam, tena tatra sarvamidamuktamayuktam; etadvacanārthā'bhāvāt
tato vacanapravṛtto vā, tadartho vā tataḥ pratīyeta ubhayathāpi svalakṣaṇaviṣayatvaṃ śabdānām
saugatānā syāditi cet; na; anyatrāpi tadaniṣedhāt
na vastugataṃ syaivā kkimadhyekṣam anyasyāpi svayaṃ tadabhyupagamāt
atyāsaṃ jaṃ ca tadasti yasya yāvata mātrā pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 233 iti
na kasyacidavikalpādanyasya vikalpādvacanamiti yuktam; itarathā dhūmo'pi kvacidagneḥ anyatrānyato'pi syāt
sa kaiḥ kiṃ kuryāt ? ityatrāha--vācakaiḥ śabdaiḥ param ātmano'nyaṃ dineyajñātaṃ niścāyayet ced yadi
tataḥ kiṃ jātam ? ityāha--śabdavikalpāḥ tattvagocarāḥ sulakṣaṇaviṣayāḥ syuḥ ityadhyāhāraḥ
evaṃ manyate--yo'sau sugatasya vikalpaḥ sa jātyādiviṣayaścet; itaravikalpavat tadvacanasya tatpratibaddhatve tataḥ sa eva pratīyate iti sa eva doṣaḥ sādhanavacanasyāpi ityādikaḥ
atha svalakṣaṇaviṣayaḥ; tarhi na nīlādivikalpo'vastugocaraḥ tattvāt marīcikānicaye jalavikalpavaditi
tataḥ vikalpo'vastunirbhāso visaṃvādādupaplavaḥ iti kathanamātram, sugatavacanasyāpi tadanivāraṇāt, tathā ca tatprabhavasya śabdasyāpi tadviṣayatvamiti

kimbhūtaṃ kim ? ityatrāha— vikalpaviṣayam spaṣṭasādhāraṇarūpaṃ tattvam iti ka imaṃ vyāghātabhāraṃ svanāśakadoṣabhāram udvoḍhuṃ samarthaḥ anyatra ekāntaviniśvarāra voḍhuṃ samarthaḥ pūrvāparaparāmarśaśūnyatvāt
nanu śiṣyāḥ sugatavacobhiḥ tattvaṃ sākṣāt na pratipadyante api tu tadabhiprāya, punaḥ svayameva tattvaṃ yuktya vabuddhyante iti cet; atrāha--śābdaśced ityādi
na khalu yuktāyuktaparīkṣayā tattvetarapratipattau dṛṣṭaśrutayorarthayoḥ kaścana atiśayo'sti yataḥ cakṣurādijñānameva tattvaviṣayam
tatsamāropavyavacchedasyaiva prāmāṇye nirvikalpajñānasya prāmāṇyaṃ na bhavet, sarvathā anyasyāpi prasaṅgaḥ syāt
dūṣaṇamāha--kiṃ naiva kasmādevaṃ cakṣurādibhiḥ tattvaṃ na pratipadyeran parīkṣakāḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadi sugatavacane pravṛtte'pi na tataḥ tattvapratītiḥ api tu yuktiḥ pratyakṣādirūpāyāḥ
tathā sati pratyakṣādiviṣayaṃ tattvam iti tata eva tatpratītiḥ iti kiṃ sugatavacanena ? iti vyartham--śabdairvaktrabhiprāyaṃ pratipadya iti
kārikāyā vyākhyānaṃ sugamatvā tatkṛtaṃ śabdairvaktrabhiprāyaṃ pratipadya ityatraiva dūṣaṇāntaramāha--naravītyādi nakhala tacetana pratipattau kriyamāṇāyām
idaṃ yuktam idaṃ vā'yuktam iti yā parīkṣa tayā
kim ? ityāha--kaścana atiśayo'sti naiva kaścedvedo sti
evaṃ manyate--yadri yāttattvaṃ pratya padya nābhiprāyaṃ parīkṣya parīkṣakā yuktyā tadeva tattvaṃ pratipadyeran, tathā śabdādapi tattvaṃ pratipadya nābhiprāyaṃ tadeva te tayā pratipadyeran iti
kīdṛśastayoraviśeṣaḥ atiśayo nāsti ? ityāha--yato yasmāt atiśayāt cakṣurādijñānameva tattvaṃviṣayaṃ na punaḥ śrutajñānaṃ bhavet tattvaviṣayaṃ so'tiśayo nāsti
nanu śrutajñānaṃ pravṛttamapi svaviṣaye samāropaṃ na vyavacchinatti anityaḥ śabdaḥ ityukte'pi nityajñānā'nivṛtteḥ, itarathā sādhanamanarthakaṃ bhavet

tatsamāropo dṛṣṭaśrutārthasamāropastadvyavacchedanumānaṃ tasyaiva tadvyavacchedasyaiva na śrutajñānasya prāmāṇye aṅgīkriyamāṇe nirvikalpajñānasya prāmāṇyaṃ na bhavet tadvyavacchedakatvābhāvāditi manyate
kathaṃ na bhavet ? ityāha--sarvathā tadvyavaccheda prakāreṇeva arthagrahaṇaprakāreṇāpi anyasyāpi prasaṅgabhayāta athavā, kṣaṇikadva prakāreṇeva nīlādiprakāreṇāpi, atrāpi vikalpāpekṣaṇāt
yadi vā anabhyāsa prakāreṇeva abhyāsa prakāreṇāpi, tadāpi dṛśyaprāpyaikatvasamāropabhāvāt kathamanyathā pratyakṣaṃ bhāvinipramāṇam ? tarhi kasyāḥ syāditi cet ? atrāha--saṃvṛtītyādi
bhedasaṃvaraṇāt saṃvṛtiḥ avayavyādivijñāna tatprabhṛteḥ tadāḥ pra bhṛtiśabdena smaraṇādiparigrahaḥ, vikalpasyaiva syāt
bhavatu ko doṣa iti cet; atrāha--tacca ityādi
evaṃ sugatasya tattvadeśanā kīdṛśī iti sāmānyena pratipādya saṃprati taduktanairātmyalakṣaṇamārganiṣedhaviśeṣaṇā kīdṛśī tattvadeśanā ityetad darśayannāha--nītyetyādi

svato'nyato vā svaparacetasāṃ satyapi sadṛśetarapariṇāmātiśaye jīvo'yaṃ pṛthak pratyātmavedanīyaḥ saṅkaravyatikaravyatirekāt svaparacetasāmaskhalattādātmyasāmānyagocarapratyayaviṣayatāṃ prathayan svayaṃ pratikṣipantaṃ durvidagdhabuddhiṃ tiraskarotyeveti atra kinnaścintayā ? na cettamovijṛbhbhaṇam
nirvikalpa itaraśca sva vikalpaḥ ātmā svabhāvo yasya vikalpajñānasya tena
sahakramābhyāṃ bhavatī ti sahakramabhavāḥ tāśca tāḥ anyo'nyaṃ parasparaṃ vyāvṛttā sve punarapi tāstāḥ ekātmanaḥ ekasantānaśca saṃvidaśca tāsām iti
tatrāyamarthaḥ--kamabhavāśca anyo'nyavyāvṛttāśca sukhādasteṣu ekasyātmano jīvasya yā sambandhitayāsaṃvidaḥ tāsām iti

syānmatam--kvacijjñāne savikalpetarākārayoḥ ekatvadarśanānukra saṃvidāmekatvasādhanamayuktam, anyathā arke kaṭukatvadarśanārtha guḍe'pi kinna tatsādhyate ? pratyakṣabādhanaṃ kramavidāmekatvasādhane'pi
tāsa mekatvaṃ cetanārūpatāṃ vihāya aparaṃ pratyakṣagamyam
tadrūpatā ca santānā ntarāpekṣayāpi iti sarvātmanāmekātmakatvam
etena dvitīyaṃ vyākhyānaṃ cintitamiti cet; atrāha--svato'nyato vā ityādi
svā ni svasantānapatitāni parāṇi putrāṇi santānāntarabhūtāni tāni ca tāni cetāṃsi teṣāṃ satyapi vidyamāne vi sadṛśetarapariṇāmā viṣaye visadṛśapariṇāmātiśaye
kutaḥ ? ityāha--svataḥ sopādā nakāraṇā t anyato vā sahakārikāraṇāt veti samuccaye
tasmin satyapi kutaḥ kiṃ kurvan kaḥ kiṃ karoti ? ityāha--saṅkaretyādi

keṣāṃ kurvanti ityāha--sa paracetasāmaskhalattādātmyasāmānyagocarapratyayaviṣayatāṃ svacetasām askhalattādātmyapratyayaviṣayatāṃ parād tasāṃ svāpekṣayā'skhalatsāmānyapratyayaviṣayatāṃ prathayan prasiddhiṃ tadā na

saṅkare svasvacetassu tādātmyapratyayaviṣayatāvat sāmānyapratyayaviṣayatā, paracetassu sāmānyapratyayaviṣayatāvat tā dātmyapratyayaviṣayatā, vyatikaraśca svacetassu tathāvidhasāmānyapratyayaviṣayatā paracetassu tādātmyapratyayaviṣayatā tayo rvyatireko'bhāvaḥ tasmāt taṃ vā prāpya
nanu sarvatra eka eva jīvaḥ, iti na yuktaṃ svataḥ ityādikamiti cet; atrāha--pṛthag iti
kiṃbhūtaḥ ? pratyātmavedanīyaḥ, atra asmin nyāye sati jīve vā kiṃ naścintayā anumānena ? kimarthaṃ tarhi tatra kramopalabdhi ityādi vakṣyate tad iti cet ? atrāha--na ca ityādi
tamaso'jñānasya vijṛmbhaṇaṃ cet yadi na tarhi kinnaścintayā
svaparayoḥ darśanaṃ cāvagraho vikalpaśca smaraṇādiḥ tāveva kramapariṇāmaḥ sa eva svabhāvo yasya sa tathokto jīvo'nyapadārthaḥ tamantareṇā'dṛṣṭeḥ
parasparaṃ viśiṣyante iti viśeṣā dravyādayaḥ ata eva tadvādī vaiśeṣika ityucyate, ekāntena viśeṣā ekāntaviśeṣāḥteṣāmiti
na kevalaṃ teṣāmeva api tu kṣaṇasthiteḥ ca śabdo'tra draṣṭavyaḥ, adṛṣṭeriti
na ca sthitireva bhāvasya vināśaḥ yataḥ sahopalambhaniyamaḥ
tathā ca sahopalambhaniyamāt hetuphalavināśotpādayoraikyaṃ syāt, yataḥ pūrvasya vaikalyamaparasya kaivalyam

na cānyo'nyaviruddhasvabhāvayoranayoḥ kathañcittādātmyaṃ viruddham niścaya...sthityā saha janmavināśayoraikyamupayan kālādibhede'pi sukhādivyāpinaṃ pratyakṣaṃ bhāvaṃ kathaṃ pratikṣipet ? svalakṣaṇaṃ parasparavyāvṛttilakṣaṇaṃ yataḥ pratikṣaṇaṃ trilakṣaṇam
tulanā--tasyānyasya pradeśasya kevalasya yattat kaivalyam ekākitvamasāhayatā tadeva aparasya pratiyogino ghaṭādeḥ vaikalyam abhāva iti
svasya svā vā saṃvidaḥ svasaṃvidaḥ svasaṃvido na parasaṃvidaḥ tāsām
tarhi vivakṣitaikakṣaṇamātraḥ syādātmā sarvasya tatra praveśāt iti syāt kathañcit na sarvātmanā iti
syānmatam--sukhaduḥkhādibhedād bheda eva tāsāṃ bheda iti; tatrāha--sukhaduḥkhādibhede'pi ka kevalam abhede
nanu bhedābhedayoranyo'nyaparihārasthitalakṣaṇayoḥ kimiva aikyamiti cet ? atrāha— sahavīkṣyāniyāmavat iti
vi citrā nānā vibhrametarādyākārā īkṣā dṛṣṭiḥ vīkṣā tasyā niyamaḥ 'vaśyambhāvaḥ, anyathā sakalaśūnyatā ityuktam, sahavīkṣyāniyama sya iva tadvaditi
atha matam--na dṛṣṭāntamātrāt sādhyaṃ sidhyati atiprasaṅgāt api tu hetoḥ, ataḥ sa eva ucyatāmiti; tatrāha--krama ityādi
pūrvam upādānasya punaḥ upādeyasya upalabdhiḥ krameṇopalabdhiḥ tasyā niyamāt iti

nanu yadyapi kadācit ghaṭapaṭayorupalabdhiḥ tathāpi niyamābhāvāt naikyamiti siddhyati, tathāpi yathā sahabhāvināṃ santānāntarasaṃvitkṣaṇānāṃ bhede'pi sahopalambhaniyamasya bhāvād vyabhicāraḥ tathā kramabhāvināṃ teṣāmeva kramopalambhaniyamasya bhede'pi bhāvād vyabhicārastadavastha eva niśādivasayośca iti cet; ucyate--kramaśabdena prakramād upādānopādeyabhūtasvaparadarśana-vikalpakramo gṛhyate tasyopalabdheḥ, anyathā'bhāvo niyamaḥ, tasmāditi
etaduktaṃ bhavati--svasaṃvidāṃ pūrvasyāḥ pūrvasyā upādānatvena parasyāḥ parasyā upādeyatvena ca yeyaṃ krameṇopalabdhiḥ tasyā niyamād anyathānupapatteḥ tāsāṃ syādabheda iti

anye punarācāryāḥ kramamaviśiṣṭamādāya tadupalabdhaiḥ niyamād avaśyambhāvāt iti hetumabhidhāya sahavīkṣyāniyāmavat sahopalambhaniyāmavat iti dṛṣṭāntaṃ bruvate; teṣāṃ kathamuktavyabhicāraparihāraḥ tatra kramopalabdhiniyamā mabhāve'pi abhedā bhāvāt ? kathanna sādhanavikalatā dṛṣṭāntasya upalambhaniyamamātrasya bhāve'pi sakalahetorabhāvāt
na cānekaśaḥ svayaṃ dūṣitaṃ punaḥ svapakṣasiddhaye aṅgīkartuṃ yuktam
sādhyavikalatā ca vādinaṃ prati, nīlajñānayostena abhedānabhyupagamāt
parāpekṣayā idaṃ nidarśanamiti cet; taṃ prati sādhyavikalatā, kathañcidabhedasyā'nabhyupagamāt
pareṇāpi ato hetoḥ kṣaṇikasya utpādavināśayoḥ tādātmyam abhyupagamyamiti pāyat kārikāṃ vyācaṣṭe bhedaikānte'pītyādinā

na kevalaṃ syādabhede api tu bhedaikānte'pi saugatavaiśeṣikasambandhinyabhyupagamyamāne kṣaṇikasya bhāvasya pradhvaṃsavat upalakṣaṇametat tena anityasya sarvasya grahaṇam, yau utpattivināśau tayostādātmyaṃ kathañcidekatvaṃ siddham
pūrvam utpatteḥ, punaḥ tatpariṇāmasya vināśasya upalambhaḥ tasyā niyamāt

yadi punaḥ utpadyamānāt utpattiḥ anyā syāt; tayā tatsambandhābhāvāt na kaścit tadvān iti na kaścit utpadyeta iti, na vinaśyet kharaviṣāṇavat, anyathā ātmāderapi tatsambandha iti so'pi utpadyate iti syāt

atha prāgasataḥ svakāraṇasamavāyaḥ sattāsamavāyo vā utpattiḥ, na sā ātmādeḥ sarvadā sattvāt iti matiḥ; kutaḥ prāk ? utpatteḥ iti cet; kasyotpatteḥ ? ghaṭāderiti cet; uktamatra bhinnā kathaṃ tasya ? anyathā ātmāderapi na syāditi
na ca nirāśrayā sā, iti kathaṃ pūrvaṃ tadupalambhaḥ ? kharaviṣāṇavat alabdhātmarūpasya kaḥ svakāraṇena sattayā vā samavāyaḥ ? labdhātmarūpatve tadevotpattiḥ ityalaṃ bhinnotpattikalpanayā
tathā yadi bhāvād vināśo'nyaḥ, na tena tasya sambandha iti kathaṃ bhāvo vinaṣṭo nāma, atiprasaṅgāt

bhāvo viśeṣyaḥ abhāvo viśeṣaṇam ataḥ viśeṣaṇībhāvastena tatsambandha iti cet; viśeṣaṇakāle viśeṣyasadbhāve yukto viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ, kintu kathaṃ bhāve sati abhāvaḥ ? nahi jīvata eva devadattasya maraṇam
arthāve nāśena pracchādanānna bhānna bhāvopalambhaḥ; tarhi na tadanuraktabhāvopalambhaḥ iti
svānuraktaṃ viśeṣye pratītimupajanayat viśeṣaṇamucyate; nīlatvaṃ tadanuraktaṃ tatpra tītau vā, na tatpracchādanam
yadi punarna vināśasamaye bhāvasadbhāvaḥ; kathamanyakāle'nyasyābhāvo yadyasau svayaṃ nivartteta, anyathā paṭotpattikāle ghaṭābhāvaḥ syāt
asambandhānneti cet; kaḥ punaḥ bhāvavināśayoḥ sambandhaḥ ? viśeṣaṇībhāvaścet; uktamatra— tasyāpi tābhyāṃ bhedāt so'pi tayoḥ katham iti ? sambandhāntarakalpane anavasthā
tadabhāvepi sā tayoriti cet; samavāyādyabhāve'pi guṇādayaḥ tadvataḥ syuḥ aviśeṣāt
na sa kasyacid ityapi nottaram; adhyakṣeṇa tadagrahaṇaprasaṅgāt, indriyeṇa tadasannikarṣāt
sannikarṣe vā, sa na saṃyogaḥ; tatsambandhasyā'dravyatvāt
sākṣāt sannikarṣe sukhādāvapi tathaiva ityalaṃ tatra sambandhasambandhakalpanayā
virodha ityeke; so'pi na yuktaḥ; agnineva śītasya tena bhāvarttanāt na vā nivarttako dharmo virodhī nāma, atiprasaṅgāt
nivarttane vā'sya tato vyatirekaprasaṅgaḥ pūrvavadbhaved anavasthā ca
avyatireke vināśena kriyamāṇo vināśaḥ tadavyatirikto nānya iti na yukto vibhāgaḥ
saṃyuktasamavāyarūpaḥ sambandhasambandhaḥ manaḥsaṃyukte ātmani sukhādīnāṃ samavāyāt
nanu bhavatu kṣaṇikasya utpattivināśayoḥ tādātmyaṃ siddham iti, tattu na kramopalambhaniyamāt, api tu sahopalambhaniyamāditi cet; atrāha--hetu ityādi
hetuḥ kāraṇam phalaṃ kāryam tayoryathāsaṃkhyena yau vināśotpādau tayoḥ samānakālopalambhābhyupagamāt

tathāhi--yadaiva mṛtpiṇḍasya vināśopalambhaḥ tadaiva śivakopalambhaḥ na punarhetuvināśotpādayoḥ, itarathā utpādavināśayoḥ parasparaṃ virodhinoḥ ekatra ekadā bhāvena bādhyabādhakabhāve na kiñcit syāditi manyate
vināśaḥ phalātmayā viviktatā, sā ca tasya udayakāla eva pratīyate iti; tadasatyam; yataḥ tathābhyupagamāt
yathaiva hi phalakāle hetorabhāvaḥ pratīyate tathā hetukāle phalasyāpi kevalaṃ nasta rūpasya tadabhāvaḥ
na ca naiva sthitireva utpattisamayasthānameva bhāvasya vināśaḥ svarūpasya nivṛttiḥ sahopalambhaniyamo yataḥ sthitireva vināśāt śaḥ syāt
yataḥ iti vā ākṣepe, yataḥ sahopalambhaniyamaḥ syāt
naiva syāt, sthityā vināśasya tena sthiterbādhanāt
yadā hetoḥ utpādasya tadā vināśasya upalambho vidhiḥ mukhaṃ pradhānaṃ yasya pratiṣedhasya, na pūrvaṃ tadudayasya paścād vināśasya ityevaṃ rūpasya, sa tathoktaḥ sa eva phalaṃ yasya so'pi tathoktaḥ
na ca vidhiratrāsti iti darśayannāha--kṣaṇasthiteḥ ityādi
kṣaṇasya parakalpitasya yā sthitiḥ ātmalābhaḥ tasyāḥ yau pratyakṣānupalambhau darśanā darśane tayoḥ ekasvabhāvaviṣayatānupapatteḥ ekasvabhāvo viṣayo yayoḥ tayorbhāvaḥ tattā, tasyā anupapatteḥ
prathamakṣaṇe pratyakṣaṃ dvitīyādau anupalambho bahirapekṣayā vinā, yugapat pratyakṣānupalambhāpekṣayā tadanupapatteḥ ityarthaḥ
utpādena vināśasya tena votpādasya bādhanāt na utpādo vināśo vā syādityarthaḥ
syānmatam--bhavatu kṣaṇasthiteḥ pratyakṣānupalambhayoḥ bahirapekṣayā ekasvabhāvaviṣayatopapattiḥ, tathā ca kiṃ syāt ? ityatrāha--tathā ca ityādi
tathā ca tena ca prakāreṇa hetuphalavināśotpādayoḥ aikyaṃ kathañcittādātmyaṃ syād bhavet sahopalambhaniyamāt
kutaḥ ? ityatrāha— pūrvasya kāraṇasya vaikalyam abhāvaḥ aparasya phalasya kaivalyam yataḥ anena bhinnamabhāvaṃ niṣedhati
nanu hetornivṛttirūpaḥ pradhvaṃsaḥ phalasya ca utpādaḥ prāgasataḥ kāraṇādātmalābhaḥ sattāsvabhāvaḥ, tadanayoḥ anyo'nyaviruddhasvabhāvayoḥ kathamaikyamiti cet ? atrāha--na ca ityādi
anyo'nyaviruddhasvabhāvayoḥ na ca naiva kathañcittādātmyaṃ viruddham tathāpratīteriti manyate
tarhi hetuphalayoḥ vināśotpādayoḥ aikyaṃ yadi paro'bhyupagacchet ko doṣaḥ syāt ? ityatrāha--janma ityādi
phalasya yajjanma hetoryaśca vināśaḥ tayo raikyamupayan abhyupagacchan saugataḥ
kena ? sāhasthityāha sthityā kena ? ityāha--sahasthityā kiṃ kuryāt ? ityāha--bhāvaṃ kathaṃ pratikṣipet ? kiṃbhūtam ? pratyakṣam adhyakṣaparicchedyam
nanu sukhaduḥkhādīnām ekasantatipatitānām saccetanā'bhedāt yadi tadvyāpina mucyate tarhi santānāntaragatānāmapi tadaviśeṣāt taducyatām
athātra kālādibhedānnaivamucyate; anyatrāpi nocyatāṃ tadaviśeṣāditi cet; atrāha--kālādi ityādi
na hi sāṅkhyakalpitaṃ bhāvaṃ tadvyāpinaṃ kathaṃ pratikṣipediti cet ? atrāha--svalakṣaṇam ityādi
sva ātmā lakṣaṇaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ tamiti
parasparaṃ vyāvṛttiḥ lakṣaṇaṃ yasya taṃ yataḥ
vaiśeṣikādi sambandhinaṃ taṃ kathaṃ pratikṣipet ? ityatrāha--pratikṣaṇaṃ trilakṣaṇaṃ pratyakṣamiti

nanu ca svasaṃvidāṃ kramopalabdhiniyamaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvād ekasantānatvācca na punarabhedāt, tato'nyathāsiddho hetuḥ iti kimarthamucyate--kramopalabdhiniyamāt syādabhedaḥ svasaṃvidām iti cet ? atrāha--kāryakāraṇatā ityādi
sadrūpasaṃsthanādivivarta-vicitragrāhyagrāhakākāraikasādhāraṇajñānānubhavāviruddhaṃ pūrvottarasvabhāvabhedāt hetuphalabhūtaṃ bhāvanairātmyavādī pratikṣipatīti kṣaṇikabhāvaṃ samakṣamati laṅghayati
sati kṣaṇike kāraṇe yadi kāryaṃ syāt tadidaṃ jagat kṣaṇikamakramaṃ niḥsantāni ca syāt
tasminnasati bhavataḥ kutaḥ punaḥ tadanantarotpattiniyamaḥ yatastadaniṣṭakālotpattirna bhavet
sadeva tatsamarthaṃ kāraṇaṃ svasattākālameva kāryaṃ prasahya janayet
svarasataḥ kāryotpattikālaniyame svatantrasya kuta eva kāryatvam
nairantaryamātrāt prabhavaniyame sarvatra sarveṣāmaviśeṣe kuta eva niyamaḥ
dravyasya prabhavaniyame na kiñcidatiprasajyate svahetūpādānasya parapratyayatāyām
na ca niranvayānāṃ bhāvānāṃ sādṛśyāt prabhavaḥ santatirvā vyavasthāpyeta tadviparyaye'pi tathopalabdheḥ
bhedaikānte sādṛśyaṃ ca yathā yathā vicāryate tathā tathā viśīryate nīlanirbhāsajñānavat
kṣaṇikānāṃ bhāvānāṃ hetuphalabhāvo nāsti, tadabhāvāt kva bahirantarvā santatiḥ santānaḥ, tasya tadātmakatvāt
satyapi kāryakāraṇābhāve pūrvāparayoḥ sārūpyam ekasantativyapadeśanibandhanaṃ gatyantarābhāvāt syāt tacca nāsti iti darśayati--kutaḥ kāraṇāt pramāṇādvā teṣāṃ kṣaṇikānāṃ sārūpyaṃ samānarūpatā
syānmatam--sakalaśūnyatāyāḥ niraṃśapratibhāsādvaitasya copagamāt na saugatānāmayaṃ doṣa iti cet; atrāha--sadrūpa ityādi
bhāvaṃ pratikṣipati ityayuktam, tatpratikṣepe pramāṇapratikṣepāyoga iti manyate

tena sattvaṃ svarūpaṃ svabhāvo yasya saṃsthānādeḥ, ādiśabdena sakalakramabhāvibāhyadharmaparigrahaḥ, sa tathoktaḥ, sadrūpapadena saṃsthānādeḥ kalpitatvaṃ niṣedhati, sa vivartto yasya ghaṭādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ
vicitrau nānāprakārau yau grāhyagrāhakākārau tayoḥ ekaṃ ca tat sādhāraṇajñānaṃ ca tadapi tathoktam, punaranayordvandvaḥ tayoranubhavaḥ tenā'viruddham
tata eva kramānekānto'pyaviruddha iti darśayannāha--hetuphala ityādi
kuta etat ? pūrvam uttaraṃ ceti cetrāha svabhāvabhedāt svarūpatvābhāvānnāvasya iti sambandhaḥ
yena pramāṇena tatpratikṣepaḥ kriyate tasya bhāvarūpatvāditi bhāvaḥ
atha matam--kṣaṇikabhāvaṃ samakṣamatilaṅghayati ityuktam, tasya sakalahetuphalabhāvavyavahāranibandhanatvāt nānyaṃ viparyayāt iti cet; atrāha--satītyādi
sati vidyamāne kṣaṇike kṣaṇamātrāvalambini kāraṇe yadi kāryaṃ syād utpadyeta tat pareṇopagatamidaṃ vicāryamāṇaṃ jagat syāt
kimbhūtaṃ syāt ? ityāha--akramameva kṣaṇapratiṣṭhaṃ syāt ityarthaḥ
tathā ca paralokādisādhanaṃ parasya svavacanabādhitaṃ bhavediti manyate
punarapi kimbhūtaṃ syāt ? ityāha--niḥsantāni santāninaḥ upādānopādeyabhūtakṣaṇāḥ tebhyo niṣkrāntaṃ niraste vā yena tanniḥsantāni savyetaragoviṣāṇavat
yadi vā, yata evākramata eva niḥsantāni śamātra rahitaṃ bhavet
etaduktaṃ bhavati--svotpattisamaye kṣaṇikaṃ kāraṇaṃ sat, tadaiva kāryabhāve hetuphalayoḥ samasamayatā iti
athavā sāmpratikaṃ kāryaṃ pūrvamuttaraṃ vā kāraṇaṃ svakāle janayati, tadapi svakāraṇasvakāle tadapi svakāraṇaṃ svakāle iti utpattikālānavasthiteḥ akramam
sati kāraṇe yadi kāryaṃ tadā sarveṣāmuttarottarakāryabhūtakṣaṇānāṃ pūrvapūrvakāraṇakāle saṃkramāt ekakṣaṇamātraṃ jagat
pūrvamuttaraṃ vā kāraṇaṃ sāmpratikaṃ kāryaṃ svakāle pūrvakāle uttarakāle vā janayati
atha mā bhūdayaṃ doṣa iti kālabhūto hetuphalayoriṣyate; tatrāha--tasminnasati ityādi
tasmin kṣaṇike kāraṇe asati atīte vināśe, na bhāvinyanutpannasattvena, kāryakāle avidyamāne bhavato jāyamānasya kāryasya kuto nimittāt na kutaścit
punariti vitarke tadanantarotpattiniyamaḥ tasya kāryasya kāraṇānantarotpattiniyamaḥ
tasya vā kāraṇasya yo'nantaraḥ kālaḥ tatro tpatti niyama iti
tasya kāryasya aniṣṭakālotpattiḥ pūrvabhāvitvenābhimataṃ paścāt syāt, paścādbhāvitvena vā pūrvaṃ syāt, iti nānumeyādivyavahāro niyataḥ syāditi manyate
kāraṇa sati bhāvatohetukatvam ahetośca na deśādiniyamaḥ iti
yaduktaṃ svayameva pareṇa nityaṃ sattvamasattvaṃ vā pra॰ vā॰ 1
syādetat kālāntare svayameva bhavataḥ kāryasyāyaṃ doṣo na kāraṇāt bhinnadeśamiva bhinnakālamapi kāraṇaṃ kāraṇameva, yathādarśanaṃ tadvyavasthānāt
dṛśyate ca prabodhakāle asadapi jāgradvijñānaṃ tatkāraṇamiti; tatrāha--sadeva ityādi
sadeva nāntaṃ samarthaṃ kāryajananayogyaṃ kāraṇaṃ kartṛ kāryaṃjanayet
kiṃ kālam ? ityāha--svasattākālameva ātmasattākālameva prasahya haṭhāditi
atrāyamabhiprāyo yathā nityaṃ yadaiva svayaṃ samarthaṃ tadaiva prasahya kāryaṃ janayet i tyucyate tathā kṣaṇikamapi
yadi punaḥ pūrvaṃ samarthamapi kṣaṇikaṃ kāryakālameva kāryaṃ janayet tatsvabhāvatvāt; tathā nityamapi
tanna yuktam--kṣaṇikatvena kāryajanakatvaṃ vyāptam iti, anyatrāpyaviśeṣāt
atha svakāle samarthe'pi kāraṇe kāryaṃ svabhāvataḥ paścājjāyate; tatrāha--svarasataḥ ityādi

svarasataḥ svabhāvataḥ kāryasya utpattikālaniyame kasyacidanantaram, aparasya kālāntare utpattiniyamaḥ utpattikālaniyamaḥ tasminnaṅgīkriyamāṇe svatantrasya svapradhānasya kuta eva kāryatvaṃ nityapakṣavat iti manyate
paratantraṃ hi kāryam, parasmin samarthe avaśyaṃ jāyate iti
parasya tu darśanam— pūrvamanantaraṃ kāraṇam aparaṃ kāryamiti; tatrāha--nairantaryetyādi
kāryakāraṇayoḥ nairantaryaṃ vyavadhānābhāvaḥ tanmātrāt prabhavaniyame hetuphalaniyame kuta eva niyamo na kutaścit ? kutaḥ ? ityāha--sarvatretyādi
sarvatra kārye anyatra ca sarveṣāṃ kāraṇānām itareṣāṃ ca aviśeṣe nirantaratvasaṃbhavāt kuta eva niyama iti
nanu sarvatra kāryakāraṇā bhāve'yaṃ doṣaḥ iti sa na bhavet iti cet; atrāha— dravyasya ityādi
dravyasya jīvādeḥ prabhavaniyame aṅgīkriyamāṇe na kaścida nantaramatiprasajyate
paro'nyaḥ pratyayaḥ sahakārikāraṇaṃ yasya tasya bhāvaḥ tattā tasyām
syādetat nānantaryamātrāt tanniyamaḥ api tu sādṛśyāt, pūrvaṃ sadṛśamupādānam itarad upādeyamiti cet; atrāha--nacetyādi
keṣām ? bhāvānāṃ sādṛśyāt samānarūpatvāt prabhavaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ santatiḥ santānaḥ, veti samuccaye, vyavasthāpyeta
tadviparyaye'pi sādṛśyaviparyaye'pi na kevalamaviparyaye tathā prabhavasantatiprakāreṇa upalabdheḥ bhāvānām iti sambandhaḥ
yadi vā, tadviparyaye'pi prabhavādiviparyaye'pi tathā sādṛśyaprakāreṇa yamalakādivad bhāvānām upalabdheḥ iti
sādṛśyamabhyupagamya idamuktam, yāvatā bhedaikānte tadeva nāsti iti darśayannāha--sādṛśyaṃ ca ityādi
sādṛśyaṃ ca śabdo dūṣaṇasamuccaye yathā yathā yena yena bhedābhedādiprakāreṇa vicāryate tathā tathā viśīryeta

pra jñā ka ra gu pta sya ca nityatvavat sādṛśye'pi kathaṃ pramāṇavṛttiḥ iti cintyatām ? yathaiva hi madhyakṣaṇagrāhiṇā pratyakṣeṇa pūrvāpara kṣaṇayoragrahaṇe na tadgataikatvasya grahaṇaṃ tathā sādṛśyasyāpi
nīlo nirbhāsa ākāro yasya tacca tajjñānaṃ ceti tasyeva tadvaditi
śrutamayī bhāvanā parārthānumānarūpā cintāmayī ca bhāvanā svārthānumānarūpā, tābhyām anumānarūpābhyāṃ yogijñānaṃ nirvikalpakaṃ jāyate ityarthaḥ
evaṃ nairātmye niraste sati yatsiddhaṃ taddarśayannāha--prāptetyādi
kiṃbhūtaḥ ? ityāha--prāptau vyaktitirobhāvau yena sa tathoktaḥ
nanu dṛśyād yadi adṛśyaṃ rūpam abhinnam, dṛśyameva syāditi cet; syādeva tadevaṃ yadi vastusattāpekṣāṇi grahaṇāni syuḥ yāvatā puruṣaśaktyapekṣāṇi
puruṣo yadi samarthaḥ kiñcit atyantamapi bhinnena saha gṛhṇāti yathā candramasā svāṅgulim
viparītaḥ punarapi bhinnenāpi saha na gṛhṇāti yathā candraparvatayoḥ saṃlagnatādarśī tadvivekena tāviti
atha dṛśyasya adṛśyena sahaikatve kharaviṣāṇenāpi syāt; tarhi dṛśyasya nīlākārasya jñānasya dṛśyenāpi pītākāreṇa ekatve sarvasya syādaviśeṣāt
atha yathā kasyacinnīlajñānasya kenacit pītākāreṇa ekatvaṃ pratīyate, naivaṃ sarvasya sarveṇa; tarhi yathā candraparvatayoḥ tadvivokana naivaṃ kharaviṣāṇena iti samānam
anupalabdhi na kathamiti cet ? puruṣāntareṇopalambhamānena syāt, anyathā anumānenāpi pratīyamānena kṣaṇikatvena ekatvaṃ śabdāderna syāt, svayaṃ vā punarupalabhyamānena
kutaḥ paścād upalabhyamānaṃ pūrvopalabdhasya rūpamiti cet ? tathāpratīteḥ iti brūmaḥ, akrameṇeva krameṇāpi citraikavastugrahaṇaprasādhanāt
nanu yadyātmā bodhasvabhāvaḥ, sarvadā tadrūpatvāt svāpādyavasthābhāvaścet; atrāha--sa jīvaḥ svāpādiprabodhāvātmānau yasya iti
evaṃ manyate--yathā prabodharūpe'pi pratibandhakāraṇavaśāt prāptavyaktitirobhāvau yugapat tathā krameṇāpi svāpādiprabodhātmeti
yastu manyate--svāpādāvanupalambhāt tadabhāva iti; tasya tata eva sarvatra kṣaṇakṣayābhāvaḥ
tadupalambhe svāpādau jīvopalambhaḥ kinna syāt ? atra tadabhāvaḥ; anyatra anumānādyabhāvaḥ
nanu yathā kṣaṇikatvavyavasthāpakaṃ sattvādi liṅgam, naivaṃ tatra ātmavyavasthāpakaṃ kiñcit iti cet ? prabodhaḥ iti śiṣmaḥ
nahi ciravyatīte upādāne jāyamāne kārye ubhayaprasiddhamudāharaṇamasti
sarvaṃ sarvasya tathāvidham upādānam, ciravinaṣṭaṃ cedupādānam
yadi punaretanmataṃ parasya garbhādimaraṇaparyanta eva jīvaḥ siddho nānādyanantaḥ pramāṇābhāvāt
na ca tena paralokavādinaḥ siddhenāpi kiñciditi
tathāhi--yad dravyaṃ tadanādyanantātmakaṃ yathā pudgaladravyaṃ pṛthivyādidravyaṃ ca jīvaḥ
nanvasau jīvaḥ saṃsārasvabhāvo'nyathā vā bhavet ? prathamapakṣe--nirvāṇaprahāṇam
kadācit saṃsārarūpaḥ anyadā anyathā iti cet; anityatvamiti tadabhāvaḥ iti cet; atrāha--saṃsāram ujjhati iti
saṃsāraṃ garbhādisaṃcaraṇam tatkāraṇaṃ bhāvakarma dravyakarma ca ujjhati tyajati sāmagrīviśeṣavaśāt
saṃsaraṇalakṣaṇāt guṇāt svarūpād mokṣarūpo guṇaḥ tadantara tasyādhānaṃ samyagdarśanādinā svādhāravyavasthāpanam, tasya pratiṣeddhumaśakyatvāt
kiṃbhūtasya ? ityāha--dravyāśrayasya dravyam āśrayo yasya iti
nahi nityaikasvabhāvaḥ tasya ātmā āśrayo yuktaḥ
vyatireke na tasya tau; asambandhāt, samavāyaniṣedhāt
kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇaṃ prati vyakti-virodhābhāvau samanubhavato jīvasya kramavṛtteḥ tathaivā'pratiṣedhāt
nanu yasyāṃ pratibodhāvasthāyāṃ vyaktiḥ na tasyā tirobhāvaḥ, yasyāṃ svāpādyavasthāyāṃ tirobhāvo na tasyāṃ vyaktiḥ, ato'darśanāt tatra taṃ bhāva iti cet; atrāha--svāpa ityādi
tadanupapatteḥ kiṃ jātam ? ityāha--anādirayaṃ svasaṃvedanapratyakṣagrāhyo jīvaḥ
evaṃ manyate--yathā svāpādidaśāparigataḥ punaḥ prabuddho bhavati, prabuddho vā taddaśāparigataḥ, tathā jīvo'nādiḥ
na jīvo'nādiḥ api tu jñānakṣaṇasantānaḥ, tatraiva bandhamokṣavyavastheti cet; atrāha--santānasyāpi ityādi
santānasyāpi na kevalaṃ bandhamokṣayoḥḥ pariṇāminaṃ bhāvamantareṇa niyamāsaṃbhavāt
sarvaḥ santānaḥ sarvasya yasyā tanniyāmakasya prabhavādervyabhicārāt, saṃsāre nirvāṇe vā ekaḥ siddhaḥ
tanu yo'sau saṃsāranirvāṇayorekaḥ tatastayoravyatireke abhedaḥ syāt
yo hi abhinnādabhinnaḥ so'pyabhinna eva yathā svarūpam, abhinnau ca abhinnāt saṃsāramokṣau iti cet; atrāha--paratvavyāvṛte
paratvaṃ nānātvaṃ saṃsāranirvāṇayoḥ aikāntikaṃ yat tasya vyāvṛtteḥ tatra ekaḥ siddhaḥ
tayoḥ naikāntena abhedo bhedo vā; anyathā saṃsāranirvāṇayorekādhikaraṇatvābhāvāt anupādānaṃ nirvāṇaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ
nanu hetuphalabhūtāḥ kṣaṇā eva pratyakṣā nātmā kaścit
teṣu ekapratītistu sato palambhena sadṛśāparotpattyā vā vipralambhena āropitaviṣayā yamalakavat māyāmālakavacca
tato cetatkṣaṇe eva paramārthasantaḥ naikatvamiti cet; atrāha--akramam ityādi
tāṃ punaranityatāṃ paśyannapi mandabuddhirnādhyavasyati sattopalambhenasarvadā tadbhāvaśaṅkāvipralabdhaḥ sadṛśāparotpattivipralabdho vā...--pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 2
nāpi bahirantarvā pratikṣaṇaṃ paramārthato bhedopalabdhiryathā vyāvarṇyate, pratyakṣasya vipratipattiviṣayatvāt nirviṣayatvāccānumānasya
na vai kiñcijjñānaṃ sanmātratattvaṃ vyabhicarati bhedeṣveva vyabhicārāt

svaparasantānavikalpasya mithyāvabhāsād bhedaikānte'pi kutaḥ siddhiḥ ? vyāpārādibuddheśca samīhāmātravyabhicāre pāramparyeṇāpi kriyā'vyabhicāraḥ kinna syāt yato bahirarthasiddhirna bhavet ? svaparakramavikalpānāṃ sarvathā'vidyātmakatvāt sarvavikalpātītaṃ tattvamiti; tadanupapattiḥ pramāṇābhāvāt bhedaikāntavat
kena kāraṇena tathāvidhaiḥ taiḥ tadābhāti ? ityāha--avidyayā iti
avidyayā mithyājñānena, na punarvidyāyā abhāvena tasya hetutvāyogāt
tattvaṃ jñānalakṣaṇaṃ yathā bahirantarmukhākāraiḥ sadbhiḥ ābhātyavidyayā tathā sat
tato'bhedavat bhedo'pi na paramārtha ityevamapare saugatādanye sattaikāntavādino viduḥ iti
idaṃ vyākhyānaṃ sundaraṃ yadvakṣyati vṛttau--navai kiñcijjñānaṃ sanmātratattvaṃ vyabhicarati bhedeṣveva vyabhicārāt iti
athavā yaduktam--saṃsāre nirdvāṇā vaika siddhaḥ iti; tatsatyam; kintu sa sakalapuruṣapariṇāmādikalpitaḥ syāt
yadi vā brahmaiva paramārthasat aparavidyāvaśādābhātīti vādikalpitaḥ syāt
nanu yadakramaṃ tatkathaṃ kramavadābhāti iti cet ? atrāha--bahirityādi
asyā'yamarthaḥ— yathā'kramaṃ vijñānatattvaṃ bhedavādinaḥ bahirantarmukhākāraiḥ sadbhirābhāti tathā prakṛtamapi iti
saṃbhavato viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ iti avidyayā iti viśeṣaṇam anenaiva sambadhyate na pūrveṇa
nanu yadi sattāmātraṃ tattvaṃ kathaṃ kārakādibhedapratītiḥ iti cet ? atrāha--bhedaikānte'pītyādi
na kevalam abhedaikānte sattaikānte kintu bhedaikānte'pi kāryakāraṇabhāvaniṣedhāt kāra kāṇāṃ kartrādīnāṃ jñāpakānāṃ pratyakṣādīnāṃ sthitiḥ navai naiva paramārthataḥ kintu kalpanātaḥ
nanu bhedaikāntasya pramāṇaviṣayatvāt tatra tatsthitiḥ paramārthata iti cet; atrāha--pratikṣaṇam ityādi
kathaṃ nāsti ? ityāha--yathā yena kṣaṇikaikaparamāṇvākāraprakāreṇa vyāvarṇyate saugataiḥ bhedopalabdhiḥ tena prakāreṇa
nahi tad vādiprativādinoḥ avigānena prasiddham, yena tataḥ kiñcit siddhaṃ cet avivādaṃ syāditi na saugatena tadekānte sādhanaṃ vācyam
na cānyakalpanayā siddhaṃ nāma kasyacit sādhanaṃ vā anyathā buddhicaitanyayorbhedasiddhirevaṃ kinna syāt ?

syānmatam--mā bhūt ekaikaparamāṇuniṣṭhasya pratyakṣasiddhiḥ tato vā vastunaḥ; vyavahārāttu parasya syāt, tato bhedopalabdhirapi syāditi cet; atrāha--pratyakṣasya viruddhā vicitrā vā pratipattiḥ anekāntapratipattiḥ tadviṣayatvāt
mā bhūt pratyakṣāttadupalabdhiḥ anumānāt syāditi cet; atrāha--nirviṣayatvācca anumāna syeti
sāmānyaviṣayamanumānam anyat sāmānyaṃ so'numānasya viṣayaḥ nyāyabi॰ 1
sāmānyaṃ ca parasya na kiñcit, tato marīcikājalajñānavat nāto vastusiddhiriti bhāvibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadi pratyakṣaṃ pūrvaṃ paścācca bhedaikāntaviṣayaṃ syāt yuktametat--tata utpatteḥ tadavyabhicārācca tatrānumānaṃ pramāṇamiti, na caivamiti

yatpunaretat parasya matam--yadyapi bahirantaśca bhedavadabhedasyāpi pratibhāsaḥ tathāpi bheda eva pāramārthiko'vyabhicārāt nabhedo viparyayāditi; tatrāha--na vai kiñcidi tyādi navai naiva kiñcit pratyakṣam anyadvā jñānam tanmātratattvaṃ vyabhicarati
kva tarhi tasya vyabhicāraḥ ? ityāha--bhedeṣveva vyabhicārāt jñānasyeti
tato bhedavadabhedasyāpi na vā kasyacit siddhiriti
nanu sattāmātraṃ cet tattvam; tarhi pratipādyapratipādakabhedavirahāt kutaḥ kaḥ tattvaṃ pratipādyata iti cet ? atrāha--svetyādi
svo vādī paraḥ prativādī tayoḥ santānau tayorvikalpasyā vya vasāyasya bhedasya vā mithyāvabhāsād bhedaikānte'pi kutaḥ siddhiḥ bhedaikāntasyeti
tathāhi— svasantānapratyakṣasya vipratipattiviṣayatvāt, anumānasya nirviṣayatvāt, parasantānaviṣayasya svapne tadabhāve'pi vyāpārādiliṅgabhāvāditi bhāvaḥ
atha jāgraddaśāyāṃ paracetaso vyāhārādiḥ sākṣāt, svapne paramparayā, tato na vyabhicāra iti; atrāha--vyāpāra ityādi
vyāpārādibuddheśca samīhā ceṣṭā saiva tanmātram tatrāvyabhicāre aṅgīkriyamāṇe

api śabdāt sākṣāt tadavyabhicāre iti grāhyam, kriyā'vyabhicāraḥ kriyā vyāpāravyāhārātmiṃkā iha gṛhyate, kriyāgrahaṇam upalakṣaṇaṃ tena ghaṭāderapi grahaṇam, tadavyabhicāraḥ kinna syāt ? syādeva tadbuddheḥ iti sambandhaḥ, yato'vyabhicārasyā bhavanād, bahirarthasiddhirna bhavet

evaṃ manyate--yathā svapne artharūpakriyāvirahe'pi tadavabhāsadarśanāt anyadāpi tadvirahe'pi tadavabhāsa iti nārthasiddhiḥ tathā svapne parama samīhā'bhāve'pi vyāpāravyāhāranirbhāsabuddherbhāvād anyatrāpi tadabhāve'pi tadbhāva iti na santānāntarasiddhiḥ iti
etena svapnāntikaśarīramavitathaṃ kalpayan vinivārito draṣṭavyaḥ bahirarthā'nirākaraṇāt
atra pra jñā ka ra matamāśaṅkate dūṣayituṃ svaparetyādi
sva sva śca paraśca kṣa maśca hetuphalabhāvaḥ teṣāṃ vikalpo vyavasāyaḥ
anena teṣāṃ pratyakṣaviṣayatāṃ darśayatāṃ darśayati tasya
tasya sarva vikalpātītasya tattvasya anupapattiḥ tadanupapattiḥ
tathāhi--na tatra pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇam, anekāntātmakasukhādighaṭādivyatirekeṇa tadanupalabdhiḥ
na ca dharmadharmivikalpābhāve anumānaṃ vikalpetarasvarūpābhāve ca
na kevalamabhedaikānte api tu bhedaikānte'pi kārakajñāpakasthitiḥ na vai naiva paramārthataḥ kintu puruṣapariṇāmapakṣa iti bhāvaḥ
anena akramaṃ kramajanmādyaiḥ sadbhirābhāti iti vyākhyātam

svasaṃvedanādhyakṣasya grāhyagrāhakasaṃvittibhedarūpasya vipratipattiviṣayatvāt, indriyapratyakṣasyāpi anekāvayavarūpādyātmakadhāti pattiviṣayatvāt, nirviṣayatvācca mithyāvikalpavāsanopakalpitasvāṃśamātraviṣayatvādvā'numānasya kutaḥ pratyakṣādanumānādvā bhedaikāntasya siddhiḥ pariṇāmasyaiva syāditi manyate
kim ? vijñānaṃ sanmātratattvaṃ saṃvedanaṃ mātra tattvaṃ sadanaṃ satsaṃvedanamityarthaḥ
vyabhicarati sarveṣām ātmanām saṃvedanāpekṣayā ekātmakatvād eka evātmā paramārthasannityarthaḥ
kva tarhi vyabhicāraḥ ? ityāha--bhedeṣveva sukhādiṣveva vyabhicārāt jñānasyeti
nanu svaparasantānabhedāt kathaṃ puruṣamātramiti cet ? atrāha--svaparetyādi
anena akramaṃ kramajanmādyairasadbhiravidyayā bhāti iti vyākhyātam
sarvasya sarvato vyāvṛtti ḥ bhedaḥ tasya ekāntaḥ tasyeva tadvad iti
kutaḥ ? ityāha--pramāṇābhāvāt sarva puruṣasyaikasya pariṇāmaḥ ityatra pratyakṣasya pramāṇasyābhāvāt
nahi yathā ekasantānapatiteṣu sukhādiṣu ahamahamikayā askhaladekatvapratyayaviṣayatvaṃ tathā sarvasya tanottasura sukhādiṣu ghaṭādiṣu ca
yo'pi tatra yacceta vīti pratītiḥ so'pi samānapariṇāmaviṣayā, naikatvaviṣayā, tattathānanubhavanāt
na cānyapratīteḥ anyaviṣayasiddhiḥ, anyathānīlapratīteḥ pītasiddhiḥ syāt
na caikātmapariṇāmitvamantareṇa jagataḥ kiñcidanupapannaṃ yataḥ tatparikalpanaṃ syāt
nanu pramāṇābhāvāt ityasiddham, puruṣa evedam ṛk॰ 10
2 ityādi āgamasya bhāvāditi cet; na; asya adhyakṣabādhitatvena anāgamatvāt pi ṭa ka tra yā divat, tadantarasadbhāvācca
yadi vā, tasyāmalasya nirvikalpasya brahmaṇāṇo'nupapattiḥ tadanupapattiḥ
bhidyate anyasmāt sarvataḥ iti bhedā daḥ niraṃśajñānaṃ tasyeva tadvad iti
tadabhāvo'pi pratyakṣasya vipratipattiviṣayatvāt cetanetarabhedaviṣayatvāt, nirviṣayatvācca anumānasya
tatrāpīdaṃ vaktavyam--kutaḥ siddhiḥ abhedaikāntasya iti ? āgamo'pi yadi tato'nanyaḥ; tadvadasiddhiḥ
na ca tadeva pratipādyaṃ pratipādakaṃ ca, virodhāt
āgamapratipattireva vā asmin darśane tatpratītiḥ iti kastatra āgamasyopayogaḥ ?
kiṃca, āgamād brahma vā tatsvarūpaṃ pratipadyeta, anyo vā ? prathamapakṣe--
svavittirahitaṃ brahma yadi vetti, tataḥ katham
tanna vettyātmanā rūpa svasaṃ brahma tataḥ punaḥ
anyena vedane tasya tadadvaitaṃ kathaṃ bhavet || 7
anyo'pi vettimātmānaṃ yadi so'stu kathaṃ hi san
brahmavad vittisadbhāvaḥ tasya syāt svayameva cet || 10
brahmaṇā vedanaṃ tasya yadi bhaṇyeta bhāvataḥ || 11
ye bhāvān vacanaṃ teṣāṃ nānumānena bādhyate || vākyapa॰ 1 | 38 iti
avidyaiva mataḥ so'pi tvayā cedāgamaḥ katham
tatastattvaṃ pratīyeta sa vā kena pratīyatām
avidyā kathamucyeta vidyāyāḥ paṇḍitaiḥ svayam | iti
itaśca naikāntato bhedo'bhedo vā'rthānāmiti darśayannāha--bhedābhedātmaka ityādi
tadavidyātmakaṃ cet kenāyaṃ pratipakṣamandhāyati ? samāropavyavacchedasyāpi tattvāpratipattyātmakatvāt kutastattvaṃ pratipadyeta ? yadimau nānyonyamatiśayāte yataḥ paramārthasattvābhāvaḥ pratīyate
tanna yathādarśanameveyaṃ mānaneyaphalasthitiḥ api tu paramārthataḥ, paramārthābhyupagamānyathānupapatteḥ avyavasthāprasaṅgāditi
bhedaikānte saṃviditasya asaṃviditākārāsaṃbhave bhrāntireva na kvacit syāt
prastāvād arthānām ekasantānasukhādīnām na santānāntarāṇāṃ tatra abhedā'nabhyupagamāt
anyathā anyena bhedasyā'bhedātmatvābhāvaprakāreṇa anupapattitaḥ bhedasya arthānām iti vā yojyam
yathaiva hi teṣāṃ bhedā'bhāve nārthakriyādayaḥ tathā abhedā'bhāve'pi
bhedātmakaḥ tathā tena anyathānupapattiprakāreṇa abhedaḥ tattvamane kāntataḥ tataḥ
nanu sarvasya grāhyasya taimirikakeśādivadasattvāt arthānām ityayuktamiti cet; atrāha--pramāṇam ityādi
kasya sambandhi ? ityāha— mārgapratipatteḥ yo yenābhyupagato mokṣopāyaḥ sa tasya mārga iṣyate
abhyupagatā ca saugatena prameyāsatyatā nirvāṇopāyaḥ, tataḥ saiva tasya mārgaḥ, tasya pratipatteḥ
na hi sā pramāṇatāmantareṇa sidhyati viṣayavat
tat pramāṇaṃ ced yadi avidyātmakaṃ svarūpe'pi ca bhrāntam

evaṃ manyate--svapne ghaṭāderavidyātmakatvadarśanāt anyadāpi pareṇa tasya tattvamiṣyate, tadubhayatra tattvadarśanāt pramāṇasyāpi tadiṣyatām iti kena hetunā ayaṃ saugatalokaḥ pratipakṣaṃ sakalasya paramārthasattve mandhāmati

nanu na saugataḥ kasyacit kenacit tattvato'sattvaṃ sādhayati yenā'yaṃ doṣaḥ, kintu paramārthasattvābhāve yadāropitaṃ bahirantarvā pareṇa tatsattvaṃ tadeva anumānena avidyātmanāpi nirākriyate iti cet; atrāha--samāropa ityādi
paramārthasattvarahite'pi paramārthasattvajñānaṃ samāropaḥ tasya vyavacchedo nirāsaḥ tadanumānaṃ vā tasyāpi na kevalaṃ pratyakṣasya tattvāpratipattyātmakatvāt
yathaiva hi pratyakṣāt tathā tadvyavacchedādapi na tattvapratipattiriti
na tato'pi tatpratītiriti cet; atrāha--kuta ityādi
tattvaṃ mithyātvaṃ pratipadyeta vibhramā'siddheḥ iti bhāvaḥ
yad yasmāt tattvapratipattirūpādiyau vicāryamāṇau bhedā'bhedaikāntau dravyaparyāyaikāntau na anyonyamatiśayate yataḥ paramārthasattvābhāvaḥ pratīyate
tadasti svasaṃvedanādhyakṣaṃ paramārthata iti cet; atrāha--tanna ityādi
tat tasmāt sarvavikalpābhāvapratītirūpāt svasaṃvedanāt na yathādarśanameveyaṃ mānameyaphalasthitiḥ
357 kathaṃ tarhi sā ? ityāha--api tu kintu paramārthataḥ
paramārthasya sakalavibhramādisvabhāvasya yo'bhyupagamaḥ tasya anyathā anyena tattvato mānameyasthityabhāvaprakāreṇa anupapatteḥ hetoḥ tattvataḥ sā iti sambandhaḥ
nanu tadabhyupagamaśca syānna ca tattvataḥ tatsthitiḥ; ityāha--avyavasthāprasaṅgāditi
vibhramādikamevāsti na nityatvādikam ityabhyupagamasya yā vyavasthā tadabhāvo'vyavasthā tasyāḥ prasaṅgāt tattvataḥ tatsthitiḥ iti
nanu bhavatu arthā bahirantaśca, tathāpi teṣāṃ bhedātmako'bhedo abhedo vā bhedātmakaḥ kutaḥ, virodhāditi cet ? atrāha--bheda ityādi

bhedaikānte saṃviditasya cetanasya itarasya vā jñānena viṣayīkṛtasya vastunaḥ asaṃviditaḥ tadaiva tenaiva jñānena aviṣayīkṛto ya ākāraḥ kṣaṇikakakāryajananasāmarthyaviṣayākāravivekādilakṣaṇaḥ tasyā'saṃbhave tasya sarvātmanā saṃvedanāṅgīkaraṇe ityarthaḥ, bhrāntireve na kvacid bahirantarvā yāda bhrāntiḥ sarvatra syāt ityevakārārthaḥ
tathā bhedaikānte saṃviditasya cetanasya itarasya vā saccetanādirūpeṇa asaṃviditasyāvidyāvivekarūpasyā'saṃbhave bhrāntireva na kvacit syāt
saṃvedanasya svaparagocarajñānasya kaṃcana ākāraṃ kṣaṇikatvādikaṃ rūpaṃ saṃvṛṇvato vibhramasyaivā'yogāt

tathā ca prayogaḥ--yasya yo viṣayo'saṃvṛtaḥ tasya na tatra bhrāntiḥ, yathā vivakṣitasaṃvedanasya saccetanādyākāre, asaṃvṛtaśca jñānasya sukhādarvivādāspadībhūta ākāra iti nānumānaṃ bhrāntivyavacchedaphalaṃ nāma
iṣyate ca pareṇa bhrāntiḥ, tato manyāmahe--saṃviditākāra iti
nanu bhavanmate'pi yathāvasthitāśeṣapadārthagrahaṇasvabhāvasya jīvasya kathaṃ bhrānta saṃbhava iti cet ? atrāha--jīvasya ityādi
jñānasvabhāvo jīvaḥ cetanasyāpariṇāminaḥ acetanasyā'pariṇāminaḥ jīvasya niṣedhāt nairātmyāsiddheśca tadanyathātvaṃ dravyāntarasambandhāt madādivat
yadi punaḥ karmaṇāmeva kartṛtvabhoktṛtvaprabandho'nādiḥ; nirātmakādayanna viśiṣyeta, svabhāvāntarānavadhāraṇāt kṣaṇakṣayādivat
cetanasya tadeva karma sākṣāt saṃsāranimittaṃ na punaḥ prayatnasadharmā jīvapariṇāmaḥ
samīcīnā, yathāvasthitāśeṣavastugrahaṇarūpā vā, tattadāsyena sthitā vā vibhramahetutvā'yogāt, itarathā yasya kasyacit karmaṇo yasya kasyacid bhrāntiḥ iti nābhrāntiḥ kaścit syāt
yathaiva hi devadattavibhramahetuḥ madirādiḥ tasya tathaiva karmāpi
atha atadīyo'pi sūryagrahaṇādiḥ tadvibhrame hetuḥ, śukle vastre tataḥ pītajñānadarśanāt tato vyabhicāra iti cet; na; tatsambandhe tadraśmīnāṃ tadīyatvāt
nanu karmasambandhe jīvasya na cet svarūpahāniḥ; na tatastadbhrānti ḥ, ataḥ muktetarāviśeṣaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati-- yathā madirādisambandhe tasya kathañcidanyathābhāvaḥ, anyathā mattetarā'viśeṣaḥ santānabhedo vā, tathā karmasambandhe'pi iti
yo'pi manyate--na tasya madirāderapi svarūpānyathābhāvo nityatvāt api tu madāvasthā tato'rthāntarabhūtā jāyate iti; tasyottaram--tadavasthāyāstato bhede na sa mattaḥ syād ātmāntaravat
tasyāḥ tena anubhā vāt matta iti cet; kathamevaṃ yogī na syāt
atha avasthā tatkāryatvāt tasya ityucyate; īśvarāderapi ucyatām aviśeṣāt
niṣiddhaśca nitye hetuphalabhāva iti na kiñcidetat
mattaḥ na syāt tena madāvasthāyāḥ pratyakṣeṇānubhavāt
samavāyasya nityatvāt sarvagatatvācca na tato viśeṣaḥ, tasya sarvatrāviśeṣāt
jīvasya svaparāvabhāsanasvabhāvasya yā bhrāntiḥ tasyāḥ tatkarma madirādivat pratīyate ityadhyāhāraḥ
kiṃ punaḥ tattasyā yato'numīyata iti cet ? atrāha--nimittamiti
yato nityatvādyekāntabhrānteḥ madirādivat karma nimittam, tataḥ tattataḥ pratīyate
tathāhi--prāṇināṃ nityatvādyekāntabhrāntiḥ tatsambandhadravyāntaraviśeṣapūrvikā, tattvāt, madirādyupayogino digādibhrāntivat
yo'sau taddravyāntaraviśeṣaḥ sa naḥ karma iti me
pare prāhuḥ--upalādauna kadācid bhrāntirbhavatu tadupayuktadravyaviśeṣapūrvikā tathā darśanāt, kṣaṇakṣayādyekāntabhrāntistu satpūrvabhrāntinimittā, parasya karmaṇo'nyasya vā nimittasyādarśanāditi
nanvevam aṅkuro'pi adṛṣṭabījaḥ tatpūrvako na bhavet
atha tajjātī yasya tatpūrvakatvadarśanāt tasyāpi tathānumānam; prakṛte'pi samānamidam
yathā ca indriyabhrāntayaḥ tathā manobhrāntayo'pi mattasya dravyāntarasambandhāt pratīyante
athā viśiṣṭopadeśādapi tadbhrāntayo dṛśyante; tā api tadupadeśasahakāriṇaḥ karmaṇaḥ karmaṇa eva madirādivat

api ca tadbhrāntereva bhrāntisaṃbhave ciragāḍhasuptotthitasya kutaḥ tatsaṃbhavaḥ, svāpādau manobhrānterabhāvāt, punastathaivā'smaraṇāt, tathāpi tatra tadabhyupagame na saṃhṛtāśeṣavikalpāvasthāsaṃbhavaḥ kasyacit
tajjñānamātrasyāpi tatrānabhyupagamaḥ; na ca vyavahitaṃ kāraṇam ityuktam
tannityatve bhrānte na uparama iti cet; atrāha--āgantukamiti
tasmāt jñānamātramapi svāpādau na svīkriyate iti śaṅkākartuḥ prajñākarasyābhiprāyaḥ
kāraṇasyākṣaye teṣāṃ kāryasyoparamaḥ katham | nyāyavi॰ 1 | 103 iti
evamapi pūrvaṃ śuddhasya tato muktavat kathaṃ karmaṇā sambandha iti cet ? atrāha— tasya ityādi
tasya karmaṇaḥ prapañca pravāho'nādiriṣyate, tatkāryaprabandhasyānāditvaprasādhanāt tadgatiḥ
jñānasvabhāvo jīvaḥ kuta etat ? ityatrāha— cetanasyā'pariṇāminaḥ sāṅkhyakalpitasya acetanasyā'pariṇāmino vaiśeṣikakalpitasya, jīvasya niṣedhāt nirākaraṇāt nairātmyā'siddheśca kāraṇāditi
jñānasvabhāvasya anyathātvaṃ kuta iti cet ? atrāha--tadanyathātvamiti
tasya jīvasya anyathātvaṃ bhrāntatvaṃ dravyāntarasambandhāt ātmadravyād anyat karmadravyaṃ danaṃtaraṃ tena sambandhāt
yathā madādi tadanyathātvaṃ tatsambandhāt tathā prakṛtam
nanu na kutaścit tasya anyathātvaṃ nityatvena anādhārā'praheyātiśayatvāt, kevalaṃ karmaṇāṃ prakṛtipariṇāmaviśeṣāṇāṃ śarīrendriyādikaraṇāt kartṛtvaṃ sukhaduḥkhādinaṃdyati vyaktihetutvād bhoktṛtvam
puruṣe tu bhoktṛtvamupacāreṇākartṛtvāt paramārthena tadabhāvāditi cet; etadeva darśayannāha--yadītyādi
paramatasya sūcane yadīti, pakrāntarassa punarati karmaṇāmeva nātmanaḥ ityevakārārthaḥ
etad dūṣayannāha--nirātmakānna viśiṣya teti--nirātmakād ātmābhāvapakṣād ayaṃ pakṣo na viśiṣyeta na bhidyeta, kartṛtvabhoktṛtvarahitasya sato'pyātmano'sadaviśeṣāt iti bhāvaḥ
na kaścidatiśayaḥ ādhātuṃ prahātuṃ vā śakyate ityarthaḥ
atha mataṃ dravyāntarasambandhakṛtānyathātvalakṣaṇaṃ bhoktṛtvaṃ tasya na vidyate arthāntarabhūtasya sukhāderanubhavanalakṣaṇaṃ tu vidyate caitanyaṃ puruṣasya svarūpam yogabhā॰ 1
caitanyātmakasukhādyanubhavarūpabhoktṛtvasvabhāvādanyo nityanityaniravayavadarśanasvabhāvaḥ tadantaraṃ tasya anavadhāraṇād aniścayāt kṣaṇakṣayādivat
tarhi prayatnasya samavāyāt kartṛtvaṃ sukhaduḥkhādidarśanasya bhoktṛtvam ātmano na karmaṇām ityeke

ātmano jīvāparanāmnaḥ tathā tena prayatnasukhādidārśaprakāreṇa yaḥ pariṇāmastamantareṇa prayatnaśca sukhaduḥkhādi vā diśabdena icchādiparigrahaḥ darśanaṃ ca prayatnāde rūpādeśca buddhiḥ teṣāṃ samavāyikāraṇasya bhāvaḥ tattā tasyā anupapatteḥ tadanyathātvamiti padaghaṭanā
kuta etat ? ityāha--anupayogāditi prayatnādirūpeṇapariṇāmāt, pariṇāmikāraṇasyaiva samavāyikāraṇatopapatteḥ iti bhāvaḥ
tulanā--ekamevedaṃ harṣaviṣādādyanekākāravivartaṃ paśyāmaḥ tatra yatheṣṭaṃ saṃjñāḥ kriyantām
yatrotkalitaṃ kāryaṃ jāyate tat samavāyikāraṇamiti cet; kimidaṃ yatrotkalitam iti ? yatra samavāyena sambadham ityuktaṃ
tathāpi taddarśanakalpane varam avayavā'vayavinoḥ guṇaguṇinoḥ jātitadvatoḥ kathañcittādātmyamavigānadṛṣṭamastu
na kevalaṃ tayostādātmye meva viruddham api tu darśanakalpanamapi, adṛśyasya
na ca svarūpeṇa kasyacid virodhaḥ; niḥsvabhāvatāpatteḥ
nanu na darśanāt samavāyavyavasthā, api tu tatkāryataḥ
tacca kāryam kim ? ityāha--avayaveṣu avayavī iti pratyayaḥ iti cet; na; tādātmye'pi tadupapatteḥ
iha tantuṣu paṭaḥ iti ko'rthaḥ ? teṣu kathañcittādātmyena varttate ityarthaḥ, yato vivakṣātaḥ paṭe tantavaḥ ityapi pratīyate
na ca prathamaṃ rūpādirahitasya paṭasyotpattiḥ pratīyate'dhyakṣataḥ yena tadrūpādyutpattau tanturūpādīnām asamavāyikāraṇatā syāt, rūpādisahitasyaiva utpattidarśanāt
āśuvṛtteḥ tathādarśanābhimāna ityapi vārttam; sarvatra tathā prasaṅgāt
svaśabdena paṭarūpaṃ gṛhyate, tasya kāraṇaṃ paṭaḥ, tatkāraṇeṣu tantuṣu samavāyi tanturūpaṃ paṭarūpaṃ pratyasamavāyikāraṇam
atha matam--bhavatu ātmanaḥ tathāpariṇāme prayatnādisamavāyikāraṇatopapattiḥ, tathāpi jainasya kiṃ siddham ? ityāha--cetanasya ityādi

cetanasya prayatnasukhaduḥkhādidarśanapariṇāmasya tadeva dravyāntararūpameva karma saṃsāranimittam iṣṭāniṣṭaśarīrādikāraṇaṃ sākṣāt, tadantaraṃ hīnasthānaparigrahadarśanāt mattasya aśucisthānaparigrahavat
na punaḥ prayatnasadharmā jīvapariṇāmaḥ; tasya akāraṇatvāt
atha deśādiprāptervāñchāpūrvakatvadarśanāt sau ca tannimittam; na; aśucisthānapātinā mattena vyabhicārād ityevakārārthaḥ
kuta etat tadeva karma tannimittam ? ityatrāha--dravyāntaretyādi

dravyāntaraṃ vyākhyātam, tena sambandhasya udayo yathākālaphaladānam udīraṇā apakvapācanam ādiśabdena dravyāntarasaṃskārādiparigrahaḥ, tasya vaśāt mithyādarśanādeḥ mithyārucyādeḥ ādiśabdena mithyājñānaparigrahaḥ, vikārasya jīvapariṇāmasya darśanāt
evaṃ manyate--saṃsāriṇo jīvasya āgantukasukhaduḥkhādikaṃ dravyāntarabandhodayodīraṇavaśāt āgantukatvāt mithyādarśanādivat
tayo yaduktaṃ pareṇa--vivādāspadībhūtaṃ sukhaduḥkhādikaṃ saṃsāriṇaḥ prayatnasadharmaṇā tadguṇena kṛtam, kāryatve sati tadupakārakatvāt grāsādivat iti; tannirastam
atha sākṣāt; tarhi dravyāntarasambandhāt tadvikārasya sākṣād darśane'pi anyahetukalpane anavasthā
bhavatu tadeva saṃsārakāraṇamiti cet; atrāha— tatparikṣayāt karmaparikṣayāt mokṣa iti
tathāhi yat yannimittaṃ tat tadabhāve na bhavati yathā bījābhāve aṅkuraḥ, karmanimittaśca saṃsāra iti
tulanā--devadattaviśeṣaguṇapreritabhūtakāryāḥ tadupagṛhītāśca śarīrādayaḥ kāryatve sati tadupabhogasādhanatvāt gṛhavaditi
īśvaraprerito gacchet svargaṃ vā śvabhrameva ca
kālaḥ sṛjati bhūtāni kālaḥ saṃharate prajāḥ
saṃharantaṃ prajāḥ kālaṃ kālaḥ śamayate punaḥ
kālaḥ saṃkṣipate sarvāḥ prajā visṛjate punaḥ
kālaḥ supteṣu jāgarti kālo hi duratikamaḥ
atītānāgatā bhāvā ye ca vartanti sāmpratam
tān kālanirmitān buddhvā na saṃjñāṃ hātumarhasi
puruṣa evedaṃ sarvaṃ yadbhūtaṃ yacca bhāvyam--ṛk॰
prakṛtermahānsāṅkhyakā॰ 22 ityādivacanāt prakṛtiḥ kāraṇam, na karmaiva iti;
kalpayatā'pi iti padena etena etaddarśayati--uktavidhinā na tatra kiñcit pramāṇam, kevalaṃ kalpanāmātramiti
kevalam anyeṣāṃ muktātmanāṃ saṃsāriṇāṃ cāviśeṣeṇa tat tannimittaṃ syād api tu tasyāpi īśvarasyāpi īśvaraḥ saṃsāranimittaṃ syāt
yathaiva hi niḥkarmaṇāṃ jīvānāmasau saṃsārakāraṇaṃ tathā tathāvidhasyanmāno'pi syāt
atha sarvajñatvād ātmanatta duḥkhena yojayati; tata eva paramapi nirdoṣaṃ na tena yojayet śuddhavipastada saṃvāt
dṛśyante hi tayā praraṇikā pūraṇikāḥ ātmānaṃ citsārayantaḥ
svabhāvata eva sa tannimittam ityapi nānena parihṛtam
na cādarśane paratraiva sa tasya svabhāvo nātmani iti vibhāgo yuktaḥ
yadi vā tasyāpi īśvarasyāpi saṃsāranimittam anye jīvāḥ
akarmaṇāṃ hi sarvajñatvādinā guṇena jīvānāṃ viśeṣābhāvāt
nanu kimucyate tadabhāva iti, yāvatā tadbhāve sa tannimittamiti cet; atrāha--yathākarmasambandham ityādi
atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--na karmaṇā īśvarasya tena vā karmaṇaḥ kiñcit kriyate, kevalaṃ tayoranyo'nyasahakāriṇoḥ kārye vyāpāraḥ
karmaṇā vā prerita īśvaraḥ kāryaṃ janayati nakarmetaravat , īśvareṇa vā karma acetanatvād vāsyādivat iti ? tatra prathamapakṣe yathākarmasambandham ityādi

yasya prāṇino yaḥ karmasambandhaḥ surūpānyathā vā jhaṭiti phaladāyānya thā vā tadanusāreṇa yathākarmasambandhaṃ pravarttane tatsambandha sahakāriṇamāśritya kāryajanmani īśvarasya pravṛttāvaṅgīkriyamāṇāyāṃ paramaiśvaryānupapattiḥ atiprasaṅgāt ityetad atrāpyanuvarttate
tathāhi--karmasahakāriṇaḥ tasya kāryaṃ kurvato'pi yadi pāramaiśvaryam; kālāderapi syādaviśeṣāt
atha īśvaro jñatvājñatvāt kāryakāraṇakalāpaṃ kāryaṃ janayati anyathā kālādiḥ viparyayāt, tato'yaṃ viśeṣa iti cet; kutastasya tatparijñānasiddhiḥ ? jananāt; kālādinā vyabhicāraḥ
ātmatve sati tajjananāt ityapi nottaram; gāḍhasuptena svavyāpāravyāhārahetunā vyabhicāraḥ
sarvavyāmoharitattve sati iti cet; tadapi kutaḥ ? sarvajñānāt; anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ--sarvavyāmohavirahasiddhau tatparijñānam, ataḥ tatsiddhiriti
bhavatu vā tatparijñānam, tathāpi tato'sya na viśeṣaḥ akiñcitkaratvāttatparijñānasya
yo hi karmavaśāt akarttavye pravarttamānamajñaṃ jñāttvā karttavye pravartayati janam, tasya parijñānaṃ phalavat, ayaṃ punaḥ tatraiva
yadi yādiva yathākarmasambandha pravarttane sarvajñatvādinā guṇena yat pāramaiśvaryaṃ tasyā'nupapatteḥ karmaiva tannimittam

tathāhi--karma acetanamapi yadi yathākālaṃ kāryajananasamartham; tata eva tanniṣpatteḥ kim īśena tajjñena ? nahi tathājananāsamartham anyasannidhānena janayati, anyathā yavabījaṃ śālyaṅkuraṃ tatparijñānavataḥ sannidhāne kuryāt

atha tasya tatsāmarthyaṃ tena kriyate; tarhīśena karma janyate na kāryam iti kathaṃ sa tatsahakārī tajjanayati ? dvayamapi sa eva iti cet; kuta etat ? anyataḥ tathāvidhajanakakarmā'saṃbhavāditi cet; īśvarasya tatkāryadvayajanane kutaḥ sāmarthyamāyātam ? ahetukam; sarvatra syāt, itarathā anyatrāpi kiṃ hetoḥ kāryaniyamakalpanena ? tatsāmarthyasya nityatvādadoṣa iti cet; na; tanniṣedhāt
svahetoḥ iti cet; karmaṇo'pi tata eva iti kim īśena ? iti sthitam--yathā ityādi
atha karmaṇā īśvaraḥ preritaḥ, tena vā karma kāryakṛt iṣyate; tatrāha--viparyaye vā ityādi
uktakramād anyaḥ kramo viparyayaḥ, sa ca seśvarakarmavādimate'nantara eva saṃbhavati, tasmiṃśca pravarttane pāramaiśvaryānupapatteḥ karmaiva tannimittam
tathāhi--pṛthagjanavat karmaṇā preritasya tasya pravarttane na tato viśeṣaḥ
kiñca, tena preritaḥ, pṛthagjana eva sa kāryaṃ vidadhātu kimīśapreraṇena ? acetanamapi tat īśaṃ prerayati na tajjñā namiti kiṃkṛto vibhāgaḥ ? anyena preritamīśaṃ prerayati ityayuktam; anavasthāpatteḥ
tathāhi--varaṃ kāryameva tena kṛtaṃ kiṃ karmapreraṇena ? yasya kārye'sāmarthyaṃ tasya tatpreraṇe sāmarthyam atiśraddheyam
karmaṇa eva vā tadastu kiṃ tatprerakeṇa

atha acetanaṃ tad vāsyādivat ceranā niścitameva kārye pravarttate tadadhiṣṭhāpakasya jñānādeḥ kathaṃ cetanatvaṃ ghaṭādivat ? asmadādivat syāditi cet; tadetadasat; yadasatā samudāyahṛtam ; asmadāderapi tato bhede; na cetanatvam

sato'pi sarvagatatvenā'viśeṣāt kiṃ kva jñānam ? atha sambandhāviśeṣe'pi sambandhaviśeṣa iṣyate; kuta etat ? svabhāvata iti cet; tadapi kutaḥ ? tathā darśanāt; yuktametad yadi gaganādiparihāreṇa īśvara eva kiṃ deva jñānaṃ dṛśyeta
sa eva paśyatīti cet; kośapānāt pratyeyam
svabhāvata eva ca sambandhiniyame kiṃ samavāyena ? iheti pratyayo'pi tata eva bhaviṣyati
tanna parasya kaścit cetano yaḥ tasya adhiṣṭhātā syāt
tathā ca anīśvarasya anityajñānādisvabhāvasya kāryatvam iti, taddṛṣṭāntena īśvarasyāpi tatprasaktamiti tasyāpi anyo dhīmān karttā, tataḥ pāramaiśvaryānupapattiḥ iti
pradhānaparamāṇukarmāṇi prāk pravṛtteḥ buddhimatkāraṇādhiṣṭhitāni pravartante acetanatvāt vāsyādivat
kiṃca, yadi sarvamacetana naṃ cetanādhiṣṭhitameva kārye pravarttate ityekāntaḥ; tarhi yasya yat karmādi sa eva tasyāpidhiṣṭhātā iti vyartham īśvarakalpanam
tadajñāne tatkatham ityapi nottaratvātklottaratvāt suptasyā'jñāne'pi svāṅgāvayavapreraṇaṃdarśanāditi
yadi punaridaṃ codyam--śarīrasambandhāt prāg aśarīrasya kathaṃ tadadhiṣṭhātṛtvamiti ? tadīśvare'pi samānamiti darśayannāha--jīvopayoga ityādi
vitanukaraṇasya punaricchayā jīvopabhogayogyaśarīrādikaraṇaṃ kathaṃ saṃbhāvyeta ? tadutpatraviśeṣāt, pratiṣiddhaṃ ca
tatpariṇāmopagame'pi samavāyikāraṇatvasthitvāpravṛttyādeśca pariṇāmina eva saṃbhavāt pravartanālakṣaṇāḥ doṣāstajjanmahetavaḥ kathanna syuḥ ? ata eva karmasambandhopapatteḥ
cetanakṛtaṃ kiñcidupabhogayogyaṃ saṃprekṣya sarvatra kalpanāyāṃ satanukaraṇakṛtiḥ kinna prasajyeta ? tathā ca anavasthā
ca śabdo apyartho bhinnaprakramaḥ īśvarasya ityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ
na kevalamanyasya anīśvarasya api vītu īśvarasyāpi
kaiḥ ? ityāha--śarīrakāraṇādibhiḥ ādiśabdād bhuvanādiparigrahaḥ, abhedopacārāt tadgatāḥ kāryatvādayaḥ śarīrakaraṇādayaḥ ucyante

kiṃbhūtaiḥ ? ityāha--jīvāpayogayogaiḥ īśvarād anyajīvā gṛhyante, tasya īśvarasya ityanena abhidhānāt, teṣāmupayogaḥ tajjananavyāpāraḥ tatra yogyaiḥ yathā īśvareṇa te niṣpādayituṃ śakyāḥ tathā anyairapi ityarthaḥ
tasya kā kimanumīyate ? ityāha— icchā sisṛkṣā
yathā vitanoranyasya taddhetuḥ sonānumīyate tathā īśvarasyāpīti bhāvaḥ
yadi vā caśabdaḥ avadhāraṇe, īśvarasyeva kimanumīyatām ?
nanu yathā īśvarasya tatkaraṇe sāmarthyam, naivamanyasyeti cet; yuktametad yadi tathādarśanaṃ syāt
atha īśvareṇa sarvasya jananāt kimanyeneti cet ? etadapi yuktaṃ yadi kutaścit siddhaṃ syāt, yāvatā śarīrādikāryadarśanāt īśo'pyanumīyate
tacca nānāvidhamiti tathāvidham ātmanaḥ karttāramanumāpayanti ghaṭapaṭanagarārāmādivat

atha kenocyate--ekasya karaṇadarśanād ekaḥ pratīyate ? pratīyatām yadi kārye tadvijñānānugamaḥ syāt, na caivam śabdaha ścevaṃnanidhatratyatrāparā prāha--sakalaṃ jagad eko'vayavī tasya prāsādavad anekakartṛsaṃbhave'pi sūtradhārasamānena ekena sakalakārakagrāmavedinā bhavitavyam iti; tadapyayuktam; yataḥ ekasyāpi bhāgaśaḥ anekasūtradhārasaṃbhavāt
vitanukāraṇasya ityādinā kārikāṃ vyākhyātu śarīrendriyetyādi pūrvamupacati tanvādisaṅgamanubhavatisaṃsāriṇa ityarthaḥ
svayam ātmanāna īśvarādinā, utpattuḥ gatadisaṃbandhitayā jāyamānasya
kiṃbhūtasya ? ityāha--aniṣpannakāyakaraṇasya katham ? na kathañcit, ātmāpayogyayogyaniṣpādanasāmarthyam
notpattuḥ tanniṣpādanasāmarthyamapi tu tadviparītayoḥ pitroḥ iti cet; atrāha--niṣpannetyādi
na ca tadeva tatra vyāvṛttiḥ pratimaithunamapatyotpattiprasaṅgāt iti bhāvaḥ
karmmaṇātatra vyāvṛtti riti cetyādi tatkṛtiḥ śarīrendriyādirna saṃbhāvyeta
kutaḥ kasya sā saṃbhāvyata ityāha--pāriśeṣyāt ityādi
prasaktapratiṣedhe anyasiddhiḥ pāriśeṣyaṃ tasmād īśvaraḥ kāraṇam
tathāhi--śarīre tipādikāryaṃ kāraṇāvinābhāvi, tasya ca uktavidhinā nānyat kāraṇam iti pāriśeṣād īśvaraḥ ityevaṃ vaiśeṣikādayaḥ
icchayā śarīrādikaraṇaṃ vāñchayā kathaṃ saṃbhāvyeta ? kim ? ityāha--jīvopabhoga ityādi
tasyecchā tādṛśī kuto'vagamyate ? īśvarasya kutaḥ ? kāryaniṣpatteḥ; anyatra samānam
janmottarakālaṃ tadicchātaḥ kuto na kāryam ityapi nottaram; īśvarecchāsarveka kāryaniyātaṃ

syānmatam--ātmanaḥ śarīrādisambandhakaraṇe na kasyacid icchā asti, satī vā kathaṃ nedānīṃ sarvaiḥ smaryate iti; tanna sāram; yataḥ tasyārthasyamaraṇepyanivāraṇāt asmaraṇaṃ mathāpi viśiṣṭam, sāmarthyam ubhayatra sandigdhamiti manyate
sa cāsau utpattā vanenā viśeṣād īśvarasyeti
yata eva viśeṣo'ta eva varamīśvaraṇa siṣṭaḥ evaṃ tadārādhanād dharmasiddheḥ iti cet; atrāha--pratiṣiddhaṃ ca ityādi
nanu mama buddhimatkāraṇamātrasiddhyā prayojanam, tatkāraṇam īśvaro bhavatu paro vā pariṇāmyeva iti cet; atrāha--samavāyītyādi
tasya īśvarasya anyasya vā pariṇāmopagame'pi, apiśabdaḥ pakṣāntarasūcakaḥ
samavāyikāraṇatvaṃ ca sthitvāpravṛttiśca ādiśabdena nimittakāraṇatvādiparigrahaḥ tasya pariṇāmina eva saṃbhavāt iti
pravartanālakṣaṇā doṣā rāgādayaḥ kathaṃ na syuḥ naiva īśvarasyeti
kiṃbhūtāḥ ? ityatrāha--tajjanmahetavaḥ tacca tanu śarīrendriyādisambandhalakṣaṇaṃ janma tasya hetavaḥ, tasyāpi saṃsāra itarajīvavat syādityarthaḥ
tasya doṣāstitve kiṃ pramāṇamiti cet ? atrāha-- pravarttamānānāṃ jantūnāṃ preraṇā pravarttanā saiva lakṣaṇaṃ cihnaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ
tathāhi--yaḥ paramamiṣṭa karmaṇā yojayati sa rāgādināmave tano yathā dhyāno ? yojayati ca tena paramīśvara iti
rāgādyabhāve'pi tasya tatpravarttanā'virodhādanaikāntiko heturiti cet; atrottaram tanvādikaraṇād ityādi bhaviṣyati
sato'pi tasya rāgādayo na karmasambandhakāraṇaṃ devatāviśeṣatvād yathā mayūrasya viṣaṃ na ramaṇa kāraṇam
ata eva doṣasadbhāvata evaṃ karmasambandhopapatteḥ tajjanmahetavaḥ kathanna syuḥ iti ? anyathā sarvasyāpi tatastatsambandhabhāva iti manyate
evaṃ tāyat svayuktyā saṃsāritvaṃ tasya darśanam
cetanakṛtaṃ sūpādi kiñcit, na sarvaṃ tathā, pramāṇābhāvāt parasya iti nirūpitam bhūtā bhavyāḥ siddhivi॰ 3
tatkiṃ kṛttvā ? ityāha--saṃprekṣya dṛṣṭvā sarvatra sarvasmin upabhogayogyakalpanāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ cetanakṛtatvasya iti sambandhaḥ
tathā ca paraprayogaḥ--rājyādivānnarendrādibhiḥ kenacit cetanāvatā kalpitaṃ bhujyate, bhogyatvāt, sūpādivat
yo'sau te kaḥ saṃbhavāvān maheśvara iti

tatra parihāraḥ— satanukaraṇakṛtiḥ tanukaraṇavatā karaṇam upabhogayogyasya kinna prasajyetau ca atrāpi sa eva prayogo dṛṣṭānto'pi sūpakāra eva tathā ca tenā ca svaśarīrādikam anyena tadanubhujyate, tenāpyanyena ityanavasthā iti bhāvaḥ
athāsau atanukaraṇa iṣyate anyena vā dattaṃ śarīrādi bhuṅkte; na; atrāha--dṛṣṭetyādi

paropabhogayogyasya sūpādeḥ karaṇam, dāna vā satanukaraṇasya sūpakārādeḥ anyadattaṃ jātasya vā dṛṣṭam tadvyatikrame kriyā ? kriyamāṇe svakarmaṇaḥ bhokturyadātmīyaṃ karma tasya tatsāmarthyaṃ bhoktrupabhogayogyakaraṇasāmarthyaṃ kalpayituṃ yuktam
yathā acetanasya cetanānadhiṣṭhitasya tatsāmarthyaṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ tathā cetanasya vitanukaraṇasyāpi na dṛṣṭam

nanu svaśarīrakaraṇasaṃcaraṇakaraṇaṃ prāṇabhṛto vitanukaraṇasyaiva sarvasya dṛṣṭam, tatsaṃcaraṇakaraṇe aparatanukaraṇāderabhāvāt, tattena dṛṣṭavyatikrama iti cet; ucyate--svāpādyavasthasya vicetanasyāpi na dṛṣṭavyatikramaḥ
nahi tasyāmavasthāyāṃ pareṇa cetanā'bhyupagamyate yatastadā cetanaḥ puruṣaḥ syāt
jainopagamāt tadā tadastitve tadupagamādeva sarvasya śarīrāntaraṃ kārmmaṇaṃ tatsaṃcaraṇakāraṇaṃ sidhyet

atheśvaraḥ tadavasthasya tatsaṃcaraṇakāraṇaṃ tato'yamadoṣaḥ; tarhi sa eva satanukaraṇaprāṇabhūtaḥ tatsaṃcaraṇakāraṇamiti nātanukaraṇasya tatsaṃcaraṇahetutva dṛṣṭaṃ kutaḥ vicetanātātprerakasya ? tathādarśanāt; satanukaraṇasyāpi
yataḥ ātmā paraloke śarīrāntaraṃ prati saṃcarati
atrāha paraḥ--neśvarasya janmahetavodoṣāḥ, tadrahitasyāpi ca saṃsāranimittatvam iti; tatrāha--tattvād ityādi
muktātmanāṃ tanukaraṇādiduḥkhopayogamakurvataḥ svayaṃ svaprerakaṃ karma īśvaro'vaśyamapekṣate yataḥ tadicchāmātraṃ sannidhāpayati tata eva dehādikaṃ niṣpādayet kimīśvarecchayā ? tadvaramīśvara eva
taccādī nāṃ karaṇād bhavakleśena saṃsāraduḥkhena kasmāt kutaḥ kāraṇāt na kutaścit yojayet sattvān prāṇinaḥ svayam ātmanā droham aparādhamakurvataḥ īśvaraḥ, sarvasyātmano buddhimattvā'vyabhicārāt
buddhimāniti vacanāt nirdoṣayā sakalaviṣayayā buddhyā tadvyāt gṛhyate jantubhiḥ ityādinā
athāparādhamakurvato'pi tān tairyojayati; tatrāhyanya thā aparādham kurvato'pi yo'pi yojayati ityanyathāśabdārthaḥ, prekṣāpūrvakāritānupapattiḥ
tatra yadyasau tāṃstairna yojayati saṃsārābhāvaḥ syāditi saṃsārapravṛttyarthaṃ taistān yojayatīti cet; atrāha— bhavakleśa ityādi
tādṛśena prekṣāpūrvakāriṇā na bhavakleśahetunā iti bhāvaḥ

yadi punarmatam--nā'kṛtāparādhatān svayamīśvaraḥ saṃsāradaduḥkhairjantūn yojayati, api tu bhūtaireva tādṛśāni karmāṇi kṛtāni yaḥ preryamāna taiḥ tadyojane kṣamayyau dāsīnyaṃ na labhata iti; tatrāha--sakarmaṇāṃ vā ityādi
sakarmaṇāmeva na niṣkarmaṇāṃ jantūnāṃ dehādikarmaṇi hetuḥ
prāṇisthaṃ dehādihetuḥ kinna īśvarādvinā īśvaramantareṇa sakarmaṇām iti sambandhaḥ
evaṃ manyate--yayā pratyāsattyā karmāṇi īśvaraṃ prerayanti tayanti tayā dehādi hādikunviti

nanu dehādikarmaṇīśvarecchāyāḥ pravṛttirheturiti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ kṛtaḥ, dūṣaṇaṃ punarīśvara evocyate, pūrvapakṣānusāriṇā ca dūṣaṇena bhavitavyamiti cet; na; tāsthātātātsthyāt tacchabdamiti icchayā īśvaraḥ tena ca sādhya iti na doṣaḥ
muktātmanāṃ tanukaraṇādiduḥkhopayorāma kuvarvakutaḥ akarmakatvātteṣām, sakarmaṇāmeva kurvanti ityarthaḥ
svayaṃ svasya prerakam īśvaro'pekṣate karmetyādyavaśya niyamena
yataḥ yasmāt sāmarthyāt tadicchāmātram īśvarecchāmātraṃ sannidhāpayati tata eva māhātmyāt dehādikaṃ tato niṣpādayedacetanam kim īśvarecchayā ? dūṣaṇāntaramāha— tadvaramityādi
nanu na kenacit prerito'sau tannimittam, api tu krīḍayā iti cet; atrāha--muktātmano'pi ityādi
na kevalaṃ sakarmaṇām api tu muktātmano'pyakarmaṇo'pi kurvan syāt dehādīḥ krīḍānaḥ nānyathā
na siṣṭa parihāreṇa rājā kṛtadoṣaṃ vadhabandhanādinā yojayan krīḍano nāma
muktātmano'pi tatkaraṇe siṣṭa na syāditi cet; kiṃ krīḍanasya
tayā tasyāpi karotīti cet; atrāha--kiṃ buddhimān naiva krīḍana iti sambandhaḥ
kiṃca, yadi krīḍanaḥ san dehādīn dehināṃ vidadhāti maheśvaraḥ, tadā śubhakāriṇo'pi narakādinā yojayed aśubhakāriṇo'pi svargādinā iti tadārādhanādikamanarthakam; etadevāha--yojayedi tyādi
yojayet jantūn dehādibhiḥ iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha--bhavitavyatāvaśāt na śubhāśubhakarmavaśāt kathaṃ naiva saṅkareṇa yojayet ityarthaḥ
etena padmavikāsakāraṇabhāsvata iva tasya dehādikaraṇe svabhāvaḥ cintitaḥ
nanu dehādīnāmārambhakā avayavā buddhimadadhīnāḥ svakāritvāt tantvādivat
tathā, śarīrādayo buddhimatkāraṇakāḥ svārambhakāvayavasanniveśaviśiṣṭatvād acetanopādānatvāt kāryatvāt paṭādivat iti cet; atrāha--sthitvā pravṛttītyādi
buddhimatkāraṇādhiṣṭhitaṃ mahābhūtādivyaktaṃ sukhaduḥkhādinimittaṃ bhavati rūpādimattvāt turyādivat
dharmādharmau buddhimatkāraṇādhiṣṭhitau puruṣasyopabhogaṃ kurutaḥ karaṇatvāt vāsyādivat
...buddhimatkāraṇādhiṣṭhitāni svāsu svāsu dhāraṇādikriyāsu mahābhūtāni vāyvantāni pravartante acetanatvāt
naiva tanukaraṇādīnāṃ buddhimaddhetukatve sthitvāpravṛttiḥ arthakriyākāritvaṃ vā hetuḥ vyabhicārāt

nanvetad īśvarasādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ pūrvaṃ jīvopayogayogyaiḥ ityādinā dūṣitamapi kimarthaṃ punardūṣyate iti cet ? na; pūrvam itarad vitanoḥ śarīrādikaraṇasāmarthyaṃ nirastam, idānīṃ tatsādhanaṃ nirākriyate iti vibhāgaḥ

sthitvā pravṛttiśca viramya kārye vyāpāraḥ saṃsthānaviśeṣaśca svārambhakāvayavasanniveśabhedaḥ arthakriyā ca kāryaḥ kāraṇāntāḥ ādayo yeṣām, ādiśabdena kāryatvādiparigrahaḥ, te, anyathaiva īśvarābhāvaprakāreṇa upapadyeran tato viruddhā iti
nanu vipakṣa eva bhavan viruddho hetuḥ, ayaṃ tu sapakṣe'pi ghaṭādau varttate, vyabhicārī tu syāt

atha nityeśvaraviruddhe pariṇāmini varttate iti viruddha ucyate; tasyaiva sādhane kathaṃ viruddhaḥ ? nityatvapratijñāvyāghāta iti cet; na; bhavato'pi lokaṃ khalu akṛtrimaḥ ityasya tatsādhane'pi virodhaḥ
ce tasya pariṇāmitve kāryatvena anyeśvarapūrvakatvam anavasthākāri, anyathā anaikāntiko hetuḥ iti cet; ayameva tarhi doṣo'stu kimapareṇa iti cet; na; anyathā vyākhyānāt
evakāro nipātatvād apiśabdārthaḥ, tataḥ anyathāpyupa ca raṃstato neśvarahetavaḥ ityarthaḥ
yadi vā, ya evaṃ vadati nityo'śarīro maheśvaraḥ śarīrādikāraṇam iti; tadapekṣayā evakāro'vadhāraṇe, anyathaiva na bhāva evopapadyeran tato na īśvarahetavo viruddhatvāt
sthitvā pravṛttiḥ arthakriyākāritvaṃ vā na hetuḥ
svayam ātmanā īśvaravādinā'bhimatatvāt sthitvāpravṛtteḥ arthakriyākāritvasya ca
nityagrahaṇena tatrāyam buddhimatkāraṇābhāvaṃ darśayati, ātmagrahaṇena svakārye'nacetanādhiṣṭhitatvābhāvam, anyathā anavasthā syāt
yastarhi saśarīramanityajñānam īśvaraṃ kāraṇamicchati tasya kathaṃ doṣaḥ ? ityāha--pareṣām ityādi
evaṃ manyate--īśvarasya jñāna-tanukaraṇabhuvanādīnyupakaraṇāni yadi tatkarmaṇo bhavanti parasyāpi tata eveti kim īśvareṇa ? tadadhiṣṭhitāditi cet; etadapi nā'nena utsṛṣṭam
ati tyajñānasya de śvarasya sakalopakaraṇādijñānaṃ pra mā ṇa saṃ gra habhā ṣye nirastam
kiṃca, svatanvādikaraṇe yadyat yāvat paraṃ tadapekṣeta saṃsāritvam itaravat
anapekṣaṇe anyatanvādikaraṇe'pi kiṃ tadapekṣaṇena ? vitanukaraṇo'pi svasya dehādikaṃ sampādayanti na parasya iti mahatī prekṣāpūrvakāritā ! etadeva darśayannāha--vitanukṛteḥ ityādi
ka ṇa ca ra sya a kṣa pā da sya ca dehādīnām īśvaraṃ kāraṇaṃ vadataḥ svavacanavirodham idānīṃ darśayannāha--saṃsāra ityādi
sū tra kā raḥ ātmāditattvajñānāt niḥśreyasādhigamaṃ paraṃ puruṣārthamāha
sa eva saṃsāraṃ paraṃ sūcayati, yataḥ dehādirīśvarahetuḥ
tadanayoḥ parasparavirodhāt sū tra kā ra sya buddhimattvaṃ kathaṃ kalpyeta ? kaḥ prekṣāvānapavargamacaitanyaṃ pratīyate tadviṣayaṃ śāstraṃ kuryāt yato neśvaro buddhimān ? tanna, anyasyā'saṃbhavāt
deha ādiryasya sakalakāryagrāmasya sa tathoktaḥ tasya īśvaro nityo vyāpī yadi heṃ śāstre ka ṇa ca rā dervacana sa vā vihanyate bādhyate

kutaḥ ? ityāhā saṃsāra sukhasaṃvittikṣayāt, saṃsāro janmamaraṇādiprabandhaḥ sukhagrahaṇamupalakṣaṇaṃ duḥkhādeḥ, saṃvittiḥbuddhiḥ duḥkhādivitsaṃ cetairapi grahaṇe prāpte tadupādānaṃ pṛthak mokṣasyāsyā'yuktatāṃ pratipādayitum, tāsāṃ kṣayāt
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadā sarvotpattimatām ekasvabhāvo nityo vyāpīśvaraḥ kāraṇam; tadā sarvaṃ sarvadā sarveṣāmaviśeṣeṇa dehādaya iti na tatkṣayāt mokṣaḥ
taduktaṃ nyā ya vi ni śca ye--
kāraṇasyākṣaye teṣāṃ kāryasyoparatiḥ katham | nyāyavi॰ 1 | 103 iti
bhava nityasyā bhāve yā 'tiśayasya kācidapekṣā ityuktam
tanu tatkṛya syāpi sa eva kāraṇaṃ tatkathaṃ tadanupapattiriti cet; saṃsāranirvāṇapurapraveśaḥ
tato mokṣamicchatā prakṛtyādivad īśvaro'pi tatkāraṇaṃ nābhyupagantavya iti
kiṃ bhūtam ? ityāha--mokṣāhvakaṃ mokṣasya sannidhānaṃ yasminniti
tathāhi--sarvadā ātmano dehādikartṛtvaṃ pratipadyamāna eva saṃsārodikṣo yān mokṣahvakaṃ śāstraṃ vadan tadabhāvaṃ vadatītyeṣa virodhaḥ
atha tacchāstraṃ tatpraṇītaṃ na bhavatyanyato bhāvāt; na sarvamīśvarakṛtam, tena vyabhicārāt
athavā, yaduktam karmaparavaśaḥ kiṃ buddhimānavenama tiśete saṃsāriṇaṃ vā''tmānam iti ? tattva parakīyaṃ tadbuddhimattvasādhanamāśaṅkya dūṣayannāha--saṃsāretyādi
kiṃ kṛttvā taddheturasau ? ityāha--saṃsārasukhasaṃvittikṣayāt tatkṣayamāśritya śuddhasukhasaṃvittīḥ samāśritya iti yādeva marthaṃ ca saṃsāragrahaṇam, itarathā sukhasaṃvittigrahaṇameva kuryāt
kiṃ kurvan samāśritya taddhetuḥ pratīyate ? ityāha--vadan mokṣātmakaṃ śāstram, mokṣagrahaṇaṃ tadupajñāśeṣatattvopalakṣaṇārtham
tadyathā--yadi śuddhaṃ sukhaṃ saṃvedanaṃ ceśceṣṭaṃ tadeva pareṣāmapi vidhātavyam, na śarīrādi
yadi punaḥ na śarīrā ye ca ? ātmāno'pi tadeva kuryāt
atha karmaṇaḥ sahakāriṇaḥ paratra bhāvāttatraiva tatkuryāt nātmani viparyayāt; karmāpi iṣṭatayā ātmani vidhātavyam, anyathā nānyatrāpi
tasya tadā tadahetutve kathamavyabhicāro hetūnām ? athavā śāstra vihanyata pramāṇena iti vyākhyātavyam
kārikāṃ vyākhyātumāha--sū tra kā ra ityādi
sū tra kā raḥ a kṣa pā dā diḥ paraṃ puruṣārthamāha
kutaḥ ? ityāha--ātmādeḥ tattvajñānāt, neśvarāt; anyathā tadvaiphalyam
īśvarā yāvat tattvajñānotpādanātyāyā tmānaṃ kleśayati tāvanmokṣameva vidadhātu ityetadanena darśayati
sa eva sū tra kā raḥ saṃsāraṃ mukteḥ paraṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ sūcayati
yata evaṃ tattasmāt anayoḥ sū tra kā ra vacasoḥ parasparavirodhāt buddhimattvaṃ kathaṃ kalpyeta sū tra kā ra sya iti
yadi vā, sūtrakāro maheśvaraḥ sarvasya tatpūrvakatvāt aparaṃ pūrvavat
ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ buddhimattvaṃ kathaṃ kalpyeta īśvarasya iti
athavā, a kṣa pā dā tyiprepa sādhigamamāha, dehādiḥ sūcayatīti vākyabhedena vyākhyātavyam

tatrāpyevaṃ vākyabhedaḥ tadanayoḥ īśvarakārayoḥ sūtrakāraye buddhimattvaṃ kathaṃ kalpyeta ? parasya īśvarabuddhimattvasādhakaṃ kaḥ ityādyāśaṅkate dūṣayitum— kaḥ prekṣāvān atīndriyārthadarśī apavargam upalakṣaṇametat aśeṣā''tmāditattvasya

kiṃbhūtam ? acaitanyaṃ cetanārahitatvaṃ pratīyate, ta tadviṣayaṃ śāstraṃ kuryāt na kaścit ? sugatāderasambaṃdhābhidhāyitvāt ka ṇa ca rā de śca tadupadeśādeha samīhitasiddheḥ yato'nyasya taṃpratipannā neśvaro buddhimān
yata iti vā''kṣepe yato na buddhimān ? tadvāneva
kutaḥ ? uktaprakārādanyasya muktiprakārasya saṃbhavāvevamanyante yathā īśvarasya anantajñānasvabhāvasya sataḥ tadvivanuka karmāpāye yadā sarvajñatvaṃ na kadācidācaitanyaṃ tathā'nyasyāpi
viśeṣaḥ punarayameva bhavansyāpagamena kasyacit svābhāvikastadapāyo'nyasyopāyāt, tato'nyāvimuktiṃ prati yatata iti
tulanā--na hi guṇādivināśāt jaḍaḥ, guṇaguṇivināśāt śūnyaḥ, bhogyavirahāt tadabhoktā--laghī॰ svavṛ॰ ślo॰ 76
na vai nirvāṇam abhavituḥ nirātmakam aśeṣaguṇavaikalyaṃ sātmakaṃ dṛśyadarśanarahitam śiṣmaḥ dravyāntaravat
kiṃ tarhi ? malakṣayāt jīvasya ātmalābhaṃ maṇivat
tathā sati neśvaro buddhimān aśeṣaguṇavaikalyarūpamokṣābhidhānāt, na kaṇabhakṣādiḥ tadarthaṃ tadvacanāt pravṛtteḥ, parasparaviruddhābhidhānāt buddhavat
tatra niravaśeṣasyāvidyārāgādikasya kleśagaṇasya prahāṇāt sopadhiśeṣaṃ nirvāṇamiṣyate
yatra tu nirvāṇe skandhamātramapi nāsti tannirupadhiśeṣaṃ nirvāṇam
