nirgata upadhiśeṣo'sminniti kṛtvā, nihatāśeṣacauragaṇasya grāmamātrasyāpi vināśasādharmyeṇa
tulanā--tasmāttatsaṃyogād dṛśyasyopalabdhiryā sa bhogaḥ, yā tu draṣṭuḥ svarūpopalabdhiḥ so'pavargaḥ
taṃlābhaḥ kutaḥ ? ityāha--antarmalakṣayāt jīvasya svabhāvā'nyathābhāvo'ntarmalam tasya kṣayāt
kiṃ viduḥ ? mokṣaṃ ata eva na caitanyamanarthakaṃ grāhyaśūnyaṃ tasya taṃ viduḥ
svaparaprakāśanalakṣaṇasya pratibandhābhāve nitarāṃ lakṣaṇābhivyaktiḥ na punarabhāvaḥ
jīvādravyādanyad dravyaṃ pṛthivyādi tadantaram tasyeva tadvat
yathā niḥsvabhāvatābhayāt na pṛthivyāderaśeṣaguṇavaikalyaṃ tathā jīvasyāpi
kiṃbhūtaṃ tarhi tadbhavantaḥ kathayanti ? ityāha--kiṃ tarhi ityādi
kiṃ tarhi kintu jīvasya jñasvabhāvasya ātmalābhaṃ nirvāṇaṃ śiṣmaḥ
evaṃ jīvasya ātmalābhalakṣaṇo mokṣe sati yajjātaṃ parasya taddarśayannāha--tathā satītyādi
tathā tena prakāreṇa sati jīvasya ātmalābhalakṣaṇe mokṣe neśvaro buddhimān aśeṣaviśeṣaguṇavaikalyarūpasya mokṣasyā nabhidhānāt, na karaṇa bhakṣādiḥ buddhimān tadarthaṃ tadvacanāt pravṛtteḥ
svātmanyavasthānam ātmano'śeṣaguṇavaikalyena, tasmin sati tadabhāvāpatteḥ viruddhaṃ tadapi tasya tatrāvasthānena, tasyābhidhānāt
nidarśanamāha— buddhena tulyaṃ varttate iti buddhavat
tattvaṃ śūnyaṃ padārthānāṃ yeṣāṃ te nirātmanaḥ
pañcaskandhaapunarbhavalakṣaṇaṃ nirvāṇaṃ svarasataḥ siddhaṃ yadarthaṃ tapastapet
caramacittasya akiñcitkaratvena avastutve taddhetuparamparāyā api tathā'bhāvāt
kathamanyathā yasmin satyeva yadbhāva eva vikāre ca vikāraḥ tat kāryamitarat kāraṇam iti lakṣaṇaṃ vyavatiṣṭheta ? na cāparamanyo'nyapratyakṣalakṣaṇam
yadi punaścintāmayīmeva prajñāmanuśīlayatāṃ vibhramavivekanirmalamanaḥprāptiḥ nirvāṇam; tadapi mithyābhāvanāyāṃ na saṃbhavati kāmaśokabhayonmādādivat nairātmyam...
kasya te ? ityāha--nirātmanaḥ sautrāntikādimanavato buddhasya ityarthaḥ
ye padārthāḥ rūpādayaḥ pañcaskandhaḥ , bahirarthaśūnyāḥ vijñānasantānāḥ, sakalaśūnyatā veti teṣāṃ tattvaṃ svarūpaṃ śūnyaṃ niḥsvabhāvaṃ nirūpitavidhinā tattattvasya ghaṭanāyogāt
tathā sati kim ? ityāha--saṃsāra kimviṣyeta nirvāṇaṃ tenaiva bhimatarayoḥ aviśeṣa iti yāvat
yadartha yasya nirvāṇasya nimitta yastasyeta tatsvata eva siddham
asaṃskṛtatvāt santānibhyo bhinnasyābhinnasya vā santānatva syā sattvāt, tataḥ tatkṣayārtho yatnaḥ kiṃśukarāgavadviphala eva iti bhāvaḥ
itaśca na tatkṣayārtho yatna iti darśayannāha--carametyādi

yasya na kadācidaparaṃ sajātīyaṃ cittaṃ bhaviṣyati taccaramacittaṃ ta syākiñcitkaratvenānarthakriyākāritvena avastutve sati taddhetuparamparāyā api tathā tena avastutvaprakāreṇa abhāvāva santānakṣayārthaṃ tapastapyata iti
sva vata hetuphalaṃ ca svopādānopādeya ityarthaḥ, tābhyāṃ pravṛttiḥ
keṣām ? ityāha--dravyasantānānāṃ guṇaparyāyavanti dravyāṇi, tatsantānānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ ca tatpravṛttireva lakṣaṇaṃ tathaiva darśanāt
na ca yasya yallakṣaṇaṃ tattadabhāve bhavati, svavedanābhāve jñānavat
tato yathā jñānāt tatsaṃvedanasiddhiḥ tathā dravyāt tatpravṛttisiddhiḥ ityasya punardarśanārthaṃ dravyagrahaṇam
parasparamanyonyaṃ pratyayaḥ kāraṇaṃ bhāvapradhāno'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ, sa eva ātmā svabhāvo yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ bhāvāt tattvāt teṣāṃ pravṛttireva

evaṃ manyate--yathā yogino'nyasya vā acaramacittaṃ sahakārikāraṇam anyathā viṣayatvāyogāt, tathā sacci ttasyāpi yogyanyo vā, anyathā rūpasya rasaṃ prati sahakāritve'pi na rasasya tatprati tad iti ekasāstāmapya dhīnasya pra॰ vā॰ 3
tathā sati upādānasahakāripratyayasānidhya vijātīyavad anyadavi kārya kena vāryate ?
uktaṃ hi bhagavatā trīṇīmāni bhikṣavaḥ saṃskṛtasya saṃskṛtalakṣaṇāni
saṃskṛtasya bhikṣava utpādo'pi prajñāyate vyayo'pi sthityanyathātvamapi iti
athāpi syāt sajātīyānusattvā tasya tṛṣṇāpi kāraṇam iti tadanubandhābhāvādananusantānaṃ naḥ
na anusantānaḥ ananusantānaḥ, paścāt santānābhāva ityarthaḥ
prāṇino yasya te na sto na sa janmādhigacchati || pra॰ vā॰ 1 | 83
iti cet; na; tatkāryasya hīnasthānānu sattvā nasya tadabhāve'bhāvāt na cittamātrasyasyātatkāyatvā hi tṛṣṇe'pi dhyānini bhāvāt
atha matam--śuddhāśayānāṃ bahāva ruṇāvaśāt sadavasthā na taduktam— tiṣṭhantyeva parādhīnā yeṣāṃ tu mahatī kṛpā
201 santānocchedavatāṃ tu tadabhāvāt sadānavasthāyitvamiti; tadayuktam; acetanavattadabhāve'pi svahetoreva prabandhā'nivṛtteḥ

syādetat caramacittasyobhayaśaktiyoge'pi paratra bahulaṃ tathā darśanāttadanurūpaṃ yāvadadṛṣṭakalpanaṃ yuktam, anyathā jñānamanavayavena svāvabhāsi kathaṃ sidhyet ? bādhakamanyatrāpi darśitam rasād rūpapratipattirna syāt iti
vijātīyavat sajātīyaṃ kāryaṃ svayameva na jāyata iti kathamucyate--svahetuphalapravṛttireva dravyasantānānām iti ? tatrāha--kathamanyathā ityādi

tatprabhavekāreṇānyathā yasmin kāraṇābhimate satyeva nāsati yadbhāvo yasya kāryābhimatasya bhāvaḥ utpāda eva ityavadhāraṇīyam vikāre ca yasya vikṛtau ca vikāro yadvikāraḥ iti draṣṭavyam, idam upādeyasya, pūrvaṃ kāryamātrasya lakṣaṇam tattasya kāryaṃ tathetarat kāraṇam iti ca draṣṭavyam ityevaṃ lakṣaṇaṇaṃ kāryakāraṇayoḥ kathaṃ na kathañcid vyavatiṣṭheta ? yathaiva hi caramacittābhimate samarthe'pi svayameva na bhavati, tathā asmin satyapi svayameva bhaviṣyati, yathā sabhāgamakurvato'pi visabhāgakaraṇam tathā visabhāgamakurvato'pi anyakaraṇamiti na sāmagrījanyatā kāryasya, kadācidubhayaṃ vā svayameva na bhaviṣyati, iti kāryamakurvato'pi caramasya sattve nityasyāpi tamiti bhāvaḥ
satyeva yasmin yajjanma vikāre cāpi vikriyā
yadi matam--upādānena sahakārikāraṇaste dānasyātiśayāpādanaṃ na sahakāritvam api tu sarveṣām ekatra kārye vyāpāraḥ, sa caramasyāpi na virudhyate iti; tatrāha— nacetyādi
na hi sadā svaṃ nityasya samarthasya parāpekṣā ityuktam
etena antyaśabdasya kakālīyānāraṃbhe sattvaṃ niraṃśaṃsannā sambandho'pi cintitaḥ
nanu mā bhūt cittasantānanivṛttirnirvāṇam, āsravavirodho nirāsravacittotpattiḥ tat syāt; etadeva darśayati dūṣayituṃ yadi ityādinā
kiṃ kurvatām ? ityāha--cintāmayīmeva anityatvādyanumānarūpāmeva nānyāṃ prajñāṃ buddhim anuśīlayatām abhyasyatām iti
kasmin sati tanna saṃbhavati ? ityāha— mithyābhāvanāyāṃ mithyā parasya sarvasyam numānaṃ tasya bhāvanāyāṃ satyām
śrutādibhyaḥ prajñā prabhavati tatra śrutamayī prajñā nāmārtham, cintāmayī ubhayasya nāmno'rthasya ca kṛte
bhāvanāmayī prajñā kevalamarthasya kṛta iti vaibhāṣikāḥ
sautrāntikāḥ śrutamayī prajñā hi āptapramāṇajo niścayaḥ, cintāmayī prajñā yuktinidhyāna jo niścayaḥ, samādhijo niścayaḥ bhāvanāmayī prajñā

apara āha--yathā ātmanyavainateye'pi vainateyo'ham iti, mithyābhāvanāyāmapi viṣāpahāraḥ tathā prakṛtāyāmapi doṣāpahāra iti cet; na; ātmādibhāvanāyāmapi tatprasaṅgāt, nidarśanasya cobhayatra samānatvāt
vastupratibandhāt mithyātve'pi na doṣaḥ ityapi na yuktam, uktottaratvāt tadabhāvāditi
svayaṃ ca nirbājīkaraṇadṛṣṭāntena dīkṣayā nirvāṇahetutvaṃ sādhayantaṃ nirākṛtya viṣāpahāranidarśanena mithyābhāvanayāḥ tatsādhayati ityayuktakārī
nanu mithyātvāviśeṣe'pi sarvaṃ duḥkhamanityam ityādyukteḥ viṣayeṣu vairāgyam upasthamūtrachiḥvat ityukteḥ nātmāvitattvam ityukteśca
tato nairātmyabhāvanaiva muktyaṅgamiti cet; atrāha--vairāgya mityādi

atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--ātmaiko'nādinidhanājñānasvabhāvaḥ, tasya āgantukā rāgādayaḥ, sacīrādayaścetyukte'pi tatra tattvavido vairāgyasaṃbhavāt, yathā kasyacit mahādbhāvasya kutaścidakarttavye pravṛttasya punaḥ kulaśauryādivarṇane tatra vairāgyam, atattvavido mūtracchidram ityukte'pi na tatra tat
galaṃgadhirāditacchidradarśane'pi tasya tatra pravṛttidarśanāt, viparītasya varāṅgamityukte'pi taditi
yadi vā, madīye pakṣe mithyābhāvanāyāṃ nirvāṇaṃ na saṃbhavati ātmavādimate tu tadarthamanuṣṭhānamapi

ātmātmīyatattvamajānanneva kaḥ duḥkhapīḍito'pi hitāhitaprāptiparihārayoḥ pravarteta mattavat ? yadā punaḥ kutaścit anantajñānādikaṃ caitanyamātmatattvaṃ tattvajñānena ca tadupeyaṃ mithyātvādi karma heyaṃ pratipadyeta tadā ātmānaṃ paraṃ vā nirvyādhitaṃ kartukāma iva nisargāt tadupāye'bhiyujyeta nānyathā
kutaḥ ? ityatrāha--mama jñānaṃ svarūpaṃ yataḥ anyathā ghaṭādivattadayogāt
nanu jñānasambandhāccetano na jñānasya tatsvarūpatvāditi cet; sambandhe tasya prākṛnārthatana rūpaparityāge anarthakaṃ tatsambandhakalpanam, tatsvarūpata eta eva cetanopapatteḥ
tadaparityāge na cetanaḥ syāt, tadvā~stu bhavet
dhanuḥ praviśati ityādivat syāditi cet; na; upacāramātraṃ dṛḍhapratyayavarjitaṃ bhavaivaṃ
kiñca, jñānasyāpi svagrahaṇavikalasya kutaścetanatā, yatosyopi tatsambandhāccetanaḥ syāt
svaparaprakāśanaṃ varamātmana eva kalpitaṃ kimapareṇa jñānena ? tataḥ sthitam--mama jñānaṃ svarūpam iti
tadvikalpaṃ tasya jñānasvarūpasyā'sampūrṇatvam niyataprakāśanarūpamiti hetoḥ kaivalyārthaṃ kevalasya karmavikalasya ātmano bhāvaḥ kaivalyaṃ tadartham
ko hi nāma jñānavān ātmano vairiṇaṃ sopāyavilayaṃ vīkṣyamāṇo'pi upekṣate tatkṛtāgantukasukhaleśapāśavaśāt

atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--atattvajño vā''tmadarśī tadarthaṃ na pravartteta, tattvajño vā ? tatra prathamapakṣe siddhasādhanamityāha--konatrave pravartteta ? kim ? ityāha--ātmīyatattvam anantajñānādikaṃ yāvaddravyabhāvitvāditi nirūpayiṣyate, na śarīrādikaṃ tatprabhavaṃ vā sukhādikaṃ viparyayāt paratantratvācca
hitaṃ nirvāṇaṃ tatsādhanaṃ ca ahitaḥ saṃsāraḥ taddhetuśca tayoryāthāsaṅkhyena prāptiśca parihāraśca tayoriti
nanu duḥkhānubhave tadajānannapi tatra pravarttata iti cet; atrāha--duḥkhetyādi
nahi bubhukṣāpīḍito'pi bālakaḥ udanaṃ tadupāyaṃ ca jānan tatra pravarttate
dvitīyapakṣe ātmadarśī tadarthaṃ pravarttate; ityāha--yadā ityādi
punariti pakṣāntaradyotane, kutaścid anumānādipramāṇāt pratipadyeta puruṣaḥ
nanu tat sarvadā pratipadyate sarvo'pi, iti sa tadarthaṃ pravartteta iti cet; atrāha--anantajñāna ityādi
tathā yadi punaḥ pratipadyeta, kim ? ityāha--karma
yathā ca tattve yaṃ tathā pratipādayiṣyete
tatkuto jāyate ? ityāha--nisargāditavā tadupāye nirvāṇopāye bhiścakṣyeta
ātmānaṃ svaṃ paraṃ vā nirvyādhitaṃ kartukāma iva, vaidya iva ityarthaḥ

yathā ātmānaṃ paśyannapi vaidyaḥ tattvadarśī svasya parasya tādhāro hānārthaṃ tadupāye vamānādau tadādhikaṃ sukhaṃ manyamānaḥ pravarttate tathā prakṛto'pi puruṣa iti, nyaṣā nāpareṇa prakāreṇa tatrābhiyujyeta
kutaḥ ? ityāha--ekāntapakṣe nityaikāntapakṣe kṣaṇikaikāntapakṣe ca svaparayoḥ śreyaso mukteḥ prāpteratyantamasaṃbhavāt
svasaṃvedanameva lakṣaṇaṃ cittasya, anyathā sarvacittacaittānāmātmasaṃvedanaṃ nopapadyate
yathādarśanam anekāntātmakatvāt, yathākūtaṃ tattvasya svataḥ pratipatteḥ
parataśca na saṃbhavatyevādhigatiḥ, jñānāntarasya atadviṣayatvāt ananyavedyaniyamāt anekāntasvarūpasyāpi grahaṇāvirodhāt
kathaṃ punaḥ sataḥ kāryatvaṃ kṛtatvāt kāraṇavaditi ? ekāntānaṅgīkaraṇādanukūlamācarasi
yathaiva tarhi satkāryaṃ tathaiva notpattumarhati niṣpannatvāt, yathā cāsat tathā ca atyantamasaṃbhavāt khapuṣpavat iti
na kvacidekāntadarśanaṃ yadavalambya anekāntasiddhiḥ saṃśayādinā upālabhyeta
tadapahnave kva kasya karaṇādayaḥ ? svaparasantānabhedānupalabdhau sattvabhedābhāvāt
satyāṃ ca svaparasantāna vyavasthāyāṃ kathamevaṃ parāpratyakṣatvāt kāryādṛṣṭeśca pramāṇābhāvāt guṇadoṣān kathañcidajānāno'yaṃ yathāviṣayaṃ maitryādīn bhāvayet ?

cittaṃ dvividham--kṣaṇikana vyāpakaṃ saukatakalpitam, nityaṃ vyāpakaṃ ca sāṅkhyavedāntavādyabhimatam, tattva sve paro va santānaśca sabhāgahetuphalaprabandhaḥ, tadabhāve visabhāgaprasantāno dūrotsārita evaṃ tadapekṣatvāt, tasya bhedaśca pravyādī nāṃ nānātvam abhedaśca teṣāmeva ekatvam teṣām avyavasthiteḥ kāraṇāt ekāntapakṣe iti sambandhaḥ
tathāhi--niraṃśaṃ na kiñcit sadapi cittaṃ svato'dhyakṣataḥ pratīyate
na kevala tatra śreyaḥprāpteratyantamasaṃbhavaḥ kintu maitryāderapi iti darśayannāha--maitryādirityādi
na kevalaṃ ādiśabdena karuṇādereva parigrahaḥ kintu dīkṣāderapi, sa tka siṣṭhe 'nyatra vā na kvacit, anuṣṭhānavataḥ kasyacidabhāvāditi bhāvaḥ
kriyā vyāpāravyāhārādiḥ tasyāḥ saṅkaraḥ sarāge vītarāgeceṣṭāsaṃbhavaḥ tatra vā sarāgācaraṇaṃsaṃbhavaḥ taṃ kiṃtunāṃ śīlānāṃ saugatānām
kva mithyādau maitryāpi ? tasya sato jñātumaśakyatvāt
te hi sarvaṃ sarvatra vidyate iti vadantaḥ maitrīviṣaye upekṣāviṣayaṃ kinna śaṅkate
ayamevakāraḥ sthānatraye draṣṭavyaḥ— svasaṃvedanameva lakṣaṇameva cittasyaiva iti
nanu parasaṃvedanamapi tasyāsti tadapi lakṣaṇaṃ kasmānnoktamiti cet; avyāpakatvāt, sukhādāvasattvāt
tadeva tallakṣaṇaṃ kuta iti cet ? atrāha--sarvetyādi

svasaṃvedanameva cittasyaiva lakṣaṇameva ityasyābhāvaprakāreṇa anyathā ātmasaṃvedanaṃ svarūpagrahaṇaṃ nopapadyate tadekārthamasamartha samavetānantarajñānena arthāpattyā vā tadgrahaṇe anavasthāprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ
keṣām ? ityāha--sarveṣāṃ cittānāṃ nīlādijñānānāṃ caittānāṃ sukhādīnāmeva ityavadhāraṇīyam, anyasyāpi prasaṅgāt
tadātmavedanābhāve ca na viśeṣavyavasthā iti manyate
bhavantasya tadeva lakṣaṇamiti cet; atrāha--na ityādi
na ca nai ci kānta svasaṃvittiḥ svasya svayaṃ gṛhītiśrittasya kintu kathañcidityarthaḥ
sāṅkhyasya puruṣaścetanaḥ yathā ātmānaṃ saccetanādirūpatayā svalayamavagacchati tathā cet prakṛtiviviktayā ; tarhi sarvadā prakṛtipuruṣāntaratattvaparijñānāva kuta iyaṃ bhrāntiḥ--
guṇakartṛtve ca tathā kartteva bhavatyudāsīnaḥ || sāṃkhyakā॰ 20 iti
yataḥ saṃsāra syāt ? nahi niraṃśayostayoḥ saṃyoge'pi tatathātedane upacārabhrāntisaṃbhavaḥ
prakṛteḥ sā bhrāntiḥ na puruṣasya iti cet; tasyāḥ svarūpāvedane kutastadvyavasthā ? na hyacetanamevamavaiti--mamātra bhrāntiḥ iti
puruṣo'vaiti cet; na; tena prakṛteravedane tadayogāt
vedane yathā tasyaiva svapradhānagrahaṇaṃ yathārtham, ayathārthagrahaṇaṃ kutaścittathāstu kiṃ prakṛtervibhramakalpe na
kathamekasya vibhrametarakalpanam ? kathaṃ pradhānasya ? pariṇāmitvāt; puruṣe'pi tatkalpane ko virodhaḥ ? tataḥ sthitam--nacaikyamtena svasaṃvittiḥ bhrānterabhāvaśca prasaṅgāt iti
etena brahmavādyamitinistaḥ brahmaṇo'pyekāntena svasaṃvittisaṃbhave kuta eṣa nagarārāmādivibhramaḥ tena tadavedanāt ? svayaṃ vedane brahmaṇo vaikalyamiti

yastu manyate--anekakṣaṇasthāyi sat na kṣaṇikaṃ jñānam ātmani samavetam, tatra samavetāḥ sattāvaya iti; so'pyanena yosṭaṣṭo yataḥ arthagrahaṇarūpavadanekakṣaṇasambandhivaṃsyāpi svata eva grahaṇe kutastatra bhrāntiḥ ? yatastadvyavacchedārthaṃ śāstrapraṇayanam
etena tasyātmani tatra sattādīnāṃ samavetatvaṃ cintitam
kiṃca, sattādestato vyatireke kiṃ tasya rūpaṃ yastvayaṃ jānīyāt, tenacā saṃbaṃdhye ta ? arthagrahaṇamiti cet; arthagrahaṇaṃ buddhiḥ nyāyabhā॰ 3

46 iti vacanāt tadapi tato vibhinnaṃ kuto na bhavati sattāvattatrāpi bhedapratyayasyāḥ yaḥ asyāḥ buddheridamarthagrahaṇam ? asyā idam iti bhāvāt buddhireva tadrūpaṃ yathā nīlameva nīlarūpaṃ jātireva jātirūpamiti cet; ucyate--atha keyaṃ buddhirityarthaḥgrahamiti cet; punaḥ punasādevāvarttata iti cakrakam
na ca sattādikaṃ sambandhaśūnyaṃ sambadhyate tayā
itaśca ekāntapakṣe na caikāntena ścasaṃvittiścittasya iti darśayannāha--yathādarśanamityādi
darśanānatikrameṇa yathādarśanam anekāntātmakatvāt yathākathaṃ yathāparābhiprāyaṃ tattvasya cittasvarūpasya svataḥapratipatteḥ, kutaḥ svarūpasya svato gatiḥ pra॰ vā॰ 1
anekānta eva saṃbhavati iti darśayati yathākūtam ityādinā
parasya dharmāpya siddheḥ anumānādyabhāvāt kutaścintāmayī bhāvanetyādi ?
syānmatam--na kasyacidvijñānasya svataḥ saṃvittiḥ, ātmani kriyāvirodhāt
nāpi parataḥ, tasya ajñeyatvād ghaṭādivaditi; tatrāha--parataścetyādi
na kevalaṃ yathākūtaṃ tattvasya svataḥ pratipattirnāsti kintu parataśca prasyakṣottarād arthāpattyādervā tra saṃbhavatyevādhigatiriti
vivakṣitajñānādanyat pratyakṣādi tadantaraṃ tasyāntadviṣaya tvāt niraṃśadittā viṣayatvāt
etaduktaṃ bhavati--svātmani kriyāvirodhānna tatra jñānapratibhāsaḥ, paratrāpi na niraṃśasya pratibhāsa iti kathocchedaḥ
yamācca na vidyate anyad vedyamasya nānyasya vedyaṃ tasya niyamāt
athavā anyace tadvedyaṃ ca tasya niyamo tadeva gṛhyate jñānena, punarasya tatrā bhisambandha tasmāt, anekāntesvarūpasyāpi grahaṇavirodhāt
yadi vā, anyasya vedyaṃ tasya niyamaḥ--jñānāntareṇaiva jñānaṃ vedyate, na svavedyaṃ nāpi parokṣaṃ yatvava ttenārthāgrahaṇāt

prathamadvitīye viṣamadoṣatvāt, anyathā kiṃ dvitīyakalpena ? cadvā yaduktaṃ sāṅkhyena buddhiḥ pratyakṣā parokṣā parokṣaḥ puruṣa iti; tatrāha--ananyavedyaniyamāt, vanānyavedyore nanyavedyaḥ puruṣaḥ tasya niyamāt, tataśca svataḥ parataśca tasyāgrahaṇāt sarvāgrahaṇameva
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt na svaparacittavyavastheti

syānmatam--na cintitaṃ tadantarāvedyaṃ nāpi parokṣameva saccetanādisvabhāvena svayaṃ pratyakṣatvāt, ityatrāha--viṣayetyādi viṣayākārāravivekaḥ sthūlastambhādyākāraśūnyatvam, yadi vā, viṣayaḥ pradhānaṃ tasyākāraḥ kartṛtvādi tena vivekaḥ tasya
kiṃbhūtasya ? ityāha--svato'codyasya parokṣasya ityarthaḥ, paratvaprasaṅgāt saṃ citte sakāśādamattve prāpte tatra tadvyavastheti tasya tato'nyatve saṃvidviṣayākārayoḥ tādātmyaprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ
idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam--viṣayo jñānatvādi jñānavedyaḥ tato bhinnaḥ tato vivekasyeti
354 ityādi matam; tanna; na viṣayākārādanyā saṃvittiḥ nīlādyākārasyaiva tattvāt
tacca sahopalambhaniyamādibhiḥ iti kaścit saugataḥ; tatrāha--paracittasyāpītyādi
na kevalaṃ viṣayākārasya api tu paracittasyāpi svasvabhāvāpatteḥ vivakṣitajñānarūpatāpatteḥ tattad vyavasthā iti
nanu viṣayākārasya vijñānāda ekasya nānekatvamiti cet; ayamayato doṣo'stu
itaśca na svaparacittavyavasthā iti darśayannānām ityādi
cittānāṃ cetasā kutaḥ santatiḥ ? kuto na syāt ? ityāha--kāryetyādi
vinaṣṭāt kāraṇāt tatsaṃbhava iti cet; atrāha--nara viṣāṇasyeva ityādi
na sati nāpyasati kāraṇe tadasaṃbhavaḥ kiṃ tadyatheti cet; atrāha--na cetyādi
yataḥ kharaviṣāṇasyeva asataḥ kathaṃ hetutvam ? tato nairantaryamayuktata kutaḥ ? ityatrāha--kāryetyādi
ciravinaṣṭaṃ tu kāraṇaṃ nityamaviśiṣṭamiti na tadanapekṣyate
tathā ca tenaiva prakāreṇa atyantamasato hetvavasthāyāmavidyamānasya kāryatva pratiṣiddham veditavyam kharaviṣāṇasyeva ityanuvarttate
nanu kharaviṣāṇasya sarvadā'samā mā bhūt kāryatvam, ghaṭādestu prāgbhāgbhāvavataḥ syāditi cet; anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ
utpannasya, nānutpannasya kharaviṣāṇavat, sambandhe vā utpattiri ti ? na ca vastuvyatirekeṇa prāgabhāvo nāsaṃ pramāṇasiddho'sti yena tadvataḥ kāryatvam
kāraṇasattaiva prāgabhāva iti cet; na sadetat; yataḥ kāraṇasyaivā'parijñānāt
prāgabhāvi kāraṇaṃ na ce tathāvidhaṃ sarva bhavet ityatiprasaṅgaḥ
yasyānvayavyatirekau kāryamanukaroti tat kāraṇamiti cet; kimidam anvayānukaraṇam ? tasmin sati kāryasya bhavanaṃ cet; anubaddhaḥ prasaṅgaḥ--sahotpattiprasaṅgāditi
siddhe hi kāryatve tatprāgabhāvasiddhiḥ, tataśca kāryatvamiti
kiṃ vā vyatirekānuvidhānam ? tadabhāve'bhavanaṃ cet; kāraṇasyābhāve eva bhavataḥ kathaṃ tadanuvidhānam ? svakāle tasya bhāvaḥ; ityapi vārttam; sarvasya tatkāle bhāvāt
para āha--kathaṃ punaḥ na kathañcit sataḥ utpatteḥ prāg vidyamānasya kāryatvam
kutaḥ ? ityatrāha-- kṛtatvāt kāraṇavyāpārāt prāgeva janitatvāt kāraṇavaditi
nanvapekṣitaparavyāpārabhāvatvaṃ kṛtakatvamucyate, kṛtakatvāt kāraṇavyāpārāt prāgavi sattvād ityarthāt, karoteḥ kriyāsāmānyavācitvāt
yadi vā, kṛtatvāt, yad yat kāryatvaṃ tat kathaṃ punaḥ sataḥ iti vyākhyeyam
athavā kathaṃ punaḥ sataḥ kāryatvaṃ kāraṇavat sattvāt iti gamyate ityevaṃ vākyam
nanu nāsato janyatvāt kāryatvam api tu sato'pi vyaṅgyatvāt ghaṭādivattaditi cet; atrāha--kṛtaṃ kāraṇavaditi
sarvathā yathaiva sato na janyatvaṃ tathā vyaṅgyatvamapi iti
atyantaṃ sataḥ kāryatvam ityekāntaḥ, tasyā'naṅgīkaraṇād anukūlamācarasi ketairapi tasya kāryatvānabhyupagamāditi bhāvaḥ
kathañcit sato'pi kāryatve dūṣaṇamastīti darśayannāha paraḥ--yathaivetyādi
yathaiva yenaiva prakāreṇa tarhi hetvavasthāyāṃ satkāryā tenaiva prakāreṇa notpattimarhati
yathā ca yena ca prakāreṇa asat tathā ca notpattumarhati, atyantamasaṃbhavāt khapuṣpavat
kimuttaraṃ kṛtam ? ityāha— pratikṣaṇam siddhivi॰ ityādi
yadi vijñānamanyadvā anekāntātmakamubhayasiddha syādevatā naivame kāntasya bhāvāditi cet; atrāha--na ityādi
kvacid bahirantarvā na ekāntadarśana yadekāntadarśanamavalambya āśritya 392 dravyeṣvanekāntasiddhiḥ upālabhyeta
tasyā'nekā ntasya pratyakṣasyāpahnave kva na kvacit kasya na kasyacit karaṇādayaḥ
svasya niraṃśacittasya parasya ca santānabhedasya anupalabdhau tatpratibaddhaliṅgadarśanāt paratrāpi nānumānam iti bhāvaḥ
nanu svapara ityādinā gatārthametaditi cet; na; tena tatsantānabhedasya svarūpābhāva uktaḥ, anena svaparacittasantānabhede satyapi sattvānāṃ bhedasya guṇādhikyādiviśeṣasya pramāṇābhāvenābhāva ucyate
satyāmapi svaparāmattva vyavasthāyāṃ na kevalamasatyāṃ kathamayaṃ saugato yathāviṣayaṃ sattvaguṇādhikādiviṣayānatikrameṇa maitrādā bhāvayet
kiṃ kurvan ? ityāha--apratipanna kānataḥ kathañcit kenāpi prakāreṇa

na kevalameva na vetyanyaguṇadoṣān saṅkaravyatikaravyatirekeṇa kathañcidapratiyan kathamayaṃ yathāviṣayaṃ maitryādīn bhāvayet api tu tānapratijānānaḥ sugatamapi kathaṃ jānīyāditi darśayannāha--vipralambhaśaṅkānubandhāt ityadhikāṃ kārikām
maitrībhāvanāyā ākāraḥ sukhitān sattvān dṛṣṭvā sukhitāḥ vata sattvāḥ, karuṇābhāvanāyāḥ duḥkhitāḥ vata sattvāḥ, upekṣā mādhyasthyarūpā
sattveṣu maitrīṃ guṇiṣu pramodaṃ kliṣṭeṣu jīveṣu kṛpāparatvam
mādhyasthyabhāvaṃ viparītavṛttau sadā mamātmā vidadhātu deva
vītarāgādayo vicitrābhisandhayaḥ kāyavāgvyavahārān mithyāpi pravartayeyuḥ sadoṣavat
sarāgādivat puruṣātiśayaḥ sannapi jñātuṃ yadyaśakyaḥ; yadi puruṣātiśayāpekṣi śāstraṃ pramāṇamiṣṭaṃ sa jñātuṃ śakyeteti dha rma kī rti vacanaṃ poplūyate
vipralambho vacanaṃ tasyā śaṅkā tasyā anubandhāt kāraṇāt puruṣātiśayaḥ kimiṣyate neṣṭavya ityarthaḥ
vītarāgā api sarāgā iva ceṣṭante iti vacanāt tato'pi vipralambhāśaṅkānuvṛtteḥ kiṃ tena iti tadanubandhikāraṇaṃ darśayannāha--ceṣṭate vyāpriyate vedyādi yathākūtam
dūṣaṇāntaramāha— puruṣātiśayaḥ sannapi jñātuṃ yadyaśakyaḥ kimiṣyate ?
tato yadi kāyavāsyava hārān mithyāpi na kevalaṃ satyāt pravarttayeyuḥ
puruṣasya atiśayo yathārthadarśanādirūpaḥ tasmin peśī yasya tattathoktam
kim ? ityāha--śāstraṃ pramāṇamiṣṭamabhyupagataṃ saugatairyadi sa yathārthadarśanādilakṣaṇo'tiśayo jñātuṃ śakyeta ityevaṃ dha rma kī rte rvacanaṃ poplutena
kuta etat ? ityatrāha--sugatasyāpītyādi tataḥ kim ? ityāha— tādṛśa ityādi
evaṃ tāvat tāyitvāt pramāṇo evaṃ na caturāryasatyābhidhānalakṣaṇāt sugatatattva manumīyate, tato'pyupāyānuṣṭhānam ityādi vyākhyānaṃ pramāṇabhūtāya pra॰ samu॰ 1
adhunā jagaddhitaiṣitvāt śāstṛtvam upāyābhyāsalakṣaṇam anumīyate, tato'pi sugatatvam iti vyākhyānaṃ nirākurvannāha--tadetasminnekānte ityadhikāṃ kāryaṃ vetyādi kārikām
tataḥ pramāṇaṃ tāyo vā catuḥsatyaprakāśanam--pra॰ vā॰ 1
catuḥsatyopadeśalakṣaṇāt kāryabhūtāt tāyāddhi bhagavān sugata iti jñāyate
pramāṇabhūtāya jagaddhitaiṣiṇe praṇasya śāstre sugatāya tāyine
upāyābhyāsa evāyaṃ tādarthyācchāsanaṃ matam--pra॰ vā॰, vārtikāla॰ 1
pravṛttikāmaḥ prekṣāvān sopāyaṃ heyopādeyatattvamanveṣate na vyasanena

tadarthānarthayoḥ idantayā nedantayā vā pramātumaśakyatvāt kathamarthe anarthe sandigdhe pravarteta nivarteta vā ? svayamayoniśo manaskāre'pi bhaviṣyati pramāṇābhāvāt, tathā duḥkhasantateḥ pravṛttinivṛttyoḥ, rasāt rūpādivat bhūtaikakālayoḥ niyamāt
kāryaṃ ca na kevalamakāryam apitu kāryamapi nānumeyaṃ nānumānaparicchedyaṃ ced yadi
nāvaśyaṃ kāraṇāni kāryavanti bhavanti pratibandhavaikalyasaṃbhavāditi bhāvaḥ
heyaḥ saṃsāra upādeyo mokṣaḥ tāveva tattvaṃ kena na kenacit pramāṇena mīyate
kiṃbhūta ? sopāyaṃ saṃsārasya kāraṇamavidyādṛṣṭe mokṣasya nairātmyaṃdarśanaṃ vāśabdaḥ apiśabdārthaḥ
tulanā--nāvaśyaṃ kāraṇāni kāryavanti bhavanti pratibandhavaikalyasaṃbhavāt--hetu bi॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 210
sa ca na pratyakṣato'numīyate, tatra tadapravṛtteḥ, anyathā cārvāka nakhilaṃ jagat syāt
atha pratyakṣe'pi tadviparyayasamāropādadoṣo'yam; naivam; sarvasya sarvadarśitvāpatteḥ
śakyaṃ hi vaktuṃ sarvasya sarvadarśitve'pi tadviparyayāropānnathā vyavahāra iti
nanu yadi na bhāvī saṃsāraḥ pratyakṣaḥ; kathaṃ bhāvini pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇamuktaṃ pra jñā ka re ṇa ? tata utpatteriti cet; taditaratra samānam
na hi parasmād antyaṃ vittyanta jāyate atadrūpaṃ vā, anyathā kiñcidapi bhāvino na bhavet
lokasya tathā vyavahārābhāvāt tatastanneti cet; ata eva na prāpyādṛśyayuktiḥ anyatrāpi vijṛmbhitaiva
syānmatam--nānyat pratyakṣaṃ bhāvini saṃsāre pramāṇaṃ dṛśyaikatvāvyavasāyābhāvāt, prāpye tu pramāṇa viparyayāt
tatra tadavyavasāyasya kinnimittam ? hetuphalabhāva iti cet; prakṛte'pi samānam
vāsanā ityapi nottaram; anyatra samatvāt, kathamanyathā sattvadṛṣṭiḥ ? bhavatu tarhi tatra saṃsāre tatpramāṇamiti cet; uktamatra
kiñca, pitrādicetaso'pi bhāvani pratyakṣatvam, sparśādivad ekatvavyavasāyanimittasya aikyasāmagrya dhīnatvasyā'viśeṣāt
teyaṃcāyatanaṃ liṅgam iti cet; tathā hi--śarīra tṛ kvaṃ cittaṃ madhyāvasthāyāmanu sattvāna kāraṇamupalabdham, upalabhyate tadantyāvasthāyāmavikala
na vā vikale kāraṇe kāryānudayaḥ, atkāryaprasaṅgāt iti; tanna; yataḥ--
niyamo liṅgasaṃkhyāyāḥ kvavaṃ vrajati te yayā
syānmatam--nāntyādvigrahasatṛṣṇācetaso bhāvyanusavya namanumīyate, kintu tasyaiva tajjananasāmarthyaṃ svabhāvabhūtam, tāvanmātranibandhanatvāttadanusandhānasya, tataḥ svabhāvaheturiti
tadapyasāram; yataḥ tataḥ kāryānumāne ko doṣaḥ ? vyabhicāraścet; kiṃ punaryogyatāyāmavyabhicāraḥ ? tathā cet; kārye'pyastu

na yogyatāpya niyama tyanumīyate api tu saṃbhavaḥ, tathāhi--antyaṃ śarīrasa tṛṣṇaṃ vitta pratibandhavaikalyā'saṃbhave vivakṣitakārye yogyaṃ tattvāt pūrvavaditi cet; atredaṃ cintyate— taccetaso'nu satvāne pratibandhādyasaṃbhavi vā ? prathamapakṣe kāraṇāt kāryānumānamadūṣitaṃ syāt
anyatrāpi vi mānasya siddhau mānaṃ karotu kim
sthāṇurvā puruṣo veti jñānaṃ mānaṃ bhavettathā
vividhaṃ te yathā kāryaṃ kāraṇāvyabhicāri te
kāraṇaṃ tadvadeva syāt kāryakāvābhicāri me || iti
nanu taccetasi na pratibandhavaikalyasambhavaḥ, tathāpi svabhāvahetoreva tatra gamakatve kiṃ kāraṇakalpanayeti cet; kāraṇasya gamakatve kiṃ svabhāvahetunā iti samānam ? kiṃvā ,

apara āha--taccittaṃ bhāvyamasandhānakārya tadavyabhicārāt arthāntaratve sati, bhāvi ca kāraṇam, kathamanyathā ariṣṭādermaraṇādyanumānam, tatonasandhāne kāryaṃheturiti; sa na yuktakārī; yataḥ pūrvajanmāntyacittānumānābhāvaḥ syāt, taccittasya ādyamaihikaṃ cittaṃ kāraṇam arthāntaratva satyavyabhicārāt, anyathā kathaṃ bhāvi kāraṇam ? kāraṇatvenāpyabhimatasyāpi bhāvinaḥ tasmā pekṣayā aihikatvāt
kiṃ ca, anādyanantasaṃsāravādinaḥ saugatasya na bhāvī bhavaḥ, tadatītakarmavipratipattivādiśūnya tatastaṃ prati kathamatītajanmānumāna kāraṇāt kāryānumitiprāpteḥ
atha tajjanma tadbhavāṣyacetasaḥ kāraṇamiṣyate, nāntyacetaso bhāvibhavānumānaṃ kāraṇāt kāryapratipattiprasaṅgāt
tadapratipattau ca kathaṃ mokṣārthī tadupāye pravartteta ?
nanu kimucyate upāyābhāvāditi, yāvatā kila nairātmyādabhyāsaḥ tadupāyaḥ

tathāhi--yo yatkāraṇamavikalamanutiṣṭhati sa tatphalalābhī dṛṣṭaḥ, yathā'genyatho rūpa sa mākāraṇa mavikalamanutiṣṭhan tadupaśamaphalalābhī, anutiṣṭhati ca kaścin mokṣakāraṇamavikalaṃ nairātmyadarśanābhyāsamiti cet; ucyate--yuktametad yadyadhivi kalakāraṇādṛyaṃ prasavaḥ

tathābhyupagame tataḥ kāryānumānaṃ kena vāryeta ? kāryādarśane tadapi jñātuṃ na śakyate, taddarśane kiṃ tatrānumānena iti cet ? tarhi mokṣakāryānumānaṃ ta na syāt tadadarśane jagati kasyacittadavikalakāraṇānuṣṭhānasya jñātumaśakyatvāt, sarvatra pratibandhavaikalyāśaṅkā'nivṛtteḥ
idaṃ tvasiddham--vītarāgā api sarāgā iva ceṣṭante ityādi
kiṃca, kathaṃ kāraṇādarśane kāryapratītiḥ, yataḥ tatastadanumīyeta ? pūrvadṛṣṭakāryasādharmyāditi cet; pūrvadṛṣṭakāraṇasādharmyāt kāraṇapratītirapi tathāstu

atha matam--antyakāraṇadarśanāt pūrvatatsmaraṇatathāpratītirnetarathā, tathā sati tatsmaraṇakāla eva kāryapratyakṣībhavatīti kimanumānena iti; tadasatyam; kāryāt pūrvakāla bhāvi vā kāraṇamapi tathā pratyakṣaṃ kinna syāt ? khalavilāntargatamanyathāpi dṛśyate iti cet; kāryamapi tathā dṛśyata eva
tathāhi--śabdāderdṛśyasya sato'nantarabhāvyapi kāryaṃ nāvaśyaṃ dṛśyam, tadabhāve'pyuktam
yasya tu vyavahitamapi kāraṇam taṃ prati suparihāramidam
śabdasya kāryānutpādakatve anarthakriyākāritvena avastutvaṃ syāt iti bhāvaḥ
kiṃca, yathā dṛṣṭāntasmaraṇābhāve'pi kāryādergamakatvaṃ tathā yadi kāraṇasyāpi, anarthakata codyam
athatadapi neṣyate; tarhi niravakāśamidam--tadbhāvahetubhāvau hi pra॰ vā॰ 3
atha tathāpi na kāraṇasya gamakatvam; na; upādeyatattvāpratīteḥ
khyāpyete viduṣāṃ vācyo hetureva hi kevalaḥ
na pravṛttikāmatadadveṣate api tu vyasanena iti cet; atrāha--na vyasanena, aprekṣāvattāprasaṅgāditi manyate
bhavatvevaṃ ko doṣa iti cet ? atrāha— naca ityādi
kiṃbhūtam ? ityāha--anāgataviṣayaṃ bhāvikālayoram apramāṇam avidyamānapramāṇaṃ bhāvini pramāṇābhāvāditi
tataḥ kiṃ jātaṃ parasya ityāha— tadarthetyādi
tat tasmād uktānnyāyād artho mokṣaḥ tatkāraṇaṃ ca anarthaḥ saṃsāraḥ tatkāraṇaṃ ca tayoḥ idaṃtayā arthatayā nedaṃtayā anarthatayā vā pramātumaśakyatvāt kāraṇāt kathamarthe mokṣādau pravartteta paraḥ
ityāha--sandigdhativartateyā narthe saṃsārādau sandigdhe sati tasmādidamapekṣam
syānmatam--artho mokṣaḥ sākāntaddhetu atīndriyatvādastu sandigdhaḥ, anarthaḥ punaḥ saṃsāraḥ tatkāraṇa va piparyayāvat kutaḥ sandigdha iti cet ? atrāha--sveya mayonisomanaskāre'pi ityādi
abhiprāyaḥ— na khalu saṃsāraḥ kaṇṭakavad uddharttuṃ śakyaḥ sati kāraṇe punaḥ pravṛtteḥ, api tu kāraṇakṣayeṇa
kva ? ityāha--ayoniso manaskāre'pi yonim--āryasatyavaṣmarūpaṃ na yo manaskāraḥ tasminnamit kevalam anyasmin bhaviṣyati tṛṣṇāvidyācetasi ityarthaḥ
tathā duḥkhasantateḥ pravṛttinivṛttyoḥ pramāṇābhāvāt bhaviṣyatyoriti vacanapariṇāmena sambandhaḥ kāryaḥ
saṃsārakāraṇe saṃsāre tadabhāve vabhāvini pramāṇābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ
ayonyā anyāyena kleśayogena ca pravṛtto manaskāraḥ
nanu dṛśyād rūpāt prāpye bhāvini rūpādau reṇapramāṇamiṣyate eva, tatkathaṃ nidarśanamiti cet ? uktamatra
kiṃca, kathamasmin darśane bhūtaikakālasya rūpādeḥ kutaścihatiḥ, apratibandhānuyata idaṃ subhāṣitam--bhūtaikakālānāṃ gatiḥ ityādi
yadatītaṃ kāraṇaṃ tadapekṣamidamiti cet; yadi tanna kasyacit pravṛttiviṣayaḥ kiṃ tena ? taṃ vi ṣayaścet; na bhātena bhāvyam
atha bhāvi bhūtaṃ caikakāryamiṣyate; na; bhinnajālānām ekatra sahakāritvābhāvāt, tathā'vyavahārāt caramakṣaṇābhāvaśceti yatkiñcidetat
yadi mataṃ bhaviṣyato'pi kāraṇaṃ gatiriti cet; tatrāha--nāvaśyamityādi
bhavatāṃ tarhi kathaṃ nedaṃ codyam ? ityāha--ekalakṣaṇetyādi
atītaikakālānāṃ ca gatirnānāgatānām--pra॰ vā॰ sva॰ pṛ॰ 49
karmaphalasambandhatatkāraṇādikaṃ praśastapaṇḍitavedanīyam ariṣṭaṃ tathā lakṣaṇaṃ kṛtam, yathā ahaṃ mariṣyāmi, prakṛtajanamastake śṛṅgaṃ nodeṣyatīti ca, atrāpi saṃśītiravatarati
pravṛtto'yaṃ vyavahāraḥ itarathā dṛṣṭe'pi kutaścidāśaṅkāyāṃ na kasyacit pravṛttiḥ syāt
yasunaḥ kāraṇasya anyasya vā rūpaṃ nopapadyate na ghaṭate yasmin kāryābhimate anyasmin vā śakaṭādau
kārikārthaṃ na kevalaṃ parasya heyopādeyatattve sopāye saṃśītirapi tu lokavyavahāre'pi iti darśayannāha--karma ca phalaṃ ca tayoḥ sambandhaśca te ādayo yasya tattathoktaṃ tatkāraṇādikam

praśastapaṇḍitavedanīyatatkim ? ityāha--astaṃ viṣṭaṃ nu manuṣyeṇāpaṇḍitarūpeṇa, tathā lakṣaṇarūpaṃ kṛtaṃ niścitaṃ yathā yena niścitalakṣaṇaprakāreṇāhaṃ mariṣyāmi, anena bhāvini maraṇe'riṣṭāderakāryasvabhāvasyāpi gamakatvamāha vyājanamana mastake śṛṅgaṃ nodeṣyati iti ca tena lakṣaṇaṃ kṛtam, anena ca svabhāvānupalabdhyāderapi bhaviṣyati śṛṅgodayābhāve, parasya atrāpi na kevalaṃ paralokādau saṃśītiravatarati
syānmatam--kasya cidrasāyanādeḥ senāvanābho devatānugrahādvā tasya maraṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati śṛṅgaṃ rodeṣyatīti saṃbhāvanā yadā tadā saṃśītiriti cet; atrāha--pravṛttyetto'yamityādi
viśiṣṭā'riṣṭadarśane maraṇaṃ tadi ṣyati na tatra kutaścit pratibandhaḥ saṃbhavati ityayaṃ vyavahāraḥ prasiddhaḥ, anyathā sarvatrā'numānavilopaḥ
tathā prā kṛtapuruṣamastake śṛṅge na bhaviṣyatī va pravṛtto'yaṃ vyavahāraḥ, itarathā dṛṣṭe udanāvapi kutaścit kaṇṭakādudeṣyatītyāśaṅkāyāṃ na kasyacit pravṛttiḥ syāt nedānīṃ pravarttyata iti
nanu pratibhāsādvaitasya svasaṃvedanādhyakṣasiddhasya bhāvānna heyopādeyatattvaṃ tadupāyo vā, nāpi tatra saṃśītiḥ nirṇītirvā tato'yamadoṣa iti cet; atrāha--pratyakṣetyādi
saṃvidāṃ vibhramaḥ sidhyet syādvādena vinā katham || 26
kathañcit saṃvidāṃ vibhrame'pi ātmasaṃvedanaṃ pratyakṣamabhrāntamicchan syādvādamanuvarteta
kathañca tadbhāvanāpariniṣpattau duḥkhasaṃvedanaṃ parisphuṭamupādeyam ? sarvathā vibhramavivekanirmalatve na kiñcit kvacididamaparisphuṭaṃ jñānaṃ yat parisphuṭaṃ syāt
na ca rāgādikleśanivṛttiḥ duḥkhasaṃvedanasya sphuṭataiva kāma...
eko'nto dharmo yasya tacca tacjinnaṃ ca niraṃśacittamityarthaḥ
pratyakṣaṃ svasaṃvedanavedyam ekāntacittaṃ yeṣāṃ saugatānāṃ teṣāṃ kopādeyetarasthitiḥ ? upādeyaḥ pratibhāsādvaitalakṣaṇo mokṣaḥ tasya pareṇa mokṣatvopagamāt, taduktam--
itaro heyo bhedaḥ tayoḥ sthitirvyavasthā kā ? na kācit, tannibandhanapramāṇābhāvāt
na hi niraṃśacittam anyadvā anubhūyate, sthūlanīlādivedanāt, yada stadupādeyam
nāvi bhedabādhaka yena sa heyaḥ prathata
devānvayaṃ bhrāntyā tathā na bhāsate; tatrāha--vibhrama ityādi
vibhramo bhrāntiḥ sthūlādipratibhāsarūpaḥ saṃvidām aiktyāvārthaṃ bahuvacanam, sidhyet syādvādena vinā kathaṃ sarvathā vibhrame tadayogāt
kathañcit sthūlagrāhyākāreṇa na svasaṃvedanakāreṇa vibhrame'pyaṅgīkriyamāṇe saṃvidāṃ na kevalamavibhrame syādvādamatīṣṭhamanuvarttita
kaḥ ? ityatrāha--ātmasaṃvedanaṃ pratyakṣamabhrāntam icchet saugataḥ ityarthaḥ
tataḥ svasaṃvedanaparihāreṇa sthūlākāra eva vibhramamabhyupagacchanta sat saṃkhyādikaṃ nirākaroti iti kathaṃ svasthaḥ ?
nanu niraṃśameva suvidāṃ svarūpamābhāti na ka dākāra iti cet; atrāha— sarvathetyādi
mokṣaḥ saṃsāraṃ nātiśete mokṣasaṃsārayoraviśeṣa iti yāvat
grāhyaṃ na tasya ityādivacanāt ātmasaṃvedana naikāntikaṃ mokṣaḥ, tacca saṃsāre'viśiṣṭamiti bhāvaḥ
anyeṣāṃ darśana na saṃsāro nāmāsti anunu kalpanāyām iti; teṣāṃ citraikasaṃvedane tadane tadapratiṣedhaḥ, itarathā sakalaśūnyateti na mokṣo nāma ityuktam
asmin darśane paramapi doṣaṃ parasya darśayannāha--kathaṃ ca ityādi
kim ? ityāha--duḥkhasaṃvedanaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṃsāriṇaḥ skandhāḥ, teṣāṃ saṃvedanaṃ grahaṇam
kathannopādeyamiti cet ? ucyate--sarvathā vibhramavivekanirmalatvaṃ sarvacetasāṃ na kiñcit kvacididaṃ parisphuṭaṃ jñānaṃ yad bhāvanāpariniṣpattau parisphuṭaṃ syāt
yataḥ tadupādeyatvāt cittameva parisphuṭaṃ bhāvataḥ syāt, naiva bhavet
syānmatam--rāgāhikleśavinirmuktiḥ bhavāntaḥ, sā ca duḥkhasaṃvedanasphuṭateti ve tyāha--na cetyādi
na ca naiva rāgādikleśanivṛttiḥ sphuṭataiva duḥkhasaṃvedanasya

nanu kāmaśokādiṣu sviṣṭa tā vikalpemātrabhāvanātaḥ udbhavati bhrāntāyuktā, na duḥkhasaṃvedanasya spaṣṭatā arthasambandhānumānamūlatvāditi veśa numānābhyāse tadviṣaye eva sāmānye spaṣṭatā na svalakṣaṇa ityanivṛtteḥ
nahi citrābhyāse dhanuṣi karmaṇaḥ spaṣṭād āsravasaṃvaranirjarādiṣu śrutaṃ pramāṇaṃ syātkāralāñchanamavisaṃvādi
sarvathaikāntaviśleṣāt samyagdarśanādinā sakalakarmakṣayeṇa pratilabdhātmasvabhāva eva kaivalyaṃ bhaviṣyatīti suniścitaṃ naścetaḥ
bhāve kim ? anupadeśamaliṅgamavisaṃvādaṃ śrutajñānaṃ brūma iti
svayaṃ bahirantaśca arvāgbhāgamadhyaparabhāgādivivartaikadravyaṃ dṛśyādyekarūpaṃ vyāvahārikamalakṣayan jyotirjñānādikamaparopadeśaṃ kathaṃ pratipadyeta ? na caikāntavādināmatra pramāṇamasti
syānmatam--avisaṃvādastatra pramāṇāntaravṛttiḥ, na ca sā jīvādāvasti iti; tanna yuktam; svātmani pratyakṣasya aparatrānumānasya tadanādyanantatayośca pramāṇāntarasya vṛtteruktatvāt
karmabandhe ca, tathā ni svabhāvaśuddhasya ātmanaḥ śarīre aśucini sarāvasthānaṃ tasya tatra sthāpakatatsaṃdaṃdhapudgalaviśeṣapūrvakaṃ tattvāt gāḍhanigaḍanibaddhasya sāvovi
kārāgāre anyatastatra tasya praveśo vā tatpūrvakaḥ tata eva, matrasyāśca vi pūrṇagarttapraveśavat
mithyādṛśām anekānte nityādyekāntajñānam āvaraṇavat atasmiṃstadgrahātmakatvāt madirādyupayoginaḥ sthirabhūte bhramaṇānubhavavat

tathā āsrave; tadyathā--cetanasya jīvasya sato'bhiratisahitaṃ śarīrādiṣvavasthānaṃ tadabhilāṣādyupāttapudgalaviśeṣapūrvaga tattvāt aṅganāṅgābhiratyabhilāṣotpattau ṣadhaviśeṣasya kāmukasya tadaṅgasthānavat
tadabhilāṣo vā tadavasthānanimittam ātmani pudgalamavasthāpayati yoṣidaṅgābhivatyabhilāṣavaditi
nanu kasyacit tadauṣadhābhāve'pi tadaṅge tathāvasthānaṃ dṛṣṭamiti cet; na; tasyāpi pakṣīkṛtatvāt na tena vyabhicāraḥ
tadapi tathāvidhakāraṇapūrvakam, anyathā sarvasya sarvatrāṅganāṅge tatsthānaṃ bhavet
nu rūpādayo'pi vyabhicāro nottaraṃ tasyāṃ tatrāpi tathāvidhaṃ kiñcit kāraṇamiti
syānmata tadabhilāṣaḥ svasya atra tu tadavasthānanimittaṃ pudgalakāraṇam, nāvaśyaṃ kāraṇāni kāryavanti bhavanti
nahi aṅganādve tadabhilāṣaḥ sarvo'pi tadavasthānanimittaṃ yogamātmasātkaroti iti; tanna sāram; uktatvāt--kāryaṃ ca nānumeyaṃ ca siddhivi॰ 7
liṅgaṃ saṃyogyatāyā ca vyābhicāro na kiṃ svataḥ
kvacit dṛṣṭasya tasyāstu viparīte paratra tu
nanu tadabhilāṣo yāvad anyasya karmaṇaḥ kāraṇaṃ tāvanna tadavasthānasyaiva iti cet; na; tasmiṃściravinaṣṭe kāryānudayaprasaṅgāt
prayatnasadharmā ātmaviśeṣaguṇaḥ tatsādhyaḥ karma iti cet; na; prayatnavat pudgalaviśeṣasambandhe'pi devadattaṃ prati yoṣidādyupasarpaṇadṛṣṭeḥ tatsadharmatā'siddheḥ

kathamanyathā deśāntarasthadravyākarṣakam, yato viśeṣādṛṣṭākṛṣṭaparamāṇvārabdhaṃ śarīraṃ syāt ? mūrttā yadahaya yaskāntādayastuyadā kṛṣṭihetavo dṛṣṭā nātmādayaḥ, itarathā ātmana eva tatsiddheḥ kiṃ karmakalpanayā ? tadviśeṣopapatteḥ nā'viśeṣakalpanāpi
yadi matam--amūrtto'pi mantraḥ tadākṛṣṭihetuḥ ato vyabhicāra iti; na; śabdasya mūrttatvāt
dhyānenānekānta iti cet; na; tasya mūrttakarma vetsi tattvāt, anyathā ātmaiva taddhetuḥ ityuktaṃ syāt, tatra ca ukto doṣaḥ
prayatnena iti cet; na; karmaviśiṣṭātmapradeśatvavyatirekeṇa paraṃ prati tadasiddheḥ
na ca prayatnasya kevalasya taddhetutvam; tadabhāve'pi tadbhāvāt
tato mūrttameva tadabhyupagantavyamiti kathaṃ nābhimataṃ parasya na sidhyati
tatkuyevā numānam de vā ga mā da vagantavyam
jyotirnakṣatrādijñānam cintā sukhaduḥkhādi tadādiryeṣāṃ na dṛṣṭādīnāṃ teṣviva tadvad iti
sakalasya karmaṇaḥ kṣayeṇa nābhyāsasāpekṣeṇa viśiṣṭādṛṣṭamātreṇa anena vā pratilabdho'yam ātmasvabhāvotanna jñānādilakṣaṇaḥ sa eva kaivalyaṃ tad bhaviṣyati iti evaṃ suniścitaṃ naścetaḥ
syānmatam--adhyakṣādibādhiteyaṃ pratijñeyaṃ tat kaivalyamastu iti; tatrāha--nahi ityādi
na khalu jñānaviśeṣamantareṇa anupadeśamaliṅgamavisaṃvādaṃ śrutajñānaṃ saṃbhavaditi
tasya uktakaivalyasya pratyanīkaṃ yat tasya sādhanasya siddheḥ syādvādena nirākṛtatvāt
śrutajñānasya vā tadbhāve śrutajñānaṃ brūma iti
tatpratyanīkasādhanasya tadabhāvasādhanasyeti kasmānna vyākhyāyata iti cet ? na; śrutajñānaṃ brūmaḥ ityanena tannirāsāt
nahi tadabhāve sarvatra sarvakālaṃsarvajñe nāsti iti vacanamavisaṃvādi saṃbhavati
nanu syādvādābhāvāt kathaṃ tena kasyacidbādhanamiti cet; atrāha--dṛśyetyādi
sugato'nyo vā ka ṇa ca rā diḥ svayam ātmanā kathaṃ na kaṃcana pratipadyeta
api tu anyataḥ tatsākṣātkāriṇa iti bhāvaḥ
kiṃkurvannasau kathaṃ tat pratipadyeta ? ityatrāha--alakṣayan anavadhārayan
arvāgbhāgādīnāṃ dvandvaḥ punaḥ teṣām ādiśabdena bahuvrīhiḥ vivarnnā stadarthāḥ teṣvekam abhinnaṃ yad dravyaṃ taditi
dṛśyādirekaṃ pradhānaṃ rūpaṃ svabhāvo yasya tattathoktam
na ca naiva ekāntavādināṃ vaiśeṣikādīnāṃ atra bhāvini jātinādau pramāṇamasti
kathamiti cet ? ucyate--atra na tāvatpratyakṣamaindriyam; tena indriyasaṃsargābhāvāt
tatsaṃsargaṃ ca parasya tatpratyakṣam ātmā manasā yujyate tad indriyeṇa tadapyarthena nyāyama॰ pṛ॰ 74 iti vacanāt
etanmānasamapi tadatra nirastam; tadapi ātmamanaḥsaṃyogasahacāriṇā'rthena janyate
evata tanmanasāpi bhāvi bhaviṣyati saḥ, na tadā saṃsargaḥ prākṛtasyāpyasti
paramparāsatyatve'pyasatā kīdṛśaḥ ? sattvāt kathaṃ sarvasya tatra jñānaṃ na janayetghaṭaḥ ? tadagrahaṇātmakatvāt
kuta etat ? abuddhitvāditi cet; etadapi kutaḥ ? arthagrahaṇātmakatvāt; anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ, tathāhi--ghaṭāderabuddhitve tadagrahaṇātmakatvam, ato'buddhitvamiti

atha ghaṭagrāhiṇā pratyakṣeṇa sa tadgrahaṇavimukhaḥ pratīyate tato'yamadoṣaḥ; kiṃ punarnityeśvarajñānaṃ tadgrahaṇābhimukhaṃ pratīyate ? na cet; kastasya ghaṭād viśeṣaḥ ? pratīyata iti cet; na svayam, asvasaṃvedanātmakatvāt anyathā paramatasiddhiḥ

tasyaiva tattatheti cet; kimetad īśvaraceṣṭitam ? tatra yathā nityajñānaṃ tasyaiva netarasya, tathā svasaṃvedanamapi kuto'yaṃ vibhāgo labhyate ? nahyekadharmavailakṣaṇye sarvairavi tathā bhavati, anyathā tayorjñānatvādinā'pi vailakṣaṇyaṃ bhavet
atha tena tayorna virodhaḥ; svasaṃvedanenāpi na virodhaḥ
tatra bāhye rūpādau viṣaye catuṣṭayasannikarṣājjñānamutpadyate— ātmā manasā yujyate, mana indriyeṇa, indriyamartheneti
sukhādau tu trayasannikarṣāt jñānamutpadyate, tatra cakṣurādivyāpārābhāvāt...--nyāyama॰
uktaṃ ca--ātmā sahaiti manasa mana indriyeṇa...--bṛhatsaṃ॰ 74
atha itarajñānasya svasaṃvedanapratijñā anumānena bādhyata iti vipadha tathāhi— anīśvarajñānaṃ tato bhinnenaiva jñānena vedyate jñeyatvāt paṭādivat iti cet; īśvarajñānena hetorvyabhicāraḥ
yadi punaḥ anīśvarajñānajñeyatvāt iti viśiṣya ucyate; tathāpyagamaka tvaṃ vyatirekā'siddheḥ

katham ? yadīśvarasya svaparagrāhijñānaṃ tāvataiva sakalaprayojanasiddhiḥ kimīśvareṇā vāramalareṇa ? kathamavasthānaṃ tasyeti cet; kuta etat ? guṇatvād rūpādivaditi cet; ata eva asmadādijñānavat asvasaṃvedanamastu
tato yathā jñānatvā'viśeṣe'pi tadeva svasaṃvedanaṃ tato nirādhāramapyatra brūmahe
kathamevaṃ sati tasya guṇatvam ? yugapat svaparagrahaṇasvabhāvadvayavat krameṇāpyanekasvabhāvasaṃbhavepradhyatvāt
athaikasvabhāvena yathā kāraṇam anekakāryaṃ tat tathedaṃ svaparagrāhakamiti cet; na; paraṃ prati dṛṣṭāntāsiddheḥ
dravyāśrayiṇaḥ eva guṇatvaṃ bhavati na tu nirādhārasya
etena idamapi nirastam--anekasya parasyeva svaparayorapi tadekameva grāhakam iti; taditaravat tadapi nātmavedanamiti na ghaṭādviśeṣaḥ

syānmatam--īśvaraḥ svajñānasya arthagrahaṇātmakatvaṃ pratyeti; tadapi cintyate--gṛhītasya, itarasya vā ? na tāvaditarasya; idaṃtayā nedantayā vā tasya vyavasthāpittamaśa nto jñānakalpanāvaiphalyāpatteḥ
bhāve vā nityamekatrānekam, anavasthāna ca vijñānaṃ prasajyeta

syānmatam--tasya jñānadvayamasti--ekaṃ svato'nyasya sarvasya vedakam, aparaṃ tasyeti; tanna; yasmādekatra yāvadodravyabhāvinaḥ sajātīyasya yugapad guṇadvayasyā'yogāt anyathā ghaṭādau yadvayaṃ tathā bhavet
atha maheśvaraḥ tajjñāna svayameva tathā pratyeti; bahirarthamatitatheti vyarthaṃ sarvatra jñānakalpanam
tathā pratipadyamānamātmānaṃ na cedīśaḥ pratipadyate; kutastena tatparicchedaḥ ? tadāsti tvaṃ vāsvayaṃ pratipadyate cet; ekasya svaparāvabhāsitvam
tanneśvarajñānaṃ ghaṭādviśiṣyata iti na jyotirjñānādau pramāṇam
dvitīyena jñātaṃ sat prathamajñānamātmasattāṃ khyāpayet, khyāpitātmasattākañca prathamaṃ dvitīyena jñāyeta iti
etenavaiśeṣikasyāpi cintitam--tasya acetanā buddhiḥ parokṣaḥ pumāniti
sugatajñānaṃ tatra pramāṇamiti cet; yadi tat sakalabhepānkāri kathaṃ kvacidapyekāntasaṃbhavaḥ ? tata evocyate--na vaikāntavādināmiti
pratyākāraṃ bhede; naikaḥ sugataḥ ? tadākārayituḥ tenādarśanāt nāpi sarvajñaḥ
kathatyā svamekamanekākāraṃ svayaṃ pratipadyamānaḥ paraṃ nisaṃkṣaṇikaṃdhruvaṃ svasthaḥ ? nirākāraṃ cet; tathaitat sarvasyeti na yuktam--
sugatavat sarvo'pi sarvadarśī syāditi cet; na; niyataśaktitvād bhāvānām
nāpyekasyāpi yā ekatvaśaktiḥ saivānyatra; anyathā sakalasya grahaṇavat jñānamapi sugatasya syāditi neśvarabādhanam
itarathā svasantānajñānajananadhigata syāditi kathaṃ vastutvam ? atha tasya grahaṇaśaktireva sarvatra, itarā tu kvacideva; yadya kasyaiva nānātmani nitarām
nanvevam ekasya śaktidvayātmakatvamiti cet; ayaṃ parasya doṣo'stu
na cā'śeṣagrahaṇaśaktireva pratiniyatajananaśaktiḥ, sā vā prakṛtā; grahaṇajananayoraviśeṣaḥprasaṅgāt
nā'kramāt kramiṇo bhāvaḥ pra॰ vā॰ 1 | 45 ityādi
kiṃca, yogyatābalena tadarthasya grāhakam; pratibandhadvayavyāghātena liṅga saṅkhyāniyamavaiyarthyam
tata utpatteścet; na bhāvinaḥ cirabhūtasya vā grahaṇaṃ tasmādanutpattiḥ
utpattau ca; aparatatkāryakāla eva tena bhavyamiti tanniyatakālatā

syānmatam--itarajanāpekṣayārthasya vibhinnakālatvaṃ na sugatāpekṣayā, tasya sākṣāt rūpeṇa sarvajñaṃnā tmani pratibhāsamānaṃ varttamānameva, sākṣātkaraṇameva vartamānameva sākṣātkaraṇameva vattva sama rthasya na vartamānakālasambandhitvaṃ tadabhāvāditi; tadasāram; yataḥ tada pekṣayateḥ tajjanakamapi na kiñcit syād varttamāneṣu tadayogāt, anabhyupagamācca
itarāpekṣayā arthādutpattiḥ tasya, samakālayoḥ paramārthataḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ pratiyat sa bhrāntaḥ syāt
tadbalena sugatasya paragrahaṇe so'pi tathāvidha iti na ca vandanīyaḥ
nanu pratyakṣam arthasannikarṣamato janmayā pekṣate nāgamaḥ, tataḥ sa evātra pramāṇamiti cet; atrāha--śruteḥ ityādi
śruteḥ āgamasya atadviṣayatvāt jyotirjñānādyagocaratvāt, na caikāntavādināmatra pramāṇamasti iti sambandhaḥ
evaṃ manyate— yade kāntavādināṃ parokṣaviṣayamadhyakṣaṃ bhavati tadā tatpūrvikā śrutirapi tadviṣayā syānnānyathā, na caivamiti
mīmāṃsaka āha--svata eva parokṣaśrutiḥ pramāṇaṃ na tatpratyakṣāpekṣā
na hi svato'satī śaktiḥ karttumanyena śakyate
nityasyānekārthasaṃbhavāt na tasmādarthaṃ pratipattumarhati, kathamanyathā vipratipattiḥ syāt
yadi punaḥ rāgādirahitasya kasyacidupalabdhiryato vedārthapratipattiḥ syāt

rāgādimattve'pi yadi kaścid vivakṣitatadarthatattvaṃ jānīyād brūyādvā kiṃ tena ? na brūmaḥ rāgādimattvāt api tu paropadeśāpekṣīti; kaḥ punaḥ tadarthadarśinaḥ paraḥ saḥ yasyopadeśamu pa va rṣā da yaḥ pramāṇayantaḥ ka pi lā dī na tiśerate ? tadanekārthasaṃbhavāt kutastattvamidantayā nedantayā vā vyavasthāpayet yataḥ pauruṣeyād viśeṣyeta
śabdāt arthagatinagaraprāptihetutvāt mārga iva mārgaḥ śabdārthasambandho vācyavācakarūpaḥ tasya pratipattiḥ nāpi śrotuḥ
kena ? anvayaparamparaikāntenātvā ivātyā jai mi nyā da yaḥ śāstrārthadarśanaviguṇatvātteṣām parai vaikāntaḥ tena, na hyānvetā parotvo mārgaṃ pratipadyate
kiṃbhūtā sā nāpītyāha--yasyā yāmāśritya śruteḥ vedāt sakāśādakṛtṛmāyāstattvapratipattiḥ syādityādhyāhāraḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--pūrvaṃ sākṣāt śabdārthasambandhadarśanaḥ sambandhapratipattiḥ parasya punaḥ śabdaśravaṇāt tatpratipattiḥ, na caivamiti
yadi vā, svargāpavargayormārgo yāgādiḥ tasya pratipattiḥ nāpīti vyākhyeyam
mābhūt tena tatpratipattiḥ, śrutereva tu tattvapratipattiḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--mantramityādi
mantra ghṛtādyāhavanavākyaṃ svargādidānasamarthaṃ pratipadyeran idantayā jānīyuḥ
ke ? ityāha--prākṛtāḥ śūdrādayo jai mi nyā di kaṃ
tathā ca tadvatte'pi tadarthānuṣṭhāyinaḥ syuḥ iti manyate
jai mi nyā da ya eva tatpratipadyante nānyaditi cet; atrāha--nityamiti
ayamabhiprāyaḥ--yadā nityaḥ sarvagato mantraḥ puruṣanirapekṣaḥ svamarthaṃ pratipādayati tadā sarvatra tadaviśeṣāt śabdo'pi pratipadyeta, na vā kaścit
pakṣapātinā kiṃ tena ? paro'pi tadbhaktaḥ samupalabhyate
atha tasyaiva āgama eva; tadapi kutaḥ ? tena tadarthānuṣṭhānāt; anyenāpi dṛśyate
vipropadeśāt; kintena, yadi mantra eva samarthaṃ kathayati
yadi punaḥ dvijārādhanātaḥ taṃ pratyeva tatpratipādanasamartho jātaḥ; kathaṃ nityaḥ ?
kiṃ ca, tadārādhanākramo yadi mantrārthaḥ; so'pi tato'nyenāpi pratīyate

no cet; puruṣakalpito nābhimataphaladāyī syāt anyathā kiṃ mantreṇa ? atha vipra eva tadgrahaṇānuṣṭhāne yogyaḥ, na caitāvatā mantro'nityaḥ, nityānāmapi ātmādīnāṃ kāryaniyamadarśanāt iti; tanna sāram; yataḥ syādetadevaṃ yadi paropadeśādadvijasya tadarthapratipattirna syāt, agneriva dhūmaḥ, na caivaṃ tataḥ taddarśanāt
kiṃca, na tāvat mantro dvijo'yam iti svayaṃ jñātvā tasmai svasamarthaṃ nivadeyati acetanatvāt, anyathā ātmajñānakalpanāvaikalyam
nāpi yasmādahaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ tasmādahaṃ mantrārthaṃ gṛhṇāmi iti dvijo jānāti; brāhmaṇatvapratipatteḥ tasyāpi svayamasaṃbhavāt

kam iti praśne uttaramāha--tadarthajño'yaṃsampradāyād vṛttatemantrārthajñasampradāyo bhāvaprakāreṇa viśeṣyate tadabhidyata yataḥ tatsampradāyamantareṇa prākṛtānāṃ tatpratipatteḥ mantro nityaḥ ne nāt pauruṣeyātmatvāt
anyathā anyena tataḥ tasya tatpratiprattiprakāreṇa kathaṃ vipratipattiḥ syāt prativyākhyātrivyākhyābhedaḥ syāt
nahi svayameva niyataṃ svamarthaṃ nivadeyati ve te nitye sati sā yuktā
athavā, pratipattyabhāvo vipratiprattiḥ kathaṃ kasyacit syāditi cet ? tadeka evārthaḥ tataḥ pratīyata itināsti sā iti; tatrāha--aneka ityādi
vedasya puruṣāpekṣayā anekasya niyogādi rūpasyārthasya saṃbhavāt kathaṃ syāditi ? atha, yānānartho vedāt pratīyate sa sarvo'pi tasyaiva, anyathā na ko'pi syāditi cet; atrāha--nityasya ityādi

svargo'rthaḥ, tasya kāmyamānatvāt svargakāmaḥ iti vacanāt tasmai tannimittaṃ tattvaṃ yāgādi tat tasmāt kathaṃ pratipatturmahati ? kutaḥ ? ityāha--anekārthasaṃbhavād vedasya anekārtho'rthatattvam, anyathā sārameyamāṃsabhakṣaṇāt svargaḥ syāt ekaḥ tasyārtha iti cet; atrāha--kathamityādi
agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityasya agniṃ hantīti agnihaḥ śvā, tasya utraṃ māsaṃ juhuyāt khādet ityarthaḥ syāt
khādet śvamāṃsamityeṣa nārtha ityatra kā pramā
nanu na jai mi ni ḥ vedād arthanārthepratyeti, api tu svayaṃ sākṣāt tatpratipadyatevītarāgatvāt, vedena yāvad bodhayati paramiti cet; tadāha--yadi punaḥ ityādi
kasya ca jai mi nibrahmaṇo vā rāgāyātasyarūpa lakṣaṇametat yathārthadarśanasya, tadyadi syād yato rāgādirahitāt vedārthapratipattiḥ syāt parasya ityadhyāhāraḥ
jai mi nyā di nā hetorvyabhicārāditibhāvaḥ
atha tasyāpi pakṣīkaraṇānna doṣaḥ, tatrāha--rāgādimattve'pi ityādi
vivakṣitatadarthatattvaṃ vedārthatattvaṃ kaścidanantarajñeya yadi jānīyād brūyādvā kimanyathā tena kutaḥ pauruṣeyasya vacanasya prāmāṇyaṃ na syāt ? syādeva
paraḥ prāha--na brūmo rāgādimattvāditi apituparopadeśopekṣī vetti brūyādvā iti brūmaḥ, itiśabdaḥ parapakṣasamāptau
yasyopadeśam u pa va rṣā da yo jai mi nyā da yaḥ pramāṇaṃ yataḥ ka pi la dī na tisarate
u pa va rṣā da yastattvavādino na ka pi lā da ya iti bhidyeran
sa kaḥ paraḥ u pa va rṣā di bhyo'nyaḥ prakṛṣṭo vā kaḥ ? nakaścit

paro'pi paropadeśāpekṣī sansvārthaṃ vetti brūyāt tāso'pi tadupadeśāpekṣī ityanādiriyam upadeśaparamparā'visaṃvādinī iti cet; atrāha--tadanekārthasaṃbhavāt kāraṇāt kuto na kutaścit pramāṇadavya paraḥ iti padaghaṭanā
idantayā abhimatarūpatayā nedaṃ brūyā nā nabhimatarūpatayā vā yataḥ tattvasya vyavasthāpanāt pauruṣeyād vacanād viśeṣyeta veda iti

evaṃ manyate--yadi tasya eka evārthaḥ syāt paramārthaḥ syāt paramārthataḥ sanniyataḥ tadā tasya kalpanāśatenāpyanyathā karttumaśakyatvāt syādyapyatādyupadeśaparamparātaḥ tattvapratipattiḥ, anekārthasaṃbhavetkastatra anādiḥ ko vā kalpitaḥ iti tajjñāyenārtha śiṣṭasaṃgṛhīto'nādiramyotya iti matiḥ; kaḥ śiṣṭaḥ ? brāhmaṇa iti cet; uktamatra--tadanirṇayāt iti
tata eva aneko'pi tadarthaḥ syāt aviśeṣāt
kiṃ ca, saugatamatānusāreṇādvijena śvapiśitāśanamucyamānaṃ kuto'nādi na vedārthaḥ ? avāntarakalpanā na, pramāṇābhāvāt
athāsau na dvijadhustarhi saḥ ? brāhmaṇaḥtvaṃyogī cet; kiṃ punastasya tadyogo nāsti ? tathā cet; kathaṃ tadanusaraṇāt pūrvaṃ sa brāhmaṇaḥ ? na hi gocaiḥsambandharahitaḥ karkaḥ kadācanāpi gauriti
tadāpi na brāhmaṇa iti cet; ka idānīṃ brāhmaṇaḥ ? yaḥ kālatraye'pi na mantrāntarāyogī ti cet; ka evapratipadyatāṃ yato devadattādayaḥ pratīyamānāḥ dvijakāryā ho saḥ
tadāpyasau brāhmaṇaḥ tadanupraveśe tu viparītaḥ iti cet; nanu kiṃ brāhmaṇatvaṃ naṣṭam ? tathā cet; na nityaṃ sāmānyamiti karkamadhyamadhyāsīno muṇḍo na gauḥ syāt
atha na naṣṭam; tadanupraveśe'pi brāhmaṇa eva
vede bhaktyabhāvānneti cet; kiṃ tadbhaktireva brāhmaṇyam, anyadvā ? prathamapakṣe na tatsāmānyam jñānaviśeṣatvāttasyāḥ
tathā ca suptādyavasthasya vyāpādanā badhe'pi na brahmahatyādidoṣaḥ
dvitīyapakṣe tadabhāve'pi tadavasthaṃ taditi sa eva doṣaḥ
atha tadbhaktyā sa eva jñāpyate; na; śūdre'pi tadbhāvāt
vedapāṭharahite satyapi sā na jñāyata iti cet; kutaḥ tatra dvijatvajñānam ? gotrāderiti cet; itaratra samānam
tathāhi--tadeva dvijatvam, anyadvā sāmānyam ? tadeva cet; tadrahitaḥ sisuḥsa na bhate
tathāpi tadā tadabhyupagame anyadāpi kutaḥ tadanuṣṭhānāt syāt ? anyo'pi syāt
tasya tadabhāvānneti cet;kuta etat ? advijatvāditi cet; prakṛtasyāpi tabhavet
tadanuṣṭhānāt sa dvija iti cet; anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ--dvijatve tadanuṣṭhānam, atastaditi
sāmānyaṃ tad iti cet; tadabhāve'pi tattadavasthamiti nāsāvabrāhmaṇaḥ
bahujanagṛhīta iti cet; na; aneko'pi tadgṛhīta eva samānasabhakṣe'pi bahujanaparigṛhītameva
dveṣeṇa tatkalpitam ato nārtha iti cet; bhaktyā anyo'pi dvijaiḥ kalpita iti samānam
vedasya pramāṇatve paroktāṃ yuktiṃ dūṣayituṃ darśayannāha--veda ityādi
svaśāstrakartuḥ smartā apalapyeta na kiṃ paraiḥ || 29
śabdasya anyasya vā pariṇāmitvaṃ siddham ityuktam
apariṇāme'pi nacākṣararāśerapauruṣeyatvaṃ yuktaṃ yena vedaḥ svataḥ pramāṇaṃ syāt, śāstrāntarasyāpi tadanuṣaṅgāt viśeṣābhāvācca
tāvatā pramāṇatve śāstrāntarasyāpi pramāṇatvaṃ bhavet na vā śruteḥ
varṇānāṃ padānāṃ ca na kvacit prāmāṇyaṃ na bhavet
saṅketāttadarthapratipattau prakṛtavākyarāśeritaraṃ prati na kaścidviśeṣaḥ ? pauruṣeyyā vyaktyā ca
sampradāyāvicchedo'pi pauruṣeyasya vipratipattinirākaraṇopāyaḥ syāt, tadarthadarśibhiḥ punaḥ punaḥ ucchinnasya ucchinnasya pravartanāt
rāgādayaśca puruṣāśritāḥ, tato vedāt puruṣaḥnivartamānaḥ svāśrayān rāgādīnādāya nivartate
rāgādinivṛttau ca tannibandhanaprāmāṇyamapi nivartate ityautsargikaṃ prāmāṇyamavatiṣṭhate
tathāhi--yadyanibandhanaṃ na tattadabhāve bhavati pāvakābhāve dhūmavat
vede vakturabhāvānu doṣāśaṅkai ca nāsti naḥ | mī॰ ślo॰ codanā॰ ślo॰ 62 iti
tathāhi--yadasmaryamāṇakartṛkaṃ tannityaṃ yathā gaganam tathā vedaḥ
svaśāstrasya tvāmṛtāgamasya pravacanāderyaḥ karttā jinādiḥ tasya yaḥ smāttāso'palapyeta na kiṃ paraiḥ apalapyetaiva jainādibhiḥ
idamatra tātparyam— vedavat pradhānasyāpi tadasmaraṇaṃ tena tattvamastu, tatreva vede'pi hiraṇyagarbhādayaḥ smaryante
tadapalāpo'nyatrāpi iti na vedetarayoḥ viśeṣaḥ syāt

tena vede vyavaharadbhiḥ avaśyaṃ smaraṇīyaḥ sambandhasya kartā syāt vyavahārasya ca...tasmāt kāraṇādavagacchāmo na kṛtvā sambandhaṃ vyavahārārthaṃ kenacid vedāḥ praṇītā iti...tasmādapauruṣeyaḥ śabdasyārthena sambandhaḥ
na svaśaktyā tadāptatvaṃ mitau na smaryate katham
tasmādavaśyaṃ smartavyasya vedānāṃ sambandhānāṃ ca karturasmaraṇāt yogyānupalambhanādabhāve'vadhārite siddhaṃ vedānāṃ sambandhānāṃ ca nityatvamityāha dṛṣṭa iti
smartavyatve satyasmaraṇāt yogyānupalabdhinirastasya karturanumānāsaṃbhavāt samākhyāpravacananimittatvāt apauruṣeyā vedā iti
kārikāyām anukrāṃti nityatvasya asiddhatāṃ darśayannāha--śabdasya ityādi
anyasya suvarṇāderiva śabdasya anekāntamantareṇa adaḥ tatra mityuktam, apūrvamnyasya pariṇāmitvaṃ siddham ku mā ri la sye va iti dṛṣṭāntaḥ

nanu pariṇāmanityatvaṃ na kūṭasthanityatvam hetuḥ, tasya ca ubhayāsiddhatvāt nāsiddho hetuḥ iti cet; atrāha--pariṇāme'pi pariṇāmanityatve'pyaṅgīkriyamāṇe navākṣarāśerapauruṣeyatvaṃ yuktam apuruṣakartṛkatvam upapannam yena puruṣāśritadoṣābhāvāt svataḥ pramāṇaṃ vedaḥ syāt
na caivam, ato vyabhicārī hetuḥ iti bhāvaḥ
atha durbhaṇatvādimattve sati tannityatvāt iti viśiṣṭo'nyata iti na doṣaḥ; tatrāha— viśeṣābhāvācceti
tadantaraparihāriṇa vede viśeṣasyābhāvāt, aśeṣaviśeṣasya anyatrāpi karaṇasaṃbhavāt
tāvatā karturasmareṇa nityatvamātreṇa pramāṇatve vedasya karttusmartā enanasmata śāstrāntarasyāpi na kevalaṃ vedasya hiraṇyagarbhādivat tataḥ tasyāpi pramāṇatvaṃ bhavediti
atha śāstrāntarasya tathāpi na pramāṇatvam; tatrāha śruteḥ ityādi
kiṃca, śrutervarṇānāṃpadānāṃ vākyānāṃ vā pramāṇatvaṃ bhavediti pakṣāḥ
tatrānya pakṣadvaye dūṣaṇamāha--varṇānāṃ padānāṃ ca na kvacit pramāṇyaṃ na bhavet, api tu vedavayādāvapi bhavet pratiṣedhadvayena pratyakṣārthagateḥ
tṛtīyapakṣe dvaiddhatasaṅketāpekṣāṇām, anyathābhūtānāṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe dūṣaṇamāha--saṅketa ityādi
prakṛtavākyarāśeḥ vaidikavākyarāśeḥ ityaṃ prati pauruṣeyavākyarāśiṃ prati na kaścidviśeṣaḥ pramāṇatvetarakṛto na bhedaḥ
kasmin sati ? ityāha--saṅketāt tadarthapratipattau, rāgādimān puruṣaḥ saṅketaṃ kuryāditi tanniyataḥ saṅketa iti manyate
vyaktiḥ sadā sataḥ tadvākyarāśeḥ prakāśanam, na tadarthasya saṅketetyādinā uktatvādasya
tayā tadrāśeḥ itaraṃ prati na kaścid viśeṣaḥ
evaṃ manyate--yathāasato vākyarāśeḥ rāgādimavākaraṇe neti niyatārthatā, tathā prakṛtavākyarāśeḥ sato'pi tathāvidhapuruṣeṇa vyaktau tadanyathā vyaktiriti sa eva doṣaḥ
nanu yathā vyaṅgyaṃ tenāpi vyaktiḥ, ghaṭādau tathādarśanāditi cet; na khaṭvādau mukhāderanyathāpi vyaktidarśanāt
atha sarvatra prasṛtasya tadvākyarāśeḥ na kena cidanyathā vyaktiḥ kriyate, janāpavādabhayādanādeyatāprāpteśca, yā bhrāntyā kasyacidanāthāpi tadvyaktiḥ so'vyatastatyātake sa samudāyānnivarttate

ata evendrotsave sahabhūya vedajñāḥ tatpāṭhamadyāpi śodhayantīti cet; ucyate--anādāvatīte kāle tathaiva sarvatrāyaṃ prakṛta āsīditi kimatra pramāṇam ? na tāvat pratyakṣam; idānīntanasya kasyacit tatkālādhyakṣābhāvāt
tadvidamasti--vedaḥ tatkāle sarvatra prakṛta eva tattvād yathedānīm iti cet; kathamevaṃ bha ra tādināṃ tatkāle prakṛtatvaṃ na syāt ? vyā sa kṛtibādhanāditi cet; na; hiraṇyavyaktibādhanamatrāpi
asya vilopo anyatra kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ ? atha yathedānīṃ tathā anyadāpi veda āsīditi prasiddhiḥ atra pramāṇam; anyadā hiraṇyagarbhādikṛta ityapi prasiddhiḥ aviśiṣṭāsti
nahi ātmanaḥ sarvadā sarvatra prasṛtatvapratipādakaḥ parasya āgamo'sti, kārye'rthe tadabhyupagamāt
hiṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre, yo vai vedāṃśca prahiṇoti ityādinā hiraṇyagarbhakṛto vedaḥ iti prasiddhiḥ vede'pi samāneti bhāvaḥ
tadevaṃ sarvadā tatprasṛtatvasiddheḥ kadācidanyathāpi vyaktiḥ saṃbhāvyata iti nā pauruṣeyādasya viśeṣaḥ

nanu yaduktam--saṅketavaśāttadarthapratipattau iti; tadayuktam; tadvaśāt padasyārthaḥ pratīyate na vākyasya, pratipannapadārthasyāpūrvasyāpi ślokasyāpi śravaṇe tadarthapratītidarśanāt, vākyārthaśca vedārtha iti cet; atrāha--svata ityādi
svataḥ svamāhātmyāt tadvasannirapekṣatvāt pramāṇatve svārthapratipādakatve prakṛtavākyarāśeḥ saṅketādarśano'pi pramāṇaṃ syāditi
parijñātapadārthasya sarvasyāpi tadvākyarāśiśravaṇo daparopadeśatadarthapratītiḥ syāt, na caiva na ca paṇḍito'pi parakāvyaṃ tadupadeśād yathāvadavagacchati
syānmatam, yaduktam--pauruṣeyavyaktāprakṛtavākyarāśeḥ itaraṃ prati na kaścid viśeṣaḥ iti; tadanupapannam; tadvyaktirapi nityaiva punaḥ punaḥ pravarttate na punarapūrvātkadācit kenacit kṛtāt
saṃbhāvanāyām apiśabdaḥ, tadvyakteḥ yaḥ karttā tasyāsmaraṇe'pi prabandhānāditvasyād vyakteḥ na punaḥ nityatvameva
tathāpi tatprabandhānāditvaprakāreṇāpi kathaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ tadrāśeḥ mlecchavyavahāravat
naapauruṣeyasyāpi vākyarāśeḥ saṅketavaśādarthapratītau kathaṃ viśvāsaḥ idīnīntasya rāgādimattvātsaṅketavidhātuḥ
yadi vā, vyaktivat tatkaraṇamapi anyathā saṃbhāvyate iti cet; atrāha--pauruṣeyasya ityādi
kaḥ ? ityāha--samupāyā vicchedo'pi na kevalaṃ māhātmyameva
śāstrārthadarśibhiḥ, punaḥ punaḥ ucchannasya ucchannasya pravarttanāt sampradāyasya
atha matam--apauruṣeyavat pauruṣeyamapi śāstram arthe tādātmyādipratibandhābhāvāt pramāṇaṃ mā bhūt, atrāha--śāstram ityādi
sarvajñaiḥ saha cetaso viniyataṃ pratipādakaiḥ syāt param
kutaḥ ? ityāha--svataḥ svayogyatāvaśāt na tādātmyādibalāt, kṛttikodayavad bhaviṣyati śakaṭe
sarvaṃ syāditi cet; atrāha--viniyataṃ kiñcideva na sarvam
śakyasvāmā viśeṣaśca pratyakṣādirūpaḥ tasya viṣayo gocaro'śeṣo yasya tattathoktaṃ pramāṇāntarādisaṃvādakam iti yāvat
atītānāgatayorasatoḥ pravarttamāna nirviṣayaṃ tadapramāṇam; tatrāha--sarvajñaiḥ saha taścetaḥpramāṇam
evamanyate--yathā sarvajñātmatītādau pravarttamānā apisvataḥ pramāṇaparamārthataḥ tathā idamapi iti
tataḥ yadi ca sāmānyaṃ vyaktirvāvācyaṃ śabdānāṃ bhaved atītānāgataṃ vācyaṃ na syāt iti; tannirastam; sarvajñānavakṣā vṛtasyāpi tatrātidhāraṇāt
atītaḥnāgataṃ vācyaṃ na syādarthena tatkṣayāt--pra॰ vā॰ 2
atītānāgate'pyarthe sāmānyanibandhanāḥ sāmānyāśrayāḥ śrutayo niviśante vyavatiṣṭhante— āsīt ghaṭo bhaviṣyatītyādayaḥ
tathā cāsato ghaṭasya sāmānyaṃ dharma ityuktaṃ syāt tacca sāmānyaṃ sat asato'tītāderdharmaḥ kathaṃ bhavet ? na hi taikṣṇyaṃ śaśaviṣāṇasya bhavati
kathamevaṃ sarvajña nirviṣayāḥ śabdayatnasyaḥ teṣāmapi sāmānyaṃ vyaktirvā viṣayaḥ

athānyakāle; svakāle tarhi śabdaṃprasaktamiti kathaṃ taddharmaḥ sāmānyamasaddharmaḥ ? athātītādervarttamānasyasattvāttadasaddharma ityucyate; tarhi citraikajñānanīlākāre avidyamāneṣu pītādiṣu varttamānamasaddharmaḥ syāditi dustaram
atha atītādeḥ svarūpeṇa pratibhāsane kathamatītādi ? taduyuktam
svarūpeṇa hi ya vṛṣṭaṃ tadatītādikaṃ katham ?
iti cet; na satyametat; yataḥ sarvajñeṣu svarūpeṇa pratibhāsamānaṃ katham atītādikamati samānam
na samānam, teṣu pratibhāsamānasya sarvasya varttamānatvāditi cet; uktamatra na teṣāṃ kiñcit kāraṇaṃ syāt varttamānānāṃ tadanabhyupagamāt

kiṃca, sugataścet svahetvavasthānaṃpratyeti; kathaṃ sarvajñaḥ ? pratyeti cet svātmanā varttamānatayā; kathamātmanaḥ tattvābhyāsadaśāṃ hetuṃ jānīyād brūyād vā ? anyathā samakālaṃ rūpaṃ pratīyamānaṃ rasasya hetuṃ jānīyāditi rasāt sāmagryanumānaṃ kurvatīdha rma kī rtti tā sugatamataṃ na vyajñāyi
yadi punarātmanaḥ prāgbhāvitayā; na tarhi svarūpeṇa pratibhāsamānaṃ na varttamānatā
atha sugataḥ svarūpādanyanna paśyati; kuta etena nānyo'nubhāvyo buddhyāsti pra॰ vā॰ 2
svarūpamātradarśino yogina iti cet; sarve'pi syuḥ aviśeṣāt
kathaṃ caivaṃ svarūpamātrayasyavasānaṃ sarvajñānakasyacit sidhyed ityuktam
kasyacit tatsiddhyabhyupagame sugatasyāpi tatsiddhiranivāritā iti sarvajñā iva śabdā apyatītādāvapratiṣiddhaprasaṃgaiti sāsaktaṃ sarvajñaiḥ saheti
nanu śāstraṃ ced arthe pramāṇam śabdendriyajñānayoraviśeṣaḥ taduktam--saivaikarūpācchabdāderbhinnābhāsā matiḥ kutaḥ ? pra॰ vā॰ 2
yadi vā, tata eva arthapratīteḥ indriyasaṃhatervaiphalyaṃ syāditi
etadapyuktam--śabdād vyaktirūpapratipattau tācchevatsaṃhateḥ sāphalyam, vaiphalyaṃ bhavediti; tatrāha--pratipādakairiti
etaduktaṃ bhavati--sarvajñavacanāccet janaḥ tattvamavaiti svarūpeṇa; kathaṃ na uktadoṣadvayam ? no cet; kiṃ sarvajñaparikalpanena ? yataḥ idaṃ subhāṣitam--jñānavān mṛgyate pra॰ vā॰ 1
vikalpākāramiti cet; kathaṃ tadapratibaddhajanmanaḥ ? atha sarvajñeṣu vikalpo'sti na yuktametat; uktottaratvāt
tathāhi--svalakṣaṇagocaraścet teṣu vikalpaḥ; na pūrvadoṣaparihāraḥ, paratrāpi tadanivāraṇāt nāpi pramāṇasaṃkhyāvyavasthā
mānādisarvajñaiḥ saha iti cet; atrāha--syād ityādi
saiva pratyakṣāpratyakṣābhāsā bhinnābhāsā matiḥ ekarūpāt śabdādeḥ, ādiśabdāt gandharasādeḥ kutaḥ ? ekarūpaviṣayā ca bhinnābhāsā ceti viruddham
nanu vedavedakavacanānāmabhāvāt kathaṃ kvacit kasyacit śāstrasvataḥ pramāṇamiti cet; atrāha--ko'traityādi
siddhaudaneḥ śikā digrādeḥ ko'nyo vipaścit saṃsatyuccārayati, kintu sa eva
kiṃbhūtam ? ityāha--vedyaṃ ca ghaṭādi vedakaṃ ca jñānaṃ vacaścaghaṭādyabhidhānam tāni śūnyāni niḥsvabhāvitiyasmiṃstattathoktam
tathāhi--kiñcidapi cennāsti; kathamkenetatpratipādakaṃ vacanam ? asti cet; kathaṃ na kiñcidasti iti ? svapnādivat syāditi cet; kathaṃ tat ? bhrāntyā iti cet; uktamatra vibhramaikānte tadasiddheriti
tathā śūnyatā cet, svasaṃvedanācca dhyāna sarvavikalpātītatā, sā venasātadvedyeti
iti ra vi bha dra pādapaṅkaja ca rā na nta vī rya viracitāyāṃ si ddhi vi ni śca ya ṭīkāyāṃ śāstrasiddhiḥ saptamaḥ prastāvaḥ
nanu sarvajñaiḥ ityavācyam; tadabhāvāt pramāṇābhāvena iti cet; atrāha--siddho'rtha ityādi
hetuḥ karmavimokṣaṇāya na punardravyasya loke śrutaḥ || 1
arthaḥ svaparaprakāśako bhāvaḥ, buddhiḥ saiva ātmā jīvaḥ na punaḥ buddheranyaḥ tatpratibhāsavirahāt

yadi punaḥ tato'nyaḥ syāt kumbhakārasyāpi tayā sambandhābhāvānnābhāvātna ghaṭādikam upalabdhimatkāraṇamiti kutaḥ tadbalāt kasyacit cetanāvataḥ tanubhuvanādikartṛtvam, yataḥ tasya sakalahetuphalagrāmaparijñānaṃ sidhyet
atha tatkāryatvādbuddhiḥ tasya ityucyate; ghaṭāderapi ucyatām, prameyakāryatvenāpi tadabhyupagamāt
asamavāyikāraṇatvānneti cet; kasya tarhi ? samavāyikāraṇasya iti cet; na; hetuphalayoḥ bhedaikāntena samavāyīta karaṇavidhikasyakartumaśakyatvāt

atha yatra samavetaṃ ceti kāryaṃ tat samavāyikāraṇam; samavetam iti ko'rthaḥ ? samavāyena vṛttam; ko'yaṃ samavāyo nāma ? ayutasiddhayorādhārādheyabhūtayoḥ yaḥ sambandha ihetipratyayahetuḥsasamavāya iti cet; na; hetuphalaviśeṣayorevatatpratyayahetutopapatteḥ

nanu hetau heturiti buddhiḥ, phale phalamapi na miti na hetīti cet; tarhi samavāye'pi ihetibuddhiḥ syāt na punaḥ idaṃ sāmānyam idaṃ sāmānyam ityanugatabuddhiḥ, samavāyasyātra pratyayahetutvaṃ na punaḥ prakṛtahetuphalayoḥ heturiti kiṃkṛtametat
ayutasiddhānāmādhāryādhārabhūtānāṃ yaḥ sambandha ihapratyayahetuḥ sa samavāyaḥ

kiṃca, samavāyaḥsamavāyibhirasambaddhyamāna eva yogino'nyasya vā yadi ayaṃ samavāya iti tantuṣu paṭaḥ iti ca buddhimutpādayati svamāhātmyāt na ākāśādiḥ; tarhi paṭo'pi tantubhiranabhisambaddhyamāna eva ayaṃ paṭaḥ itisa ca iheti buddhimutpādayet tata eva
ayameva trānyaḥ pakṣaḥvṛttedaṃ śākhā ityapi pratīteḥ, tannadvayorapisambandhaḥ
tato yathā śākhā yāṃ vṛkṣa iti tato bhavati buddhiḥ tadā tatra śākhā ityapi iti cet; na; śākhāyā vṛkṣārabhyutvaprasaṅgāt
atha yat pūrvaṃ tadāraṃ śākhāśca pūrvā iti; tanna sāram; pūrvātāsāmadarśanāt paṭāt pūrvaṃ tantuvat
anumīyanta iti cet; śākhābhyaḥ pūrvaṃ vṛkṣo'stītyanumīyatām
atha dṛśyasya sato'darśanam pūrvabādhakam; etadanyatrāpi samānamiti na kiñcidetat
na ca kuṇḍabadarasambaddhyamāna eva kaścid iha kuṇḍe badarāṇi iti pratyayahetuḥ pratipannaḥ, yato'nyatra tathā kalpanā syāt
tatsambandhaḥ samavāya iti cet; iha samavāyiṣu samavāyo varttate iti buddhiryadi anyasamavāyanibandhanā; anavasthā
śṛṅgaṃ gavīti loke syāt śṛṅge gaurityalaukikam
vṛkṣe śākhāḥ śilāścāga ityeṣā laukikā matiḥ
syānmatam--viśeṣaṇībhāvaḥsambandhanibandhanā tadbuddhiriti; tanna sāram; samavāyavat jātyādayo'pi dravyādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇam iti sarvatra tadibandhatvaprasaṅgāt
viśeṣaṇībhāvo'pi svasambandhibhyāṃ sambaddhaḥ asambaddho vā ityādi
atha buddhirūpatayātmanaḥ pariṇāmaṇāmāt asyāstatra samavāyaḥ; tarhi siddhamidam buddhiḥ ātmā iti
nanu saugatamataṃ syāditi cet; atrāha--anekānte ta tattvataḥ siddhaḥ tadātmā ityanekāntaḥ tattvaṃ svarūpaṃ yasyeti
ekasyā'nekadharmātmakatvasya kalpitatvād anarthaḥ sa bhavet iti cet; atrāha--arthaḥ siddho nirūpitanītyā niyataviṣayaḥ siddhaḥ
tato na vivādaparisamāptiḥ iti cet; atrāha--trikālaviṣaya iti
triṣu kāleṣu vyavasthitāḥ padārthā api trikālaśabdena ucyante, trayaḥ kālaviṣayo yasya iti
codanā vā kasmaitrikālaviṣayamarthaṃ nivedayet ? yataḥ codanā hi śābarabhā॰ 1
codanā hi bhūtaṃ bhavantaṃ bhaviṣyantaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vyavahitaṃ viprakṛṣṭamityevañjātīyakamarthamavagamayitumalaṃ nānyatkiñcanendriyādikam--śābarabhā॰
kaścideva tathā syāditi vaiśeṣikaḥ; tatrāha--sakalo niravaśeṣaḥ, nahi kaścidevātmā cetanaḥ
tathā cet; itaro taro , nānumāno vā syāt
yadi matam--ṣaṭpramāṇakaḥ tadviṣayaḥ iti siddhasādhanam; taduktam--
yadi ṣaḍbhiḥ pramāṇaiḥ syāt sarvajñaḥ kena vāryate
ekena tu pramāṇena sarvajño yena kalpyate
nūnaṃ sa cakṣuṣā sarvān rasādīn pratipadyate
svasmin trikālarūpe viṣayovaiśadyamāsādyayattatra va sakalaḥ iti na sambaddhyate uttaragranthavirodhāt
nahi sarvasvagocare nirāvaraṇaṃ jñāna niyataprakāśakaṃ yuktam bhānumaṇḍalavat
yatpunaratroktaṃ pra jñā ka re ṇa--sakalaviṣayatve sati ātmano nirāvaraṇatve tatra vaiśadya sidhyati tatsiddhau ca tadviṣayatvaṃ sidhyati ityanyo'nasamāśrayaḥ
tacca kimiva tatra viśadaṃ yathārthaṃ vā syāt, dṛṣṭāntayuktyābhāve tadasiddheḥ
manojñānaṃ tathābhyāsāt naiva yāti sadarthatām || iti;
prahīṇaṃ timiram, upalakṣaṇametat rajonīhārādeḥ, yasya tattathoktam akṣam indriyaṃ yasya tasyedrūpalabhya ādiryasya vṛkṣopalambhādeḥ so'pi tathoktaḥ sa iva tadvaditi
evaṃ manyate--yathā candrādijñānaṃ svaviṣaye aviśadamayathārthaṃ vā āvaraṇavaśāt na svataḥ tathā manovijñānam, yathā ca tad āvaraṇāpāye viśadaṃ tatra yathārthaṃ ca tathā manojñānamapīti
evaṃ hi bhavadīyaṃ bhaved yadi tad aviśadāyathārthagrahaṇasvabhāvaṃ nityaṃ vā syāt, taccāyuktam anekāntatattva iti vacanāt, satyaṃ svapnāvāvasatyāviśadayathārthagrahaṇadarśanācca
tathāpi tatsvabhāvaṃ tad iti vecandrādijñānamapi tatsvabhāvam iti na parato'prāmāṇyam
yathā cātra timirādi tatkāraṇamupalabhyate tathā manojñānamanumīyate
nanudvicandrādijñānaṃ yadi tatsvabhāvaṃ kadācanāpi na tato viśadasya yathāvasthitasya vā'rthasya pratītiḥ syāditi cetidititatrasamānam
atha satyasvapne tasya anyataḥ satyārthatā vaiśadyaṃ ca, tata eva candrādijñāne jñāne'pi iti svato'prāmāṇyaṃ parataḥ prāmāṇyamiti prasaktam
nanu tadupalambhavat tasya svaviṣaye vaiśadyāsādanekohetuḥ iti cet; atrāha--atiśayo hetuḥ iti
kasya iti cet ? ucyate— āvaraṇasya prahīṇatimirākṣendūpalambhādivat svaviṣaye vaiśadyamāsādayantīti yan iti vadatā prahīṇāvaraṇatimira ityuktaṃ bhavati
tathā ca prayogaḥ--āvaraṇaprahāṇaṃ puruṣeṣu kvacit paramakāṣṭhāniṣṭham atiśayatvāt timirādiprahāṇavat
nanu tatprahāṇavat dṛṣṭiprāhamavyatiśayavad upalabhyate tato'syā api tadvadabhāvaḥ syāt, na caivamiṣyate, tato vyabhicāra iti cet; atrāha--karma ityādi
karmaṇāṃ timokṣaṇam ātmanaḥ sakāśād apasāraṇaṃ tasmai tadartho hetuḥ na punaḥ tadatyantābhāvārthaḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha--na punaḥ naiva dravyasya jīvasya pudgalasya anyasya vā kṣayaḥ atyantābhāvopalakṣyate yataḥ sato'tyantavināśābhāvāt iti pratipāditamiti na punarucyate
tato na yathātmanaḥrmaṇāṃ tathā tasyapyanātmanā vimokṣaṇasaṃbhavānna vyabhicāra iti bhāvaḥ
yadi vā jñānasya thaisatyasyavā atiśayo gṛhyate
nanvevaṃ svaviṣaye sadyamāsādayan siddho'pi kiṃ sugato'nyo veti viśeṣarūpatayā na siddhaḥ tatpratibaddhahetvabhāvāditi cet; atrāha--śruta ityādi

śruteḥśravaṇaviṣayatāmupanīto loke anantaraprastāve nāḥ syādvādaḥ syātkāralāñchano vākyarāśiḥ praśasto vā karmaphalasambandhādiviśeṣaḥ tataḥsiddhiḥ tadviśeṣaḥ ityadhyāhāraḥ, vacanaviśeṣād vatkuviśeṣasiddherapratiṣedhāt
nanu sugatenāpi kalpitaḥ syādvāda ukta iti so'pi tatastatra vaiśadyamāsādayan siddhaḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--paramārthataḥ
syānmatam--jñānasya vaiśadyam akṣavyāpārāt; akṣāṇāṃ ca sannihite varttamāne vyāpāraḥ, tatkathaṃ sa tatra vaiśadyamāsādayan siddho'pi sarvajñaḥ syāt
sambaddhaṃ vartamānaṃ ca gṛhyate cakṣurādinā--mī॰ ślo॰ sū॰ 4 ślo॰ 84
yena sākṣātkṛtāḥ tena kinna sākṣātkṛtaṃ jagat
parokṣajñānamiṣyata eva kathamanāgatārthaviśeṣeṣu jyotirjñānāvisaṃvādaḥ tatsvabhāvakāryayoḥ prāgagrahaṇāt, śruteśca tatra prāmāṇyānabhyupagamāt vidhyādiviṣaye niyamāt, pramāṇāntarābhāvāt
yadi punaḥ trikālaviṣayā śrutiriṣyate, prāptaṃ parokṣāṇāṃ puruṣajñānamiti
dhānantarokto buddhyātmā vaiśadyamāsādayanta cet na vidyate yadi

punaḥ ityatra vīpsārtho draṣṭavyaḥ--punaḥ punaḥ anādyanantakāle, jyotirjñānāvisaṃvādaḥ jyotīṣi grahanakṣatrādīni teṣāṃ jñānaṃ grahaṇāparāyaprabaddhacāratatphalatatkāraṇādhāradharmādiprāṇikṣetrādiparicchedaḥ tasyāvisaṃvādaḥ tadabhāve tadanyakāraṇābhāvāt
keṣām ? ityāha--puṃsām pṛthagatānyam asti ca tadavisaṃvādaḥ tato'sti tatra dhīriti
yastu kvacid visaṃvādaḥ samāstārthasambandhāparijñānāt liṅgaliṅgisambandhā'jñānād anumeyajñānavisaṃvādavat
apauruṣeyaṃ śāstramasti tataḥ tadavisaṃvāda iti cet; atrāha— śrutāt śāstrāt cet tadavisaṃvādaḥ sādhanāntaram atiśayarūpāt sarvajñasyarādhanādidaṃ śāstrarūpam aparaṃ sādhanam
nanu parokṣasya asmadādyapekṣayā deśādivyavahitasya dharmāderjñānaṃ kena anumānameveṣyate, yenaivamodyate ? na saugatādinā sarvajñavāditā; pratyakṣasyāpi tajjñānasya tenābhyupagamāt
na ca laukāyatikena; najñānasyānumānasya anyasya vā pramāṇatvena tenānabhyupagamāditi cet; saugatena iti brūmaḥ
tathāhi--yasmād utpannaṃ yadākārānukāraṃ tasyaiva grāhakajñānaṃ sugatasyāpīti tadākārādhāyakaḥ parokṣaḥ
sa ca tadākārajñānavyatirekānu yathā asmadādibhiranumīyate tathā sugatenāpīyitarathāpratyakṣeṇa anumānena vātadarthasya tenā'paricchedāt pṛthagjanādapyasau pāpīyān
tenadyasarvajñāgamajādinā vyavahāramicchatā paracaitanyādāviva naṣṭādāvapyanumānamabhyupagantavyam, anyathā na saṃpūrṇavyavahārasiddhiḥ
anāgatārthaviśeṣeṣu grahaṇādiṣu bhāviṣu jyotirjñānavisaṃvādaḥ kathaṃna kathaṃcit
kutaḥ ? ityatrāha--tad ityādi, teṣām anāgatārthaviśeṣāṇāṃ ye svabhāvakārye tayoḥ prāgagrahaṇāt grahaṇādeḥ pūrvanirṇayāsaṃbhavāt
evaṃ manyate--sugatena saha tatsvabhāvasya nirṇaye teṣāmanāgatārthātāṃkutaḥ ? tadrūpajñānasya praśnādervā tatkāryasyāpi nirṇaye sa eva doṣaḥ
yadi vā, anumānapravṛttiḥ prājñātanirṇayāsaṃbhavāt ekadvipramāṇaniyamavādinām iti draṣṭavyam
tarhi parokṣajñānam āgamo'pyasti tato'yamadoṣa iti; tatrāha— śruteśca ityādi
śrutijanitaṃ parokṣārthajñānaṃ śrutiḥ tasyāśca tatra anāgatanaṣṭādau prāmāṇyānabhyupagamāt saugatādibhiḥ
idamatra tātparyam--yadā anāgataviṣayaṃ pratyakṣamanumānaścā sugatasya anyasya vā na vidyate, tadā apauruṣeyī śrutiḥ tatra pramāṇayitavyā
na ca tatkṛtamiti mīmāṃsakaiḥ tatprāmāṇyamiṣyata iti cet; atrāha--vidhyādītyādi
vidhiḥ ādiryasya niyogabhāvanādeḥ sa eva viṣayaḥ tatra niyamāt; śrutestatra prāmāṇyānabhyupagamāt mīmāṃsakairapi iti
anyadeva tatra pramāṇamiti cet; atrāha--pramāṇa ityādi
atha aviśeṣeṇa trikālaviṣayā śrutiḥ iṣyate; tadāha--yadi punaḥ ityādi
atha vedaḥ svayameva parokṣamarthaṃ pratipādayati iti kiṃ tatra jñānena iti cet ? atrāha— trikālaviṣayam ityādi
puruṣāḥ kutaścanāpi tadavidyāvaraṇavicchedāniṣṭeḥ na boddhumarhanti, tatprakarṣānivāraṇāt
vedo na kasyacit svataḥ pramāṇam, tadaviniścayāt
kasmai na kasmaicit vedo niṣpādayet tattvam
cakṣurādivat svayogyaṃ tatra jñānaṃ janayet sarvasya na vā kasyacit tatra saṅketānarthakyam

kimapiseveṇa na nivedayet ? ityāha--akṣayyāvaraṇekāntāt kāraṇāt na ced yadi vetti trikālaviṣayaṃ tattvaṃ tathā viśadaprakāreṇa naraḥ tathā tadvedane nivedayet saṅketakāriṇo viśiṣṭasya narasya abhāvāditi
vedārthasya sākṣāt kaścit jñātā'stu na tu sarva iti cet; atrāha--puruṣā ityādi
na kevalaṃ svata eva api tu kutaścana kāraṇāt samyagdarśanādeḥ tattvarāgādi avidyāvaraṇaṃ ca tayorvicchedasya nāśasya aniṣṭeḥ na boddhumarhantīti
nanu sākalyena tadāvaraṇavicchedo nāsti puruṣāṇām anākamanorvidyate iti cet; atrāha--tadityādi
tasya tadvicchedasya prakarṣasya atiśayasya sarvajñājñasiddheranivāraṇāt prāptaṃ parokṣāṇāṃ puruṣajñānam iti
nanu satyam, puruṣā na vedārthaṃ boddhumarhanti, vedaḥ punarapauruṣeyaḥsvataḥ svārthaṃ prativādayati
paraḥ pṛcchati kasya pramāṇam iti ced iti
vedārthatattvā'viniścayāt puruṣatvena rathyāpuruṣavat svayaṃ tarhi niścayābhāvāt, vedasya vā'cetanatvena tatra viniścayānutpādanāt iti bhāvaḥ
nāsti kaścit vedārthatattvajñaḥ puruṣatvāt rathyāpuruṣavat ityanumānena
kiṃca, sarvaṃ vacanaṃjanyam, arthapratipādanaṃ ca puruṣāpekṣam ātmani dadhadṛṣṭamapi yadi vaidikaṃ vacanamanyathā saṃbhāvyeta, tarhi puruṣeṣu arthajñānaṃ viśadaṃ akṣāddṛṣṭamapi tadabhāve'pi syāt
nanu vede kartturasmaraṇaṃ sādhanamasti neha taditi cet; na; atrāpi jñānātiśayo'sti iti darśayannāha--jīvānām ityādi
sthāvarādeḥ śāstrārthatattvajñaparyantasya jīvarāśeḥ uttarottarabuddhiprakarṣaṃ prati na kaścid viprattipattumarhati anyatra viprakṛṣṭasaṃśītivādinaḥ śauddhodaniśiṣyakāt
katham ? upanibandha...tathaiva kasyacit śāstrārthanirapekṣaṃ parokṣajñānapāṭavaṃ yadi syāt kiṃ virudhyeta ? yato'saṃbhavatprakarṣeṣu svata eva vedaḥ pramāṇaṃ na syāt
yathā vacanatvāviśeṣe'pi vedaḥ svata eva svārthaṃ pratipādayati tathā puruṣatvāviśeṣe'pi kaścideva akṣanirapekṣaḥ parokṣārthaṃ viṣayīkaroti
nāsti sarvajñaḥ anupalabdheḥ khapuṣpavat ityatrocyate--yadi sādhakapramāṇanivṛttiḥ ātmā vā tadrahito'nupalabdhiḥ; yathāsvaṃ nairātmyaṃ prasajyeta
tadiyaṃ pratipatṛpramāṇanivṛttiḥ sarvasambandhinī pratipattumaśakyeti na kevalaṃ sarvajñābhāvaṃ sādhayati api tu savavastuvyatirekaṃ ca
bhāve tarhi kiṃ pramāṇam ? śāstraṃ brūmaḥ
kathamasya prāmāṇyam ? codanāyāstarhi katham ? nityatvāt, tasyāstat; tata eva pravacanasyāstu
kathaṃ tarhi codanāyāḥ nityatvam ? karturasmaraṇāditi; tata eva paramāgamasya
paramāgamasya tīrthakarāḥ kartāraḥ smaryante iti cet; nanu ka ṇa bha kṣā da yo vedasya karttāraṃ smaranti
ka ṇa bha kṣā dī nāṃ smaraṇasya aprāmāṇye punaḥ itareṣāṃ paramāgamakartṛ viṣayasmṛteḥ prāmāṇye na kaścidviśeṣaḥ
tadetat pravacanamapauruṣeyam, tīrthakarāḥ samutsannaṃ pravacanaṃ pravartayantīti sarvajñāgamayoḥ prabandhanityatvena nityatvopagamāt kutastatra evamanyo'nyāśrayaṇaṃ syāt
na ca tatpratyanīkaṃ pramāṇamasti syādvādena bādhitaviṣayatvāt piṭakatrayavaditi
sa hi ekānto na saṃbhavati nirviṣayaṃ veti rājapathīkṛtametaditi

yadi punaḥ te na sarvajñāḥ vaktṛtvādibhyaḥ vaktṛtvāt puruṣatvāt rāgādimattvāt rathyāpuruṣavaditi; jai mi ni ranyathā vedajñaḥ kutaḥ ? nahi kiñcitsādharbhyāt sarvaṃ tathaiveti pratipattuṃ yuktamatiprasaṅgāt
sarvajño nāstyanupalambhāt iti vyāptisādhane svopalabdhiḥ asiddhā sarvaprāmāṇya...sarvajñānāṃ svaparopalambhasaṃbhavāt
narte tadāgamāt sidhyet na ca tena vināgamaḥ

na vidyate sahāyo yasya tadasahāyam atarkvamindriyam tasmād ekendriyādeḥ āśāstrārthavidaḥ jīvānāṃ prāṇināṃkramātkrameṇavijñānātiśaye na vai vidvān vipratipadyate, yathā paramāṇoḥ parimāṇād ārabhya āgaganāt parimāṇātiśaya iti

8 ityādinā pratinā pratipādayiṣyate, tatkimarthamiha ucyate ? tasmād anyathā vyākhyāyate— vidvān paṭhiteḥ śāstreṣu uktānuktaparyālocanapaṭuḥ navainaivavipratipadyate akṣa vijñānātiśaye atīndriyārthagrahaṇayogyatāyāṃ jñānasya
kasya ? ityāha--ā śāstrārthavidaḥ ā samantāt sakalānśāstrasya vedasya dyotiḥśāstrasya vā artham atīndriyaṃ vettīti tadarthavit sarvajñaḥ tasya
atha akṣābhāve kutaḥ sa iti cet ? atrāha--kramāditi āmnāyād āgatād darśanādeḥ
yo hi vidvān svayaṃ śāstrānukramarthamabhyūhya jānāti sa kathamanyatra asahāyākṣārthasya jñātari vipratipadyeteti bhāvaḥ
nanu tadatiśaye yadyapi vaddhāṃtavipratipadyate, saṃsateatyantādṛśye anakṣajñāne gatyantarābhāvāt
tat tasmāt atyantaparokṣeṣu sadasattāniścayau na staḥ, satyapi pramāṇāvṛtteḥ
sthāvaro vṛkṣādiḥ ādiryasya śāstrārthatattvajñaḥ paryanto yasya tasya
uttarasyottaraḥ adhikasyāpi adhiko buddhiprakarṣo yasya sa tathoktaḥ taṃ prati na kaścit vipratipattumarhati vakṣyamāṇam iti anyatra śauddhodaniśiṣyakāt
anyaḥ kasmānna vipratipattumarhati iti cet ? atrāha--śāstrārthavidāṃ ca ityādi
ca śabdaḥ apyarthaḥ, śāstreṇa arthaṃ vidantīti tadarthavidaḥ teṣāmapi na kevalamanyeṣāṃ vivādagocarāṇām tadarthajñānaprakarṣaḥ śāstrārthajñānādhikyam sarvathā sarvaprakāreṇa astyeva
svabhāvena pāṭavaṃ ca abhyāsaśca tau ādī yasya auṣadhādisenādeḥ tasya tāragyāt
katham iti praśne tasya uttaram upanibandha ityādi
ko hi nāma svayaṃ śāstrārthapratipadyamānaḥ anyatrāpipratipadyate ? anena vidvān iti pratipāditam
tathaiva tenaiva svabhāvapāṭavābhyāsāditārasyaprakāreṇa kasyacit puruṣaviśeṣasya śāstrārthanirapekṣaṃ parokṣajñānapāṭavaṃ yadi syāt kiṃcirupyeta na kiñcit
yato jai mi nyā deḥ prākṛtād viśeṣāt svata eva puruṣanirapekṣa eva pramāṇaṃ vedo na syāt syādeva
tataḥ sthitam--yathā vacanatvāviśeṣe'pi vedaaivaṃ puruṣanirapekṣaḥ svārthaṃ pratipādayati tathā puruṣatvāviśeṣe'pi kaścideva akṣanirapekṣaḥ parokṣārtha viṣayīkaroti iti
nanvevaṃ svaparapakṣayoraviśeṣa eva uktaḥ syāt, na punaḥ svataḥprāmāṇya vedasya nirākṛta syāditi cet; atrāha--saṃbhavatprakarṣeṣviti
saṃbhavadatīndriyārthadarśaneṣu puruṣaviśeṣa svata eva pramāṇaṃ vedo na syāditi sambandhaḥ, tebhya eva tatpramāṇatvabhāvāditi bhāvaḥ

syānmatam--vedasya parānapekṣasya arthapratipādane na kiñcit pramāṇaṃ vāyavamasti puruṣasya tu akṣānapekṣasya arthaviṣayīkaraṇā'saṃbhava eva tadbādhakamasti tatkathaṃ sāmyamiti cet ? atrāha--pramāṇamityādi

loke niravaśeṣe jāgati kvacit tadabhāvasādhane siddhasādhanam iti lokagrahaṇam, pramāṇam kīdṛśaṃ na kiñcit pramāṇamityarthaḥ sarvajñasyābhāvasādhakaṃ pratyakṣādeḥ pramāṇapañcakasya abhāvaviṣayatvavirodhād abhāvapramāṇavaiphalyāpatteḥ anabhyupagamācca
cārvākasya nāyaṃ doṣa iti cet; na; tasya pratyakṣaikapramāṇavādinaḥ sarvatra loke tadabhāvasādhanamayuktam, svayaṃ sarvajñatāpatteḥ, anumānāderabhāvāt
parābhyupagamāt tasya taditi nottaram; ta eva atīndriyajñānaprasaṅgāt
yathaiva parasya anumānamantareṇa na tadvyavahāraḥ tathā tadapi na atīndriyajñānamantareṇa
aviśadaṃ tadastu iti cet; na; anumāne jīvati viśadamapi tadaniṣedhanityāstāṃ tāvadetat
sarvatra sarvajño nāsti iti pratyakṣaṃ jānataḥ svayaṃ sarvajñatā
atīndriyajñānam, na vidyate niṣedho yasya tat aniṣedham aśakyaniṣedhamityarthaḥ
iti cet; na; dharmāderapi sa tatsādhanam, sarvajñavat pratyakṣādeḥ tatrāvṛtteḥ
āgamasya bhāvādasiddhaḥ tatra pramāṇapañcakābhāva iti cet; na; sarvajñe'pi tasya bhāvāt
tadāha--tadabhāvesarvajñābhāveśāstram asmākamasti, tato'trāpyasiddham abhāvākhyaṃ pramāṇamiti manyate
nanu sarvajñoktatayā tat pramāṇam, tatpramāṇatayā ca sarvajñasadbhāva ityanyo'nyasamāśraya iti cet; atrāha--na yuktyā bādhitam pramāṇena yatubādhitaṃ śāstraṃtadasti
na taduktatvena tatpramāṇam apitu bādhārahitatvemapratyakṣādivat iti gamyate
nanu tatra śāstraṃ yuktyābādhitam asiddham, anupalambhasya tadbādhakasya bhāvāt
kimarthamidam anumānamupanyastam ? paramatānuvādamātram ityeke; na; parasya tadabhāvāt, na bhāvaḥpramāṇāt tadabhāvasādhanāt
na ca prekṣāvatā tanmatam asambaddhamanūdyate iti; tatrocyate--abhāvapramāṇamevamuktaṃ nānumānam
tasya hi matam--asti sarvajñaḥ sunirṇītā'saṃbhavadbādhakapramāṇatvāt sukhādivat iti
atra pūrvapakṣe idamucyate yadi sādhakapramāṇanivṛttiḥ sarvavitsādhakasya pramāṇasya nivṛttiḥ ātmā vā tadrahitaḥ anupalabdhiḥ yathāsvaṃ nairātmyaṃ prasajyeta
nahi asarvadarśī tathaiva yatra sarvātmaviśeṣā vyavasthitāḥ tān sākṣātkartumarhati
anumānena pratyeti iti cet; atrāha— natadevaityādi
yata eva sa tān sākṣātkartuṃ nārhati tata eva anumānamaśakyam, bhāvapradhāno'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ asatyatramiti
nanu parātmanoyato'numānāt pratīyate tataḥ sāmānyaviśeṣātmakā eva, tanna yuktam--anumānamaśakyatvaṃ pratyātmaviśeṣāṇām iti cet; atrāha--tadaviśeṣeṇa ityādi
tad ityayaṃ nipātaḥ tasmād ityasya arthe varttate
nahi parātmā niyatenaviśeṣeṇa saṃyukto'numānāt pratīyate, pratyakṣānumānayoraviśeṣaprasaṅgādanumānamaśakyatvaṃ pratyātmaviśeṣāṇām iti
syānmatam--tyāhārādiviśeṣāt krodhādiviśeṣo'pi pratīyate, tannedamuttaramiti; tatrāha--kutaścid ityādi
kutaścit vyavahārādiviśeṣāt tatpratipattau pratyātmaviśeṣapratipattau satyām apratipannaviśeṣāvinābhāvinaḥ
evamanyate--vyāvahārādiviśeṣāt krodhādipratipattirapi anumāna eva tadapi krodhādikam avāntarasāmānyena viṣayīkaroti na niyataviśeṣeṇa

tatasteṣāmanupalabdhirabhāvaḥ prasakta iti; tanna; apratipannaviśeṣaṃvināna bhavati ityevaṃśīlasya apratipannaviśeṣāvinābhāvinaḥ pratipannasvabhāvasyāpi krodhādisāmānyasya tathaiva anātmakatvaprasaṅgāt
tathāhi--pratikṣaṇakṣaṇasūkṣmaviśeṣāpekṣayā sāmānyaviśeṣā ātmano bhavatitadabhāve te'pi tasya na syuḥ pratīyamānā api
na ca tadvivikta ātmā upalabhyata iti tadabhāvo bhavan nairātmyam syāt
tatra ko doṣa iti cet ? atrāha--tata ityādi
tato nairātmyāt kasyacid upalabdherabhāvānukasyacidupalabdhiḥ ityupalambhanivṛttibhāvāt sarvajñavat sarvābhāvaḥ
atha śrutāt pratyātmaviśeṣāḥ pratīyante ityadoṣaḥ; tatrāha--śrutasyāpi ityādi
śrutasyāpi na kevalaṃ pratyakṣāderevam uktavat prasaṅgāt
atha viṣayīkaroti śāstram iti cet; atrāha--anyathā ityādi
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt iyam anantaravarṇitā pratipatṛpramāṇanivṛttiḥ pratipattuḥ mīmāṃsakasya sambandhinī sarvajñaviṣayapratyakṣādipramāṇanivṛttiḥ sarvasambandhinī satyapi pratipattumaśakyeti
pratipatṛgrahaṇaṃ na kevalaṃ sarvajñābhāvaṃ sādhayati api tu kintu sarvavastuvyatirekaṃ ca sarvabhāvavastuno'bhāvaṃ ca sādhayati svāpamadamūrcchādyavasthāyāṃ sarvatra tannivṛtterbhāvāt
