anyaiḥ tadā sarvasya darśanaṃ na rvasyeti kiṃ kṛtametat ? punastenaiva tasya darśanam; janmāntare tenaiva sarvajñasya darśane kiṃ vibhāvyeta ? yadi vā, parokṣajñānaikāntavādinaḥ sarvatra tannivṛttiriti

yathā ca śāstrāt pratīyamāne dharmādau na sādhakapramāṇanivṛttiḥ anupalabdhiḥ, tathā sarvamapi iti darśayitum ātmānaṃ pareṇa paryanuyojayannāha--bhāve sarvajñasya tarhi kiṃ pramāṇam iti ? tatrottaraṃ śāstraṃ brūmaḥ iti
tasya sarvajñasya sadbhāvapratipādanāt caturdaśaguṇasthānopavarṇanāt na kevalaṃ labdhikathanācceti

kathamasya tatsadbhāvapratipādakasya śāstrasya prāmāṇyamiti cet ? iti paramatam; atrottaram--codanāyāḥ tarhi kathamiti dharmādipratipādakam vaidikaṃ vākyaṃ codanā, tasyāḥ kathaṃ prāmāṇyam ? ubhayoraprāmāṇye dharmāderapi lopa iti manyate
sūcirāhatata eva nityatvādeva pravacanasya guṇasthānapratipādakasya āgamasya astu prāmāṇyam
kathaṃ pravacanasya iti paraḥ; tasyottaraṃ yathā ityādi
pārśvavarttī pṛcchati--kathaṃ tarhi codanāyāḥ nityatvam iti ? śrotriyaḥ prāha--karturasmaraṇāditi
karttāraḥ tīrthakarāḥ paramāgamasya smaryantaiti cediti paramatāśaṅkā; atrottaram--vedasya ityādi
teṣāṃ ca smaraṇamapramāṇamiti cet; atrāha--ka ṇa bha kṣa ityādi
punaḥ itareṣāṃ mīmāṃsakānāṃ yā paramāgamakartṛviṣayā smṛtiḥ tasyāśca prāmāṇye na kaścidviśeṣo vedaparamāgamayoriti
nanu vede paravādināmeva tatsmaraṇaṃ na vādinām tatastadapramāṇam upapanne pravacane tu ubhayeṣāṃ tatsmaraṇamiti nāpramāṇamiti cet; atrāha--tadetad ityādi
tat sarvajñapratipādakam etad vicāryamāṇaṃ pravacanamapauruṣeyaṃ nityam
yadyapauruṣeyaṃ tīrthakarāḥ tatra kiṃ kurvanti yena tatkalpanamiti cet ? atrāha--tīrthakarāḥ pravarttayanti samutsantaṃ samutsantaṃ pravacanam vyañjayanti iti jaināḥ
kuta iti cet ? sarvajñāgamayoḥ prabandhanityatvena nityatvopagamāt
kathaṃ tasya tarhi dvādaśāṅgasya samucchedaḥ ? vedaśāstravaditi
tadvadetā gatīyācāryaiḥ smaraṇaṃ na kāraṇam iti sarvaṃ sustham
evaṃ sati yallabdhaṃ tadāha--kuto na kutaścit kāraṇāt tatraiva vyavasthite nyāye satyā nyonyāśrayaṇaṃ syāt yata idaṃ śobheta--
narte tadāgamāt sidhyet na ca tena vinā''gamaḥ
yata eva śāstraṃ pramāṇamasti tat tasmānnānumānaṃ kiñcidapi sarvaabhāvasādhanaṃ śāstraviṣaye tadapravṛtteḥ iti bhāvaḥ
atha nāsau śāstrasya viṣaya iti cet; atrāha-- pravacanaṃ ca ityādi
nanu mā bhūdanumānaṃ tatsādhanaśāstrāntaraṃ tu syāt samabalatvāditi cet; atrāha— na vedyādya bhiprāyaḥ--na tāvad anekāntaśāsanaṃ na jīvānāṃ nānāpariṇāmapratipādakam
nanu yadeva yadvidhātṛ tadeva tasya niṣedha virodhāt
anyaccet; na ca naiva tatpratyanīkaṃ śāstraṃ pramāṇamasti
nidarśanamāha--pi ṭa ka tra ya vaditi
nanu pi ṭa ka tra yasya kathaṃ syādvādena bādhitaviṣayatvaṃ yāvatā syādvāda eva tena bādhitaviṣaya dtaredatrāha--sa hi ityādi
sa pi ṭa ka tra ye pratipādyamānaḥ hi yasmād ekānto na saṃbhavati
tathāhi--nirviṣayaṃ yataḥ tato mithyājñānam anumānayadi; kutaḥ kiṃ sidhyet ? nahi nirviṣayāt tataḥ tattvasiddhiḥ dvicandrādijñānavat
nanu maṇiprabhāyāṃ maṇijñānāmithyājñānamithyājñānādapi tattvapratipattiḥ tato vyabhicāra iti cet; na; tasya sādhyāntaḥpātitvāt
yadi punaḥ anumānamadhyakṣaṃ cet; tarhi kalpanāpoḍhena abhrāntena tena bhāvyamiti na tena vyabhicāraḥ

yo hi manyate--ya eva maṇirdṛṣṭaḥ sa eva prāpta iti taṃ prati pratyakṣaṃ tad iti cet; yastarhi mīmāṃsakādiḥ sa evāyam ityekaṃ pratyabhijñānam indriyajātavisaṃvādi manyate taṃ prati tadapi pratyakṣamiti na prameyadvaividhyāt pramāṇaṃ dvividham, asya pratyakṣatve'pi sāmānyaviṣayatvāt, avikalpaikāntavyāghātaśca
kathaṃ caivaṃvādinaḥ pratyakṣasiddhaṃkṣaṇikatā yena yadyathāvabhāsate ityādi sūktaṃ bhavet
asya vicārato'pratyakṣatve tata eva prakṛtasyāpi pratyakṣatvaṃ mā bhūt
kiṃca, yadi bhāvini pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇam; pratibandhadvayavyāghataḥ
vātirapyanyathā dṛṣṭā pakṣaścāyaṃ kṛtottaraḥ || pra॰ vā॰ 2 | 56 iti
syānmatam--yadi bhāvini na pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇaṃ tarhi pramāṇameva na bhavet
yadi varttamāne syāt ko doṣaḥ ? na ca varttamāne kvacid vyabhicāradarśanāt sarvatra sa yuktaḥ, svasaṃvedanamātre'pi tadanuṣaṅgād ityuktam

api ca, yadyanumānamavisaṃvādaṃ kathaṃ nirviṣayam ? avastusāmānyaviṣayatvāditi cet; pratyakṣamapi tathā syāditi maṇiprabhāyāṃ maṇijñānasya anumānasya avisaṃvādaḥ kena pratīyatā ? nahi prāpyamaṇipratyakṣaṃ niraṃśaparamāṇugrāhakam ityuktam
nanu yaduktam--tīrthakarāḥ pravacanaṃ pravartayantīti iti; tatsatyamastu, kevalaṃ te sarvajñā na bhavanti vaktṛtvādibhyo rathyāpuruṣavaditi; tadeva darśayannāha--yadi punaḥ ityādi
nanu puruṣāntare vaktṛtvādau sati sarvajñatvamupalabdham, upalabhyate ca tīrthakare'pi vaktṛtvādikamiti tatrāpi tadastu, anyathā nu kṛtakatvādeḥ anityādipratīḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--na hi ityādi

tīrthakarapuruṣāntarayoḥ kiñcitsādharmyāt vaktṛtvādisādharmyāt sarvam asarvajñatvādikaṃ tathaiva vaktṛtvādiprakāreṇa iti pratipattu na hi yuktam, atiprasaṅgāt--vaktā mūrkho dṛṣṭa iti sarvo'pi tathā syāt
yadi punaḥ paṇḍito'pi sa kādāvi dṛśyate; sarvajñe'pidrakṣyate iti samānam
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt ime pareṇa ucyamānā vaktṛtvādayo'hetavaḥ
anyathānupapattirahitatvāt na tādātmyātyādirahitatvāt ityanena darśayati tasyātra bhāvāditi nirūpitam
asarvaṃ rvajña jñātā sarvadā teṣāṃ darśanāt, kathaṃ tadrahitatvamiti cet ? vipakṣe bādhakābhāvāt
kṛtakatvādivat virodho bādhaka iti cet; na; tadgrāhakābhāvāt
yadi hi saṃvedanotkarṣe tadapakarṣaḥ syāt, bhaved virodhagatiḥ, na caivam iti
sarvajño nāsti anupalambhāt ityevaṃ sādhyena hetoḥ vyāptisādhane aṅgīkriyamāṇe
tadupābha santi sarvajñāḥ, tatkathaṃ te svaṃ paraṃ vā sarvajñamupalavyanta iti cet ? atrāha-- sarvajñābhāvasandeha ityādi
nāsti sarvajñaḥ ityatra yathā anyo'nyāśrayatvaṃ tathaiva vaktuḥ sarvajñasyānupalabdhau
etena rathyāpuruṣādanye sarve puruṣāḥ rāgādimanto baktṛtvādibhyastadvaditi sākalyena rāgādimattvasādhanaṃ pratyuktam
tathā tatsādhane jai mi nyā derapi sādhanānna vedaḥ pramāṇamitarat anyatheti
sarvajñānāṃ yo bhāvaḥ pareṇa iṣyate tatra sandehe anupalambhaḥ sarvānupalabdhirna sidhyati sarvajñānā svaparolambhavān
punarapi teṣāṃ tadanupalambhenābhāvasādhane tadavastho doṣo'navasthā cakrakamivimanvate
atha matam--yaḥ sarvaktuḥ bhātmānaṃ parañca paśyati ityucyate; nāsau sarvajñaḥ puruṣatvādibhyo rathyāpuruṣavaditi cet; uktamatra--anyathānupapattirahitatvāt naite hetavaḥ iti
sarvajñasya puruṣasvavaktṛtvānupalabdhiḥ prakṛtavyāptiriti cet; punarapi tadevāvarttate iti cakrakam
nanunavipakṣe'bhāvasiddhyā puruṣatvādayaḥ kvacit sarvajñā vā bhāvaṃ sādhayanti kintu yadvyāyo; nanu sarvajñābhāvasandehe tadvyāptirapi kathaṃ sidhyati ? tayaiva tadasandeha iti cet; anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ
tathāhi--siddhānāṃtadvyāptau tadabhāvaḥ sidhyanti tatsiddhau ca sā sidhyati
tadāha--tato'nupalambhasyā'siddhitaḥ syāt tatra sarvajñābhāvasādhane vyāptau vā sarvahetūnāṃ puruṣatvādīnāmanyo'nyasamāśrayaḥ
sarvajñābhāve siddhe sarvābhāvopalambhanaṃ sidhyati, tatsiddhau ca tadabhāvaḥ sidhyati iti anyo'nyāśrayatvaṃ yathā, tathaiva vaktuḥ sarvajñasyānupalabdhau sādhyāyām itaretarāśrayatvam
tathāhi--sarvavido'bhāve siddhe sākalyena vaktuḥ sarvavido'darśanaṃ tataḥ tadabhāvasiddhiriti
kena rūpeṇa tatsādhanam ? ityāha--sākalyena, rathyāpuruṣād anye sarve puruṣāḥ rāgādimantaḥ vaktṛtvādibhyaḥ tadvaditi
kathaṃ pratyuktam iti cet ? ucyate--tathā tatsādhane jai mi nyā de rapi sādhanāṃtavedāḥpramāṇamitarat anyathā
vivakṣitapuruṣasyaiva tatsādhane jai mi niḥ anyo vā tadviparīta iti tena hetūnāṃ vyabhicāraḥ
cakṣurādijñānasya anyasya vā abādhitaviṣayatvena svayaṃ yadi prāmāṇyaṃ tataḥ tena pravacanasyāpi yuktam

akṣabuddhigrahaṇam upalakṣaṇamiti codanādibuddhirapi gṛhyate, tasyāḥ tathā yena prakāreṇa pravṛttā tena eva dhānaniścayāt prāmāṇyaṃ cet yadi nirṇītāsaṃbhavadbādhaḥ nirṇīto'saṃbhavatvāt yasya sa tathoktaḥ sarvajñeneti sāhasam iti bhāvaḥ
anyasya codanājñānasya vā svayam ātmanā yadi prāmāṇyam
kena ? avāpitaviṣayatvena tataḥ tenaabādhitaviṣayatvena pravacanasyāpi sarvajñapratipādikāgamasyāpi prāmāṇyaṃ yuktam
kutaḥ ? ityāha--suṣṭhu niścitam asaṃbhavadbādhakaṃ yasya tat tathoktaṃ pramāṇaṃ śāstraṃ yasya tasya bhāvāt tattvāt
tatra yathā sukhādinīlādiṣu suniścitāsaṃbhavadbādhakapramāṇaṃ pratyakṣādi naivaṃ sarvajñe, tato'siddho heturiti cet; atrāha--suniścitetyādi
suniścitāsaṃbhavadbādhakapramāṇaṃ tatra sarvajñe siddhaṃ yat pareṇoktaṃ pratyuktam ityanuvarttate
apare śāstrāprāmāṇyāt iti paṭhanti, teṣām anantarameva tatprāmāṇya mevatprāmāṇyaṃ samarthanaṃ kiṃ vismṛtaṃ yena evaṃ paṭhanti ?
aduṣṭakāraṇārabdhaṃ pramāṇaṃ lokasammatam iti ca parakīyaṃ matadvayamāśritya tatpravacanasya prāmāṇyaṃ vyavasthāpayannāha--sarvajñe'sti ityādi
sarvajñe'stīti vijñānaṃ pramāṇaṃ svata eva tat
sarvajñe astīti vijñānaṃ nahi na svataḥ pramāṇam
na ca tat doṣavatkāraṇaṃ tatpratipādakasyāpi śāstrasya apauruṣeyatvāt bādhakapramāṇābhāvaḥ siddha eva
sarvajñe'sti itya pravacanād yadvijñānaṃ sarvajñagocaramupajāyate tat pramāṇaṃ svata eva nānyataḥ kāraṇāt
nanu tasya autsargikaṃ yat svataḥprāmāṇyaṃ taddoṣavatkāraṇajanyatvenā- pohyate iti cet; atrāha--na ca ityādi
na ca naiva tat prakṛtaṃ vijñānaṃ doṣavatkāraṇaṃ doṣavatkāraṇaṃ yasyeti
tatpratipādakasyāpi sarvajñapratipādakasyāpi na kevayavaidikasya śāstrasya apauruṣeyatvāt doṣāśrayapuruṣarahitatvāt
nanu vāramānaṃ taddoṣavatkāraṇam, yathāśukleśaṅkhe pītajñānam, bādhyamānaṃ ca sarvajñe'stītivijñānamiti cet; atrāha--bādhakapramāṇābhāvaḥ siddha eva
anupalambho bādhaka iti cet; atrāha--svopalambha ityādi
pramāṇāntaraṃ bādhakamiti cet; atrāha--kasyacidanupalambhamantareṇa kasyacidapi sarvajñasya anyasya vā anupalambhamantareṇa vyatirekā'siddheḥ abhābasiddheḥ abhāvapramāṇavaiphalyāpatteḥ
abhāvapramāṇavaiphalyamiti cet; tadiṣyata eva, pratyakṣāviśeṣatvāttasya iti paraḥ
pratyakṣataḥ tadabhāvasādhane dvaitaṃ bhavati kvaviśākalyena vā ? prathamapakṣebhimatatvānna dūṣayitumāśaṅkitaḥ sarvabhāvasattvasya sapratipakṣatvāt
dvitīye'pi pakṣe dvetasedvaita sendriyād, anyato vā ? atrāpi prathamapakṣaḥ śrotriyasya anabhimataḥ sannihitamātre cakṣurādivyāpāropagamanāt nāsaṃkiṃtaḥ
tatra sākalyena anavayavena svayam ātmanā liṅgendriyādinirapekṣasya mīmāṃsakādeḥ bhāvapratipatteḥ sarvajñābhāvapratipatteḥ virodhāt tatpratipatteḥ iti bhāvaḥ
tathāhi--sākalyena svayaṃ tadabhāvapratipattiścet kasyacit; sa eva sarvajña iti tatpratipattiḥ
sā cet na; sa sarvajña iti na tatpratipattiriti
yadi vā, tathā tatpratipatteḥ sakāśād virodhāt samprayoga mī॰ sū॰ 1
evaṃ tāvat paraprasiddhyā dharmādivat sarvajñasya āgamāt sattāṃ prasādhyatā tatra pramāṇapañcakaṃ yatra vasturūpe na jāyate
mī॰ ślo॰ abhāva॰ ślo॰ 1 ityādi nirastam
sambaddhaṃ vartamānaṃ ca gṛhyate cakṣurādinā--mī॰ ślo॰ sū॰ 4 ślo॰ 84
satsamprayoge puruṣasyendriyāṇāṃ yad buddhijanma tatpratyakṣam--mī॰ sū॰
adhunā anumānāt tāṃ prasādhya tannirākurvannāha--jñānasya ityādi
tulanā--etaddhi varghamānaṃ yatra niratiśayaṃ sa sarvajñaḥ
asti kāṣṭhāprāptiḥ sarthajñabījasya sātiśayatvāt parimāṇavaditi, yatra kāṣṭhāprāptirjñānasya sa sarvajñaḥ
nanu tasya bhavatu vibhutvam, na ca sakalavyāptijñānasya vā'viśadasya sakalasya vā syāditi cet; atrāha--vaiśadyam ityādi
kuto'sya vaimyam iti cet ? atrakidoṣa ityādi
itrāepinātyantaṃ kṣayo'darśanāt kvacittasya iti cet; atrāha--māṇikyāderityādi

māṇikyādeḥ ādiśabdātsuvarṇādeḥ atiśayavatī vṛddhimatī malasya kiṭṭikālikādeḥ vyāvṛttiḥ ātyantikī bhavatyeva kasyacit malapratipakṣopayogaprakarṣavato yathā tathā ātmano'pi sā tathāvidhā bhavatyeva iti
nanu buddhivyāvṛttirapi atiśayavaevavatīdṛśyate iti sāpi kvacid ātyantikī syāt, itarathā hetorvyabhicāra iti cet; atrāha--na hyatraityādi
nahikhalu atra ātmaniatiśayāditihetorvyabhicāraḥtato yathā acetanasya karmaṇaḥ ātmanyabhāvaḥ tathā ātmano'pi kvacit acetanobhāva iti sādhyāntaḥpātitvānna vyabhicāraḥ iti
nanu jainasya na nidarśanamātrato heturgamakaḥ api tu vipakṣe sadbhāvabādhakabalāt, na ca vibhutvābhāve jñānātiśayabādhakam iti cet; atrāha--jñānam ityādi
jñānaṃ nirupamaṃ no cet veda sarvagataṃ svataḥ
pratipakṣe sati rāgādyapakarṣadarśanāt, tatprayogātiśayavaśāt doṣāvaraṇavimukteḥ kaivalyasiddhiḥ svabhāvopalabdhireva na punaḥ svabhāvātikrāntiḥ
jñānaṃ no cetnāsti yadi kāṃbhūtam ? ityāha--nirupamaṃ malottaram atīndriyaṃ viśadamabādham

punarapi kiṃbhūtam ? ityāha--sarvagataṃ sarvaviṣayaparicchedanasamartham, svataḥ svamahātmā nendriyādyapekṣātaḥ kutaḥ pramāṇād veda vetti mīmāṃsako laukāyatiko vā lokān jagantikiṃbhūtān ? ityāha--sarvajñavika lānīti
yadi vā lokān puruṣān sarvajñavikalān iti draṣṭavyam ? vedānakṛtrimānanādinidhanān kuto veda ? nahi tathāvidhajñānamantareṇa tadvedanasaṃbhavaḥ indriyajñānasya tatrāsāmarthyāt, anumānābhāvāt

nanu idamasti--vivādagocarau deśakālau sarvajñavikaktotatrāda sannadeśakālavaditi cet; na; uktamatra--anyathānupapattirahitatvādahetava iti, anyathā kaṃciddeśa kālaṃ vā paṇḍitapuruṣarahitaṃ svamātṛvivāharahitasyopalaṃbhasyasarve tathā kinna sādhayetu ? paryāyeṇa narāntareṇa vā tasya darśanaṃnasarvajñasyeti kiṃkṛtametat ? āgamasya tadabhāve apramāṇatvāt, vidyādiviṣayatvācca
arthāpattiḥ punaḥ sarvajñabhāvamantareṇa kasyacidanupajāyamānasya arthasya abhāvāt ayukta vā
vedāgamasya kārye'rthe prāmāṇyāt na tu svarūpe
āgamātrakṛtrimatvasiddhiriti cet; kutaḥ tasya prāmāṇyam ? tata eva iti cet; anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ--siddhe tadakṛtrimatve tataḥ prāmāṇyam, ataśca tatsiddhiriti
na cāparaṃ vākyaṃ tathāvidhamasti yena tatsādṛśyād vedasya tatsiddhiḥsyāt
nāpi tadantareṇa kiñcit pratipannamanupapannamastiyena arthāpattyāakṛtrimatvapratipattiḥ syāt
tacced anādyanantakālaviṣayīkaraṇe'samarthaṃ cet; tattataḥ kutaḥ tatpratipattiriti ?
jñānaṃ nirupamaṃ sarvagatamasti ityetad vyākhyātumāha--kṛtametad ityādi
ato nyāyāt jñānaṃ kartṛ vyāpnoti eva viṣayīkarotyeva
sarvasyāviśeṣāt tattad vyāpnuyāditi cet; atrāha--svaviṣayalokālokarūpe tadviparyayaḥ tasya jñānasya apravṛtti-avaiśadya-mithyātvalakṣaṇo viparyayaḥ jāyate ityadhyāhāraḥ
doṣāvaraṇayoḥ pratipakṣaḥ samyagdarśanādiḥ tasmin sati rāgādyapakarṣadarśanāt adṛṣṭapūrvārthadarśanād upanibandhādeḥ ananyakartṛkasya pravartanāt
na cāvaraṇavigamābhāve svaviṣayonmukhatā jñānasya, timiropahatalocanasya tathā'darśanāt
tasya prayogaḥ samagratā tasyātisaevasāt doṣo rāgādiḥ vyākhyātaḥ pra mā ṇa saṃ gra ha bhā ṣye, āvaraṇaṃ jñānādipracchādakaṃkarma tayoḥ viyukteḥsakāśāt kaivalyasiddhiḥ
syānmatam asarvajñasya sarvajñatvakalpane svabhāvātikramo bhavediti; tatrāha— na punaḥ naiva svabhāvasya kiñcijjñatvasya atikrāntiḥ tatkalpane jīvasya tatsvabhāvāt abhāvaḥ syāt
tatrevam ātmasvabhāve sarvajñatve siddhe sati siddhaṃ phalaṃ darśayannāha--tanna ityādi

yata evaṃ jñānasyātiśayād vibhutvam ātmasvabhāvaṃ malakṣayasādhyatvādapunayatnasādhyaṃ tattasmānulaṅghanādidṛṣṭāntodvyādiśabdena udakatāpaparigrahaḥ, jñānastabhāvātiśayakāṣṭhāvyāptim uparuṇaddhi nirākaroti, dṛṣṭāntena tayāvaiṣamyāt
sa kiṃ kāraṇaṃ svabhāvopalabdhireva siddhirna punaḥ avidyamānadharmā vā tamiti cet; atrāha--nahi ityādi
hiyataḥ tasyāḥkartumaśakyatvāt akṣaliṅgādibhiḥ ādiśabdād āgamābhyāsadharmādiparigrahaḥ, svaviṣayaṃ sahedāsadvagraṃ lakṣaṇam vyāpnuyāt jñānaṃ nānyathā na-svato doṣāvaraṇāpāye iti syāt
nahi ākāśādīnāṃ buddhyādisamavāyikāraṇatvaśaktirahitaṃ svataḥ anyataḥ tatsahitaṃ kriyate, padārthasvabhāvavyavasthābhāvāpatteḥ

atha ātmanaḥ sakalaviṣayagrahaṇasvabhāvajñānajanikā śaktiḥ ātmabhūtānaanyena kriyate; ātmano'pi kriyāprasaṅgāt, jñānaṃ tu kriyate iti cet; ucyate--parayā śaktyā sabhūtayā sa jñānaṃ bhinnam upajanayati, tayaiva arthasya grāhako'stu kiṃ bhinnakalpanayā ? atha bhinnajñānamantareṇa tadgrahaṇaṃ nāsti; bhinnaśaktimantareṇa tajjananaṃ mā bhūt
tatheti cet; yuktam atra śakterevajñānābhāva saiva tatsamayakāriṇamityakāraka ātmeti tadavastutvam
sato'pi tasyā'viśeṣād ākāśāderapi sā na kim ? yadi punaḥ sambandhasyāviśeṣe'pi sambandhinorviśeṣa iṣyate; sa kuto mataḥ ? svayogatā śaktiḥ unyate,tasyā api tato bhede anavasthā
abhede; ādyāpi tathaivāstu kiṃ tadbhedakalpanayā iti sa eva doṣaḥ
sadvargaḥ dravyaguṇakarmarūpaḥ sattāsāmānyasambandhavān, asadvargaśca sāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyātmakaḥ sattāsambandharahitaḥ svataḥsan ityarthaḥ
kiṃca, śaktestato bhede nityatve vyāpitve ca, anyathā na sarvatra sarvadā jñānodayaḥ, iti na yuktam--sarvagata ātmā savatraupalabhyamānaguṇatvāt iti
yadi punaḥ anyatra anyadā sā kenacit kriyate; kathaṃ tadrahitena tatkaraṇam ? anyathā gaganādāvapi tat syāt
ayogyatvānneti cet; kiṃ punaḥ ātmani tadyogyamasti ? bhinnaṃ tathā cedanavasthāparā tato nityavyāpinī ca sā iti kim ātmanā ? tata eva tatkāryasiddheḥ
saiva ātmā iti cet; anubaddhaḥ prasaṅgājñānotpāda-tadarthagrahaṇaṃ tayaivā'stu iti
yadi punaḥ bhinnaṃ jñānatvagrahaṇam; tarhi bhinnā śaktiḥ na tajjananamiti, śakterapi aparā śaktiḥ ityanavasthā cakrakaṃ śaktyantarasya nityatvasarvagatatve

nanu yadi saivārthasya grāhikā, tarhi tasyāḥ sarvasya sarvatra sarvadā'viśeṣāt sarvo'pi sarvadarśī syāditi cet; na; tajjñānasyāpi tataḥ sarvatra sarvadā sarvasyotpattiprasaṅgāditi parapakṣe'pi sa eva doṣaḥ
sahakāravaikalyānneti cet; yathā tarhi tadvaikalyāt jñānaṃ na janayati; tathā āvaraṇavaikalyādarthaṃ na gṛhṇāti
tasya āvaraṇena kiṃ kriyate ? tadvaikalyena kiṃ kriyate ? na kiñciditi cet; āvaraṇenāpi na kiñcit
arthagrāhikā kuto neti cet; jñānavat janikā kuto neti samānam

atha tasyā īdṛśaḥ svabhāvo yatastadvaikalyānna janayati api tu sahakārisākalyājjanayati; tarhi īdṛśo'pi svabhāvo'stu yena āvaraṇasadbhāve na prakāśayati artham api tu tadvaikalye, bhāvaśakteḥ acintyatvāt iti
tattvāvaraṇenāna cet tatsvarūpakhaṇḍanakiṃ tena ? taccet; saugatamatamiti cet; sahakāriṇā na cettasyāḥ kiñcit kriyate; nānyathāsa eva doṣaḥ
yathā tatsānnidhyena karoti, tathā āvaraṇasānnidhye na jñānasvabhāvātiśayakāṣṭhāpsu parova prakāreṇa anyathā kathamayaṃ pratipadyeta
anantarārthasya daśahastāntaraṃ nyostītyosti vyomni yo nāmotplutya gacchati
tattvasaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 826 pūrvapakṣe ityādikaṃ prakārāntareṇa nirākarttuṃ yadi nāma ityadhikāṃ daśahastāntaram ityādikāṃ kārikāmāha--
daśahastāntaraṃ vyomno noplaveraṃbhavādṛśāḥ yadi nāma, yojanānāṃ sahasraṃ kinnotplaveta yatkirādutpaplavetaiva

jātyantaratvam anyatrā'nivārita, yuktaṃ vya manuṣya iti sa paśyeta madhunā naraiḥ vālisiriti vainateyasyādarśanāt yojanasahasrotplavanam asiddhamiti cet; na; bheruṇḍādīnām itarapakṣapekṣayā sātiśayotplavanadarśanāt vainateye tadanivāryam ityevamuktatvāt
garuḍaḥ pakṣijātīyaḥ, itarastu manuṣyajātīya iti bhinnajātīyatvam
nanu ca bheruṇḍasya tadutplavanaṃ jātimātrabhāvitvāt sahajam, puruṣasya tu jñānātiśayo laṅghanavadabhyāsajaḥ ititadvanniyato yukta iti cet; atrāha--vīryāntarāya ityādi
vīryaṃ sāmarthyaṃ tasya antarāyaḥ sato'pyāvāraṃbhaḥkarmaviśeṣaḥ tasya kṣayātiśayo viśleṣavivṛddhiḥ tasya vasā laṅghanādiśakteratiśayapratipatteḥ
ākūtaityāha--āgaruḍādanivāraṇāt kāraṇāt sātiśayasya puruṣasya upapattiḥ sātiśayopapattiḥ
evaṃ manyate--na garuḍasya sahajaṃ laṅghanam, api tu tadvighātikarmakṣayajam, tathā prakṛtamapi syāditi
karmādi damavagamyate ? ātmani vīryaṃ sadeva kenacid āhṛtaṃ tatkṣayād vyajyate, na punaḥ jātyādeḥ asadeva bhavatīti cet; ātmaviśeṣaguṇatvātjñānavaditi
nanu yaduktam--doṣāvaraṇavimukteḥ kaivalyasiddhiḥ iti; tatadoṣavimukteḥ sarvajñe'pi vakturyasaṃbhavāt kvacit, tatpratijñāyāḥ vacanaliṅgajarāgādyanumānena bādhanāt
vacanaṃ hi rāgādimatkāryamiti cet; atrāha--vaco rāgādimatkāryam 426 ka iti
ayaṃ ca vaktṛtvākhyo hetuḥ yasya jñeyaprameyatvavastusattvādilakṣaṇāḥityatra ādipadena ākṣipta eveti
pramāṇaṃ nityatā tāsāṃ vaktāraḥ kiṃ kariṣyate || 13

sarvo vaktā tattvādeva rāgādimān tata eva aviśeṣeṇa yadyapramāṇam; kathaṃ vedasya prāmāṇyam ? vākyānāṃnityatvetālvādivyāpāravaiphalyam anyathā abhivyaktiḥ kriyate na vākyamiti kiṃkṛtametat ? na ca vaidikavākyāni tattvāviśeṣe'pi vaktṛdoṣairnopalipyeran yataḥ pravacanamitarasmāt viśeṣayet, nānyathā
na ca vākyam icchākāryamsuptādau anyathāpi darśanāt
buddhikaraṇapāṭavahetukaṃ vākyam tacca jñānapāṭavaṃ svakāryaṃ parasmāt viśeṣayet
vākyāntarāṇāṃ caitanyanāntarīyakatvaṃ na vedavākyānāmiti svabhāvātikramo mābhūt

atredaṃ vicāryate--sarvaṃ vacanaṃ rāgādimatkāryam, atha kiñcit ? kiñciccet; yadā dṛṣṭakartṛkaṃ tattathā kuto'vagamyate ? anadṛṣṭakartṛkasāmyātcet; kutaḥ sāmyam ? varṇādeḥ iti cet; so'yaṃ varṇādiḥ sarvatra samānaḥ tathā pratyabhijñānānnavā kiñcid ityayuktam--asadarthābhidhānād iti cet; asadarthaviṣayaṃ tarhi vacanaṃ rāgādimatkārya miti tatkartureva rāgādimattvaṃ nānyasya iti siddhasādhanam
yadi punaḥ sarvaṃ vaco vacanaṃ sarvatattvāde rāgādimatkāryaṃ ced yadi codanā vedavacāṃsi kathaṃ pramāṇam tata eva tadvat tatkāryatvāt
nanu sarvakartṛkaṃ sarvatatkāryam ucyate, codanā punarakartṛkā nityatvena iti cet; atrāha--nityatā ityādi
tāsāṃ codanānāṃ sambandhinī nityatā tāsāmeva karttāra kiṃ kariṣyate ? te ca tasyāḥ pramāṇābhāvena niścetumaśa kyatvāt
na hi sā satyapi pratyakṣeṇa niścīyate, tanniścetuḥ sarvajñatāpatteḥ
yadi vā, vyabhicāriṇī pravacanādau bhāvāt ityuktam
yadvā, anyathā vicāryate--kūṭasthanityatā, pariṇāmanityatā vā hetuḥ syāt ? prathamapakṣo'yuktaḥ; pratiṣiddhatvāt
sarvoniravaśeṣo vaktā tattvādevarāgādimān vacanaṃ sarvaliṅgam iti liṅgapariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
tata eva vakto rāgādimattvādevaapramāṇamaviśeṣeṇa yadi kathaṃ vedasya prāmāṇyam ? vedasya karttā nāstīti cet; atrāha--vākyānām ityādi
tālvādivyāpāravaiphalyam, anyathā vyaktirayatī kriyate na vākyam iti kiṃ kṛtametat ? nirūpitaṃ caitat
nanu vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ svata eva arthamabhidadhati na puruṣāt; tataḥ kṛtrimatvena aprāmāṇyaṃ teṣāmiti cet; atrāha--na ca ityādi
na ca naiva vaidikavākyāni vaktṛdoṣau tāpalipyerankintuupalipyerannetvāviśeṣe'pi puruṣapūrvakatvāviśeṣe'pi
na kevalaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā yataḥ nityatvaviśeṣa vacanasya sarvajñatvaṃpravacam itarasmād vedādaviśeṣeyat pramāṇatvena bhinnaṃ tato vyavasthāpayet nānyathā naprakārāṇa
nanu coktam--rāgādimatkāryaṃ vacaḥ sarvam icchāyā rāgādiviśeṣatvāditi cet; na ca vākyam ityādi
kutaḥ ? ityāha--suptādau ādiśabdena anyatragatacittādau anyathāpi samanantarecchāhitaprayatnābhāve'pi daśanādvāsyeti kiṃ tatkāraṇam ? ityāha--buddhi ityādi
atha sarvasya tatpūrvakatvā viśeṣe kathamanyo'nyaṃ samayānāṃ bheda iti cet; atrāha--na ca jñānapāṭavaṃ jīvādijñānapāṭavaṃ svakāryaṃ pravacanaparasmāt sugatādivacanāt viśeṣayet
tatpāṭavaṃ nityaṃ vākyaṃ parasmād viśeṣayet svakāryam iti cet; atrāha--tannityavākyaṃ tattato naviśeṣayet
evaṃ manyate--yadi nityatvaṃ svayaṃ svārthapratipādayet, yuktametat, na caivam
tadvipratipattyabhāvapradhānato vā nirdeśaḥ, na nityatvaṃ vākyaṃ parasmād viśeṣayet
tatra yaduktam vākyaṃ buddhipūrvakameva iti niyamaḥ syāt iti; tanna subhāṣitam
vaidikavākyasya anyathā bhāvāditi cet; atrāha--caitanya ityādi

caitanyanāntarīyakatvaṃ buddhipūrvakatvaṃ vākyaṃ narāṇām pravacanādivākyānāṃ kathaṃ sākyakalpitānavayavatvenāna vedavākyānāṃ tannāntarīyakatvam ityevaṃ yaḥ pareṇa svabhāvātikramaḥ kalpitaḥ sarvajñavītarāgavādinaṃ prati svabhāvātikramaṃ doṣaṃ vadatāpi sa mā bhūt
tat suptādau icchāvacāri buddhipūrvakaṃ kṛtvaṃśruteḥ vedasya pauruṣeyatvaṃ sāvayavatve ca yataḥ tatsādhane niḥkalatvāt
nanu vākyatvaṃ syāt na ca śruteḥ pauruṣeyatvaṃ sādhayiṣyati, vipakṣavyāvṛtteḥ sandehādaheturityāha-- puruṣātiśayaḥ siddhaḥ ityādi
nityaṃ vedaṃ bruvatāmapi sarvajño vītadoṣaḥ siddhaḥ
kathaṃ sarvajño'sarvajñaiḥ jñāyate yataḥ pravṛttikāmastatpravacanaṃ pratipadyeta
tathaiva iti śravaṇāt yathaiva ityanumīyate yattadornityasambandhāt
tato'yamarthaḥ— yathaiva cānyatvāviśeṣe'pi āgamasya vedasya nityatā na parasya, vaktṛtvādyaviśeṣe'pi puruṣasyātiśayaḥ sarvajñavītarāgādilakṣaṇaḥ siddhaḥ tathaiva, anyathā tannityatāpimābhūdaviśeṣāt
nāviśeṣevede nityatānibandhanasya prāmāṇyasya bhāvāt puruṣe tvatiśayanibandhanasya viparyayāditi cet; na; asyatadatiśayanibandhanatvena pratipādayiṣyamāṇatvāt atraiva
nahi sakaladeśakālakalāpavyāpī vyāmīśa tadatiśayamantareṇa pratyetuṃ śakyaḥ
yataḥ prāṇabhṛnmātradarśanena yadi padārthasattāmātraṃ vyāpyate taddarśanaṃ ca smaraṇena, yuktametat syāt, na caivamiti

syānmatam--sarvajñasyābhāvāt na sa vedasya karttā, tasyadheyatogranthaprabandhasya parokṣe'rthe pramāṇabhūtasya karaṇā'sāmarthyāt siddhā tannityatā, naivaṃ tadatiśayaḥ, evaṃvidhāpāyābhāvāditi; atrāha--sarvajñabhāvasaṃvittesvānyathānupapattitaḥ puruṣātiśayaḥ siddhaḥ iti ghanāyamṛdu sarvajñasyābhāvānu sa vedasya kartā iti, sākalyena tadabhāve niścite sati, śaṅkā'nivṛttiranyathā tanniścayo'pi sarvajñād iti bhāvaḥ
nityaṃ vedaṃ bruvatāmapi na kevalamanyeṣām sarvajño vītadoṣaḥ siddho vākyatvavat vaktṛtvāderapi sadoṣatvāt iti
anena sarvajñaḥsiddha iti darśayati, yathā samayam ityādinā vītadoṣa iti ca nityatvādeva vedonanāstikyavacanādikam anityam aviśeṣata iti cet; atrāha--karturasmaraṇād ityādi
yadi vā, nityatvād vedaḥ pramāṇam nānyo viparyayāt; tatra hetoḥ vyabhicāraṃ darśayannāha--nava ityādi
karttā tasya smaryata iti cet; atrāha--sarvatra ityādi
ya eva syādasarvajñaḥ sa sarvajñaṃ na budhyate
mā jñāyatā kiṃ tena jñāteneti cet; atrāha--yata ityādi
yato yasmāvṛdvi jñānāt pravṛttikāmaḥ tatpravacanaṃ sarvajñapravacanaṃ pratipadyeta
taduktam sarvajño yena na jñātaḥ mī॰ ślo॰ codanā॰ ślo॰ 136ityādi

sarve sthāvaraprabhṛtayaḥ sakalajagadvāsina ātmāno jīvāḥ teṣāṃ ca yānijñānāni yacca vijñeyaṃ paricchedyam ajñeyaṃ aparicchedyaṃ tattva tadvivecayan pratyakṣeṇa jānan, anyasya tatrāvyāpārāditi nirūpayiṣyate mīmāṃsakaḥ sarvajñaḥ syāt

yathaiva hi sarvajñasya jñānaṃ tadvijñeyatṛtvam vā jātanā sarvajño'yam iti jñātuṃ na śakyate, tajñāteva so'pi sarvajñaḥ, tathā sarvātmanā tajjñānānāṃvijñeyoyājñevaṃ tattvasya vāasākṣātkaraṇe etenāmanujānāti pravṛttim anyatrate tyajātet kathaṃ sākalyena sarvajñābhāvavit ? jānan sa eva sarvajñaḥ iti
tathā ca dharme codanaiva pramāṇamnānyat kiñcana indriyādikam śābarabhā॰ 1
sarvajñatvena ātmānaṃ yadi svayameva jānāti anyo'pi tathaiva svaṃ tathā jānāti iti tadviṣayānupalabdhisiddhau
ataḥ kaḥ ? sarvajñasadbhāvaścāghā anena jñāyate iti sa eva doṣaḥ
tathā sati kalpanīyāśca sarvajñāḥ mī॰ ślo॰ codanā॰ ślo॰ 135 ityādi parapakṣe'pi samānam
caudanaiva pramāṇañcetyetad dharme'vadhāritam--mī॰ ślo॰ co॰ sū॰ ślo॰ 4
codanā hi bhūtaṃ bhavantaṃ bhaviṣyantaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vyavahitaṃ viprakṛṣṭamityevaṃ jātīyakamarthamavagamayitumalaṃ nānyat kiñcanendriyādikam --śābarabhā॰ 1

kiṃca, tasya jñānaṃ kvacit kadāvidyādi parisamāptam; tāvanmātratvam ātmanāṃ jñānānāṃ ceti prāptamiti katham anādyanantatā teṣāmiti ka idānīṃ cedasya anādyanantatāṃ pratīyāt ? tataḥ paraṃ tatpāṭhako vā ? yataḥ sattvaṃ saṃbhāvyeta ? atha tatparisamāptāvapi na teṣāṃ tāvanmātratā; tarhi tenāparicchinnasvarūpāṇāmapi bhāvat, na vā kālasya kiñcijjñatāsiddhiḥ
yadi punarna kvacit tatparisamāptamiṣyate; na tarhi bahukalpasahasrairapi sarvātmajñānavijñeyājñeyatattvavivecanam ya eva tena ajñātaḥ tatraiva sarvajñatvāśaṅkā nāt nivarttate
kālatvāditi hetoḥ vartamānakālavat iti yaḥ sarvajñatā'bhāvaḥ sādhyate sa na iti bhāvaḥ
yasyātmakaṃ yathābhāvamasau pratyeti tenā'yamadoṣaḥ; anyo'pi sarvajñaḥ tathaiva pratyeti iti tatrāsyadoṣā syādbhāvāt
nanu syādayaṃ doṣo yadyasau sarvātmajñānavijñeyājñeyatattvaṃ vivecayet, yāvatā naivamiti cet; atrāha--no cet na yadi dhayet svayam ātmanaiva sarvajñābhāvavit kathaṃ naiva
sarvajñabhāvāvedane ca dharme codanaiva pramāṇam ityanyayogavyavacchedena codanāprāmāṇyasādhanamasāram
vedānyasmin-sarvajñe yogasya-prāmāṇyasambandhasya yaḥ vyavacchedo'bhāvaḥ tena rūpeṇa
kiṃca, tadabhāvasandehe vede'kartṛtvaṃ sandigdhaṃ kathaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ sādhayet yataḥ pravṛttikāmo'pauruṣeyād vacanāt tataḥ pravartteta ? sarvajñasya asmadādyadṛśyasyatatkartuḥ sadbhāvāśaṅkā'nivṛtteḥ
asmaraṇamapi tadabhāvaṃ na sādhayati; smaraṇaṃ hi anubhavakāryaṃ na prameyakāryam, aviśeṣeṇa sarvasya tataḥ tatprasaṅgāt
natadabhāvāt prameyābhāvāt prameyābhāvaḥ; anyathā dhūnābhāvāt sarvābhāvaḥ syāt
kintu yadi syāt tatkāraṇasya anubhavasya syāt
na ca asmadādyanubhavaḥ sarvaprameyakāryaḥ yena tadabhāve vivakṣitaprameyābhāvaḥ syāt
tato vedasyaakartṛtvamicchatā tadabhāvo jñātavya iti na prakṛtadoṣaparihāraḥ
atha tadavivecayanneva tadabhāvaṃ veti tatrāha--yadi ityādi
tasya sarvajñeyasya jñānaṃ tasya jñeyaṃ tatra jñānaṃ tena vaikalyāt sutarāṃ sarvātmanāmasarvajñatvam svayaṃ na budhyeta asarvajña iti
syādayaṃ doṣo yadi sarvātmanāmasarvajñatvam adhyakṣeṇa pratīyeta, na caivam anumānena tatpratīteriti cet; atrāha--puruṣa ityādi
evaparasya sarvajñatāpratipādane yat phalaṃ prāptaṃ taddarśayannāha--nara ityādi
satyapi puruṣatvādisāmānye yathā kecideva sarvajñaśūnyaṃ jagat tadrāgādimattvaṃ vā vidanti netare tathaiva yadi kecana sarvajñāḥ syuḥ kinnopapadyeta yataḥ sarvajño naiva syāt ?
naraḥpuruṣaḥ śarīrī vaktā vā sakalajñāsakalajña kiṃvijñatvājagadvidatu sarvajñaḥ syāt tato nāsti sarvajñābhāvasādhanam, tatsādhanasya tena vyabhicārād iti bhāvaḥ

satyapi na kevalam asati puruṣatvādisāmānye yathā kecideva sarvajñaśūnyaṃ jagat jai mi nyā da yo vidanti, kasyasugatāde rāgādimattvaṃ vā parokṣasya vidanti netare rathyāpuruṣāḥ tathaiva yadi sarvajñaḥkecana syuḥ kinnopapadyeta yato'nupapatteḥ sarvajña naiva na kvacit syāt
nanu syādayaṃ doṣo yadi pratyakṣeṇa jagat tathā vidanti kecit, kintu anumānena
tathāhi--sarvātmajñānātipratyakṣābhimatāni vivādagocaratāṃ gatāni, indriyārthasannikarṣajāni niyataviṣayāṇi tā, tattvāt, atredānotadyakṣajñānatvaṃ
tathā viṣayā vivādaviṣayāḥ pratiniyatārthendriyādhyakṣaviṣayāḥ, tattvāt, vivakṣitaviṣayavat
iti cet; na; satyasvapnena asya vyabhicārāt
taddhi satyasvapnajñānam indriyāsaṃsṛṣṭaṃ vyavahitaṃ cārthamavaiti iti pra mā ṇa saṃ gra he nirūpitam
tarhi bādhakavat sādhakasyāpi sarvajñobhāvāt saṃśaya iti cet; etadevāha— sādhaka ityādinā
tanna sākalyena bādhakapramāṇavyāvṛtteranyat sādhakaṃ nāma, yatastasya sādhakabādhakapramāṇābhāvāt sarvajñatvaṃ saṃśītimavataret
kvacit puruṣaviśeṣe sarvajñatvaṃ siddha kutaḥ ? ityāha--bādhakā'saṃbhavāt
anenaitat kathayati--bādhakābhāvaḥ paramārthasattvena vyāptaḥ, sukhādisvasaṃvadene tathādarśanāt, paramārtha tattvābhāve ca grāhyamarīcikādinirādyākārobādhakābhāvanivṛtteḥ
yannivṛttyā yanniyamena nivarttate tattena vyāptam, yathā jñānatvaṃ svasaṃvadenena, nivartate ca tatsattvanivṛttau tadabhāva iti
syānmatam--tatsattvābhāve'pi svapnādidṛṣṭaghaṭādau tadabhāvātna tena tadvyāptiriti; tattatsvasaṃvedanagrāhyākārayoraviśeṣaprasaṅgāt tadākāranivedanāt
apare manyante--prāgabhāvādau tatrāsaṃbaṃdharahite tatsattvābhāve'pi bādhakapramāṇābhāvaḥ iti nānayoḥ vyāpyavyāpakabhāva iti; tanna; bhāvād bhinne'bhāve bādhakasatasya darśitatvāt, sattāsambandha vā
tato yataeva bādhakāsaṃbhavād bhāvaniścayaḥ tata eva tatraśabdehamvavadataḥ mūḍhamataya iti
nanu na tata ekena tatsvarūpāt kevalāt kvacit saṃśītiriṣyate, api tu sādhakābhāvasahitāt
na ca sarvajñe so'stīti cet; atrāha--sāvakasyaivaṃsaṃbhavāt iti vyatirecako niyato'yaṃ siddham ityasyā'nantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ
sādhakasya saṃbhavāt kvacit sarvajñatvaṃ siddhesaca tatsaṃbhavo darśito neha punarupadarśyate
yadi ca ātmanaḥ sakalapadārthasākṣātkārī kasyacid avasthāviśeṣaḥ samastīti śrautī bādhakarahitā pratītiḥ tatsādhakaṃ pramāṇamiti
yatpunaruktaṃ dha rma kī rti nā--sādhakabādhakapramāṇābhāvāttarhi sandeho'stu iti; tatrāha--kena pramāṇena taddvayasya sādhakabādhakapramāṇadvayasya abhāvanirṇayaḥ na kenacid iti niveditametat
evaṃ manyate--sarvajñe hetoḥ sandehasādhanam, hetunāca siddhena bhavitavyam, anyathā tataḥ tatsādhanāyogāt, sandigdhāsiddhāvacanaprasaṅgāditi
seyaṃ sādhakabādhakapramāṇānupapattau satyāṃ samānadharmopalabdhiḥ vinaśyadavasthā viśeṣasmṛtyā sahāvinaśyadavasthaya ekasmin kṣaṇe satī saṃśayajñānasya heturiti siddham
nanu mā bhūt taddvayābhāvanirṇayaḥ, sandeho bhavadviti cet; tata eva tatra sandehaḥ syāt na taddvayābhāvāt iti
astu tata eva sandeha iciṃti cet; atrāha— bādhaka ityādinā
tatra śabdaḥ kramavācī, tanna tatsandehāttatra sandeha iti bhāvaḥ
tathāpi tata eva tatra sandehaṃ cet; atrāha--tata eva ityādi
kutaḥ ? ityāha--pratyakṣasyāpi, na kevalam āgamasya tata eva prāmāṇyaṃ yataḥ iti
syānmatam--pratibhāsāt tatpramāṇyaṃ na tataḥ iti; tatrāha--yathādarśanam ityādi
tattvapratipattau prāmāṇyapratipattāvaṅgīkriyamāṇāyām atiprasaṅgāt sakalajñānapramāṇatāpraṃsaṅgāt, sva vetadbāsyamapi nirārekabhavet

yata evaṃ tat tasmāt na sākalyena bādhakapramāṇavyāvṛtteḥ sakāśāt anyat sādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ nāma kintu saiva sādhikā iti, yato'nyasya sādhakasya bhāvāt tasya sarvajñatvasya sādhakabādhakapramāṇābhāvāt sarvajñatvaṃ saṃśītimavataret
sādhakabādhakayoḥ anyo'nyaṃ parasparaṃ yau vidhipratiṣedhau tāveva lakṣaṇaṃ yayoḥ tayorbhāvāt tattvāt
tathāhi--bādhakapratiṣedha eva sādhakavidhiḥ, tatpratiṣedha eva sabādhakavidhiḥ, tathā bādhakavidhireva sādhakapratiṣedhaḥ tadvidhireva bādhakapratiṣedha iti
anyathā jīvaccharīre nairātmyaniṣedhaḥ sātmako na syāt, kṛtakatvādervā hetoḥ asati vipakṣe abhāvābhāvo bhāvātmako na bhavet dha rma kī rtteḥ iti
tanna bādhakanivṛttiśca syāt na ca sarvajñasadbhāvaḥ pratibandhābhāvāt iti; sandigdhavipakṣavyāvṛtteḥ śeṣavat sādhanam
satī bādhakanivṛttiḥ sarvavitsattāṃ sādhayet nātra saṃśayaḥ
na vai kasyacidapyabhāve bādhakapramāṇameva na syāt kintu tadabhāve sādhakapramāṇaṃ ca na
tadiyameva niścitā sarvajñasadbhāvaṃ kuto na sādhayati, sādhakavyāvṛtterasaṃbhavāt
jagataḥ sakalajñavaikalye sādhyaviparyayarūpe satitadbādhakanivṛttiḥ saṃbhavantī tatsadbhāvehetuḥ sarvajñasadbhāvahetuḥ kathamiti ? tatrottaram--bādhaka nivṛttiḥ ityādi
kasmin sati ? ityāha--sarvavido'tyaye sarvajñābhāve, tannivṛtteḥ tatsadbhāvena vyāptatvāt
nanu kathaṃ tatsadbhāvā'siddhau tena tadvyāptiḥ ? tannivṛtteḥ tatsiddhiriti cet; anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ
tathāhi--tannivṛtteḥ tadvyāptisiddhau tataḥ tatsadbhāvaḥ sidhyati, punaḥ tena tadvyāptiḥ iti; tanna; śabdānityatvena kṛtakatvādervyāptisādhane'pyasya samānatvāt
athātra na dharmiṇi vyāptisiddhiḥ iṣyate, api tu sapakṣe ghaṭādau; tarhi ta sarvajño dharmiṇi tannidhyatvasadbhātena vyādhiḥ sādhyate kintu sapakṣe sukhādau
atra anityatvasāmānyena; anyatra sattvasāmānyena vyāptiriti samānam
tavaetāvatā hetogamatvam; tatputratvāderapi gamakatvaprasaṅgāt, antarvyāpteḥ tasya gamakatvopagamāt, sā ca dharmiṇi gṛhyate
na caitanna nivṛtte ra stāti cet; atrāha--satī ityādi
sarvade di dharmiṇi bādhakasya nivṛttiḥ sarvavidaḥ sattāṃ sādhayet nātra sādhye saṃśayaḥ kāryaḥ ityadhyāhāraḥ
garbhastho maitratanayaḥ śyāmo bhaviṣyati maitratanayatvāt ityādeḥ
nanu idamanumānam tadantarabādhitaviṣayakathaṃ sādhyasādhakamiti ? tathāhi--nāsti sarvajñā suniścitāsaṃbhavatsādhakapramāṇa tvāṃtarāna vai ityādi

kasyavidarpya hato'nyasya vā sarvajñasya abhāve aṅgīkriyamāṇe bādhakapramāṇameva na syāt uktavidhinā sarvajñasya iti kintu api tu tasyābhāve sādhye sādhakapramāṇaṃ ca na syāt sādhakapramāṇābhāvaḥ syāditi
na vai naiva sarvajñābhāve sādhakapramāṇābhāvasya niścetumaśakteḥ, tasya tadantarasya vā tatsādhakapramāṇasya bhāvāt
tadabhāvānneti cet; kutaḥ tadabhāvaḥ ? anyata iti cet; asya vaiphalyam
ata iti cet; anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ--siddhe tadabhāve sākalyeṃtadasādhaka pramāṇaṃ na syāditi syātbhaveca tadabhāvasiddhiriti yatkiñcidetat
sādhakavyāvṛttiḥ tadabhāvaṃ kuto na sādhayati ? ityāha--sādhakavyāvṛtterasaṃbhavāt sarvajñābhāve tannirṇayāsaṃbhavād iti bhāvaḥ
vipakṣe bādhakaṃ darśayannāha--prameyāntarasyāpi sukhādirūpasya na kevalam aśeṣavitprameyasya bhattvaṃ parapārśvatattvam abādhitavijñānajñeyatvādeva, darśitamātrasya vyabhicāritvāt
arthakriyākāraṇāditi cet; na; tadapratibhāsane tataḥ taditi svapāyogāt
aitena arthakriyātaḥ taditi nirastam, anavasthā ca tatrāpi tadantarāpekṣaṇāt
sattāsambandhāt ityeke; marīcikātoye śakrato na ? bādhanāditi cet; patito'simadupadiṣṭo dharmanya ca marthaṃ caivakārakaraṇam
darśitaṃ darśanaviṣayībhūtam etāvanmātreṇa pramāṇatvaṃ neti bhāvaḥ
syānmatam--abādhitavijñānajñeyatvam aśeṣavidi asiddham; ityatrāha--tadabādhitajñānajñeyatvam asti sarvajñe'pi, gatārthametat
sādhakapramāṇaṃ sarvajñaviṣayaṃ jñānam bādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ tadabhāvaviṣayaṃ tat tadabhāve tadviṣayajñānarahitatve aṅgīkriyamāṇe saṃśayo'pi mā bhūt
śūnyatvavat ityarthaḥ kadācit syāt mṛtavat ityarthaḥ
nanu sarvajñānam ātmādhīnaṃ pañcatve tadabhāvāt kathaṃ taditi cet ? atrāha--supta ityādi
paramapyatra vaktavyamasti iti darśayannāha--ityalaṃ prasaṅgena iti
nanu satyapi sarvajñe katham arhanneva sarvajño netaraḥ ? taduktaṃ suktam
sugato yadi sarvajñaḥ kapilo neti kā pramā
tāvubhau yadi sarvajñau matabhedaḥ kathaṃ tayoḥ
kasya ? stātra vastunaḥ sukhādinīlādeḥ anekāntātmano'nubhūtasya ekāntarūpatayā lakṣaṇāt kalperansarvajñaḥ kiṃ parīkṣakaiḥ ? naiva
syānmatam--paracetovṛttīnāṃ duranvayatvāt kathamavagamyate tadalakṣayantaḥ iti ? anyathābhidhānā dūranaliṃvāṃdviprantati prāyāḥ

utpattirātmalābhaḥ, sthitiḥ sattvam, nāśaḥ punaḥ svabhāvapracyavanam ca, etat parasparaikārthātmakaṃ katham ? apariṇāmino'pi tāvat kṣaṇikasya kalāntarasthāyino vā'rthasya yo yadātmā yathābhūtaḥ sa taṃ sadaiva labhate
na ca tryātmavyatirekeṇa utpattiḥ sthitirvipattirvāyujyeta, dravyāntaravyāvṛttilakṣaṇatvāt svasvabhāvasthiteḥ
sato dravyasya dṛśyaṃ madhyarūpaṃ kathañcitsadeva, anyathā...sarvathā...
tadante kṣayadarśanāt pūrvamapi kṣayamicchan madhye sthitidarśanāt pūrvāparakoṭyorapi svabhāvasthitiṃ niścetumarhati aviśeṣāt
natu anekāntātmakatvavat ekasya pratikṣaṇaṃ sthityutpattivyayātmakatvam, na ca manyā dīnātathotpattivyayau, caramadhyakṣaṇānāṃ ca sthitiḥ pratīyate iti cet; atrāha--sarvasyaiva ityādi
sarvasyaiva na niyatasya cetanetaravargasya sato vidyamānasya, hetupadametat
kiṃ sarvatra sarvathā ? na ityāha, kvacit kathañcid iti sthityutpattivyayānāṃ madhye anyatamātmanaḥ anyatamasvabhāvasya manya dau sthityātmanaḥ saṃsārijīvādau trayātmanaḥ
kā ? ityāha--ātmalābhaḥ ātmanaḥ svarūpasyalābhaḥ, prāgasato na kāraṇasamavāyaḥ sattāsamavāyo vā iti bhāvaḥ
tathāhi--pūrvaṃ svataḥ sataścet samavāyaḥ utpattiḥ; ātmādivibhutvādīnāṃ ca syāt

pūrvavat paścādapi teṣāmasattvāt neti cet; kimidaṃ tadasattvam ? tatsambandhābhāvaścet; so'pi kutaḥ ? abhāvāccet; anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ— tathāhi--siddhe tadabhāve tatsambandhatvābhāvaḥ, tasmācca tadabhāva iti
kathaṃ va pradhvaṃsābhāvo vidyamānaḥ ? yato mudgarādisāphalyam
nimittakāraṇamasti iti cet; itaratra kutaḥ ? adarśanāditi cet; tata eva buddhiśabdādīnām atyantabhinnam ātmākāśādi samavāyikāraṇaṃ na syāt
nirādhāratā syāt cet; astu, ko doṣaḥ ? nirūpatā iti cet; na; pradhvaṃsena vyabhicārāt
guṇatvābhāvaścet; kimidaṃ guṇatvaṃ nāma ? svarūpameva iti nottaram; pradhvaṃsetipi prasaṅgāt
dravyāśritatvam iti cet; tadapi kutaḥ ? guṇatvāditi tu bhāṣitam, anyo'nyasaṃśrayāt--guṇatve tadāśritatvaṃ tato guṇatvamiti
kāraṇābhāve atyantābhāvarūpatā siddhyati, tasyāśca kāraṇābhāva iti
yatpunaretat--buddhyādiḥ guṇaḥ niṣidhyamānadravyakarmabhāvatve sati sattāsambandhitvād rūpādivat iti; tadapi na sundaram; pradhvaṃsena vyabhicārāt
na vyabhicāraḥ; tasya sattāsambandhitvābhāvāditi cet; na; tasya sattāsambandho'pibhavatudoṣābhāvāt
kathamanyathā pradhvaṃsaḥ san iti pratyayaḥ ? aupacārika iti cet; kuta etat ? tatsambandhābhāvāsyāpi kutaḥ ? tatpratyayasya aupacārikatvāccet; anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ
atha pradhvaṃse satpratyaya upacarito dravyādiviṣayaupacarito dravyādiviṣayatve sati tatpratyayatvāt sāmānyādivaditi; tadviṣayatvaṃ kutaḥ ? tatpratyayopacārāt; punaḥ anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ
atha na pradhvaṃso dravyādīnāmanyatemonyāśriyatvetāpratītecata eva buddhyādirapina syāditi tadeva āvartate iti cakrakaprasaṅgaḥ
tulanā--guṇaḥ śabdo dravyakarmānyatve sati sattāsambandhitvāt rūpādivat
syānmatam--pradhvaṃsātāsambandhe abhāvatvaṃ hīyate iti; tasyotpāde arthakriyākāritve vā kuto na hīyate ? tato yathā tadaviśeṣe'pi tanna hīyate tathā tatsambandhāviśeṣe'pi iti sarvaṃ sustham
kiñcittatsambandhābhede'pi yadi dravyādīnāṃ bhāvābhāvabhedaḥ; abhāvo'pibhinna ḥ syāt, avāntarasāmānyasya abhāveṣvapi niṣeddhumaśakyatvāt
tanna buddhyādīnāṃ guṇatvaṃ pradhvaṃsavaditi na samavāyikāraṇasiddhiḥ
atha buddhyādeḥ kādācitkatvaṃ samavāyikāraṇaṃ gamayati; tadapi pradhvaṃsena vyabhicāri
bhāvatve sati ityapi na sundarataram; pradhvaṃsavat bhāvasyāpi kasyacit tathotpanyavirodhāt, citratvād bhāvasvabhāvānām
atha buddhyādeḥ samavāyikāraṇābhāve kuta utpattiḥ ? pradhvaṃsavat nimittakāraṇāt kinna syāt ? itarathā pradhvaṃsasyāpi na syāt
nirhetu pradhvaṃsabhāve na kāraṇābhāvaprayukta ḥ kāryābhāva iti cet; sauvikrate abhāvatvāditacet; uktamatra
api ca, ghaṭādīnāṃ kāraṇaṃ sattāsambandho vā asti iti kutaḥ ? svarūpeṇa sattve tadapi vetite cet svatvamāyātam
ubhayamapi neti cet; padārthāntaraṃ tathāvidhaṃ kinna syādṛtaḥpadārthasaṃkhyāniyamo vyavatiṣṭheta
punaḥ ityādinā saṃ svabhāvaśabdena bhāvādbhinnaṃ svātsaṃpratiṣedhati pracyavanam ityanena sataḥ tirobhāvam, nirūpitaṃ caitat
etat utpattyāditrayaṃ parasparasya anyo'nyasya ekārtha ātmā svabhāvo yasya tattathoktam
apariṇāmino'pi na kevalaṃ pariṇāminaḥ, tāvat śabdaḥ bhāvanāyām
kiṃbhūtasya ? kṣaṇikasya kālantarasthāyino vā nityasya ityarthaḥ

tasya kim ? ityāha--yauyasya kṣaṇikasya nityasya ātmā svabhāvo yathābhūtaḥ kṣaṇiko nityo vā so'rthasamātmānaṃ sadaiva labhate kadācinneti nāyaṃ vibhāgaḥ anyathā sarvatra sarvadā kṣaṇikam ātmādikaṃ vā nityaṃ tasyā
tathā ttayātmako'pyarthaḥ taṃ sadaiva labhate iti bhāvaḥ
syādetadevam yātmako'rthaḥ syāt karaṇavasetkadācit prāpteḥ iti cet; atrāha--nacetyātmyaṃ tryātmakatvaṃ tasya vyatireko'bhāvaḥ tena utpattiḥ nahi
utpattisvabhāvarahitaṃ kharaviṣāṇādi kāraṇābhāvādanutpattimat na ghaṭādirviparyayāditi cet; uktamatra
kiṃ ca, sadadhikāraṇam anutpitsusvabhāvaṃ notpādayati, anyathā avinaśvara vināśayet
na kasyacidutpattiriti cet; uktamatra cakrādivaiphalyam iti
na khalu sthitisvabhāvagarhitaṃ kutacit sthāva na marhati
nahi karma dattaphalamīśvareṇāpi sthāpayituṃ śakyadhi kāryavirodhi vaiśe॰ 1
atha īśvarasya tatsthāpanaśaktiḥ nāsti; anyatra katham ? anyathā ubhayarūpatā īśasya
yathā vā'śakto na sthāpakaḥ tathā sthitiśaktirahito na kutaścit tiṣṭhati iti samānam
kāryavirodhi karma--karma svakāryeṇa phalena virudhyate vināśyate ityarthaḥ
nanu na sthitisvabhāvatāprayuktā sthitiḥ, tasyāmapi vinośrutyayapraṇidhāne ghaṭādervināśadarśanāditi cet; na; tasya vinaśvarasvabhāvatvāt
sarvadā kuto na nāśae ti cet ? ka evamāha--ne tīti ? kevalaṃ tirodhānādanupalakṣaṇaṃ suvarṇe uṣṇasparśavat
kāraṇabhedāt kadācitkī śaktistu vināśaiti sthitisvabhāva eva tiṣṭhati
tathā tadvyatirekeṇa vipatī rvya vināśo vā na yujyeta
na vināśa iti cet; kapālādau ghaṭādidarśanaprasaṅgaḥ
svedravyādinyonedravyādupaḥ tadantarāṇi tebhyo vyāvṛttiḥ lakṣaṇaṃ yasya tasya bhāvāt tattvāt vastunaḥ ityadhyāhāraḥ
svena svabhāvena sthiteḥ sarvabhāvānām, anyathā sarvātmakam anādyanantaṃ ca sarva syāt iti bhāvaḥ
itaretarābhāvābhāve sarvātmakam, prāgabhāvābhāve--utpattyabhāve anādi, pradhvaṃsābhāvābhāve anantaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ
tathā coktam--sarve bhāvāḥ svabhāvena pra॰ vā॰ 3
ṣu ityavadhāraṇe pariṇāmina eva arthasya ta sthite sadaivaṃlabhate iti
kuta etad iti cet ? atrāha--sato vidyamānasya pūrvasvabhāvapracyutireva saugatena iṣyamāṇā punaḥ paścāt svabhāvāntaraprāptiḥ
yadi vā, tatprāptireva tatpracyutiḥ na punaranyaḥ pradhvaṃsaḥ
tatra yadā uttarakāryamanantaraṃ bhavati tadā bhavatu etat, yadā kāle na bhavati vā tadā kathamiti cet ? atrāha--pariṇāmi ityādi
pariṇāmikāraṇasya upādānakāraṇasya svakāryātmano yo vivarttaḥ taṃ pratyanyānapekṣaṇāt tatpracyutirekatatprāptiḥ
syānmatam--na tatprāptireva tatpracyutiḥ kintu bhinno'bhāva iti cet; atrāha--pūrvasya vaikalyam abhāvaḥ uttarasya kaivalyam pūrvākārarahitatā parasya na tasthaḥpradhvaṃsaḥ
tadadā kāle na bhavati vā tadā kathamiti cet ? atrāha--pariṇāmītyādi
pariṇāmikāraṇasya upādānakāraṇasya svakātmano yo vivartaḥ taṃ pratyanyānapekṣaṇāt tatprapratīti
tarhi pūrvāparākāravināśotpādamātraṃ sthitiḥ iti prasaktamiti cet; atrāha— na ca ityādi
atha mataṃ yatra nirantaraṃ sapatrayaṃ labhyatetatra sthitipratipattirastu, yatra madhyarūpameva tatra kathamiti cet ? atrāha--sata ityādi
sato dravyasya dṛśyaṃ yat madhyarūpaṃ tat pūrvāparakoṭyoranupalabhyam sadeva kathañcit na sarvātmanā
yadi matam--pūrvaṃ tat sadaśrutiḥ kāraṇotpattivirodhāt, paścāt kutaḥ ? ityāha svam ityādi
kuda idamavagamyate tatpariṇāmamaprāpnuvataḥ tadupakārāsaṃbhavaḥ ? ityāha--paraspara ityādi
parasparam anyonyaṃ pravarttanaṃ samartharūpeṇa utpādanaṃ pravṛttiḥ asamartharūpeṇa nivarttanaṃ nivṛttiḥ tābhyām anvayaḥ anugrāmovyatireko vyāvṛttiḥ tāveva lakṣaṇaṃ yasya tasya bhāvāt tattvāt
evaṃ sati yat siddhaṃ tad darśayannāha--tad ityādi

yata evamanantaraṃ saṃvṛttaṃ tat tasmāt ante visadṛśakāryotpādakāle kāryānutpādasamaye vā kṣayadarśanāt dravyāṇāṃ pavyepi kṣayaṃtiṣṭhi kṛt saugato madhye sthitidarśanāt pūrvāparakoṭyoḥ adhi svabhāvasthitiṃ niścetumarhati
atha atra pramāṇabādhanam tatpūrvatra ; ityāha— aviśeṣāditi
nanu dṛśyādṛśyasvabhāvayorbhedāt kathamekaṃ dṛśyetararūmamiti cet ? atrāha— dṛśya ityādi
udbhūtānudbhūtaurūpasparśau ādī yeṣāṃ gandhādīnāṃ te tathoktāta, dmū tānudbhūtārūpasparśādayo yasya yugalotrānyapadārthaḥ, tasyeva tadvaditi
tathāhi--pṛthivyāṃ rūpādayaḥ sarve'pi sāmānyena udbhūtā dṛśyāḥ, viśeṣāpekṣayā tu ubhayathā vibhattiapsu gandho'nudbhūto netare, tejasi gandharasau, vāyau sparśa eva udbhūtaḥ
atha jalādau gandhādayaḥ sattāti kutaḥ pratītiriti cet ? sparśavattvāt pṛthivīvat
anyatra najātīye udbhūtiḥ syāditi cet; na; pṛthivyāṃ tadbhāvād adoṣāt
kathaṃ tasyāḥ tajjātīyatvam ? kathaṃ hemajātīyatvam ? hemajātīyatvam agneḥ tejodravyatvāt; pudgalatvāt iti samānam
kathaṃ tatra ? hotri kathaṃ tejastvam ? nahi aparaṃ tatra tsāmāhāti vivādābhāvaprāpteḥ
bhāsurarūpadarśanātra tatrānumīyate; anumīyatāṃ yadi asya avyabhicāraḥ syāt
itaśca pudgaladravyaviśeṣā bhūmyādayaḥ pariṇāmaparigrahadarśanāt, jalādeḥ muktāphalādibhāvādiva marthaṃ ca pudgalavat ityuktam
guṇināguṇānāṃcabhedāt na taddṛśyetaratvā syādṛśyate iti cet; na; asya pakṣasya niṣedhāt
bhede'pi pratibhāsamānaguṇasambandhinaivadṛśyā netireti sa eva prasaṅgaḥ
tasyā api dṛśyatve sakalaguṇagrahaḥ, tadabhāve tatsambandhitā'grahaṇāt, anyathā dṛśya mānaguṇagrahaṇe'pi tatsambandhitāpratītiḥ na syāt
syāpikinnevi cet; kathaṃ tasya ? sambandhāccet; anyā tatsambandhitā punarapi anyā punarapi anyā ityanavasthā
pratyakṣaḥ svabhāvo yasya śabdādeḥ tasyaiva, nānyasya dharmiṇo'siddheḥ anumeyatopapatteśca dṛśyādṛśyādi ityādinā sambandhaḥ
nanu tatsvabhāvasya kimanumeyavayenivedatrāha--kathañcit śabdādirūpeṇa na kṣaṇakṣayādirūpeṇa tatsvabhāvasya tadanumānavaiphalyāpatteḥ
aniścitaniścayā'bhāvānneti cet; sa eva doṣaḥ--ubhayarūpatā iti
nanu dṛśyasvabhāvakāle anyasyādarśane kathaṃ tayorekatvam śruto tpannapadārthāntaravaditi cet ? atrāha--nahi ityādi
na kevalaṃ bahinna śabdādhirapi tu saṃvitterapijñānamātrasyāpi abhāvaprasaṅgāt
kṣaṇikatvottarakāryajanakatvāpratibhāsasarvāpratibhāsanāt, sarvasya vibhramamātre samavesāna kiñcit kvacit śaktam
evadṛśyatvādṛśyatvaviruddhadharmādhyāsenaasattvād anyasyāpratibhāsenāsattvāt naikasya dṛśyetararūpateti cet; atrāha--tanmithyaikānta ityādi
tat saṃvittimātramapi mithyeti peryamekāntābhiniveśaḥ tattvataḥsvaga tādayo gṛhyante
ātmendriyamano'rthasannikarṣāt kathaṃ niravaśeṣajñānam ? satyapi tapaḥprabhāve indriyāṇāṃ samprayogānatikramāt niyataviṣayatvāt
aṇormanaso'dṛṣṭavaśāt bahirarthasannikarṣavaiśadyakalpanāyām yugapajjñānānutpattirmanaso liṅgaṃ na bhavet
nanu nityamapi tasya jñānamasti, tena kiṃ sā'viruddhā yena tadatra dūṣayituṃ nāśaṅkyate ? no cet; tattarhi tadāśaṅkanīyam
atha īśvaranirākaraṇe tannirastamiti nāśaṅkyate; tarhi kṣaṇikaniraṃśavastuniṣedhena anyasyāpi niṣedhāttadapi nāśaṅkanīyam
prapañcārthamiti cet; nityamapi tathaiva iti cet; na; tadabhāvāt
etena vibhudravyaviśeṣaguṇatve sati vibhutvavat iti nirastam
sarvaviṣayatve sati iti cet; na; itarayogijñānena
sarvadā tadviṣayatve sati iti cet; yadi tasyaiva tadeva sādhyaṃ tadeva hetuviśeṣaṇam ityasāraṃ parasyānityatvam
syānmatam--īśvarajñānaṃ nityaṃsattvesati dharmādikāraṇājanyatvāt tad vibhutvavat iti
na ca paradharmādeḥ tadvijñānam; ātmaguṇānām ātmāntaraguṇākāraṇatvāditi
kiṃ punaḥ īśvarajñānaṃ na kiṃcit karoti ? tathā cet; kuto'śeṣakāryajanma ? maheśvarāccet; na
atha padārthagrahaṇenatajjanmani; sarvasyāpi buddheḥ tatraiva vyāpāro na kāryajanmani, iti idaṃ buddhipūrvam, idamathākāryam iti vyavahāravilopaḥ
atha tatsahitena puṃsā kṛtam iti upacāreṇa buddhikṛtam ityucyate; tayāpi tatkaraṇe ko virodhaḥ ?
kiṃ ca, yadi nānyātmaguṇaḥ anyātmaguṇanimittaṃ kathaṃ mantriṇadhyānād anyayoṣitaḥ taṃ prati pratyoanyamantro'piātmana eva taccatutvamiti cet; na; dharmādeḥ sarvatrānupayogāpatteḥ, ātmana eva upayogāt
atha mantriṇo dhyānaṃ cittavikārakāraṇam; īśvarajñānamapi tathaiva syāt
bhavatu ko doṣa iti cet; tadvad anyadharmādiḥ tatkāraṇam iti kāraṇābhāvo'siddhaḥ

nanu yathā bhavadīye mate sarvajñaḥ tena tadantareṇa vā jñāyate, tathā madīye tadeva jñānam ātmanityatvamavaiti tadantare svot cet; na; ekatvasaṃvedanatāpatteḥ, īśvarakalpanamanarthakam, tāvataiva tatprayojanasiddheḥ
yathā jñānatvā'viśeṣe'pi tadeva nityaṃ tathā guṇatvāviśeṣe'pi tadeva anāśrayam iti
tatra satā arthena samprayogaḥ sannikarṣaḥ indriyāṇāṃ tajjatve na jñānasya viruddhā sakalajñātā ku mā ri lo ktā'śeṣadoṣāparihārāt iti bhāvaḥ
dūṣaṇāntaramāha--nityasya ātmanaḥ sarvajñatā kutaḥ kāraṇāt ? na kutaścit, nityatvavirodhāt
svabhāvikī sā iti cet; atrāha--kutaḥ pramāṇāt avagamyate ityadhyāhāraḥ

nanu kāraṇena bhinnajñānamaśeṣaviṣayaṃ janyate, tatsambandhāt tasya sā iti cet; atrāha--asakalajñasya tasya prāk, paścājjñāne utpanne sā kutaḥ ? nahi svayam arthagrahaṇābhimukhyarahitasya anyataḥ tad yuktam
ātmā ca indriyaṃ ca manaśca arthaśca teṣāṃ sannikarṣāt saṃyogādirūpāt kathaṃ niravaśeṣajñānam itarayāvat
tapaḥprabhāvāt, niravaśeṣaviṣayaṃ tato'pi jñānamiti cet; atrāha--tapaḥprabhāva ityādi
tapasaḥ prabhāvaḥ sāmarthyāviśeṣaḥ tasmin satyapi na kevalamasatiindriyāṇāṃsamprayogānatikramād vijñānasya
nahi tatra sati jñānaṃ prayoganirapekṣam; paramatasiddheḥ
yadi ca indriyāṇām tatprayogānatikramāt iti vyākhyeyam
na khalu tasmin sati indriyāṇi satsambandhamarthaṃnagṛhṇanti; taireva sannikarṣasādhakahetūnāṃ vyabhicāraprasaṅgāt
atha asmadādicakṣuḥ sambandhamarthamaveti tatprabhāvarahitatvesati indriyatvāt sparśanavatiti cet; na; tadrahitatvasiddheḥ, janmāntare tadaniṣedhāt
atha tatprabhāvād indriyāṇi tathāvidhāni jñāyanne yātisarvaviṣayaiḥ atisaṃpadyate; tatrāha--niyata ityādi
nahi sparśanādikaṃ tatprabhāvataḥ śarīraṃ vihāsaprativiṣayaṃ bhramati, tena saha bhramaṇe tasya sarvagatatvam
cakṣūraśmīnāṃ sarvatra gamane'pi rūpasyaiva sarvasya grahaṇaṃ syāt na rasādeḥ
mānasaṃ yogino'śeṣagocaramadhya na cakṣurādijamiti cet; atrāha--manasa ityādi
manasaḥ aṇoḥsakāśād bahirarthasannikarṣevaiśadyakalpanāyāṃ kutaḥ ? ityāha--adṛṣṭavaśād dharmādisahāyāt; kevalasya tatsaṃvittivaiśadyakāraṇasāmarthyād atītādītanmānasasaṃvittivadevacanam
nanu svapnādipratyayānāṃ manasa eva vaiśadyamiti cet; anyeṣāmapi syāt tadaviśeṣāt
api ca, tata eva yogino'śeṣārthajñānavaiśadye sarvasya sāttasya sambandhasambandhasyabhedāt
sarvendriyaviṣayasannidhāne'pi yā yugapajjñānānāmanutpattiḥ sā manaso liṅgam na bhavet
tadvaiśadyavat tadanutpatterapi adṛṣṭata eva bhāvāditi bhāvaḥ
ātmanā manaḥ saṃyuktam, tena ca sarve'rthāḥ iti paramparāsambandhasya
teṣāmanyena manasā vā saṃyogaḥ kuto yataḥ || 24
ātmamano'kṣārthasannikarṣādbahirarthajñānotpattau yugapajjñānotpattiḥ kinna bhavet ? manasāmekatve ekaiva buddhiḥ syāt

yadi tadartha...tasya tādṛśasya kramaśaḥ kvacit jñānasambandhāt sarvajñatvam; kiṃ punarasarvajñasvabhāvamajahataḥ idam ? prāk tajjñānasvabhāvasambandhavikalasya tatsamavāyikāraṇatvamasaṃbhāvyam asamavāyikāraṇatvaṃ ca
tad ityanena tadvaiśadyakāraṇam adṛṣṭaṃ parāmṛśyate, tasya vaicitryāt kāraṇāt bahirantaśca keṣāñcid īśvaraprabhṛtīnāṃ yugapat saṃvit syāt, tapaḥprabhāvavikalānām anyathā krameṇa itthaṃ vyavatiṣṭheta

nanu anumānagamyasya evamabhāvāyogāt, itarathā sarvatra kārye dṛṣṭasyāpi kāraṇasya vaiphalyaṃ bhavet, ata eva tanniṣpatteriti cet; na; talliṅgasya kvacit tena pratibandhādṛṣṭeḥ, adṛṣṭasye vāṣavasya mābhyupagamanīyatvāt
ata eva liṅgaṃ na bhavet; ityāha--...
na kevalamasati kintva satyapi manasi smṛtīnāṃ yugapadutpattiḥ prasajyeta
tacca mana ātmā puruṣaḥ tayoḥ sannikarṣasya apekṣekācitotpatteḥ
yadi vā, tadātmasannikarṣasya ca yugapadutpattiḥ syāditi ca vyākhyeyam
nanu cakṣurādibuddhīnāmapi tata eva pareṇa yaugapadyaṃ neṣyate, tataḥ sāmānyena saṃvittīnām iti vaktavyam
na ca smṛtiśabdaḥ sāmānyavācī tadviśeṣavācitvāt, tanna yuktam smṛtīnām ityetaditi cet; cakṣurādidhiyāṃ kadācid yaugapadyamapi syāt, tathā pratibhāsa nānumāma savikalpānāṃ viparyayāt
asta vā, tiṣṭhatodbhāvacanamiti pradeśatadvatoḥ saṃskṛtapradeśātmanoḥvyatirekāt parasparaṃ bhedovyatireke anyataradityeyadeva syādityevaṃ vacanam, tatpradeśānām avastutvasyāt
tato'nyasya padārthasya anabhyupagamāt pareṇa iti bhāvaḥ
tadvyatiriktā api te satyaityeke; tanna ko'rtha ityādi
dravyaguṇakarmāṇi arthāḥ dravyaguṇakarmasu arthaḥ vaiśe॰ sū॰ 8
tebhyo vyatirekavataḥ padārthasya sattāyāḥ samavāya samavāyāsaṃbhavāt tripadārthasatkarī sattā ityabhidhānāt
sāmānyāvipatte santa iti cet; atrāha— dravyetyādi
teṣām ātmapradeśānāṃ manasyanyena vā śarīrādinā vā saṃyogaḥ anyatarakarmakaḥ saṃyogajāyā kutaḥ ? naiva
kuto na syāt ? ityāha--dravyātirekāt dravyād bhedāt teṣām iti, dravyasya ca tadantareṇakutaḥ saṃyogādiḥguṇaḥ ? yataḥ saṃyogāt
kutaścid adṛṣṭādeḥ sahakāriṇaḥ dravyānatirekaḥ teṣāmiti cet; atrāha--tavetyādinā

tātparyamidamatra--ātmano vyatiricyamānāḥ tatpradeśāḥ yadi dravyam, yathā ghaṭād vyatiricyamānā kapālādayaḥ; tadātmadravyam, tadantaraṃ vā syuḥ ? tatra ādye pakṣe ātmatvasamavāyād ātmadravyaṃ te prathamātmavat; taccāyuṃyuktivirodhāt
tadāha--na ca naiva ātmatvamavāntaraṃ sāmānyaṃ pradeśeṣu samavetam
kutaḥ ? ityāha--pratyātmam ātmānam ātmānaṃ prati pratyātmam ātmanaṃ bhedaprasaṅgād bahutvaprāptiḥ
teṣāṃ ca manasā saṃyoge adṛṣṭasamavāyo'pi teṣāmeva tatsaṃyogajanyatvāt, tasya saṃyogajanyatvāt tasya saṃyogajaḥ adṛṣṭaḥ ātmamanaḥsaṃyogajaḥ ityabhidhānāt
na ca anyasaṃyogajaḥ anyaṃ samaveti sattvāntare'pi tatprasaṅgāt
adṛṣṭa phalaṃ ca teṣvevāstu kartṛ phaladāyī iti vacanāt
teṣāṃ ca lokāntaragamane kriyāvattvam, avāmane saṃsārabhedavilopaḥ
dvitīyapakṣe deśāntaradravyaiḥ tatsaṃyogavirahāt kathaṃ tadadṛṣṭena tadākarṣaṇam ityavici cintyam
pradeśamanaḥsaṃyogaḥ paramāṇusaṃyogavat sadoṣa iti na asarvagatatva sarvagatatve prathamavat prasaṃghātavasthā ca
tatparikalpanavaiphalyaṃ vā, prathamātmatāt kāryaniṣpatteḥ punarapi sa eva doṣaḥ
punarapi tatparihārāya tatpradeśakalpane tadeva āvarttata iti cakrakam iti na kiñcidetat
pakṣāntarasūvāpi anātmanaṃ pradeśasarūpasya dravyāntarasya manasā yaḥ sannikarṣaḥ tasmāt na sukhādayaḥ smṛtayo bhavitumarhanti
ātmā manasā yujyate, manaḥ akṣenaindriyotākṣam arthena' iti ya ātmamano'kṣārthasannikarṣaḥ saṃyogādisambandhaḥ tasmād bahirarthajñānotpattau satyāṃ yugapajjñānotpattiḥ kinna bhavet ?
nanvekatvānmanaso na tena sarvendriyāṇāṃ tairarthānāṃ yugapat sambandha iti cet; atrāha— manasām ityādi
ekatve manaso yugapad ekaiva buddhiḥ syāt
tata eva tadudaye ekatrāpi yugapadekajñānodayo'nivāryaḥ, anekatrotpādāya ititi naikatra iti kiṃkṛto vibhāgaḥ ?
syodatat bahutve'pi ekenaiva masā'taukaḥ saṃyujyate; ityatrāha--pratyekam ityādi
ekam ekaṃ manaḥ pratyekaikasya ātmano yaḥ sambandhaḥ tasya niyamena avaśyaṃbhāvena ayogāt ātmanāṃ vyāpitvavirodhāt iti bhāvaḥ
atha atadeśasya ātmanaḥ pradeśadoṣayojanā kīdṛśī ? ityatrāha--yadi ityādi
tādṛśasya kūṭasthasya kramaśaḥ krameṇa punaḥ punaḥ iti kvacit kasyāṃcid avasthāyām jñānasambandhāt sarvajñatvam asaṃbhavyam iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ

asarvajñasvabhāvamajahataḥ kiṃ sarvajñatvam ? idam damattvaivaṃ paryatra tsambandhāt pūrvaviṣayānabhimukhasvabhāvo gaganādivat asāccate tadabhimukhasvabhāvaḥ ? prathamapakṣe pūrvaṃ vākyaṃ dvitīye'pi sakalaviṣayābhimukhaḥ, katipayapadārthābhimukho vā asya svabhāvaḥ ? tatra ādye vikalpe janmimātrasya sakalakutvām iti
na hi tatsambandhe'pi viṣayagrahaṇonmukhatā pūrvavat iti dūṣaṇaṃ vaktavyam
natva cottarajñānaṃ sati samavāyikāraṇatvamevāsya viṣayābhimukhaṃ nāparam, sahakāriviśeṣāt kadācit kīdṛkṣajñānaṃ prati tasya tad iti cet ? atrāha— prāg ityādi

prāgivasthitajñānotpatteḥ pūrvaṃ na jñāna svabhāvasambandhaḥvikasya tajjñānameva svabhāvaḥ sa eva sambandhaḥ tena vikalpasyaacetanasya ityarthaḥ, tatsamavayikāraṇatvaṃ jñānasamavāyihetutvam asaṃbhāvyam
tathāhi nmajñānasvabhāvaṃ sambandhavikala tajñānasamavāyikāraṇam yathā pṛthivyādi, tathā ca parasya ātmā tadvikalaḥ, itarathā pṛyivyādirapi tatkāraṇaṃ bhavet
nanu kāryasya pṛthivyādeḥ tatkāraṇatve pratyabhijñāvilopaḥ, śarīrāderanityatvāditi cet; paramāṇūnāṃ syāt
teṣāmadarśanāt neti cet; kiṃ punaḥ paraparikalpitātmanādarśanamasti ? tathā cet; paramāṇūnāmastu
jñānasya guṇatvād ādhāramātraṃ sidhye tu ccātmā paramāṇavo vā iti na niścayaḥ
teṣāṃ tatkāraṇatve tadrūpādivad buddheḥ asmadādibhiragrahaṇamiti cet; ātmano'pi tatkāraṇatve tadvibhutvavat tadagrahaṇaṃ kinna syāt ? atra guṇavaicitryaṃ na paratreti na vibhāgahetuḥ
atha paramāṇunāṃ buddhiguṇatve vyāpitvaṃ vyomavat syāt
tathāhi--paramāṇavo vibhavaḥ nityatve sati asmadādipratyakṣaguṇādhāratvād vyomavat iti cet; na; ghaṭādinā vyabhicārāt
tato yathā tatsambandhavikalatvāt na paramāṇavaḥ tatsamavāyikāraṇaṃ tathā ātmāpi mā bhūt
asamavāyikāraṇatvaṃ syāditi cet; atrāha— asamavāyikāraṇatvaṃ ca iti sarvamasaṃbhāvyam
nanu kimidam asamavāyikāraṇam ? samavāyikāraṇād anyaditi cet; nimittakāraṇamapi tato'nyad bhavati, tathā ca cakṣurādivat tadvikalamapi tatkāraṇam iti niṣedhānupapattiḥ

atha svakāraṇasamavāyi ca uttaraśabdasya pūrvaśabdaḥ, svakāraṇakāraṇasamavāyi yathā paṭaḥ, kāraṇakāraṇasamavayivāpi vā yathā jñānasya ātmamanaḥsaṃyogaḥ, asamavāyikāraṇamucyate; tadayuktam; ātmanaḥ kva cit kāyetadanabhyupagamāt

abhyupagamāśca pūṣyanta iti cet; ucyate--smaraṇajñānotpattau saṃskārasya, tasya tadutpattau jñānasya jñānajo jñānahetuśca saṃskāraḥ iti vacanāt asamavāyikāraṇatvamiṣyate pareṇa, svakāraṇasamavetatvasya bhāvāt; tadapi tadvikalasya asaṃbhāvyam
yathaiva hi cetanasya cātanamupādānam, tathā tatsamavetaṃ cetanaṃ yuktam
paṭarūpasya kāraṇaṃ paṭaḥ, tasya kāraṇaṃ tantavaḥ, teṣu samavāyi samavāyasambandhena vartamānaṃ tanturūpam
jñānasya ekaṃ kāraṇam ātmā, aparañca kāraṇaṃ manaḥ, ubhayatra samavāyasambandhena vartamānaḥ ātmamanaḥsaṃyoga iti
smaraṇasya kāraṇam ātmā tatra samavetaḥ saṃskāraḥ iti
bhavatu ātmanaḥ pradeśāḥ, te catataḥ kathañcidbhinnā iti cet; atrāha--yadi punaḥ ityādi
ātmādīnāṃ pradeśatadvatoḥ bhede'pi svabhāvata eva kathañcittādātmyaṃ sambandhāntarābhāvāt

guṇaguṇinoḥ sahabhūtayoḥ jātitadvatośca na kathañcittādātmyamiti svamanīṣikayā tattvamidantayā pratiṣṭhāpayitukāmaḥ vaiyātyena kutarkavibhramāt svārthākārayoḥ tādātmyapariṇāmaṃ pratikṣipataḥ śauddhodaniśiṣyakān vijayate
nahi pradeśatadvatāṃ ghaṭapaṭavat svātantryaṃ samavāyāsaṃbhavādanyatra tādātmyāt
pradeśa-ātmanoḥ kathañcittādātmye'pi atra tacanneti cet; atrāha— tadvadesa tadvadaikyaṃ ced ityādi
pradeśatadvatoḥ aikyaṃ prapattapratipanvaḥ pratipannavānayaṃ naiyāyiko na lakṣyayecit syāt kathañcid dravyaparyāyayoḥtattvam ekatānātvameva lakṣayed ityarthaḥ
kārikāṃ vivṛṇvannāha--ātmādīnām ādiśabdena gamanādirgṛhyate, pradeśatadvatoḥ bhede'pi kathaṃcittādātmyaṃ svabhāvata eva
na caivam ātmādīnām teṣu teyāsyuḥ, itarathā ghaṭādayo'pi saṃyogā'viśeṣāt
nāpi samavāyaḥ; teṣāṃ tadārabdhatvaprasaṅgāt, tathā ca ghaṭādivadanityatvam, svārambhakāvayavasanniveśaviśiṣṭatvena īśvarasyāpyanyeśvarapūrvakatvam
na guṇaguṇinoḥ kathañcittādātmyam, api tu bheda eva
ityevaṃ svamanīṣikayā tattvam idantayā bhedaikāntarūpatayā ca nānekāntakṣaṇikādirūpatayā pratiṣṭhāpayitukāmaḥ śauddhodaniśiṣyakān ca vaiyātyena vijayate
pradeśatadvatorapi tādātmyaṃ neti cet; atrāha--nahi pradeśatadvatāṃ ghaṭapaṭavat svātantrya bhaved iti bhāvaḥ
tādātmyād anyasmin sambandhatve iṣyamāṇe tadasaṃbhavaḥ, tādātmye tu saṃbhava eva
sarvatra tathāpariṇāmaṃ muktvā nāparaḥ saṃyogaḥ samavāyo vā sambandhaḥ parikalpyaḥ
tadbhedaikānte samavāyavṛtteḥ...samavāyasya viśeṣaṇibhāvo'tra sambandhaścet; sarvatra ayamevāstu
svataḥ svabhāvatādātmyād ṛte vinā anyatra anyeṣu parasparaṃ bhinneṣu kutaḥ sambandho vyavatiṣṭheta ? dṛṣṭāntamāha--vibhudravyavad iti
saṃyogātervyavatiṣṭheta iti cet; atrāha--saṃyogasamavāyābhyāṃ na vyavatiṣṭhate iti
nyathāpariṇāmam avinirbhāgapariṇatiṃ muktvā nāparaḥ puruṣadaṇḍayoḥ sambandhaḥ parikalpyaḥ
yadi punardvayoḥ kathañcittādātmyena vartamānaḥ saṃyogaḥ syāt, tasya puruṣadaṇḍāvavayavau sa ca avayavī iti prasaktam kapālaghaṭavaditi tathā ca ekākarṣaṇāt niyamena sarvākarṣaṇam
tathā guṇyādīnāṃ tathā pariṇāmaṃ tādātmyapariṇāmamuktvā nāparaḥ sambandhaḥ parikalpa
kutaḥ ? ityātrāha--tadabhāve tathā pariṇāmābhāve sarvagatānām ātmādīnām svapradeśeṣu vṛtterapratibandhabhāvāt sambandhābhāvāt tathāpariṇāmaḥ parikalpaḥ
samavāyaḥ pratibandha iti cet; atrāha--samavāyavṛtteḥ ityādi
samavāyasya svata eva vṛttiḥ iti cet; atrāha--samavāyasya ityādi
asambandhaḥ samavāya ityeke; teṣāṃ guṇo guṇī samavāya iheti pratyayajananāt tatsambandha ucyate; nāsakasye padārthāntaravat tajjananavirodhāt
punaḥ samavāyakalpane naivanevasthā viśeṣaṇībhāvātrasambandhaśca sarva ca yamevāstu kiṃ samavāyena ? nahi guṇādayo dravyasya na viśeṣaṇam

guṇānuraktapratītiḥ eva syāt na ihapratītiḥ iti cet; kathaṃ samavāye śaktiḥ iti pratītiḥ ? so'yaṃ viśeṣaṇibhāvaḥ iha ihetipratyayahetuḥ nānyatrasatyamīśvaravilasitam ! tatsambandheti tadantarakalpane anyā'navasthā
viśeṣaṇībhāvo'pi bhāvasya kiṃ kurvāṇaḥ syāt ? akiñcitkarasya vastutvā'yogāt
śaktiḥ tato'bhinneti cet; tathā guṇādayo'pi tadvato na vyatiricyante

ghaṭasya rūpādayaḥ iti na syāditi cet; tadvataḥ śaktiḥ iti katham ? guṇaguṇinorabhede ekagrahaṇe sarvagraṇamiti cet; kiṃ punardravyādigrahaṇe sannigrahaṇam ? tathā cet; mantrādau saṃśayādiḥ kutaḥ ? iti yakiñcidetat
ātmamanasoḥ niraṃśatvaikānte sannikarṣāsaṃbhavāt akādācittvātmavibhutvavadyāvadadravyabhāvitvāt kathaṃ tatprabhavaguṇaviśeṣasya anyānapekṣiṇaḥ kādācitkatvaṃ yataḥ kadācit smṛtiḥ
satyapi aṇau manasi ātmanaḥ smṛtīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ saptānāṃ vā sahaivotpattiḥ syāt paramāṇuvat...
tadetat tadāgamapāṭhitaṃ karaṇamātmāntaraṃ dravyāntaraṃ sadapi vicāryamāṇaṃ antarbahiścākiñcitkaram
aṇuriti manaso'bhidhāna niraṃśau yai ātmāṇū tayoḥ saṃyogād heteḥ smṛtiḥ nityaṃ sadā, upalakṣaṇametaditi sarvatra ca prasajyate
na khalu samarthasya kāraṇasya sarvatra sarvadā bhāve kāryakādācitkatvam; atattvārthatvaprasaṅgāt
nanu saṃyogasya dravye sarvatrā'vṛtteḥ nāyaṃ doṣaḥ, nahi paramāṇūnāṃ saṃyogāḥ tāvadvyāpya varttate
yathā paramāṇuṣu saṃyogo varttamāno na sarvadā tadātmani varttate ayāvaddravyabhāvitvādasya tathā ātmamanasorapyatadiṣṭaṃ cet; atrottaramāha--smṛtiṣaṭkaṃ saha yugapad īkṣyatām

evaṃ manyate--ātmano vyāpino madhye varttamānasya aṇumanaso'yāvaddravyabhāvino'vaśyaṃ ghaṭasaṃyogāḥ ātmanaḥ, svātmanā tasya ṣaḍbhiḥ digbhiḥ sambandhāt, tathā ca tayoḥ tadeva sāvayavattvam, anyathā kuto'sya pradeśavṛttitvamiti ? atha yathā jainasya paramāṇūnāṃ nairantaryeṇa avasthānaṃ saṃyogaḥ tathā mamāpi ātmamanasoḥ iti; yuktametat, kintu na saṃyogo guṇaḥ sarvagatatvaṃ manodeśaparihārāt
bhavantu tasya yugapat ṣaṭsaṃyogāḥ, tebhyastu smṛtiḥ ekaiva vajjā tantubhya ekapaṭavat tatsaṃyogebhyo vā iti cet; na; anyathā'bhiprāyāt
tathāhi— yathā ekatve'pi manasaḥ tataḥ sahātmani samavetāḥ saṃyogāḥ ṣṭ tathā smṛtiyo'pīti na tadekatvaṃ smṛtyekatvaṃnibandhanamiti

ātmamanasoḥ niraṃśatvaikānte aṅgīkriyamāṇe sannikarṣasya ātmamanasoḥ saṃyogasya tayoranyasya sambandhasya asaṃbhavāt akādācittvātmavibhutvavadyāvaddravyabhāvitvāt kāraṇāt kathaṃ tasya tatprabhavaguṇaviśeṣasya tasmāt sannikarpāt prabhava utpattiḥ yasya sa cāsau guṇaviśeṣaśca buddhyādiḥ tasya
nanutadapekṣasya sahakāriṇaḥ kādācitkatvāt kādācittvam iti cet; atrāha--anyānyapekṣiṇa iti
yataḥ tatkādācitkatvāt smṛtiḥ kadācit syāt ityadhyāhāraḥ
tato yaduktam— sukhādisvapnādijñānāni indriyajanitāni, tattvāt, cakṣurādijanitarūpādijñānavat, yat tad indriyaṃ tat manaḥ iti; tannirastam
adṛṣṭasya kādācitkatvamabhyupagamya tasyavi tatkāraṇatve doṣaṃ darśayannāha--adṛṣṭa ityādi
nanu cakṣurādijñānam adṛṣṭādupajāyata iti; tata eva tanniṣpatteścakṣurādikam anarthakaṃ bhavet
tatpratīterneti cet; mano'pi tata eva nā'narthakam anantarānumānāt tatpratīteḥ iti cet; na; svasaṃvedanavyabhicārāt, tasya ca sādhanāt
satyapi na kevalamasati aṇau sūkṣme manasi pradeśavattve satvatya pyātmanaḥ smṛtīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ saptānāṃ vā...ma gyanāpyātmanaḥ sambandhātsahaivotpattiḥ syāt
tatprayojanasya adṛṣṭataḥ siddhernaivaṃ cet; tvadīye'pi samānam
tadāgamayatitametad vicāryamāṇam ato'kiñcitkaram kiñcidapi karttuṃ na samartha
nanu anyārthakriyākaraṇāttadakiñcitkaraṃ kathaṃ sapasyāditi cet ? tadanyasyakāryakaraṇe'pi sukhādivedanādau vikalendriyādivad anupayogād evamabhidhānāt
punarapi kiṃbhūtam ? ityāha--dravyāntaram, pratīyamānāt cakṣurādidravyādanyad dravyaṃ dravyāntaram iti
antaḥ sukhādisvavedane, nahi sukhādisvamvadena na śeṣamindriyatrana na naske anyathā vibhāgopagamāt bahista ghaṭādau
satyapi ityanena āgamagamyatvam, akiñcitkaram ityanena tadasādhāra ṇakāryā'bhāvād ananumeyatvaṃ darśayatisma
natu ātmapradeśāvaraṇakṣayopaśamarūpasya bhāvendriyasya dravyakaraṇāpekṣatvāt tat siddhiriti cet; ku tasya tadāpekṣā ? rūpādau iti cet; tatra cakṣurādiliṅgāderbhāvāt siddhasādhanam
kiṃca, sarvasya tatkṛpe ve samasya prameye pravṛttāvadhi jñānaṃ parāśrayam iti pratyakṣata syāt
ku ? bhāvini sukhādāviti cet; na; uktamatra amanaskasukhādinā vyabhicārāditi
kiṃ ca, evaṃ vādinaḥ sarvamadhyakṣam indriyajaṃ tattvāt kuto na sidhyati ? anyathānupapattivaikalyāt; itaratra samānamiti sthīyatāmavivādena
bhavatu vā parapakṣikalpitaṃ manaḥ tato jñānaṃ vā, tathāpi yaugamate na sarvajñānaṃ vā tathāpi yaugamate na sarvajñaḥ iti darśayannāha--svata ityādi
na sarvajñānaṃ vā tathāpi yaugamate iti dvirlikhitam
yato'yaṃ yoganirmitendriyaśarīraḥ ṛddhau sarvān anekadhā paśyedanusmaredvā
svataḥ svarūpeṇa atyantam ekāntena ātmani svarūpe'satyātatrāvyāpriyamāṇāyāḥ saṃvido jñānasya prakāśāsaṃbhavāt tasyāḥ pratibhāsābhāvāt kutaḥ punaḥ sarvajñatvam svabuddherapyagrahaṇāt
jñānāntarāt tasyāḥ prakāśaḥ; ityatrāha--parataḥ anyato jñānāt tasyāḥ prakāśāsaṃbhavāt iti sambandhaḥ, anavasthānetorthamātrasyāpi grahaṇābhāvāt
yad yasmāt sannikarṣasatvādayaṃ parīkṣamāṇa ātmā sarvān arthān paśyet
atha saṃvida ātmani sattve'pi sannikarṣavādinaḥ prakārāntareṇa sarvajñatvābhāva darśayannāha--satyapi ityādi
yoganirmitendriyaśarīrasyāpi yoginaḥ manasaḥ cakṣurādervā arthaiḥ sannikarṣasya bhāvato'bhāvādriddhiprādurbhāvāt pūrbam utpadya vinaṣṭaiḥ saddhivyuparamāt, ūrdhvaṃ utpatsyamānaiḥ sannikarṣābhāvāt
tathāpi ucyate— satyapi sarvataḥ sarvārthaiḥ sannikarṣe asya ayam ityanena jātavibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhāt
ayamabhiprāyaḥ--yeṣāmarthānāmindriyasannikarṣaḥ sadātmanām teṣāṃ tena grahaṇamastu, asadātmanānumānāstīti kathaṃ tena grahaṇam ? ghaṭādiprāgabhāvādiḥnaindriyeṇa saṃyuktaḥ adravyatvāt
saṃyuktasamavāyaḥ samavetasamavāyādiko vā, viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo vā, na saṃbhāvyaḥ, sambaddhayoreva tadbhāvāt
syānmatam--indriyeṇa ghaṭādika sannikṛṣṭaṃ tena ca prāgabhāvādiḥ, tato rūpādivad asya grahaṇamiti; tadasa vyataḥ abhāvasya adravyatvāt na tena ghaṭasya saṃyogaḥ

atha matam--ghaṭasaṃyuktendriyasya ghaṭabhāvena saṃyuktaviśeṣaṇībhāvasambandhaḥ, rūpādyabhāvena saṃyuktasamavetasamavetaviśeṣaṇībhāvasambandhaḥ, rūpādyabhāvena saṃyuktasamavetasamavetasamavetaviśeṣaṇībhāvaḥ, evaṃ karmādāvapi vaktavyamiti; tadapyasat; susamayāvyāghātāt
yadahi ghaṭasya prāgabhāvapradhvaṃsābhāvābhyā sākṣāt sambandhaḥ saiva anityatā iti
indriyasaṃyukte ghaṭe rūpaṃ samavetaṃ tatra rūpatvaṃ samavetaṃ tadviśeṣaṇamabhāvaḥ
anityatāśrutiḥ = yasya naiyāyikādeḥ ubhayasya prāk paścād bhāvasya antasya vyavadhāyakaḥ sattāsambandhaḥ tadvācinī anityatāśrutiriṣṭā--pra॰ vā॰ manoratha॰ 2
kiṃca, viśeṣaṇībhāvasambandhāpratipattau idamasya viśeṣaṇam iti kutaḥ pratipattiḥ ? na hi saṃyogāpratipattau idamapyasya saṃyogi iti saṃvittiryuktā
nanu yathā samavāyāgrahaṇepā ṇe'pi i damatra samavetam iti pratītiḥ, tathā atrāpīti cet; na; sādhyasamatvāt nidarśanasya
samavetam iti hi samavāyāpekṣiṇī pratītiḥ, yathā saṃyuktaḥ iti saṃyogātapa gāpekṣiṇī
na ca tadapratītau sā yuktā, anyathā śuklatā'pratītau śukla iti saṃvittiḥ syāt
pratīyate so'pīti cet; tasya indriyeṇa kaḥ sambandhaḥ ? viśeṣaṇībhāva iti cet; anavasthā
api ca, indriyaghaṭasaṃyogakāle na prāgabhāvaḥ pradhvaṃso vā,tat katham indriyasya tena pāramparyasambandhaḥ
na hi asatā sataḥ sambandhaḥ kharaviṣāṇeneva
prākpaścāttasthorbhāva iti cet; tadā na ghaṭaḥ nāpi indriyasaṃyogaḥ
pratipannaścet; na tāven saha ghaṭena, tatkāle tadabhāvāt
saṃyukta iti samaveta iti vā pratītiḥ
paraḥ prāha--indriyasaṃyukte ghaṭe sattā samavetā tadviśeṣaṇaṃ prāgabhāvādiḥ, tataḥ saṃyuktasamavetaviśeṣaṇībhāva iti; tadapyasāram; nityāyāḥ tasyāḥ tadviśeṣaṇāyogāt ātmādivat
kiṃca, prāgabhāvo ghaṭakāle vinaśyati tadā tasyāpi pradhvaṃso'sti, tathā pradhvaṃsasya prāgasato bhāve prāgabhāvaḥ, na ca tatreyaṃ grahaṇapradviyā; sattāsamavāyā'bhāvādabhāvasya
nāstīti cet; padādau kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ ? upacārāt sa tatreti cet; anyatrāpi tataḥ syādaviśeṣāt
viśeṣaṇībhāvo parato vyamāno'vadhānāt tasyāpi tena kaḥ sambandho yena grahaṇaṃ bhavet ? viśeṣaṇībhāva iti cet; kiṃ punarasādhanekaḥ tathā cet; samavāyo'pi syāt
samavetabuddherabhedānnaivaṃ cet; tannibandhanāpi buddhirna bhidyata iti samānam
tanna asadātmanā indriyasannikarṣa iti na tasya grahaṇam itinasarvajñatvaṃ sannikarṣavādinaḥ iti sthitam
arthāt yaḥ utpadyate vinaśyati ca sa evānityaḥ
tathāpi sarvajñatvopagame naiyāyikavat saugatasyāpi kiñcit svābhyupetaṃ tasyatīti darśayannāha--pratyakṣam ityādi
vetti cedarthasārūpyāt prāmāṇyaṃ saṃvidāṃ na vai || 31
kutaścidarthādutpannaṃ jñānaṃ yadi tadatikrāntāveva yogyatayā pratyakṣam; anāgate'pi kinna syāt ? tatsārūpyātiśayasaṃbhavāt tadutpatteśca tatpratyakṣatvakalpanāyāmatiprasaṅgāt
yathaiva hi kāraṇābhāvalakṣaṇe bhavataḥ svatantrasya kāryatvamatyantamayuktaṃ tathaiva svakāryakāraṇasvalakṣaṇasaṃvedanaṃ ca
yadi kutaścit saṃvitteḥ paricchedasāmarthyam; prameyakāle eva syāt
tadetad dravyaṃ svata eva yathā pariṇāmalakṣaṇaṃ tathaiva jīvātmakametat svata eva jñānasvabhāvakaṃ pratyeyam
tanna kaścidajñānātmā jñānasambandhāt jñātā nāma ghaṭādivat
tadayamātmaiva svataḥ saṃvidātmā sukhādirūpeṇa, doṣāvaraṇavimuktaḥ svalakṣaṇamanantajñānādi kevalaṃ pratipadyeta
pratyakṣaṃ tat sarvaviṣayam, kiṃbhūtam ? anāgataṃ bhāvi, upalakṣaṇametat tena bhūtamapi gṛhyate
tat kiṃ karoti ? ityāha--bhinnakālārthā vetti ced yadi bhūtaṃ bhāvino bhāvi bhūtāniśeṣāniti prāmāṇyaṃ saṃvidānavai naiva arthasārūpyāt kintu anyataḥ kutaścid atiśayād bhavet
nahi bhāvino yogino'pi jñānaṃ jāyate, yataḥ tadākāraṃ syāt, anyathā sarvabhāvibhāvakāryakāla eva tena bhavitavyamiti na jñāyeta nātra kāryakāle, kasya kāle tena bhavitavyam iti
evaṃ vaktavyam tathā ekasmād bhinnakālaṃ kāryadvayam nākramāt kramiṇo bhāvāḥ pra॰ vā॰ 1
atha yoginaḥ sakalaṃ vartamānameva, na tasya kiñcit kāraṇaṃ na ca kāryaṃ nāpi tajjñāne svākārasamarpakam iti; praśamakāryakāraṇe ca tajjñāne sakalaṃ tathaiva bhavet
atha na jñānam atatkāryam atadākāraṃ grāhakam; sakalaṃ tathāstu, yasya yāvatī mātrā iti na sarvāviśeṣaḥ
tathā saṃvidā tat tasmād arthāt janma na vai
nahi vivakṣitajñānaṃ prati sarve bhāvino bhūtā vā arthāḥ kāraṇam
kāryakāle sannihitasyaiva yogeḥkāraṇatvopagamāt, itarathā arthadeśe asannihitaṃ tatra cakṣurjñānamupajanayet
adṛṣṭo vā agnyādideśeasinnihitaḥ tasya ūrdhvajalamiti nātmasarvagatvam
kutaścid anantarādatītād bhāvino vā vijñānasamānakālādvā arthāt utpannaṃ jñānaṃ yadi pratyakṣam arthasākṣātkāri
kasmin sati ? ityāha--tadatikrāntāvevatasya arthādutpannārthasya atikrāntiḥ atikramaḥ tasyāmeva yogyatayā tattvasyaprameya tatpratyakṣaṃ tadutpannatvāditi bhāvaḥ
anāgate'pi apiśabdād varttamāne'pi kinna syāt ? pratyakṣam ityanuvartate, tatra ca ukto doṣaḥ
tena prameyeṇa sārūpyātiśayo yaḥ tasya saṃbhavāt tataḥ prameyādutpatteśca taṃ pratyatvakalpanāyām atiprasaṅgāt
tatra sārūpyātiśayāttatkalpanāyām atiprasaṅgaṃ darśayannāha--yasya darśanayoḥ ityādi
tātparyamatra--yadā grāhyatahetutvameva tadākārakṣamam ucyate tadā amuta eva grāhyatā ityuktaṃ syād alaṃ paryāptaṃ asato grahakalpanayā
tata utpatteśca tatkalpanāyām atiprasaṅgaṃ darśayannāha--yathaiva hi ityādi
yenaiva hi prakāreṇa kāraṇābhāvalakṣaṇe bhāvalakṣaṇe bhavataḥ jāyamānasya
tathaiva svasya svasya kāryasya yat kāraṇasvalakṣaṇajñānakāle'vidyamānaṃ tasya saṃvedanaṃ ca anyantamayuktam

evaṃ manyate--yathā saugatasyayadi naṣṭaṃ kāraṇaṃ na kāryajanmani vyāpriyate kāryaṃ vā na tasya iti vyapadiśyate, tathā saṃvedanakāle avidyamānaṃ na tadgrāhyaśaktisamanvitam, saṃvedanaṃ vā grahaṇasāmarthyasahitam, anyathā hetuphalabhāvo bhinnakālayoḥ grāhyagrāhakavad bhavedaviśeṣāt
athavā, saṃvedanasya kāraṇaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ tasya saṃvedanamatyantamayuktam kāryaviśeṣatvādasya
kāraṇātyaye ca jāyamānaṃ na tasya iti vyapadiśyate viratavat

tarhi yathā kāraṇaṃ kāryakāle sadeva tadutpādayati tathā saṃvedanaṃ prameyasamaye sadeva tad gṛhṇāti, tatphalatvād iti naiyāyikaḥ; tatrāha--yadi kutaścit sambandhāt tadutpattilakṣaṇāt saṃvitteḥ paricchedasāmarthyam; atra dūṣaṇam--pratyevaṃkajñānakāla eva vastuni syāt paricchedasāmarthyam na atīte na bhāvini iti kathaṃ kasyacit sarvajñatvamiti bhāvaḥ
atītānāgataṃ vā jñānasya kāraṇam iti tatraiva tatsāmarthyam iti
nahi atītā'nāgatasādṛśyamapi darśanasya mithyābuddhyavasāyādanyataḥ parasya ni manyate
bhinnakālaṃ kathaṃ grāhyamiti ced grāhyatāṃ viduḥ
saṃprati darśanasya na sambandha upakārābhāvāditi cet; atrāha--upakāryopakārakabhāvasya dṛśyadarśanayoḥ sarvadā kālatraye'pi bhāvāt mithyāvikalpabuddheḥ sakāśād iti
nanu grāhyaṃ na tasya grahaṇaṃ na tena ityādivacanāt svarūpevedanameva sarvajñatvam na sarvavedanam ityaparaḥ; tatrāha--tadetad dravyam ityādi

tat tasmād uktānnyāyāt etat pratīyamānaṃ dravyaṃ svata evanabhinnapariṇāmād yathā pariṇāmalakṣaṇaṃ pariṇāmo lakṣaṇaṃ yasya iti tathaiva jīvātmakaṃ bhenaṃtat svata eva nānyato jñānasvabhāvakaṃ svaparagrahaṇaparyāyātmakam pratyeyaṃ citraikarūpasya svaparagrahaṇasvabhāvāvirodhāt
cakṣurādi vyāpārareṇaiva svayaṃ tasya tatsvabhāvakutve syāditi cet; atrāha--kāraka ityādi
kārakaṃ kartrādi, jānātīti jñāpaka ātmā tayoḥ śakteḥ svataḥ sadbhāvinyā eva parataḥ cakṣurāderapi pariṇāmātmopakāryaviśeṣapratilambhopapatteḥ
nanu ca jñātṛvicāre kimartham aprastutasya kārakasya grahaṇamiti cedahantārtham
yathaiva kārakasya śaktiḥ svataḥ satī śālibījādeḥ, parato'pi pariṇāmātmopakāryaviśeṣapratilambhaḥ tathā jñāturapi
nahi kiśyādinā yavavījasya śālyaṅkurajātikā śaktiḥ ādhīyate
ya ta evaṃtattasmāt kvacid ātmā anyo vā ajñānātmā jñānasvabhāvarahito jñānasambandhāt na jñātā nāma ghaṭādivad iti
nanu ghaṭādeḥ tatsambandho'pi nāsti tatkathaṃ nidarśanamiti cet; na; samavāyasya vyāpakasya sarvatrāviśeṣāt niṣedhācca
svata eva jñānasvabhāvatve sarvasya sarvadarśitvamiti cet; atrāha— svata eva ityādi
yata evaṃ tat tasmād ayaṃ svasaṃvedanādhyakṣa ātmaiva svataḥ saṃvidātmā nādātmasaṃvidorbheda ityarthaḥ
doṣāvaraṇavimukto doṣāvaraṇavaikalyāt svalakṣaṇaṃ svasvarūpam anantajñānādi kevalam asahāyaṃ pratipadyeta yataḥ svabhāvavibhutvam iti
bhavantu tarhi ātmanaḥ svabhāvabhūtāḥ pradeśāḥ; ityatrāha--yathā ityādi
yathā anantapradeśaiḥ sambadhyeta vistarātmādisvataḥ na samavāyādivaśāt tathā arthaḥ prameyo ghaṭādiḥ anantaparyāyaiḥ tattanmānārthāḥ samavāyinaḥ samavāyavantaḥ
paramārthataḥ pradeśanānātvābhāve ākāśasya pratyekaṃ rūpādijñānaṃ prasajyeta
viprakṛṣṭadeśānāmapi śabdānāṃ śrutiḥ syāt saṃyuktasamavetatvasya grahaṇakāraṇasya bhāvāt ātmākāśayoḥ sarvagatatvāt manasaśca sakriyatvāt
tasya ātmanaḥ pradeśopacāre'pi vastuto'pradeśasya upacaritapradeśopagame'pi yugapajjñānasaṃbhavaḥ
kārikārthaṃ darśayannāha--paramārthataḥ anupacārataḥ pradeśanānātvābhāve bhvākāmasya pratyekaṃ rūpādijñānaṃ prasajyeta
yadeva hi cakṣurādīnāmanyatamena manaḥ saṃyujyate tadeva ākāśena, tataḥ saṃyuktasamavāyād rūpādigrahaṇakāle gaganasamavetasarvaśabdagrahaṇamiti
yadi punaḥ ākāśena saṃyoge'pi na śrotreṇa ityucyate; atrāha--ākāśasya ityādi
kāryaṃ śabdaḥ tajjñānaṃ ca ākāśasya, tasya vyatirekaḥ sarvatrābhāvaḥ tena upalakṣaṇācca kāraṇabhedasyagaganapradeśanānātvasya
upacāritaḥ tasya pradeśabhedaḥ tataḥ śrutibhedaḥ iti cet; atrāha--nahi agnirityādi, kuto na dahatyeva ? ityatrāha--āropito'pītyādi
māṇavakād anyasminnapi jalādau na dahati ayamiti yaṅmukhosyaḥ tasya abhāvaprasaṅgāt
upacārasya sarvatra kartuṃśakyatvāt sambandhād uṣṇasparśābhāvasya ca aviśeṣāditi bhāvaḥ
yato'gnirapi svataḥ uṣṇasparśarahitaḥ, uṣṇasambandhādeva uṣṇo bhavati ityarthaḥ

santu tattvataḥ tatpradeśā iti cet; atrāha--kutaścit tadavinābhāvikāryāt pradeśaniyamābhyupagame karṇaśaṣkulyavaruddhaḥ anyaḥ tadviparītaḥ anyaḥ pradeśaḥ iti niyamasya aṅgīkaraṇe tasya ākāśasya bhedāvaśyaṃbhāvī
tathā ca ekatvaṃ gaganasya durlabham, ātmapradeśavat prasaṅgaśca cintyaḥ
yatra nabhasi samavetāḥ sarvaśabdāḥ tatra saṃyuktaṃ manaḥ tataḥ saṃyuktasamavetatvasya grahaṇakāraṇasya bhāvāt taṃ ca varaṇamititarhi āsanne'pi etadeva śravaṇakāraṇam

syānmatam--manaḥsaṃyuktātmapradeśasaṃprāptaḥ śabdo manasā gṛhyate, vibhudravyaviśeṣaguṇatve sati asmadādyupalabhyamānatvāt, sukhādivat, tato'yamadoṣa iti; tatrāha--ātmākāśayoḥ sarvagatatvāt manasaścasakriyatvāt viprakṛṣṭadeśānāmapi śabdānāṃ śrutiḥ syāditi
evaṃ manyate--kriyāvat manaḥ śabdo'kriyaḥ, tataḥ śabdadeśaṃ prāpya tat prakāśakaṃ cakṣūraśmivat
evaṃ ca dūrādipratītiḥ saugatakalpitā na viruddhyate
adhvadūradeśānāṃ śravaṇe kathaṃ nikaṭā pratītiḥ ? kathaṃ sakhopradeśe candramasaḥ pratītiḥ ? indriyasyā''śuvṛtteḥ; atrāpi manasaḥ śabdagrahaṇe tathaiva āśuvṛttiḥ
atha manaḥ śarīraṃ vihāya nānyatra yāti; kathaṃ cakṣuryāti ? gamanādarśanam ubhayatra
syānmatam--cakṣuḥ arthadeśaṃ gatvā taṃ prakāśayati taijasatvāt pradīpavat; mano'pi indriyatvāt nayanavat iti samānam
atha ye śrūyante śabdāḥ taddeśe tadgamanam nānyatra deśe; kena kṛtametat ? adṛṣṭena iti cet; atrāha--adṛṣṭa ityādi

adṛṣṭena niyame manaḥ atiricyatām adṛṣṭata eva tadarthasiddheḥ tadanarthakamiti yayuktaṃ pareṇa gandhaikasya granthe, ekasya sarvaiḥ mūrtimadbhiḥ yugapat saṃyogaḥ sarvagatatvam, ātmāra iti; taṃ nirasatve anupapannam iti
pradeśāḥ santu mā vā sambadhyed yugapadvibhuḥ
vibhorātmanaḥ anyasya vā yāvadbhiḥ parasparavyāvṛttairmūrtimadbhiḥ saṃyogāḥ tāvantaste parasparavyāvṛttātmānaḥ saṃyoginaḥ tāvataḥ svabhāvabhedān anyathānupapattyā sādhayanti
te punaḥ pradeśavyāpadeśabhājo bhavantu mā vā, bhāvastādātmyāttaiḥ svata eva sambadhyeta
tathā ca kasyaciccalane sarvakāryadravyaṃ sakṛdeva calet sarvatra saṃyogaikatvopapatteḥ
pradeśā bhāgāḥ santu mā vabhūvan pradeśā gaganādeḥ tathāpi sambadhyet vibhuḥ sarvagataḥ padārthātmā yugapat sarvamūrtaiḥ itīpekṣam
tataḥ kiṃ jātam ? ityāha--anantaiḥ paryāyaiḥ ātmasambādhyetasvata ātmane asakṛt kramaśo'pi tathā
kārikāṃ vivṛṇoti--vibhoḥ sarvagatasya ātmano'nyasya vā gaganādeḥ yāvadbhiḥ saha saṃyogāḥ
kiṃbhūtāste ? ityāha--parasparavyāvṛttātmānaḥ te saṃyogāḥ tāvanta eva saṃyogina ātmādeḥ tāvataḥ svabhāvabhedān sādhayantyeva
kena hetunā ? ityāha--anyathānupapattyā anyathā anyena tāvatāṃ svabhāvabhedānāmabhāvaprakāreṇa teṣāṃ yā'nupapattiḥ tayā
tedi yena svabhāvena nabho'bhisambaddhyate ekena paramāṇunā, tenaiva sarvadravyaiḥ; tatparamāṇusaṃyuktasvabhāve sarvasya praveśaprasaṅgāt
te svabhāvabhedāḥ, punaretad vitarke pradeśavyapadeśabhājo bhavantu mā vā bhūvan, bhāvo gaganādiḥ taiḥ svabhāvabhedaiḥ svata eva saṃyogāditvi na pekṣya eva sambadhyeta
nanvekaḥ paramāṇuḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ saṃyujyate, na ca tasya tāvantaḥ svabhāvabhedāḥ tato vyabhicāra iti cet; atrāha--etena ityādi

tadanupapattyo kiṃ syāditi cet; atrāha--saṃyogabhedābhāve sarvāvayavānāṃ saṃyogaikatve tadanya tadanyatamavibhāge teṣāṃ kāryadravyārambhaka-paramāṇūnāmanyatamasya paramāṇoḥ vibhāge saṃyogābhāve sati saha yugapat sarveṣāmaṇūnāṃ vibhāgaprasaṅgāt
tathā kiṃ syāt ? ityatrāha--tathā ca sarveṣāṃ vibhāgaprakāreṇa pakṣavit paṭādau kasyacit paramāṇo taṃbane sarvakāryadravyaṃ sakṛdeva calet nāsyatu
sarvaparamāṇuṣu saṃyogekatvopapatteḥ kāraṇāt kasyacit paramāṇoḥ calane sarvakāryadravyaṃ sakṛdeva calet
āha paraḥ--kriyāto vibhāgaḥ, tata ekasmin paramāṇau kriyāyāṃ tatraiva sa yukto nānyatra

nahi devadattād daṇḍasya vibhāgo sarvataḥ sarvasya bhavitumarhati tatkathamucyate— tadanyatamavibhāmaimahasarveṣāṃ vibhāgaprasaṅgāt iti ? tanna; saṃyogavināśasya vibhāgatvāt, saṃyogasyadhakatve tasyāpyekatvāt
na hi ekasya ghaṭasya bahavaḥ pradhvaṃsāḥ
atha vibhāgāt saṃyogavināśo na punaḥ sa eva sa iti cet; na; tathā'pratīteḥ
navai khalu saṃyogapratītirasti, yataḥ saḥ san tasya vināśakasyāt
tathāpratītisadbhāve yāsakṛdeva saṃyuktaṃ vibhaktopurudaṃḍāditi pratītiḥ syāt
nahi yadaiva daṇḍī tadekadaṇḍī puruṣo bhavati
atha saṃyogasya vinaśyadavasthāyāḥ vibhāgaḥ tenāyamadoṣaḥ; tadavasthā saṃyoga eva cet; sa eva doṣaḥ
anyā cet; yadi tatkālabhāvinī; yugapat trayapratītiḥ--saṃyogaḥ, tadavasthā, vibhāgaśca iti
atha taduttarakālabhāvinī; tadā na tarhi saṃyogaḥ
tathā cet; na nahi vibhāgāt saṃyoganāśaḥ
pūrvaṃ tasya nāśāt tadaṃtaścet; anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ--saṃyoganāśād vibhāgataḥ tannāśa iti
para āha--vināśasakakāraṇasamagratā vinaśyadavastheti; tatkāle saṃyogasya bhāve sa eva doṣaḥ--saṃyogavibhāgayoḥ sahapratītiriti, vibhāgasyaiva tadvināśakakāraṇatvāt
atha vibhāgajena vināśena tiraskārāt na tatkāle tatpratītiḥ; tadasat; tābhyāmuttarakālabhāvī vināśaḥ kathaṃ pūrvasaṃyogatiraskārakārī

syānmatam--vibhāgasaṃyogasyavanāśayorāśuvṛtterekakālatādhyavasāyaḥ, tato vibhāga kāle'pi adhyāropeṇa tadvināśasya bhāvāt tena tattiraskāraḥ; tadapi na sundaram; yataḥ adhyāropitasya arthakriyāsāmarthyaniṣedhāt
kiṃ ca, bhāvapakṣasya balīyastvāt bhāvena satā saṃyogena vināśasya tiraskāro yuktaḥ, itarathā jñānajñānavyavāye vicchinnā vyavāye vicchinnā jñānavyavāye vicchinnā vaṃśādisvaradhārā pratipattirna syāt
api ca, ko'yaṃ tena tasya tiraskāraḥ ? vināśakaraṇaṃ cet; tarhinavibhāgāt saṃyogavināśaḥ, tataḥ saṃyogasyaabhāvato vināśo na vibhāgāditi prāptam
punaḥ syāditi cet; tadvināśasamaye syāditi na vibhāgaprayuktaḥ tadvināśaḥ, sahabhāvāt
kutastarhi vināśaḥ ? kuto vibhāgaḥ ? kriyata iti cet; ata eva vināśaḥ, tathādarśanāt
tataḥ sthitam--saṃyogavināśo vibhāgaḥ, tasya caikatve vibhāgaikatvam iti
tathā tena prakāreṇa sati tatparihāre vibhudravyavat paramāṇoḥ anantaparyāyasiddhiḥ svata eva
krameṇa tattvamekatvam anubhavat dravyaṃ bhavati ityādhyāhāraḥ
kathaṃ saṃsāretaravyavasthā iti cet ? atrāha--pratyanīka ityādi
