yata evaṃ tato nānyadeva jñānam ātmanaḥ
cetanāsambandhāt sa iti cet; atrāha--saṃvedanameva ātmā svabhāvo yasya sa saṃvedanātmā
abhāvamātrātmaka iti cet; netyāha--jñātā svaṃ paraṃ ca janātītyarthaḥ
kadācit sarvajñaḥ punaritaraḥ syāditi cet; netyāha--pratikṣaṇaṃ punaḥ pratibandhakāraṇābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ
sannihitameva jānāti netaratannedamiti cet; atrāha— aprāpyakāritvāvyetanasyeti
parikṣīṇadoṣāvaraṇo no cet bhāsayate hi kaḥ || 38

tulanā— yadāha akalaṅkaḥ--yadi sūkṣme vyavahite vā vastuni buddhiratyantaparokṣe na syāt kathaṃ tarhi jyotirjñānāvisaṃvādaḥ ? jyotirjñānamapi hi sarvajñapravartimeva, etasmādavisaṃvādino jyotirjñānāt sarvajñasiddhiḥ
taduktam— dhīratyantaparokṣe'rthe na cetpuṃsāṃ kutaḥ punaḥ
karaṇāni indriyāṇi, paryāyaḥ paripādiḥkrama iti yāvat, vyavadhānaṃ deśādinā virodhānam, tyativarttati ityevaṃ śīlā dhīryasya sa tathoktaḥ sarvajñaḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha-- parikṣīṇadoṣāvaraṇabhāsrayatono cet itthambhūtaḥ sarvajñena yadi, kaḥ sarvajñaḥ ? na kaścit
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt nāparataḥ bhinnajñānāt cakṣurādervā kasyacid īśvarādeḥ sarvajñatvam
evaṃ yaugasaugatasāyane aśeṣajñāṃ nirākṛtya sāṅkhyamate tannirākartukāmaḥ tanmatamupanyasyavyavakāretyādi--
caitanyavṛttimacetanasya svārthamindriyāṇi ālocayanti manaḥ saṅkalpayati ahaṅkāro'bhimanyate buddhiradhyavasyati iti viniyojayantaḥ kāpilāḥ kevalaṃ...
buddhyadhyavasitamevārthaṃ puruṣaścetayate ityekānte na kaścit sarvadarśī syāt cakṣurādinivṛtterbuddherdarśanāt
yadi punaḥ syāt tathaiva puruṣasya buddhiriti adhyavasyatyeva tatra kimālocanādibhedakalpanayā ? avagrahādijñānaviśeṣābhidhānabahutvāt parisaṅkhyā virudhyeta tadupayogaviśeṣāṇāṃ matiśrutādiviṣayatvāt
ahaṅkārādīnāṃ kṛtadvandvaṃjāṃ vibhāgena saha tāsaḥ tena tataḥ, ātmano jīvasya upayogaṃ vyāpāraviśeṣaṃ ālocana-manana-saṅkalpanā'dhyavasāyalakṣaṇasaṃjñasya acetanasya
kiṃ kutaḥ sa na ? ityāha--apitaḥ citaḥ puruṣādanyasya ityarthaḥ
tathā ca teṣāṃ rāddhānte indriyāṇyarthamālocayanti, ahaṅkāro'bhimanyate, manaḥ saṃkalpayati, buddhiradhyavasyati, puruṣaścetayate
anena cetanātmadharmān ālocanādīn acetane pradhāne adhyāropayantaḥ kāpilā mūḍhamatayaḥ iti darśayati
nahi anyadharmamanyatra jānan svasthaḥ, itarathā hemno pītatāṃ śukle śaṅkhe paśyan svastho bhavet
kathaṃ te taddharmā iti cet ? kathaṃ ghaṭasya rūpādayaḥ ? tathā darśanāt; anyatra samānam--cetanākapalitānām ālocanādīnāṃ pratīteḥ, jñānadarśanopalakṣaṇatvādātmanaḥ
atha teṣu cetanā samāropitā pratibhāṃti na mukhyataḥ; kva punariyaṃ mukhyataḥ ? puruṣe iti cet; na; tatraivaupacaritā'stu anyata mukhyā
tadālocanādivyatiriktatataḥ puruṣa pratītibhāk, yasya cetanā syāt

atha paramārthataḥ puruṣasyaiva sā bādhavarjanāt, na teṣāṃ viparyayāt; kiṃ punasteṣāṃ svatanye bādhakam ? cetanāyāḥ pariṇāmitvāpattiḥ iti cet; kiṃ punaḥ sāṅkhyasya pariṇāmitvamasiddham ? tatheti cet; pradhānamapariṇāmīti na yuktam--prakṛṣṭha prakṛtermahān sāṅkhyakā॰ 22 ityādi
prakṛtiḥ pariṇāminī, na cetanā iti kiṃ kṛto vibhāgaḥ ?
syānmatam--prakṛteḥ pariṇāmitve'pi na puṃsastat gotratvāt bhāvasvabhāvānām, anyathā dahanavat jalamapi vāhakaṃ syāditi
syādetadevaṃ yadi pradhānaparihāreṇa puṃsyeva avikārirūpaṃ kutaścit pratipannaṃ syāt, jalaparihāreṇa pāvakasya uṣṇarūpavat
āgamāt pratipannam, yadāha--na prakṛtirna vikṛtiḥ puruṣaḥ sāṅkhyakā॰ 23 iti tannedamuttaram; anyatra samatvāt
kiṃca, tastathāvidhaṃ puruṣaṃ kaḥ pratyeti ? pradhānamiti cet; kathamacetanam ? anyathā buddhyadhyavasitamarthaṃ cetayamāno'pi puruṣaḥ acetanaḥ syāt
puruṣa iti cet; āgamena kriyamāṇā tasya svapratipattiḥ yadi kādācitkā; tadeva tatpariṇāmitvami vedāgamavaiphalyam
caitanyasya vṛttim ālocanādipariṇatim, acetanasya pradhānasya viniyojayantaḥ tatsambandhinīṃ kurvantaḥ kapilāḥ

buddhyadhyavasitamanukṛtaṃnaṣvitaṃ niścayasyāpi gamarūpatvād evakāreṇa bāhyasya vyavaccheda sa hā artham arthākāraṃ puruṣaścetayate ityevaṃ yadyekānto'vaśyaṃbhāvaḥtasmin na kaścit kapilo'nyo vā sarvadarśī syāt
svari revaṃ manyate--yadi buddhiṃ puruṣo na paśyati; kathaṃ tadayavasi tamarthaṃ paśyet ? nahi darpaṇā'dṛṣṭau tadgatamukhaviśvadṛṣṭirasti
kiṃca, buddhestenā'darśane kutastasyāḥ siddhiḥ, arthādhyavasāyasiddhirvā ? puruṣāditi cet; sa tāṃ na paśyati, tata eva tatsiddhiḥ iti vyāhatam atiprasaṅgāt
svata iti cet; saugatamatānupraveśaḥ, arthākārasya svasaṃvedanasya saugatenopagamāt
atha karaṇamantareṇa arthagrahā'siddheḥ tatsiddhiḥ; na; cakṣurādereva tathā siddhaḥ tato'pyanyakalpanāyāmanavasthā--tato'pyaparasya kalpanātu

paśyatīti cet; yadālocanādiprakrameṇa arthavama tta yuktam; tatra aparacakṣurādivirahānavasthāprāptāranyatheti cet; arthamapi tatraiva paśyatīti sūktam--buddhyadhyavasitam ityādi ! tataḥ sūktam cakṣurādinivṛtterdarśanāt iti
tatrāsamarthaḥ--cakṣurādivṛttyā darśanād arthasya tasyā eva tena sambandhāt, puruṣastu buddhipratibimbameva paśyati nārthasugatavaditi
yadi iti parābhiprāyasya punaḥ iti pakṣāntarasya dyotane yathā kaścit sarvadarśī syāt tathaiva tenaiva ālocanādyantaramantareṇa pratyakṣatāprakāreṇa puruṣayasyabuddhiḥ syāt iti gatena sambandhaḥ
adhyavasyatyeva niścinoti tathaiva buddhiḥ artham iti sarvamapekṣam

tatra tasminnanantarokte paramate kim ālocanādibhedakalpanayā ? svārthamindriyāṇyālocyanya ityādinā kim ? yathaiva puruṣaḥ tadbhedakalpanāmantareṇa buddhiṃ paśyati, buddhirvāartham indriyāṇi tadālocanāti manaḥ tatsaṃkalpanam, ahaṅkāraṃ tadabhimānam tadaparendriyādikalpanāmantareṇa adhyavasyati, anyathā anavasthā
tato na kaścit sarvadarśī syāt, tathā so'rthaṃ paśyet iti bhāvaḥ
adhunā caitanyānnānyā buddhiḥ iti darśayituṃ tadīyahetorvyabhicāraviṣayaṃ darśayannāha— avagrahādijñāna ityādi
tātparyamidamatra-tathā caitanyaṃ buddhiḥ ityabhidhānabhedamādāya, tathā avagrahādijñānaviśeṣādhātabuhutvāt kāraṇāt parisaṃkhyā buddhiścaitanyamiti parigaṇanaṃ virudhyeta tattvabahutvaṃ syāditi
syānmatam--tadabhidhānabahutvaṃ jainasya svecchākalpitamiti; paramapi sāṅkhyasyeti samānam
syādetat, avagrahādijñānaviśeṣā buddhereva bhedāḥ tatastadabhidhānabahutvaṃ buddhereva paryāyaśabdabahutvamiti; tatrāha--sati ityādi
tasya ātmanaḥ upayogaviśeṣāḥ tadupayogaviśeṣāḥ teṣāṃ matiḥ avagrahādyātmikā śrutaṃ śābdaṃ jñānam ādi— parigrahaḥ te viṣayo yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ bhāvāt tattvāt parisaṅkhyā virudhyeta
evaṃ manyate--yathā avagrahāderbuddhāvantarbhāvaḥ tathā tasyā ātmanīti
tatra ko doṣa iti cet ? atrāha--nāsti jñatvamityādi
yathaiva hi śarīrayogāt śarīrī prāṇayogāt prāṇīti vyapadeśaścetanasya tathā arthāntareṇa ahaṅkārādinā yogād ahaṅkārī boddheti yadi vyapadiśyeta; dṛṣṭiśca pṛthak prāpnoti
ayaṃbhāvaḥ--cetanā pariṇāmātmikā buddhirna pradhānasya puruṣasya vā'pariṇāminaḥ iti
sāṅkhyena puṃsā jñatvaṃ pariṇāmitvakrayākapilamāste ko na kaścit sarvajño'nubhayātmakaḥ pradhānapuruṣasvarūpād bhinnasvābhyānyasyānabhyupagamāt
athavā, tatra ka ātmā sarvajñaḥ syāt tadurūpasvabhāvād bhinnasvabhāvaḥ

yathaiva hi spaṣṭaṃ śarīrayogāddhetoḥ jīvaḥ śarīrī prāṇayogāt prāṇī ityevaṃ vyapadeśaḥ cetanasya jainamate arthāntaramātmano'nāccharīrādi, tadyogādeva, na svataḥ, tathā'rthāntareṇa ahaṅkārādinā yogād ahaṅkārī boddhā ityevaṃ yadi vyapadiśyeta sāṅkhyaḥ cetanaḥ ityanuvarttate
dṛṣṭirapi caitanyamapi na kevalam ahaṅkārādi pṛthak bhinnaṃ puruṣāt prāpnoti
na caivam, ato dṛṣṭivad ahaṅkārādikaṃ tato'bhinnamabhyupeyam
tathāpyucyate— sato'pi puruṣasya na saṃyuktaḥ kutaḥ ? ityāha--ajñatvā'buddhimattvābhyām
anyaḥ sarvajña iti cet; atrāha--ka ityādi
parārthāḥ cakṣurādayaḥ saṅghātatvāt śayanādyaṅgavat iti cetanasaṅghātena cetanācetanasaṅghātena aparārthenānaikāntikatvādahetuḥ
cetanaṃ sarvaṃ cetanācetanaṃ vā sarvam iti dharmidvayam na punaḥ acetanaṃ sarvam iti vaktavyam, pariprati siddhasādhyatāpatteḥ, tenaṃ tathābhyupagamāt
cetanasya sarvasya kartṛtvam, anyathā cakṣurāderavi tanna syāt
tathā ca akarttā nirguṇaḥ ityādi virudhyate
atha nānumīyate, tarhi tenaiva puruṣasādhanasya vyabhicāraḥ iti bhāḥ
pakṣīkaraṇānna tenam vyabhicāra itya di cetanavargāt cetanācetanavargādvā so'nyaḥ syād yadarthaṃ tannimittaṃ sakalaṃ jagad bhavediti
kārikāṃ vyākhyātuṃ paraprayogamāha--parārthā etādyanta dūṣayannāha--cetane tyādi
cetanasaṅghātena puruṣasaṅghātena cetanācetanasaṅghātena prakṛtipuruṣasaṅghātena aparārthena anaikatvādahetuḥ saṅghātatvāditi dharmaḥ
nanu yathaṃ yādṛśaṃ saṅghātatvaṃ cakṣurādīnāṃ na tādṛśaṃ vipakṣe, tato na vyabhicāra iti cet; atrāha--nahītyādi
hi yasmānna cakṣurādīnāmapi na kevalaṃ prakṛtasya saṅghātatvamanyadeva anyatra samavasthānāt avinirbhāgavartanādapi tu tadeva
bho tu tathāpi na tadvipakṣa iti cet; atrāha--tatsamavasthānamitaratrāpi prakṛtavipakṣe'pyasti
na cakṣurādīnāṃ saṅghātatvam ekatvam, na na cetanānāṃ cetanācetanānāṃ vā tato'viśeṣa iti cet; atrāha--viśeṣābhāvāditi
bhedānāṃ parimāṇāt ityādinā sāṅkhyakā॰ 15 ekaparimāṇasya rūpādebhāt bhedasya ca sarvatra sādhayituṃ śakyatvāt iti bhāvaḥ
tatredaṃ vicāryate--kastatra paraḥ yadarthaṃ tat ? śarīramiti cet; na; tadbhoktṛtvāpapatteḥ
puruṣa iti cet; kaḥ tattadarthaṃ ca pratyeti ? pradhānamiti nottaram; uktatvāt
sa eva svaparaprakāśarūpatvāttasyeti cet; cakṣurādāvapi svārthamindriyādi sa eva avagacchatīti kimarthaṃ tatrānumānam ? vyāmohavyavacchedārtha ; śayanādau tadarthaṃ tadatastatrāha--vyāmohabhāvāt
kiṃca, svaparaprakāśakatvaṃ puṃsaḥ pariṇāmāvirodhi, sadekasvabhāve tadayogāt
nanu raśvetaragrahaṇavat kasyacit kāraṇāpi yadi tasyopayogaḥ kiṃ virudhyeta ? na kiṃcit, kevalamakartṛtvaṃ na syāt
anyathā viṣaye sa kiṃtadapekṣate ? tāthātmānaṃ tatpratyeti, tadarthaśayanādikaṃ na pratīyate, ubhayapratipattināntarīyakatva tatparītehitidṛśāṃtesarvamasiddham
tanna kapilamate kaścidaśeṣavit, nāpi mukta iti
na pradhānasyāpi pariṇāmātikramaḥ, caitanyasya vā, anyathā adṛśyasvabhāvaṃ pradhānasya prāpnoti
etena puruṣakaivalyārthā prakṛtipravṛttiriti prativihitam, prāgapi prakṛtinivṛtteḥ puruṣakaivalyasiddheḥ
ata eva na kaścit tāpavimuktaye yateta nahi...
dṛśyaṃ pradhānaṃ darśanarūpaḥ puruṣaḥ tayormuktiḥ katham ? kiṃbhūtayoḥ ? ityāha— anityetyādi
yato yabhyāṃ vaktaṃ tāpāttāpatrayād vimucyeta tadarthaṃ vā tāpavimokṣārthaṃ vā yateta
yata iti vā ākṣepe, naiva vimucyeta matena vā
nanu pradhānaṃ pariṇāmi na nityam; ityāha--na pradhānasyetyāpyabhyupagamasūcako viśabdaḥ, bhāvatastatpariṇāmābhāvaḥ, sarvatra āvirbhāvatirobhāvopagamāt
sa eva pariṇāmāśca so'pi syādataḥkaraṇasaṃyogāpāye tasyābhivyakterupagamāt
mābhūttasya tadatikramaḥ puṃso darśanaśaktyatikramaḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--caitanyasya vā ityādi
dṛśyasvabhāvaṃ jahāti pradhānamiti cet; atrāha--adṛśyasvabhāvam ityādi

tatra yadi sarvathā dṛśyasvabhāvatattajja hāti, syādayaṃ doṣaḥ, anyathā abhayarūperahitasya vandhyāstanatvaṃ yāvatā muktātmānaṃ prati tatsvabhāvaparityāgo'pi paraṃ prati viparyayaḥ, itathā kapilena saha sakalaṃ jaganmuktibhāg bhavediti cet; tadasat; yataḥ yatra tadā taddṛśyarūpatā, tatra tadā sarveṣāṃ puṃsāṃ darśanasvabhāvānāṃ bhāvānāṃ bhāvāt
nahi samānadarśanadṛśyānāṃ samānadeśānāṃ ghaṭādīnāmayaṃ vibhāgo dṛṣṭaḥ
atha yathā prakṛteḥ dṛśyasvabhāvasya parityāgaḥ, tathā puṃso darśanasvabhāvasyeti cet; atrāha--tathetyādi

dūṣaṇametadanyatra atidiśannāhai teutpādyatena dṛśyadarśanayoḥ muktiḥ nityavyāpakayoḥ katham ityādinā, puruṣakaivalyārthā puruṣasya kaivalyaṃ muktiḥ tadarthā, prakṛteḥ pravṛttiḥ ityetat pratibiddhiṃtaṃ nirastra
nahi garānaṃ tathāvidhaṃ kvacit pravarttate nivarttate vā kutaścit, vyāpitāhāneḥ
kiṃ ca, kā tasyāḥ tadarthā pravṛttiḥ ? tena saṃyogasya karaṇam; na; tasya sarvadā bhāvāt, kṛtasya kāraṇābhāvāt
tatsaṃyogaśca ātmanaḥ saṃyogena sadṛśaḥ evena darśitaṃ citaṃ matha kādācitkātatpravṛttiriṣyate; tatrāha--prāgapi pūrvamapi tatpravṛtteḥ prakṛtinivṛtteḥ puruṣakaivalyāsiddheḥ prativihitam
puruṣastarhi yateta iti cet; atrāha--doṣadarśana ityādi
doṣāṇāṃ rāgādīnāṃ ca darśanaṃ teṣāṃ doṣāṇāmapaghāto vināśaḥtaddhetuśca samyagdarśanādiḥ prayataścate eva svabhāvo yāsyasvavāsāvekapuruṣaśca tadabhāve kṣaṇikatvavat kutaḥ pravṛttiḥ
svarūpamātravedanasya sarvatrāviśeṣāt na tāvatāaśeṣajña iti bhāvaḥ
kvāde syāditi cet; atrāha--apunatṛtayāditi nanu yadyasau vati vivakṣāvānta vediti nasakaladoṣavicchedaḥ
nanu vaktā sarvo'pi radyopuruṣavat sadoṣa iti cet; atrāha--vijñeyetyādi
mahatām aśeṣavidāṃ gatiḥ anyavilakṣaṇā prāktanapuruṣavilakṣaṇā jñātavyā jyotirgaṇanāmiva
iti ra vi bha dra pādopajīvya na nta vī rya viracitāyāṃ si ddhi vi ni śca yaṭī kā yāṃ sarvajñasiddhiraṣṭamaḥ prastāvaḥ
nanu yadīhānantarabhāvitāṃ vāgvṛttirvyabhicarati; vācaḥ tarhi kā vārttā ityatrāha--saṃsargādityādi
saṃsargāt paramāṇavaḥ pariṇatā bhāvāḥ śruteḥ gocarāḥ,
śruteḥ śravaṇendriyasya gocarā viṣayā bhāvāḥ śabdā na sarve ghaṭādayaḥ
śabdāḥ te mā bhūvan tatpariṇāmāḥ syuḥ
iti cet; na; teṣāṃ tadātmakatvena pratītiprasaṅgāt gṛhātmakatvena ghaṭādipratītivat
nahi mṛdaḥ na pariṇāmā ghaṭādayo'tadātmakāḥ pratīyante kintu tadātmakāḥ
itarathā nālikeradvīpāyātasya dahanavattadabhidhānāpratītiḥ syāditi sarvatra saṅketānarthakyam
yathā nālikeradvīpāyātasya dahanaṃ na pratīyate tadvat abhidhānasya pratītiḥ na syāt iti vyatirekyudāharaṇamidam
atha matam--yathā bhavataḥ śabde rūpādayo nahivyaktāḥ santi tathā mamāpi śabdo ghaṭādau iti; tadasāram; yataḥ tatra teṣāmanabhivyaktānāmanumānato vyaktidarśanāditi pratipādayiṣyate anantarakārikayā
na ca tathā ghaṭādau śabdāstitve anumānādya saṅketāttatra tatpratīteḥ, pūrvamapi sa tatreti matiḥ; sāpi na yuktā; tato'pi tatra tadapratīteḥ
nāpi deśabhedena pratīyamānayoḥ pariṇāmibhāvaḥ, sahacaraghaṭapaṭayorapi tatprasaṅgāt
bhrāntestatpratibhāso dvicandravat jaletaracandravadvā iti cet; tarhi svapnādivat śabdaghaṭapratibhāso'pi bhrānta iti kaḥ kasya pariṇāmaḥ ? bādhakābhāvo'nyatrāpi

tattva tayordeśabhede kathaṃ ghaṭapaṭavat sāmānādhikaraṇyam ? asti ca, gaurayamiti pratīteḥ iti cet; evaṃ sati sthūlo'ham iti pratīteḥ nātmā śarīrādbhinnaḥ syāt, kuntebhyo vā puruṣāḥ kuntāḥ praviśanti iti pratīteḥ
hetuphalayostattvādeva parasparamabhedopacāro bhavati cakṣuṣā paśyati, annaṃ vai prāṇāḥ iti, kimaṅga punaḥ vācyavācakayoḥ na bhavati ?
kiṃ ca, bhinnapravṛttinimittānāmekasminnadhikaraṇe pravṛttiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyāccāthaṃ gośabdayorastīti tayoreva aikyaṃ yuktaṃ na gośabdārthayoḥ tadabhāvāt
ekavibhaktikatvaṃ taditi cet; ghaṭapaṭayoḥ syāt ghaṭapaṭā iti pratīteḥ
tādātmyaṃ taditi cet; tadasiddhaṃ tayoḥ, tadeva ca sādhyaṃ sādhanaṃ ca
tasmādabhedopacāreṇa ayaṃ tatra śabdaḥ pravarttate--ayaṃ māṃsapiṇḍo gosaṃjñaḥ, tathā bhedena ca asya māṃsapiṇḍasya gauriti saṃjñā
apareṣāṃ tu parihāraḥ--gauḥ śabdo yasya sa gośabdaḥ ityasya padasamudāyasya lupto'ntarāvayavasya prayogaḥ gauḥ iti, yathā bhīmasena iti; teṣāṃ sa na yuktaḥ
sarvatra saṃjñāśabdeṣu tathā kalpanena bhīmasenaḥ ityādyapi na syāt api tu bhīmasenaśabdaḥ ityādi syāt
kevalānāṃ padārthānāṃ saṃjñiṣu yojanapratīteḥ, anyathā gauḥ śabdo yasya ityanyapadārtho'pi na syāt, pṛthak pṛthak kevalayoḥ siddhayoreva taddarśanāt citraguḥ ityādivat
bhīmasenaḥ śabdaḥ saṃjñā yasya sa bhīmasena ityatra śabda iti śabdaḥ lupyate tathā gauḥ ityatrāpi gauḥ śabdo yasya iti śabdaśabdasya lopo draṣṭavyaḥ
bhavatuśruteḥ gocarā bhāvāḥ śabdāḥ, te tu nityāḥ syuriti mīmāṃsakāḥ; tatrāha— pariṇatā iti
śrutyagocararūpaparihāreṇa tadgocarākāreṇa gatāḥ pariṇatā nirucyante anyathā pūrvavat paścādapi kutasteṣāṃ śravaṇam ? tadagocarasvabhāvatve tālvādivyāpārāt pūrvamapi cā śravaṇam
vyañjakābhāvāditi cet; āstāṃ tāvadetat, anyatra vicāraṇāt, atrāpi leśato vicārayiṣyamāṇatvāt tadime paramāṇavaḥ ityādinā
uccaritamātre hi vinaṣṭe śabde na cānyo'nyān arthaṃ pratyāyayituṃ śaknuyāt, ato na parārthamuccāryeta
atha na vinaṣṭastato bahuśa upalabdhatvāt arthāvagama iti yuktam
rūparasagandhasparśavanto'tisūkṣmāḥ pudgalāḥ paramāṇavaḥ te śrutigocaratvena pariṇatāḥ śabdāḥ
ākāśaśca śabdavāniti, sa eva śrotraṃ tadguṇaśca śabdaḥ
nanu paramāṇu-gaganayoḥ atyantaparokṣatvā'viśeṣe kathaṃ gaganaparihāreṇa paramāṇukāraṇaḥ śabdaṃ sidhyatīti cet; uttaramatra--nacākāraṇaguṇāḥ ityādi bhaviṣyati
mābhūdākāśaṃ tatkāraṇam, tathāpi paramāṇavaḥ tatkāraṇam iti kutaḥ sidhyati ? na tāvat pratyakṣataḥ tena tadagrahaṇāt
tena gṛhīteṣu pratyakṣata idaṃ bhavati--asmādidaṃ jātam, agnerdhūmavaditi
atha paṭavat sthūlasya śabdasya tato'lpaparimāṇena upādānena bhāvyamiti tatsiddhiriṣyate; sā'pi na yuktā; sthūlādapi mṛtpiṇḍāt tathāvidhaghaṭotpattidarśanāt
syānmatam--yathā yatra yaddṛśyate tathā tatra tad bhavati, yatra sthūlaṃ dṛśyate tatra tat, yatretaraḥ tatra itaradupādānam
na cā'nupādānaṃ kāryamiti adṛśyakāraṇasiddhyā tatsiddhiḥ; na; adṛśyasyāpi sthūlatvā'virodhāt, taduttarapariṇāmarūpatve'pi tata eva alpaṃ kāraṇamiṣyate
tasya tattve'lpe yāvat paramāṇuriti; na; sthūlādapi tatpratipādanāt
niraṃśaparamāṇvasthāprāptau tu kiñcid bhāvasya jaṃvitīti na pramāṇamasti
kiṃca, sahatakārā bhyāmeva śabdodayadarśanāt tadupādānaḥ sa iti yuktam

syādetat--upādānopamardanevo pādeyasiddhiriti śabdotpādakakarādarśanaṃ ghaṭotpātromṛtpiṇḍādṛṣṭivaditi; tadapi na sāram; candrakāntena vyabhicārāt candrakarasaṃyogāttasya jalapariṇāme'pi tāvat eva darśanāt
anye punaretad itthaṃ pariharanti--na tatsaṃyogā tu ndrakāntacyutiḥ api tu vidhakarā dravantīti; teṣāṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ karpūrādidravyaṃ svalaparimāṇāt nyūnaparimāṇaṃ syāt
sarvadikṣu tadrūpādigamanāt tatrā'parapraveśo anyatrāpi sa evā'stu
yadi vā, vāyavīyāḥ te; tathāhi--nābhipradeśād ūrdhvamākrāman vāyuḥ kaṇṭhādibhirabhihataḥ śabdaḥ iti
yattāvaduktam--nāpyanumānatastatpratipattiḥ liṅgābhāvāditi; tanna; cetanā'cetanayoḥ parimāṇāpakarṣasyā'tiśayāḥ kvacid vyavasthitāt sā tattvāt tadutkarṣasya atiśayavat
yatra acetane sa vyavasthitātmā sa naḥ paramāṇuriti
na ca tasyā'darśanādabhāvaḥ; anumeye tadayogād atiprasaṅgāt
na ca sādhyavikalatā nidarśanasya; prasādhanāt sarvajñasya
bhavantu paramāṇavaḥ, te tattatkāraṇamiti kutaḥ ? kiṃ tarhi śabdasya upādānakāraṇaṃ mūrttasya ? na cānupādānaṃ kāryam; atiprasaṅgāt
daṇḍabheryādikamiti cet; kiṃ sahakārikāraṇam ? tadabhāve ca kāryaṃ na dṛṣṭamiṣṭaṃ vā kasyacit
kiṃca, tālvādīnāṃ tadupādānatve tadupamardaḥ tadbhāve, upādeyākāragamanalakṣaṇatvād upādānasya

atha tadbhāgāḥ kecana adṛśyāḥ tadrūpatayā pariṇamante, apare ca tathāvidhāstatra praviśanti, tato na ttatāpitasyaśabdānāṃ sarvadikkaṃ visarpaṇamiti matiḥ; siddhaṃ tarhi naḥ samīhitam tadbhāgānāmeva paramāṇupadeśāt
kathamevaṃyavā yadi nāmaadṛṣṭabījāḥ śālyaṅkuraḥ ktiṃ tyādi upādāno na syāt ? anyatra bījādarśanāditi cet; pūrvamadṛṣṭasthūlakāraṇasya tadviparītahetupūrvakatvā'darśanāt anyatra samānam
yo'pi manyante--vāyavīyaḥ śabdaḥ iti; so'nukūlamācarati, pudgalaparyāyā'natikramāt, vāyostatpariṇāmatvāt
nirvāte ca bhūmigṛhādau karatāḍanāt kutaḥ śabdaḥ ? stimitāttataḥ iti cet; etadapyanukūlameva
jātimūkasya ca pramāṇa vāyasadbhāve'pi na śabdaḥ
tathā ca śikṣākārāḥ āhuḥ vāyurāpadyate śabdatāmiti--śābarabhā॰ 1
pratyekaṃ pariṇatāḥ prāyeṇa syuḥ iti cet; atrāha--saṃsargāditi
santu dhvanayaḥ parasparasaṃsṛṣṭaparamāṇupariṇāmaviśeṣāḥ, varṇādisphoṭaḥ tadvyaṅgyo nityo vyāpako'mūrttaḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--tadbheda ityādi
kiṃbhūtaḥ ? ityāha--pratilabdha ityādi pratilabdho varṇapadavākyātmā yena sa tathoktaḥ
evaṃ manyate na śravaṇendriyagrāhyākārādivyatirekeṇa dhvaniḥ tadgrāhyo vā varṇasphoṭaḥ pratītibhāk
varṇātirakto varṇābhivyaṅgyo'rthapratyāyako nityaḥ śabdaḥ sphoṭa iti tadvido vadanti
ata eva sphuṭyate vyajyate varṇairiti sphoṭo varṇābhivyaṅgyaḥ sphuṭati sphuṭībhavatyasmādartha iti sphoṭo'rthapratyāyakaḥ iti sphoṭaśabdārthamubhayathā nirāhuḥ
nanu na śrotrendriyādhyakṣagamyo'sau api tu arthapratipattyanyathānupapattyā arthāpattigamyaḥ iti cet; atrāha--abhilāpa iti
abhilapyate anena ityabhilāpaḥ vācakaḥ, tadbhedo varṇādyātmā, tata eva arthapratītidarśanāt
tathāpi anyataḥ tatkalpane anavasthā, tato'pyanyataḥ kalpanāsaṃbhavāt
pratyekamapratyāyakatvāt sāhityābhāvāt niyatakramabhavavartināmayaugapadyena saṃbhūyakāritvānupapatteḥ nānāvaktṛprayuktebhyaśca pratyayādarśanāt kramaviparyaye yogapadye ca

atha ekapadārthaḥ bahubhirayugapadbhāvibhirasthirairghakāraṭakāravisarjanīyaiḥ pratiyādayitumasadya ityeveta bhāvyamiti; tadapi na sūktam; yatastadapi ekamanabhivyaktaṃ cedatra pratītihetuḥ; sarvadā syāt iti ghakārādyuccāraṇamanarthakam
abhivyaktaṃ cet; yadyanyena sa; evaṃ doṣaḥ ghakārādivaiphalyamiti
ghakārādibhiriti cet; tarhi yayā pratyāsattyā ekaṃprakāṃ prakāśayanti vācakam, tayā artham iti kimapareṇa ? na ca nityasya kasyacidvastutvamiti nirūpayiṣyate'nantaram
ekasmṛtyupārūḍhānāṃ vācakatve saro rasa ityādau arthapratipattyaviśeṣaprasaṅgāt, tadvyatiriktaḥ sphoṭo nādābhivyaṅgyo vācakaḥ
kiṃca, evaṃ paramparāpariśramaśca ghakārādibhyo vācakasyābhivyaktiḥ, tato'rthapratipattiḥ tebhyo'rthagatau na syāt
na caivaṃ vyavahāraḥ, tathāpi tatkalpane dhūmāderanyaḥ pratīyate tato'gniriti syāt
nanu tadbhedena kiñcidabhilapyate ? na tāvat sāmānyam; tadabhāvāt, prayojanābhāvācca
nahi sāmānyaṃ vādadohādāvupayujyate, viśeṣāṇāmeva tatropayogāt lakṣitalakṣaṇayā pravṛttiḥ iti na yuktam; tayāsāmānyapratītau sa eva prasaṅgaḥ
tataḥ tadbhedo'narthaka iti cet; atrāha--siddhārtha mati
tathāhi--yathā cakṣurādivyāpārāt athapratipattiḥ pravṛttiḥ prāptiśca, tathā śabdādapi iti, nirūpayiṣyate śeṣamatraiva
śabdena lakṣitaṃ sāmānyam, tena lakṣyate viśeṣa iti lakṣitalakṣaṇā
atha matam--pratibandhā'bhāvāt kathamasau abhilāpaḥ ? tathāhi--na śabdārthayoḥ deśabhedāt tādātmyarūpaḥ pratibandhaḥ
na ca tadantaramasti iti; tatrāha--svataḥ siddhārtha iti
yaṃ tadbhedamupetya śravaṇaviṣayatāṃ nītvā vakti brūte
punarapi kiṃbhūtaḥ ? sāmānyavedī yamupetya ityetadatrāpyapekṣyam, śabdaṃ śrutvā tadvedī ityarthaḥ
yadi prathamaṃ śabdaśravaṇāt sāmānyaṃ tena viditaṃ kimarthamevaṃ brūte ? nahi nīle svarūpeṇa jñāte kimetat iti tadrūpe praśno yuktaḥ iti cet; atrāha--bheda ityādi
tasya sāmānyasya bhedo'vāntaraviśeṣaḥ tasya kāṅkṣaṇam grahītumīhā tatra mano yasya iti
nanu sāmānyavedane bhedavedanam, anyathā sāmānyasyāpi kuto'tādātmyena, ubhayātmakaṃ tattvamiti, na tatra kāṅkṣaṇam
tādātmyo'pi prathamaṃ sāmānyasyaiva kuta iva śabdāt syāt iti cet; atrāha--akṣādiva
yathaiva hi dūre akṣāt manuṣyatvādisāmānyapratītiḥ, punaḥ tadbhidākāṅkṣaṇam, punarapi deśanaikaṭyādisāmagrīvaśāt tadbhedāvāyaḥ
tathā śabdātu prathamaṃ sāmānyapratītiḥ punaḥ tadbhedākāṅkṣaṇam tato'pi saṅketasāmagrīto bhedaniścayau naitāvatā śabdaḥ svato'śaktaḥ; akṣe'pi prasaṅgāt
yathā ca śabdāt svārthasandehaḥ tathā akṣādapi
atha tatra jñānāntaraṃ sandeharūpam, anyatrāpi tadeva
nahi ghaṭābhidhānādeva caṭo nāstīti vā sandeho jāyamāno janena vibhāvyate, tato'pravṛttiprasaṅgāt
atha śabdādarthapratītā vat sutopi kutaḥ sandehaḥ ? svasaṃvedanāt dānādicetasāṃ svargaprāpaṇasāmarthyapratītau tato'pi sa kutaḥ
atha tadbhāvābhāvayoḥ tatpratīteḥ sādhāraṇatvāt sa iti matiri tatra samānam
tathā sati kathaṃ śabdo'rthaviṣayaḥ iti anena nirastam
tatra nirṇayotpatterneti cet; yasya rūpasukhādau nirṇayarūpaṃ mānasamadhyakṣaṃ tasya tatsāmarthye'pi durlabhaḥ saṃśayaḥ
itarathā śabdārthe'pi sa tathā na bhavet
yasyāpi mānaso' vikalpo'niścayaḥ, tena tasya svalakṣaṇagrahaṇāt, avikalpena gṛhītasya agṛhītakalpatvāt tathā
yathā śabdāvastuviṣayaḥ sandehahetutvāt, tathā pratyakṣamapi parasya
tato'kṣāt sāmānyagrahaṇāt viśeṣākāṅkṣaṇe viśeṣā'vāyakāraṇābhāve yathā saṃśītiḥ tathā śabdādapi iti sthitam

syādetat--bhāṣāntare saṃkīrttita eva śabdāt sāmānyaṃ pratipadyatena akṛtasaṅketāt, tataḥ saṅketa eva pāramparyeṇa taddheturiti; tarhi indriyādapi pūrvaṃ pratipannasāmānya eva— tataḥ punaḥ sāmānyaṃ pratyeti iti
namu niḥprayojanaśabdasvarūpaparīkṣaṇena kim ? lokata eka tatsvarūpasiddheḥ; ityatrāha--niḥśreyasādhigateḥ ityādi
tathā cāhura kalaṅkadevāḥ--śabdaḥ pudgalaparyāyaḥ skandhaḥ chāyātapādivat

katham ? kathaṃ ca na syāt ? sarvathā niraṃśānāṃ digbhāgabhedena pratyekaṃ ṣaḍaṃśatāpatteḥ kathaṃ saṃsargaḥ ? kiṃ punarasaṃsargiṇa eva pṛthak syuḥ ? kathaṃ teṣāṃ vyavadhānam prakṛtavikalpānativṛtteḥ ? svakāryakāraṇakṣaṇābhyāṃ svata eva nairantaryamanubhavataḥ kālapracayabhedopalakṣaṇāt na vai kṣaṇavat kasyacit kaiścinnairantarye'pi sāṃśatvam, vyavadhānābhāvasyaiva tatsaṃyogātmakatvāt
svata eva pradeśamātrasya vyavadhāyakatopapatteḥ; anaṃśasyāpi svabhāvabhedāt grāhyādyākārasaṃ vedanavat tadime...
kathañca atyantaparokṣasya guṇaḥ pratyakṣaḥ ? parimaṇḍalānāṃ tādātmyapariṇāmopapatteḥ
tadime caitanyaviśeṣa kāryāḥ varṇapadādirūpāḥ kathañcit arthasaṃsargayogyatāṃ pratipadya vyavahārapadavīmupanīyante nānyathā śabdāntaravat
sattāpi syāditi cet; kiṃ punaḥ sā tato bhinnā yena evaṃ na syāt ? tathā cet; asan śabdaḥ
tasya tato'bhede sa eva sadbhavet iti cet; atrāpyuktam
rūpādimantaḥ punaḥ pudgalāḥ, teṣāṃ paryāyo vikāraḥ, na tatparyāyāḥ pudgalāḥ itarathā śabdānugatasya cakṣurādinā ghaṭādergrahaṇaṃ bhavet, sadrūpānugatasya iva
nanu yadi paramāṇurūpapudgalaparyāyaḥ; tadgataśyāmatvādivat tarhi tasya asmadādīndriyeṇa agrahaṇaṃ syāditi cet; atrāha--skandha iti
skandhaḥ śabdaḥ mūrttatve asmadādipratyakṣatve sati sāvayavatvāt paṭādivat
tathāpi tadasiddhau na kiñcat siddhaṃ syāt
puṭṭhesu tesu jāyadi saddo uppādago ṇiado
paudgalikaḥ śabdaḥ asmadādipratyakṣatve acetanatve ca sati kriyāvattvāt bāṇādivat
tulanā--karṇaśaṣkulyāṃ kaṭakaṭāyamānasya prāyaśaḥ pratighātahetorbhavanādyupaghātinaḥ śabdasya prasiddhirasparśatvakalpanāmastaṃ gamayati
apara āha--tīvratvamandatvajātisambandhāt tatpratyayaviṣayatvaṃteti; sarvatra tathā prasaṅgena sparśābhāvaprasaṅgāt
śabdasahacaritasya vāyoḥ tadviṣayatā ityeke; teṣāmapi vādyasahacaritasya anyasya tadviṣayatā ityevamanavasthā
yaccaivaṃ bahubhirbherīmādhnadbhiḥ gośabdamuccārayadbhiḥ mahān śabda upalabhyate, tena pratipuruṣaṃ śabdāvayavapracaya iti gamyate; naivam; niravayavo hi śabdaḥ avayavabhedānavagamāt

syānmatam--asarvagatadravyaparimāṇaṃ mūrttiḥ na sparśavattvam, anyathā manaso'mūrttatvaṃ syāt tadabhāvāditi; tanna; śabde'pyasya bhāvāt sparśavattvātdravyatvamasarvagatatvaṃ kecāsyavāryate ? parimāṇaṃ dīrghādipratītiviṣayatvāt suprasiddhameva
kiṃca, tallakṣaṇam atiprasaṅgi; tasya ātmanyapi bhāvāt sarvagatatvaniṣedhāttatra
nāpi sāvayavatvāt ityasiddham; sāvayavo dhvaniḥ alpamahattvagrahaṇagrāhyatvāt stambhādivat
atha vyaṅgye vyañjakadharmāropāt tadgrahaṇagrāhyatā na svataḥ, mukhasyeva darpaṇādau iti cet; syādetadevam--yadi ekarūpaḥ sarvadā śabdaḥ kutaścit syāt
na ca dṛṣṭāntamātrāt sādhyaṃ sidhyati, atiprasaṅgāt
evaṃ dīrghādayaḥ sarve dhvanidharmā iti sthitam

nanvevaṃ loṣṭādineva śarīrāvayavādighātaiḥtena, tadvattasya niyatadeśagamanam, ekatra karṇapraviṣṭasya tadantarā'gamanam, vāyunābhihatasya lokāntaprasarpaṇam, indriyāntareṇa ca darśanam iti cet; atrāha--chāyā ityādi
ādiśabdena andhakārādiparigrahaḥ, tena tulyaṃ varttate iti tadvat iti
yathā atra na te doṣāḥ tathā śabde'pi iti dṛṣṭāntārthaḥ
na hi yad yasya anvayavyatirekāvanuvidhatte 464 tad anyahetukamahetukaṃ vā yuktamatiprasaṅgāt
tadabhivyaktiḥ tāvanuvidhatte iti cet; na; anavasthāprasaṅgāt, tatrānyasya tadanuvidhānakalpanāt
sa eva viśeṣevarṇādibheda ātmā yasya sa tathoktaḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha--abhilāpaḥ sa eva yato'bhilapyate'nena iti
kva ? ityāha--svārthagocare sāmānyaviśeṣātmake vastuni vyañjanaparyāye vā
śabdaḥ pudgalaparyāyaḥ ityatra sādhyasūrermanasi mūrttittvāt iti heturvarttate
tasya paramāṇubhirvyabhicāraḥ, na hi te mūrttitve'pi tatparyāyāḥ tataḥ parasya sūkṣmasya tasya abhāvāditi
pudgalasya pariṇāmo'nyathābhāvaḥ, sa eva viśeṣaḥ sthūlaikasya sūkṣmanānārūpabhedaḥ, sūkṣmanānārūpasya vā sthūlaikarūpabhedaśca tasmāt
bhedo nānātvam saṃsargaḥ ekatvapariṇāmaḥ tayoḥ pratīteḥ

etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā anekasmāt alpaparimāṇāt saṃsṛṣṭād ekamahattvopetaṃ jāyamānaṃ prāgasat dṛṣṭamiti tatkāryam, tathā ekasmāt mahattvopetāt tadviparītaṃ prāgasat kapālādi dṛṣṭam tatkāryamastu aviśeṣāt
atha kapālādīnāṃ prāgapi bhāvāt na tatkāryatā; sāṅkhyadarśanamāyātam, ghaṭāderapi tathā bhāvaprasaṅgāt
tantavaḥ paṭe dṛśyante iti cet; na; tadā paṭasyaivabhāvāt, anyathā saugataśāsanam
tato'nya iti cet; na; asya pakṣasya niṣedhāt
kiṃca, yadi ghaṭakāle tato bhinnāni kapālāni santi, teṣāṃ tena saha utpatterna samavāyikāraṇatvam anyo'nyamiva
teṣāṃ prāgapi bhāvānneti cet; tathā ghaṭasyāpi prāgabhāvo'stu
anumānāt tatsādhanānna tadbādhanam; paṭo'pi mahākāraṇapūrvakaḥ ghaṭavatkinneṣyate ? tatra sthūlasya atra sūkṣmasyādarśanam
tantūnāṃ vaiyarthyaṃ syāditi cet; atra mṛtpiṇḍasya iti samānam
nanu mṛtpiṇḍasya ghaṭakāraṇatve tatra sthitasya ghaṭasya upalabdhiḥ tantusthitapaṭavat iti cet; na; kāryākāraṇapariṇatasya upādānatvopagamāt
tato yathā bahūnāṃ saṃsargādekaṃ tathā tasya viśleṣādanekamiti kathanna paramāṇavaḥ tatparyāyāḥ ?
atrāha saugataḥ--kathamityādi ? tamācāryaḥ pṛcchati--kaṃ ca na syāt iti
anya na kathañcit sambandhasya prakāreṇa niraṃśānāṃ paramāṇūnāṃ digbhāgabhedena pratyekaṃ ṣaḍaṃśatāpatteḥ kathaṃ saṃsargaḥ ? parihāro'tra--kiṃ punaḥ asaṃsargiṇa eva ityabhiprāyaḥ
evaṃ saṃsargaṃ dūṣayatā'pi tena bahirarthamabhyupagacchatā bahīrūpādiparamāṇavo'bhyupagatā eva--
uktāste sañcitāḥ te hi nimittaṃ jñānajanmanaḥ

kiṃ punarnaiva pṛthak ? pṛthakāvasthitāḥ— tadrahitāḥ, sañcitāstu saṃsargiṇaḥ; anyathā stambhādau adho madhyordhvatiryagbhāgādiṣu avicchinnā pratipattiriti naiyāyikaṃ prati etad dūṣaṇamasaṅgatam--avicchinnā na bhāseta tatastatsaṃvittiḥ kramagrahe
nanu ca rūpādigrahaṇe sahaiva sukhādigrahaṇamupalabhyate iti cet; stambhādau bhāgapratipattiravicchinnā tathaiva upalabhyate iti samānam

aparaḥ prāha--nāvicchedapratibhāsanātteṣām avicchedasyasiddhiḥ, tadabhāve'pi dūrasthitaviralakeśādau tatpratibhāsanāditi; tasyāpi teṣāṃtathāpratibhāsane yadavabhāsate avicchinnaṃ rūpaṃ na tatteṣām, yannāvabhāsate vicchinnaṃ tatteṣāmiti prāptam
tathā ca saṃvedane pratibhāsamānaṃ svavedanaṃ tadrūpaṃ na bhavet
tadabhāve tadabhāva iti cet; kuta etat ? tadrūpatvāttasya iti cet; tadapi kutaḥ ? tathāvabhāsanāt; anyatra samānam, abādhanaṃ ca
na caikatra tadabhāve'pi tatpratibhāsadarśanāt sarvatra tathā kalpanam; atiprasaṅgāt
paramāṇavo nāvabhāsante iti cet; kuto grāhyāḥ ? jñānakāraṇatvāt; cakṣurādau prasaṅgaḥ
svākārasamarpaṇāt; jñānātmani tadākāro'nyo'nyavicchinnaḥ, tasyaiva samarpaṇamiti sa eva doṣaḥ
yathā viraladeśasthā api keśamaśakamakṣikādayaḥ ekaghanākāraṃ pratyayamupajanayanti
yadyapi nīlatā jaḍatā ca staḥ, tathāpi kevalaṃ nīlatāyā jñāne samarpaṇam
kiṃca, teṣāmapratibhāsane kiṃ kalpanena ? nīlādijñānaṃ tu anyata eva rūpādirūpādbāhyataḥ syāt
te svayamavicchedavikalāḥ avicchinnaṃ jñānaṃ janayanti nānyad arūpādisvabhāvaṃ rūpādyākāraṃ jñānamiti kiṃ kṛtametat ? tasmāt paramāṇūnāmabhyupagame tatpratibhāso'bhyupagantavyaḥ
sa ca avicchinna iti te'pi tatheti sādhūktam--kiṃpunarasaṃsargiṇa eva iti
dūṣaṇāntaramabhidhātuṃ pūrvapakṣamutthāpayati--syuriti bhaveyuḥ asaṃsargiṇaḥ ityatra varttate
prakṛto vikalpo vyavadhāyakavyavadhīyamānayoḥ saṃsargo'saṃsargo vā tasyā'nativṛttiḥ ekatra pratijñāhāniḥ, anyatra anavasthā--punarapi aparāpara vyavadhānakalpanāt
yadi vā, prakṛto vikalpaḥ sarvathā anyathā iti tasyānativṛtteḥ vyavadhāne'pi
bhavatu teṣāṃ vyavadhānābhāvaḥ, nanu prasaṅgaḥ ṣaḍaṃśatāpatteriti cet; atrāha--na vai kasyacit ityādi
na vai kasyacit madhyavartinaḥ paramāṇāḥ kaiścid digbhāgavyavasthitaiḥ paramāṇubhiḥ nairantarye'pi sāṃśatvam

nanu sarvasyābhāvasya aguṇātmakatvāt saṃyogasya ca guṇātmakatvāt kathamucyate vyavadhānābhāvasyaiva saṃyogātmakatvāt iti cet; na; avyavahitāṅgulidvayavyatirekeṇa tadapratīteḥ, vyavadhānābhāve eva saṃyoga ityabhidhānapravarttanāt
kiṃca, avayavebhyo'vayavina iva saṃyogibhyo'syā'bhede ekākarṣaṇe pādādyākarṣaṇavat
evaṃ sati avayavino vaiyarthyam, tatprayojanasya ata eva siddhe riti cet; ayamaparo'sya doṣo'stu
eko hi avayavarūpādyātmakaḥ pratīyate, sa saṃyogaḥ avayavī vā bhavatu

saṃyogasya avayavitve anekamasrāṇisamūho'vayavī bhavet iti, nirantarabrāhmaṇacāṇḍālasamūho vā iti cet; ayamapi tasyaiva doṣo'stu yena tebhyo'bhinna ekaḥ saṃyoga iṣyate nā'smākaṃ teṣāṃ vyavadhānābhāvaṃ saṃyogamicchatām
tanna etebhyo'bhinnaḥ sa iti cet; uktamatra samavāyaniṣedhāt, sambandhā'siddhiriti
tebhya utpatteḥ sa teṣāmiti cet; atredaṃ vicāryate--nirantarāḥ santaḥ te taṃ janayanti, anyathā vā ? prathamapakṣe avayavinameva te janayantu kiṃ saṃyogajananena paramparāpariśramakāraṇāt
tathā dṛṣṭeradoṣaścet; syādadoṣaḥ yadi tathādarśanaṃ na bhavet, na caivam, nahi te pūrvaṃ saṃyogaṃ punaḥ avayavinaṃ janayantaḥ pratīyante
āśuvṛttestathāpratītiriti cet; yugapad dvayapratītau idamuttaraṃ syāt, na cāsti, anyathā saṃyogamapi paraṃ tamutpādya janayantīti prāptam
apare āhuḥ--nāsmābhiḥ jñānasya anyasya vā paramāṇavaḥ kāraṇamiṣyante svayaṃ tanniṣedhāt, tanniyuktam--kiṃ punaḥ ityādi; tatrāha--kṣaṇavadityādi
kṣaṇavat iti sāmānyena vacane'pi jñānakṣaṇa eva iha gṛhyate, tasyaiva pareṇa paramārthenābhyupagamāt kṣaṇasya iva tadvat, na vai kasyacit kaiścit nairantarye'pi sāṃśatvam
svaśabdena dṛṣṭāntīkṛto madhyakṣaṇo gṛhyate, tasya kāryakṣaṇa uttara upādeyakṣaṇaḥ kāraṇakṣaṇaḥ upādānakṣaṇaḥ, tābhyām
kutaḥ tadanubhavataḥ ? ityāha--svata eva na saṃyogādeḥ ityarthaḥ
nairantaryābhāvaprakāreṇa anyathā kāryakāraṇavyavasthā upādānopādeyayoḥ saṅkarādiparihāreṇa sthitireva mā bhūt
bhavenmatam--jāgratprabodhajñānavat vastusvabhāvata eva anyatrāpi nairantaryābhāve'pi tadvyavasthā iti; atroktamuttaram
vastu kāryakāraṇe tayoḥ svabhāvo yogyatā tataḥ tadvyavasthāyāṃ kāryakāraṇa vyavasthāyām

kimekadeśena sarvātmanā vā saṃyogaḥ ? ityāha--tatsaṃyuktāḥsvaparamāṇavaḥ teṣāṃ parābhyupagamādevamuktam, paramāṇavo'pi kṣaṇavastusvabhāvata eva saṃsargarahitāḥ sthūlamekaṃ pariṇāma vibhrati iti manyate
sarveṣāṃ tatprasaṅga iti cet; kṣaṇānāmapi samānam
śakyaṃ hi vaktum--bhinnakālaṃ yāvat prabodhasya jāgradvijñānaṃ kāraṇaṃ tāvat atītajanmāntarajñānaṃ kuto na bhavati ? anyat; ubhayatra samānam
tantavastarhi pṛthagavasthitāḥ kuto na paṭakāraṇam iti cet ? jāgradvijñānavat kasmānna agniḥ dhūmasya kālavyavahitaḥ kāraṇam ? tathā'darśanam anyatrāpyuttaram

idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam--yadyapi tataḥ kvacid vyavadhāne'pi tadvyavasthā, tathāpi tatsaṃyuktānāṃ tena madhyakṣaṇena saṃyuktānām avyavadhānena vyavasthitānāṃ pūrvāparakṣaṇānāṃ dhārāvāhināṃ kutaḥ saṃyogaḥprabandhaḥ ? saṃyogena vyavadhānābhāve prabandhaḥ pravāhaḥ kuto na syāt ? ityāha— aviśeṣaprasaṅgāt aviśeṣeṇa prasaṅgāddoṣāt deśapracayavat kālapracaye'pi doṣādityarthaḥ
athavā, yaduktaṃ pareṇa--kiṃ syāt sā citrataikasyām pra॰ vā॰ 2

tena vivakṣitanīlajñānaparamāṇūnāṃ saṃyuktānāmapi na nirbhāgavṛttibhājām anyeṣāṃ nīlajñānaparamāṇūnāṃ kutaḥsaṃyogenāvinirbhāgena prabandhaḥ prakṛṣṭo vicchedarahito bandhaḥ sahavarttanaṃ kuto na syāt ? ityāha--aviśeṣa ityādi

syānmatam saugatamate na kvāpi kenacit kiñcitsaṃyuktam; ityatrāha--svataḥ ityādyabhiprāyaḥ--nairantaryābhāve sāntaratvaṃ prasaktam, tacca vyavadhāyake sati nānyathā, tasya svata eva anyanirapekṣasya pradeśamātrasya niraṃśasya vyavadhāyakatāyā upapatteḥ navai kasyacit kaiścinnairantarye'pi sāṃśatvamiti upapatteḥ iti
mā bhūt kāryakāraṇavyavasthā tathāpi na doṣaḥ, pratibhāsādvaitavādinā tadabhyupagamāditicet; atrāha--anaṃ saṃkhyādi ityādi
na kevalaṃ sāṃśasya api tu anaṃśasyāpi svabhāvabhedāt navai ityādi saṅgatiḥ
vaiśeṣikaḥ prāha--guṇaḥ śabdaḥ niṣidhyamānadravya karmatve sati sattāsambandhitvāt rūpādivat
tadādhāro dravyaṃ vibhu nityatve sati asmadādipratyakṣaguṇatvāt ātmavat
yaśca tathāvidhaḥ tadādhāraḥ tadākāśamiti cet; atrāha--tathā śabdaprakāreṇa pariṇāmo yasya tasyaiva tadguṇatvasya śabdaguṇatvasya saṃbhavāt
na caivam ākāśaṃ nityatvenopagataṃ rūpādirūpam; rūpa pariṇāmasyaiva pareṇāpi rūpādiguṇatvopavarṇanāt
guṇaḥ śabdaḥ dravyakarmānyatve sati sattāsambandhitvāt rūpādivat
pratau akṣaracatuṣṭayaṃ truṭitam atighṛṣṭaṃ ca pareṇāpi ityeva paṭhituṃ śakyate

kathañcid atyantaparokṣasya gaganasya guṇaḥ śabdaḥ pratyakṣaḥ asmadādīndriyagrāhyaḥ ? tathāhi--yo'tyantaparokṣaguṇaḥ nāsau asmadādi pratyakṣaḥ yathā paramāṇurūpādiḥ, atyantaparokṣaguṇaśca parasya śabda iti

nanu ca atyantaparokṣaguṇatvaṃ syāt pratyakṣaśca iti sandigdhavipakṣavyāvṛttiko hetuḥ iti cet; atrāha--parimaṇḍalānāṃ paramāṇūnāṃ sa śabda ātmā svabhāvabhūto guṇo yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ tādātmyaṃ sa eva pariṇāmaḥ tasya upapatteḥ
yathā adṛśyasyākāśasya tathā vidhānāṃ paramāṇūnāṃ na syāditi bhāvaḥ
atha tasya paramāṇuguṇatve tadrūpādivadapratyakṣatā syāditi cet; ākāśaguṇatve'pi tadvibhutvavat sā bhavediti samānam
atra guṇavaicitryasaṃbhave anyatra ko'paritoṣaḥ ? tanna yuktam paramāṇuguṇatve śabdasya tadrūpādivat apratyakṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ iti
yatpunaruktam--śabdādhāro dravyaṃ vibhu nityatve sati asmadādipratyakṣaguṇatvāt ātmavat tadanena nirastam; paramāṇūnāmapi vibhutvaprāpteḥ
tulanā--yadyākāśaṃ vyāpakaṃ na bhavati tadā sarvatra śabdotpattirna syāt, samavāyikāraṇābhāve kāryotpattyabhāvāt
divi bhuvyantarikṣe copajātāḥ śabdā ekārthasamavetāḥ śabdatvāt śrūyamāṇādyaśabdavat
atha atyantaparokṣaguṇasya parokṣatvam; vāyuguṇasya sparśaviśeṣasya samānaṃ taditi cet; atrāha--asamānam
anena sparśaviśeṣasvabhāvatāṃ vāyoḥ darśayati anyathā na guṇaguṇibhāvaḥ
kathaṃ ca vāyuḥ pratyakṣaḥ ? akṣeṇā'sannikarṣāt; sparśe'pi bhavet, tasya tatsannikarṣadvāreṇa tena sannikarṣāt saṃyuktasamavāyopagamāt

atha vāyoḥ tena sambandho'sti, sa tu tatra jñānaṃ nopajanayati; yena indriyaṃ sākṣātsambaddhaṃ tatra na jñānaṃ saṃpādayati yena taddvāreṇa tatsampādayati, tadidamāyātam--yasya bhojanaṃ khaṇḍaśarāva iva
sparśe utpādayad dṛṣṭaṃ tena tatra utpādayati, nānyatra viparyayāt
kuta etat ? sparśapratītiḥ iti cet; kiṃ punaḥ iyaṃ pratītirnāsti--mṛduḥ kharaḥ anyathā vā vāyuḥ me lagati iti ? bhrānteriyamiti cet; kuta etat ? apratyakṣe'pi tasmin pratyakṣatvāropāt
tadapi kutaḥ ? tatpratīteḥ vibhramāt; anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ--siddhe tadvibhrame tadapratyakṣatvam, ataḥ tadvibhrama iti
ayamarthaḥ--yasya bhojanaṃ kṛtaṃ tasya śarāvaḥ bhāṇḍaḥ khaṇḍitaḥ
syānmatam, sparśamātre vāyorāropāt sa lagati iti pratītiḥ na tadgrahaṇāt iti; tahi rūpe ghaṭāropāt ghaṭaṃ paśyāmi iti vittiḥ na taddarśanāt iti saugatamatam
rūpopādhirghaṭaḥ pratīyate na sparśopādhirvāyuḥ iti kuto'yaṃ vibhāgaḥ ? atha dvīndriyagrāhyaṃ dravyaṃ pratyakṣam, na ca vāyustathā; candrārkādīnāṃ pratyakṣatvaṃ na syāt
pārśvavartinā teṣām indriyadvayena grahaṇādadoṣaścet; vāyorapi viśiṣṭapuruṣeṇa taddvayena grahaṇādadoṣo'stu
kimatra pramāṇam ? anyatra kim iti samānam
tasya rūpāderabhāvānna viśiṣṭenāpi tathā grahaṇamiti cet; candrādau sparśādirasti iti kutaḥ ? rūpavattvāt; prakṛte sparśavattvāt ityabhyupagamāt
yadi cāyamekāntaḥ dvīndriyagrāhyameva pratyakṣam; ātmā pratyakṣo na syānmatama eva tadgrahaṇe vyāpāro nānyendriyasya
athavā, gaganavat paramāṇavo'pi atyantaparokṣā iti tatpariṇāmo'pi śabdaḥ pratyakṣo na syāditi samānamiti cet; atrāha--parimaṇḍalānām ityādi
vāyunā vyabhicāra iti cet; atrāha--vāyorapi ityādi
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt ime śabdāḥ
kām ? ityāha--artha ityādi arthe ghaṭādau saṃsargaḥ sambandho yasyāḥ śabdānāṃ yogyatāyāḥ tām
nanu nārthe śabdānāṃ yogyatayāpi sambandhaḥ, tathāpi puruṣaprakāreṇa te vyavahārapadavīmupanīyante iti cet; atrāha--nānyathā iti
nanu yogyatā kāryadarśanādanumīyate, na ca śabdānāmarthapratītirūpaṃ kāryamasti, tebhyaḥ aspaṣṭasādhāraṇākārasyaiva pratītinnirāsārtha nvasti teṣāmindriye'nyathā pratibhāsanāt
atha yogyatātaḥ tatkāryavyavasthā; anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ--yogyatāyāḥ tadvyavasthā, ataśca yogyatāsiddhiriti cet; atrāha--vāg ityādi
kathamanyathā abhrāntajñānena vastu paśyannayaṃ śuktikāyā viśiṣṭameva rūpaṃ na paśyati ? samānarūpāsaṃbhavāt
tadayamāsannavat tadasādhāraṇaṃ rūpaṃ paśyannapi na niścinoti niścayapratyayavaikalyāditi ucyamānaṃ na jāghaṭīti
kathaṃ ca tayoḥ dūretaratvādisāmagrībhedāt darśanasvabhāvabhedo na syāt ? yataḥ pratyāsannavat dūrasthaḥ spaṣṭameva paśyet ? tanna...
vācām akṣāṇāṃ svakāryabhūtāḥ saṃvidaḥ tāsām ekārthagocaratve'pi yojyate
dūrāsannau yau puruṣau tayoḥ ekaḥ sādhāraṇo yo'rthaḥ vṛkṣādiḥ tasya upalambhayoriva tadvat
yathā dūrasya tatraivārtho'spaṣṭa upalambhaḥ āsannasya itaraḥ tathā kṣaṇasya aspaṣṭaikatrārthe saṃviditi na doṣaḥ
nanu dūrasthasya aviśadaṃ jñānam anarthaviṣayameva, tadavabhāsino ghanā'viśadākārasya arthe'bhāvāt
vastuviṣayaṃ tu śuktikādijñānaṃ dūre'pi viśadameva, tatra rajatādipratītiḥ anyā mānasī bhrāntiḥ tatkathamuktam sāmagrītyādi iti cet ? atrāha--kathamanyathā ityādi
anyathā sāmagrībhedād buddhipratibhāsabhede arthabhedaikānteprakāreṇa dūrasthaḥ paśyan abhrāntajñānena avikalpena vastu pratipadyamāno'yaṃ janaḥ

tena dūrasthasyāpi śuktikādijñānaṃ parasya pratyakṣam, tataḥ paraṃ rajatādibhrāntiḥ mānasī, anyathā tadbhrānteḥ na kiñcidudāharaṇam iti mataṃ darśayati--śuktikāyāḥ, upalakṣaṇametat tena marīcikācakrarajvādeḥ ityapi gṛhyate, viśiṣṭameva sarvato vyāvṛttameva rūpaṃ svabhāvaṃ na paśyati kathamiti sambandhaḥ paśyatyevetyarthaḥ
nahi nīle anyato vyāvṛtte dṛśyamāne sā'sti iti bhāvaḥ

syānmatam--yathā dūre'pi viralakeśeṣu parasparavivekāpratibhāsesarvasādhāraṇī kṛṣṇatā pratibhāti; tathā śuktikāyāḥ viśiṣṭarūpādarśane'pi śuktikārajatasādhāraṇaṃ caikavidya mātraṃ paśyati iti; tatrāha--samānarūpāsaṃbhavāditi
tathā ca dūre keśapratītivat śuktikāyāmapi samānarūpapratītirmānasī bhrāntiḥ syāditi manyate
tatra tadrūpabhāve dūṣaṇamāha--tatsaṃbhave samānarūpasaṃbhave pratyāsannena nareṇa rūpadvayopalambhaprasaṅgāt tadrūpāsaṃbhavāditi
paśyatyeva tarhi tasyā viśiṣṭameva rūpam anyathā anekāntaḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--tadayam ityādi
so'yaṃ drasthaḥ tadasādhāraṇaṃ tasyāḥ śuktikāyā viśiṣṭaṃ rūpam āsannavat āsanna iva tadvat paśyannapi na niścinoti tadrūpam

hiryasmāt na pratyāsannetaravijñānayoḥspaṣṭāspaṣṭapratibhāsaviśeṣamantareṇa pratyāsannasya vijñānasya spaṣṭapratibhāsabhedam itarasya dūrasya vijñānasya aspaṣṭapratibhāsabhedaṃ vināśamānapratibhāsa ityarthaḥ
anubhavo hi tatpratyayaḥ, sa ca dvayorapi samānaḥ, naikatra tasya sākalyam aparatra vaikalyam iti bhāvaḥ

darśanapāṭavādikamapi tatkāraṇam, tad dūrasthe nāstīti cet; atredaṃ cinyate--kimidaṃ tatra darśanasya pāṭavam ? pravṛttyabhāva iti cet; kutaḥ tasya śuktikāyāṃ mānaso rajataviparyayaḥ ? yata idaṃ syāt--
śuktau vā rajatākāraḥ rūpasādharmyadarśanāt || pra॰ vā॰ 3 | 43 iti
atha sato'pi niścayajananāsāmarthyāt tadiṣyate śuklatāmātre'pi tato niścayo na bhavediti na tatra darśanavyavahāraḥ
tatra sāmarthyam anyatra viparyayaścet; na niraṃśe tadapyayogāt
kiṃca, svagrahaṇaśaktireva paragrahaṇaśaktiḥ iti na bahirarthagrahaṇaniṣedho'pi

yadi punaḥ avaiśadyam apāṭavam; tarhi idamāyātam--itaravijñānā'spaṣṭapratibhāsaviśeṣe sati niścayapratyayavaikalyasaṃbhavaḥ iti, svabhyāsādimato'pi dūrasthasya tanniścayaḥ iti na tadvaikalyaṃ tatra tadabhāvahetuḥ

atha adūratvamapi niścayapratyayaḥ, tato dūrasthasya tatpratyayavaikalyasaṃbhava iti cet; atrāha— kathaṃ ca ityā dyabhiprāyaḥ--yathā pratyāsannetarayoḥ śuktirūpānubhavā'viśeṣe'pi nikaṭatvā'nikaṭatvapratyayabhedātniścayāniścayau, tathā arthāviśeṣe'pi tayoḥ dūretaratvādisāmagrībhedād darśanasya svabhāvabhedaḥ viśadetararūpaviśeṣaḥ kathanna syāt ? syādeva, yato darśanasvabhāvabhedābhāvāt pratyāsannavat dūrasthaḥspaṣṭameva paśyet
yataḥ iti vā ākṣepe naiva paśyet
yadi ca, yathā āsannaḥ tathā dūrastho'pi śuktau viśiṣṭaṃ spaṣṭameva rūpaṃ paśyet; tarhi dūrasthitaviralakeśānāmapi tathāvidhameva rūpaṃ paśyati, niścayapratyayavaikalyāt na niścinoti iti syāt
tathā ca aṇavo dūraviralakeśavat ghanaikābhāsamatihetavaḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 2
92 iti pra jñā ka ra sya vacanaṃ plavate
dha rma kī rtteḥ candradvayajñānam indriyajam iti
śakyaṃ hi vaktum--prathamamekaṃ tadarśanaṃ tadanantaraṃ taddvayavikalpa iti
yathā viraladeśasthitā api keśamaśakamakṣikādayaḥ ekaghanākāraṃ pratyayamupajanayanti...--pra॰ vārtikāla॰
nanu ca uktamatra manasoryugapadvṛtteḥ pra॰ vā॰ 2
akṣabhāvābhāvānuvidhānaṃ katham ? ityapi na codyam; asya tadvikalpe'pi samatvāt
na ca tatra tannāsti; lokasya tathaiva vyavahārāt taduktam--akṣajñānamanekāntamasiddheraparākṛteḥ
akṣajadarśanāntarabhāvitvāttatra tadvibhramaḥ iti cet; tathā coktam--
pratyakṣāsannavṛttitvāt kadācid bhrāntikāraṇam iti; tadapi tādṛgeva
298 iti; tadapyetena nirastam; nahi tadvikalpaḥ tāmapekṣate kvacittaddarśanā'nabhyupagamāt
tadvāsanātaḥ tadvikalpaḥ iti cet; na; sarvasya sarvadā tasya bhāvāt
kāmādyupaplavavat bahirarthābhāvaḥ syāditi cet; ata eva saṃvedanasyāpi sthūlaikākāravat na dvicandrākārasya vikalpagocaratve'pi santānāntare vācakaiḥ samarpaṇam
yadi punaḥ tathāpi taimirikaḥ candrādeḥviśiṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ na paśyati; dūrasthaḥ śuktikāderapi tanna paśyati
taccavastuno bhinnetadrūpamasti virodhāt, tato nirviṣayaṃ taditi cet; atrāha--śabda ityādi
yadi punarayaṃ sthirasthūlākāraḥ asanneva kathaṃ pratyakṣaḥ kathaṃ vā svārthakriyākārī yato lokavyavahāraḥ ? tathā vikalpasvalakṣaṇasya tadatadātmakatvamaniṣṭamapyupapadyeta
tathā ca bahirarthasya kasyacit akṣaśabdajñānaviṣayatvaṃ kathannāṅgīkriyate yataḥ śabdānāṃ vikalpānāṃ ca mithyaikāntatā'vasīyate
śabdasya tena vā saṃsargaḥ sambandhaḥ tasmai yogyaḥ itaro'yogyaḥ tau ākārau nirbhāsau tayorekaḥ sādhāraṇo vikalpaḥ
nanu so'pi asādhāraṇarūpamagno'vikalpa eveti cet; āstāṃ tāvadetat
syād bhedo bahirarthasya tataḥ tattvaṃ dvayātmakam sāmānyaviśeṣātmakam
yata evaṃ tataḥ paramārthasan na saṃvṛtisan śabdabuddhau pratibhāseta
nanu vikalpasvalakṣaṇasya abhilāpasaṃsargayogyatvenābhimata ākāraḥ tato na vyatiricyate iti svalakṣaṇameva, tanna dṛṣṭāntasiddhiriti cet; atrāha--yadi punaḥ ityādi

ayaṃ paridṛśyamānaḥ sthirasthūlākāraḥ śabdavācyo yadi punaḥ asanneva avidyamāna eva vikalpabuddhi rniraṃśāsetiyāvat kathaṃ pratyakṣaḥ svasaṃvedanādhyakṣagrāhyaḥ ? yena pra jñā ka ra gu pta sya idaṃ vacanaṃ śobheta--prameyadvaividhyaṃ pramādvaividhyasādhanaṃ pratyakṣataḥ pratīyate iti
rahayasa'cha saviṣāṇamadhyakṣagocaraḥ; tathā ca svalakṣaṇamekameva prameva prameyam, tatra pratyakṣameva pramāṇaṃ na dvitīyapramāṇāvakāśa iti bhāvaḥ
syānmatam--sa eva tadākāro viśeṣeṣu samāropitaḥ sāmānyam, tato'yamadoṣaḥ iti; tatrāha--kathaṃ ca ityādi
śabdavṛttiḥ anumānapravṛttiścasvārthakriyā tatkārī vikalpabuddherayamākāro'sanneva katham ? vā iti dūṣaṇasamuccaye, yataḥ tatkā lokasya vyavahāraḥ pravṛttyādirūpaḥ

idamatra tātparyam--ākāro'yaṃ viśeṣeṣu kiṃ tenaiva vikalpena āropyate, vikalpāntareṇa vā ? yenocyate pra jñā ka re ṇa--sa evākāro'spaṣṭaḥ tato'vyatiricyamānatanuḥ svalakṣaṇamapi bhinne khaṇḍādau cāropyamāṇaḥ sāmānyam iti
tatrādye pakṣe siddhā vikalpasya abhilāpasaṃsargayogyatā, anyatra āropyarūpasya bhrāntasyāpi svīkārāt
etena dvitīyo'pi vikalpaścintitaḥ; tathāhi--dvitīyo'pi vikalpaḥ prathamavikalpasya ākāramanyatra āropaya riyatisvasya neti tasyāpi bhrāntetararūpāparityāgaḥ
atha tasyāpi tatra tadāropaḥ svākāratvāt svalakṣaṇam; atrāpi sa eva doṣaḥ asanneva kathaṃ svā-- ityādikaḥ
punarapi vikalpāntareṇa tasya tatra tadārope anavasthā, punarapi tadantarakalpanāt
kiṃ ca, ādya eva anyatra svākāramāropayatu kiṃ dvitīyena ? tatra satyapi ekatra vibhrametaratvānivṛtteḥ
bhavatu ādya eva tathā vikalpaḥ tathāpi na bhavato'bhimatasiddhiḥ, āropitākārasya asattvāt, tato'nekānte'pi tathā syāt paramārthākārānekāntopagamāditi cet; atrāha--svalakṣaṇasya ityādi
vikalpasvalakṣaṇasya tadatadātmakatvam āropitetarākārātmakatvaṃ tathā tena anantaroktaprakāreṇa upapadyeta
kiṃ bhūtam ? ityāha--aniṣṭamapi sauga tasya anabhimatam

tathā ca tadaniṣṭānuṣaṅgaprakāreṇa ca bahirarthasya ghaṭādeḥ kasyacit jainopagatasya nāparasya akṣaśabdajñānaviṣayatvaṃ kathaṃ nāṅgīkriyate ? ekatra bhrāntetarākāradvayāvirodhe abhrāntasādhāraṇetarākāradvayāvirodho'pi durnivāra iti bhāvaḥ
yato maṃgīkaraṇāt śabdānāṃ vikalpānāṃ ca mithyaikāntatā avasīyate
adhunā tatrāstīti darśayannāha--na caitad yuktam ityādi
na ca nāpi etad vikalpasvalakṣaṇasya tadātmakatvam āropitākārātmakatvaṃ yuktam upapannam
kasyacid vikalpasya samyaktvaṃ yathārthatvamantareṇa teṣāṃ vikalpānāṃ yo mithyātvaikāntaḥ tasya pratipatterayogāt
astyeva sa vikalpaḥ samyak, yataḥ tadekāntapratītiriti cet; atrāha--tattattva ityādi
sa tanmithyātvaikāntaḥ tattvaṃ paramārtho yasya vikalpasya tasya saṃbhave kathaṃ sarvavikalpamithyātvam ? vivādagocarāpannā vikalpā mithyā tattvāt īśvarādivikalpavat ato'numānāt tatpratītiḥ
tacca atattvaviṣayamapi pramāṇam avisaṃvādāt, so'pi pāramparyeṇa vastunaḥ utpatteḥ
tatkathamucyate tatsaṃbhava iti ? tadapyasatyam; yataḥ anumānasya atattvaviṣayatve tataḥ tattvā'siddheḥ, anyathā pradhānādivikalpādapi tatprasaṅgāt
asya vastunyapratibandhāt neti cet; marīcikājalajñānādapi tattvasiddheḥ tadapi pramāṇaṃ bhavet, tasyāpi pāramparyeṇa tatra pratibandhāt
43 ityādi vacanādastu pramāṇamiti cet; pramāṇāntaraṃ syāt
8 ityanena paryāptamiti bhrāntisaṃvṛtisaṃjñā nam pra॰ samu॰ 1

loka evaṃ na manyate; yo manyate taṃ pramāṇe ti kiṃ syādapramāṇam ? itarathā śuklaśaṅkhādau pītādijñānaṃ visaṃvādadhiyaṃ prati pramāṇaṃ syāditi tatrānumānotthāpanamayuktamiti cet; ucyate--vyākhyātāraḥ khalvevaṃ vivecayanti pra॰ vā॰ svavṛ॰ 1
72 iti vacanāt teṣāṃ tat pramāṇaṃ na syāt
bhrāntijñānaṃ mṛgatṛṣṇikāyāṃ jalāvasāyi, saṃvṛtisato dravyāderjñānam, anumānaṃ liṅgajñānam, ānumānikaṃ liṅgijñānam, smārtaṃ smṛtiḥ, ābhilāpikaṃ ceti vikalpaprabheda ācāryadignāgena uktaḥ
vyākhyātāra evaṃ vivecayanti na vyavahartāraḥ, te tu svālambanameva arthakriyāyogyaṃ manyamānā dṛśyavikalpyārthāvekīkṛtya pravartante
atha te vivecayanto'pi gatyantarābhāvāt dṛśyavikalpyayorekīkaraṇāt pravarttate; tarhi dūrastho'viśadapratibhāsād vivecanacaturadhīrapi pravarttate iti tadavastham anumānotthāpanamanarthakam
pravarttatāṃ ko virodha iti cet ? anumānavat pramāṇam
astu iti cet; kiṃ nāma ? pratyakṣamiti cet; anumānamapi syāt
liṅgajatvānneti cet; evaṃ tarhi kāraṇabhedāt mānabhedo na prameyabhedāt
tathā sati akṣajanmano mānasādi pramāṇāntaraṃ syāditi na pramāṇasaṅkhyāniyamaḥ
atha vyākhyātṝṇāṃ nānumānaṃ pramāṇam; kutaḥ te svayaṃ tattvamavabuddhyante paraṃ vā prabodhayanti, yena dha rma kī rtti pra jñā ka ra gu ptā da yo vyākhyātāraḥ syuḥ ?
atha matam--paraprasiddhānumāne na teṣāṃ vṛttiriti cet; na te cārvākebhyo viśiṣyante
svayaṃ cānumānamanicchanto nirālambanāḥ sarve pratyayāḥ iti ko'rthaḥ ? svarūpālambanāḥ pra॰ vārttikāla॰ pṛ॰ 365 iti kathaṃ brūyuḥ tatra pratyakṣāvṛtteḥ ityuktam
atha anumānamarthaviṣayamiti teṣāmapi pramāṇaṃ na marīcikātoyajñānam; āgatāste'pi tarhi madīyaṃ panthānamiti sādhūktam— savavikalpamithyātvamiti
aparaḥ prāha--vyavahāreṇa anumānaṃ pramāṇamiṣṭam prāmāṇyaṃ vyavahāreṇa pra॰ vā॰ 1
vyavahāratyāge tattyāgo bhāṇḍatyāge śuklātyāgavat, tattvaṃ punaravikalpādhyakṣāt siddhyati; ityatrāha--avikalpasaṃvṛtteḥ ityādi
kutaḥ ? ityatrāha— tathā tena mithyā sarve vikalpā iti prakāreṇa nirṇayavirodhāt avikalpasaṃvitteḥ iti
yadi vā, tathā sarvaṃ vikalpajñānaṃ mithyā ityanena prakāreṇa avikalpasaṃvitteḥ sakāśāt nirṇayavirodhāt
nanu tasya darśane na kaścid vikalpo nāma, svarūpamātravedane tadayogāditi cet; uktamatra— sthūlaikākārapratibhāsāditi
athāyamākāro na jñāne nāpyarthe, vanādivadvicāryamāṇasyāyogāt, kevalamavidyābalādābhātīti; tatrāha--svagrāhyākāraṃ vikalpamityādi
cittasvalakṣaṇaṃ kathañcit pratibhāsanaṃ svārthayoḥ pratibhāseta grāhyādyākāratvāt yataḥ, tato na yuktam anaṃśaviṣayaṃpratyakṣādi, vikalpakaṃ nirviṣayam iti
grāhyākārasya sthūlākārasya vaikalyam abhāvaḥ tacca jñānasya svarūpameva
svaṃ ca tad grāhyākāravaikalyaṃ ca iti tat
saṃvad buddhiḥ saṃvṛṇvatī svata ātmanaiva sadapi svayaṃ viṣayatāmanayantī, itarathā na sthūlākārāvabhāsaḥ syāt
nahi nīlaviviktayāte vadyamāne nīlasya vibhramato'pi pratibhāsaḥ
atha tadākārādbhinnamātmānamasau vetti nīlādiśarīravyatirekeṇa saṃvedanasyānyasyāpratibhāsanāt ityasya virodhāt
pṛ॰ 345 sukhādinīlādivyatiriktamaparamiha jagati saṃvedanaṃ nāstīti sukhādivat svasaṃvedanaṃ nīlādikamapīti yukta eva nirṇayaḥ

kiṃca, ayamākāraḥ saṃvedanātcedbhinnaḥ; kathamābhāti ? svataścet; saṃvedanāntaram, tatra cokto doṣaḥ--viruddhadharmādhyāsaikavastusiddhiriti, māyāmarīciprabhṛtipratibhāsavadasattve'pyadoṣaḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
saṃvedanatve'pyasattvamiti cet; na; ajñātārthaprakāśaḥ iti paramārthalakṣaṇam pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 1
atha vikalpena āropyate sa tatrākāraḥ; na; spaṣṭatāprasaṅgāt
nahi nīlādbhedena pīte pratibhāsamāne tatra nīlākāreṇa sākāratvabhramaḥ kasyacit
atha abhedādhyāropādabhedabhramaḥ; sa kuto mataḥ ? uttaravikalpāt; saṃhṛtāśeṣaviphalpadaśāyāṃ na syāt, abhyāsāt pravarttamānasya ca
tata eva saṃvedanāccet; nanu ca tena tatra tadavyāpāro'bhedagrahaṇānnāparaḥ
evamiti cet; tarhi bhede'pi abhedagrahaṇāt tatsaṃvṛṇvatī iti sūktaṃ bhavatvevanvevamiti cet; atrāha--svabhāva ityādi
cetaso niraṃśatvapratipādanārthaṃ svalakṣaṇa grahaṇam, parasya tatraiva svalakṣaṇatvopagamāt, kathañcit pratibhāseta na sarvathā
kiṃ kurvāṇam ? ityāha--kathañcit saccetanādiprakāreṇa na dharmāntareṇapratibhāsamānam
yata iti yata evaṃ tato na yuktam
kiṃbhūtaṃ tat ? ityāha--svārtho rūpādiparamāṇavaḥ tadanukāri cet yadi syāt
atra dūṣaṇamāha--savikalpamanaskāraśakteḥ sāmarthyāt syāt savikalpakaṃ pratyakṣam ityanuvarttate
tathāhi--saugatapratyakṣam anumānasavikalpakamupādāya upajāyate, tathā kāmaśokādyupaplavaḥ, etadubhayorapi nālatvāt kutastayoḥ anyo'nyato vyāvṛttiḥ yena vyapadeśabhedaḥ syāt
atha jñānasya arthājñātatvena, arthasya tato jaḍatvena; kuta etat ? ekaikasvabhāvasyānyāsadṛśasyāpi anyatrābhāvāducyate; tayoḥ sadṛśetaratāṃprasaṅgaḥ
api ca, yena svabhāvena tayoḥ akāryakāraṇebhyo vyāvṛttiḥ tena cet parasparamakāraṇatātayoraikyam
śrutamayī cintāmayī ca bhāvane anumānarūpe, tatprakarṣapariprāptau sugatajñānaṃ bhavati
yena ca svabhāvena ghaṭavyapadeśabhājaḥ paramāṇavaḥ meruparamāṇubhyo vyatiricyante, tena cedanyo'nyam; samūhābhāvaḥ
sugatajñānaṃ svopādānānumānakṣaṇāt yena rūpeṇa vyāvarttate tena yadi svopādeyottarakṣaṇāt; tasyopādeyatvameva na upādānatvam

etadeva darśayannāha--tataśca tasmācca ekatvaprasaṅgāt kasyacit kāraṇakṣaṇasya kāryakṣaṇasya vā kenacit kāryakṣaṇenakāraṇakṣaṇenavā yaḥ kramaḥ kasyacid rasādeḥ kenacid rūpādinā yaśca akramaḥ kasyacijjāgradvijñānasya kenacit pūrvajñānena nairantaryapratyāsattiḥ svāpavyavahitaprabodhitaviprakarṣaḥ, ādiśabdena jaḍatetaratvādiparigrahaḥ
yadi vā, ghaṭe kasyacit paramāṇoḥ kenacit paramāṇunā nairantaryaṃ pratyāsattiḥ dravyāntaraparamāṇunā viprakarpādiḥ teṣāṃ vyavasthaiva na syāt
tathāhi--citrajñānaṃ yena svabhāvena kevalanīlajñānād vyāvṛttaṃ pītena tena cet tathā vijñānāntarebhyaḥ pītameva syāt iti kutaḥ citraṃ nāma ? pūrvamatra yathāsaṃbhavaṃ yojyam
nanu yaduktam--tatra dṛṣṭasya bhāvasya dṛṣṭa evā'khilo guṇaḥ pra॰ vā॰ 3
44 iti; tadasāram; dṛṣṭasya adṛṣṭasvarūpāyogāt atiprasaṅgāt tasyeti sambandhābhāvāt śaśaviṣāṇavat
na hi dṛṣṭasya ghaṭasya adṛśyaṃ śaśaviṣāṇamiti bhavati vyapadeśaḥ
paścāttatraiva pratīyamāneneti cet; na; atra pramāṇābhāvāt iti; atrāha--dṛśyādṛśyātmabhede'pi ityādi
svaścāsau saṃvidgrāhyanirbhāsavivekaśca sa ādiryasya citrajñānanīlādyākārāṇāṃ te tathoktāḥ teṣviva tadvat
tadupakāre'pi tadekopādhidvāreṇa sarvopādhyupakārāṅgaikātmano dharmiṇo grahaṇe pramāṇāntarāvṛttiḥ
mābhūdanavastheti tadabhedakalpanāyāṃ kuta etat samastamanekāntasādhanam upādhi...tadekopādhiviśiṣṭasya dharmiṇaḥ pratipattāvapi pramāṇāntaram, tadanyaviśiṣṭasya tasyāpratipatteḥ
yadarthasāmarthyotpannaṃ tadākāramevānukaroti pratyakṣaṃ tadanantaravat; nāyamekāntaḥ citsvabhāvābhāvaprasaṅgāt
upādhayaḥ viśeṣaṇāni tadvanto viśeṣyāḥ teṣām anyo'nyam ekāntena yau bhedābhedau tadanuṣaṅgiṇo ye anavasthādidoṣāḥ ādiśabdena virodhādiparigrahaḥ, syuḥ bhaveyuḥ
yat paraṃ pareṇoktam upādhitadvatorbhedaikānte aṅgīkriyamāṇe sambandho na sidhyet

tulanā--yo'pi manyate upādhayaḥ parasparamāśrayācca bhinnā eva, tannibandhanāḥ śrutayo'pi tadādhāre tatraiva vartante, tadayamaprasaṅga iti; tasyāpi nānopādhīnāmupakārāṅgaśaktibhyo'bhinnātmanaḥ sarvātmanā grahe kṛte upakāryasya ko bhedaḥ syādaniścitaḥ
nanvevam agnidhūmayorapi sa na sidhyet; ityatrāha--yadyanupakāraḥ iti
tayoryadyupakārābhāvaḥ tadā na sidhyet, upakāre tu sidhyedeva
kena ? ityāha--tadekopādhidvāreṇa, tasya dharmiṇo va eka upādhiḥ viśeṣaṇaṃ taddvāreṇa
sarvasya upādheḥ ya upakāraḥ tasya aṅgaṃ nimittam eko'bhinnaḥ ātmā svabhāvo yasya tasva iti
evaṃ manyate paraḥ--ekopādhidvāreṇa sakalopādhyupakāraśaktyātmā tadvān pratīyamānaḥ sakalopādhīāhayati, tadagrahe tadagrahāt iti kutaḥ pramāṇāntaravṛttiriti
atha tadupakāraśaktayo bhinnāḥ tenāyamadoṣaḥ; tatrāha--tadupakāra ityādi
teṣāmupādhīnām upakārikāḥ tāśca tāḥ śaktayaśca tāsām bhedakalpanāyām
punarapi tadbhedakalpanāyāṃ sa eva doṣaḥ ityanavasthā syāt
sāṃkhyasya matamāśaṅkate paro dūṣayitum mā bhūt ityādi
mābhūdanavasthā iti hetoḥ tayoḥ upādhitadvatorabhedakalpanāyāṃ sāṃkhyena kriyamāṇāyām ? kim ? ityāha--kuta ityādi
tat tasmāt tayoḥ kathañcittādātmyāt ekopādhiviśiṣṭasya dharmiṇaḥ pratipattāvapi pramāṇāntaraṃ pravartate ityadhyāhāraḥ
syānmatam--pratipannasya apratipannaṃ rūpam iti kuto'vagamyate ? ityatrāha--vyavasāyātmakasya ityādi
vyavasāyātmakasya sāmānyaviśeṣātmakavastuviṣayasya pravartakatvāt na pratiparamāṇuniṣṭhājaṃbhrāntamavikalpakam indriyajñānaṃ cābhyāse pravarttakaṃ keṣāñcit
teṣāṃ ca savikalpakatve tatsantā nināṃ tadeva

yadi punaḥ tanmanaskārāccidrūpānukaraṇameva nābhilāpasaṃsargayogyānukaraṇaṃ tathā dṛṣṭeḥ, bhāvaśakteracintyatvāt; tata eva tarhi paramāṇubhyo nīlādyākārānukāritaiva na parasparavivekānukāritaiti prāptam, tathā ca paramāṇūnāṃ sāvayavatvam, pratyakṣaṃ ca sāmānyagocaram anekasādhāraṇākārānukaraṇāt
atha tatrāsau ākāro nāsti, kathamabhāti ? asanneveti cet; bhrāntamadhyakṣam
vyavahārārthaṃ taditi cet; na; anumaśabdajñānagocarasyāpi svalakṣaṇatvamiti prameyadvaividhyāt pramāṇaṃ dvividham ityasāram, vicāryamāṇasyā'yogāt
neti cet; ata eva cakṣurādigocarasyāpi na syāt
atha anumānādiviṣayo na svalakṣaṇam, tasya indriye anyathā pratibhāsanāt; sthūlākāro'pi na svalakṣaṇaṃ yogijñāne anyathā pratibhāsanāt
anyathā kutaḥ paramāṇusiddhiḥ yenocyate--dūraviralakeśavat paramāṇavaḥ sthūlapratibhāsahetavaḥ iti ? anumānāttatsiddhiriti cet; aseḥ kośasya tīkṣṇatā--yad yoginā'pratipannam anumānaṃ pratyeti
yathaiva keśā davīyasi deśe'saṃsaktā api ghanasanniveśāvabhāsinaḥ, paramāṇavo'pi tatheti na virodhaḥ
kiṃca, itaravad yogino bhrāntatvaṃ savikalpakatvaṃ ca, tadākāro yoginaḥsvalakṣaṇaṃ mā bhūt anyasya bhaviṣyatīti cet; abhilāpasaṃsargayogyākāro'pi vyākhyātṝṇāṃ mā bhūt vyavahāriṇāṃ bhaviṣyati
anarthakriyākāritvānneti cet; tadākāraḥ kimarthakriyākārī ? tathā cet; paramāṇukalpanāmanarthakam
vyākhyātāro manyante iti cet; tadanusaraṇe śūnyataiva śaraṇam
pratyakṣaṃ yasyārthasya sāmarthyena utpannaṃ tasyākārameva na jātyāderanukaroti
nidarśanamatra, tasya pratyakṣajanakasya arthasya anantaram upādeyo'rthasvalakṣaṇamiva tadvaditi
tathāhi--yathā tat tathā tattasya nīlatāṃ tathā jaḍatāmanukaroti dvitīyārthakṣaṇavat jaḍatvāpattiḥ
anyathā viṣayasāṃśatvam idaṃ nirākuryāt śabdādarthapratītau akṣasaṃhatervaiphalyam iti
nanu pitrorākāramanukurvadapi apatyaṃ na sarvathā yathānukaroti tathā idamarthasya iti cet; atrāha— tadekānta ityādi
ayam abhiprāyaḥ--anekānte'pi tata utpatteḥ tadākārānukaraṇe'yaṃ doṣo nānyathā iti, savikalpe tyādyanena vyākhyātam
yadi samastāḥ sāmānyajñānena pratīyante tadā śabdādutpadyate yatsāmānyajñānaṃ tena sakalavyaktisvarūpapratipatterakṣasaṃhatervaiphalyaprasaṅgaḥ
syānmatam--yathātatarthasya nīlatvamanukaroti na jaḍatvaṃ tathā tanmanaskārāt cidrūpatāmātraṃ nābhilāpyamākāram; ityatrāha--sāmagrībhedāt ityādi
tātparyamidamatra--yathā kutaścit prattyāsatteḥ pratyakṣam arthasya nīlatāmātramanukaroti nācetanāṃ tathā śābdaṃ jñānaṃ tanmātraṃ tasya gṛhṇāti na vaiśadyamiti
tato yaduktam--yadi viśado'nyathā vā'rthaḥ tathaiva ubhayatrāpi pratibhāseta; tannirastam; anyatra doṣāt

yathā arthasya cetanād vyāvṛttiranyā anyā vānīlavyāvṛttiḥ nīlasya, anyathā nīlānukaraṇe jaḍatānukaraṇamavaśyaṃbhāvi, tathā ekasya yato vyāvṛttiḥ tadrūpāpekṣayā paramārthabhūtāstāvatyo vāvṛntayaḥ prāpnuvantīti darśayannāha--ekasya ityādi
tanna dṛṣṭasya bhāvasya dṛṣṭa evākhilo guṇaḥ || 9
avikalpapratyakṣasya anyasya ca ekadā pravṛttau kutaḥ punaḥ pravṛttiḥ, tasya tadgrāhyasya cārthasya vyavasāyopapatteḥ
ata eva akṣaśabdajñānānāṃ kathañcit paramārthaikaviṣayatvam pratyakṣa...
kayā ? ityāha--vyāvṛttyā, jātyapekṣayā ekavacanam vyāvṛttibhiḥ ityarthaḥ
kutastayā ? ityāha--sarvataḥ sājātīyād vijātīyācca anyasmāt parasmāt
yata eva tat tasmāt dṛṣṭasyabhāvasya upalakṣaṇametat anumitasya śabdapratipāditasya ca na dṛṣṭa eva idamapyupalakṣaṇam anumita eva akhilo guṇaḥ jaḍatāvad anyasyāpi adṛṣṭasya virodhāt
atrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ--tasmād dṛṣṭasya bhāvasya dṛṣṭa evākhilo guṇaḥ
yena svabhāvena kaścid ekasmād vyāvarttate tena parasmādapi iti sautrāntikasya
tatra prathamapakṣe hiryasmāt na kaścid bhāva ekasmāt cetanābhimatāt vyāvṛttaḥ
tacchabdena yebhyo vyāvṛttaḥ te gṛhyante, teṣāmekatvaṃ samānarūpatā tasya prasaṅgāt
tathāhi--yathā jñānājjaḍatāmādāya vyāvṛtta iti majñāne jaḍatā tathā anyato'pi iti, tataḥ tasyāpi jaḍatā na syāt, ekatraiva sā bhavet
atha jaḍatā yathā ekatratathā anyatrāpi iti matiḥ; hanarhi yathaikasmāt vyāvṛttaḥtathā'nyasmādapi

kiṃca, nīlajñānārthayoḥ yaivā'tannīlāt svabhāvabhūtā vyāvṛttiḥ saiva cet parasparam; tadā anīlād vyāvarttamānasya jñānasya tato yathā nīlavyapadeśaḥ tathā bahirarthādapi vyāvarttamānasya sa eva syāt na vyapadeśāntaraṃ tannimittābhāvāt
atha tayoranīlānnīlatayā vyāvṛttiḥ na tayā jñānasya nīlārthāt; kutavikalpapratyakṣasya anyasya ca anumānādeḥ pravṛttau satyām ekadā punaḥ paścāt pravṛtteḥtatraiva vyavasāyātmakasya iti ghaṭanāt
tasya pratyakṣasya anyasya vā tadgrāhyasya cārthasya vyavasāyopapatteḥ

upapatteḥ ityanena etaddarśayati--yathaikacitrajñānaṃ svanirbhāseṣu yugapadāvarttate tathā krameṇāpīti, ata eva anantaranyāyād akṣaśabdajñānānāṃ kathaṃcit paramārthaikaviṣayatvaṃ siddham ityādhyāhāraḥ
na hi dṛśyātmakameva ekaṃ stambhādyavayavarūpamutprekṣāmahe, saṃvittimātrasyāpyabhāvaprasaṅgāt
tadetat dravyaṃdṛśyādṛśyān sahabhūtān svān svabhāvānasaṅkareṇa svayaṃ svavyāpakatayā lakṣayet svalakṣaṇamāśritya mithyāsantānavyavasthāpanāt
pratyakṣasya madhyāvasthāyām akṣajñānasya vaiśadyasyaśabdādeḥ tathā parokṣatā
dṛṣṭāntamāha--svahetuphalasantāno yathā svahetuphale upādānopādeyakṣaṇe, tayoḥ santāno yena yathā pratītyādiprakāreṇa pratyakṣaḥ san parokṣaḥ tathā prakṛtamapi
svāpe'yaṃ hi parokṣaḥ prabodhe pratyakṣo bhavati, punaḥ tatra pratyakṣaḥ svāpe parokṣa iti
upalabhyaṃ madhyarūpaṃ pūrvāparakoṭyorapi na kevalaṃ madhya evā'stu
tarhi pūrvameva parameva vā syāditi cet; atrāha--kathañciditi
svabhāva ityanena ekāntasvarūpaṃ parāmṛśyate tasya viruddho nityādye kāntaḥ tasya anupalabdhiḥ suvivecitametadasakṛt
hi ryasmāt dṛśyātmakameva ekaṃ stambhādyavayavirūpaṃ vyavasthitamutprekṣāmahe yugapat krameṇa ca kathañcidadṛśyatāvirodhāt
tadekānte saṃvido'nyasya vā dṛśyātmakaikasvabhāvaikānte arthakriyānupapattiḥ yato'rthasya uttarakāryasya kriyā tadanupapattiriti vicāritametat
4 iti vacanāt, na ca tadanupapatteḥ saṃvedanamātrasya pratīyamānasyāpyabhāva iti cet; atrāha— viruddha ityādi
tadekāntaviruddho'nekāntaḥ tasya kāryaṃ pūrvasya uttarapariṇāmalakṣaṇaṃ tasya upalabdhireva nānupalabdhiḥ
yata evaṃ tattasmādetat pratīyamānaṃ jīvādi dravyaṃ lakṣayet cihnayet
kayā ? ityāha--svavyāpakatayā svena rūpeṇa na samavāyena yā vyāpakatā tayā iti
kutaḥ ? ityāha--svalakṣaṇaṃ na dravyamāśritya mithyāsantānavyavasthāpanāt saugateneti
kutaḥ kāraṇāt pramāṇādvā santānaikatvaṃ pratipadyata saugataḥ ? na kutaścit
kena ? ityāha--naditiprasaṅgopālambhena--tasya dravyasya atiprasaṅgopālambho sarvasyobhayarūpatve ityādikaḥ pra॰ vā॰ 3
tu svāpe yata eva caitanyaṃ nopalabhyate tata eva nāsti, tatkathaṃ tannidarśanena ekasya dṛśyetaratāsādhanamiti cet ? atrāha--parokṣa ityādi
sudūramapi gatvā dṛśyādṛśyātmaikarūpasya cittasya itarasya vā pratikṣepe abhāvāt kiṃ kena pramīyeta
kiṃbhūtaḥ syāt ? ityāha--parokṣamindriyagrāhyaṃ kṣaṇikānām anantānāmaṇūnāṃ varṇaparimaṇḍalaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ
punarapi kiṃbhūtaḥ ? ityāha— pratyakṣāttha...pratyakṣaścāsau sthiraḥ kālāntarasthāyī ekaḥ sādhāraṇa ātmā svabhāvo yasya sa cāsau sthūlaśca
sthiraikātmanaḥ sthūla syārthasya viśadadarśane pratibhāsanāt nāviśadakalpa ityarthaḥ
tato yadyadarśanāt svāpacaitanyābhāvaḥ; tata eva arthasya kṣaṇikānantāṇuvarṇaparimaṇḍalābhāva iti sautrāntikaḥ, sarvadā svāpākrāntaḥ anyathā hetoraneka vyabhicāra iti bhāvaḥ
svāpābhāvaḥ syāditi cet; ko'yaṃ svāpo nāma ? caitanyarahitā middhadaśā iti cet; kathamadṛśyasya caitanyasya tadā'bhāvaḥ ? adṛśyānupalabdhergamakatvāpapatteḥ
vyavahārajanāt; sa hi svapnadarśanavirahiṇīṃ tāṃ daśāṃ manyate iti cet; sa eta tarhi tatparimaṇḍaladarśanavikalāṃ sakalāṃ sakalakālakalāpakalitāṃ tāṃ manyate iti samānam
syānmatam--na vyavahāriṇo'nabhyupagamāt paramāṇudarśanābhāva iti svāpe caitanyābhāvo'pi mā bhūt lakṣaṇayukte bādhāsaṃbhave tallakṣaṇameva dūṣitaṃ syāt pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 226 iti
vyavahārīmayā dūṣitaḥ syāditi cet; kriyāpīti samaḥ samādhiḥ
yathā ca tava tadrūpanepi na doṣaḥ paramāṇusiddhiranivāraṇāt tathā mamāpyātmasiddhiḥ abādhanāt
atha taddūṣaṇe mamāpi tat, ahamapi yato vyavahārī; tavāpi taditi samānam, bahiḥ paramāṇuṣu tvamapi vyavahārī prāmāṇyaṃ vyavahāreṇa pra॰ vā॰ 1
atha prathamaṃ vyavahārī paramāṇūnyasya darśanottarakālabhāvinyā t vikalpabuddhyā sthiraikātmasthūlāvyavasāyo mithyā iti cet; na; uktamatra--sphuṭadarśanāditi
kiṃ ca, svāpe'pi sa caitanyaṃ paśyati svavedanadarśanāt, tatra tanniścayavirahāt punaḥ jāyamānā mithyāvikalpabuddhiḥ tadabhāvaṃ vyavasyati
saṃhṛtavikalpadaśāyāṃ jñānahetutvātte dṛśyāḥ; prabodhahetutvāt svāpacittaṃ dṛśyam
kathamanyasya dṛśyatvamanyasya iti cet ? paramāṇuṣu katham ? tadākāratā ca neṣyate, pareṇāpyanekākārapratibhāsopagamāt
yadi sadbhāve'pi sarvatra nīlajñānābhāvāt paramāṇavo'numīyete; mṛtaśarīre antyacittasadbhāve'pi prabodhādarśanāt suptasya prabodhā'darśanāt svāpe caitanyamanumīyatām
jāgraccittāttatprabodha iti cet; sthūlāttatpratibhāsa iti na paramāṇusiddhiḥ
atha keśeṣu tadākārahiteṣvapi tatpratyayadarśanānna tatsiddhiḥ; paramāṇvabhāve'pi kāmalikakeśādipratyayadarśanāt tadavastho doṣaḥ
tathāpi paramāṇava eva tatkāraṇaṃ kalpante tvayā mayā svāpacittaprabodhakāraṇaṃ kalpyate

nanu cittaṃ cet; kathamadṛśyam ? adṛśyaṃ cet; kathaṃ cittamiti cet ? ucyate-- paramāṇavaścedālambanakāryaṃ katham atadākārajñānahetavaḥ ? tathā cet; kathamālambanakāraṇam ? anyathā nīlajñānasya pītaṃ syāt
atha na tena tadālambanakāraṇam; anyadeva tadvaktavyam, tasyāpyaṇurūpatve anyadvācyamityanavasthā
nīlatāmātreṇa svākārajñānahetava ityadoṣaścet; kathañcit pratyakṣateti ātmano'pi svāpe'pratyakṣasyāpi prabodhe pratyakṣateti sarvaṃ sustham
aparaḥ prāha--svāpe'pi pratyakṣaṃ cittamiti cet; so'pyanena nirastaḥ; tatparimaṇḍalapratyakṣatvaprasaṅgāt
vijñānavādino na yaṃ doṣa iti cet; na; tasyāpi sthiraikātmasthūlajñānasambhave yathāpratibhāsaṃ tattvasiddhiḥ
kathaṃ tarhi tatra pratibhāsate ? ityāha— parisphuṭamityādi
tasya yathoktākārapratibhāsasya atikrame dṛśye ghaṭādiḥ, adṛśya īśvarādiḥ tayoḥ vyavasthāyāḥ anupapatteḥ

nanu dṛśyavyavasthānupapattiriti vaktavyam tato'nyasya adṛśyasyā'bhāvāt, na punaḥ adṛśyavyavasthānupapattiḥ iti tato'nyasya sarvasyāsya dṛśyavyavasthānupapattiḥ anyasya tatparimaṇḍalasya pratibhāsopagame tadvadākāśakuśeśayāderapi tadupagamāpatteḥ adṛśyavyavasthānupapattiriti
mābhūt dṛśyā'dṛśyavyavasthā, sakalaśūnyatopagamāditi cet; atrāha--sudūramapi ityādi
sudūraṃ sakalaśūnyatvam aśeṣasaugatamatānte vyavasthānāt, tadapi gaṃdhāma kevalamadūraṃ sautrāntikādimatiṃ kim śūnyatādikaṃ kena pratyakṣādinā pramīyeta ? na kenacit
yadi vā, itarasya vā bāhyasya ca
nanu cittasya yathāsthitāśeṣārthagrahaṇasvabhāvatvāt kathamadṛśyātmanā anyasambandha tadekatve anyataradeva
tathāpi svarūpanānātve anyatyatrā'kiñcitkaramiti tadavasthacittasya svaparayoḥ sarvātmanā grahaṇamiti cet; atrāha--

tadetaccittamanyathācetanaṃ karma vastu parasparamanyo'nyaṃ bandhaṃ saṃyogaviśeṣaṃ prati ekatve'pi lakṣaṇato lakṣaṇena nātva hemādiśyāmikādivat ajahadaparityajat tathā tena dṛśyādṛśyātmaikarūpapareṇa pariṇāmalakṣaṇāmeva nānyathā jātim ātmalābham anuruṇaddhi svīkaroti

tadbuddhau cittetaragrāhikāyāṃ buddhau apratibhāsanāt cittetaravastunaḥ kiṃ sa tasya ityāha--varṇaḥ nīlādiḥ ākṛtiḥ vartulatvādiḥ parimāṇam iyat tonyādibhūtāni yeṣāṃ anugatecetadharmāṇāṃ te tathoktāḥ taiḥ vikalātmanaḥ
nanu nārthaḥ śabdagocaraḥ api ta vyāpohatvābdavijñānasya asadekāntaviṣayatvamiti cet; atrāha--vyapohasya ityādi
vyapohanaṃ vyapohaḥ anabhimatavyāvṛttiḥ tasyā tadā tmakatve svalakṣaṇātmakatve aṅgīkriyamāṇe kiṃ kena pramīyeta iti sambandhaḥ
nanu śabdena liṅgena vā samārope vyavacchinne tena svalakṣaṇaṃ pramīyata iti cet; atrāha— samāropa ityādi
pratyakṣasya akṣavijñānasya atītaviṣayatvābhyupagamāt, upalakṣaṇametat tenāagataviṣayatvābhyupagamāditi ca gṛhyate, tato vyavahāre śabdavijñānasyāpi asadekāntaviṣayatvamiti bhāvaḥ
atiprāyoyathā arthavyāpāraḥ tathā ātmavyāpāro'pi, tadvikakalpasya śabdenānyathā tadatajjanyarūpatayā sa eko bhavet
atha svasaṃvedanarūpatā pūrvajñānāt; kuta etat ? yasmin sati bhāvāccet; śabde'pi sati samānam
nahi śabdavikalpāḥ tadabhāve svarūpaṃ labhante,atatkāryatāprasaṅgāt vikalpāḥ śabdayonayaḥ iti plavate
atha svasaṃvedanarūpatā śabdābhāve'pi pratyakṣe'stīti na tajjanyā; tarhi vikalparūpatāpi saṅketabhāvini śabde tadabhāva iti sāpi tajjanyā na bhavet
anyā sā iti cet; anyatrāpi samaḥ samādhiḥ
ubhayaṃ tata iti cet; ubhayamasatyaṃ na vā kiñcit
syānmatam--adhyakṣasya atītāt bhāvino vā utpatteḥ svarūpeṇa tādātmyāt tadviṣayatā, na śabdasya arthaviṣayatā viparyayāditi cet; etadevāha--kathamityādi
vibhramaikāntāt yathā vibhramo na sidhyati tathaiva sākalyena śabdānāmarthānabhidhānam arthāpratibandhāt
satyapi bahirarthe vikalpānāṃ vibhramaikānte tadvibhramaikāntāsiddheḥ nirvikalpasyaanirṇayātmakatvāttadvivakṣāviṣayaikānte kutaḥ satyamithyāvyavasthā yato jayaparājayavyavasthā kalpyate ?
ayamabhiprāyaḥ--yadi arthāpratibandhānnirviṣayā eva śabdāḥ tannirviṣayatāpratipādanāya na śabdaprayogaḥ śreyāniti
tathāhi--yathā yena prakāreṇa arthavibhramaikāntaḥ stambhādijñānamaśeṣaṃ bhrāntam ityekāntaḥ
yadi vā, arthe vibhramaikānto vikalpānāmabhipreto na sidhyet
atha sicat svayaṃ bauddhasya tathā tena prakāreṇa sarvaṃ niravaśeṣamuktaṃ vacanam, ucyate sma uktam iti vyutpatteḥ, mṛṣā mithyā ityapi sidhyet
atro'rtha sarvaśabdamithyātvaṃ parābhyupagataṃ gṛhyate tatrā'pratibandhatvāt tanmithyātvapratipādakaṃ śabdānāṃ tathā ca sarve mṛṣā śabdāḥ ityapi na bhāṣaṇīyam tadarthānabhidhānāt

syānmatam--vyavahārī na manyate sarvaśabdamṛṣātvam, ataḥ taimirikavadaparataimirikeṇa sa mithyāśabdena pratibodhyata iti; tadasāram; yataḥ ghaṭamānaya ityādau bhavatu kācid gatiḥ vastu vācāmagocara ityabhidhāne tu sākalyena yadyasau tathā pratipadyate, na tattvaṃ pratipāditaḥ syāt
nahi śabdāt sarvaśabdamithyātvaṃ pratipadyamānaḥ tatpratipadyate, na tattvaṃ pratipāditaḥ yāt
nahi śabdāt sarvaśabdamithyātvaṃ pratipadyamānaḥ tatpratipadyate nāma virodhāt
nahi śabdasya anyasya vā mṛṣātvaṃ jānanneva kaścit tadastadavaiti
yato'vaiti tattasya tannāvaiti iti cet; kuta etat ? tatastatparijñānāt; paṭādiśabdāt paṭādikamavaitīti tasyāpi tanna pratyetīti samānā
nahi vyavahārī sarvapratyayānāṃ mithyaikāntaṃ mithyāpratyayāt tathā'vagatādavagacchati
evamarthaṃca arthavibhramaikānto na sidhyet vibhramāt ityucyate, agatyā tata etatpratīyatām
atha arthaviṣayā na śabdāḥ tatrā'pratibandhāt hetvābhāsavata idamavagamyate ? tadapratibandho'pi kutaḥ ? pratyakṣāditi cet; na nna kta m, āstāṃ tāvadetaditi
tadabhāve'pi pravṛtteriti cet; uktamatrottaraṃ pūrvam--akṣajñānasyāpi tadabhāve pravṛtteḥ
kāryakāraṇatā teṣāṃ nārthān śabdāḥ spṛśantyapi--nyāyāvatā॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 44
ata eva ucyate--arthe vibhramaikānto vikalpānānna sidhyed vibhramāt iti
kiṃca, sarvaśabdamṛṣātvapratibaddhaḥ, anyathā vā tatpratipādakaḥ śabdo bhavet ? ādye vikalpe siddhaṃ naḥ samīhitam, tadvadanyasyāpi svārthapratibandhasaṃbhavāt
nahi jānanneva saugataḥ sādhyāpratibaddhaṃ vastu, tena vyavahāramuparacayati; prekṣākāritāhāneḥ

agatyā tenāpi racayati iti cet; kim idānīmadhyakṣasya anyasya vā tadutpādikalpanayā ? svayamapratibaddhād vyavahāraṃ kurvannanyasmai tata eva taṃ kurvāṇāya kupyatīti kathaṃ svasthaḥ ? tadvivakṣāyāṃ tatpratibandha iti cet; atrottaram--sadasadvastubhedena ityādi bhaviṣyati
kim ? ityāha--sarvajñānānāṃ vibhramaikānte bahirarthavat svarūpasyāpi pratikṣepaprasaṅgāt, svarūpavat arthasyāpi pratibhāsanāt
tataḥ kim ? ityāha--vibhramaikāntādyathā vibhramo na sidhyati tathaiva sākalyena śabdānām arthānabhidhānaṃ na sidhyati
yathā vā sautrāntikasya satyapi bahirarthe vikalpānāṃ vibhramaikānte tadvibhramaikāntāsiddhiḥ tacchabdena vikalpānāṃ parāmarśaḥ, tavaivetyādyatrāpi pūrvavat
nanu sarve śabdā nirviṣayāḥ ityasyāṃ vivakṣāyāṃ pratibandho'sti madīyasya śabdasya, tato'yamadoṣa iti cet; atrāha--tadvivaktetyādi

nirviṣayāḥ sarviṣayāḥ sarve śabdā iti vāñchā tadvivakṣā viṣayo yasya tasya bhāvaḥ tattā tadekānte kutaḥ satyamithyā sarve śabdā vahirahitā iti vacanaṃ satyam, tatsahitā iti ca mithyā tayoḥ vyavasthā kutaḥ yato jayaparājayavyavasthā kalpate ? vivakṣāvyabhicāraḥ; ubhayatrāpi
syānmatam--madīyā vivakṣā paramparayā arthapratibaddhā netarā, tataḥ tadvyavasthā iti; tadapi madīyamatānukūlam; bahirarthe'pi tathā pratibandhasadbhāvāt
śabdārthavivakṣāmanādṛtya sarvo'rthakriyārthī tatsamarthameva śabdārthaṃ parīkṣeta tatraiva...
tataḥ vyavahāraṃ śāstraṃ ca kurvāṇaḥ tadarthapratipādanāyaiva kartumarhati nānyathā
na cāyamekāntaḥ sarvatra arthapratibandhādeva buddhīnāṃ prāmāṇyam
kvacit rūpamātrapratibhāsanāt varṇarasādipratibandhāviśeṣe'pi...tajjanmasārūpyayoravastutvāt sarvathā tadanupapatteḥ sa eva pratibandho'stu anyatra vikalpaghaṭanāt
yadyayaṃ nirbandhaḥ nākāraṇaṃ viṣayaḥ pratyayasyeti; kathamanumānajñānaṃ kvacit pramāṇam ? kathaṃ ca na ? saṃviditapratibandhaviśeṣasya pratyakṣasiddhatvāt
tadanyatra pratibandhāsiddheḥ kathaṃ pramāṇam ? sāmānyena; kiṃ punaranyāpohaḥ ? tadanumānakalpanāyāmanavasthānāt
sādṛśyalakṣaṇajātimantareṇa kathaṃ pāvakādikamanyavyāvṛttamekatvena pratīyāt ? vivakṣitajñānapadārthasya anyavyāvṛtteḥ sarvatrāviśeṣāt
tad vastu cintyate parīkṣyate yatra vastuni prativai āyattaḥ phalodayaḥ phalātmalābhaḥ śabdāviṣayatveni tyadhyāhāraḥ
kathaṃ cintyate ? ityāha— saccā'sacca sadasat bhāvā'bhāvāvityarthaḥ, sacca tadvastubhedaśca saḥ tena
kasya śabdasya bahirartho'sti, kasya nāsti ityanena rūpeṇa vivakṣā kasmānna cintyate ? ityāha--vivakṣāyāmanādarāt
nahi tasyāṃ jalāharaṇādiphalaṃ pratibaddham, anyathā na bahiḥ kaścit pravartteta
vivakṣā cecchabdārthaḥ; tatraiva pravṛttiḥ syāt na vahirarthe
na hi śabdādanyapratipattau anyatra pravṛttiḥ, itarathā gośabdād aśve pravṛttiḥ
atha vivakṣā arthapratibaddhā, tataḥ tatpratipattyā tatra pravṛttiḥ; nanvevaṃ mīmāṃsakasya prati parasāmānyasya viśeṣe vṛttiraviruddhā syāt
syādetat, vivakṣitasyārthasya svalakṣaṇe samāropād bhrāntyā tatra vṛttiriti; tanna sāram; yataḥ sarvasya sarvatrāropāt pravṛttiprasaṅgāt
atha matam--govivakṣārūḍhasya svadāvevāropaḥ sādṛśyāt, nānyatra viparyayāt; siddhaṃ tarhi vivakṣāvikalpasya bahirarthagocaratvam

nanu niyatavṛttayo bhrāntayaḥ tataḥ kācit kvaciditi na sarvatra pravṛttiriti cet; kuta etat ? ya eva hi pāramparyeṇa tadvikalpavāsanāprabodhakāḥ tatraiva tadvikalpasya darśanāt, kathamevamānavantā rthapratibaddhajanmāno vikalpāḥ, yatastadyonayaḥ śabdāḥ tathā na syuḥ ? bhavantu tatparivadvā nanu tadviṣayā iti cet; pratyakṣasya tadviṣayatā na bhavet
sārūpyāditi cet; kutaḥ tasya tat ? tasmādutpatteriti cet; avikalpādutpattirvikalpasyāpi syādityuktam
kiṃtvapāramparyeṇa svalakṣaṇādutpatteḥ tadavyavasāyī ced vikalpaḥ; cakṣurādyavyavasāyī syāt
ayogyatvānneti cet; svalakṣaṇe yogyatvaṃ kutaḥ ? tadanubhavādutpatteḥ; tasyānubhava iti kutaḥ ? tatautpatteścet; cakṣurādeḥ syāt
tataḥ sthitam--śabdādvivakṣāpratītau arthe pravṛttirna syāt iti
śabdasya arthaḥ sa vidyamāno'sattvādavidyamāno vā iti tadvivakṣām arthavāñchām anāvṛtyasarvaḥ
kaḥ ? arthakriyārthī jalādyāharaṇārthī tatsamarthameva arthakriyāyogyameva śabdārthaṃ parīkṣeta

yata evaṃ tata evaṃ tataḥ vyavahāraṃ śāstraṃ ca kurvāṇaḥ sugato'nyo vā tadanāyaiva arthakriyāsamarthapratipādanāyaiva karttumarhati nānyathā nānyena vivakṣāpratipādanaprakāreṇa, tatpratipādane'pi prayojanābhāvāditi
kathaṃ punaḥ arthā'pratibaddhajanmanaḥ śabdād arthapratipattiḥ iti ? atraiva punarapi dūṣaṇamāha--navaityādi na ca naivāyamekāntaḥ
ko'sau ? ityāha--sarvatra meyabuddhīnāṃ prāmāṇyam arthapratibandhādeva iti
kvacit cakṣurvijñāne rūpamātrapratibhāsanāt, mātraśabdena rūpaviśeṣasya kṣaṇanāśāderapratibhāsanāt, varṇarasādipratibandhāviśeṣepyā ...
...sattvaviśeṣāt nāpi vyatirikānuvidhānena; saṃśayādijñānasya arthābhāve'pi bhāvāt, api cakṣurādiṣu samartheṣu satsvapi arthābhāve jñānābhāvaḥ
tadanuvidhānaṃ tacca na tenaiva jñānena pratīyate; tadā tadabhāvāt, anyathā tadvirodhaḥ
anyena pratīyata iti cet; ubhayadaśāvalambinā tena bhavitavyam, itarathā tena tadgrahaṇāyogāt
tataḥ sthitam--tajjano vastutvāt sarvathā tadanupapatteḥ sa eva pratibandho'stu
tathā sārūpyasya sarveṇa sarvātmanāna kathañcit prakāreṇa anupapatteḥ jñānajaḍatvānekāntaprasaṅgāt, sa eva astu iti
yadi vā, sarveṇa pratyakṣānumānaprakāreṇa tadanupapatteḥ iti grāhyam
tathāhi--jñānārthayoḥ dvayorapi darśane idamanena samānamiti bhavati niścayo yamalakavat
so'pi na yuktaḥ, yataḥ pūrva dvayoḥdarśane, punaranyataradarśanāt tatsadṛśānyadarśanādhyāropasya tattvāt caitramaitradarśanādhyāropavat
dvayordarśane vā tadākāreṇa cetasā; tadavastho doṣo'navasthā
bhrāntyā tadākāreṇa vedane siddhaṃ naḥ samīhitam
atra ādarśapratau 486 kha tame pṛṣṭhe paṅktidvayaṃ riktamalikhitam, 487 ka tamaḥ pṛṣṭhaśca saṃpūrṇo rikta; 487 kha pṛṣṭhe ca paṅktirekā riktā vartate
vetti tasmānna sārūpyaṃ siddhaṃ jñānārthayoḥ kvacit
iti loke yato dṛṣṭo vyavahāro hyavigānataḥ

sārūpyasya sarvathānupapatteḥ sa eva pratibandho'stu kiṃ sarvathā tajjanmasārūpyayoravastutvam ? na; ityāha--anyatra vikalpaghaṭanāt vikalpeghaṭanāt anyasmin paramārthapakṣovastutvaṃ tadghaṭanāttu vastutvameva ityarthaḥ
5 ityabhidhānāt saugatenana saṃvṛtyā tayā ta eva doṣāya iti cet; na; anyathābhiprāyāt
tathāhi--tajjanmasārūpyavat vikalpaghaṭanāt nirākārameva jñāna bastu tathaiva loke vyavahārāditi
na pratyayasya jñānākāraṇam api tu kāraṇameva viṣayaḥ iti; katham na anumānajñānaṃ kvacit pāvakādau sādhye pramāṇam ? paraḥpṛcchati--kathaṃca na iti ? tasyottaramāha--saṃvidita ityādi
saṃviditaḥ pratyakṣeṇa pratipannaḥ pratibandhaviśeṣaḥ tadutpādilakṣaṇo yasya mahānasasambadhino'gnyādeḥ tasya pratyakṣasiddhatvāt, na tatra tat pramāṇamiti
tasmādanyatra pratyakṣādanyatra parokṣe pramāṇaṃ katham ? kutaḥ ? ityāha--pratibandhāsiddheḥ anyatra iti
syānmatam--dhūmasāmānyam agnisāmānyena vyāptamekadā pratipannaṃ sarvadā pratipannameva iti cet; tadāha--sāmānyena ityādi
anyasmād vijātīyādapohaḥ vyāvṛttiḥ, anyasya vā apohaḥ, anyo vā apohyate'smin vikalpākāre iti
tasya vyāpyavyāpakāpohasāmānyasya anumānakalpanāyāṃ satyām anavasthānāt kathamanumānajñānaṃ kvacit pramāṇamiti ? tathāhi--sāmānyam anumānāt pratīyate
tadapi liṅgādudayavat, tatrāpi sāmānyena pratibandhavedanam, tatrāpi tadeva vaktavyaṃ yāvanna kvacidavasthānamiti
syānmatam--pramāṇamantareṇa tatpratīyate iti; tatrāha--pramāṇamantareṇa na tasya apohasya pratipattiḥ tatpratipattiḥ
anyatrāpi pratyakṣānumeyābhimate'pi pramāṇakalpanā'narthakyāt prakṛtasāmānyavad anyasyāpi tadantareṇa pratīteḥ
yogipratyakṣaṃ tadastīti cet; uktamatra sarvasmāt svaviṣayāt tadanutpatteḥ ityatteḥ itarathā tata eva sādhyasiddheḥ kimanumānena ? tatrāpi sāmānyena pratibandhagrahaṇe savikalpaṃ tat iti
sadṛśapariṇāmalakṣaṇaṃjātiṃ sāmānyamantareṇa katham anyavyāvṛttam anyasmāt vijātīyādapasṛtaṃ pāvakādikam ekatvena abhedena pratīyāt ? na kathañcit
svayaṃ hi sādṛśyād vyāvarttate nānye sadṛśapariṇāmalakṣaṇajātisadbhāve ca kimanyāpohasāmānyena iti bhāvaḥ
kutaḥ na kathañcit pratīyāt ? ityāha--vivakṣita ityādi
vivakṣitaṃ jñānam aśeṣaṃ sa eva padārthaḥ padābhidheyaḥ tasya anyasmādajñānāt paṭāt vyāvṛttiḥ tasyāḥ sarvatra ghaṭādāvaviśeṣāt
tathā ca ajñānāt paṭād vyāvarttamānaṃ yathā jñānaṃ jñānapadābhidheyaṃ tathā ghaṭādikamapi syāt
atha svayaṃ jñānameva tato vyāvarttamānaṃ tadvyapadeśabhāgucyate; tarhi sādhvetat--sadṛśa ityādi
nanu na paramārthataḥ sādṛśyamapyevaṃ sāmānyamasti, kevalamekapratyavamarśajñānahetutvāt dhiyāmabhedaḥ, tadabhedād vyaktīnāmabheda iti
keṣām ? arthānāṃ pāvakādīnām pratyabhijñābalāt pratipattā saugato'nyo vā arthān vibhajate vibhāgena vyavasthāpayati
kiṃbhūtān ? tadataddhetūn taddhetūn udakādyāharaṇahetūn ghaṭān ataddhetūn paṭādīn svayam ātmanā kila iti arucau, sādṛśyābhāve pratyabhijñānasyāpi durlabhatvāt
nahi lūnapunarjātakeśādāvapi tadasti, anyathā tṛṇadarśanādapi ta eva keśā iti syāt iti manyate
tataḥ kiṃ kasya kāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ vā yato'yaṃ vyavahāraḥ pravartate
na varṇādeḥ pratyakṣād vyavasthā; sadṛśātmanaḥ pratyakṣatvāt
na pratīteḥ prameyavyavasthā; evaṃ hi varṇādivyavasthāpi mā bhūt
viṣayo rūpādiḥ viṣayi tadvijñānam tayorvyavasthaivasarvatra bahirantaśca utsannaiva syāt kilaśabdaḥ anena vyākhyātaḥ
varṇaḥ śuklādiḥ rūpamādiryasya rasādeḥ tasya pratyabhijñānaṃ mānaso vikalpaviśeṣaḥ tasya kṛteḥ kāraṇāt varṇādisaṃvidaḥ rūpādisaṃvittayaḥ varṇādisaṃvidāṃhetuḥ varṇādiḥsyāt na tato varṇādiḥ syāt
atha matam--varṇādyabhāve kharaviṣāṇavat na tatsaṃvidaḥ, tadabhāve na tatpratyabhijñānamiti; samānametadanyatrāpi
varṇādipratyabhijñātādvarṇādisaṃvido vyavasthāpyante tatsaṃvidāṃ varṇādidhiyāṃ hetutvātmānānāṃ varṇādimattvaṃ na svabhāvataḥ sādṛśyavat iti nidarśanam
tataḥ tasmāt bhabhāvānāṃ tattvāvyavasthābhāvāt kiṃ cetanamacetanaṃ vā kasya tathāvidhasya kāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ vā na kiñcit kasyacit ityarthaḥ
tathāhi--samayarahitasya anyatra gatacittasya vā kvacit khaṇḍamuṇḍādidarśinaḥ ete samānāḥ iti pratītiḥ, asyā apalāpe sakalāpratītiviloparaḥ
paraḥ prāha--na pratīteḥ prameyavasthā itarathā marīcikāyāṃ jalavyavasthā tatpratīteḥ syāditi; so'nena nirastaḥ; evaṃ hi varṇādivyavasthāpi mā bhūt
śakyaṃ hi vaktuṃ na tatpratīteḥ tadvyavasthā marīcikājalavadite
bādhakābhāvaṃ naivaṃ cet; sādṛśyapratīteḥ kiṃ bādhakapratyakṣamiti cet; kiṃ punaḥ tad ātmānaṃ bādhate ? sādṛśyamātra iti cet; bhedamātra iti samānam

kiṃca, tadātmani bādhitetararūpadvayaṃ pratipadyamānameva anyatra sadṛśetarasvabhāvadvayaṃ na sahata iti mahatī prekṣākāritā ! kiṃca tena tatra bādhanam ? agrahaṇamiti cet; tadasiddhaṃ varṇādimātre'pi prasaṅgāt
atasmistaṃdgrahajñāpanamanena cintirva varṇādivad anyatrāpi na tathāpratītiḥ
vyaktivyatirekeṇa tadadarśanaṃ bādhakamiti cet; kiṃ punaḥ varṇādeḥ tadvyatirekeṇa darśanamasti ? sa eva vyaktiriti cet; sādṛśyamapyastu
