nahi naiyāyikeneva jainena tada bhinnaṃ sāmānyamiṣyate
vyaktaya eva syuḥ iti cet; bhavantu kā no hāniḥ ? kevalaṃ parasparaṃ sadṛśātmāna iti
niraṃśaparamāṇudarśanāt na tāsāṃ sadṛśetararūpatāṃ yuktā iti cet; atrāha--tadeko hi ityādi
kathaṃ kim ? ityāha--parisphuṭaṃ yathā bhavati tathā avabhāsate iti
asyānabhyupagame dūṣaṇamāha--tadapratyakṣatve tasya ākārasyā'pratyakṣatve tako na kaścit pratyakṣārthaḥ
evaṃ manyate--yadi ayamākāraḥ bahuṣu paramārthasan khaṇḍādiṣu sadṛśapariṇāmo'pi syāditi

pra jñā ka ra gu ptastvāha--na tadākāradarśanād bahiḥ tathā vastusiddhiḥ dūraviralakeśādau tadākārapratibhāsena vyabhicārāt iti; sa praṣṭavyo bhavati--kiṃ bahirarthamāśritya evamucyate, uta jñānamātram, vibhramamātram, śūnyatāmātraṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe bahirvarṇādivyavasthāpi mā bhūt śukle śaṅkhe pītapratibhāsanena vyabhicārāt
na subarṇādau pītabhāsāva' tatpratibhāsāt; madhure kṣīre pittajvariṇaḥ kaṭukapratibhāsena anekāntāt
evaṃ sarvatra yojyamiti sādhvī sārūpyavyavasthā ! bādhakābhāvo'nyatrāpi
dvitīyavikalpe bahiriva jñāne'pi sa katham ākāra iti cintyam ? nāstīti cet; kiṃ punaḥ nīlāderanyadvijñānam ? tathā cet; nīlādiḥ kim ? na kiñciditi cet; vijñānamapi tathāstu
bhrānta iti cet; tena tarhi vyabhicārāt na pratibhāsāt kasyacit svasaṃvedanasiddhiḥ
nīlādireva jñānamiti cet; kathaṃ tatra tadākāraḥ pāramārthikaḥ ? anyathā arthe'pi syāt
atha dūraviralakeśeṣu vyabhicārāt na tatra sa tathā; tata eva jñāne'pi na syāt

atha jñānapakṣe tatkeśānāmabhāvāt na tairvyabhicāracodanā; parapakṣe tairasadbhiḥ sā kathaṃ kriyate ? parābhyupagamāditi cet; bhavadabhyupagamād vijñānavad arthe'pi sa ākāraḥ pareṇa kinna sādhyate ? sandehaḥ syāditi cet; tathahi--kiṃ jñānavadarthe'pi sa san uta tatkeśavadasan iti ? tadetadasat; yataḥ jñāne'pi sandehānivṛtteḥ
tadyathā stambhādyarthavat jñāne san ayamākāraḥ ahosvinnakhakeśādivadasanniti

bhavedayam arthavādinaḥ sandeho vyabhicāraviṣayatenāṅgīkaraṇe dhūmamaviparyayāditi cet; na; sārametat; yataḥ yathaiva parābhyupagatavyabhicāraviṣayamādāya parasya sandeha utpadyate, tathā ātmanyapi utpādanīyaḥ, evaṃ hi madhyasthātā syāt

paro vā yadā evaṃ vadati--bahiriva jñāne'pi tata eva vyabhicārāt nāyamākāraḥ satyaḥ; tadā kiṃ tvayā vaktavyaḥ--tadabhyupagamādeva sa vyabhicāraḥ sa cābhyupagamo na pramāṇam iti cet; na; apramāṇāt saṃsitpratyādanāyogāt
athaṃ paro yathākathaṃcidvaktavya iti, tata eva saṃśayagarttapātī kriyate; tarhi bauddho'pi pareṇa yathā kathaṃcidvaktavya iti vyabhicāraviṣayamanādṛtya vijñānavadarthe'pi tadākārasatyatā sādhyate
abhyupagataparityāgo doṣa iti cet; na; yatparityāge'pi bahutaraṃ siddhyati svapakṣe parapakṣakṣayakārī tatparityāge'pyadoṣāt
grāmaṃ janapadasyārthe ātmārthe pṛthivīṃ tyajet || taditi
atha jñāne'pi na sa paramārthataḥ; tarhi tena vyabhicārāt varṇādirapi tatra tathāstu
idānīṃ tṛtīyo vicāryate--yena vibhramovigamyate tatpratibhāsasya vibhrameṇa vyabhicārānna satyatā
mā bhūt iti cet; uktamatra— vibhramāsiddheriti
caturthaḥ pañcatāṃ nītaḥ pakṣaḥ pūrvaṃ yathāvidhi
nanu yayā pratyāsattyā kiṃcit sādṛśyaṃ kecana bhāvāḥ svīkurvanti tayā svayamatadātmakāḥ tathāvabhāsiṣyanta iti cet; atrāha--svīkurvanti ityādi
svīkurvanti guṇānarthā yayā śaktyā'guṇā na kim

yathā tatsāmānyamekaṃ vyaktaya upakurvanti na punarekabuddhimiti na yujyeta tathaikaṃ ghaṭāditattvamātmani sparśādīn bibharti na punaḥ sparśādyākāraṃpratyayāneva karotīti na ghaṭāṃ prāñcati, tato nirākāro'rthaḥ syāt

svīkurvanti guṇān rūpādijñānādīn arthāḥ ghaṭādayaḥ yayā śaktyā aguṇā guṇarahitāḥ na kiṃ tayā śaktyā tatsaṃvido guṇasaṃvidaḥ kuryuḥ bhinnaḥ parasparavilakṣaṇāḥ arthāścet yadai kasaṃvidaḥ ekā saṃvid yeṣāmiti
tatsāmānyaṃ sādṛśyasāmānyam ekaṃ sakalabāhuleyādivyaktisādhāraṇamupakurvanti ātmani dhārayanti vyañjayanti vā

na punareṣāṃbuddhiṃ gaurgauḥ iti pratyayaṃ kurvanti vyaktaya ityevaṃ yathā yena tadbuddhikaraṇaprakāreṇa na yujyeta kintu tadekabuddhimeva kurvantītiyujyetatatraiva sāmarthyadarśanāt, tathā ekamakhaṇḍaṃ ghaṭāditattvam ātmani svasvarūpe sparśādīn guṇān bibhartti na punaḥ sparśādyākārapratyayāneva karoti ityevaṃ na ghaṭāṃ prāñcati api tu atadguṇamapi tatpratyayān karotīti ghaṭāṃ prāñcati
evaṃ hi nirākāramarthaṃ pratipādyāvu tāntaḥ pratipādayannāha— jīva ityādi
yayā...tato bhedaikānte kva darśanapratyabhijñānādayaḥ kathañcid vyavahārapadavīmavatareyuḥ ?
jīvaḥ ātmā sukhādiparyāyān eti gacchati śaktyā yogyatayā yayā tayā śaktyā śaktama vā niva lakṣyeta anubhavottaravikalpabuddhyā vyavasīyeta nānubhavena gṛhyata
citramevakādau grāhyādau vā vuddhiḥ svayamacitrāpi yathā citrāpi yathā citrāneva lakṣyate
tataḥ kiṃ jātam ? ityāha--tataḥ tasmāt nyāyāt kva bahirantarvā na kvacid darśanapratyabhijñānādayaḥ kathañcid vyavahārapadavameva tareyuḥ kvabheyuḥ
bhedaikānte ekapratyavamarśamabhyupagamya dūṣaṇamuktam, idānīṃ ya eva nāstīti darśayannāha--arthā ityādi
nahi pratyabhijñānaṃ svayamaviṣayīkṛtān pratyavamṛśati, prameyādhikyācca pramāṇāntaratvaprasaṅgāt
tataḥ tadahetutvāt tatpratibandhasya teṣāṃ liṅgaliṅgibhūtārthānām avinābhāvaḥ syāt na laiṅgikamanumānaṃ syāt

nahi ityādinā kārikārthamāha--na khalu svayaṃ pratyabhijñātrā aviṣayīkṛtā nanubhūtā narthātu pratyabhi pratyabhijñānaṃ pratyavamṛśati tathāvidhe viṣaye tadudayābhāvāt, anyathā sarvatra tadudayaḥ syāditi manyate
pratyakṣānumānābhyām avikalpaliṅgajābhyām anyat pramāṇaṃ tadantaraṃ tadbhāvaḥ tattvaṃ tasya prasaṅgāt pratyabhijñānasya iti
labdhaṃ phalaṃ darśayannāha--tataḥ svayamaviṣayīkṛtasya pratyabhijñānenā'parāmarśāt tatra niraṃśe tattve pratibandhāsiddhau liṅgasyāvinābhāvā'niścaye kuto liṅgādanumānam ? na kutaścit
bhavatu vā sannihite pratyakṣataḥ viṣayīkṛte pratyabhijñānena pratyavamarśaḥ, tathāpi sākalyena tadabhāvānnānumānamiti darśayannāha--sākalyena ityādi
tulanā--anye tu vyāptigrahaṇakāle pratipatturyogina ivāśeṣaviṣayaṃ parijñānamastīti bruvate
anyathā hi sarvo dhūmo'gniṃ vinā na bhavatīti vyāptismaraṇaṃ na syāt
dhūmamagnisahacaritamindriyeṇopalabhya anagneśca jalādervyāvartamānamanupalammena jñātvā manasā niścinoti dhūmo'gniṃ na vyabhicaratīti
yāvān...ityavicāritena nāmātmanā pratibandhaṃ vyavasthāpayatīti suvyavasthitaḥ pratibandhaḥ ! tadanumānakalpanāyām anavasthākṣaṇikatvenavyāptyasiddhau vyāpakānupalaśbhaśca na sidhyati
nanu vicāritametat--bhūtā bhavyā bhavanto vā sarve bhāvāḥ siddhivi॰ 3
8 ityādinā tatkimarthaṃ punarucyate iti cet ? tatra sākṣādanumānanirūpeṇa taduktam, atra tu śabdasya pratibandhābhāve agamakatve liṅgasyāpi tat syāditi pradarśanārtham ityadoṣaḥ
kvacid bahirantarvā kāryasvabhāvai vā pratyakṣān kutaścanāpi vyāptirna sidhyati na tadviṣayatāṃ gacchati

anumānāt sidhyatīti cet; atrāha--anumānevaṃ gīkriyamāṇe anavasthitiḥ sattvasya vyāpakam arthakriyākāritvaṃ tasya nitye'nupalambhaḥ sattvasya kṣaṇikatvena vyāptiṃ sādhayatīti cet; atrāha--vyāpakānupalambhaśca na sidhyati sattvavyāpakasya arthakriyākāritvasya anupalambho'pi akṣaṇike sākalyena na sidhyati
nahi arthakriyāvikalamakṣaṇikaṃ sarvaṃ draṣṭuṃ śakyaṃ yena tatra tadabhāve sattvābhāvaḥ syāt vṛkṣābhāve śiṃśapābhāvavat

athā kṣaṇikatvābhāvāt tatra arthakriyākāritvānupalambhaḥ; kutaḥ ? tadabhāve'darśanāditi cet; mīmāṃsakasyāpi darśananivṛttiḥ sarvajñasattāṃ nivartayet iti sādhūktam--sugato na sarvajñaḥ vaktṛtvādibhyo rathyāpuruṣavaditi
atha akṣaṇike sarvādarśanaṃ na sarvajñaḥ , tatra svayaṃ sarvajñāntareṇa darśanasaṃbhavāt
prakṛte sarvādarśanaṃ kutaḥ siddham ? taddṛṣṭaḥ kasyacijjagati bhavato'darśanāt
mīmāṃsakenāpi sarvadṛṣṭhaḥ tatra kasyacidadarśanāt iti samānam
parārthaṃ taditi cet; parasyāpi icchāmātreṇa aśeṣajñatvāt
nanu yadi kaścidakṣaṇikadarśī syāt, sa yadi indriyajñānena; tanna śakyam; tasya varttamānamātraviṣayatvāt
na ca pramāṇāntarāditi cet; kathamidavagatam--sarvamakṣajñānaṃ vartamānaviṣayameva ?
syānmatam--akhilamindriyajñānaṃ varttamānaviṣayaṃ tattvāt asmadādita nahi sugato na sarvajño vītarāgo vā puruṣatvādibhyo rathyāpuruṣavat ityapi syāt
atha puruṣatvādyaviśeṣe'pi kaścit sarvajñaḥ kalpyate; indriyajñānamapi yadi kiñcideva trikālānuyāyinamekamarthaṃ paśyet ko virodhaḥ, yato'kṣaṇike sarvādarśanaṃ sidhyet ? tanna adarśanāt kṣaṇikābhāvaḥ

yadi matam--kṣaṇikatvena arthakriyā vyāptā, tacca virodhādakṣaṇikād vyāvarttamānaṃ tāmānaṃ tāmādāya vyāvarttate, sā ca ta ttvamiti; tatrāha--vyāptyasiddhau na sidhyati kṣaṇikatvena arthakriyāyāḥ yā vyāptiḥ tasyāḥ asiddhau uktanītyā na sidhyati
atrāha paraḥ--pratyakṣāt na paramārthataḥ kasyacit kenacit saugatena vyāptisiddhirisvate, api tusaṃvṛteḥ, saṃvṛtiśca vicārānupapattiḥ iti; tatrāha--avicārita ityādi
avicāritena vicārā'sahiṣṇunā ātmanā svabhāvena saṃvṛtikalpitena ityarthaḥ, nātmetyaruccau pratibandhaṃ liṅgaliṅginoravinābhāvaṃ vyavasthāpayati saugata iti evaṃ suvvavasthitaḥ pratibandha ityupahāsaḥ
tataḥ sthitam--sākalyena pratibandhasiddhimantareṇa yadi liṅgaṃ namakaṃ śabdo'pi syāditi
tādātmyatadutpattisambandhe'pi samanantarapratyayasya aviṣayīkaraṇāt kāraṇa...yatra yadeva yadarthaniyataṃtadeva tamarthaṃ viṣayīkarotīti yuktaḥ pratibandhaḥ
nanu cāyamarthaḥ na cāyamekāntaḥ sarvatra arthapratibandhādeva buddhīnāṃ prāmāṇyam ityanena uktaḥ, kiṃ punarucyate ? tadupasaṃhārārtham ityeke

samanantaramiti na upādānajñānamucyate uktatvāt, api tu samaṃ nīlākārajñānasadṛśaṃ nīlam anantaraṃ sannihitaṃ pūrva kiṃbhūtam ? ityāha--svarūpārpaṇakāraṇam svarūpārpaṇena kāraṇaṃ samānantaramakāraṇamapi tyasyopādānam
tatkim ? ityāha--ajñeyaṃ pratyakṣasyā'paricchedyam adṛśyaṃ varttamānaṃ ca jñeyam ityarthaḥ
tathāhi— ahamahamikayā svasaṃvedane jñānamaghaṭākāramapi ghaṭagrāhakaṃ pratīyate
tato yaduktam--na nīlādimukhyādivyatirekeṇa tad grāhakaṃ pratīyate iti; tat pratyakṣapratītibādhitamiti
tatkiṃ kuryāt ? ityāha--pratibandhāntaraṃ sāmarthyalakṣaṇaṃ dhiyāṃ śaṃset arthamarthaṃ pratipratyarthaṃ tatra niyataṃpratyarthaniyataṃ
yathaiva hi visadṛśādapi gomayādereva sāṃlūkādyeva jāyamānaṃ tasyaiva ātmani sāmarthyaṃ sūcayati na sarvasya

nahi evaṃ tatra vaktuṃ śakyam— sarvaṃ vijātīyaṃ tatkāraṇamatu na vā kiñcit iti, pratītibādhanāt, tathā visadṛśāt samānakālāt niyatādeva jñānāt niyato ghaṭādiḥ pratīyamānaḥ tasyaiva ātmagrahaṇe śaktiṃ saṃśati
yato yaduktam--niyatakāryadarśanāt yogyatānumīyate kāraṇasya, na yogyatāyāḥ tatkāryam atīndriyattvāttasyāḥ
yathā ca na sukhādivyatirekeṇāparaṃ vijñānaṃ tathā nīlādivyatirekeṇāpi
etena idamapi cintitam--saṃvinmātrasya sarvatrāviśeṣāt sarvasya sarvadarśitvam iti; niyatārthadarśanapratītyā bādhanāt
etena anubhayadharmatā cintitā iti cet; ucyate--kāryakaraṇaṃ nīlādikāryadharmaścet; sarvo'pi kasyacit kāryasya hetuḥ
yathaiva hi tasya nīlatvaṃ naikaṃ pratyeva api tu sarvaṃ prati, tathā janyatvamapi yena yanyate taṃ pratyeva tat; taditaratra samānam
etena ubhayadharmatānirastā; anubhayadharmatā tanmata vyākhyāta kāriṇī
atha kvacidapi hetuphalabhāvo neṣyate; kimiṣyate ? svasaṃvedanamātramiti cet; etadapi tādṛgeva
tathāhi— nīlajñānalatvaṃ yathā sarvāṇi jñānānyuddiśya tavāsya saṃvedanamapi iti sapīti sarvaiḥ tatsaṃviditaṃ bhavet; viśeṣakalpanamarthe'pi samānam
atha anyajñānaṃ neṣyate; kiṃ tarhi syāt ? ekavyaktipratibhāsādvaitam iti cet; atrāha--mitīva ghaṭāderapi pratibhāse tadayogāt

ghaṭajñānayoḥ sahapratibhāse svarūpasaṃvedanamātraniyatatā iti cet; pararūpasaṃvedananiyatatā kuto na bhavati, kalpanāyāḥ niraṃkuśatvāt ? yadi ca sahapratibhāsādekarūpatā; tathā pratibhāsamānayoḥ nimbāmrayoḥ kaṭukatā madhuratā vā syāt
atha na sahapratibhāsāt samānatā kintu tathā pratibhāsāt; na tarhi ghaṭajñānayoḥ saṃvedanaikarūpatā, grāhyagrāhakatayāvabhāsanāt ityalamatiprasaṅgena
mitiḥ saṃvedanam sā iva saṃvedanavat ityarthaḥ

-- tādātmyaṃ ca tadutpattiśca te tādātmyatadutpattī, te eva sambandhaḥ tasminnaṅgīkriyamāṇe'pi samasya sadṛśasya anantarasya avyavahitasya pratyayasya kāraṇasya aviṣayīkaraṇād asadṛśasya varttamānasya viṣayīkaraṇāt ityarthaḥ
yatra prameye yadeva matijñānam avagrahādisaṃvedanaṃ śrutajñānaṃ vā
tadeva jñānaṃ tamarthaṃ viṣayīkaroti iti yuktaḥ pratibandhaḥ
sa pratibandhaḥ śabdajñānajñeyayorapi śabdasya yajjñānaṃ yacca tasyajñeyaṃ prameyaṃ tayorapi pāramārthikaḥ
asya hetorasiddhatāṃ pādatrayeṇa udbhāvya caturthapādena pariharannāha--aphalatvāt ityādi
nahi śabdāḥ asaṅketitaṃ pratipādayanti saṅketaṃ ca kurvan pratipitsurvā tataḥ pratipattumicchan arthakriyāmeva samuddiśya kartuṃ pratipattuṃ vā'rhati
na ca svalakṣaṇameva saṅketitam vyavahārakālamanveti punaḥ asaṅketitaśabdārthapratipattyayogāt
na cāyaṃ svalakṣaṇe śakyaḥ kartum aviṣayīkṛtayoḥ viṣayīkṛtayośca bhinnendriyagrāhyayorasaṃbhavāt
sāmānye'pi sutarāṃ na saṅketaḥ tasya dṛṣṭāvapratibhāsanāt sato'pyarthakriyā'sāmarthyāt
tadviṣayaṃ śabdajñānaṃ vibhramavaśāt dṛśyavikalpyāvekīkṛtya puruṣaṃ vyavahāre niyuṅkte
asyāpi saṅketitātatkāryakāraṇavyapo haikarūpasya puruṣārthakriyākāriṇaḥ kathamabhāvaikāntatvam ? khapuṣpādeḥ...tatkṛtāmarthakriyāmupajīvati na punastadbhāvatattvamiti tathāgataprajño devānāṃ priyaḥ
itaśca na tatra te saṅketyeran; ityāha--aśakteśca iti
nāpi pratipannayoḥ indriyajñānena; tasya idamasya vācyamidaṃ vācakam iti parāmarśāyogāt
asaṅketitamarthaṃ śabdāḥ kathayanti iti cet; atrāha— asaṅketitaṃ vāhuḥ na, paropadeśavaiphalyāpatteḥ
ca śabdo bhinnaprakramaḥ svalakṣaṇe ityasyā'nantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ uktasamuccaye
tato'yamarthaḥ--na kevalaṃ svalakṣaṇe api tu sāmānye'pi śabdā na saṅketyeran
hetvantaramāha— aśakteriti tatra saṅketasya kartumaśakyatvāt apramāṇaviṣayatvāt
atha śabdāt sāmānyaṃ tato'pi viśeṣaḥ pratīyate iti matiḥ; tatrāha--asaṅketitaṃ vāhuḥ na
asyāyamarthaḥ--na vidyate saṅketitaṃ sāmānyaṃ yasmin svalakṣaṇe tadasaṅketitaṃ na ca vācaḥ kathayante
nahi yaddvāreṇa viśeṣe pravṛttiḥ tatra sāmānyamasti

nahi ityādinā kārikārthamāha--na hi śabdāḥ asaṅketitaṃ pratipādayanti saṅketitaṃ pratipādayanti iti cet; atrāha--saṅketaṃ ca kurvan saṅketakārī pratipitsurvā tataḥ saṅketaṃ pratipattumicchattāpratipādyaḥ arthakriyāmeva samuddiśya kartuṃ pratipattuṃ vā arhati, anyathā aprekṣākāritāpatteḥ
tatraiva saṅketa iti cet; atrāha--na ca ityādi
saṅketāt paścāt asaṅketitaśabdārthapratipattyayogāt anyathā gośabdād aśvapratītiḥ syāt
viṣayīkṛtayoḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--viṣayīkṛtayośca viṣayīkṛtayorapi asaṃbhavāditi
nānyonyaviṣayīkaraṇe ca asyedam iti ghaṭanāyogāt santānāntaravat
kutastarhi saṅketaḥ ? ityāha— manovikalpamantareṇa ghaṭanāyogāt, asyedam iti sambandhasya karaṇāsaṃbhavāt, manovikalpādeva tadyogāt ityarthaḥ
tata eva bhavatu iti cet; atrāha--manovikalpe ca ityādi
na cāyaṃ saṅketaḥ svalakṣaṇe śakyaḥ kartumiti
dvitīyamarthaṃ kathayannāha--sāmānye'pi na kevalaṃ svalakṣaṇe vastuni sutarāṃ na saṅketaḥ
anena aśaktaṃ sato'pi vidyamānasyāpi tasya arthakriyā'sāmarthyāt sāmānye'pi na saṅketa iti
tatrāpi śabdāt kathaṃ svalakṣaṇe pravṛttiḥ iti cet; atrāha--tadviṣayam ityādi
tatpakṣī karoti ? ityāha--puruṣaṃ vyavahāreṣu niyuṅkte iti
na tat vivakṣitaṃ kāryakāraṇaṃ yeṣāṃ vijātīyābhimatānāṃ te atatkāryakāraṇāḥ tebhyaḥ teṣāṃ cā vyapohaḥ, saṅketitānām atatkāryakāraṇavyapohaḥ khaṇḍādīnāṃ sa ekaṃ rūpaṃ yasya tasya iti
tatkṛtāṃ vyapohakṛtām arthakriyāmupajīvati na punaḥ tadbhāvatattvaṃ tasya vyapohasyabhāvarūpamupajīvati
ko'sau ? ityāha--tathāgataprajñaḥ tathāgate sugate prajñā yasya sa tathoktaḥ devānāṃpriyaḥ
yadi vā, tathā tena prakāreṇa gatā dhvastā prajñā yasya iti grāhyam, ata eva devānāṃ priyaḥ
bhāvāstarhi kuto'sya bhāvatattvamupajīvati iti cet ? atrāha--saṃvida ityādi

saṃvido jñānasya nīlatayā arthena saha yaḥ na samāno yaśca jaḍetararūpatayā itaraḥ asamānaḥ pariṇāmaḥ tamantareṇa tathā pratyakṣādiprakāreṇa dṛśyaprāpyayorekatvādhyavasāyaprakāreṇa vā pravartamānāsaṃbhavāt vyavahāriṇaḥ ityadhyāhāraḥ
tathāhi--pūrvottarapāvakajñānayoḥ upādānopādeyabhūtayoḥ bhāsuratayā samāna upādānopādeyayogyatayā itaraḥ pariṇāmaḥ tayāpi samānaparaṇāmo vijñānavāde'pi na hetuphalabhāvaniyamaḥ
saṃvido bhavattatpariṇāmo nārthasya iti cet; atrāha--tatsaṃbhave samānapariṇāmasaṃbhave saṃvidaḥ ityanuvarttate bahirapi kinna syāt tatpariṇāmaḥ ?
jñānaṃ na jaḍam, arthastu jaḍa iti
yaduktaṃ pareṇa--na cāyaṃ saṅketaḥ svalakṣaṇe śakyaḥ kartum iti; tatra dūṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha--aśakyasamayamityāha
tadā svalakṣaṇe nāsti saṅketastena tatra na
yathā artharūpaṃ tathaiva draṣṭumaśakyaṃ kāraṇasyāpi dṛṣṭeraviṣayatvāt kālabhedāt tatsamānākāradarśanāt
na ceyaṃ dṛṣṭiḥ svakāraṇasyaiva rūpamanukaroti, kvacit svayamupādānarūpamanukarotyapi, svakāraṇopādānasya ca
kiṃbhūtam ? ananyabhāg asādhāraṇam aśakyadarśanaṃ rūpaṃ kṣaṇikaparamāṇulakṣaṇam tathā arthānāmananyabhāk iti vicāritamevat
kāraṇesya viṣayatā syāditi cet; atrāha--kāraṇasyāpi dṛṣṭeraviṣayatvāt
tenārthena samāno ya ākāraḥ jñānasya tasya darśanāt tadviṣayīkaraṇavyavasthāyām, tadityarthaḥ parāmṛśyate
sākalyena bahirantaśca tatsāmānyaṃ sadṛśapariṇāmasāmānya viṣayaḥ syāt dṛṣṭiḥ iti sambandhaḥ
anena kārikāyāḥ pāścātyo bhāgo vivṛto na pūrvaḥ sugamatvāt
yaccānyaduktam--manovikalpamantareṇa yojanāsaṃbhavāt majñovikale ca vastupratibhāsapratyastamayāt iti; tatrāha--na cāyam ityādi
ca śabdaḥ apiśabdārthaḥ bhinnaprakramaḥ dṛṣṭiḥ ityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ
tayo'yamarthaḥ--dṛṣṭirapi na kevalaṃ manovikalpaḥ iyaṃ pareṇa abhyupagamyamānā avikalpikā na svakāraṇasyaiva kāraṇaśabdāt sāmānyavācino'pi prakramād ālambanakāraṇasya parigrahaḥ

kvacit sitādiśaṅkhādau svayam ātmanā na pāramparyeṇa upādānasya samanantarakāraṇasya rūpamanukaroti api na kevalaṃ nānukaroti, tatra hi uttarottaraṃ pītajñānaṃ pūrvapūrvapītajñānasya ākāramanukaroti nārthasya tadākārābhāvāt

ayamabhiprāyaḥ--manovikalpasyakvacidarthābhāve'pi pravṛttidarśanāt tatra sarvatra yadi vastupratibhāsapratyastamayaḥ, dṛṣṭiripi kasyāścit arthākārānukaraṇābhāvāt sarvavastupratibhāsapratyastamaya iti tathā svakāraṇopādānasya ca rūpamanukaroti api
kvacid śīghrabhramadalābhādau dṛṣṭeḥ svakāraṇam anantarakṣaṇam anantare kṣaṇaḥ, tasya ca yat sākṣāt pāramparyeṇa upādānaṃ tayoḥ dvandvaikavadbhāvaḥ, tasya ca rūpamanukarotyapi
svakāraṇasyaiva rūpānukṛtau ekacakrākārā pratītirna syāt sarvadā prasaṅgāt
kathaṃ bhinnakālarūpānukṛtiriti cet ? kathaṃ bhinnadeśarūpānukṛtiḥ ? yato dūraviralakeśeṣu ghanaikapratītiḥ syāt
atha yāvato'lātakṣaṇāḥ tāvatya eva kramabhāvinyo dṛṣṭayaḥ kalpyante; santānāntaravat cakrabuddhirna syāt
mānasī sā iti cet; na; spaṣṭatvāt dvicandradarśanavat
syānmatam--bhāsuratāmātrānukṛtireva tatra, nāśeṣarūpānukṛtiḥ, na caika trāha--kathañcit ityādi
kathañcit bhāsvaratāmātreṇa na itarākāreṇa yatsādṛśyaṃ sārūpyaṃ tasya anyatrāpi pratyakṣābhimate'pi jñāne anivāraṇāt iti
nīlākāreṇaiva kāreṇaikatvādyākāre'pyanukaraṇam sarvathānukaraṇam tasya svakāraṇaṃ pratyasaṃbhavāt
nanu yata eva sākṣadyatejñānaṃ tasyaiva rūpamanukaroti nāparasya iti kadācit nirākṛto'pi paro vrūyāt; tatrāha--sākṣāt ityādi
avyavadhānena tasmāt svakāraṇopādā nāt utpatterabhāvāt atatpratibhāsitvaṃ tadupādānāpratibhāsitvamayuktam
nāpi tadākāraṃ jñānam; cirakālavyavahitādapi tadākārājjñānāt tatrārthapratibhāsapratīteḥ
tadeva tadupādānamiti cet; evaṃ kālavyavahito'rthopi tajjñānakāraṇam iti na svapnādijñānasya vāsanāmātrabhāvitvam
timirādijñānaṃ ca kathamevaṃvādino nirviṣayatā; tatrāpi vyavahitasyārthasya kāraṇatvopapatteḥ
avyavahitārthābhāvāt nirviṣayatve; anantaropādānābhāvād anupādānaṃ kinna syāt ?

syādetat--lākṣārasāvasekopakṛtakusumāhitaśaktikāt kārpāsasantānād antarālavijātīyanīlapatrādisaṃbhave'pi yathā phale raktatā, tathā nīlādijñānāhitaśaktikāt cittasantānat vijātīyā'ntarālavijñānabhāve'pi svapne nīlādijñānamiti; tatrāpi yadi sajātīyājñānāhitavāsanaṃ bhinnajātīyam upādānakāraṇam; na tarhi sākṣātkāraṇasyaiva ākāramanukaroti vyavahitasyāpyanukaraṇāt
tadatadgrahaṇalakṣaṇatvāt kathaṃ ca na doṣa eva tallakṣaṇavyabhicāre'pi iti citrametat
svapnādau bhrānteḥ kāraṇādadoṣaḥ arthapratibhāsābhāvaprasaṅgaḥ iti yo doṣaḥ tasyābhāvaḥ; sākṣādakāraṇasyāpi ākārānukaraṇāditi cet; atrottaramāha--katham ityādi
anyatrāpi jāgrajjñāne'pi saugatasya abhrāntiḥ katham ? kutaḥ ? ityāha--ātmāna ityādi
kasya ? saṃvitteḥ arthasya ghaṭādeḥ asataḥ pratipatteraviśeṣāt
yasmādevaṃ tat tasmāt atadgrahaṇalakṣaṇatvāt na tadtta sya grahaṇaṃ tadeva lakṣaṇaṃ yasya tasya bhāvāt tattvāt, anyasya kathaṃcana doṣa eva
kasmin sati ? āha--lakṣaṇāvyabhicāre'pi tadutpattisārūpye bahirarthadarśanalakṣaṇaṃ tadvyabhicāre'pi iti citrametat
anena sautrāntikasya sarvatra vibhrametararūpatāṃ darśane darśayati
yasmāt yat sākṣādupākṣāya te tasyeva dvūyamanukaroti ityatra punarapi dūṣaṇamāha--tadrapānukṛtau ityādi
tathā ca pratyakṣavat smṛtipratyabhijñānatarkāderatītārthānukaraṇāt vastuni saṅketo na punarvyāvṛttau nīrūpatvāt khapuṣpavat
arthakriyākaraṇācca tatraiva saṅketaḥ phalavān vyavahārakāle'pi tadbhāvānnānyatra
nahi tayorakāraṇaṃ viṣayaḥ, kāraṇaṃ vyavahārakāle na saṃbhavatyeva akṣaṇikatāpatteḥ
vikalpakalpitāt dṛśyaprāpyaikatvādavastunaḥ arthakriyāsiddhau svalakṣaṇadarśanaṃ kvopayujyeta ? tatkāraṇatve'pi...
tasya vivakṣitasya rūpaṃ tasyānukṛtau kriyamāṇāyāṃ hetuḥ kāraṇam tasmād vivakṣitāt sākṣād dhyanena janma yasya tasya bhāvaḥ tattā saiva na
nahi pituḥ sākṣādapatyaṃ bhavati śukrādestathā tato bhāvāt
yadi sākṣāt tajjanma nākārādhānakāraṇaṃ kiṃ tarhi syāt ? ityatrāha--tathā tena vyavahite'pi kārye tadākārasamarpaṇaprakāreṇa pariṇāma eva tadākārānukāritvalakṣaṇaṃ vivakṣitavastvākāritvajñāpakam
bhavatvevaṃ tathāpi prakṛtaṃ kiṃ siddham ? ityāha--tathā ca ityādi
tena hi takāraṇākārānukaraṇaprakāreṇa ca pratyakṣasya ca tadvat smṛtipratyabhijñānatarkāderatītārthānukaraṇāt kāraṇād vastunisaṅketo na punarvyāvṛttau
kutaḥ ? ityāha--nīrūpatvāt vyāvṛtteriti khapuṣpavat iti sūktam--tasya yapohavastuṣu bhāvāt tatkathaṃ nīrūpatvamiti cet ? atrāha— vastu ityādi
vastu ca tatpariṇāmaśca saḥ sādṛśyarūpaḥ tasyaiva vastuni khaṇḍādau bhāvāt na ekāntavādikalpitasyāpohādeḥ ityevakārārthaḥ
tatraiva sadṛśapariṇāma eva saṅketaḥ phalavān vyahārakāle'pi tasya bhāvāt nānyatra phalavān viparyayāditi bhāvaḥ
yaccānyaduktam— śabdāḥ saṅketitaṃ prāhuḥ vyavahārāya sa smṛtaḥ
tadā svalakṣaṇaṃ nāsti saṅktetastatra tena na
anyena vastuni saṅketābhāvaprakāreṇa anyathā pratyakṣānumānayorapi na kevalaṃ śabdasyaiva nirarthakatvaṃ niṣphalatvam
etadevāha--na hiryasmāt tayoḥ pratyakṣā numānayoḥ akāraṇaṃ viṣayaḥ kintu kāraṇameva, parāpekṣayā idamuktam
bhavatvevamiti cet; atrāha--kāraṇaṃ vyavahārakāle na saṃbhavatyeva akṣaṇikatāpatteḥ
na ca tatra yogināpi pravartituṃ śakyam
tathāpi pravṛttau na pramāṇāt pravṛttaḥ syāt
nahi yadaiva dhūmādagniḥ anumīyate, tadaiva prāpyate
apravṛttiḥ iti cet; tadakāraṇaṃ nāsti saṅketitavat
tatsadṛśe bhāvini pravṛttau tatrāpi pravṛttiryathā devadattasadṛśe yajñadatte iti; tarhi saṅketitasadṛśe pravṛttirastu
bhrāntirupacāro vā syāditi cet; pratyakṣādau tathaiva bhāvini

bhrāntyaiva tatpramāṇamiti cet; śabdo'pyastu, tathā ca kutaḥ pramāṇadvayam ? atha saṅketavyavahārakālārthayoḥ bhinnasantānatvāt na; ekāntena santānabhedābhāvāt; ekasminnapi devadattasantāne saṅketavyavahārayordarśanāt
śabdāḥ saṅketitaṃ prāhuḥ vyavahārāya sa smṛtaḥ
tadā svalakṣaṇaṃ nāsti saṅktetastatra tena na || pra॰ vā॰ 3 | 91 iti
kiṃca, prāpya-pratyakṣādikāraṇayoḥ ekasantānatāniścayaḥ kutaḥ ? sādṛśyāditi cet; na; vyabhicārāt yamalakena
pūrvasya ca rasatve cānyasya tatsadṛśasya kutaścit sannidhānāśaṅkāyāṃ duravabodhametat
nahi kāryameva anantaraṃ sadṛśaṃ vā; sarvasyāpi tathāvidhasya kāryatvaprasaṅgāt
tataḥ sūktam— kāraṇaṃ vyavahārakāle na saṃbhavatyeva iti
pratyakṣādinā yadeva dṛṣṭaṃ svakāraṇabhūtaṃ vastu yacca tena prāpyam pravṛttau satyām, tayorekasantānatāniścayaḥ vṛttaḥ ityabhiprāyaḥ
hetuphalabhāvaḥ ityadhikaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ sādṛśyāt iti hetau deyamiti bhāvaḥ
yadā sugataḥ itarajanajñānaṃ jānāti tadā sugatajñānena itarajanajñānasya viṣayatayā kāryakāraṇabhāvo'sti, sādṛśyamapi jñānarūpatayā vidyate eva, ataḥ tayorekasantānatvaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ
pūrvaṃ raso'pi san tasmājjāyamānaḥ kadācit anyaḥ syāt athavā santānāntaravartī sadṛśo rasaḥ syāditi śaṅkāna nivartate

bhāvi tayoḥ kāraṇam tanvakāla eva saṃbhavāpya paraḥ paraḥ; śabdasyāpi yadi vyavahārakālo'rthaḥ kāraṇaṃ ko doṣaḥ ? cirabhāvī kathaṃ kāraṇamiti cet; kathaṃ maraṇādiḥ tathāvidhaḥ ariṣṭādeḥ yena ataḥ tadanumānaṃ kāryaliṅgaja ? narakādideśavyavahitaṃ kathaṃ deśāntare śabdakāraṇamiti cet; uktamatra kathaṃ bhavato'pi svapnāntikaśarīraṃ deśāntare suptaśarīrāt ? suptādervā deśāntaranītasya pūrvacittāt prabodha iti
nanu yadyarthāt kutaścit śabdasya janma; tadābhāve sa na bhavet, bhavati ca anyathāpīti cet; ucyate--yadi prāpyātdṛśyasya jalābhāsasya janma, kathaṃ marīcikācakre ? nahi tatra snānādikaṃ prāpyamasti
bhrāntaḥ sa iti cet; anyatra samānam
arthabhāvābhāvayoḥ ekaḥ śabdaḥ; kuta etat ? pratijñānāt; ata eva prāpyārthakriyābhāvābhāvayoḥ jalapratibhāsa ekaḥ syāt
vyavahārī tathā na manyate ityubhayatra samānam
nanu dṛśyaprāpyayoreka vyavasāyatdṛśya vyavahārakāle'pyasti iti cet; atrāha--vikalpa ityādi

kiṃbhūtāt ? avastunaḥ arthakriyāsiddhau aṅgīkriyamāṇāyāṃ svalakṣaṇadarśanaṃ kva upayujyeta ? na kvacit, vikalpādeva sarvadā pravṛttisadbhāvāt so'yaṃ dṛśyaprāpyayorekatvāvyavasāyena pratyakṣabhāvini pramāṇamicchan abhyāse'vikalpakameva icchatīti kathaṃ svasthaḥ ?
kiṃca, dṛśye prāpyasya kutaścit sarvathā ārope, tāvanmātrameva iti kathaṃ tathāpi pravṛttiryato'sya vyavahāraḥ sughaṭaḥ syāt ? prāpye dṛśyasya prāpyavadasyāpi parokṣatā iti sa eva pravṛttyabhāvaḥ
na ceyaṃ dṛṣṭiḥ svakāraṇasyaiva rūpamanukaroti ityanutra
jñānaṃ nīlena sārūpyaṃ svasya rūpasya darśayet
varṇādyātmako'vabodho'yaṃ svārthena svasya atyantasārūpyaṃ svīkaroti na tatkāraṇādīnāmapi nīlāntarāṇāmiti kathaṃ sambhāvyam ? yataḥ ananyabhāgasādhāraṇo'rthātmā pratyakṣaviṣayaḥ syāt

nīlenaiva sākṣāt kāraṇenaiva jñānaṃ sārūpyaṃ svasya rūpasya svabhāvasya darśayet sarvathā nīlatvamātreṇeva kṣaṇakṣayādināpi no na cet yadi nīlāntarāṇaṃrūpasya nīlena sārūpyaṃ svasya vā darśayet ayaṃ parasyāsaṃgrahaḥvirūpābhiniveśaḥ

kārikārthamāha--ayaṃ svasaṃvedanaviṣayo vā'vabodho bāhya ghaṭādijñānaṃ sautrāntikasya, varṇādyātmikaḥ bāhyarūpādipratibimbaḥ svārthena svasya sākṣāt kāraṇena arthena nīlādiviśeṣeṇa svasya ātmanaḥ atyantasārūpyaṃ sarvākārasādṛśyaṃ svīkaroti na nīlāntarāṇāṃ svasya sārūpyaṃ svīkaroti
tasya kāraṇamādiryeṣāṃ tatsantānapātināṃ sarveṣāmanyeṣāṃ vā tāni teṣāmapi iti kathaṃ saṃbhāvyam ? na kathaṃcit
yataḥ saṃbhāvanāt ananyabhāg asādhāraṇo'rthātmā pratyakṣaviṣayaḥ syāt ityadhyāhāraḥ
evaṃ manyate--nahi jñānaṃ svārthasyāpi dāyād iva dhanam ākāraṃ gṛhṇāti ityucyate
yadi svārthenaiva sārūpyam; tarhi citro mitrānukārīti loke vyapadeśo na syāditi
nanu svārthasyaiva rūpaṃ svīkurvadupalabhyate jñānam na nīlāntarāṇām tena evamucyate iti cet; atrāha--tadākāra ityādi
tatra samayaḥ kartuṃ śakyaḥ phalavānapi tādṛśastrikālaviṣayatvāt
anyathā arthakriyānupapatteḥ kathaṃ kutaścit vyavahārapravartanaṃ yataḥ tatprāmāṇyam, arthakriyā'bhāve tadabhāvāt
sacca vijñānaṃ tasya svayamupalabhyamānatvāt--upalambhaḥ sattā pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
54 iti, asacca tat svakāraṇakāraṇādikam, asya sākṣādapratīteḥ sadasatī tayo rūpaṃ svabhāvo na vyāvṛttimātraṃ tato bhinnaṃ vā, tatsvāmānyaṃ ca sadṛśapariṇāmalakṣaṇamartho yasya tattathoktam
yathā arthe'dṛṣṭe'pi tatsadṛśajñānadarśanadarśanāt na nīlāditā dṛṣṭā ityucyate, tathā śāvaleyādāvadṛṣṭe'pi tatsadṛśakhaṇḍadarśanāt tatsadṛśapariṇāmasāmānyaṃ dṛṣṭamucyatāmiti bhāvaḥ
tavā ca yaduktam a rca ṭā di nā-- ekavyaktidarśanakāle anyāsāmadarśanātkathaṃ tadādhāraṃ sāmānyaṃ pratyakṣataḥ pratīyate ? iti; tadanena nirastam

bhavatu pratyakṣaṃ tadartham, tataḥ kim ? ityāha--tathā tena prakāreṇa smṛtiḥ sadasadrūpasāmānyārtheti, tathā pratyabhijñā tadarthā, vitarkaśca tadarthaḥ saṅketaḥ tatra tasmin yāye sati nāsati apohe api tu vastuni
kārikāṃ vivṛṇvannāha--sadasadātmani bhāvābhāvātmake vastuni pratyakṣam anyatra smaraṇādikaṃ pramāṇam
nanu bhavatu tatrapratyakṣam anyatvapramāṇam, nanuśabdaḥ tajjo vā vikalpaḥ tatra pramāṇam, anyaviṣayatvāditi cet; atrāha--śabda ityādi
śabdasvārthavikalpaśca na īśvarādivikalpaḥ, tayośca tadviṣayatvāt sadasadātmakavastugocaratvāt
tataḥ kiṃ jātam ? ityāha--samayaḥ saṅketaḥ tatra sadasadātmani vastuni śakyaḥ karttuṃ na kevalaṃ śakya eva kartum api tu phalavānapi
anyena arthasya trikālaviṣayatvābhāvaprakāreṇa arthasya uttarakāryasya anubhavasya vā kriyā karaṇaṃ tasyāḥ anupapatteḥ iti
kutaścit pratyakṣāt anumānādvā vyavahārapravarttanaṃyata ekāntavādinaḥ kathaṃ tatprāmāṇyaṃ pratyakṣādimānatvam
nanu yadi nāma tadanupapattiḥ prāmāṇyasya kimāyātam yena tanna syāt ? ityāha--arthakriyā ityādi
evaṃ śabdānāṃ vastuni saṅketaṃ tatra ca tatsāphalyaṃ pratipādya adhunā yaduktam--vivakṣāpratibandhajanmānaḥ śabdāḥ tāmeva sūcayeyuḥ iti; taddūṣayannāha--vākyānām ityādi
vākyeṣu vaktrabhiprāyasūcaneṣu aviśeṣeṇa tattvaviṣayatvamantareṇa satyānṛtavyavasthā nopapadyate pratyakṣavat
saṃvṛteḥ mithyaikāntātmakatvāt tadvikalpāt kutaḥ tattvapratilambho yato vādī vijayī syāt
bahirantaśca pratikṣaṇaṃ parasparātmakaṃ svalakṣaṇamanubhavato'pi timirādipratyakṣasya jñānāvaraṇakarmaṇa udayodīraṇābhyāmanyatra kutaḥ niranvayaikānte viparyayapratipattiḥ ?
padasya arthavyabhicārād vyavahārānupayogād vākyānāṃ viparyayāt iti vākyānām ityuktam
kena ? ityāha--aviśeṣeṇa sākalyena yathā hariharahiraṇyagarbhavākyānāṃ tadvācitvam; tatrāha— satyānṛtavyavasthā sugatavākyānāṃ satyavyavasthā ka ṇa ca rā divākyānām anṛtavyavasthā yā sā syāt na
evaṃ manyate--tadvācitvāt yadi sugatavākyānāṃ satyavyavasthā anyeṣāmapi syāt
atha teṣāṃ tattvapratipādanābhāvādanṛtavyavasthā; ata eva sugatavākyānāmapi iyamevāstu
tathāhi--arthebhyaḥ sugatajñānaṃ tato vāñchā tasyāśca vākyāni, naivamanyatra
tato'pi tadvyavasthā anumāna tadā bhavaduktam maṇipradīpaprabhayoḥ pra॰ vā॰ 2
57 ityādi iti cet; uktamatra anumānavatteṣāṃ pramāṇāntaratvamiti tanna tadvyavasthā syāditi
tattvārthasya mithyārthasya darśanāt pratipādanāt, dṛśerṇijantasya ayaṃ prayogaḥ
teṣvapi keṣucit sā bhavatīti cet; atrāha— aviśeṣeṇa iti
na paramārthataḥ tatra tadvyavasthā api tu saṃvṛteḥ, ataḥ paramārthataḥ tatra tadabhāvasādhanaṃ siddhasādhanamiti cet; atrāha--saṃvṛteḥ ityādi

satyānṛtavyavasthā'bhāve'pi tadvyavasthāvikalpaḥ saṃvṛtiḥ tasyāḥ mithyaikāntātmakatvāt mithyārūpa ekāntaḥ mithyaikāntaḥ tadātmakatvāt kāraṇāt tadvikalpāt śabdavikalpāt kuto na kutaścit tattvasya kṛtakatvādisādhanasya anyasya vā pratilambho yataḥ kṛtakatvādivacanāt vādī vijayī syāt
nahi tadvikalpasaṃvṛtyā tattvaviṣayo vyavasthāpyamānaḥ tatpratilambhahetuḥ, atiprasaṅgāt
syādetat--dvicandradarśitaimirikadvayavat sarvatra tadvyavasthā iti cet; atrāha--timira ityādi
svayamudayovīraṇābhyāṃ kuto'nyatra api tu tābhyāmeva tasya tatpratipattiḥ iti

kasmin ?ityāha niranvayaikānta ityādyabhiprāya— dvicandradarśataimirikadvayasya bhrāntyā śabdavyavahāradarśanāt sarvatra tatkalpanāyā pratyakṣasyāpi vyāvarṇitarūpasya mithyādṛṣṭeḥ kvacid viparyayapratipattidarśanāt sarvatrānāśvāsaḥ syāditi
nanu bhavatu pratyakṣasya karmasaṃśliṣṭasya tābhyāṃ tatpratipattiḥ śabdastatta tadviparītasya sā kutaḥ ? ityāha--udayodīraṇābhyām ityādi

kṣāyopaśamikasyāpi bhāvasya ghātikarmodayodīraṇābhāve tattvapratipattiḥ, na kevalaṃ tajjanma sārūpyābhyām tadanena kutaścittattvaṃ vyavasthāpayitukāmena svābhipretamātraṃ nirastatattvaṃ saṃsūcayitumayuktam pakṣāntarānatiśāyanāt
svayamabhimatasya satyānṛtasya anṛtānṛtāt na kañcidviśeṣaṃ paśyāmaḥ vaktrabhiprāyamātre tadvyāpāropagamāt
tadutpattisārūpyābhyāṃ syāditi cet; atrāha--na kevalaṃ tajjanma ityādi

yata evaṃ tat tasmāt anena saugatena tattvaṃ caturāryasatyādilakṣaṇaṃ trirūpaṃ hetulakṣaṇaṃ vā vastu kutaścit sugatasambandhino'nyasambandhino vā vākyād vyavasthāpayitukāmena svābhipretamātram, kiṃbhūtam ? nirastatattvaṃ saṃsūcayitumayuktam vākyāt iti ghaṭanā
anyathā gāṃ pratipādayitukāmena aśvo'pi sūcayituṃ yuktaḥ syāt
kiṃca, sādhu kartumaśaktimatā sādhunā kimasādhu karttavyam ? tatra upekṣaiva tasya nyāyo ti bhāvaḥ
saugatapakṣāt nityādipakṣaḥ tadantaraṃ tasmādanatiśāyanāt svapakṣasya, tatsūcanasyāviśeṣāt iti

nanu saugatapakṣe vākyasya kṣaṇakṣayavijñānavibhramaśūnyaikānte yadyapi visaṃvādaḥ tathāpi na rūpādau, vaktrabhiprāyadvāreṇa tataḥ tatpratīteḥ, pakṣāntare tu sarvatra visaṃvādaḥ tatkathamucyate pakṣāntarānatiśāyanāt iti cet; atrāha--satyānṛtasya ityādi
satyaṃ ca tad rūpādau anṛtaṃ ca kṣaṇikatvādyekānte satyānṛtaṃ śāstraṃ tasya

kiṃbhūtasya ? svayaṃ bauddhena abhimatasya aṅgīkṛtasya anṛtāt sato'pyarthasyāpratipādanaṃ tatpratipādanābhiprāyeṇa saugataiḥ prayujyamānaṃ vacanamanṛtaṃ tasmādapi atyantāsato'kṣaṇikatvākāntasya pratipādanābhiprāyeṇa prayujyamānahamṛtamanṛtānṛtatasmāt kaṃcidviśeṣaṃ na paśyāmaḥ tattvajñānāt ityarthaḥ
na ca parasya tadasti, vaktrabhiprāyamātre tadvyāpāropagamāt, sato'pi rūpādeḥ bahiḥ śabdenāpratipādane asadaviśeṣāt iti bhāvaḥ
kathaṃ tattve asambandhācchabdāt tattvajñānaṃ bhavatpakṣe'pīti cet ? atrāha--vācyavācakasambandha ityādi
vācyavācakayoḥ svataḥ sambandhaḥ kathañcit siddhaḥ pariṇāmaviśeṣāt cakṣurūpavaditi
kathamanyathā kimayamāheti vācyaviśeṣaśaṅkā upapadyeta apratipannarūpadarśinaḥ tadviśeṣavat
vācyo ghaṭādiḥ vācako ghaṭādiśabdaḥ tayoḥ sambandho'vinābhāvaḥ
kathamanyathā anyena svataḥ sambandhābhāvaprakāreṇa śaṅkā saṃśītiḥ
kadā ? ityāha--girāṃ śabdānāṃ śrutau samīcīnaśravaṇe'pi na kevalamaśravaṇe
anena tadbhede na sāmānye śaṅketi darśayati
tathā ca mīmāṃsakapakṣaḥ, taduktam--nityāḥ śabdārthasambandhāḥ vākya pa॰ 2
23 ityādi; atrāha--pariṇāmaviśeṣādi vāyavācakayoḥ yaḥ pariṇāmaviśeṣaḥ tadabhāve ubhayorabhāva iti tasmāt, kathañcit deśanādiniyatatvena siddho niṣpanno niścito vā sambandha iti
upalakṣaṇametat, śrotrādiśabdādīnāṃ pariṇāmaviśeṣastatsambandhādeva cakṣureva rūpameva prakāśayati na grāṇādikaṃ rasādikaṃ vā

syānmatam--cakṣuṣo rūpeṇa santānavṛttyā'tiśayaḥ kaścidāpādito'sti, na tattadeva prakāśayati, naivam arthena śabdasya, tatkathaṃ dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayoḥ sāmyamiti; tadasat; yataḥ cakṣuṣā rūpasya kimidaṃ prakāśanam ? tatra jñānajanakatvaṃ cet; svasamānakālabhāvini rūpakṣaṇe tajjñānaṃ janayati, kathamanyathā tajjanane rūpalakṣaṇaḥtatsahakārī yato jñānena gṛhyeta, akāraṇasyāviṣayatvāt ? na ca samānasamayena tatkṣaṇena cakṣuṣo'tiśayaḥ kriyate
atha tadupādānena tadupakāraḥ kriyamāṇaḥ tena kṛta ityucyate santānāpekṣayā; tadapi na sundaram; evaṃ hi rasādināpi kṛtaḥ iti syāt
yathaiva hi tad rūpagrāhakarūpajanakaṃ tathā tatsamānakālarasāderapi
nopādānatvena iti cet; na; upādānetarabhāvasya bhedaikānteapramāṇatvāditi pratipāditam, anvayavyatirekānukaraṇasya sarvatrāviśeṣāt
bhavatu rasāderapi tadupakāra iti cet; na; tasyāpi tena prakāśanaprasaṅgāt
ayogyatvānneti cet; tarhi yogyataiva prakāśananibandhanamastu kiṃ tadupakārakalpanayā ?
samānasamayavartinoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāve na santānaḥ syāt, sarveṣāmekakṣaṇe eva utpadya anantaraṃ nāśāt
kiṃca, pūrvāpararūpametkaṇāmame vaikasantānatve'pi nīlatāmiva jaḍatāmapi teṣāṃ tatprakāśayet, tasyāḥ api tadupakārakatvāt anyathā aṃśena janyajanakabhāvaḥ
katham anyathā anyena svataḥ sambandhābhāvaprakāreṇa upapadyeta ghaṭeta
pratyakṣeṇa viṣayīkṛteṣu svapararūpādiviśeṣeṣu yathā kṛtasaṅketaniścayapāṭavāḥ svānubhūtaviśeṣān vivecayanti na tathetare
na caitāvatā itare anupalabdhā eva, satyapi saṅkete tathā'pratipattiprasaṅgāt

kathaṃ punaḥ svābhāvikaḥ sambandhaḥ saṅketādanyathā kriyeta ? na hi bhāvasvabhāvāḥ puruṣecchayā parāvartyante niḥsvabhāvatāprāpteḥ ? vacanaṃ tu dārāḥ ṣaṇṇagarītyādau yathā vācakatvena vaktṛbhirniyamyate tattathaivānapekṣitabāhyārthaṃ parāvartyam
pratyakṣapramito'rthaḥ pratyakṣaḥ tasya bhedāḥ avāntaraviśeṣāḥ yathā yena tathā yogyatāprakāreṇa anyena vā syuḥ bhaveyuḥ
kiṃbhūtāḥ ? ityāha--samayāpekṣanirṇayāḥ samayāpekṣaḥ nirṇayo yeṣāmiti, saṅketagrahaṇamupalakṣaṇaṃ tena darśanapāṭavāderapi grahaṇam

evaṃ manyate--yathā anubhavaḥ svārthabhedaniścaye svato yogyo'pi, na hi tasya tadyogyatā niścayena kriyate anyo'nyāśrayadoṣa, na svasattāmātreṇa niścayaṃ tatra janayati kṣaṇabhaṅgādau prasaṅgāt, api tu sahakārikāraṇaṃ saṅketādikamapekṣyata tathā śabdo'pi svato yogyata eva svārthaviśeṣe saṅketamapekṣya nirṇayaṃ janayati

keṣu ? svapararūpādiviśeṣeṣu svaṃ ca pratyakṣaṃ paraśca bahirghaṭādiḥ tayoryathāsaṃbhavaṃ ye rūpādiviśeṣāḥ teṣu yathā kṛtasaṅketaniścayapāṭavāḥ kṛtaścāsau saṅketaśca tena niścayapāṭavaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ yathā svānubhūtaviśeṣān vivecayanti vyavasyanti na tathā itare akṛtasaṅketapāṭavaḥ tathā na tāva yaṃ ti na caitāvatā tairitare viśeṣāḥ anupalabdhā eva api tu upalabdhāḥ
tathā śabdārthopalambhinaḥ samayaḥ saṅketaḥ tadviśeṣanirṇayahetuḥ śabdārthabhedaniścayakāraṇam
kathaṃ punaḥ svābhāvikaḥ vācyavācakayorātmabhūtaḥ yogyatā lakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ saṅketādanyathā arthāntarapratipādanaprakāreṇa kriyeta
ayamabhiprāyaḥ parasya— śabdasya vit sarvatra vārthe sa sambandhaḥ, pratiniyate vā ? prathamapakṣe yugapat tataḥ sakalārthapratītiḥ syāt
atha saṅketāntarād arthāntarapratipādanayogyatā asya iti cet; atrāha--nahi ityādi
hiryasmāt na bhāvānāṃ śabdādīnāmarthānāṃ svabhāvāḥ puruṣecchayā parāvarttyante anyathā anyathā ca jāyante
śabdasvabhāvo'pi tarhi saṅketānu parāvarttata iti cet; atrāha--vacanaṃ nvitvityādi
dārāḥ ṣaṇṇagarītyādau yathā vācakatvena vaktṛbhirniyamyate tadvacanam tathaivānapekṣitabāhyārthaṃ parāva rttyamiti jātapariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
tayoḥ vācyavācakayoḥ sambandhaśca vyapadeśaśca asyedaṃ vācakaṃ vācyaṃ ceti pratipādanaṃ tayoḥ saṅkaraḥ sarveṣāmayogavyavacchedādīnāmeva va gamanaṃ vyatikaraḥ parasparaviṣayagamanam tayoḥ prasaṅgāt
pārtho dhanurdharo nīlaṃ sarojamiti vā yathā
na vai puruṣecchayā citro dhanurdhara eva, pārtha eva dhanurdharaḥ; nīlaṃ sarojaṃ bhavatyeveti ayogavyavacchedādisvabhāvasthitavākyeṣu anyathātvaṃ saṃbhāvyate, tathāpratipattiprasaṅgāt
tata eva evakāraprayogavikaleṣvapi vākyeṣu sāmarthyāt bhavatyeva ayogavyavacchedādipratipattiḥ, na vivakṣayā tatpratipattiḥ, tadgrahaṇatvāt
viśeṣaṇaṃ nīlatvādi viśeṣyam utpalatvādi tābhyām, kriyā bhavatyādikā tayā ca sahoktau drayoge sati ayogaṃ yogamaparairatyantāyogaṃ vyavacchinatti
kiṃ sarvaḥ ? na, ityāha--vyatirecakaḥ evakāra ityarthaḥ
tathāhi--viśeṣaṇena sahoktau ayogaṃ viśeṣeṇa anyayo gaṃ kriyayā vā atyantāyogam evakāro dharmasya vyavacchinattīti
puruṣecchāto na svasvabhāvata iti cet; atrāha--na ca naiva anyathā uktāpichātaḥ taṃ tasya savyavacchinatti tathā'darśanāt
nahi citro dhanurdhara eva ityukte icchāto'pi parayogasya vyavacchedaḥ pratītiviṣaḥ itarathā yathāvinyāsameva ca iṣṭārthapratīteḥ bhinnaprakramayojanaṃ sarvatra ayuktaṃ bhavet

syādetat— anādirayaṃ saṅketo viśeṣaṇādinā saha prayujyamāna evakāro'yogādivyavacchedakṛditi, tataḥ tathā pratītiḥ na śabdasvabhāvyāt anyathā saṅkete hi tathaiva taṃ vyavacchinatti, na vādau prasāyasti iti; tadayuktam; yataḥ tathā saṅketayato'pi lokasyānivṛtteḥ
na khalu pakṣasyaiva dharmo hetuḥ iti vākyād ayogavyavacchedaṃ pratipadyasva ityukto'pi lokaḥ tathā pratipadyate iti
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadi icchāta eva tadarthaḥ pratīyate, tadā tadaprayoge tadicchāstīti kuto niścayaḥ ? atha ca tadarthaḥ sāmarthyāt pratīyate iti
kārikāyā yugalaṃ vivṛṇvannāha--citro dhanurdhara eva ityādi

citro viśeṣaḥ tasya dhanurdhara iti viśeṣaṇam asmāt para evakāraḥ, po'rthojanau viśeṣyaḥ asmācca paraḥ eva sa tadviśeṣaṇaṃ dhanurdhara iti, nīlaṃ sarojam iti viśiṣṭaṃ kartṛ nirdiṣṭaṃ tatkriyā bhavati iti, asyāḥ para evakāra ityevaṃ yathā stam ayogāvyavacchedādinā svabhāvena sthitāni yāni vākyāni teṣu navai naiva puruṣecchayā anyathātvaṃ viparītatvaṃ saṃbhāvyate
tathā tena puruṣecchayā anyathātvaprakāreṇa pratipattiprasaṅgāt ayogavyavacchedādisaṃvittiprāpteḥ
athavā tathā saugatābhimataprakāreṇa pratipattiprasaṅgāt' iti grāhyam
adhunā sāmarthyācca ityādi vyākhyātumāha--tata eva ityādi
tata eva puruṣecchayā anyathā saṃbhāvanābhāvādeva sāmarthyād bhavati ayogavyavacchedādipratipattiḥ
vivakṣayā tatpratipattiriti cet; atrāha--na vivakṣayā tatpratipattiriti
1 ityādi vākye anyathā vivakṣāyāmapi nānyathātvaṃ saṃbhāvyate pramāṇabādhanāt, pratyakṣābhāsavat
nanu yadi evakāraprayogavikalāni vākyāni kānicit santi, kutaḥ teṣu idamavagamyate— ayamarthaḥ atra evakārasya iti ? nahi śaśaśṛṅgasya ayamartha iti śakyamavasātum
tena sāmarthyalabhyena arthena grahaṇam upādānaṃ yasya evakārasya tasya bhāvāttattvāt
yathaiva hi dhūmaḥ pratīyamānaḥ svakāraṇamagniṃ tadavinābhāvādgamayati tathā artho'pi kutaścit pratīyamānaḥ svavācakamavyabhicāraṃ
18 ityanena voḥ evaiyoḥ pratiṣedha ucyamānaḥ tayoḥ vikārivikārava dbhāvaṃ sūcayati tadabhāve tayorabhāvāt pratiṣedhānupapattiḥ
tato jñāyate na voḥ sarvasya khe iti, so'pi jñāyamānaḥ śrutārthāpattyā ekadeśaśabdaṃ gamayatīti, loke'pi sthūlabahalo devadatto divā na bhuṅkte iti vākyaṃ rātrau bhuṅkte iti gamayati
caitro dhanurdhara eva iti...tadayuktam--pakṣadharma eva ityayogavyavacchena viśeṣaṇam
yadi punaḥ anyayogavyavacchedena pakṣadharmaṃ viśeṣayet pakṣasyaiva dharmo heturiti; tadviśeṣaṇāpekṣasya hetorasādhāraṇatā anyatrāpyavṛtteḥ ityayuktam, katham ?
bhiprāyaḥ--caitrasya dhanuṣā ayoge vyavacchinne yogaḥ pratipādito bhavet itarathā caitro dhanurdhara eva iti prayogānupapattiḥ
sa ca sarvathā, kathaṃcidvā syāt ? ādye pakṣe caitrasya dhanuṣā ayoge vyavacchinne sati na caitratā sidhyet dhanurbhāvaḥ sidhyet
sarvathā tasya tena yoge gardabhīkṣīratāpattiḥ tayoḥ anyathā ekānta iti bhāvaḥ
kārikāṃ vyākhyātumāha--caitro dhanurdhara eva iti ityādi

kim ? ityāha--pakṣadharma eva iti ayogavyavacchedena viśeṣaṇam, pakṣa-dharmayorekatvāpattyā guḍayorasatāpatteḥ punaḥ ayogavyavacchedavyavasthāpareṇa anyatra dūṣaṇamuktam, tad dūṣayituṃ prakaṭayannāha--yavi punaḥ ityādi

punariti pakṣāntaradyotane anyayogavyavacchedena anyo vipakṣaḥ tena ayogaḥ pakṣadharmasya tasya vyavacchedo nirāsaḥ tena viśeṣayet pakṣadharmaṃ pakṣasyaiva dharmo heturiti kaścid vyākhyātā pakṣadharmastadaṃśena hetubi॰ pṛ॰ 52 ityādeḥ
sa ca pakṣo viśeṣaṇaṃ ca tat, tasminnapekṣā yasya, tadapekṣā tadviśeṣaṇe, tadviśeṣaṇāpekṣaḥ tasya
atra sūriḥ dūṣaṇamāha--ityevaṃ pareṇocyamānam ayuktam ityanuvarttate
katham iti praśne, kena prakāreṇa ayuktam iti ?
so'pi cet pakṣadharmaḥ syāt evakārasya kiṃ phalam || 35

sajātīye sanneva heturityayogavyavacchede śabdānityatve prayatnānantarīyakatvāderahetutvaprasaṅgabhayāt sajātīya eva san iti anyayogavyavacchedenaiva viśeṣayet, tathaiva viśeṣito'pi taddharmaḥ san ekāntamatikramya yadi vastusvabhāvena pakṣadharmaḥ syāt tarhi pakṣe eva sanniti viśeṣito'pi sajātīye varteta svarasataḥ anekāntāvalambanāt

anyayogavyavacchedena hetunā saṃvidyamānaḥ sapakṣa eva nānyatra tadviruddhe heturiti sambandhaḥsa itthaṃbhūto'pi ced yadi pakṣadharmaḥ syāt itarathā cākṣuṣatvādivad apakṣadharmaḥ syāt, tadapekṣa eva san sapakṣe kinna syāt ? syādeva
viśeṣyeṇa saha evakārasya uccāraṇe kiṃ phalam iti cet ? atha tattulya eva san ityatra kiṃ phalam ? atulyayogavyavacchedyaiti cet; anyatrāpi sa evāstu
tulyayogavyavacchedaḥ kasmānneti cet ? pakṣayogavyavacchedo bhavato'pyastu, vipakṣavat pakṣo'pi anya eva

etat pare pariharanti ittham— anumeyet kathatattulye sadbhāvaḥ ityatra anumeye prathamaṃ hetoḥ sadbhāvamabhidhāya tattulya eva ityucyamānam uktaniṣedhakaṃ na bhavati, yathā dvau putrau janayāṃbabhūva naraṃ nārāyaṇameva ca iti nārāyaṇameva iti śrutiḥ naramuktaṃ na niṣedhati, anuktaniṣedhaparatvāt
evamarthaṃ ca sa tu sapakṣa eva ityabhiprāya
pakṣa eva san ityukte yathā pareṇa pakṣadharmaḥ ityuktvā tadaṃśena ityuktam
naraṃ ca nārāyaṇameva cādau svataḥ sutau dvau janayāṃbabhūtava--hetubi॰ ṭīkālo॰ pṛ॰ 247
kārikārthaṃ prakaṭayituṃ san sajātīya eva ityavadhāraṇe parābhiprāyaṃ dyotayannāha— sajātīye sanneva ityādi

sajātīye sanneva nā'san manāgapi hetuḥ ityevam ayogavyavacchede aṅgīkriyamāṇe śabdānityatve sādhye prayatnānantarīyakatvādeḥ ādi śabdādanyasyāpi tatprakārasya sapakṣaikadeśavṛtteḥ ahetutvaprasaṅgabhayāt anyayogavyavacchedenaiva viśeṣayejjanaḥ sajātīya eva san iti
tatra hetulakṣaṇameva tatra yaḥ san sajātīye ityādikaṃ yuktaṃ vaktum--pra॰ vā॰ manoratha॰ 4
tathaiva anyayogavyavacchedaprakāreṇaiva viśeṣito'pi taddharmaḥ san ekāntamatikramya viśeṣyeṇa sahodito nipāto vyatirecakaḥ anyayogavyavacchedaniyamamapahāya
kena ? ityāha--vastusvabhāvena śabdamāhātmyena yadi pakṣadharmaḥ syāt
tarhi pakṣe eva sanniti viśeṣito'pi sajātīye vartteta
anyayogavyavacchede'pi anuktasyaiva vyavacchedo netarasya iti yo'yam anekāntaḥ tasyāśrayaṇāt kāraṇāt pakṣa eva san ityukte'pi sapakṣe vṛttyaniṣedhaḥ
dṛśyate hi pūrvoktasyaiva ekasmin vākye paścādapyuktasyā'niṣedhaḥ, tadyathā
jina eva parā bhaktiḥ sarvajñe narasevidhaṃ
asyāpramāṇatve prakṛte kaḥ samāśvāsa iti na kiñcidetat
yatpunaruktam--asādhāraṇatā syāt iti; so'pina doṣa iti darśayannāha--na ca ityādi
tanna pakṣa eva san ityukte'pi asādhāraṇatā nāma doṣaḥ, aya tuṃ syāditi darśayannāha--anyayoga ityādi
yaccānyaduktam--kriyayā sahodito'tyantāyogameva ca vyavacchinatti nipāto vyatirecakaḥ
nīlaṃ sarojaṃ bhavatyevetyatyantāyogavyavacchedaikānte svakālādiniyamākrāntaṃ sarvaṃ nīlamayaṃ sarojātmakaṃ śāśvataṃ jagat syāt
tato nīlaṃ sarojamityeva na syāt vyāghātāditi
kathamanyathā anena pakṣasya dharmo bhavatyeva iti nāśriyeta ? yato'yogavyavacchedenaiva viśeṣayet ? tanna...na ca syādvāde kācidanavasthitiḥ, svayamabhimatavastutattvapratyāyanāt
nīlaṃ sarojaṃ bhavatyeva iti cet yadi tarhi samantāt nityaṃ sarvadā nīlaṃ sarojaikarūpaṃ vyaktaṃ yathā bhavati tathā idaṃ jagat prāptam
ayam abhiprāyaḥ--sarvathā, kathaṃcidvā nīlaṃ sarojaṃ bhavatyeva ? prathamapakṣe ayaṃ doṣaḥ
kāla ādiryasya dravyādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ punaḥsvaśabdonāsya karmadhārayaḥ tena niyamaḥ tena, sa ca atikrānto yena tattathoktam, sarvaṃ nīlamayaṃ jagat syāt
kiṃ nīlamayameva syāt ? na, ityāha--sarojātmakaṃ jagat syāt
tasmāt anantaraikāntāt nīlaṃ sarojam ityeva na syāt
yaditi yadi nīlamayaṃna sarojātmakam, atha tadātmakaṃnanīlātmakam ityanayoḥ anyonavirodhāt
syānmatam--nīlaṃ sarojaṃ bhavatyeva iti vacane'pi nāyaṃ doṣaḥ yathābhāvasvabhāvam abhidhānapravṛtteriti cet; atrāha--kathamityādi
anena, asya doṣasya abhāvaprakāreṇa anyathā pakṣasya dharmo hetuḥbhavatyeva iti kathaṃ nāśriyeta yato'nāśrayaṇāt ayogavyavacchedenaiva viśeṣayet
nanu syādvāde'pi tathaiva doṣaḥ; ityāha--na ca ityādi
kutaḥ ? ityāha--svayaṃ jainasya abhimataṃ yadvastutattvaṃ tasyaiva pratyāyanāt
punarapi vaktrabhipretamarthaṃ śabdāḥ sūcayantītyekānte dūṣaṇamāha--evakāra ityādi
dhvanayo vaktrabhiprāyameva sūcayanti ityekānte yathā evakāraḥ bhinnaprakramaḥ cakāro veti yadā svārthapratipādane kathañcit śaktisvābhāvyaṃ na bhavet svecchayā kramaṃ na laṅghyet
vicāritaṃ caitat svābhāvikatvādabhidhānasya ekaśeṣānārambhaḥ ityatra bhagavadbhiḥ pū jya pā daiḥ śabdānuśāsanadakṣaiḥ
padāvadhikaḥ samayaḥ svārthapratipādane puruṣābhiprāyādhīnaścet; na; tāvanmātreṇa vyavahārābhāvāt

padāntarasannidhāne svata eva viśiṣṭārthapratipādane kathaṃ vācakasya svata eva śaktiḥ pratyākhyāyeta ? ekapadasya nānārthapratipādanasaṃbhave sarvathā niyamāsaṃbhavāt ekānto na sidhyati ityalaṃ prasaṅgena
evakāraḥ svārthe ayogavyavacchedādau śrūyeta svato bauddhena
kiṃ kurvan ? ityāha— anuvarttayan anuvarttamānaṃ prayuñjānaḥ bhikṣādivad acetanasyāpi hetukartṛtvam
tadanyatra atidiśannāha--yathā evakāraḥ tathā paro'nyastādiḥ ādiśabdaḥ nipātarāśigrahaṇārthaḥ śrūyeta anuvarttayan svakramaṃ vaktrabhiprāyam
na caivam, vyavadhānena prayoge'pi yāvadviśeṣaṇādinā nābhisaṃbadhyate, tāvat tataḥ tadarthā'pratipatteḥ iti bhāvaḥ

kārikāvivaraṇamāha--dhvanayo vaktrabhiprāyameva nārthaṃ sūcayanti ityekānte sati yathā yena prakāreṇa evakāraḥ bhinnaprakramaḥ, bhinnaḥ viśeṣaṇādivyatikrameṇa prakramaḥ prayogaparipāṭiryasya sa tathoktaḥ, tasyaiya cakāro yattadornityasambandhāt tathaiveti gamyate
na kevalaṃ cakāraḥ kintu vā iti
iti śabdaḥ prakāravācī vā, evaṃ prakāro'nyo'pi śabdaḥ
tat kiṃ kuryāt ? ityāha--kramaṃ svavinyāsasthitiṃ na laṅghayet puruṣakāraṇe anyatra uddiṣṭo viśeṣaṇādinā na sambandhamarhet yathānyāsamavetamarthaṃ gamayedityarthaḥ
kadā ? ityāha— yadi yadā śaktisvābhāvyaṃ kathaṃcit kenacit prakāreṇa nigaditena svārthapratipādanena bhavet
kena kṛtvā ? ityāha--astecchayā puruṣecchānuvarttanena, śabdaśaktisvābhāvye tu taṃ laṅghayet anyatra nirdeśe'pi viśeṣaṇādisambandhamantareṇa tadarthāpratipatteriti
kathaṃ tarhi tatsvābhāvye ekasmin kāminīkāye dārāḥ bahuvacanam ? tasya bahutve niyatatvāt
ṣaṇṇāṃ nagarāṇāṃ samūhe ṣaṇṇagarī ityekavacanam ? asya ekatra niyamāt, ṣaṇṇagaravyatirekeṇa tatsamūhābhāvāt
dṛśyate ca tadvacanam, tato manyāmahe vivakṣārthā'śabdā iti; tatrāha— yoga ityādi
yogarūḍheṣudārāḥṣaṇṇagarī ityādiṣvapi dhvaniṣu na kevalaṃ pūrveṣu bhedapratipattau bahutvaikapratipattau śabdaśaktireva anugantavyā na vivakṣāmātram, anyathā tata ekavacanādiprasaṅgāt
1000ityatra bhagavadbhiḥ pū jya pā daiḥ śabdānuśāsanadakṣaiḥ iti
punruṣasya vaktuḥ abhiprāyaḥ samicchā tadadhīnaḥ tadāyattaḥ svārthapratipādane iti cet; atrāha--na ityādi
kutaḥ ? ityāha--tāvanmātreṇa padamātreṇa vyavahārābhāvāt śabdasya pravṛttirūpasya nivṛttirūpasya vā vyavahārasyā'yogāt
na khalu ghaṭa iti vacanamātreṇa tadbhāvaḥ
syānmatam--padāntareṇa abhisambandhād viśiṣṭārthapratipattiḥ, tato vyavahāra iti; tatrāha— padāntara ityādi
vivakṣitapadād anyat padaṃ tadantaram tasya sannidhāne sati svata eva ātmanaiva puruṣakṛtasaṅketamantareṇa viśiṣṭārthapratipādane aṅgīkriyamāṇe

na hi sarvā vākyārthapratipattiḥ saṅketamapekṣate asakṛt pūrvavākyādapi keṣāṃcit sudhiyām arthapratītidarśanāt kathaṃ svata eva śaktiḥ bādhakasya pratyākhyāyeta ? evamabhyupagamya padāvadhikasya samayasya puruṣābhiprāyādhīnatvamidaṃ dūṣaṇamuktam
adhunā tatrāpi tadadhīnatvaṃ nāstīti darśayannāha--nānārtha ityādi
nānārthasya anekārthasyaukabhyapadasya pratipādanaṃsaṃbhave, yathā agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāmaḥ maitrā॰ 6
36 pratyatra vākye agnyādipadasya vaktrabhiprāyameva śabdāḥ sūcayantīti niyamāsaṃbhavāt sarvathā ayaṃ parakīya ekānto na sidhyati
tathāhi--yadi vaktrabhiprāyameva śabdāḥ sūcayanti; tarhi vaktuḥ mīmāṃsakasya agniḥ svetyabhiprāyābhāvāt kathaṃ kīrtteḥ tataḥ svārtha pratipattiryena ucyate--
agniṃ hantīti agnihaḥ śvā tasya utraṃ māṃsam agnihotramiti
tena agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāma iti śrutau
khādet śvamāṃsamityeṣa nārthaḥ ityatra kā pramā
tasya vyākhyātaiva vaktā ityucyate; na; vyākhyātṛkathitārthādadhikasyāpi sayuktike śrotari prameyasya pratibhāsanāt
atha matam--na paramāṇuvyatirekeṇa varṇāḥ padāni vākyāni ca santi atrasaṃvṛteḥ, tatkathamuktam tadbhidaḥ pratilabdhavarṇapadavākyātmā siddhivi॰ 4
tathā ca vyalīkamātrānirbhāsamakṣaraṃ vitathavarṇanirbhāsaṃ padamadṛṣṭapadārthaṃ vākyamapyapratiṣiddham akramapratipatteḥ
tadanabhyupagame niraṃśatattvopagamād vaiyākaraṇasya iti na tathāgatasya patasyapakṣapātād vimokṣaḥ iti
padam ityupalakṣaṇam varṇavākyayoḥ, tato varṇaḥ padaṃ vākyaṃ cāvabhāsate
kiṃbhūtaṃ tat ? ityāha— abhinnaṃ svāvayavasādhāraṇam, athavā niraṃśam
punarapi kiṃbhūtaiḥ ? ityāha--sadāsadbhiriti jainamatāpekṣayā sadbhiḥ vidyamānaiḥ vaiyākaraṇaviśeṣadarśanāpekṣayā asadbhiḥ
yathā yena prakāreṇa jñānam ākāraiḥ tathāvidhaiḥavabhāsate ityevaṃ kecit pracakṣate jaināḥ vaiyākaraṇāśca
nanu kva tadavabhāsate ? svātmani iti cet; vijñānam
anyasmin pratyakṣe cet; na; tanniṣedhāt, sato'pi tasya varttamānamātraparyavasānācca
nānumāne'pi; pratyakṣābhāve tadabhāvāt iti cet; ātmani anekātmani svaparasaṃvedanapariṇāmātmani tadavabhāsate iti brūmaḥ
taduktaṃ nyā ya vi ni śca ye--ātmanā'nekarūpeṇa nyāyavi॰ 1
pūrvapūrvarṇaśravaṇāhitasaṃskārasya antyavarṇaśravaṇāt pūrvavarṇasmaraṇe sati mānasaṃ pratyakṣamupajāyate, tatrāvabhāsate ityeke
darśanānatikrameṇa yathādarśanaṃ jñānatattvavyavasthāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyām anekāntaprasaṅgāt anekāntātmakavarṇādiprasaṅgāt kāraṇāt tattvaṃ jñānaṃ vastu, kiṃbhūtam ? ekarūpam niraṃśamāstheyam
punarapi kiṃbhūtam ? ityāha--kathaṃcit pratyakṣādiprakāreṇa svasaṃvedanādvaitādiprakāreṇa vā'dṛṣṭapūrvam, na hi niraṃśaṃ jñānaṃ puruṣavat draṣṭuṃ śakyam
iṣyata eva tathāvidhaṃ jñānatattvamiti cet; atrāha--tathā ca tena ca tathāvidhajñānābhyumagamaprakāreṇa akṣaram apratiṣiddham iti gatvā sambandhaḥ karaṇīyaḥ
kiṃbhūtam ? ityāha— vyalīkamātrānirbhāsaṃ vyalīko'satyo mātrāṇāṃ hrasvādīnāṃ nirbhāso yasminniti
na kevalam akṣaram api tu padamapyapratiṣiddham
dṛṣṭasya mātrādibhedasya hāniḥ adṛṣṭasya niraṃśākṣarādeḥ kalpanā iti cet; atrāha--saṃvittāvapi na kevalam akṣarādau samānaḥprasaṅgo doṣaḥ
na samānaḥ tatra citraikarūpatvopagamāt citrapratibhāsāpyekaiva buddhiḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
tasyāḥ saṃvitteḥ bhedābhedātmakatve anyatra varṇādau kaḥ pradveṣaḥ bhedābhedātmakatvasya yattatra tanna bhavet ?
nānu nādṛṣṭapūrvaṃ jñānatattvamiṣyate yenāyaṃ doṣaḥ, api tu dṛṣṭam, svasaṃvedanātmakasya parokṣatvavirodhāt
yadi punaḥ jñānaparamāṇavaḥ sarvathā bhinnāḥ; kutastattvamanyathā pratibhāseran ? vedyākāraḥ punaḥ vedakādyākāravilakṣaṇa eva saṃvitsvabhāvamativarteta arthāntaravat

vedakākāraḥ tadvyatirekeṇāsaṃvedyaḥ kathaṃ cetanaḥ yataḥ tasya svasaṃvittiḥ syāt ? tanna tadabhedaikānte vibhramavaśādanyathāvabhāsaḥ, bahirapi vibhramavaśāt niḥkalasyaiva padāderanyathāvabhāsaḥ kalpeta
abhinnamavibhāgaṃ jñānaṃ yat saugateṣṭam anyathā grāhyagrāhakasaṃvitterbhedavantamiva ātmānaṃ svasvarūpamavabhāsayet
akramaṃ kamarahitaṃ sakramaṃ kramavadiva kuryāt gṛhṇīyāt karoteḥ kriyāsāmānyavācitvāt
kim ? na kuryādeva tajjñānam ? kim ? padam, upalakṣaṇametat varṇādeḥ
354 na gṛhyate iti; tatrāha--yadi punaḥ ityādi
kiṃbhūtāḥ ? ityāha-- sarvathā bhinnāḥ parasparavyāvṛttatanavaḥ tattvam ityavyāronyathā baṃdhasya niḥkalatvāsiddheḥ
tataḥ kim ? ityāha--kutaḥ kāraṇāt na kutaścit, kathaṃcidekatvena upalakṣaṇametat tena sthūlatvena dīrghatvena sāvayavatvena pratibhāseran
nahi yadrūpaṃ yanna bhavati tadrūpeṇa svagrāhiṇi jñāne tat pratibhāti, itarathā cakṣuṣi rūpaṃ ca rasātmanā pratibhāseta
nāsti ca tatparamāṇuṣu pratyekaṃ samuditeṣu vā tadekatvādikamiti, pratibhā sante ca, saṃhṛtāśeṣavikalpadaśāyāmapi sthūlasyaikasya darśanāt
taduktaṃ dharma kī rtti nā pi--
sarūpayanti kiṃ jñānaṃ sthūlābhāsaṃ ca te'ṇavaḥ
te parasparaṃ bhinnā aṇavaḥ tajjñānaṃ sthūlābhāsaṃ sthūlākāraṃ kena rūpeṇa sarūpayanti ? yadaṇusvarūpamasthūlamasti na tat jñānārūḍham
syānmatam--nābhātyeṣa ākāraḥ, sa tu grāhyākāro'sanneva māyāmarīciprabhṛtipratibhāsavadasattve'pyadoṣaḥ pra॰ vārtikāla॰ 3
211 iti vacanāditi cet; atrāha— vedyākāra ityādi
vedyākāraḥ grāhyākāraḥ sthūlaikarūpaḥ yadi ityanuvartate punaḥ vedakādyākāravilakṣaṇa eva, vedakaḥ yenāsau vedyākāro gṛhyate, tadabhāve tadapratītiḥ
svataḥ pratītiriti cet; prāptaṃ jñānatvam iti citraikatattvasiddhiḥ
na caitat parasya pathyam, tato jñānādanya evāsau
nahi kriyārahitaṃ karma asti, tadevākāraḥ tasmād vilakṣaṇa eva bhinna eva saṃvitsvabhāva jñānasvarūpaṃ svasaṃvedanalakṣaṇamativartteta atikrāmet, vedyākāro'cetanaḥ syāt ityarthaḥ
tathā ca yadavabhāsate tajjñānaṃ yathā sukhādi ityasya anena vyabhicāraḥ
nīlārthād anyo'rthaḥ tadantaram pītyādi tadiva tadvat iti
yathā pītaṃ nīlasvabhāvamativarttate tathā vedyākāro'pi saṃvitsvabhāvamiti
yadi vā, saṃvit kartrī svabhāvaṃ nīlabodharūpatāyādvyātmānaṃ viṣayajñānaṃ tajjñānaviśeṣācca dvirūpatā
12 iti vacanāt ativartteta nirākārā syāt ityarthaḥ
kathaṃ cetano'yamatadākāro yataḥ cetanatvāt svasaṃvittiḥ tasya syāt
nanu na vedyākāraḥ saṃvedanādanyaḥ, kintu paramārthato'tadvatyapi tadvatīva pratibhātīti cet; atrāha--tadabhedaikānte vibhramavaśādanyathāvabhāsaḥ saṃśatayeva pratibhāsanam
atrottaraṃ bahirapi na kevalam antaḥ, vibhramavaśādanyathā'vabhāsaḥ kalpeta
nanu varṇadisphoṭasya tadavayavā vyañjakā iṣyante, teṣāṃ cāvidyatikriyā vyāpāraḥ
nahi marīcikājalekvāṃti darthakriyāṃ vidhātumalamiti cet; atrāha— mithyākāraiḥ ityādi
dvaidhyaṃ mithyākramaiḥ vākyaṃ vyajyate vyañjakaiḥ padaiḥ || 40
nānānirbhāsairekaṃ jñānaṃ yadi vitathairarthairapi vyajyeta; vitathakramaiḥ padaiḥ vākyaṃ vyaṅgyaṃ kinna bhavet viśeṣābhāvāt
mithyā asatyairākāraiḥ aṃśaiḥ yathā yena taddvāreṇa pratipattiprakāreṇa jñānam ekamadvayaṃ dvaidhyaṃ tyadyata jātucit kadācit tathā mithyākramaiḥ mithyā kramo yeṣāṃ taiḥ iti
vākyam upalakṣaṇametat, tena varṇaḥ padaṃ vyajyate
nānābhirbhāsaiḥ vedyādyākāraiḥ ekaṃ niraṃśaṃ vitathairarthairapi yadi vyajyeta jñānaṃ vitathakramaiḥ padaṃvākyaṃ vyaṅgyaṃ kinna bhavet ? bhavedeva
nanu nityo vyāpī ca sphoṭaḥ parairiṣyate
na ca tathāvidhasya vedanamiti cet; atrāha— na jñāyetetyādi
varṇātirikto varṇābhivyaṅgyo'rthapratyāyakaḥ nityaḥ śabdaḥ sphoṭa iti tadvido vadanti ...--sarvada॰ pṛ॰ 300
pratyakṣānupalambhasādhane kāryakāraṇabhāve na kiñcit kasyacit kāryam, niṣkalasākṣātkṛterasaṃbhavāt
na jñāyeta na gṛhyeta notpadyeta na naśyatyekamañjasā paramārthena
tasya jñānatva-janma-nāśasya vittiḥ tadvittiḥ tasyā vitatho ya ātmā svabhāvaḥ tena
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadi jñānamajñātamapi svarūpamātraparyavasitaṃ kṣaṇikam ahetuphalabhūtam anaṃśaṃ cocyate; rhi varṇādikamadṛṣṭamapi nityavyāpitayā iṣyatām
kiṃcit jāgradvijñānaṃ svāpādivijñānaṃ vā kasyacit cakṣurādeḥ vāsanādervā kāryaṃ na tathā kiṃcit subantamidamanyadvā padaṃ vākyaṃ vā kasyacit tālvādeḥ gaganasya vāyoḥ śabdasya vā na kāryam
niṣkalasya jñānādeḥ niraṃśasya yā sākṣātkṛtiḥ tasyāḥ asaṃbhavāt
mā bhūt tatkāryaṃ tat, tathāpi anityaṃ syāditi cet; atrāha--tata eva tadasaṃbhavādeva na naśyet
nanu jñānasya niṣkalasya sākṣātkṛterasaṃbhave'pi vibhramākārairanumānāditi cet; atrāha— jñānatattvasya ityādi
jñānatattvaṃ niraṃśaṃ na pratyakṣam, yadaṅgīkṛtya sphoṭamupālabheran, sarvavikalpātītaṃ niraṃśaṃ tattvaṃ yadi sāṃśamiva lakṣyate na pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyate; taditaratrāpi samānam
anādinidhanaṃ sādinidhanavat akramaṃ kramavadiva pratibhāsate iti tattvasya kutaścit svabhāvataḥ siddhau satyāṃ syāt, anyathā sarvatrānāśvāsaprasaṅgāt, sarvathā vibhramasya asiddheḥ
jñānatattvasya niraṃśasya nirbhāsaiḥ grāhyādyākāraiḥ nāsti tādātmyaṃ sarvathā bhrāntaiḥ hetupadametat vitathatvāditi
tathā nāsti tadutpattiḥ tasya taiḥ yad yasmāt tādātmyāt tadanumīyate tairākārairiti
jñānatattvamitatattvamityādinā kārikārthamāha--jñānatattvam kiṃbhūtam ? ityāha— niraṃśaṃ yad vijñānatattvam aṅgīkṛtya āśritya sphoṭam upālabheran saugatāḥ śabdabrahma vā, tanna pratyakṣam iti

yatpunaruktam--bhedavāniva lakṣyate na gṛhyate iti; tatrāha--sarvān sattvādīn vikalpān atītaṃ tattvaṃ jñānasvarūpaṃ yadi niraṃśaṃ vedyaṃsavikalaṃ sat sāṃśamiva sabhedamiva lakṣyeta vikalpena vyavasīyeta na pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyate; tad anantaroktam itara trāpi padādāvapi samānam
śakyaṃ hi vaktum--avikalpabodhena padādi akramaṃ pratīyate, taduttarakālabhāvinyā tu vikalpabuddhyā sakramamiva vyavasīyate
nanu sakalaṃ jñānaṃ svarūpa eva magnaṃ kathaṃ padādau bhinne pravṛttimat ? svarūpe magnamiti kutaḥ ? itarathā, jñānaṃ tatra bhave
lakṣaṇāntarābhāvāt iti cet; ata eva padarūpe'pi magnamityapyastu
yadi svarūpamagnaṃ na syāttadā jñānameva na syāt
bhavatu tarhi vā padavākyādi janmādirahitam iti cet; atrāha--anādi ityādi

na vidyate ādinidhane janmavināśau yasya tadanādinibaṃdhasyādi nidhanavadakramaṃ hetuphalakramarahitaṃ kramādiva hetuphalakramavadiva pratibhāsata iti evaṃ tattvasya jñānādisvarūpasya kutaścit pratyakṣāt anumānāt anyato vā svabhāvataḥ svabhāvena siddho nirṇītau satyāmevaṃ syāt, anyathā svabhāvataḥ tatsiddhyabhāvaprakāṃreṇa sarvatra sukhādāvapi anāśvāsaprasaṅgāt
tathāhi--'na sukhādikaṃ nāma kiṃcana, kevalaṃ sukhādikamiva na pratibhāsate, pratibhāsata iva ityapi syāt
nanu nāstyeva sukhādinīlādivyatirekeṇa parasya pratibhāsanam, sukhādinīlādeśca vicāryamāṇasyāyogāt, pratibhāsane'pi bhrāntatā iti cet; atrāha--sarvathā ityādi
atrāha pra jñā ka raḥ--pratibhāsamānasya vibhramāyogāt pratibhāsādvaitamastu iti; tatrāha--dhvanibhyaḥ ityādi
dhvanibhyaḥ padādivyañjakebhyo vācakaṃ sphoṭākhyaṃbhinnamarthāntarabhūtaṃ śraddheyaṃśraddhāgamyam na pramāṇagamyaṃ syāt
atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ--pratibhāsādvaitaṃ stambhādisvabhāvam, anyadvā syāt ? prathamapakṣe āha--yathādarśanam pra॰ vā॰ 2
357 ityādi parīkṣāyāḥ nimittaṃ na bhavati, jīvāditattvāpratikūlaṃ hi tat iti
tanna yuktam--ajñātārthaprakāśo vā iti pāramārthikaṃ pramāṇalakṣaṇam pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 30 iti
bahirantarjñeyayoḥ vidhipratiṣedhaikāntasaṃvṛtivādān parasparavilakṣaṇānavalambya kimapyākulaṃ kathayan kathaṃ svasthātmā nāma yato'yaṃ parīkṣakasamayamavatarati ?
nāsti bahirarthaḥ arthākārā nīlādyākārā, tatraiva lokasya artha iti vyavahārāt evamabhidhānam buddhirastīti yogācārāḥ
bahirapibuddhāvapi paramāṇvākāraparihāreṇa vyavasthitasya sthūlasya nīlākārasya asaṃbhavāt anākṛtiḥ na vidyate ākṛtiḥ nīlādyākāro yasyāḥ sā anākṛtiḥ buddhirasti ityanyaḥ tadviśeṣaḥ
arthadṛṣṭatayā tasyāpi kvacid bhrāntyā sahadarśanābhāvāt na tatastadanumānam ityasaṃbhāvyā'nanumeyetyevamā kula manavasthitatvaṃ kimataḥ param ? api tu idameva ākulatvam
bahirartho vicetano ghaṭādirastipramāṇavalābalaṃ vā vidyate, tathāpi nāsti bahirarthaḥ

buddhiranākṛtirasti tathāpi arthākārā saṃbhāvyā ahamahamikayā svasaṃvedanādhyakṣaniścebā tathāpyasaṃbhāvyā sukhādinīlādi vyatirekeṇa adhyavaseyetyevamākulam asambaddhaṃ vacanam kimataḥ param idameva pramāṇavāditābhidhānāt
bahirjñeyaṃ ghaṭādi antarjñeyaṃ buddhisukhādi tayoḥ pūrvaṃ vidhiśca punaḥ pratiṣedhaśca tāvekāntau ca saṃvṛtivādaśca tān
kim ? avalambya āśritya ākulamanavasthitam kimapi rūpādi skandhajātaṃ duḥkhādijātaṃ vā kathayan kathaṃ svasthātmā nāma yataḥ svasthātmatvādayaṃ saugataḥ parīkṣakasamayamavatarati
dvitīye tu vyākhyāne bahirantarjñeyayoḥ yo vidhiḥ svarūpādicatuṣṭayena, yaśca pratiṣedho viparyayeṇa bhāvenaikāntau pradhānadharmo tayoḥ saṃvṛtivādān kalpanāśilpitadharmabhedavacanaviśeṣāviti grāhyam
tarhi sarvasya vastuno vicāryamāṇaspādayogāt sakalaśūnyataiva bhavatviti cet; atrāha--etat vastubalāgatam ityādi
yasmāt kāraṇāt vastu ca itarajātaṃ vicāryamāṇam akhilaṃ niravaśeṣaṃ nāvasthitam
ca ityavadhāraṇe iti evamayaṃ dha rma kī rttiḥ loke'sminna avaveyavāk ādeyavacanaḥ kila mahākaṣṭaṃ praviṣṭaḥ kaliḥ
kiṃbhūto'sau ? ityāha--ekāntagrahena raktāḥ ta eva raktapaṭāśca vācālāśca taiḥ pūrvaṃ vipralambhaḥ vañcitaḥ paścādākulaḥ pramāṇaprameyavikalavacanāditi
iti ra vi bha dra pādopajīvi-a na nta vī rya viracitāyāṃ si ddhi vi ni śca ya ṭī kā yāṃ śabdasiddhirnavamaḥ prastāvaḥ
pramāṇasiddhividhānānantaraṃ nayasiddhiṃ vidhitsuḥ tadādau tadarthasaṃgrahavṛttamāha--jñātṝṇām ityādi
pramāṇena pratyakṣādinā svārthaṃ jānanti jñātāraḥ teṣām abhisandhayaḥ pramāṇapramitārthaikadeśāvasāyakalpāḥ khalu sphuṭaṃ nayāḥ
tadbhedamāha--te nayā dvedhā dvābhyāṃ prakārābhyāṃ vyavatiṣṭhata ityadhyāhāraḥ
dravyato dravyamāśritya paryāyataḥ paryāyāṇonāśritya dravyārthikaparyāyārthikanayā ityarthaḥ
dravyasvarūpamāha--dravyam anantaparyayapadam anantāḥ paryavasānarahitāḥ paryayāḥ paryāyāḥ pariṇāmā ityarthaḥ teṣāṃ padaṃ sthānam
upalakṣaṇametat--tena anādiparyayapadam ityapi grāhyam, anena nityaikarūpaṃ dravyamapāstam
tat paryāyāṇāṃ padam ityanena teṣāṃ svātantryaṃ niṣedhati
tadvaddravyasya kiṃ padam ? dravyāntaram iti cet; tasyāpi tadantaram ityanavasthā
svatantraṃ taditi cet; paryāyāḥ tathā satta viśeṣahetu bhāvāditi cet; uktamatra--citraikajñāne nīlādinirbhāsavat paratantrāṇāṃ sadā teṣāmavabhāsanāt tajjñānavadeva
na ca tasya avaśyam aparasthānānveṣaṇa nyāyopapannam

nanu yadā dravyādayo bhinnāḥ samavāyena ca tatra vartante, tadāpi teṣāṃ tatpadam, tatkuto'sya vyudāsa iti cet ? ata eva, dravyaparyāyasamavāyānām anyo'nyaṃ bhedaikānte kiṃ kasya padam iti na niścayaheturasti
paryāyasvarūpamāha--bhedātmakāḥ bhedaḥ parasparavyāvṛttiḥ ātmā svarūpaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ paryāyā iti pariyanti bhedam iti vyutpatteḥ
nanu paryāyā iti nipātanaṃ bādhakamiti tadasiddhiriti cet; na; paryāyārharṇotpattau vun jainendra॰ 2
36 iti nipātanaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ jñāpakam tadanityatvasya iti ubhayasiddheriti
teṣāṃ dravya-paryāyāṇāṃ stadviśca dravyasya śuddhiḥ paryāyanirākṛtiḥ, paryāyāṇāṃ śuddhiḥ teṣāṃ parasparāpekṣā, tayordvandvaikavadbhāvena napuṃstvahrasvādeśaḥ
tadeva tasya vā bhedataśca tayā dvedhā iti ghaṭanā
pṛrvaṃsunayāpekṣam, idaṃ tu sunayadurnayāpekṣaṃ dvaividhyam iti viśeṣaḥ
saptānāṃ nayānām ādau ādito ye catvāro naigamaprabhṛtayaḥ atra loke te arthāśrayāḥ arthapradhānāḥ śeṣāḥ śabdādayaḥ
kiyantaḥ ? trayaṃ ste kim ? ityāha— śabdataḥ śabdamāśritya pravartayanta iti
tulanā--ṇāṇaṃ hodi pamāṇaṃ ṇao vi ṇādussa hidayabhāvattho
jñānaṃ pramāṇamevetyucyamāne anabhimatenāpi prasajyeta akiñcitkarāderaticāraṇāt tadavisaṃvādaniyamābhāvāt, anadhigatārthādhigamalakṣaṇatvāt
nayasya pramāṇātmakatve pṛthag vacanamanarthakam, anyathā kathaṃ tenādhigamo nāma yataḥ pramāṇanayairadhigamaḥ pratipādyeta, tanna; tatastattvādhigamopapatteḥ tatparīkṣālakṣaṇatvānnayasya
jñānam iti vacanāt jñānameva iti draṣṭavyam, evamanyatrāpi, anyathā tadvacanamanarthakam, pramāṇam ityasya taṃ taṃ
nayamāha--etanmūlatvāt nayo jñātuḥ pramāṇavato matam abhiprāyaḥ mataḥ
kimarthaṃ pramāṇanayanirūpaṇamiti cet ? atrāha--tābhyāṃ pramāṇanayābhyām adhigamo nirṇayaḥ pramāṇanarayaidhigamaḥ ta॰ sū॰ 1
atra kimbhūtānām iti praśnasya uttareṇa dravyaparyāyaśālinām iti bhavitavyam
kiṃbhūtasya ? asaṃvidātmanaḥ matyajñānādeḥ vyudāso nirāsaḥ pramāṇatvena
nanu bhavatā atrānugamānusāriṇā jñānapadena matyajñānādikaṃ nirākriyate, saugatādinā abhrāntādipadena tataḥ tasmād bhavataḥ ko viśeṣa iti cet ? atrāha--kāra mityādi
syātkāramantareṇa matyajñānādeḥ kathaṃcit kenāpi tacchedakaviśeṣeṇaprakāreṇa vyudāse ityanena kāt sambandhaḥ
atra dūṣaṇam--abhimatātmanāpi saugatādibhiḥ yenātmanā svasaṃvedanādisvabhāvena matyajñānādeḥ prāmāṇyamabhimatam tenāpi na kevalaṃ dvicandrādirūpeṇa vyudasyeta matyajñānādiriti
na caivam, ataḥ sarvatra syātkāro'pekṣā iti bhāvaḥ
nanu jñāneprāmāṇyaṃniyatamupadarśitaṃ jñānaṃ tvaniyatam aprāmāṇyamapi gacchet; tanna yuktam matiśrutāvadhimanaḥparyakevalāni jñānam
9, 10 iti, iti cet; atrāha--jñānaṃ pramāṇameva ityubhayāvadhāraṇamatra iti bhāvaḥ
yato'yamarthaḥ--syātkāramantareṇa jñānaṃ pramāṇameva ityucyamāne yenātmanā tatpramāṇamanabhimataṃ parasya tenāpi prasajyeta pramāṇamiti
jāgraccittopādāna iti cet; samānasamayasuptapitrādi vidhopādānaḥ kuto nasyāt ? bhinnakālatvāt; itaratra samānam

bhinnasantānatvāt; anyatraikaḥ santāna iti kutaḥ ? upādānopādeyabhāvāt; anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ; tathāhi--vivakṣitajāgraccittaprabodhayoḥ ekasantānatve siddhe sati upādānopādeyabhāvaḥ, tatra sati ekasantānatvamiti
tadabhāvānteti cet; sa kuto mataḥ ? bhinnasantānatvāt; ayamaparo'nyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ--tadabhāve bhinnasantānatvam, ataśca tadabhāvaḥ
atha bhinnaśarīravarttitvāt na janakajāgraccittaṃ janyaprabodhopādānakāraṇam; tarhi suptaśarīracittāt svapnāntikaśarīracittaṃ tasmācca suptadehe cittam svāpaśarīraprabodhacittaṃ vā'cetanopādānaṃ syāt
kiṃca, devadattajāgratsuptaprabuddhaśarīraikatvaṃ bhedaikānte katham ? upādānopādeyabhāvāt; ata eva anyatrāpyastu
yadi punaḥ bhinnadeśayoḥ janakāpatyaśarīrayoḥ na upādānopādeyabhāvaḥ; suptasvapnāntikadehayorna syāt
anyatra suptasya anyatra prabodhaśca, cittayoḥ bhinnadeśayorapi upādānopādeyabhāvo na śarīrayoḥ iti cintyametat
syānmatam--pitṛśarīre tadavastha eva tataḥ katham upādeyamapatyaśarīraṃ jāyata iti; kathaṃ suptaśarīre taducchvāsādau vā tadavasthe svapnāntikaśarīrocchvāsādikam ? tanna kiñcidetat
tathāhi— ruṣṭasya suptasya mūrcchitasya vā tadanurūpa eva prabodho lakṣyate, punaḥ śastrādigrahaṇādinā iti; tanna; niyamābhāvāt
kadācit prasannasya vyāmohavato vā prabodhasya darśanāt
tathāhi--garbhe śukraśoṇitasaṃpātānantaraṃ kutaścin mṛte pitari kālāntarādau punarapatyaṃ jāyamānaṃ cetasāpi tadanukāri pratīyate
api ca, yadi dīrghakālavyavahitamapi upādānakāraṇam; jñānasya ālambanakāraṇaṃ tathāvidhaṃ kinna syāt ? bhavatu ko doṣa iti cet; bhrāntyabhāvaḥ, taimirike anyadeśādeḥ keśoṇḍukādeḥ pratibhāsanāt
vyavahārī naivaṃ manyate iti cet; vyavahitāt jāgraccittātprabodhamapyasauna manyata iti samānam
na hi suptasya vyavahārī mṛtavyavahāra nā ca caśati kintu viśiṣṭākāradarśanāt caitanyamanuminoti
svayamanupalakṣitaṃ tattatra kathamastīti cet ? mānasamadhyakṣaṃ tathāvidhaṃ kathamasti ? yathā tat āgame paṭhyate tathā svāpādicetanāpi
sokṣyaṃ sopagat manupalakṣitam asti iti vadati na paropagatamiti svecchācārī
nanu nīlamidaṃ pītamidamiti nirṇayātmakaṃ mānasaṃ pratyakṣaṃ lakṣitamevāste ityaparaḥ; uktamatra— indriyavyāpāradaśāyāṃ tatkalpaneindriyajameva tat ityasyaiva nāmāntarakaraṇam
na ca anyā rūpādyavabhāsinī daśā'sti, yatkalpanā syāt
satyasvapnadaśā iti cet; tatra tarhi pūrvaṃ paścāt cākṣuṣavyāpārāpratīteḥ indriyajñānena janitam nyāyabi॰ 1

kathamevaṃ yogipratyakṣaṃ tatpratyakṣaṃ na syāt ? atha abhyāsadaśāyāṃ mānasaṃ tadiṣyate; tatredaṃ cintyate--prāpyabhāviviṣayam, varttamānaviṣayaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe tadeva tatra pramāṇaṃ nendriyajamiti aprāmāṇyamasya vikalpavat
apica, vartamāne akṣāṇāṃ vyāpāraḥ tatra mānasam, bhāvini na tadvyāpāraḥ tatra indriyajam iti vyāghāto mahāniti
syānmatam--indriyavyāpārāvasthāyāṃ pratyakṣadvayaṃ mānasam indriyajaṃ ca sadā pravarttate iti; tarhi naiyāyikasyeva saugatasyāpi asya sarvadā dviḥpratibhāsaṃbhavet rūpādīnām
atha manuṣe yaduta anirṇayātmanā mānasesi tiraskārādindriyajñānamavikalpamanupalakṣitamāste tathā svāpādisaṃvedanaṃ tathāvidhaṃ middhaditiraskṛtamastu iti sādhūktam--svāpādibodhaḥ iti
sa ādiryasya saṃśayaviparyāsakarasya sa tathoktaḥ tasyāticāraṇāt vijñānābhimatātmanāpi prasajyeta iti
bhavatu tasyāpi prāmāṇyamiti cet; atrāha--tad ityādi
tasya akiñcitkarādeḥ avisaṃvādasya niyamena avaśyaṃbhāvena asaṃbhavāt
bhavatu tadasaṃbhavaḥ, tathāpi tasya prāmāṇyam ajñātārthaprakāśanāditi cet; atrāha--anadhigata ityādi
nayojñāturmataṃ mataḥ iti na vyācaṣṭe sugamatvāt
kevalaṃ tatra codyaṃ pariharttuṃ kurvannāha--nayasya ityādi
nayasya pramāṇātmakatve pṛthak vacanamanarthakam, jñānaṃ pramāṇam ityetāvadeva vaktavyam tathā ca paraikavākyatā

tasya tadātmakatvaṃ nāsti, tataḥ pṛthagvacanamiti cet; atrāha--anyathā pramāṇātmakatvābhāvaprakāreṇa kathaṃ tena nayenādhigamo nāma svārthavyavasāyo nāma yatastena adhigamāt pramāṇanayairadhigamaḥ tattvārthasū॰ 1
6 pratipādyeta ta ttvā rtha sū tra kṛ tā
nahi apramāṇena kasyacidadhigamaḥ, pramāṇaparīkṣānarthakyaprāpteḥ iti bhāvaḥ
yaduktaṃ pareṇa tanna; kutaḥ ? ityāha--tato nayāt tattvasya jīvādeḥ adhigamopapatteḥ
etadapi kutaḥ ? ityāha--tatparīkṣālakṣaṇatvāt tasya jīvādeḥ parīkṣā vicāraḥ saiva lakṣaṇaṃ svarūpaṃ yasya tasya bhāvāt tattvāt nayasya iti, tataḥ tadadhigamopapattiḥ
dravyārthikaparyāyārthikayoḥ nayayoḥ dvayena dvayasya vā vicāre sati paramārthapratipatteḥ paramārthasya paramārthā vā pratipattiḥ tasyāḥ avirodhāt
nanu yadi tataḥ tadadhigatiḥ; tarhi pramāṇatvāpattistasya tallakṣaṇatvāt
tathā ca antyacodyaparihāro nānyasya iti cet; atrāha--syāt pramāṇātmakatve'pi ityādi
svayaṃ sākṣātkṛte'pi vivādadarśanāt punaḥ ūhāpohābhiprāyamantareṇa na tatra tattvābhiprāyābhiniveśaḥ yataḥ sarvatra tadanuṣṭhānam
pratyakṣopalambhasya parīkṣetarayoraviśeṣāt, tāvatā'rthasiddhau na kasyacittattvajñānaṃ syāt
samāne'pi sākṣātkaraṇe abhiprāyabhedāt tattvetarābhiniveśopapatteḥ tanniṣṭhatvāt parīkṣāyāḥ
syāt bhavet pramāṇabhāvaḥ pramāṇāt anekāntagrahaṇarūpāt prabhava utpādo yasya sa tathoktaḥ tato bhinna ityarthaḥ, hetuphalayoḥ kathaṃcidbhedāt
nayasya tadātmakatvaṃ kutaḥ ? ityāha--nirṇayopāyo nayo gataḥ
nanu pratyakṣāderapi savikalpakavādino vicāro bhavati, tato'sya ko viśeṣa iti cet ? atrāha--parīkṣati parīkṣā iti nityaḥ kṣaṇiko vā bhāvaḥ anena prakāreṇeti yā parīkṣā sā nayeityevamavagamyatām
syānmatam--pramāṇaparicchinnārthaikadeśe nayaḥ, tasya ca pramāṇata eva siddheḥ, nahi samudāyāḥ tadekadeśasiddhimantareṇa sidhyanti
vṛkṣaḥ pracalan sahāvayavaiḥ pracalati, tataḥ kiṃ tatra nayena iti ? tatrāha--svayam ityādi

svayaṃ pratipatrā sākṣātkṛte'pi upalakṣaṇa metat, tenā'bhihite'pi anumite'pi vivādadarśanād vastuni punaḥ paścāt ūhāpohābhiprāyamantareṇa nutatra tattvābhiprāyayābhiniveśaḥ tattvaruciryataḥ tadanuṣṭhānaṃ sarvatra bahirantaśca iti

pratyakṣameva atiprasaṅgaṃ nivārayatīti cet; atrāha--pratyakṣopalambhasya pratyakṣeṇa darśanasya parīkṣetarayoraviśeṣāt kāraṇāt tāvatātadupalambhamātretyaivārthasiddhau aṅgīkriyamāṇāyāṃ tattvajñānaṃ na kasyacit parīkṣakasya itarasya vā syāt itarasmāt parīkṣako na bhidyeteti parīkṣā'narthikā bhavet iti yāvat
paraḥ pṛcchati--kutaḥ kāraṇāt punaḥ tattvajñānamanyadvā'tattvajñānaṃ vā ityevaṃ cet ? atrottaramāha--sunayadurṇayābhyām iti
saugatādivadetaditi cet; atrāha--samāne'pi jainaikāntavādinoḥ sākṣātkaraṇe abhiprāyabhedāt abhiprāyasya jñāvabhisattveḥ arthānusāritvetaratvakṛtaviśeṣāt tattvetarābhiniveśopapatteḥ
sadeva satsyāt saditi tridhārtho mīyeta durnītinayapramāṇaiḥ
tatra nayasāmānyalakṣaṇe, mūlanayau naigamādiprakṛtibhūtanayau dravyaparyāyārthau dravyaṃ paryāyaśca artho gocaro yayoḥ tau tathoktau--dravyārthodravyārthikaḥ paryāyārthi paryāyārthika ityarthaḥ
mithyātvaṃ tayoḥ nirapekṣatve parasparāpekṣābhāvo samyaktvaṃ tadviparyaye nirapekṣatvaviṣaye sāpekṣatvaviṣaye sāpekṣatva ityarthaḥ
tamhā savve vi ṇayā micchādiṭṭhī sapakkhapaḍibaddhā
ya eva nityakṣaṇikādayo nayāḥ mitho'napekṣāḥ svaparapraṇāśinaḥ
ta eva tattvaṃ vimalasya te muneḥ parasparekṣāḥ svaparopakāriṇaḥ
keṣāmiti kiṃ viṣayā sā ? ityāha--bhedābhedapratiṣṭhā bhedobhedayoḥ viśeṣasāmānyayoḥ pratiṣṭhā sthitiryasyāḥ, dravyaparyāyaviṣayadvaividhyāt nayadvaividhyamāha
tatra tasmin nayasvarūpatadbhede sati anyo'nyaṃ parasparaṃ dravyayaryau ravinābhāvasya pratipattiryasyāṃ parīkṣāyāṃ sā anyo'nyāvinābhāvapratipattiḥ
sā kim ? ityāha--pramāṇaṃ munaya iti yāvat
mithyātva mityādya yadi sati terathā tvamityādi vyācaṣṭe--itarathā anyo'nyāvinābhāvapratipattiprakāreṇa itarathā na pramāṇaparīkṣā iti
satyeva vidyamāna eva paryāyārthikasyadravyedravyārthikasya paryāye asattvapratipatteḥ na pramāṇam
dravyārthikasya dravyaviṣayapradhānābhiprāyasya paryāyāḥ sthāsaśivikādibhedāḥ satyeva atra vidyanta eva, tadabhāve dravyasyāpyabhāvaḥ ityuktam
nayapramāṇayoraviśeṣaḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--avivakṣitā guṇībhūtāste tasya santi, pramāṇe tūbhayaṃ pradhānamiti vibhāgaḥ
yadi dravyārthikasya paryāyāḥ santi paryāyārthikasya dravyam, kathaṃ satpratikṣepa iti cet ? atrāha--saṃvidām ityādi
aviśeṣeṇa guṇaparyāyeṣu mithyātvapratipattyā dravyārthāvadhāraṇaṃ kvacit keṣucit vā pratyabhijñāvisaṃvādāt sarveṇa tadvisaṃvādāt paryāyāvadhāraṇaṃ ca durṇayaḥ tattvapratikṣepāt
nahi ekasya anekaṃ rūpaṃ paramārthasat yuktam, virodhāt
vibhrāmyatīti vibhramaḥ pācādilakṣaṇo'ta pratibhāso yeṣāṃ mantrādyupaplutopalabdhamṛcchakalādīnāṃ teṣu
prasiddhaḥ parīkṣaketaralokavikhyāto vitatho'satyaḥ ātmā yeṣāṃ teṣu iti
tathāhi--antaḥ saṃvitsukhādibhedaḥ bahiśca ghaṭapaṭādibhedaḥ mithyā bhinnapratibhāsavedyatvāt grāhyādyākāradvicandrādibhedavaditi
tayākim ? ityāha--tayāmithyātvapratipattyā dravyārthāvadhāraṇaṃ dravyameva arthaḥ tasya avadhāraṇam--tadeva astīti
evammanyate--yathā grāhyādyākārabhrame'pi na svasaṃvedanabhramaḥ svapnādibhrāntāvapi na jāgradbhrāntiḥ tathā sakalabhedavibhrame'pi na sattāmātrabhrāntiḥ

tato yaduktaṃ pra jñā ka re ṇa— pratibhāsane'pi sukhādinīlādeḥ vitathatve dravye kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ ? iti; tannirastam; kvacid bahirantarvā keṣucit vā arthāntareṣu lūnapunarjātanakhādiṣu pratyabhijñāvisaṃvādāt sarveṇa deśāntarādiprakāreṇa tadvisaṃvādāt paryāyāvadhāraṇaṃ ca
pūrvo dravyārthikanayābhāsaḥ paraḥ paryāyārthikanayābhāsa iti bhāvaḥ
nākārabhedo na rūpādiḥ na kramo na sukhādayaḥ || 7
na khalu vijñānaṃ sadbhāvaṃ vyabhicarati viśeṣeṣu vyabhicārāt
na caivaṃ bhedāvyabhicāri jñānamasti iti śuddhadravyaprarūpaṇāt
paryāyanirākaraṇāt durṇayaḥ yathā ārāmaṃ tasya paśyanti na taṃ paśyati kaścana bṛhadā॰ 4
śuddhaparyāyanayaḥ punaḥ yadi svabhāvabhede'pi bhāvaikatvaṃ na kvacit kathañcinnānātvaṃ sarvathā advaitaprasaṅgāt iti sarvathā dravyapratikṣepe paryāya prarūpaṇakramo'yaṃ durṇayaḥ
yadvā naikaṃ gamo yo'tra sa satāṃ naigamo mataḥ
śuddhaṃ paryāyamalakalaṅkavikalaṃ dravyameva artho'syāstīti śuddhadravyārthikaḥ tasyāsti
kim ? ityāha--sanmātraṃ paramārthato na saṃvṛtyā, nākārabhedo'sti na grāhyādiviśeṣaḥ sthūlādiviśeṣo vā na rūpādiḥ na kramo hetuphalabhāvo na sukhādayaḥ paramārthataḥ, api tu saṃvṛtyā iti
kārikāṃ vivṛṇvannāha--na khalu vijñānaṃ sadbhāvaṃ sattvaṃ vyabhicarati
tarhi vijñānaṃ viśeṣamapi na vyabhicarati iti cet; atrāha--na caivam ityādi
evaṃ sanmātrasya tadviśeṣāvinābhāvāt bhedāvyabhicāri nā jñānamasti tatra vyabhicārapratipādanāt ityevaṃ śuddhadravyaprarūpaṇāt
nidarśanamāha-- yathetyāgama māṭopaṃ tasya sattāmātradravyasya paśyanti janāḥ na taṃ sadbhāvaṃ kaścana paśyatīti tadāśrayaṃ sanmātrāśrayadarśanāntaram
ārāmaṃ tasya paśyanti na tat paśyati kaścana
svabhāvabhede'pi svarūpanānātve'pi yadi bhāvaikatvaṃ na kvacit paṭādau kathaṃcid deśādibhedaprakāreṇa nānātvam, kutaḥ ? ityāha--sarvathā sarveṇa ghaṭādiprakāreṇa advaitaprasaṅgāt
sarveṇa deśādiprakāreṇa anayoḥ dravyaparyāyayoḥ atādātmyāt naigamaḥ tamāśritya darśanāntaraṃ vaiśeṣikamatam
dravyaparyāyayoravivakṣitaṃ sadapi nārpitaṃ yat tādātmyaṃ tallakṣaṇatvāt naigamanayasya
dravyārthikanayamāśritya dravyasya tatsaṃkhyādeḥ sāmānyasamavāyānāṃ ca nityatvaṃ śeṣāṇāmanityatvaṃ ca kecinnigacchanti kāryadravyakarmaguṇaviśeṣāṇāmanityatvābhyupagamāt
na tat sāmānyaṃ vastvantarameva yuktam, saṃvidāṃ viṣayasārūpyamiva
na hi vastvantarabhedā bhāvāḥ tadvantaḥ nāma syuḥ
na tādṛśasya kvacid vṛttiḥ kvacidavṛttiḥ vā
sadādipratyayakartṛtvamakartṛtvaṃ ca kvacit kadācit kathaṃcinna saṃbhāvyam
svaviṣayasarvagatatve niṣkriyasya prāk tatrāsatāṃ arthotpitsudeśaprāptirna syāt
sāmānyāni ca samavāyaśca teṣām ātmādīnām vā ādiśabdāt atmavyatiriktasakalamūladravyaparigrahaḥ
taṃta eva nityadravyeṣu varttamānasya saṃkhyādeḥ nityatvaṃ saṃkhyādinityatvam
nityatve bhāvānāṃ dravyārthikasyaiva vyāpāro na naigamasya anyathābhūtatvāt ato dravyārthikanayamāśritya ityucyate
dravyasya ātmādeḥ tatsaṃkhyādeḥ sāmānyasamavāyānāṃ ca nityatvam śeṣāṇām anityatvaṃ ca, ca ityavadhāraṇe sāmānyādiṣu kecana naiyāyikādayo nigacchanti pratipadyante
kutaḥ śeṣāṇā ne hā ha kāryadravya ityādi

kāryadravyam prāgasat sattāsamavāyikāraṇa samavāyi yā dravyam, karma utkṣepaṇādi guṇaviśeṣāḥ kāryadravyagatāḥ sarve rūpādayaḥ nityadravyagatāḥ saṃkhyādibhyo'nye buddhyādiraktādayaḥ teṣām anityatvābhyupagamāt
teṣu sāmānyādiṣu madhye samānānāṃ sadṛśānāṃ bhāvaḥ sāmānyam tad viśeṣebhyo bhinnameva iti yaugāḥ
tatrāha--na tat sāmānyaṃ vastvantarameva vyaktibhyo bhinnameva yuktaṃ kathañcidbhinnaṃ tu yuktam iti evakāreṇa darśayati ekatra pramāṇābhāvād anyatra viparyayāt
kathaṃ tattarhi iti saugataḥ; tatrāha--saṃvidām ityādi
saṃvidāṃ jñānānāmiva viṣayasārūpyaṃ yathā jñānānāṃ viṣayeṇa sārūpyaṃ tathā sāmānyamiti vicāritamasakṛta
kuto na tad vastvantarameva iti cet ? atrāha--nahi ityādi
hi yasmāt na vastvantareṇa bhedāḥ parasparavilakṣaṇā bhāvāḥ samānā itarathā candramasaikena sarve'pi uḍuviśeṣāḥ samānā iti na teṣu tāropati pratyayaḥ
syānmatam--na teṣu vidhurvartate, sāmānyaṃ tu svapi śeṣavṛtti, tato'yamadoṣa iti; tatrāha--tadvantaḥ sāmānyavanto bhedā nāma syuḥ
yathā avyavannagaraṃ tadvanta eva iti cet; atrāha--kathaṃ ca ityādi
kena ca prakāreṇa na kenacid upakāryopakārakabhāvamantareṇa vastvantareṇa tadvattvam atiprasaṅgāt vindhyasya sādhyena tadvattā syādityatiprasaṅgaḥ
nanu bhavanmate--rūpatadvijñānayoḥ upakāryopakārakabhāvamantareṇāpi bhavati tadvattā rūpasya jñānam
atha tatra ayameva tadbhāvo yo grāhyagrāhakabhāvaḥ; jātivyaktyorapi prakāśyaprakāśakabhāva eva tadbhāvo'stu
jātyā vā vyaktīnāmupakāraḥ--tatra viśiṣṭabuddhijananamiti cet; atrāha--apariṇāmino nityaikarūpasya sāmānyādeḥ tāvadvastutvameva sattvameva na saṃbhāvyaṃ pramāṇābhāvāt
nahi khaṇḍādibhyo bhinnasya nityasya niraṃśasya amūrttasya sāmānyasya pratītirasti yataḥ tasya tā vyañjikāḥ syuḥ, sadṛśātmanāṃ tāsāṃ svabuddhau pratibhāsanāt
nāpi sāmānyaṃ tathāvidhaṃ tāsu pratyayaviśeṣamupajanayadupalabdhayena tāvatā dupaka mucyate, pariṇāmino bhāvasya svayaṃ cakṣurādipratyaye prathānāt
atha mataṃ ropakāryopakārakabhāvād bhedānāṃ tadvattamapi tu sāmānyasya tatra samavāyāditi; tatrāha--tādṛśasya ityādi
tādṛśasya asaṃbhāvitavastutvasya kvacit śāvaleyādau vṛttiḥ samavāyaḥ sambandhaḥ kvacit karkādāvavṛttiḥ na saṃbhāvyā iti sambandhaḥ
yadi hi tādṛśaṃ tadupalabdhaṃ bhavet tadā tat kvacidvarttate na vā iti kalpanamarhati, nānyathā vandhyāsutavat
yadā hi tadvarttamānaṃ tatropalabdhaṃ bhavati tadā iha jātirvarttate iti pratyayāt tadyuktaṃ na vā
evaṃ kadācit piṇḍotpattisamaye vṛttiḥ tadvināśasamaye avṛttiḥ na saṃbhāvyā
nanu piṇḍa eva utpadyate vinaśyati vā na sāmānyaṃ samavāyo vā, na vā'nyasya utpattyāderanyat tadvat; atiprasaṅgāt

ato yathā kartṛtvākartṛtvabhāve'pi na tadbhedaḥ tathā vṛttyavṛttibhāve'pi iti cet; na sadetat; yataḥ pūrvarūpāparityāge idamiha varttate na varttate ceti tataḥ pratyayāyogāt, sarvadā vā tatpratyayaprasavaḥ, nityasya apekṣāyogāt
nanvekasya sadādipratyayakartṛtvākartṛtvavat vṛttyavṛttī syātāmiti cet; atrāha— sadādi ityādi
sadādiryasya dravyaguṇādeḥ tasya pratyayaḥ tasya kartṛtvaṃ akartṛtvaṃ ca kvacit kadācit kathaṃcinna saṃbhāvyam ityevaṃ durṇayaḥ
kiṃca, sāmānyaṃ sarvagatam, svavyaktisarvagataṃ vā bhavet ? prathamapakṣe dūṣaṇamāha--sattāvat mahāsāmānyavat jātyantarāṇyaṃgotvādīnāṃ sarvagatatve aṅgīkriyamāṇe vṛttipratyayasaṅkaraḥ
yathā gotvasya khaṇḍādau vṛttiḥ sayavāyathādadittvāderiti vṛttisaṃkaraḥ, tata eva tatra gopratyayavat davyādipratyayo'pi syāditi pratyayasaṅkaraḥ
svaviṣayasarvagatatve svagocare vyaktivyāpitve kriyāvattvamantareṇa niṣkriyasya ityarthaḥ
artho dravyādiḥ upitsuryasmin deśe sa tathoktaḥ, kāmacāreṇa viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ iti utpitsupadasya viśeṣyatvaṃ sa cāsau deśaśca tatpraptiḥprāgutpatteḥ pūrvaṃ tatra deśe'satāṃ jātyantarāṇāṃ na syāt
taduktaṃ sa ma nta bha dra svā mi bhiḥ--
antareṇāśrayaṃ na syāt nāśotpādiṣu ko vidhiḥ
ataśca na tad vastvantarameva yuktamiti darśayannāha--satsvabhāvopalabdhau ityādi
yadi punaḥ syāt svapakṣaghātī kathamanunmattaḥ ? kaśca dravyādīnāṃ svataḥ parato vā sadbhāve viśeṣaḥ yataḥ sattāsambandhena artho viśeṣyeta

satsvabhāvaḥ svarūpaṃ yeṣāṃ te satsvabhāvāḥ ghaṭādayaḥ, anena sattātadvatorvyaṃtirekaṃ pratyācaṣṭe, teṣāmupalabdhau darśane sati, anenāpi khaṇḍādau gaurgauriti jñānaṃ bhinnaviśeṣaṇanimittaṃ svayam anyathābhūte anyathā jñānatvāt puruṣe daṇḍīti jñānavat iti hetoḥ vyabhicāraṃ darśayati
santo ghaṭādayaḥ iti jñānasya bhinnaviśeṣaṇamantareṇāpi bhāvāt
tatrāpi bhinnasattā dipyata iti cet; atrāha--kiṃ na kiṃcit sattayā bhinnasattāsambandhena ityarthaḥ
nanu svataḥ satāṃ tatsambandhe syādayaṃ doṣo nā'satāmiti cet; atrāha--asatāṃ ca sattayā'bhisambandhe aṅgīkriyamāṇe nābhāvaḥ kasyacit śaśaviṣāṇādeḥ kvacid deśādau bhavet ityupaskāraḥ
antyaviśeṣaṇa grahaṇaṃ kuto neti cet ? keṣāmatyantaparokṣatvena parairabhyupagamāt
