atha yogināṃ vyāpakadravyeṣu bhedabuddhiryannimittā te'ntyā viśeṣāḥ; na; teṣu svayameva tadbuddhibhāvāt, anyathā tatrāpi teṣāṃ tadbuddhiraparatatpūrvikā ityanavasthā
nanu sāmānyādayo na svataḥ, nāpi parataḥ sattāsāmānye tadantarābhāvāt tatkathaṃ te nidarśanamiti cet ? atrāha--yadi punaḥ ityādi
sugamamuttaramatra svapakṣaghātī vaiśeṣikādiḥ kathamanunmattaḥ unmatta eva
kutaḥ ? ityāha--svataḥ parato vā syāt yato viśeṣāt sattāsambandhena artho dravyādiḥ viśiṣyeta
tathāhi--guṇadoṣadarśanābhyāṃ kvacit pakṣapātetarau satāṃ yuktau, nānyathā
na ca svataḥ sadbhāve arthasya doṣam leśasyāpi darśanam
tathā'darśanameva taddarśanamiti cet; kiṃ punaḥ svato'satāṃ śaśaśṛṅgādīnāṃ darśanamasti ? virodhāt
syānmatam--arthasya svataḥsadbhāve aparasāmānyābhāvaḥ sattādivat syāditi; na; uktamatra--citratvādbhāvānām
kasyacit svataḥ sato'parajātiḥ na śabdasya tathā'darśanāt guṇādiyogavat
nanu na sarvasya svato'sato darśanamiṣyate kintu sattāsambandhina iti cet; atrāha— yadi punaḥ ityādi
upalakṣaṇametat vyāpitvāt ca utsannā naṣṭā idānīmabhāvavārttā kharaviṣāṇādīnāmapi sattvāpatteḥ, yata evaṃ tanneyaṃ parakīyā vācoyuktirupapadyate ityupasaṃhāraḥ
sattāyāmiva sāmānyāntareṣu dravyatvādiṣu ayam anantaraḥ samānaścarcaḥ parīkṣā
tathāhi--jīvādīnāṃ dravyādisvabhāvopalabdhau kiṃ dravyatvādinā bhinnena ? svayamadravyādīnāṃ dravyatvādyadisambandhe nādravyādiḥ kaścit syāt
sāṃprataṃ sāṃkhya naigamābhāsaṃ darśayannāha--dravyaṃ śuddham ityādi

cicchakterātmano'darśitaviṣayavato nānātvamekatvaṃ ca mamāśritya pradhānaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvamāsādya mahadādikrameṇa vivartamānamātmānaṃ tadarthaṃ samarpayati iti naigamo durṇayaḥ, pradhānapuruṣayoḥ pariṇāmasvabhāvavyavasthāpanāt
pradhānasya puruṣārthipravṛttisaṃbhavena anīśvarabhedaḥ tatpravṛtterasaṃbhavena seśvarabhedaḥ; apariṇāminaścaitanyasya vastutvaṃ pratyuktam sāmānyādinā
harṣaviṣādādyanekākāravivartajñānavṛtteḥ prakṛteraparāṃ caitanyavṛttiṃ kaḥ prekṣāvān pratijānīte ? anupayogāt
puruṣasya bhoktṛsvabhāvanityātve prakṛteḥ bhogyātmano nityatve sati tatpravṛttinivṛttī iti duranvayam
prakṛteḥ pariṇāme vā cicchakterapi vivartaḥ taddarśitaviṣayatvāt
acetanabhedānāṃ sukhaduḥkhamehātmakapradhānamityabhidhānātmā jātiḥ prakṛtireva, na punaḥ sarvapuruṣāṇāṃ saṃvedanajātiḥ sāmānyamiti duranvayametat
dravyaṃ puruṣarūpam, kiṃbhūtam ? śuddham sukhādibhedarahitam aśuddhaṃ ca mahadādiparyāyaparikaritaṃ dravyaṃ pradhānalakṣaṇaṃ saṃśritya anyo naiyāyiko naigamāt bhinno'sti naigamaḥ citpuruṣaḥ
kathamasti iha ? yathā yena pramāṇānupapannatvaprakāreṇa lakṣyeta niścīyeta durṇayaḥ tathāsti
kiṃbhūtasya ? ityāha--cicchakteḥ cit cetanā śaktiḥ svabhāvo yasya tasya cicchakteḥ caitanyaṃ ṣuruṣasya svarūpam yogabhā॰ 1
kim ? ityāha--nānātvam puruṣabahutvaṃ siddham sāṃkhyakā॰ 18ityādivacanāt tridaṇḍimatat
tat pradhānam ekapuruṣam ekapuruṣabhogyam anekapuruṣam anekapuruṣabhogyam ityarthaḥ
punarapi pradhānabhedaṃ kathayannāha--anīśvaretarabhedād bhidyate iti tat ityanuvarttate
kutaḥ ? anīśvarabhedāt na vidyate īśvaraḥ pravarttako yasya vatsavivṛddhinimittaṃ te cetanaṃ yathā kṣīram ityādi vacanāt, tasyaviśeṣāt
itarabhedāt śaśvadaviśeṣāt ajño janturanīśo'yam mahā॰ vanaparva 30
pradhānasya vicetanasya ṣuruṣārthipravṛtteḥ saṃbhavena svataḥ ityadhyāhāro'nīśvarabhedaḥ tatpravṛtterasaṃbhavena seśvarabhedaḥ
kutaḥ sa durṇayaḥ ityadhyāhāraḥ ? apariṇāmina ityādi
pariṇāmavikalasya caitanyasya puruṣasya vastutvaṃ pratyuktam apākṛtam
na kevalametadeva pratyuktam api tu paramapi ityāha--kādācitkam iti hetoḥ
na hi apariṇāmina ekadā viṣayānubhavanam, anyadā tadviparyayo yukta iti vicāritam
eka eva hi bhūtātmā...ekadhā bahudhā caiva...--tri॰ tā॰ 5
īśvaraprerito gacchet śvabhraṃ vā svargameva vā
adhunā caitanyasya sato'pi vaiphalyaṃ darśayannāha--harṣa ityādi
prakṛteḥ sakāśādaparām anyāṃ caitanyavṛttiṃ viṣayānubhavalakṣaṇāṃ kaḥ prekṣāvān pramāṇikaḥ pratijānīte
kiṃbhūtāyāḥ prakṛteḥ ? ityāha--harṣaviṣādādyanekākāro vivarttaḥ pariṇāmo yasya tattathoktam tacca tajjñānaṃ ca tadeva vṛttiḥ varttanaṃ yasyāḥ tasyā iti
kuto na pratijānīte ? ityāha--anupayogāt caitanyaśakteḥ kvacid vyāpārābhāvāt, tatprayojanasya prakṛtyā karaṇāt
viśeṣataḥ ityādinā punarapi tatra doṣaṃ yojayannāha--viśeṣeṇa viśeṣataḥ

anena pūrvadoṣādasya atiśayamāha--prakṛtyā darśito darśanagocaratāṃ nīto yo viṣayaḥ tadvataḥ tadanubhavataḥ puruṣasya avikāritvaṃ duranvayam apramāṇam, evaṃ manyate--sarasi aparāparatārānikurumbasyeva puṃsi prakṛtidarśitā'parāparaviṣayaṃpratibhāsanameva tasyāvikāritvamiti yuktaṃ yadi tatra pramāṇaṃ pravartteta, vacanamātrakāttadasiddhiriti

paramapi tatra duranvayaṃ kathayannāha--to kṛtsvabhāvanityatve darśanarūpanityatve puruṣasya prakṛterbhogyātmano dṛśyabhāvasya nityatve sati tasyāḥ pravṛttiḥ saṃsāradaśāyāṃ nivṛttiḥ nirvāṇe iti duranvayametat, sarvadā darśanamadarśanaṃ vā syāditi bhāvaḥ
prakṛteḥ pariṇāme vā bhogyasvabhāvaparihāreṇa abhogyasvabhāvavikāre vā cicchakterapi puruṣasyāpi vivarttaḥ bhoktṛsvabhāvaparihāreṇa abhoktṛsvabhāvapariṇāmaḥ
tayā prakṛtyā darśito viṣayaḥ sa yasyāsti tasya bhāvāt tattvāt
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā yadā puruṣeṇa yujyeta prakṛtiḥ tadaiva tasyā bhogyatā nānyadā, tathā yadā prakṛtyā puṃso viṣayaḥ pradarśyate tadaiva tasya bhoktṛtā, viśeṣābhāvāditi
evaṃ puruṣaṃ nirākṛtya adhunā prakṛtiṃ nirākurvannāha--sukha ityādi
keṣām ? ityāha--acetanabhedānām na punaḥ saṃvedanajātiḥ sarvapuruṣāṇāṃ sāmānyamiti duranvayametat
vinā...vyāpitve...bhāvasyaiva sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvopapatteḥ samavāyiviśeṣāt; sattāsamavāyinorbhedaikānte ayamapi paraḥ naigamo durṇayaḥ
sattāyāḥ samavāyo yeṣāmasti dravyādikhaṇḍādīnāṃ te samavāyinaḥ, teṣāṃ te vā viśeṣāḥ tairiti
tāṃ prātipadikārthaṃ ca dhātvarthaṃ ca pracakṣate
sā nityā sā mahānātmā yāmāhuḥ tvatalādayaḥ || vākyapa॰ 3 | 34 iti
nanu yatraavāntaregotvādijātayaḥ samavetāḥ tatraiva sattā, tasmādekārthasamavāyāt sā tadvyapadeśabhāgiti cet; atrāha--vinā ityādi
nanu yaugapakṣopakṣiptamatra dūṣaṇaṃ kuto neti cet ? atrāha--vyāpitve ityādi
doṣānuṣaṅga eva na bhavati ekasāmānyavādināṃ sattājātivādinām
kutaḥ ? ityāha--bhāvasyaiva sattāyā eva sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvopapatteḥ dravyatvagotvādisāmānyabhedopapatteḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha--samavāyiviśeṣāt soṇādivyapadeśabhākta vā prakṛtāpi iti sattāsamavāyinorbhedaikānte ayamapi durṇayaḥ
pūrvavidhinā ata eva uktam tathā tena prakāreṇa paro'nyo naigamo durṇaya iti
saṃprati saugatena naigamasya sarvasya durṇayatvaṃ cintitaṃ dūṣayannāha--sattām ityādi
yena...iti yat codyaṃ tat saṃvidāṃ viṣayākārapratipattāvapi sāmānam
yad yasmād yogyatāviśeṣāt vvaktayo viśeṣāḥ bibhrate dhārayanti
kim ? sattāṃ jātyantaraṃ vā gotvādikaṃ tasmāt yogyatāviśeṣāt jñānaśabdakṛto'nugatajñānābhidhānapravṛttihetavaḥ satta vyaktayaḥ ityevaṃ codyam arthākāre rūpādilakṣaṇe grāhye vidāṃ buddhīnāṃ samam
tathāhi--yataḥ paṭādayo'rthāḥ rūpādīn bibhrate tata eva svayamatadātmāno rūpādibuddhihetavo bhaviṣyantīti kiṃ rūpādikalpanayā ? iti nirākārārthasiddhiḥ
atha rūpādyātmako'rthaḥ pratīyate; sāmānyātmako'pi pratīyate iti samānam
iti evaṃ yaccādyaṃ na saṃvidāṃ viṣayākārapratipattāvapi samānam anyatrāpi asakṛduktametat
tathāhi— saṃvido yataḥ svasaṃveda yataḥ svasaṃvedanātmatāṃ svīkurvanti tata eva atadātmikā suthāvabhāsanta ityapi syāt
tadeva naigamaṃ tadābhāsaṃ ca pratipādya saṃgrahanayaṃ pratipādayannāha--āyāsādvā ityādi
sa eva bhedasaṃvyavahārān kevalo na karoti kim || 13
bhedavādino'pi niraṃśamavarṇādyātmakaṃ tajjñānaṃ rūpādikaṃ sthūlatvādyanekadharmābhinnaṃ sāṃśamiva tadvyavahāraṃ prathayatyeva tattvadarśanasya sarvathānupapatteḥ
āyāsādyantādyato vā iti pakṣāntaradyotakaḥ, bhedān cetanetaraviśeṣān abhedaḥ sattāmātraṃ svīkaroti aya bhedasaṃvyavahārān kiṃ na karoti so'bhedaḥ kevalaḥ sakalabhedavikalaḥ
nanu yadi abhedaḥ; bhedavyavahāraḥ tataḥ katham ? anyathā nīlāt pītavyavahāraḥ syāt iti cet; atrāha--nahi abhinnatattvasya ityādi
svapne hi kṛśo'pi sthūlatayā, anyakālādiḥ anyakālāditayā, devadatta eko'pi anekatayā, jāgaraṇe candraḥ tathā sutti kānekatayā pratibhātīti bhāvaḥ

parasyāpi etadastīti darśayannāha--bhedavādino'pi na kevalamabhedavādinaḥ tajñānaṃ bhedavādijñānam; kiṃbhūtam ? niraṃśam, punarapi kiṃbhūtam ? avarṇādyātmakaṃ rūparasādirahitam, rūpādikaṃ sthūlatvādyanekadharmābhinnaṃ na ca niraṃśe tadyuktam
kiṃbhūtam ? sāṃśamiva varṇādinirbhāsamiva, ca śabdo'trāpi yojyaḥ
nanu yathā bhedaḥ pratibhāti naivamabhedaḥ, tato'styanayoḥ viśeṣa iti cet; atrāha--tattva ityādi
tattvasya niraṃśātmano yaddarśanaṃ tasya sarvathā sarveṇa pratyakṣādiprakāreṇa svataḥ parataḥ iti vā prakāreṇa anupapatteḥ
syānmatam--ta jñānaṃ niraṃśamavarṇādyātmakaṃ tathaiva vyavahāraṃ prathayati iti; tatrāha--tattva ityādi
yadi vā, yadi jñānaṃ sāṃśameva varṇādinirbhāsaṃ vyavahāraṃ prathayati tathaiva taditi tattvam ityādi saugatasya yattasya darśanasya sarvathānupapattervā bhedavādino'pi ityādinā sambandhaḥ
nanu yadi abhedaḥ tarhi jāgraddaśāyāmavisaṃvādoyaḥ pramāṇavyavasthānimittaṃsvapne yaśca visaṃvādo'pramāṇavyavasthākāraṇaṃ tau kathaṃ syātām ? bhede tasyā tāmiti cet; atrāha--saṃvād ityādi
kiṃbhūtau ? pramāṇetaranimittabhūtau yathāsaṃkhyena pramāṇāpramāṇahetubhūtau tatra tayoḥ bhedābhedayoḥ syātām
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt sarvavikalpātītaṃ tattvam
atra yaduktaṃ saugatena dūṣaṇam kathaṃ bahirantaḥ pratibhāsabhede sanmātraṃ tattvam ? tadvibhrame sanmātre kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ iti; tadega tasyāpi samānamiti darśayannāha--saṃvittereva ityādi
bhedavādino bauddhasya vijñaptimātraṃ buddhimātraṃ tattvaṃ yathā saṃgrahavādinaḥ sanmātram
nanu tasya bahirantarvā bhedo'pyasti iti cet; atrāha--saṃvittereva nānyasya bahiriva pratibhāsanāt tato yathā asyā'bāhyamapi bāhyatayā cakāsti tathā parasya abhinnaṃ bhinnatayā iti manyate
syānmatam--yathā vijñaptimātraṃ dṛśya na tathā anyaditi cet; atrāha--tad vijñāptimātraṃ punaḥ adṛṣṭaparamārthameva
nahi niraṃśaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ śakyam, anyatrāpi prasaṅgāt
tato yathā bhedavyavahārasya mithyātve'pi na saṃvittesat tathā anyatrāpi iti bhāvaḥ
nanu vijñaptimātre svaparasantānabhedaḥ kṣaṇakṣayādibhedaśca pāramārthika iti cet; atrāha--tatra ityādi
tatra vijñaptimātre svaparasantānāśca kṣaṇakṣayaśca te eva teṣāṃ vā vikalpā bhedāḥ, yadi vā, mānasāḥ pratyayāḥ, teṣāṃ vyavastheyaṃmābhāseta
kutaḥ ? ityāha--avidyātmanaḥ avidyāsvabhāvāt kutaścid vikalpavāsanātaḥ, tatra parasya pramāṇābhāvāt
nanu jāgraddaśāyāṃ sākṣād vyāpārādinirbhāsaḥ, paracetasaḥ śarīrāntare svapne paramparayetyavyabhicāra iti cet; atrāha--pāramparyeṇāpi ityādi
cetanāntarasaṃbhaveniyamaḥ santānāntaracetaneyoḥ sakāśāt saṃbhavasya utpādasya niyamaḥ kuśakāśāvalambanam

kena prakāreṇa saḥ ? ityāha--na kevalaṃ jāgaraṇe sākṣāttasyāḥ tanniyamaḥ, tadavalambanasvaśarīre'pi niraṃśabuddhivyāpārayoranvayagrahaṇābhāvāt sakalavyāpterasiddheḥ pramāṇavirahāt, svāpādau caitanyābhāve'pi vyāpārādibhāvāt, śālūkādi śālūkādibhyo dṛṣṭāvapi punargomayādeḥ darśanāt saṃbhāvyavyabhicāritvāt, vyāpārapratibhāsasya sarvatrārthapratibhāsavad bhrāntatvāt, api tu pāramparyeṇāpi jāgaraṇe sākṣāt cetanāntaraḥ tasyāstanniyamaḥ svapne pāramparyeṇa buddhereva tadbuddhisaṃbhavāt, tadvibhramastadavalambate uktadoṣeṇa anumānāpravṛtteḥ, śarīraprabhṛteḥ sarvasya bhrāntatvācca
pratiṣiddhaḥ saugatena nirākṛto yo'rthaḥ acetano ghaṭādiḥ tasya pratiprasavaḥ pratyujjīvanaṃ tasya prasaṅgāt
tathāhi— svavapuṣi buddhivyāpārayoḥ paramārthato yadi kutaścit hetuphalabhāvaḥ pratīyate; vyaktaṃ grāhyagrāhakabhāvaḥ samāpatati
vāsanātaḥ sakalaṃ jñānam ityatrāpi nyāyo'yaṃ yojyaḥ

nanu arthaḥ pratibhāsāt sidhyati, sa ca svapne tadabhāve'pi bhavannanaikāntika iti cet; na; vyāpārādirapi tathaiva syāditi doṣāt, tatrāsya pāramparyeṇa paracetasaḥ sabhāvo nārthapratibhāsasya iti kiṃkṛtametat ?
apare manyante--tatrāpi svapnāntikaśarīrasya paramārthato'bhyupagamāt sākṣāt paracetasa eva sa iti; teṣāṃ tatra stambhādipratibhāso'pi satya iti kalpanāpoḍhamabhrāntaṃ pratyakṣam nyāyavi॰ 1
4 iti abhrāntagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ nivarttyābhāvāt, taccharīravat dvicandrāderapi satyatāprāpteḥ

vyavahāreṇa abhrāntagrahaṇamiti cet; na; tenaiva taccharīrasyāpi satyatvopagamāt, vyavahāreṇa paraloka sādhanāt, itarathā kutaḥ pratibhāsādvaitam ? nirālambanāḥ sarve pratyayāḥ pratyayatvāt pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 361 ityatra vā kiṃ vā nidarśanam ? svarūpālambanatve'pi anekāntārthaprati sya baddhasya pratiprasavaprasaṅgaḥ, śarīrādeḥ sāṃśatvena pratibhāsanāt

anyeṣāṃ darśanam--na santānaḥ santānāntaraṃ vā anyatra saṃvṛteḥ iti tadabhāvasādhanaṃ siddhasādhanamiti, teṣāmapyuttaramuktam neha punarucyate, citrajñāne nīlādīnām anyo'nyānanugame santānāntarasiddhiḥ
parasparādarśane'pi sadbhāve itarathā sakalaśūnyatā, tadanugame anekāntasiddhiriti
syānmatam--prāgabhāvādicatuṣṭayapratīteḥ kathaṃ sanmātraṃ tattvamiti ? tatrāha--vijñeyam ityādi
nahi abhāvacatuṣṭayajñānaṃ sarvathā nirviṣayaṃ yuktam, arthāntarālambanopagamāt
tanna bhāvavyatirekto viśeṣaḥ kvacit kathañcit prameyatāṃ pratipadyeta
kathaṃcit kenāpi tadutpattiyogyatāprakāreṇa nānyathā buddhyā vijñeyatvābhāvaprakāreṇa vuddhiḥ abhāvacatuṣṭaye iti sambandhaḥ
nahi abhāvacatuṣṭayajñānaṃ sarvathā nirviṣayaṃ viṣayarahitaṃ tucchābhāvagocarameva nahi yuktam
nanu yadyabhāvaviṣayaṃ kathaṃ nirviṣayamucyate iti cet; na; saugatāpekṣayaivamabhidhānāt
kuto na nirviṣayamiti cet; atrāha--arthāntara ityādi
vivakṣitādarthād anyo'rthaḥ tadantaram tad avalambanaṃ yasya tasya upagamāt saugatena
nvavenamapi parasparaviviktabhāvāvalambanāt kathaṃ sanmātragocarā buddhiriti cedatadatta sa ityādi

arthagrahaṇāt jñānasya tadvyapadeśo na svarūpāvalambanāditi cet; nanu arthagrahaṇaṃ buddhiḥ iti kenāvagamyate ? tayaiva buddhyā iti cet; na; svarūpagrahaṇaprasaṅgāt, tadagrahe mamārthagrahaṇam iti pratipattyayogāt
budhyāttayāiti cet; sāpi svarūpasaṃvedanavikalā buddhiḥ iti kathamavagamyate ? ādyajñānārthagrahaṇāt; tadapi kuta iti tadavasthaṃ codyam anavasthā ca
nanvartho yato dṛśyate tajjñānamiti cet; satyam; dṛśyate, nā'svasaṃvedanajñānāt; itarathā parajñānādapi dṛśyeta ityuktam
bhavatu svarūpāvalambanaṃ jñānam, tat svarūpamanyate vyāvṛttamavalambyata iti cet; atrāha--tanna ityādi
tat tasmāt svarūpamavalambeta iti nyāyāt na bhāvavyatirikto jñānasattābhinno na viśeṣo bhedaḥ kvacid vijñāne anyatra vā kathaṃcidekānekādirūpeṇa prameyatāṃ pratipadyeta
nahi svarūpamagnaṃ jñānam anyadaviṣayīkurvāṇaṃ tataḥ kasyacidbhedam anyadvā pratipadyata iti
syādetat--yadi jñānaṃ svarūpameva laṃbi , tadeva pratibhāsādvaitamāyātam, tacca saugatasya nāniṣṭam, abhyupagamāt
atha tathā sattādvaitam; tanna; apratyayāt, citrapratibhāsāt
asya mithyātve tato bhede na sattādvaitamiti cet; atrāha--mithyaikānta ityādi
yasmāt citrajñānād vyāvartate yacca vyāvartate tadapekṣayā dvaitaṃ syāt

yathā paramātmanaḥ sadrūpasya tattvam adṛśyātmanaḥ sakalavikalpāt sarvathā vyatiricyeta adṛṣṭaṃ yataḥ kharavipāṇavaditi tathā kṣaṇikasaṃvido'pi tattvaṃ tatastathā vyaticyeta, yathātattvaṃ svayameva saṃvedanāt
antam avasānam atikrānto'ntaḥ sa cāsau bhedaśca viśeṣaḥ nirava sāno viśeṣo'yaṃ pareṇa ucyamānaḥ sanmātrapakṣe samaḥ sadṛśaḥ

mithyātvam ekānto yasya sa tathoktaḥ sa cāsau vividhaḥ sthūlatvadīrghatvavartulatvādinā citro nirbhāsaśca ghaṭādipratibhāsaḥ tena vidyate pratibhāso darśanaṃ yayoḥ aikyatattvayoḥ niraṃśatvasvasaṃvedanasvarūpayoḥ satoḥ ātmanaḥ kṣaṇikasaṃvidaḥ

etaduktaṃ bhavati— yathā mithyācetanetaranirbhāsatiraskṛtatvāt na sattāmātrasya nityatvādi svarūpaṃ vā'vabhāsate, tathā sthūlatvādicitrapratibhāsena pratihataprasaratvā na saṃvidātmanorekyatattvayoḥ pratibhāsanamiti
punarapi kiṃbhūtasya ? paramātmanaḥ paramaḥ sarvādhika ātmā rūpaṃ yasya tasya iti
tattattvaṃ kiṃ syāt ? ityāha--vyatiricyeta svayaṃ bhidyeta
kutaḥ ? ityāha--adṛṣṭaṃ yata yataḥ kharaviṣāṇavaditi tathā kṣaṇikasaṃvido'pi tattvaṃ tataḥ tathā vyatiricyeta
mithyā grāhyagrāhakau yasyāḥ nānyo'nubhāvyo buddhyāsti pra॰ vā॰ 2
nanu sattā vyāpinī nityaikā nneṣyate, na ca tatra pramāṇamiti kṣaṇabhaṅge nirūpitam
saṃvittiḥ punaḥ kṣaṇikā anekā, tatra pramāṇamasti iti cet; atrāha--nahi ityādi
svapnādau vibhrame vā avarṇātmikaiva saṃvittiḥ varṇādyātmanā niraṃśaiva sāṃśeva avabhāsate
naitāvatā svayamadṛśyātmaiva yato dṛśyāt sarvathā bhidyeta iti samādhiḥ paramātmanaḥ dravyamātre'pi samaḥ
anena nityaivatvavyāpitvavad anyatrāpi kalpanāto nānyā gatiriti darśayati
kiṃbhūtā sā ? ityāha--mithyā asatyā, nityatve'vasthāpayati na khalu
tān kiṃ kṛtvā ityāha--svasmād ātmanaḥ sakāśāt nirākṛtya taddoṣān iti, samānatvāt ubhayatra taddoṣāṇām iti bhāvaḥ
nanu sattāvannādṛśyā saṃvittiḥ, tasyā eva anyathā pratibhāsanāt, maruṣvivālpasya mahattvena iti cet; atrāha--avarṇātmikā
yathā marūbhūmiṣu dūre alpo'pi mahān dṛśyate

svapnādau vibhrame vā avarṇātmikeva sthūlārthākārarahitaiva saṃvittiḥ varṇādyātmanā yathā viplavasāmarthyaprakāreṇa avabhāsate tathā niraṃśaiva avibhāgaiva sāṃśeva avabhāsate naitāvatā svayamadṛśyātmaiva adṛśya ātmā svarūpaṃ yasyā iti, tasyā eva tathāvabhāsanāditi
yato yasmādadṛśyātmakatvāt dṛśyāt grāhyādiviplavāt sarvathā sarveṇa svabhāvena bhidyeta ityevamucyamānaḥ samādhiḥ samaḥ
saṃgrahanayena saugataṃ dūṣayitvā saṃgrahābhāsamadhunā vyavahāranayena apahastayannāha--bheda ityādi
bhede sati pravarteta nābhede saḥ pravartate || 17
kva ? ityāha--ihaloko'ca karmaśabdena kriyā gṛhyate phalavacanenaudanādikam
paratra vā atrāpi karma śubhāśubhamadṛṣṭaṃ phalaṃ svargādikam
abhede'pi saḥ pravarttate iti cet; atrāha--nābheda ityādi
tulanā--karmadvaitaṃ phaladvaitaṃ lokadvaitaṃ ca no bhavet
yaduktam--nahi abhinnatattvasya bhedapratibhāsavyavahāro vipratiṣiddhaḥ svapnādau darśanāt iti dūṣayannāha--mithyātvam ityādi
mithyātvaṃ saṃvidāṃ vīkṣya kvacit sarvatra tadvidaḥ
kutaḥ...tattvamidantayā anyathā vā vyavasthāpayitukāmena tatvajñānaṃ pramāṇamanveṣyam, anupāyopeyāsiddheḥ
saṃvidāṃ bhedajñānānām mithyātvam asatyatvaṃ vīkṣya kvacit svapnādau sarvatra jāgraddaśāyāmapi yā tadvit mithyātvaṃ saṃvit tasyāḥ tadvidaḥ sakāśāt tyajet saṃgrahavādo svābhimata sanmātram
yathaiva hi kvacid bhedavibhramadarśanāt sarvatra tadubhramaḥ, tathā aviśeṣeṇa viśeṣavibhramadarśanāt sanmātrabhramo'pi syāditi manyate
nahi tad viśeṣādanyadeva upalabhyate, yato'yaṃ bhedaḥ syāt
nanu dvitvāhu candratvādikaṃ bhinnamupalabhyate, tathāpi tadeva sat na dvitvam, tathā atrāpi syāditi cet; tadasat; bhede'pi tathā satyetaravyavasthāpatteḥ

api ca, pramāṇāt, anyato vā sanmātraṃ pratīyeta ? prathamapakṣe--dhāte pramāṇāt, pramāṇamantareṇa na tadvyavasthitiḥ, api tu pramāṇataḥ sanmātrapratipatteḥ svābhimataṃ tyajet, pramāṇasanmātrabhedasiddheḥ
syādevaṃ yadi bhinnāt pramāṇānna jñāyeta, yāvatā ātmani tadeva pramāṇaṃ nāsaṃ pratyayād bhedasiddheḥ
dvitīye'pi pakṣe etadeva vācyam pramāṇādṛte tadantareṇa tadvyavasthitaḥ sanmātrasthiterabhāvāditiprasaṅgāt
nanu yathā vibhramavādinaḥ pramāṇamantareṇa svābhimataṃ sidhyati tathā mamāpi iti cet; atrāha--āstāṃ tāvat ityādi

kimantareṇa ? ityāha--samyaṅmithyātvavedakamantareṇa kvacid bahirantarvā svapnādau anyatra vā kasyacit pratyakṣasya anyasya vā kathaṃcit abhimataprakāreṇa samyaktvam anyathāpi viparyaya iti prakāreṇa tadasiddheḥ
na mayā parabalena tattvaṃ vyavasthāpyate api tu svabalena iti cet; atrāha--tattvam ityādi
tattvaṃ bhāvasvarūpamidaṃtayā sanmātratayā anyathā vā vyavasthāpayitukāmena saṃgrahavādinā tattvajñānaṃ tacca pramāṇamanveṣya
tattvam idantayā nedantayā vā avācyamiti cet; atrāha--prākṛtāt ityādi
tadanvayaikānte kaḥ prākṛtabuddhiḥ boddhā vā kvacit kiñcidāśritya na tiṣṭhet pratiṣṭheta apasaredvā hitānveṣī
prākṛtaḥ atattvajñaḥ nityatvādidharmaiḥ vastuvācyatābhiniviṣṭaḥ tasmād bhidyate viśiṣṭo bhavati
kutaḥ tato bhidyate ? ityāha--samyagjñānāvalambanāt, avācyatattvagocaram abādhitaprasaraṃ samīcīnaṃ jñānaṃ samyagjñānaṃ tasyāvalambanāt svīkārāt
yadā hi śvagagrāhikayā tattatvaṃ kutaścit prati padyate, tadā sa tato'nyathā sarve'pi prākṛtā iti na avācyatattvāvatāraḥ
tathāpi tadavatāre doṣamāha--tadabhāve'pi samyagjñānāvalambanābhāve'pi avācyatve tattvasya abhyupagamyamāne vyaktaṃ yathā bhavati tathā nidrāyitaḥ nidrākrāntaḥ puruṣo nidritamivācarati sma
evaṃ manyate--yathā nidrākāntaḥ adṛṣṭatattvo'pi kiṃcidasambaddhaṃ pralapati tathā'yamapi iti
sadasadadvaitam ekatvādidharmairavācyam asat nīlādibhedajātaṃ tayorvyavahārasya vyavasthāyāḥ nibandhanaṃ, kim ? sabhyagjñānaṃ tadanvayaikānte, kaḥ prākṛtabuddhiḥ atattvabuddhiḥ na kaścit

ddhirityucyate, tadabhāve na kiṃcidbādhyate kenacit kaḥ boddhā vā tattvajño boddhā so'pi tadabhāve...ti hetoḥ kvacit sammātrādavāvāñyekiṃcidāgamādikamāśritya na tiṣṭhet sthitiṃ na kuryāt bha rtṛ ha riḥ na pratiṣṭheta na vā'pasaredvā kutaścit bhedavargāt
kenāpi pratyakṣādiprakāreṇa tattvamithyātvavyavasthāpanaṃ kartṛ pekṣā kāraṇaṃ pravarttayati
caśabda ivārtho bhinnakramaḥ ṛjusūtra ityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ

tato'yamarthaḥ--tataḥ taddharmāt uktāt nyāyāt saṃgrahe vyavahāro na syāt ṛjusūtra ḥka iva kutaḥ ? ityāha--santānaḥ hetuphalabhāvaviśeṣaḥ samudāyaḥ skandhaḥ ādiśabdena anyo'pi jagannivāsī gṛhyate, sa na, kva ? ekāntābhedabhedayoḥ yataḥ iti nirūpitametadasakṛt
kārikāvivaraṇamāha--prabhava ityādi tadanyathā tadanyathā so'nyathā ca kāryavyatireka sādhanaśca śeṣaṃ sugamam
ṝju praguṇaṃ sūtrayati nayata iti ṛjusūtraḥ
tatra bhede yathā nṝṇāṃ santānaikyaṃ tathā nayan
smṛtipratyavamarśakarmaphalasambandhādayaḥ kvacit syuḥ hetuphalabhāvaviśeṣāt iha niyatavṛttayaḥ smṛtyādayaḥ na punaraikyāt, vipratiṣedhāt
kim ? ityāha--santānaikyaṃ santatyabhedaḥ, keṣām ? nṝṇām puruṣāṇām
katham ? ityāha--yathā yena kalpanāropitaprakāreṇa abhede saṃgraha ityarthaḥ
tathā nayan vastu gamayan ṛtrusūtranayo bhavati ityadhyāhāraḥ
tadaikyaṃ bhāvataḥ kuto na iti cet; atrāha--asarva ityādi
tataḥ kiṃ jātam ? ityāha--tadvayasā i vyavahāravaśād ekatvavyavasthāpanamayuktam
tu pramātari pūrvāparapratyayayoryadyekatvaṃ na syāt sattvāntaravat smṛtyādayo na syuḥ iti cet; atrāha--smṛti ityādi

smṛtiśca sa iti jñānaṃ pratyavamarśaśca pratyabhijñānaṃ karma ca kriyā adṛṣṭaṃ vā phalaṃ voda nādi svargādi ca, tayoḥ sambandhaśca te ādayo yeṣām ūhādīnām te tathoktāḥ kvacid ekasmin santāne syuḥ bhaveyuḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha--hetuphalabhāvaviśeṣāt hetuḥ anubhavaḥ phalaṃ smaraṇam tayorbhāvaḥ tasya viśeṣāt atiśayāt
tathāhi--svasantānagato'nubhavaḥ tadgatasmaraṇajananasamartha eva tadeva janayati nānyo viparyayāt, itarathā ātmavādino'pyayaṃ samāno doṣaḥ
anyasya anubhavaḥ anyasya smaraṇaṃ kutona janayati ? asāmarthyāt; anyatra samānam
ekatvābhāvāt; svaparayoḥ ekatvamapi kuto na ? taddhetoḥ tathā sāmarthyāt; ānugata prasaṅgaḥ
nanu yāvattadviśeṣānniyatavṛttayaḥ te tāvadaikyāt kuto na bhavanti ? tatrāha--na punaraikyāt
kutaḥ ? ityāha--vipratiṣedhāt ki śeṣeṇa niṣedhāt aikyasya
naca naiva anekasattvasya parasparabhinnatattvasya darśanādera va tve aṅgīkriyamāṇe kvacit pādādau anekatvaṃ yuktam sarvasya aikyaṃ syāt ityarthaḥ
itaśca tanna yuktam; ityāha--ekatvānekatvayoḥ vipratiṣedhāt virodhāt kathamekaṃ tattvam anekam ? anekaṃ vā ekamiti ? ataśca na tattathā; ityāha--vikalpetyādi
etaduktaṃ bhavati--ekatra anityatvādyanekadharmavikalpaśabdavyavahārāṇāṃ bhedadarśanāt tatra bhedasiddhiḥ prārthyate, teṣāṃ ca vastutattve niyamānupapattiḥ
tanna yuktam saṃjñāsaṃkhyāviśeṣācca āptamī॰ ślo॰ 72 ityādi
nanu bhedaikānte kathamupādānopādeyabhāvaḥ yataḥ tathā smṛtyādaya iti cet ? atrāha— svabhāvānanvaye ityādi

anyatra sahakārikāraṇe svāpādau vā vallīdāha-deśāntaraparṇakothayorvā kāryakāraṇabhāvo yathā yena yogyatāprakāreṇa svabhāvānanvaye kāryakāraṇorūpāṇayorupādānopādeyā nanugame sati syād bhaved vivādaviṣaye hetuphalayoḥ upādānopādeyayoḥ tadvattadbhāvaḥ, tataḥ tattvaṃ niranvayam

syānmatam pūrvāparakṣaṇayoḥ nirantaropalabhyamānayoḥ upādānopādeyabhūtayoḥ anvayo'pi pratīyate iti; tatrāha--tadviśeṣe hetuphalabhede upādānopādeyabhūte kvacinnirantaropalabhyamāne anvayapratipattiḥ ekatvasaṃvittiḥ
atha tadviśeṣa eva hetuphalayostādātmyam; tatrāha--sādṛśyam ityādi
kutaḥ ? ityāha--akāryakāraṇatve'pi yamalakayoḥ tadviśeṣasya sādṛśyaviśeṣasya pratipatteḥ
bhrāntaḥ sa tatra iti cet; atrāha--tad ityādi
kathamayaṃ durṇaya iti cet ? atrāha--pratyakṣetarayoraikyam ityādi
yadi ekāntavirodhāt na saṃvidaḥ pratyakṣādibhirekatvaṃ pratipadyeta; kiṃ kena pratipadyeta tadvyatirekeṇa svaruciviracitaniraṃśatattvasyānupalabdheḥ gatyantarābhāvāditi
pratyakṣaḥ pratyakṣajñānaparicchedyaḥ candratvādiḥ, itaraḥ tadaparicchedyaḥ vibhrame ekatvādiḥ
athavā tatraiva pratyakṣa kalpanāpoḍhamabhrāntaṃ jñānasya rūpaṃ vā valyādinā itarat tadābhāsaṃ dvitvādinā

yadi vā, pratyakṣaṃ vikalpabuddheḥ svarūpam itarad apratyakṣam arthe'nabhilāpyaṃ rūpaṃ tayoraikyaṃ pratipannamabhyupagataṃ cet yadi saugatena, kutaḥ anekāntaṃ saugatadarśana viruṇaddhi vyāhanti viruṇaddhyeva tadanyatrāpi tathā'nekāntānivāraṇāt
tato'yamarthaḥ— ko vā na vijayeta api kintu sarvo'pi vijayeta ṛjusūtrakam
adṛṣṭamekāntaṃ kalpayataḥ sarvaiḥ bādhanasaṃbhavāt, tasya vā sarvaiḥ kalpanasaṃbhavāditi bhāvaḥ
itarasya sugamatvāt, ko vā ityādi vivṛṇvannāha--saṃvida ityādi
saṃvido jñānasya pratyakṣādibhirekatvaṃ saṃvitpratyakṣavikalpavikalpavibhramaikatvaṃ tadyadi saugato na pratipadyeta nābhyupagaccheta
tatra dūṣaṇamāha--kiṃ kṣaṇakṣayādi kena pratyakṣādinā na kenacit pratipadyeta
na jainopagatā śepi niraṃśāt saṃvidrūpāt kiṃcit pratipadyate api tu anyataḥ iti cet; atrāha— gatyantarābhāvāditi
nanu sautrāntikānayāpekṣayā bhavatu jñānaṃ nirdiṣṭaprakāraṃ na jñānavādinayāpekṣayā, tatra hi svarūpasya svato gatiḥ pra॰ vā॰ 1
saṃvidastattvaṃ niraṃśamabhinnaṃ kutaścit bhinnapratibhāsamiveti kalpanāyāṃ saṃgrahe'pi tathaiva kinna kalpyeta, yataḥ kṣaṇakṣayādisādhanamāyāsa mātraphalam avalambeta
ayamabhiprāyaḥ--nīlādeḥ anyanīlādireva vā, saṃvidrūpaṃ syāt ? prathamapakṣe anyathā anyena niraṃśaprakāreṇa saṃvidaḥ tattvaṃ svarūpaṃ pratibhāsaḥ saṃvidaḥ anyathā grāhyādibhedaprakāreṇa
evaṃ manyate--yadā nīlāderanya tattvaṃ tadā nīlādibhedapratibhāsaḥ
tadviplava eva iti cet; atrāha--ityapi ityādi
evamapi mataṃ saṃgrahaḥ prāpnoti saṃgrahākrāntaṃ bhavet ityarthaḥ
tattvam ityādinā kārikārthamāha--tattvamabhinnaṃ niraṃśaṃ saṃvidaḥ kutaścid āntaravibhramakāraṇavaśāt bhinnapratibhāsamiva ityevaṃ kalpanāyāṃ saṃgrahe'pi na kevalaṃ ṛjusūtre tathaiva kinna kalpyeta
nanu saṃgrahe nityaṃ tattvam, itaratrānityaṃ hetuphalātmakamiti tayorbheda iti tatsādhanamiti cet; atrāha--aprāpta ityādi
tādṛśāmupādānetaravyavasthā kīdṛśī ? tadarthakriyāyāḥ nityatve kṣaṇikatve cāsaṃbhave kathamakāryakāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ na syāt, yadyanekāntasiddhirna bhavet
aprāptaḥ kāryakālo yena niraṃśena, pūrvameva sarvathā nāśāt tasya kāraṇatvamaniścitam
tadanubhavapathapratho'pi na bhavati tatkathaṃ kāraṇatvaniścaya iti bhāvaḥ
etadevāha--sarvathā kṣaṇakṣayādirūpeṇaiva saccetanādirūpeṇāpi sarvadā vikalpāvasthāyāmiva saṃhṛtavikalpe'pi, yadi vā svāpa iva jāgaraṇe'pi adṛṣṭaṃ śraddheyam atibahvidaṃ saṃvidastattvam
nanu na pūrvamutpadya vinaṣṭaṃ kāraṇam api tu samanantaramiti cet; atrāha--kārya ityādi

kāryotpatteḥ kṣaṇasamaye kāraṇātmalābho yathā yena tadupattyakāraṇaprakāreṇa, nahi sahasaṃbhavinorekamanyasya janakam, dvayorapi anyo'nyaṃ janakatve anyo'nyāśrayadoṣāt, na kiṃcitkaraḥ tathā samanantarasaṃbhavaśca akiṃcitkaraḥ
tathāhi--pūrvaṃ samanantaraṃ yāvaduttarasya kāraṇam; tāvaduttaraṃ tathāvidhaṃ pūrvasya kuto na bhavati ? avinābhāvasya ubhayāpekṣayāpi samānatvāt
syānmatam--yathā sahabhāvinoritareṇa nānyasya upakāraḥ tathā samanantarayorapi, tathāpyekamanyasya kāraṇaṃ niyamena tadanantarabhāvāditi; tatrāha--tatkṛtopakārānapekṣasya ityādi
anyathā sarvaṃ sarvasmāt niyamena anantaraṃ syāt
yato yasmāt tanniyamaśraddhānāt nairantaryaviśeṣameva prabhavaṃ hetuphalabhāvamācakṣīta saugataḥ
na paurvāparyameva upakāraḥ sarveṣāmapi pūrvāparībhūtānāṃ sa bhavet iti bhāvaḥ
nanu na kiṃcit kasyacit kāraṇam aśaktaṃ sarvam pra॰ vā॰ 2
sā cāsau yadevārthakriyākāritadeva paramārthasat iti vacanāt saugatābhyupagatārthakriyā ca tasyāḥ nityatve kṣaṇikatve ca asaṃbhave aṅgīkriyamāṇe kathamakāryakāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ na syād bhavet
tathā ca brahmavadanityapakṣe'pi sarvahetvādivyavahārāpahāra iti bhāvaḥ
nanu khātpatitā ratnavṛṣṭiḥ pratibhāsādvaitavādinaḥ, tenābhyupagamāditi cet; atrāha--yadi anekāntasiddhirna bhavet syād akāryakāraṇaṃ sarvamiti sambandhaḥ
yāvatā nīlādisvabhāvāmapi saṃvidaṃ vadato'nekāntasiddhiḥ hetuphalabhāvāvirodhinī bhavet ityuktam
nanvanekānte virodhādidoṣāt kathaṃ tatsiddhiḥ ? ityatrāha--virodhāt ityādi
bahirantaranubhavaviṣayaṃ pratyakṣagocaramanekāntatvaṃ virodhaśaṅkayā pariharataste kṣaṇakṣayaikāntopalambhāvalambanaṃ vahirarthanirākaraṇaṃ gaṇḍūpadabhayādajagaramukhapraveśamanusarati
tasya anekāntasya sambandhī yo virodhaḥ tasmād bibhyataḥ tava saugatasya kathaṃ na virudhyate
evaṃ manyate--anekāntasya virodhādinānyasyānudalaṃbhenāt sakalaśūnyatā mānatrāṇarahitā sutarāṃ virodhamāstighrute iti

anekāntatvaṃ pratyakṣagocaraṃ virodhaṃ śaṅkayā kṛtvā pariharataḥ tyajataḥ te saugatasya kṣaṇakṣayaikāntopalambhāvalambanaṃ tadekāntadarśanasvīkaraṇaṃ kartṛ gaṇḍūpadabhayāt mūkasarpo'jagaraḥ tasya mukhapraveśamanusarati
tadanekānta parityāge ekaparamāṇumātraṃ tattvaṃ bhavet ityuktam, tasya vānupalambhanamiti kimāśrayaṃ tadekāntopalambhanam
nanu nayadurṇayacinteyam āgama eva siddhā, tatkimanayā paramārthavicāra iti cet ? atrāha--sāpekṣā ityādi
sāpekṣā nayā siddhāḥ durṇayā api lokataḥ
navai grāmavāsitam api tu tatpāṭake gṛhe vṛkṣe śākhāyāṃ mukhādau vā vyavahāradarśanāt
tato'yamarthaḥ syādvādināṃ jainānāṃ lokāt lokato'pi na kevalam āgamata eva siddhā niścayamupāgatāḥ
durṇayāśca tato'pi siddhāḥ, ityāha--durṇayā lokato'pi siddhā iti
nanu ekāntavādinaḥ kutaḥ lokataḥ siddhāḥ ? ityāha--lokavyavahāra ityādi
nidarśanamatrāha--kukkuṭena grāme gṛhaviśeṣaviśiṣṭadeśe vāsitam iti saṃgrahābhiprāyaḥ sāmānyamātrasyārpaṇāt
navai naiva grāme sarvatra vāsitam api tu tatpāṭake grāmaikadeśe iti naigamasiddhiḥ pradhānetarabhāvena ubhayārpaṇāt
atrāpi na caitat pāṭake api tu gṛhe vṛkṣe śākhāyāṃ vāsitam iti yojyam
mukhe eva vāsitaṃ śabda iti bhravati iti ṛjusūtrābhiprāyaḥ
bhedābhedau vyākhyātalakṣaṇau tāvevātmānau vastunaḥ svabhāvau, naikāntena bhinnau, tanniṣṭheṣu tatpareṣvapīsyasyānantare paṭhitavyaḥ
teṣu kim ? ityāha--nayāḥ syuḥ jñātrabhisandhayo bhaveyuḥ
kva ? ityāha--loke jinapatisamaye ca jināgame ca
kiṃbhūte ? ityāha--arthamātrālaṃbārthamātram upalakṣaṇametat, tena paryāyamātragrahaṇam, tadavalambāna kevalaṃ nayo durṇayāśca syuḥ
nayāḥ durṇayāśca vijñeyāḥ kovidānāṃ kovidaiḥ paṇḍitaiḥ ityarthaḥ
anyathā nayābhāvaprakāreṇa ko nu vidadhīta na kaścit
iti ra vi bha dra pādopajīvi-a na nta vī rya viracitāyāṃ si ddhi vi ni śca ya ṭī kā yām arthanayasiddhiḥ daśamaḥ prastāvaḥ
śeṣāstuya śabdanayā ityuktam, tatra śeṣā vyākhyātuṃ tannibandhanabhūtaṃ śabdaṃ nirūpayannāha--prokta ityādi

nityasya sarvathaiva sataḥ utpattyayogāt tadabhāvaikāntāviśeṣe akṣarādeḥ kāraṇamasti netarasyeti kiṃkṛtametat ? kharaśṛṅgasya punaḥ yathā anutpatterasattvam, asattvāccānutpattirityanyo'nyasaṃśrayadūṣaṇaṃ tathā akāraṇatvādanutpattiḥ anutpatterakāraṇatvamiti samānam

svasmādbhāvasya janma vyāhatam ātmani kriyāvirodhāditi cet; kathamasati pūrvamutpadya kāryakālaṃ gatvā tatkaraṇe kṣaṇikatvam ? yadi māyāsutaḥ pūrvaṃ saṃsārī kathaṃ punaḥ tattvābhyāsād buddho jātaḥ ? kathañcit sanneva sugatatvaṃ prāpnotīti samañjasam
nāpi māyāsutādanyo buddhaḥ saṃbhāvyate yataḥ parasmādeva janma syāt, tattvābhyāsatatphalayoḥ bhinnādhikaraṇatvaprasaṅgāt
tatra santānanānātvaṃ netaratreti nāparaṃ kāraṇamutprekṣāmahe anyatra dravyabhedāt
nanu nedānīṃ tat kenacit prathamamuktam, na hi kaścidācaṣṭe pūrvamekāntena asad vyākaraṇatattvamidaṃ mayā idānīṃ prādurbhāvitamiti cet; atrāha--purā iti
evaṃ hi śrūyate--purā purudevo bharatādīn pāṭhayituṃ pañcaśatādhyāyaparimāṇaṃ sva ya mbhū nā ma kaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ cakāra iti
nanu tasyāpi anyataḥ tadadhyayanam asmadādivaditi cet; bharabhā ratā di vat karaṇe ko virodhaḥ ? vedāṅgatvavirodha iti cet; na; vedasyāpi kṛtrimatvapratipādanāt
atha kaiścit tadaṅgatvena kenacit tiritarodbhavad ; vedasyāpi kṛtatvaprāpteḥ
nahi devadattasyā gama darśanena sa marditaḥ syāt, atiprasaṅgaścaivam
sarvasyāpi vrāhmaṇakṛtasya nāstikādiśāstrasya tadaṅgatāprāpteḥ, tathā catadarthānuṣṭhānam
atha brāhmaṇo'sau na bhavati; kuta etat ? apramāṇārthābhidhānāt; śabdasādhutve kiṃ pramāṇaṃ yena tadanuvādakaraṇāt pā ṇi niḥ brāhmaṇaḥ syāt
śastra miti cet; anyatra samānam, anyasyāpi vedāṅgatvapratipādanāt
dharmahetutatsādhutvakathanāt sa brāhmaṇa iti cet; na; atrāpi pramāṇābhāvāt
atha vaidikaśabdānuśāsanāt brāhmaṇo'sau; anyo'pi vaidikamātrikavivāhādyarthānuśāsanād brāhmaṇo'stu
vede so'rtho nāstīti cet; na; tacchāstrasya vedāṅgatvāt
puruṣakṛtasya kathaṃ taditi cet; na tarhi pā ṇi ne stadaṅgatā
pāṇi ni nā tatsmṛtamiti cet; prakṛte'pi samānametat
kiṃca, jai ne ndraṃ pū jya pā de na tīrthaṅkarādadhītaṃ punarvismṛtaṃ smṛtamiti kinneṣyate ?
syānmatam--pā ṇi ni matānusaraṇaṃ tatra śrūyate, dṛśyate ca; tatrāpi paramatānusaraṇaṃ śrūyate dṛśyate ca iti samānaṃ parasyāpi parānusaraṇam
yathā ca idānīm anyamatānusaraṇāt keṣāṃcid vyākaraṇaṃ tathā dvijānāmapi purā paramatānusaraṇāt tatkaraṇe ko virodhaḥ ? tanna ato vyākaraṇasya tadaṅgatā
atha vedārthapratyāyanāt tadaṅgatā; na; tatra śabdāḥ kevalaṃ vyutpādyante, tatra te vyutpāditāḥ tadarthavad anyamapi saṅketāt kathayanti
yathā ca kvacit sāmānyalakṣaṇāparigṛhītā vaidikāḥ śabdā vyutpādyante tathā anyatra anya iti samānam
yadi matam--vedoktaśabdāśrayaṇāt taditi tattadaṅgamiti; tadāstāṃ tāvat
1 ityādau vākyānyapi uddiśya tatproktam tatkathamiha tadagrahaṇamiti cet ? na; tadupalakṣaṇatvād asya
dvayoja pādānamanarthakam ekena upalakṣaṇāditi cet; na; mīmāṃsakaṃ prati dṛṣṭāntārthatvāt padopādānasya
tathāhi--yathā 'gauḥ ityatra na gakārādivyatirekeṇa padam, atha gauḥ ityatra kaḥ śabdaḥ ? gakāraukāravisarjanīyāḥ iti bhagavānupavarṣaḥ
sāvayava cākṣaraṃ yadvakṣyati aṇumayam iti tanmayasya ghaṭādivat sāvayavatvāt
tathāpi akṣarabhāvavat tadabhāvo'pi iti tatra kim ? ityāha--tatra ityādi
tatra vyākaraṇe, teṣu vā madhye ityeke, akṣaraṃ varṇajātyapekṣam ekavacanam
nanu paramāṇuvikārasya ghaṭādivad dravyātmakatvāvyabhicārāt kiṃ dravyātmapadena iti cet; na; ekāntābhāvāt
tadvikāro hi kaścid guṇaḥ śyāmatvaraktatvādivat, aparaḥ karma gamanādivat, anyo dravyaṃ kumbhādivat, tata itaravyavacchedenāsya pratipādanārthaṃ dravyātmagrahaṇam
tadapi kimarthamiti cet ? ucyate--guṇaḥ śabdaḥ niṣidhyamānadravyakarmabhāvatve sati sattāsambandhitvāt rūpādivat ityatra asiddhatāpratipādanārthaṃ hetoḥ tat
kiṃ tat pramāṇamiti cet ? kathyate--dravyamakṣaraṃ kriyāvattvāt loṣṭavat
kriyāvato hi pareṇāpi dravyatvamiṣyate--kriyāvadguṇavatsamavāyikāraṇaṃ dravyam vaiśe॰ sū॰ 1
na ca kriyāvattvaṃ tatrā'siddham; akṣaraṃ kriyāvat krameṇa deśāddeśāntaraprāptimattvāt vāṇavat
pareṇāpi tathā vaktṛmukhadeśāt śrotṛśravaṇadeśaprāptasya grahaṇopagamāt cakṣuḥśrotramanasām aprāptakāritvam iti vacanāt
utpattideśa eva gṛhyate ityeke; teṣām anuvātaprativātābhyāṃ tadgrahaṇāgrahaṇe na syātām stambhavat
nahi stambhaḥ svadeśastho gṛhyamāṇaḥ anuvāte gṛhyate na prativāta iti dṛṣṭam
atha prativātena pratighātaḥ śrotrasya vidhīyate; nanu prāptaḥ saḥ pratighātakārī nānyathā, atiprasaṅgāt
tataḥ śabdadeśād yadā śrotṛdeśaṃ yāti vāyuḥ tadā śabdagrahaṇaṃ bhavet
tasya tena pratighātānneti cet; na; anyatra tathā'darśanāt
etatasyāt, prativāyunā śravaṇapratikūladeśopanīto nopalabhyate tūlādivaditi yogyatāvaditivirahāt prativacane agrahaṇo yogyatvāt, anyathā same anukūle vā maruti grahaṇaṃ na syāt
saiva sāmagrīti cet; nirvāte na graho bhavet
atrāpi saiva sāmagrīti cet; syādyadi vātābhāvaḥ padārthāntaraṃ bhavet
śabdarūpameva iti cet; tat pratikūle'pi anile avikalam
tena tasya grāhyatā śaktiḥ pratihatā ityapi nottaram; tatrasthasyaiva tacchaktiḥ pratihatā, uta deśāntaraṃ nīta iti na niścayaheturasti
vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ deśāntaraṃ nītaḥ tatrasthaiḥ śravaṇāt
naca kṣaṇikavādino gandhādivad bhinnadeśotpattiḥ śabde viruddhyate
tathāpi na śrotrapradeśaṃ prati tadutpattiriti cet; tadbhāve'pi na kiṃcid viruddhyate
dūre śabdaḥ iti pratītirvirudhyate iti cet; tatra tanna; gandhe'pi tatpratitibhāvāt
āha--anupavanaṃ gatyāpīti pavanena saha anupavanaṃ śabdasya yā gatiḥ tayā taddravyātmā apiśabdaḥ uktahetusamuccaye, tena sparśasaṃkhyāvattvena ityādi grāhyam
nanu gandhasya anuvacanaṃ gatirasti tathāpi na dravyam ato vyabhicāra iti; na; pakṣīkaraṇāt

gandhavad dravyam anupavanaṃ gatimat na gandhaḥ, tathāpi upacāreṇa so'pi tadvān vyapadiśyate yathā tathā akṣaramiti cet; kiṃ punaḥ gandhādhārasya dravyasyeva śabdādhārasya gatirasti yenaivam ? no cet; katham upacārakalpanā ? atha vāyugateḥ akṣare adhyāropāt tadvat; tathā gamanamapi bhavet

syānmatam, gagane tadadhyāropanimittaṃ nāsti; kiṃ punarakṣare asti ? tatsāhacaryyamiti cet; na; niṣkriyasya tasya kīdṛśyaṃ vāyunā sāhacaryam ? na hi ghoṭakārūḍharājavat vāyvārūḍhasya deśāntare prāptirasti

atha matam, yaṃ deśamupasarpati vāyuḥ tatra deśe samavāyikāraṇād ākāśād asamavāyikāraṇāt pūrvaśabdād vinasyattāvato'parāparaśabdabhāvāt sāhacaryamiti; pāṃśvādivat tasyaiva gatipariṇāme ko doṣaḥ ? kṣaṇikatvānna tatpariṇāmaḥ kutaḥ kṣaṇikatvamucyate ? kṣaṇikaḥ śabdaḥ asmadādipratyakṣatve sati vibhudravyaviśeṣaguṇatvāt sukhādivat iti cet; na; vakṣyamāṇaguṇottaratvāt
tataḥ sthitam--akṣaraṃ dravyātmā anupavanaṃ gatyāpi loṣṭavaditi
syānmatam--dravyātmatve'pi nānupavanaṃ gatiḥ, sarvagatā'mūrtatvāt ākāśavaditi cet; atrāha--aṇumayam iti
aṇavo bhāṣāparamāṇavaḥ tadvikāraḥ tanmayam tato'siddho hetuḥ sarvagatāmūrttatvāt iti
tanmayaṃ kuta iti cet ? āha--mūrttaṃ rūparasagandhasparśavanmūrttaṃ pūrvācāryairabhyupagataṃ yataḥ
yadi vā, dravyasvabhāvamapi mīmāṃsakakalpitaṃ na syāt; ityatrāha--aṇumayaṃ
etadapi kena ? ityāha— anupavanaṃ gatyāpi mataṃ na kevalaṃ śarīrāvayavaviśeṣaspaṣṭādinaiva iti apiśabdaḥ tathāhi--anupavanaṃ gatyā tasya tṛṇādivattena saṃyogaviśeṣo'numīyate tadabhāve tadabhāvāt
paraḥ prāha--tālvādisaṃyogavibhāgajāḥ śabdābhivyaktihetavaḥ pavanena vāyavaḥ preryante, taistu yathāvasthitamakṣaraṃ vyajyate, ato'nupavanaṃ gatirasya asiddhā iti; tanna; nityasya vyaktiniṣedhāt
bhavatu akṣaraṃ tanmayam, tadabhivyaṅgyaṃ padaṃ nitya mūrttatvaṃ syāditi cet; atrāha--padasamudayaḥ teṣāmakṣarāṇāṃ tadvyatirekeṇa tadanupalabdheḥ iti bhāvaḥ
tataḥ kim ? ityāha--matam abhyupagatam kṛtrimaṃ kṛtakapadam
kṣaṇikatvāttasya, nānupacārāditi vaiśeṣikādiḥ; taṃ pratyāha--nityam ityādi
nanu viruddho'yaṃ hetuḥ; prāgasataḥ punarātmaparigrahalakṣaṇatvāt janmanaḥ, nitye ca kālatrayānuyāyini tanna saṃbhavati iti cet; atrāha--asadanutpatta ityādi
tasya kutaścidātmalābho viruddhyate iti cet; atrāha--janma ityādi
janmanyeva anantavivarttāḥ pariṇāmāḥ tadvataḥ, ekāntena sataḥ ātmalābhaviruddho na pariṇāmina iti bhāvaḥ
viruddho hetuḥ iti cet; atrāha--labheta ityādi
sarvathā asata utpattau ko doṣa iti cet ? atrāha--sarvathaiva ityādi
syānmatam, akṣarākāśādikaṃ kāraṇamasti tena utpadyate, na tu kharaśṛṅgādi viparyayāditi cet; atrāha--tadabhāvaikāntoviśeṣa ityādi
tayoḥ akṣarādikharaviṣāṇayoḥ abhāvaikāntāviśeṣe sati akṣarādeḥ kāraṇamasti na itarasya kharaśṛṅgasya ityevaṃ kiṃkṛtametat
nanu kharaśṛṅgamakāraṇam anutpatteḥ nākṣarādiḥ viparyayāditi cet; atrāha--punaḥ ityādi

ayamabhiprāyaḥ, kharaviṣāṇāmakāraṇam iti sādhyam, anutpatteriti hetuḥ, tena ca siddhena bhāvyamiti, tasya kutaḥ siddhiḥ ? asattvāditi cet; ucyate--punaḥ iti vitarke, kharaśṛṅgasya yathānutpatteḥ sakāśādasattvaṃ siddhyati asattvācca anutpattiḥ iti evamanyo'nyasaṃśrayadūṣaṇaṃ tathā tena prakārasya akāraṇatvādanutpattiḥ anutpatterakāraṇatvam ityevaṃ samānam anyo'nyasaṃśrayadā
paro brūyāt na asattvāt tadanutpattiḥ sādhyate yato'yaṃ doṣaḥ, api tu kāraṇābhāvāditi, tadā idaṃ vaktavyam ityabhiprāyaḥ
tathāhi--jīvaḥ pudgalādupādānakāraṇāt kuto na bhavati ? tasya tadakāraṇatvāditi cet; etadapi kutaḥ ? tato'nutpatteḥ iti cet; sāpi kutaḥ ? tadākāraṇatvāt; pūrvavadanyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ
tatra tasya asattvādanutpattiḥ iti cet; asattvaṃ kutaḥ ? anutpatteścet; sa eva prasaṅgaḥ

atha jīvasya dṛśyasataḥ pudgalopādeyatayā adarśanāt tatrāsattvam ataśca tatastadanupapattiḥ asyāstattadakāraṇam ityanyo'nyasaṃśrayābhāvaḥ, evamanyatrāpi tadabhāvaḥ syāditi cet; satyaṃ syāt, kintu pratītiranusṛtā syāt, na vicāramātram
tathā sati mṛtpiṇḍāt ghaṭādikaṃ tatra mṛddravyādirūpeṇa sadevaṃ jāyate tathāpratīteḥ, na kharaviṣāṇaṃ viparyayāt
paramatamāśaṅkate svasmādityādi bhāvasya kāryapadārthasya janma utpattiḥ vyāhatam
kutaḥ ? ityāha--svasmād ātmanaḥ sakāśāt, ātmani kriyāvirodhāt ityevaṃ cet; etad dūṣayannāha--katham ityādi
sati kāraṇe tasya janma ityadoṣa iti cet; atrāha--asatītyādyayamabhiprāyaḥ--pūrvamutpadya kārya kāryakālaṃgatvā tatkaraṇe kṣaṇikatvam ? kāryeṇa saha kāraṇotpattau santānocchedaḥ iti virodhaḥ
punarapi yadi ityādinā parābhiprāyamāśaṅkate, katham ityādi atra dūṣaṇam
māyāsutaḥ māyā nāma sugatasya jananī tasyāḥ putraḥ pūrvaṃ saṃsārī punaḥ paścāt tattvābhyāsād buddho vidhūtakalpanājālaparyāyasvabhāvo jātaḥ
etadapi neṣyate iti cet; atrāha--kathaṃcit saccetanādirūpeṇa sanneva sugatatvam apunarāvṛttyādidharmakatvaṃ prāpnoti iti samajjasam vandhyāsutavat
nanu na māyāsutaḥ sugato bhavati gantā nāsti śivāya cāsti gamanam iti vacanāt, api tu tadapādānādanya eva sugato bhavatīti cet; atrāha--nāpi ityādi
māyāsutāt kāraṇabhūtādanyaḥ buddho jātaḥ saṃbhāvyate nāpi yataḥ saṃbhāvanāt parasmādeva vastvantarādeva janma syād buddhasya
kuto na saṃbhāvya iti cet ? tattvābhyāsatatphalayoḥ bhinnādhikaraṇatvaprasaṅgāt
māyāsuta-sugatatvayoḥsantānāpekṣayā ekatve'pi vastvapekṣayā māyāsutasugatasvalakṣaṇāpekṣayā nātvamiti cet; atrāha--pitā ityādi
syānmatam--hetuphalalakṣaṇaprabandhaviśeṣaḥ sa tayornāsti iti bhinnasantānatvamiti cet; atrāha--tatra ityādi
tayoḥ pitāputrayoḥ santānanānātvaṃ netaratra itarayoḥ māyāsutasugatayorna santānanānātvaṃ tatra tadekatvam ityarthaḥ, ityevaṃ mate nāparaṃ kāraṇamutprekṣāmahe
yatra dravyabhedaḥ tatra santānasya nānātvaṃ yatra tadabhedaḥ tatra ekatvam, anyathā hetuphalabhāvaviśeṣo'pi durlabha iti nirūpitam
punarapi paramatamāśaṅkate--kathaṃ punaḥ ityādi; tatrottaram--uktamatra ityādi
sthūlamekaṃ sakṛttattvaṃ bāhyaṃ jāyeta ghaṭādi cet
vidvedyavedakalakṣaṇaṃ cāntaḥ tattvamiti gamyate, sakṛdekadā jāyeta tarhi krameṇa ekaṃ tattvaṃ vivartteta ityuktam
nanu sarvasya vicārato'yogāt kasya kuto'nekāntasādhanamiti cet ? atrāha--bahirantaḥ ityādi
yathaiva hi ekāntavādinaḥ aṇūnāmapratibhāsanānna cakṣurādiviṣayahetutvamiti na kiñcit pratyakṣavyapadeśabhāk

aprāmāṇika...tathaiva svayamabhimataṃvyavasthāpayan ekāntamavalambya punarapi vicārabhaṅguratvaṃ punarapi sattāṃ nivartayan na kevalaṃ svāmeva vṛttiṃ svavācā viḍambayati apitu anekāntatattvaṃ samarthayati
kasyāṃ satyām ? ityāha--parīkṣāyāṃ vicāre sati ityarthaḥ
kaimparyamatra sakalasya ekāntasya anavasthānāt na tadavalambanena kvacid vidhipratiṣedhavyavahāraḥ
yathaiva hi ityādinā kārikāṃ vivṛṇoti--yathaiveti gamyate yattadoḥ nityasambandhāt
tato'yamarthaḥ--yathaiva hi kim ? na kiṃcit pratyakṣavyapadeśabhāg ekāntavādinaḥ
syānmatam--paramāṇuccātmabhūtaḥ kaścidekaḥ sthūla upakāro'sti sa tadvyapadeśabhāk syāditi cet; atrāha--paramāṇuṣu sthū lasyaikasya ākārasyā'saṃbhavāt
kiṃbhūteṣu ? saṃciteṣvapi na kevala pṛthagavasthiteṣu ghaṭādivat paramāṇutvavirodhāt kiṃ pratyakṣasya vyapadeśabhāgiti

atha matam--tebhyo bhinnaḥ kriyāguṇavān dṛśya ākāraḥ tadvyapadeśabhāgiti cet; atrāha--tadvyatiriktasya ca paramāṇubhyo bhinnasya ca kasyacidavayavyāderabhāvāt kiṃ pratyakṣavyapadeśabhāk ? vicāritaścāyaṃ paro neha vicāryate
ata eva svarūpasya ca svato gatiḥ pra॰ vā॰ 1
paramāṇuṣu sthūlaikā kāravyatirekeṇa parasya abhāvāt kasya vā svasaṃvedanam ? na kasyacit
svasaṃvedanadharmasya dharminiṣṭhatvāt, anyathā kharaviṣāṇaṃ svasaṃvedanaṃ bhavet
nanu nīlādi yathāvabhāsate tattathaiva svasaṃvedanam, yad yathaiva avabhāsate tattathaiva paramārthasat ityādeḥ yadavabhāsate tajjñānam ityādeśa vacanāditi cet; atrāha— yathāpratibhāsam ityādi
pratibhāsānusāreṇa yathāpratimāsamasaṃbhavāt tattvasya kintu tadvyapadeśabhāk kasya vā svasaṃvedanam ? tadasaṃbhavaśca vicārāyogāt

tathaiva svayam ātmanā abhimatam ekāntatattvam vyavasthāpayan na kevalaṃ svāmeva vṛttiṃ caritaṃ svavācā viḍambaya cet sāvayati api tu samarthayati anekāntatattvaṃ tadantareṇa pratibhāsādvaitāderapyasaṃbhavāt
kiṃkurvan svavṛtti vācā viḍambayati ? ityāha--ekānta ityādi
prathamaṃ kṣaṇikatvādyekāntamavalambya punarapi vicāracaṃcuravalambya punarapi vicāratakāntadarśanāt sattāṃ vidyamānataṃ nivarttayan abhyupagatatvaṃ dūṣayannityarthaḥ
ekāntadarśanamāśritaṃ tarhi vyavasthāpayati iti cet; atrāha--bhāva ityādi
dravyasya sadādirūpeṇa bhāvyam, yena pratyutpādaṃ bhidyeta
yathā citramekaṃ jñānaṃ bodhākāreṇa sarvatrāviśiṣṭaṃ taṃ svabhāvaṃ bibhartti yena prativiṣayaṃ bhidyeta iti tathā prakṛtamapi
bhāvo jīvādiḥ yenātmanā saccetanādisvabhāvena siddhaḥ sarvadā labdhātmalābhaḥ, tena jāyate utpattimān bhavati upalakṣaṇametat, tena vinaśyatitiṣṭhati ca
etaduktaṃ bhavati--bhāva eva udyati vinaśyati tiṣṭhati nānye paryāyā iti
jñānaṃ svasaṃvedanaṃ yenātmanā saccetanādisvabhāvena sarvatra sādhāraṇena siddhaṃ jñānaṃ niṣpannaṃ vā yathā tenāvabhāsate pratibhāsate kathaṃcit iti sambandhaḥ
tathāhi--sautrāntikamate na tat kṣaṇakṣapāva bhāsate; tadanumānavaiyarthyāpatteḥ
nāpi svakāraṇāt; arthasya nīlākāreṇaiva jaḍākāreṇāpi; jaḍatāpatteḥ
naca citrajñānaṃ bodhākāreṇaiva, nīlākāreṇāpi pītādyākāre pratibhāsane citratāhāneḥ
sugatajñānam ātmānaṃ yathāsvam atītapūrvakṣaṇopādeyaṃ paśyati naivaṃ tathāvidhottarakṣaṇopādeyam; vibhramaprāpteḥ hetuphalabhāvānavasthitervā iti
yogācāradarśane tat grāhyākāravivekam ātmano na paśyati bhrāntyabhāvaprasaṅgāt
dravyasya jīvādeḥ sadādirūpeṇa svarūpādicatuṣṭayena yatsattvaṃ tadādiryasya pararūpādicatuṣṭayena asattvādeḥ tattathoktam
tacca tadrūpaṃ ca tena bhāvam anyathā tadavyavasthitiḥ iti de vā ga mā da vagantavyam
yena tadrūpeṇa pratyutpādaṃ bhidyeta nānā bhavet dravyam
vivarttate arthabhāvena prakriyā jagato yataḥ || vākyapa॰ 1 | 1
kutaḥ ? ityāha--sadasadātmakatvāt upalabhyamānaḥ paryāyaḥ san, tadviparītaḥ pūrvo'paraśca asan tau ātmānau yasya tasya bhāvāt tattvāt tasya dravyasya iti
yadi vā, yaduktam--dravyasya sadādirūpeṇa bhāvyam iti; kuta etat ? ityāha--sadetyādi
nanu dravyādekāntena utpādādayo bhinnāḥ; tatkathaṃ pratyutpādaṃ tadbhidyeta ? nahi anyasya bhede anyadbhidyate iti cet; atrāha--bhedaikāntadarśane'pi ityādi
dravyaparyāyayoḥ bheda eva bhedaikāntaḥ tasya darśane mate apiśabdaḥ bhāvanāyāṃ taddarśanasya pūrvaṃ nirāsāt
tat pratyutpādaṃ dravyabhedasvabhāvasya anirākṛteḥ kāraṇāt yena pratyutpādaṃ bhidyeta iti sambandhaḥ, dravyasya svabhāvabhedamantareṇa bhinnotpādādyayogāt iti pratyayāditi
tato yaduktam--śabdādhāro dravyaṃ vibhu dravyatve sati asmadādipratyakṣaviśeṣaguṇatvāt ātmavat iti; tannirastam; sādhyadṛṣṭāntayoḥ nityatvaikāntasiddheḥ
vibhuno'pratyakṣasya gaganasya anyasya vā guṇaścet śabdaḥ; na asmadādipratyakṣa ityuktam
jñānaṃ citrapekaṃ saṃvedanaṃ bodhākāreṇa sarvatra nīlādau bāhye'viśiṣṭaṃ taṃ svabhāvaṃ bibhartti yena prativiṣayaṃ bhidyeta iti evaṃ yathā tathā prakṛtamapi iti
na cāyamākāraḥ sthūlākāraḥ asya jñānasya paramārthato'ṅgīkriyate saugatena ekatra viruddhadharmādhyāsabhayāt
evaṃ manyate--yadi ayamasya bhrānta ākāraḥ ekasya vibhrametarātmatā na bhavati viṣayavivekādarśanād dṛśyetararūpatā iti nīlādyākāraiścitramekaṃ tadi ṣyate iti cet; atrāha--tad ityādi
varṇamekamasahāyamanekaṃ vā varṇaṃ padaṃ śaṃsanti pūrvācāryāḥ tadeva padaṃ vā ekam arthapratipādakaṃ saṃti
ghaṭādyarthapratipattyanyathānupapattyā tatpātatpari kalpanam, sā contapada eva upayuktaśaktikā iti na tataḥ tatparikalpanā iti bhāvaḥ
nanu yadyeko'pi varṇaḥ padaṃ kimarthamuktam--padasamuccayaḥ teṣām siddhivi॰ 11

adarśanāt ityanena etaddarśayati prati pratipattuḥ kṛtasaṅgīterakārādiśravaṇād vāsudevādipratipattirupalabhyate, sā akārādeḥ, anyato vā saṃbhavantī bhavet ? prathamapakṣe siddhaṃ varṇānāṃ vācakatvamiti sphoṭo'narthakaḥ
akārādireva sphoṭa iti cet; na; tasya aṇumayatvapratipādanāt sphoṭo'mūrtto nityaśca syāt
kiṃ ca, so'bhivyaktaḥ, anyathā vā tatpratītihetuḥ ? ādye mate kutaḥ tasyā'bhivyaktiḥ ? śrotrāderiti cet; tarhi ghaṭa ityatrāpi tata eva tadabhivyakterghakārādikamanarthakam
ghakārādeḥ iti cet; iḥ kāmadevaḥ ityatra parasya dhvaneḥ vyañjakasyābhāvādanabhivyaktiḥ

atra tālvādipreritā vāyavo vyañjakā nānyatra iti kiṃkṛto vibhāgaḥ ? atha anyatra ghakārādervyañjakasya bhāvāt na te tadvyañjakāḥ; kiṃ tatra vāyavo na vidyante ? santi tathāpi te ghakārādīnāṃ vyañjakāḥ, ghādayaśca sphoṭasya iti cet; taditaratra samānam
śakyaṃ hi vaktum— vāyoḥ akārābhivyaktiḥ, tataḥ sphoṭasya iti
tathā'darśanamubhayatra hetuḥ iti sarvadā tataḥ tatpratītiḥ syādaviśeṣāt
dvitīyaḥ syāditi cet; na; akārādereva pratītibhāvāt
api ca, akārādiranarthakaḥ kvacidanupayogāt tadabhivyaktāvupayoga iti cet; na; tataḥ tadvadarthābhivyaktiprasaṅgāt

nanu visarjanīyādirvācako dṛśyate na kevalaḥ tathā ca vaiyākaraṇamatam--na kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā na ca kevalaḥ pratyayaḥ iti; tataḥ samudāyasyaiva padatvāt kathamuktam--varṇasamudāyaḥ padamiti prātiprāyikametat iti
atha sambodhanādau vibhaktilopāpekṣayā idamucyate; na; lope'pi padatvaṃ pratyupayogāt
tulanā--ubhayaniyamo'yaṃ prakṛtipara eva pratyayaḥ prayoktavyaḥ pratyayaparaiva ca prakṛtiḥ
yadāha akalaṅkaḥ siddhiviniścaye--varṇasamudāyaḥ padamiti prāyikametat, pratyekamakārādeḥ kādācitkatvadarśanāt
106ityanena pūrvasya padatve kevalo'kārādiḥ padamiti; tanna sāram; yataḥ vācakasya padatvāt, vācakaṃ ca savibhaktikam, pūrvasya tu prayojanaviśeṣāpekṣayā padatvaṃ pāribhāṣikam iti

103 iti pāribhāṣikapadamiti pāribhāṣikapadamiha gṛhyate, api tu padyate gamyate yenārthaḥ tatpadam, arthaśca avibhaktikādapi śabdāt anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ gamyate, itarathā vittatsutpatteḥ prāk arthavattvāparijñānāt na prātipadikasaṃjñāvidhānam ityanarthakamiti na sūktam arthataddhātuprajñāyaḥ prātipadikam pāṇini॰ 1
nanvevaṃ niyatopasargāṇām padatvaṃnasyāt, nahi taiḥ kaścidartho'pūrvo gamyate prakṛtyarthādyotakatvāditi cet; atrāha--dyotakatve'pi ityādi
na kevalaṃ vācakatve api tu dyotakatve padatvāttato'pyarthaḥ pratīyate anyathā tatprayogānarthakyam
yadi padyate yenārthaḥ tatpadam; sphoṭa eva syāt, tena hi akārādivyaṃjena arthaḥ gamyate iti cet; atrāha--na ca naiva vācakaṃ yukta nyāyena
kim ? ityāha--dhvanivyaṃgya dhvanibhiḥ akārādibhiḥ prakāsthāṃ dhvanibhya eva arthapratītidarśanāt ityuktam
tadapi kutaḥ ? ityāha--anabhivyaktam adṛśyatmānaṃ svabhāvaṃ vihāya ātmāntaraṃ dṛśyasvabhāvamāsādayato'nityatāprasaṅgāt
etadapi kutaḥ ? ityāha--tādātmyaṃ vyaktena ca ātmatvaṃ hiryasmāt pariṇāmalakṣaṇam
atha dhvanibhiḥ tasya na kiṃcidasatīyate ca pa nīyate vā tattva tha manityatvam, atrāha--nayāyopajanetyādi
tādṛśāṃ niyamena nityatve niṣkalatve abhivyaktau ghaṭādestathābhāvaḥ kinna kalpyeta aviśeṣāt
dhvanibhyo'rthāḥ...na ca...tato na sat kūṭasthaṃ nāma tadbuddherasañcāraprasaṅgāt
nanu kṣaṇikatve'pi tadbuddhyasaṃcāradoṣaḥ tadabhāvāviśeṣāt anantarakṣaṇavat anyadāpi prasaṅgāt
āpāyo vināśa upajananam upajanaḥ janma, na vidyete apāyopajanau yasya sa tathoktaḥ
sa vikāro yasya tadapi tathoktam avikāram ityarthaḥ
tatpratidhvanīnām akiñcitkaratvāt kathaṃ vyañjakatvaṃ teṣāmiti ? kiṃ ca tasya tairyaugapadyenābhivyaktau ghena ekena sarvātmanābhivyaktatvāt ṭakārādīnāṃ vaiyarthyam, prakāśitaprakāśanadoṣāt

tādṛśāṃ dhvanivyāpārāt pūrvam ekāntenānupalabhyamānānāṃ tadvyāpāre ca upalabhyamānānāṃ niyamena nityatve niṣkalatve niraṃśatve aṅgīkriyamāṇe tādṛśāṃ sphoṭādīnāmabhivyaktau ca cāṅgīkriyamāṇāyāṃ ghaṭādeḥ tathā nityatvaniṣkalatvābhivyaṅgyatvaprakāreṇa bhāvaḥ sattā kinna kalpeta ? kutaḥ ? ityāha— aviśeṣāt atiśayābhāvāt
ghaṭādirapi nityo niravayavaścakrādibhirabhivyajyate na kriyate ityapi syāt
dīpādivaiyarthyamiti cet; na; ekatra prakāśakadvayāvirodhāt rūpe cakṣurālokavat
sadā cakrādisahitasyaiva dīpādeḥ tatprakāśanaṃ cet; na; kadācit nirālokasya cakṣuṣa eva prakāśakatvadarśanāt

atha ghaṭādeḥ pradīpāreriva vyañjakaḥ; cakrādiḥ kiṃ bhaviṣyati, akiñcitkarasya apekṣaṇīyatvāyogāt ? kāraka iti cet; kuta etat ? prāgasataḥ tata ātmalābhāt ghaṭāderiti cet; prāgasataḥ iti kutaḥ ? dṛśyasyādarśanāditi cet; sphoṭasya dhvanivyāpārāt prāk kiṃ darśanamasti ? tathā cet; tadvyāpāravaiphalyam
no cet; kutaḥ sattvam ? punarupalambhāt, itarathā kharaviṣāṇavat tadayogāditi cet; tadetat ghaṭādau samānam
ṣyāsyātmakatve dhvanibhyo'pi na darśanamiti sādhvī teṣāṃ vyañjakatvakalpanā
pūrvaṃ tadātmakatvaṃ na paścāt; itaratra samānam
syānmatam--dhvanīnāṃ kārakatve vyañjakaṃ kiṃ tasya ? tailādeḥ kārakatve dīpādervyañjakāntaraṃ mṛgyam ityalaṃ prasaṅgena
syānmatam--ghaṭādeḥ sāvayavasya pratīteḥ tathābhāvo niṣkalabhāvaḥ kalpyeta, sphoṭasyāpi kramaśo'bhivyajyamānasya sāvayavatvapratītiḥ tadavasthā

bhavatu tasya tato'bhivyaktiḥ na dhvanibhyaḥ sphoṭasya viparyayāditi darśayannāha--dhvanibhyo'rthā...548 ka, kha 549 ka, kha iti dve patre alikhite eva vartete ...karṣamantareṇa pratyayahetuḥ syāt tanna gotvaṃ bhinnaṃ viniyataṃ siddhyati
anyatrāpi tathākalpanāyāṃ sūktam na ca ityādi
nanu yaduktaṃ kenacit kiṃcidkriyamāṇaṃvakṣyamānaṃ vā tatkṛtopakāramapekṣate nāma iti; tadayuktam; jñānasyaiva tena tatra jananāt
idamatra cintyate--sāmānyaṃ svavijñānajanana yogyam, anyathā vā ? yogyaṃ cet; vyaktyabhāve'pi janayet
prakṛtaṃ nigamayannāha--tato na sad vidyamānaṃ kūṭastha nāma
kūṭasthasya buddheḥ tadbuddheḥ saṃcaraṇaṃ deśakālāntaragamanaṃ saṃcāraḥ na saṃcāro'saṃcāraḥ tasya prasaṅgāt
tathāhi--yadā ekasmin kṣaṇe deśe vā tasya sattvam; tataḥ kālāntarāditatsambandhasya ekāntena abhede tāvanmātraṃ taditi dvitīyādikṣaṇānāṃ tacchūnyatvamiti na tatra tadbuddhyavatāro nirviṣayatvabhayāt
yadi vā, yena svabhāvena kvacid deśādau svajñānaṃ janayati tat tenaiva, anyatra anyadā tajjanane sarvatatkāryasyaikadā ekatra prasava iti na kālādairdhyādipratītiḥ
nanvevam--pra jñā ka ri ṇai va bhavatāpi kṣaṇikatvaṃ kakṣīkṛtaṃ syāt, ta cca nakṣamṛte atyakṣādātmānaṃ kṣaṇamātramapi bhedena vyavasthāpayitum; ityāha--nanu ityādi
na kevalaṃ kūṭasthe kintu kṣaṇikatve'pi samānaḥ tasya kṣaṇikatvasya buddhiḥ tasyāḥ asaṃcāraḥ sa eva doṣaḥ tadbuddhyasaṃcāradoṣaḥ
yathaiva hi kūṭasthasya pūrvāparasattvayormadhyasattvābhedabhāvaḥ, tathāhi niraṃśakṣaṇikaparamāṇusaṃvedanasya puruṣādyasaṃvedanādabhedādabhāvaḥ
yathaiva hi kūṭasthe samarthe ekatra kṣaṇe sakalabuddhyutpādaḥ tathā kṣaṇike'pi tatkāla eva buddhibhāvāt santānasaṃcaraṇābhāvaḥ
kāraṇakṣaṇād dvitīyaḥ kṣaṇaḥ anantarakṣaṇaḥ tatra iva tadvat anyadāpi kālāntare'pi prasaṅgāt kāryasya pāratantryābhāvāt
anyatrāpi prasaṅgo'styeva jāgraddarśanāt prabodhabhāvāditi cet; na; tadanantaraṃ tanniścayānudayaprasaṅgena kṣaṇakṣayādivat tadvyavahāroccheda ityuktamiti
yaduktaṃ kūṭasthavat kṣaṇikatve'pi buddhyasaṃcāra iti satyamevamuktaprakāreṇetat, ubhayātmakatattvopagamāditi bhāvaḥ
nahi caurasamudāyo'cauraiṣṭa iti cet; atrāha--syāddhetuphalatādātmye ityādi
kathañcinnityatve'pi pūrvāparayoḥ...yathā nityatve kṣaṇakṣaye vā paramāṇūnāṃ pārimaṇḍalyamajahatāmeva sthūlatve sthūlākāreṇāpi nānupalambhaprasaṅgaḥ pārimaṇḍalyavat
yathā vā jñānasya saṃvedanavat nīlādyākārasya nāviśeṣaprasaṅgaḥ kathañcittādātmyāt, tathā sarvasya syāt, hetuphalayostādātmyenaivopalabdheḥ iti
syāt kathaṃcit hetuphalayoḥ upādānopādeyayoḥ tādātmye sati na ubhayaikāntadoṣaḥ ādiśabdena virodhādiparigrahaḥ
sthūlaṃ ca tadavayavyapekṣayā aṇu ca avayavāpekṣayā tadeva ca tattvaṃ mahacca tat sthūlāṇu tatreva tadvaditi
yathā avayavāvayavinoḥ kathaṃcittādātmye sa na doṣaḥ, tathā anyatrāpi
kṣaṇakṣayeti nityatve kṣaṇakṣaye vā paramāṇūnāṃ pārimaṇḍalyaṃ niraṃśavartulatvamajahatāmeva tatparityāge abhāgo'vayavī sakalāvaraṇādidoṣabhāg bhavet
keneva ? ityāha--pārimaṇḍalyeneva tadvaditi sthūlākāravadvā teṣāṃ na pārimaṇḍalyopalabdhiḥ
nidarśanāntaramāha--yathā cā jñānasya citrabodhasya yo nīlādirākāraḥ tasya nāviśeṣaprasaṅgaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā jñānasya svanīlādyākāre saṃvedanamaviśiṣṭaṃ naiva nīlādiḥcitrarvābhāvaprasaṅgāditi
yathā vā na tātparya saṃvittiḥnīlena nīlākāratayā samānāpi na jaḍatayā samā iti

nanu yadi nāma dṛṣṭāntatvenopātte vastuni kathaṃcidabhedaḥ tathopalabdheḥ pūrvāparayoḥ kimāyātam, yenocyate kathaṃcinnityatve'pi iti cet; atrāha--syāt kathaṃcit hetuphalayroḥ yattādātmyaṃ tenaiva upalabdheḥ sarvasya iti
tatra vahistattvam antastattvaṃ vā avikalpe niraṃśakṣaṇikatayā cakāsti
viparītapratibhāsastu mithyāvikalpa iti cet; atrāha--nityakṣaṇikatattvārtha ityādi
svasaṃvitteḥ svataḥ vyavasāyopapatteśca, anyathā ana vasthānādapratipattiḥ parataḥ...tasmāt tattvataḥ iṣṭāniṣṭagrahatyāgayoḥ niyogataḥ anupapatteḥ prekṣāvān kutaḥ pravarteta ?
kvacit paricchedye karmaṇi niyojanamiti niyogi nityaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ vā viṣayīkurviti, na vidyate niyogo'sya iti aniyogaḥ sa cāsau grahaśca nirviṣayagraha ityarthaḥ
nityādi nityakṣaṇikatattve sarvopāyo stau ca tau mithyaikāntavikalpau ca tayoḥ satoḥ iti
nirvikalpe sati sa niyogagraho'nayoriti cet; atrāha--avikalpāprasiddhiḥ avikalpasya avikalpena ca aprasiddhiḥ anayoriti vyākhyāne
kutaḥ ? ityāha--avikalpenāprasiddhiḥ syādanayoḥ yataḥ, taduktamatra pūrvam aṅgīkṛtātmasaṃvitteḥ siddhivi॰ 1
tathā idamaparaṃ tadvikalpayoraniyogagrahaḥ kṣaṇikavikalpasya pramāṇatvena svīkāro netarasya iti yo niyogo niyamaḥ tasya abhāvo yasmin tathokto grahaḥ dvayorgrahaṇamagrahaṇaṃ vā ityarthaḥ
atha kṣaṇikavikalpasya vastuni pratibandhāt tasyāvikalpena pratipatteḥ tasyaiva graha iti cet; atrāha--avikalpaprasiddheḥ avikalpena tattvasyāsiddhiḥ
kṛta ityāha--dṛṣṭe pratyakṣeṇa pratipātra kṣaṇikatvādau pramāṇāntarasya anumānasya vṛtteḥ itarathā tanna vartteta
syānmatam--yatra samāropo nāsti tasya niścayamantareṇāpi siddhiḥ, tadāha--asamāropita ityādi
samāropasya vyavacchedo yasmin jñāne tasyaiva vyavasāyātmakatvāt ityuktaprāyam prathamaprastāve
etena abhyāsadaśāpi cintitā tasyāmapi sāṃśasyaiva pravedanādi ti; tatra ityāha--svasaṃvitteḥ ityādi
vyavasāyasya yā ātmavittiḥ tasyāḥ svataḥ ātmanaiva vyavasāyopapatteśca tatra anyathā svato vyavasāyābhāvaprakāreṇa anavasthānādapratipattiḥ vyavasāyasvarūpaniścāyakasyāpi niścayasya anyato niścayāt
sugamam ? tataḥ kiṃ jātam ? ityāha--tattvata ityādi
paramārthataḥ tacceṣṭamiṣṭaṃ tayoḥ grahatyāgayoḥ niyogataḥ svayamanupapatteḥ prekṣāvān kuto nityavikalpād anyato vā pravartteta tadyadi anekāntapratipattiriti
nityamapi vyāpi syāditi mīmāṃsakaḥ; tatrāha--nityatve'pi ityādi
śrotraṃ tāvat samānendriyagrāhyasamānadeśasamānadharmāpannārthānāṃ grahaṇmaya pratiniyatasaṃskārakasaṃskāryaṃ na bhavati indriyatvāt cakṣurvat
śabdā vā pratiniyatasaṃskārakasaṃskāryā na bhavanti samānendriyagrāhyasamānadharmāpannatve sati yugapadindriyasambaddhatvāt ghaṭādivat
samānakaraṇānāṃ tādṛśāmabhivyaktiniyamāyogāt sarvatra sarvadā sarveṣāṃ saṃkulā śrutiḥ syāt
nityatve kūṭasthatve'pi śabdānāmakṣarāṇāṃ na kevalaṃ kadācitkaśravaṇaṃ na saṃbhavati śravaṇaikasvabhāvānāṃ sarvadā śravaṇaṃ saṃbhavati ityarthaḥ
atha yadā jñānaṃ tadā śravaṇam, anyadā viparyayaḥ; na jñānaṃ kutaḥ tebhyaḥ sarvadā syāt ? nityasyāpekṣaṇaṃ ca nirastam
syānmatam--āvaraṇasadbhāve aśravaṇaṃ tadabhāve śravaṇam; upapannametat--yasyāvaraṇena teṣāṃ tajjananasāmarthyamapasāryeta
samarthaṃ tu vyavahitamapi svakāryaṃ janayati yathāsaṃbhūtacakṣuḥ timiravyavahitaṃ rūpasya
tato na kevalaṃ kādācitkaśravaṇaṃ na saṃbhavati vivakṣitaikaśrutiniyamaśca na saṃbhavati sakṛt sarveṣāṃ śrutiḥ syāt ityarthaḥ
atha sarvatra sarvadā sarveṣāṃ sannidhāne'pi yasya yatra vyañjakasannidhiḥ tatra tasya śravaṇamiti; tatrāha--samākṣa ityādi
iṣṭasya akārasya anyasya vā tālvādipreritāt dhvanerabhivyaktiḥ prakāśanaṃ netarasya iti yo'yaṃ tadvyaktiniyamaḥ sa na
nanu ekendriyagrahayogyā api deśādibhinnā ghaṭādayo naikapradīpavyaṅgyā iti cet; atrāha--vyāpināṃ teṣāṃ samavasthiteḥ ekadeśe sthiteḥ ataḥ tanniyamābhāvāt sarveṣāmakṣarāṇāṃ sakṛcchrutiḥ
na khalu samānadeśeṣu samānendriyagrahaṇayogyeṣu vyaktiniyamo dṛṣṭaḥ yena anyatrāpi kalpyate
nanu ghaṭādau dṛṣṭo dharmo nānyatra yojanamarhati, anyathā rathyāpuruṣe upalabdho dharmaḥ puruṣa svayamabhimate yojanamarhet

syānmatam--anupadeśā'liṅgā'vyabhicārinaṣṭamuṣṭyādyupadeśānyathānupapatteḥ tatkalpanamiti; tarhi vyāpināṃ samākṣagrahayogyānāṃ kādācitkā'śravaṇānyathānupapattyā pratiniyatāvaraṇam, tathā vidhaśravaṇānyathānupapatteḥ pratiniyatavyañjakānāṃ vā iti kalpanamastu aviśeṣāditi; na; pratiniyatāvaraṇaniṣedhāt, tatsvarūpākhaṇḍanāt
atha indriyasya tadgrahaṇayogyatā tena pratihanyate; sāpi na sādhvī kalpanā; viṣayasya darśanajananayogyasya bhāve darśanasya avaśyambhāvāt
sahakāriṇaḥ pratihataprasaratvānneti cet; na; nityasya tadapekṣāyogāt
ātmanaḥ sā tena pratihanyata ityapi mithyā; nityatvāttasya
kāryotpattipratibandhaḥ kriyate cet; na; samarthe kāraṇe tasyā'vaśyaṃbhāvāt, itarathā kāraṇaṃ janayati tacca pratibadhnātīti kācapacyaṃ bhāvānā
tadapi kathamiti cet ? ayamaparo'sya doṣo'stu, kevalaṃ vayamabhyupagamavādinaḥ
tacca vyavadhāyakamekamapi samānadeśānāṃ samānendriyagrāhyāṇāṃ samānamiti kenacittadapasāraṇe sarveṣāṃ yugapadgrahaṇam, kaupaṭāpasāraṇe tathāpica ghaṭānāmiva
ye'pi manyante--ātmā manasā yujyate tadapi nabhasā śravaṇendriyeṇa, tatpunararthena śabdena

atra indriyārthayoḥ samavāyaḥ sambandha iti; te'pi etena nirvarttitottarāḥ; teṣāmapi sakṛt sarveṣāṃ śabdānāṃ śrutiḥ syāt vyāpyekāntataḥ śrotram, tatra samavetāḥ sarve śabdā iti saṃyuktasamavāyaḥ manasā vivakṣitavat sambandho'viśiṣṭa iti
adṛṣṭavaśād gaganasamavetasya karṇaśaṣkulīśrotreṇāvirodhāt grahaṇasya, ghaṭasamavetarūpasyeva cakṣuṣā
tanna yuktam--śabdaḥ svasamānajātīyaviśeṣaguṇavatā indriyeṇa gṛhyate bāhyaikendriyagrāhyatvāt rūpādivat
yugapajjñānānutpattirapi viśiṣṭādṛṣṭādeva syāditi manaḥkalpanā vyarthā syāditi bhāvaḥ
tulanā--yasya bāhyaikendriyagrāhyaviśeṣaguṇagrāhakaṃ yadindriyaṃ tattadguṇakaṃyathā rūpagrāhakaṃ cakṣū rūpādhikaraṇam, śrotraṃ ca tathābhūtasya śabdasya grāhakaṃ tasmāttadapi śabdaguṇakam
syānmatam--anekatvāt nabhaso nāyaṃ doṣa iti; tathāhi--devadattakarṇaśaṣkulīparikarapariruddhamatra nabho'nyadattaḥ tatra samavetasya nānyena grahaṇam
tatredaṃ cintyate--kiṃ tasya kāraṇamiti ? tadeva nabhaḥ iti cedaṃsamavāyikāraṇaṃ vācyam ? na ca tadantareṇa parasya guṇabhāvaḥ
bherīdaṇḍasaṃyoga iti cet; na; tatra tadabhāvāt, svakāraṇasamavāyi vā samavāyi kāraṇa dhvaneḥ
vyuparate ca tatsaṃyoge punaḥ tacchravaṇaṃ na syāt
kṣaṇikatvāt dhvaneḥ na tasya tat; śabdānna śabdaniṣpattiḥ vaiśe॰ sū॰ 2
atha pūrvaḥ śabdo'samavāyikāraṇam sa nabho'ntarasamaveto tatatkāraṇam, anyathā kapālarūpādayaḥ paṭarūpādīnāṃ tatkāraṇaṃ syuḥ
yadi punaretanmatam--pūrvaśabdākāśaiḥ tadākāśajanyate, tataḥ svakāraṇasamavāyi vā' samavāyikāraṇaṃ na virudhyete
tāni tasya samavāyikāraṇaṃ cet; prathamaśabdākāśamārūḍhānāmeva pareṣāmutpattiriti nākāśavṛddhiḥ, sati kāraṇe kāryotpattau santānāvṛddhivat
atha śabdaḥ antaḥkaraṇapratyāsanno gṛhyate vibhudravyaviśeṣaguṇatvāt sukhādivat; atrāpi nabhaso'nekatve pūrvavad doṣaḥ
ekatve; gaganamanasoranaṃśayoḥ saṃyoge sarveṣāṃ śabdānāṃ tatpratyāsattiḥ samānā iti sthitamidam--sarveṣāṃ sakṛcchratiriti

ayamabhiprāyaḥ--vyañjakena vyaṅgyābhimatasya kaścidatiśayaḥ kriyate, na vā ? prathamapakṣe tatkṛtaṃ vyañjakakṛtam upakāraṃ grāhyatālakṣaṇamitiśayamātmasātkurvataḥ svabhāvabhūtamavalambamānasya taddeśavṛttiniyamābhāvāt vyañjakadeśavarttananiyamāt
śravaṇendriyagrāhyasvabhāvaḥ padārthaḥ śabdaḥ, sa yatraiva śrūyate tatraivāsti, vyañjakadeśe ca śrūyate
na khalu ghaṭo'nyatra dṛśyamānaḥ anyatrāpyasti, sarvagatatvaprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ
tanniyamāt kim ? ityāha--kūṭasthasya nityābhimatā kṣasya niyame tadeśa vṛttirevatataḥ kim ? ityāha--na saṃbhavati sarvagatatvam ityadhyāhāraḥ
sarvagatatve satyapi śabdānāṃ vivakṣitaikaśabdaśrutirna syāt, sarveṣāṃ syādityarthaḥ, śravaṇagrahaṇayogyatvāt
na hiryasmāt samānadeśānāṃ samānākṣaviṣayāṇāmetat niyatavyañjakatvam nāpyaṃpramāṇopapannaṃ kvacit tathā'darśanāt vyavadhāyakatadapasāraṇayoḥ sarvatra sādhāraṇatvāt
ekamekaṃ varṇaṃ prati pratyekam vyañjakaniyame akārasya vyañjako nāparasya iti niyoge aṅgīkriyamāṇe kalakalaśruteranupapatteḥ kāraṇāt etannyāyyam nahi
tathā hi--āvaraṇavigamakāriṇi vyañjake tanniyamo na saṃbhavati ityuktam
vyaṅgyātiśayā vāpi ne tu saṃbhavati kintu tasyānityatvam, śrotrātiśayādhāyyakiñcitkaram ityuktam
kevalaṃ tadbuddhijanakaṃ vyañjakamavaśiṣyate, tasya vyaktirapi buddhireva
tatraikatvena buddhiḥ kasyacit kenacidutpāditā yadā bhavati, tadā sato'pyanyān na gṛhṇīyāt
vivakṣitaiḥ vyañjakaiḥ saha saṃbhūya saikā janyata iti cet; na sadetat; yataḥ vyañjakāniyamaprasaṅgāt, anyavyañjakairapi anyabuddhijananāt
eko varṇaḥ kalakala iti cet; na; varṇabhedapratīteḥ
atha vyañjakena tasya na kiṃcit kriyate tathāpi tato vyaktiḥ; tatrāha--vyakta ityādi
vyañjakavyāpāradaśāyāṃ vyaktaśca tadvyāpārātpūrvamavyaktasva tau svabhāvau ca yotaḥ prāptiśca parihāraśca yāthāsaṃkhyena tāvantareṇa kuto vyaktiḥ ? adhunā vyaktasya tirodhānaṃ dūṣayannāha--tat ityādi
tayoḥ vyaktāvyaktasvabhāvayoḥ yāthāsaṃkhyena tyāgaścopādānaṃ ca tābhyāmṛte kutaḥ tirodhānam ityuktaprāyam
śabdānāmavyāpitve satyapi vyañjakavyāpāre vyaktiravaśyambhāvinī na bhavet jātisambandhavat
na hi vyaktijanmadeśe prāk asatyā jātyā sambandho yujyate
vyañjakasya tālvādeḥ tajjanitavāyorvā vyāpṛtau na syād vyaṅgyasya śabdasya niyamādgatiḥ
tataḥ kim ? ityāha--nāvaśyaṃbhāvaniyamaḥ śruteḥ śabdasya uccāraṇāt tālvādivyāpārāttataḥ
kārikāṃ vivṛṇvannāha--śabdānāmavyāpitve aṅgīkriyamāṇe satyapi vidyamāne'pi vyañjakavyāpāre vyaktiravaśyaṃbhāvinī na bhavet
nahi prāk vyaktyutpatteḥ pūrvam asatyā jātyā
saugatena ucyamānamidaṃ mīmāṃsakadūṣaṇaṃ tasyapi lagatīti darśayannāha--sanniverityādi

vedya...ityabhyupetya saugataḥ pratipattuḥ yathāsannidhānaṃ sakalopalambhāśakteḥ kathañcit kasyacit śrutiriti bruvāṇaṃ mīmāṃsakaṃ kathaṃ pratikṣipet ? viṣayaviṣayiṇoḥ avisaṃvādaniyamasya anekāntākarṣaṇāt tadanyathānupapatteḥ, asaṃbhavāt
nahi...paramparayāpi svalakṣaṇāni hetavo na bhavantyeva kṣaṇikatve...ataḥ sarvathā na saṃbhavatyarthasya avisaṃvādalakṣaṇam
tata eva jñānasyāpi tadākārasya, tadviṣayatāyāḥ saugatairanabhyupagamāt tatpratibhāsavirodhācca kathamavyāptiḥ ? upādānopādeyasaṃvidoḥ
ekadā ekasmin kṣaṇe śrutiḥ śravaṇaṃ saṃbhavet ityupaskāraḥ
katham ? ityāha— aśeṣataḥ aśeṣarūpeṇa, sadādineva kṣaṇakṣayādināpi ityarthaḥ
kasmin sati ? ityāha--ekākṣasambandhe ekena akṣeṇa sambandhe sati yenākṣeṇa sadādeḥ tena kṣaṇakṣayāderapi

evaṃ manyate--yadi samānadeśānāṃ samānendriyagrāhyāṇāṃ niyamena yugapachrutiḥ tarhi sadādikṣaṇakṣayādeḥ yugapacchravaṇaṃ bhaved ekādhāraikendriyagrāhyatvāt, tathā ca vyañjakāntaravat pramāṇāntaramanarthakamiti bhāvaḥ
52 ityādi vacanāt, iti cet; atrāha--na ityādyate na kevalam antarabhipretānaṃśakṣaṇikasaṃvido na bahirapyabhipretānaṃśakṣaṇikasaṃvido na tathāpratītiḥ iti bhāvaḥ
ko'nyo na dṛṣṭo bhāgaḥ syādyaḥ pramāṇaiḥ parīkṣyate
kṣaṇikeṣu paramāṇuṣu na tattvasya niraṃśakṣaṇikasvabhāvasya upalabdhiḥ
tathā antastattve samānaṃ na tattvopalabdhiḥ ityetatsadṛśam
ityevam abhyupetya abhyupagamya saugataḥ kathaṃ pratikṣipet nirākuryāt ? kiṃ kurvantam ? ityāha--pratipattuḥ ityādi

pratipattuḥ puruṣasya yathāsannidhānaṃ sannidhānānatikrameṇa sakalasya śabdarāśeḥ upalambhāśakteḥ kathaṃcit kenāpi niyatadeśādiprakāreṇa kasyacid akārasya anyasya vā śabdātmanaḥ śrutirityevaṃ bruvāṇaṃ mīmāṃsakam

yathā bahiḥparamāṇūnāṃ nīlatāmātrasya antaḥsaṃvedanasya saccetanāderupalambhe'pi sannihitasyāpi na kṣaṇakṣayāderupalambhaḥ tathā akāropalambhe sannihitasyāpītarasya na śrutiḥ pratipattiḥ tathāśakteḥ iti bhāvaḥ
nanu nāntarbahirvā paramārthato niraṃśakṣaṇikaparamāṇurūpaṃ tattvaṃ yenāyaṃ doṣaḥ syāt api tu yathā'visaṃvādaniyamamiti cet; atrāha--viṣaya ityādi
viṣayo ghaṭādiḥ viṣayi jñānaṃ tayoḥ yo'visaṃvādaniyamaḥ tasya anekāntākarṣaṇāt tena tadākarṣaṇāditi draṣṭavyam
kutaḥ ? ityāha--tasya tanniyamasya anyathā tadākarṣaṇābhāvaprakāreṇa anupapatteḥ
nanu yaduktam--na bahirabhipretānaṃśakṣaṇikasaṃvidaḥ iti, niyamasya anekāntākarṣaṇāt' iti ca; tanna yuktam; paramāṇubhyo'naṃśakṣaṇikākārasaṃvido'bhāvāt
tanniyamo'pi tatraiva iti cet; atrāha--asaṃbhavāt ityādi
svasya saugatasya iṣṭo'rthaḥ kṣaṇikaniraṃśaparamāṇulakṣaṇaḥ tasyā'visaṃvāde saṃpratipattau kriyamāṇāyāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ na pramāṇam sārūpyamasya pramāṇam nyāyabi॰ 1
kim ? ityāha--svākārajñānaṃhetutā svasya arthasya ākāra iva ākāro yasya jñānasya hetoḥ bhāvaḥ tattā
tarhi svalakṣaṇebhyaḥ kāryaṃ kiṃcilliṅgabhūtaṃ tataḥ tadākāraṃ jñānam ataḥ paramparayā tāni svākārajñānahetava iti; tatrāha--paramparayāpi uktayā na kevalaṃ sākṣāt hetavo na bhavanti eva svalakṣaṇāni
ato'smānnyāyāt sarvathā pratyakṣānumānaprakāreṇa na saṃbhavatyarthasya paraparikalpitavastuno'visaṃvādātkṣaṇamavyabhicāri pramāṇam
mābhūt bahiḥ svalakṣaṇānāmavisaṃvāhalakṣayaṃ saugataiḥ tanniṣedhāt, jñānasya tu syāditi cet; atrāha--tata ityādi
tata eva sthūlaikānvayinaḥ sākṣāddarśanādeva jñānasyāpi na kevalaṃ bahiḥsvalakṣaṇānām
kiṃbhūtasya ? tadākārasya svalakṣaṇākārasya sarvathā na saṃbhavati tallakṣaṇamiti padaghaṭanā
yadyathāvabhāsate tattathaiva paramārthasadvyavahārāvatāri ityādi vacanāt sthūlaikānvayiviṣayameva jñānamastu iti cet; atrāha--tad ityādi
tad ityanena sthūlaikānvayī parāmṛśyate sa viṣayo yasya jñānasya tasyabhāvaḥ tattā tasyāḥ saugatairanabhyupagamāt kṣaṇabhaṅgādibhaṅgabhayāt
tasya sthūlaikānvayinaḥ pratibhāsaḥ tadākāratā jñānasya tasya virodhāt
dvitīyaṃ hetuṃ vyākhyātuṃ pareṇa ātmānaṃ payuti kathamavyāptiḥ iti; uttaramāha--upādānopādeyasaṃvidoḥ ityādi
avyāptiṃ vyākhyātuṃ praśnayati— kathamavyāptiḥ iti ? tatrottaraṃ vijñāna ityādi tādṛgeva
bhavatu vā sadādineva kṣaṇayādināpi bhāvasya grahaṇaṃ tathāpi saugatasya mīmāṃsako durjaya iti darśayannāha--bhinnasya ityādi
pratyakṣaṃ sarvataḥ tadvat niyamaḥ syād girāṃ śruteḥ || 11

svalakṣaṇasya svabhāvavilakṣaṇasya darśanaṃ tatsvabhāvaviśeṣasannidhānāviśeṣe'pi kvacit yadi sākṣād vyavasāyaṃ janayati, girāṃ...buddhiḥ akhaṇḍaṃ svaṃ paraṃ vā khaṇḍayantī kathaṃ niyamāt sannihitasakalārthagrāhiṇī nāma, na vai vikalpavuddhiḥ aparamārthaviṣayā proktam...
kiṃ bhūtāt ? sarvataḥ sajātīyetararūpāt saṃbandhi yat pratyakṣaṃ tadvyavasāyaye niśvāsaṃya yet
kim ? bhedaṃ vyāvṛttim na sarvataḥ vijātīyāttaṃ vyavasāyayenna sajātīyapūrvottarakṣaṇābhyāṃ kṣaṇikatvānumānavaiphalyāpatteḥ yadvat tadvaditi śravaṇādevaṃ gamyate tadvanniyamaḥ syāt girāṃ śruteḥ
tat kathaṃ kurvan kiṃ karoti ? ityāha— sākṣād avyavadhānena vyavasāyaṃ niścayaṃ janayatsatata sarvavyāvṛttiprasaṅgāt
saḥ svānubhūte vyavasāyajanakaḥ svabhāvaviśeṣo yasya, anyathā nīlādā vasāyo na bhaved asaktasyājanakatvāt, tajjanaketarabhedāt tadbhedo vā, tattathoktaṃ darśanaṃ tasya sannidhānasyā'viśeṣe'pi yadi
atha nīlādivat kṣaṇakṣayādau vyavasāyajanakaḥ tadviśeṣaḥ tasya nāsti; tatrāha--akhaṇḍam ityādi
akhaṇḍamadvayaṃ svam ātmānaṃ buddhiḥ khaṇḍayantī svaviṣaye adhyavasāyajananasamarthetararūpatayā sāṃśaṃ kurvantī

nanu nīlādau tajjananasāmarthyameva anyatrā'sāmarthyam, ato'yamadoṣa iti cet; nityasyāpi ekadā sāmarthyamanyadā asāmarthyaṃ syāt, tato yathā nityaṃ svakāryaṃ yugapat sarvadātmānaṃ bhinnanti tathā buddhirapi iti sthitam paraṃ vā'khaṇḍaṃ khaṇḍaṃ khaṇḍayantī
tathāhi--nīle niścayaṃ janayati na kṣaṇakṣaye, tato gṛhītetarayoriva niścitetarayorapi bhedaḥ
yathāhi darśanaṃ svaviṣayatvā'viśeṣe'pi sannihitayorapi nīlakṣaṇikatvayorapi nīlakṣaṇikatvayorvibhāgena niścayaṃ janayati tathā śrotraṃ svabiṣayeṣu rākārādiṣu iti bhāvaḥ
nanu syādevaṃ yadi darśanavad arthaviṣayā vikalpabuddhiḥ syāt, yāvatā nirviṣayatā tatkathaṃ tadbhedādarthabheda iti ? tadāha--na vai vikalpabuddhiḥ ityādinā
darśanaṃ nīlavat kṣaṇakṣaye pravṛttamapi sahakārivaiphalyādaviśeṣeṇana niścayamutpādayati ityatra darśane punarapi dūṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha--sākalyena ityādi

sākalyena sāmastyena gṛhīte'pi śabdarāśau akārihakāraparyantavarṇasamūhe sakṛdviyā śravaṇajñānena, yasya śabdasya vyavasāyo yadvyavasāyaḥ tasmin karttavye asti pratyayaḥ sahakārikāraṇaṃ vidyate śaśabdaḥ pratīyate nānya iti
darśanasya vibhāgena vikalpajanakatvamabhyupagamya idamuktam, idānīṃ tadeva nāstīti darśayannāha--yathā ityādi
yathā rūpasvalakṣaṇaṃ sākṣādupanipatya vijñānaṃ janayat ātmanāntarīyakamākāraṃ puraskartuṃ nāyuktaṃ tathā taddarśanaṃ vyavasāyaṃ tena viśeṣaḥ vyavasīyeta
yathāyenayogyatāprakāreṇa artho rūpādiḥ anubhavaṃ darśanaṃ sākṣād avyavadhānena kartumarhati
kiṃbhūtam ? ityāha--svāpekṣaṃ svaśabdena arthaḥ parāmṛśyate tasmin apekṣā tadanubhavanākāṅkṣā yasya tattathoktam svākāram ityarthaḥ
tathā tena prakāreṇa arthānubhavaḥ sākṣādananyavyavasāyakṛt na vidyate anyat svarūpāntaraṃ yasya tat ananyat svalakṣaṇamiti yāvat, tasya vyavasāyaḥ tatkṛta

rūpagrahaṇamupalakṣaṇaṃ rasādeḥ tadeva svalakṣaṇaṃ sākṣādupanipatya upaḍhaukya vijñānaṃ svānubhavaṃ janayatāyathā yena vastusvabhāvaprakāreṇa nāyuktamevam ātmanāntarīyakam ātmānamavidyamānamākāraṃ puraskartum tathā taddarśanaṃ svalakṣaṇānubhavaḥ sākṣādupanipatya vyavasāyaṃ nātmānantarīyakamākāraṃ puraskartu māyuktam, tena kāraṇena viśeṣaḥ svalakṣaṇaṃ vyavasīyeta

adhunā prakārāntareṇa darśanasya vyavasāyahetutvaṃ nirākurvannāha--dṛṣṭabhiprāyaḥ--svayaṃ vyavasāyātmikā dṛṣṭiḥ, anyathā vā syāt ? tatrādyapakṣe; kimapareṇa vyavasāyena ? dvitīye; dṛṣṭeḥ svabhāvabhūto viśeṣavyavasāyaḥ tasyābhāve avikalpakatve, kutaḥ sajātīyasmṛtiḥ ? naiva
asti ca parasya tatsmṛtiḥ, tatastadanyathānupapatteḥ vyavasāyātmikā dṛṣṭiriti
adhunā śrotriyavat sphoṭavādyapi parasya durjaya iti darśayannāha--vyavasthāyām ityādi
yataḥ svalakṣaṇaṃ śabdaḥ sphoṭo neti vyavasthitiḥ || 14
svalakṣaṇaviṣayamavikalpakaṃ jñānaṃ na tāvat sarvathā svārthasādhanam, adhyavasāyātma tvāt siddheḥ
tadabhāvaṃ viṣayīkaroti vikalpakamiti na paricchinattīti akiñcitkaro vikalpaḥ kutaḥ sādhanam yataḥ tattvasiddhiḥ samayāntaravat ? tadayaṃ kiṃpramāṇaḥ paramupālabheta aśabdarūpam...?

tattvamidaṃ nedamiti sthitiḥ vyavasthā tasyām, avikaraṇabhūtāyāṃ syād bhavet tattvaṃ vastusvarūpaṃ kuto vikalpāvikalpayormadhye vikalpādavikalpādvā na kutaścit dvayorapi tadadhyavasāyakatvāditi bhāvaḥ
yataḥ tayoḥ kutaścittatra tadbhāvāt svalakṣaṇaṃ śabdaḥ sphoṭaḥ śabdo neti vyavasthitiḥ dvayorapyadṛṣṭakalpanā'viśeṣāt
kim ? jñānam svārthasādhanaṃ na tāvat sarvathā nīlādiprakāreṇa cakṣaṇakṣayādināpi
tato'pi pratītimātrarūpā siddhiḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--siddheḥ ityādi
kuto'nyathā tasyāḥ tallakṣaṇatvābhāvaprakāreṇa anubhūte avikalpakagṛhīte anumānaṃ kṣaṇakṣayādau pramāṇaṃ syāt
vikalpāt syāditi cet; atrāha--vikalpajñānam ityanuvarttate sāmānyaviṣayaṃ
tataḥ kim ? ityāha--bhāvato nirviṣayatvaṃ vikalpakasya iti
bhavatvabhāvaḥ sāmānyam, tataḥ kim ? ityāha--tadabhāvam ityādi

tadabhāṃvevijātīyavyāvṛttiṃ viṣayīkaroti vikalpakamityevaṃ na paricchinatti iti prāptam tato'kiñcitkaro vikalpaḥ kutaḥ sādhanaṃ pramāṇaṃ yataḥ sādhanatvāt tattvasiddhiḥ vikalpāt iti samayāntereiva tadvaditi nidarśanam
yata evaṃ tasmādayaṃ saugataḥ kiṃpramāṇaḥ paraṃ prativādinam upālabheta

evaṃ paramate saugatadoṣaparihāraṃ vidhāya idānīṃ jainamate yaduktaṃ tena--rūpādimatpudgalavikārasya dhvaneḥ śabdarūpasya kenacid grahaṇe tadavyatirekiṇo rūpādeḥ tenaiva grahaṇāt tasmād dṛṣṭasya bhāvasya dṛṣṭa evākhilo guṇaḥ pra॰ vā॰ 3
svalakṣaṇamekaṃ sannihitaṃ pratyakṣam, tasya yāvanti pararūpāṇi tāvatyo vyāvṛttayaḥ, tatra kācit kenacit pratīyate tato na pratijñārthaikadeśāsiddho hetuḥ, apratīta...nāma...
ato'nyāpohaḥ teṣāṃ viṣaya iti, tathā svalakṣaṇaṃ śabdādyātmakam, tatra śrotrādisāmagrīṃ puraskṛtya anubhavāt aśabdavyavacchedaḥ kevalaṃ pratīyate,
pratyakṣataḥ śabdādisvalakṣaṇabhedapratīteḥ asamānam; tanna; svalakṣaṇasya avyavaseyatvāt
nirjitānyasamāropamanasaḥ svārthānubhavasya vyavasāyātmakatopapatteḥ niścayāropamanasorbādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ anyathā nopapadyeta
dṛṣṭeḥ khaṇḍaśaḥ pāṭavādisaṃbhave anekāntaprasaṅgāt tathā arthopalabdhiḥ, kinna pratipadyeta ? yataḥ anupāttasparśādyātmanaḥ śabdapudgalasya śrutirna syāt
tannāyaṃ vikalpānāmeva aparādhaḥ yataḥ dṛṣṭasya arthasya akhilo guṇaḥ dṛṣṭa evetyekāntaḥ śobheta

aśabdaḥ śabdābhāvaḥ na punaḥ śabdādanyaḥ rūpādīnāmapi tato'nyathā da śabdavyavacchinnam iti vaktavyaṃ syāt, sa ādi ryeṣāṃ rūpādīnāṃ tebhyaḥ svayaṃ vyavacchidyate sma tadvyavacchinnaṃ śabdarūparasasparśagandhātmām ityarthaḥ
ghaṭādivadekaṃ na syāditi cet; āha--ekameva viruddhadharmādhyāsasya ekāntena abhedaktvāt iti bhāvaḥ
tat pratyakṣaṃ viśadavedanavedyaṃ yathā bhavati tathā vyavasīyeta niścīyeta
anena pratyakṣavyavasāyayorekatvamāha--kathaṃcidaśabdavyavacchinnaprakāreṇa nārūpādivyavacchinnena kenacit śrotreṇa na cakṣurādinā
tasya svalakṣaṇasya yāvanti pararūpāṇi tāvatyo vyāvṛttayaḥ tatra tāsu vyāvṛttiṣu madhye kācidaśabdādivyāvṛttiḥ kenacit śabdādivikalpena śabdena śabdabdādyabhidhāne cākaraṇabhūtena pratīyate
nahi śabda iti vikalpena abhidhānena vā nityavyāvṛttiḥ pratīyate tataḥ tasmānnyāyāt na pratijñārthaikadeśāsiddho hetuḥ sattvādiḥ
ataḥ asmāt karaṇāt anyāpohaḥ teṣāmabhidhānavikalpāntarāṇāṃ viṣaya iti tathā tena prakāreṇa svalakṣaṇaṃ śabdarūpam
tatra svalakṣaṇe śrotrādisāmagrīṃ puraskṛtyotyatrādanubhavāt pratyakṣāt aśabdavyavacchedaḥ kevalaṃ pratīyeta nā'sparśādivyavacchedaḥ
yata evaṃ tattasmāt na śeṣendriyāṇām kaimarthakyaṃ vaiyarthyaṃ syāt teṣāmapratītapratyāyanārthatvāt

atrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ--tasmādekasya bhāvasya yāvanti pararūpāṇi tāvatyastadapekṣayā tadasaṃbhāvikāryakāraṇastasya tadbhedāt yāvatyaśca vyāvṛttayaḥ tāvatyaḥ śrutayo'tatkāryakāraṇaparihāreṇa vyavahārārthaḥ
kimarthasya bhāvaḥ kaimarthakyam kasmai prayojanāya iti bhāvaḥ

nanu cakṣuṣā rūpaṃ pratīyate rasanena rasaḥ, evaṃ śeṣendriyeṣvapi vācyam, na ca tatra aparamābhāti, na ca indriyāntaramasti yatra vastvantarapratibhāsaḥ, tato na rūpādibhyaḥ kimapiparaṃ pudgalasvalakṣaṇamekam, tadāha--pratyakṣata ityādi
pratyakṣāt śrotrādijñānād uktavidhinā śabdādisvalakṣaṇabhedapratīteḥ kāraṇādasamānaṃ yathā vikalpena anyato vyavacchedaḥ pratīyate tathā pratyakṣeṇāpi iti asadṛśamiti cet; uttaramāha--na ityādi
evaṃ manyate yathā cakṣuṣā kevalaṃ rūpaṃ pratīyate nānyātmakaṃ nāppanyā vā na pramāṇāntarāpekṣaṇamasti
svārthānubhavādeva anyasamāropavyavacchedena tattvasiddhiriti cet; atrāha--svārthānubhavasya svaparadarśanasya vyavasāyātmakatopapatteḥ tadapapatteḥ tadapekṣaṇāditi
bhaviṣyati tadanubhavo na ca vyavasāyātmaka iti cet; atrāha--niścaya ityādi

niścayaśca āropamanaśca tayoḥ bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ pareṇa iṣṭaḥ anyathā tadanubhavasya vyavasāyātmakatābhāvaprakāreṇa nopapadyeta na ghaṭeta avikalpānyasamāropamanasorapi bādhyabādhakabhāvopagamāt, tathā ca anubhavagandhādeva naṣṭavyaṃ samāropeṇa iti, na samāropavārttāpi na bhavet
nanu nīlādau anyasamāropamanaso nānubhāvād vyavacchedaḥ, api tu sādṛśyadarśanasya tatkaraṇasyābhāvāt svayamevānutpāda iti cet; na, pradhānādisamāropasya sadṛśadarśanābhāve'pi bhāvāt
anādyantarvāsanā tatra kāraṇamiti cet; na; avāntaravāsanāto'pi samāropadarśanāt śrotriyatriyajohidbhasyeva aśucau śucitvasya
bhavatvevam, ko doṣa iti cet ? nīlādau tathā anīlādisamāropaḥ syāt
tanniścayānneti cet; idamatra cintyate--kim anubhavāt, uta uttaravikalpādvā ? ādyavikalpoḥ anukūlamācarasi svārthānubhavasya ityādyanivāraṇāt
atha anubhavo haṭhānniścayamupajanayati; anīlavāsanā anīlasamāropam iti kācapacyam
tatra sāmarthyaṃ nānyatrevikalpanāyāṃ dṛṣṭeḥ sāṃśatve mekāntaṃ prativahati

tadāha--dṛṣṭeḥ khaṇḍaśaḥ nīlādau na kṣaṇakṣayādau pāṭavaṃ niścayopajananasāmarthyamādiryasya abhyāsādeḥ tasya saṃbhave anekāntaprasaṅgāt kāraṇāt tathā tena khaṇḍaśa iti prakāreṇa arthopalabdhiḥ arthadṛṣṭiḥ kinna pratipadyeta svīkriyeta toasvīkārāt śabdapudgalasya śrutirna syāt
kiṃbhūtasya ? anupāttasparśādyātmanaḥ anupāttaḥ sannapi agṛhītaḥ sparśādyātmā yasya iti
yata evaṃ tattasmādayaṃ khaṇḍaśaḥ pratipattilakṣaṇaḥ aparādho doṣo na vikalpānāmeva kintu dṛṣṭerapi iti bhāvaḥ
yataḥ teṣāmevāparādhāt dṛṣṭasya arthasya akhilo guṇodṛṣṭa eva ityekāntaḥ śobheta
tasmād dṛṣṭasya bhāvasya dṛṣṭa evākhilo guṇaḥ

nanu śabdarūpādīnāṃ pudgaladravyadharmatvā'viśeṣe'pi śabdasyaiva grahaṇaṃ na rūpādīnām iti kuto'yaṃ vibhāgaḥ ? tathā, sahopalambhaniyamābhāve'pi ca tādātmyamiti kutaḥ ? iti cet; atrāha--dravyāṇām ityādi
kathañcittādātmye'pi rūpādeḥ sannihitasya tatkāraṇāntarasākalye'pi sahānupalambhaḥ udbhūtaguṇatvāt
tadyathā tajodravyasya kvacit kadācit udbhūtasparśasyopalambhe'pi na rūpopalabdhiḥ tadanudbhūtavṛtteḥ, ālokasya rūpopalabdhau sparśānupalakṣaṇam
dravyāṇām upalambho darśanaṃ guṇaiḥ saha na kevalānām
kiṃbhūtaiḥ ? ityāha— svīyaiḥ ātmīyaiḥ na dravyāntaragataiḥ
punarapi kiṃbhūtaiḥ ? ityāha--udbhūtavṛttibhiḥ udbhūtā puruṣamātrasya jñānagrahaṇayogyā vṛttiḥ pariṇāmo yeṣāṃ taiḥ iti
tejodravyādeḥ ādiśabdena gandhadravyādiparigrahaḥ stotādibhiḥ udbhūtaguṇairupalambha iti udbhūtavṛttiḥnānudbhūtavṛttibhiḥ iti, anena sahopalambhaniyamāt ityasya vyabhicāramāha
nahi ityādinā etadeva darśayati--śabdā ādiryeṣāṃ rūpādīnāṃ teṣām
sthūlākāropalambhe'pi na tadārambhakaparamāṇūpalambhaḥ tathāpi na tadbhedaikāntaḥ
anena śabdapudgalasya śabdarūpādīnāṃ bhedaikāntasādhane sahopalambhaniyamābhāvasya vyabhicāraṃ darśayati
paramāṇūnāmupalambhada bhāva ityekesthūlākārasya ityapare tatkathaṃ tairvyabhicāro hetoḥ iti; tatrāha--tadanyatarāpāya ityādi
tayoḥ paramāṇusthūlākārayoḥ anyataraḥ, tasyāpāye arthasya ghaṭāderanupapatteḥ tadvat na teṣāmatādātmyaikāntaḥ
tathāhi--sthūlākārāpāye paramāṇava eva, teṣāmanupalambhena asattvam, paramāṇūpāye sthūlākāramātramanavayavaḥ, tathā sati ekadeśacalanādiprasaṅgaḥ
dṛśyāḥ bhaṃgāḥ santi nānya iti cet; tarhi prāgasatāṃ meghādīnāṃ kutaḥ prādurbhāvaḥ ? ahetuka iti cet; sarvaḥ tathā syāditi hetuphalabhāvavilopaḥ
svayaṃ vā'dṛśyaparamāṇubhyo dṛśyaparamāṇūtpādamabhyupagamya te taḥ sthūlotpādaṃ kathaṃ necchet ?
syānmatam, astu sūkṣmaṃ kāryakāle kāraṇavilayāt; uktamatra ahetukatvaprasaṅgāditi

nanu paramāṇubhyaḥ sthūlamanyadeva, kāraṇāt kāryasya anyatvāt, ataḥ teṣāmapi pakṣīkaraṇāt na tairvyabhicāra iti cet; atrāha--vyatirekaikānte bhedaikānte pṛthaksiddhiprasaṅgāt anyatra laukike deśe avayavānām anyatra avayavinaḥ siddhiḥ upalabdhiḥ pitāputravat, tasyāḥ prasaṅgāt
sāṃkhyapakṣaḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--abhedaikānte paramāṇusthūlākārayoḥ 'ekatvaikārayoḥ, ekatvaikānte sahopalambhaniyamāt kāraṇāt vyartham indriyanānātvam
evaṃ mana paramāṇūpalambhaḥ, tatkathaṃ tadabhedaikāntaḥ ? tathāpi tadupalambhakalpane cakṣuṣā rūpopalambhe rasādīnāmupalambha iti vyarthamindriyanānātvamiti
