kathaṃcitpakṣe kuto'yaṃ na doṣa iti cet ? atrāha--kathaṃcittādātmye'pi na kevalaṃ viparyaye rūpādeḥ apiśabdaḥ atrāpi draṣṭavyaḥ, na kevalaṃ paramāṇutadākārayoḥ, sannihitasya sahānupalambhaḥ
kasmin satyapi ? ityāha— tatkaraṇāntarasākalye'pi tatkāraṇaṃ rūpajñānakāraṇaṃ cakṣuḥ tadantaraṃ rasanādiḥ tasya sākalye'pi
yadi vā, śabdādīnāṃ sahopalambhaniyamābhāve parasparam ekasāmagryadhīnānām mābhūtādatādātmyaikāntaḥ śabdopalambhe rūpādyanupalambhāt, abhāvaikāntastu bhavediti cet; atrāha--paramāṇusthūlākāravaditi
sthūlākāropalambhe paramāṇuvat śabdopalambhe rūpādyanupalambhe'pi nābhāvaḥ ityadhyāhāraḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha--tadanyatarāpāye sadā sāvanyataraśca śabdo rūpādi bhrāntasyopāye arthasya cetanasyetarasya vānupapatteḥ
tathāhi--pratīyamānasya śabdasya abhāve ghaṭādau kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ ? anumīyamānasya tasya tatra rūpāderabhāve sthūle paramāṇuṣu nāśvāsaḥ
taduktam anupavanaṃ gatyāpi mūrtta matam siddhivi॰ 11
bhavantu śabde rūpādayo'pi tatra bhinnā iti cet; atrāha--vyatirekaikānta ityādi
tejodravyasya kvacidavātāndhakārapūritāpavarakādau kācid bhaiṣmarātrisamaye udbhūtasparśasya udbhūtaḥ sparśo yasya tasya upalambhe'pi na rūpopalabdhiḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha--tadanudbhūtavṛtteḥ tasya rūpasya yā'nudbhūtavṛttiḥ tasyā iti
nanu yathā ubhayopalabdhiḥ udbhūtavṛtterupadarśitā tathā ubhayānupalabdhiḥ viparyayāt kasmānna darśitā ? viṣayābhāvāditi cet; na; nāyanaraśmirūpasya viṣayasya bhāvāt
naitadasti, yataḥ sarvaviśeṣaguṇānudbhūtā va evaṃ bhāvasya anudbhūtasakalaguṇasya ghaṭādeḥ sarvatra bhāva iti sāṃkhyadarśanam
nāyanaraśmiṣu anumānāt, anyatra viparyayāt asamānamiti cet; na; tanniṣedhāt ityabhiprāyaḥ tathāvadataḥ
nanu pṛthivyāṃ kvacit sannapi gandho nopalabhyate yathā ghaṭe, evaṃ rūpādayo'pi vaktavyāḥ
tathā sarvatra apsu gandhaḥ, tejasi gandharasau, vāyau rūparasagandhāḥ, tatra kā vārttā iti ? jalādau gandhādyabhāva ityeke
tato'yamarthaḥ--pṛthivyeva pārthivam ādiryeṣām abādīnāṃ teṣāṃ gandhādayaḥ teṣāmupalabdhāvapi na kevalamanupalabdhau kramo'yamanantarokto lakṣyate
tathāhi--pṛthivyāḥ gandhādayo yogināṃ pratyakṣā eva udbhūtatvāt, asmādṛśām ubhayathā udbhūtānudbhūtavṛttitvāt
na ca yadānudbhūtiḥ tadā tadabhāvaḥ; caramakṣaṇaniṣedhāt, rasāt rūpādyanumānābhāvaprasaṅgācca
jalādau yogināmeva gandhādyupalabdhiḥ, asmādṛśāṃ viparyayaḥ anudbhūtatvāt
asmādṛśaḥ prati pārthivagandhādigrahaṇaṃ paraṃ prati dṛṣṭāntārtham
yathā satāmapi pārthivagandhādīnām anudbhūtiḥ tathā abādīnāmapi
tatra sadbhāve kiṃ pramāṇamiti cet ? sparśavattvaṃ brūmaḥ
evaṃ dṛṣṭāntaṃ vyākhyāya dārṣṭāntike yojayati tathā ityādinā
tathā pudgalasya prakṛtasya rasādyātmano'pi śabdātmano'pi śabdātmanopalabdhiḥ
nanu pṛthivyāmiva jalādau gandhādisadbhāve kvacittajjātīye tadabhivyaktiḥ, hemasajātīye pāvake uṣṇatāvyaktivat, na caivam, iti cet; atrāha--vicitrā hi ityādi
vicitrā nānārūpā hiryasmāt vṛttiḥ varttanaṃ pariṇāmānām
tathāhi--kvacit tatra tajjātīye ca guṇābhivyaktiḥ, yathā sarvatrātmani jñānābhivyaktiḥ
kvacit tatra tajjātīye vā kiṃ vyakti paramate'pi ātmādivibhutvavat
yasya ca pudgalavikārāḥpṛthivyādayaḥ tasya jalādiśaśabhīyepārthivavikāre gandhādyabhivyaktiḥ sulabhaiva iti sarvaṃ sustham
kutaḥ tadasaṃbhavaḥ ? ityatrāha--tasyāḥ svasaṃvitteḥ anyato grāhyādyākārād yā vyāvṛttiḥ tayā pratibhāsanāt
śabde yathā rūpādyanabhivyaktiḥ pudgalajātīye ghaṭādau tadabhivyaktiriti
yata eva pariṇāmasiddhiḥ ata eva siddham; ityāha--sāmānyasya ityādi
tadetat sāmānyamavastu abhidheyatvāt arthakriyā'samarthatvādityādi tatsādhanaṃ pariṇāmasādhanena pratyuktam
śeṣendriyasāmarthyaṃ pramāṇāntaravat pāramparyeṇa samāropavyavacchedārthaṃ na virudhyeta, tannirṇayaviśeṣopapatteḥ
abhilāpyatvam ādiryasya vastunaḥ tattvābhāsavācyatvādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ tasmāt
hetvantaramāha--svalakṣaṇaviparyayāt svalakṣaṇam arthakriyākāritvaṃ tadviparyayaḥ tasmācca sāmānyasya yadavastutvaṃ pareṇa uktam tatprativyūḍham nirastam
bhavatsadṛśapariṇāma eva sāmānyaṃ tadapi parasamānamiti cet; atrāha--yatpunaḥ ityādi
svalakṣaṇameva pratyakṣamiti cet; atrāha--atadātmanaḥ samānapariṇāmasvabhāvarahitasya svalakṣaṇasya svākārajñānaṃ svalakṣaṇākārajñānaṃ tadeva arthakriyā tasyā nanu prayogāt
svalakṣaṇaviparyayāt iti kathayannāha--arthakriyā'samartha tvādityādikaṃ parakīyaṃ bhāṣitaṃ pariṇāmasādhanenapratyuktam nirastaṃ tatsādhanam
kathaṃcidupalabdhiṃ sādhayannāhā-ha- saṃbhāvitaikātmano'pi saṃbhāvita ekaḥ akhaṇḍa ātmā svabhāvo yasyāḥtasyā api

kṣaṇikaḥ parimaṇḍalo niraṃśatvalakṣaṇa ādiśabdāt svargaprāpaṇādiryasya tattathoktaṃ tacca tatsvalakṣaṇaṃ ca iti, tasya cākṣuṣatve, upalakṣaṇametat sarvādhyakṣasaṃvittīnām, rasādyātmanāpi cākṣuṣatvaṃ upalakṣaṇametat sarvādhyakṣasaṃvittīnām, rasādyātmanāpi cākṣuṣatvaṃ syāt

śeṣendriyavaiphalyaṃ syāditi cet; atrāha--śeṣendriyasāmarthyaṃ pramāṇāntarasya anumānasyeva tadvat, samāropavyavacchedārtham anumānasāmarthyaṃ na virudhyate tathā cakṣuṣā rūpavatā rasādike gṛhīte'pi na virudhyeta

yathā pratyakṣeṇa nīlavat kṣaṇikatve pratipanne'pi tatsamāropavyavacchedārtham anumānasāmarthyaṃ na virudhyate tathā cakṣuṣā rūpavat rasādike gṛhīte'pi tatsamāropavyavacchedārthaṃ śeṣendriyasāmarthyaṃ na virudhyate
katham ? ityāha--pāramparyeṇa śeṣendriyebhyo rasādijñānaṃ tato vikalpaḥ tasmāt samāropavyavacchedaḥ
cakṣurvudderatadābhāsatve'pi yadi svalakṣaṇaṃ viṣayaḥ; śabdabuddheḥ kinna syāt ? spaṣṭetara...tanna...tathā ca pratyakṣavyakteḥ svalakṣaṇānāṃ tattvānyatvābhyāmavācyatvam
svalakṣaṇe abhidheyatvādi ādiśabdād vastunaḥ tattvānyatvābhyāmavācyatvādiparigrahaḥ, asti vidyate tenāpi na kevalamanantaranyāyena asādhanamabhidheyatvādyaliṅgam
sāmānyābhāvatattvam ādiryasya avayavyādyabhāvasya, tasya vyabhicārāditi manyate
tasyāpi pakṣīkaraṇādadoṣa iti cet; atrāha— tu śabdaḥ śiraḥkampe
tadabhāvaṃ svalakṣaṇābhāvaṃ kiṃ tu sādhayet tatsādhane sarvavyavahāravilopa iti bhāvaḥ
atadābhāsatve'pi asvalakṣaṇābhāsatve'pi yadi svalakṣaṇaṃ viṣayaḥ śabdadveḥ kiṃ na syāt bhavedeva svalakṣaṇaṃ viṣayaḥ
svalakṣaṇe śābdendriyajñānayoḥ na pratibhāsabhedo'sti, tathāpi abhyupagamya ucyate spaṣṭetara ityādi
paramapi parakīyahetuṃ tathāvidhaṃ darśayannāha--tathā ca ityādi
tathā ca tenaiva ca prakāreṇa pratyakṣeṇa viṣayīkṛtā sthūlākārā vyaktirviśeṣaḥ pratyakṣavyaktiḥ tasyāḥ sakāśāt tattvānyatvābhyāmavācyatvam
tadahetatve ityādinā hetvantaraṃ punarapi dūṣayannāha--sādhāraṇatvāt sāmānyasya avastutve aṅgīkriyamāṇe
asya anyatrātideśaṃ kurvannāha--e tai te tyādi

kathañca etadubhayaṃ tattvaṃ paramārthataḥ asadarthajñānāviśiṣṭapratyayagrāhyatvāt ? nanvayam asadarthajñānasvalakṣaṇeṣu bhavan kathaṃ sāmānyābhāvaṃ sādhayet ? sādhayan vā kathaṃ svalakṣaṇābhāvaṃ na sādhayet ? ubhayatra...ayamaparo'sya doṣo'stu na punaḥ svalakṣaṇeṣvastītyetāvatā prakṛtaṃ sādhayet vyabhicārāt
svalakṣaṇaṃ paraparikalpitaparamāṇulakṣaṇam aniścayamavikalpaparicchedyam iti asadavidyamānaṃ niścitamityapi mithyārthaniścayaikāntāt kila tattvaṃ prapadyate saugataḥ
kārikāṃ vivṛṇvannāha--svalakṣaṇaviṣayam ityādi vyavasthāpayet iti paryantaṃ sugamam
kathaṃ ca ? na kathaṃcid etat svalakṣaṇaviṣayamavikalpakam asatsāmānyaviṣayaṃ vikalpajñānam ityubhayaṃ tattvaṃ paramārthaḥ taḥ ityāha--asadārtha ityādi dṛṣṭāntaḥ
nanvetannidarśanamasiddham, sāmānyasyāpyabhāve yasmāt asadarthajñānāviśiṣṭāpratyayagrāhyatvādityayaṃ hetuḥ, sa ca svalakṣaṇe satyapyasti, tadabhāve na kiñcit syāt; tadāha--ananvayam ityādi

ayam anantarokto hetuḥ asadarthajñānasvalakṣaṇeṣu asannartho yasya tattathoktaṃ jñānaṃ yeṣu tāni tathoktāni svalakṣaṇāni teṣu bhavanu kathaṃ sāmānyābhāvaṃ sādhayet ? sādhayan vā sāmānyābhāvaṃ kathaṃ tatsvalakṣaṇābhāvaṃ na sādhayet
kutaḥ ? ityathāha--ubhayatra ityādi iti naiyāyikādiḥ; atra uttaramāha--ayamaparo'sya saugatasya nānekāntavādinaḥ doṣo'stu na punaḥ svalakṣaṇeṣvasti ityetāvatā prakṛtaṃ saugataṃ sādhayet
kutaḥ ? ityāha--avyabhicārāt jainasya ubhayabhāvaṃ sādhayatīti bhāvaḥ
na ca jainaprasiddhasya sāmānyasya asadarthajñānāviśiṣṭapratyayagrāhyatvam; ityāha--sthūla ityādi

indriyārthavikalpabuddhiḥ paramārthataḥ sthūlaikatattvam indriyārthasannikarṣamāśritya, bahirarthagrāhitvāt svayaṃ grāhyādyākārāṃ svasaṃvittiṃ vā vyavasthāpayantī kathaṃ bhrāntirnāma ? sāmānyasya ca...
vikalpabuddhiḥ sāmānyabuddhiḥ kathaṃ bhrāntirnāma ? kiṃ kurvatī ? ityāha--vyavasthāpayantī paramārthataḥ
antaraṅgāpekṣayā āha--svasaṃvittim ātmasaṃvedanaṃ sādhya vyavasthāpayantī kathaṃ bhrāntirnāma ? kiṃbhūtām ? ityāha--grāhya ityādi
na tattvataḥ tathā svasaṃvittiḥ, kevalaṃ bhrāntyā tathāvabhāsate, taduktam--avibhāgo'pi buddhyātmā pra॰ vā॰ 2
pratyakṣaṃ mataṃ na syāt kathaṃ sāmānyagocaram
viṣayaviṣayiṇoḥ sadasatsārūpyaikānubhavalakṣaṇa...tatpratyakṣabuddheḥ tatsārūpyavyatirekeṇa yadi arthadarśanaṃ cet; tena tadvyavadhānāt sannikarṣādivat sādhakatamataiva mā bhūt
tatpunaḥ sārūpyaṃ saṃvitterevānubhūtaṃ rūpaṃ nārthasyeti kutaḥ arthopalabdhiranyatropacārāt
na caitat kāryakāraṇabhāva eva syāt yataḥ tatraiva tadbhāvāt samakālabhāvino bhaviṣyato vā darśanaṃ na bhavet
tadetat jñānaṃ trikālaviṣayasārūpyaṃ kutaḥ kāraṇasyaiva viniyamyeta yataḥ vikalpajñānavat sāmānyagocaraṃ na syāt
na caikarūpeṇa anekārthānukaraṇaṃ viruddham, saṃcitālambanatopagamāt pañcavijñānakāyānām
kāyagrahaṇāt pratyekaṃ saṃcitālambanatvameva iti cet; na; sthūlaikapratibhāsāvirodhāt, santānāntaravat
pratyakṣaṃ sāmānyagocaraṃ kathaṃ matam abhyupagataṃ saugatasya na syād bhevedeva
kiṃ kurvat ? ityāha--paśyatu kim ? ityāha--arthākāraṃ samaṃ sadṛśam

tasya svalakṣaṇasya yā pratyakṣabuddhiḥ tasyāḥ tatsārūpyavyatirekeṇa yadi arthadarśanaṃ nirākāreṇa jñānena yogyatābalācced arthasākṣātkaraṇaṃ tena tadbalena tadvadyavadhānāt sannikarṣādivat sādhakatamataiva mā bhūt, tataḥ kiṃ sārūpyakalpanayā ? sārūpyameva sādhakatamamiti cet; atrāha--tatpunaḥ sārūpyaṃ jñānārthayoḥ sādṛśyaṃ saṃcittoreva rūpaṃ svabhāvaḥ anubhūtam
kutaḥ pramāṇāt parasya arthopalabdhiḥ na kutaścit anyatropacārāt
tata eva tadupalabdhiryathā caitramitrayoḥ caitradarśanāccaitrasadṛśe mitre darśanopacāraḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--ubhayadarśanāt sārūpyapratipattiryathā caitramitrayoḥ, na ca parasya arthadṛṣṭiḥ tatkathaṃ tadgatasārūpyapratītiḥ upacārāt ? iti tvabhyupagamya uktam, na bhāvataḥ

tadupalabdhiḥ upācārādeva tu iti cet; atrāha--na caitat sārūpyaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāva eva syāt api tu tadabhāve'pi yamalakayoriva syāditi bhāvaḥ, yataḥ tatraiva tadbhāvāt samakālabhāvino'rthasya bhaviṣyato vā darśanaṃ na bhaved bhavedeva
tathā ca pra jñā ka ra sya kuto bhāvinyeva varttanāt pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇaṃ syāt ?
nanu akāraṇena sārūpye avisaṃvādo na syāditi cet; atrāha--na caivam avisaṃvādo na syāt bhavedeva yamalakavat

yata evaṃ tattasmād etannīlādyākāraṃ jñānaṃ trikālaviṣayasārūpyaṃ trayaḥ kālo viṣayo yasya sārūpyasya tadvibhūtsambhava kutaḥ kāraṇasyaiva viniyamyeta yato viniyamād vikalpajñānavat sāmānyagocaraṃ na syāt bhavedeva
kathamekasya trikālagocarārthānukaraṇamaviruddhamiti cet ? atrāha--na caikarūpeṇa ekasvabhāvena jñānena anekārthānukaraṇaṃ viruddham
saṃcitāḥ sanniveśaviśeṣaviśiṣṭāḥ paramāṇava ālambanaṃ yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ tattā tasyā upagamāt
keṣām ? ityāha--pañcavijñānakāyānām cakṣurādijñānasamūhānām saṃcitā lambanāḥ pañca vijñānakāyāḥ iti rāddhāntāt
evaṃ manyate--yathaikajñānam samānakālamanekamarthamanukaroti tathā bhinnakālamapi iti nirākṛtametat--varttamānamātravṛttiḥ akṣāṇām iti
nanu jñānasamūhaḥ saṃcitālambanaḥ, pratyekaṃ tu jñānam ekaikaparamāṇuniṣṭham
samūhābhidhānāt pratyekaṃ saṃcitālambanatvamaya jñānānām ityeva ced; atrottaramāha--na ityādi
sahaikārthopanibaddhadṛṣṭīnāṃ yathārthānukaraṇaṃ tathā anyo'nyānukaraṇamavaśyambhāvi, tato'rthopalabdhiriva anyo'nyopalabdhiḥ viṣayarūpataiva yato grahaṇakāraṇam
nākāraṇaṃ viṣaya iti cet; na tarhi arthasārūpyam, satyapi tasmin prāmāṇyavyabhicārāt, ālambanābhimatāt kāraṇācca saṃvittirnavai viśeṣāntaraṃ pratilabhate anyatra tadākārānukaraṇāt
atrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ--tasmāccakṣuśca rūpaṃ ca pratītyodeti netradhīḥ
190 bhinnakālaṃ kathaṃ grāhyamiti ced prāhyatāṃ viduḥ
na tajjanma na tādrūpyaṃ na tadvyavasitiḥ saha
pratyekaṃ vā bhajantīha prāmāṇyaṃ prati hetutān
na kevalaṃ vipayabalāt dṛṣṭerutpattiḥ api tu cakṣurādiśakteśca
viṣayākārānukaraṇād darśanasya tatra viṣayaḥ pratibhāsate na punaḥ karaṇam tadākārānukaraṇāditi cettarhi tadarthavat karaṇamanukartumarhati na cārthaṃ viśeṣābhāvāt
darśanasya tajjanmarūpāviśeṣe'pi tadadhyavasāyaniyamād bahirarthaviṣayatvamityasāram; varṇādāviva upādāne'pyadhyavasāyaprasaṅgāt
tādrūpyasya samānārthaiḥ tadutpatteḥ indriyādibhiḥ taddvayasya samānārthasamanantarapratyayaiḥ, tattritayasya śukle śaṅkhe pītākārajñānena vyabhicārāt
ekasmin narttakīlakṣaṇe arthe sannikṛṣṭāni saṃsṛṣṭāni akṣāṇi yāsāṃ dṛṣṭīnāṃ darśanānāṃ tāsām anyo'nyavīkṣaṇaṃ

kutaḥ ? ityāha--anyo'nyākārasaṃvittvāt parasparasadṛśatvāt no cet na yadi parasparavīkṣaṇaṃ tāsāṃ naikārthavīkṣaṇam ekasyārthasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavet, tatrāpi sārūpyameva grahaṇakāraṇaṃ tattu avyabhicārīti bhāvaḥ
saha yugapad ekasminnarthe upanibaddhāḥ dṛṣṭayo yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ yathārthānukaraṇaṃ tathā anyo'nyānukaraṇamavaśyaṃbhāvi tato'rthopalabdhiriva anyo'nyopalabdhiḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha--satyapi tasmin arthasārūpye prāmāṇyavyabhicārāt uktayāyena
nanu sārūpyamātre tadvyabhicāraḥ, kāraṇācca tadviśeṣo'vyabhicārī jāyata iti cet; atrāha--kāraṇācca hetorapi
kiṃbhūtāt ? ālambanābhimatāt anena samanantarādinirāsaḥ saṃvittirna vai naiva viśeṣāntaraṃ pratilabhate anyatra tadākārānukaraṇāt kāraṇānukaraṇameva viśeṣaṃ labhata ityarthaḥ
nīlatayeva dātmanāpi sārūpyam iti svatarām ityanena darśayati
samānaḥ sadṛśo'rtho yeṣāṃ darśanānāṃ tāni tathoktāni darśanāni teṣāṃ nānaikasantānāḥ teṣu saṃbhavāt samānārthadarśanānāṃ santāneṣu saṃbhavāt tajjanmasārūpyayoḥ
tathāhi--pitṛśarīrāt jāyamānamapatyaśarīraṃ yathā kadācittadākāraṃ tathā taccetaso'patyacittaṃ kadācittadākāramupalabhyate, janyajanakayoḥ prāyeṇa samānatyāgādicittavyavahāraprasiddheḥ
na cāpatyacittaṃ janakacetasi pramāṇam, itaraśrā prakṛtapuruṣasya paracittapratyakṣatā iti vyāhatametat--śarīrapratyakṣatve'pi na buddhiḥ pratyakṣā, buddhivikalpe saṃśayāt ityādi
tathāhi--nīlāt nīlajñānaṃ tasmāccāparāparāṇi nīlajñānāni jāyante tadrūpāṇi, na ca tāni tatra pramāṇam, vahistato'pravṛttiprasaṅgāt
syānmatam--tebhyo janmaiva na tadrūpatā; arthāpi sā na bhavet
dṛśyate nīlatayā iti cet; bodharūpatayā bodhādapi iti samānam
tāvanmātreṇa bhavatu na nīlatayā iti cet; na; aṃśena janyajanakabhāvaprasaṅgāt
tathā, pūrvajñānam uttarasya bodharūpatayā janakaṃ na nīlarūpatayā tathā uttaraṃ tathaiva janyathā yathā bodhāt tadrūpatā tathā nīlādapi syāt

yadi vā, naikasya nānākārānukaraṇaṃ viruddham ityuktam; kathamanyathā sarvadarśijñānam aśeṣanīlākārānukāri bhavato bhavet ? yadi matam, ādyaṃ nīlajñānaṃ pūrvanīlajñānamantareṇa jātaṃ tanna tasya nīlatā pūrvajñānanīlatākṛtā, tathā anyatrāpi iti; tanna sāram; yataḥ yathāsaṃbhavaṃ hetuphalabhāvāt
tadavyavasāyasahitaṃ na tathā iti cet; atrāha--tadadhyavasāyahetutvaṃ ca tasya arthākārajñānasya vyavasāyakāraṇatvaṃ ca vyabhicarati
nanvevaṃbahirarthasya agrahaṇameva prakārāntarāsaṃbhavāditi pāyase ghṛtaplavaḥ saugatajanasya iti cet; atrāha--pratyarthaniyatā ityādi
tathā ca samāne'pi arthagrahaṇe akāraṇaṃ cārthaṃ viṣayīkurvato na kaścid vyāghātaḥ
tathā ca tena prakāreṇa arthagrahaṇe sati arthagrahaṇe'kāraṇaṃ ca arthaṃ viṣayīkurvataḥ saṃvedanasya na kaścit pratyakṣādibādhalakṣaṇo vyāghātaḥ
saṃvādo na syāditi cet; atrāha--saṃvādasya ityādi
tathāpi svakāraṇa evā'visaṃvāda iti cet; atrāha--pratyakṣasyāpi ityādi
vyatītasya jñānātmani apratibhāsanāt sārūpyaniṣedhāt bhāvikāraṇanirākaraṇāditi bhāvaḥ
nanu bhaviṣyadarthaviṣayā buddhirnirviṣayā, tatkāle tadarthasyāsaṃbhavena tatrāpratibhāsanāt, tadasyāḥ kathamavisaṃvāda iti cet ? atrāha--anāgatasya ityādi
anāgatasya arthasya maraṇādeḥ saṃprati ariṣṭādikāle abhāve'pi viṣayatopapatteḥ ariṣṭaliṅgajanitabuddhigocaratopapatteḥ avisaṃvādaḥ

nanu bhāvī cet maraṇādiḥ kathaṃ prākpratibhāsagocaraḥ ? prāganutpannaḥ bhāvī ityucyate, anutpannaśca kharaviṣāṇavat na tadgocaraḥ, itarathā na bhāvī, varttamānaghaṭādivat, tato bhaviṣyadarthabuddhirnirviṣayā iti cet; atrāha--akṣa ityādi
akṣaśabdayoḥ kāryabhūte vastujñāne, śabdajñānagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇam tena anāgataviṣayam aviśadaṃ sarvaṃ vijñānaṃ gṛhyate
evaṃ manyate--yathā bhaviṣyadarthaḥ tadbuddhikāle nāsti, tathā pratyakṣārthaḥ taddeśe nāsti
nahi pratyakṣaparicchedyāḥ arthāḥ sarve tadādhāre ātmani vyavasthitāḥ
ataddeśāḥ paricchidyante nātatkālā iti kiṃkṛto vibhāgaḥ ? bhāvino'pi svakālasattā'niṣedhaḥ, anyathā varttamāno bhavet
nanu kimucyate--nāntaramucyate— nāntaramutprekṣāmahe iti ? yāvatā viśadetaratākṛtaṃ tadasti iti cet; atrāha--pratibhāsabheda ityādi
syānmatam--śabdajñānasya nāviśadatvāt nirviṣayatvamucyate, kintu tadgrāhyasāmānyasya avastutvāt, tadapyasadarthapratyayatvāditi; tatrāha--svakāraṇa ityādi
keṣāṃcinmithyātve'pi kathañcit kenacit tattvavyavasāya ityapi mithyā vikalpāt kutastattvapratipattiḥ ? yataḥ svalakṣaṇavyavasthā'visaṃvādaḥ
svakāraṇaṃ tatsvalakṣaṇaṃ ca iti tasyāpi vikalpavat sāmānyavat asadarthapratyayaviṣayatvamavagantavyam
paramārthaḥ kṣaṇikaniraṃśaparamāṇurūpaḥ tadavisaṃvādi na pratyakṣam uktanyāyāt, ata eva na laiṅgikam
pratipatrabhiprāyāditi cet; atrāha--pratipatrabhiprāyāṇāmapratiṣṭhānāt tathā tattvaṃ yuktamiti tadanukaraṇa pratipatrabhiprāyānukaraṇena svamatavyāghātāt
astu yathātattvaṃ taditi cet; atrāha--tattvata ityādi
nanvavikalpād vikalpavāsanāprabodhaḥ, tato vikalpaḥ tasmāt tattvavyavasthā iti, ato vikalpāt seti cet; atrāha--paramparayā ityādi
bhavatu tat teṣāmeva iti cet; atrāha— na cānarthaviṣayairvikalpaiḥ tattvavyavasthāpanam
tebhyo'pi paramparayā vastupratibaddhebhyastadvyavasthāpanamiti cet; atrāha--mithyātve'pi ityādi

mithyātve'pi keṣāṃcit vikalpānāṃ tattvavyavasāyaḥ kathaṃcit kenacit paramparāpratibandhaprakāreṇa ityapi evamapi mithyā, vikalpāt kutaḥ tattvapratipattiḥ yato yasyāḥ tattvapratipatteḥ anumānabhrānteḥ sakāśāt svalakṣaṇavyavasthā'visaṃvādaḥ
evaṃ manyate--vikalpasya kasya cit paramparayā arthapratibandho na tāvadavikalpāt; tena vikalpāviṣayīkaraṇāt, tataḥ tattvāt siddheśca kṣaṇakṣayādivat
nāpi vikalpāt nirviṣayāt; tasyāpi tadantarāt pratibandhasādhane anavasthā
atha ekena vikalpena anyasya tena pratibandhaḥ sādhyate; anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ
etena vikalpātmavedanāt tatsiddhirnirastā; tena arthāparicchedādavi kalpadoṣācca iti
yadi vā, vikalpāpekṣayā viparītā viruddhā vā pratipattiḥ tasyā iti
vikalpakaṃ svalakṣaṇatattvāvisaṃvādi syāditi cet; atrāha--nāpi ityādi

kutaḥ ? ityāha--atadviṣayatvāt svalakṣaṇatattvāviṣayatvāt vikalpakasya paramārthataḥ, kalpanayā kevalaṃ paraṃ syāt vyākhyātrabhiprāyavaśādavikalpakaṃ tadavisaṃvādi iti cet; atrāha--tata eva vikalpasya atadviṣayatvādeva
yadi vā, vikalpe vipratipattereva avikalpapratipattereva avikalpajñānaṃ vyākhyātrabhiprāyeṇāpi nāvisaṃvādakam
pratyakṣaṃ sarvato vyāvṛttaṃ vastu gṛhṇadapi anīlādisamāropaṃ vyavacchinatti, sāmānya...tannaitat pratyakṣaṃ na cānumeyam
satyapi svapnādau kathaṃ tadā cittacaittānāṃ pratyakṣatvam ? kathaṃ ca na syāt ? niraṃśatattvasya spaṣṭapratibhāsābhāvāt tadvyavacchedānirṇayācca yataḥ sarve pra॰ vā॰ 3
pratyakṣaṃ svalakṣaṇe na pramāṇaṃ kintu sāmānye
kutaḥ ? ityāha--niścayāpekṣaṃ yato niścaye svasāmānye, itarathā kṣaṇikatvānumānamanarthakameva
tadapekṣamapi svalakṣaṇe pramāṇam; tarhi tadapekṣā yaugaḥ
svalakṣaṇasya yat sannidhānaṃ yacca itaradasannidhānaṃ tābhyāṃ dhiyaḥ pratyakṣabuddheḥ pratibhāsabhidā ca na tadākārāsāna ityarthaḥ
kārikāṃ vivṛṇvannāha--sarvataḥ sajātīyād vijātīyād vyāvṛttamapasṛtaṃ vastu gṛhṇadapi pratyakṣam anīlādisamāropaṃ vyavacchinatti yatrāṃśe niścayaṃ janayati ityarthaḥ
yadi tatraiva pramāṇaṃ kiṃ syāt ? ityāha--sāmānya ityādi
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt naitat svalakṣaṇaṃ pratyakṣaṃ na cānumeyam pratyakṣābhāve anumānābhāvāt
svānubhūte sarvatra pramāṇamiti cet; atrāha--naca ityādi
kiṃbhūtayoḥ ? viṣayaviṣayiṇoḥ viṣayo'rthaḥ viṣayi jñānaṃ tayoḥ vinaṣṭetarayoḥ pratibhāsāviśeṣāt
tarhi bahiḥ svalakṣaṇasyāvicāryamāṇasya ayogāt, antaḥ svalakṣaṇamastu iti cet; atrāha--nāpi ityādi
vijñaptireva nārthaḥ vijñaptimātraṃ tasminnapi na kevalaṃ bahiḥ, etallakṣaṇam etasya paraparikalpitasvalakṣaṇasya lakṣaṇaṃ darśanaṃ nāpi
abhyupagame vā nīlādipratibhāsaḥ kimasatya iti cet; anyatra kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ ? kutaśca tadasatyatā ? grāhyatvenāvabhāsanāt; taimirikopalebdhakeśādivaditi cet; atrāha— svapnādāvityādi
svapna ādiryasya kācakāmalādivibhramasya sa tathoktaḥ tatra tallakṣaṇābhāvaprasaṅgād vijñaptidarśanābhāvaprasaṅgāt nāpi tanmātre'pi tallakṣaṇamiti
ayamabhiprāyaḥ— yathā vibhrame bahirarthābhāvaḥ, pratibhāse'pi tathā svasaṃvedanābhāvo'pi
tatra parasantānasya asato'pi pratibhāsanāt tatra sattve, anyatra kaḥ pradveṣaḥ iti vicāritam

tarhi pratibhāsāviśeṣāt bādhyabādhakabhāvavirahāt jāgraddaśāvata svapnādāvapyartho'sti iti cet; atrāha--sadyapi vidyamāne'pi bāhyārthe svapnādau kathaṃ tadā svapnādikāle cittacaittānāṃ pratyakṣatvaṃ pratyakṣagrāhyatvam ? kathaṃ ca na syāt ? iti paraḥ pṛcchati
tasya viparītāropasya vyavacchedo'bhāvaḥ tasyānirṇayācca yataḥ spaṣṭapratibhāsāt tannirṇayā cca sarve pra॰ vā॰ 3
tataḥ sarvadā niraṃśajñānatattvasyāpratibhāsanād bahirarthasya viparītasya pratibhāsanāt tāvanmātraṃ saugatasya tattvaṃ prasaktamiti bhāvaḥ
yatraiva janayedenāṃ tatraivāsya pramāṇatā ityatra punarapi dūṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha— ṣaṇṇāṃ dhiyāmityādi
śabdādiṣvabhimateṣu yugapatsannihiteṣu tadvijñānānāṃ kramotpattau pratyekaṃ pañcabhirvyavadhānāt pratyekaṃ vicchedaḥ pratīyeta
bhāvapakṣasya balīyastvāditi cet sa eva rasaḥ...tataḥ...iti kalpanāyām tadanyavyavacchedavyavasāyātmanāṃ savikalpamano'kṣajñānānām tadavicchedapratītau sahabhāvaḥ prasajyeta
tatraiva hi vicchedānupalakṣaṇaṃ yuktam tadaviśeṣāt spaṣṭanirbhāse'pi tataḥ tadanyavyavacchedavyavasāyātmanāṃ ca sahabhāvaḥ prasajyeta
tātparyamidamatra yathā'nantaraḥ parasya abhyupagamaḥ tathā śabdādiṣu yugapat sannihiteṣu tathā ṣaṭbuddhayo jāyanta iti
kutaḥ tadbhāvaḥ ? ityāha--vivekānupalakṣaṇāt vivekasya karkaṭībhakṣaṇādau dhiyā kālavicchedasya aniścāt
samarthakāraṇabahutvād yugapatkāryabahutvamanivāryam, tathā ca aśvaṃ vikalpayato'pi godarśanāt ityādi virudhyate
ṣaṇṇāṃ dhiyāṃ sakṛdbhāve parakīyāṃ yuktiṃ darśayannāha--śabdādiṣu ityādi
kiṃbhūteṣu ? abhimateṣu yugapat sannihiteṣu satsu tadvijñānānāṃ śabdādidhiyāṃ kramotpattau aṅgīkriyamāṇāyāṃ pratyekam ekamekaṃ prati vicchedaḥ pratīyeta yugapacchabdādipratītirna syāt
anyasyaanyato vā vyavacchedaḥ, teṣāṃ tajjñānānām anyavyavacchedaḥ tadanyavyavacchedaḥ tasya vyavasāyo nirṇaya ātmā evabhāvo yāsāṃ tāsāṃ ca saṃvidām iti padaghaṭanā, manovikalpānām ityarthaḥ
kasmin sati ? ityāha— tadavicchedapratītau teṣāṃ savikalpamano'kṣajñānānāmavicchedapratītiryā tasyāṃ satyām
kiṃ tābhiḥ karttavyam tajjñānaireva tatpratītisadbhāvāditi cet; atrāha--tatraiva hi ityādi
tatraiva tāsveva vyavasāyātmakasaṃvittiṣu satīpu hiryasmād vicchedasya anyato vyāvṛtteranupalakṣaṇaṃ yuktam na punaravikalpajñāneṣu satsu
nanuyataḥspaṣṭanirbhāsā'nyavikalpajñānāni iti, tata eva tadupalakṣaṇamiti cet; atrāha— spaṣṭanirbhāse'pi ityādi
tataḥ tadanyavacchedavyavasāyātmanāṃ ca sahabhāvaḥ prasajyeta iti
syānmatam--ṣaṇṇāṃ dhiyām anantaramekaṃ savikalpamanojñānaṃ tadavyavasāyi jāyate, tato'yamadoṣa iti; tanna; anekāntaprasaṅgāditi pratipāditam
pratikṣaṇaṃ niraṃśakṣaṇikaparamāṇuṣu pratyakṣeṣu parasparāsamplave kutaścakrabhrāntiḥ ? sā ca bhavantī kathamanekāntasiddhirna bhavet tadupalambhānupalambhayorvirodhāt
bhinnaprakramaḥ apiśabdaḥ, tato na kevalam antarekavikalpavibhramasya api tu spaṣṭasyāpi alātacakrādeḥ vibhramasya vīkṣaṇāt anekāntasiddhiḥ ityupamkāraḥ
nanu pratiparamāṇu pratikṣaṇaṃ saṃvidāṃ bhedāt naikaṃcitram alātacakrajñānamiti cet; atrāha— svalakṣaṇopalabdhīnām ityādi
keṣu ? niraṃśakṣaṇikaparamāṇuṣu pratyekam ekaṃ paramāṇuṃ prati pratyakṣeṣu darśaneṣu parasparāsaṃplave eva citrajñānābhāve kutaḥ cakrabhrāntiḥ na ekaikānudarśanaṃ cakṣudarśanaṃ nāma iti bhāvaḥ
sā ca cakrabhrāntirbhavantī jāyamānā katham anekāntasiddhiḥ anekāntapratītirna bhavet ? bhavedeva
atha aparadeśopasarpiṇām alātakṣaṇānām anyo'nyavivekānupalambhe'pi sarvasādhāraṇabhāsuratāmātradarśanāt cakrabhrāntiriti; tatrāha--tadupalambha ityādi
teṣām alātasvalakṣaṇānāṃ bhāsuratāmātreṇa ya upalambhaḥ yaśca parasparavivekarūpeṇa anupalambhaḥ tayoḥ virodhāt ekasya dṛśyetaratāprāpteḥ anekāntasiddhiriti
na kevalam anantaravidhinā anekāntasādhanam, api tu tadantareṇāpi iti darśayannāha— pratyakṣāt ityādi
pratyakṣāt pratyakṣapramitādarthāt syādvādasya syādasti ityādi śāsanasya śaṃsanaṃ
tathā anumeyādeśca anumānagamyam anumeyaṃ pratikṣaṇapariṇāmādikam ādiryasya cittādigocarasya sa tathoktaḥ tasmācca syādvādaśaṃsanam
kiṃ bhūtāḥ ? madagocarāḥ asmādṛśāṃ darśanāviṣayāḥ kevalaṃ yogigamyāḥ sanni vedyanta iti evam āgamād yad avisaṃvādijñānaṃ dharmādiviṣayaṃ tadapi tacchaṃsanamiti
kiṃ bahunā uktena, unmiṣitamapi anekāntamantareṇa nāstīti

saugatādibhiḥ yāni parigaṇitāni pramāṇāni teṣāṃ yā vṛttiḥ vidhisādhanāya pravṛttiḥ yā ca kutaścit niṣedhyānnivṛttiḥ tayoḥ arthasya cetanetararūpasya tattvaṃ vidhipratiṣedhātmakatvaṃ tasya siddhiḥ anekāntamapekṣate pratyakṣaṃ vṛtteḥ arthatattvasiddhiḥ
avācyaṃ kevalaṃ neti tathā ca pratipāditam || 29
cittānāṃ svarūpasya kathanna svataḥ siddhiḥ ? avyavasāyātmakatvāt, tādṛśāṃ parataśca na
na ca nityasya kādācitkadarśanaṃ yuktam, taddarśanasya pariṇāmāvinābhāvāt
tatkiṃbhūtam ? ityāha--asatkalpam asti iti kalpanārahitametad arthabhedābhedaikāntārthagrāhakaṃ vikalpakam
kevalamavācyaṃ tat iti cet; atrāha--avācyaṃ kevalam iti evaṃ netyeva yuktam, na kevalamatraiva uktam api tu anyatrāpi iti darśayannāha--tathā ca pratipāditam
svarūpasya ātmanaḥ svataḥ siddhiḥ cittānāṃ niraṃśasaṃvedanānāṃ na kathaṃ na
parataḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--parataśca jñānāntarā na pi tathā na, tādṛśāṃ niraṃśānāṃ pratibhāsābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ
bhedaikāntasyāpi pratibhāso nāstīti darśayannāha--na ca ityādi
pariṇāmaḥ tasya syāditi cet; atrāha--nāpi ityādi
nanu vicārayato'pi tadekāntaviṣayaṃ nirṇayādhyakṣaṃ na nivarttata iti cet; atrāha--tad ityādi
kiṃbhūtam ? ityāha— avyavasāyātmakam iti eva parakalpanamanubhavaviruddham, anekāntasya anubhave pratibhāsanāt
arthaikāntavad anekāntasyāpi apratibhāsanāt samānaṃ codyamiti cet; atrāha--sarvatra ityādi
bhavatu tatpratipattiḥ, tathāpi virodhānna yuktamiti cet; atrāha--virodha ityādi
kathaṃcit sakṛt astitvāditidharmapratipādanaprakāreṇa avācyaṃ tattvasya iṣṭam
vācyaṃ tarhi tattvamiti cet; atrāha--vijñaptimātre ityādi
niraṃśajñānamātre nairātmye ca kā kasya padā rthasya uktiḥ ? sarvasyāsya vicāryamāṇasyāyogāt iti bhāvaḥ
sarvatra tadekānte kā na kācidarthakriyāyāḥ kārakajñāpakarūpāyāḥ sthitiḥ
evaṃ śabdasvarūpaṃ nirūpya adhunā tadāśritanayāt darśayitum antyavṛttamāha--bhedaiḥ ityādi
bhedaiḥ śabdārthabhedaṃ nayan sa vācyaḥ kārakādisvabhāvaiḥ,
athavā yo yatrābhirūḍhaḥ sa tatra sametya ābhimukhyenārohaṇāt samabhirūḍhaḥ
samabhirūḍhaḥ evaṃ mattvaikībhāvena ābhimukhye eka eva rūpādirartha eveti yā jñānā samabhirūḍhaḥ
vaṃjaṇa attha tadubhayaṃ evaṃbhūo visesei--anu॰ 4 dvāra
yonātmanā bhūtaḥ tenaivādhyavasāyayati ityevambhūtaḥ athavā yenātmanā yena jñānena bhūtaḥ pariṇataḥ tenaiva adhyavasāyayati
bhedaiḥ viśeṣaiḥ śabdasya arthaḥ vyañjanaparyāyaḥ tasya bhedaṃ nānātvaṃ nayan tatpratipattat prāyat vācyaḥ kathanīyaḥ
kiṃbhūtaḥ ? ityāha--kriyārthavacanaḥ eteṣāṃ krameṇa udāharaṇāni na ya pra ve śa ka pra ka ra ṇā davagantavyāni
ko vayaḥ ko vā'nyaḥ ? ityāha--syātkāra ityādi
tatpramitaḥ tena samyaṅnayena pramitaḥ arthāśaḥ kathaṃcana na sarvātmanā svārārāt pṛthak ityevaṃ tattvadarśinaḥ tīrthakarādayaḥ saṃviduḥ
iti si ddhi vi ni śca ya ṭīkāyāma na nta vī rya viracitāyāṃ śabdanayasiddhiḥ ekādaśamaḥ prastāvaḥ
atha kimiti nikṣepaḥ kriyate iti cet; ucyate— trividhāḥ śrotāraḥ avyutpannaḥ avagatāśeṣavivakṣitapadārthaḥ ekadeśato'vagatavivakṣitapadārtha iti
dvitīyaḥ saṃśete ko'rtho'sya padasyādhikṛta iti, prakṛtārthādanyamarthamādāya viparyasyati vā
tatra yadyavyutpannaḥ paryāyārthiko bhavennikṣepaḥ; avyutpannavyutpādanamukhena aprakṛtanirākaraṇāya
atha dravyārthikaḥ; taddvāreṇa prakṛtanirūpaṇāya aśeṣanikṣepā ucyante vyatirekadharmanirṇayamantareṇa vidhinirṇayānupapatteḥ
uktaṃ hi— avagayaṇivāraṇarṭṭha payadassa parūvaṇāṇimittaṃ ca
dharmiṇi kvacid dharmāṇāṃ nayādhigatānāṃ nikṣepaṇaṃ yojanam adhyāropaṇaṃ nikṣepaḥ

sa katividhaḥ ? ityāha--anantakalpaḥ anantabhedaḥ tadviṣayānantyāt; kathamanyatra caturvidho nikṣepa uktaḥ ? ityāha--caturavaravidhaḥ cattvāro nāmasthāpanādravyabhāvalakṣaṇaiḥ avara vāntararūpā vidhā bhedo yasya sa tathoktaḥ
prastāvagataṃ vastu prastutaṃ tasya viśeṣeṇa aniṣṭanivṛttyādilakṣaṇena ā samantāt karaṇaṃ vyutpādanaṃ vyākriyā tasmai tadarthaḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha--tattvārthajñānahetuḥ yataḥ tattvārthā jīvādayaḥ teṣāṃ jñānaṃ tasya hetuḥ kāraṇam
sa kiṃ kāraṇaḥ ? ityāha--dvayanayaviṣayaḥ nanyatrabhāvaḥ--dvayopalakṣitānnayāt dravyārthikaparyāyārthikarūpādinyato na bhavati kintu tata eva iti tadviṣaya ityucyate
na kevalaṃ tattvārthajñānahetureva, api tusaṃśayacchedakārī viparyayādivyavecchedopalakṣaṇametat
pūrveṇa tattvārthajñānahetutā anena samāropavyavacchedahetutā uktā iti vibhāgaḥ
tajjñānahetuḥ kutaḥ ? ityāha--śabdārthapratyayāṅgam iti śabdānu kāraṇād arthasya ghaṭādergrāhakaḥ yaḥ pratyayaḥ tasyāṅgaṃ nimittam
yata evaṃ tataḥ pratipattuḥ puruṣasya śrutaviṣayavikalpopapabdheḥ upayogaṃ nikṣepa iti
jattha ya jaṃ jāṇejjā nikkhevaṃ nikkhive niravasesaṃ
jattha vi a na jāṇejjā caukkagaṃ nikkhive tattha
yasya kasyacit anirdiṣṭaviśeṣasya nimittāntarānapekṣaṃ saṃjñākarma nāma
nimittāntaraṃ punaḥ jātiḥ dravyaṃ guṇaḥ kriyā
kimanayeti saugataḥ, so'yaṃ ghoṭakārūḍho'pi vismṛtaghoṭako jātaḥ
atadguṇe vastuni saṃvyavahārārthaṃ puruṣakārānniyujyamānaṃ saṃjñākarma nāma

tulanā— kiñciddhi pratītamekajīvanāma yathā ḍittha iti, kiñcidanekajīvanāma yathā yūtha iti, kiñcidekājīvanāma yathā ghaṭa iti, kiñcidanekājīvanāma yathā prāsāda iti, kiñcidekajīva-ekājīvanāma yathā pratīhāra iti, kiñcidekajīvānekājīvanāma yathā kāhāra iti, kiñcidekājīva-anekajīvanāma yathā mandureti, kiñcidanekajīvājīvanāma yathā nagaramiti prativipayamavāntarabhedād bahudhā bhidyate saṃvyavahārāya nāma loke
yaḥ kāṣṭhapustacitrakarmākṣanikṣepādiṣu sthāpyate jīva iti sthāpanājīvaḥ
kīrai va ṇirāgāraṃ ittaramiyaraṃ va sā ṭhavaṇā
ittaramaṇittarā yā ṭhavaṇā ṇāmaṃ tu āvakahaṃ
āhidaṇāmagassa aṇṇassa soyamidi ṭṭhavaṇaṃ ṭhavaṇā ṇāma
tattha āgāravaṃtae vatthummi sabbhāvaṭṭhavaṇā tavvivarīyā asabbhāvaṭṭhavaṇā
anāgatapariṇāmaviśeṣaṃ prati gṛhītābhimukhyaṃ dravyam, atadbhavaṃ vā
nyāso nikṣepaḥ samāsataḥ saṃkṣepeṇa nāmasthāpanādravyabhāvataḥ etānāśritya bhavati iti vyāsato vistārataḥ aṅgapraviṣṭa-aṅgabahiḥśrutavikalpakaḥ
ā cā rā dī ni aṅgāni teṣu praviṣṭaṃ tadantarbhūtam
yacchrutam aṅgebhyo bahiḥ śrutaṃ tasya vikalpā bhedā yasya sa tathoktaḥ
yasya kasyacit cetanasya itarasya vā anirdiṣṭaviśeṣasya saṃjñākarma
kiṃbhūtam ? ityāha--nimittāntarānapekṣam yasya tatkarma kriyate tattasya nimittaṃ tato'nyajñātyādikaṃ tadantaram, tasmin anapekṣā yasya tattathoktam
aśca co dāhārya nāma iti sambandhaḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha--vyastaśca samastaśca ekaśca anekaśca te eva jīvāḥ te viṣayo yasya tattathoktam tasya bhāvaḥ tattā tasyāḥ upapatteḥ
tathā vyastajīvaviṣayatopapatteḥ, ayaṃ māṃsapiṇḍo devadattaḥ ayaṃ devadatta ityādivat
anekajīvaviṣayatopapatteḥ ayaṃ ḍitthaḥ ayaṃ ḍavitthaḥ ayaṃ jinadatta iti catvāro jīvabhedāḥ
ekājīvaviṣayatopapatteḥ ākāśaṃ kālo dharmaḥ adharma ityādivat
kiṃ punaḥ nimittāntaraṃ yadanapekṣaṃ taducyate ? ityāha--nimittāntaraṃ punaḥ ityādi
nanu jātyādau varttamānaḥ śabdo yadi nimittāntaramapekṣate; anavasthā
śca tatra varttate; anyatrāpi tathaiva varttatāṃ kimanyanimittavṛttikalpanayā iti cet; na; ubhayathāpi śābdavyavahārasya darśanāt
evaṃ codayatāpi pra jñā ka re ṇa pratyakṣajñānagrāhyatāpekṣayā bahirarthe pratyakṣavyapadeśaḥ kriyate, nānyathā atiprasaṅgāt
ata eva akṣāśritatvopalakṣitavaiśadyāpekṣayā jñāneṣu pratyakṣavyapadeśaḥ tadaṃśaḥ hetubi॰ pṛ॰ 53
ityatra dharme aṃśaśabdaḥ na kiṃcidapekṣya kriyate
yadi ca, śabdā saṅketitaṃ prāhuḥ pra॰ vā॰ 3

91 sa ca saṅketo vyavahārijanāyattaḥ, vyavahāriṇa eva jānanti kiṃ tatra bhavataḥ prayāsena ? tadanusāriṇā kevalaṃ bhavatā bhāvyaṃ vyavahāre atyakṣādicintāpi dūrotsāritā syāt yadi bhavadanusāriṇo vyavahāriṇaḥ, te ca śābda ubhayathā dṛśyante iti yatkiṃcidetat
syādetat jātyādidvāreṇa viśeṣe śabdanikṣepaḥ kinnāmā syāt ? sthāpanānāmā iti, anyaśabdasya anyatrāropād arhacchabdasya asadbhāvasthāpanāvat
kimanayā prayojanam anya yāttitayā iti saugataḥ; so'yaṃ ghoṭakārūḍho'pi vismṛtaghoṭako jātaḥ
vikalpākāre arthasadṛśe arthavyavahāraṃ pravarttayan yadi māmanarthikāṃ brūyāt tathaiva pariharttavyaḥ
kaḥ ? ityāha-- vivakṣitaścāsau asāmpratiko'nāgataḥ paryāyaviśeṣaśca tatra sthitiryasya sa tathoktaḥ
nimittaṃ dravyanikṣepaṃ kaḥ kṣeptuṃ kṣamate janaḥ
tathaiva vivakṣitaprakāreṇaiva upayogo vyāpāraḥ pariṇāmo lakṣaṇaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ āgamanoāgamaprabhedaḥ iti anuvarttate bhāvanikṣepa iti
kiṃ catvāra eva bhedā nikṣepasya ? na, ityādisa nikṣepo vyāsato'nantavikalpaḥ pratipattavyaḥ
nāmaṃ ṭhavaṇā davie tti esa davvaṭṭhiyassa nikkhevo
bhāvo u pajjavaṭṭhiassa parūvaṇā esa paramattho
paryāyamātraṃ,...tathā dravyārthikasya pratyetavyaḥ nāma...sarvathā śuddhasya aśuddhasya ca dravyasyaivopalabdhiḥ
bhāvaḥ bhāvanikṣepaḥ paryāyārthikasya śeṣā nikṣepāḥ dravyārthika kriyante
na khalu dravyamasti, anupalabdheḥ kharaviṣāṇavat, tatkathaṃ tadvān nayaḥ, yasya nāmādinikṣepaḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--sarvathā ityādi
kiṃbhūtasya ? ityāha— śuddhasya nirviśeṣaṇasya aśuddhasya saviśeṣaṇasya
bhrāntijñānaṃ punaḥ...tanna tathā avagrahādibhiḥ vikalpayan avaśyaṃ svaparasvabhāvavivekī
kiṃbhūtāt ? ityāha--acetana ityādi, sasmānmad avikalpe ti ca draṣṭavyam
sattāmātraṃ paśyan darśanena viṣayīkurvan ātmā śuddhasya iti darśitam

tathādvi--yasya viśeṣasya yadgrahaṇaṃ tat tatsāmānyagrahaṇapūrvakaṃ yathā sthāṇupuruṣatvaviśeṣāvāyadvayagrahaṇaṃ tadūrdhvatāsāmānyagrahaṇapūrvakam, sāmānyaviśeṣagrahaṇaṃ ca avagrahajñānam, tataḥ tadapi tatsāmānyagrahaṇapūrvakam
na ca sattāto'paraṃ sāmānyam, yato'navasthā syāt
saḥ paśyan kiṃ karoti ? iti āha--vijānāti dravyādi viśiṣṭaṃ dravyaṃ jānāti
nanu viṣasyāgrahaṇe kathaṃ dravyasya grahaṇaṃ tayorbhedaprasaṅgāditi cet; atrāha--viplave'pi ityādi
svapnādau ādiśabdena taimirikādidaśāparigrahaḥ, tatra, yo viśeṣeṣu svaśarīrādikṛsṭatvādibhedeṣu viplavaḥ anyathāgrahaḥ tasminnapi, na kevalamaviplave sāti siddhaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā sthaulyādigrahaṇaviplave svaśarīrādikādyagrahaṇe ṣutaṇat tathā viśeṣāgrahaṇe'pi sanmātragrahaṇamiti
nanu svapnādau yadyarthagrahaṇaṃ kathaṃ viplavasaṃbhavaḥ yataḥ tannirāsārthaṃ pramāṇalakṣaṇapraṇayanamiti cet ? atrāha--jñāne
svārthayoḥ svārthasya vā svabhāvāḥ kārśyādayaḥ teṣā prakāśanaṃ tasya bhrāntirapi na kevalam abhrāntiḥ syāt
tathāhi--ariṣṭe bāhusthaulyadarśinaḥ tatkārśyamapaśyanto'pi bāhuṃ paśyanti, tadadarśane vā nāriṣṭadarśanaṃ viparītadarśanābhāvāt, madīyo'yaṃ bāhuḥ avisaṃvādaśca na syāditi
tathā tena bhrāntijñānaprakāreṇa avagrahādibhiḥ vikalpayan vā avasyan nāvaśyaṃ svaparasvabhāvavivekī
paśyan svalakṣaṇameva paśyatīti cet; atrāha--svataśca ityādi
svataḥ svarūpeṇa kāryataḥ phalarūpeṇa ca arthānāṃ saṃvittiḥ saṃvedanaṃ sambandhi saṃpratīyate
punarapi kiṃbhūtānām ? aśuddhānāṃ śuddhānāṃ vā naca naiva anyathā anyathātmanāṃ saṃvittiḥ saṃpratīyate
nahi ityādinā na cānyathā iti vyācaṣṭe, pratyeyam iti paryantena
pudgalānāṃ pārimaṇḍalyādibhedān paśyanta eva tatsāmānyamekaṃ sthūlaṃ svabhāvaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ paśyanti
pratyakṣabuddhau tathā pratibhāsanāt tadatikrame tathā tatkṣaṇakṣayādiviśeṣamadṛṣṭvaiva ubhayatra dravyatattvaṃ paśyantyeva aviśeṣāt
kutaḥ ? ityāhā--sthūlākṛtīkṣaṇāt kāraṇāt tathā kṣaṇakṣayaṃ vā'vīkṣya tata eva kiṃ vīkṣeran ? ityāha— arthaṃ vīkṣeran
pudgalānāṃ paramāṇurūpāṇāṃ pārimaṇḍalyādibhedān paśyanta eva janāḥ
tathā tena prakāreṇa teṣāṃ kṣaṇakṣayādiviśeṣamadṛṣṭaiva dravyatattvaṃ paśyantyeva
syānmatam, tatsāmānyaikasthūlasvabhāvasya ghanāditad bahirantaśca bhrāntatvenāyogāt, ato'nyadevādvayaṃ jñānatattvamiti; tatrāha--vijñānam ityādi
yathā dūraviralataruṣu ekaṃ vanamiti pratyayo bhrāntyā bhavati, yathā vā ekaṃ ghanaṃ saghanamiti vā pratyayaḥ
tata eva svabhāvanairātmyaṃ pratipadyamānaḥ svāmeva vṛttiṃ svavācā viḍambayati āptāgamavilopāt
pramāṇamantareṇa tadabhāvapratipattau bhāvapratipattireva kinna syāditi yatkiñcidetat, prastutetarakathanāt
kim ? ityāha— grāhyanirbhāsavaikalyātmānaṃ grāhyo nirbhāso grāhyākāraḥ tasya vaikalyam abhāvaḥ tadeva ātmā svabhāvaḥ tam
punarapi kiṃkurvat ? ityāha--kathaṃcit saccetanādiprakāreṇa svam ātmānaṃ saṃvidat
evaṃ manyate--tatsāmānyaikasthūlasvabhāvo bahiriva jñānasyāpi yadi nāsti, jñānaṃ tarhi tataḥ tattvato bhinnam, tadbhedaṃ ca ātmano yadi jānāti; tadeva na tadbhrāntiḥ
nahi nīlajñānaṃ pītādbhinnam ātmānaṃ pratipadyamānaṃ tatra bhrāntam
atha tatsvabhāvaṃ paśyati, svaṃ ca tato bhinnaṃ tato'yamadoṣaḥ; nirākāradarśanam, nānyo'nubhāvyo buddhyāsti pra॰ vā॰ 2
asata iva sato'pi bhinnasya vedanasaṃbhavād bahirarthasiddhiḥ
tarhi grāhyākāraviviktaṃsvabhāvamiva sattādyākāramapi ātmano nānubhavati iti śūnyavādī; tatrāha--tata eva ityādi

tata eva anantaranyāyāt svabhāvanairātmyaṃ sakalaśūnyatvaṃ pratipadyamānaḥ saugataḥ svāmeva vṛttiṃ svaceṣṭitaṃ śūnyatādyabhyupagamalakṣaṇaṃ svavācā viḍambayati vitsārayati, tatpratipādakavacanābhyupagame tadayogāt

tadvilopaḥ tattvata iṣyate, saṃvṛtyā tadabhyupagamāditi cet; atrāha--pramāṇamantareṇa tadabhāvapratipattau teṣām āptādīnām abhāvasaṃvittau aṅgīkriyamāṇāyāṃ bhāvapratipattireva ātmādīnāṃ kinna syāt bhavedevaiti yatkiñcidetat na kiṃcidetat paramatam
śabdo nirṇayo vā tattvāpratyāyanāt kiṃ kurvāṇo'nyāpohaṃ karoti ? pratipatrabhiprāyānusaraṇe'pi yathā anyāpoho'rthaḥ, tathaiva svārthapratyāyanamaviśeṣāt
kena ? ityāha--anayā diśā svāmeva vṛttiṃsvavācā ityādinā mārgeṇa
nanu yadyapi nirviṣayo vikalpaḥ, tathāpi anyāpohakaraṇāt vyavahāropayogī iti cet; atrāha--kiṃ kurvāṇa ityādi
kiṃ kurvāṇaḥ na kiṃcitkurvan śabdo nirṇayo vā anyāpohaṃ karoti ityucyate
evaṃ manyate--yadi saḥ tattvaṃ viṣayīkaroti; tadaita bhūtvamanyato'smāt cākvādyāvṛttamiti pratipadyamānaḥ anyāpohaṃ karoti ityucyate anyathā vacanamātrakamiti
nanu paramārthato'nyāpohakaro'pyasau na bhavati, kevalaṃ pratipatrabhiprāyavaśādevamucyate iti cet; atrāha--pratipatrabhiprāya ityādi

śabdādervastuno nityādivyāvṛttireva anityādiśabdanirṇayābhyāṃ kriyate, na vastu vidhirūpatayā viṣayīkriyate iti yaḥ pratipattṝṇāmabhiprāyaḥ tasyānusaraṇe'pi yathā anyāpohaḥ śabdanirṇayayorarthaḥ tathaiva svārthapratyāyanaṃ tadabhiprāyasya tatrāpyaviśeṣāt
evaṃ manyate--anyāpohaḥ paryudāsarūpaḥ, prasajyarūpo vā syāt ? prathamapakṣe tayorvastuviṣayatvam
savikalpāt kutaḥ siddhiḥ ? tattvaṃ cennāsya gocaraḥ || 9

jīve ajīve vā paryāyatattvaṃ nikṣipan saugato na pratyakṣato nikṣeptumarhati, tad anirṇayātmakatvāt samāropavyavacchedakatvābhāvāt anyathā atiprasaṅgāt nāpi vikalpataḥ; tadbhāvāvipayatvāt vipakṣāviśeṣācca
svalakṣaṇadarśane prabhavavikalpasyāpi sarvathā mithyātvāt kuta eva bhāvanikṣepaḥ ? tadupekṣitatattvārthaiḥ yathāvikalpapratibhāsanaṃ nikṣepakaraṇe dravyanikṣepo'pi kinna syāt ?

nirvikalpāt pratyakṣāt kuto naiva siddhiḥ tattvapratipattiḥ corrected folio number 777 siddhiśced yadi nirṇayātmikā sabikalpāt kutaḥ siddhiḥ tattvaṃ cet tasyasavikalpasya gocara iti svāpāviśeṣaprasaṅgaḥ
jīve ajīve vā paryāyatattvaṃ nikṣipan yojayan saugataḥ na pratyakṣato nikṣeptuṃ yojayitumarhati
vikalpato nikṣeptumarhati iti cet; atrāha— nāpi ityādi
atha anumānavikalpād vastupratibandhena pramāṇam, tannikṣeptumarhatītyucyate; tatrāha--svalakṣaṇadarśana ityādi

svalakṣaṇamātratattvamiti yaddarśanaṃ mataṃ tasmin svalakṣaṇadarśane aṅgīkriyamāṇe prabhavavikalpasyāpi hetuphalanirṇayasyāpi na kevalaṃ tādātmyanirṇayasya sarvathā mithyātvāt kuta eva bhāvanikṣepaḥ ? hetuphalabhāvo'pi vikalpasādhyaināvikalpasādhya iti manyate

syānmatam--bhavatu prabhavavikalpaḥ sarvathā mithyā, tathāpi tata eva vyavahāraṃbhaṅgabhayāt hetuphalabhāvaṃ pratipādya anumānānumeyavyavahāraṃ pratiyanti saugatāḥ tato'numānavikalpāt tannikṣepa iti; tatrāha--tadupekṣita ityādi

sa kṣaṇasthāyī niraṃśaḥ upekṣito'vajñātaḥ tattvārtho yaiḥ saugataiḥ taiḥ yathāvikalpapratibhāsanaṃ vikalpapratibhāsanānatikrameṇa nikṣepakaraṇe dravyanikṣepo'pi kinna syāt ? tatrāpi kalpanayā hetuphalabhāvasya anumānādivyavahāranimittasya bhāvāditi bhāvaḥ
nanu paramārthato niraṃśaṃ pratibhāsādvaitatattvam anyat sarvaṃ mithyā vikalpabuddherupaplavamātram, tadvaśāt paryāyatattvanikṣepa iti cet; atrāha--mithyā ityādi
sarvamekātmakaṃ tattvaṃ kevalamavidyā ātmani vinirbhāsabhedādasatāṃ janma darśayatīti etāvatā sarvaṃ susthitam
tadaśakyaḥ...nahi vyāpāravyāhārādinirbhāsajñānaṃ svopādānaprakṛterbhavitumarhati iti kiṃ kāraṇāntarakalpanayā ? mithyaikānta...
mithyāvikalpena nikṣepe paryāyatattvayojane abhyupagamyamāne saṃgrahasaṃsṛto varam
athavā, dravyānaśyati rahita santānāntaraṃ ca utsṛjya
nīlādisukhādināna sarvam ekātmakam ekasvabhāvaṃ tattvaṃ paramārtharūpam
kathaṃ citrapratibhāsa iti cet ? atrāha--kevalam ityādi
kutaḥ ? ityāha--nirbhāsabhedāttadbhedamāśritya ityevam etāvatā sarvaṃ susthitam
syādetat, pratibhāsabhedāt viruddhadharmādhyāsācca nānātvameva yuktamiti kathaṃ sarvamekātmakamiti cet ? atrāha--nahi ityādi bhedalakṣaṇaparyantaṃ sugamam
nanu mābhūdanvayaḥ, tathāpi anyathānupapattyā sattvādikaṃ kṣaṇabhaṅgaṃ sādhayati iti cet; atrāha--nahi ityādi
kathaṃ santānāntaravyasanaṃ vādinaḥ prekṣākāritāṃ vyāhanti iti cet ? atrāha--vyāpāra ityādi
vyāpāravyāhārādi nirbhāsajñānaṃ svopādānaṃprakṛteravidyāprakṛteḥ bhavitumarhati iti evaṃ hetorvā kiṃ kāraṇāntarasya santānāntaralakṣaṇasya kalpanayā ? kutaḥ ? ityāha--mithyaikānta ityādi
abhinnaḥ saṃvidātmārthaḥ bhāti bhedīva saḥ punaḥ

vidyā tattvajñānam avidyā viplavajñānaṃ tayorvinirbhāsāt pratīteḥ nityānityatvasaṃbhavo ya ekatra tasmāt svārthasvarūpayoḥ svasvarūpasya arthaṃsvarūpasya ca siddhiḥ niṣpattiḥ nirṇītirvā dvayarūpā nityānityatvasvabhāvā ityevaṃ naigamaḥ

sākalyena ityādinā kārikāṃ vyācaṣṭe--sākalyena anavayavena nityakṣaṇikaikāntayoḥ nityaikānte kṣaṇikaikānte ca ayaṃ grāhyākāro nīlādisthūlādyākāraḥ ayaṃ grāhakākāraḥ ayaṃ bahirmukhapratibhāsaḥ ayamantarmukhapratibhāsaḥ ityevaṃ vyavasthā sthitiḥ
tatra tasmittaranyāye sati svasaṃvinmātram svaśabdena parasaṃvidaṃ nirācaṣṭe nityaṃ kālāntarasthāyi
kutaḥ ? iha tāvataḥ svasaṃvinmātrasya sarvatra svasantānasukhādau aviśeṣāt
kaḥ ? ityāha--saṃvidātmā sa evārthaḥ saṃvitsvabhāvo jīva ityarthaḥ
kimabhinna eva ? na, ityāha-- bhedāva bhāti manāk bhedī pratibhātītyarthaḥ
saḥ saṃvidātmārthaḥ punaḥ svāpaprabodhādau ādiśabdena janmamaraṇādiparigrahaḥ, na bhidyate santānāntaraṃ nānā na bhavati iti
etadeva vyācaṣṭe— bodhākāreṇa cetanārūpeṇa sarvatra svasukhādāvaviśeṣo'bhedo jñānasya
nanu svāpe jñānaṃ nāstyeva iti cet; atrāha--tadabhāva ityādi
tadabhāve jñānasya asati middhādeḥ anupapatteḥ iti
middho nidrā ādiryasya mūrcchādeḥ tasyānupapatteḥ maraṇopapatteḥ avasthācatuṣṭayābhāvaḥ tadavasthā eva
punastatraiva jñānodayāt nāyaṃ prasaṅga iti cet; na; ahetukodayāyogāt
jāgrajjñānahetukatvaṃ nirastam, ciravinaṣṭasya akāraṇatvāt, itarathā antyacittaṃ punaḥ tatraiva śarīre citrakāraṇamiti na maraṇaṃ nāma iti
athāvedhakarmavaśāt dehāntare tadārambhakamiṣyate; na; tadvyatirekeṇa karmaṇo'bhāvāt
tadeva viśiṣṭaṃ karma iti cet; na; viśiṣṭasya kharaviṣāṇovamasya kā viśiṣṭatā nāma ? svakāle sarvasyāpi sattvamiti na svapnādidarśanam anarthakahetukaṃ syāt
tadabhāvaścet; viruddho hetuḥ iti cet; anupalakṣitajñānabhāvaḥ iti pratipāditam
tadastitvaṃ sukhenāhaṃ suptaḥ iti punarvikalpodayāt punarvikalpayan kiṃcit pra॰ vā॰ 2
āgantubhiḥ kādācitkaiḥ sukhādinīlādinirbhāsauḥ sukhādibhiḥ nīlādinirbhāsaiḥ tadanubhave bhedinīmiva vṛttimanubhavati jñānamiti
yathā vikalpāvasthāyā ūrdhvaṃ punarvikalpayan pumān āsīt me kalpanedṛśīti vetti
citrasaṃvidaḥ saṃbhāvyaniraṃśasvabhāvasya sarvathānupalabdhau nirupākhyataiva syāt anavasthāprasaṅgāt
tadetena sa mba ndha pa rī kṣā prativyūḍhā
kathaṃ hi sambandhābhāve bahirantarmukhādipratibhāsaniyamaḥ kvacit pratīyeta ? nahi...kutaḥ grāhyādyākāraṇāṃ svabhāvabhedaḥ tadekatvahāneḥ iti nāmasthāpanādravyabhedāt nikṣepastatraiva
kaiḥ ? ityāha--āgantukaiḥ anantaroktaiḥ tathā jātibhedaḥ santānanānātvaṃ tataḥ tattvaṃ nityātmakam
saṃkaraḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--pṛthak parasparaṃ bhinnaṃ ca anena sarvasyobhayarūpatve pra॰ vā॰ 3
nanu citratā ekasyāḥ saṃvido'pi neṣyate kiṃ syāt sā citrataikasyām pra॰ vā॰ 2
210 ityādi vacanāt, kevalaṃ sā niraṃśāpi sāṃśeva bhāti iti cet; atrāha--saṃbhāvya ityādi

saṃbhāvyaḥ saṃvido yaḥ niraṃśaḥ svebhāvaḥ tasya sarvathā pratyakṣānumānaprakāreṇa anupalabdhau satyamanupalabdhasvabhāvasya sabhedasya tathā virodhaprakāreṇa saṃbhāvanāyām nirupākhyataiva nairātmyameva syāt
211 iti vacanāt iṣyate eva taditi cet; atrāha--na ca ityādi
tathā ca kiṃ jātam ? ityāha— tadetena ityādi
tena etena saṃvida ekasyāḥ citratāpādanena ca saṃ ba ndha pa rī kṣā sambandhanirākriyā dha rma kī rtti sambandhinī prativyūḍhā

kutaḥ ? ityāha--kathaṃ hiryasmāt sambandhābhāve bahirantarmukhādipratibhāsaniyamo grāhyagrāhakasaṃvedanākārāṇāṃ niyamaḥ niyatajñānāyattatā kvacit pratīyeta ? tādātmyānniyama iti cet; atrāha--nahi ityādi
yadīdaṃ svayamarthebhyo rocate tatra ke vayam
kasmin ? ityāha--nityatve kṣaṇakṣaye ca cetanādinikṣepe kriyamāṇe
kutaḥ ? ityāha--sarvathā kramayaugapadyaprakāreṇa arthakriyā'yogo nityatve kṣaṇakṣaye ca iti sambandhaḥ
kathaṃ tarhi vyavahāranikṣepaḥ pravarttate ? ityāha--jīvādi ityādi
tathā ca kiṃ pṛthak paryāyakalpanayā ? tāvatā yato vyavahārasiddhiḥ iti vyavahāranayastathaiva vinikṣipet
jīva ādiryasya pudgalādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ tasya bhedaṃ nānātvam āśritya tatparyāyāṃśca jīvādiparyāyāṃśca āśritya nikṣipan jīvādīnyapāyeṣu paryāyān jīvādau yojayan vyavahāraḥ pravarttate ityupaskāraḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha--prasiddhaṃhi yasmāt mithyātvaṃ vyavahārasya bhedasaṃśritaṃ dravyaparyāyanānātvāśritam
dravyaparyāyayoḥ bhedaikāntamavalambyāpi vaiśeṣikādibhiḥ dravyasya ātmādeḥ paryātmatā aparāparakāryotpādakāparasāmarthyapariṇāmātmatā aṅgīkarttavyā
anyathā tadanaṅgīkaraṇaprakāreṇa abhāvāviśeṣāt śaśaviṣāṇādyaviśeṣāt dravyasya sā aṅgīkarttavyā iti
tadaṅgīkaraṇamastu iti cet; atrāha--tathā ca tadaṅgīkaraṇaprakāreṇa ca kiṃ pṛthak paryāyakalpanayā ? kutaḥ ? ityāha— tāvatā tatsāmarthyapariṇāmamātreṇa vyavahārasiddhiryataḥ iti evaṃ vyavahāranayaḥ
tathaiva tanaiva prakāreṇa vinikṣepe dravyaparyāyān ityadhyāhāraḥ
kālabhedāt tāvadabhūt bhavati bhaviṣyati iti, kārakabhedāt karoti kriyate ityādi, liṅgabhedāt devadatto devadattā iti, tathā paryāyabhedāt indraḥ śakraḥ purandara iti tathaitau śabdasamabhirūḍhau
iti si ddhi vi ni śca ya ṭī kā yām a na nta vī rya viracitāyāṃ nikṣepasiddhiḥ dvādaśamaḥ prastāvaḥ samāptamiti
sa mā pto ' yaṃ gra nthaḥ
